title: 💫Al caer la noche💫, Poema original de @reuel30,Esp/Ing.
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURpStmMfLj351tidk9CVctvf83BhET1UyF5GQJcKvVT6/1771723951559.jpg)
[fuente ](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-luna-llena-en-el-cielo-nocturno-con-nubes-OGmiFxiLQKk)
💢💢💢

                    Al caer la noche


Termina el día y comienza el reinado de la melancolía,
pensamientos aturdidores como motores de trenes al pasar,
el creyente empieza a rezar y el ateo a murmurar.

Cae la noche y con ella la subida de las mareas,
el mar no se ve pero se escucha, se siente, se huele,
se erizan muchas pieles por cosas inconclusas
en recuerdos de imágenes casi difusas.

Los resignados duermen y los soñadores, su desvelo en huelga
como opositores, sueños que no dejan dormir
al que se levanta con sueño para realizarlo.

Abrázame, noche, en tus alas oscuras de ángel caído,
porque si la vida tiene un descuido,
cuando amanezca lucharé por mis sueños.

Gracias por leerme.
💥💥

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWV6VqAi1o2pxDowhKGEAd34oFFVkoZ3f7xjZam1Zu7T2/1771724238765.jpg)

Traducción por google translate. 

Title: As Night Falls
Original poem by @reuel30

As Night Falls

The day ends and the reign of melancholy begins,
dazing thoughts like the engines of passing trains,
the believer starts to pray and the atheist to murmur.

Night falls and with it the rising of the tides,
the sea is not seen but it is heard, felt, smelled,
many skins tingle from unfinished things
in memories of nearly blurry images.

The resigned sleep and the dreamers, their wakefulness on strike
like opponents, dreams that won't let sleep
the one who rises with sleepiness to fulfill them.

Embrace me, night, in your dark wings of a fallen angel,
because if life ever falters,
when dawn breaks I will fight for my dreams.

Thank you for reading me.

title: #MyHiveGoals - Rough Week, Good Week?
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVkeVHomPCsfMMGDzyeVqCu6UG2UERiKrUQDP73inKajD/cwwr.png 



This time last week, I got home from 6 days on the road.

I was pretty excited about being home and figured I'd be able to get a lot of content created on chain.  It's amazing though, that I found more time to write while on the road compared to being at home.  I had some stuff at work I had to deal with and of course family obligations really took me away from chain.

So much so that this is my first blog post in.....Over 3 days lol

O.K., it's not that long....But overall with my time on the blockchain, I usually get about 6-7 posts done every week.  

No excuses though, it's life.  It happens.  And that just means, by God's grace, I'll have another 7 days on chain now to crush it.

I know the price of the tokens is meh, and people are really in the dumps when it comes to their general feeling around the chain...But to me, this is the time to create.  Remember, when things aren't 'sexy' there are less people creating.  Which means it's easier for you to stick out, and on paper, should attract more eye balls to your content.

On paper that is lol

You can't control the markets.  You can't control how the chain is managed.  You can't control who comes by and gives you a comment or two.

All you can do, is control the effort you put out there.

And to me, that's all we'd ever want to be able to control :)

Let's see how the past 7 days on chain went for yours truly....

## 25,000 Hive Power

I'm pretty happy with how much Hive I've ben accumulating....

**25,000 - 16,650 = 8,350 left to go**

There is absolutely no way on earth I would power Hive down these days and cash out.  Far from it.  Now is the time I think is perfect to accumulate it.  And while I'm not opening up the Brinks truck to buy Hive (well I can't I'm broke lol) I can create and power as much of it up as possible.

Which I've been doing...

Case in point, my K/E ratio went from **6.27 last week, all the way down to 5.77.**  And that means I should be sub 5.00 in the next few weeks if things stay the same on my end. Maybe that makes the whales happy, maybe it doesn't lol I just love the idea of tracking my way back up the ranks of Hive Power holders.

My strategy going forward doesn't really change...

- I'm setting my rewards to 100% Hive Power

- I'm sending 3% as beneficiary reward to @commentrewarder to help support the community 

All that and.....Grinding out content and curation :)

## LEO Power

Still generating LEO from my delegation to @leo.voter as well as creating through the front end.  It's most definitely not stacking like I had always hoped, but I get why it's so low.

I don't really have a goal per se with LEO these days other than hoping and praying my stubbornness over the years will one day pay off.  lol I'm gracefully bowing out of SURGE though, I have to feed my family, and that ended up being one of the toughest investments decisions I've ever made.  But alas, I own it.  It's my own fault for thinking it was something it was not.

So I'll keep stacking LEO for as long as I can, and keep creating on Hive.  To be honest, that's all I can do these days.  No more investing for this guy, just investment in time.  Because the crypto markets have really hurt me over the years and I'm pretty much done as thinking this stuff has a future as an investment.

Instead, it's a home for my #web3 content.  It's a great community.  And if I end up earning a few bucks a long the way.  Perfect :)

That's the mentality, and I think if we all have that....We'll enjoy out time here much more!  I hope you crush your goals this week and have a fantastic 7 days on chain!

body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaHgfXgjuzEkquA38udmorJeW7eW5cQbwjaqfKikWJF5T/IMG_4156.jpeg  

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQvisvKub3q1KMLHgukbP3umRHMVDqkoQnuoWPr74Vc4C/IMG_4133.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbg3mBDyPgfRGweC3U9bPRxVQwmjDyBo884m4k4M6Q7zL/IMG_4120.jpeg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaJRe1eJTyVaUzP26fqZW1DtY9h2ecNi3tf9BDyXLzGcn/IMG_4136.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWJrZgzn12s5LurwdaZ3iHPh2cfW4UVJckX9BWj65Qc6c/IMG_4122.jpeg 
 
ENGLISH 🇬🇧

These photos capture a moment that felt quietly powerful.
Walking through the terraces and gardens of the Castillo de Chapultepec, I felt surrounded by symmetry, geometry, and history.

The black-and-white tiled floor almost looks like a chessboard — ordered, structured, deliberate. It reminded me how architecture, like mathematics, is an applied language. Every line has intention. Every column supports more than just weight; it supports time.

Standing there with Mexico City expanding in the background, I couldn’t help but reflect on perspective. From above, chaos looks organized. Traffic becomes patterns. Buildings become coordinates. Movement becomes flow.

As a Doctor in Chemistry, I’m used to thinking about structure at the molecular level. But here, structure operates at a civic scale. Stone walls, iron lanterns, carved details — all interacting with sunlight and shadow like a carefully designed experiment.

And then the gardens — precise, almost engineered. Red flowers outlining green geometry. Nature shaped, but still alive.

What I love about these moments is that they connect science and humanity.
We build. We design. We analyze.
But we also pause, breathe, and simply exist within what has been created.

History behind me.
City in front of me.
Sky above me.

That balance feels meaningful.

ESPAÑOL 🇪🇸

Estas fotos capturan un momento que se sintió profundamente significativo.
Caminando por las terrazas y jardines del Castillo de Chapultepec, me sentí rodeado de simetría, geometría e historia.

El piso blanco y negro parece casi un tablero de ajedrez — ordenado, estructurado, intencional. Me recordó que la arquitectura, al igual que las matemáticas, es un lenguaje aplicado. Cada línea tiene propósito. Cada columna sostiene algo más que peso; sostiene tiempo.

Estando ahí, con la Ciudad de México extendiéndose al fondo, no pude evitar reflexionar sobre la perspectiva. Desde lo alto, el caos parece organizado. El tráfico se convierte en patrones. Los edificios en coordenadas. El movimiento en flujo.

Como Doctor en Química, estoy acostumbrado a pensar en estructura a nivel molecular. Pero aquí, la estructura opera a escala urbana. Muros de piedra, faroles de hierro, detalles tallados — interactuando con la luz y la sombra como si fueran parte de un experimento cuidadosamente diseñado.

Y luego los jardines — precisos, casi ingenieriles. Flores rojas delineando geometría verde. Naturaleza moldeada, pero viva.

Lo que más me gusta de estos momentos es que conectan la ciencia con la humanidad.
Construimos. Diseñamos. Analizamos.
Pero también nos detenemos, respiramos y simplemente existimos dentro de lo creado.

Historia detrás de mí.
Ciudad frente a mí.
Cielo sobre mí.

Ese equilibrio se siente profundo. ✨

body.title: Scrambled eggs with tomato and onion, wow, a delight, a perfect side dish for dinner.
body.body:
> Happy Saturday to all of you, my dearest Hivers! I hope you're all well and enjoying the weekend. This time, I'm sharing another easy and simple recipe with you, this one used as a filling for Venezuelan arepas. Yes, my friends, I'm talking about the popular perico, nothing more and nothing less than scrambled eggs with tomato and onion. Wow, a real treat! We can enjoy it for breakfast or as a side dish for dinner.
![GridArt_20260219_175425337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EpXLW8BzNgVBGGA2wMEF37k97FLASZYXT3gm8kxcG6GffKL9wQ2QzFZnuRzXxfH8Rrb.jpg)
>Feliz sábado para todos ustedes mis queridísimos hivers deseo que estén bien y disfrutando del fin de semana, en esta oportunidad, aprovecho para regalarles otro contenido enmarcado en otra receta fácil y sencilla de preparar pero que la misma es utilizada como contorno para rellenar las arepas venezolanas, pues sí mis amigos les hablo del popular perico, nada más y nada menos que un revoltillo de huevos con tomate y cebolla, uff una delicia el mismo lo podemos degustar como desayuno o acompañante para la cena. Ingredients: 3 eggs, 2 large tomatoes, 1 large onion, oil, salt. >Ingredientes: 3 huevos, 2 tomates grandes, 1 cebolla grande, aceite, sal. Preparation: First, wash the vegetables and peel them. Then, chop and dice them. Next, preheat a pan and add some oil. Sauté the tomato and onion, adding salt to taste. Stir until the mixture reduces and is cooked through.
![GridArt_20260219_175202785.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EpJa24UqN3DzocFcCES7ECaDB7HqDnqG5HSWSJJWnWhQixbqMweya41G5rq2qFNcZJ2.jpg)
>Preparación: Primeramente debemos lavar los vegetales y luego retirar la cáscara para seguidamente picar y pelar en cubitos para continuar debemos precalentar un sartén agregarle cierta cantidad de aceite para poner a sofreír el tomate con la cebolla debemos de agregar el toque de sal al gusto, revolver hasta lograr la reducción y la debida cocción. In a bowl, whisk the eggs. Add this mixture to the onion and tomato mixture and cook, stirring occasionally. Remove from the heat when desired.
![GridArt_20260219_175305758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EpT5ff7Err2ga8Hpy6gENErqZzSyJR1frybygKTdwTW9wCKasE1vPt5ngt2pQTADP1o.jpg)
>En un bols debemos agregar los huevos para luego hacer batir después echamos esa mezcla a la cebolla con el tomate dejar en su cocción y revolver para luego retirar del fuego cuando ya sea necesario. Thank you for joining me here and see you another time. Thanks for reading me and your valuable support. >Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl >The photos are of me @cielitorojo with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Translated with Deepl translator.

body.title: Un sábado de telenovelas./ A Saturday of soap operas.(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español

# Saludos amigos de Liketu 💁☀️
¡Feliz y relajante día para todos!
Este sábado amigos, opté por quedarme en casa y disfrutar junto  a mi esposo de una telenovela mexicana recomendada por mi madre, llamada Los Hilos del Pasado. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_202813602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AKGaPBW8ZbF8fC61po2jQD9TH4FtqF5FQTwmHpToAdYvPmZh4McW4bESzUxih1Y.jpg)
</center>
#
En este primer capítulo que he visualizado , su trama se basa en que la familia adinerada de un joven llamado Salvador, lo ha preparado durante toda su vida para que su futura profesión sea sacerdote, incluso llegara ser miembro del Vaticano. El joven, aunque posee vocación pues es de  sentimientos nobles, no se encuentra totalmente convencido de querer aceptar esa gran responsabilidad, pues siente amor por una joven costurera llamada Carolina, que  suspira emocionada al verlo,  cada vez  que coinciden en su casa dónde, le realiza trabajos de costura a María  Luisa, la madre de Salvador.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200036515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AKGZksACaWPsUb7tp54akBit6sro5eupDfm45mPH2rWHVDS5ghyz1yegvTq9ZLi.jpg)
</center>
#
Las coincidencias se vuelven amistad, y la amistad, amigos, de  esos dos jóvenes se vuelve amor, tanto, que  antes de irse para el Seminario  a estudiar su vocación Vicente y Carolina, tienen una noche de pasión, y por supuesto con una bonita y a la vez terrible consecuencia¡Carolina queda embarazada!
Las mujeres enamoradas , actúan de corazón, y Carolina pensando que iba ser bien acogida en esa gran familia, busca darle la noticia a Vicente, quien había partido llevándose ese gran recuerdo de su amor oculto.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200234317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23x112Afz6nqNX72igATBqrtaycCstnSytsjdzpK7Vixo1wGWPfDrQkdfhzDVSR26k7Pu.jpg)
</center>
#
Lamentablemente, a quién se encuentra es a la madre de Vicente, María Luisa,  que decirles amigos, que es una excelente actriz, pues su actuación de villana es tan perfecta, que me produjo un sentimiento no grato 😅.
Bueno para seguirles contando, Carolina encaró a  la madre de Salvador , quién en su devoción porque su hijo llegará lejos en su carrera religiosa, humilló, ocultó, difamó a la joven, quién tuvo que marcharse embarazada   de la casa de su tía, al carecer de trabajo.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200159329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynX4EJGwC5UqwGhzE4NAR13H7gFgcAdLUe3iwmpk6ViGfVRMkhq5Y43k8TQCr1NaAMp.jpg)
</center>
#
Con su equipaje y vestuario humilde, Carolina marcha hacia la ciudad en un autobús, acompañada de personas nobles, que le  ayudan a dar a luz a  a su pequeña durante la travesía.
Sin aliento, debido a las condiciones pésimas que tuvo a la pequeña, Carolina logra llegar a la  casa de un familiar que suponía que la iba acoger en la ciudad.Pero lamentablemente las cosas no suceden como pensaba , pues el familiar se había mudado, y a  todas las casas a dónde  llegó a pedir ayuda con su pequeña en brazos, le negaron ayuda.
Una escena devastadora amigos, ¡que triste! conmueve, y más al ver cómo con su últimas fuerzas deja a la pequeña en la entrada de una mansión, para que no muriera de hambre y frío.
Al  observar como su pequeña  hija era tomada   entre los  brazos cálidos de un guardia, Carolina se desmaya por la perdida de sangre y abre los ojos en una institución médica, dónde inmediatamente, ruega que le encuentren a su hija.
Fue en vano la búsqueda, pues no hubo señal de la pequeña.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200352549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/Ep1WQGPRcbFavnrLJ5WuX71NJZGcVwV4kW96QvwHv5qKSRqugjyajggX3FNWxYpSn7G.jpg)
</center>
#
Carolina, desde ese día  revolucionó su ser, logrando que  al cabo de los años fuera una de las más exitosas diseñadoras del país, reconocida cómo Carolina Guillén.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_195855968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AK3far5FRBHZaMp9rrFMytWL5gYHDhRiVpApfiJv23LfbenBuq6bh7pCdta5ez7.jpg)
</center>
#
Bueno amigos, está interesante la novela hasta el momento, los voy a dejar para seguir disfrutando de este fin de semana televisivo.
Espero que les haya gustado, las fotos y este breve recuento del inicio de la novela.
Felices y prósperos días a todos.
Abrazos 💁☀️
Fotografías personales propias, y  las capturas  son de  escenas de la novela Los Hilos del pasado.
*** 
# English

# Greetings friends of Liketu 💁☀️
Happy and relaxing day to everyone!
This Saturday, friends, I decided to stay at home and enjoy with my husband a Mexican telenovela recommended by my mother, called Los Hilos del Pasado. 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_202813602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AKGaPBW8ZbF8fC61po2jQD9TH4FtqF5FQTwmHpToAdYvPmZh4McW4bESzUxih1Y.jpg)
</center>
#
In this first chapter that I have visualized, its plot is based on the fact that the wealthy family of a young man named Salvador, has prepared him all his life for his future profession to be a priest, even to become a member of the Vatican. The young man, although he has a vocation because he has noble feelings, is not totally convinced of wanting to accept this great responsibility, because he feels love for a young seamstress named Carolina, who sighs excitedly when she sees him, every time they meet at her house where, she does sewing work for María Luisa, Salvador's mother.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200036515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AKGZksACaWPsUb7tp54akBit6sro5eupDfm45mPH2rWHVDS5ghyz1yegvTq9ZLi.jpg)
</center>
#
Coincidences become friendship, and the friendship, friends, of these two young people becomes love, so much so that before leaving for the Seminary to study their vocation Vicente and Carolina, they have a night of passion, and of course with a beautiful and at the same time terrible consequence Carolina gets pregnant!
Women in love, act from the heart, and Carolina, thinking that she would be well received in that big family, seeks to give the news to Vicente, who had left taking that great memory of his hidden love with him.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200234317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23x112Afz6nqNX72igATBqrtaycCstnSytsjdzpK7Vixo1wGWPfDrQkdfhzDVSR26k7Pu.jpg)
</center>
#
Unfortunately, who is to be found is Vicente's mother, María Luisa, to tell you friends, that she is an excellent actress, because her villain performance is so perfect, it gave me an unpleasant feeling 😅.
Well, to keep telling you, Carolina faced Salvador's mother, who in her devotion because her son will go far in his religious career, humiliated, hid, defamed the young woman, who had to leave her aunt's house pregnant, because she had no job.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200159329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynX4EJGwC5UqwGhzE4NAR13H7gFgcAdLUe3iwmpk6ViGfVRMkhq5Y43k8TQCr1NaAMp.jpg)
</center>
#
With her humble luggage and wardrobe, Carolina sets out for the city on a bus, accompanied by noble people, who help her give birth to her little girl during the journey.
Out of breath, due to the terrible conditions that the little girl had, Carolina manages to get to the house of a relative who supposed that she was going to take her in the city.But unfortunately things do not happen as I thought, because the relative had moved, and all the houses where he came to ask for help with his little girl in his arms, they refused him help.
A devastating scene friends, how sad! it is touching, and even more so when he sees how with his last strength he leaves the little girl at the entrance of a mansion, so that she would not die of hunger and cold.
Watching as her little daughter was taken into the warm arms of a guard, Carolina faints from the loss of blood and opens her eyes in a medical institution, where immediately, she begs for her daughter to be found.
The search was in vain, for there was no sign of the little one.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_200352549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/Ep1WQGPRcbFavnrLJ5WuX71NJZGcVwV4kW96QvwHv5qKSRqugjyajggX3FNWxYpSn7G.jpg)
</center>
#
Carolina, from that day she revolutionized her being, achieving that after years she was one of the most successful designers in the country, recognized as Carolina Guillén.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260221_195855968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/AK3far5FRBHZaMp9rrFMytWL5gYHDhRiVpApfiJv23LfbenBuq6bh7pCdta5ez7.jpg)
</center>
#
Well friends, the novel is interesting so far, I'm going to leave you to continue enjoying this TV weekend.
I hope you liked the photos and this short account of the beginning of the novel.
Happy and prosperous days to all.
Hugs 💁☀️
Own personal photographs, and the captures are of scenes from the novel The Threads of the Past.

body.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  Oliver Twist #11/214
body.body: >Oliver was frightened at the sight of so many gentlemen, which made him tremble: and the beadle gave him another tap behind, which made him cry. These two causes made him answer in a very low and hesitating voice; whereupon a gentleman in a white waistcoat said he was a fool. Which was a capital way of raising his spirits, and putting him quite at his ease.
>“Boy,” said the gentleman in the high chair, “listen to me. You know you’re an orphan, I suppose?”
>“What’s that, sir?” inquired poor Oliver.
>“The boy is a fool—I thought he was,” said the gentleman in the white waistcoat.
>“Hush!” said the gentleman who had spoken first. “You know you’ve got no father or mother, and that you were brought up by the parish, don’t you?”
>“Yes, sir,” replied Oliver, weeping bitterly.
>“What are you crying for?” inquired the gentleman in the white waistcoat. And to be sure it was very extraordinary. What could the boy be crying for?
>“I hope you say your prayers every night,” said another gentleman in a gruff voice; “and pray for the people who feed you, and take care of you—like a Christian.”

>“Yes, sir,” stammered the boy. The gentleman who spoke last was unconsciously right. It would have been very like a Christian, and a marvellously good Christian, too, if Oliver had prayed for the people who fed and took care of him. But he hadn’t, because nobody had taught him.
>“Well! You have come here to be educated, and taught a useful trade,” said the red-faced gentleman in the high chair.
>“So you’ll begin to pick oakumnto-morrow morning at six o’clock,” added the surly one in the white waistcoat.

>For the combination of both these blessings in the one simple process of picking oakum, Oliver bowed low by the direction of the beadle, and was then hurried away to a large ward: where, on a rough, hard bed, he sobbed himself to sleep. What a noble illustration of the tender laws of England! They let the paupers go to sleep!

>Poor Oliver! He little thought, as he lay sleeping in happy unconsciousness of all around him, that the board had that very day arrived at a decision which would exercise the most material influence over all his future fortunes. But they had. And this was it:

>The members of this board were very sage, deep, philosophical men; and when they came to turn their attention to the workhouse, they found out at once, what ordinary folks would never have discovered—the poor people liked it! It was a regular place of public entertainment for the poorer classes; a tavern where there was nothing to pay; a public breakfast, dinner, tea, and supper all the year round; a brick and mortar elysium, where it was all play and no work. “Oho!” said the board, looking very knowing; “we are the fellows to set this to rights; we’ll stop it all, in no time.” So, they established the rule, that all poor people should have the alternative (for they would compel nobody, not they), of being starved by a gradual process in the house, or by a quick one out of it. With this view, they contracted with the water-works to lay on an unlimited supply of water; and with a corn-factor to supply periodically small quantities of oatmeal; and issued three meals of thin gruel a day, with an onion twice a week, and half a roll on Sundays. They made a great many other wise and humane regulations, having reference to the ladies, which it is not necessary to repeat; kindly undertook to divorce poor married people, in consequence of the great expense of a suit in Doctors’ Commons;oand, instead of compelling a man to support his family, as they had theretofore done, took his family away from him, and made him a bachelor! There is no saying how many applicants for relief, under these last two heads, might have started up in all classes of society, if it had not been coupled with the workhouse; but the board were long-headed men, and had provided for this difficulty. The relief was inseparable from the workhouse and the gruel; and that frightened people.

>For the first six months after Oliver Twist was removed, the system was in full operation. It was rather expensive at first, in consequence of the increase in the undertaker’s bill, and the necessity of taking in the clothes of all the paupers, which fluttered loosely on their wasted, shrunken forms, after a week or two’s gruel. But the number of workhouse inmates got thin as well as the paupers; and the board were in ecstasies.

body.body: >\n\nI don't really play guitar. A know a few chords, and I enjoy strumming and learning some of my favorite songs - if they're not too complicated that is. I'm not really good at keeping a rhythm and singing at the same time, in addition to my voice being barely \

. I do hit most of the notes, it just sounds weird. At least to me.


![IMG_20260221_155024444_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EoyPzjyAnhimrTobGGggckgdipEbNd5izHxo2uw7fSNn7SEM8BkLod7hzynJDTPKFUs.jpg)

But I lost a lot of the shyness about it and these days I fully embrace the fun and emotional release in singing. Yesterday, I didn't really get a chance. We had a full house [(here's a video)](https://peakd.com/@beelzael/snap-1771638808311), so many musicians, a great atmosphere - but it didn't really give for me jumping in, and then suddenly everyone left.

All but a friend who I had worked with on several occasions. We set in the garden with her and Ellie, talking, and when I got up and gathered the instruments there was a confusion about her acoustic guitar and mine. She didn't know I played a little, and asked me to play a song. I haven't much played in front of people on the guitar. Worse singing and playing. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6nQCxwneUwA

But I did, and I chose \
by Rise Against, one of my favorite bands from \

. It's a straight forward song, with a few little complications that I did not master at all, but had to try several times. I hadn't played the guitar in a while. https://youtu.be/e8X3ACToii0 I hadn't played much of anything in quite a while, which is sad. Only the bass on Friday evening, which is something. But since I'm back from Germany, I haven't really done much for that. I'm a bit lost. And the constant fighting with Lily's mom isn't helping. Which means that I really should do more music. More reading, and not only Marcus Aurelius. Why am I working on opening the bakery as a café? That's what I'm asking myself a lot. I don#t really need to do it. It's fun, I know, but it also adds stress. I like things to be great for people, I want them to feel good in my space, to enjoy every little thing. But right now, I'm overwhelmed by it. I'm not quite sure if it's my usually well trained gut feeling about it just being to much at the moment, or fear to fail. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02JdW2KWMNM My priorities do lie elsewhere at the moment. Yes, it would be great. Yes, it WILL be great. But not right now. I have to take a step back and reassess my situation, work out a couple of things with myself, get energized again. Because when it works out, that's one of the main reasons of my success - the passion that I pour into my endeavors. The notable excitement when I talk about something that fascinates me. I carry people along easily. But only when I'm in that state, when I'm in my rhythm. I got to find that beat first. ___ Post written for the #saturdayselections by Galenkp inviting us to share music in the [Weekend Experiences community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-168869/created) on Saturdays. body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《昭月传》（赵佳主演）
body.body:
![IMG_9481.jpeg](https://s2.loli.net/2025/10/19/lK7ZXjioOLsfwz2.jpg)

赵佳是我非常喜欢的短剧女主，这两天刷到她的新剧必须要看啊！看完以后我个人觉得，这个本子和制作班底较她之前的作品有所回落，换句话说我觉得剧组配不上她。

虽然这话看着像是贬义，但《昭月传》本身是兼具新颖和客观看性的。不同于俗套的宫斗戏码，这部剧直接玩出了新花样来。女主被皇帝坑了以后，某天发现自己变了。

她可以看得到这篇文读者的弹幕，根据弹幕内容得知信息并迅速做出反应和调整。她在保护一双儿女和闺蜜的同时，手撕绿茶和渣男，最后去父留子逆天改命成功。

从剧情的角度来说，这部剧在宫斗权谋剧里玩出了新花样。别的剧会写成女主重生以后逆天改命，这弹幕系统的确有点意思。她跟庄妃的闺蜜情让人动容，太好磕啦！

从演员的角度来说，女主赵佳是当仁不让的颜值和演技双双在线。她的脸看着就很高级大方，不管现代剧还是古装剧都游刃有余。演技方面一如既往的稳，气场直接拉满。

从摄影和服化道的角度来说，剧的画面看着还是比较舒服的，没有很明显短剧的弊端。女主的服化道很到位，几套衣服同女主当下的心境处境呼应，衣服配饰的质感很棒。

总的来说，这部剧相当精彩好看，五星推荐！


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物

body.title: Content Creation Pandemic
body.body: > # Content creation pandemic I don’t know how we got here, but the content creation pandemic is at an all-time high, and it’s scary!! Very very scary! I love content creation, I love it as it gives us the willpower to freely write, record, and design just anything, and also have people enjoy our content too. In this context, I’d be referring to the TikTok content creators and every content creator out there who is running mad just for views and engagements.

> [source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/influencer-business-social-media-6371253/) I love how content creation is changing the world and through various platforms, the dissemination of information has become faster and smoother. It’s always nice to see creators work their butt out to put themselves out there, talk about breaking the norm! While I love content creators and appreciate the role every one of them plays, I can’t seem to wrap my head around the fact that so many people want to be content creators by all means.

> [source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/email-marketing-digital-marketing-7421283/) If there’s one thing that I always tell people, it would be that not everyone is cut out to be a content creator. It’s okay to be a content consumer and it’s very okay to enjoy consuming others' content without the thought of diving into it. Today, everyone with a smartphone and a ring light giving unsolicited advice on the internet is a content creator. How did we reduce such a beautiful craft to farming for views and engagement? How did we reduce content creation to chasing clouts and seeking validation, How??

> [source](https://pixabay.com/photos/podcast-microphone-record-audio-7693636/) This pandemic is a result of some content creators declaring their assets and the huge sums of money gotten from creating content. This has fueled the pandemic greatly as almost everyone believes that they can “blow” overnight by creating content, this has led to so many content creators doing ridiculous things just to “blow”! This post was fueled by a content creator in my country who pulled a crazy stunt that left all of us in awe. While we are yet to recover from this, a good number of people feel stupid for falling for her scheme. All images are mine except otherwise stated. **Thanks for stopping by** **Loads of Love🥰🥰** **XOXO**

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![tptTsbM661ObYqbW_mmexport1771722215585_edit_596936213101101.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/tptTsbM661ObYqbW_mmexport1771722215585_edit_596936213101101/tptTsbM661ObYqbW_mmexport1771722215585_edit_596936213101101.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

过完年啦，年初五接财神啦！希望新的一年，好运不请自来！财源广进日进斗金！喜气洋洋！首先清扫送穷，扫地清理家中垃圾并倒掉，寓意送走贫穷与晦气，为财神进门扫清障碍。把穷神送走，准备迎接财神！把开门窗纳财，吉时打开门窗，象征打开财路，迎接财神。阳光从窗户照过来就跟金子一样！

虽然早上还是冷！但是迎财神宜早不宜迟的！再次家里焚香祭拜，在供桌摆上供品，焚香叩拜，可念诵吉祥话祈愿。愿新的一年健康快乐财运亨通。燃放鞭炮，怪不得隔壁大白天也放烟花啦！在我窗户门口炸开了花！在门口燃放鞭炮，一串串炮仗响不停！

以声响驱邪迎财。一切平安顺遂！有些地方还吃吃饺子，吃饺子，俗称\

，寓意防小人，兜住财气。哈哈～有些习俗真的寓意特好！也特别有意思！所以一切都是寓意美好生活的向往。年初五接财神，有些地方都开业啦！上班的也陆续到位，准备迎接新的一年美好的生活！得到和得不到的都是一切美好的开始！都是最好的安排！年初五接财神，财运亨通，合家欢乐财运滚滚～

body.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/bafybeicrtj57ldlxncf66f5ip52em63w7ghfzehuvuv7tx3f6ojbnzn7pa/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=orlandogonzalez/djbwqnus)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=orlandogonzalez/djbwqnus)


---

¡Hola, mis queridos amigos de Hive Music Festival!

Danny Rivera es un cantante puertorriqueño, que obtuvo la nacionalidad Dominicana y mantiene así ambas nacionalidades. Logró un éxito muy grande cuando grabó la canción Madrigal del compositor puertorriqueño, Felipe Rosario Goyco, conocido en el ámbito artístico como Don Felo, de quién se dice que compuso más de 200 canciones. 

La carrera artística de Danny Rivera está llena de grandes logros, con sus 80 años cumplidos ha grabado alrededor de 150 discos, en diferentes formatos, además de innumerables giras, conciertos y participaciones con otros artistas. Ha realizado una intensa labor social en pro de la paz y la libertad y sus canciones abarcan diferentes géneros musicales.

Aunque no soy bolerista, quise compartir con ustedes esta canción tan icónica de su repertorio.

Espero les agrade mi versión, así como disfruté yo al grabarla.

Les agradezco su apoyo, siempre es bien recibido.

Un cordial saludo.

Por acá les dejo la letra:

Madrigal

Estando contigo me olvido de todo y de mí
Parece que todo lo tengo teniéndote a ti
Y no siento este mal que me agobia y que llevo conmigo
Arruinando esta vida que tengo y no puedo vivir
Eres luz que ilumina las noches en mi largo camino
Y es por eso que frente al destino no quiero vivir
Una rosa en tu pelo parece una estrella en el cielo
Y en el viento parece un acento tu voz musical
Y parece un destello de luz la medalla en tu cuello
Al menor movimiento de tu cuerpo al andar
Yo a tu lado no siento las horas que van con el tiempo
Ni me acuerdo que llevo en mi pecho una herida mortal
Yo contigo no siento el sonar de la lluvia y el viento
Porque llevo tu amor en mi pecho como un madrigal
Yo a tu lado no siento las horas que van con el tiempo
Ni me acuerdo que llevo en mi pecho una herida mortal
Yo contigo no siento el sonar de la lluvia y el viento
Porque llevo tu amor en mi pecho como un madrigal

ENGLISH VERSION

Hello, my dear friends at Hive Music Festival!

Danny Rivera is a Puerto Rican singer who obtained Dominican nationality and thus holds both nationalities. He achieved great success when he recorded the song Madrigal by Puerto Rican composer Felipe Rosario Goyco, known in the artistic world as Don Felo, who is said to have composed more than 200 songs. 

Danny Rivera's artistic career is full of great achievements. At 80 years of age, he has recorded around 150 albums in different formats, in addition to countless tours, concerts, and collaborations with other artists. He has done extensive social work in support of peace and freedom, and his songs span different musical genres.

Although I am not a bolero singer, I wanted to share with you this iconic song from his repertoire.

I hope you like my version as much as I enjoyed recording it.

I appreciate your support, it is always welcome.

Best regards.

Here are the lyrics:

Madrigal

When I'm with you, I forget everything and myself.
It seems that I have everything when I have you.
And I don't feel this evil that overwhelms me and that I carry with me,
ruining this life that I have and cannot live.
You are the light that illuminates the nights on my long journey,
and that is why, in the face of destiny, I don't want to live.
A rose in your hair looks like a star in the sky
And in the wind, your musical voice sounds like an accent
And the medal around your neck looks like a flash of light
At the slightest movement of your body as you walk
By your side, I don't feel the hours passing with time
Nor do I remember that I carry a mortal wound in my chest
With you, I don't hear the sound of the rain and the wind
Because I carry your love in my chest like a madrigal
By your side, I don't feel the hours passing by
Nor do I remember that I carry a mortal wound in my chest
With you, I don't hear the sound of the rain and the wind
Because I carry your love in my chest like a madrigal

---

body.title: Big Fish (2003) | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body:
>
![4984.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/EoAd4cPhQzhAv1fPUMJH9ki7W1tiP8994f2RBCwKDK7MQqUmHpz6meUcWb3cN7VVXV6.png)
**Hello, cinema fans**. We continue with more **Tim Burton** films, and this time I bring you a movie that I have loved since I first saw it as a child. A unique story full of adventure, fantasy, and romance that is well worth watching. Directed by [**Tim Burton**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Burton) himself, the film was based on [**Daniel Wallace**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daniel_Wallace_(author))'s novel [**Big Fish: A Novel of Mythic Proportions**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Fish:_A_Novel_of_Mythic_Proportions). **Big Fish** stars **Ewan McGregor**, **Albert Finney**, **Billy Crudup**, **Jessica Lange**, among others. Discover a film that will take you on an unforgettable journey through a lifetime of stories. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > **Hola, fanáticos del cine**. Seguimos con más cintas de **Tim Burton** y en esta ocasión les traigo una película que me encantó desde que la conocí de pequeño. Una historia única repleta de aventura, fantasía y romance que vale toda la pena ver. Dirigida por el mismo **Tim Burton**, la película se basó en la novela de **Daniel Wallace** titulada **Big Fish: A Novel of Mythic Proportions**. **Big Fish** está protagonizada por **Ewan McGregor**, **Albert Finney**, **Billy Crudup**, **Jessica Lange**, entre otros. Conoce una película que te hará vivir un viaje inolvidable de toda una vida de historias.
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
![4979.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23zGa4X5L3w7ixCijhhwd6jNgGyG3qp3E3GYZQdQhWi6WKcEnfBpaSM5aeRB2aP4RQ4Xv.png)
***Source:*** [*FilmAffinity*](https://m.filmaffinity.com/en/film974553.html)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
#### Plot The film begins by showing us a huge fish in a river while a voiceover tells us that, of all the fish in the world, there are some that are not so easily caught. The fish we see at the beginning is one of them. Among the many legends and stories that exist in the village about this fish, our narrator tells us that he used some of them to catch it. He tells us that he didn't use any ordinary bait, but something that would catch its attention, and that was his gold ring. He tied the ring securely and managed to catch the huge fish. But then the narrator tells us that, once he had it in his hands, he thought about releasing it because he realized it was pregnant. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > #### Trama > > La película inicia mostrándonos a un enorme pez en un río mientras una voz de fondo nos cuenta que, de entre todos los peces que existen en el mundo, hay algunos que no se dejan capturar tan fácilmente. El pez que vemos al principio es uno de ellos. Entre tantas leyendas y cuentos que hay en el pueblo sobre este pez, nuestro locutor nos cuenta que usó algunos de ellos para conseguir atraparlo. Nos dice que no utilizó ninguna carnada común, sino algo que le llamaría la atención y eso era su anillo de oro. Ató bien el anillo y logró atrapar al enorme pez. Pero luego el locutor nos cuenta que, al tenerlo en sus manos, pensó en soltarlo ya que se dió cuenta de que estaba embarazada. #### Trailer & Review
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
***Next, I will leave you with the movie trailer:*** https://youtu.be/D0kiS4ROWkQ?si=CN95vRYKodpyyK1z
***By**:* [***Rotten Tomatoes Classic Trailers***](https://m.youtube.com/@RottenTomatoesCLASSICTRAILERS)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)

> To be honest, I didn't know this movie was by **Tim Burton** until recently, when I remembered it while making the list for this special feature. I remember quite well how many times I watched this film when I was a child and even more so as a teenager. Clearly, there were many reasons for someone like me to watch a film like this. Apart from its great story, what I like most about **Big Fish** is its unique blend of adventure, fantasy, drama, and comedy. All this, together with **Tim Burton**'s unique direction, makes this film one of the best in his entire filmography. There are certainly better choices, personally, especially the movie I brought you last time. But if you're someone who likes fantastic stories, full of adventures and completely unexpected, absurd, and even funny plot twists, then **Big Fish** is for you. This film stands out from most others because of its narrative structure, which is composed of various stories that are part of the life of a single character: ***Edward Bloom***. He would be the perfect protagonist for any fantasy story, if that were what this film were about, which is not entirely the case. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > Si les soy honesto, no sabía que esta película era de **Tim Burton** sino hasta hace poco que la recordé al momento de hacer la lista de este especial. Recuerdo bastante bien la cantidad de veces que veía esta cinta desde que era pequeño y más cuando adolescente. Claramente, tenía muchas razones para que alguien como yo viera una película como esta. Aparte de su grandiosa historia, lo que más me gusta de **Big Fish** es la mezcla única que posee de aventura con fantasía, drama y comedia. Todo esto junto con la dirección única de Tim Burton hacen de esta cinta una de las mejores de toda su filmografía. > > Ciertamente hay elecciones mejores, en lo personal, sobre todo la película que les traje la vez pasada. Pero si eres de los que les gustan las historias fantásticas, repletas de aventuras y giros de trama completamente inesperados, absurdos y hasta graciosos, entonces **Big Fish** es lo tuyo. Esta película se destaca por sobre la mayoría debido a su apartado narrativo, el cual está compuesto por diversas historias que forman parte de la vida de un solo personaje: ***Edward Bloom***. Este sería el perfecto protagonista para cualquier historia fantástica, solo si de eso se tratara esta película, lo cual no es del todo así.
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
![4980.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTWyf3yeKiYZdHsHcguYZCbouzgWUFCYvxq7isBMFProzQrUztMz2BDoxx9t7MmiK1w.gif)
***Source:*** [*Tenor*](https://tenor.com/es-US/view/here-i-come-ewan-mcgregor-ed-bloom-big-fish-this-is-my-time-gif-21690661)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
Something that really struck me when I watched **Big Fish** after a long time without seeing it was the contrast between the plot itself and the stories **Edward** tells his family in his old age, and what we actually discover about his past. If I told you each of these stories, they wouldn't have the same effect as seeing and hearing them in his own voice in this film. That's why I'll focus more on the plot itself and the relationship **Edward** has with his family, especially with his only son, **William**. In this regard, it's interesting to note that the film takes several different directions in terms of its story, the main one being that of an adult son who is tired of hearing the same fantastic stories from his father. As we watch each story being told and narrated in such an entertaining way, we can also see the relationship between father and son. When our beloved **Edward Bloom** falls ill, his son **Will** decides to return to his parents' home with his pregnant wife to keep them company in their final days. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > Y es que algo que me llamó muchísimo la atención al ver **Big Fish**, después de mucho tiempo sin haberla visto, fue el contraste que tiene en su propia trama con las historias que nos cuenta **Edward** en una edad ya mayor a sus familiares y lo que uno va descubriendo realmente de su pasado. Si les contara cada una de dichas historias no tendrían el mismo efecto que verlas y escucharlas por su propia voz en esta película. Es por eso que me centraré más en la trama como tal y esa relación que Edward tiene con su familia, en especial con su único hijo, **William**. > > En cuanto a esto, es interesante notar que la película posee diversas direcciones en cuanto a su historia, siendo la principal de un hijo ya mayor que está cansado de escuchar las mismas historias fantásticas de su padre. Mientras vemos cada historia ser contada y narrada de una manera tan entretenida, podemos ver también esa relación que tienen padre e hijo. Cuando nuestro querido **Edward Bloom** cae en cama debido a su mala salud, su hijo **Will** decide regresar a casa de sus padres junto con su esposa que está embarazada para así hacerles compañía en sus últimos días de vida.
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
![4981.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/243ze1iXdnUJtyTLELbxfNXXeKXUnAkXAfRRtCk7QeVaQH6JQZjM2FkpGHNiZ2fnH5M8E.gif)
***Source:*** [*Tenor*](https://tenor.com/es-US/view/let-me-wash-you-ewan-mcgregor-ed-bloom-big-fish-let-me-clean-you-gif-21690555)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
That's right, the contrast between all these fantastic stories told by our protagonist is much more tragic and cold than one can imagine. The fact is that real life can often be sad, tragic, and boring for many people. That's why there are fantastic stories full of witches with glass eyes, giants who eat humans, and circus owners who turn into wolves. All these stories that spark our imagination are like an escape from real life for many. This may include our protagonist **Edward** who, from a very young age, believed he was born to be someone important in his life. Perhaps the enormous number of fantastic and surreal stories he tells all the time are a way of escaping from that tragic, depressing, and uninteresting reality. This can happen to anyone, especially when they reach adulthood and are closer to their death. It is normal to see and hear stories that are somewhat embellished by our storytellers, giving them that touch of interest and intrigue that they need. But there are times when it is simply not good to live in fantasy and you have to know how to face reality. Obviously, **Edward**'s case is an example that not everything is fantasy. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > Así es, el contraste de todas estas historias fantásticas que nos cuenta nuestro protagonista es mucho más trágico y frío de lo que uno se puede imaginar. Y es que la vida real muchas veces puede llegar a ser algo triste, trágico y aburrido para muchos. Es por eso que existen las historias fantásticas repletas de brujas con ojos de cristal, gigantes que comen humanos y dueños de circos que se convierten en lobos. Todas estas historias que hacen volar nuestra imaginación son como un escape de la vida real para muchos. Esto puede incluir a nuestro protagonista **Edward** quien, desde muy joven, creyó que nació para ser alguien importante en su vida. > > Tal vez y la enorme cantidad de historias fantásticas y surrealistas que cuenta todo el tiempo son para escapar de dicha realidad trágica, deprimente y para nada interesante. A todo el mundo le puede llegar a suceder esto, sobre todo a su mayoría de edad y más cerca de su fecha de muerte. Es normal poder ver y escuchar historias un tanto adornadas por nuestros locutores y que le dan ese toque de interés e intriga que necesita. Pero hay momentos en los que simplemente no es bueno vivir de la fantasía y hay que saber afrontar la realidad. Obviamente, el caso de **Edward** es un ejemplo de que no todo es fantasía.
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
![4982.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23tv6H96GPaSxUvPsUVSzBXKPV2qvgkMW2rfFNWZxaADANaYwK8UJSPUMPe53FWM7cxqo.gif)
***Source:*** [*Tenor*](https://tenor.com/es-US/view/who-is-there-helena-bonham-carter-the-witch-big-fish-who-wants-to-see-me-gif-21690487)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
But telling you more about this would be a spoiler, which I won't do for those who haven't seen this movie yet and are interested in seeing it right now. However, before I do, I want to mention another interesting detail that really caught my attention in this film, and that is its characters. **Tim Burton** is definitely a genius at creating fantastic, dark characters who are different in more ways than one, and I think this film really highlights that. Especially because in each story they tell us, we meet different characters who really grab our attention. Among the many things that can be gleaned from **Big Fish**, another detail that caught my attention is the theme of romance, which is quite fleeting, but at the same time very emotional and fun to watch. What definitely makes this film special is that each story we see from beginning to end is part of **Edward Bloom**'s entire life. Imagine turning your life into a series of unimaginable fantastic tales that you can tell children and adults alike. Everyone would like to have a life like that, and I think this film leaves us with that feeling as a message, especially those of us who still have a lot to live for. >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > Pero contarles más sobre esto es darles un spoiler, cosa que no haré para los que aún no han visto esta película y estén interesados en verla en este preciso momento. Sin embargo, antes de hacerlo, quiero que me dejes mencionar otro detalle interesante que me llamó mucho la atención de esta película y son sus personajes. Definitivamente, **Tim Burton** es todo un genio para crear personajes fantásticos, oscuros, diferentes en más de un sentido y creo que en esta película se destaca demasiado. Sobre todo porque en cada historia que nos cuentan, conocemos a distintos personajes que llaman mucho la atención. > > Entre tantas cosas que se pueden extraer de **Big Fish**, otro detalle que me llamó mucho la atención es el tema del romance, siendo este bastante efímero, pero a la vez muy emotivo y a la vez divertido de ver. Lo que definitivamente hace especial esta película es que cada historia que vamos viendo de inicio a fin es parte de la vida entera de **Edward Bloom.** Imagínate hacer de tu vida una serie de cuentos fantásticos inimaginables que puedes llegar a contarles a los niños y a los adultos por igual. Todo el mundo desearía tener una vida así y creo que esta película nos deja esa sensación como mensaje, sobre todo a los que apenas nos falta mucho por vivir.
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
![4983.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yJJkEJCxst5rFW3pZ8YPDRh21yzJgY9dw4xNnKy4T5FTp3vL6i35wmdfC2VVi73tZSc.gif)
***Source:*** [*Tenor*](https://tenor.com/es-US/view/big-fish-tim-burton-tim-burtons-universe-edward-edward-bloom-gif-15239777)
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)
I'm not talking about living in a dream or daydreaming or anything like that, but rather about seeing every part of our lives as if it were a fantastic story and becoming the characters worthy of becoming the protagonists. This can have many meanings, but the main one would be to give that positive, emotional, and fantastic vision to every aspect of our lives, as if they were an important arc in our story. Both happy and sad moments are all part of the great story that is our own life. That's why everyone should see this movie, really. Last but not least, let's talk about the audiovisual aspect of **Big Fish**. As expected, **Tim Burton** manages to maintain his high standard of quality with his southern gothic art style and direction. This includes the narration, as well as the photography styles, the static and moving shots, the bright color palettes, and the use of light and shadow. Another noteworthy detail is the use of practical visual effects that look great in this film, especially in terms of makeup, costumes, props, etc. The sound effects also stand out, but nothing compares to the soundtrack. In short, I leave you with this **Tim Burton** film for those who wish to see it. > ##### *Personally, I give it a rating of 9/10 in terms of the adventure, fantasy, drama, romance, and comedy genres.* >! [SPANISH VERSION] > > No hablo de vivir en un sueño o dormir despierto ni nada de eso, sino de la forma de ver cada parte de nuestra vida como si fuera una historia fantástica y convertirnos en los personajes dignos para convertirnos en los protagonistas. Esto puede llegar a tener muchos significados, pero el principal sería darle esa visión positiva, emotiva y fantástica a cada aspecto de nuestras vidas, como si fueran un arco importante para nuestra historia. Tanto los momentos felices como los tristes, todos son parte de una gran historia que es nuestra propia vida. Es por eso que todo el mundo tiene que ver esta película, de verdad. > > Por último, pero no menos importante, hablemos del apartado audiovisual que tiene **Big Fish**. Como es de esperarse, **Tim Burton** consigue mantener su alto estándar de calidad con su estilo de arte gótico con sureño y su dirección. Tanto la narración como también los estilos de fotografía, los planos fijos y en movimiento, las paletas de colores brillantes y el uso de luces y sombras. Otro detalle muy destacable es el uso de efectos visuales prácticos que se ven muy bien en esta película, sobre todo en cuanto a su maquillaje, vestimentas, recursos, etc. Los efectos de sonido también se destacan muy bien, pero nada como su banda sonora. En fin, les dejo esta película de **Tim Burton** para los que deseen verla. > > ##### *Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 9/10 en lo que respecta al género de aventura, fantasía, drama, romance y comedia.*
![2539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nattosenpai/23yTcsKgLCYoEDYYqtYUjt2rHCbptvUSzSoGmqDFXrRL4yyhcJ8bex687rSh33gFqmPpN.png)

body.body: > A toda velocidad se marchita la secuoya roja, pero todo se aprecia en cámara lenta. Es febrero de 2026 d. C., el viajero ausente de la nave del cuerpo holográfico verifica la geometría de figuras elementales, el núcleo del octaedro. Emigra a la gota de rocío del ojo felino. Se amplifica según la longitud adecuada para el nivel de consciencia, trasmutando cual esfera metálica levitando sobre las raíces del tronco. Medita siempre de manera divergente. La luz solar petrifica la ensoñación lacónica y eterna, por lo que la información cuantificada agota las posibilidades del programa, mientras su rostro polarizado se manifiesta en todas las direcciones de la superficie de una fotografía obscura. #

> Adelante en el tiempo o atrás, la distorsión del alma inunda, ahoga la copa cristalina, crea el conflicto filosófico de la existencia. Un personaje sobrio juega en el laberinto de espejos. No se distingue el pensamiento de la experiencia. Simultáneamente, el obelisco fuera del campo, emana números binarios inherentes a las abstracciones violetas de las ramas. #
> El fuego del genio se expresa entre pirámides, respira, despierta del sueño, de vuelta al Inframundo. # https://images.hive.blog/DQmaTxRK5PU54LFemLdraAcP2Nfp42mWMS5gxmkbWc4HVSs/2.png #

body.title: Narrow Points
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPRr37LwRSX35hYUEz1vqjFhyx5EPf6NE1FSgrTEctb8/1771723120655.jpg)


လိုက်လေ ဝေးလေက Aston Villa အသင်းကို ပြောတယ် ထင်ပါရဲ့။ ကြားရက် ကြိုကန်ထားတဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်မှာ Arsenal တို့ Wolves နဲ့ ၂-၂ သရေကျခဲ့ပါတယ်။ အမှတ်ကွာဟချက် လျော့ချနိုင်မယ့် အခွင့်အရေးရှိပေမယ့် အရ မယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ရှုံးတောင် ရှုံးသွားနိုင်ပါသေးတယ်။ Leeds က သူတို့အသင်းကို ကောင်းကောင်းကြီး ဒုက္ခ ပေးသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ပထမပိုင်း ၃၁ မိနစ်မှာကတည်းက ဧည့်သည် Leeds အသင်းက ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး သွင်းယူခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၈၈ မိနစ် ရောက်မှသာ Aston Villa တို့ ချေပဂိုး သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပြီး သရေ ၁ မှတ် ရယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။

Aston Villa အနေဖြင့် Tittle Challenger အဖြစ် သတ်မှတ်ထားဖို့ မဖြစ်နိုင်ပါဘူးလို့ပဲ ဆိုရမယ် ထင်ပါရဲ့။ အဆင့် ၁ မှ ၄ အတွင်း ဝင်ဖို့သာ ရှိပါတယ်။ နိုင်ပွဲတွေ ပျောက်နေတဲ့ Brighton အနေနဲ့ Brentford အသင်းကို အဝေးကွင်းမှာ ၀-၂ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Chelsea vs Burnley ပွဲစဉ်မှာလည်း ၁-၁ သရေသာ အဖြေ ထွက်ပေါ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ပထမပိုင်း ၄ မိနစ်မှာ ကတည်းက Chelsea တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး စရခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၇၂ မိနစ်မှာ Chelsea ကစားသမား တ‌ဦး ၂ ဝါ ၁ နီနဲ့ ထုတ်ပယ်ခံခဲ့ရပါတယ်။ ၉၀+၃ မိနစ်မှာ Burnley အသင်း ချေပဂိုး ပြန်လည်လို့ သွင်းယူသွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2PpmyARYZck6HngcP4hxNNEy9V4DwkYXFmzvaxJerHL/1771723120735.jpg)


West Ham အနေဖြင့် Bournemouth နဲ့ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ ဂိုးမရှိ သရေကျခဲ့ပါတယ်။ တန်းဆင်းဇုန်က လွတ်ဖို့ အရေးကတော့ အလှမ်းဝေးနေဆဲပါပဲ။ Aston Villa တို့ သရေ ၁ မှတ်သာ ရယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပေမဲ့ City ကတော့ ၃ မှတ် ရယူကာ Arsenal ကို ဆက်လက် ဖိအားပေးထားနိုင်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ New Castle ကို ၂-၁ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရယူပြီး Arsenal နဲ့ ၂ မှတ်ကွာ အနေအထားထိ ရောက်လာခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ နောက်ထပ် ပွဲစဉ် ၄ ပွဲ ကစားသွားဖို့ ရှိနေပါသေးတယ်။ အဆိုပါ ၄ ပွဲထဲမှာမှ Super Sunday ၏ အကောင်းဆုံး ပွဲစဉ်လို့ ပြောရမယ့် Tottenham vs Arsenal တို့ရဲ့ London Derby ပွဲစဉ် ကစားသွားဖို့ ရှိနေပါတယ်။ ဆောင်းကုန်မှ ဆောင်းဝင်ပြီနော် ဂရုစိုက်လို့ ပြောရမလို ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။ EPL မှာ ၂ ပွဲဆက် သရေကျထားပြီး အမှတ်တွေ မဆုံးရှုံးသင့်ဘဲ ဆုံးရှုံးသွားရပါတယ်။ 

တဖြည်းဖြည်း Man City က နောက်ကနေ ဖိအားပေးလာနေခဲ့ပါပြီ။ ကြားရက်က Wolves နဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်ကိုသာ အနိုင် ကစားထားနိုင်ခဲ့ရင် ပိုကောင်းသွားမှာ ဖြစ်ပေမယ့် သရေသာ ရခဲ့ဆာမို့ ခု Tottenham နဲ့ပွဲက ဖိအားတွေ ပိုများလာခဲ့ပါပြီ။ Tottenham က Arsenal ထက်ကို အခြေအနေဆိုးပါတယ်။ EPL မှာ ၈ ပွဲဆက်တိုက် နိုင်ပွဲ ပျောက်ဆုံးနေခဲ့ပါတယ်။ Arsenal နဲ့ ပွဲကြမှ ထကောင်းပြီး အမှတ်တွေ ယူသွားရင်တော့ ဆင်ပျံကြီးတို့ ရင်ခံသွားနိုင်ပါသေးတယ်။

body.title: Diy: planta en forma de corazón con limpiapipas. (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
Saludos queridos amigos de Hive Diy, un gusto estar nuevamente compartiendo con ustedes, espero se encuentren bien en este día, que esta semana entrante sea de bendición y prosperidad para sus hogares, aún me encuentro de vacaciones y aproveché el tiempo para realizar una nueva idea en limpiapipas fácil de hacer.


>Greetings dear friends of Hive DIY, it's a pleasure to be sharing with you again. I hope you are all doing well today, and that this coming week is filled with blessings and prosperity for your homes. I'm still on vacation and took advantage of the time to create a new, easy-to-make pipe cleaner project.



![Pinzas de margaritas_20260221_210034_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhrTpegDdxokC2efVxHtLrofmeRZsgQJaod5HQCjV6yZ/Pinzas%20de%20margaritas_20260221_210034_0000.jpg)



En esta oportunidad les comparto una bonita idea de [corazón](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/500462577365758499/sent/?invite_code=42b15004bddd42b2b10fd5bc16a48498&sender=500462714750026847&sfo=1) con flores en limpiapipas más su maceta, me gusta mucho este tipo de diseños ya que es tierno y se puede realizar fácilmente para obsequiar o emprender, noneceistas ser experto en las manualidades para crear algo bonito por ti mismo.


>This time I'm sharing a cute idea for a [heart](https://www.pinterest.com/pin/500462577365758499/sent/?invite_code=42b15004bddd42b2b10fd5bc16a48498&sender=500462714750026847&sfo=1) flower arrangement made from pipe cleaners, plus a pot. I really like this type of design because it's sweet and easy to make as a gift or for a small business. You don't need to be an expert at crafts to create something beautiful yourself.


<center>
![ezgif-7bbe8e9f71f1f1dc.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPaabYv943yYAqt2DVMGqmcuHzPd9z6BXjub4LhmPVPh9/ezgif-7bbe8e9f71f1f1dc.gif)
</center>


Este corazón tiene una base de alambre, también utilicé para la maceta un pequeño envase plástico, espero pueda servir de ayuda en algún momento, a continuación los materiales y el paso a paso.


>This heart has a wire base; I also used a small plastic container for the pot. I hope this can be helpful at some point. Below are the materials and step-by-step instructions.


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


| Materiales| Materials|
| --------|---------|
|Limpiapipas fucsia, blanco, rosa|Fuchsia, white, and pink pipe cleaners |
| Tijera, silicón| Scissors, silicone|
| Limpiapipas verde, marrón | Green and brown pipe cleaners |
| Envase plástico pequeño|Small plastic container|
| Pintura blanca| white paint |
| Algodón| Cotton|

![1001252015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wMeffKVAm8gERjYTqBPP6xuHzmgPkhmDoyXgTJn4Vyr3vJzvf5YMPHGvEN9hvKBZG9f.jpg)


![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)



### *Paso a paso / Step by step*
#


El primer paso que voy a realizar será armar una base para el corazón utilizando un alambre delgado y fácil de moldear, no te preocupes si no te sale a la primera puedes ajustarlo poco a poco.

>The first step I'm going to take is to make a base for the heart using a thin, easily moldable wire. Don't worry if you don't get it right the first time; you can adjust it little by little.

|![1001252016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmMo97gGxJj418GoMgkuumyRX3ftpdLwuh1abCgR3XZ1fyWSP4W5bp8CuVvkVuuMbQ5.jpg)|![1001252033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoCj3m4v6F84j8DUUd8T81hGomHSDwC7StbNsPZJeRcAMnWANmAntUTZsAVswpYxGHG.jpg)|
|-|-|



Luego voy a seleccionar los limpiapipas a utilizar, de color rosa, blanco, fucsia, este alambre lo voy a cubrir con el limpiapipas fucsia comenzando desde la parte inferior, una ves que termines de cubrir todo terminas de ajustar la forma del corazón, lo ideal sería que quedará un poco ancho.

>Next, I'm going to select the pipe cleaners to use: pink, white, and fuchsia. I'm going to cover this wire with the fuchsia pipe cleaner, starting from the bottom. Once you've finished covering everything, you finish adjusting the heart shape. Ideally, it should be a little wide.

|![1001252048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/Eoc8Tzuor7Cvok2QB6xKox59SLX1dwwArVfDukgdySBYVZCuycFtdtwsk4naSStdKGP.jpg)|![1001252050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tHCEdn3Pb2yuZj2cM5TyXd3TWduRQX3dfbfQ62shzUu7MWZDssjufLjruFWqSUJipKW.jpg)|![1001252111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFa4qnMRFD4GWFHkQp2QnbNzeSeEnmyw89WuvZPs3zvJp9a28jfULFhDgMqgvRjarpd.jpg)|
|-|-|-|




Bien, ahora el siguiente paso es comenzar a realizar las flores de limpiapipas, utilizando la técnica del lapicero, tres blancas, dos rosas claro, tres fucsia, dos fucsia oscuro, en total serán diez flores. Todas del mismo tamaño, luego voy a tomar cada uno de ellas y la punta la vamos a doblar hacia dentro, verás que quedan más pequeñas así.

>Okay, now the next step is to start making the pipe cleaner flowers, using the pen technique: three white, two light pink, three fuchsia, two dark fuchsia—ten flowers in total. All the same size. Then I'm going to take each one and fold the tip inwards; you'll see they get smaller that way.


|![1001252123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoGypHsk4PH53ShsdE2cVJQ2GkRnRkBVhrH3thEannx3W5CsKxgt77Mhgu7BfwrkGqq.jpg)|![1001252169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EogNrv6SBnKFsoUdN2DYYcJ49tgcDLqTm3E6ncu3orUWvFpoSWkKjM5TUvW4HRLifHZ.jpg)|![1001252202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EogPqMMxiyzi2W6oojnN57pELbFQpMp3fQyzuGVm1KxZw8kyaRXGYRnmRd3pkcaGVDu.jpg)|
|-|-|-|





Comenzamos a pegar las flores, no es necesario que las flores sean variadas, puedes elegir un solo color y también se verá bien.

>We start gluing the flowers; the flowers don't need to be varied, you can choose a single color and it will also look good.


|![1001252244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoK7hoVZzVs95WwYZDHmKSHkXfeJDcakSAnMVQU7jhdnPw2b2xiVPtC6zsCjfQhy2Dv.jpg)|![1001252247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uFY9yvrLS3m45mK8JTQ2kaLQ5BeufWcGRocR54sDPosHXEB2z941eva1zgEDo4wTm7A.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![1001252254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tvnbrqMsDZzxcbp5G588M8zVaYeoXutR62nNPm73MshxPDmwLKdSnJBCmWph4o9ZBSZ.jpg)|![1001252275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoGytFCAEXURUQSm7dSXbV9hVeihQaSvXJpGxaJecQ4SaZP8Y2EJFGwybXrbFDH9z1X.jpg)|
|-|-|



Ahora vamos a realizar la maceta, para esto tomaré un pequeño envase plástico y lo voy a cubrir con pintura blanca utilizando una esponja, cuando ya esté seco colocaré el algodón dentro del envase, y con limpiapipas color marrón claro cubrimos la parte superior de la maceta solo debes enrollar el limpiapipas en toda el área.


>Now we're going to make the flowerpot. For this, I'll take a small plastic container and cover it with white paint using a sponge. Once it's dry, I'll place the cotton inside the container, and with light brown pipe cleaners, we'll cover the top of the flowerpot. You just need to wrap the pipe cleaner around the entire area.

|![1001252285.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQrRv2fyTBidMHSzL8GsBbMHj7vGExQ7UkyJiDTE3mNSbjS7UEQL7MMDuhTEon9swnh.jpg)|![1001252428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoeFM2k7M2xxE32mngpcAHAqqsE9dDyHvLzXGUuxjEmoNhq3bYQKaHosCAhVtT2pqA2.jpg)|![1001252429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoK6GupctAPt6xFxHpkm4nBo7u5wYmHBqZyc7oahddRaFJ4KSCTtNWxNmx95QL4eNg2.jpg)|
|-|-|-|


|![1001252430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wMf2vxS4EvUDk3baRY4tjYs6or9AqZr6jJd2MeaHkdLxg9771G6hTSKZQMeXKMTvQ5j.jpg)|![1001252442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoK7HRTfn2kCmvgmzyNhajdzYmiHCJJzV2tVhow1adJHspMrbqj9KGVsH791mWVDB5a.jpg)|
|-|-|



Por último con limpiapipas verde cubrimos el tallo del corazón y realizamos dos hojas que vamos a unir también al tallo, y listo, colocamos nuestra planta de corazón con flores dentro de la maceta, listo para obsequiar o la puedes dejar como decoración.


>Finally, using green pipe cleaners, we cover the heart's stem and make two leaves that we will also attach to the stem, and that's it! We place our heart-shaped plant with flowers inside the pot, ready to give as a gift or you can leave it as decoration.


|![1001252443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23uQw2PFZ7XzVxuaVYotjqVeyqairXLDvUGEHD2TCHbu7dvQFpYSD8HVmmNerAGPy6NPn.jpg)|![1001252458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmPwTiiurwJzhXPBsRitkQCVjjqB7R5A9KC8fH4kFnELsP9YZunhnMH74KM45nCfchf.jpg)|
|-|-|




Muchísimas gracias por el apoyo y por visitar mi publicación, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad más ideas creativas.

>Thank you so much for your support and for visiting my post. See you next time for more creative ideas.

![1001252653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tmL9K6bzcwwtBjfYZPZKyAKvhRFk6h8tLPi8WNxhZg8KWdVx1DqP9sX2c3rJ2BX5L6L.jpg)




![1001252695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23tHA2QE4aqHt2BxDPHt9qwUADGARjAuN5zwRXZnvWdsF5NqUvwo23UkyfjuvEE3CAdFH.jpg)

![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


![1000095868.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWG8Jt6SU3neCCGF5ZCDw8KzpFGS63KR5cYgcCEoKEYgi/1000095868.png)

body.body:
*I started writing a new story for the [Finish the Tale contest](https://ecency.com/hive-133311/@ecency-star/writing-contest-finish-the-tale-3a8f915258e14)*.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWCABPoowzSqSjDmupP3xSd8Es4nxDZ1EDjRFJxKN5H2/image.png)




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZNWANsLZeqUMJdECRWJurkiK3a31uUZtmFsdUXayTLo/ecency_banner.jpg)

Here is how the previous part finished:

> *And now the final year had come.*

Over the past ten years, the villagers had considered every possible idea to find the criminal. They made a list of everyone who had visited the village on the days when the girl disappeared. They checked each person on the list. But in those ten years, there was one individual who had never returned. Which meant that in that year, he had come under a false name. And the villagers did not know his face. That made the task far more difficult.

Everyone regretted not listening to the young man sooner. Perhaps he had even seen the kidnapper - after all, he had rarely left the girl’s side. But the young man died the same day he told his story.

This year was their last attempt - their final plan to catch the kidnapper. It seemed like the most absurd plan of all, but there were no other options left. They had tried everything they could. And ten whole years had already passed.

*To be continued…*

body.title: 21 February 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3021: velvet curtain
body.body:
/>

“OK, so, I think that when we do this one-on-one, we oughta upgrade the fashion for it – coming off the porch into a chute to get onto the field is so last season – they've been doing it since the prehistory of basketball and we need to upgrade!”

“Tell me something, son,” Mrs. Gladys Jubilee Trent said to her son, Sgt. Vincent Trent about their little neighbor, eight-year-old Edwina Ludlow. “Is little Miss Warrior Princess ever calm?”

“It was good when we had our gardens up at the Veteran's Lodge; Edwina would work in her grandmother's garden and then come over and work in Velma's garden and just be contented all day, but since we moved and didn't expect to be here long, none of us have invested in gardening.”

“OK, so, Edwina is one of those who literally needs grounding every day,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said. “Hey, Tom!”

“Yes, Gladys?” Mr. Thomas Stepforth, Sgt. Trent's father-in-law said.

“You're the landlord here – you got a problem with us doing a garden?”

“No, especially since with the Bayard Heights washout so near y'all's houses up at the Veteran's Lodge means you're going to be here at least six more months before the literal dust settles. Big Velma and little Velma are already planning their winter garden – suppose I will remember today to let the Lees and the Ludlows know, too!”

“Yeah, so we can get some peace around here,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said. “That little offshoot of Hilda Lee over there and that big voice of hers needs something else to do than making war with the fashion of the prehistory of basketball!”

“Oh well, there's a faster way to do that and he is coming out of the house right now,” Mr. Stepforth said with a smile as Capt. R.E. Ludlow came off his back porch.

“Edwina!”

“Yes, sir!”

“At ease!”

“Yes, sir!”

“Stop giving my opponent all the business about my entrance to the basketball court. Remember that the element of surprise is an advantage.”

“Oh, right – well, yeah, but they ain't gonna be ready for the setup anyhow!”

“Never underestimate your opponents, Edwina, by giving them time and information they don't need to have.”

“Oh, OK, that makes sense.”

“I'm going to be ready for warmups and nine-man shoot around in a little bit – Grandma says you'll want to come in and get some water before then.”

“OK, I'm coming!”

“Both of them just have an immense voice,” Mrs. Jubilee Trent said, “and the size of her voice at that age makes sense when you hear the size of his voice, period.”

“Lil' Robert is like that, too,” Sgt. Trent said, “but he's back in bed for his warm-milk-with-drops-of-coffee nap so it will be a little while before he is telling the world 'next week, though!'”

Then, the sergeant flinched.

“Not that we don't have voices of our own over here to be concerned with.”

“Duh-duh-doo-duh-duh-doobeedoobeedoobeedoobeedoo!”

Eight-year-old Gracie Trent and her anthem of attention sounded in the morning air, and Sgt. Trent and Mr. Stepforth almost tripped over themselves, running before Gracie's latest morning coffee manifested like a fresh hot cup of coffee made from God's own water … out of the house's downspout.

Meanwhile, inside the Ludlow house …

“So, Papa, I was thinking we would order a velvet curtain like they have at the old theaters, except ours would be spiritual purple, and then set that up across the porch, and you should come out looking like the singing star you are!”

“One problem, Edwina. Would be a shame to be playing ball in and sweating out a tuxedo.”

“Oh, no – never mind – back to the drawing board!” Edwina said.

body.title: [Eng-Esp] Delicious ham and cheese pastries//Deliciosos pastelitos de jamon y queso
body.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. Today I want to introduce you to these delicious ham and cheese pastries. These are similar to empanadas; their filling depends on each person's taste, but their dough is made solely from wheat flour. \n

> Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta nueva oportunidad , hoy quiero presentarles estos deliciosos pastelitos de jamon y queso, estos son similares a las empanada su relleno depende del gusto de cada persona , pero su masa es unicamente de harina de trigo ![728062.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23w2uCs3h8AYzpcHk8jW1B17iKVpwBiGg4S8AyxzwTJtdyT7mnfNBJGEyvRZxVEXT1rq2.jpeg) Used materials//materiales utilizados
> *masa de harina de trigo *jamon *queso ![IMG_5327.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23tmHZt44jnXqJJ9jnyCzytg57romCmq8zYhGXsZrnSEtLCAN5qDBwAby54PhHbzakLWH.jpeg) Step1//paso1

> The first step is to chop the cheese and ham into small pieces. I like mozzarella cheese because it melts well. Then I separate the wheat flour dough; this is artisanal and comes in a plastic bag that allows for proper separation. Next, I add the ham and cheese, close it, and seal it by pressing firmly with a fork. Meanwhile, I heat the oil. These pastries cook very quickly; they can't be left in the oil for too long. \n

> El primer paso es picar en pequeños el queso y el jamon , me gusta el queso mozarela porque se funde, luego separo la masa de harina de trigo esta es artesanal y viene con una bolsita plastica que permite separarlas correctamen, luego le aplico el jamon y queso lo cierro ,haciendo presion fuerte con un tenedor la sello de la siguiente forma por otro lado , pongo calentar el aceite estos pastelitos se cocinan muy rapido no se pueden dejar mucho tiempo en el aceite ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AK7yGHD6FF81nUg6wKdFAqr4fcCzjcCJ3e4ioY6j4NnbLru9ddN5Mv8PwgFshP8.jpeg) Step2//paso2
> Once they are ready, they look like this; the cupcakes vary in shape and size. \n

> una vez esten listos quedan de la siguiente forman , los pastelitos varian en su forma y su tamaño ![IMG_5335.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23wMiiUMVsoz6WeyKRf4ooBSF96wRiN15GTSAoSiBf6uutGRZc1e1JjsTyiENP26CU5iJ.jpeg)

body.title: Velvet Curtain
body.body: It was always there, in the brightest corner of the house, the window. So magestic and impressive as if belonging to the royalty. My grandmother never wanted to get ride of it, even when my mother insisted on changing decoration, but it was the favorite cloth object of my grandmother. I used to hide inside all covered while my mother looked all around the house for me at dinner time. I still remember when the first washing machine arrived home. My mother and grandmother debated to wash it, but it was so big that it didnt fit in the washer and all the cleaning had to be done at hand. That red velvet curtain is the silent witness of the house. \n\n
