body.title: Corocoros with spaghetti (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Fish is the most commonly consumed food in the city of Cumana. Its variety and price have made it a favorite among the public, and today I'm going to bring you some delicious fried corocoros. This fish is one of the most popular because it is delicious and meaty, and its aroma when it's in the pan is unmistakable. I served it with spaghetti.
![1000094993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zar3eV5uBeocgEZKMEw2MF5bd5UNhoQRAzaFn7UKsafUhw6LvvLGt3Ln5h7NbmZ4Uag.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 3 corocoros - 1/2 kilo of spaghetti - 3 liters of water - Salt to taste - 2 cloves of garlic - Oil
![1000094983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8fGu7kFPoU4MXMbes6hszDDQ5Uy4maQGcDxGCTLZmXDijoyEx5X5yWFBkRzspAtgX1.jpg)
## Procedure: I cleaned the fish, removing the scales, guts, and gills. Then I submerged them in water again and made two diagonal incisions on their sides so that they would cook well inside. Next, I salted them, crushed two garlic cloves, and rubbed them on the fish to enhance the flavor.
![1000094987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vi6UhYGAcnZnf6nNJ5Rbr8ksxWgF3HMs9qNmv3ah3Mf2cpjzWPCnWkTiWoyE6Yy1MgZ.jpg)
Next, I put enough oil in a frying pan to fry the fish. I like it well browned, so I cooked it for about seven minutes on each side. In a separate pot, I put 3 liters of water, added a tablespoon of salt, and waited for it to boil. Then I added the spaghetti and stirred it so it wouldn't stick. I also added a tablespoon of oil to make the pasta looser. In about 7 minutes, it was al dente.
![1000094990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23x172CxsFrrDRexQD84ZBYr3DjTr2jH9xac36YAt6sFwgsAGnsMkqtHzvadsoSu6GvaH.jpg)
I turned off the stove, strained the pasta, and added a touch of butter. All that was left was to serve the spaghetti with fried corocoro and enjoy the delicious flavors that the coast sucrenses has to offer. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El pescado es el alimento que más se consume en la ciudad de Cumaná, su variedad y precio le han hecho ganar la preferencia entre el público y hoy les voy a traer unos deliciosos corocoros fritos, este pescado es uno de los más populares porque es delicioso y carnoso, además su aroma cuando está en el sartén es inconfundible. Lo acompañé con espaguetis.
![1000094993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zar3eV5uBeocgEZKMEw2MF5bd5UNhoQRAzaFn7UKsafUhw6LvvLGt3Ln5h7NbmZ4Uag.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 3 corocoros - 1/2 kilo es espaguetis - 3 litros de agua - Sal al gusto - 2 dientes de ajo - Aceite
![1000094983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8fGu7kFPoU4MXMbes6hszDDQ5Uy4maQGcDxGCTLZmXDijoyEx5X5yWFBkRzspAtgX1.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Limpié los pescados, retiré las escamas, vísceras y las agallas. Después los sumergí nuevamente en agua y les hice dos incisiones en forma diagonal en sus laterales para que se cocinen bien por dentro. Luego les puse sal, trituré dos ajos y se los unté, así tienen mejor sabor.
![1000094987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vi6UhYGAcnZnf6nNJ5Rbr8ksxWgF3HMs9qNmv3ah3Mf2cpjzWPCnWkTiWoyE6Yy1MgZ.jpg)
Posteriormente coloqué un sartén con suficiente aceite para freír los pescados. Me gustan bien dorados, cociné por unos siete minutos de cada lado. En una olla aparte coloqué 3 litros de agua, agregué una cucharada de sal y esperé que hirviera. Luego agregué los espaguetis, revolví para que no se pegaran. También agregué una cucharada de aceite y así lograr una pasta más suelta. En unos 7 minutos estaban al dente.
![1000094990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23x172CxsFrrDRexQD84ZBYr3DjTr2jH9xac36YAt6sFwgsAGnsMkqtHzvadsoSu6GvaH.jpg)
Apagué la cocina, colé y le puse un toque de mantequilla. Solo quedaba servir el espagueti con corocoro frito y disfrutar de las deliciosas que nos ofrecen las costas sucrenses. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.
###

body.title: Problems of education of poor students
body.body:
Greetings students. How are you? Today I want to inform you about real life events. Basically, there are some children in our world who have huge problems with education. Basically, their families have the most economic problems. As many people as there are among us or students, it is seen that most of their families are poor. And students from a poor family never get the quality of their education and the necessary materials properly. As a result, students fail to conduct their educational activities.






 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSVehwuBRu3s7HFz1b4ZzyFZVVvNWjQDPqSSJMuqq3jvh/photo-1559633817-40d48f80e184.jpeg 



[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/girl-behind-boy-with-backpack-wdOl-SqTSBY)


Education is compulsory for a child and education is his fundamental right. But due to financial problems in the family, that family cannot take advantage of education. Especially in a poor family, several students remain. As a result of being the father of the family, he cannot take responsibility for everyone. A head of the family runs out of all his money just to collect food for the day. It becomes very difficult for a boy and a girl to bear school uniform, books, notebooks, pens, private fees and transportation expenses. I have seen this incident especially in my own life. Despite being a good and talented student from a poor family, I could not improve my position and move myself forward. I tried many times to improve my position and establish myself as a talented person in the society. God gave me a lot of talent. However, I was not supported by my family in any way to get all the materials needed for education. Because I am a child of a very poor family. There were a total of five members in our family and the financial condition of our family was very bad.


When I was admitted to school, the first year went very well for me. However, due to financial problems in my family, I was unable to continue my studies properly.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma4g6JsjRxAS3HrXYYthFwg6argDRvVViEKeR6WEMjf6o/pexels-safari-consoler-3290243-11742889.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-boy-walking-while-holding-a-dirty-plate-11742889/)


Due to financial problems in the family, I used to walk to school all the time. I used to sit in a corner of the bench while going to school. Because I had a different school dress on my body. However, I had to go to school wearing a dirty and torn school dress. Sometimes, it was necessary to pay the school fees along with the examination fees. However, due to the weak financial condition of the family, I could not pay them properly and for this I had to suffer a lot and listen to the teachers' scolding. 

I was always a brilliant student. While being a brilliant student, I decided to participate in the Junior School Certificate Examination. However, the subject of mathematics was very difficult for me. To solve the subject of mathematics, I started private lessons with a mathematics teacher. However, even though that mathematics teacher taught me privately, I could not pay his monthly private fee of 300 taka. As a result, in the following months, I found myself without private lessons and took the examination. Although I could not achieve the expected results in the examination, then the ability to achieve good results was developed. 

 However, if I had studied mathematics privately, I would have had the lowest plus score there.


Moreover, I could never participate in various school programs. It is said that education is very difficult for a poor student. On the one hand, education and on the other hand, family pressure are two problems that a student has to face during his student life. Sometimes it is necessary to buy a guide in school. The most neglected poor student is a talented one, although he is talented. 

If a talented student is poor, then nothing can be more difficult than this. A beautiful talented student and whose life was like a flower. But only due to lack of money, our lives are being ruined constantly. 

Education for poor students is a struggle. In this struggle, some survive and some drop out. But finally, I also lost this struggle and now my education has completely stopped. 

Let me finally give you a suggestion, if there is a poor student around you, try to help him at least a little. Because these students of today can give us a beautiful world in the future. I wish all the poor students sincere love, respect and prayers.

body.title: A new fish soup (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today's lunch was a delicious fish soup. My dad brought me three beautiful corvina fish again, so I didn't hesitate to make a stew. I've noticed that the flavor changes depending on the quality of the vegetables and the seasoning, so it's best to stick with the same supplier when the product is good. I recommend choosing ingredients from the place where you've had the best results.
![1000096059.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ydA9BHmh9VsqW4BsPBHoeKV8vCwyZnzuGT8njHtyhj4yJpQuG5T2pHxBmpVWHZn5MBt.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 3 medium corvina fish - 2 bell peppers - 11 sweet peppers - 2 onions - 1 chaco - 1/4 kilo of pumpkin - 1 white taro - 1/2 Chinese taro - 2 pieces of yuca - Salt to taste - 1 head of garlic - 3 liters of water
![1000096025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpCw1TTFrdndtRRuEJYqdC28rbyPWo6eEiutA5BCBcG9pP7KNMmZgwgENHbgDJQ75L9.jpg)
## Procedure: I cleaned the fish, removing the scales, guts, and gills. I cut them in half and also cut off the tails. I washed them in a container with enough water and set them aside. Then I removed the bark from the cassava, which comes off easily if it is of good quality, and cut it into medium-sized pieces. I filled a pot with enough water and boiled them with a pinch of salt.
![1000096022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJRH6tDkzWmSxceiQBhpsUXk2LLt6LVjNZwNcDq9xFiTwChVdvLJgckZyLPRZgw7qzD.jpg)
While the softening process began, I set about removing the seeds from the chili peppers and bell peppers, cutting them into julienne strips. I did the same with the onions. Then I peeled the Chinese taro, white taro, and chaco taro, cutting them into pieces. This time, I didn't remove the skins from the squash so that they wouldn't fall apart.
![1000096029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgWNP93bf92hkF5X1LNBEApYkbFEjYsxdHFwQ1YfMQySRmCb6u928LsbhT2sYh9s9Td.jpg)
I crushed the head of garlic very well until it became a paste. When the yuca softened, I added another tablespoon of salt and the rest of the vegetables. I let it cook for 20 minutes, then added the fish, since it cooks very quickly and if overcooked, it would break apart.
![1000096033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tbwBvau9vHEnd3uJipPzHTu6ZtfZkg1hzRzo875riRSX5CSunYLYV9THVcqTDSi5cR5.jpg)
Finally, I added the seasonings and let it cook for five more minutes. I turned off the heat and distributed the garlic throughout the soup, mixing it well. This stew turned out delicious; I loved the result. Corvina makes a good broth, but you have to be careful to prevent it from breaking down. Every experience is definitely unique and worth reviewing. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El almuerzo de hoy fue una deliciosa sopa de pescado, papá me trajo nuevamente 3 hermosos ejemplares de curvina, así que no dudé en preparar un hervido. Me he dado cuenta de que el sabor cambia dependiendo de la calidad de las verduras y del aliño, por tal razón es recomendable acudir a un mismo proveedor cuando el producto es bueno. Recomiendo entonces elegir los ingredientes en el lugar donde se alcanzaron los mejores resultados.
![1000096059.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ydA9BHmh9VsqW4BsPBHoeKV8vCwyZnzuGT8njHtyhj4yJpQuG5T2pHxBmpVWHZn5MBt.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 3 curvinas medianas - 2 pimentones - 11 ajíes dulces - 2 cebollas - 1 chaco - 1/4 kilo de auyama - 1 ocumo blanco - 1/2 ocumo chino - 2 pedazos de yuca - Sal al gusto - 1 cabeza de ajo - 3 litros de agua
![1000096025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xpCw1TTFrdndtRRuEJYqdC28rbyPWo6eEiutA5BCBcG9pP7KNMmZgwgENHbgDJQ75L9.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Limpié los pescados, retirando las escamas, vísceras y agallas. Dividí a la mitad y también corté la cola. En un envase con suficiente agua los lavé y los guardé. Luego quité la corteza de la yuca, al desprenderse fácilmente es sinónimo de buena calidad, corté en pedazos medianos. Monté la olla con suficiente agua y los puse a sancochar con un punto de sal.
![1000096022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23yJRH6tDkzWmSxceiQBhpsUXk2LLt6LVjNZwNcDq9xFiTwChVdvLJgckZyLPRZgw7qzD.jpg)
Mientras inició el proceso de ablandar, me dispuse a retirar las semillas de los ajíes y pimentones, corté en julianas. Hice este mismo procedimiento con las cebollas. Luego pelé el ocumo chino, el blanco y el chaco, corté en pedazos. Esta vez no retiré las conchas de la auyama para que no se desmoronaran.
![1000096029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgWNP93bf92hkF5X1LNBEApYkbFEjYsxdHFwQ1YfMQySRmCb6u928LsbhT2sYh9s9Td.jpg)
Trituré muy bien la cabeza de ajo hasta volverlo una masa pastosa. Cuando la yuca ablandó, agregué otra cucharada de sal y el resto de las verduras. Dejé cocinar por 20 minutos, luego incorporé el pescado, dado que se cocina muy rápido y si se pasa de cocción se rompería.
![1000096033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tbwBvau9vHEnd3uJipPzHTu6ZtfZkg1hzRzo875riRSX5CSunYLYV9THVcqTDSi5cR5.jpg)
Finalmente añadí los aliños y dejé cocinar por cinco minutos más. Apagué y distribuí el ajo por toda la sopa, mezclé muy bien. Este hervido quedó delicioso, me encantó el resultado. La curvina da un buen caldo, pero se debe permanecer atentos para evitar que se rompa. Definitivamente, cada experiencia es única y merece ser reseñada. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

/> La cortina de terciopelo era roja, pesada, ridícula para una oficina pública donde ni el aire servía. Siempre pensé que esa cortina resumía toda la vergüenza de los entes públicos del país, lujo viejo intentando tapar la desfachatez Afuera la gente hacía fila desde las cinco de la mañana y adentro el jefe hablaba de protocolos políticos mientras se sacudía las migas del “sánguche” que se acababa de desayunar y se limpiaba la mancha del café de su camisa, como si la mancha fuera el problema del día. Yo miraba la cortina y pensaba, el país es eso, una tela gruesa que no deja pasar la luz, pero igual deja entrar la miseria disfrazada de trámite. La señora del turno 47 llevaba tres horas esperando para que le dijeran que le faltaba una fotocopia, el muchacho del fondo necesitaba un sello que solo pone el que nunca viene, y los demás fingimos sorpresa, porque el sistema se cae dos veces al día, en la mañana y en la tarde. El jefe dice que debemos “cuidar la imagen institucional”. Por eso nadie habla del baño que se rebosa cuando llueve, ni de las computadoras dañadas, por eso se está escribiendo todo a mano. Pero la cortina, esa sí está impecable, la mandan a limpiar cada tres meses, prioridades, le llama el jefe. A veces creo que la cortina no está para tapar el sol, sino que está para que no veamos lo que pasa afuera. La fila, la frustración, el murmullo de rabia que se va acumulando, porque es más fácil correr la tela y hacer como que todo está en orden. Total, mientras no se vea, no existe. Y lo peor es que uno se acostumbra, cuando llega alguien nuevo empieza criticando la cortina y al final termina defendiéndola, decimos, así son las cosas, eso no depende de mí, y sin darnos cuenta nos volvemos parte del terciopelo, gruesos, opacos y medio gastados. A veces me dan ganas de arrancarla de tajo y dejar que entre toda la luz, que se vea el polvo, la vergüenza, la verdadera cara del asunto. Pero luego llaman el siguiente número y vuelvo a sentarme. * * * Me gustaría invitarte a participar en esta dinámica diaria. [Puedes hacerlo aquí...](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/21-february-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3021-velvet-curtain) Invito a: @ungrancuento @silveiragca @edgerik

> _The velvet curtain was red, heavy, ridiculous for a public office where even the air conditioning was useless._ _I always thought that curtain summed up all the shame of the country's public institutions, old-fashioned luxury trying to mask the brazenness._ _Outside, people had been queuing since five in the morning, and inside, the boss was talking about political protocols while brushing crumbs off the \

he'd just eaten for breakfast and wiping the coffee stain off his shirt, as if the stain were the day's biggest problem._

_I looked at the curtain and thought, that's what the country is like, a thick fabric that doesn't let the light through, but still lets in misery disguised as bureaucracy._

_The woman in line 47 had been waiting for three hours to be told she was missing a photocopy, the young man in the back needed a stamp that only the one who never shows up can provide, and the rest of us feigned surprise, because the system crashes twice a day, in the morning and in the afternoon._

_The boss says we have to \

That's why nobody talks about the overflowing toilet when it rains, or the broken computers; that's why everything is being handwritten._

_But the curtain, that's spotless. They send it to be cleaned every three months—priorities, the boss calls them._

_Sometimes I think the curtain isn't there to block the sun, but rather to keep us from seeing what's happening outside. The line, the frustration, the murmur of anger that keeps building, because it's easier to pull back the fabric and pretend everything's fine._

_After all, as long as it's not visible, it doesn't exist._

_And the worst part is that you get used to it. When someone new arrives, they start by criticizing the curtain and end up defending it. We say, \

and without realizing it, we become part of the velvet: thick, opaque, and half-worn._ _Sometimes I feel like ripping it all off and letting in all the light, letting the dust, the shame, the true face of the matter shine through._ _But then the next number comes in and I sit back down._ * * * _I'd like to invite you to participate in this daily exercise._ [You can do so here...](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/21-february-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3021-velvet-curtain) _I invite:_ @ungrancuento @silveiragca @edgerik

description.body: As Hong Kong gets more modernized, Neon Signs, which were part of what made Hong Kong unique is slowly disappearing. Replaced with LED lights instead. DX DESIGN HUB ============= On the second floor of this building, there is a whole section dedicated to the Neon Signs of Hong Kong. The neon signs were one of the most famous features of visiting Hong Kong. These signs were all handcrafted by skilled craftsmen. There are not many left today. All that remains are the Neon Signboards that will one day be removed and replaced with LED lights.

description.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![XX9Y2EzA8X1ewdcY_bd1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/XX9Y2EzA8X1ewdcY_bd1/XX9Y2EzA8X1ewdcY_bd1.webp)
![5ARlotw7l3Z1Yksv_bd2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/5ARlotw7l3Z1Yksv_bd2/5ARlotw7l3Z1Yksv_bd2.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

大年初四这天继续带孩子串亲戚，这次的亲戚家有条柴犬，孩子最喜欢和狗狗玩了。我们吃完午饭以后才到亲戚家，到了后孩子马上和柴犬玩了起来，孩子专门给狗狗带了一个毛绒玩具。正好有4个老人凑一桌打麻将，我和孩子下楼遛狗。到了楼下遇到小区门卫，狗狗和门卫很熟悉，门卫给狗狗喂了一点火腿肠，狗狗吃的很开心。然后我和孩子带着狗狗来到小区附近的一个广场，这里地方比较大适合遛狗。

初四这天阳光很好，下午最高气温达到20度以上，穿厚衣服热的不行。我让孩子自己带着狗狗围着广场走圈，我找了一个阴凉地方休息。溜了一会狗，孩子开始和狗狗互动玩游戏，把带了毛绒玩具放到狗鼻子跟前，然后扔出去，结果狗子只是回头看看完全没有捡回来的意思，孩子给狗狗说握手，狗狗也不知道抬起前爪，看来亲戚家的狗狗没有接受过训练，不知道如何与人互动。

狗子比较懒，有时候我特意跑起来狗子也只是加快脚步走路，没有四足奔跑过。我和孩子在广场上遛了两个小时狗子，回去后狗狗趴在垫子上一副累坏了的样子，好家伙这体力还不如人类呢。孩子喝了一杯酸奶，我用剪刀把酸奶壳子剪开，孩子把酸奶壳子丢给狗狗，狗子开始添酸奶壳子里剩余的酸奶，添的特别开心。过年期间总算让孩子撸了一把狗子。

---

description.title: Iniciativa // Los matices de la Culpa//Esa vida nuestra// (Esp/Eng)
description.body:
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000413955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EogPpPzBBWLTaBQP8pz1XDBHiJjFvna7JvDqDY1H7QctDJNqpEmeQwNtYXpPQoKPcG2.jpg)

>
 
---
Hola a todos, vuelvo a la comunidad #holoslotus para participar en la iniciativa presentada por nuestra amiga @charjaim, que trata sobre: **Los matices de la culpa**. Sinceramente, amigos, cuando leí el título de este tema, me recordó mucho a un libro que leí hace años titulado \

. Es cierto que este tema nos invita a reflexionar. > Hello everyone, I'm returning to the #holoslotus community to participate in the initiative presented by our friend @charjaim, which is about: **The nuances of guilt**. Honestly, friends, when I read the title of this topic, it reminded me a lot of a book I read years ago called “The Cow's Guilt.” It's true that this topic invites us to reflect.
![1000385559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/241tYsb97xh65f2JrXE8Y6kUzVnqca6ucFz9xuBByFR9QrSgPLF5V8JPenCt8oKqjH8Wu.jpg)
¿Cuántas veces hemos oído decir a la gente: \

¿Sabes por qué culpamos a los demás? Porque siempre hemos creído en culpar a los demás. Desde el principio de los tiempos ha existido la culpa, y fue cuando Adán culpó a Eva, y ella, a su vez, culpó a la serpiente por persuadirle de que comiera el fruto prohibido; desde allí fue que comenzamos el hábito de culpar a los demás por nuestras propias acciones.\n\nPor eso escuchamos a adultos que siguen culpando a sus padres por todo lo que les sucede en la vida; también escuchamos a otros culpar al tráfico, al gobierno, a los vecinos, a los hijos, a los jefes y a los hermanos por lo que sucede. ¿Sabes por qué? Porque nos hace sentir mejor. Culpar a los demás es la forma más fácil de evitar la responsabilidad, porque no tenemos el valor de decir \
o \

. How many times have we heard people say, “It's your fault”? Do you know why we blame others? Because we have always believed in blaming others. Blame has existed since the beginning of time, when Adam blamed Eve, and she, in turn, blamed the serpent for persuading her to eat the forbidden fruit. From then on, we began the habit of blaming others for our own actions. That's why we hear adults who continue to blame their parents for everything that happens to them in life; we also hear others blame traffic, the government, neighbors, children, bosses, and siblings for what happens. Do you know why? Because it makes us feel better. Blaming others is the easiest way to avoid responsibility, because we don't have the courage to say “I'm sorry” or “I was wrong.”
![1000361359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yd5dsSmcBQZpV8MiYhJRLE3GC4WykeDuWKcT9w7eCdmnU8PeCF33XfUCs8M53RmmxxH.jpg)
Es fácil culpar a los demás por nuestras decisiones. Cuando algo no sale según lo planeado, nuestro objetivo es encontrar a alguien a quien culpar. Por ejemplo, llegué tarde al trabajo porque el autobús se averió o porque me quedé sin gasolina. Siempre buscamos excusas para justificar la culpa que sentimos. La realidad es que nuestro cerebro está diseñado para culpar a otros de nuestras propias acciones, ya que utilizamos este mecanismo de defensa para las cosas malas que hacemos, los errores que cometemos y muchas otras situaciones. It's easy to blame others for our decisions. When something doesn't go according to plan, our goal is to find someone to blame. For example, I was late for work because the bus broke down or because I ran out of gas. We always look for excuses to justify the guilt we feel. The reality is that our brains are designed to blame others for our own actions, as we use this defense mechanism for the bad things we do, the mistakes we make, and many other situations.
![1000292590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQfYPqPedZ8QjJBqHGLT7M3sSDJF91T44NRcQCH2kHJbuwFauXhsGUy81m3mvKGCMZi.jpg)
Les diré que cuando nos reunimos en familia, a menudo oigo a mis hermanas y a mi madre decir «es culpa tuya», lo que me hace sentir mal. A veces me da vergüenza hacer algo allí y que no salga bien porque solo buscan a alguien a quien culpar. Sentirse culpable es también lo peor que podemos experimentar, ya que nos impide vivir bien. Así que pasé años culpándome por la muerte de mi hijo, y eso no me dejaba vivir; incluso ahora, cuando me río y me siento feliz, o bailo, o me compro algo, sigo sintiéndome un poco culpable. Sin duda, vivir con esa culpa no me ha llevado a nada bueno; solo me ha dado más problemas, ya que me he sentido deprimida y eso me ha hecho ver que la vida no tiene sentido. Para ello, tuve que recurrir a expertos para dejar de castigarme y culparme por algo de lo que no era responsable. Así comprendí que la muerte forma parte de la vida y aprendí a perdonarme por no seguir torturándome por sentirme culpable por algo que pensé que podría haber hecho, pero no hice en ese momento, y que no se podía hacer nada más. No hay forma de evitar la muerte de un ser querido, así que con el tiempo tuve que concederme el perdón. I'll tell you that when we get together as a family, I often hear my sisters and my mother say, “It's your fault,” which makes me feel bad. Sometimes I'm embarrassed to do something there and have it not turn out well because they're just looking for someone to blame. Feeling guilty is also the worst thing we can experience, as it prevents us from living well. So I spent years blaming myself for my son's death, and that didn't let me live; even now, when I laugh and feel happy, or dance, or buy something, I still feel a little guilty. Without a doubt, living with that guilt has not led me to anything good; it has only given me more problems, as I have felt depressed and that has made me see that life has no meaning. To do this, I had to turn to experts to stop punishing and blaming myself for something I wasn't responsible for. That's how I understood that death is part of life, and I learned to forgive myself for not continuing to torture myself with guilt over something I thought I could have done but didn't do at the time, and that nothing else could have been done. There is no way to prevent the death of a loved one, so over time I had to grant myself forgiveness.
![1000308266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xVEe25vZM2oegbxRHyGcBHuLqLxkAYQkUSW3rmMy22HgHkZGRaGVsZxGhopHYDmJZPF.jpg)
Por lo tanto, no debemos responsabilizar a los demás por lo que nos sucede, ni culparnos a nosotros mismos por los giros y vueltas de la vida. Debemos aceptar nuestras responsabilidades, ya que somos nosotros quienes construimos nuestra propia existencia. Reconocer nuestros errores nos anima a aprender y aceptar nuestras obligaciones cuando nos pertenecemos a nosotros mismos. Esto mejorará nuestro ser y nos permitirá tomar el control de nuestras vidas. Therefore, we should not hold others responsible for what happens to us, nor blame ourselves for the twists and turns of life. We must accept our responsibilities, as we are the ones who build our own existence. Recognizing our mistakes encourages us to learn and accept our obligations when we belong to ourselves. This will improve our being and allow us to take control of our lives.
![1000331917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMcbdv3HJsZr8QQDhs2kuTjhsneJi5opxXpCpFjFBQqZqkhZXTnK95UiXnYXUtnWQ1p.jpg)

description.body: <center>![LMAC-FreeStyle-No149-CleanlinessPark.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/48JdoPrUcKjoaTRyC33V1XqQLSPJgRJpMEBPNcMX9qtS1Lti3oDDrMAWh4hi2ADbnQ.jpg)</center>\n\n<div class=\

>

Hello LMAC and Hive members. I wanted to share my current freestyle collage whose theme entails an unusual facility where services are rendered. My style of collage is a Freestyle. Although I usually do, I wasn't required to utilize any contest photo in my design. However, if you'd like to join in visit: [Let's Make a Collage - A Contest for All Creatives on Hive - Round 245 - ✨41 HIVE in the Prize Pool!](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-245-41-hive-in-the-prize-pool).

<center>![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)</center>

<center>***Wholesomeness Park***</center>

\

Morris quipped as he sat high on a tree branch overlooking Wholesomeness Park.

As advertised, Wholesomeness Park opened on time on the outskirts of Wellington on Saturday, February 21, 2026. Touted as the newest facility to usher in its Wellness for Everyone campaign, the facility attracted the locals in its citywide  circulation posters. The earlier mild day where clouds skipped happily across the sky quickly turned cloudy.

Creatures of all kind gathered to take part in the community service to improve the health and happiness of all its animal residents. All were welcome, and no one would be excluded or turned away.

He glanced back to see whether his wife, Gladys, would come take a look. But she wasn't as curious as he. Besides, she'd already noticed various animals taking advantage of the two-day advertised special.

\
Morris whispered as he moved to a lower branch. \

Gladys approached her husband and hunched behind him, careful not to rustle the branch. Her eyes grew wide.

There standing in the middle of the park was a hand protruding from the ground. It held in its hand some type of clear crystal object from which water flowed. What was odd about the washing device was that it was attached to roots springing up from the earth.

*\
* she pointed, pacing back and forth on the limb. *\
he postured as though knowing more than the advertisement promised. \

* Gladys backed away, scurried down the tree and headed north toward home.

Gladys has always been stuck in the past. This is a new era. New thinking. New ways of doing things, Morris surmised.

Still, he cocked his head to the side and peered intently at the glass orb, piercing its outer shell to the core where the water originated.

To his surprise, the orb's eye turned in his direction. A bulb flashed red. Morris gripped the branch as his legs weakened. Not able to hold on any longer, he tumbled from the tree.

A clump of white roots attached to the hand holding the orb scratched its way toward Morris' limp body. Catching the end of his tail, the roots pulled him in the direction of the hand.

Morris meowed as loud as he could, hoping his wife or someone would come to his aid. Sweating profusely, he tore at the ground with his nails as hard as he could. No solid object lay within his reach to anchor himself, 

The community planners had done an excellent job of removing any obstacles that prevented their clients from enjoying the luxuries of the Park. 

Two gray balls above the orb whined as if their gearbox had failed. The motor ramped up to a high pitch as the orb turned colors and spewed out some foamy liquid.

Next, the hollow-ringed voice from behind the orb shouted.

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

In preparing my collage theme, I wanted to present an unusual setting where in theory animals could congregate and be well groomed. The main focus of the theme is not the animals attending the facility, but a bystander who's observing the activities. Sensing something is amiss, the onlooker encounters a different facility than what was advertised. I hope my short story accompanying the collage reflects this discrepancy.

In pulling together the various images, I utilized Canva to blend them. One of the items that is pouring the liquid is a hand protruding from the landscape through roots.

Below are my steps in which I began with a blank, white canvas, then added layers of elements, removing backgrounds, resizing, duplicating, detaching elements from their backgrounds, colorizing, and repositioning items as needed incorporating the tools at my disposal in my Annual Pro Membership Subscription.

body.title: (ENG/ESP) 😸😎 Cleo without limits / Cleo sin límites 😸😎
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to everyone in this community and fellow cat lovers! Today I had planned to go for a walk in the park, but I ended up staying home to sew and do my own thing, as usual. At the same time, I had to keep an eye on Cleo, the kitten, since she tends to try to play with things she shouldn't, like my sewing machine. I'm surprised she can fall asleep to the noise of the machine running at full power, but when she's intrigued by a snaking piece of fabric or a loose thread, I have to reject her role as \

In that respect, I prefer Ying, who's a feline supervisor who just observes and lies down on any scrap of fabric he can find.
![1000367188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpEHoysKaghknDv2G7bARsyraahjAzV6iS3ugVS8s5Acg2gsQt2LEMggqZn4LhftTcv.jpg) ![1000366757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23zS3TXpPXvqigh1uPjrD9s8hSw5y9AQoECiV3auRRnwnRzBfKhzodxXmU19SREMPJbkP.jpg) ![1000366756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1MbMY1sK9aS76LzMMf2rAfK5SSx7VmivSxbwBGdLqEPSYEYhhj9fr24gsEXwifmT.jpg)
**Baby Cleo supervising me and sleeping in the process 😆**

Another of her mischievous habits is wanting to play with the structure we set up when we do the laundry. Since we live in an apartment, we don't have a proper place to hang the clothes to dry, so we have to improvise in the entryway... Well, Cleo thinks that's her \

because she immediately tries to climb on top of it. She's already fallen a couple of times while doing her somersaults, like a real circus cat, but she keeps trying. She's a daredevil kitten, unlike Ying, who was a pretty calm little boy.
![1000362202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep1WuZQEUBKTFBXJ4xQEUHzjxKW4iLkqVAXie6YawQ9AxccppJwg527ETJjRuUr55Z6.jpg) ![1000362203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoptt8LxpWDYZKrJ4nqcPvTiXBqNVEdmrsehksHMagrwedoXvy7vXowmrvdhD23UBJm.jpg)
**Cleo playing tightrope and chasing a clothes hanger 😆**

At least we can be thankful that she's no longer trying to chew on things like cables, although sometimes she bites my hair when I hold her, haha. She's a very playful kitten, and even though I realize how much she's grown, she's still tiny when I hold her in my arms. I take advantage of playing with her and holding her when she's awake, because when she's sleeping peacefully, I leave her alone and admire her face while she sleeps—a wonderful thing that we cat lovers truly appreciate.
![1000365866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK6kK7H5phNkoMtbV1aMuaWYKRC68FGJ8jeA5sedMaDG2bv8Jkin7LsBFWfHSC5S9Y.jpg) ![1000365873.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoc7ZFH2nxjCa876Dn9pgjrmQRj2xFhTfzsXzDdps3MHQ9zA3n33DSFDJ1pac9zSWnu.jpg) ![1000365865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoGyM8dDEUJ6aLMfWUR9KnReyf7RMepWsD4t3HRA5ceMKPdtn8tkiQSHPdf9cQ2z6on.jpg)
**The baby girl regaining energy to continue her games 😇**

Cleo and Ying's relationship is incredibly comforting. They don't play those rough games so often anymore, which is a relief, since I used to see Ying running away or fur flying everywhere, haha. Now, when they play, they're more careful with their strength and respect each other's moods. The same goes for grooming time, although Ying is the more intense one. Sometimes I've seen Cleo get stubborn when Ying tries to lick her insistently, and that does touch my heart. But then, I see them both grooming each other at the same time, and it's quite sweet.
![1000367039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo8UFVBuFEi1m1fxy2dsq97essy2a7TRLw7W9eSFZyNoovT6nFaeSbrhafiyRGRnwtk.jpg)
**Cleo with a sleepy face 😍**
![1000367187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpXLuUs5AvDzpDPwR74MxYJyb1mPR2xG6Kwz1UzkrMCwtSK8yH8ZN3Gwnmh72t4ycQs.jpg)
**A candid photo of Ying (he hates photos 😝)**

### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sticker-hive-ikki.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK6W53nZk27Way4ADpHJXF3ienr5k8cvBuxY5GRG63otvMAxjSqoZ8DgrDqkvbL.gif)

#
💚 Until next Caturday! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de los gatos! Hoy había pensado en salir al parque a pasear, pero acabé quedándome en casa a coser y a hacer mis cosas, como siempre. Al mismo tiempo, tenía que estar pendiente de Cleo, la gatita, ya que suele buscar de jugar con las cosas con las que no debería, como por ejemplo, mi máquina de coser. Me sorprende que se pueda quedar dormida con el ruido de la máquina a toda potencia, pero cuando le llama la atención la tela que se desliza o algún hilo suelo, tengo que rechazar su labor como \

; en ese aspecto, prefiero a Ying, quién es un supervisor gatuno que sólo está pendiente de observar y de acostarse sobre algún trocito de tela disponible.
![1000367188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpEHoysKaghknDv2G7bARsyraahjAzV6iS3ugVS8s5Acg2gsQt2LEMggqZn4LhftTcv.jpg) ![1000366757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23zS3TXpPXvqigh1uPjrD9s8hSw5y9AQoECiV3auRRnwnRzBfKhzodxXmU19SREMPJbkP.jpg) ![1000366756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1MbMY1sK9aS76LzMMf2rAfK5SSx7VmivSxbwBGdLqEPSYEYhhj9fr24gsEXwifmT.jpg)
**La bebesa Cleo supervisándome y durmiendo en el proceso 😆**

Otra de sus travesuras es querer jugar con la estructura que armamos cuando se lava la ropa. Al vivir en un apartamento, no contamos con un lugar adecuado para poder poner a secar la ropa, por lo que toca improvisar en el recibidor... Pues, Cleo piensa que eso se trata de su \

porque inmediatamente buscar de subirse encima del mismo. Ya se ha caído un par de veces mientras hace sus maromas, como si fuera toda una gata de circo, pero no deja de intentarlo. Es una gatita temeraria, a diferencia de Ying, que fue un cachorro bastante tranquilo.
![1000362202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep1WuZQEUBKTFBXJ4xQEUHzjxKW4iLkqVAXie6YawQ9AxccppJwg527ETJjRuUr55Z6.jpg) ![1000362203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoptt8LxpWDYZKrJ4nqcPvTiXBqNVEdmrsehksHMagrwedoXvy7vXowmrvdhD23UBJm.jpg)
**Cleo jugando a caminar en la cuerda floja y cazando un gancho de ropa 😆**

Al menos, hay que agradecer que ya no esté buscando de morder cosas como cables, aunque, cuando la cargo, en ocasiones me muerde el cabello jaja es una gatita muy juguetona y a pesar de que me dé cuenta de lo mucho que ha crecido, sigue siendo pequeña cuando la tengo entre mis brazos. Aprovecho de jugar con ella y de cargarla cuando está despierta, porque cuando duerme plácidamente, la dejo tranquila y admirar su carita mientras duerme, es una maravilla que apreciamos mucho los amantes de los gatos.
![1000365866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoK6kK7H5phNkoMtbV1aMuaWYKRC68FGJ8jeA5sedMaDG2bv8Jkin7LsBFWfHSC5S9Y.jpg) ![1000365873.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eoc7ZFH2nxjCa876Dn9pgjrmQRj2xFhTfzsXzDdps3MHQ9zA3n33DSFDJ1pac9zSWnu.jpg) ![1000365865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoGyM8dDEUJ6aLMfWUR9KnReyf7RMepWsD4t3HRA5ceMKPdtn8tkiQSHPdf9cQ2z6on.jpg)
**La bebesa recuperando energía para seguir sus juegos 😇**

La convivencia de Cleo con Ying, es de lo más reconfortante. Ya no tienen esos juegos rudos tan seguidos y eso me calma, ya que en ocasiones podía ver a Ying huyéndole o los pelos volando por todos lados jaja Ahora, cuando juegan, son más medidos con sus fuerzas y respetan cuando el otro, no está de ánimo. Lo mismo ocurre con la hora del acicalamiento, aunque Ying es el más intenso en éste aspecto; en ocasiones, he visto como Cleo se obstina cuando Ying se acerca a lamerla insistentemente y eso, si me da sentimiento. Pero luego, los veo a ambos acicalarse al mismo tiempo y es bastante tierno.
![1000367039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo8UFVBuFEi1m1fxy2dsq97essy2a7TRLw7W9eSFZyNoovT6nFaeSbrhafiyRGRnwtk.jpg)
**Cleo con carita adormilada 😍**
![1000367187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpXLuUs5AvDzpDPwR74MxYJyb1mPR2xG6Kwz1UzkrMCwtSK8yH8ZN3Gwnmh72t4ycQs.jpg)
**Una fotito de Ying desprevenido (odia las fotos 😝)**

### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![Sticker-hive-ikki.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK6W53nZk27Way4ADpHJXF3ienr5k8cvBuxY5GRG63otvMAxjSqoZ8DgrDqkvbL.gif)

body.title: A Tropical Escape at Moalboal Beach, Cebu
body.body: > ![yufhv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23vsJTGK3udqN3s9TkTE2AmdEzga8PFg7Kg2HPvZTk6ei4MMqkSPhXWQrajSvdNUMfw2K.jpg) Moalboal is a jewel and this is because it is situated at south western Cebu Philippines and owed to the fact that it has beautiful beaches, colorful underwater world and relaxed environment. I am lucky enough to visit this tropical paradise recently and it was a magical visit. I felt that I was at home because when I came there because of the beauty of the view and the goodness of the locals. In this instance, I am forced to discuss a trip I visited called Moalboal, activities I have done and the experience I had which I will never forget whenever I refer to this visit. ![634708718_1130715385764268_7209833579890196155_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23w2cMqUfcPUNdPmBsSVwGVwnw9pXKwr7ooeHVaeApeAYx45P7XAorF9TFYNVByHhXQE9.jpg) This was completely different as I was travelling in Cebu City to Moalboal. The city lifestyle and the busy streets have been replaced by the woods and the beautiful scenes of the sea. After a few hours of travelling I finally reached my destination. The smell of the ocean in the air and carbonating waves on the beach were my welcomes. ![638122650_2092035371641440_3862304013770557553_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23vhsZCG45f8rBkS38ZKT6BjuFHrC2eojw3ERbuwCiVH6kxpqgD5fvpQGMpiexEWajCmn.jpg) When I finally got to my place of stay that is a beautiful hotel on the beach, I was served of a cool welcome drink by well-wishers. My room was facing the ocean and I could not believe my eyes to see the ocean and I was anticipating to see the beach that was just outside my door. ![637672934_765894453240182_8141436924235585005_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23tbsG45eGuxgWx28JynTXA4eCRfL6WZAVf2Z7J6s29bSSDFKKuZupuEnmy1cnQcbik3B.jpg) I first of all, having settled down, proceeded to the beach. Sand was very fine and powdery and waters of the turquoise were sparkling in the merciless sunshine. I was afraid to imbibe in the beauty of the things adjacent to me, the palm trees, which were swayed by the wind, the laugh of other people on the beach and the wonder of the horizon. ![632584715_1283042400395873_3740713359340505651_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23vhweiEtJ24R86kNxfD1R9eCMCLiD7jAF7Xre9T6JcRD9zbco8kWqBGTsMUDnRBnocSD.jpg) I decided to dive into the sea. The water was shouting and warm and I was instantly overtaken with this feeling of relaxation. I was amazed at the radiant marine life that was literally under water when I was swimming. I was able to watch the fish of every color swimming in the spot and I was anxious to find out more about what Moalboal had to offer. ![634592900_905847185526205_2680729255916014236_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23vsJ5uymDLX2oBDfNULhCxKJnfL34EGgkvzgGT9CpKVccSQ1frwkSaD6XNB2SoMFdK4p.jpg) The fact that I got a chance to snorkel in Pescador Island that is only some few minutes away by boat in Moalboal is one of the activities that I enjoyed during my trip. I did a group guided tour that was accommodative to other tourists and we started early in the morning and made the best out of our day. ![632360146_1991585805106314_468478241423717714_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23wMUEEkYdqPz1X1SRbF55uxDvqU4LjpT4kMnpvfy9XZMpwxXVbdP4Ad9n4xEuj87Ggr6.jpg) Our approach to the island was astonishing as we went through the water beauty. The blue colours were mesmerising and I was barely able to contain myself to jump in. Upon arrival, we received the snorkeling equipment and safety precautions were explained to us. When I finally got there in the water, I was brought to a new atmosphere where I was in a bright under water world. ![636885154_1435861754854136_2158779136525482013_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/2423o3Qu1wqeDTdLU9UHJyRgDvzSjXuv6PGkQ6zq9uCCuXBsGGZPzBzqfzrYeZdaGwvHb.jpg) they had all the life one could get in the school of colorful fish in the coral reefs, and there was also passing a school of reef sharks and sea turtles as elegant as they were agile. It was just but a dream because I was flying through the corals with amazement at the beauty of marine ecosystem. It was a very thrilling and motivating experience and something that made me understand that we ought to preserve our oceans. I was also able to take time and appreciate nature as I had a swim somewhere I was undisturbed. The shades were also offered by the trees in the area and I took my time to consider the tremendous moments that I had already experienced in my trip. It was the ideal revival of my love of traveling, and it is something new to experience, to enjoy nature and leave memories that would last. ![634708718_1130715385764268_7209833579890196155_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23w2cMqUfcPUNdPmBsSVwGVwnw9pXKwr7ooeHVaeApeAYx45P7XAorF9TFYNVByHhXQE9.jpg) As the sun was setting I went back to Moalboal to sleep. It was on golden sun and I was able to find a very comfortable place where I could view the sunset. The sky was painted in orange, pink and purple canvas forming a spectacular background. I had a chance to observe such beauty in this instance. As the sun was setting on the horizon, I was so much determined to make a discovery of the eating scene in the neighborhood. I have discovered a beachfront restaurant where one may get fresh seafoods and traditional Filipino food. I had rice and grilled fish and a serving of the local vegetables. The food was excellent with every bite and the tastes made me feel that I was in the warmth and the warmth of the Philippine. ![638122650_2092035371641440_3862304013770557553_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23vhsZCG45f8rBkS38ZKT6BjuFHrC2eojw3ERbuwCiVH6kxpqgD5fvpQGMpiexEWajCmn.jpg) My visit to Moalboal was a lovely break on the mundane. The three factors that comprised savoury beaches, colourful life at the sea and the friendly nature of the people made it a memorable moment. The past thoughts were filling and now I am watching the beauty of nature in a different light. When I got my bags packed to get away, I felt like I was missing going back. Moalboal was now in love with me and I was aware that it was only going to be the beginning of my adventures in the Philippines. I vowed within myself that I would go back there and have a glimpse of what this beautiful country could bring to me. ![637672934_765894453240182_8141436924235585005_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/23tbsG45eGuxgWx28JynTXA4eCRfL6WZAVf2Z7J6s29bSSDFKKuZupuEnmy1cnQcbik3B.jpg) Moalboal, Cebu is a real heaven to the adventure travelers, relaxation and nature. The beauty of our world was reminding me of the beauty of our planet and this was because of the scenery of the beautiful beaches, the colorful life under the water all the seconds of being in this tropical paradise. It is possible to say that Moalboal can do something to any person regardless of whether he/she is a true diver, a beach lover or just wants to forget about the stress and busy life. ![636885154_1435861754854136_2158779136525482013_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/michelleeeeys/2423o3Qu1wqeDTdLU9UHJyRgDvzSjXuv6PGkQ6zq9uCCuXBsGGZPzBzqfzrYeZdaGwvHb.jpg) I would suggest Moalboal to any person who wishes to travel to the Philippines. It will be lifetime impressions that you will make here and as far as you would wish the beauty of the island. Until next time, Moalboal! [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.030818 lat 123.413954 long d3scr)

---

¡Hola, estimados amigos de Hive Music Festival! Comenzamos una nueva semana para participar y compartir un poco de lo que amamos hacer y, en nuestro caso, la música ocupa un lugar especial. Para esta nueva ronda traigo un tema de Obie Bermúdez, cantante y músico puertorriqueño - estadounidense. El tema en cuestión formó parte de su segundo disco titulado \
(julio, 2003).  Es una de las canciones con las que más se dio a conocer y está ubicada en el género \

, Pop latino con la producción de Cachorro López, bajo el sello discográfico EMI Latin.

Es una canción romántica cuya letra expresa el dolor del fin de una relación amorosa, el horrible sentir de la despedida anunciada y él último beso de amor. Un final que, además de esperado, no fue el mejor para uno de los dos y deja una huella marcada por la nostalgia en el corazón. Siempre me ha gustado porque más allá de su letra melancólica, tiene una hermosa melodía, además de pegajosa.

Para lograr esta canción conté con la inapreciable colaboración de @orlandogonzalez, quien me acompaña en la mayoría de mis participaciones. Un abrazo y mi eterno agradecimiento.

A continuación, les dejo la letra original de \

.

Jamás imaginé que llegaría este día
donde apostaria yo toda mi vida
por amarte y por hablarte otra vez.
Pero que diablos, ya perdí todo mi tiempo
y por mis errores ahora estoy sufriendo,
quisiera regresar.
Pero antes de andar y salir de tu vida
y andar a solas,
quisiera llorar y sacarme de adentro tus besos
tu cuerpo.
Antes, de olvidar
quisiera llorarte una vez más y soñarte
antes, del libro cerrar
quisiera contarte que no me gustó su final.
Antes...
Jamás imaginé que llegaría a perderte
llegué a sentirme tan seguro de tenerte
pero ves mi vida que no fue asi.
Pero que ya diablos, ya perdí todo mi tiempo
y por mis errores ahora estoy sufriendo
quisiera regresar.
Pero antes de andar y salir de tu vida
y andar a solas,
quisiera llorar y sacarme de adentro tus besos
tu cuerpo.
Antes, de olvidar
quisiera llorarte una vez más y soñarte
antes, del libro cerrar
quisiera contarte que no me gustó su final.
Antes, de olvidar
quisiera llorarte una vez más y soñarte
antes, del libro cerrar
quisiera contarte que no me gustó su final.
Antes...

Disfruten y hasta la próxima canción.

ENGLISH VERSION:

Hello, dear friends of Hive Music Festival! We are starting a new week to participate and share a little of what we love to do, and in our case, music occupies a special place. For this new round, I bring you a song by Obie Bermúdez, a Puerto Rican-American singer and musician. The song in question was part of his second album entitled “Confesiones” (July 2003). It is one of the songs that made him most famous and is classified in the “Tropical Music” genre, Latin Pop, produced by Cachorro López, under the EMI Latin record label.

It is a romantic song whose lyrics express the pain of the end of a romantic relationship, the horrible feeling of the announced farewell and the last kiss of love. An ending that, in addition to being expected, was not the best for one of the two and leaves a mark of nostalgia in the heart. I have always liked it because, beyond its melancholic lyrics, it has a beautiful and catchy melody.

To create this song, I had the invaluable collaboration of @orlandogonzalez, who accompanies me in most of my performances. A hug and my eternal gratitude.

Below are the original lyrics to “Antes.”

I never imagined that this day would come
when I would bet my whole life
to love you and talk to you again.
But what the hell, I've already wasted all my time
and now I'm suffering for my mistakes.
I wish I could go back.
But before I walk away and leave your life
and walk alone,
I want to cry and get your kisses
and your body out of me.
Before I forget,
I want to cry for you one more time and dream of you.
Before I close the book,
I want to tell you that I didn't like the ending.
Before...
I never imagined that I would lose you.
I felt so sure that I had you,
but you see, my life, that wasn't the case.
But what the hell, I've already wasted all my time
and now I'm suffering for my mistakes
I want to go back.
But before I walk away and leave your life
and walk alone,
I want to cry and get your kisses out of me
your body.
Before I forget
I want to cry for you one more time and dream of you
before closing the book
I want to tell you that I didn't like the ending.
Before I forget,
I want to cry for you one more time and dream of you.
Before I close the book,
I want to tell you that I didn't like the ending.
Before...

Enjoy, and see you next song.

body.title: Lighting the Journey
body.body:
Today I took another set of black and white photos during my walk, and once again I found myself paying attention to one thing more than anything else, light. ![1000106525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D87Dfiac5QbVBSbfZdZjV9JupfxXsJaqtQdMSPVAhvEgRt9Dc2gB5DwGJJNxBG23.jpg) Lighting makes a photo feel alive. It gives the subject a personality, even when the subject is something simple like a small flower or a cluster of leaves. In one of the shots, the flower is gently lit while the background falls into darkness, and it instantly becomes the main character of the scene. It looks calm, hopeful, and quietly strong. In another photo, the light hits the ground and the textures stand out, broken pieces, dirt, little details that people might usually ignore. But under the right light, even those “ordinary” things become worth looking at. I also captured leaves with visible veins and soft shadows, and I love how monochrome makes them look like sketches. The highlights feel clean, and the darker parts feel heavy, like they’re holding a story. And honestly, I think life works the same way. A brightly lit photo feels happy to me, pleasant, gentle, and easy on the eyes. A dimly lit one feels dramatic, sometimes even sad. It’s not that darkness is “bad,” but it carries a different emotion. It makes you pause longer. It makes you feel something deeper. Maybe that’s how our journey is too. It depends on how we shine light on it. If we choose to focus on the things that push us forward, the path feels brighter. If we only stare at fear and doubt, everything starts to look heavier than it really is. I’m learning that I can’t control every situation, but I can control where I place my attention, just like framing a photo. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000106525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D87Dfiac5QbVBSbfZdZjV9JupfxXsJaqtQdMSPVAhvEgRt9Dc2gB5DwGJJNxBG23.jpg) ![1000106522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo4AeHp23cvhKF5u7fAKNvULiBrKPcu3BqoFkW33eUDWhUBqRASokktHoeYu6qQXgFj.jpg) ![1000106523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAYKwFP5aaL9RP33khmtDPYpJyB4NMAYeKEi2kSR9CA7P7R585meARr7NhDmbuGuEP.jpg) ![1000106521.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCbr4UAvBf9dqZFZyFoWpxdMj89m7LbHiEJPfMQBEcWjApqeFpvYfz1hcRgiZSUnaG.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

body.body:
1/2 🧵 The plot centers on **three converging motivations**:

**Jack Sparrow** wants his ship, the Black Pearl, back. Barbossa led a mutiny years ago, marooned Jack on an island, and stole it. Jack's entire arc is reclaiming what's his—he's less hero, more opportunist with a personal vendetta.

**Will Turner** discovers his father Bootstrap Bill was a pirate. When Barbossa kidnaps Elizabeth (Will's childhood crush), Will learns Bootstrap was cursed along with Barbossa's crew. Bootstrap was tied to a cannon and dropped into the ocean—still alive, immortal, suffering. The crew needs Turner blood to break the curse, making Will the key.

body.body:
2/2 🧵 **Barbossa and his crew** are cursed by stolen Aztec gold from Isla de Muerta. They're undead—can't taste food, feel pleasure, or die. Moonlight reveals their skeletal forms. To lift the curse, every piece of gold must be returned with blood from everyone who took it. They thought Elizabeth was Bootstrap's child (she had the last coin), but it's actually Will.

The climax: Jack and Will infiltrate the island, return the gold with Will's blood, lifting the curse. Barbossa becomes mortal just in time for Jack to shoot him. Jack reclaims the Pearl, Will gets Elizabeth, and everyone wins—except Barbossa, who dies confused about why the apple he finally tasted matters.

The brilliance? It's a heist film disguised as a rescue mission, with all three leads lying to each other the entire time.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 **Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003)**\nCaptain Jack Sparrow arrives in Port Royal to commandeer a ship, but gets caught up with blacksmith Will Turner when the cursed pirate Barbossa kidnaps Elizabeth Swann, the governor's daughter. Barbossa's crew are undead, cursed by Aztec gold they stole. They need Elizabeth's blood to break the curse—but she's the wrong person. Will's blood is actually needed, as his father Bootstrap Bill was part of the original crew. Jack and Will team up, rescue Elizabeth, and lift the curse, leaving Barbossa mortal and defeated.

body.title: WYDARZENIE. Sutartinės – litewskie pieśni wielogłosowe z Beatą Motuk
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKAPU29ZQaEp8xTX9sKVDgGs3o4EEhjGLEXNEDgha99x/sutartines.jpg)  
 
W środę, 25 lutego, spotykamy się w Królestwie, aby pośpiewać sutartinės, czyli litewskie pieśni wielogłosowe. Warsztaty poprowadzi Beata Motuk. Rozpoczęcie o godzinie 20.00. Wstęp wolny, ale jak zwykle można się dobrowolnie opodatkować na rzecz otwartej enklawy.
 
Słowo od Beaty:  
 
Choć na co dzień mieszkam w Polsce, moje serce i korzenie sięgają głęboko w stronę Litwy – krainy lasów, jezior i niezwykłych tradycji muzycznych. To właśnie stamtąd płynie sutartinė – pieśń, którą noszę w sobie przez krew przodków. Jej powtarzalny rytm, misternie splatające się głosy i hipnotyczne brzmienie łączy w sobie historię, wspólnotę i dawne obrzędy.  
 
Z serca Litwy, z mgieł nad jeziorami i szeptu sosnowych lasów, płyną sutartinės – unikalne wielogłosowe pieśni wpisane na listę niematerialnego dziedzictwa UNESCO. To muzyka, która przetrwała wieki, przekazywana z pokolenia na pokolenie w północno-wschodniej Litwie. Jej powtarzalny rytm i misternie splatające się głosy niosły dawniej radość wesel, rytm pracy w polu, a także magię obrzędów i świąt w formie mantry. Sutartinės są wyjątkowym przykładem tradycyjnego śpiewu, w którym prostota formy łączy się z bogactwem brzmienia. Ich hipnotyczny dźwięk potrafi zatrzymać czas i połączyć ludzi – bez względu na wiek, umiejętności czy doświadczenie muzyczne.  
 
Podczas warsztatów wyruszymy w muzyczną podróż, w której krok po kroku nauczymy się kilku sutartinių. Odkryjemy ich puls, wspólny oddech i radość bycia w kręgu głosów. Nie potrzebujesz przygotowania wokalnego – wystarczy otwartość i chęć, by wsłuchać się w siebie nawzajem. Wejdź w krąg. Oddychaj rytmem pieśni. Przyjdź i daj się ponieść głosom, które pamiętają więcej niż my sami.  
 
<center>* * *</center>  
 
On Wednesday, February 25, we meet at Kingdom to sing sutartinės – Lithuanian polyphonic songs. The workshop will be led by Beata Motuk. Starts at 8:00 p.m. Admission is free, but as usual, you can voluntarily contribute to the open enclave.
 
A word from Beata:  
 
Although I live in Poland, my heart and roots reach deeply toward Lithuania – the land of forests, lakes, and extraordinary musical traditions. It is from there that sutartinė flows – a song I carry within me through the blood of my ancestors. Its repetitive rhythm, intricately interwoven voices, and hypnotic sound combine history, community, and ancient rituals.  
 
From the heart of Lithuania, from the mists above the lakes and the whispers of pine forests, flow the sutartinės – unique polyphonic songs inscribed on the UNESCO list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. This is music that has endured for centuries, passed down from generation to generation in northeastern Lithuania. Its repetitive rhythm and intricately entwined voices once carried the joy of weddings, the rhythm of work in the fields, and the magic of rituals and festivals in a mantra-like form. Sutartinės are an exceptional example of traditional singing, where the simplicity of form meets the richness of sound. Their hypnotic tone can stop time and unite people – regardless of age, ability, or musical experience.  
 
During the workshop, we will set off on a musical journey in which, step by step, we will learn several sutartinės. We will discover their pulse, shared breath, and the joy of being in a circle of voices. You don’t need any vocal preparation – only openness and willingness to listen to one another. Enter the circle. Breathe with the rhythm of the song. Come and let yourself be carried away by the voices that remember more than we do.
body.author: krolestwo

body.body:
>

<center> 
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23wzzebmrAGSigY1SVU29PLxxep8rXAf5bFq3QdZ3Gn8yNP2FVZnyhfm83Nu8JPFQR6fd.jpg

Saludos querida comunidad, hace un poco de una mes publiqué un [patito](https://peakd.com/hive-127911/@irenenavarroart/patito-a-crochet-2fd) que hice guiándome por un video tutorial que vi en las redes, desde aquel entonces mi hijo Rafael insistió en hacer uno igual, pero como yo lo hice en hilo acrílico y mi hijo está acostumbrado al estambre le dije que era mejor que lo hiciera con ese material, eligió hacerlo de color estambre amarillo y usar  ganchillo de 3 mm, lo comenzó el mes pasado pero solo trabajo un día en aquel entonces, es un  proyecto muy sencillo de esos que se acaban solo en una jornada, pero como el tenía tiempo sin hacer trabajos a crochet se le dificultó un poco porque era en forma tubular, es decir solo eran 6 puntos bajos en todas las rondas, lo cual dejaba un margen muy estrecho para los movimientos de la aguja, antes de que se frustrara le dije que se lo tomara con calma.

> Greetings dear community, a little over a month ago I posted a [duck](https://peakd.com/hive-127911/@irenenavarroart/patito-a-crochet-2fd) I made following a video tutorial I saw online. Since then, my son Rafael has insisted on making one just like it, but since I made it with acrylic yarn and my son is used to wool, I told him it would be better if he made it with that material. He chose to make it with yellow wool and use a 3 mm crochet hook. He started it last month but only worked on it for one day at that time. It's a very simple project, one of those that can be finished in a single day, but since he hadn't crocheted in a while, he found it a little difficult because it was in a tubular shape, meaning there were only 6 single crochet stitches in each round, which left a very narrow margin for the hook's movements. Before he got frustrated, I told him to take it easy.

<center> 
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJpkXUBo1fQPu8SBGpgnvSNbWjtJ14uqQpMPxB2uCBhmwAxQqjQGzXnknRuMAX2.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
</center>

El dejó el proyecto guardado por muchos días, a veces lo sacaba y hacia pocas hileras y volvía a abandonarlo por un tiempo, pero hoy de la anda sintió ganas de terminarlo y lo hizo, creo que es normal que se dedique al crochet solo cuando se siente inspirado y tranquilo, antes que hacerlo bajo presión, pues hoy todo fluyó de buena manera y pudo hacer incluso las patitas que eran la parte mas pequeña con hilo de 1mm y ganchillo de 1.25mm.

> He left the project stored away for many days, sometimes taking it out and making a few rows before abandoning it again for a while, but today he suddenly felt like finishing it and did. I think it's normal for him to only crochet when he feels inspired and calm, rather than doing it under pressure. Today everything flowed well and he was even able to make the little legs, which were the smallest part, with 1mm yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook.

<center> 
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJkT8kvwz34KRjcaMhebw3dcEdftxYWFTtJjRUkq936hSoycy6iJjdn8kDAk6VW.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
</center>

Yo solo le ayudé con el piquito y a coser las piezas, el se encargó de todo e incluso hasta del asa para colocarlo como llavero, después de haber terminado el proyecto se dio cuenta que realmente era mucho más sencillo que todos los proyectos que hizo anteriormente por lo que no debió haberlo dejado tanto tiempo guardado, está muy contento con su trabajo y eso para mi es la mayor satisfacción 😊

> I only helped him with the little beak and sewing the pieces together; he took care of everything, even the handle to attach it as a keychain. After finishing the project, he realized it was actually much simpler than all the projects he'd done before, so he shouldn't have left it stored away for so long. He's very happy with his work, and that's the greatest satisfaction for me 😊

body.title: We are not for everyone...
body.body:
>

>Has it happened to you? ... Rejection hurts, it burns us to the skin and makes us doubt even what we call ourselves. Rejection does not speak of our value but of what the other cannot give. Of course, that doesn't mean that we don't care or that they're missing out. I'm not going to tell them that it doesn't matter because the truth is that rejection does hurt, but I've learned that what's important to me is that someone else's NO is either a diagnosis of who I am, it's a filter and IT's NOT a retaining wall and understanding this allows me not to suffer unnecessarily. Our value is ours, but let's not stay and live from there. Because that's not where they don't see us. That's like begging for attention or forcing a bond where there was already rejection, that's emotional neglect. It's even worth convincing someone that we're worth it. We have to learn to differentiate the I hurt from the I'm no good for anything. We must have the courage to nip in the bud the profile of those people who reject us. I think it's the best way to get back to our center to remember that we are good. In addition, in this way we avoid handing over control of our lives to people who do not know us thoroughly. Accepting rejection, even if it hurts, puts us on the path to a solution.More self-love, and more self-awareness. Of course, it hurts that they don't choose you, even if inside you pretend to be strong and we tell ourselves that we don't care. That rejection is life pushing us out of where we have left to come back to you. I have withdrawn from where I have been rejected, with fear, with uncertainty, trembling But I have withdrawn, I left never to return again. It was the best decision, because I found myself again. I took back my place in my own life. Now I live for myself, and I feel at peace. I recognize myself as someone brave who knew how to choose himself. We have to learn to get out of that loop where it prevails: \

. Everyone must take care of their wounds and know how to choose themselves and not stay where they are not being valued. We must not let ourselves fall by the rejection of others so that our light never goes out because dignity is not negotiable. I am talking about the inability of the other. And yes, does it hurt to deal with rejection? What do we do? Well, dealing with rejection is not expecting to be accepted, it's being very clear that the opinion of others does not define us. Janitze 🦋

1/2 🧵 **Back to School** (1986) is a comedy about Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield), a wealthy but uneducated businessman who owns a chain of tall-and-fat clothing stores. When his son Jason struggles at college and considers dropping out, Thornton enrolls as a student himself to encourage him to stay.

Thornton's unorthodox approach to college life — bribing professors, hiring Kurt Vonnegut to write his own paper, throwing massive parties — clashes with the academic establishment, particularly Dean Martin (not the singer). He hires a team of experts to do his homework while romancing English professor Dr. Diane Turner.

The climax comes when Thornton must pass his finals honestly to avoid expulsion. He actually studies for the first time in his life and passes oral exams by applying his real-world business experience to economics questions. Jason gains confidence, makes the diving team, and both father and son graduate together.

body.title: Inter triunfa y se mantiene lider en la Serie A [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> Milán es ese lugar que se caracteriza por la moda, diseño, historia y carácter. Pero visto desde otro punto de vista es un lugar donde el fútbol es exigente, profesional y un espectáculo. Por eso hoy el gran equipo del Inter de Milán jugaba para seguir creando historias y construyendo un equipo sólido, competitivo y cada vez más cerca de poder levantar esa copa en la Serie A. Le tocaba enfrentarse al US Lecce siendo un partido muy esperado, que parecía accesible, pero que en el campo exigió paciencia, orden y ese nivel de fútbol que caracteriza a los dos equipos que saben competir por objetivos grandes. >Milan is a place known for fashion, design, history, and character. But from another perspective, it is also a place where soccer is demanding, professional, and spectacular. That's why today the great Inter Milan team played to continue creating history and building a solid, competitive team that is getting closer and closer to lifting the Serie A trophy. They faced US Lecce in a highly anticipated match that seemed accessible, but on the field demanded patience, order, and the level of soccer that characterizes two teams that know how to compete for big goals. ![ineetr.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbDfAzKtNQKrXgqVsFEFqKmFLWEAbXzwpUcmSbWbbw6Es/ineetr.jpg) El gran estadio San Siro fue ese lugar donde ambos equipos les toco jugar esos noventa minutos, como una nueva jornada Serie A, competencia que viene cada vez más fuerte semana tras semana, pocos errores y los partidos se resuelven más con cabeza que con espectáculo. En ese encuentro el Lecce tenía que pararse firme, con un bloqueo, líneas juntas y la intención de incomodar cada circulación local y poder buscar esa anotación lo más rápido posible. Durante los primeros minutos de juego el equipo del Inter tuvo la posesión, el territorio y la iniciativa, pero no la claridad, algo que le estaba afectando mucho, como también se notó falta de velocidad entre líneas y ese último pase que rompiera el orden y anotar. Muchas veces el dominio fue para el Inter y lograron hacer varios disparos, pero ya desperados de que el gol no llegaba y el tiempo avanzaba. Mientes que, por otro lado, el equipo del Lecce resistía, muy bien ordenado, disciplinado y esperando su oportunidad al contragolpe, puesto que sabían que esa potencia de un equipo local podía terminar. El inter siguió insistiendo, realizó algunos cambios y cuando el partido comenzaba a entrar en esa zona peligrosa donde la ansiedad puede jugar en contra, el Inter encontró el momento justo para abrir el marcador. Ese primero gol llegó que dejó a todos sorprendidos por la gran circulación del balón entre los jugadores, desde una segunda línea y contundencia en el área. Todo el estadio respiró aliviado, a pesar de que el partido estaba muy cerrado y podían pasar muchas cosas. >The great San Siro stadium was the venue where both teams played those ninety minutes, as part of another Serie A matchday, a competition that is getting stronger week after week, with few mistakes and games being decided more by brains than by spectacle. In that match, Lecce had to stand firm, with a block, tight lines, and the intention of disrupting every local move and looking for that goal as quickly as possible. # >During the first minutes of play, Inter had possession, territory, and the initiative, but not clarity, something that was affecting them greatly. There was also a noticeable lack of speed between the lines and that final pass that would break the order and score. Inter dominated for long periods and managed to get several shots on goal, but they were desperate as the goal did not come and time was running out. Meanwhile, Lecce resisted, very well organized, disciplined, and waiting for their chance on the counterattack, as they knew that the home team's power could run out. # >Inter kept pushing, made some changes, and just as the game was entering that dangerous zone where anxiety can play against you, Inter found the right moment to open the scoring. That first goal came as a surprise to everyone, thanks to the great ball movement between the players, from the second line and the forcefulness in the area. The whole stadium breathed a sigh of relief, even though the game was very close and anything could happen. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWDWG1fDwydANrdkAwC9pZ7YBTKxqCUjoZVPoNHtre53H/image.png) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/Inter/status/2025300105608269925) Con esa pequeña ventaja el Inter cambió el ritmo, ya que no necesitaba apresurarse, sino jugar inteligente, mover más el balón y aprovechar esos espacios que aparecieron cuando el Lecce cometió errores y adelantó líneas. Pero la diversión continuó con la llegada de ese segundo gol, donde se notó una transición rápida, decisión en los metros finales, efectiva e imposible de tapar, donde el Inter con esa anotación cerró el encuentro con un 2-0 que habla más de control que de espectáculo. Siendo un equipo que cuando juega ordenado, compiten, minimiza errores, todo le saldrá muy bien. El Lecce, no logró hacer nada para este encuentro a un así dio batalla, mostró cómo es jugar ordenado, solidario y competitivo durante muchos minutos. Pero ante un rival con mayor calidad y profundidad de plantilla, resistir no siempre es suficiente. Ese estadio se mantiene invicto y este es un triunfo muy importante que permite seguir soñando y estar en la cima, porque la carrera de la Serie A, a penas está comenzando. >With that slight advantage, Inter changed the pace, as they didn't need to rush, but rather play smart, move the ball around more, and take advantage of the spaces that appeared when Lecce made mistakes and pushed forward. But the fun continued with the arrival of that second goal, which featured a quick transition, decisive play in the final meters, effective and impossible to stop, with Inter closing out the match with a 2-0 score that speaks more of control than spectacle. As a team that plays in an orderly fashion, competes, and minimizes mistakes, everything will turn out very well for them. # >Lecce, despite putting up a fight, was unable to make an impact on this match, showing how to play in an organized, supportive, and competitive manner for many minutes. However, against an opponent with greater quality and depth in its squad, resistance is not always enough. body.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmU4i4vyKWttG3a9LLfUNDoxq7iFuSEgB4xxtbWhVPNP7t/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=lazybug/e814ff83)

---

<center><sup>The thumbnail was created in Canva.</sup></center>

<div class=\

>

Following a meeting with Chief Arish, I set out to repair the NSC coolant pumps. After surviving a surprise encounter with explosive Hiss enemies, I navigated a power-locked cage door by replacing power cores. I cleared a large chamber of floating Hiss soldiers using Launch strikes to maintain a safe distance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmav3ZwCuX1zEWQ47zRVU5pYUQwHwf9sueZQonr4Y7uBHw/screenshot_1_.png)

After having the last conversation with Chief Arish in the security control room, my mission was updated to fix the NSC coolant pumps and the energy converters. I left him in the room to begin the process.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMUZkTp5VcFrn11rTK9aAmqY4hx52rpn7JTfugoJ9KHw/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRUS4J8PCbySbZDHMwT2y7K4K1ArooEsgZLxzVx6tN2X/screenshot_3_.png)

I went to the sign area directly and noticed the NSC coolant pumps were to the left and the energy converters were to the right. I decided to head towards the coolant pumps first to start the repairs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRZsYCbnPLtG1dN5v7ko6o9mVWS6QsNVJJJUSdU26kyG/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQeJL93SgFeKAXyKLNHrfYNJR852bdZaHD4brKKFgLwq/screenshot_5_.png)

When I was getting towards the door, some new kinds of evil beings came out and started trying to attack me. They were getting blown up when they got close, which unfortunately killed me very fast.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMFzQyM1YfHy7baLNpeg72YLjeefg1kpzhbRVs1EgZ5M/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrE66HvYYLWZY4FjCyQNt1rRPKJhiUAzEdGXrFgTxvVZ/screenshot_7_.png)

At the restart, I approached that same door again, but I didn't find any of those explosive beings this time. It felt a little weird, as if the Hiss had changed their defensive strategy during the reset.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmba3Ct93GZNj2dASzZYYC62mJzdmgCMSET183jwarVR12/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrmcGZtphWvAwctoi38PYSXrb7RcMgWKaozBdQzroicA/screenshot_9_.png)

I went inside and noticed a big red room on the other side of a cage door. There was a small room on my right where I found a material that was added to my assets.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3sK9rTVnHcfHSPtAEPq6aXXmVEy6LJJQsN9FGKh69Mo/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTeqwamyDaVjAsi35UtXeStjn5QV9etijeToJVSH197f/screenshot_12_.png)

The cage door was closed because of a power cut, so I had to replace the parts using my Launch ability. I launched a power core into the socket to restore energy to the mechanism.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUk9a5zAVzjgLpL3pWfHtBZxaZ23usCskJEp5J9T4TSVL/screenshot_13_.png)

The door opened once the part was replaced, and I noticed there were several Hiss soldiers floating in the air. I started attacking them immediately before they had a chance to land and take cover.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaX4NTvhVppSj8NgigQKuD5JsZWFEpzbNSMp5FZEo7YJ2/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcQSmLoYKJ91XUrPKSXrmt9U4WCfVPvrb1fYVijt1Vr1/screenshot_15_.png)

I moved ahead and found many soldiers below who were shooting at me. While I was winning the fight, a special enemy came close and blew up, nearly taking me along with the blast.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakQTffG21JtZcgz7WsG4KNaA7PNdkaNnuyXX2F28ZH2P/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhQwzkzQB8gapRiNtsVE8t7AyaNSpucCmu5FkQgkeV5H/screenshot_17_.png)

I had to be super careful this time to stay at a distance. I cleared the room by throwing heavy obstacles at the enemies from afar, ensuring they exploded well away from my position.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVYLsRbo8ycMCsp5v1bcnQuvaw8Hh5Zfm4jyvHYEBkUuq/screenshot_18_.png)

At last, I had to clean the remaining threats in this area. I began looking for my next entrance towards the coolant pumps that I would finally have to fix up to progress.

**To be Continued...**

---

body.body:
