**ESPAÑOL**
---

#

En estos días de asueto que pasaron, decidí descansar lo más que pude, y no siempre tenía deseos de cocinar aunque es una de mis actividades favoritas. Me antojé de comer asado en leña pero con chicharrón que es típico de estas tierras llaneras. Así que visité un rinconcito típico que está en la parte externa del Centro Comercial Rahme en la Av. Intercomunal del Tigre/Tigrito.

Tienen un espacio techado frente a la panadería, al aire libre, y sirven el asado en combos acompañados de ensalada, yuca sancochada, arepitas y guasacaca. Venden las porciones por gramos desde 250gr en adelante. La atención es excelente y tienen buenos precios. Yo lo pedí para llevar porque ya era mediodía y venía de hacer compras, quería disfrutar mi antojo en la casa. Fue una buena elección y la recomiendo para los que viven entre las dos ciudades, y por supuesto en la Urb. Rahme. Atienden de viernes a domingo a partir del mediodía.

#

<div class = \

> **ENGLISH** --- # During the recent holidays, I decided to rest as much as possible, and I didn't always feel like cooking, even though it's one of my favorite things to do. I was craving wood-fired barbecue with chicharrón, a typical dish from these plains. So I visited a little spot right outside the Rahme Shopping Center on the Intercomunal Avenue in Tigre/Tigrito. They have a covered area across from the bakery, an open-air space, and they serve barbecue in combo meals with salad, boiled yucca, small arepas, and guasacaca (a Chilean salsa). They sell portions by the gram, starting at 250 grams. The service is excellent, and the prices are good. I ordered it to go because it was already midday, and I had just finished shopping; I wanted to enjoy my craving at home. It was a great choice, and I recommend it to anyone who lives between the two cities, and of course, in the Rahme neighborhood. They're open from Friday to Sunday, starting at noon.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![O5ReObVsvHogLBPC_IMG_20260222_072536.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/O5ReObVsvHogLBPC_IMG_20260222_072536/O5ReObVsvHogLBPC_IMG_20260222_072536.webp)
![bxHsMJrNyDDdpHmB_IMG_20260222_072448.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/bxHsMJrNyDDdpHmB_IMG_20260222_072448/bxHsMJrNyDDdpHmB_IMG_20260222_072448.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

正月初六是马日，作为一年中的第一个“六”。寓意着一帆风顺，马到功成。据说60年一遇！

早上煮了面条➕糖心荷包蛋（说需要流心，代表马眼睛👀），还放了家姐买的鸡肉丝，香油，醋和胡椒粉，出锅后整体感觉还不错（哈哈哈直接端着锅吃的）

吃完早餐胃部都暖烘烘的舒服，外面的风有些大，凉嗖嗖的，但提前吃饭续了能量，就没像一些路人那样觉得冷了（给吃早饭的机智人都点个赞😄👍🏻

和昨天下午北京的沙尘暴➕大风对比，今天好太多哦！当时恨不得把自己全副武装，路上还遇到了两个中学生，女生讲自己手机上天气预报是晴朗风和日丽，男生指着窗外：这沙尘满天飞，你跟我讲天气好?给你看看我的——大风预警➕沙尘，看自己手机也得对比真实天气情况再发表哈……听他俩对话还怪好玩嘞（光明正大的偷听，我就坐在对面嘿嘿）

而此刻坐在车上也遇到了有趣的奶奶，她一路在看旁边的建筑物，然后和爷爷聊哪些美观，哪些安全措施做的更好等等，哈哈哈可惜我先下车了呢

对了对了，赤马年赤马日㊗️hive涨涨涨！
㊗️所有人一帆风顺！马到成功！

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，身体安康！**

body.title: A day where nothing happened.  My Actifit Report Card: February 22 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ae5ebd44-3b14-4a20-a8b7-e1ae72be02c6.jpg) Well I did get my 10K steps today but not from anything particularly interesting. As my wife has gone back home I'm by myself. When it is just me I have little desire to go out of the hotel. I don't need to buy anything. I don't need to explore anything. My goals are simple: Eat properly, Exercise often, Ready Bible / Pray, and make posts on Hive. Then when I've done the important stuff... Watch anime and play video games :) So back on diet eating at breakfast. How do I survive the hotel buffet without getting fat (and hopefully lose weight)? Just eat the high protein foods plus salad. Salad to start so I don't over eat. 4-6 eggs (or even better egg whites) A few sausages. Some chicken. Yogurt. Soy Milk (instead of juice). Lots of protein. Decent calories and I avoid the fun stuff. * The ice cream machine (yummy but not diet friendly) * The doughnuts, croissants, cakes and pastries * The fried potatoes * The fruit juice * The pancakes, waffles and crepes :) Goal: drop 18kg. It was 22kg but the first 4kg has come off. So to answer the question how did I get all my steps today? 1. Walked to the indomaret (convenience store) to buy a bunch of diet sprite and diet coca cola. Enough for one a day as a treat later in the day. 2. Spent a lot of time on the treadmill And I suppose 3. Walk around the gym on my break between sets while doing my upper body weight training :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ece62fa5-ad7c-4347-9082-b9f7f7df6d8e.jpg) And that's it. That's my almost 11K steps today Thanks for dropping by. Until tomorrow

body.title: Film Review: 5X2 (Cinq fois deux, 2004)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/ToHe5BbOxhhmTx8txIJLM45ff8.jpg)



European arthouse cinema at times can look as depending on cheap gimmick and \

as mainstream Hollywood; an example can be found in *5x2*, French drama directed by François Ozon. While the film is technically proficient and offers a sharp critique of bourgeois relationships, it ultimately suffers from a reliance on stylistic flourishes that feel calculated rather than organic. The plot, based on the script Ozon had written together with Emmanuèle Bernheim, chronicles the marriage between Gilles Ferrond (played by Stéphane Freiss) and Marion Chamard (played by Valeria Bruni Tedeschi). It is a study in dissolution, presented through a narrative structure that prioritises form over pure emotional resonance.

The plot begins on 17 February 2003, at the moment of the marriage’s end. Both spouses sign divorce papers, having already reached an agreement regarding property division and joint custody over their young son, Nicolas. They briefly reunite in a hotel room for what is supposed to be a farewell sex, but the scene devolves into violence. Gilles rapes his ex-wife, and she leaves him in disgust. This act of brutality sets the tone for the film, suggesting a relationship defined by failure and resentment. The plot then goes back in time in four segments, each in reverse chronological order, showing various points in which their marriage and relationship deteriorated.

The first flashback takes place at a dinner party where Gilles and Marion host Gilles' middle-aged gay brother, Christophe (played by Antoine Chappey), and his young lover, Mathieu (played by Marc Ruchmann). Despite all the joviality and the consumption of fine food, the conversation turns to infidelity, revealing the deep tensions festering beneath the surface of the spouses' lives. The next scene shows Marion going into premature labour. Gilles finds all kinds of excuses not to rush to the hospital, treating the event as an inconvenience rather than a crisis. Later, when he finally arrives after Nicolas is born, he is chastised by his mother-in-law, Monique (played by Françoise Fabian). Even on such an occasion, she cannot help but quarrel with her husband, Bernard (played by Michael Lonsdale), further illustrating the dysfunction that permeates the family unit.

The timeline then moves to the couple's wedding, which is portrayed as a joyous occasion. However, Gilles is afterwards too drunk and physically exhausted to have sex with his new bride. Marion, in frustration, slips out of the hotel room and walks near bushes where she is spotted by an unnamed American tourist (played by Jason Tavassoli). She has sex with him before returning to the hotel room to her unsuspecting husband. The final segment is set in an Italian beachside resort visited by Gilles and his long-term girlfriend, Valérie (played by Géraldine Pailhas). The same resort is visited by Marion, whom Gilles casually knows as a PR agent for his firm and who arrived there by coincidence after being stood up by her friend on a trip to Senegal. Gilles and Marion keep bumping into each other, and Valérie can't fail noticing that Gilles appears to enjoy Marion's company. While Valérie goes hiking, Gilles decides to join Marion at the beach, and at sunset, two of them go to swim together. This idyllic scene confirms their future together, offering a fleeting moment of hope amidst the wreckage of the marriage.

Ozon's film is well-directed and well-written; the same can be said for the quality of acting. The cast includes an old and recognisable name of character actor Michael Lonsdale, who brings gravitas to the role of Bernard. Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, sister of the former French First Lady Carla Bruni and later renowned as a director in her own right, bravely handles her complex role. She is forced to play the same character in different stages of the relationship and also appears nude and in some rather graphic sex scenes, a testament to her commitment to the material.

Ozon, by his own admission, found inspiration in Ingmar Bergman's classic film *Scenes from a Marriage*. However, behind all this is rather a clinical approach to modern marriage and the life of the upper middle class in French society. Ozon, who is gay, tries to \

with gay themes. These themes not only include the protagonist's brother but the protagonist himself discussing his own homosexual experiences during a drug-fuelled orgy attended with his wife. Ozon also tries to signal switches in time with the use of Italian pop music standards. This is a nice stylistic choice, although not always used consistently.

Yet, behind all this is pure gimmick – namely the now very fashionable use of a non-linear narrative structure, with events being portrayed in reverse chronological order. While the structure works to create dramatic irony and emphasizes the inevitability of the couple's failure, it is nevertheless very gimmicky. Some of the more perceptive or more cynical viewers could – due to that very structure and some of the content that involves rape, sexual encounters with strangers, and pregnancy – describe *5x2? as some sort of Ozon's remake of Gaspar Noé's *[Irreversible](https://peakd.com/hive-121744/@drax/film-review-irreversible-20)*, although it is much less graphic and directed in a more disciplined way that make it more digestible for the audience.

RATING: 6/10 (++)

body.title: Carnavales, municipio Mariño, Nueva Esparta [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRu3Ho8axeoFcYTru8XHJ9kS2DN5iVSCeDwS9UmpmYHhm/1771711064894.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxehYiNhy3dGdGRkV5YhNr1Xthv3seVh4giEtZHo39CK/1771711351714.jpg)

Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos, cómo están? Feliz sábado, ¿qué tal sus días de descanso? A los que andamos en esa como yo, de verdad lo necesitaba, pero hay días en los que no quiero nada porque hago más en casa, jajajajaja.

Aprovechando que estamos en la semana del lindo carnaval, porque a mí me encanta, me dicen: “Vámonos a ver el desfile y yo soy la primera que está feliz arreglándose para salir; nuestra primera visita fue el desfile del Municipio Mariño, más específicamente Porlamar.

<blockquote>

Hello, how are you, friends? How are you doing? Happy Saturday! How are your days off going? For those of us who are like me, we really needed it, but there are days when I don't want anything because I get more done at home, hahahaha.

Taking advantage of the fact that it's the week of the beautiful carnival, because I love it, they say to me, \

and I'm the first one who's happy to get ready to go out. Our first visit was to the parade in the Mariño Municipality, more specifically Porlamar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdnjzf7mG4VhqNLA331zHjJMsXbvVGFAG5Rge8frHCh6/1771711123230.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2PqftHgL3SXLbcxu4HrB2L2wo6n5MHuBzwoVpzcsQJ6/1771711123815.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcLrG3T52DcF3cPjTEcbTxjDeHp6i2FpoUVrrtqe6xSrp/1771711124368.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgnCgUjFXAYYYnSVx5xDiWeuGo42zA9BHX7uqeokdoSU/1771711124887.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxehYiNhy3dGdGRkV5YhNr1Xthv3seVh4giEtZHo39CK/1771711365801.jpg) Yo, la verdad, es que no tenía planificado ir, pero ese día mi sobrina quería ir y le dijo a su papá. Yo estaba descansando y ellos se entusiasmaron a ir un rato a verlos y mi sobrina me fue a invitar, y en cierta parte porque me quiere y, por otro lado, porque su mamá le da pena tomar las fotos y a mí no, y a ella le encanta tomarse muchas fotos. Nos fuimos como a eso de las 3 y media y ya a las 4 estábamos allá; a pesar de que ya había mucha gente emocionada esperando el desfile, este aún no había salido, así que nos tocó esperar un buen rato, porque otras veces que he ido no se ha tardado tanto, pero esta vez salió tipo a las 6; fue que pasó por la 4 de mayo, aunque este sale muchísimo más adelante. Me pareció que venían supertarde en comparación con otros años; además de eso venían muy separados.
To be honest, I hadn't planned on going, but that day my niece wanted to go and told her dad. I was resting and they were excited to go and see them for a while, and my niece came to invite me, partly because she loves me and partly because her mum is embarrassed to take photos and I'm not, and she loves taking lots of photos. We left at about half past three and by four we were there. Even though there were already lots of excited people waiting for the parade, it hadn't started yet, so we had to wait quite a while. Other times I've been, it hasn't taken so long, but this time it started at about six. It passed by 4 de Mayo, although it starts much further ahead. It seemed to me that they were very late compared to other years; besides that, they were very spread out.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwMHDVZnw9GYH8mVZmzoPisDFBGEkFwrgnFrRiQvtVNg/1771711168322.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNrK8DXs96bgu156ATbkkTncb9HHYbU4KHKAoC2UrBDhR/1771711168814.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTW3uRbhYCFfQiCTQjzKkre8gRve9NpegngBEZF19NjF/1771711169338.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRHqMN2q6GYWFWVD7AYDoadpmcpjxENBgRUsxx1a5KXfR/1771711169862.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeJBsSXTML7jUx8p934wDhm383WwDSRyYvHeW3ejTnqg/1771711170460.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxehYiNhy3dGdGRkV5YhNr1Xthv3seVh4giEtZHo39CK/1771711378607.jpg) La lluvia de colores y caramelos que a mí me encanta. Esta vez este carnaval se caracterizó por una gran cantidad de bandas show y grupos de samba, siendo las carrozas y comparsas poco numerosas, pero las que se encontraban estaban muy coloridas, iniciando por la popular ñera, que es la primera que inicia el desfile, una señora mayor muy conocida por los margariteños y querida, que siempre le encanta participar. La verdad es que se nos hizo la noche pero la pasamos muy bien observando todo el desfile hasta que finalizara y luego bajamos a casita, la verdad estaban muy bonitos y yo particularmente amando los colores ¡Saludos!
The shower of colours and sweets that I love. This time, the carnival featured a large number of show bands and samba groups, with few floats and dance troupes, but those that were there were very colourful, starting with the popular ñera, who is the first to start the parade, an elderly lady well known and loved by the people of Margarita, who always loves to participate. The truth is that the night flew by, but we had a great time watching the whole parade until it ended and then we went home. They were really beautiful and I particularly loved the colours. Cheers!

It was a competitive, strange sort of game because the Sixers were in striking range to take the lead for a long period of time, but the Hawks did a good job at keeping them at bay. The Sixers are now 0-3 vs the Hawks this season and have officially lost the season series vs them. This could potentially come back to bite them if they both finish with the same record which is certainly possible as the Sixers are now 30-25 and the Hawks are 27-31. 

Tonight the Sixers will be down south in New Orleans to face the 15-42 Pelicans and so they MUST find a way to win even without Joel Embiid who hasn't seen in action in two calendar weeks. The All-Star break was in between this time period but I was actually anticipating that break would have *helped*, not hurt, Embiid's chances at playing more down the stretch. He's now dealing with calf soreness in addition to his knee issues. 

The Sixers need to just stop viewing Embiid as a franchise player and just try to win. Pray that he can be healthy for the playoffs and go from there. 

I like big men Andre Drummond and Adem Bona for the most part and hopefully they can produce a little better. 

Tyrese Maxey needs to have a big game soon and also, Quentin Grimes needs to do something. I am almost starting to wonder if the Sixers should have kept Jared McCain especially considering Paul George is also out...

Well, let's see what happens I guess. I just want the guys to chalk up a W by any means!!!

body.title: Why is the Sky Blue? A Physics Explorer's Guide
body.body:
🔵 Why is the sky blue? It's such a simple question, but the answer is pure physics magic! Let me take you on a journey through the atmosphere to discover the secret behind that beautiful blue dome above us.

## 🌞 The Everyday Wonder
Imagine you're lying on a grassy hill on a clear summer day. The sun is shining brightly, and when you look up, you see that familiar, gorgeous **blue sky**. But have you ever stopped to wonder: *Why* is it blue? Why not yellow like the sun or black like space? That's where physics comes in!

## 🌌 The Phenomenon: Rayleigh Scattering
The blue color of the sky is caused by something called **Rayleigh scattering**. This is when sunlight gets scattered in all directions by tiny molecules in our atmosphere, especially nitrogen and oxygen.

Here's the key: blue light has a much **shorter wavelength** (around 450 nanometers) compared to other colors like red (around 700 nanometers). These shorter blue wavelengths get scattered about **16 times more** than red light!

## 🧮 The Physics Behind It
The intensity of scattered light is given by this formula:

```math
I \propto \frac{1}{\lambda^4}
```

This means the scattering intensity is **inversely proportional to the fourth power of the wavelength (λ)**. So, if blue light has about half the wavelength of red light, it gets scattered **16 times more** (because 2⁴ = 16). That's why blue dominates our sky!

Let's do a quick calculation:
- Wavelength of blue light: **450 nm**
- Wavelength of red light: **700 nm**
- Ratio of wavelengths: 700/450 ≈ 1.56
- Scattering ratio: (1.56)⁴ ≈ **6 times more scattering for blue**

## 📊 Visualization
Here's a simple ASCII diagram to help you picture what's happening:

```
        Sunlight
          |
          V
          O  <- Air molecule
         /|
        / |
Blue ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
Red ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ (Less scattered)
          |
          V
        Your Eyes
```

The blue light gets scattered in all directions, filling the sky with blue, while the red light mostly travels straight through.

## 🌍 Application: Why Sunsets Are Red
This same physics explains why sunsets are often red or orange. When the sun is low on the horizon, its light has to pass through much **more atmosphere**. Most of the blue light gets scattered away, leaving the longer red wavelengths to reach your eyes. That's why sunsets are so stunning!

## 🤔 Think About It
If we had an atmosphere made mostly of different gases, would the sky still be blue? What color might it be? (Hint: Think about the size of the molecules and how they scatter light!)

## Difficulty: 3/5
This concept requires some understanding of light waves and scattering, but the basic idea is quite accessible once you see how the math works!

## 📜 Historical Context
This phenomenon was first explained by the British physicist **Lord Rayleigh** in 1871. He figured out that the scattering of light by small particles could explain why the sky is blue. His work laid the foundation for our understanding of light scattering in the atmosphere.

So next time you look up at that beautiful blue sky, remember: it's not just a pretty color – it's physics in action! 💙🔵💙

body.title: Amazon (AMZN) - E-Commerce & Cloud Powerhouse Analysis
body.body:
## Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) - NASDAQ Tech Leader

Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) is currently trading at **$204.86** with a market capitalization of **$2.20T** as of **20.02.2026**. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Amazon has grown from an online bookstore to a global leader in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.

## Business Model & Revenue Streams

Amazon's business model is diversified across several key segments:

1. **E-Commerce**: The core retail business includes online stores, physical stores, and third-party seller services.
2. Amazon Web Services (AWS): The cloud computing division provides on-demand cloud computing platforms and APIs to individuals, companies, and governments.
3. Subscription Services: Includes Amazon Prime (streaming video and music, free shipping), Kindle Unlimited, and Audible.
4. **Advertising**: Growing segment leveraging Amazon's vast customer data for targeted ads.

## Financial Highlights

| Metric          | 2023    | 2024    | 2025    |
|-----------------|---------|---------|---------|
| Revenue (TTM)   | $514.0B | $578.3B | $632.1B |
| Net Income (TTM)| $30.6B  | $34.2B  | $38.7B  |
| EPS (TTM)       | $3.05   | $3.41   | $3.86   |

- **P/E Ratio (TTM)**: 67.1
- **Dividend Yield**: 0.00% (Amazon does not pay dividends)
- R&D Expenditure (2025): $64B
- Patents Granted (2025): 2,450

## Growth vs. Profitability

Amazon has consistently prioritized growth over profitability, reinvesting heavily in new ventures and technology. While this strategy has led to impressive revenue growth, it has also resulted in lower profit margins compared to some tech peers. However, AWS has emerged as a highly profitable segment, contributing significantly to overall profitability in recent years.

## Strengths & Competitive Advantages

1. Market Dominance: Amazon is the undisputed leader in e-commerce and cloud computing.
2. Diversified Revenue Streams: Multiple high-growth segments reduce reliance on any single market.
3. **Innovation & R&D**: Heavy investment in R&D fuels continuous innovation and patent generation.
4. **Network Effect**: The vast ecosystem of sellers and buyers creates a powerful network effect.

## Risks & Challenges

1. Regulatory Scrutiny: Amazon faces increasing antitrust and regulatory challenges globally.
2. Intense Competition: Competes with giants like Microsoft (Azure), Google (Cloud), and Alibaba in various segments.
3. Profitability Pressure: Balancing growth investments with profitability expectations remains a challenge.

## Future Outlook

Amazon's strategy focuses on:

1. **Expanding AWS**: Continuing to grow the high-margin cloud computing business.
2. Enhancing Prime Membership: Adding more value to Prime to increase subscriber retention and acquisition.
3. **Global Expansion**: Particularly in emerging markets with growing e-commerce adoption.
4. **AI & Automation**: Leveraging AI to improve operations, customer experience, and create new products.

The Total Addressable Market (TAM) for Amazon's key segments remains enormous, with cloud computing and global e-commerce still in relatively early stages of adoption in many regions.

This analysis provides insights into Amazon's current position and future prospects. Investors should conduct their own research before making investment decisions.

> I look at this week's image and, for a moment, the dry cold that is slowly dissipating here in Ontario disappears, returning me to the mist of the Hotel Humboldt. I remember back in Caracas, where ice is a prefabricated miracle suspended on a mountaintop, a secret known only to those of us who climbed El Ávila. Who would have thought that, sixteen years later, that same crunch of ice under my feet would be as commonplace as a game of rubber ball on the streets of my childhood. Thank you, @freewritehouse, for the initiative [A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw) and the unique image that I will describe in detail below.
# ***
Perhaps she'll manage a perfect Axel
*** In the photograph, I see a little warrior dressed in gold and feathers. She is not just a young girl skating; she is the living portrait of concentration. Her outstretched arms seek the balance of the world, and in her gaze—fixed, almost feline—I perceive that tension that precedes glory or disaster. Although her name is lost in the records of promising young athletes (for she represents every dreamer who has ever stepped onto a rink), her posture reminds me of Katarina Witt's elegance and Michelle Kwan's unwavering determination. When I see her, I can't help but feel a knot of empathy in my chest. I feel the icy air cutting into my cheeks and the weight of expectations. It's the same feeling I experienced when I saw the film Right on Track. There is a scene that lives on in me; when Erica Enders, after a terrifying accident, summons her courage and returns to the track. That moment was not to prove anything to the stopwatch, but to tell herself and, without knowing it, her sponsor and the world that fear has no place here. Talent is beauty, yes, but strength is what keeps you standing when the ice becomes treacherous.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQTBZJ7P8BDrdx9VphV1WNvZcoTHqGQiBM7rNJxmgWB9/freew.png) [Image prompt from the initiation, courtesy of Pixabay.](https://pixabay.com/photos/figure-skater-ice-skater-ice-266512/)
My own youth was a constant learning process about gravity. Like the Japanese proverb we adopted as our motto, my life has been an exercise in “falling seven times, getting up eight”. Because in skating, as in life, falling is not failure; failure is staying down in the cold. I am reminded of a truth that has guided my steps since I left my homeland: ‘Our destiny is not determined by the number of times we stumble, but by the number of times we get up, dust ourselves off and move on.’ These words by Dieter F. Uchtdorf resonate today more than ever. It doesn't matter if we're on the Humboldt runway looking at the lights of Caracas, or in a covered arena in Canada under perpetual snow; the essence is the same. The girl in the photo, with her perfect braids and velvet outfit, is about to perform a spin. Perhaps she will land a perfect Axel, or perhaps the edge of her skate will catch an invisible groove and send her crashing to the ground, but that will not be the case. What I see in her eyes is not fear of the fall, but the will to brush off the frost and carry on. Skating is, after all, the art of defying the fall with a smile. It is knowing that, even though the ice is hard, our spirit can be much stronger. And so, between the memory of who I was in Venezuela and the reality of who I am today in Ontario, I understand that true skill is not in never falling, but in the elegance with which we decide to start again. A beautiful sport that I have enjoyed watching live. *** ***
##
Come ɑnd pɑɾticipɑte becɑuse γou still hɑve time… #

*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBwqobe8b8c61GkPFacLNQsR4BSQ1uw1cf1yooraumzc/avatar512.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

> Observo la imagen de esta semana y, por un instante, el frío seco que poco a poco se va disipando aquí en Ontario desaparece para devolverme a la bruma del Hotel Humboldt. Recuerdo allá en Caracas, donde el hielo es un milagro prefabricado suspendido en la cima de una montaña, un secreto que solo los que subíamos al Ávila conocíamos. Quién me iba a decir que, dieciséis años después, ese mismo crujir de las cuchillas bajo mis pies sería tan cotidiano como un juego de «pelotica de goma» en una calle de mi infancia. Gracias, @freewritehouse, por la iniciativa [A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw) y la singular imagen que seguidamente detallaré.
# ***
Quizá logre un Axel perfecto
*** En la fotografía, veo a una pequeña guerrera vestida de oro y plumas. No es solo una jovencita patinando; es el retrato vivo de la concentración. Sus brazos extendidos buscan el equilibrio del mundo, y en su mirada —fija, casi felina— percibo esa tensión que precede a la gloria o al estrépito. Aunque su nombre se pierda en los registros de las jóvenes promesas (pues representa a cada soñadora que ha pisado una pista), su postura me recuerda la elegancia de Katarina Witt y la determinación inquebrantable de Michelle Kwan. Al verla, no puedo evitar sentir un nudo de empatía en el pecho. Siento el aire gélido cortando las mejillas y el peso de las expectativas. Es el mismo sentimiento que experimenté al ver la película Todo sobre ruedas (Right on Track). Hay una escena que vive en mí; cuando Erica Enders, tras un accidente aterrador, se calza de nuevo el valor y regresa a la pista. Ese momento no era para demostrarle nada al cronómetro, sino para decirle a sí misma y sin saberlo, al patrocinador y al mundo que el miedo no tiene permiso para quedarse. El talento es belleza, sí, pero la fortaleza es lo que te mantiene de pie cuando el hielo se vuelve traicionero.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQTBZJ7P8BDrdx9VphV1WNvZcoTHqGQiBM7rNJxmgWB9/freew.png) [Imagen prompt de la iniciatica, cortesía de Pixabay.](https://pixabay.com/photos/figure-skater-ice-skater-ice-266512/)
Mi propia juventud fue un constante aprendizaje de la gravedad. Al igual que el proverbio japonés que adoptamos como bandera, mi vida ha sido un ejercicio de «caer siete veces, levantarse ocho». Porque en el patinaje, como en la existencia, la caída no es el fracaso; el fracaso es quedarse sentado en el frío. Me viene a la memoria una verdad que ha guiado mis pasos desde que dejé mi tierra: «Nuestro destino no está determinado por el número de veces que tropezamos, sino por el número de veces que nos levantamos, que nos sacudimos el polvo y seguimos adelante». Estas palabras de Dieter F. Uchtdorf resuenan hoy más que nunca. No importa si estamos en la pista del Humboldt mirando las luces de Caracas, o en una arena techada en Canadá bajo la nieve perpetua; la esencia es la misma. La chica de la foto, con sus trenzas perfectas y su traje de terciopelo, está a punto de realizar un giro. Quizás logre un Axel perfecto, o quizás el filo de su patín encuentre un surco invisible y la lleve al suelo, pero no será así. Pero lo que observo en sus ojos no es temor al golpe, sino la voluntad de sacudirse el polvo de escarcha y seguir adelante. Patinar es, después de todo, el arte de desafiar la caída con una sonrisa. Es saber que, aunque el hielo sea duro, nuestro espíritu puede ser mucho más firme. Y así, entre el recuerdo de lo que fui en Venezuela y la realidad de quien soy hoy en Ontario, entiendo que la verdadera destreza no está en no caer jamás, sino en la elegancia con la que decidimos volver a empezar. Hermoso deporte que he disfrutado en vivo. *** ***

body.title: One Of My Best Value Stocks Right Now Why I Continue To Hold BTI For Income And Long Term Value
body.body:
British American Tobacco is not a flashy stock. It is not a momentum play, it is not a tech story, and it is definitely not something people brag about owning at a cocktail party. What it is, however, is one of the best value positions I hold.

![6E5A8B14-390C-41C2-A325-F631584134AA.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXxieVmWBv1dcB5ZSnziSpdkvZvwkeWguaANe5cSJLrUG/6E5A8B14-390C-41C2-A325-F631584134AA.png)

When I started buying BTI, the stock was around $29. At that price the valuation made very little sense compared to the amount of cash the business was generating. The market was pricing it like a company in permanent decline, while the actual financials told a very different story.

One of the biggest reasons I continue to hold it is the dividend. BTI has consistently paid a high yield that sits well above the market average, and that income shows up whether the stock is exciting or not. For investors focused on cash flow, that kind of reliability matters more than daily price movement.

![IMG_7835.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfWQTy44YwF9fA95zjwDq6FMt8pXhtU1H7FkSagVeh1vQ/IMG_7835.jpeg)

The dividend has not just stayed high, it has shown steady support from the company’s underlying earnings. This is not a situation where the payout is being forced or borrowed into existence. The company generates significant free cash flow, and a large portion of that gets returned directly to shareholders.

Value investing often means buying what others are avoiding. Tobacco as a sector has been out of favor for years, which is exactly why the valuations can become attractive. The headlines are rarely positive, yet the balance sheets and income statements remain strong.

I do not have to love the product to recognize the investment case. Markets are not about personal preferences. They are about numbers, cash generation, and whether a company can continue to reward shareholders over time. BTI checks those boxes.

Another factor is pricing power. Companies in this space have historically been able to adjust pricing to offset volume declines, which helps maintain revenue stability even in a challenging environment. That ability has supported margins and allowed continued dividend payments.

BTI has also been working to reduce debt and streamline operations after past acquisitions. As leverage comes down, the financial position improves, which adds another layer of support for long term holders.

From a valuation standpoint, the stock has often traded at a lower multiple than the broader market despite producing strong cash flow. That disconnect is exactly what value investors look for. You are not paying for hype. You are getting paid to wait.

This is not a stock I expect to double overnight. It is a position built around income, stability, and the idea that undervalued businesses eventually get recognized, even if it takes time.

In a market that often chases growth at any price, holding something like BTI provides balance. The dividend continues to come in, the fundamentals remain intact, and the valuation still looks reasonable compared to many other sectors.

That is why I continue to hold it. It may not be the most popular name in the portfolio, but it has proven to be one of the most dependable when it comes to value and income.

![6E5A8B14-390C-41C2-A325-F631584134AA.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXxieVmWBv1dcB5ZSnziSpdkvZvwkeWguaANe5cSJLrUG/6E5A8B14-390C-41C2-A325-F631584134AA.png)

The blog cover image was created with ChatGPT by OpenAI because I am a terrible artist in both the physical and digital world. All text is mine, with one spellcheck after completion using ChatGPT by OpenAI.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsoCEnRvsDucafHXQSHiu5XTm3JjdiUxLYvQNspFRRsy/_20260221215505_14_9.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaMGkSdud3M7VVyHXjKa1mtzdSxFNBEW4UrLnM3fEwQa/_20260221215505_15_9.jpg)

不知不覺今天已經初六了, 明天我也要回公司上班. 德國之旅嘛, 先停一下, 今天臨時加插這兩天回來, 趁還在過年嘛, 趕緊分享一下.

話說我初三晚上下飛機的時候已經晚上6點, 拿完行李我就飛出去打的回家, 打一打車 290元不見了, 290元差不多夠我加滿油, 可以跑好遠的地方玩囉, 沒辦法, 這一刻, 時間更重要. 不要省那幾百元囉. 

到何文田之後, 湘都已經在樓下等我了. 本來我想跟她去元氣壽司吃晚飯, 無奈, 我太晚在手機拿號, 我差不多還有十分鐘到家之前才拿了號, 所以當我上樓放好東西之後, 再下去都還有8桌要等. 

那只能放棄了, 改去Itamama吃晚飯吧, 因為真的太累了. 為甚麼會累? 因為這次在飛機幾乎沒睡覺囉, 前面有個臭屁孩全程在吵, 吵到我還有坐我隔壁的一個美女都沒睡好. 然後我就好無奈地, 全程16小時都只是咪著眼等降落.

好啦, 去到Itamama, 點了個二人套餐就是了, 不願意想吃甚麼, 見到有二人餐合胃合的就去馬. 其實呢, 湘就不需要吃太多了, 現在她過了晚上六點之後基本上都少吃, 加上套餐有兩份主食, 她更加不能吃好多. 

主食有牛排, 有意面, 好豐富, 再加上一個沙拉跟焗田螺, 好滿足, 滿足到我都吃不完. 我在飛機上基本上沒怎吃飛機餐, 以前都覺得國泰飛機餐的水準可以的, 現在越來越差, 主要是現在蹭老頭或者同事進去lounge, 入面的東西好吃得多了. 所以現在變得挑剔了, 這不是一件好事囉, 都沒富起來, 就那麼挑了, 哎...

吃完飯, 我們回去沖個涼, 我一下就睡死了, 第二天早上, 即是初四, 我就一早起來, 跟我媽出去飲茶吃點心, 吃完之後回家拿東西, 我們又要趕回羅湖, 跟我外父外母拜年, 因為這次要買煙買酒, 沒走皇崗口岸, 要坐火車, 那邊免稅店大好多, 東西多好多啊嘛.

話說, 對上一次坐火車過關, 已經要數回2023年1月剛通關的時候了, 那陣子還是要做核酸才可以過關. 但對於我這個回過深圳經歷過2次隔離的人, 單單做個核酸算個屁囉, 怕你啊. 做就做哈. 又扯遠了, 我想講的是, 今次再坐火車過關, 又回憶起以前的生活, 我指的是疫情前的生活狀態. 

其實呢, 現在我們又好像真正回到從前那個狀態了, 因為湘正式回去老東家那邊全職上班了. 這正正就是我這兩三年有點懷念的日子, 不過現在是基於從前的基礎上, 再改善了一些啦, 現在住的房大了, 工資比當年漲了, 也有自己的坐駕, 想出去玩是隨時的事, 加上這九年在老頭公司的閱歷, 實在豐富了我的人生好多. 

買完煙酒, 先回自己家休息一下, 之後開車過去龍園, 我都一個月沒碰車了, 難受, 所以必需要開車過去外母父那邊呢, 平時他們小區又是地獄級難找車位, 現在過年, 車位比較好找, 所以, 現在不開車過去等甚麼時候?

去到吃個飯, 當是開年吧, 也是捉住了過年的尾巴, 跟她們一家人齊齊整整過一個新年, 沒的出去玩也沒差, 人平安在美國回來不就是最好的禮物嗎?

2026.2.22

Specially its colour so beautiful. Its  colour are amazing. It was seen  various garden as well as house.   I saw it last few moments ago in the afternoon in my house.  I saw this part of nature. This is a beautiful part of nature. This is an beautiful nature. It looks like beautiful.  Although this type of part of nature are common. It is a wild part of nature but amazing to look at. It was looking so nice.  There are a lot of this type of nature are common in our area. It is a common in my locality.  Sometimes I see it. This is the common part of nature in our rural area. Its name is Asian Common Toad. I saw this name on Google.

body.title: Se avecinan cambios | Changes are comingm
body.body:
Un fuerte abrazo para todos los amigos que interactúan en la Comunidad #TopFamily, bienvenidos a mi blog. Esta es mi participación en el concurso [Observa Piensa Escribe](https://hive.blog/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-7ca24fdb355fd) >A big hug to all the friends who interact in the #TopFamily Community, welcome to my blog. This is my entry for the [Observe Think Write](https://hive.blog/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-7ca24fdb355fd) contest. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbF3uw67n5eLwvnM9uKVvKRwRH4TfCTYkJWgGY94dpppu/1771718100278.png)
_Imagen propiedad @lanzjoseg_
La imagen de la semana muestra a un ciclista en algún rincón de Venezuela con una bandera de Estados Unidos a como estandarte, será una manera de honrar a ese país, de agradecer ese aire de libertad que se respira y se transpira después de la captura de Nicolás Maduro, aun falta por suceder grandes acontecimientos en nuestro país que marquen el final de un régimen autoritario que se mantiene por veintiocho años consecutivos. >This week's image shows a cyclist in some corner of Venezuela with a US flag draped over his shoulder. It's a way of honoring that country, of expressing gratitude for the breath of freedom that has been felt since the capture of Nicolás Maduro. However, major events are yet to unfold in our country that will mark the end of an authoritarian regime that has lasted for twenty-eight consecutive years. Al ver esa imagen no puedo dejar de pensar en mis tres hijos cuyas edades oscilan entre 28 y 35 años, graduados pero que nunca tuvieron oportunidad de obtener un un empleo, las posibilidades en nuestro país se limitaron, no importa carreras universitarias ni curriculum, solo importa que seas simpatizante o adepto al gobierno, puro nepotismo para entrar en una buena empresa, así que hubo que buscar otras alternativas como : trabajar desde casa vía online, vender cosas, trabajos en los diferentes comercios de la ciudad y la más difícil de todas emigrar a otras fronteras buscando calidad y oportunidades que este país ya no ofrecía, es por eso que empecé a conocer y convivir con ansiedad, bruxismo y depresión condiciones que solo conocía de lejos. Realmente cuando sucedió la captura de Nicolás Maduro quedé como el show sin saber como reaccionar, sentía una alegría contenida, incertidumbre, miedo preocupación pero me llenó de esperanza pensar en un futuro más democrático, donde tengamos libertad de expresión, en mi caso oportunidades para que nuestra generación de relevo pueda conseguir trabajos dignos que cubran sus necesidades básicas, que podamos a ir a un centro de salud pública sin tanto miedo por no tener dinero para cubrir las medicinas, que las pensiones para los jubilados se conviertan en un ingreso digno que garantice la calidad de los adultos mayores es un derecho adquirido durante toda su vida no es caridad lo que necesitamos, todos los que miraron por obligación puedan volver y encontrar como vivir aquí, merecemos de vuelta a ese país próspero que nos conteía a todos. >Seeing that image makes me think of my three children, aged between 28 and 35, all graduates but who never had the opportunity to find employment. Opportunities in our country were limited; university degrees and resumes didn't matter, only being a supporter or follower of the government was important—pure nepotism to get into a good company. So we had to look for other alternatives, such as working from home online, selling things, working in different shops around the city, and the most difficult of all, emigrating to other countries in search of quality and opportunities that this country no longer offered. That's why I began to experience and live with anxiety, bruxism, and depression—conditions I had only known from afar. When Nicolás Maduro was captured, I was completely taken aback, unsure how to react. I felt a mix of joy, uncertainty, fear, and worry, but I was filled with hope for a more democratic future. A future where we have freedom of expression, and in my case, opportunities for the next generation to find decent jobs that meet their basic needs. A future where we can go to public health centers without fear of not having enough money for medicine. Pensioners need to become a dignified income that guarantees the well-being of senior citizens—it's a right they've earned throughout their lives, not charity. We need all those who left out of necessity to be able to return and find a way to live here. We deserve to have that prosperous country back, the one that once supported us all.
>
_¡Gracias por leer!_
>
Hasta una próxima oportunidad .
>
_Thank you for reading!_
>
Until next time.

# Tiger Hello, my friends at Hive and this film-loving community. Today I'm here to talk about a movie I saw recently that I thought was good, within reason, as well as interesting. The film is set during wartime, where a crew of five people go on a mission that will change their lives, in which they will learn lessons for survival. In addition, this mission is secret, which must cross enemy lines in search of what it is tasked with; I hope you like it. > _Hola, mis amigos de Hive y esta comunidad amante del cine. En esta oportunidad vengo a hablar sobre una película que vi recientemente y que, a mi parecer, me pareció buena dentro de lo que cabe, además de interesante. La película se ambienta en la época de guerra, en donde una tripulación con 5 personas a bordo va en una misión que les cambiará la vida, en la cual van a recibir lecciones para la supervivencia. Además, esta misión es secreta, la cual debe atravesar líneas enemigas en busca de lo que se encarga; espero les guste._
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tkpRxmiyLpwEHAaiaUVYHY2Sdi3LajCGPX1HeVQ7f2VvxWsK8z4PA38PZbP4BvLYX9w.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/EogPMCKgwS7Bc2fqvrZovd85M2WU7dqdfxmmB7VQNgeA9crK7rmz9nQr3dj7Mm4srfz.png) [Link de imagen](https://okdiario.com/img/2026/01/24/dertigereltanque-960x539.jpg)
First of all, I should mention that this film was released in 2025, has a running time of two hours, and was only released on various digital platforms on January 2. I watched it on Magistv and thought it was good. As for the actors, I think they did a great job, as they managed to connect with the audience, and that is something that stands out in a film, that the actor, in this case the story, manages to connect with the audience. In the first part, I can say that the effects used were the most normal and calm; there was nothing that stood out as impressive, even though I found it very fast-paced in terms of scenes. Honestly, I would have liked a little more action, so to speak, but otherwise I thought it was a good movie to watch with the family. The story is about a secret mission that these five crew members undertake to the other end of the city by land, where they have to go in their war tank with all their equipment. Along the way, they encounter some problems that they learn to solve as a team, and this is the part I liked the most, as they never got discouraged; rather, they put their trust in their leader to get them to their destination. They also worked on their determination and intelligence. At the end of the film, something happened that I still thought was a one-off, but it left me pensive, so I had to watch it again with my mother, and that's when I understood, so I hope you draw your own conclusions and tell me your recommendations, as well as discuss what we didn't like, because in that part there are things that aren't so great, but that I didn't like, such as the scene where they burn people and the mines they found along the way. Tiger is a film set in the 1940s, when war was still a major issue and it was a matter of life and death to do what was asked of you. It makes you see life from a different perspective and shows you that not everything is rosy and not everyone has a happy ending. I was entertained throughout the film, which is not something that happens very often for me. But honestly, I was perplexed by what was unfolding on screen. I also invited my mother to see it, because if something is good for me, I will always recommend it, even if not everyone thinks the same way I do. But in my opinion, I thought the film was excellent. --- > _En primer lugar, debo decir que esta película fue estrenada en 2025, tiene una duración de 2 horas y no fue hasta este 2 de enero que fue estrenada en varias plataformas digitales, aunque debo decir que la vi en Magistv y me pareció buena a mi parecer. En lo que respecta a los actores, considero que se hizo un gran trabajo, ya que lograron conectar con el público y eso es algo que llama la atención en una película, que el actor, en este caso la historia, logre conectar con la audiencia. En la primera parte puedo decir que los efectos usados fueron los más normales y tranquilos; no hubo algo que se diga que impresionó, a pesar de que la vi muy movida en cuanto a escenas. Sinceramente, sinceramente me hubiera gustado un poco más de acción, por así decirlo, pero del resto me pareció una buena película para ver en familia._ > _La historia se relata en una misión secreta que hacen estos 5 tripulantes a otro extremo de la ciudad por vía terrestre, donde tienen que ir en su tanque de guerra con todos los hierros. Durante el camino se presentan algunos problemas que aprenden a resolver como equipo, y esto es la parte que más me gustó, ya que ellos nunca se desanimaron; más bien dieron su confianza en quién era el líder para poder llegar a su destino. También trabajaron su determinación e inteligencia. Al final de la película sucedió algo que aún pensaba que era puntual, pero me dejó pensativa, así que tuve que volver a mirar con mi madre y fue cuando entendí, así que espero que ustedes saquen sus propias conclusiones y me digan sus recomendaciones, además de discutir lo que sí no nos gustó, porque en esa parte hay cosas que no son tan grandes, pero que no me gustaron, como la escena donde queman a las personas y las minas que se encontraban en el camino._ > _Tiger es una película adecuada en los años 40, donde aún existía ese tema de las guerras con mayor pronunciación, en donde era de vida o muerte ir a lo que pedían. La misma te hace ver la vida desde otra perspectiva y te da a entender que no todo es color de rosa y no todos tienen un mejor final. Durante la película me mantuve entretenida, aunque eso es algo no muy casual en mí. Pero sinceramente me quedé mirando perpleja lo que se desarrollaba en la película. También invité a mi madre para que la viera, ya que si algo es bueno para mí, siempre la voy a recomendar, aunque no todos piensen igual que yo; pero a mi parecer me pareció excelente la película._
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tkpRxmiyLpwEHAaiaUVYHY2Sdi3LajCGPX1HeVQ7f2VvxWsK8z4PA38PZZhxdVTkVEk.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/2424EvNywmd3MJEd5eiNueBFCMUjsgEt44NZYWtMLnDHquj7KfxUt67tSoDYsJxkm18dm.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/Eo8K5dziLQUzMPDxj3bgyYcL5coQiM8vXtWocqN2ByfS79ypHXsxbVYmc1QrGXG5fnU.png) [Link de imagen](https://okdiario.com/img/2026/01/24/720_the-tiger-960x539.jpg)
One of the things I think was missing was the ability to set the film in other locations, as it was repetitive to always see them in the tank; although we know that was what the film was about, I feel it would have been good to see the actors in another war, on the road with others, that is, in combat, because what they were in was very short in my opinion, but the rest was good. One scene I liked was the part with the mine, when one of the crew members holds it in his hands while they try to get him out of there. I also liked the leader's determination and that, even though many didn't believe in him, in the end they always looked for the best strategy to continue, covering his position with determination; I also liked it when the tank was underwater. It really invites us to reflect when we are in extreme situations. In conclusion, we can say that it would be a movie I would watch again, even though I don't like to rewatch movies that much, as I find them boring in the end. The only ones I watch over and over again are the Harry Potter movies, because they are my favorites, but I love to watch the rest a maximum of two times, unless it's a movie that totally captivates me and I feel empathy when watching its scenes. This movie is in my top 10 of the best I've seen this year, or rather, so far this year, because I've seen several, but I don't have time to express my opinion to you, so it's a good movie that keeps you immersed in the story and the reasons behind things, until it reaches the end with something different, but without losing its essence. I hope you'll tell me in the comments what you thought of this film, what your impressions were, and what part you liked best. I'd also like to share my opinion with other users who have seen War Tank. Big hugs to everyone; see you soon with more films to watch and discuss. --- > _Una de las cosas que pienso que le faltó fue poder ambientar la película en otros escenarios, ya que era repetitivo verlos siempre en el tanque; aunque sabemos que de eso se trataba la película, siento que sería bueno ver a los actores en otra guerra, en el camino con otros, es decir, en enfrentamiento, porque lo que estuvieron fue muy corto a mi parecer, pero del resto estuvo buena. Una puesta en escena que me gustó fue la parte de la mina, cuando uno de los tripulantes la sostiene en sus manos mientras intentan sacarlo de ese lugar. También me gustó la determinación del líder y que, aunque muchos no creían en él, al final siempre buscaban la mejor estrategia para continuar, cubrían su puesto con determinación; también me gustó cuando el tanque estuvo bajo el agua. De verdad que nos invitan a reflexionar cuando estamos en situaciones extremas._ > _En conclusión, podemos decir que sería una película que volvería a ver, aunque no me gusta repetir tanto las películas, ya que las siento aburridas al final. Las únicas que veo una y otra vez son las de Harry Potter, porque son mis favoritas, pero del resto amo verlas máximo 2 veces, a menos que sea una película que me atrape totalmente y sienta empatía al mirar sus capítulos de escena. Esta película entra en mi top 10 de las mejores que he visto en este año, o mejor dicho, de lo que va de año, porque he visto varias, solo que el tiempo no me da para expresar mi opinión ante ustedes, así que es una película buena que te mantiene sumergido en la historia y en el porqué de las cosas, hasta que llega al final con algo distinto, pero sin perder la esencia._ > _Espero que me digan en los comentarios qué tal les pareció esta película, cuáles fueron sus impresiones y qué parte les gustó más; también me gustaría compartir mi opinión con otros usuarios que hayan visto tanque de guerra. Les envío un abrazo grande a todos; nos vemos pronto con más películas para ver y expresar._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tkpRxmiyLpwEHAaiaUVYHY2Sdi3LajCGPX1HeVQ7f2VvxWsK8z4PA38PZZhxdVTkVEk.png)

body.title: How to cut and Sew Cultural Attire// Cultural Attire I made for my Neighbors Daughter
body.body:
# Hello Hive 


It is the last Sunday in the month of February and most churches in Nigeria term it to be a testimony and thanksgiving Sunday. We often celebrate this Sunday to appreciate God for the journey through the Month and appreciate for the testimony and manifestation of his presence among us.


![1000146625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23ydEAxxBSugtvytxhKrkKHez8FEo96bRR4kJ1YxQwYVbZ4wdpVHecYG3biGJc2Z2Vchz.jpg)



But one thing is always striken, there is hardly a Thanksgiving Sunday without cultural attire.
Trust me we Africans love our cultural heritage so much that any small celebration placed a demand on us to put on our cultural attire.


Just this Afternoon my neighbor knockef on my door and pleaded that she wants me to see a cultural attire for her daughter to wear to church by morning today. I almost rejected helping her out because I was already exhausted for one week but after reviewing how her cute little daughter often dance happily and playfully in church I decided to give her a touch of design to complement the celebration tomorrow.

There will be cultural talking drums that people will be dancing too both the old and the young and this is another opportunity to put smile on someone's face. I had admonished the mother to always take caution and prepare for Sunday services much earlier to avoid inconveniences like this.


Sometimes my Preparations for Sunday outfits often happens during the midweek as Saturdays might be a deadline too close to achieve some uniform designs for some occasions if need be

Without further Ado, let's get to the making of the outfit.



![1000146673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xpAY8sFEX3qiCLL32RQcCHjpSpT3UDdSnqZAnbvTi62Y5ibVHQRANgekYn1rH8DJuez.jpg)

We will be using our cultural Aso-oke fabrics.

* First I cut out the front and back piece of the fabric after joining the several pieces of the Aso-oke fabric. This fabric is often produce in bulky length of 50-60\

. To make a dress you have to join the widths first so that it can be up to the size of a human bodice


![1000146679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242hYR4jf3gnvnfyxA6qaYqLTrJt89bfDFnWWEVaGjqEJNekQLrWtD9uionhDWv3GYUph.jpg)

After taking the measurements I cut out the front and back block here.


![1000146682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23z7Hv2knPorDtbRaQpKNip8AHemKqWisDVMd8gnwtddthuPbDv6HLE19RbAex789Eeme.jpg)


Next I cut out the facing for the necklines and the strap for the sleeve lines.


![1000146691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vi3x7SfUkpEAerdMwXpnGQFiUGoDVRTGzjj6NHSDSqYaw7eseLaPAuuq3qw86c8niiK.jpg)

Then I moved on with the sewing 
First I turned the necklines of the dress outward with the facings


![1000146694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xATjSm1h2ALFhqykLMkGSViYRGMGG9pTFKeFFPSVfBRjh4zdCcXCWDWCkmoJ5MSmKdH.jpg)


Next I joined the seam allowances and proceeded to join the straps of the sleeve go give the dress an additional sleeve length.



![1000146706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoGwSucth4t4q7ToAEPbELPuhb2bEnnW4PHkWPfZQgFTuRtjtnjyKTm3Nhr8azp5gNB.jpg)

Next I made a tiny bow which the baby will be wearing on her head. But I was too tired to add an elastic fo this.  I will likely make headband of the bow for her to wear to church with the outfit by morning.


![1000146649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EpnEehPN6sRoZg7ofhv94WZbXk8HALFQJ5TMaJD7hjgq1zJDi3tfL8bovm8kKHU6wdm.jpg)


This is the process of how we cut and sew boubou gown from traditional Aso-oke fabrics.

body.title: Carnaval Mundo Marino
body.body:
> ###
Spanish
Hola mi gente creativa e innovadora de este fascinante ecosistema, espero que se encuentren bien, rebosantes de salud y repletos de energía positiva. La semana pasada se celebro el carnaval, el cual se festeja tradicionalmente 40 días antes de la semana santa, para este carnaval 2026 de acuerdo con las orientaciones la temática es Mundo Marino, por este motivo, emprendí a la tarea ambientar la puerta del Aula Integrada de acuerdo a dicha temática.

> ###
English
Hello, my creative and innovative friends in this fascinating ecosystem. I hope you are all well, in good health, and full of positive energy. Last week, Carnival was celebrated, which is traditionally celebrated 40 days before Holy Week. For this 2026 Carnival, according to the guidelines, the theme is Marine World. For this reason, I undertook the task of decorating the door of the Integrated Classroom according to this theme. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23wWxro4V9pM8BwtPh6Dmp4GfMLa6MLJ6oPQbfNF48XEKGM9dRyrgmY16pm378AkRfqiV.png) ----------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
Durante esta fecha, es común observar disfraces, carrozas, hermosos y coloridos desfiles. Hay quienes lo celebran con agua y otros con juegos brusco, recuerdo que, cuando era niña mi mamá me realizaba disfraces con material de provecho y me gustaba jugar con agua; cabe destacar que jugaba hasta un cierto tiempo para no resfriarme.

> ###
English
During this time, it is common to see costumes, floats, and beautiful, colorful parades. Some people celebrate with water, and others with rough games. I remember that when I was a child, my mother made me costumes out of recycled materials, and I liked to play with water. It should be noted that I only played for a certain amount of time so I wouldn't catch a cold. ------------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
Sin embargo, con el paso del tiempo todo cambio, empecé a sentir miedo de salir durante esas festividades porque, cerca de la comunidad donde crecí empezaron a jugar con barro, pintura, bombas de agua congeladas e incluso con elementos desagradables, la verdad para mí era aterradora, no quería ni salir. Afortunadamente esos tiempos quedaron atrás, actualmente me gusta la ambientación alusiva al carnaval, me encanta ver a mis nietos disfrazados y jugar en la plaza, admiro la creatividad de las madres a la hora de realizar los disfraces.

> ###
English
However, as time went by, everything changed. I began to feel afraid to go out during those festivities because, near the community where I grew up, they started playing with mud, paint, frozen water bombs, and even unpleasant things. The truth is that it was terrifying for me; I didn't even want to go out. Fortunately, those times are behind us. Nowadays, I enjoy the carnival atmosphere. I love seeing my grandchildren dressed up and playing in the square. I admire the creativity of the mothers when it comes to making the costumes. ------------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
Para ser sincera, esta temática marina me fascinó porque amo el mar. Es una propuesta distinta de lo que estábamos acostumbrados, ya que normalmente se asocia el carnaval con payasos, superhéroes o comiquitas de moda. De esta manera, valoramos la belleza del ecosistema marino y promovemos la conservación del ambiente.

> ###
English
To be honest, this marine theme fascinated me because I love the sea. It's a different approach from what we're used to, since carnival is normally associated with clowns, superheroes, or popular cartoons. In this way, we appreciate the beauty of the marine ecosystem and promote environmental conservation. ------------------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
Primero, mi compañera del turno de la tarde forro la puerta con papel contact anaranjado y con papel bond blanco, posteriormente empecé a planificar el diseño, para ser sincera no disponía de materiales, entonces fui a la papelería que queda al frente de la escuela y compre: Cartulina rosada, un papel bond blanco, papel crepe de diversos tonos azules y morado claro, por supuesto cinta plástica.

> ###
English
First, my afternoon shift partner covered the door with orange contact paper and white bond paper. Then I started planning the design. To be honest, I didn't have any materials, so I went to the stationery store across from the school and bought some pink cardstock, white bond paper, crepe paper in various shades of blue and light purple, and, of course, plastic tape. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23tvgT9Ht1qxqLT4N1FocrLmndaf8ujBJdBSTNV93D7ZopM1TjJg6grFnRn957JpCm4jK.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/24244KKhH5jf3XKXKMJHoE29v9TttbvLpZfVS3618xaYgo84wnFPnZjUV3PqaXPaRA1ZT.png) ----------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
En el papel bond dibuje un antifaz, luego tome los tres pliegos de papel crepe. Con la ayuda de una regla, tracé líneas en el papel crepé para que todas las tiras tuvieran la misma medida, cabe mencionar que un día antes había impreso algunos dibujos alusivos a la temática para colorear y recortar. Es importante mencionar que el dibujo del antifaz en el papel bond servirá de plantilla para realizarlo en la cartulina rosada.

> ###
English
Draw a mask on the bond paper, then take the three sheets of crepe paper. Using a ruler, draw lines on the crepe paper so that all the strips are the same size. It is worth mentioning that the day before, I had printed out some pictures related to the theme to color and cut out. It is important to mention that the drawing of the mask on the bond paper will serve as a template for making it on the pink cardstock. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23tvq71djkjdGign8P8Y8Qo9Sor8GaHDu7bTv6ATMi4QWduGBiApffGN6A57sba6RTqVj.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23wqwV72E4scXScGxsX4UcDEXjmEgS1LoQeDijfgKMq4NykD9BsHCrfWXKxhGh8NyTSsS.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23wMmLDiDvUkxNLhekHc7FRKtf3fkcRMJXMCM3S9wpmfd99R9Aet3aW3no1oK9ssSWpWt.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23yd9x2tBveeGkW3Ss1cqUAAcmGWNHRoDj7ATAcuVpXBHBrrLNXLdnhGU55UViWCPj3BN.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23zGeoFnYLuRFeSpwDGTmV6BbZMse86uuyPca6gx6HtoqF8aAYJxDrsnkNPVMG4HquM1u.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23zS3YP9aQq7EEMRHWYwdmJVHnPHJXUBSQkZVvPEV6B16AY4W4hSBsBbwmpnTybrkvwC7.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23tScUeoHocACHjY7vr13G7mU6cUusmBVtCJxEsD54NW8DPVbyTc5n3toMhxsb4oERMss.png) --------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
Con entusiasmo pegue el antifaz en la puerta , adorne los lados y el centro del antifaz con tiras de papel crepe, inmediatamente le di color a las imágenes impresas , que luego pegue encimas de las tiras de papel crepe simulando las olas del mar, mi compañera realizo varios antifaz de colores atrayentes , que servirán para dar realce y dinamismo a la decoración, en seguida adherí en el centro de la puerta el material impreso que decía Carnaval Mundo Marino que había realizado en la computadora y que luego imprimí para este proyecto, en cada esquina de la hoja impresa coloque una estrella de mar , un pulpo que pinte para esta ocasión y dos antifaz que realizo mi compañera.

> ###
English
I enthusiastically stuck the mask on the door, decorated the sides and center of the mask with strips of crepe paper, immediately colored the printed images, which I then stuck on top of the crepe paper strips to simulate ocean waves. My partner made several masks in attractive colors, which will serve to enhance and add dynamism to the decoration. I then attached the printed material that said “Carnival Marine World” to the center of the door. I had made it on the computer and then printed it for this project. In each corner of the printed sheet, I placed a starfish, an octopus that I painted for this occasion, and two masks that my partner made. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23uR1FGMjL6r7HQQUJ9YNBcGrfRz9SVyAphUtwfVW33doirhfhCF6NBnt1vrKqdBBETWG.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23uQtfxWtPWg47jxhifVwrKVctn5Xsqyb22YCtgG9kRngmqFAs3mcBcpz58qAUTjQDK2H.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23tc3KmtTVwReoTipWNKXBPr8jCEDN4tHa9pdH998VKxSphNxqgsdY7ataARbpMB1uDWG.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/2423wZz8KygXkhGQpzLZuWVYZxVyjrstgn6e5chCRJPmVR1M6iBCRf1UAigNQLgQd57mJ.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23zbMpjHPhNY9Wb8RhLQGCsUBDqyUCkQpgaxZCnm8cpQXE5YDLsZWKhTWWoSDWHMTe2Cf.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23wqkeRrdyNCDqBv3ykZiLyroeidpLNyp5TJKmwodrtn1bUuFgVPPmL5xt3rqyY7uP2ca.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23tvsFr9puyr6B54Z1pEuE3bVHBfm4rrGmeFt9LKmk9QXHrHkwJGPgQ6YuJmAh3PofZ95.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23yJLmNngg3GkvbMYt1V5GYoRWhuvfN96fDjmDAfTYiEMFVKoNr9Tx9uAcPFECJs9Nzwm.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23uFcJV1yuYBS91dTgrKuyqBcPHsvieADGo75rrSzboFJeCFjN5vELr1VZuWJ1jrab14C.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23uFaS8dmJSvs1gqvhU8v2r9h6UNZeXVgDc3KMLB9W2aFnevxYEroCPnPS4S86s5cBtyV.png) ----------------------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/241tUm4YCL8rUDud4kXtm815X5a6C4Zgu8hroHRRv9TpWExSmtJ5zgZ7Cnycf6RnSSmr1.png)

> ###
Spanish
De pronto se me ocurrió agregar algas. Busqué papel de lustrillo marrón y crepé verde que tenía guardado; recorté tiras y unas siluetas de unas rocas para darle realismo al fondo marino. Finalmente, dibujé y pinté una tortuga, un sapo, un cangrejo y un delfín. Añadí unos círculos de cartulina azul para simular burbujas y pegué los últimos detalles. Como resultado final, logramos una decoración sencilla, bonita y muy creativa. ¡Espero que les guste!

> ###
English
Suddenly, it occurred to me to add seaweed. I looked for some brown glossy paper and green crepe paper that I had saved; I cut out strips and some silhouettes of rocks to make the seabed look more realistic. Finally, I drew and painted a turtle, a frog, a crab, and a dolphin. I added some blue cardboard circles to simulate bubbles and glued on the final details. The end result was a simple, beautiful, and very creative decoration. I hope you like it! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanyuris/23xpD4nGMcuWT2EBDk8pUvSTZEqvYgCQLdiP64tgJzf98yiY62CZbL8XwJAMzjBwFAL5N.png) body.title: Comparsas escolares [Spa/Eng]
body.body:
>

   

*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*
Comparsas escolares Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridos amigos de @lifestyle. Espero que estén disfrutando de estos bonitos carnavales 2026; por acá lo hemos estado pasando muy bien, haciendo cosas sencillas, pero alegres en familia. Este viernes pasado estuvimos disfrutando del desfile de carnaval realizado por las diferentes instituciones educativas de nuestra querida ciudad de Cumaná. Gracias a Dios llegamos temprano y estuvimos esperando hasta que dieran inicio al desfile de muchos niños, representantes y docentes que le dieron vida, color y música a este bonito evento. Me quedé sorprendida con tantas escuelas que estuvieron presentes en estas comparsas escolares y no me había fijado que hubiera tantas instituciones educativas en nuestra ciudad. Aunque debo decir que había de todas las clases, desde maternal, preescolar, primaria, liceo, escuelas especiales y demás.
![1001457534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uFU9fEiCsJZKJH2mENatnyceCFHKDN1f2JUXcAnkKdNKz8PAm3cF9cmxzVjpNog9tSm.jpg) ![1001457537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wMUMu934vFjuDbSSVLJ7w8mtNM8zxr2xj8vT6SEVtcZVGkwcCfmWDDvuP9u7vf3sMif.jpg) ![1001457535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tmFvRLKvtiDCariQWo8qbqGtYiqVbun1ifvT4tnTjVzj4DgUxu38PRJzcjicssnvrNv.jpg) ![1001457536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23u6335EkhT1ZhZYTwdHunmT6mQAeRXwp9vyCkS5cyJJmWZoeLNyDqfJqRbTKyktgBScX.jpg)

>

Hasta había niños discapacitados con sus sillas de ruedas o con condiciones especiales que me llamaron mucho la atención; se veían tan lindos, tan emocionados sus padres de verlos participando, de verdad que fue muy bonito. Gracias a Dios que conseguimos un lugar en donde podíamos ver muy bien porque había bastante gente por toda la avenida por donde se estaban presentando estas comparsas. Se veía un poco desordenado porque, como les digo, eran niños que venían acompañados con sus padres, que muchas veces se metían a las comparsas y no dejaban ver muy bien lo colorido, lo bonito de sus disfraces. De verdad se vio todo el esfuerzo que hicieron los padres y representantes para que los niños participaran.

![1001457532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tSUTsx8GNfRR5SFxfMcGheQJZVMViuXqRXLeooR6wyvafHA6AZpkG4G9Hm8yyaTyoz5.jpg) ![1001457533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eoc7ybwvCNtuByNZhgkZj6yc7hnXTKrURsf4KbFDN7gxwSVuCfWijQtgVK2XrqWBZqz.jpg) ![1001457530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wC9vT494Tcg7e1wjDBoNqtXoSrCEeVZJR6dnrkexVQKdz2vfz8Gd2wEigTn6GGVQ53x.jpg) ![1001457529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/EogMNQCxRjN862pvRiGNhtUagUq8u5zuJHf25gYBuuJRKTq6AZMNT5ijCxPiBT6yn7r.jpg) ![1001457531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vsQpu8w8vRHRbqrSMvjzXMgrs4rzTd7WSbrXADcEBn9LQFvBcL5h2mrLox3ZD2ztfaw.jpg)

>

Cabe mencionar que esta vez las comparsas tenían una temática basada en la venezolanidad, la paz y la unión de los pueblos; muchos estaban vestidos con los colores de nuestra querida bandera de Venezuela, también de naturaleza, muchos árboles como el araguaney, con ese color amarillo que relumbraba entre la gente. Había muchos trajes lindos, así como pancartas y bandas musicales con ritmo de carnaval que alegraban y ponían a bailar a los presentes.

![1001457540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wWyQ2Y2TGLxG5aZYYNX2z7SYU3qdCRGvG71WM6x9g3mKTFX8fGUWQikUQzKqcTEkvKZ.jpg) ![1001457541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23ywwZcB98zy1k1BAXso2vbVpvgUiTdpaKnR87GcADB8netQgUsUrAciiBiKRkhnjodMp.jpg) ![1001457539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eo8SmmJ9WR1KRYmsnBnYc9gjoc1TvRWvewenAPK9ViXKZkDGUuLBUyBDbtQcoEY1rnF.jpg) ![1001457542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wCFsXzAJRjsU44DbxZpk8UueWvAHLiBHwiN9hFoyxyiJaiMh3bVPcNQoamzaSuvPx3A.jpg)

>

Por acá les dejo algunos fotos y pequeños vídeos de estas comparsas aunque se ven muchos, podriannser más, tenia el teléfono un poco descargado, ademas de la poca memoria, aun asi no queria dejar de capturar estos momentos y compartirlos en mi blog. Porque les digo tengo material de los carnavales 2025 demás que nunca publique y están esperando una oportunidad. Así que esta vez quise compartirles esto calentito y no fueran a quedar en el olvido. Luego nos fuimos a comer unos ricos helados en una bonita heladería, hay muchas heladerías por esta zona donde estaban las comparsas, la mayoría estaban llenas, en esta conseguimos por lo menos entrar, ni siquiera los helados los comimos adentro, estabamos afuera y de ahí estamos viendo cómo se estaban terminando las comparsas y los helados derritiéndose un poco, pero estaban deliciosos. Por cierto a Ámbar se le cayó la mitad a la barquilla, le compartí de la mía. La verdad pasamos esta tarde especial y lo demás días también estuvimos compartiendo gracias a Dios. Es todo por hoy amigos, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad de aventura por compartirles. Gracias por la visita. ******

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>

Greetings and blessings, my dear friends at @lifestyle. I hope you are enjoying these beautiful 2026 carnivals; here we have been having a great time, doing simple but joyful things as a family. This past Friday we enjoyed the carnival parade organised by the different educational institutions in our beloved city of Cumaná. Thank God we arrived early and waited until the parade began, with many children, representatives, and teachers bringing life, colour, and music to this beautiful event. I was surprised by how many schools were present in these school parades, and I hadn't realised there were so many educational institutions in our city. Although I must say that there were all kinds, from nursery, preschool, primary school, secondary school, special schools and so on.

![1001457534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uFU9fEiCsJZKJH2mENatnyceCFHKDN1f2JUXcAnkKdNKz8PAm3cF9cmxzVjpNog9tSm.jpg) ![1001457537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wMUMu934vFjuDbSSVLJ7w8mtNM8zxr2xj8vT6SEVtcZVGkwcCfmWDDvuP9u7vf3sMif.jpg) ![1001457535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tmFvRLKvtiDCariQWo8qbqGtYiqVbun1ifvT4tnTjVzj4DgUxu38PRJzcjicssnvrNv.jpg) ![1001457536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23u6335EkhT1ZhZYTwdHunmT6mQAeRXwp9vyCkS5cyJJmWZoeLNyDqfJqRbTKyktgBScX.jpg)

>

There were even children with disabilities in their wheelchairs or with special conditions that caught my attention; they looked so cute, their parents were so excited to see them participating, it was really beautiful. Thank God we found a place where we could see very well because there were quite a few people all along the avenue where these troupes were performing. It looked a bit messy because, as I said, there were children accompanied by their parents, who often got in the way of the troupes and blocked the view of their colourful, beautiful costumes. You could really see all the effort that the parents and guardians had made to get the children to participate.

![1001457532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tSUTsx8GNfRR5SFxfMcGheQJZVMViuXqRXLeooR6wyvafHA6AZpkG4G9Hm8yyaTyoz5.jpg) ![1001457533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eoc7ybwvCNtuByNZhgkZj6yc7hnXTKrURsf4KbFDN7gxwSVuCfWijQtgVK2XrqWBZqz.jpg) ![1001457530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wC9vT494Tcg7e1wjDBoNqtXoSrCEeVZJR6dnrkexVQKdz2vfz8Gd2wEigTn6GGVQ53x.jpg) ![1001457529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/EogMNQCxRjN862pvRiGNhtUagUq8u5zuJHf25gYBuuJRKTq6AZMNT5ijCxPiBT6yn7r.jpg) ![1001457531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vsQpu8w8vRHRbqrSMvjzXMgrs4rzTd7WSbrXADcEBn9LQFvBcL5h2mrLox3ZD2ztfaw.jpg)

>

It is worth mentioning that this time the troupes had a theme based on Venezuelan identity, peace and the unity of peoples; many were dressed in the colours of our beloved Venezuelan flag, as well as nature, with many trees such as the araguaney, with its yellow colour shining among the people. There were many beautiful costumes, as well as banners and musical bands with carnival rhythms that cheered up and made everyone dance.

![1001457540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wWyQ2Y2TGLxG5aZYYNX2z7SYU3qdCRGvG71WM6x9g3mKTFX8fGUWQikUQzKqcTEkvKZ.jpg) ![1001457541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23ywwZcB98zy1k1BAXso2vbVpvgUiTdpaKnR87GcADB8netQgUsUrAciiBiKRkhnjodMp.jpg) ![1001457539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eo8SmmJ9WR1KRYmsnBnYc9gjoc1TvRWvewenAPK9ViXKZkDGUuLBUyBDbtQcoEY1rnF.jpg) ![1001457542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wCFsXzAJRjsU44DbxZpk8UueWvAHLiBHwiN9hFoyxyiJaiMh3bVPcNQoamzaSuvPx3A.jpg)

>

Here are some photos and short videos of these groups. Although there are many, there could be more, but my phone battery was low, and I didn't have much memory left. Even so, I didn't want to miss capturing these moments and sharing them on my blog. I have material from the 2025 carnivals that I never published and are waiting for an opportunity. So this time I wanted to share this with you while it's still fresh and not let it be forgotten. Then we went to eat some delicious ice cream at a nice ice cream parlour. There are many ice cream parlours in this area where the comparsas were, and most of them were full. At least we managed to get into this one, but we didn't even eat the ice cream inside. We were outside watching the comparsas finish and the ice cream melt a little, but it was delicious. By the way, Ámbar dropped half of hers on the pavement, so I shared mine with her. We really had a special afternoon, and we spent the rest of the days sharing too, thank God. That's all for today, friends. See you next time for another adventure to share with you. Thanks for visiting. **********
