>

   

![1001457558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tbw3q5xjHKbe2djTEHrQJMT1Ciuf6D2irPLoj4YJE3nTDstLNCUgYWmTxScx4XCLqm3.jpg)

>

   

*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*
Comparsas escolares Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridos amigos de @lifestyle. Espero que estén disfrutando de estos bonitos carnavales 2026; por acá lo hemos estado pasando muy bien, haciendo cosas sencillas, pero alegres en familia. Este viernes pasado estuvimos disfrutando del desfile de carnaval realizado por las diferentes instituciones educativas de nuestra querida ciudad de Cumaná. Gracias a Dios llegamos temprano y estuvimos esperando hasta que dieran inicio al desfile de muchos niños, representantes y docentes que le dieron vida, color y música a este bonito evento. Me quedé sorprendida con tantas escuelas que estuvieron presentes en estas comparsas escolares y no me había fijado que hubiera tantas instituciones educativas en nuestra ciudad. Aunque debo decir que había de todas las clases, desde maternal, preescolar, primaria, liceo, escuelas especiales y demás.
![1001457534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23uFU9fEiCsJZKJH2mENatnyceCFHKDN1f2JUXcAnkKdNKz8PAm3cF9cmxzVjpNog9tSm.jpg) ![1001457537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wMUMu934vFjuDbSSVLJ7w8mtNM8zxr2xj8vT6SEVtcZVGkwcCfmWDDvuP9u7vf3sMif.jpg) ![1001457535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tmFvRLKvtiDCariQWo8qbqGtYiqVbun1ifvT4tnTjVzj4DgUxu38PRJzcjicssnvrNv.jpg) ![1001457536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23u6335EkhT1ZhZYTwdHunmT6mQAeRXwp9vyCkS5cyJJmWZoeLNyDqfJqRbTKyktgBScX.jpg)

>

Hasta había niños discapacitados con sus sillas de ruedas o con condiciones especiales que me llamaron mucho la atención; se veían tan lindos, tan emocionados sus padres de verlos participando, de verdad que fue muy bonito. Gracias a Dios que conseguimos un lugar en donde podíamos ver muy bien porque había bastante gente por toda la avenida por donde se estaban presentando estas comparsas. Se veía un poco desordenado porque, como les digo, eran niños que venían acompañados con sus padres, que muchas veces se metían a las comparsas y no dejaban ver muy bien lo colorido, lo bonito de sus disfraces. De verdad se vio todo el esfuerzo que hicieron los padres y representantes para que los niños participaran.

![1001457532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23tSUTsx8GNfRR5SFxfMcGheQJZVMViuXqRXLeooR6wyvafHA6AZpkG4G9Hm8yyaTyoz5.jpg) ![1001457533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eoc7ybwvCNtuByNZhgkZj6yc7hnXTKrURsf4KbFDN7gxwSVuCfWijQtgVK2XrqWBZqz.jpg) ![1001457530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wC9vT494Tcg7e1wjDBoNqtXoSrCEeVZJR6dnrkexVQKdz2vfz8Gd2wEigTn6GGVQ53x.jpg) ![1001457529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/EogMNQCxRjN862pvRiGNhtUagUq8u5zuJHf25gYBuuJRKTq6AZMNT5ijCxPiBT6yn7r.jpg) ![1001457531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vsQpu8w8vRHRbqrSMvjzXMgrs4rzTd7WSbrXADcEBn9LQFvBcL5h2mrLox3ZD2ztfaw.jpg)

>

Cabe mencionar que esta vez las comparsas tenían una temática basada en la venezolanidad, la paz y la unión de los pueblos; muchos estaban vestidos con los colores de nuestra querida bandera de Venezuela, también de naturaleza, muchos árboles como el araguaney, con ese color amarillo que relumbraba entre la gente. Había muchos trajes lindos, así como pancartas y bandas musicales con ritmo de carnaval que alegraban y ponían a bailar a los presentes.

![1001457540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wWyQ2Y2TGLxG5aZYYNX2z7SYU3qdCRGvG71WM6x9g3mKTFX8fGUWQikUQzKqcTEkvKZ.jpg) ![1001457541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23ywwZcB98zy1k1BAXso2vbVpvgUiTdpaKnR87GcADB8netQgUsUrAciiBiKRkhnjodMp.jpg) ![1001457539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/Eo8SmmJ9WR1KRYmsnBnYc9gjoc1TvRWvewenAPK9ViXKZkDGUuLBUyBDbtQcoEY1rnF.jpg) ![1001457542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23wCFsXzAJRjsU44DbxZpk8UueWvAHLiBHwiN9hFoyxyiJaiMh3bVPcNQoamzaSuvPx3A.jpg)

>

Por acá les dejo algunos fotos y pequeños vídeos de estas comparsas aunque se ven muchos, podriannser más, tenia el teléfono un poco descargado, ademas de la poca memoria, aun asi no queria dejar de capturar estos momentos y compartirlos en mi blog. Porque les digo tengo material de los carnavales 2025 demás que nunca publique y están esperando una oportunidad. Así que esta vez quise compartirles esto calentito y no fueran a quedar en el olvido. Luego nos fuimos a comer unos ricos helados en una bonita heladería, hay muchas heladerías por esta zona donde estaban las comparsas, la mayoría estaban llenas, en esta conseguimos por lo menos entrar, ni siquiera los helados los comimos adentro, estabamos afuera y de ahí estamos viendo cómo se estaban terminando las comparsas y los helados derritiéndose un poco, pero estaban deliciosos. Por cierto a Ámbar se le cayó la mitad a la barquilla, le compartí de la mía. La verdad pasamos esta tarde especial y lo demás días también estuvimos compartiendo gracias a Dios. Es todo por hoy amigos, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad de aventura por compartirles. Gracias por la visita. ******

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

body.title: Salida con mi mejor amiga [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> Holis comunidad de Hive, ¿como se encuentra? ¿Cómo los trata el universo? Tengo tanto que contar, pero hoy vamos a ser precisas, se que estoy perdida y desde que trabajo mis escusas es el trabajo, creo que estoy perdida de floja, porque son quinientas palabras no? Que me cuesta. Pero la verdad es que si me cuesta y mucho, todo el día es pensar, analizar probabilidades y escribir, y al llegar a casa lo menos que quiero es escribir y hablar de mi vida aburrida jaja. Bueno en fin, comenzamos, el tema de hoy es ¡salida con mi mejor amiga! Okey el pasado martes sali con mi amiga yosimar o como yo le digo bonsai jaja, resulta que era necesario una salida porque si no mi mejir amiga desde kinder me iba a bloquear por no cunplir con mis obligaciones jaja. >Hello, Hive community, how are you? How is the universe treating you? I have so much to tell you, but today we're going to be precise. I know I'm lost, and since I've been working, my excuse is work. I think I'm lost because I'm lazy, because it's five hundred words, right? It's hard for me. But the truth is that it's really hard for me. All day long, I'm thinking, analysing probabilities and writing, and when I get home, the last thing I want to do is write and talk about my boring life, haha. Anyway, let's begin. Today's topic is going out with my best friend! Okay, last Tuesday I went out with my friend Yosimar, or as I call her, Bonsai, haha. It turns out I needed to go out because otherwise my best friend since nursery school was going to block me for not fulfilling my obligations, haha. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaK1D3CJfy4Xrsk2xzioxynr1acV2yWn6csjy3HACcF68/1771700313245.jpg) Nos fuimos en un autobus llegamos al sambil y toco dar vueltas, primero buscamos el forro de mi teléfono nuevo, fue ultra difícil buscar lo juro, pero lo encontramos, mi amiga buscaba el cargador del teléfono nuevo de su novio, así que aja. >We left on a bus and arrived at Sambil, where we had to walk around. First, we looked for a cover for my new phone. It was really difficult to find, I swear, but we found it. My friend was looking for a charger for her boyfriend's new phone, so yeah. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDtoZJB5CgtNaZrmrG6jSJUxh3fwkf8KMzWxmyeRkwUB/1771698437611.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXUMh1KvQbaqmuy59Xc2iVbjpvmLxdsqLbaoghTZTAPbV/1771698389262.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXx9VHZdgrWFwWxWxwU7te6qSMG4LR7HjE4dfcxm9Ed1C/1771699113674.jpg) Luego pasamos por roselab, una tienda de maquillaje que la verdad no me genera confianza, ya me acostumbré a el maquillaje de Kimbeaty, no me saca espinillas a diferencia de las bases y correctores de roselab que según redes da espinillas, bueno el lugar lindo, les precios mas costosos de lo normal y con poca variedad. >Then we went to Roselab, a make-up shop that I don't really trust. I've gotten used to Kimbeaty make-up, which doesn't give me spots, unlike Roselab's foundations and concealers, which, according to social media, do give you spots. Well, it's a nice place, but the prices are higher than normal and there's not much variety. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAx3MvDgHpXwFW4JBmobjL6iKhbxTWRR3SyZ4vdLhUtv/1771698546549.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZ5WYEuWuLmhZ1HrGM6Rag3g8vE7JKfgvRWvsjM5Gv4L/1771698643314.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ8hJM8SUy5aKy69FQ3MaZ4m6eab7hKycch5P9e8cLMm5/1771698735682.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVM2n6xMqFM46GQ22CzH9ZSwzwsej9YrsdpDRSAVrNiJq/1771698666692.jpg) Yosimar compro un labial y un hidratante, mientras que mi persona compro un labial para mi mamá, porque yo fui la culpable que ella quedara sin labiales, ademas con el luto no puede usar colores como el rojo que en realidad ese es el color de la mayoría. Compramos eso, todo super la bolsa hermosa. >Yosimar bought a lipstick and a moisturiser, while I bought a lipstick for my mum, because I was the one who made sure she didn't have any lipsticks left, and besides, with the mourning, she can't wear colours like red, which is actually the colour most people wear. We bought that, everything was great, the bag was beautiful. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1muD8xqTBzQAg2KTktn1SqGhWSHwyxrJJ61ZEc8JvPU/1771698976872.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU2xH2QXRMQoaUnU9nfZ18RNA6cDcX4A34UHh9DF6Qxr/1771699205176.jpg) Ya una vez que se logro el propósito, fuimos a comer heladoooo, una barquilla, hablamos de todo, quemanos a mucha gente en la feria del Sambil y luego de ellos decidimos pasar por farmatodo comprando un agua y tonterías la verdad, todo estuvo de maravilla lo ame full, espero pronto se repita esa salida. Hasta un próximo post los amuuu. >Once we had achieved our goal, we went to eat ice cream, a cone, we talked about everything, we bumped into lots of people at the Sambil fair and then we decided to stop by Farmatodo to buy some water and other nonsense, to be honest. Everything was wonderful, I loved it, I hope we can do it again soon. Until the next post, love you all. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8nccjW8ZHvHS5z29pxmtaXkQrCmKJnoBhhjPLGxbELN/1771699064955.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8nccjW8ZHvHS5z29pxmtaXkQrCmKJnoBhhjPLGxbELN/1771699021153.jpg)

I thought today we might do another post with the YouTube videos I've watched this week. body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - Velvet Curtain
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Velvet Curtain. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcS7fcJuE2vIntyxkXjojtkBUAGOJOENFmh4Nx9g3rjuSA&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcS7fcJuE2vIntyxkXjojtkBUAGOJOENFmh4Nx9g3rjuSA&s=10)

[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcS7fcJuE2vIntyxkXjojtkBUAGOJOENFmh4Nx9g3rjuSA&s=10)

Jane stormed into Jason's room and pulls the velvet curtains apart. Letting a blast of bright sunlight into the room. She was surprised by the scene she saw when she turned around ready to be screaming at her younger brother.  

Jason has locked himself in his room for a week, after his girlfriend of a year had initiated a breakup citing differences in character, but they knew it's not the truth. She is leaving him for her boss. 

Unable to take the news, Jason went into his room and draws the velvet curtains and has not responded to calls or messages, cutting himself off from the world. 

Despite calls from his love ones to come out of the room and starts taking care of himself. No one was able to get in contact with Jason and the drawn velvet curtains made matter worse as police were unable to surveillance the room when they were called in, that's why we had our opening scene.

body.title: A Hive Friends UK 🇬🇧 Meet Up + A Power 🆙
body.body: In December 2025, some UK Hivians descended on London for the [Tokenize:LDN](https://tokenize-event.com/) event to represent Hive for the 10th Annual Defi Web3 Conference held at the ExCel Centre. @mcsamm spoke for the Hive project @wellsforall and I spoke on behalf of Hive. \n\nSome of us on @steevc's #britlist could make it, but given it was December other Brits could not. I pledged to make an \
a reality. The promise is now fulfilled and a new Friends UK episode, \

happened today in lovely Bedford. 
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYiboUg2i95MmnrpPJffYTxvSHEHhATSgxBSCtp9JD3Xc/hive_friends_uk_framed.jpg)
___



It was a midday meetup with folk training in or driving for hours from the North, South, and East of England to reach our rendezvous in the county town of Bedfordshire. @steevc and I brought Hive merch from @hivefest and other recent chain events we've attended, so the beginning of our get-together felt like we were opening stockings on Christmas morning. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxWHVHDe19zbAbcMPxuqdw5zRpnCg8uETz3mr4eNUs1r/aw_hive_meetup_2026_02_21.jpg)

From L to R, here's the Hive Friends UK MeetUp, 21 February, 2026—
♦️@alessandrawhite 
♦️@madasaboxof
♦️@chris-uk 
♦️@steevc 
♦️@nicklewis
♦️@shanibeer 
___

In additional to this being a Hive Meetup, today serves double-duty as a Creative Work Hour (CWH) meetup, too! Actually, this is **the 21st organized Hive & CWH MeetUp** in the last three years! Our dear @nicklewis is now properly invited into the @creativeworkhour crew. Welcome Nick!! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXk69fw5kGs5DruwqyTAFCxRPFbWGdKHbK19fm6XdU4Ch/aw_hive_meetup_powerup.jpg)

A daily part of how CWH reinforces its commitment to the chain is that we power up based on the number of active Hivians (based on the status shown on [HiveBuzz](https://hivebuzz.me)) who join us in the daily live online co-working sessions. To celebrate CWH MeetUp #21, we will power up an additional 6 HIVE to our daily total, to honour those who joined us in Bedford today. 🎉
___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeWsssnyKYw6prMrUvM4hRtiGAXvVS3fQPXdSF1ZmLau/aw_hive_1_of_2026_02_21.jpg)

To divide the tasks of organizing the meetup, I ran communications & photography and @steevc took care of lunch reservations, the after lunch walk route, and the venue for end-of-day drinks. 

After lunch at the [Olive Tree](https://olivetreerestaurants.co.uk/olive-tree-bedford/), @steevc led us on a brisk walk along the River Great Ouse, which is famous for it's swans, but Canadian geese like to encroach on the prized waters traditionally dominated by the majestically-paired water foul. 🦢🦢

___

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXnbwLXuDwrC1vyAYd2P5CLU3BEwpFmquCPPzHz8KnHom/aw_hive_2_of_2026_02_21.jpg)

It turns out that the swans aren't the only stars of Bedford. Along our walk we saw the White Water Arena signage honouring the British slalom canoeist Etienne Stott, a beloved son of the city, who rigorously trained on this river and earned a Gold 🥇 Medal at the 2012 London Olympic Games. 

___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQ5LVE5y6BkUrMsCAFTdob8FpKbtUzsgZRny5ayR76we/aw_hive_3_of_2026_02_21.jpg)

At the conclusion of our Riverside walk, we took the corner opposite St. Paul's Church which has origins dating back to the 8th Century, but the current structure dates to the 13th Century, albeit with restorations along its timeline. A stunning example of mediæval collegiate architecture. 
___

A perfect ending to a perfect day together, we enjoyed drinks courtesy @shanibeer and @madasaboxof at the riverside Bedford Swan Hotel's Pen & Cob bar and restaurant. I tried to stump dear @steevc. I asked, \
Without missing a beat he said, \

So quick, that Steve!

Besides being a winning partner at trivia, should you need one, @steevc was brilliant in helping me organize the day. That said, it all came to life because @nicklewis, @madasaboxof, @shanibeer, and @chris-uk trekked the whole way to Bedford so we could spend the day together. 

Many it be one of many more to come! 

Much love! 🥰
Alessandra

Ps. if you want to be added to the invitation list for the next Hive Friends UK MeetUp, please let me know in the reply below. Even if you just have plans to travel to the UK and want to be included, let me know that, too!

___

body.title: Vibing into the Void
body.body:
AI is everywhere. ~~AI is taking our jobs. AI is walking our dogs.~~ AI is going to replace all Hive devs. 

Right?

So let's put it to the test from the perspective of a non-developer. The idea here is to consider a regular person who looked up Hive briefly, maybe has a faint understanding of what a repository is, and how they may prompt AI to develop a Hive dapp.

## Problem
Middle Earth is in peril. Tourism is at its lowest since Covid. They need a travel app to track and engage visitors.

# Development
## Prompt
*Build me an app that's based on the Lord of the Rings map where each town, village, and marker is connected to the Hive blockchain using the Hive Application Framework. Users can log in using the Hive Keychain and visit locations by pressing on them. When they press on a location it will transmit to the Hive blockchain the words \

followed by the name of the location.*

**Follow-up Prompt:** Use https://github.com/hive-keychain to achieve this.

## Base44
https://middle-earth-trek.base44.app/

Base44 is owned by WIX, the website builder. Started off strong and enabled JSON transactions. It achieved this after the initial and the follow-up prompts. It meters free credits and initially refreshes them every 21 hours, which is fair. 
- Original 2 x prompts
- Prompts to simplify the backend
- Prompt to initiative a Hobbiton expansion by adding a \

function which opens a modal where users write exactly 14 lines about a random Hobbiton topic (the topic is provided by AI, the title of the post is auto-generated with AI, and it is to publish to Hive with a \

tag and 100% power up)
- Numerous failures 
- Fast thinking AI, good to work with despite failures
- Backend is full of modules which will have to be rewritten to functionally deploy 
Several days of auto-refresh credits led to a 23-day long wait for credits. Now waiting to see what the future holds. 

**Relevant posts:** 
- https://hive.blog/hive/@ab-tester/look-mom-no-hands-mlfurzyx
- https://hive.blog/hive/@ab-tester/hobbiton-expansion-mlhm68qw
- https://hive.blog/hivedevelopment/@ab-tester/ai-stuck-mlkcucyu  (troubleshooting simulation)

## Blackbox AI
A quick search for alternative AI services brought me to Blackbox AI. 
- Prompted to reference the Base44 app and recreate it with the same prompt
- Keychain login does not work
- Map looks unfortunate to say the least
- This is a fast AI, easy to work with
- Product is a downloadable scrip which you deploy using own resources
- Graphics are lacking 

**Relevant posts:**
- https://hive.blog/ai/@ab-tester/journey-through-ai-mllvv5x5

## Replit
https://middle-earth-ledger--guiltyparties.replit.app/

This was a very brief test as its free credits run out after one use. Fortunately I've smartened up by now and combined the first two prompts into one, immediately pointing it towards the Hive Keychain github repo. It produced an interesting app although hard to say why it figured it'd be best to use the world map for Middle Earth. 
- Fast and graphically inclined
- Keychain login worked right away
- Transmission of visitation data worked right away 
- Location graphics seem to shift on the map when moused over
- Daily refresh of credits means I have to wait to test it further

**Relevant Posts:**
- https://hive.blog/ai/@ab-tester/back-in-business

## Vercel
https://v0-lord-of-the-rings-app.vercel.app

I don't know what level of patience I need to use this AI to develop but I know I don't have it. It thinks slow. Reminds me of that scene from Zootopia with the DMV. My self-control ran out of credits before it did. 
- Slow af
- Had to be prompted twice at the start as it thought so long it disabled itself and produced a 404
- Keychain login works 
- Transmitting JSON does not work
- Attempts to give it another source of information did nothing

**Relevant Posts:**
- https://hive.blog/moredev/@ab-tester/vercel-404-oof

# Graphics 
## Grok 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTJXgdocsFxNrQTLgVaE3KpEoo36GjXK1TWrbqLzqVq71/image.png)

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTe7o8BMB5whs5797iqMXKdcScMr6RyG5gwwrKiMa1SNf/image.png)

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSctzYERdszgqgSUKb2qhJShGFqUM4FMBbQt5ByEajeqs/image.png)

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfGTrBKXHtG43d8S9wApicVq2yt8oxubvgymBDi19jvMD/image.png)

**Conclusion:** AI is not taking anyone's jobs, let's get this out of the way first.  

We evidently need to make Hive more promptable for AI agents and for that we need to provide AI-targeted resources. We also need to develop structured example prompts that anyone can use to craft their Hive interaction application.  Hive is a blockchain designed with ease of building in mind. We should focus on allowing normal people to build their interaction tools vs building full-fledged apps. 

Remember, back in 2016 key interactions were done either through CLI wallet commands or through custom scripts. Problem is that required skill. This is a gap that can be filled with AI. We want to give people that flexibility to use Hive however they want to use it, to store whatever data they need, to have light interactions, to make their Middle Earth maps. We can't expect them to sit there researching repos and developing highly-targeted prompts because they'll give up. 

**Next Steps:** 
1. Keep testing and building out Middle Earth
2. Create a series of example prompts 

Keep an eye out for @ab-tester updates.

# Chasing Sunsets: My Journey Through the Most Stunning National Parks

As the sun dips below the horizon, painting the sky with hues of orange, pink, and purple, there's a magic that unfolds in the great outdoors. There's no better way to experience this breathtaking phenomenon than in the heart of our nation's national parks. Join me as I recount my journey through some of the most stunning landscapes, where each sunset was a masterpiece waiting to be discovered.

## 1. **Yosemite National Park, California**

Yosemite is a haven for nature lovers, and its iconic El Capitan and Half Dome provide the perfect backdrop for a sunset. I hiked to Glacier Point, where the panoramic views left me speechless. As the sun set, the granite cliffs were bathed in golden light, and I felt a profound connection to the beauty surrounding me.

![Yosemite Sunset](https://example.com/yosemite_sunset.jpg)

## 2. **Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona**

No list of stunning sunsets would be complete without the Grand Canyon. I arrived at Mather Point just in time to witness the sky transform into a vibrant canvas. The shadows danced across the canyon walls, creating a mesmerizing display that reminded me of nature’s artistry. It was a moment of reflection, standing on the edge of one of the world’s greatest wonders.

![Grand Canyon Sunset](https://example.com/grand_canyon_sunset.jpg)

## 3. **Zion National Park, Utah**

Zion's dramatic cliffs and canyons offer an extraordinary setting for sunset chasers. I hiked the Watchman Trail, where the view of the Watchman mountain against the colorful sky was breathtaking. As the sun descended, the cliffs glowed in shades of red and orange, making every step worth it.

![Zion Sunset](https://example.com/zion_sunset.jpg)

## 4. **Acadia National Park, Maine**

Acadia is known for its rugged coastline, and I made my way to Cadillac Mountain, the first place to see the sunrise in the U.S. However, the sunset views were equally stunning. The sky reflected off the Atlantic Ocean, creating a serene atmosphere that felt like a dream. Sitting there, I realized that every sunset is unique, just like our experiences in nature.

![Acadia Sunset](https://example.com/acadia_sunset.jpg)

## 5. **Glacier National Park, Montana**

In Glacier, I found myself surrounded by towering peaks and pristine lakes. The sunset at Lake McDonald was a sight to behold. The water mirrored the colorful sky, and I couldn’t help but take a moment to appreciate the tranquility. It was a reminder that the journey is just as important as the destination.

![Glacier Sunset](https://example.com/glacier_sunset.jpg)

## Conclusion

Chasing sunsets through these national parks has been a transformative experience. Each park offers its own unique beauty, and witnessing the day come to an end in these stunning locations is a reminder of the wonders of nature. Whether you’re an avid hiker or a casual traveler, I encourage you to seek out these magical moments. Grab your camera, hit the trails, and let the sunsets lead you on your next adventure!

---

Feel free to share your own sunset stories or favorite national parks in the comments below! 🌄✨

body.title: Daily Prompt | Velvet Curtain
body.body:
Mrs. K's house was one of the strangest and most mysterious in the neighborhood, because no one could ever be seen inside it, partly thanks to the dark velvet curtains.

Not a single ray of light had entered that house since Mrs. K bought the property, as she never left unless the moon was already well up in the sky.

Her habits were quite eccentric, and combined with her pale, almost transparent complexion, she seemed less like a person and more like a ghost.

She went out shopping once a month, always during the new moon, as if even moonlight bothered her, dressed in enormous sunglasses that barely revealed part of her face, gloves, a scarf, long trousers and long-sleeved shirts.

Upon returning, she would always peer through the window, shifting the velvet curtains just a few millimeters, as though searching for something or someone who might have followed her.

Once she had made sure that everything was fine, she would gently let the dark velvet curtains fall back into place, shielding the house from curious eyes — and perhaps from something more that only she knew.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDTWkkZeK6UQ215Yp8rX1yntDd7ENpcVFnsQ9pne5vsH/1771717412430.jpg)





La casa de la señora K era una de las casas más raras del barrio, y también misteriosas, porque nunca se podía ver a nadie dentro de ella, en parte gracias a las oscuras cortinas de terciopelo.

En esa casa nunca entró un solo rayo de luz desde que la señora K compró la propiedad, ya que nunca salía de la casa si no hasta bien salida la luna.

Sus hábitos eran bastante extravagantes, lo que sumado a su pálida tez blanca casi transparente la volvían una persona que más parecía un fantasma.

Salía a hacer las compras una vez al mes, y siempre lo hacía en luna nueva, como si hasta la luz de la luna le molestara,  ataviada con unas enormes gafas de sol que apenas dejaban ver parte del rostro, guantes, bufanda, pantalones y camisas de mangas largas.

Al volver, siempre observaba por la ventana, corriendo apenas milímetros las cortinas de terciopelo, como si buscara con la vista algo o alguien que pudiera haberla seguido.

Una vez se hubiera asegurado de que todo estaba bien, dejaba caer con suavidad las oscuras cortinas de terciopelo, blindando la casa de miradas curiosas y tal vez de algo más que solo ella conocía.

body.title: Healthy and filling  smoothie with almonds, carrot and banana. [ENG - ESP]
body.body:
***Greetings dear Amazing Drinks community 🤗***

+ ***Saludos querida comunidad de Amazing Drinks 🤗***

Have you ever had breakfast and then been hungry again two hours later? I imagine you have; it happens to me sometimes. Today I had that mid-morning craving for something to eat—well, actually, it was almost noon—and I wanted to eat everything in sight. Cookies weren't the best option, so I decided to make this recipe: a very healthy smoothie with almond milk, banana, and carrot.

I had seen a similar smoothie online a while ago, but it used cow's milk. I preferred to use plant-based milk, which I consider healthier, and I need to reduce my dairy intake. The truth is, I made my smoothie and it was fantastic—very filling and delicious. I think it will become one of my favorite smoothies! 👌

+ ¿Les ha pasado que desayunan y después a las dos horas tienen hambre? me imagino que sí, a mi suele pasarme algunas veces y hoy estaba con esa ansiedad de comer algo a media mañana, bueno la verdad era casi el mediodía y me provocaba comer de todo lo que veía, y galletas no era la mejor opción, así que me propuse hacer esta receta, un batido muy saludable, con bebida vegetal de almendras, cambur y zanahoria.

+ Había visto hace tiempo un batido parecido por internet, pero este llevaba leche de vaca yo preferí usar una bebida vegetal, la considero más saludable, además mi consumo de lácteos debe disminuir, lo cierto es que he hecho mi bebida y me pareció estupenda, muy saciante, y tiene muy buen sabor, creo que se convertirá en uno de mis batidos preferidos 👌

---
---
![photo_4958986020858825566_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/241tfR3puzzLDVP2W6DyWQmn3AmicP1WEoBnboEfcQ7vbbQw4H5Njq4PS8P4Tn3PvkDMx.jpg)

---
---
***Now I'll share the recipe with you! Will you join me? 😉***

+ ***¡Ahora compartiré contigo la receta! me acompañas? 😉***

# Ingredients:
-60 grams of almonds, soaked for at least 8 hours and drained.
-500 ml of cold, filtered water.
-1 medium banana.
-125 grams of carrot (equivalent to one medium carrot).
-2 teaspoons of ground flaxseed.
-1 tablespoon of honey (optional).
-1/4 teaspoon of salt.

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -60 gramos de almendras, previamente remojadas por mínimo 8 horas y escurridas.
+ -500 ml de agua fría filtrada.
+ -1 cambur mediano.
+ -125 gramos de zanahoria, equivale a una zanahoria mediana.
+ -2 cucharaditas de linaza molida.
+ -1 cucharada de miel, opcional.
+ -1/4 cucharadita de sal.

![photo_4958986020858825548_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpLfzZ5JKMsrD7brVmkytwzyfCMk2mjcsRJTp78BjZ6y2ftuD6Z575fWGHzRjNonqbv.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

We'll begin by making the almond milk. It's important to soak the almonds for a few hours. Mine soaked in water for about 10 hours. Then I drained the soaking water, rinsed them with clean water, and they're ready to make the milk.

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Vamos a comenzar haciendo la leche de almendras, es importante hidratar las almendras por unas horas, las mías estuvieron aproximadamente 10 horas remojándose en agua, luego le saqué el agua de remojo, les pasé agua limpia y están listas para hacer la leche.

We put these almonds in the blender along with 500 ml of water, and blend very well, approximately 1 minute, then strain, you can use a strainer with very fine holes or a special cloth, now that we have strained, we have our plant-based drink ready.

+ Estas almendras las echamos en el vaso de la licuadora junto con los 500 ml de agua, y licuamos muy bien, aproximadamente 1 minuto, luego colamos, puedes usar un colador con agujeritos muy finos o una tela especial, ahora que hemos colado, tenemos nuestra bebida vegetal lista.

![photo_4958986020858825549_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeFNtkChxjDMJZhx8ZsbSnzFQtPC5B2JJJbKjfVS4Hg9eXZCug8higetPgSaHZpddL.jpg)

![photo_4958986020858825550_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Ep3dsHqMBVvGVEjB1nHgXDA7PFB2EfT7M1gyZeqdmbpiMQpm7BHCemXmhuUGu2KL72T.jpg)

---
![photo_4958986020858825551_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoAaHccb2B2CgGquufdeCpRtBPptCSGFjQ1XQGhoeFx6DEmbpHVQXEs2UTNck1TDHvr.jpg)

---
![photo_4958986020858825552_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EopuKU5C67enGtX8uZtRzp92BpbcjMjusuY7torGYxHkQW6HjpGagxFCpZY7MDxuwsy.jpg)

Next, we chop the carrot and put it in the blender, we also add the banana, which I cut into slices.

+ Seguidamente picamos la zanahoria y la echamos en el vaso de la licuadora, agregamos también la banana esta la corté en rodajas.

![photo_4958986020858825553_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23yTjdjwGwwEGPRtH8naMHdd6QhXQk59M9nCo1cxX6W6MN7fY89ALCigwmen75aQ5Uopq.jpg)

![photo_4958986020858825556_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoeEU9VCVFCThYYS7RgUSWdLrB4ptqaJR59q9fr87qMmF1sFXHmb8kFjoRSUK4CnwcP.jpg)

We add the flaxseed and the salt.

+ Añadimos la linaza, la sal.

![photo_4958986020858825557_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoEq3Huxs1i6ngjVHkB56kb1x99S4hCWvoXQfhbokqfYSMkdicx34o3oFERBZFWNDSs.jpg)

---
![photo_4958986020858825558_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiVGYNBh2vGsqwTPJC4jtfYxwQvUsVu8GCfpuXYWku8Cd3NcwxJ4UdSJq7JGgzrUbA.jpg)

Now we add the plant-based milk, and if you want this smoothie a little sweeter, I suggest you use honey 👌

+ Ahora integramos la leche vegetal, y si quieres este batido un poco más dulce, te sugiero que uses miel 👌

![photo_4958986020858825559_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EopsNYuJ7AfKXSUckF2GziYQoqexyXiAuZP23U2BobxaVXtUW2r33Pj4xEByEasTzr9.jpg)

---
![photo_4958986020858825560_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xyZaGoJ1qmopYCXMZfnrFGbxHx8LEPVakLSSsmvgpZZNutHNmDPyVaQAzEQGP3W4SrE.jpg)

---
![photo_4958986020858825561_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoK5uicq6cTwqG2aT8XkMHx5t3BL6At3QWyWsEiKp7sZKwyBdVKutW7KrF9cUYiWiyv.jpg)

Blend everything very well, that's it! If you prefer a more delicate drink you can choose to strain it, I preferred to leave it like this, it's thicker but I don't want to waste anything.

+ Licuemos todo muy bien, ¡listo! si prefieres una bebida más delicada puedes optar por colarla, yo preferí dejarla así, queda más gruesa pero no quiero desperdiciar nada.

![photo_4958986020858825562_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23x1FfybAT314PqgRRcr3QxNCcyt6ZxM76uBmMKk6P18mrkBAkWrEjtkfTcTrQK28V4du.jpg)

***It's time to serve and enjoy! 💪***

+ ***¡Es hora de servir y disfrutar! 💪***

![photo_4958986020858825564_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23zGh3RQA6iLUcoqdfe6tenvdtUhGUqXpHvqsTFjSJ93Z5sm1ez9rHFccTFrtG2byRwVs.jpg)

![photo_4958986020858825565_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpGRCCTjWs9RjetqNqdzjrpPT3MnRH2EnfyzgvvgnoWxyKfArhzW72vbVtrqEfnRj8g.jpg)

body.title: The Discipline I’m Trying to Build
body.body:
I've a lot of things last year which was the year 2025 and I can say that there were lots of things that I don't know about at that time, my colleagues help me in times that I have questions about the programming language that I am studying and yeah, they help me a lot. 

So, while most of the programming languages that we've been using is that the PHP, JavaScript, CSS, html, and such but there's this website or tool that I eagerly want to know about. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/AJbhBb9Ev3i1cHKtjoxtsCAaXK9njP56dzMwBRwfZVZ21WseKsCa6ZT7ocSs7Sd.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/illustrations/a-person-sitting-at-a-desk-with-a-laptop-wRTI0TGGlx8)

You know what is that? The WordPress.. it sounds silly to learn because that's only a tool or a platform where you can drag and drop some of the programming languages that we've been using like the CSS, HTML, and etc. 

But I am a hands on PHP coder where there's no drag and drop but I think it's hard for me to adjust the drag and drop style.. Do you have any idea how to cope up with this with the drag and drop style for the WordPress? It seems that I am stuck with this hands on and wanted to shift to a WordPress which is the drag and drop with so much tools that are present.. 

I think it also needs time to adjust things and to migrate my knowledge into another platform with a drag and drop but starting slowly is not bad since if I am eager to learn, I need to do the hard way but there were times that my laziness kicks off and that's why I cannot start to work with the things that I want to do.

I am somewhat torn on things that I want to do and there were lots of things that I have on my mind, in which I cannot focus myself clearly. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23xAu2kAS4cwqwYvUQaZ24WHiudvxuAMt2mp3YQtnjBQDwsuxxPApEvwpoyBXztq9UDM2.png)
[*Source*](https://unsplash.com/illustrations/open-to-do-list-with-sticky-notes-and-coffee-e2vXg_pzZyk)

Well, I think for me, if I want to learn, I also need to balance my time more while taking it slowly, like an hour or two every day make sense and have a time stamp on what will be my itinerary for that day. 

What I'm lacking is not the passion because I have that one but I think the time management on how to manage my time correctly and what would be the best course on doing so.

body.title: Leaving marks on life/ Dejando marcas en la vida
body.body: >\n\nFreewriters' spaces offer us the opportunity to observe a photograph and contribute a story based on what we see there. It's a writing exercise called: \

I'm sharing the link to the post and inviting you to participate: [A picture is worth a thousand words](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw)
VERSION ESPAÑOL(click here!)

Los espacios de Freewriters nos brindan la oportunidad de observar una fotografía y aportar una historia sacada de lo que miramos allí. Un ejercicio de escritura denominado: \

Les comparto el enlace del post extendiéndoles las invitación a participar: [Una imagen vale más que mil palabras](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw)

**Describe what you see** Looking at a young ice skater, with all her equipment ready to perform a routine for competition. Her face shows concentration and at the same time concern for perfect execution. **Describe what you feel** I'm thrilled to see the image, a young skater with a well-prepared physique, her strong legs make me envious, I know how difficult it is to maintain balance in skating.
VERSION ESPAÑOL(click here!)

**Describe lo que ves** Mirando una joven patinadora sobre hielo, con todos sus complementos para ejecutar algún ejercicio para la competencia. Su rostro demuestra concentración y al mismo tiempo preocupación por la ejecución perfecta. **Describe lo que sientes** Me emociona ver la imagen, una joven patinadora con una contextura de preparación, sus piernas fuertes me dan envidia, se lo difícil que es mantener el equilibrio en el patinaje.

**Leaving marks on life**
Each line, each turn seems to mark the course, always moving forward gliding with each movement. With each step, an advance with each shift a point of advantage. Success encourages us, points and applause encourage us. Harmony with every step, tells no tales of effort, of daily sacrifices. With every stumble; the spirits reveal, a total state of worldly success. A coming and going on either side of the track, a constant strengthening. In the end, simply applause.
VERSION ESPAÑOL(click here!)

** Dejando marcas en la vida**
Cada linea, cada vuelta parece marcar el recorrido, avanzar siempre hacia adelante deslizarse con cada movimiento. Con cada marcha, un avance con cada desplazamiento un punto de ventaja. Nos anima el éxito, nos animan los puntos y aplausos. La armonía con cada paso, no cuenta historias de esfuerzo, de sacrificios diario. Con cada agitación; los animo revelan, un estado total de éxitos mundanos. Un ir y venir a cada lado de la pista, un fortalecimiento constante. Al final simplemente los aplausos.

Because every step is a constant exercise in learned courage, leaving footprints on the sharp pencil of ice. Leaving marks as a daily exercise, leaving marks by example. An exercise in leg strength, an exercise that strengthens through imagery. You have to be brave for the daily cold, the sprains and muscle aches. Everything gains strength at the end of the day. It's all worth it for that small medal. Others are following the path, the example in skating. Every clap becomes priceless.
VERSION ESPAÑOL(click here!)

Porque cada paso es un ejercicio constante de valor aprendido, dejando huellas en el afilado lápiz del hielo. Dejando marcas como ejercicio diario, dejando marcas con el ejemplo. Un ejercicio de fortaleza de piernas, un ejercicio que fortalece a través de imágenes. Hay que tener valor para el frio diario, las torceduras y dolores musculares. Todo va tomando fuerza al final del día. Todo queda saldado por esa pequeña medalla. Otros van siguiendo el camino, el ejemplo en el patinaje. Cada aplauso se vuelve de un valor incalculable.

body.title: 🏛️ Between History and the Sky
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTCWF924yh5cQ1EdnvL7ChnwPgRREe339583M2VPgFdMV/IMG_3336.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUYN1Z2Tagdx28YqZJFLXGiRyHsc5qmh4R4mFqGNg3jNr/IMG_3334.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTbbdD6JG2GDEwrUtxRhiSgnRT1K1mGwLCJ6Kptysresp/IMG_2950.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZQBXW5qT7HFZErnqtsjGDXuTB6kzTdm8gqa4C74joFkf/IMG_3333.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb37XbuahJqZ2BPwjK4tw4ZG5pwMrZLh5u7g8r5qNFd75/IMG_3335.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ1Cq3Wr5ve9nPWRvsrrS5sPMEE14hNkNWhui7jHJ44Np/IMG_2951.jpg 


There’s something magical about standing above the city and feeling like time slows down.

From the stone statues surrounded by pigeons, to the ivy climbing quietly over old balustrades… everything feels alive in its own way. The architecture tells stories. The stairs feel endless, yet inviting. And the view — that wide, open view of Barcelona — makes you breathe differently.

Walking through Montjuïc feels like stepping into another era. The fountains, the columns, the symmetry of the city stretching toward the mountains… it’s powerful without being loud. Just elegant. Just present.

Sitting on those historic steps, watching the domes rise behind, you realize how small moments turn into unforgettable memories. A quiet smile. A simple pose. A phone in your hand. A city at your feet.

And from above, Barcelona doesn’t just look beautiful — it feels timeless.

Some places aren’t just destinations.  
They’re feelings you carry with you.

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands - Entering Survival Mode
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfUR6EbatMr9v5aNB2EVgJhawJsCTvo9f7CUY16BviL6x/Portada%20-%20Splinterlands%20-%20Entering%20survival%20mode.png </center>

<center>A few days ago, the **Survival** mode returned with the start of this season, and I spoke about its effect on the markets and my thoughts on that first day; but I also mentioned that I wanted to test this mode. However, since I wanted to see how far I could go, I did not start playing as soon as it began because I wanted to see where the majority of players gathered and, with it, the greatest possibilities of finding battles with balanced enemies and the best rewards.</center>

><center>Hace unos días volvió el modo **Survival** con el inicio de esta temporada y hablé de su efecto en los mercados y de qué me parecía ese primer día; pero donde también dije que quería probar este modo pero que, al querer ver qué tan lejos podía llegar, no empecé a jugar apenas empezó porque quería ver dónde se reunían la mayoría de jugadores y, con ello, la mayor posibilidad de encontrar batallas con enemigos equilibrados y las mejores recompensas.</center>

<center>In my publication [**Splinterlands - Survival - Impact on the Market and Battles**,](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-splinterlands-survival-impact-on-the-market-and-battles-2wh) I mentioned that the majority of players were in the **Bracket XI – Expert - Automated** where **Bots** were allowed, but I wanted to see if there would be any change over the days; and there was an increase in all modes, but the majority of players remained in **Bracket XI – Expert - Automated**.</center>

><center>En mi publicación [**Splinterlands - Survival - Impact on the Market and Battles**](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-splinterlands-survival-impact-on-the-market-and-battles-2wh), hablé de que la mayoría de jugadores estaban en el **Bracket XI – Expert - Automated** donde se permitían los **Bots**, pero quería ver si habría algún cambio con los días; y sí hubo un aumento en todos los modos, pero manteniendo la mayoría de jugadores en **Bracket XI – Expert - Automated**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWawPvmYHEoSn9XyfZQYnZJTyckvYNd81K6PdN5i1Zm3a/Brackets.png </center>

<center>I did not only wait these days to see where there would be more players; I also did it because since **Survival** is a very **Hardcore** mode that locks cards upon losing, I wanted to let the most enthusiastic players with the most resources play during the first days, or the crazy players who entered to test crazy strategies just for laughs, and thus let them go up or down to the leagues where they should be, thereby facilitating my battles without losing cards against teams far superior in resources to mine.</center>

><center>No solo esperé estos días para ver dónde habría más jugadores; también lo hice porque, al **Survival** ser un modo muy **Hardcore** que bloquea tarjetas al perder, quería dejar que los jugadores más entusiasmados y con más recursos jugaran los primeros días, o los jugadores locos que entraron a probar usando estrategias locas solo por las risas, y así dejar que subieran o bajaran a las ligas donde deberían estar y así facilitar mis batallas sin perder tarjetas contra equipos muy superiores en recursos a mis equipos.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSiDg6C8qy7hMveuqKrj2Htc2GHEj7UFdM2tuh2awEfQ4/2.png </center>

<center>This mode allows the use of cards of any level without limitation, so it is better to use cards at their maximum levels; but if one has cards at lower levels, they can be used without problem, which suits me well since, despite renting many cards with all the **Archons** that I usually use at their maximum level, I have cards that are not at their maximum level but are good despite that and end up being the key to several of my victories. This means that if I lose some battles, I will be able to use cards even the cards I have at level **1** to fill the positions if I lose many battles, serving even as decoys for the enemies.</center>

><center>Este modo permite el uso de tarjetas de cualquier nivel sin limitación, por lo que es mejor usar las tarjetas en sus máximos niveles; pero si se tiene tarjetas en niveles más bajos, se podrán usar sin problema, lo que me viene bien ya que, a pesar de alquilar muchas tarjetas con todos los **Archons** que suelo usar en su máximo nivel, tengo tarjetas que no están en su máximo nivel pero que son buenas a pesar de eso y llegando a ser la clave para varias de mis victorias. Esto significa que si pierdo algunas batallas, podré usar tarjetas incluso las tarjetas que tengo en nivel **1** para rellenar las posiciones si pierdo muchas batallas, siendo aunque sea señuelos para los enemigos.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUwdqycHaR3aBv1WrWgCwS9H83qUmT4LPbZgGQZvJT8qC/Leaderboard%20V2.png</center>

<center>Another advantage of waiting a few days is being able to see the **Leaderboard** list to know which **Bracket** to enter to calculate things such as how many players who entered have managed to play more than **100** battles, which helps to know how long they will take to find opponents. Seeing which players are at the top allows for a lot of information, such as the level they play in other modes, if they are recurring players you play with, and how many chances of winning you have, or watching the battles to get an idea of what you may face. But it must also be taken into account that this list only shows players who have played more than **100** battles in that mode during this season, not the **100** best players; that is why one must pay close attention when viewing this list because players who have lost **100** battles may appear and be in **Bronze**, or players who have won **99** battles and are in very high leagues like **Diamond** or **Champion** may not appear on the list.</center>

><center>Otra de las ventajas de esperar unos días es el poder ver la lista de **Leaderboard** para saber en qué **Bracket** entrar para calcular cosas como cuántos jugadores de los que han entrado han llegado a jugar más de **100** batallas, lo que ayuda a saber qué tanto tardarán en encontrar contrincantes. Ver qué jugadores están en el top permite saber mucha información, como el nivel que juegan en otros modos, si son jugadores recurrentes con los que juegas y qué tanta posibilidad de ganar tienes, o ver las batallas y darte una idea de lo que puedes enfrentar. Pero también hay que tomar en cuenta que esta lista solo muestra a los jugadores que han jugado más de **100** batallas en ese modo durante esta temporada, no los **100** mejores jugadores; por eso hay que tener mucha atención al ver esta lista porque pueden aparecer jugadores que han perdido **100** batallas y estén en **Bronce**, o puede que no aparezcan jugadores que han ganado **99** batallas y estén en ligas muy altas como **Diamond** o **Champion**, pero que no aparecerán en la lista.</center>

### <center>OPINION</center>

<center>Already with all this information, I can start playing, but I have to manage the time between playing the **Frontier** mode and the **Wild** mode, and add this new **Survival** mode, even if only for a few days until I lose all the cards I can use; but I want to test how different it is to play against other players who know that if they lose, they will not be able to use their cards, in addition to seeing how much can be won in this mode using the same cards I already use in other modes.</center>

><center>Ya con toda esta información, puedo empezar a jugar, pero tengo que gestionar el tiempo entre jugar al modo **Frontier** y el modo **Wild**, y agregar este nuevo modo **Survival**, aunque sea por unos días hasta perder todas las tarjetas que pueda usar; pero quiero probar qué tan diferente es jugar contra otros jugadores que saben que, si pierden, no podrán usar sus tarjetas, además de ver qué tanto se puede ganar en este modo usando las mismas tarjetas que ya uso en otros modos.L</center>

# <center>[Join Splinterlands here. / Unete aqui a Splinterlands.](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=durlan)</center>

body.title: ¿Se trata de sentido? [ESP][ENG]
body.body:
Hace unos días visité el Decanato de Humanidades y Artes de la UCLA, y para mi sorpresa había una exposición de obras de los estudiantes y aunque le tomé fotos a las que más me gustaron, hubo una en especial con la que me sentí identificado. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd4bYD3k9ZVSuqNsq7qEXxVZvcpmQfbsG3M4uxH8Z7Jvj/image.png 


Lamento no recordar el nombre de la obra, solo que me sentí identificado por todo el mensaje que a  mi parecer parece expresar. Desde hace meses he tenido que acompañar a Zully en su proceso tras el diagnóstico de “Trastorno depresivo mayor” y que me ha hecho mucho más consciente de todo lo que implican las enfermedades mentales. 

La obra es a mi parecer rica en elementos que evidencian la fragilidad de las personas que atraviesan procesos de este tipo y que aunque no todo es del todo oscuro, y hay personas que pueden acompañar, no siempre se tienen las mejores herramientas o conocimientos adecuados para hacer un acompañamiento más asertivo. Lo que me ha hecho investigar sobre el asunto y estar más atento a lo que ocurre. 

Hay una analogía que escuché en un podcast que me sacudió mucho, a una persona que atraviesa un cuadro clínico complejo como lo puede ser un diagnóstico de cáncer no se le suele decir cosas como: “vamos echale ganas”. La motivación no es mala per se, pero cuando las afecciones están más allá del control no sirve de nada la motivación. Entonces por qué a los pacientes con enfermedades mentales si le decimos: “Échale ganas, tú puedes”. No es como que las personas quieran estar enfermas.  Porque al final es una enfermedad.

Lo cierto, es que la obra me hizo reflexionar mucho, y  al escuchar al joven artista explicar cuál fue su motivación, sentí la obra aún más cercana. Pues expresa que le inspiró la obra  El hombre en búsqueda de sentido de Victor Frank texto que estoy releyendo justamente y que en gran medida podemos rescatar una valiosa enseñanza de la obra, se trata de comprender que en las situaciones más oscuras aún podemos encontrar bondad y se puede expresar cosas maravillosas del ser humano. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSmqMFkBSCX15McDj9UXHFBMLXjvSCSNmnTxBXfdNijvH/image.png 


Y se puede reinterpretar las situaciones complejas como procesos que pueden tener una transformación positiva, hay cosas que pueden sacar lo mejor de nosotros a pesar de someternos a barbáricos procesos internos que nos doblegan y nos hacen más frágiles de lo que nos gustaría y pensar en eso puede ser una relectura positiva a procesos que simplemente no terminan de entenderse. 

El sentido no es que sea algo fijo o determinado, se puede reescribir y reinterpretar, aunque no siempre sea algo sencillo de hacer y nos exige más de lo que  podemos imaginar, nos podemos sentir muy exigidos pero, no hay mal que por bien no venga o eso me gusta creer. 


**PD: QEPD Willie Colón**


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y5tRf-M5vmc

*Fotografía @filoriologo Redmi Note 14**Edición: Adobe Photoshop Lightroom*



***

---

##  ENGLISH VERSION

# Is it about meaning?

A few days ago, I visited the Dean of Humanities and Arts at UCLA, and to my surprise, there was an exhibition of student work. Although I took photos of the ones I liked best, there was one in particular that I identified with. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd4bYD3k9ZVSuqNsq7qEXxVZvcpmQfbsG3M4uxH8Z7Jvj/image.png 

I regret not remembering the name of the work, only that I identified with the message it seemed to express. For months, I have had to accompany Zully in her process after being diagnosed with “major depressive disorder,” which has made me much more aware of everything that mental illness entails. 

In my opinion, the work is rich in elements that highlight the fragility of people going through processes of this type, and although not everything is completely dark, and there are people who can accompany them, they do not always have the best tools or adequate knowledge to provide more assertive support. This has led me to research the subject and be more attentive to what is happening. 

There is an analogy I heard on a podcast that really struck me: you don't usually say things like “come on, cheer up” to someone going through a complex clinical situation such as a cancer diagnosis. Motivation is not bad per se, but when conditions are beyond control, motivation is useless. So why do we say to patients with mental illnesses, “Come on, you can do it”? It's not like people want to be sick. Because in the end, it is an illness.

The truth is that the play made me think a lot, and when I heard the young artist explain what his motivation was, I felt even closer to the work. He said he was inspired by Victor Frank's Man's Search for Meaning, a text I am currently rereading, and to a large extent we can glean a valuable lesson from the play: it is about understanding that even in the darkest situations we can still find goodness and express wonderful things about human beings.  

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSmqMFkBSCX15McDj9UXHFBMLXjvSCSNmnTxBXfdNijvH/image.png 



Complex situations can be reinterpreted as processes that can lead to positive transformation. There are things that can bring out the best in us despite subjecting us to barbaric internal processes that break us down and make us more fragile than we would like. Thinking about this can be a positive reinterpretation of processes that we simply do not fully understand. 



The meaning is not something fixed or determined; it can be rewritten and reinterpreted, although this is not always easy to do and demands more of us than we can imagine. We may feel overwhelmed, but every cloud has a silver lining, or so I like to believe.


**P.S.: R.I.P. Willie Colón**

body.title: Valentines' Decoration Set with my Children ..! ❤️ || At Galerias Mall
body.body:
>

*Feliz sábado queridos hivers, gusto en saludarlos esperando que tengan un buen fin de semana junto a sus seres queridos, el día de hoy les quiero compartir unas hermosas decoraciones de San Valentin ❤️ que estaban decorando las tiendas y establecimientos en el centro comercial el pasado fin de semana, a propósito de celebrarse el dia sabado el día del Amor y la Amistad, fecha que nos permite demostrar el amor mas puro que sentimos por nuestros hijos, padres, pareja, hermanos, amigos.* *Las decoraciones estaban hermosas llenas de corazones, globos y flores que son los elementos más característicos en este tipo de sets; la que más me gustó fue el corazón blanco donde pose junto a mis hijos, los cuales amo con toda mi alma, y representan mi mayor motivo de lucha diaria, después de ahi nos fuimos a comer unos helados para seguir disfrutando este dia* *A pesar que estas fechas son más que todo comerciales, ya que considero que el Amor es un sentimiento que debe demostrase a diario y en cada oportunidad que podamos, es propicio darse la oportunidad de expresar nuestros sentimientos con una tarjeta, un dulce o incluso con un beso y un abrazo de esas personas especiales que hacen nuestra vida más bonita* ****

>

***Happy Saturday, dear Hivers! It's a pleasure to greet you and hope you have a wonderful weekend with your loved ones. Today, I want to share some beautiful Valentine's Day decorations ❤️ that adorned the shops and businesses at the mall last weekend, in celebration of Valentine's Day, a day that allows us to show the purest love we feel for our children, parents, partners, siblings, and friends.*** ***The decorations were beautiful, filled with hearts, balloons, and flowers, which are the most characteristic elements in this type of display. The one I liked best was the white heart where I posed with my children, whom I love with all my heart, and who are my greatest motivation every day. After that, we went to get some ice cream to continue enjoying the day.*** ***Although these holidays are mostly commercial, since I believe that love is a feeling that should be shown every day and at every opportunity, it's a good idea to take the chance to express our feelings with a card, a sweet treat, or even with a kiss and a hug from those special people who make our lives more beautiful.*** ***

body.title: Serenity Awaits: Exploring Landthai Hills, Lantay, Bohol
body.body:
![Gray Minimalist Special Moment Photo Collage A4 Document_20240809_153753_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23xVVQ2qUqYGPmBNZADH82tQev8er6TLkwDsuv2XrCi3B1yHPxxdjW8ke1cFpW1iQLi4x.png)

***A God-given opportunity once again — this was my third time at Landthai Hills.***

![IMG20240809114549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EqfFuNLAd4PFmgNhHJTojU8MtLga6UwEiP8g3cZBfV2695evBh2QaUFcJbuzC4rr5DJ.jpg)
 Far away from any toxic surroundings, it’s a peaceful place with no noisy echoes, perfect for a relaxing moment at the top. The walk from the bottom to the summit was exhausting, but every step was worth it. **There’s truly nothing like the beauty of nature and the amazing creation of our Almighty God.**

![IMG20240809120353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23zvHTVaeTo9PM5tCj6Qi666EsXVRPWHA4kS5f3GMBYhogvJGnucVXU1d4yVtwcshYVJL.jpg) 
***This is one of the breathtaking views you can see and truly appreciate.***


![IMG20240809093614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/AJpjqF6dcPc4chyjzUQ3gZjrAG6vDYPfxW4G2E5mzobQxYnr1rxbQWnicnSSjeQ.jpg)
 This is the entrance to what we call **Landthai Hills**. It takes about 20 minutes to walk from the bottom up to this entrance area.



![Messenger_creation_33d20020-5bc8-4d4e-b067-31517a009207.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EpzxJVctxDoqNVCNMsZTrdsCLKEuPhzZCNh6qtme17RXCYz37g8aB3QuzExTUky5zZr.jpeg)
 **This is the Vego and Felicia families.** The girl with the unique black-and-white hair is the second child of our Senior Pastor, married to a Norwegian. They have three wonderful kids, each with their own personality — all adorable when in a good mood 😄 (*the youngest isn’t visible here, hiding behind his mother).*


![Brown Aesthetic Family Photo Collage_20240809_153208_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/48Gi7JZ6mEqEKt6bXJap5Ay2wdEttbNT2DkYsXRKW7mEQTQyvvwAEcPwcfVEeoS43p.jpg) 
**Meet the three little Musketeers from Norway!** 😄 I always call them himossshhhh, which means “cute” in English. They’re all so handsome and adorable, and many people say the eldest is especially good-looking 😎



 
![Green Black Minimalist Photo Collage Instagram Post_20240809_152612_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/EonmTyqYtoYQqHUvrnAjZ5z94UFvZxMhhvawGUmVT8QVXRgxrbSxPrEYfWcTAAJLSfk.png)
**I captured beautiful photos and shared wonderful moments with the Vego and Felicia families.** Here at Landthai Hills, you can sit back and relax anywhere, and the surrounding views will truly amaze you. It’s a place where memories are made and peace can be felt in every corner.




![Beige Blue Minimalist Aesthetic Photo Collage Beach Desktop Wallpaper_20240809_201130_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23ynSfGtpZr4KApcf1D9npwqhvKwGoUtwYynp4NbbCmsRfrBS8kau65sMazKrj483aDcp.png)

**They also have a swimming pool — and you know what makes it unique? There’s no chlorine! It’s filled with natural spring water, which makes it super cold, especially in the evening.**

I remember when we had a youth camping fellowship overnight here. Pastor Jose’s grandsons were so excited about the pool that right after we arrived and had lunch, they immediately jumped in! 😂 ***You know kids — full of energy and always ready for fun*** 😊 


**Overall, my time at Landthai Hills was truly a blessing.** From the peaceful views and refreshing spring water to the joyful laughter of the kids, every moment was worth remembering. It reminded me to slow down, appreciate nature, and cherish the simple yet meaningful times spent with wonderful people. Indeed, it was another God-given opportunity I will always treasure.

Til next then, thanks for reading my story 🫶🏼

body.title: [EN/PT] Island Tour final stop - Morro de São Paulo
body.body: > # [EN] These photos are from the last part of the Volta à Ilha tour in Morro de São Paulo. After leaving the floating restaurant, where we enjoyed delicious oysters, we headed to the historical part of the tour, which was a visit to a church. However, no one in the group showed any interest in doing this part of the tour. Even so, everyone had to get off the boat to refuel at a station by the water. We took advantage of this stop to explore the beginning of this small village and take some photos. Upon arrival, we saw several stalls with shells and handicrafts produced by local residents, which made the place even more charming. We also took some pictures of the statues that mark the beginning of the path leading to the church. While we were taking pictures, the boats were being refueled, creating that typical scene of a bustling coastal village. My wife and I took full advantage of the opportunity to capture these moments of the place and also our own. I hope you enjoyed this short post! 😊 --- # [PT] Essas fotos são do último trecho do passeio Volta à Ilha, em Morro de São Paulo. Depois de sairmos do restaurante flutuante, onde saboreamos deliciosas ostras, seguimos para o ponto histórico do roteiro, que seria a visita a uma igreja. Porém, ninguém do grupo demonstrou interesse em fazer essa parte do passeio. Mesmo assim, todos precisaram descer da lancha para o abastecimento em um posto à beira da água. Aproveitamos essa parada para conhecer o início dessa pequena vila e tirar algumas fotos. Logo na chegada, vimos várias barracas com conchas e artesanato produzido pelos moradores locais, o que deixou o lugar ainda mais charmoso. Também registramos algumas imagens das estátuas que marcam o começo do caminho que leva até a igreja. Enquanto fazíamos as fotos, as lanchas e barcos eram abastecidos, compondo aquele cenário típico de vila litorânea cheia de movimento. Eu e minha esposa aproveitamos bastante para guardar esses momentos do local e também nossos. Espero que tenham gostado desse pequeno post! 😊 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-island-tour-final-stop-morro-de-sao-paulo)

body.title: Challenge #04802-M053: Define Normal
body.body:
![victoria-JGK2EWz6iAE-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23wX1YRBErxxACzXPiEEjsjH1xVujW24NBuqNWtuvmpqMy4kXBsfdUze4WJpxnqwYGZKV.jpg)

> Amy haven’t made a milkshake in a while, so she started gathering fresh ingredients her favourite strawberry-banana milkshake. Her mouth waters as she fill the blender, But something lingers in the back of her mind something she’s forgetting… suddenly her neighbour knock on her door. “Amy! The boys are back in town!” But it was too late [the blender just started whirling](https://youtube.com/shorts/DZt-CyKfAxQ?si=1sfDRDy8H2YzyIwB) -- Anon Guest

The return to normal had been irrevocably altered. They _pretended_ everything was normal after the sweeping changes. By and large, they could all manage just fine in a world without real men.

Science, and the fact that humans weren't fully mature until thirty, had done much to keep the population stable. The only remaining issue was that the male portion of the population were compelled to become nomadic. Seasonal visits were equal parts heartbreaking and enlivening. Many got to see their loved ones again.

Maybe that was the other reason why Amy did it.

Her husband was long gone, thanks to the awful plague. She could see her sons again, true, but she wanted...

She wanted someone to stay. Even if she had to grow them herself.

There was one thing they all craved. They could smell it from miles away. It always drew them in. It skated on the edge of morals, but more and more women were doing it. Darla had told her the migrating herd was on their way. All the 30-something's lagging behind as the plague entered its final stages. All the older teens and twenty-somethings looking for a mate.

She'd been a teenager when she had to marry Richard. Her sons were over eight - old enough to join the herd - before she turned twenty-three. She didn't miss Richard at all, but she missed having a baby to cherish.

Which was why she had seven blenders working away by an open window, and her door wide open.

As the thunder of tramping feet grew more definite in Amy's ears, and she  took off her panties. All the better to get it done quickly.

They craved fruit and dairy, and the oldest and fastest would be lucky enough to mate. And today? _Today_ marked her best chance to conceive a girl.

The first of the herd leaped her fence. She offered him the whole blender full of milkshake, and let him do the rest.

##### Hi everyone :)

Here it is again :)
I've already photographed a few that I've had the opportunity to share the results of here, but they never cease to amaze, all seemingly the same, but all demonstrably different in their most intrinsic details.
The shell representing the pilgrim walkers who travel the roads of Santiago de Compostela.
As with all the others I've photographed, at first glance it seems like a fairly simple and uniform piece, but when you bring the lens closer, all those fascinating details immediately begin to emerge.

##### Session Purpose
The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

##### Let me present today’s model:


![IMG_3476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23yTdB6bzH4T6QWGXi1Ld4L4rcqHjJkF3HDda5xyWbZxiX7S58qSmbNEnv4X7eoSrSYht.jpg)

---

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/5 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: Variable aperture between f/3 and f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (600) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)

body.title: Give Me A Place To Stand
body.body:
*Give me a place on which to stand, and I will move the Earth.* History is littered with individuals making outside the box statements on the edge of what their contemporaries considered rational. Personally, my first thought process is always where are they coming from to make such statements, the know-how build up and developed confidence to speak with that kind of certainty. Bold statements without a foundation are just noise. When someone has done the deep work, followed the logic all the way to its most extreme conclusion and still found it holds, that's a different thing entirely. There's a long line of the same type of statements that have now proven to be incorrect, though at that time folks believe it was the truth. For example, Earth located at the center of the universe and the flatness of the world beyond the horizon. People didn't believe these things out of stupidity, the available framework at the time made them reasonable. Good update thanks to the forceful hand of change. Can you imagine still believing that we are at the center of the universe around which everything moves? It seems laughable now, but that belief directed entire civilizations. And now, I wonder what ideas we believe now to be true that future generations will look back on with the same disbelief we reserve for flat earth maps. ![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/7657221/pexels-photo-7657221.jpeg)[Image Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/yellow-and-green-lemon-fruit-on-gray-concrete-surface-7657221/) ### Physics of leverage Unchanging principles that have existed for centuries are intriguing for me to look closely as a way for building more foundational knowledge of the world. Ideas that survive that long have been tested by time, stress, contradiction, revolution etc. and something in them held. There's strong comfort in knowing that beneath the noise of trends and disruption, certain structures of reality stay put. Leverage is one of those words that is subjectively popular to me nowadays. A good tool to know how to use across different domains against the backdrop of a world where traditional effort is getting more divorced from expected outcome proportional to effort. The statement on the top is from Archimedes, a ancient Greek mathematician and inventor born around 287 BC, said about mechanical advantage, which I think is a subset of leverage at large. Mechanical advantage is basically the mathematics behind why a lever works. On a given rigid bar pivoting around a fixed support, the same effort produces vastly different results depending on its position, so what matters really isn't just the force you apply, but where you apply it relative to the fulcrum, which is that fixed support point or the thing that stays still so everything else can move. For example, a small weight placed far enough from the fulcrum balances a much heavier weight sitting close to it. The product of weight and distance is what nature responds to, i.e double the distance, halve the force required. Extend the distance far enough, and theoretically, no load is too great to lift. Hence, the saying *I will move the Earth when given a place on which to stand.* However, in terms of executing that in practice, the only missing variable is a long enough lever and somewhere outside the Earth to stand and pull it off. ### Surrounded by levers On a serious note, it goes back to how one can look at effort, specifically to restructure how the work is expressed. We are surrounded by levers, many of which we don't fully recognize as such or have the know how to actively utilise. Capital is a lever. Money, deployed well, compounds and produces returns that no equivalent hours of labor could generate. Knowledge is another lever. Having understanding of a domain deeply enough means one insight can unlock decisions worth far more than the time it took to acquire it. Coupled with the right relationship, in the right context, can open doors that years of direct effort couldn't. The sort of superficial first reaction conclusion is having a shortcut to fast track much of the boring needful work from point A to Z. This may work in the short term, but mid to long term, one will inevitably revert back to baseline without sufficient understanding of the underlying principles. I think in some sense, the shift happening in the world right now is essentially a shift in which levers are available and how accessible they are. ### Effort is not THE variable Coming back to traditional effort, i.e showing up, working hard, putting in hours, etc. used to be the primary mechanism of advancement. It still matters as a foundational work, but it is increasingly insufficient on its own. The people moving disproportionate weight are not necessarily working harder. They have found better fulcrums(pivot positions) and understand that the insight is where you are standing when you apply force as opposed to how much force you can generate. Archimedes didn't need to move the Earth. He just had to understand the principle well enough to know that he could. That confidence coming from following logic to its conclusion is itself a form of leverage. One will still have to do the work first, and then apply the lever. Now, I need to continue with finding where I ought to stand in order to move my own Earth.
*Thanks for reading!! Share your thoughts below on the comments.* Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@takhar/give-me-a-place-to-stand-esu)

body.body:
[**Shadow Hunters Contest - Round 414**](https://ecency.com/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-be9c20eca751b)
**Show Me A Shadow** 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeLU9ob9yFb98mJnZaWFZLcxeh6M2bpSBgda6K3p6rKn/20220730_094501.jpg)

Letnje pozornice odolevaju svim vremenima. Znamo da najstarije letnje pozornice na svetu potiču iz antičkih vremena. I danas, vekovima kasnije, duh zajedništva i umetnosti lebdi nad svakom otvorenom scenom.

Zanimljivo je pitanje, šta je to u ljudima što ih privlači da grade i posećuju letnje pozornice i amfiteatre?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT53jwHK5FJuZxxcMEjoSFTteZFQJXA9JWWUpFGsRXpiZ/20220730_103337.jpg)

 
Možda je to potreba da budemo deo nečeg većeg, da pod zvezdanim nebom delimo emocije sa drugima, bliskim ali i nepoznatim ljudima.
Pozornice spajaju istorijsko nasleđe sa različitim kulturnim manifestacijama, pružajući jedinstven doživljaj posetiocima koji zatvoreni prostori ne mogu da pruže.

I ja sam jedan zaljubljenik u letnje pozornice. U njihov izgled, i njihovu namenu. 
Kad čujete \

, pomislite na koncerte, predstave, prigušenu prijatnu atmosferu i sjajnu energiju.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmco63DS4VyFL3RQ4kjcL5LKeywzA5RrTpSgfGsAGjFnGK/20220730_103403.jpg)

Fotografije amfiteatra u Vrnjačkoj Banji snimljene su jula 2022. godine. Podsetile su me na avgust 2018. godine i koncert grupe \
, poslednji koncert na kom sam bila.\n\nUlaz je bio slobodan za sve posetioce, letnja pozornica popunjena do poslednjeg mesta. Prelepa noć pod zvezdanim nebom uz koncert grupe \
i muziku koja povezuje sve prisutne, izveštavali  su sa događaja.\n\nTako je to. Tokom leta, najčešće u avgustu, banja uvek \

besplatan koncert posetiocima. Ljudi pohrle, ne samo fanovi, zbog posebne atmosfere u letnjim noćima, zbog osećaja slobode i radosti. Otvoreni prostor, blagi povetarac i muzika uživo dovoljan su motiv.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeR7P38oYTPqu98KXQhjD1aVPXMq9Lf7BZGsFqNDht1pr/20220730_103659.jpg)

Kao i za mnoge druge stvari u životu, iskoristićemo ponuđenu priliku i uživati u događaju. Ne mogu a da se ne zapitam, koliko ljudi bi zaista otišlo na koncert da nije besplatan ili otputovalo u drugi grad ako nije u pitanju njihova omiljena grupa?

A ono što žarko želimo ostaće nam nedostižno... Mada, nikad ne reci nikad!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9qrvvxuCiA3xmLqwy3La2Tfo91Av8o8pH3zgAQETzLR/20220730_104252.jpg)
