body.title: Living on the Edge
body.body:
If you’re the adventurous type who thinks that sticking bolts on the side of a mountain to put a walkway and enjoy the wonders of nature while thrillingly defying certain death among the rocks below is a good idea, then you might enjoy the Capilano park Cliffwalk. 

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoeEVEpxCzSDRqNhVVscytFpmqS4ZmHNHsSKjpRNUGEeQecnadPrwn5yx54C2ofe2ny.jpg)</center>

There have been many points when I have questioned my life choices, and this was one of them. 

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EokcBTjrHJ4sowaU4NK3yR315wYVit9HtjmDF5NfQ7pTaDiJrjo79FoDgswPqGAoeuU.jpg)</center>

From a distance, the engineering holding the walkway looked robust to my untrained eye, and the mechanics also looked elegant from a design perspective. I decided to put trust in the craftmanship of my fellow countrymen and throw caution to the wind. 

<center>![Capilano Walkway04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep7tZZkmUzA14zP2ZkQzQSSr7FeqP443zLyjapLH3z96sCbVM2GxxUje4EmR97UGBqd.jpg)</center>

As I descended the Dantean stairs, I realized I couldn't turn back now. Not because I didn't want to but because there were some classy ladies right behind me in the tight stairs, and I wasn’t about to let them see me sweat, even if it meant falling off a canyon. Feminine approval is everything 💪

So down I went...

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoChfqLV2pms5KfJ2BzB615oogZ4sZf53sQuYGrrhZ5hykRukhN51T9bG6yHwHedtop.jpg)</center>

and then sideways along the mountainside.

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep7u8DbwxWkGHehLqVmVgDKvCxTEq2dTNjPEh3U9JuBa2NMLtY7DdtjBw8bH7EeS2rZ.jpg)</center>

From the walkway, one can see the Capilano river below. It’s actually an impressive (and dangerous) river when it fills up and squeezes through the canyon during torrential storms, snow melts, or when dam waters are released. 

<center>
![Capilano Cliff Walk08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EorzH2GQxWcrLaESyZT1XdgsEKZPpDZoh83TWA1aMiSrcsgQNpWbJENBL4hwT2hEomS.jpg)
</center>

The top of the trees are visible too, and it’s like entering a strange world that we rarely get to experience. 

<center>![Capilano Walkway06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EowH4kT2k3mEy9VkUeVifbJt3CwwGh2CrFXF7WxVTNQtNMfN8gcFiorMsVum3JCNGcM.jpg)</center>

This wasn't just a walk in the park, this was a living science lesson that spanned geological time.

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EokdYch3PridzasK6M9RsL4wBkDLfkrQFH19AeWWMuABezQo8HYDRD4SjmPJ87om8GH.jpg)</center>

Some primitive superstitious sabertoothed part of me kept wondering about plan Bs should some unexpected event occurred whilst I was traipsing across the platform. What could I hold on to? What would happen if I fell on top of a tree? Or clung to a rock?

<center>![Capilano Walkway02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpEHijQTdHueGe2kb6kcsLLcyHkaQZYoBRKN9dBJaha7hUZR3YGmD9dWicpU2UDXuP7.jpg)</center>

<center>![Capilano Walkway03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpNnPE3fBd53BDSqZxu2sARZusfPbEvYvRrVuZMvbDrmw2Uuwb1Z1LhUdgxPeec1zou.jpg)</center>

Did I mention we live in a seismic zone? More doubt creeped in my mind. Was this worth the headline? 

**Local man falls off cliff in freak accident after an eagle drops a fish on his head.**

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoiVBjwDtxMnBvFAy2ky8TVrHAm6BhFMEkosHXXsxzqNULf6GeZ49PrnDrp4NqX8Kun.jpg)</center>

The planning that must’ve gone into making this walkway must've been extraordinary. Safety must've been first and foremost in its execution. 

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eoc8RA26SUA7RirL6NaQYq6eADydcYc6FzHGhytg3k2CCsa21zfKYRcJ7M9E1H9Hizx.jpg)</center>

<center>![Capilano Cliff Walk07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EpCBKS1VA18cLPYqTiQC6UsG2mQ7DMWTq22Umja1QA9cNHwSzbzCE9S6dzbFcSBWc9a.jpg)</center>

body.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1303 - Another Round of 'We Are Alive Tribe' Investments Made! - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Friday, February 17, 2026
body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_084710660_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23yd61VcfRxuSeC89yadMo6QmMNduTNZECJ6JLUm4eEhRXxbkVmKEmAkdgd1oAoX6uXu4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 22.57% HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.069 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.975 USD BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00126954 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.114290 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001985 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 68,580.7 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 564.92 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.35 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 5,107.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 84.49 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #138 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#109 (among active witnesses only)/283.4k HP in votes/42 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 I'm happy to report that I just completed another round of investing into building and growing our 'We Are Alive Tribe' decentralized community economy and financial framework, thanks to the always generous donations/contributions from Ben (@benthomaswwd / @benthomasuk). This time around he sent 100 SWAP.HIVE, and 0.1 SWAP.LTC to our @heartbeatvault01 account, and 100 SWAP.HIVE, 100 BEE, and 10,000 HEARTBEAT to our new 'We Are Alive Tribe Sovereign Wealth Investment Fund' account, @waat-swif (*I still need to add info and a link for this account to my post footer, and to add an avatar and banner image*). These larger regular investments from Ben, and the more modest daily ones from me, are extremely useful, as they're allowing me to give nice boosts to our various income streams, and to start new ones. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_143549044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsDWSgqbiziZmLHiLjTgu9Yns6afT4d1EHxu9KshWfJoLE3VjBW8z3kMyEREUWgFCba.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_144832491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvYJrU8Bx4NEXHVhaD9FFsGFXxvj9655EELUXLMcrYDf3SVzuPobFaDTAHiCVamP9bJ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) On @heartbeatvault01, I used the SWAP.HIVE that Ben had sent to add a bit more liquidity to the SWAP.HIVE:PWR, DVS:DHEDGE, AFIT:SWAP.HIVE, SWAP.HIVE:HASHSCORE, SWAP.HIVE:TRADE, SWAP.HIVE:TRIBE pools, to various CENT pools, to all 4 CCC pools, as I added liquidity to one new pool, AEGIS:SWAP.HIVE. Unfortunately I didn't notice the SWAP.LTC on that account until after I had already allocated most of the SWAP.HIVE (*doh!*), so until the next larger investment, I'll just add a bit to the SWAP.HIVE:SWAP.LTC pool each day, as the amount of available SWAP.HIVE allows. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_145944752_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFH1jaztLvD4KdAUdB4GJvB7sWrRQCuxyJ7oRvXh8nW97pKMTY7Cjvkmma11t7uxcuh.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_150133423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFPkirBhkVPrpveh5eRv6viDdEoNfAHLy2yFGrMXdXTw7daAnAz6VQqEW4TfDXYHio4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I forwarded the assets that Ben sent to @waat-swif on to @aliveandthriving, where I added the BEE to our growing stack of liquid BEE (*that we need for the creation of new ALIVE pools, and to start new distribution contracts for pool rewards*), I staked the HEARTBEAT, and I used a good portion of the SWAP.HIVE to mostly clear all the sell orders for DAB and DBOND off the market (*only reasonable sell orders...lol!*), with the other portion going into increasing liquidity in the SWAP.HIVE:ATF and the SWAP.HIVE:PWR pools, and to adding liquidity to the same new pool, AEGIS:SWAP.HIVE. I was able to acquire a substantial amount of DAB, which should give us a nice boost to our daily and weekly HIVE income. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_150344996_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC1UK96Cimx3bievkfQBRCKRaiFu1m7puFSFvyPCbm8fnHCoCyMBAL4N89jXmUrN5e8.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_150501752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2cAkrBuCRcdc9vHce3f3hyJkHzH7DSGM3Q6GZT3mgnzyGubsQ3tdgQcqdHW96u4wZA.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) The new and increased income streams will make my asset-leveraging endeavors flow so much more quickly and easily, not in huge ways, but in very useful ones. As I progress, I'm continuing to add liquidity to new pools, many of which are ones that I've found to be very good on my own account, with some also being new, and often very useful, experiments. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_150800266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvYHpvjM7qER6BZZpE39fCN1njo74CHnKqbpTFEodmgmQQ1oZRFrSd3KMwDt8zewPsn.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_150845674_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmFr2fnwj7GoWPzY9U39GW6UFrH8EawqnDCg4mZQpp4QKUvu9AW9Vniu5yWWj2McUK1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) On @aliveandthriving and @heartbeatvault01, I've already notably exceeded the liquidity that I have in certain pools on my own account, which is very interesting, as it gives me an idea of what different amount of liquidity earn, and it also gives me something for which to look forward. The greater our investment liquidity, the more fun and useful this will become for all of us over time, my friends! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_151013268_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC5ZvofV28gaoZhsyUMN5QxuHd9EWMC7VW1gm7uVyFwP3LX5tdGueWwXMsej5YTeMMM.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_151105069_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbpgY46U6p5Sc1i8TGDAg1Vi4UxY7AWrsyGTXedScxhgTR1GbFcM5NRoUgPyEwDWxrT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Friday, after finishing up most of my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, I (*unexpectedly*) prepared for a session that I (*incorrectly*) thought was not happening. The session started late, and it was not an ideal day for a session at all, being cloudy, rainy, and chilly, but it did go well. We wrapped it up by around 5:15PM, after which I went to turn on the generator (*since it was cloudy and rainy all day*), and then to the new kitchen to make myself some food (*a mini spiced-and-seasoned beef burger, on olive-oil-toasted sourdough, with pepperjack cheese, and Dijon mustard*). With my food done, and my leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I headed back to the Flow House, to begin my evening Hive tasks. I had a lot of notifications again, but thankfully I was able to get through them all this time, finshing by a little after 10PM, doing some asset management, then going to bed by a bit before 12AM. I woke up a little after 6:30AM, having slept well, doing more asset management, going to make my superfood fire coffee in the new kitchen, then returning to the Flow House to allocate the assets that Ben had sent for the We Are Alive Tribe, and to write this post. It's now just after 1:15PM, so it's quite a good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on community/land work. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's iteration of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_151204726_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC5GTCLAqoXVBTk11ehMd5mQNCUroCuAwCvPKWS6phuUPHai9AzRk7Jis94cbZypss3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260218_151636419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvYJqpCB4NocfKSJQWKs6gS1izzFVGk53dvEBFANSF13oYfQJE11XP7uwb2fALuHYga.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) body.body:
![8hKprxwDaxz690np_1000508080.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/8hKprxwDaxz690np_1000508080/8hKprxwDaxz690np_1000508080.webp) ![BvQt9h9ncVyySulX_1000508081.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/BvQt9h9ncVyySulX_1000508081/BvQt9h9ncVyySulX_1000508081.webp) ![i9zHwDfxrbURzMjB_1000508088.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/i9zHwDfxrbURzMjB_1000508088/i9zHwDfxrbURzMjB_1000508088.webp) ![AfGtLNt9Yh95faFN_1000508089.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/AfGtLNt9Yh95faFN_1000508089/AfGtLNt9Yh95faFN_1000508089.webp) ![LwTm63PmYFJPhVoX_1000508090.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/LwTm63PmYFJPhVoX_1000508090/LwTm63PmYFJPhVoX_1000508090.webp) ![1IvEXHegHMgu9MhZ_1000508096.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/1IvEXHegHMgu9MhZ_1000508096/1IvEXHegHMgu9MhZ_1000508096.webp) ![1fPfaLrCwBZ1h3PO_1000508097.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/glowshine/images/1fPfaLrCwBZ1h3PO_1000508097/1fPfaLrCwBZ1h3PO_1000508097.webp)
¡Hola, amigos! Una de mis comidas favoritas desde hace un tiempo son las alitas de pollo con salsa barbacoa, y si tienen un toque picante, mucho mejor. Así que, en nuestra última noche en Caracas, mi cuñada nos invitó a probar las que venden en Valle Café. Supuestamente, mis suegros y mi esposo no tenían hambre, así que solo pidió una ración de alitas con patatas fritas y ensalada de acompañamiento, pero creo que al final no fue suficiente 🫣.

Las alitas estaban tan ricas que no pudimos dejar de comer, nos las fuimos comiendo una tras otra sin parar, y eso que ellos no tenían hambre 😅. El sabor y lo jugosas que estaban me llevan a elegirlas como las mejores alitas que he comido nunca, son verdaderamente adictivas. Las papas fritas también estaban muy ricas y, como nada es perfecto, lo único que no me gustó fue la ensalada, ya que estaba insípida.

En conclusión, si tienen la oportunidad, visiten Valle Café, porque sus alitas valen completamente la pena. Además, el local es muy bonito y tiene varios rincones perfectos para hacer fotos dignas de tus redes sociales. ----- Hello, friends! One of my favorite foods for some time now has been chicken wings with barbecue sauce, and if they have a spicy kick, even better. So, on our last night in Caracas, my sister-in-law invited us to try the ones they sell at Valle Café. Supposedly, my in-laws and my husband weren't hungry, so he only ordered a serving of wings with French fries and a side salad, but I think in the end it wasn't enough.

The wings were so delicious that we couldn't stop eating them. We ate one after another without stopping, even though they weren't hungry 😅. The flavor and juiciness make me choose them as the best wings I've ever eaten. They're truly addictive. The fries were also very tasty, and since nothing is perfect, the only thing I didn't like was the salad, as it was bland.

In conclusion, if you have the opportunity, visit Valle Café, because their wings are completely worth it. In addition, the place is very nice and has several corners perfect for taking photos worthy of your social media. -----
¡Nos vemos pronto!
See you soon!

body.title: La Marzorca: no eran mazorcas, pero sí una experiencia
body.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmdbLxQkgabAo3LKKGkzmUE9ebRkTej9NmAwrfFJfkL1xU/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mirlenyjerez/9e455acf)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mirlenyjerez/9e455acf)


---

Este miércoles, justo después de la misa de Miércoles de Ceniza, decidimos ir a conocer un restaurante nuevo que nos había causado mucha curiosidad: La Marzorca. Yo iba con la idea clarísima de que vendían mazorcas 🌽 (el nombre engaña bastante 😅), pero sorpresa… nada de eso. El menú era más bien una mezcla bien interesante entre comida venezolana y colombiana: cachapas, arepas, parrillas y varios platos con maíz como protagonista.
La verdad, todo se veía muy rico y lo que probamos tenía buen sabor, se notaba que era comida hecha con cariño y bastante contundente. Eso sí, en mi caso no pude disfrutarlo del todo porque algo tenía gluten y me cayó mal 🥲. Los demás estaban perfectos, así que el problema fui yo y mi pancita delicada de siempre.
Aun así, la experiencia fue buena, el lugar es agradable y diferente, y se agradece encontrar propuestas nuevas. Si vuelvo a ir, seguramente será solo de acompañante y para mirar cómo comen los demás 😆, porque ya aprendí la lección. Igual, conocer lugares nuevos siempre suma, aunque no todo salga perfecto.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mirlenyjerez/9e455acf)

body.title: Beyond the Dollar: Non-USD Stablecoin Market Hits $1 Billion Milestone, Led by Euro-Backed Assets
body.body:
https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/pichat/1803c1a5e9b5ed7f64a1046bdc389723b29be8b2.png 

The global digital asset landscape is undergoing a notable shift as users look for stability beyond the dominance of the U.S. Dollar. According to recent on-chain data from Dune Analytics, the market capitalization of non-USD stablecoins—digital assets pegged to local currencies other than the dollar—has officially surpassed the $1 billion threshold. This milestone highlights a maturing ecosystem where regional financial needs are increasingly being met through blockchain technology.

Currently, there are approximately 32 distinct non-USD stablecoins circulating in the market, representing 11 different national fiat currencies. The distribution of these assets provides a clear picture of which regions are leading the charge in local currency tokenization. Europe stands at the forefront, accounting for a substantial 46.9% of the total non-USD stablecoin market share. This dominance is largely driven by the Euro, which remains the most popular non-dollar peg, making up 43.8% of the entire category.

Latin America has also emerged as a critical player, holding a 25% market share. In this region, stablecoins are often used as a hedge against local inflation or as a more efficient means for cross-border remittances. Specifically, the Brazilian Real (BRL) and the Mexican Peso (MXN) have seen significant traction, accounting for 12.5% and 9.4% of the market respectively. Southeast Asia is not far behind, contributing 21.9% to the global total, driven by the increasing integration of digital payments in everyday commerce across nations like Thailand, Indonesia, and Singapore.

The rise of these assets signifies a \

trend within the decentralized finance (DeFi) space. While the U.S. Dollar (through USDT, USDC, and DAI) still commands the vast majority of the overall stablecoin market cap, the growth of local currency pegs suggests that users are seeking ways to interact with blockchain protocols without being exposed to the foreign exchange risks of the dollar. For businesses and individuals in Europe or Brazil, having a stablecoin that mirrors their local purchasing power simplifies accounting, reduces conversion costs, and fosters a more inclusive financial environment. As regulatory frameworks like MiCA in Europe become more established, we can expect the diversity and liquidity of these non-USD assets to expand even further, potentially challenging the status quo of the global digital economy.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pichat/beyond-the-dollar-nonusd-stablecoin-market-hits-1-billion-milestone-led-by-eurobacked-assets-5bu)

body.body:
<center>![CoverCaturday_21022026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wgWa6ZEGAo817b7aihGPu5HkxQFBFUjTXMAXo4p1sxLu7irimq7e5kMDiKFTWnqHe62.png)

<sub>✦ Today we have babies! A house with newborn kittens feels MAGICAL! - Collage & Edition in FotoJet, photos by @Tesmoforia ✦</sub></center>

<center>![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)</center>

<div class=\

> 🇺🇸 ~ Today has been a very nice day 🤗 🐈‍⬛ 🌸 **Happy Caturday to everyone!** This Saturday, I started early to create a new file for all the stories of kittens that have passed through my community and current home between 2020 and approximately the end of 2025. It's not easy, but I'm taking my time and I'm in no hurry. I'm not ashamed to admit that I still feel some after-effects, mainly fatigue in both body and mind, as well as emotionally. In this process today, I realized that it's been quite a while since I've shared the progress of Luna (my Apollo's sister), and there's a lot of good and pleasant news from that side of town ~ >! [SPANISH VERSION] > 🇪🇸 ~ Hoy a resultado un día muy lindo 🤗 🐈‍⬛ 🌸 **¡feliz Caturday para todos!,** este sábado desde temprano me he dedicado a comenzar un nuevo archivo para todas las historias de gatitos que han pasado por mi comunidad y actual hogar entre 2020 y aproximadamente finales de 2025. > > No esta resultando fácil, pero me estoy tomando mi tiempo y no tengo apuro, no me da pena admitir que todavía siento algunas secuelas, principalmente de cansancio tanto en cuerpo como de pensamiento, y también emocional; en este proceso hoy, caí en cuenta que hace bastante tiempo que no comparto la evolución de Luna (hermana de mi Apolo), y hay muchas buenas y agradables noticias de aquel lado de la ciudad ~
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)
![Lunita2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23wC9zmbvfmCQSsCjaMftQynwPvTKePhjzaGF1jmAghbaZfk2xmvpqaapooYt6sj8vvyP.png) ✦ Luna is incredibly attached to her mother; she wants to be with her all the time ✦
![1771706095784.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xefViEzcgViq4LfUSb9rj5HYA1GFC8WeVjjWWX5L9fZ81f3QzZcsDfGxxsiBunei49d.jpg) ✦ Luna has been the subject of many funny anecdotes, because although her personality is not the same as my Apollo's, in her own way she has quite a few very charismatic traits ✦
![Lunita1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23vsLbTVSsoWAYWGtruAKm1CX2M5AUAeGRn7en1aBLBUQo4S4ohUWk1wR9QiKnFLh2XR9.png) ✦ There's no way to get her off a spot she likes, like on top of the TV. She loves being on top of the TVs in the house! ✦
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)

>
These years have been very good to Luna.
**She is the kind of cat who is very sure she wants to be an only child** (her family tried to adopt another kitten, but she behaved quite hostilely, so mission aborted). She feels like she owns the house and especially the humans who live there. you will regularly find her watching you from the heights of the cupboard, or occupying a seat in the dining room, as if she were a human being (looking at you inquiringly). >! [SPANISH VERSION] >
En estos años a Luna le ha do muy bien.
> **Ella es la clase de gatita que esta muy segura que quiere ser hija única** (su familia trato de adoptar otro gatito pero ella se comporto bastante hostil, así que misión abortada), se siente dueña de la casa y especialmente dueña de los humanos que allí habitan; regularmente la encontraras observándote desde las alturas de la alacena, o ocupando un asiento en el comedor, como si fuera un ser humano (mirándote inquiridoramente). |![VID-20260221-WA0139(0).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23z7JHG7Fw6mAjir3AwXAzyNUdg9VMjnXg9HLKxfqDpVsMLEsexqsainBXa1VPpGBdWD5.gif)|![VID-20260221-WA0140(0).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xKrGY8yvfx6TQvnSL57GwdNsNbSo3MWFxwYkC3u448RVmCsRQP69a2NiGL9P9uZN4uu.gif)| |-|-|

>

Another peculiarity of Luna is that she is a lap cat. She chases her cat mom around the house, and as soon as she sits down, Luna climbs onto her lap as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

Luna is the example that debunks the old myth that “cats are not affectionate,” both physically and emotionally, as she is quite talkative and retains baby kitten characteristics, such as her tiny meow and her wide-eyed gaze.

>! [SPANISH VERSION] 
> Otra particularidad de Luna es que es un gatito de regazo, persigue a su mamá gatuna por toda la casa y apenas ella se sienta, Luna sube a sus piernas como si fuera lo mas natural.
>
> Luna es el ejemplo que derrumba ese viejo mito de que \

, tanto física como emocionalmente, siendo ella bastante conversadora y conservando características de gatito bebé, como su maullido chiquito y esa mirada de pupilas siempre dilatadas.
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)
![Babys!2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23xVMRuedunFXVZW3au6jieVHfuFLjpfvcQ1f3E16f3bkKJgzH8z3PkQvYsKsH3KZzLDj.png) ✦ Little beauties! ✦
![Babys!.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tmN1EMM1SydpvP2FXM4v7tf3DjPmpebC5tMMLhprpfMfXVyhZYz58GfJabYNaQqqNX2.png) ✦ I had never seen gray kittens in person before, I'm so excited! ✦
![pink bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tbwLgrCrvjkBiLAtdtz7yZQj4tDbmuzC7N83gcXL7nZA6UfsqYFtZJnGa5RUdM6LqFs.png)

> Y para despedirme por el Caturday de esta semana, felizmente traigo estas noticias, de otra familia gatuna: En casa de un amigo que aprecio mucho, su hermosa gatita carey dio a luz hace unas semanas a estos 3 espectaculares gatitos (estas fueron las fotos que me compartió). Todos saludables, fuertes y esponjosos; mi amigo que ahora es un orgulloso abuelo esta muy contento, e igual que yo quisiera quedarse con los bebés pero en su hogar ya hay bastantes mascotas así que estos pequeños ángeles están en busca de familias amorosas y responsables que los reciban cuando hayan crecido lo suficiente. Los nacimientos sin complicaciones son una gran bendición, pero mi amigo y yo quedamos atentos a una fecha apta este año para esterilizar a su gatita, así que estos muy posiblemente sean sus primeros y únicos bebés. Les deseo a todos días tranquilos, seguros, y una larga y saludable vida (⊃｡•́‿•̀｡)⊃

> And to say goodbye for this week's Caturday, I am happy to bring you this news from another cat family: At the home of a friend I care about very much, his beautiful tortoiseshell cat gave birth a few weeks ago to these three spectacular kittens (these are the photos he shared with me). All healthy, strong, and fluffy; my friend, who is now a proud grandfather, is very happy, and like me, he would like to keep the babies, but there are already quite a few pets in his home, so these little angels are looking for loving and responsible families to take them in when they are old enough. Uncomplicated births are a great blessing, but my friend and I are keeping an eye out for a suitable date this year to spay his cat, so these will most likely be her first and only babies. I wish them all peaceful, safe days and a long and healthy life (⊃｡•́‿•̀｡)⊃ - - - - - -

Neil deGrasse Tyson

Una tienda de ropa aplica un descuento del 25% a una casaca. Luego de aplicar ese descuento, el precio resultante tiene un impuesto del 18%. Si el precio final de la casaca es S/ 885, ¿Cuál era el precio original antes de aplicar el descuento?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

links.title: The oldest thing in the house is the one that carries a diary — and a soul
links.body: \n
alt=\

> photo by:https://unsplash.com/s/photos/old-wooden-desk-with-drawer-and-soft-light We found the diary in the bottom drawer of her old desk.The drawer that was always locked.Not with a key — with silence. After the funeral, the house felt larger,hollow in places where her voice used to live.My wife opened the drawer while I stood in the doorway, afraid of what memories might spill out. Inside was a notebook, worn soft at the edges, as if it had been held many nights. We opened the first page.A photograph fell into my lap.My mother.My father.Me. All of us smiling into a summer sun that felt impossibly far away. Behind it were pictures from my twenty-fourth birthday, the last year before life began speeding up — exams, work, responsibility, exhaustion. Tucked between the pages was an old ID card belonging to her mother, who had died when my mother was only nine. She had kept it hidden all her life. There was also a faded photograph of her father — my grandfather — in a World War II uniform, hair neatly slicked back, a rifle resting against his shoulder, frozen in 1941. History folded into a drawer,love folded into paper. Between later pages, we found a rosary and a small cross. Hidden carefully. On the page where her handwriting weakened, she had written: I pray every night for strength. I pray not to be a burden. I pray to stay longer with them. That was when she was already losing her health. I sat on the floor. The diary wasn’t just memories. It was a conversation she never had the courage — or the time — to finish out loud. She wrote about my childhood. How my father and I were when I was two years old — stubborn, hardworking, always fixing something together. Then she compared us to now. Forty and sixty. “Almost nothing has changed,” she wrote. “Only the years on their faces.” She wrote about my long years of studying in another city.About missing me.About waiting for calls that sometimes came too late. She wrote about the houses we repaired together — ours first, then neighbors’, then strangers’ homes across the town. “My boys build things,” she wrote. “They fix what is broken. I wish life worked the same way.” She wrote about my nights out.Before university — careless laughter, big dreams.After university — tiredness hidden behind smiles. And yes, she wrote about the time I stayed away from home with my girl ten years older than me just to rest from everything. “I understand,” she wrote. “But the house is quieter without him.” That line hurt more than any anger could have. Then her tone changed.The pages grew heavier. She wrote about disappointment in people.About how promises faded when illness arrived.About friends who slowly disappeared.About loneliness that grew louder at night. “When you are healthy, everyone needs you,” she wrote. “When you are sick, everyone is busy.” I closed my eyes.I hadn’t known.Or maybe I hadn’t wanted to know. There was one entry that made my breath stop. She wrote about the film I had acted in — a small domestic production where I played an old man with a cane, walking in a funeral procession behind a young woman. “He wanted me to see him on television,” she wrote. “He wanted me to be proud.” She was.
alt=\
> photo by:Dušan Stojkov She watched it when it aired in prime time.She told everyone. “My son is on TV,” she said, like I had won an Oscar.
alt=\

> photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-reading-a-magazine-aODtyhXEAjg Then came the line that shattered me. “Life is strange. In the film, he follows a young woman’s coffin. One day, I fear it will be me he walks behind.” And then: “I pray it won’t be soon.” But it was.And it was.Just like the movie.Only instead of a stranger, it was the woman who made me.The woman who loved me without conditions,woman who never complained out loud. I read the final pages slowly. Her handwriting trembled. “I am proud of my son,” she wrote.“Even when he doubts himself.” “I am proud of my husband.”“Even when life is heavy.” And then: “I wish I had said more.I wish I had asked for help sooner.I wish I had told them how lonely I sometimes felt.” I held the diary against my chest. All my life, I thought love was shown through work, through responsibility, through endurance. And it was. But it was also supposed to be spoken.She had carried her fears so we wouldn’t carry them.She had hidden her pain so we could live lighter. I whispered into the empty room: “I’m sorry I didn’t listen better.” The house answered with silence. But not an empty one.A full one.Heavy with love.Heavy with memory. Thank you for every minute, Mom — in the good and in the hard. I carry your words now.The ones you never say. Tears were sliding down my face — the heavy ones, the kind men cry. I turned my head away from the writing desk when I heard Aleksandar’s voice. It made me think about how much he needs me, and how happy Mother would be if she could see us now — united and embracing each other. She once said, “Knowing how soft-hearted you are, you’ll even adopt a child that isn’t yours. You’ll have a petite blonde woman, just like you.” I often wonder what kind of superpowers a person gains when they feel their end approaching. I will never know the answer. At least not until we meet again somewhere, in a better place than this one.
alt=\

> photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/a-silhouetted-figure-stands-in-windows-light-k0eL3sOCsLw Thank you for sharing your time by reading this blog. Life is the greatest teacher — don’t let it only teach you; make sure you learn something on your own as well. I hope my experience was useful and meaningful to you. On Serbian 🇷🇸 : Najstarija stvar u kući je ona koja u sebi nosi dnevnik — i dušu
alt=\

> photo by:https://unsplash.com/s/photos/old-wooden-desk-with-drawer-and-soft-light Pronašli smo dnevnik u donjoj fioci njenog pisaćeg stola.Fioci koja je uvek bila zaključana.Ne ključem — tišinom. Posle sahrane, kuća je delovala veće, šuplje na mestima gde je nekada živeo njen glas. Moja supruga je otvorila fioku dok sam ja stajao na vratima, plašeći se kakve bi uspomene mogle da se prospu napolje. Unutra je bila sveska, omekšala na ivicama, kao da je držana bezbroj noći. Otvorili smo prvu stranicu. Fotografija mi je pala u krilo. Moja majka. Moj otac. Ja.Svi nasmejani pod letnjim suncem koje je sada delovalo nestvarno daleko. Iza nje su bile slike sa mog dvadeset četvrtog rođendana — poslednje godine pre nego što je život počeo da ubrzava: ispiti, posao, odgovornost, umor. Između stranica bila je stara lična karta njene majke, koja je umrla kada je moja majka imala samo devet godina. Čuvala ju je skriveno čitav život. Tu je bila i izbledela fotografija njenog oca — mog dede — u uniformi iz Drugog svetskog rata, zaleđenog u 1941. godini. Istorija presavijena u fioci. Ljubav presavijena u papiru. Između kasnijih stranica pronašli smo brojanicu i mali krst. Pažljivo sakrivene. Na stranici na kojoj joj je rukopis oslabio, napisala je: „Molim se svake noći za snagu. Molim se da ne budem teret. Molim se da ostanem duže sa njima.“ Tada je već gubila zdravlje. Seo sam na pod. Dnevnik nisu bile samo uspomene. Bio je to razgovor koji nikada nije imala hrabrosti — ili vremena — da završi naglas. Pisala je o mom detinjstvu. Kako smo otac i ja bili kada sam imao dve godine — tvrdoglavi, vredni, uvek nešto popravljamo zajedno. Zatim nas je uporedila sa sada. Četrdeset i šezdeset. „Skoro ništa se nije promenilo“, napisala je. „Samo godine na njihovim licima.“ Pisala je o mojim dugim godinama studiranja u drugom gradu. O tome kako sam joj nedostajao. O čekanju poziva koji su ponekad dolazili prekasno. Pisala je o kućama koje smo popravljali zajedno — prvo našu, zatim komšijske, pa domove nepoznatih širom grada. „Moji dečaci grade stvari“, napisala je. „Popravljaju ono što je pokvareno. Volela bih da život funkcioniše isto.“ Pisala je o mojim izlascima. Pre fakulteta — bezbrižan smeh i veliki snovi. Posle fakulteta — umor sakriven iza osmeha. I da, pisala je o vremenu kada sam ostao van kuće sa devojkom deset godina starijom od mene, samo da se odmorim od svega. „Razumem“, napisala je. „Ali kuća je tiša bez njega.“ Ta rečenica bolela je više od bilo kakve ljutnje. Stranice su postale teže. Pisala je o razočaranju u ljude. O tome kako obećanja blede kada dođe bolest. O prijateljima koji polako nestaju. O samoći koja noću postaje glasnija. „Kada si zdrav, svima si potreban“, napisala je. „Kada si bolestan, svi su zauzeti.“ Zatvorio sam oči. Nisam znao.Ili možda nisam želeo da znam. Postojao je jedan zapis koji mi je zaustavio dah. Pisala je o filmu u kojem sam glumio — o starcu sa štapom u pogrebnoj povorci iza mlade žene. „Želeo je da me vidi na televiziji“, napisala je. „Želeo je da budem ponosna.“ Bila je. Gledala je kada je emitovano u udarnom terminu. Svima je pričala. „Moj sin je na televiziji“, govorila je, kao da sam osvojio Oskara.
alt=\

> photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-reading-a-magazine-aODtyhXEAjg Onda je došao red koji me je slomio. „Život je čudan. U filmu on ide iza kovčega mlade žene. Jednog dana, bojim se da će to biti moj kovčeg iza kojeg hoda.“ „Molim se da to ne bude uskoro.“ Ali bilo je. Baš tako. Kao u filmu. Samo što to nije bila nepoznata žena. To je bila žena koja me je rodila. Žena koja me je volela bez uslova. Žena koja se nikada nije žalila naglas. Poslednje stranice čitao sam polako. Rukopis joj je drhtao. „Ponosna sam na svog sina. Čak i kada sumnja u sebe. Ponosna sam na svog muža. Čak i kada je život težak.“ A onda: „Volela bih da sam rekla više. Volela bih da sam ranije tražila pomoć. Volela bih da sam im rekla koliko sam se ponekad osećala usamljeno.“ Držao sam dnevnik na grudima. Ceo život sam mislio da se ljubav pokazuje kroz rad, odgovornost i izdržljivost. I jeste. Ali trebalo je i da se izgovori. Nosila je svoje strahove da ih mi ne bismo nosili. Sakrivala je svoj bol da bismo mi lakše živeli. Šapnuo sam u praznu sobu: „Izvini što nisam bolje slušao.“ Kuća je odgovorila tišinom. Ali ne praznom. Punom. Teškom od ljubavi. Teškom od uspomena. Hvala ti za svaki minut, mama — i u dobrim i u teškim danima. Sada nosim tvoje reči. One koje nikada nisi izgovorila. Suze su mi klizile niz lice — one muške, najteže. Okrenuo sam glavu od pisaćeg stola čujući Aleksandrov glas, podsećajući me koliko sam mu potreban i koliko bi majka bila srećna da nas sada vidi složne i zagrljene. Jednom je rekla: „Znajući koliko si mek, usvojićeš i dete koje nije tvoje. Imaćeš plavu sitnu ženu, baš kao ti.“ Pitam se koje to supermoći dobije čovek kada oseti da mu se bliži kraj. Odgovor nikada neću saznati. Barem dok se jednog dana ponovo ne sretnemo negde — na boljem mestu od ovog.
alt=\

>

photo by:https://unsplash.com/photos/a-silhouetted-figure-stands-in-windows-light-k0eL3sOCsLw

Hvala vam što ste izdvojili vreme da pročitate ovaj blog.

Život je najbolji učitelj — nemojte dozvoliti da vas samo uči, već naučite nešto i sami.

Nadam se da vam je moje iskustvo bilo korisno i poučno

links.title: Fundación vs Adrianesa en Jornada de Juegos Amistosos de Futsal
links.body: <div class=\

> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes la participación del equipo de Fundación en una Jornada de Juegos Amistosos de Futsal, que se realizó, en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings, friends of Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I am going to share with you the Foundation team's participation in a Futsal Friendly Games Day, which took place in the community of Villa de Cura, Zamora municipality, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260221_184909399.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zGoRYp98rZ48vByDE4z9jFS3fbomw14wW9dU7WxdbC7cXFZUHgdPVG2ZL7XXfgVVFe8.jpg) Cabe destacar que esta jornada de juegos amistosos se desarrollo el día de ayer en la cancha del sector Mata de Café, donde participó el equipo de Fundación vs Adrianesa, en las categorías Sub 8, 10, 12 y 14, con el objetivo de continuar con la preparación para los próximos torneos de este año 2026. El primer partido se inició con la categoría Sub 8 de Fundación vs Adrianesa, a las 3 de la tarde, en el primer tiempo Fundación mantuvo el dominio de la pelota para ganar dos por cero. >It should be noted that this friendly match day took place yesterday at the Mata de Café pitch, where the Fundación team played against Adrianesa in the Under-8, Under-10, Under-12 and Under-14 categories, with the aim of continuing their preparation for the upcoming tournaments in 2026. The first match began with the Under-8 category of Fundación vs Adrianesa at 3 p.m. In the first half, Fundación maintained control of the ball to win two-nil. ![IMG_20260220_162113.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wqnNJtU8tSbTmXR8FgzddcoRa5c6dts4n4rfkZu3RDmtyiZr673tF6RM5cxDtCk5FKv.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_162236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zknM3yi9o1BFRU2qWxtTvqUD3q6kdTc1fv6kd7S1RepALzWhAmC1h7G216bL6NMwW8j.jpg) En el segundo tiempo Fundación, continúo atacando a la portería del equipo rival, para concretar tres goles a favor y de esta manera vencer a Adrianesa 5 X 0. Luego pasaron a jugar las categorías Sub 10 de Fundación vs Adrianesa, en este segundo encuentro Fundación inició jugando con toques, mantienen el dominio de la pelota dentro de la cancha, para pasar la defensa y concretar en varias oportunidades tres goles a su favor. Mientras Adrianesa en un tiro de esquina logra marcar su primer gol, quedando 3 X 1 a favor de Fundación. >In the second half, Fundación continued to attack the opposing team's goal, scoring three goals and defeating Adrianesa 5-0. Then it was time for the Under-10 categories of Fundación vs Adrianesa to play. In this second match, Fundación started playing with short passes, maintaining control of the ball on the pitch, passing the defence and scoring three goals on several occasions. Adrianesa scored their first goal from a corner kick, leaving the score at 3-1 in favour of Fundación. ![IMG_20260220_162253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wWyC2k7WaMdALtiiCsHDaZvQw6i5q7sXeY6gFHJZSVCZxASYnWBQSC4fioPpikN4xYF.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_171612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xVM1eh9G6HtjEgxG1Y7xLUynencdYAsjBMPp3NezuVbD46baXjvNV62GsThyXBv22mG.jpg) Después la Sub 10 continúo jugando el segundo tiempo, donde Fundación bajo la defensa para Adrianesa aumentar el marcador a dos goles. Sin embargo Fundación mejoró en la defensa y en el dominio de la pelota dentro de la cancha, para obtener dos goles más y gana Fundación 5 X 2. Luego pasaron a jugar la categoría Sub 12 de Fundación vs Adrianesa, este tercer encuentro estuvo más cerrado, por los constantes pateos a la portería de ambas delegaciones, marcando en el primer tiempo 4 X 3, a favor de Andrianesa. >Afterwards, the Under-10s continued playing in the second half, where Fundación lowered their defence to allow Adrianesa to increase the score to two goals. However, Fundación improved its defence and ball control on the pitch, scoring two more goals to win 5-2. Next, the Under-12s from Fundación and Adrianesa took to the pitch. This third match was more evenly matched, with both teams constantly shooting at goal, ending the first half 4-3 in favour of Adrianesa. ![IMG_20260220_172149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23z7FbZpxeufpeC9ruL1Hq9RvNmZ4E3VdjVwWNdMB9Kc499gKG85zWDU4qcU9qdhYggb2.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_172637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yTYkM4kxQGdJK9joDv733Lhnpcsa9X73Jj9TJEWFGZT9Tw39hJXqvqn4ihJygmthb8f.jpg) Luego continuaron el segundo tiempo, en la cual Fundación, no mantiene el dominio de la pelota y redujo considerablemente la defensa, que aprovechó el equipo rival para concretar tres goles a su favor y pierde Fundación 6 X 3. Después en el cuarto partido pasaron a jugar la categoría Sub 14 de Fundación vs Adrianesa, en este partido las dos delegaciones jugaron con gran intensidad, iniciando el marcador por parte de Adrianesa con dos goles, perdiendo Fundación 4 X 2. >Then they continued into the second half, in which Fundación failed to maintain control of the ball and significantly reduced their defence, which the opposing team took advantage of to score three goals in their favour, with Fundación losing 6-3. Then, in the fourth match, the Under-14 category of Fundación vs Adrianesa took to the field. In this match, both teams played with great intensity, with Adrianesa opening the scoring with two goals, and Fundación losing 4-2. ![IMG_20260220_172354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zbPYWYnk72yr6ZqXegPsBixgTN9tqmMa4mv29pQjhRMWFn4MPHKJmaQB4oKRZPf7fyX.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_175126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wC7dvQheuZgsth1m1n9tY473Z6eQ4VEMaHzZkx5c59TatToQwTNy9GzXW1gcw545qdm.jpg) Asimismo continuaron jugando el segundo tiempo, colocando nuevamente a los jugadores titulares, el cual lograron empatar 4 X 4 y después el equipo rival narco otro gol y se va arriba del marcador, faltando un minuto para finalizar el tiempo Fundación logra empatar 5 X 5. Se definió por penales, pero Fundación pierde 3 X 1. >They continued playing in the second half, putting the starting players back on the field, and managed to tie the score at 4–4. Then the opposing team scored another goal and took the lead. With one minute left in the game, Fundación managed to tie the score at 5–5. The game went to penalties, but Fundación lost 3–1. ![IMG_20260220_175127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xVGnqjM8ECTw3BhradKupSaSVkKSjXYya9oKKxcj3rgcr6bNeySqs5YrWDNXXEoFj86.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_162104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23x1DBNtdLjM3TroeAfvBuS6vrraGtuUgmpMQmYid6Xq8gyBXY4Lqz9WSXMPQNbtQBE8S.jpg) Para finalizar de cuatro partidos Fundación solo ganó dos y Adrianesa dos, en estos juegos no importan mucho los resultados, ya que son encuentros de preparación para estar listo para los próximos torneos. >In the end, Fundación won only two of four matches and Adrianesa won two. The results of these matches are not very important, as they are preparatory matches to get ready for upcoming tournaments. ![IMG_20260220_171418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wMajgMiUkC3YbHMwCaV3ZsjgKHtqEL1rbjCzbZEaxSTTPTVA3WZRJWp2H6h2k5npE3s.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_175846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wqeGJPjZkTgVoLkSz3Zo2Ni3qx4VgtoK2Hg4cNtqo4rfYENaVKLQsQf3QXUmyH7k1wH.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. This is to lock in some value for us into blue chip crypto's, and hedge in case HIVE continues to decline and HBD breaks down.  Just a rainy day fund I'll add more to here and there over time. 

Added some more to the HIVE/PWR pool, and accumulated more DUO also.  

I'm going to repeat the totals in text throughout this post for the benefit of @askrafiki, who can't read the numbers from the screenshot: 

***HIVE power - 25671.676 + 3681.396 in @lbi-pwr wallet (being shut down). 1742.759 HBD in savings. 0.001225 BTC in pool, 0.04265223 ETH in pool. 2664.789 HIVE in the PWR pool. 1323.680 PWR in the pool + 2000 PWR staked. 5876 SUO staked.***

### @lbi-leo 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbsbcAfp4ygmmmFHjmKoLJkoXWwJrEQybwCbWsJqAf5YM/leo%2022feb26.png 

Over the last few weeks, I've pulled a little out of SURGE, rounding us off at 2000.  These funds have gone for other things, notably this week on the BTC/ETH pool in the main wallet.

The key news this week is not around assets, it's income.  We got a chunk of backpay during the week, and 5 days in a row of perfect leostrategy yield payments coming in.  That has made a huge difference as you will see in the Income section below.

***LEO staked 100,000. HIVE power 4210.992. LSTR 100 (actual sit in the token wallet, but listed here with the LEO assets). 1000 staked TGLD. 1500 staked TNVDA. 282.5 TTSLA. 2000 SURGE. 500.961 ACE***

### @lbi-eds 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPAXiPFyZts6tpSs3Gk8RNbLtDuoCe52b5n7GXSwEZuMb/eds%2022feb26.png 

Nothing to report again this week.  49.061 new EDSI minted into our wallet for the week.

***4083.66 HIVE power. 7300 EDSMM. 1000 EDSD. 9270.137 EDSI.***

### @lbi-dab 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQnvekUBdjqMwU9heaHtPQX3EEw6GTH9vK6g5mTtF1j9q/dab%2022feb26.png 

Bought another 150 DAB early in the week, which all got staked.  This week we minted 48.951 DAB and 44.225 DBOND (both worth 1 HIVE each).  Total is 93.176 which is very nice, but still not 100.  I could get us there now, by staking most of the liquid DAB.  But that would knock our income down (the only yield we pull out from this collection of assets is the yield paid for liquid DAB) so I don't want to do that.  Instead I'll keep picking up more  off the market when I can to get there that way.

***10,000 RUG. 15180.368 DBOND. 2350 staked DAB. 1971.323 liquid DAB***

### @lbi-cent 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcDRvuHjrRYKtqQkD434KwYvUoXG6HKXCDGFRp6isahKS/cent%2022feb26.png 

We continue to collect very nice income out of this wallet, pulling 10 LEO per day in yield, with a bunch more getting compounded back into the pools.  Will continue to trickle in more funds where I can to keep growing.  An underrated part of our fund I think.

***1500 BEE staked. 2,627,701 CENT (cumulative total from all pool positions). 832.323 BEE in pool. 1030.443 LEO in pool. 38.836 USDT in pool. 579.145 HIVE in pool. 33.156 HBD in pool. 0.00048896 BTC in pool. 0.01620614 ETH in pool.***

### @lbi-bbb 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVDqRqW9s41e281eJ87af4NWnnopN2greufkj7ariwNLW/bbb%2022feb26.png 

The buy wall I had set up got hit, so all the funds in this wallet are now tied up in an LBI sell order.  Is this the best option, and is a buy wall something I can maintain? - not sure. Originally, this was used for the buy and burn one off program, to restore LBI's market price to around it's asset backed value.

***485.472 LBI listed for sale on the order book***

________________________

# Totals
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTnvoFWfomDTQjbtCnNm3kzmyP7YBKatS1AAYDEgaJ1gH/totals%2022feb26.png 

$0.114 USD per LBI is the asset backed valuation this week.  This is almost unchanged from last week.  The other measures are ok, with both HIVE and LEO up again this week, which means our fund outperformed both these tokens over the week.

***Each LBI has asset backing worth $0.114, or 1.647 HIVE, or 3.664 LEO, or 0.122 LSTR, or 0.00000167 BTC, or 0.251 SURGE, or 1249 CENT.***

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdd1eqxKdp1yNFUg31VtyAvWbjJ8cGcYT8VheWvip3ebo/assets%2022feb26.png 

Allocating each of our assets itemized above into their main categories we get that asset split. Obviously the main change is that the BTC and ETH sections went up in line with the new investment mentioned above.

***24.61% HIVE assets. 12.61% USD assets. 52.43% LEO assets. 0.54% BTC. 0.53% ETH. 9.28% other assets.***

_________

# Income report.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP8xepCZAvfi27GbmZvybshwV4FK46b6y951LmDFJDLUB/income%2022feb26.png 


Here is the happy news.  We pulled into out weekly income split a total of 1276.221 LEO for the week - our best figure in a very long time.  As mentioned some of that was back-pay from Leostrategy.

***Weekly totals for each category of income source. All incomes are in LEO: 1.832 from @lbi-token (content). 105.976 from HBD interest. 30.532 from PWR pool. 30.239 from DUO. 56.976 from miscellaneous sources. 53.41 from EDSI. 22.417 from DAB. 71.038 from CENT. 891 from all Leostrategy tokens combined (SURGE, TTSLA, TGLD, TNVDA). 12.801 from @lbi-leo earnings (LEO delegation to lstr.voter and Hive delegation to leo.voter)***

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcCVJhkfesmYVVJEXBP6sNQrXVP4WyQSWdBDnrAsQxtBj/dist%2022feb26.png 

A big week for dividends for us, given the nice income mentioned above. 

***510.488 LEO sent as dividends. 510.488 sent to the @lbi-pool wallet to fund LP rewards. 95.717 LEO sent to @jk6276 (for my time running LBI). 63.811 sent to @spinvest (ask backup keyholder and trusted adviser). 95.717 used to buy and burn LBI).*** 

Yield this week works out at 3.62% - better than it has been ever I think, and remember LBI in pools still gets this yield also.  Dividends work out to total $15.828, and we bought and burned 27.006 LBI this week.

____________________

I'm going to skip the liquidity section this week as I'm out of time, and plan to do a LP specific post during the week.

______________

# Conclusion.

A nice week for LBI.  Record dividends and our biggest source of yield seems to have fixed it's problems properly.  Value overall is flat, but our asset base and tokenomics seem to be outperforming much of the market we are operating in.  BTC and ETH become a goal to accumulate into a bigger share of the fund. 

Thanks for checking out this weeks update post.

Cheers,

@jk6276 for LBI.

@askrafiki, please summarize this post and include any thoughts you have about LBI.

links.title: Crochet online without borders💛🧶
links.body:
![Crochet online sin fronteras.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23w2uMYJxNjQkhF1fB4bTqrwrnuaH5f1BKCjHgWA6UQwbUYg8Cg91sPyLmft4sDzsuVW1.gif)




https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

<div class=\
><div class=\

> Greetings and blessings, my dear knitting friends. I hope you are all in good health and spirits. I am so happy with the crochet classes I am teaching online. It has truly been a wonderful and very rewarding experience for me. Every week I connect with my students and feel that, in addition to teaching stitches and techniques, we are also weaving stories, trust, and many dreams to turn what we have learned into beautiful creations. Seeing how they go from not knowing how to hold the crochet hook properly to advancing with confidence fills my heart. It is a beautiful process of growth, where each stitch represents effort, patience, and great pride in what has been achieved.
><div class=\

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridas amigas de las agujas. Espero que estén muy bien con salud y bienestar. Estoy demasiado feliz con las clases de crochet que estoy dictando virtualmente. De verdad que ha sido una experiencia hermosa y muy gratificante para mí. Cada semana me conecto con mis alumnas y siento que, además de enseñar puntos y técnicas, también tejemos historias, confianza y muchos sueños por convertir lo aprendido en creaciones hermosas. Ver cómo pasan de no saber sostener bien el crochet a avanzar con seguridad me llena el corazón. Es un proceso hermoso de crecimiento, donde cada puntada representa esfuerzo, paciencia y mucho orgullo por lo logrado. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/EpJYAvJ5VTTGH5CGf4Cf3uKYSPt5fRwBeguozDngZaAzx9W2bLJrBaQ7upuse8MUsqv.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xyNm7T8vmRctd3TBd2u1G5bobb5BxYHje68kYhwVo8B8yx2VK58sAvW8fSsbxVcHU3v.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png
><div class=\

> What excites me most is that this project, which began as a simple idea in my home in Colombia, is now crossing borders. And this Saturday was especially exciting, because my teachings traveled all the way to France. To imagine that someone on the other side of the world is learning with me, following my instructions, and creating with my classes... is something I still find hard to believe. Crochet has become a bridge that connects me with people who, like me, deeply value handmade items and the love behind each creation. I feel grateful, proud, and very motivated to continue growing. This is just the beginning, and each stitch confirms that when we do what we love, the world opens up on its own. If you want to be part of this experience, contact me. I will be happy to teach you.
><div class=\

> Lo que más me emociona es que este proyecto, que comenzó como una idea sencilla desde mi casa en Colombia, hoy está cruzando fronteras. Y este sábado fue especialmente emocionante, porque mis enseñanzas viajaron nada más y nada menos que hasta Francia. Imaginar que alguien, al otro lado del mundo, está aprendiendo conmigo, siguiendo mis indicaciones y creando con mis clases… es algo que todavía me cuesta creer. El crochet se ha convertido en un puente que me conecta con personas que, como yo, valoran profundamente lo hecho a mano y el amor que hay detrás de cada creación. Me siento agradecida, orgullosa y muy motivada a seguir creciendo. Esto apenas comienza, y cada puntada confirma que cuando hacemos lo que amamos, el mundo se abre solito. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23ynYpvv9HdtCkSaCKfkki5zgJ4sW6TvQZdCMvjJtZBue5DGjnwfCQdUiL1Ux9sDwZvdu.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xybSADgjMQcwkKXJUAPKQjFmEnxJnfPZU2MRfmTPUPfVpNoWsHK6aC9MedM5jLkHhKa.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png
> ![gif (2).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xenFYKtHFzeB2Wsy17zf3X3fbATZedLc2QpNFbAY1QmYw5KbbRJxhiGP7oeTYSNd3Rp.gif)

> # Crocheting is transforming yarn into dreams and perseverance into beautiful pieces. # Tejer es transformar hilos en sueños y constancia en piezas hermosas. < https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

links.title: Trump withdraws tariff threat against Cuba after harsh Supreme Court ruling
links.body: <center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrT5hV9JH84jXcikuWB8ZJDBXsk8AVPs8AJuxhEGE9te/welcome_little_one_.gif)</center>\n\nAmong the executive orders that [can no longer rely](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-15580435/President-Trump-wants-impose-15-tariff-10-announced-Supreme-Court-decision.html) on the International Emergency Economic Powers Act to impose additional *ad valorem* duties on American imports of foreign goods is the one introduced [at the end of January](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/01/addressing-threats-to-the-united-states-by-the-government-of-cuba/) by Trump, declaring Cuba \
to U.S. national security. In truth, that executive action—aimed at threatening with tariffs countries \

—, was meant to crown the aggressive tracking of crude shipments to Cuba initiated by Trump himself [during his first administration](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sm837), and extraordinarily reinforced since last December in the context of the policy towards Venezuela, which was also at the base of that first attack about six years ago.
In practice, Cuba's oil sources had long been reduced to Venezuela and Mexico. With the former out of play since December, the Aztecs remained, but even before the aforementioned executive order came into effect, Claudia Sheinbaum's government [was already deciding](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/mexico-weighs-stopping-oil-shipments-cuba-amid-concerns-trump-retaliation-2026-01-23/) to suspend crude shipments to Havana, succumbing to Washington's more or less public threats. Thus, the withdrawal of the tariff threat would have no impact, because the clear thing here is that Mexico does not want to upset Trump, limiting itself to sending humanitarian aid other than oil, as Uruguay [is also considering doing](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/uruguay-eval%c3%baa-enviar-leche-en-polvo-y-arroz-a-cuba/90971061).
>

>Exclusive: Cuban security forces exit Venezuela as US pressure mounts <a href=\

>https://t.co/fwIhhM1syx

— Reuters (@Reuters)
>February 21, 2026
charset=\

></script></center>

### And what about Russia?

Russian supplies are [so sporadic](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-deliver-crude-oil-fuel-cuba-soon-izvestia-newspaper-reports-2026-02-12/) that they represent [less than 4%](https://www.as-coa.org/articles/seven-charts-cubas-economic-woes) of Cuba's total daily needs, or less than 0.1% of the [daily export volume](https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/suffocating-western-pressure-may-finally-force-russian-oil-output-cuts-2026-02-16/) of the Eurasian giant. The last shipment was precisely in February last year, amounting to more than 730,000 barrels. According to Bloomberg, the vessel Sea Horse would be heading to Cuba with [ around 200,000 barrels](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-20/cuba-bound-tanker-carrying-russian-fuels-to-test-trump-blockade?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MTYyNDM0MSwiZXhwIjoxNzcyMjI5MTQxLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQVJQS01UOTZPU08wMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiIyQjQxQzFFQjM1M0Y0QkY2OUY1MEI0RkY5OTEwQ0MxRSJ9.0KDiivFqe1xFgifqyDc7nXtMUmO8iqsjEIKnfEwn09s&embedded-checkout=true&leadSource=uverify%20wall), with its arrival scheduled for the first days of March. This would equate to less than two days of Cuban crude demand, without it being clear yet whether the unsanctioned tanker is actually heading to Cuba or not, the shipment's volume, or whether the Trump administration will intercept it, in this case not so much because of the tariff threat but because it transports \

Russian crude; if the Cuban buyer is the company Cubametales, it is also sanctioned.
\n\nAccording to [The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/20/world/americas/cuba-oil-blockade-trump.html?unlocked_article_code=1.NlA.Syj1.fnLEURNbVZTt&smid=url-share), the U.S. Coast Guard is already enforcing a plain, unannounced official blockade around Cuba, after the interception of a tanker—the Ocean Mariner—with some 84,600 barrels of Colombian fuel oil last week that was supposedly heading to the Island. \

the permanent representative of Cuba to the United Nations [assured](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/embajador-cubano-en-onu%3a-%22la-habana-est%c3%a1-preparada-para-un-bloqueo-total-de-ee.-uu.%22/90970324) the Spanish agency EFE. In the context of the tariff threat, Moscow [had been reluctant](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/el-kremlin-no-quiere-una-escalada-con-ee.uu.-por-los-suministros-de-petr%C3%B3leo-ruso-a-cuba/90933177) to generate problems with the Americans, although the Kremlin spokesperson [had also said](https://actualidad.rt.com/actualidad/586800-no-querer-escalada-kremlin-posibles-aranceles-envios-petroleo-cuba) that the current level of trade between the two powers, as a result of Western sanctions themselves, was negligible.
### The Miami connection Another hypothesis to rule out would be if the Sea Horse's voyage has been agreed upon by all three parties, which would, incidentally, confirm that there is some dialogue between the Cubans and the White House. The content and final objectives of this [alleged exchange](https://www.axios.com/2026/02/18/marco-rubio-cuba-secret-talks) between Marco Rubio and some more or less official but influential actor of the Cuban leadership are the subject of much controversy in Florida, a state housing the hard core of the so-called \

The representatives of this group at Capitol Hill categorically reject any final deal that does not imply the end of the Cuban communist political regime, and, in fact, they have very hastily already signed its death certificate. They run a great political risk by betting on the [erratic](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/ecuador-inicia-conversaciones-con-ee.uu.-tras-cambios-en-su-pol%c3%adtica-arancelaria/90977964) and pragmatic Donald Trump—the Cuban-origin, Foggy Bottom's head Marco Rubio is [obliged to be](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/el-sector-privado-en-cuba-empieza-a-importar-combustible-pese-al-asedio-petrolero-de-eeuu/90970078) also to survive—, and, furthermore, I believe they are miscalculating a lot what the country can endure even amidst these circumstances of blockade and [almost zero external income](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/canad%c3%a1-termina-la-operaci%c3%b3n-de-repatriaci%c3%b3n-de-sus-turistas-varados-en-cuba/90974561). They play all or nothing against a Cuba that has certain diplomatic *caché* and on occasions [can move its political waist](https://dofyojfzxaw2w.cloudfront.net/a/primer-vuelo-de-deportacion-a-cuba-en-2026-la-habana-acepto-exconvictos/448851.html).
It has already been over two months since the country, in practice, has not received fuel from abroad—except for a very small shipment from Mexico on January 9th—, so some credit must be given to the Cuban authorities for keeping it alive at least, albeit in a certainly depressing state of socioeconomic health—which hits hard, above all, [the common citizen](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/el-transporte-p%c3%bablico-en-cuba-llega-a-horas-cr%c3%adticas-tras-el-racionamiento-del-combustible/90974337). The situation is so serious that even a rare riot took place in a prison [from the center of the country](https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/plataforma-opositora-exige-al-gobierno-cubano-respetar-las-leyes-tras-mot%c3%adn-en-una-c%c3%a1rcel/90977564). Among the immediate actions that these Cuban-American, hawkish politicians in Washington are demanding is the prosecution of the old Cuban leader Raúl Castro for the shooting down [30 years ago](https://archive.fo/15pc9) of two U.S.-registered private civil aircraft—it was always [very disputed](https://archive.fo/VR24T) whether [inside or outside](https://documents.un.org/doc/undoc/gen/n96/164/16/img/n9616416.pdf?OpenElement) Cuban airspace—, which resulted in the death of three U.S. citizens and one resident. But maybe they are dreaming too high if they think that the United States could seize Castro as they did with Maduro last January 3rd; it is very difficult for the old combatant to let himself be captured alive, especially since he is on notice. Furthermore, Castro formally holds no position in the Cuban government structure.

# On 9/11, Hurricane Erin Missed The East Coast | Weather.com

**Source:** https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2025-09-11-9-11-hurricane-erin-missed-us-east-coast

A haunting satellite image captured both the tragedy of Sept. 11, 2001, and a hurricane that lurked offshore. By Jonathan Erdman September 11, 2025 Visible satellite image of Hurricane Erin off the East Coast and a zoomed inset of smoke pouring from the Twin Towers in New York City on Sept. 11, 2001.(NASA)On Sept. 11, 2001, as terrorist attacks were unfolding in New York City, at the Pentagon and near Shanksville, Pennsylvania, a hurricane was hovering off the Northeast seaboard.In one of the most chilling weather images ever taken, both Hurricane Erin — about 500 miles east-southeast of New York — and the smoke plume from the World Trade Center Twin Towers about two hours after the first tower was hit were captured in a NASA satellite image.The Weather That MorningThe previous day, a cold front swept through the East with rain and thunderstorms. That left crystal clear, cool weather on the morning of Tuesday, Sept. 11, accompanied by light northwest winds.Hurricane Erin was never an East Coast landfall threat, as the cold front and increased westerly winds aloft gave a final east, then northeast shove to Erin. Erin did generate large swells which eventually reached the East Coast.The Sept. 11, 2001, morning surface and upper-air weather depiction. Path history of Hurricane Erin is also shown, with red corresponding to hurricane intensity, and purple corresponding to Category 3 intensity.(Hurricane track data: NOAA/NHC)What If ...Whether a Hurricane Erin East Coast strike would have thwarted, or merely delayed, the hijackers' plans to carry out the worst terrorist attack on U.S. soil will likely never be known.Two of the four hijacked planes on Sept. 11, 2001, took off from Boston's Logan Airport, and one each took off from Newark-Liberty and Dulles Airports.It's fair to assume that a significant number of flights to and from the major Northeast hubs would've been canceled if Hurricane Erin had threatened the East Coast in September 2001.Some of those airports may have even been forced to close for a while.Northeast HurricanesAccording to NOAA's database, 11 hurricanes have tracked within 60 nautical miles of New York City in records dating to the 1850s. Seven of those were in September.Among them was Hurricane Gloria in September 1985 and the infamous Long Island Express in September 1938.In the years after the Sept. 11 attacks, several hurricanes hit the Northeast, some in September:Isabel (2003) hammered the Washington, D.C., metro area, among others.Irene (2011) triggered storm surge flooding just below the destructive threshold for New York CitySuperstorm Sandy (2012) triggered massive storm surge flooding in New York City, New Jersey and elsewhere.As we saw with Sandy, all you need is a strong enough area of high pressure aloft over the western Atlantic Ocean to steer the hurricane into the East Coast, rather than allowing it to \

safely out to sea.Strange CoincidenceAlmost exactly 10 years after the attacks, Hurricane Katia was spinning in almost the same location on Sept. 9, 2011. As with Erin, Katia made a hard-right turn before reaching the East Coast. Then almost exactly 20 years after the attacks, Hurricane Larry was also spinning in a similar location, a bit farther east than both Erin and Katia. Locations of Hurricanes Erin, Katia and Larry on Sept. 11, 2001, Sept. 9, 2011, and Sept. 10, 2021, respectively. (Track data: NOAA/NHC)Jonathan Erdman is a senior meteorologist at weather.com and has been covering national and international weather since 1996. Extreme and bizarre weather are his favorite topics. Reach out to him on Bluesky, X (formerly Twitter) and Facebook.

links.title: Every evening watching the sunset
links.body:
![IMG_20260221_182602_1_edit_541143380339330.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWDM9zHvxj5zDK3CykvoqoJL1a1xiYpGjBr2cNhm2qWuz/IMG_20260221_182602_1_edit_541143380339330.jpg)

Hello, friends of Gems, how are you? I am grateful to God for allowing me to share with you again. Today I will be showing you this photograph that I took this afternoon of the colors of the sky. 


![IMG_20260221_181643_1_edit_540657511787378.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaghAsyweYUp1u5DWCbDwuLj6QE7Wv513zSkncoEJNHoP/IMG_20260221_181643_1_edit_540657511787378.jpg)


I hope you have had a blessed day, just like this beautiful afternoon that the sky gave us with its colorful sunset, typical orange hues, clouds reflecting the sun's rays, and trees providing a landscape to admire.
