links.title: JeanMar's Oasis Inn in Patanemo, Venezuela
links.body: ![IMG_20241025_155827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242hajdErAMZrrHGWNm9Mm7hBQosurRktbq2gt92vNwtWmjvtGf8D11dkmp5bhyvgZLYc.jpg)

> Happy weekend everyone! I wanted to stop by this Architecture and Design community to share a bit about the tranquility of this place. Although it has humble facilities, it gave me an excellent stay in a very remote part of my country. It's an inn located in Patanemo, but it's far from the town and also far from the bay; even so, it seems to be one of the most popular destinations to stay, something they've gradually achieved, especially thanks to their good use of social media. This peaceful and picturesque place is called JeanMar's Oasis... The inn is located in the Puerto Cabello Municipality of Carabobo State, and right on this long street, since the inn is located at the end of a long walk from the beach entrance, you can appreciate the silence of a place with few inhabitants and few people spending the day on the beach. Silence is a great friend of the village of Patanemo.
> ![IMG_20241027_082304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyT4mNaF16JC9qw2HPy1hLXxezNhxcvg3PxN2V9mxjnztNoKeHWQ1FAt7Fbsvf7s9gG.jpg)

> ![IMG_20241027_081334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2432BfuPpFYogYjaVT6JStfRrX9vNGuaAMmVDxdeDjo6378emQ5Qouak4swbadxUQ44ho.jpg) ![IMG_20241025_135336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xebjLUVK8ujno5YdfBS8mC3wRCmNYB1U5ishLB36thYVHoPhZs1fw6bEcNpA9XHkNnU.jpg)
¡Feliz fin de semana para todos!. Quería pasar por esta comunidad de Arquitectura y Diseño para compartirles un poco de la tranquilidad de este lugar, que aunque tiene unas instalaciones humildes, me regaló una excelente estadía en un lugar muy remoto de mi país. Se trata de una posada que se encuentra en Patanemo, pero está lejos del pueblo y también lejos de la Bahía; aún así, parece ser uno de los destinos más populares para hospedarse, algo que han logrado poco a poco, especialmente por su buen manejo de las redes sociales. Este tranquilo y pintoresco lugar se llama El Oasis de JeanMar... La posada se encuentra en el Municipio Puerto Cabello del Estado Carabobo, y justo en esta larga calle, ya que la posada se encuentra al final de un largo recorrido desde la entrada de la playa, se aprecia el silencio de un lugar con poca población y de personas que pasan el día en la playa. El silencio es un gran amigo del poblado de Patanemo.
![IMG_20241027_082231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xp69g6Fu7DXfkjZpvRvq3J2wFzzmsTJz99DCZXN6eBqDaoFwHrmqxBnR4vpeFCtjo1W.jpg)
I won't deny it, it's not the most elegant place in terms of its facade, but believe me, the rooms are very modern, comfortable, and airy, although I don't have any photos to show you, since taking pictures wasn't allowed in those areas. Even so, although it has a rustic look, it's very nice, and it's the kind of design many people want to see when they go on a trip to the coast. Stone walls, earth tones combined with blue, lots of palm trees, a large pool area—so special that it makes you want to stay at the inn instead of going to the beach—and all the necessary amenities for a good stay, such as food, parking, music, a refrigerator, and most importantly in places so remote from my country, a generator, since the electricity service is often interrupted in the region.
![IMG_20241027_070800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xKmq6iLRznFfbYycoFGP6AfUHiViYwF4UvoLkNY9SiK3ws3yK61U9Fjx84hwk3Hqn7t.jpg)
No lo voy a negar, no es el lugar más elegante en cuanto a su fachada, pero créanme que las habitaciones son muy modernas, cómodas y frescas, aunque no tengo fotografías para demostrárselo, ya que no estaba permitido tomar fotos en esas áreas. Aún así, aunque luzca rural se ve muy bien, y es el tipo de diseños que muchos desean ver al ir a un viaje a las costas. Paredes de piedra, colores tierra combinados con azul, muchas palmeras, un gran espacio para las piscina, tan especial que provoca quedarse en la posada en vez de visitar el mar y todos los servicios necesarios parea tener una buena estadía como comida, estacionamiento, música, nevera y lo más importante en lugares tan retirados de mi país, una plata eléctrica, ya que el servicio de luz suele ser interrumpido en la región.
![IMG_20241027_074021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23ynSEjhHNXrvHdQuMvq1cTEucMwyYAKtNXVkDkU75g9XD9Kftm88gp8dRKFtuesGBbG6.jpg)
The gray color stands out due to the earth-themed walls, separated by white and with many sky-blue details, a perfect combination that makes you feel calm and connected to nature. An additional great detail to the architecture is that they have some farm animals roaming freely on the premises, such as roosters and rabbits, for example. The town is surrounded by many mountains, which are visible from the inn, and the views are wonderful. The pool area is beautiful, though simple, but it has enough space for a large family or a group of friends. It's not visible in the photos, but there are many tables under the palm trees and an area with a TV and a large dance floor, which we didn't use because we were looking for peace and quiet, and we certainly found it here. The inn is located across from a path that leads directly to the beach, although it's a 10- to 15-minute walk. It's very safe and faster for those without a car, since, as I mentioned, it's situated between the town and the beach. What I can assure you is that the stay is very affordable, as is the food; we only spent $25 per night. Without a doubt, it's a place you should visit if you're planning a weekend in Patanemo, Carabobo State, Venezuela.
![IMG_20241027_070911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242Y5yrEEfdtG5eZpWjfPFpDH8QtYX8cXPgGKYXVVxRK8LpKi9gHYi6ghw6yL6FVPMCSm.jpg)
Resalta el color gris por las paredes en temática de tierra, separadas por blanco y con muchos detalles en azul cielo, una combinación perfecta que te hace sentir en calma y en conexión con la naturaleza y un gran detalle adicional a la arquitectura es que tienen algunos animales de granja sueltos en el lugar, como gallos y conejos, por ejemplo. El poblado está rodeado de muchas montañas, las cuales se ven desde las instalaciones de la posada y las vistas son maravillosas. El área de la piscina es hermosa, aunque humilde, pero tiene el suficiente espacio para ir con una gran familia o un gran número de amigos. No se ve en las fotos, pero hay muchas mesas bajo las palmeras y una zona con televisión y gran pista de baile, las cuales no usamos porque fuimos a buscar paz, y vaya que la encontramos aquí. La posada queda frente a un sendero que nos lleva directo a la playa, aunque hay que caminar entre 10 a 15 minutos, pero es muy seguro y más rápido para las personas que no tenemos automóvil, ya que como les dije, está entre el pueblo y la playa. Lo que sí les puedo asegurar es que la estadía es muy económica, igual que la comida, nosotros solo invertimos 25 dólares por cada noche. Sin duda alguna es un lugar que pueden conocer si piensan pasar un fin de semana en Patanemo, Estado Carabobo de Venezuela.
> ![IMG_20241025_135416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244KJTpUEb7TqdN2rc5K9uVeQSv5BVDiv1R96emwNfPc1kTEYYKRyWCknG9rUcttiXHMC.jpg)

links.title: Pierogi z KBK
links.body:

Jednym z ważniejszych źródeł wpływów w tym roku stały się warsztaty ceramiczne. Wprowadzenie symbolicznej odpłatności 30 rycarów sprawiło, że ich popularność zaczęła przekładać się na wpływy do kasy KBK. A te w tym miesiącu będą rekordowe. Do końca lutego został jeszcze tydzień, a już ocieramy się o najlepszy wynik w historii.

Warsztaty to jednak nie wszystko. Ceramikę przecież można również wytwarzać. Ostatnio za sprawą igrzysk olimpijskich doszedłem do wniosku, że czymś co dość łatwo jest z gliny ulepić, a co mogłoby być naszym towarem eksportowym są... pierogi. Na zdjęciu powyżej pierwsze próby. Myślę, że jest potencjał. Zwłaszcza jeśli połączy się to z warsztatami malowania.

links.body: ER-phagy (endoplasmic reticulum-specific autophagy) is a specialized autophagy pathway that breaks down and recycles damaged or excess ER components via lysosomal digestive enzymes, acting as a crucial quality control mechanism for cellular homeostasis, anti-aging, and potential lifespan extension. As cells age, decreased ER-phagy leads to accumulation of damaged, misfolded proteins and dysfunctional organelles, reducing longevity. \n\nMechanism of Action: The cell uses autophagy receptors to mark specific ER subdomains. These are engulfed in specialized vesicles that fuse with lysosomes, where acid hydrolase enzymes break down the damaged material into raw components for reuse.

links.body: Hello, friends, everyone who is always present in this beloved community with me.\n\n

/> I hope you are all in good health wherever you are. On this blessed evening, the holy month of Ramadan, I will be back active in this beloved community with you all. My purpose here is to share some images I took while on holiday in the month leading up to the holy month of Ramadan. My friends and I decided to go on a weekend getaway to relax and de-stress. I went to my brother's hometown because it had been a long time since I visited. It was a long journey, taking about three hours from my hometown. While on the way, I took some photos to capture the moments and share them with you in this beloved community. I saw a beautiful road with tourist attractions in sight, and I immediately took out my phone to take some pictures to share with this beloved community.

My friend and I decided to stop for a moment by the side of the road to take some pictures of the cafe area and enjoy the beauty of the outside. I pulled out my phone again to take some pictures.

My friend and I even stayed there to enjoy coffee and food. One day, our journey was long, and we needed a break at a cafe or tourist attraction to relieve our fatigue. After stopping briefly to take some pictures of the cafe's beauty, my friend and I decided to continue our journey. Since our journey would take about an hour, we would reach our destination.
alt=\

My friend was also incredibly satisfied and happy to have visited the natural beauty here, enjoyed the cool breeze and the towering mountains along the way. I noticed the tourist attraction with the triangular villa wasn't open that day. Of course, if it were open, I'd have to wait until it was half full. After taking a few pictures of the villa, my friend and I continued our journey. After a long journey, I saw the natural beauty beside the road: plantations and towering mountains that I could see from the vehicle. I was deeply drawn to the natural beauty around me. I felt very happy and satisfied with this moment. And I didn't forget to take some photos of the natural beauty around me.

links.title: Waiting in rays
links.body:
I must admit that this photo is kinda sucks, the photo that I took using my phone quite early in the morning, without much light to illuminate the scene. But what I wanted were the light rays that came out from the grills or part of the building where people are waiting. This is the scene, usual scene during any ceremony in my area that involves *Satay* offering. We all gathered to grind the pork that we will use for satay. This is the semi-modern meat grinder that we all have here in my place. Not every household has it, so when we needed to grind the pork, we visited this grinder to grind the pork, so that it would be easier for us to make the satay. And I think almost every time I visited the place, I always loved these light rays, maybe it also got the help from the cold weather, as the ceremony was in the rainy season. :) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabYKDRFMwALoZNn2yFkydweD3ifovkrrTzJ1LNK38Uwq/1771198901494.jpg) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) ||| | || |------------|------------| ------------| ------------| ------------| | Photo Style | Portrait Photography || Accesory | Normal Lens | Location | Bali, Indonesia, April 2023| |Lighting |Natural Light | | Gear |Infinix Note 30 Pro | |Diffuser | None |

links.title: Надважливі речі
links.body:
![photo_2026-02-21_22-51-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uakulinar/EpzwjHvw8NNabqH8kNxZyeBVxtNrJWSzgz5h1VEq1fX7qEsw1ytqTsqassG8DQnWKwz.jpg)


Привіт! Сьогодні без заморочок — кава та піца. Але, підкреслюю, піца обовязково домашня — смачна й корисна. 

Ну як ви сьогодні вже щось опублікували в інстаграм? Ще ні? Ну то день пройшов даремно. Обвоязково викладіть історію про те, що ви сьогодні снідали. Або ще краще зробіть світлину якогось дорого сніданку, що вам не по кишені та викладіть її. І не забудьте пропустити світлину через низку фільтрів, котрі, на жаль, не можна накласти на рівень інтелекту. 

Ви люите черги? То ви неодмінно ідеальний представник стада. І в першу чергу це відноситься до тих хто, хто любить черги до макдональдсів та подібних “закладів громадського харчування”. Черга — це ваше навіть в тому випадку, коли ви віддаєте грошенятка за щось шкідливе й несмачне. 

Якщо ви прийшли в макдональдс, то неодмінно попрацюйте там з нетбуком. Хоча б зробіть пост до іНСТАГРАМУ. Ви купили місце на стільці, як бездомний неокапіталізму, а тепер імітуйте діяльність. Ваша робота є “надважливою”. Можливо, що ви навіть самі в це вірите й це в черговий раз підтверджує факт — ви середньостатистичний представник стада. Ніякої ненависті, злості, агресії, намагання образити когось: нічого подібного. Просто факти з життя.

Всім добра!    

Super important things

Hello! Today, no worries — coffee and pizza. But, I emphasize, [pizza must be homemade](https://weganpolska.pl/szybka-pizza-bez-wyrastania/) — tasty and healthy.

Well, have you posted anything on Instagram today? Not yet? Well, the day was wasted. Be sure to post a story about what you had for breakfast today. Or even better, take a photo of some expensive breakfast that you can’t afford and post it. And don’t forget to run the photo through a series of filters, which, unfortunately, cannot be applied to your level of intelligence.

Do you love queues? Then you are definitely the perfect representative of the herd. And first of all, this applies to those who love queues at McDonald’s and similar “catering establishments”. The queue is yours even if you give away a little money for something harmful and tasteless.

If you come to McDonald's, then definitely work there with a netbook. At least make a post to INSTAGRAM. You bought a place on a chair, like a homeless neo-capitalist, and now imitate activity. Your work is “super important”. It is possible that you yourself believe in it and this once again confirms the fact — you are an average representative of the herd. No hatred, anger, aggression, attempts to offend anyone: nothing like that. Just facts of life.

Good luck to everyone!

On Netflix our movies keep gaining recognition and in the music industry we find people like Burna boy, Tems and Arya Star ranking up ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbokUVnyTVfdYMGb16ujpr1ZQ5a1iGVXgff7z8wpBTEuc/1771713411064.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://pixabay.com/photos/way-the-path-gloomily-gray-3845758/) This prompt got me thinking, because how did a country with so much potential for it citizens, turn really bad that everyone wants to travel out. Picking a starting point was quite emotional, it got me thinking about the problems in my country, especially the issue of insecurity, which has been a matter of concern for years , but our leaders choose to act like that isn't a problem . Alot of interesting things have been happening in my country recently, I'm currently taking a break off the media but that doesn't stops me from getting information . As instructed, write about the good and bad about my country, I started with the good and now the bad, there are numbers of bad things going on in my country currently, which generally involves our leaders, the political sector is currently preparing for another political campaign season and we get to see how gullible and selfish citizens will decide to follow a leader that has failed us during their last tenure and that part is hard to believe, it seems some individuals like how bad the country is becoming by the day The fear of insecurity and how it's becoming uncontrollably in every region is very alarming, the raising alarm of poor health system and their victims , and everyone complaining about the new tax law, because we benefit nothing as citizens of the country. If we have good leaders, these issues will be fixed. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeYnky72fENhLFv8dd7Nd8zG7XtfkPJWC84zaoEkkSZ57/1771713428221.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://pixabay.com/photos/measure-security-terrorism-this-2413879/) Focusing on the issue of insecurity in my country, it's really heartbreaking that safety isn't assured, especially for the common citizens. Traveling by road is now a risky , because you don't even know what's ahead of you or what will happen. Insecurity is one of our major problems, because that's causing more harm than good, causing sorrow for many families. This insecurity affects lives of citizens, financial reck and many other risk. Recently, my sisters friend had an encounter with kidnappers on her way home from work and watching her survive and fight diverse emotions, so she could forget the experience has really bothered me, the trauma plus her family used their savings to pay ransom. I really hope our leaders help fight insecurities, keep proper protection and appoint more security officials to affected areas. One of things I dislike in my country currently is the insecurity, we need to do better as citizens in securing ourselves, this is our home regardless, our government and leaders have shown over time that they can't help control insecurity. The solution to this insecurity issues in my country is having the right leaders, a compassionate president and not one whose primary purpose is to steal again and fund their trips to different parts of the world . Well, I still have hope and believe that things will get better no matter how less concerned our leaders get. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

Velvet curtain
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSFSUbKjfEoUdHBcoNJLFpkMTvvnfLc8j7ewzmuxGTrTT/image.png) [GLOBALDSIO IT SOLUTION](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1771039621930-812911f55ba2?q=80&w=880&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) The velvet curtain shouted Ugonna, can’t you hear me? But Chike was busy touching the satin curtains made for the deputy governor, simply because Ugonna resembled the deputy governor. Two weeks earlier, the deputy governor visited their exquisite shop on the Island looking for a place to order satin curtains. They sighted one owned by Chike’s uncle. With his aide, he walked into the heavily studded décor home and paid for the satin curtain materials, which they started sewing. Coincidentally, Ugonna had just arrived from Europe in search of a Velvet curtain with which to launch the exquisite mansion he built on the Island. He also found what he desired at Chike’s uncle’s décor home. Negotiated with him and paid for the material to sew the curtains. Two weeks later, Ugonna went back, as discussed, to pick up his Velvet curtain and met Chike instead of his uncle. Meanwhile, Chike was not around when he negotiated and paid. He arrived with some of his friends and proceeded to the décor home requesting his Velvet curtain. However, Chike was busy unwrapping the already-made satin curtains for the deputy governor, thinking that Ugonna was the governor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme59yb5L5mGWUSfxf9Jc6XzSpV5ynmePLtUXE7vf3VZvk/image.png) [Bien'arts](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1765175094470-ed3bef04ed40?q=80&w=687&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) The resemblance is stunning. While Ugonna was there, confused and nearly getting angry, Chike, on the other hand, is confused and scared of displeasing the deputy governor. But then he subtly insisted the satin curtain was for Ugonna, thinking he was the deputy governor. The confusion and arguments continued until Ugonna placed a video call to Chike’s uncle, who confirmed that Ugonna owned the Velvet curtain while the deputy governor owned the satin curtain. Case closed. Chike apologised, yet with a look of bewilderment and utmost dismay at the striking resemblance between the two clients, then apologetically handed Ugonna his Velvet Curtain. links.title: When Bad Things Happen To Good People
links.body:
Good day believers, I'm happy to write in this community for the first time.

The topic review on how, why God allows bad things to happen to good people. Surely God wants all his students to enjoy everything on earth and to be fruitful and multiply. This is not the will of God for everyone to struggle, but yet we see many people struggling on earth, even the good ones.

One of the important hindrance of this is fear.
Most of the time we Christians are always afraid of the unknown. Sometimes we fear that there will be opposition, we fear that we might not make it to life, that we might not go far.

This all these things hinders us and makes us experience a lot of obstacles. When we want to achieve things in life. And this also causes mind and spirit paralysis. When we see such a fear and it's rooted in the challenges we face in life, then it really holds us down.

So many things can hold us down. insecurity, violence, economic, financial crisis. Regardless of all these things, God still wants us to have faith in him, to believe in him.
We must not allow this economic hardship or insecurity that is going on on earth to really hinder us. And we must not allow it to paralyze us.

We must stand on that promise of God which has already been promised to us. God has promised us so many things that we have a lot of fear to hinder us. But when we have faith, then we can be free from all this and embrace the will of God in our lives.

body.title: A Moment That Left Me Completely Shocked.. 😲
body.body:
*Hello hive lovers.. How are you doing today? Trust you've been good? For today's talk, i will be sharing with y'all about a moment that left me completly shocked and unstabled. So, There was a moment in my life that still feels unreal whenever I remember it. It happened during my year one in university, on what seemed like a very normal evening. Nothing special , just lectures, stress, and the usual lodge loud noise. During the night hours, I was studying alone because exams were close. My roommate had gone out, so the room was unusually quiet. Around midnight, I suddenly heard a loud knock on our door. It wasn’t a normal knock, it was urgent, almost desperate. My heart started racing. I opened the door slowly, expecting to see one of my friends, but nobody was there.*



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQ6kpjnNYbmfgn2iEszN1tVtMzCQLMyzHn3ZGLqLGRaS/snapchat_2068709720_1718697720180_1.jpg)


*I stepped into the balcony, looking confused. The hallway was empty and silent. I even checked both ends, thinking someone was playing a prank, but there was absolutely no one around. Just as I turned back into the room, my phone rang loudly, and it was my roommate calling to tell me she had almost been involved in a serious accident outside campus at that exact moment. The timing shook me deeply. Till today, I cannot explain why that knock happened or why it came exactly when something dangerous was happening to someone close to me. Whenever I tell the story, people laugh and say it was coincidence. Maybe it was… or maybe some moments in life remind us that not everything can be explained.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSv435Syfqd4w24q6sj6mrsmnQrZbb7ny5Wti6osfjVDj/snapchat_573235976_3.jpg)

**Some experiences are simply too real to believe, even when you lived through them yourself. Thank you all for reading.. I wish to invite my friends @marsdave @favouright @nellybestie to partake in this contest.. See y'all in my next post..!!**

body.title: Weekend Visit to the Farm
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmchEHpUUVFCBqdmyKPH7YqR9iSDjn4wu3aAYWSxJYBoyc/InShot_20260221_164403356.jpg 

I was (am) stressed and my mom, that already have planned a walk to her godfather farm, suggested me to join them. I say yes. 

We started walk in the early morning and bring with us Lila too. The farm it's CloseFar: close to the city but a few Kilometers of walk. Remember, Santiago de Cuba city is surrounded by mountains. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWy9x2ioic5xEzS2qcTFr2Mz88kxiVjVJ3gvZXPKz4CmB/IMG_20260221_160441.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYLGUh9aGWoeF8Tm53NKm8qqfFhwcMmSSExrgdTWUhdsZ/SAM_6657.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeFGkC5nYMYqtMgBaRVis1fRXhy3nCzYBQjDognbeFzqm/SAM_6659.jpg 

Lila I was happy, running like there's no tomorrow. And that was good for her to liberate energy and stress.

We walk all the way talking and we see a few the havoc caused by Hurricane Melissa 4 months ago. People that after that just moved out or left things abandoned. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaNwGLC1tJnLtueC3pRiCpsHk1dgEcYk2xtSQTZ3emMzu/SAM_6642.jpg 

When we arrive we start to diggin in search of Sagú a edible tubes or root (in fact looking for this was the main objective). If you don't know the Sagú It requires a process where its juice or pulp is extracted, left to dry and then used to prepare drinks or thicken others. It's delicious.

While we were digging, my mom took the opportunity to clean the roots. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSfy1icqnERgduoghPrQmmPi71gKT5fqVjv1XtWUeKZFr/SAM_6652.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRTKuKDzm5gdo9MRj5U3FBQWGGG1h9uHEmAMvH6hzjG3D/SAM_6648.jpg 

This is the plant 👇
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcuMTo62zDY8idmtFEtdozW6uWS3RbqkMYj5484jMjbR1/SAM_6645.jpg 

This is the root we need 👇

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYDyZhRpgVyigWzo14sVmcceGLtdqjE6grRUDHPPL9y5F/SAM_6644.jpg
 
And here it is already clean. 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS2vKJEc9Skz4fjXQBsQQiiCVwCh6m1zyh51EhvLgVdFS/SAM_6655.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW42nveDNcpoxf6Mx8jex2tF95z9RGhwgYSAqfrmT7BNM/SAM_6654.jpg 
  
Do it in place save us Weight when transporting and helps to return some nutrients to the soil. Of course, while it is being extracted, some seed is replanted to harvest again next year.

After that I intended a technique to obtain postures of a lemon plant that has already borne fruit. Which would allow me to obtain in 1 year a tree that already bears fruit. I don't have photos of this because I pricked myself a lot with the thorns during the process, plus the ants had feasted on me. So I just wanted to finish and come backI don't have photos of this because I pricked myself a lot with the thorns during the process, plus the ants had feasted on me. So I just wanted to finish and come back. In a few weeks we will see if it worked. 

The sun was already high so the return was a little more exhausting Taking into account also the fatigue of the work. Even Lila did not have much encouragement to run and she already felt the heat.

In short, it was a good day, a different one and either because of exhaustion or to release stress I think I will sleep better today. 

***

PS: I usually forgot take photos of my self, today was the case 😅

body.title: My First Owambe in 2026
body.body: >I was invited to a wedding which took place today. A few weeks back, I was excited to attend the wedding, and I even started trying to save up as I had nothing to wear. After going through my clothes, I was able to settle for one as this also went along with the colour of the day (white, pink, and gold). I got my white cloth ready, had the cap material bought and sewn by my tailor. I even had to sew a pair of slippers to wear as I literally had nothing new to wear. All this was done within 1 week, and I had at least a month to plan properly, but I was indecisive about whether I would be able to attend.  Today came, and I am really glad that I was able to attend. body.title: My 4 a.m. routine || Mi rutina a las 4 a.m. Mi informe de Actifit: febrero 21 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/73c56e97-15fb-478c-9e7f-a03e5c73e493.jpg) Lately, something I enjoy about living on a farm is getting up very early. In my case, to achieve this, I have to go to bed before 11 p.m. on an empty stomach or after having metabolized dinner, which I usually do at 8 or 9 p.m. In the beginning, I used an alarm clock, but now my body wakes up automatically. Whenever I put my first foot on the floor, I thank God for a new day. ___ En este último tiempo, algo que disfrutan de masía es levantarme bien temprano. En mi caso para lograrlo, tengo que dormir antes de las 11 de la noche y con la panza vacía o luego de haber metabolizado la cena, que normalmente lo hago a las 8 o 9 de la noche. En los primeros tiempos lo hacía con el despertador, pero hoy día mi cuerpo se despierta automáticamente. Siempre que apoyo el primer pie en el piso, agradezco a dios por un nuevo día. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d0a01920-f1e3-4721-ac90-b03e433b0aa4.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/19f98a9d-7e25-4391-b4e1-84b7ab01642d.jpg) The first thing is always a glass of water with a pinch of salt while I heat the water for the first mate of the morning. With the stove on, I leave the panquequera to heat up while I put four tablespoons of oats, two eggs, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, a little baking powder or baking soda, and a little water in a bowl to hydrate the oats. While I stir the mixture, I drink the first few cups of mate, and when the pan is hot, I start cooking. I usually make two pancakes. One for Zuni, who is about to get up, and the other for me. To top off this delicacy, I add a little honey, which honestly makes breakfast sublime. ___ Lo primero siempre es un vaso de agua con una pizca de sal mientras caliento el agua para los primeros mates de la mañana. Con el fuego encendido dejo ya la panquequera calentándose, mientras coloco en un bol cuatro cucharadas de avena, dos huevos, una pizca de sal, una pizca de azúcar, un poquito de royal o bicarbonato, y un poquito de agua para que se hidrate la avena. Mientras realizo los movimientos envolventes, tomo los primeros mates y cuando está caliente la panquequera, realizo la operación. Dos panqueques normalmente. Uno para Zuni que está próximo a levantarse y el otro para mí. Para adornar la exquisitez le agrego un poquito de miel y eso sinceramente lo hace sublime al desayuno. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9370020b-c634-4e39-8010-e1add4e8c3f3.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a322aefb-a946-40c9-8b6d-54618810ced8.jpg) After finishing breakfast in front of my computer, looking at some posts from different communities and thinking about what kind of posts I will make, I start getting dressed and preparing for today's ride. By the way, on March 1, I have my first presentation in the town of Abbot, in the province of Buenos Aires. This week we are doing specific work with very high heart rates, and of course, nutrition and rest are fundamental to the results we hope to achieve. ___ Concluido el desayuno frente a mi computadora y mirando algunas publicaciones de diferentes comunidades y pensando qué tipo de publicaciones haré, se comienza a vestirme y a prepararme para la rodada de la fecha. Que por cierto el primero de marzo, tengo la primera presentación en la localidad de Abbot provincia de Buenos Aires. Esta semana estamos haciendo trabajos específicos con pulsaciones muy altas y por supuesto la nutrición y el descanso son parte fundamentales para los resultados que esperamos. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/43a721a7-b358-4d6c-8e79-7688fc9095ff.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6b80184e-d05d-49fe-849f-8083a287e175.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/19f2ac9c-2dd2-483a-8f88-d7005ca14f06.jpg) Today we set off in search of fortune with our friend Damián and Whass... For various reasons, only the author of these lines and the tireless Whas, who is almost 70 years old, made it there. On the way back, I passed by a little school where we usually fill our water bottles, and I forgot to take some photos because I was busy picking, without permission, a little plant that we use to flavor our daily mate, called burrito. It has a scent that reminds me of my childhood in the countryside, which is why I bring it back to share with my family. ___ Hoy partimos hacia la fortuna junto al amigo Damián y el Whass... Por diferente motivos solamente llegamos quién escribe estas líneas y el incansable Whas con sus casi 70 años. De regreso pasé por una escuelita de donde normalmente cargamos nuestras caramañolas y olvidé sacar algunas fotos, porque me entretuve sacando sin permiso, una plantita que usamos para condimentar nuestros mates cotidianos, qué se llama burrito. Tiene un perfume que me recuerda a mi infancia en el campo y es por eso que lo traigo para compartir con mi familia. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c786068b-0a86-4bbd-af00-cb8342d34fc2.jpg) When I got home, I found my brother sweeping his sidewalk, and of course I left him a little burrito for his mate too. That's how I ended my training day today. Tomorrow will be another journey, which sometimes seem similar, but the experiences are totally different. Happy Saturday, everyone 🫂 ___ Llegando a casa me encuentro con mi hermano que estaba barriendo su vereda y por supuesto le dejé un poquito de burrito para su mate también. Así concluí mi día de entrenamiento el día de la fecha. Mañana será otra travesía, que en ocasiones parecen similares, pero las vivencias son totalmente diferentes. Feliz sábado para todos 🫂. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/33662699-3577-4153-b001-e5dfcf3524ad.jpg) Screenshots taken with my Samsung S22 cell phone ___ Capturas con mi celular Samsung s22.

body.title: When 8 Tons Become 20: Why Many Indonesian Roads Fail Too Fast
body.body:
## Abstract

In Indonesia, many roads are designed based on standard axle load assumption. But in real condition, trucks often carry load much higher than legal limit. Because of that, pavement structure receive damage much faster than expected.  

![IMG-20260222-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaT5d3ebDLe6FB7WhwmW8n9kMG7FpGa79UiKZtewMzDpT/IMG-20260222-WA0002.jpg)

This article explain in simple way how exponential damage work in pavement engineering, using simulation from 8 ton until 20 ton axle load. The comparison also refer to Indonesian Bina Marga standard and international pavement design reference.

---

## 1. Introduction

Road pavement in Indonesia is designed using traffic prediction and standard axle load calculation. According to *Manual Desain Perkerasan Jalan 2017 (Revisi 2020)* by Direktorat Jenderal Bina Marga:

https://binamarga.pu.go.id  

The design assume that vehicle load is controlled and within regulation.

But in many provinces and districts, overloaded truck is very common. In some case, axle load can reach 16 ton or even 20 ton.

Based on AASHTO pavement design concept:

https://store.transportation.org  

There is principle called **Fourth Power Law**, which say:

> Pavement damage is proportional to axle load power four.

This mean, damage is not linear. It grow exponential.

---

## 2. Road Condition in Indonesia

Data from Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS):

https://www.bps.go.id  

Indonesia have more than 540,000 km road network. National road condition reported above 90% stable, but many provincial and district roads still damaged.

One important factor is overloaded freight transport.

Many people blame contractor quality. But mathematically, load factor is more dominant than workmanship issue.

---

## 3. Simplified Damage Model

We use simple equation:

**Damage Ratio = (Actual Load / Standard Load)^4**

Assume:

- Standard axle load = 8 ton  
- Design life = 10 years  

---

## 4. Simulation Analysis

### Case 1 – 8 Ton (Standard)

Damage = (8/8)^4 = 1  

Road last full 10 years (as designed).

---

### Case 2 – 12 Ton

Damage = (12/8)^4  
Damage = (1.5)^4  
Damage = 5.06  

Damage increase 5 times.

Service life:

10 / 5.06 ≈ 2 years  

---

### Case 3 – 16 Ton

Damage = (16/8)^4  
Damage = (2)^4  
Damage = 16  

Damage increase 16 times.

Service life:

10 / 16 ≈ 0.6 year  

Only about 7 months.

---

### Case 4 – 20 Ton (Extreme Overload)

Damage = (20/8)^4  
Damage = (2.5)^4  
Damage = 39.06  

Damage increase 39 times.

Service life:

10 / 39 ≈ 0.25 year  

Only around 3 months.

This explain why sometimes newly rehabilitated road fail after one rainy season.

---

## 5. Exponential Curve Reference

Exponential Damage Simulation Graph

[Axle Load vs Damage]
![Screenshot_2026-02-22-04-59-36-42_965bbf4d18d205f782c6b8409c5773a4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY9MLS9SbXbwvuS2Yg8LNkXpq83W2mTeNvrgYjWKggQA1/Screenshot_2026-02-22-04-59-36-42_965bbf4d18d205f782c6b8409c5773a4.jpg)

The curve show small increase in load can produce very big structural damage.

---

## 6. Discussion

This situation show that:

- Pavement failure not always because poor asphalt quality  
- Not always because contractor corruption  
- But because structural stress exceed design assumption  

Transportation Research Board (TRB) publish many research about pavement fatigue and axle load effect:

https://www.trb.org/Publications/Publications.aspx  

World Bank also explain infrastructure asset management importance:

https://documents.worldbank.org  

Without load control, infrastructure become financially inefficient.

Even if we increase asphalt thickness, exponential factor still dominate.

---

## 7. Comparison with Bina Marga Design Philosophy

Bina Marga design assume:

- Controlled ESAL calculation  
- Predictable traffic growth  
- Standard load enforcement  

If real condition not same with assumption, then:

- Design life become unrealistic  
- Maintenance cost increase  
- Budget always used for reactive repair  

This is not only technical issue, but also policy and enforcement issue.

---

## 8. Strong Conclusion

From simple simulation, we can see clearly:

When axle load increase from 8 ton to 20 ton, pavement damage increase 39 times.

This is not small deviation.  
This is structural collapse acceleration.

If road designed for 10 years, extreme overload can reduce life into only 3 months.

![IMG-20240611-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme8BwHscthf8yL8jH9UBSfzSkh3dhjG6XiKPSfSRKGQvB/IMG-20240611-WA0006.jpg)

This mean, no matter how good the contractor work, no matter how thick asphalt layer, if overload continue, road will fail.

Therefore, solution is not only better construction.  
Solution must include strict load control, weighbridge enforcement, and consistent regulation.

If not, infrastructure development will always become cycle of rebuild and repair without long term sustainability.

Engineering without enforcement is mathematically fragile.

---
Regards from your engineer @kharrazi

---
## References

1. Direktorat Jenderal Bina Marga – Manual Desain Perkerasan Jalan (2017, Rev 2020)  
   https://binamarga.pu.go.id  

2. AASHTO – Guide for Design of Pavement Structures  
   https://store.transportation.org  

3. Badan Pusat Statistik – Statistik Transportasi Indonesia  
   https://www.bps.go.id  

4. Transportation Research Board – Pavement Research  
   https://www.trb.org/Publications/Publications.aspx  

5. World Bank – Infrastructure Asset Management  
   https://documents.worldbank.org

body.title: The Two Popes Movie Review
body.body:
After quite a long break, I decided to go back into movie watching. I realized that maybe I've been going too hard for too long and I needed to just relax.
Still, I know it might be odd for others but my best movie to use relax is none other than a theological movie.
So, going into my ever growing movie list, I looked for the most recent theological movie I had and it was a pleasant surprise that it was based on the most recent real world theological event. 
The Catholic Church.
***
## <center>The Two Popes.</center>
***
### Plot
> When Pope John Paul II died, the conclave that followed was one of a very political mindset. With the Cardinals separated into two factions gunning for two spiritually strong men; Cardinal Bergolio and Cardinal Benedict.
After Cardinal Benedict won, the newly elected Pope faced the trials of the head of the church and decided to have a talk with his rival.

https://youtu.be/T5OhkFY1PQE?si=OkBO9GER7ufIHYmV
***
Now I'm not a Catholic, but the fact that they're the biggest Christian fellowship movement means that the majority of the Christianity themed movies are based on Catholicism. At such, we have so many great movies to choose from.
And this is just another beautiful one.

The Two Popes is a biography so these are based on real events and yet somehow it seemed so otherworldly because of how young and uninterested I was when they began in the year 2005 (I was born in the year 2005).

![1002750079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23u62jkxDM5zc3167AJyVAxNTH6DwCXCCAbKXBGjthFWeVVMLPMiywB8cFMneThkiandd.jpg)

The majority of the movie is actually a conversation. A conversation between two different men who have to come to terms with each other, have to forgive each other and then have to forgive themselves, before carrying the burden their choices have placed on them.

![1002801461.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tkhYqq4dVQh5p3p3T3j7arsj1bbdpFwEiWop8D7BtgzL8dZ8PmqxFUuYhaN8uqGj1BY.jpg)

Father Bergolio is the main character in this film. A jovial, minimalistic and easygoing Arch Bishop who loved soccer and to help the poor and was loved even more by the people he helped.
Because of his fame, good deeds and expressive acts of kindness and holiness, he moved up the ranks and was a strong presence even amongst the other Cardinals and Arch Bishops.


![1002801462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tkmq5dZ26VCERRcfZw4n8RsshNZbNfEawux6voh6egVN3MQFCvN55iZenwAxBYj4t3S.jpg)

As for Cardinal Benedict, his form was more rigid. The textbook Christian who believed what people saw and thought to be right was more important than what he thought was right.
He won the papalcy through his relationships formed and on the chair, he treated the church with an iron fist, earning him the name \
and amongst less of his fans, \

![1002801496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23w2ixykcj3u5tSnyvPcD9mtfviwxFFfTGmE8hYEjeLXDLhYaSA2nsKvSSRGgYnojVAWH.jpg)

The church had a scandal and the blowback on him is where the movie began.
We see Bergolio come to Pope Benedict with his letter of resignation and Pope Benedict questions him, trying to find the real reason for his resignation.

![1002801474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tbGnTrYjP7xcjspcHy9GxYdobvKCYdp6VPa6J3WBYfC4CsiEHuhMDAY797o1QRJbc1e.jpg)

Throughout this questioning turned conversation turned confession we learn a lot about these two men of God.
We see their troubles, their fears, their sins and then we're forced to understand that elevated they may be, they are still just men.

![1002801492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23wMap5FWWsMzn5PsDgT8JNQPVFA6vJqRavcC9kQxRSAxuWoZ4V3MxUnxZyrCkvK83kZi.jpg)

This movie somehow reminds me of the cinematography style of the \

, because of how minimal the change of scenes are.
It's a conversation, despite it being in three different locations..
- The Popes Garden
- The Dinner Sitting Room
- The Room of Tears.

No action, no over expressive drama, just the sheer power of words and the words said draws you in.
Still this is a type of movie where I feel the actors need to have a certain flare to draw you in with such minimalistic movement. 
Of course the actors Anthony Hopkins and Jonathan Pierce are literally two of the best in their games and are still moving in their old ages of 88 and 75 respectively. It's just an incredible feat.


![1002801495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23xVPTMbxDhdQwR7aWyDutS8pMUhwXw3JaYBK9bxVdWk6uJHegaB8ReFhSGTEC2HHRrDV.jpg)

Regardless, despite this being a movie you can check for the details anywhere or one you already know about because you lived and was an active Catholic during the incident. Still I tried my best to keep some details private to avoid spoilers.
I assure you, despite it being mostly a conversation, the movie is anything but boring. I rate it a stunning 9 out of 10 and I urge everyone to give it a try!


![17717112655045659563775778036827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tSQ5xKRZAwm4kPkXMeC5vfwYmqtNFyejgsCoctVLHWtNFByS2FLqoFkukS2eAE7eSps.jpg)

**Source:** https://911revision.substack.com/p/the-untold-secret-of-the-twin-towers

Tobin Plaza with the 27 foot high Sphere, the North Tower (left), WTC 5 and 6 (right and center) and 7 World Trade Center with the U.S. Post Office on the right. This beautiful shot was taken in August 1993 (6 months after the bombing).After the famous 58 seconds elevator ride (from the lobby to the 107th floor), visitors could enjoy the views from the indoor observatory at an height of 1,310 ft (400m).Two more escalators led to the “Top of the World”, the outdoor viewing platform at an height of 1,377ft (420m). On clear days visitors could see up to 50 miles (80 km)!The sphere showed us something. Something most people missed and they still miss it today when you talk to them about it and boy, have I talked about it to sooo many people and the responses I get are blank stares of nothingness. People just run out of computing power and shut off. It’s crazy. This is another angle of the sphere. What was it like at the Sphere in the Austin J. Tobin Plaza on 9/11? The music still playing in the Austin J. Tobin Plaza on 9/11 was truly eerie. (4 minute clip)There are two 110 story buildings, weighing about 500 000 tons each, right next to the sphere. You will see the sphere was circled by lamp posts, like this one.If two 110 story buildings collapsed due to a raging inferno and pancaked down into it’s own footprint, or was blown to bits using explosives, ejecting debris 600 feet in ALL directions, then what should happened to the sphere? Leave your answer in the comments, before reading further.Austin J Tobin Plaza, 5 minutes after “Flight 11” struck the North Tower.What  did we see right after the dust settled with the disintegration of the last Tower, the North Tower 1? What did the news media report on, on September 12, 2001? (46 second clip) What would the rubble pile be if it was a fire induced structural collapse, or a conventional controlled demolition, utilising thermal or kinetic mechanisms?  When you apply some critical thinking, you come to the realisation that it was a disintegration on a molecular level. Not just the building, but EVERYTHING in them. (1 minute clip) When surveying the damage on September 12, the following news report went out and strangely enough, people thought they found the antenna, that was on top of the North Tower in the rubble. Have a listen to what these first responders had to say. (2 min clip) It wasn’t the antenna of the North Tower. It was a lone surviving lamppost that was next to the sphere.It was quickly removed, as I think people might have started catching on that it was a lamp post and not the antenna, because you really cannot find a lot of pictures of the lamp post with the flag draped on to it.We know the rubble didn’t go into the basements, as they were mostly undamaged as I have discussed in my two basement articles, that you can read here and here.Dr Wood is right and the narrative of a collapse or demolition, does not fit the evidence.What happened to the sphere?Now you also know the important secret the sphere told and is still telling us, after it’s been repurposed. (6 minutes)It’s amazing how people could not see the story the sphere tells. links.title: My Actifit Report Card: February 21 2026
links.body:
It was an absolute delight to meet up with @steevc @alessandrawhite @shanibeer @chris-uk @gillianpearce today in the town of Bedford. It was a good 2h 20m by car and similar time back at the end of the day. We met at The Olive Tree, a Mediterranean restaurant and the food was lovely. I’ve met Steve before but this was the first time I’d been to a bigger gathering and I’d definitely go to another one. After lunch we went for a walk along the Great River Ouse. Since this is the first time I’d been to Bedford, I would like to go back at some point to explore a little more. If I do, I’ll check in at The Swan which is where we ended up for some more drinks, chatted some more for a couple of hours. It is a lovely hotel with spa facilities and a fabulous looking restaurant. We decided we should host more meetups and a number of locations were suggested. Whilst walking along the river, I was excited to discover a slalom kayak course, celebrating Etienne Stott’s gold medal awarded at the London Olympics 2012. Have you ever been to Lee Valley? links.body: **Prompt:** Build me an app that's based on the Lord of the Rings map where each town, village, and marker is connected to the Hive blockchain using the Hive Application Framework. Users can log in using the Hive Keychain and visit locations by pressing on them. When they press on a location it will transmit to the Hive blockchain the words \

followed by the name of the location. Use https://github.com/hive-keychain to achieve this.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdxgbKjeyMfS4jQpZVF9sEgGJBEBNniKD2fEiNHuYxzZ/image.png)

😵 Unfortunately looks like we broke the internets.

Let's try again.

**Follow-up prompt:** Reattempt above.

Seems to have worked. Signed in right after and now got a fatal error. 

**Prompt:** Redeploy the app.

Vercel thinks at the speed of 1995 dial-up. Let's publish and hit the road.

I don't know why every Middle Earth app is designed in diarrhea brown.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVxHmc8KyLX5Grv2RYV5k1YqmjJv8d6apjbhX3z2ciDfZ/image.png)
 
Keychain login worked. Not sure where our map is. 

**Prompt:** Fix map to display Middle Earth locations in a visual manner.

> Now I have a thorough understanding of the problem. The app is getting a \

and the map markers are placed using percentage coordinates on a background image, but the generated image is just a decorative illustration -- not an actual geographic map with accurate regions. The core issue is the map approach: percentage-based markers overlaid on a generated image won't visually make sense because the generated image has no consistent geography.

> The fix is to build a proper SVG-based map with hand-drawn region shapes, paths, and labeled locations rather than relying on a background image with absolute-positioned dots. This will create a visually compelling, always-working map. Let me rebuild the interactive map as a proper SVG canvas.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSmVFb74M8qqjNogvXhJkdtUJ1GvB2f6NFU9Xx8envU9F/image.png)

We have our map now, we have our login, but we can't transact. 

**Prompt:** Make sure that logged in users can visit locations by pressing on them. Visiting should pop up a Hive Keychain prompt to authorize a transaction to transmit the location to Hive. The transmission should be \

followed by the name of the location. 

Nothing.

**Prompt:** Location is still not transmitting to the Hive blockchain. Read https://developers.hive.io/ and see if there is another way to transmit.

I don't have the patience for this. Let's stop for now.

links.body: <div class=\

>

Everyone loves their country very much. It doesn't matter how bad the economic condition of a country is, the people love the country and want development of the country. Because of what situation some people feel irritated also but most of them are not ready to leave the country either. People have already become used to the situation and resist leaving the country. It's because of the love for the country even if many things of the country irritate them. I have seen many people who always speak bad about their country but inside of them they actually love their country. Those people criticizer blame government because they want development or improvement in the country. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8wJgp2E5vSHBB5zrP5vD2W1Nzao5iqdjzE7j4pywKWK/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-is-casting-a-vote-into-a-box-T9CXBZLUvic) I'm from Bangladesh and he just known as one of the developing countries and naturally the economic condition is not so good enough to mention. As the financial condition is not good, the illegal activities and crime rates are at the peak. In case of corruption, it’s very common in my country. It’s something like an open secret for my country. Everyone knows about it, but nobody speaks about it. If I want to share something good that happened recently in my country, it’s about the election in my opinion. After Seikh-Hasina run way the election occurred on 12th February 22, 2026. To be honest In the election I didn’t have any favorite candidate to support because I feel that no one is worthy to be president. It was an election for who is less bad candidate in my opinion. It’s understandable as good people mostly like to avoid politics. But the good thing is that after many years in my country a fair election occurred (except few exceptions), and many people could vote according to their will. People could choose their own leader truly this time. I wanted the power distribution to be diversified and that happened and it also means that only one political party can’t decide everything on their own. A strong opponent is very necessary in politics, and it happened this time. Again, this time there are some good, potential and powerful politicians who are going to rise up this time, in whom we can keep faith because through their hands we could be free from the dictator Hasina. For the first time in our country, some young and fresh blood entered in politics and their role is quite dominating as our reformed country came through their hand. I believe that they are not afraid of anything and their words are fearless and they can speak even against the president if president do something wrong. I believe that through this hand a major change is going to happen in the near future. So, for the country I think now we can truly hope for something good. In case of bad thing is that the track record of the current government is not good. Our country became a champion under this government. As I said already this time election were for who is less bad candidate. But still, I believe that those young candidates will make waves and won’t allow those greedy people to stay in peace. I can’t expect the change overnight, but I believe the change will come soon.

[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/raining-contract-digital-splashed-drawing_1077781.htm#fromView=image_search_similar&page=1&position=26&uuid=a60d2e9f-a5b0-43cf-bf28-774d90c66b98&query=Heavy+day+AI+generated+)
 It has been one of those days I have had to push some [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job) out by double force; entering the office early and having to retire late. In [short](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-short-selling), it has been twelve hours straight. I had some forgone alternatives anyway, something that also in the process delved into my timing of meeting. One of those toughest [deliveries](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery) is learning something new within a [short](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-short-film) period. It has been one of those things since early December of last [year](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year).    

Anyway, I have seen improvement in skills in the process although it is taking my [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) away from focusing on other things. My focus this year is on making every skill as lucrative as possible or better put, making my time worth much more, without this, it get difficult to scale without this.  
Before going any further, the take [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) lesson today is, [TRY](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-try-currency), keep trying. And when it seems [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) hopes is lost just insist on another try. Yes, never give up or at least not that easy. Where am I going here? What would you do if you your backup generator got faulty while the former is yet to be repaired? I had such an incident today, our back up gen, developed a fault and what can you say to a metal tank?  
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdddhL6Fi1C9VgQRNVqcRGJVkWN4iThUbaXzUvhSioNVW/1000133324.jpg

An emergency delivery at hand and general [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity) is nowhere to be found. When will [The Mechanic](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-the-mechanic-1972-film) arrive for repairs and what probability do we have today. We are not even considering his prepared English to lift the moment when he sees how urgent everything is. Yes, you can pay double. 

Well, I had to first introduce my foreknowledge and after several trial on quick service checkup nothing actually worked  So what was the main problem of our most preferred gen? The [mechanic](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-machanic-profession) spoke last and gave us an exorbitant repairs [price](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-price) so I thought we would manage to alternative for the moment. 

Alternative is down, quick repairs strategy failed, u guess it time I really know what happened to the former. Knowledge is [Power](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-power-1986-film); can you imagine we were parking out gen for a loosened valve after the mechanic had done a quick checkup the day he came?  

When I saw that disconnection between the gas supply valve and the carburetor, I was a little curious yet not fully convinced, there was no supply going in. So how did I figure it out? I tried several ways to get it going to no avail (business management is not a day’s job; in the middle of both pressure and expensive and you have to deliver). 

I finally had to go [check](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-check-cheque) a similar carburetor with a neighbor that has the same and found out that their was connected to the supply pipe.   To conclude, let me add, that simple discovery saved the day. I was first able to meet up with urgent demand plus spare the [company](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-company-business) of some extra [expenses](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-expense). 

A good management tactic must say; try that first aid repairs but also make sure you don't spoil anything extra. Frying pan to fire is not a [statement](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-statement) you would want to see making up your repairs quotation. I guess it’s time I close my eyes for the day, it has been one heavy day but I am happy it has produced positive results.

links.title: La calle de la esperanza. #ObservaPiensaEscribe
links.body: alt=\

/>

La calle de la esperanza.
=========================

A veces los cambios son tan rápidos que tardamos en asimilarlos. Hoy, las calles de Venezuela no son solo de asfalto; son el escenario de un nuevo comienzo. Mientras pedaleamos, el aire se siente distinto; Es la esperanza que vuelve a cobrar fuerza en cada camino recorrido, todos los que nacimos en esta noble y hermosa tierra, estamos en búsqueda de un nuevo **Horizonte** , Sin gritos, sin peleas, solo queremos trabajar.

Y no se trata de la bandera que sostengas, sino de la mano que estés dispuesto a estrechar. El verdadero progreso no se construye con muros ideológicos, sino con el esfuerzo compartido de quienes soñamos ver convertido a nuestro amado país, y a nuestra ciudad de Maturín en el faro del progreso. La paz es el punto de partida y la reconstrucción nacional nuestra meta común, pero eso sí, alejados de la vieja política.

Es el momento de montarnos en la bicicleta, sin mirar atrás, y comenzar a rodar por la calle de la esperanza. Debemos dejar la sombras del pasado, de la mano de la Dios, de la verdad y de la justicia para enfocarnos en dejar un buen legado para las nuevas generaciones. Porque lo importante es que al final del día, pedaleamos o caminemos calle arriba, todos andamos bajo el mismo cielo, con los mismo anhelos de ver pueblos prósperos, de ver hijos regresando a sus casas y la riqueza petrolera bien y honradamente invertida.. Venezuela y Monagas y sus ciudades tienen el más grande y brillante Horizonte.

Norberto Peña Q.

* * *

links.title: Save our environment today
links.body:
Namaste, my Indian family. I'm here for this week's prompt, and it's an interesting topic to discuss.

In my country, people complain a lot about the government because such fellows believe that it's the responsibility of the government to save our environment, the same people who complain go about disposing their trash anyhow not minding the effect on the environment.

Most times when there is heavy rain you see some people pour their trash into the drainage system thinking the water will push the trash down but this ends up blocking the drainage system and causing erosion that affects everyone and they start blaming the government. 

**TIPS FOR EVERYONE**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVL3MmAo859zsngmj1uqx6CuP27t6U5Mc3R7P2BKAi4v/1771711667022.jpg)


* Avoid waste 

Most times when the waste company comes to pack trash I do see lots of food and household items that were trashed I keep wondering why people will buy what they don't need, buying only the quantity of food we need and the items we need at home is one way to help our environment.

It's also good for every home to have a refrigerator to help save food from decaying leading to waste.

Currently, we have recycling companies around us and that has really helped to save our environment, those empty cans that cause drainage blockage are now recycled into something useful, so instead of trashing empty cans people now make money from them, and that helps our environment.


* Plant trees


Trees help to increase the amount of oxygen intake in the environment, in cities in Nigeria we find it difficult to survive during the heat period because all the trees have been cut down, I still don't understand why cities don't have trees, if we are living where it's allowed planting trees is one way to save our environment.

Having a small garden can also help to save our environment, maybe plant vegetables or flowers 🌹 in a pot it helps to humidify the environment we live in.

* Power management.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZevVRYLpTExPz1vThM9WgjtVzLqE3VHDpqQG7hcpeRZH/1771711769368.jpg)



Currently the sound and smoke of my neighbor's generator are making it difficult for me to enjoy my environment, everyone should have a solar panel to generate light when there is no electricity because the noise of this generator makes life difficult for occupants.

And we have to manage electricity, when there is electricity it doesn't make any sense to allow every 💡 bulb on when they are not in use, only put a light on when you want to make use of it.

Another way I personally save the environment is by joining the street and helping people whenever they want to clean the compound and the street, cleaning the drainage system of the compound and the street helps to keep our environment looking clean and healthy.

In summary, I will say that saving and improving the environment is the duty of every citizen, young and old and if everyone takes the lead we will have a healthy and beautiful environment to enjoy.

# 안녕하십니까

_돌핀이 @asd5710_ 입니다

조카가 그전부터 스텔라 떡볶이 스텔라 떡볶이 하고 노래를 불렀다

그래서 사줄려고 지도를 켜보니 울 동네는 없고 가까운데가 차로 20분 거리 광주로 나가야했다

제일 가까운데 갈려면 대로변에 있고 주차를 할려면 골목으로 들어가야하는데

당연히 골목은 주차하기 무지하기 빡신곳이다

그래서 차라리 좀 멀더라도 주차하기 좀더 편하곳을 찾ㅇ아서 좀더 멀고 운전하기 편한곳으로 이동

이차 저차하고 떡볶이를 사고 집까지 30분정도 걸렷따 무슨 떡볶이 하나 사러 왕복 한시간을 가야되나

하고 집에와서 조카랑 먹어봤는데 맛은 있는데 특이한건 별모양 후레이크 같은게 있다는거 말고는 

다른게 없다

비요뜨처럼 그 과자를 부어서 먹는데 솔직히 그 과자도 거의 먹지 못하고 버린다

애들 저격한 떡볶이 인데 매장안에 식기들은 너무 산티나드라

맛은 좋은데 굳이 한시간허비하면서 갈 건 아닌듯하다

links.title: Come clean with me: Cleaning our Old Stuck Room
links.body:
Hi there, everyone!Hi, it’s me, Rhea, so today I  wam going to share new blog of mine. I know it’s been quite long since I last posted because I’m lso busy but now I am back again sharing another blog I hope you will enjoy reading my blog thank you guys!

![Grey Minimalist Furniture Collage Instagram Post.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/EpVEYnoFTexK5iwyB5kfdnuktYvbAvNaC4yKT4uuNZhcujcd9TQQ3FLoGGiPPyXWUsj.png)

Way back December 18, 2025, my mother told me that she wanted me to come with her to clean up the stuck room, and since I am not busy that time, I then immediately said yes and proceeded to come with her and clean the whole stuck room. When we entered the room, it was filled with broken things, dirty things, spider webs, leaves, and other dirty stuffs. Take a look at this. 


![IMG_5254.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23uFTQLRSRybNcepaRMSMGnrvZURgwy6tURpfT277mSXJ393EKyZKEfLwzyyP6TngjYJC.jpeg)

We also found this old broken appliance. The room was covered in dust that my allergy was triggered. 

![IMG_5255.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23u67YonK2BaW59ANRc93kfv1S7pcDsg8mKpd9zydZAV3FFRLEL2g1ETgXhDSVmFPtDVH.jpeg)

First we then started to move out the things that we need to junk out and put them away.

![IMG_5256.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23uQpedJqBt7DZSLYGZ9ak1A16arVcfo8FUcpfqjsoZDQdHLTQZGKR1yH4XvBV2QMAMKC.jpeg)

My brother also helped us move out the things because we really needed an extra hands with us lol. 

![IMG_5257.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23xp6gy4RPuKnBiRjLXEB4DDVqwqdUonewxsMFYzE6sKem4npwFAYSfZZp4vuvoKz3C3R.jpeg)

This is me resting outside because my sinusitis was getting worse and I had to go outside to get some rest.

![IMG_5258.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23yThZgbg2AB9SaRh6m1gENjc2Diifxg9iAPh91SSAEWBzBFHCuN7ftbetwNg4WbG6SXj.jpeg)

And since my brother already helped my mother inside the room, I then cleaned the things outside so that we can put them away. 

![IMG_5259.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23wCDwKJy1Xwnikjg19mif85sn73mRnLZBUT7atrixcixYCAinaAxkdDwbeA8rVsEymte.jpeg)

And after an hour the room was finally so clean. I felt so good that the room is not messy anymore. 

![IMG_5261.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23wMap4pM8DFBmTah9xv79KEzA756M52tNerzmjtVYKj1QzfKLZZyAUC2sW7u3Fwtx6p1.jpeg)

![IMG_5264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23wMcg51372ALnze8cnm7HXxsU8M9pB1Qr5iqJZGvs72epWnbnWV7SJyHCV5Y8A72vDfL.jpeg)

![IMG_5265.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23ywu7rqhM3vvWd8CKajxD9ngusnKFzxHBBbEyZfnctRmyy16ctesYboMfzrQuUdWadqA.jpeg)

After cleaning the stuck room I then immediately went to my mommy’s rest house to clean again. When I got there the whole area was covered in dust and spider webs and so I didn’t waste any more time and began cleaning. So here’s the “before” picture… 

![IMG_5267.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/2432MqS7CjHZYjpWdtP66QrbCKzBgrXhZDufg545uxRXwvmwxzqCqcFVX1qffxC7GZ7Bm.jpeg)

And after…

![IMG_5269.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23zbPY5Qkz9cnHGiwdKMRJT9A3ogASsnW4LtB7FGCn85saEG6yvTxYadzw8LeagkTLQFK.jpeg)


I am so happy seeing that the house was so clean and I can now rest. And since I deserve to be happy, I went to a nearby cafe and bought myself some frappe and hot soft tacos hehe. 

![IMG_5289.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/itsrheaa/23xp6mNjZm4jkoEtGHFX97FaJv8s4BFdMgtS72bmkzNenjfWFX2sffToZABQc9J93zs1L.jpeg)

And that’s all for today’s blog everyone, I hope you enjoyed my blog, thank you so much for supporting me and I really appreciate it, thank you very much and have a great day ahead.

links.title: “Silver Adventures”- Captain Joshua Slane – 21FE26- 'Tar Hail!'
links.body:
![Silver-Adventures.4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfZ9zYUF1e93QZrLtBtYx3hS5G2vx9nNwzkv48uc17Dh2/Silver-Adventures.4.jpg)
![Silver-Adventures-wcjs.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8PRDodPzhvX4a3N5L9g5qGvyvFUhJ4Qii8qmVKwyw9S/Silver-Adventures-wcjs.jpg)

⛵ ⛵ ⛵ ⛵...(Tour of \

)...Continued...

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHtxYf3JhtK9bqyejMpSegrXT7VuRthmozc6DwvgRSYR/image.png)

*[Last time...]*

“Sixty-six hundred ounces of silvers can buy a lot of Sable fur coats!” Commander Kerrislravenhill said as she watched the captain stroke his beard in deep thought.

“Wussatt?” He answered absently.

“I was just saying that the Seneca could buy a lot of fur for sixty-six hundred ounces of shiny…”
“Hmmm…och, aye, seems they could...” The Captain replied, but it was obvious that he was on edge and his mind…somewhere out there... in the darkness.

*(See: https://hive.blog/freewriters/@joshuaslane/silver-adventures-captain-joshua-slane-18fe26-row-now-while-you-can )*

〰️⛵〰️ ⛵〰️ ⛵ 〰️⛵〰️

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSXFkJoacCimcFoBSv2gtKnUYqLHZ3xagwTb7aeRJpXBW/image.png)

*[On the Silverton…mid-evening…]*

**“Tar hail!”** Standing Officer-Boatswain Trumpman called out from the forecastle, **”Longboat coming in! !pimp!”**

![trumpman.7..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmen6FtGJrD3VRZG1UVzesQw1cHDJ9AcYyBB9mH2Bigvkj/trumpman.7..jpg)

A rush of sailors scaled the short stairwell to the forecastle deck and held up lanterns to light the waters…
![night-lanterns.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdLcrPuurL96BwCiSzkf51KrWryx5V9L3sxeDGvGVY5ry/night-lanterns.jpg)
*“Good evening!”* Standing Officer Trayan yelled back out of the upstream darkness.

![Trayan.7..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRyzfKSNJAeig2xzQ9fBbrSWmXmiCVNSy7CxuH1L4pRk/Trayan.7..jpg)

Trumpman quickly turned to Able Seaman kamilla19, *“Quickly mate, go down and notify the Keptin!”*
“Aye, aye Sairrr!”

![Kamilla19.2..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR1Pk6BWxmZ9SkEvvhXKUPnwBzJerxCQACK2v5r5rqPDJ/Kamilla19.2..jpg)

The ship came alive as word spread that the crew was returning…

*”Oh boy!”* Able Seaman Pocketechange exclaimed as he ran for the forecastle deck with Able Seaman Geneeverett.

![pocketechange.2..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLb5L3jrhEdxALLKibjySd96YXvwcsToJP1ZvNapxifP/pocketechange.2..jpg)

*”Coming in on the portside!”* The familiar voice of Commander Galligan rang out from the darkness.

![Galligan.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeuBSaXcCxnwb35zT5DaaHiv4dvrRi4qR1QkVzGohgxnB/Galligan.jpg)

*“Get the ratline down on the portside, on the double! !pimp!”*  Trumpman ordered as he leaned out over the rail and tried to make out the image of the incoming boat.

*[On the longboat…]*
![OAR.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeJWZU35c6qjyEG6aUDkz6CgXZGxYnoRShpJUH2PF4eA/OAR.jpg)
*“Things take turns that make me think problems will be a daily occurrence!”* Warrant Officer Lupega whispered to Cockpit Mate Bitcoinman, “It seems diplomacy is not Chief Seneca's strong suit. I suppose the captain has a plan in mind, but for now we can't do much.”

![Lupega.10..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdxqgy2pHSRRuJrzSByYdRKaSRJKgy3f5z6KtTR1pwd1/Lupega.10..jpg)

“As long as we’re getting paid mate, as long as we’re getting paid!” Bitcoinman replied as he pulled on his oar.

![Bitcoinman.8..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdYW27B6emFFjY1oUiNMTR5FdmxWabu5KUU1iFkQJHHeW/Bitcoinman.8..jpg)

‘That may be…’ °°°° Lupega thought to himself, ‘But Lieutenant Bleujay is in serious trouble! How will the Keptin take the news?” °°°°

As the longboat finally beat against the tall portside hull of the Silverton, Galligan ordered the men up the ratline as he secured the boat with a line.  

As the first of the crew scaled the rail, the Captain and Commander Kerrislravenhill walked over greet them…

*“Blimey, Ahh thought ye woolds be back afair dark!”* The Keptin said with good cheer as he extended a hand to Lupega while the rest of the crew pulled Trayan, Bitcoinman and Galligan safely onto the deck.

![C-Slane-5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQVzoBDq7xqsyvhUi7kjxHCvaD7r6pYrH3T2FXZoRBumg/C-Slane-5.jpg)


Suddenly the Captain wrinkled his brow…

”Whaur’s th’ Lieutenant?”

Galligan straightened himself and took a deep breath…

links.body:
![20250530_110439_edit_977558587198746.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVrBzV5Cc1yRyXphc5eQ6qiFkoNN5jTxPRNBaoZYNY9R/20250530_110439_edit_977558587198746.jpg)

# Photograph of a 100-year-old Armenian mansion in the north of the country

Hello friends, I hope you are well, today I have prepared new photos of this beautiful area and beautiful and old mansion 

We were on our trip when my husband pinned a 100-year-old mansion on a map, and then we agreed to go and see it and we were ready to continue the trip

When we arrived, there was a village on the top of the hill. 

We used a phone number that was on the door and we called, 
and that gentleman came to open the door for us so we could see inside. 

It was two floors and had a beautiful view. 

We visited there and I thought about what happened there 

in this 100-year history and what those doors and walls have witnessed 

Traveling is interesting because we go to new places and get to know the history and culture of each region  

I hope that the situation in my country will be better soon and we will be able to travel again


Living in the difficult conditions that we are in has destroyed all of us mentally and we are all waiting and sad, I hope that the situation will improve and we can live in peace

> Hola amigos de esta prestigiosa comunidad de @vdc en Hive blockchain, El senderismo y las caminatas son actividades deportivas que día día ganan más adeptos y acá en Villa de cura ya existen distintas organizaciones donde los caminantes planifican en coordinación con otros caminantes y senderistas lo que son las rutas a seguir durante todo el año para de alguna manera sentirse participé como deportista activo de este gran deporte.
En el video que le presentamos a continuación pueden apreciar parte de lo que fue la m´s reciente participación de caminantes villacuranos en la VMINATA HACIA LA COLONIA TOVAR un actividad que ya tiene bastantes años de existencia que exige de sus participantes una buena condición de salud ya que el trayecto que supera los 10 kilómetros de distancia supone pasos difíciles de montaña, atravesar rios y soportar el sol durante horas hasta llegar a la hermosa villa alemana que es uno de los enclaves turísticos más importantes de nuestro estado Aragua. Agradecemos a la caminante y promotora de senderismo de nuestra ciudad Zully Cedeño por l material audiovisual que nos aporta para la realización de este video que resume parte de lo que fue esta importante actividad deportiva este mes de febrero 2026 . esperando que sea de su agrado nos vemos en un próxima oportunidad, su amigo y profesor @gaborockstar.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gaborockstar/23zkfhyXHqCNLFQfZWvEYQLzT3HF3WvLpWzsSUvcqxXw1zYdfZrFoSf7YngW1cwwspV5e.PNG

>
>Hello friends of this prestigious @vdc community on the Hive blockchain. Hiking and walking are sports activities that are gaining more and more followers every day, and here in Villa de Cura there are already various organizations where walkers coordinate with other walkers and hikers to plan routes to follow throughout the year so that they can feel like active participants in this great sport. >
In the video below, you can see part of what was the most recent participation of Villa Cura hikers in the VMINATA HACIA LA COLONIA TOVAR, an activity that has been around for many years and requires its participants to be in good health, as the route, which is over 10 kilometers long, involves difficult mountain steps, crossing rivers, and enduring the sun for hours until reaching the beautiful German village, which is one of the most important tourist attractions in our state of Aragua. >We would like to thank Zully Cedeño, a hiker and hiking promoter from our city, for the audiovisual material she provided us with to make this video, which summarizes part of what this important sporting event was like in February 2026. We hope you enjoy it. See you next time, your friend and teacher @gaborockstar.

___
___
I don’t think I simulated this well. The dog I used as a reference was swimming and I felt I could capture it my way. I do hope you can see what I see.
___
There were a number of title that jumped at me the very moment I finished this piece and one of them is a favourite, something I’m sure you would’ve gotten familiar with.
 
>Looking  up for heaven, waiting to be buried.

It is an excerpt from a song titled **Glory** by **Bastille**. That song is very dear to me as the music video tell how we all have different perspectives and how it is okay too.
If you haven’t seen it, please do, I promise you would love it.
___

links.title: Tuna, cabbage and potato salad/Ensalada de col, atún y patatas ❤️
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMJZEL8n75JRhPeX7Lh9aJkQjFFkRSGrCqBMcd1wU9iR/1771708637002.png)

Happy Saturday, blog friends, how are you? I'm still having some trouble chewing because of my teeth, but I'm slowly starting to eat more solid foods. In fact, this evening I made myself a potato salad, which is very soft and delicious warm or cold. 

Here's the recipe:

 * 5 medium potatoes 
* 170 grams of Savoy cabbage
 * 150 grams of canned tuna
 * 1 vegetable bouillon cube 
* 3 tablespoons of salt 
* 4 tablespoons of olive oil 

First, peel the potatoes and cut them into medium-sized pieces. Then, fill a pot with water and salt, adding the bouillon cube. Once the bouillon cube has dissolved and the water is boiling, add the potatoes and cook for about fifteen minutes. Then take the cabbage, clean it with cold water and cut the amount we need into strips, add it to the pan and cook with the potatoes, stirring for about twenty minutes.

Once the potatoes and cabbage are cooked through, drain them, take the canned tuna and drain that too, add it to the cabbage and potatoes and mix well, season with oil and then let it rest for about half an hour. Then our simple but tasty potato, cabbage and tuna salad will be ready to enjoy!


🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸

Feliz sábado, amigos del blog, ¿qué tal? Todavía me cuesta masticar por culpa de los dientes, pero poco a poco voy empezando a comer más alimentos sólidos. De hecho, esta noche me preparé una ensalada de patata, que está muy suave y deliciosa tanto fría como caliente. 

Aquí tenéis la receta: 

* 5 patatas medianas
 * 170 gramos de col de Saboya 
* 150 gramos de atún enlatado
 * 1 pastilla de caldo de verduras
 * 3 cucharadas de sal 
* 4 cucharadas de aceite de oliva 

Primero, pelad las patatas y cortadlas en trozos medianos. Después, llenad una olla con agua y sal, añadiendo la pastilla de caldo. Una vez que la pastilla se haya disuelto y el agua esté hirviendo, añadid las patatas y cocinad durante unos quince minutos. Después, coged la col, limpiadla con agua fría y cortadla en tiras según necesitéis. Añadidla a la olla y cocinad con las patatas, removiendo, durante unos veinte minutos.

Una vez que las papas y el repollo estén bien cocidos, escúrrelos, toma el atún enlatado y escúrrelo también, añádelo al repollo y las papas y mézclalo bien, sazónalo con aceite y déjalo reposar durante media hora aproximadamente. ¡Nuestra sencilla pero sabrosa ensalada de papa, repollo y atún estará lista para disfrutar!
