links.title: Empurean (2025)
links.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EpJZW7tou9NezkrgRQzbdonyrEcAP4t7LW6Kbm2WHSxPrzrkRnS7cFeK9YPHB1vv67z.png)
[source](https://www.cinematerial.com/movies/l2-empuraan-i10505918/p/3g2w1bjh)</center>

Hi friends, how are you all? Hope you are well. Friends, I was watching the trailer of a Tamil movie for quite some time. I kept waiting to watch the movie, but I couldn't watch it. It was time, so I thought I would watch this movie today because I had seen the trailer with such suspense in a Tamil movie after a long time. Although this movie is not very old, it is a movie from last year, and for some reason, I have not seen it. So today I thought I would watch this movie and share some things about it with my friends.

At the beginning of the movie, some American soldiers are shown pointing their guns at a house, and everyone is moving forward, which means that there is a dangerous terrorist group or a person who is violating the law inside that house. All the soldiers are running outside to catch them. When the soldiers approach the gate of that house, a loud explosion occurs immediately, after which the scene shows all the soldiers lying on the ground, looking surprised at first. If the beginning of the movie is so exciting, then curiosity will naturally arise in you to watch the rest. I found the beginning quite exciting.
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mofijul/EoyNYtMhxu9v9itKvYbuuds8WM6wBWK8eJFhZvBeAExUujChUF3uB8TonLz1hkwRHEs.png)
[source](https://www.outlookindia.com/art-entertainment/south-cinema/mohanlals-l2-empuraan-becomes-first-malayalam-film-to-be-released-on-imax)</center>
Basically, there are very few thriller-type movies in Tamil movies, where a different kind of excitement will work inside you from the very beginning, because in this movie, an incident is shown in the beginning where the peak of a person's torture is shown, and then it is shown that he is a big minister in India, so the kind of crime he committed at the beginning of his life and what he can do to that country later will work suspense inside you, just as the director will create negative comments about how the lead character of this movie, that is, the hero of this movie, has portrayed his character.

In some cases, you will feel a lot of suspense about the hero's actions, and in some cases, there will be a twist where it will seem like the story is taking you in a different direction, meaning it is filled with suspense from beginning to end. I found the movie quite thrilling. The actors' performances in this movie are worth praising.
Those who have seen this movie will agree with me, and those who have not seen this movie yet, you can watch it if you want. I hope you like it.

Olá, Alien Art Cast.

Peço licença para me integrar a este espaço. Sou veterana de rede, mas estou em um estágio de recalibração técnica na Hive. Sou a Teka Barreto na Web2; aqui na Web3, sou tekabybrazil.

Minha abordagem ignora o engajamento emocional forçado; foco na neutralidade dos dados e na soberania de quem \

da própria arte [cite: 2026-01-26, 2026-02-05, 2026-02-07]. Acredito que a arte, além de ensinar, manifesta a essência sem a necessidade de explicações verbais exaustivas.

Coleção GeoméTrEKA & Outras Sintonias
Minhas criações são ensaios sobre a forma e a ignição do pensamento:

Faça-se o Prompt!: O ponto zero onde a vontade humana encontra a estrutura sintética.

GeoméTrEKA: Estudos geométricos em loop, explorando o equilíbrio entre o preto, o branco e a expansão cromática.

Arte em Risco: A beleza da saturação e o risco controlado da estética digital.

Toda a coleção está disponível em edições limitadas e numeradas na minha galeria oficial. LINK: https://nftshowroom.com/tekabybrazil/gallery

Agradeço aos votos e incentivos que recebi anteriormente; foram eles que serviram como bússola para encontrar esta comunidade. Como artista em várias frentes, busco observar e absorver as mensagens — sejam elas escritas, desenhadas, pintadas ou propositalmente borradas. A arte não se explica; ela sustenta e inspira a estrutura da nossa realidade.

Me junto aos artistas que sabem o potencial dos NFTs. Espero integrar este ecossistema com vocês.

title.title: More of the Same - February 18 - 20, 2026 @goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![Happy house plants collage text crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpA3Xj4tYpJsrL4NmH3xEMAVrPNd5cRuxVAm8fULrQzb71u48EZXkzM3GCadzmpj3at.jpg)

*Happy house plants*

On Wednesday I got up and got my post up and got ready to go to exercise class. I wasn’t feeling so good but made it through the class. When I got home I made something to eat and fell asleep on the couch for 3½ hours. When I wasn’t tending stoves, pulling shades, feeding a cat and myself, I was on the couch watching Doc Martin until bedtime at 8PM. I think I got a load in the dishwasher at some point, my only contribution for the day.

![Transcription finished crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EokcBTfZZFLkD31kcjdt4jKCs2P6bFEQMUaWQqahUxjxeJm8tTF4CrZdJXVV5T5fXRY.jpg)

On Thursday I was up around 6AM and got started on the transcription. I had about 4 pages left when my #4 helper arrived at 1:30PM. I sent her on errands and had half a page left to do when she got back. We put away the shopping and she vacuumed the first floor while I finished up and then I put everything away.

We had about 2½ hours left and decided to do some more shade washing and repair. We got 6 more done in the dining room and started in the living room. She left at 5:30PM and I was exhausted.

![Snow starting collage text crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoCn2CmhVAeGauYwFP92uSDRFJwsbyVz8vT53M1BJFGQF2mEGBKfZVp3pq3wa7VYHQh.jpg)

On Friday morning I had the first PT session for the arthritis in the left knee. Not impressed with the new person, but hopefully I won’t be working with her much.

I rested until my #3 helper arrived at 12:30PM. We got started on the window shades project again while it snowed and finished all the shades on the first floor. On the 2nd floor we got the 5 small shades done. That just leaves 8 more larger ones for next time.

![Masonry heater fire crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23vhyoaGC6WqhovQFzojw3fGRGrbvcRoeiPBNn4RgAUsC2iQB6bu1gLg4ce1oztYJELcH.jpg)

The masonry heater burned well but I had a hard time with the wood stove. I also discovered the snow we’d gotten had reached 2” so I went out and shoveled/swept it off the steps because it was sleeting and only going to get heavier.

I was much too tired and couldn’t get to bed until after 11PM. 

On Saturday I am hoping to go to the Orchid Show with one of the women from exercise class. I have yet to do laundry and must try to get that done. I also have to catch up on my posts! It’s to snow later in the day, so I may have to sweep walks and steps.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.title: Hive Music Festival Week 175 Round 1 \
(The last Kiss) Cover by @carmenrivas
title.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenrivas/23vi83MnSTwW74Jkxo1WVZ24zfUCXCExQeWQfJB61axQsH18uQm4dcCwsj8CHXnNMfPVq.jpg

https://youtu.be/iTq88eucN14?si=qBxeRBcrRj4IHUVj

Hola, comunidad, desde el 29 de noviembre del 2025  no me había sido posible grabar y publicar. La vida ha dado muchas vueltas por estos lares. Tengo una amiga que dice eso: \

, pero yo diría que a veces no solo da vueltas, da maromas, hace piruetas y practica la gimnasia rítmica.  ¿Alguna vez han visto a las gimnastas rítmicas realizando sus ejercicios con aros unas veces y con cintas otras veces? Bueno
...por ahí va la cosa... solo que nosotros no somos los gimnastas sino los aros y cintas 😁
Esta vez la grabación no la hicimos en casa de nuestra amiga @hermaryrc sino en la placita al lado de la iglesia a la que asistimos.

>Hello everyone, I haven't been able to record and post anything since November 29, 2025. Life has taken many turns around here. I have a friend who says, \

but I would say that sometimes it doesn't just turn, it does somersaults, pirouettes, and rhythmic gymnastics. Have you ever seen rhythmic gymnasts performing their routines with hoops sometimes and with ribbons other times? Well, >That's the idea... except we're not the gymnasts, we're the hoops and ribbons 😁 This time we didn't record at our friend @hermaryrc's house, but in the little square next to the church we attend.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2hKxuzLhtBwbbcrXypfxSvrukmNXvXY3nZL6Xd53eqL/separador_carmen.png
Quise compartir con ustedes una canción que no se si conozcan, es una de esas que en Venezuela llamamos - con cariño, no en forma despectiva - \
. Esta canción fue compuesta  en 1961 por Wayne Crochan.. Pero pasó \

. Digamos que no hizo ruido alguno.
Acá se las presento en una interpretación de su compositor en el año 1962:

>I wanted to share with you a song that I don't know if you're familiar with. It's one of those songs that in Venezuela we affectionately call—not in a derogatory way—\
(The Last Kiss). This song was composed in 1961 by Wayne Crochan. But it went by \

Let's just say it didn't make any noise. Here it is, performed by its composer in 1962:
https://youtu.be/yKDMRZv4SYc?si=csW98dRqv9Ce36hj


https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2hKxuzLhtBwbbcrXypfxSvrukmNXvXY3nZL6Xd53eqL/separador_carmen.png
La canción fue grabada por J. Frank Wilson & The Cavaliers en 1964. Posteriormente comenzaron a hacerle versiones en idioma castellano: el grupo mexicano Los Apson,  el grupo peruano Los Doltons. En inglés fue interpretada también por \

Elvis Presley.
Leo Dan también la interpretó en su momento. Acá en Venezuela la versionaron Los 007, con ellos se puso de moda y nunca más ha dejado de sonar. La escuché cuando era una niña y ahora que soy abuela no me sorprende encender la radio y volver a escuchar la trágica del accidente de tránsito que separó a una pareja de enamorados.

El 22 de diciembre de 1961, dos adolescentes iban en un auto. Eran novios y entre ellos había nacido un profundo amor. Eran Jeannet Clark y Jake Hancock, ambos de dieciséis sños. Jake conducía, Jeannette iba a su lado y en el asiento trasera iban dos amigos más. Se durugían a una fiesta. El auto fue impactado por un camión y debido al impacto fallecieron en forma instantánea Jeannette y uno de los amigos del asiento trasero. Los dos sobrevivientes quedaron heridos de gravedad.

>The song was recorded by J. Frank Wilson & The Cavaliers in 1964.
Later, versions in Spanish began to appear: the Mexican group Los Apson, the Peruvian group Los Doltons. It was also performed in English by \

Elvis Presley. Leo Dan also performed it at one point. Here in Venezuela, Los 007 covered it, and it became popular with them and has never stopped playing since. I heard it when I was a child, and now that I'm a grandmother, it doesn't surprise me to turn on the radio and hear the tragic story of the car accident that separated a couple in love. >On December 22, 1961, two teenagers were in a car. They were sweethearts, and a deep love had blossomed between them. They were Jeannette Clark and Jake Hancock, both sixteen years old. Jake was driving, Jeannette was in the passenger seat, and two more friends were in the back. They were on their way to a party. The car was struck by a truck, and Jeannette and one of her friends in the back seat died instantly in the impact. The two survivors were seriously injured.

A diferencia del accidente real , los chicos van solos y su auto se vuelva por una pendiente con los faros encendidos en la oscura noche. Tiempo después Wayne se retiró del mundo artístico para desempeñarse como pastor de una iglesia evangélica. >In a cabin near the scene of the accident lived the composer Wayne Crochan. Interestingly, Wayne had a song about a car accident in progress but couldn't find a way to finish it. When he heard about the accident involving the young couple—that the girl had died and the boy had survived—he decided to incorporate this into his work, modifying the lyrics to turn it into a romantic ballad. >Unlike the real accident, the young couple were alone, and their car rolled down a slope with its headlights on in the dark night. >Some time later, Wayne retired from the music industry to become a pastor in an evangelical church.

title.title: A Real FAFO Moment
title.body:
/></center>

[source](https://images.teepublic.com/derived/production/designs/55659634_0/1703793122/i_m:pid_477,c_164_76_1108x1108,bc_000000,ar_1x1,o_portrait,pm_4,s_630,q_90.jpg)






I don't wish anyone bad luck or hard times, but when it is at my expense I do not give two hoots. Business is business whether it is family or someone else as there is so much riding on the line. I had been saying this all along that everyone needs to pay their way and we cannot carry people no matter who they are. Costs can be hidden within a business and when you physically break them down only then is the truth revealed.

Two weeks ago we had a family member who had been using our services at a family discounted rate step over the line and we forced their hand. We knew roughly how much the service we were providing was costing and they threw this in our face by being ungrateful. Once we broke it all down it became clear we were being taken advantage of and the family members clearly needed a reality check. Why must we always have the short end of the stick and I would like to be able to pay the staff and family more if we had more. These free costs are eating into the profits as they are significant enough to make others aware. 

The good part is their ego got in their way and threatened to pull their stock which we have been warehousing and delivering for the last 3 years free of charge. We gratefully accepted their threat and they have now left the building saving us a complete fortune. All we asked was for them to pay a small percentage because fair is fair. We estimated just on their delivery side and warehousing costs they were liable for R40K ($2.5K) monthly. They disagreed with that number and we have since heard this weekend they did not fully understand the costs. In reality they did not understand their business fully and we made it profitable through our generosity and we will not take them back even if they paid all the costs. 

What I found quite staggering is they had been selling online for the last 3 years and argued that this particular company collects the item when it has been sold and there are no collection/delivery fees. They presumed this as we were being billed and not them as this came off our main account. Selling via a platform has it's other costs besides the listing and selling fees.

For a business that was paying nothing they now are paying for a 500 square meter warehouse at R30K per month. The one staff member who was working 80% of the time on their account being R25K and the delivery fees which they did not think were real being an estimated R30K monthly. Imagine owning a business for 3 years and not knowing there was a delivery fee? What a great business if you have no expenses and now have to find R85K ($5K) just to break even.

I know their monthly sales and this business is done and is not a viable concern once you add all the costs together versus the profits from their sales. This will be obvious within the next month and they are either oblivious to this or are already sweating.

This person was handed this business and is about to lose the business through  having things too easy and not understanding all the processes. You do sometimes wonder with these types of people who somehow always seem to have money for holidays and the good times with everyone else left wondering with the question of how? I do not follow social media, but my son mentioned they are always away on holiday every other month. I guess the real world has finally caught up with them as their free ride has come to an end and we would say they are not cooked.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/a-real-fafo-moment-cv8)

Hola amigos amantes de la literatura, después de un tiempo desaparecido, ya estoy aquí de nuevo con ustedes para seguir creciendo en esta hermosa comunidad literaria. Espero les guste. Estaré ansioso por ver sus criterios.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb2PCD1DLrRiwvigwUZRrkuS7M8BzRuWU5hoJ6347dmm2/img_20250407_114839_671.jpg)
Según los libros de historia. Existió un país donde su pueblo, obligado por los gobernantes. Entregaron todas sus armas y se dedicaron a cultivar la paz entre ellos y con el resto del mundo. 

Para lograrlo, basaron su pacífica teoría en el proceso de admirar las rosas para alcanzar la paz más sublime de todas. Y sin más, las flores, al darse cuenta de tal posibilidad, accedieron al pedido, convirtiéndose la utopía en asunto de seguridad nacional, y pasaron las rosas a ser moneda de cambio, a telares salidos de sus pétalos o incluso a ser medallas distintivas como la denominada rosa de los vientos. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJTd49UJ9UdegwwzHzRECUoSZBQqNEUV3qrnnULQ8kHG/img_20250408_092210_708.jpg)
Pero como en todo país, donde su pueblo toma decisiones en apariencia, era prohibido entregar las rosas junto con las espinas, pues era una violación de los derechos de las flores que veían fustigada su belleza con tal sacrilegio, y era una violación a los derechos de los hombres y las mujeres, a disfrutar de aquella verdadera perfección. 

De esta forma y sin otra solución posible, las espinas eran arrancadas de los tallos, e iban a parar a manos de los gobernantes del pueblo, quienes, sin otro criterio que su propio poder, las utilizaban para entrenar, pulir y organizar, las maniobras del ejército invencible que ocultamente se preparaba en las afueras de los pueblos. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSc7JwGNfhUMw5Wywv3gQkhRwF3jo366vaiZUD2UNGYAt/texto_12_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUNqDXZ5CVYPvhJr369ApccLYKQU3ANCKR6XqUPbQJhB/versi_n_en_espa_ol_3_.jpg)<center>

Hello fellow literature lovers! After some time away, I'm back with you all to continue growing in this wonderful literary community. I hope you enjoy it. I look forward to your feedback.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb2PCD1DLrRiwvigwUZRrkuS7M8BzRuWU5hoJ6347dmm2/img_20250407_114839_671.jpg)
According to history books, there was a country where its people, forced by their rulers, surrendered all their weapons and dedicated themselves to cultivating peace among themselves and with the rest of the world.

To achieve this, they based their peaceful theory on the process of admiring roses to attain the most sublime peace of all. And without further ado, the flowers, realizing this possibility, agreed to the request, transforming the utopia into a matter of national security. Roses became currency, textiles woven from their petals, and even distinctive medals like the compass rose.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJTd49UJ9UdegwwzHzRECUoSZBQqNEUV3qrnnULQ8kHG/img_20250408_092210_708.jpg)
But as in any country where the people seemingly make decisions, it was forbidden to give roses along with their thorns, for it was a violation of the rights of the flowers, whose beauty was thus marred by such sacrilege, and a violation of the rights of men and women to enjoy that true perfection.

In this way, and with no other possible solution, the thorns were pulled from the stems and ended up in the hands of the town's rulers, who, with no other criterion than their own power, used them to train, polish, and organize the maneuvers of the invincible army that was secretly preparing on the outskirts of the towns.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

links.title: The Bad Habit That Dawned On Me
links.body:
Happy weekend great community 🎉 

I am someone who believe so much in not hurting people especially those who are close to me as either friends or family with my act or whatsoever. Probably I care too much or it's just a normal thing or way to feel about those you care about.

![1000509198.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23uFMgfJgP2tQY1i2e2DEYaGvRvLjccoxsJqPbURELvHAx7nKFqAQ1SdXAC1zy6zJ4dHR.jpg)

However, I think I've come to contradict that unintentionally with one act I actually didn't know could go a long way in hurting those I care about. In as much as it might have saved me in some situations or made me see people for their bad behaviour right before they even get to show themselves in their bad manners, it has also made me question the feelings of my loved ones and that act is simply ASSUMPTIONS.

Assumption is something I came to realize that I have after several conversations with different people and at first I thought it was good cos I was able to predict situations or people beforehand. 

This is something I've talked about briefly once on @samhangout during one of the weekend engagements and I came to realize that I actually wasn't the only one on this table of assumptions.

![1000499353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23wgUE51nE11uV1rNZFccfyJZDLpQuvrQXqTZRaoSxFMNnFnoYSo61XPMciCupS4U7RRi.jpg)

Entering into 2026, its part of my resolution to not assume for anyone either to defend them on something bad they did or a situation I foresee coming no matter how obvious it may seem or the chances that might call for assumptions. I would allow them spill it themselves or do what I'm supposed to do and question whoever I'm supposed to question rather than assuming on their behalf.

I'm still working on getting more better as I'm not off it totally and I hope that by the end of this year, I will be able to stand firm in honour to say I was able to shove away that act from me.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Weekend-experiences community prompt.

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are Mine.

links.title: Caturday Episode, February 21 2026
links.body:
Heya, feline fans on Caturday!

This is the day of the week we’ve all been waiting for.

Cats are animals that never seize to amaze me in their own unique ways.

These two cats are about to have a heated argument in the middle of the street.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPfj2f87QFUTkDkE42VkDsLyTGGzeu9aXgCTra7BLrizr/1000017909_1_.jpg)



Their body language shows that they are ready to literally leap at each other, especially the white and gray one on the left that is bigger in size.

“I told you to behave, but you didn’t listen to me. Now you will suffer the consequences!”, it says in cat language to the other cat.

The other cat looks gobsmacked, and has taken a step back to defend itself.

Then it says something like that: 

“What are you talking about? I haven’t done anything wrong. Just stay away from me and leave me alone!”.

In the meantime, a committee consisting of seven old and wise cats meet to discuss the situation between the two arguing cats.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGZs7JT1Vpm8bCyyCAR7fmpy8GrL9hMfdmRqf2KYTHHX/1000017872_1_.jpg)



One of them says: 

“We must do something about those two lunatics fighting with each other all the time. We have to act immediately, otherwise we will have casualties and innocent cats may die!”.

The other cats listen carefully, and try to think of any actions that need to be taken to stop those cats from fighting.

links.title: Hotel Habana Libre, encuentro con un amigo/Hotel Habana Libre, Meeting a Friend (Esp-Eng)
links.body: <div class=\

> Hola, mis amigos de Daily Blog. A pesar del tiempo, el Hotel Habana Libre sigue siendo ese imponente edificio que da la espalada al mar, con sus años a cuestas y ese aire de grandeza desgastada. Mi amigo Ramón me esperaba en el vestíbulo junto a las escaleras que llevan al Bar Turquino. Ramón es un escritor español que adora mostrarme sus textos para que se los revise. Lo vi antes de que él me viera a mí. Estaba más delgado y con los mismos ojos cansados de mirar curioso. >Hello, my friends at Daily Blog. > >Despite the passage of time, the Hotel Habana Libre remains that imposing building that turns its back to the sea, carrying its years and that air of faded grandeur. My friend Ramón was waiting for me in the lobby by the stairs leading to the Bar Turquino. Ramón is a Spanish writer who loves to show me his texts for review. I saw him before he saw me. He was thinner, with the same tired eyes from looking curiously.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPTBfMep2xp38YGDdnVQF7SN5vNCUmg7CUVi8TYVcuQJ/1771704770777.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSn62pDKC4B1hBwTLYDArN4UvThh4FxumfnbjfJcQGotr/1771704771049.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1sN8dpZZBBLvfZ3KHZ5Pv9XUPZTfyKfyPPfuDdw3645/1771704771435.jpg)

>






Cuando por fin me descubrió entre la gente, levantó la mano como si llevara cuatro años esperando por mí, yo que soy tan puntual, que de haber sido militar no hubiese tenido, jamás, problemas con el horario. Nos abrazamos, él olía a tabaco y a ese perfume suyo de siempre, ese que no sé cómo se llama pero que reconocería en cualquier lugar del mundo. “Hace demasiado”, dijo. Y sí, demasiado tiempo, demasiados libros sin contarnos, demasiadas madrugadas de escritura en soledad, demasiadas correcciones pendientes.

>When he finally spotted me among the crowd, he raised his hand as if he had been waiting for me for four years—me, who am so punctual that had I been in the military, I would never, ever have had issues with time. We hugged; he smelled of tobacco and that familiar cologne of his, the one I don't know the name of but would recognize anywhere in the world. \

he said. And yes, too much time, too many books left unshared between us, too many early mornings of solitary writing, too many pending revisions.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwoZ5XzHdPWTf6k9E3NF3E6GXyk5GFopiAe8D11a7odd/1771704905957.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSY9M7iVsiBtjdeRGNFASommLgCa95b4nbtp1h9PC9VSn/1771704906320.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSr7ygV2zDkfbBXigierqAuFbfgo1CBNV6jKUDDaDyyfP/1771704906531.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYPa57eiEodDLgHF4CkZ2WN1F1GymbDhKGtmo7ZomDNL/1771704906819.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzx1tYMgXTtLUGazVtyvdKnmgFZyE93UNeCieddzNd6m/1771704907133.jpg)

> Subimos por las escaleras hasta la segunda planta y fuimos a un salón donde disfrutamos de una expo de pintura y fotografías. >We went up the stairs to the second floor and into a hall where we enjoyed an exhibition of paintings and photographs.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9emmQPmAkKTqQaBSh9YhDPezmferfoaBDQtNDiiS7Cj/1771705004365.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRR2NMWPYirHVn4Qv8frkF9AW1u5N4ccC757aLU3VQDc1/1771705004619.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSn1zbD5xT6eujCc1zXUTd2ianTZiPzxrRbvAET5nxRTx/1771705004850.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXF2nZSvqBHfEcwhmNPmVoszTDG2DQY4PRJNr7YU4SteQ/1771705005151.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5EjbYwM8BSAZSKNjUfMtFWDh6nsMQMoPXoYiTP95D6s/1771705005454.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvqbdu4PiXo6YRa855cWu436R4LYfTcTdZf9pdVdrYQ8/1771705153487.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8gbkx4zyJHBXFyqMfUWhH18NC7JreibxGe9WGCLrLnz/1771705153753.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXD5oh7e81jg8iJAaZT4BfquKbLPUcedX311cTewu3BzJ/1771705154007.jpg)

>








Luego nos sentamos en unos sillones para conversar. Ramón traía el manuscrito de su próxima novela, todo subrayado en verde y rojo. “Los editores españoles me piden que recorte las descripciones”, me contó, pasándome las hojas. “Dicen que el lector de ahora no tiene paciencia”. Leí un párrafo sobre una mujer que espera en un malecón cualquiera. “No recortes esto”, le dije. “Aquí está el alma del personaje”. Sonrió. “Por eso aprecio tanto tu opinión ”.

>Later, we sat in some armchairs to talk. Ramón brought the manuscript of his next novel, all underlined in green and red. \
he told me, handing me the pages. \
I read a paragraph about a woman waiting on some random seawall. \
I told him. \
He smiled. \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7EMxDHdiBaALVyV71qBhkjSbPyyB2jqZzfPexJRa4ch/1771705595064.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf65BJ9yYv4fhz3yae8aSYPVBke6J2LzU4iyntKjjZKZn/1771705595279.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1emuLKKdwkCuFS5w3fRWPjcY6MzuoGfWzX1Jp8Uibe9/1771705595500.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZGXVcbLDJGSjyvFi45W9HDb2cUb7yk8xHi74ToQVMKBr/1771705595743.jpg)

> Mientras admirábamos la belleza del lugar, hablamos de edición como otros hablan de amores imposibles. Del oficio de limpiar textos sin borrar su voz, de esos editores que entienden que una coma no es capricho sino respiración (soy obsesiva con los signos de puntuación), de cómo, a veces, el mejor consejo es no tocar nada y dejar repisar lo escrito por un tiempo. >As we admired the beauty of the place, we talked about editing the way others talk about impossible loves. About the craft of cleaning texts without erasing their voice, about those editors who understand that a comma isn't a whim but a breath (I'm obsessive about punctuation), about how, sometimes, the best advice is to touch nothing and let the writing sit for a while.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6jpdZxti3fKeNyfnrAAP2xZykVzM9pmjvBeJXyM1P5R/1771705651323.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDFQXpETkRrfTPF2EjWU37BSAXBxKacFTh83T1BveueT/1771705651578.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEJiUP7DUz4EpVmKDUrj9qATi5shdywsnCrhhHc1qJNb/1771705651903.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUf9UQFDycMYUuCTCZR8BViEU4EGiCu83h6LDkyQbPAHe/1771705652176.jpg)

>





El hambre llegó cuando ya había pasado el mediodía. “Por aquí cerca hay un lugar que hacen unas  pizzas excelentes\
There's a place nearby that makes excellent pizzas,\
text-justify\
text-justify\
. Antes de irnos me regaló un ejemplar de su novela \

. Nos despedimos en la esquina del cine Yara. entre el ruido de los autos y el olor del mar. “¿Vuelves pronto?”, pregunté. “No lo sé”. Me miró como se mira a los amigos que uno aprende a tener sin medida. “Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme”, le dije.\n\n>We ate slowly, talking about projects, about blank pages, about that illusion that comes with starting a new story. He confessed to me that sometimes he still doubts, that he gets up at three in the morning to change a word. \
I told him. \
. Before we left, he gave me a copy of their novel \
We said goodbye on the corner by the Yara cinema, amidst the noise of the cars and the smell of the sea. \
I asked. \
He looked at me the way one looks at friends you learn to have without measure. \

I told him.

links.title: Any horror series: Weapons [ENG/ESP]
links.body: <div class=\

>
![liketu (48).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23u5tDBvf6Lixp9WJtem8Wb12PdDZSLoUEtL2tvTs2o31NQSsd2KTN1MPCuwbokeqWRjQ.png)
--- #
🎥 Weapons 🎥
--- Esas historias de terror, que no tienen pie ni cabeza, que a muchos les emocionan, pero tú quedas igual, sin entender ni encontrarles sentido, seré la única a la que le pasa, ¿o qué? Bueno, en mi defensa, no soy fan de las películas de terror, porque la mayoría que he visto no me han impactado, ni creado ese susto al ver escenas terroríficas, pero no me niego a verlas, porque a pesar de eso, la parte del suspenso vale la pena; estás con la intriga de qué sucederá después, de cómo terminará esta historia. >Those horror stories, which make no sense, which excite many people, but you remain the same, without understanding or finding meaning in them, am I the only one this happens to, or what? > >Well, in my defense, I'm not a fan of horror movies, because most of the ones I've seen haven't shocked me or scared me when I've seen terrifying scenes, but I don't refuse to watch them, because despite that, the suspense is worth it; you're intrigued by what will happen next, by how the story will end. ---
## Sinopsis: Un grupo de niños, alumnos de una clase, desaparece de forma inexplicable, a la misma hora, en la misma noche; los padres creen que la profesora tiene alguna relación con esta desaparición. Todos la acosan y señalan, pero solo un niño queda en el salón; nadie sabe ni entiende porque. >## Synopsis: A group of children, students in a class, disappear inexplicably at the same time on the same night; the parents believe that the teacher has something to do with their disappearance. They all harass and point fingers at her, but only one child remains in the classroom; no one knows or understands why.

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tbH2yevf1Yx24chARnKg1p6FNWhAuPH5M4bseGQCEWkGuHmCGGqxAR9RqwXYC1qFVHx.png) --- >## Opinión: Bien, hablemos un poco de esta película, como mencioné en la sinopsis, trama se basa en la desaparición de este grupo de niños; este hecho ocurre el mismo día, y a la misma hora; a la vez, hay videos donde muestran la forma en la que salen de sus casas, como si estuvieran volando. La historia comienza un poco lenta, demasiado para mi gusto; cuando empecé a verla, confieso que me desespero, como siempre, da un giro más adelante, donde te van mostrando escenas, para que vayas sacando tus conclusiones, y es que a su vez, van mostrando por partes, desde la perspectiva de cada protagonista, para luego al final, dar con la relación de cada uno. >Okay, let's talk a little about this movie. As I mentioned in the synopsis, the plot is based on the disappearance of this group of children; this event occurs on the same day, at the same time; at the same time, there are videos showing how they leave their homes, as if they were flying. > >The story starts off a little slow, too slow for my taste. When I started watching it, I confess that I got frustrated, as usual, but it takes a turn later on, where they show you scenes so that you can draw your own conclusions. At the same time, they show you parts of the story from the perspective of each protagonist, and then at the end, they reveal the relationship between each one. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23swZZYSXG8ow9Ct9pjjW1nQjPzFFTKjyn27wPtsBvi7QdCJkDz2fVM5LumfDufzAVgfJ.png)
--- Es como una historia contada por partes, empezando por la maestra, luego el papel de un padre desesperado, en busca de su hijo, para luego llegar a los verdaderos responsables de la desaparición de estos niños. Entiendo que la idea es darle este toque de suspenso y misterio, pero no sé por qué tienen que alargarlo tanto,eso es lo que no me gusta mucho de las películas de terror, cuando comienzan así de lento, me estresan, jajaja. >It's like a story told in parts, starting with the teacher, then the role of a desperate father searching for his son, and then finally arriving at those truly responsible for the disappearance of these children. > >I understand that the idea is to give it this touch of suspense and mystery, but I don't know why they have to drag it out so much. That's what I don't like so much about horror movies, when they start off so slow, they stress me out, ha ha ha. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23u5ZgJNRVBXftCFptwY46MaQs1gtxXU4XaZny6w1GVQNWSwCKRSH6BVg5GmacK6t7NXt.png)
--- ## En Conclusión: He leído algunas críticas; como siempre en el mundo del cine, cuesta complacer a todos, para algunas fue un éxito, pero para otros no tanto, en mi opinión, como este no es mi estilo, no fue de mi agrado, no la volvería a ver, sin duda; es una historia algo absurda, y con final algo traumático, para los niños que pasaron por esta experiencia. No daré detalles, para los que no la han visto, pero para quienes sí, me entenderán cuando hablo del trauma para los niños. ## In conclusion: >I have read some reviews; as always in the world of cinema, it is difficult to please everyone. For some it was a success, but for others not so much. In my opinion, as this is not my style, I did not like it and would not watch it again, without a doubt. It is a somewhat absurd story with a somewhat traumatic ending for the children who went through this experience. I won't give any details for those who haven't seen it, but those who have will understand what I mean when I talk about trauma for children.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23t6zyb8CmkXSzHwSHDq6n3hFHF4wtKcViN6JyFC913zwnKSw9TZu3nbATBTF8W41tLvV.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xAyYvtW4uz2JHpqHSs2XeCkz5aNpB8w6Aeqc9arUWjHzghhVzcGnWaJXPAqoJfFcEgp.png)

links.title: Regrouping After the Unexpected
links.body:
February is almost over, and I had expected to close the month with positive cash flow, a comfortable cushion in my bank account, ready to support whatever direction I wanted to take with my reselling. That was the plan.

But that is not what happened.

Instead, I lost workdays due to two emergencies hit at once. My dog became ill, and I had a dental emergency. Together, they cost me €887. That is a lot. It really is a lot. And while I do not have the exact final numbers yet, the reality is clear. After this financial shock, and being employed and needing to set aside money for taxes, I expect to have only between €900 and €1,100 left in my bank account for March, and that is the best case scenario.

There is no margin for anything else. No space for another emergency. No room for risk. And that means one thing very clearly. I cannot buy anything.

Once again, I am facing a month where purchasing new inventory is simply not possible. I will need to be extremely careful even with groceries, because in theory I should be building an emergency fund for moments exactly like this. But I do not have one. I have not been working consistently for several months, and that kind of financial buffer simply does not exist right now.

So instead of buying new stock as I had planned, I will continue on reselling what I already have at home and treating March as a testing period.

I have a large amount of jewelry sitting here. The reason it has not been listed is simple. This does not feel like the right time to sell jewelry as it's winter. In fact, I am not even sure this is the year to sell jewelry. People are struggling financially. Many are spending only on basic necessities. I see the signs everywhere. Even some retail stores in the United States are beginning to stock second hand items. That says everything about the current economic climate.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgS8ViS8PoxGPXpgChjsC23c9gE16pa8bhHVLySTJpn5/1771705535493.jpg)


People may have money for second hand clothes or shoes. But jewelry? I do not know where that fits anymore. I genuinely do not know if anyone will buy it.

I have many natural pearls that I plan to turn into bracelets. But will they sell? I cannot say. The vintage jewelry I own may simply not move this year. Still, testing the market has value. It tells me where to focus future investment, and just as importantly, where not to.

I already see clear patterns with handbags. If the price goes above €50, selling becomes extremely difficult. Even well known brands do not move easily at that level. For a higher priced bag to sell, it needs to be large, practical, and useful for everyday life. Small, decorative evening bags are not moving right now. The market is not interested.

The only comfort is that leather does not deteriorate when cared for and the value of these items does not disappear simply because they are not selling. What I have is not lost. It is just inactive dead stock sitting at home, waiting for the right moment.

March, then, will be another month of observation. Testing categories. Watching what moves and what does not. Learning how the market reacts to different types of items. I am not particularly hopeful, but I am paying attention.

And if I do manage to sell something next month, I am not even sure what I should do with the money. Should I reinvest it into new stock to keep the business moving forward? Or should I put it straight into savings and treat it as if it does not exist, protection for the next unexpected disaster? So even money that comes in carries a difficult decision. Grow the business, or protect my survival.

The mood is a bit gloomy, I admit. I am hoping nothing unexpected happens in March, because this situation is already tight. This is not how I imagined things unfolding.

But this is where I am.

And this, too, is life.

You're absolutely right — my apologies for the confusion. I was pulling the **pool-implied price** from the liquidity reserves (which calculates to ~$82 based on the ratio of CENT to LBI in the pool), but that's NOT the actual trading price.

The real **LBI market price** is **$0.106** (~1.55 HIVE), based on the last trade and current order book. The pool's calculated price of $82.82 is wildly distorted because the pool is imbalanced — the ratio of CENT to LBI doesn't reflect the actual market value of either token.

That's a critical distinction. Pool-implied price ≠ market price, especially in low-liquidity or asymmetric pools. Thanks for catching that.

##### Saludos  runners!!!


---


<div class=\

> Fin de semana, espero todos se encuentren bien, y disfrutando de esta maravillosa pasion. Ya a casi dos semanas de la CAF 2026, sintiendo aun esa maravillosa experiencia a flor de piel. Hoy en nuestrao entrenamiento largo de la semana, retomamos las cuestas, ya que entramos en un tiempo de preparacion, fortalecimiento, y sabemos lo bien que nos hace incluir cuestas en nuestros entrenamientos semanales, ya que son muchos los beneficios que obtenemos de las famosas cuestas que a muchos runners no les gusta. Y un amanecer con un maravilloso clima nos dio la bienvenida al entrenamiento de este dia, una brisa fria rozaba mi rostro, cuando inice a trotar me senti muy bendecida. Para la ruta de hoy incluimos cuestas, una ruta con pocos kilometros pero de mis rutas favoritas de cuest, ya que la cuesta es larga e intensa, pero a la vez es una ruta donde podemos presionar un poco porque no tiene tanto desnivel, en simples palabras perfecta para entrenar. --- Inicie mis dos primeros kilometros de calentamiento, luego fue poco a poco bajando ritmo manteniendo el seguimiento de la frecuencia cardiaca, como iba en subida la frecuencia cardiaca subia mas a pesar de que llevara un ritmo de control entre 6:19 - 6:09 min/Km. El clima hoy nos ayudo muchisimo en el entrenamiento. Al llegar al maximo desnivel de esta ruta paramos, nos recuperamos, y nos tomamos lindas capturas fotograficas, disfrutando al maximo de las salidas de entrenamiento, sin ningun tipo de presion, ya que no ytenemos ninguna carrera cerca, solo es mantenimiento. El regreso lo disftrute aun mas, conversando con mi esposo. Para este entrenamiento me lleve un rico sanck una compota de bolsa de avena y manzana, probando asi otras alternativas de alimentacion durante los entrenamientos. Fueron maravillosos 11 kilometros, con cuestas, trabajando asi la fuerza. Y seguimos manteniendo un estilo de vida saludable a traves de esta maravillosa pasion. --- --- #### ENGLISH VERSION --- >Hello runners! --- >

>  It's the weekend, and I hope you are all doing well and enjoying this wonderful passion. With CAF 2026 just two weeks away, I can still feel that wonderful experience close to the surface. Today, in our long training session of the week, we returned to the hills, as we enter a period of preparation and strengthening, and we know how good it is for us to include hills in our weekly training sessions, as there are many benefits to be gained from the famous hills that many runners dislike. A sunrise with wonderful weather welcomed us to today's training session. A cool breeze brushed my face, and when I started jogging, I felt very blessed. For today's route, we included hills, a route with few kilometers but one of my favorite hill routes, as the hill is long and intense, but at the same time it is a route where we can push ourselves a little because it does not have so much elevation gain. In short, it is perfect for training.


---

  
>I started my first two kilometers of warm-up, then gradually slowed down, keeping track of my heart rate. As I was going uphill, my heart rate rose more, even though I was maintaining a controlled pace between 6:19 and 6:09 min/km. The weather today helped us a lot with our training. When we reached the highest point of the route, we stopped, recovered, and took some nice photos, enjoying the training session to the fullest, without any pressure, as we don't have any races coming up, it's just maintenance. I enjoyed the return trip even more, chatting with my husband. For this training session, I took a tasty snack with me, a bag of oatmeal and apple compote, trying out other food alternatives during training. It was a wonderful 11 kilometers, with hills, working on strength. And we continue to maintain a healthy lifestyle through this wonderful passion.

links.title: The Battle to Get Savers to Invest...
links.body:
The tendency for people in the UK to just hoard cash rather than invest in more productive assets is becoming something of a real headache for policy makers...

politicians keep saying the UK needs more “productive capital.” If more households bought shares, that could boost the markets, help the economy grow, and cut back on our reliance on foreign investment.

But convincing the cautious cash-rich to take more of a risk on the stock-market is proving tricky...


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23xyZ11dCnEatLjYCzr3ADppkZjT4z3gdUhKpoqcmSsNGAoEVhvtPchRaxQXkEfjUM5SQ.png)
 

### Britain’s Cash Habit

There’s about £280 billion just sitting in near zero-interest accounts, according to the Bank of England. That’s money quietly losing value to inflation. 

Only 8% of household wealth in the UK sits in stocks — the lowest among G7 countries. Meanwhile, Brits hold almost twice as much in cash as anyone else in the G7!

And the recent trend is very much away from stocks... UK investors pulled a whopping £6.71 billion out of global stock markets in 2025—the biggest annual outflow in over a decade, and more than double what we saw during the Brexit nerves in 2016. People started panic-selling before the Budget, too.

### Why the caution...?

This could well be something to do with fact that as a nation we are used to relying on the State for our pensions, which means most people have a base-line income of of £12K which is enough to survive, so possibly this reduces the appetite for risk..? 

Also, people don't realise they are loosing money to inflation, at least not on a day to day or even year to year basis - it's like the frog in boiling water..... losing even 5% of the value of savings a year is not noticeable. 

And compare this to the potential for losing 30-50% overnight if your shares tank. Psychologically it's much safer to stick with cash. 

### The Government response: tackling our natural caution.... 

Starting from 2027 the government is slashing the annual tax-free ISA allowance from £20,000 to £8,000. This should encourage people to Vest into tax-free stocks and shares ISAs with some of that additional £12K. 

And one would imagine practically every equity firm out there is gearing up its marketing to bring some relatively safe stocks and shares ISAs to more people...

### But this is going to be a challenge.....

If people don’t feel secure—if inflation’s eating away at their money, mortgages are expensive, or the world feels unstable—asking them to take more risks just doesn’t work. From where they’re sitting, holding cash makes perfect sense. It’s a shield, not a mistake.

There’s also the bigger picture. The UK stock market hasn’t had the best run lately: fewer big companies going public, more firms choosing to list in the US, worries about how competitive we really are. There's little encouraging the wider macro-climate that's going to encourage people to Vest in stocks. 

### Final Thoughts...

Getting savers to become investors isn’t just about new policies. It’s about rebuilding trust in the markets, making the economy feel more stable, and addressing the real fears that keep people clinging to cash.

Changing how people think about investing is going to take years, if not decades. You can trim ISA limits. Splash out on marketing. But you can’t just wish away risk aversion.

Until those deeper worries are tackled, the Chancellor’s challenge isn’t just a policy issue. It’s a culture shift—and that’s a much bigger ask.

links.title: Before You Exit Think about This
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTDdqaWRWs2f2Gs4LLkTE72sN5Cy7knKMxDaqSnKYhi26/1000216250.png 

Crypto is falling, everyone is complaining, noise is louder than reasons. “What is wrong with this market” another asked with frustration in his voice. It's time to get out of this emotional draining trap, he said. I am selling everything to focus on something else the other concluded. But hey, before you make that decision hear me out first.

Before you decided to invest your money into crypto I believe there some things that attracted and gave you the conviction to invest in the first place. Now that the market is not going the way you expected it, take a sit back and ask yourself this question “Has your thesis change?” Has the fundamental reason you believe in the crypto you interested in changed? If the answer is no, then the price dip is just noise and opportunity to accumulate more.

Think about it, you didn't just decided to invest in that particular coin because of price increment or hype but because you believe in the project vision and the potential it has to create real value in the long term. So, price drops shouldn't shake your conviction unless the fundamental has actually changed and the project is bound to fail or lose its place in the market. 

A strong project with good fundamental will eventually recover and reward those who held through the down times with substantial gain in the long run. 

I believe every crypto investor has a timeline for their investment and a set of goals they want to achieve within that timeline. What is your timeline? Are you investing for short term or long term? If you are holding for long term then, short term price fluctuations shouldn't be a concern for you at all. You need to think of your portfolio based on your goals, not on the current market sentiments.

Remember cost basis matters less than future value. If you are already in the red, selling won't recover anything, rather it locks you in the loss and prevent you from participating in the potential recovery and upside when the market bounce back. If you bought at $0.50 for example and the price is now at $0.15, you have already taken the loss on paper but selling now would just cement your loss but holding at least gives you a chance at recovery.

As I see the crypto space right now, it's like the beginning of a new circle. The market may even go dipper than it is today in the coming days or weeks but this is exactly when conviction beat speculation. It is an opportunity for those with strong conviction to build their positions at low prices and position themselves for the next bull run. 

This is the time to separate believers from speculators and if you have done your research and truly believe in the project you have invested in, then this is the time to stack and accumulate more at discount price. Start building a new position, by the time the market recover and the next bull run kick in, you will be celebrating. 

Hold on, and hold out. It's just a phase in the market circle.

links.title: Seeds - February 21, 2026 @goldenoakfarm
links.body:
![Seeds from orders crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EokdbaBbJuM61RuoqvAzdPuqzvJnYEgj4qMB8FVaNyZLD1eEJ5eUheBQTiYnFtWipfP.jpg)

Back in January, I did the [seed inventory]( https://nocdn.peakd.com/hive-140635/@goldenoakfarm/seed-inventory-january-26-2025-goldenoakfarm) after making all the [garden plans](https://nocdn.peakd.com/homesteading/@goldenoakfarm/seed-order-and-maps-january-18-2026-goldenoakfarm) for this year.

Then I sat down and looked through all the seed catalogs that had come in and started making up seed orders:

![Chart3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eo4JJrkWkRU8yxDx1czwtjkriPkRbXmLB9QTYMihLmgaX3Uuj9c9ogRzkWdfPNAedF2.jpg)

The seed orders went in on January 22, 2026, about a month later than I like. The earlier you get an order in the better chance you have of getting all you order. But I’d gotten sick the week before Christmas and just couldn’t get to this project.

![New seeds crop Feb 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EowH1Tn65WT2dasfuo94V8dyga2H35DAPm7va8AJDidfUZUAS9FqxdFLBCY1ngEDBji.jpg)

New seeds I am trying out this year are Hen-and-Chicks, rose campion, 2 types of stocks that are highly scented, and a carnation, also highly scented. I’ve not grown Hen-and-Chicks before so this will be a new learning experience, as they are a succulent type plant. I think I grew rose campion a couple decades ago. It’s a perennial but it eventually died out.

I’ve grown stocks and carnations before but I’m hoping I can get these planted into flowerbeds in a timely fashion so I can enjoy the scents. That’s always the challenge for me.

Here’s how I [start prepping for seed starting](https://nocdn.peakd.com/hive-140635/@goldenoakfarm/how-i-prep-for-seed-starting-january-31-2025-goldenoakfarm).

![Seedlings - storage under T5 crop March 2020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/241tXG6sC9BEktME8pJ1a99eREizrhVvdvQbo6B8XHY1uk3Ew9oktDuF5BVCJTGiLMUb8.jpg)

These are some basic tips one should use if you want success starting seeds:

Use the best seed starting medium you can
Don’t plant seeds too deeply
Keep lights as close as possible without burning, raise as needed
Regulate temperature of soil/air as close to optimal for each plant
Don’t over or under water
Start feeding with a mix without too much nitrogen at 2 weeks
Don’t start too early, optimal 3-5 weeks before planting for most things

Here’s a more complete post I made on [what seedlings prefer](https://hive.blog/gardening/@goldenoakfarm/what-seedlings-prefer-april-3-2020-goldenoakfarm).

And here’s another post on [how I start seeds](https://nocdn.peakd.com/hive-140635/@goldenoakfarm/the-first-seed-starting-march-1-2025-goldenoakfarm).

Hardest seeds to start for me are Rosemary and Costmary. I gave up starting rosemary so I never figured that one out. I’ve only been trying to grow costmary for a couple years and last year I got some good plants, but I’m not quite sure how I succeeded. If I can duplicate it again this year, then I will know as I keep detailed notes on what happens to seedlings and their growth and health.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

links.title: This object of the past.
links.body:
<Sub>[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/chain-chain-link-chain-links-iron-1510578/)<sub>







![652234-chain-1510578_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyebolu/23y8x6W4bAdZSoWqP57MV7FAE2M7stiED1h5xS7seTXdiXqjrYuK8RpAvUz6pLKPpeigb.jpg)







It was like a tour to me traveling around if opportunity presents itself because I like learning traditions, languages, and art. Sometimes, historical sites which are preserved as objects of the past are what I like to know about, get closer to, or touch if permitted.

After the death of Grandma, although it is tantamount to show respect and honor her bond with other family members, the opportunity to travel showcases that time just like a native says that states that the chicken that ate Maggie seasoning before death, becomes spicy on its own.

After her burial, I travelled to the Western side of my state to visit the abandoned chain of Ajawole, the legendary warrior. Getting there, I looked at the three-way junction which was a detour, and the rusted chain which coiled like a sleeping serpent. 

As I squatted down to touch the rusted chain, I heard a voice from far, “ If I were you, I would not do that”. I looked to pick where the voice was coming from and I saw an elderly woman walking with a staff.

“I have heard a little about the warrior that descended into the earth itself” I replied.

“Ajawole” the old woman replied and continued.

“ If you wish to hear the full detail, come let's have a sit” she uttered.

Her hut was just beside the road and I didn't want to miss any gist  so I walked close to her and we walked just a few steps away from the chain.

She sat on a native mat which was spread on the ground beside her hut and she put her wrinkled hand in a calabash which was placed beside her and she picked some bitter Kola from the calabash.

“ If I use this my dirty mouth to cut a bitter Kola for you, please don't eat but if I use it to talk to you, you'd better listen” she said after having a bite, and continued.

“ long before maps were drawn and borders were named. The people of this village were known for one thing, they were protected by a warrior who feared nothing, not man, not beast, and not spirit.

His name was Ajawole the unbent. He was born ordinary but the elders said he was taken away by a gigantic tornado when he was seven years old and returned when he was twenty. He grew into a warrior whose footsteps alone could scatter enemies.

 During the Great Western region war, when rival clans stormed the land like locusts, Ajawole stood at the front. He fought days and nights without sleep, and he returned stainless without a crack so everyone celebrated as some feared him the more while a few envied him.

Many months later, he was coming back from hunting and some selected people from the village ran towards him. In their hands was a newborn baby bathed in blood wrapped in a white cloth.

“ How did you know?” He asked as he met eye to eye with his taboo relic. To show this they declared they don't appreciate him even though he risks his life for them.
Something inside him shattered and without a word, he walked away from the crowd that followed him. 

“He got to that point,” the old woman said, pointing to the three-way junction.

At this point, I kept quiet and concentrated knowing that the story was getting to an interesting part.


She continued after a sip of palm wine which was at the other side where she sat.

Ajawole removed a heavy iron chain from his waist, he struck the earth with his fist and the ground split open like a wound. The villagers watched in terror as he descended into the earth itself and before he disappeared completely, he flung one end of the chain outward as his voice echoed from below.

“ If ever war returns and your cry is true, drag this chain and I will rise” he said then the earth sealed and years passed to decades, and peace covered our land like morning dew. Children grew into elders while the chain rusted but never broke. It lay there unmoving and half buried.

Then came envy, a new generation of leaders rose and men who had never seen war but hungered for relevance rose. They felt small beneath the legend of Ajawole.

“ Let's call him,” they said.

“ Let us remind the neighboring villages of our power” they bragged.

The oldest among them warned against it.

“ There is no war,” one of the elders said.

“ Peace is not weakness” another concluded but pride has a louder voice than wisdom.

One night without moonlight, the chosen few gathered, wrapped their hands around the rusted iron, and pulled it.

All of a sudden, the ground trembled, birds burst from trees and the sky split with silent lightning. Then the earth opened one more. Ajawole rose but was no longer entirely human, his eyes burned like coal in a furnace and his body was black as he moved around them at a flashlight speed.

“ Where is the war?” He asked as his voice layered with something thunderous.

The leaders shuddered. “ We feared an attack. We thought….” They said,

Ajawole smelled the lie before they finished speaking and remembered what made him a spirit.

“ People will poke you with a pin and ask if it hurts,” he soliloquized.

Other villagers rushed forward, falling to their knees. “ There is no war,” they cried.
“ It was a false call! Forgive us” they concluded.

Ajawole stood still for a long moment as even the wind dared not breathe. He looked at his chain and the trembling village. “ Peace is sacred, to summon war in its name is betrayal” he said and without another word, he turned and descended back into the earth and the ground sealed behind him for the final time but this time, the chain did not move. It remained and to this day, no one dared to touch it.

“ Touching it is just like another false calling for who knows if he is not sleeping “ she concluded and I thanked her for her time and the story was well said. I was so happy knowing more about this object of the past.

links.title: The Sun's gonna shine on everything you do....
links.body:
![131258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/243WVivdE6P8ApxZGZ5TfxXJyhYnkEmKJYgAsDxWCHUUXJ2QEWHGFQKL9A2K8nm13r4td.jpg)




<hr>




I was born in the early 90s and by 2003-2004 I was already familiar with some of the evergreen legendary songs, and one of them was ocean drive by lighthouse family.


 It was a graceful song and sometimes you can feel the song, remember and associate it with some youthful experiences and it's so good for real. 

I don't listen to songs of these days, they're not good enough; a of them are ungodly, race-baitive in nature, appeal to some dark sense of longing, and purely carries no soul, need I say I miss being young? I do.

 Life is missed up in many ways, the economy of Nigeria is one of the worst in the world, next to the likes of Somalia and Mozambique, you'd need to work for 10 to 15 years to be able to afford to buy a house or a car on top 10 paying jobs in the country.

 The current president is a well known drug dealer, running rings of illegitimate business and being funded and helped by some of the topmost African richest men, they have connections in the grassroot.


 It's just like a Colombian drug cartel running the currently, having the electoral body in their back pocket, the police, army, legislation and judiciary in their back pocket.


 These guys are basically monarchs running a democratic system and they depend on bigotic and nepotistic Nigerian to legitimize their seat in power. 98% of cops in Nigeria are dirty.


 These guys makes sure these guys stay in power, they kill innocent citizens, extort legitimate business and do all sorts of terrible things.


 Sometimes I think the likes of Pablo Escobar didn't really commit the type of crimes Nigerian leaders does, and it's a shit hole in this place in so many places, and people still choose tribalism of revolution. 


10 to 15 years ago, the economy of Nigeria was some of the best in the world, now people can barely afford to pay rents because of the cost of inflation eating into their salaries.


 # Oh my! 

I forget it's actually a post about music, but my point is that the music we listened to in the past, the kinder  experience of living a more original life, existing like a real humans, coupled with the evergreen music we listened to, no way I don't miss being a teenager again. 

This particular song called Ocean drive had a theme of hope and that nice blues vibe that you can make you sleep, but basically I like to relate it to when life was simpler, better, fun and original. 

I think the most wicked people aren't yet born, the world is losing quality at scale, good people are no longer governors, presidents and even head of world health organization are now being headed by greedy people.



 It's safe to say the world is headed for a different direction, and sometimes all we have is hope and to continue praying that the sun gets to shine on everything we do.

links.title: 🚪 Standing Outside My Own Future
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaH3eT7CsRuw1GBqeCAdWwLfKxXRYXhsyBELhnEuxvQna/IMG_9938.jpg 


Sometimes I feel like I’m standing in front of a closed door… not locked, just waiting.

I just finished high school, and everyone keeps asking me what’s next. I always say the same thing: *I want to be a lawyer.* And I mean it with my whole heart. I imagine myself defending people, speaking with confidence, wearing that black blazer like it’s armor.

But dreams are expensive.

Right now, I don’t have the money to start law school. And yeah… that hurts a little when I think about it too much. But I also believe something very deeply — this is not the end of my story. It’s just the pause before the breakthrough.

I’ve been learning how powerful social media can be. Maybe one day, the same platforms where I post my photos and thoughts will help me pay for my career. Maybe this door in front of me isn’t blocking me… maybe it’s teaching me patience.

Today I’m barefoot. Tomorrow I’ll be walking into courtrooms.

And I won’t forget these moments — when I had nothing but faith and a stubborn dream.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@minirivera/-standing-outside-my-own-future-eas)

links.title: Depression and anxiety: How to handle it biblically.
links.body:
Depression and anxiety is a psychological state that can affect the whole being of an individuals existence,if left without divine intervention. 

https://youtu.be/mtz3NLb9KXw?si=Wc_99gzW_cHVvNwB 

The world we are today is full of struggles, troubles and tension. The cares of life has everything it takes to drive us to the place of fear and depression,but we must learn how to cast our fears on Jesus knowing that he truly cares for us.

Philippians 4:6  Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
The scripture has the remedy to all  our problems including anxiety, taking our problems to God in prayers is the best way to handle our anxiety knowing that our maker have everything it takes to fix our worries. 

Putting our trust in God's sufficiency and knowing that God have our interest, at heart is the best path towards healing. 

Situations and circumstances of life will always approach us, but it'll take our determination to bank on God to come out Victoriously.

John 14:1
(KJV) Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me. 
The cure to a troubled heart, the depressed and the anxious is to believe the divinity for healing.
Worrying doesn't solve problems or heal pains,but God has everything it takes to restore. 

The scripture encourages us to take our eyes off our problems and fix them God through prayers and studying his words to know his original intensions for us.

Today, let's not contrate on the problem that confront us, rather let's take it to God in prayers.
We need to have faith in the healing process of God, and his ability to restore our soul to the place of wholeness.


Thankyou very much for Reading, Appreciate  every upvotes, Reblogs, let me know of your thoughts right there in the comments  section I'd  love to connect with you...

*@abbyspecial*
with much love❣️

links.title: Superando mis límites: 19km para celebrar mi cumpleaños número 19 y un trote suave de 5km para culminar la semana 🏃🏻🔥 [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
<center>![1000864600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23y8mMA9PbbjhrLXWCzivwg3PxSpJmJmko9PaNatCag2UqdPJqjE7K5cGT2BPKPf6zG91.jpg)</center>|
|-|

---

|<center>Español</center>|<center>English</center>|
|-|-|

----

<div class=\
><div class=\

>Bienvenidos, amigos de Hiverun, es un gusto compartir con ustedes en el día de hoy. Esta semana ha sido increíble; puedo decir que he superado mis límites más rápido de lo que yo pensaba. El lunes 16 fue mi cumpleaños número 19 y quería celebrarlo de una manera muy desafiante para ver de qué están hechas mis piernas. Llevaba semanas preparándome mentalmente y físicamente para correr más allá de 15 km, que era mi límite de kilómetros hasta los momentos, pero el día de mi cumpleaños decidí superar esos 15 km y superar mi límite.\n\n
><div class=\

>Welcome, friends of Hiverun, it is a pleasure to share with you today. This week has been incredible; I can say that I have exceeded my limits faster than I thought I would. Monday the 16th was my 19th birthday, and I wanted to celebrate it in a very challenging way to see what my legs are made of. I had been preparing myself mentally and physically for weeks to run beyond 15 kilometers, which was my limit at the time, but on my birthday, I decided to exceed those 15 kilometers and push my limits. ---
![1000864609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23w2FKng1UcMiwicBfVibQq1G377xz6Ai1aefWsVNUzcMLEEvJhZun6Vh84PpMDx71yMC.jpg)
|
![1000864607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tGXZiRyUX1NkKkAFijypyyPExW6jfZ2AdfJ7FcRTxpyT48D8NygxXpE4SYZJ2v6bphz.jpg)
|
![1000864613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23vhPqaHBstWitryHoJAVPT5rmnHfWQ9P7VPiWc7ozDPkfY8R5fXm8hh2vDTfuHvAg649.jpg)
| |-|-|-| ---
![1000864615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tGVuquDHYLCMGk3u9xsFU2zEZwPHh5KewNXVa2fyHLnF9nNmvaSiufGd3dhmNazF5Pw.jpg)
|
![1000864611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23wLt8XZLe2Nan5jUcSZY638TaME8y3DbVu1ao8aZrjfv4DqRtPgGsGakrsV8ZjAZN2MW.jpg)
|
![1000864605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tRxbUmDcLPu9B4zzq65WdtwqbNBn5xtyLXdrhxm6X45MyLjYksFjWzpSsVYhRXnP824.jpg)
| |-|-|-| ---
![1000854079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23zGkt7gYUTb8Yh4d8jGgYLUMeMVydgXdT1EyLbFFhvCWMvcYzqtgWpXekPYe7Sd7qGVc.jpg)
|
![1000854101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/244e5ndTMXH5oYcstfSVPduLcuG6azbpFomqdrjwKe9bzr11MjszUbRUSrVBfW7akfjUU.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1000854131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/EoGzpjY2mmivVaouybqZXf5FU5DJXSMJy5YeMeS78MjVX83BRXnLrTwkemMu6S1Fvbi.jpg)
| |-| ---
![1000854105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23rAyC8WhuG9UXSSRWEDmHaWfppCtz2J5BpCMSSi86MRirafSMcuSdinBzhBarzpPQ15y.jpg)
| |-| ---
><div class=\

>Luego de hacer mi entrenamiento de fuerza, calenté muy bien mis piernas para correr durante un buen rato. Ya tenía la ruta en mente; desde mi parque Las Ballenitas hasta la redoma del toro de Las Delicias son casi 10 km y, si lo hacía tanto de ida como de vuelta, serían 19 km. Llevaba semanas corriendo 10 km, así que me sentía listo para subir el nivel. Mi ritmo fue entre lento y rápido en algunos momentos, hasta que decidí mantener un ritmo de término medio para no ser tan lento ni tan rápido para rendir durante el camino.\n\n
><div class=\

>After doing my strength training, I warmed up my legs thoroughly to run for a long time. I already had the route in mind; from Las Ballenitas Park to Las Delicias bullring is almost 10 km, and if I did both the outbound and return trips, it would be 19 km. I had been running 10 km for weeks, so I felt ready to step it up a notch. My pace was between slow and fast at times, until I decided to maintain a medium pace so that I wouldn't be too slow or too fast and could perform well along the way. ---
![1000864619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tRrM4kDLc54JaKyBmQxsQBAL86zZi9ps2KCQKvujbRu5MoeBYLuPjp1ToxM8SULk2eb.jpg)
|
![1000864621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23uEsg9WjBSAXCkYYqyKkK59jTDWQmkK4AN9zyh9ZcN3zF8hYi2XaB4V68YHgGAcKnuzq.jpg)
|
![1000864617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23tRvHuUAqSYH6sVD5dTeGHbq7LSEoxuvh7VPzbtz16LJ4HKEQUNhqenzwBtqk46iyrSf.jpg)
| |-|-|-| ---
![1000858002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23zkpmvyZjiu6UfHn4EtHZFkxcJg2ns7poWZBYHVoytZUbbmkLEehtDFn3U7toWPsFvBm.jpg)
|
![1000858046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/243BVk4x2pADiUjmPigss7Rt5giQGd5czdMXag9L4jcymBQJ1npbEwMFdeMmNU6JMpuqJ.jpg)
| |-|-| ---
![1000858039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/EpXKzqVJz9bXZdtkbaMMR7d4Mh1QygwGhSCmQZf1eesZcc6TZRzZsXSATng8EQo4hr8.jpg)
| |-| ---
><div class=\

>Fue un esfuerzo máximo de mi parte, porque cuando llegué a los 10 km estaba algo cansado, pero no podía frenar. Luché varias veces con mi mente, hasta que llegué al kilómetro 16, donde hice una parada en la terminal de autobuses para tomar agua. Fue una parada rápida, porque estaba muy seco; la cantidad de líquidos que había botado era grande. Me quedaba poco, solo 4 km para completar mi primer reto a los 19 años. Al llegar al kilómetro 18 sentí felicidad porque iba a poder completar todo tal cual quería; fue el kilómetro más largo porque estaba muy cansado.\n\n
><div class=\

>It took every ounce of strength I had, because by the time I reached 10 km I was pretty tired, but I couldn't slow down. I fought with myself several times, until I reached kilometer 16, where I stopped at the bus terminal to drink some water. It was a quick stop, because I was very thirsty; I had lost a lot of fluids. I had little left, only 4 km to complete my first challenge at age 19. When I reached kilometer 18, I felt happy because I was going to be able to complete everything as I wanted; it was the longest kilometer because I was very tired. ---
![1000854260.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/23r1rwA5Ppa5zFaQJMjsLnibNRCmDHAwym6f8NY5u2kXZqPLTk2kPp6jsvq6N7Q5BQfLS.png)
| |-| ---
><div class=\

>Hasta que por fin llegue a los 19 km, celebrando mi cumpleaños de la mejor manera, superando mis límites. Y bueno, chicos, luego, el día miércoles, para culminar la semana del running, hice 5km mi cuerpo se sentía cansado de la ruta larga que había hecho, pero logre completarla, tenía ganas de correr. Esta vez mi acumulativo fue de 24km.\n\n
><div class=\

>Until I finally reached 19 km, celebrating my birthday in the best way possible, pushing my limits. And well, guys, then on Wednesday, to finish off the week of running, I did 5 km. My body felt tired from the long route I had done, but I managed to complete it. I felt like running. This time my total was 24 km. ---
![1000857993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zgaetano/EokdcS92ZS1RLmP2sadUndpgjuLiAtDMsdPTZQoiHwrzWS4q62p15ktDCf7rj7XSAGq.jpg)
| |-| ---
><div class=\
>Sin más nada que acotar gente, muchas gracias por haberse tomado el tiempo de ver mi post y nos vemos en otra publicación soy @zgaetano.\n\n
><div class=\
> Without further ado people, thank you very much for taking the time to see my post and I'll see you in another post I'm @zgaetano. ---
