links.body:
![1000131039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naradamoon/Ep5nBErJEofRwY5uwTvNKzAsubYwPs3w2vX17qkLZ74Fs1vLnUfnDShqiazPnqeALt7.jpg)

https://youtu.be/1aAJq4ZD8fI?si=N5XvvAgKSfVx4Avk


<div class=\

>


<div class=\

>

How's it going, everyone? Blessings and hugs. A few days ago, I got creative with my electric guitar. This month, after some sacrifices and savings, I set myself the goal of buying some new cables and a multi-effects pedal, which I think is wonderful, extremely useful for recording and playing live, obviously, so that the guitar doesn't sound so dry and has a little atmosphere and depth. I did it with the aim of completing a little mystery project that will help us later xD.

>

¿Que tal gente? Bendiciones y abrazos. Hace unos cuantos días me puse creativo con la eléctrica. Este mes tuve como objetivo, después de algunos sacrificios y ahorros, comprar unos cables nuevos y un pedal multiefectos, el cual me parece una maravilla, sumamente útil para grabar y tocar en vivo obviamente, para que esa guitarra no suene tan seca y tenga un poco de atmósfera y profundidad. Lo hice con el objeto de cumplir un pequeño proyecto misterioso que nos ayudará más tarde xD. ![1000126230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naradamoon/23wC59r12qEgB8qE8qTdEoLWFFxmgfg5e2xbhZWduLQcjTDzHM1YXsH8cF8tRH4axd8DF.jpg)

>

Well, in the case of this song, the effect I added isn't that noticeable because the main focus is the amp's drive, of course. It gives it a slight depth, but it's not that relevant. I think I added a chorus or a multivoice (I can't remember now), but as I said, those kinds of effects aren't the main focus in this case. Does the song remind you of anything? Before you realize it and tell me, yes, I was inspired by one of Cerati's 1,000 songs. Of course, I had been inspired before by other artists' songs to make my own, but that was all it was, inspiration, and the end result was always very different from the reference. However, I don't know what happened in this case, and the chorus ended up sounding somewhat similar to the chorus of that Cerati song, BUT (yes, there are a couple of “buts”) really, yes, the dynamics of the chorus are very similar, but it's not plagiarism, since the intervals I use are very different. The thing is, it's similar because of that “A4” at the end of the phrases, just because of that dynamic, but the way I got there before that is another matter. Anyway, I didn't want to include it as an official song in the repertoire because it sounded the same to me, but I really liked the song, so I'll keep it, haha. The song is about how to stop clinging to or grieving over interpersonal relationships. Sometimes you get lost in a tangle of problems by trying to get others to adapt to you, and the opposite is also true: when you try to adapt to others, that's wrong too. The ideal is to maintain a balance, not to be contaminated by others, such as becoming selfish just because others are selfish, and not trying to change others or change your essence for others, as I said at the beginning. We are social beings, yes, but we always have to have a certain freedom in our individual process and learn to be alone sometimes so as not to be emotionally dependent on anyone's company.

>

Bueno, en el caso de esta canción, el efecto que le puse no se nota tanto porque el protagonista es el drive del ampli, claro, le da una ligera profundidad pero no es tan relevante, le puse creo que un chorus o un multivoice (ya se me olvidó) pero bueno, cómo dije, ese tipo de efectos no son los protagonistas en este caso. ¿La canción te recuerda a algo? Antes de que te des cuenta y me lo digas, si, me inspire en uno entre 1000 de cerati. Claro, ya me había inspirado antes en otras canciones de otros artistas para hacer las mías, sin embargo eso solo quedaba ahí, en inspiración, pero el resultado final siempre era muy diferente a lo referencia. Sin embargo, no sé que me pasó en este caso, y el estribillo quedó algo parecido al estribillo de esa canción de Cerati, PEEEROOO (si, hay un par de \
) realmente, si, la dinámica del estribillo es muy similar, sin embargo, no es un plagio, ya que los intervalos que uso son muy distintos, la cuestión es que es parecida gracias a ese \

al final de las frases, solo por esa dinámica, pero la forma de llegar antes de eso es otro tema. Como sea, no quería asumirla como una canción oficial del repertorio por el tema de que me sonaba igual, pero la canción me gustó bastante la verdad, entonces mejor me la quedaré jeje. La canción trata de como buscar dejar de apegarse o afligirse por las relaciones interpersonales, a veces uno se pierde en una maraña de problemas por buscar que los demás se adapten a uno, también pasa al revés, cuando uno busca adaptarse a los demás también está mal. Lo ideal es mantener un equilibrio, no contaminarse por otros, como por ejemplo, volverse un egoísta solo porque los demás son egoístas, y no tratar de cambiar al otro o cambiar tú esencia por los demás, como dije al principio. Somos seres sociales, si, pero siempre tenemos que tener cierta libertad en nuestra proceso individual y aprender a estar solos algunas veces para no depender emocionalmente de la compañía de nadie. ________________________________________

links.body:
![17715336068992663603423633309955.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Eoc1JzZFzUoFw9LjFtqiL5RKLqxm9EpsjK5r5vYfvo36oJ81aefnqbFHqcmAN9SeiVo.png) [Image Source](https://www.chess.com/news/view/2026-fide-freestyle-chess-world-championship-7-conclusions)
As Carlsen said in a post on X, insanity is doing the same thing over and over again expecting a different result. This time what he does is play extremely good chess like no other. The world has recently watched him claim the Freestyle Chess Championship for the 7th time and that is right. I am talking about 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and now 7. This is an event of chess960 where the pieces are placed on random squares, rather the officers, that is the pieces at the back of the pawns. For those who were debating Magnus is only good at standard chess due to his vast memory of some many games. Well this is another prove to inform you all Carlsen is the G.O.A.T. when it comes to chess. Anything that involves the 64 squares, just count the Norwegian involved. As the second name for chess960, which is Fischer's random describes it, it is a style of chess that rewards pure chess over memorization. In this style you have to create something out of random nothing and forget about whatever book lines you must have cramped in the past. Right from the preliminary stage of the tournament, Carlsen exhibited greatness against renowned super grandmaster just like him. He chose to go for a stable win through grinding of little advantages like activity with his pieces, open squares and positional play over flashy wins. Although it is quite hard to get this flashy wins against other opponents as the playing field was made up 2700 rated players, the second highest chess rating ever achieved by chess players right after the 2800 bracket. Only 15 players in the world have attained 2800 rating, namely Garry Kasparov, Fabiano Caruana, Levon Aronian, Viswanathan Anand, Vladimir Kramnik, Veselin Topalov, Hikaru Nakamura, Ding Liren, Shakhriyar Mamedyarov, Maxime Vachier-Lagrave, Wesley So, Sergey Karjakin, Alireza Firouzja, and Arjun Erigaisi. Now you can see how tough it is in the world of chess and then there is a single man that has dominated in every format. Personally, I wonder how strong Carlsen will be in crazyhouse, also called bughouse. I am sure it would not take him much time to get a hand of how this variant works. This is the only variant of chess that I have not seen the G.O.A.T. play. While for the Freestyle Chess Championship, Carlsen was in strong form despite the setback he encountered in his game against Arjun Erigaisi. I believe that was the only game Carlsen lost. Although Erigaisi played well to take him down in the tournament, he was not able to make it to the finals due to other losses to other players. On the other hand Magnus regained his form and displayed a grand style of play from the semi finals down to the finals. It was obvious nothing was going to stop him in the brilliant form he was in. Off the chess board, there was some love story with Magnus and his wife after his victory. I am amazed by how excited Magnus gets every time he wins the event. Like it is your 7th time and it still makes you happy. This speaks to how much the man loves the game of chess. There is no stopping for Magnus Carlsen and I look forward to following his games at the Norway chess championship. It is a classical tournament and in the champion's country.

links.title: A healthy day/Comida saludable/
links.body: <div class=\

>

Ing/Esp

This morning 🌞 I was enjoying my morning walk, along the way I could see many people commuting from long distances due to the lack of transportation, including adults, elderly people, and teenagers. It's incredible how human beings adapt to the situation they have to live in, so much sadness 😭.

I took advantage of the walk and went to the market where I buy my daily food, the place was very empty and despite the high prices, I found things I needed for our meals, such as onions, beets, carrots, garlic 🧄, bananas 🍌, cucumbers 🥒, eggplant, chicken 🍗, and ham 🍖.

My husband doesn't really like eggplant and other vegetables that I love, which is why my diet is so high in these; because everything I buy that he doesn't eat, I end up consuming in excess, but I love it 🤗. I am used to this type of food because my father, since I was a child, taught me to eat them regularly. I know many people who also don't like vegetables, and when they cook with natural spices like garlic, onion, and chili, they grind them well so they don't eat them whole. I, on the other hand, do like these kinds of foods, and I got my children used to eating them like I do.

On the way back, I set out to make a delicious lunch and continued with my daily routine, very relaxed and calmer, despite all the hardships.
From me, I wish you all a happy and beautiful day. 🫶🏾🥰

Español:
Esta mañana estaba disfrutando de mi caminata matutina, por el camino pude ver a muchas personas trasladándose desde largas distancias por la falta de transporte, entre ellas personas adultas,  ancianos mayores y adolescentes. Es increíble como el ser humano se adapta a la situación que le toca vivir, cuánta tristeza.

Aproveché la caminata y acudí al  mercado donde compro lo cotidiano para alimentarme, el local estaba muy vacío y a pesar de los precios elevados encontré cosas que necesitaba para nuestra alimentación como cebollas, remolachas, zanahorias, ajos, plátanos, pepinos, berenjena, pollo y jamón.

A mi esposo no le gusta mucho la berenjena y otros vegetales que yo adoro, por eso mi dieta es tan elevada en el consumo de estos porque todo lo que compro que él no consume yo lo como en exceso, pero me encanta. Yo estoy acostumbrada a este tipo de alimentos porque mi padre, desde niña, me enseñó a consumirlos con regularidad. Tengo muchos conocidos a los que tampoco les gustan los vegetales y cuando cocinan con especias naturales como ajo, cebolla y ají, lo trituran bien para no comerlos al natural, a mí por el contrario, sí me gustan ese tipo de alimentos y acostumbré a mis hijos a consumirlos como yo.

Al regreso me dispuse a hacer un rico almuerzo y seguí con mi rutina diaria, muy relajada y más tranquila, a pesar de todas las carencias. 
De mi parte les deseo un felíz y bello día para todos.🫶🏾🥰

links.title: Solo Gang On Valentine's Day - CC - WK35
links.body: I've come to understand that the best gift you can give yourself is *self-love.* Self love is all about showing yourself kindness and care, whether it's a small indulgence or a bigger reward. Like gifting yourself, going on that trip you've wanted or even treating yourself to that meal or snack you've been craving for long. \n\nWith that in mind, I said this Valentine, I go spoil myself small (give myself a special treat) as per say \

Lol. 

  
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfF1m22LQDopTjYLaKeqzTCuuwdWHAwxg3rEHoBqQT4CG/1000179549.jpg 
  


Being a weekend, I didn't go to work, so the timing was perfect. I woke up later than usual on Saturday morning, but that's expected since I retired late for the night. Moreover, we experienced a heavy downpour the previous night so the weather was cool, perfect for a restful night. 

After the usual chores, I got set to prepare the meal for the day - something nice and special -  **fried plantain and potatoes with stir fried veggie sauce.**  I won't lie, I've been craving this veggie sauce for quite a while now, and I thought why not prepare it on Valentine's day. Lol. 

 As I cooked, I found joy in the process, despite the slight stress. The process was accompanied by some soulful tunes. The playlist was perfect – it lifted my spirits and created a peaceful atmosphere -  \

Hehehe. 

 And the outcome, exactly what I had envisioned – *a simple yet beautiful meal paired with a refreshing orange drink, tasty in the right proportion.*  A look at the food, and you'll have no doubt that a lot was put in place in the preparation of this mouth-watering and colorful meal. 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWCKtBzC13Kzf6184ZTvtReHpAD4U4KPCiNRL4njGF1YQ/1000179447.jpg


To make the moment even more special, I set it up as kinda home picnic on the floor. As I sat down to eat, the music wrapped around me, making the moment delightful and relaxing, with lots of jokes and laughter. Yes I told jokes and laughed, all by myself. Lolz.

As I savored each bite, I couldn't help but celebrate my journey so far. It was a moment of self-encouragement, a reminder that it's absolutely okay to prioritize my own happiness. 




> The idea behind this solo celebration was to acknowledge that Valentine's Day isn't just about others; it's also a time to love and appreciate myself. So glad I did because it was truly fulfilling. 

[Watch how it went down here](https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1TWPnWGb5n/)

It's a general knowledge that valentine's day is all about sharing, caring and spreading love, but I believe that dedicating the day to oneself is not selfishness, but a necessary foundation for spreading love to others. The divine command says, \

– it all begins with self-love, or is it not? 

I hope this will inspire others to do the same, to prioritize their own happiness and celebrate themselves, regardless of their relationship status.

>  Remember, your happiness depends solely on you, not anyone else. 

***
Thanks for reading.

links.title: The 13F
links.body:
Today I am going to look at what happened in the latest 13F filings of the world’s largest investors. This time, we did not just see small adjustments. We saw a clash of views.

Warren Buffett reduced his position in Amazon.

At the same time, Bill Ackman and Seth Klarman were buying aggressively.

Now the question is not simply who bought and who sold.

The real question is who is seeing the next five to ten years correctly.



**WHAT 13F FILINGS ARE AND WHY THEY MATTER**

13F filings are quarterly reports that large investment funds submit, showing which stocks they hold at the end of each quarter. They are essentially a snapshot of their portfolios. They do not show when during the quarter the purchases were made. They do not show whether positions were already sold after publication. They do not include bonds, private investments, or derivatives. So they are not the full picture.

Still, they are an extremely useful tool. They reveal the thinking patterns of top capital allocators. That alone makes them worth our attention.

**BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY**

We begin with Berkshire Hathaway. Its roughly 274 billion dollar portfolio remains highly concentrated. The five largest holdings account for nearly 70 percent of the total. Apple, American Express, Bank of America, Coca-Cola, and Chevron dominate.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWVjnsFjhbVB2UrCHevmKePmN6HpUzZQh8iHNMkNP1zK/image.png)


This concentration has always been characteristic of Buffett. When he finds something exceptional, he keeps it large.

However, in recent months we have seen something different.

Berkshire has been a net seller of stocks for thirteen consecutive quarters. Its cash position has swollen significantly. The cash pile has reached historic highs.

That alone tells a story. When Buffett does not find enough attractive opportunities, he prefers to sit on liquidity rather than feel pressured to buy.

Within this environment, we saw another reduction in Apple, another reduction in Bank of America, and a reduction in Amazon.

Apple once represented more than half of Berkshire’s portfolio. Today, that percentage has declined substantially. This does not mean he no longer believes in the company, but it does show active risk and valuation management.

At the same time, we saw a new position initiated in The New York Times Company. One could argue that this contradicts Buffett’s earlier comments about newspapers and the structural decline of the industry. However, he has clarified that a few brands have successfully transitioned to a digital model while maintaining a strong subscription base. Perhaps he sees something similar here.

The bigger question, though, is different. How Buffett like are these moves?

We are in the middle of a historic transition. Greg Abel is gradually taking over leadership, while Todd Combs and Ted Weschler play significant roles in managing the portfolio.

So are all these moves purely Buffett’s decisions? Or are we already seeing the imprint of the next generation?

We cannot know for certain. What we do know is that the overall posture looks more defensive, with less aggressive exposure to technology compared with previous years.

**THE PLOT TWIST**

At the very moment Berkshire was trimming Amazon, Seth Klarman of Baupost made Amazon the second largest position in his portfolio. He bought more than two million shares and raised it to over 9 percent of his invested capital.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP1VRbgdfUdpyof7h1annshHi64hrLUNdv6RqDYf3ECd3/image.png)


Klarman is a classic value investor, so why invest in Amazon?

Because he sees something beyond simple ecommerce. Amazon Web Services is the real profit engine. It generates the majority of the company’s operating income, even though it represents a smaller share of total revenue.

With the acceleration of artificial intelligence, cloud services are becoming even more critical and growth rates are strengthening. At the same time, margins are higher and operating leverage increases.

From a valuation perspective, Amazon is trading at lower forward multiples compared with its five year average. For a value investor, that can be attractive.

And it is not just Klarman.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdMVN7e41vYd3qRBCfH8RED28MiJxk7fi5iUmKSz8z5A/image.png)


Bill Ackman of Pershing Square Capital Management made one of the most aggressive rotations of recent years. He built a significant position in Amazon. He moved aggressively into Meta Platforms. He significantly increased his stake in Brookfield Corporation. And to finance these moves, he drastically reduced his position in Alphabet.

links.title: Чому я навчилась у ірландців. Частина 3
links.body: Я навчилась у ірландців не «заходити в життя без стуку». У нас турбота часто виглядає як контроль: — Ти вже поїв? — Чому не подзвонив? — Я б на твоєму місці зробила інакше : так і отак .. * В твоєму тексті помилки, виправ тут і отут .. Це не зла воля. Це спосіб любити. Український, з присмаком радянщини.. В Ірландії люблять інакше — через дистанцію.
alt=\

/>

Тут не питають зайвого. Не розпитують про зарплату, стосунки, здоров’я, плани на дітей.

Не тому, що байдуже. А тому, що це — твоє.

Здається, ніби людям немає діла. А потім розумієш: тобі дали простір, у якому можна дихати.

Тут допомагають одразу, якщо попросиш. Але ніколи — без запрошення.

І я вперше відчула, як це — коли твоє життя належить тільки тобі.

Я навчилась у ірландців не жити в режимі постійного подвигу.

Ми виросли на формулі: втомився — потерпи, важко — ще трохи, неможливо — все одно зроби. Не має такого \
є слово \

У нас цінується витривалість. Тут — стабільність.

Ірландці не намагаються «вивезти все». Вони планують так, щоб не вигоріти.

Якщо робочий день закінчився — він закінчився.

Не тому, що вони менш відповідальні. А тому, що завтра теж треба жити.

Для нас відпочинок — це нагорода. Для них — умова нормального функціонування.

Я навчилась у ірландців дозволяти собі бути звичайною.

Ми часто живемо в режимі оцінювання: хороша мама / погана мама, успішний / не дуже, правильно / неправильно.

Тут немає цього постійного екзамену на життя.

Можна прийти неідеальним. Сказати щось незграбно. Бути втомленим. Не знати відповіді.

І нічого не станеться.

Світ не зруйнується. Тебе не запишуть у «не такі».

І це дуже заспокоює☘️

\*\* завтра буду в Дубліні на мирній ході до річниці початку війни. Хто хотів познайомитись особисто, підходьте обійматись🤗 жовтий пуховик з котами тільки в мене🫶

links.title: The Winter Beauty In The Late Afternoon
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTisavf5W6SPQta7z9FCtsRwsZfdkn1LESBuAj6woBRvD/img_20260213_164537.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBv9J87wHuUTaTYGBHApnBmZKND6DYxfqGvpwqCrgdzN/img_20260213_164504.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2iqngH7S7P8DwyD5tGbPuDKHRo1Z7ccJ1M5nJY67osh/img_20260213_164525.jpg)


<div class=\

>

Winter is not a great time for outdoor activities for long hours, and so I used to go out for some short walking or cycling sessions when I get some opportunities nowadays. The current weather is warmer, as spring is approaching in the area where I live now. I am enjoying the winter here, with temperatures warming in mid-February, when I am celebrating the Chinese New Year and Spring Festival. The best thing that I can say is that the weather is so clear and clean, and the air quality is amazing nowadays, with so beautiful scenic views without the green color as you can see in these pictures. The views are so clear and stunning in this colorless winter, thanks to the extremely clean air and the deep blue sky as a backdrop.

As a nature lover, I always enjoy exploring this area, as it fills my heart with a pure feeling of taking in clean oxygen and breathing in the soothing beauty. There is no snow in the surrounding area at this moment; it is now dry and covered with dried grasses. The area could be so beautiful if the surrounding natural scenic area were completely covered with white snow with a heavy snowfall. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKeoXgH3pN2FEeEr4BYQDkZLw9Y4dPKwQjcnWrKawKrf/img_20260213_164530.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVyZgk8abtB1aWMNCuTYv54iqQV34eKWwypsCyad7m966/img_20260213_164719.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQVSSQZFRaNQ5dH2w9TYuCJr5QgQYSnKNe5EUXPtphM1L/img_20260213_163113.jpg)


There is a river known as the QiHe river where I enjoy my walk most of the time and the scenery along the river is so beautiful from the nearby road, where I can see the natural surroundings, a vast area, and the mountains in the northern Beijing area. As winter fades away, spring beauty will be here soon, and the nearby residential area will get a brighter view. The warmer vibe is also seen in the bright sun and comfortable outdoor activities in the area in the late afternoon with the golden color of light. The whole area is so attractive, with its natural beauty, very close to the city life of the Huairou district of the Beijing municipality.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKxx7ouNc4xmEEhAePD3jdG9ksMzafjiNgdtVWF4U3U1/img_20260213_163145.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNxNSx83V4xoC4JaV6JkKVDM1yZZo5b3nibEMfpQabq7f/img_20260213_164459.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhrdjzWXWYRkkHGGdu7UCTUDAZwcsUku7WbKk1apDJpZ/img_20260213_164713.jpg)




I hope you enjoy my photos of Beijing's beautiful winter nature in the area around my living area in the golden sunlight of late winter afternoon, with trees in the same color as the dried grasses. The soothing beauty of the late winter afternoon is really a great time to enjoy some outdoor activity in this area. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

>I took all the photos, and these are my own property.

links.title: PsyopDaily DAO — Announcement
links.body: Okay so the issue with checkins I was experiencing was because i had tried to checkin to Anarchismemes after checking into @Antiwarnews / PsyopDaily DAO, the checkins table unique constraint was outdated to just user_id and date, which was the model for the single DAO system before deciding to refactor codebase to new multi-dao architecture. (There is an application command that telegram admins will be able to use to request initializing their own DAO within the system / protocol, more details coming soon on that, still testing and building right now) Migrated check_ins table to have new unique constraint of user_id, date, AND dao_id 🎯 Root Cause Confirmed: Old constraint UNIQUE(user_id, date) prevents: ✅ One check-in per day across ALL DAOs ❌ One check-in per day per DAO (what we want) New constraint UNIQUE(user_id, dao_id, date) allows: ✅ One check-in per day per DAO ✅ Multiple check-ins per day across different DAOs 🔧 The migration is complete: Preserved all existing data Allow per-DAO check-ins daily (correct behavior) Fix the constraint issue

links.title: RUGGED COASTLINE OF ASTURIAS
links.body:
![Kopia – Whispers (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAnaf2k5vQjggiLbi8EZZERR3CKxwfDiuiZXMsTDM39kj8XCRoy4mfRwWQj5rZmpEqj.jpg)

Some time ago I shared a few frames from the town of Avilés in northern Spain. Back then I mentioned that I was already looking forward to another weekend in that region, because there was still so much left to see. And it happened finally!😁
At the end of autumn last yeae I got a loading in Avilés again. I won’t lie — I was genuinely happy! Before I even finished work, I had already started planning my weekend. 

This time I wanted to explore the other side of the coastline. And that meant finding a different parking spot. Fortunately Google Maps has become a surprisingly reliable travel companion. I managed to find a quiet place slightly off the beaten path. Silence, open space, no other trucks around — exactly how I like it! 😃 At the same time, it was close to a bus stop. (very important!)

The bus toward NIEVA runs only twice a day. That honestly surprised me a little bit but it seems that in this part of Spain people rely more on their own cars than on public transport. Despite the limited schedule I was the only passenger on the bus, so basically I had my own large private taxi heading toward the Atlantic.😁 

Once I arrived, I started a walk — several kilometers along the coast.  Today I’m sharing with you the first photographs from that area, taken near Playa de Xagó, one of the wild and less commercial stretches of Asturias’ coastline.

📍 A Few Facts About This Coast

ASTURIAS is often called “Green Spain.” Unlike the dry southern regions, this northern part of the country has a humid oceanic climate. The Atlantic shapes everything here — the vegetation, the geology, even the rhythm of daily life.

Playa de Xagó and the surrounding cliffs are part of a rugged coastal system formed by constant Atlantic erosion. The high rocky walls you see in the photos were shaped over thousands of years by wind, salt and powerful waves. The coastline here is not tropical or gentle. It is raw, exposed and constantly changing.

This area is also protected due to its dune systems and coastal ecosystems. The grass-covered hills and sandy stretches create a natural buffer between land and sea, making it an important habitat for birds and native plant species.

More frames from this coastline are still waiting in my archive but I’ll share them another day.🙂


>Jakiś czas temu podzieliłam się kilkoma kadrami z miasta Avilés w północnej Hiszpanii. Wspominałam wtedy, że już nie mogę się doczekać kolejnego weekendu w tamtym regionie, bo wciąż jest tam bardzo dużo do zobaczenia. I w końcu się udało! 😁 Pod koniec ubiegłej jesieni ponownie dostałam załadunek w Avilés. Nie będę ukrywać — naprawdę się ucieszyłam! Zanim jeszcze skończyłam pracę, już zaczęłam planować swój weekend.
>
>Tym razem chciałam zobaczyć drugą stronę wybrzeża. A to oznaczało znalezienie innego miejsca parkingowego. Na szczęście Google Maps stało się zaskakująco niezawodnym towarzyszem podróży. Udało mi się znaleźć ciche miejsce trochę na uboczu. Cisza, przestrzeń, żadnych innych ciężarówek w pobliżu — dokładnie tak, jak lubię! 😃 Jednocześnie było bardzo blisko przystanku autobusowego (co było niezwykle ważne!).
>
>Autobus w kierunku NIEVA kursuje tylko dwa razy dziennie. Przyznam, że trochę mnie to zaskoczyło, ale wygląda na to, że w tej części Hiszpanii ludzie częściej polegają na własnych samochodach niż na transporcie publicznym. Mimo tak ograniczonego rozkładu jazdy byłam jedyną pasażerką w autobusie, więc w praktyce miałam swoją własną, dużą, prywatną taksówkę zmierzającą w stronę Atlantyku. 😁
>
>Kiedy dotarłam na miejsce, ruszyłam na spacer — kilka kilometrów wzdłuż wybrzeża. Dzisiaj dzielę się z Wami pierwszymi zdjęciami z tego miejsca, wykonanymi w okolicach Playa de Xagó, jednej z dzikich i mniej komercyjnych plaż na wybrzeżu Asturii.
>
>📍 Kilka faktów o tym wybrzeżu
>
>ASTURIA często nazywana jest „Zieloną Hiszpanią”. W przeciwieństwie do suchych, południowych regionów kraju, ta północna część Hiszpanii ma wilgotny, oceaniczny klimat. Atlantyk kształtuje tu wszystko — roślinność, geologię, a nawet rytm codziennego życia.
>
>Playa de Xagó oraz otaczające ją klify są częścią surowego systemu wybrzeża formowanego przez nieustanną erozję Atlantyku. Wysokie, skaliste ściany, które widzicie na zdjęciach, powstawały przez tysiące lat pod wpływem wiatru, soli i potężnych fal. To wybrzeże nie jest tropikalne ani łagodne. Jest dzikie, odsłonięte i nieustannie się zmienia.
>
>Obszar ten jest również objęty ochroną ze względu na system wydm oraz nadmorskie ekosystemy. Porosłe trawą wzgórza i piaszczyste odcinki tworzą naturalną barierę między lądem a morzem, stanowiąc ważne siedlisko dla ptaków oraz rodzimych gatunków roślin.
>
>Więcej kadrów z tego wybrzeża czeka jeszcze w moim archiwum, ale nimi podzielę się innym razem. 🙂

links.body: I've never understood the fascination of the \

version of FPL when multiple managers can all own the same best players and best bargains. I much prefer the American style of fantasy gameplay, when there is a player draft at the start of the season and player ownership is unique among a small group of players within the same league.\n\nIf there is any desire for a h2h drafted league at the start of the next prem season, I would be interested to compete. I've played in a small local draft league based in Texas with some mates for the past 15 years. We have 4 leagues of 10 teams each playing 18 games each season (home and away vs the other 9 teams). We also have promotion and relegation for two teams. We also have an FA Cup stlye tournament among all the clubs over the 4 leagues. I won promotion in my very first year and have maintained my status in the prem for the past 14 seasons.

links.title: Ми думали, що це ненадовго. Як війна залишила українців в Ірландії на роки
links.body: «Коли ми приїхали сюди, ми були як прибульці з іншої планети. Мені довелося починати життя з нуля» Через чотири роки після вторгнення ми розмовляємо з українцями, які оселилися в графстві Керрі: чому вони обрали саме це місце, які болісні історії привезли зі своєї батьківщини та як дають раду з «невеликим відсотком недоброзичливців».
alt=\

/>

[source](https://www.independent.ie/life/ukrainian-stories-when-we-arrived-here-we-were-like-aliens-from-another-planet-i-had-to-start-my-life-from-scratch/a567897723.html)

Переважна більшість із десятків тисяч українців, які нині живуть в Ірландії, ніколи не могли уявити, що залишатимуться тут і через чотири роки після повномасштабного вторгнення Росії в їхню країну.

Вони були схожі на нещасних солдатів на фронті Першої світової війни, які на початку конфлікту влітку 1914 року думали, що все закінчиться до Різдва.

Повна стаття ([https://www.independent.ie/life/ukrainian-stories-when-we-arrived-here-we-were-like-aliens-from-another-planet-i-had-to-start-my-life-from-scratch/a567897723.html](https://www.independent.ie/life/ukrainian-stories-when-we-arrived-here-we-were-like-aliens-from-another-planet-i-had-to-start-my-life-from-scratch/a567897723.html))

links.title: Sanitation as a Catalyst for Psychological Order and Human Flourishing
links.body:
Cleaning exercises are incredibly useful these days. Videos can be used to break away from a sedentary lifestyle and improve the lifestyle of the weak. Since childhood, we've heard that keeping your surroundings clean is the only way God will come. The more you clean your surroundings, the better your life will be. But honestly, until we understand the true meaning, we don't apply the model that the more you keep your surroundings clean, the better you will feel. In today's fast-paced world, where people chase success, fame, and status, we often ignore basic things. Keeping the house clean and keeping things in their proper place affects the human environment and our entire personality. When our surroundings are clean, we automatically feel elated, convincing ourselves that we live in a very clean place, and this is the difference.

I thought of a simple example: when you see your room clean and properly arranged and there is no mess around you, then you think that your mind is very organized and you live very less because if your surroundings are very clean and peaceful, then automatically the mind feels that you are in a very peaceful place. But if there is a lot of mess in the room, then your mind becomes very stressed and gets confused about whether to clean it or not and starts getting related. Environment directly controls the human mind. The surroundings give clarity to the brain, and productivity comes from clarity. Therefore, those who maintain discipline in their lives generally have clean and organized environments.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ranjan02/23xAaCRBNpYrpW47FBWVChakKVnGGcrffbo7TF1KFvd6AK35KVz5P9mDA9AgcN8AXi6Vr.png)

[scr](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-washing-hands-in-open-faucet-X_tEarX6svc)

It has a direct effect on our health. If you keep your surroundings clean and tidy, don't let them remain dirty. Regularly wash your clothes and change your clothes regularly, and then you will remain healthy. You are less likely to get sick because if you follow this in your future lifestyle, then the cleaner you keep your room and surroundings, the cleaner your health will be because dirty rooms and dirty places directly affect our health, and once the health gets affected, you know that everything, including life savings, gets spoiled. Mood gets upset. A lot of money gets spent. Everything gets spoiled. To avoid this, we should keep our surroundings as clean as possible and stay away from dirt as much as possible, and all this saves your health a lot.

For all the people who suffer from anxiety, depression, overthinking, or stress in today's time, it is a big problem for them. These people live in such a place where there is a lot of irritation and dirt because all these things boost stress a lot. People look for solutions to their mental health outside. But sometimes the solution is simple and lies within the home. By keeping our environment clean, your mental health also improves a lot. When we clean our collection room, clean the physical space, and free our mental space, then such an organization remains. Understand by example when your laptop memory is completely full. Then what do you do? You clean the space of your laptop. What happens with it? Your laptop becomes faster. In this way, when you clean your house, your mind is also affected in the same way; your mental health is also affected a lot.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ranjan02/23uFXkHcBt5WnqBxybj4eEum93yzVETTthnuPc95YjCaxH9YyooRTtbHXn7Tkjn5N47mE.png)

[scr](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-in-blue-gloves-holding-white-textile-SnKfmC1I9fU)

The cleanest discipline and foundation are to be learned when a person keeps on doing small cleanings daily and follows habits. Every morning when one has to wake up, one has to make the bed and get up. He folds the mosquito net and keeps the things in the garbage. He disposes of the water properly and throws the card sent outside where it was supposed to be thrown by discipline, so this habit is directly connected to the success of anyone who develops discipline in every area of ​​his casual life. Cleanliness makes a person peaceful, and discipline is crucial for all of this. In today's times, the connection to going and taking action can actually be made. When the environment is clean, the mind is free from distraction and always remains focused on work, and all of this is crucial for your life. So these are small things that we should keep in mind so that our mental health and lifestyle improve a lot.

links.body:
PL
Trochę czekałam na ten post. Tak, wiem, że mogłam go stworzyć sama wcześniej. Bardzo lubię mozaiki. W Polsce ta sztuka trochę teraz jest w zaniku, już nie tworzy się wielkich mozaik na całą ścianę, jak na przykład Mikołaja Kopernika w Legnicy. Chociaż chyba ten rodzaj sztuki trochę odżywa w Szczecinie. We Wrocławiu mozaik jest bardzo mało. Natomiast Wietnam to raj dla fanów ceramicznej twórczości. Najciekawszym chyba miejscem jest Hanoi ponieważ jest tam mozaika wpisana do Księgi Rekordów Guinnessa jako największa na świecie. Ciągnie się ona na długości ok 3,8 kilometra wzdłuż głównej ulicy. Niestety jest to jej minus, ponieważ ciężko jest ją dokładnie zobaczyć. Sam spacer wzdłuż ulicy nie należy również do najprzyjemniejszych. EN I've been waiting for this post for a while. Yes, I know I could have created it myself earlier. I really like mosaics. In Poland, this art form is somewhat in decline at the moment; large mosaics covering entire walls, such as the one of Nicolaus Copernicus in Legnica, are no longer being created. Although I think this art form is experiencing something of a revival in Szczecin. There are very few mosaics in Wrocław. Vietnam, on the other hand, is a paradise for fans of ceramic art. Perhaps the most interesting place is Hanoi because it has a mosaic listed in the Guinness Book of Records as the largest in the world. It stretches for about 3.8 kilometers along the main street. Unfortunately, this is also its downside, because it is difficult to see it properly. Walking along the street is not the most pleasant experience either.

Nasze plecaki ważyły ok 9 kg w stronę Wietnamu, natomiast w stronę Polski już chyba z 18 kg. Oczywiście trzeba się targować. Chyba, że coś było już na przecenie, to wtedy nie miało to sensu. Czasem było też napisane, że cena nie jest do negocjacji. Także myślę, że miłośnicy ceramiki i mozaik będą w Wietnamie bardzo usatysfakcjonowani. Our backpacks weighed about 9 kg on the way to Vietnam, but on the way back to Poland, they weighed about 18 kg. Of course, you have to bargain. Unless something was already on sale, then there was no point. Sometimes it was also written that the price was non-negotiable. So I think that lovers of ceramics and mosaics will be very satisfied in Vietnam.

links.body: ![¿Por qué soy diferente en mi propuesta (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23xyhgjcpzEXr2NWMoQt5o5qcekcMW5joxPxnx6fpzFc7Vjwk3r2GCtcN8gjHe5keAXK3.jpg)\n\n<div class=\

> Saludos, amigos de @beentrepreneur. Hace unos días, revisando materiales relacionados con la marca personal y cómo fortalecerla, me encontré con una pregunta inquietante: ¿Por qué soy diferente? Es una pregunta a la que podemos responder, con lo que se nos ocurra; quizás esa respuesta inmediata sea completamente honesta y nos dé el sustento que requiere nuestra marca personal. Sin embargo, después de esta respuesta genuina y que salta como esencia, es conveniente detenerse para pensar con calma todo lo que consideramos que nos hace diferente en nuestra propuesta. Porque de esto se trata, de buscar aquello que nos hace diferente, no solo en lo personal, sino en nuestra propuesta. Por ejemplo, cuando te preguntas: ¿Por qué soy diferente? Y te respondes: Porque soy creativo, innovador, divergente o te defines con cualquier otra cualidad, de alguna manera perdemos la perspectiva, ya que gente con estas mismas cualidades hay por millones; es más, en mayor o menor grado, todos las poseemos. Entonces la respuesta no está solo en tus cualidades, aunque estas te aplanen el camino para alcanzar tus objetivos. Entonces se hace necesaria una pregunta más concreta que nos ayude a aterrizar en lo que hacemos y cómo lo hacemos, por lo que es apropiada la siguiente interrogante: Si dejo de hacer lo que hago, ¿qué extrañarían mis alumnas de biodanza de nuestros encuentros? Mi respuesta, al igual que la anterior, fue inmediata, emocional, visceral: el autoconocimiento y la comprensión de sí mismas que se genera en la actividad. De pronto me di cuenta de que tal respuesta es mi apreciación y, aunque no sale de la nada, sino de esa vivencia compartida durante más de un año de encuentros, me propuse recoger de primera mano lo que ellas sienten que perderían si nuestras clases se suspenden. Como era de esperarse, las respuestas fueron variadas; algunas palabras que me describen son: extrañaría tu entusiasmo, la pasión que le pones a cada clase, la alegría que se genera en el grupo e incluso, una me señaló como la líder que necesita para seguir creciendo. Otra se centró en mi conocimiento y sabiduría, en mi capacidad para captar problemas y orientar, y otra se fundamentó en lo que ha encontrado en este espacio de música, danza y crecimiento; para ella este es su momento de paz, el regalo que se da cada semana para fomentar su bienestar. Más allá de las buenas y bonitas palabras con las que me adornaron y que agradezco profundamente, extraigo de esta experiencia algunos aprendizajes valiosos, entre estos: ![Ser diferente 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23wqiMuD9R3WgbuwwXuXMfJ7G94JcY7tCH9L8i7TsqgjAwmm2XEFkXv3Y4UysHKBNdgmJ.jpg) Mi mensaje llega y este se encuentra centrado en la coherencia, en la conexión entre la acción y el propósito, porque no es solo lograr las metas que se plantean, sino que su consecución las lleve a un mayor bienestar integral. El coaching nos da un modelo, una estructura que nos permite ubicarnos en dónde estoy para llegar a dónde quiero estar; la biodanza nos lleva a profundizar en nuestro ser, potenciando un hacer con sentido, propósito y bienestar, dejando a un lado la inmediatez que tanto caracteriza este momento histórico. Esto me hace diferente en mi propuesta. **¿Y a ti, qué te hace diferente en tu propuesta?** ![separador damarys entrepreneur A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/EokjHx1cFwMb9EtzLLaFiWpxzfK7JCZ3VEnjsPZV3rFcq7Z81TL3u4pMaQ1VXHfXxgK.jpg) ![¿Por qué soy diferente en mi propuesta (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23xyhgjcpzEXr2NWMoQt5o5qcekcMW5joxPxnx6fpzFc7Vjwk3r2GCtcN8gjHe5keAXK3.jpg) Greetings, friends of @beentrepreneur. A few days ago, while reviewing materials related to personal branding and how to strengthen it, I came across a troubling question: Why am I different? It's a question we can answer with whatever comes to mind; perhaps that immediate answer is completely honest and gives us the sustenance our personal brand requires. However, after this genuine response that springs to mind, it is a good idea to stop and calmly think about everything we consider to make us different in our proposal. Because that's what it's all about, finding what makes us different, not only personally, but also in our proposal. For example, when you ask yourself, “Why am I different?” and you answer, “Because I am creative, innovative, divergent,” or you define yourself with any other quality, we somehow lose perspective, since there are millions of people with these same qualities; what's more, to a greater or lesser degree, we all possess them. So the answer is not only in your qualities, even though they pave the way for you to achieve your goals. A more specific question is needed to help us focus on what we do and how we do it, so the following question is appropriate: If I stopped doing what I do, what would my biodanza students miss about our sessions? My answer, like the previous one, was immediate, emotional, visceral: the self-knowledge and understanding of themselves that is generated in the activity. Suddenly I realized that this answer is my assessment and, although it does not come out of nowhere, but from that shared experience during more than a year of meetings, I set out to gather first-hand what they feel they would lose if our classes were suspended. As expected, the answers varied; some words that describe me are: I would miss your enthusiasm, the passion you put into each class, the joy that is generated in the group, and one even pointed to me as the leader she needs to continue growing. Another focused on my knowledge and wisdom, my ability to identify problems and provide guidance, and another based her response on what she has found in this space of music, dance, and growth; for her, this is her moment of peace, the gift she allows herself each week to promote her well-being. Beyond the kind and beautiful words with which they adorned me, and for which I am deeply grateful, I draw some valuable lessons from this experience, among them: ![Ser diferente 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/23wqiMuD9R3WgbuwwXuXMfJ7G94JcY7tCH9L8i7TsqgjAwmm2XEFkXv3Y4UysHKBNdgmJ.jpg) My message is getting through, and it is centered on coherence, on the connection between action and purpose, because it is not only about achieving the goals that are set but also about how their achievement leads to greater overall well-being. Coaching gives us a model, a structure that allows us to locate ourselves where we are in order to get where we want to be; biodanza leads us to deepen our being, promoting meaningful action, purpose, and well-being, leaving aside the immediacy that so characterizes this historical moment. This makes me different in my approach. **And you, what makes you different in your approach?** ![separador damarys entrepreneur A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/damarysvibra/EokjHx1cFwMb9EtzLLaFiWpxzfK7JCZ3VEnjsPZV3rFcq7Z81TL3u4pMaQ1VXHfXxgK.jpg) Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version) **Fuente de imágenes**: Archivo personal ![separador-rojp-800x5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuEfbmsuYdBRfYDrQctCJfzA1A8kQT9hp6UYL5CdDCyq/separador-rojp-800x5.jpg) ![pie 800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irvinc/VilfkhTe-pie20800.jpg) ![separador-rojp-800x5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcuEfbmsuYdBRfYDrQctCJfzA1A8kQT9hp6UYL5CdDCyq/separador-rojp-800x5.jpg)

links.title: An innocent dream of figure skating(eng-spn)
links.body:
Warm greetings,

It's a pleasure to participate in the #freewrite initiative with today's post:

### A picture is worth a thousand words

[link to the initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23w347EWQcGMpRy37Rsu7yAqEQ12L3eKwvr1FSUXpCvKzEkP2ydLcfzVTXVKXqGexZnaR.png)

For as long as I can remember, I've always dreamed of being a professional figure skater. It was magical watching the skaters on television; my heart would race and my eyes would sparkle with admiration. So, on December 25th, the first thing I did when I woke up was look under my bed to see if Baby Jesus had brought me the gift I so longed for. And yes, with my heart in my hand, I looked under my bed, and there they were: my skates, shiny and ready to be used. It was the gift I had wished for so much and for so long.

That morning, I was in my room, filled with joy. I couldn't contain my excitement; I was the happiest girl in the world. My parents encouraged me to go out to the patio, where, with a little fear and a lot of excitement, I tried to take my first steps on skates. I fell many times, and each fall left a scrape and a small scar on my knees, but my determination was stronger than the pain.

Even though there was no winter in my country and ice was just a distant dream, each fall made me feel more alive. I imagined myself in front of a large audience, receiving applause for being the best figure skater, gliding with grace and style.

However, over time, I realized I wouldn't be able to skate the way I had dreamed. Despite the difficulties, I cherish the satisfaction of having tried to achieve that dream. My parents were always by my side, supporting me every step of the way and helping me heal my knees. This dream taught me the importance of pursuing my passions, regardless of the outcome. That experience left me with countless precious memories and a deep love for skating, which will always hold a special place in my life.

As an adult, it was a wonderful experience for me; it's not a frustrated dream, just a childhood fantasy. I thank my parents for supporting me and for the joy of owning a beautiful pair of skates.

I invite @ismeris @robotgirl2024 
____

**Sources**

*Image from the initiative post
Original story by @yusmelys
I used Google Translate*

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1rfeEHqQY4VmeebfhGCbmCr1dGj8zvVyzx5cF4ALhR/image.png 


### Español

Saludos cordiales,

Es un placer participar en la iniciativa #freewrite con la iniciativa de hoy:

### Una imagen vale más que mil palabras 

[link de la iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-taeznw)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23w347EWQcGMpRy37Rsu7yAqEQ12L3eKwvr1FSUXpCvKzEkP2ydLcfzVTXVKXqGexZnaR.png)


Desde que tengo memoria, siempre soñé con ser patinadora artística sobre hielo profesional. Era mágico ver a las patinadoras en la televisión, mi corazón latía con fuerza y mis ojos brillaban de admiración. Así que, un 25 de diciembre, al despertarme lo primero que hice fue mirar debajo de mi cama para ver si el niño Jesús me había traído el regalo que tanto anhelaba y sí con el corazón en la mano, miré debajo de mi cama y allí estaban: mis patines, relucientes y listos para ser usados. Era el regalo que había deseado con tanto deseos y por tanto tiempo.

Aquella mañana, estaba en  mi habitación llena de alegría, no podía contener la emoción, era la niña más feliz del mundo. Mis padres me animaron a salir al patio, donde, con un poco de miedo y mucha ilusión, intenté dar mis primeros pasos sobre los patines. Las caídas fueron muchas, y cada golpe dejaba un raspón y una pequeña cicatriz en mis rodillas, pero mi determinación era más fuerte que el dolor. 

A pesar de que en mi país no había invierno y el hielo era solo un sueño lejano, cada caída me hacía sentir más viva. Me imaginaba frente a una gran audiencia, recibiendo aplausos por ser la mejor patinadora artística, deslizándome con gracia y estilo.

Sin embargo, con el tiempo, comprendí que no podría patinar como había soñado. A pesar de las dificultades, guardo en mi corazón la satisfacción de haber intentado alcanzar ese sueño. Mis padres siempre estuvieron a mi lado, apoyándome en cada paso y en cada curación de mis rodillas, este sueño me enseñó la importancia de perseguir mis pasiones, sin importar el resultado. Esa experiencia me dejó un sinfín de recuerdos valiosos y un amor profundo por el patinaje, que siempre llevará un lugar especial en mi vida. 

Como adulta para mí fue una experiencia maravillosa, no es un sueño frustrado solo era una ilusión de niña. Le agradezco a mis padres por apoyarme y haber tenido la dicha de poseer unos hermosos patines.

____

**Fuentes**

Historia original de @yusmelys
He utilizado Google Traductor*

---



Hola amigos y amigas corredores, ¡hoy fue un día especial! Me puse de acuerdo con mi esposa para salir a recorrer una de mis rutas favoritas: Chipichipe. Esta ruta destaca no solo por sus desafiantes cuestas, sino también por el espectacular paisaje que ofrece, haciéndola perfecta para entrenar y disfrutar al mismo tiempo.

Comenzamos nuestro recorrido a las 6:00 a.m., con un clima fresco que resultó ser un gran beneficio para nuestros cuerpos. La temperatura baja ayuda a mantener la energía durante el ejercicio, lo cual es ideal cuando realizo esfuerzos intensos como subir cuestas. Mi objetivo era completar la ruta en una hora, y me sentía motivado para lograrlo.

Después de unos 8 minutos de trote, entablé una conversación con mi esposa. Hablamos sobre la importancia de establecer un plan de mantenimiento, especialmente ahora que no tenemos ninguna carrera programada. Es fundamental seguir entrenando y mantenerse en forma, incluso si no hay eventos próximos. 

Además, trabajar en cuestas tiene múltiples beneficios; mejora la fuerza muscular, especialmente en las piernas y los glúteos. También aumenta la resistencia cardiovascular y la capacidad pulmonar, lo que es crucial para cualquier corredor. Las cuestas son un excelente medio para quemar más calorías, y su naturaleza desafiante nos empuja a salir de nuestra zona de confort.

Finalmente termine la ruta con un t
Duración de 1 hora 8 minutos, disfrutando del hermoso paisaje mientras superaba cada pendiente, sintiendo el sudor y la satisfacción de haber completado un entrenamiento efectivo. Regresamos a casa con una sensación de logro y listos para seguir trabajando en nuestros objetivos. 




---

![IMG-20260221-WA0018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/23uQnLhm9MXyEgibAccfsPNmqw5Hnzvc6XxFDuc5gFAYpaiPoechbLoqRBn7ifRtNxPRK.jpg)

![IMG-20260221-WA0023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/23uQjqcFKMs9TsH2t26MLdfiFE7o6x5Wrotgxvj7B7h94AQK8418K6BpvWEeXTg8yvhbf.jpg)


![IMG-20260221-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/242hUV3cRL9rpFCzTMLXUxsZ4TXahSME7oxe1pCdh2ddfhytTAtTGkKA4HUDFcWhEvDxw.jpg)

![IMG-20260221-WA0017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gchacin25/242NYnuwsWGiLwYuECKVbc2zcvbUuXd2vr7gtoyKgmPvLiQAGEyWz3KVPKENBqmx8R7SY.jpg)


---



Hello fellow runners, today was a special day! My wife and I agreed to go out and run one of my favorite routes: Chipichipe. This route stands out not only for its challenging hills, but also for the spectacular scenery it offers, making it perfect for training and enjoying yourself at the same time.

We started our run at 6:00 a.m., with cool weather that turned out to be a great benefit for our bodies. The low temperature helps maintain energy during exercise, which is ideal when I'm doing intense efforts like climbing hills. My goal was to complete the route in an hour, and I was motivated to achieve it.

After about 8 minutes of jogging, I struck up a conversation with my wife. We talked about the importance of establishing a maintenance plan, especially now that we don't have any races scheduled. It's essential to keep training and stay in shape, even if there are no upcoming events. 

In addition, working on hills has multiple benefits; it improves muscle strength, especially in the legs and glutes. It also increases cardiovascular endurance and lung capacity, which is crucial for any runner. Hills are an excellent way to burn more calories, and their challenging nature pushes us out of our comfort zone.

I finally finished the route with a t
Duration of 1 hour 8 minutes, enjoying the beautiful scenery as I conquered each slope, feeling the sweat and satisfaction of having completed an effective workout. We returned home with a sense of accomplishment and ready to continue working on our goals.

links.title: Small Habits, Big Impact: My Eco-Friendly Routine
links.body: Our environment is an important part of our lives and existence, and that's why it's one thing we mustn't joke with or handle with levity, because it's the core of our lives that gives us a lot, from the water we drink to the air we breathe to the soil we plant on, amongst many others. The way we handle our environment will either make or mar our lives now and in the future, and that's why I personally always take proactive steps towards ensuring I indulge in sustainable habits that'll not only keep my environment safe but also have a lasting positive impact on lives. So in light of that, I'd be sharing a few tips on the environmentally sustainable routine I indulge in regularly. ![1000772772.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23wWyKBk7hGfjpntcF9AfZfE9VUggufBQrADKfniaBipHC3JB7TXGKTjn1inDTyQhChXt.png) A few years ago I got to learn about the 3Rs core during an environmental seminar I attended, the Rs standing for REDUCE, REUSE, and RECYCLE ♻️. I got to learn about the tons of damages many of these one-time, or should I call them disposable, items cause to not just our environment but also our health as individuals, and since then, I have made it an integral part of me to make sure I adopt the 3Rs in my daily habits so as to ensure a safer, eco-friendly society that doesn't pose danger to plants, animals, sea creatures, and our planet at large. So I'm sure you'll be wondering how I incorporate the 3Rs into my habit. Well, they're as stated below. Firstly, I made sure to stop or drastically reduce the amount of disposable items I use. Disposable items such as straws, plastic, nylon, and the like are items I keep and use very often and even disposed of without taking any cautionary steps in the past, but since the enlightenment, I make sure to avoid any one-time-use items that usually go on to pile up in our environment or in the ocean, endangering the lives of animals and humans and blocking drainage systems and causing floods. Although they seem easy to use and do come in handy, I have to take the difficult part of stopping their usage for the greater good. I also try as much as possible to sensitize friends and family about the same; after all, the change must stay with me and in my household. ![1000772771.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23x1DBQCWJyNEVs5g4AnY8QJ6Y834cGT7HKthRFfEn2WtGpLnjonoZaZezx5P4Y4HhbY7.png) Still on my habit of ensuring a safer environment, I make sure to either dispose of plastic responsibly or recycle it to be useful in other areas. Take for instance, rather than throw away plastic, I use some as ways to transplant some flowers that can't withstand too much sun, so using them for that makes it easier for me to move the flowers around when the sun is at its peak. Soda plastic that would have been thrown away is what I've encouraged my students to use as pen holders in school, among many other things. Still on recycling, when it comes to disposing of dirt and other waste I've had around, I make sure to separate glass and plastic from other waste so it'll be easier for the waste disposal company when they come around. Many people around me, due to their unwillingness to pay for waste disposal, would prefer to burn their waste, not knowing that the smoke releases toxic gas into our atmosphere, affects the soil negatively, and the like. On my path, I try to sensitize them, but that's about all I can do, and I also make sure to lead by example of disposing of waste through the right channel. ![1000772773.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23vsXCeqhtYZURWaVShbC7zPswHs5ivVSjUyhRAbb6zVbZc4bz2BD4xTPm1GaABCYs3L3.png) The routine I'm most proud of that I embark on to ensure we've a clean and safer environment in my neighborhood is introducing all my neighbors to how they can monetize their waste. Since I told a few of them this and showed them a website where they can sell plastic waste and in return get cash, they've gone on to tell others, and my particular street is having a new look that was shaped thanks to my desire for change and sensitization of my neighbors, not just about the dangers of inappropriate waste disposal, but also opening their eyes to the reward of doing that. *** All photos are taken and edited on canva. ***

links.title: Rules Of Life
links.body:
RULES OF LIFE. 

1. Make peace with your past,
so it won’t disturb your present.

2. What other people think of you
is none of your business.

3. Time heals almost everything.
Give it time.

4. No one is in charge of your happiness
except you.

5. Don’t compare your life to others 
and don’t judge them.
You have no idea what their journey is about.

6. Stop thinking too much.
It’s alright not to know the answers.

7. Smile.
Always smile — even when life gives you a reason not to.

8. Don’t take things personally.
Most people are fighting their own battles.

9. Learn to say NO without explaining yourself.

10. You don’t need everyone to like you.
You need to like yourself.

11. Focus on progress, not perfection.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHA2SQyfk5JacfpzqFR1v5TmSfUEft7Y5rZUHHaY2NEn/img_20230312_084531_818.jpg)


12. Your peace is more important than proving a point.

13. Let go of what you can’t control.

14. Never beg for attention, love, or respect.

15. Growth feels uncomfortable.
That’s how you know it’s working.

16. Not everyone deserves access to you.

17. Trust actions, not words.

18. Protect your energy like it’s money.

19. Forgive — not for them, but for your freedom.

20. Consistency beats motivation every time.

21. Silence is sometimes the best response.

22. Don’t rush life.
Good things take time.

#everyone #wave #ecency #hive.blog, #kachi2024, #sarahbaby, #ekeke, #therichking, #preshy007, 

23. Choose self-respect over temporary pleasure.

24. Learn from mistakes, don’t livye in them.

25. Keep going.
Your future self is counting on you.

RULES ARE RULES.
GIVE THANKS ALWAYS.

links.title: Influence of photoperiod and light intensity on the posture of hen
links.body: <div class=\

>In the Moderna poultry industry, the optimization of egg production depends on a fundamental triad: genetics, nutrition and environment. Within the environmental factor, lighting is positioned as the most critical external stimulus to regulate the physiological and reproductive processes of laying hens. Improper light management can mean the difference between a persistent posture curve or premature productive failure.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2zFxBzUa3RspPW8EwD6Wm8BvuBtkxb44uHrE42rsjau/image.png

>Unlike mammals, birds have a unique ability to perceive light through three pathways: the retina, the pineal gland and, most importantly for reproduction, the hypothalamic photoreceptors that capture the light that passes through the skull. When light reaches the hypothalamus, the secretion of gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) is activated. As pointed out by North and Bell (1990), this process triggers the release of follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH) by the pituitary, which are responsible for the maturation of ovarian follicles and subsequent ovulation.
The photoperiod refers to the number of hours of light in a 24-hour cycle, the golden rule in poultry farming is: never increase the light during breeding and never decrease it during laying. - Growth Phase: An excess of light in young pullets can induce early sexual maturity, this results in small eggs and a higher incidence of uterine prolapses. - Production Phase: For a hen to initiate and maintain the posture, it requires an increasing or constant stimulus, according to Jacob et al. (2015), most Moderna genetic lines reach their peak production with a schedule of 16 hours of light and 8 of dark.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXwYu2KRWi4gr611A9uCzdvzY86y4DdWCzds1F9rChiA/image.png

> A common mistake in some backyard or industrial systems is to keep the lights on 24 hours in the hope of getting more eggs, this is counterproductive and metabolically stressful. Birds need a period of total darkness (minimum 6 to 8 hours) for the formation of the eggshell process that occurs mostly during the night and to strengthen their immune system. The absence of sleep increases the levels of corticosterone, the stress hormone, which degrades the quality of the shell and the overall health of the bird.
\n\n

>Dear readers, the management of lighting is not a secondary aspect, but a metabolic management tool. A well-designed light program should be consistent, progressive and adapted to the genetic lineage. Understanding that the hen is a photosensitive animal allows the producer not only to maximize profitability, but also to ensure a healthy and balanced life cycle for the bird.
Thank you for reading our articles, until a next publication. |Bibliographic references| |-----| - Sauveur, B. (1993). The egg for consumption. Mundi-Press Books. - North, M. O., & Bell, D. D. (1990). Commercial chicken production manual. Chapman & Hall. - Jacob, J. P., Wilson, H. R., Miles, R. D., Butcher, G. D., & Mather, F. B. (2015). Factors affecting egg production in backyard chicken flocks. University of Florida, IFAS Extension.

links.title: When the Seat Changes a Person
links.body:
<div  class=text-justify>





> \

—Harvey Specter In the past, it was only money that I believed usually changes people, but as I grew older and wiser and saw how the world operates, I have seen how people who have been put in the position of power change so fast. I have seen calm, innocent, easygoing people switch as soon as they were put in the position of authority. I could remember when I was serving, there was this guy in one of the CDS that was picked by the LGI to become the CLO. He started service before me, though, but those who knew him personally said he was a calm guy, but as soon as he started that post officially, he started misbehaving and was using his power anyhow. He was no longer the calm guy but the corrupt CLO that used his position only for his personal gain without considering others. Even though I was holding a key position as the president of my CDS, I gave him distance and did not allow him to come closer to me. Everything I was doing, I was reporting it directly to the LGI without having to go through him because I know what he can do behind the scenes. It hurts to see how power could change people that we thought were good people. ![file_000000005610720aa5da492389d2c81e.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcwxTfzRhJsA57iznaWnbR9ZdvWXtNYxU4hJMt99JJTZN/file_000000005610720aa5da492389d2c81e.png) And that usually makes me think very deeply about whether people like that have been pretending or the position they occupy gave them that attitude. Maybe the posting removed the mask of fear they have been wearing and has kept them silent. Maybe the challenges they are faced with and the people they surround themselves with are probably giving them a strong backing. I have watched movies, I have heard stories, and I have been fortunate to be around some top people, and I have noticed that the people they surround themselves with at times can shape them positively or negatively. Like I said earlier, I have been fortunate to hold some little key position, and I saw how I handled it so well that even the administration after me asked how I did it. But personally, I just believe that if I cannot handle a small position well, how will people recommend me and support me for a better one? And that is why I will say that power does not change everyone; it only amplifies who we truly are. --- Thank you for reading. >

links.title: Emprender con lo que sabes hacer o con lo que deseas aprender a hacer / Start a business with what you know how to do or what you want to learn to do.
links.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcT6gZUWZX6bedMukrC5aYsbnH4d7uHTZVWkUsn1w6toW/emprender_desde_el_desconocimiento.png</center>

Los emprendimientos tienen diferentes inicios, pero todos convergen en la necesidad de las personas en sacar provecho de algún don, en función de poder monetizar esa ventaja competitiva y generar una ganancia extra o vivir de ello. En ciertas ocasiones, empiezan por ser hobbies que son bien recibidos por los demás, en otros casos, la carencia o la rabia, volcadas en acciones que produzcan un medio de subsistencia.

Pero cuando se hace de manera organizada, hay muchos factores que o bien empujan, o hacen que se desista de la idea. Uno de ellos es qué hacer, o por dónde empezar. Y aunque parezca que la respuesta es obvia, no siempre somos capaces de verla, sobre todo si estamos en un punto de quiebre o en una encrucijada que nos ha llevado a la idea de empezar algo propio.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZK5thvdwJZcJX8Kkp6i1oaS3fz1AwCMMNAtd9FQksqpr/20251206_220341.jpg</center>

Ambas respuestas son correctas. Empezar haciendo algo que ya dominas es completamente favorable: cocinar, enseñar, diseñar o cualquier habilidad que se pueda poner en función de otros, ya tiene la mitad del camino andado, pues solo falta darle forma y en todo caso aprender habilidades gerenciales que permitan llevar el aspecto administrativo para evitar caer en default.

Sin embargo, emprender desde algo que deseamos aprender, también es una opción, para aquellos que buscan una sucesión progresiva de lo que hace en la actualidad para cambiar de ramo. Un desafío a si mismos, aprendiendo en el camino o apalancándose en los que saben, generando una sinergia o buscando el apoyo de quienes ya dominan el oficio.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1Qdu3UKbtrHty5Lhh4q1CSporxPWbi9kV941iZX5HHr/photo_4958562365284748172_y.jpg</center>

En mi caso, estoy justo en este lado del juego, pues aunque cocino a diario, hacerlo para la venta es todo un desafío, y no porque se me queme la comida, sino porque es un producto que no es popular entre el público meta, con lo cual, además de la presión por que el producto guste, toca hacer el posicionamiento del mismo en un mercado que lo conoce solo por referencia.

Una pregunta sobre si sabía hacer tequeños, fue el impulso para iniciar en este campo. Ya lo había hecho hace muchos años atrás, y desistido cuando los clientes me decían que se desarmaban, pero en lugar de buscar mejorar, preferí buscar un empleo tradicional. Ya luego, haciendo para mis hijos, empecé a experimentar y probar opciones, que me llevaron a volver a intentarlo.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZApMMggqGrGEDBDH3eAGu7yGas2BC2i8VxBRYczGRuf/photo_4958562365284748170_y.jpg</center>

Todavía no doy con la fórmula perfecta, pues el queso que uso no es el tradicional, pero de hacer el queso duro o comprarlo, duplicaría el costo, por lo que busco hacer lo que puedo con lo que tengo, y que salga bien. Y en ese ensayo y error, voy aprendiendo trucos del arte culinario que me llevarán a mejorar el producto y poder hacerlo más rápido, más apetecible, más rendidor o todas las anteriores.

Lo importante es que a pesar de los primeros tropiezos, seamos capaces de dar un paso al frente, y volver a intentarlo, aunque cada caso sea distinto, el mundo del emprendimiento está lleno de pruebas, que una vez superadas, solo queda mantenerse en la cima.

[https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador\_ingles.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png)

Entrepreneurial ventures have different beginnings, but they all converge on the need for people to capitalise on a gift, in order to monetise that competitive advantage and generate extra income or make a living from it. Sometimes, they start out as hobbies that are well received by others; in other cases, deprivation or anger are channelled into actions that produce a means of subsistence.

But when done in an organised manner, there are many factors that either push you forward or make you give up on the idea. One of them is what to do or where to start. And although the answer may seem obvious, we are not always able to see it, especially if we are at a turning point or crossroads that has led us to the idea of starting something of our own.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmZK5thvdwJZcJX8Kkp6i1oaS3fz1AwCMMNAtd9FQksqpr/20251206_220341.jpg</center>

Both answers are correct. Starting by doing something you already master is completely favourable: cooking, teaching, designing, or any skill that can be put to use for others. You are already halfway there, as you only need to shape it and, in any case, learn management skills that will allow you to handle the administrative side of things to avoid falling into default.

However, starting a business based on something you want to learn is also an option for those who are looking for a progressive succession of what they currently do in order to change fields. It is a challenge to themselves, learning along the way or leveraging those who know, generating synergy or seeking the support of those who already master the trade.

However, starting from something we want to learn is also an option for those who are looking for a gradual transition from what they are currently doing to change fields. It is a challenge to themselves, learning along the way or leveraging those who know, generating synergy or seeking the support of those who already master the trade.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1Qdu3UKbtrHty5Lhh4q1CSporxPWbi9kV941iZX5HHr/photo_4958562365284748172_y.jpg</center>

In my case, I am on this side of the game, because although I cook every day, doing so for sale is quite a challenge, not because I burn the food, but because it is a product that is not popular with the target audience. Therefore, in addition to the pressure to make the product appealing, I have to position it in a market that only knows it by reference.

A question about whether I knew how to make tequeños was the impetus to start in this field. I had already done it many years ago and given up when customers told me that they fell apart, but instead of looking to improve, I preferred to look for a traditional job. Later, making them for my children, I began to experiment and try different options, which led me to try again.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZApMMggqGrGEDBDH3eAGu7yGas2BC2i8VxBRYczGRuf/photo_4958562365284748170_y.jpg</center>

I still haven't found the perfect formula, as the cheese I use is not traditional, but making hard cheese or buying it would double the cost, so I try to do what I can with what I have and hope it turns out well. Through trial and error, I am learning culinary tricks that will help me improve the product and make it faster, more appetising, more efficient, or all of the above.

The important thing is that despite the initial setbacks, we are able to take a step forward and try again. Although each case is different, the world of entrepreneurship is full of challenges, and once they are overcome, all that remains is to stay on top.

links.title: [OC] Seasonality of UK Wild Mushroom Fruiting Peaks (18 Common Species)
links.body:
Seasonality of UK Wild Mushroom Fruiting Peaks
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT3v7ssMwZLnsocgn5z1hUAewaZUD8fiWRruubWJRVG97/image.png)

 [Interactive Chart on Flourish](https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/27738981/)
[OC] 
> UK mushroom growth (0 to 100) by month. Autumn sees major overlaps (Cep, Chanterelle, Hen of the Woods); spring and winter produce select species. Educational purposes only. Never forage without expert ID!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtR87B6Uuif1XXRGuTEzwLhGeAStU8PafDjjAxGEW495/image.png)

Throughout the course of the year, mushrooms do not tend to produce fruit in a consistent manner. This original graph shows how strongly 18 different common species grow from month to month across the UK in a graphical manner (0 = no growth, 100 = maximum growth).
 
All 18 species typically have distinct growing periods due to influences from the environment such as temperature, habitat type, and precipitation.

The majority of mushroom production occurs in the fall, with the months of September and October showing the greatest amount of overlap in edible mushrooms such as cepes (penny buns), chanterelles, hen of the woods, deceiver, and shaggy ink caps. This overlap creates an explosion in mushroom growth during September and October. 

The other two major producing months are August (chicken of the woods and beefsteak fungus) and summer (field mushroom, giant puffball, and shaggy parasol).

Spring is noticeably different with one of the earliest wild edible species (St. George's mushroom) emerging in April. Winter has a low amount of mushroom growth but does provide some small amounts, with velvet shank mushrooms being most prevalent in February. Additional mushrooms found in winter that consistently produce are jelly ear mushrooms and oyster mushrooms.

The values provided above were all approximations, while there can be significant amounts of variability due to the weather. For example, heavy rains and mild temperatures can change the timing of peak mushroom production.

The above graph is for educational reference only. There is danger in foraging for mushrooms; it is imperative that mushrooms be accurately identified by an expert to prevent inadvertently eating something that could result in serious health issues or death.

Please enjoy (safely) observing the seasonal mushroom production!

Reference:

links.body:
