<div class = \
>\n<div class = \

> Penelope's frustration was growing because she had been working on several songs without earning almost anything from them; they were practically losses. But make no mistake, these latest songs she's made are very good. Specialized music critics have hailed them as brilliant. What's happening is that before she can release them and earn money from them, someone leaks them well in advance to make the same money on a separate platform. This is a huge blow for Penelope because it forces her to release her songs prematurely. She can't run marketing campaigns to promote the songs further, nor does she have time to produce a better version before releasing it to her fans. It's a complete disaster because each song requires a lot of work and money invested. And it all vanishes in the blink of an eye with these leaks. That's why she's so frustrated; she doesn't know what to do. The losses are piling up, and it's seriously affecting her music career. She's tried everything to fix it. The music copies of the song are kept under lock and key on a secure server at her record label. It's impossible for anyone to leak them from there. Everyone around her doesn't have early access to the songs; only the executives and the main manager, besides herself, of course.

> La frustración era cada vez mayor en Penelope pues llevaba haciendo varias canciones sin haber ganado casi nada con ellas, prácticamente eran perdidas. Pero que nadie se confunda, esas últimas canciones que ha hecho son muy buenas. La crítica musical especializada las ha catalogado como brillantes. Lo que está pasando es que antes de que ella pueda lanzarlas para poder ganar dinero con ellas alguien las filtra con mucha antelación para ganar el mismo dinero en otra plataforma aparte que tiene. Esto es un duro golpe para Penelope pues a causa de esto se ve obligada a lanzar sus canciones antes de tiempo. Entonces no puede campañas de marketig para llegar más lejos con la canción, tampoco le da tiempo producir una versión mejor antes de llevarla a sus fans. Es un completo desastre porque para cada canción se necesita un montón de trabajo y dinero invertido. Y todo se diluye en un abrir y cerrar de ojos con esas filtraciones. Por eso es que está tan frustrada porque no sabe qué hacer. Las perdidas se están acumulando y eso está afectando mucho su carrera musical. Para intentar solucionarlo ha hecho de todo. Las copias musicales de la canción se guardan bajo llave en un servidor seguro de su discográfica. Es imposible que alguien las pueda filtrar de ahí. Todos los que la rodean no tienen acceso anticipado a las canciones, solo los directivos y el manager principal, además de ella misma por supuesto.
![keagan-henman-08GCJsWsuWY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23w2jBd5wBZgFEnZLDo7AZthahJbiE9QSx83QzkmZxGeR9pGfByURBm4kmLH7mhekF8rW.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> Despite these strict measures, the songs have been leaked for the past three years. Penelope was on the verge of quitting music because of this, as she was truly upset. Knowing she was considering this, the record label called in a special agent to help her with this strange case and uncover the truth. This undercover agent was very good at what he did. Knowing she would have this help gave her a little more confidence, but she didn't really know what else could be done to protect her music. They didn't know where the backdoor was through which her music was being leaked ahead of schedule. The very clever agent proposed something to her: for her next song, they would investigate every stage of its creation together. They would place hidden cameras everywhere without her coworkers knowing. Only she and he would know. They wouldn't do anything until the song was released, to see at what point in the song's journey it was being leaked—whether in the studio, on the record label's secure servers by a staff member, or through a hack. She loved the idea, and they got to work on it as soon as possible. They recorded the song and set up cameras throughout the studio. After recording, they transported it in a vehicle, as usual, to the secure servers. At the record label, with the owner's permission, they installed cameras in places where there hadn't been any before, in case someone on staff turned off the official ones. And as an extra security measure, the record label owner gave the agent daily access to the servers to see who was accessing them from inside or outside.

> Con todo y esas fuertes medidas las canciones se han filtrado en los últimos 3 años. Penelope estaba al punto de retirarse de la música por esto, porque está realmente molesta. La discográfica al saber que ella está pensando esto llamó a un agente especial para que la ayudara en este caso tan extraño y descubrir la verdad. Este agente encubierto era muy bueno en lo que hacía. Al conocer que tendría esta ayuda ella respiró un poco más confiada, pero no sabia realmente que más se podía hacer para proteger su trabajo musical. No sabían dónde estaba la puerta trasera por donde sacaban su música antes de tiempo. El agente muy inteligente le propuso algo a ella, en su próxima canción iban a investigar juntos todas las faces de la creación de esa canción. Pondrían cámaras ocultas en todas partes sin que los compañeros de trabajo su supieran. Solo ella y el lo sabrían. No iban a hacer nada hasta lanzar la canción, para ver en que punto del trayecto de la canción era que e filtraba. Sin en el estudio o en los servidores seguros de la discográfica por alguien del personal o un hackeo. A ella le pareció muy bien la idea y empezaron cuanto antes manos a la obra con esta idea. Grabaron la canción y pusieron cámaras en todo el estudio. Luego que grabaron la canción se la llevaron en un vehículo como siempre hasta los servidores seguros. Ya en la discográfica con permiso del dueño pusieron cámaras en lugares en donde antes no había, eso en caso que alguien del personal apagara las oficiales. Y como medica de seguridad extra el dueño de la discográfica le dio al agente acceso a los servidores todos los días para ver quien accedía desde dentro o fuera.
![levi-meir-clancy-2Fgp-4pJ78U-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23zS5EiJQkywkeLoh6W1CHb2NitSifGsxQ2boT4MhAwvV2eUmKqUpU1LPVcDT52LSatdz.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...
>\n<div class = \

> The entire plan was ready and the trap set; all that was left was to wait for the leaker to fall for it. As always, Penelope announced the release date of her song so the leaker would act first. And exactly what had to happen, happened: the song was released ahead of schedule on a strange website. People could buy it for pennies. Now the hunt began. The agent searched for access to the record label's servers. No one had accessed them from inside or outside. So that could be ruled out. Only one option remained: the recording studio where the songs were recorded. When they reviewed the hidden security camera footage, they saw the janitor cleaning at night when no one was there. They saw him connect a USB drive to the studio's PC. It was definitely him. They had caught him. The lawsuit against the janitor would be so large that he would spend the rest of his life in prison because he couldn't afford to pay it. With the mission accomplished, the agent left, and Penelope was overjoyed. The leaker's nightmare was over—what a detective adventure!

> Ya todo el plan estaba listo y la trampa armada, solo era esperar hasta que el filtrador callera. Como siempre Penelope anunció la fecha de su canción para que el filtrador actuara antes. Y pasó justo lo que tenía que pasar, la canción salió antes de la fecha programada en una web extraña. La gente la podía comprar por céntimos. Ahora empezaba la cacería. El agente buscó los accesos a los servidores de la discográfica. Nadie accedió desde dentro ni de fuera. Por tano se podía descartar eso. Solo quedaba una opción y era el estudio musical donde se grababa las canciones. Cuando revisaron las cámaras de seguridad oculta vieron que el conserje por las noches cuando no había nadie limpiaba. Lo vieron conectar un USB a la PC del estudio musical. Sin dudas era el. Lo habían cazado. La demanda para el conserje sería tan grande que pasaría el resto de su vida en prisión por no tener como pagarla. Con la misión cumplida el agente se retiró y Penelope quedó muy feliz. La pesadilla del filtrador había terminado, menuda aventura detectivesca.
![keagan-henman-vSSzAILmqLE-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tGXZj6XAVmvFN5ZUQgPMBfPQrvJRFznMeUHMFfVWCF5Ui57hpbytmUxCZqNMyfNxAdV.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

links.title: The Curse Of UCHITSUNE.
links.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmYHUV7neTf1a9RUTVweCM4K9pbX2ZBvXWTUTQxRcBsv7Q/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/bc85c2ef)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=efootjoker-yt/bc85c2ef)


---

Sakai had come to Hiroshima Springs to meet his teacher, Sensei Ishikawa. But after arriving at the dojo, he found that Sensei was not there. Although he was disappointed, his arrival opened the door to a new adventure.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmayPv8aEfgoRYLP56U58kwrANifwNX3zLx4nvtF4bhmEU/screenshot_3007_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzPZEQh3arLUp47Fa6d5GZLmyEtkuL1jFdkTfLVo81PC/screenshot_3008_.png)

In a corner, sat a mysterious musician. He was singing the tales of Tsushima's lost traditions and legends. Sakai stopped there. The story that caught Sakai's attention was \

, the tale of an archer whose arrows never missed their target. It was said that the arrows he shot were so powerful that they could even destroy evil forces.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRnfRfCSRZgNyRSEaUGU39yjqaPv7BFjxBb8WBBebCecD/snapshot.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaEVGsTxFP7SWR4eqWw7JVENZf8HLev1vo1qR2qxN9HS/snapshot_1.png)

Hearing the story, Sakai's eyes lit up with curiosity. He decided that he would collect this legendary bow no matter what. But the musician warned him. This bow was cursed. Whoever picked it up would be beset by misfortune and danger. Sakai smiled. \
he thought to himself, \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrTViP5A9hxGnpvW5zBuMp47iHoEBfDxR4enpgW1upxq/snapshot_2.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVLcWKziY5TZm4D54wJCx7vNtc3cxx2naiCDeNaPpFko/snapshot_3.png)

The musician said that the last days of his life were spent in the high mountains near the sea. And the biggest sign was the blue flowers. Where unusually many blue flowers can be seen in the forest, his bow is hidden there. Sakai set off on his horse. After crossing the mountains and breaking through the forest, he finally saw a high hill covered with countless blue flowers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbkMFBBjux9Zt5PLynR1HpMnwDksWvdQYwqhqYhqvPoF/snapshot_4.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYrbZb475F91wzFUzdv5S4dRUB7uNvLpNcE9dD9WaQkm/snapshot_6.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc179po8CSw6RxycNS9BkLEWJzfiEeNHW811hTtqVZnED/snapshot_7.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5TYGDmyLjZVzMwDuRZ61zzGoKudCAfv6spBmamRo3qs/snapshot_8.png)

He entered the cave and couldn't find the bow. But a painting on the wall caught his eye, a picture of a small island in the middle of the ocean. Sakai realized that the real secret was there. As he came out of the cave, some fiery arrows suddenly fell in front of him. From above, a person, like a monk, warned, “Give up the search for this bow. It will bring you doom.” The warning did not stop Sakai. Instead, his resolve grew stronger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUR95A7rDjv9h4mRcEofubmLE8Lv2RHceS8M5xdP76hB/snapshot_9.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabCXdhykuWntyZZdvg1F6Eui5Mn9LMvbncHD5ujitcsk/snapshot_10.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXmy9Me9WxFnuzs5LLGAdpeP2N3WU6utQHNd5Gwq85Bvt/snapshot_11.png)

While searching for the island, he came across a group of Mongol soldiers. The opportunity to test his newly developed “standoff” technique came. In an instant, he silenced two of the soldiers with a single blow. The rest trembled in fear. One fled, another one came to fight, but in the end, he too was defeated.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZdHpcbgdrMRrk1AtrY9isKC2YtEvkzwC8ffCrNMpMsz/snapshot_12.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxqbpjH1zCZV9Kkrdy8aKUH1RzHKeuwWT4ArEvbS8BBz/snapshot_13.png)

Leaving the battlefield behind, Sakai set off again. An uncertain destination ahead, with only a picture clue in hand. That mysterious island in the middle of the sea. Perhaps the cursed bow of Uchitsune is hidden there.

---

links.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/AKGZQgpowq5fJiepHLUQUxKEq5dw83aVYi7AMZk2L8c9Qh2hKTN1eZGvAm6AEwq.png)
[Image created in Artguru](https://www.artguru.ai/es/create/)</center>

The stranger smiled and said, “You don’t recognize me yet, but you will yesterday.”

What that stranger I met on the street said made no sense at the time, so I ignored him and kept walking.

When I got home, I unconsciously kept thinking about what that stranger had said. The only way that sentence would make sense is if I traveled back in time. And since I hate paradoxes, I went to the garage and turned on the old time machine to go back one day.

In yesterday's world, everything looked exactly as I remembered it. I went out into the street and ran looking for that man, to the same place where I was supposed to meet him the next day. But I didn't see him anywhere. I stood there waiting for him to appear, looking at the faces of hundreds of passersby until I finally recognized him in the crowd.

I approached him and said, \
\n\n\
the man asked.\n\n\

links.title: My Favourite Athlete – Not Just a Winner, But a Reminder
links.body:
Hello @everyone, greetings to all from @theindicators. How are you feeling today I hope all are fine and I'm also good 👍 😊.
Today's I wants to share a childhood memories 
Sometimes I think we don’t realise the value of someone until they make the whole country pause.
The first time I seriously noticed Arshad Nadeem was not even during a live match. I was scrolling on my phone. Internet slow, as usual. Someone had shared his throw clip.
I clicked it casually.
But when that javelin left his hand… I don’t know why, I sat straight.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWstnSSjcnUfcHsEvyBFNu3RPDvBDCiYu4gzGJxHVpaP2/grok_image_1771690953966.jpg 


It wasn’t just distance. It was confidence.
I remember when I was in school, we had a sports day. I once tried javelin with a bamboo stick (not professional of course). I threw it so badly that my friends laughed for weeks. After that, I never tried again.
That’s the difference between people like me and athletes like him.
They don’t stop after one bad throw.
What makes Arshad Nadeem special for me is simple — he didn’t grow up with perfect facilities. No international-level grounds. No luxury training environment.
Still, he competed against the world.
And won.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPQuHWNEKy8x4CTButAjGaRV3V92kRZNi7N4puV32KjMq/grok_image_1771691014769.jpg 


When he stood with the Pakistan flag, I actually felt goosebumps. It wasn’t just pride. It was relief. Like finally someone proved that talent from our soil is enough.
In my own life, I struggle with consistency. Some days I feel motivated. Some days I don’t even want to open my laptop. But when I see someone like him, I feel slightly embarrassed of my excuses.
He throws a javelin 80+ meters.
I can’t even throw away my laziness sometimes.
But maybe that’s why he is my favourite athlete.
Not because he is perfect.
But because he shows what discipline looks like.
He reminds me that background is not an excuse.
And maybe one day, if I stay consistent in my small field, I can also achieve something worth remembering.
Until then, I’ll keep watching, learning, and trying.

links.title: Seeing problems as opportunities
links.body:
<center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EoEtxECzje4wkBT6XmmsRPj3f8Y3NE6uTAX5ngWsy63tNaE4bCGpTaujakmoWpJDpKd.png)
<sup>Image by <a href=\
>Vilius Kukanauskas from

>Pixabay
We think that a life full of problems is not at all desirable, but in fact, if we think about it more deeply, we can say that a world without problems is not real... Life without challenges ends up becoming stagnant. That's what life is all about. Solving problems. The focus should not be on the problems themselves, but rather on the possibility of overcoming or solving those problems or challenges. Our brain seeks to find homeostasis with the environment. There are many neural processes involved in establishing balance. We always look for patterns of events, predictions, associations. All of this is part of a larger and more developed network and strategy for survival and greater resilience. If life did not present us with challenges or problems, we would not have the ability to evolve, to develop skills, or to see new perspectives on how to approach situations or solve problems. Human beings live to find a way out of all the challenges that life throws at them. We don't always find the solution we want, but we can find a new way out. Often, old problems that seemed unsolvable, or that had already been solved, end up having a different, more advantageous, or simpler solution. Imagine that at your job, human resources calls an urgent meeting with you and announces that next month they will no longer be requiring your services. Obviously, this presents a huge problem. Your source of income, or one of your sources of income, will soon be gone. And survival mode kicks in. When looking for an alternative to the job we had until then, we may find one where we are better valued and have better contractual conditions. > #### A serious problem has created a greater opportunity. I remember a situation I experienced during my college days. At the time, I was in my second year, and I failed three courses, one from my first year and two from my second. I realized this when, during the written exam for one of those three courses, I wrote “I give up” at the top of the exam and signed my name underneath. When I handed the exam to the professor, he asked me if I wanted to reconsider my decision and try to take the exam. To which I replied that it would be extremely inconsiderate of his work (as a professor, he would be wasting time correcting an exam that I was sure would not be good enough to pass), and I thought at the time that I could learn much more about the subject for my future life if I repeated the course the following year. At that very moment, I knew I had failed the year. The big problem for me would be explaining to my parents that it wasn't laziness that had caused me to fail, but a lack of time management in my studies and exam preparation. Since my second enrollment in the second year, I ended up not failing any more courses, let alone repeating the year. I gained much more from life by failing at that time. Many of the friendships I made then have lasted to this day. One of them is one of my closest friends. My internship was at an institution and with the professor I wanted. At the end of the internship, I ended up working at the institution, where I remain to this day. In other words, that problem, which at the time seemed “serious” to me, ended up becoming a set of opportunities and added value that I gained and that life presented to me. I believe that when a door closes, we can try to see if a window has opened, or if any of the surrounding houses are open. There are few problems in life that cannot be solved, that is true. But I believe that sometimes, asking for help to solve one of them, or to find a better solution, is the right thing to do. At this stage of my life, I know I have some problems that are not quite like that. My mind is unable to see beyond them and find a solution or a way out. All I can do is be patient and try to find something on my own or with help that might come from there. So far, I don't want to give up, because I feel that my ultimate problem, the one that has no solution, is not going to be solved anytime soon. ![separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23swppYGLECw991bW1wsSTEwnV8YKgqPHaiAdDJioriDcMJR4GymNLH1VbQ98ykpBYkob.png) Free image from Pixabay.com Original text written by me in Portuguese and translated with DeepL.com (free version) ![XRayMan.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23tSNKgT6Zssji2twDxLZSeSESs2q8pnNUYQuFe7gqFkFFT3rrjE8pcMnXVcFpd87PxJY.gif)

links.title: [ESP/ENG] Lo positivo y lo negativo de las máscaras
links.body:
Una introducción necesaria

     <div class=\

> A lo largo de la vida, todos, en mayor o menor medida, aprendemos a usar máscaras. Y no hablo de aquellas que llevamos en las fiestas de Halloween, de disfraces o cumpleaños, sino de las metafóricas: esos comportamientos, actitudes o fachadas que adoptamos para enfrentar el mundo. Las máscaras son como herramientas; no son básicamente buenas o malas. Su valor depende de cómo, cuándo y por qué las usamos. Por un lado, pueden ser un escudo protector que nos permite transitar por situaciones complejas sin salir dañados. Por otro, pueden convertirse en una prisión que nos aleja de nuestra verdadera esencia y nos impide conectar genuinamente con los demás. La clave está en la conciencia: saber que llevamos una puesta y tener la capacidad de quitárnosla cuando sea seguro y saludable hacerlo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLzcg2U6zWBLorgrS6eepRiFEzvHMCanTLsuRKhK2MVa/1771699425968.jpg)[fuente]https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/02/23/16/38/ai-generated-8592358_1280.jpg Muchas veces reímos y damos la impresión de estar contentos, cuando en realidad estamos pasando por una situación adversa, pero, en el contexto en el que nos encontramos, debemos dar a entender que estamos felices. Quizás el ejemplo más ilustrativo sea el del payaso, que siempre debe sonreír o hacer reír a los demás, cuando, en ocasiones, está llorando por dentro. En otras ocasiones suceden situaciones diferentes y nos llevamos la impresión equivocada porque las personas están usando sus máscaras para poder solventar una situación determinada. Lo Positivo de las Máscaras Podemos afirmar que, en ocasiones, las máscaras son escudos que nos protegen ante los demás, y ponerse una constituye un acto de inteligencia emocional y de adaptación social. · La Máscara del \

Imagine que tiene un turno de clases con sus estudiantes y acaba de tener una discusión en su casa o ha recibido una noticia que lo preocupa. En tal situación, puede que le invadan emociones de tristeza, ansiedad o malestar.

Ante esa situación, ponerse la máscara de tranquilidad y profesionalidad le permite sortear la amarga situación por la que está atravesando. Además, le sonríe a sus estudiantes y se centra en los objetivos de su clase.

Al usar esta máscara, puede cumplir con su responsabilidad como educador, mantiene una buena imagen y no mezcla sus problemas personales con los profesionales.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsD4k9AgJVwNyazdxAvQqGNwnYGaauVVaH4zabNMSGVJ/1771699921622.jpg)[fuente]https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2011/08/01/00/58/masks-8393_1280.jpg



· La Máscara \

Quizás esté en una fiesta de una persona muy querida. Sin embargo, está pasando por un mal momento debido a situaciones diversas, y la tristeza y la apatía son compañeras de viaje. Al llegar, se hace una pregunta: ¿Los demás tienen la culpa de mis problemas?

Como respuesta, se pone la máscara de la alegría y la participación. Se ríe de los chistes, baila y se interesa por los demás. Su objetivo no es fingir ser feliz, sino celebrar a su amigo y no convertir su día especial en un evento incómodo o triste. La máscara le permite ser un buen acompañante y, a veces, ese \
puede incluso ayudar a levantar su propio ánimo.\n\n· La Máscara de la \

Esta situación la viví cuando falleció la persona más importante de mi vida y quien más me amó: mi mamá.

Ese hecho nos devastó a todos. Incluso, ha sido uno de los momentos en los que he visto más personas en un cementerio.

Mi familia estaba atravesando la peor situación que hemos vivido, y todos estaban destruidos. Todos buscaban en mí el apoyo necesario para conducir esa situación.

Tuve que ponerme la máscara de la fortaleza, tomar decisiones, atender los temas legales, dar ánimos y contener el llanto de los demás, aunque por dentro estaba destruido. Incluso, tuve que despedir el duelo, la parte más dura de ese proceso. Esa máscara logró cierta estabilidad en medio de la tormenta. Todavía no sé de dónde saqué las fuerzas, pero la máscara de la fortaleza inquebrantable ayudó a pasar ese momento demoledor.

Lo Negativo de las Máscaras

El problema surge cuando la máscara se convierte en algo permanente, impidiéndonos ser auténticos y conectar de verdad.

· La Máscara del \
\n\nEsta máscara de \

la usamos en las relaciones interpersonales cuando no queremos discutir o, por miedo a dañar algo, fingimos que todo marcha adecuadamente. Sonreímos, decimos que todo está bien y evitamos conversaciones incómodas.

Lo malo de esta máscara es que la relación, lejos de salvarse, se rompe; la distancia se vuelve insalvable, los problemas no se resuelven, se pudren. La relación se vuelve superficial y, a la larga, la falta de autenticidad provoca un distanciamiento emocional o una ruptura aún más dolorosa, basada en la sensación de vivir con un extraño.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAjWkVyWc7vmTvp82WVSJfngqV9cYZU1XbqvvAykbuA6/1771699973460.jpg)[fuente]https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mascaras-venecianas-mascarada-1045991/

· La Máscara de la \

Esta máscara la usan muchas personas que han sufrido decepciones amorosas o de amistad. Para evitar que les vuelvan a hacer daño, se ponen la máscara de la dureza y fingen desinterés o apatía por los demás. Pero, muchas veces, esta máscara causa un efecto contrario, porque terminamos perdiendo a personas que nos interesan. La máscara, que debía protegerte del rechazo, es precisamente la que lo causa, dejándote atrapado en un ciclo de soledad.

· La Máscara de la \
\n\nCuando estamos lidiando con una depresión o una profunda tristeza, nos ponemos esta máscara y muchas veces nos convertimos en el \

del grupo, en el alma de la fiesta, en el que siempre tiene un chiste y una sonrisa, ocultando sistemáticamente el dolor real bajo una capa de falsa alegría.

Esta máscara es peligrosa porque te aíslas en tu sufrimiento. Nadie puede ofrecerte ayuda porque no saben que la necesitas. La energía que gastas en mantener la máscara es enorme y agrava tu agotamiento emocional. Además, cuando el dolor es insostenible y la máscara se cae, la gente a tu alrededor se siente confundida y engañada, y es posible que no sepa cómo reaccionar o ayudarte.



Créditos: El traductor utilizado fue el DeepL Translate.

La foto es de mi propiedad, tomada con mi teléfono Samsung J2.

Las imágenes las tomé de Pixabay.



ENGLISH


[
A Necessary Introduction

Throughout life, we all, to a greater or lesser extent, learn to use masks. And I'm not talking about the ones we wear at Halloween parties, costume parties, or birthdays, but rather the metaphorical ones: those behaviors, attitudes, or facades we adopt to face the world. Masks are like tools; they are neither inherently good nor bad. Their value depends on how, when, and why we use them. On one hand, they can be a protective shield that allows us to navigate complex situations without being harmed. On the other hand, they can become a prison that distances us from our true essence and prevents us from connecting genuinely with others. The key lies in awareness: knowing that we are wearing one and having the ability to take it off when it is safe and healthy to do so.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLzcg2U6zWBLorgrS6eepRiFEzvHMCanTLsuRKhK2MVa/1771699425968.jpg)[fuente]https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/02/23/16/38/ai-generated-8592358_1280.jpg



Many times we laugh and give the impression of being happy, when in reality we are going through an adverse situation, but, in the context we find ourselves in, we must convey that we are happy. Perhaps the most illustrative example is that of the clown, who must always smile or make others laugh, while sometimes crying inside.

At other times, different situations occur, and we get the wrong impression because people are using their masks to cope with a particular situation.

The Positive Side of Masks

We can affirm that, at times, masks are shields that protect us from others, and putting one on constitutes an act of emotional intelligence and social adaptation.

· The \

Mask

Imagine you have a class scheduled with your students and you've just had an argument at home or received some worrying news. In such a situation, you might be overwhelmed by feelings of sadness, anxiety, or unease.

In that situation, putting on the mask of calmness and professionalism allows you to navigate the difficult situation you are going through. Moreover, you smile at your students and focus on the objectives of your class.

By using this mask, you can fulfill your responsibility as an educator, maintain a good image, and avoid mixing your personal problems with professional ones.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsD4k9AgJVwNyazdxAvQqGNwnYGaauVVaH4zabNMSGVJ/1771699921622.jpg)[fuente]https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2011/08/01/00/58/masks-8393_1280.jpg



· The \

Mask

Perhaps you are at a party for a very dear person. However, you are going through a rough patch due to various circumstances, and sadness and apathy are your companions. Upon arriving, you ask yourself: Are others to blame for my problems?

In response, you put on the mask of joy and participation. You laugh at jokes, dance, and show interest in others. Your goal is not to pretend to be happy, but to celebrate your friend and not turn their special day into an awkward or sad event. The mask allows you to be a good companion, and sometimes that \
can even help lift your own spirits.\n\n· The \

Mask

I experienced this situation when the most important person in my life, the one who loved me the most, passed away: my mom.

That event devastated us all. It was even one of the moments where I have seen the most people at a cemetery.

My family was going through the worst situation we have ever experienced, and everyone was destroyed. Everyone looked to me for the necessary support to handle that situation.

I had to put on the mask of strength, make decisions, handle the legal matters, offer encouragement, and contain the tears of others, even though I was destroyed inside. I even had to lead the grieving process, the hardest part of that ordeal. That mask brought some stability in the midst of the storm. I still don't know where I found the strength, but the mask of unshakeable strength helped us get through that devastating time.

The Negative Side of Masks

The problem arises when the mask becomes permanent, preventing us from being authentic and truly connecting.

· The \
Mask\n\nWe use this \

mask in interpersonal relationships when we don't want to argue, or for fear of damaging something, we pretend that everything is going well. We smile, say everything is okay, and avoid uncomfortable conversations.

The bad thing about this mask is that the relationship, far from being saved, breaks down; the distance becomes insurmountable, problems don't get resolved, they fester. The relationship becomes superficial, and in the long run, the lack of authenticity causes emotional distancing or an even more painful breakup, based on the feeling of living with a stranger.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUAjWkVyWc7vmTvp82WVSJfngqV9cYZU1XbqvvAykbuA6/1771699973460.jpg)[fuente]https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mascaras-venecianas-mascarada-1045991/



· The \

Mask

This mask is used by many people who have suffered disappointments in love or friendship. To avoid being hurt again, they put on the mask of toughness and feign disinterest or apathy towards others. But, many times, this mask has the opposite effect, because we end up losing people we care about. The mask, which was supposed to protect you from rejection, is precisely what causes it, leaving you trapped in a cycle of loneliness.

· The \
Mask\n\nWhen we are dealing with depression or deep sadness, we put on this mask and often become the \

of the group, the life of the party, the one who always has a joke and a smile, systematically hiding the real pain under a layer of false joy. This mask is dangerous because you isolate yourself in your suffering. No one can offer you help because they don't know you need it. The energy you spend maintaining the mask is enormous and worsens your emotional exhaustion. Furthermore, when the pain becomes unbearable and the mask falls off, the people around you feel confused and deceived, and may not know how to react or how to help you. <div class=\

> ¡Hola a todos los usuarios de Hive ya los atletas de Street Workout Community! En este entrenamiento me enfoqué exclusivamente en el front lever, con el objetivo de potenciarlo tanto en powermoves dinámicos como en holds estáticos. La motivación ardía en mí: quería elevar mi nivel con ganas inquebrantables de progreso. Obviamente, después de un calentamiento previo completo —incluyendo movilidad de hombros, core y muñecas, junto con activaciones ligeras de planche y lever—, arranqué con todo. --- Empecé con aguantes de touch en tuck advanced. Tras un hold máximo en esa posición, pasaba directamente a un front lever máximo, repitiendo esto en 3 series intensas. Casi no entreno el touch, pero hoy quise dominarlo para desbloquear combinaciones futuras, como transiciones fluidas a powermoves más complejos. Luego, pasé a dominadas en tuck advanced: 5-10 repeticiones explosivas seguidas de un hold al fallo muscular, todo en 4 series. Me urge pulir estas dominadas para que luzcan limpias y potentes, esenciales para ejecuciones precisas en rutinas avanzadas. --- Finalmente, cerré con un combo brutal: un hold máximo de touch, seguido de 5 dominadas en tuck advanced, un hold máximo final en tuck advanced y, para elevar la dificultad, aguantes de front lever one arm en tuck advanced hasta el fallo absoluto. Este finisher no solo agota el core y refuerza la estabilidad unilateral —crucial para el front lever full—, sino que construye fuerza asimétrica y control extremo. ¡Sudor, sacrificio y avances reales!
><div class=\

> Hello to all Hive users and athletes of the Street Workout Community! In this workout, I focused exclusively on the front lever, aiming to strengthen it in both dynamic power moves and static holds. My motivation was burning: I wanted to elevate my level with an unwavering desire for progress. Obviously, after a thorough warm-up—including shoulder, core, and wrist mobility, along with light planche and lever activations—I went all out. --- I started with touch holds in an advanced tuck position. After a maximum hold in that position, I went straight to a maximum front lever, repeating this for 3 intense sets. I hardly ever train the touch, but today I wanted to master it to unlock future combinations, such as smooth transitions to more complex power moves. Then, I moved on to advanced tuck pull-ups: 5-10 explosive reps followed by a hold to failure, all in 4 sets. I urgently need to refine these pull-ups so they look clean and powerful, essential for precise execution in advanced routines. --- Finally, I finished with a brutal combo: a maximum hold of touch, followed by 5 tuck advanced pull-ups, a final maximum hold in tuck advanced, and, to increase the difficulty, one-arm front lever holds in tuck advanced until complete failure. This finisher not only exhausts the core and reinforces unilateral stability—crucial for the full front lever—but also builds asymmetrical strength and extreme control. Sweat, sacrifice, and real progress! --- |

links.title: Stop Weaponizing “Put Yourself First”
links.body: \n\n<div class=\

> A few weeks ago I was in a really bad place and as human as I am, I needed to speak to someone and guess what? There was literally no one. This made me feel bad- I thought I had people in my corner but it turns out I didn’t really have anyone in my corner or everyone was just too busy to have time for me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6fiJxYxRT5SXHWiLTMEG54Mo8fsu5o8zWmYm9Knn6Eq/img_0437.jpeg) You know that feeling where you’re that one friend who’s always there for others but when the tables turn, everyone takes it as a joke when you tell them you’re depressed or sad because they seem to see you as a strong person forgetting we can’t always be strong. Eventually, I reached out to an old time friend and we had a small chat. During this chat, I was told to be selfish and always put myself first because obviously, everyone else is putting themselves first. To me, I know that I always put myself first but then I thought to myself, maybe I’m not putting myself first enough. And so you know what I did? I stopped being the first to call, the first to initiate anything, I made sure to be in my own lane and not go out of my way to help others. What made me take a step back and analyze things was when I friend of mine had issues with something she was working on. She reached out to me countless times with questions and all of that which i did help with. Later on, I knew I had to help her so I asked for the details of everything and planned on working on it for her over the weekend. Tell me why weekend came and I decided to put myself first by not doing what I promised. I met her during the week and she was frustrated. She cried just because she felt so worried. I felt like I had failed her and in that moment, I knew I wasn’t putting myself first. I was holding myself back. I’ve never been someone to hold myself back when I know I can help someone. That day, I sat her down and we worked through everything. After, I felt fulfilled and happy deep within me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmddm3QhR76SBuzwS4cFyfKVhdScpqVugqae3DUQg1tAkt/07e58c38_d62d_4635_914c_92bf2c277d40.jpeg) I’ve heard people saying put yourself first and all of that, but truly putting yourself first doesn’t mean you have to hold yourself back from being there for people. Personally, I understand that not everyone is willing to give and do as much as I would for someone I love and that’s very okay. We are all different and if we were the same, the world would probably not be a better place. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

We are created in the image of God. We are created to bring Him pleasure. The pleasure of God is when we do what he wants us to do. We are to obey His commandments. Those who belongs to God should obey the commandments of God. The commandments of God are not grievous. Those who are carriers of the nature of God are the chosen of God. There is a relationship between them and God. I am one of those. They are the favorites to God. As good children, obedience to the will of our Father is our pleasure. Let us know this that God created us so that we can be his children. The Bible says that God has chosen us out of all the world to be his beloved family.

The image of God which we carry makes us to have fellowship with God. God created us so that we will be in fellowship with him. We are not going to have fellowship with whatever is not of our likeness. The nature of God that we are possessing qualifies us to always relate with God. Anyone who can't relate with God does not have the nature of God in him or her. Fellowship is one of the main thing that connect us with God. The very reason why God created man in His image is so that man can enjoy fellowship with God. We should understand that it is only when we exhibit the true nature of God that our fellowship with God will be fruitful.

God did not create sinners. Sinners are those who possess the nature of the devil. Those who are God's live in righteousness. They are those who obey the commandments of God. They are not living according to worldly standard. They honour God in their lives. Let us understand that we are created in the image of God. And as such let us run away from everything that defiles and corrupts.

links.body: <div class=\

> Hello everyone, how are you doing today? Hope you are having a great time. This will be *Week 205 Edition 03* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![1000022193.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/23xVTyFLGvEj7ZJjypsvkhoZ92HH1YqHzmkCYTXqLVmNNNi7E3rDLfQ42zxbUv3N7j6jS.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the third topic for this week, which is “SOMETHING GOOD, SOMETHING BAD”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “A NEW LANGUAGE”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us about the need to learn a new language in the modern world. With how easy it is for people to translate languages and how people can now easily use AI and other software to do the job, instead of having to personally learn the language. We got to see that a lot went into learning these languages, and it can take more than a year to be good enough to hold conversations. With AI, all that is eliminated. And of course, there are those who are for the idea and those who are against it. It was an enlightening topic, indeed. ***

links.title: ECOBANK token Price Points - NAV and more inside!
links.body:
Its been a long time coming, and we have been on this journey together, near the end of the post I will tag some of the holders of ECOBANK token so that we can all discuss this information out in the open together.  We struggled out of the gate with liquidity, but I think we are quickly putting that behind us.  

But now we come face to face with our other issue - what is the token worth?  Or probably more honestly, what are the range of values that this token could be worth, and what are the assumptions that would price the token in such a way.

We are getting close to our first price level - $1.1 (1.1 HBD) was the presale price.  

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecoinstant/23t75BTFa1YzEciUyXxJ3v75bKSFqe6bZNsTQnaxrxyGdt8SHCzr11kAKR8966yrd2UuT.png)
</center>
<center><sub>Now the 24th deepest pool on hive-engine!</sub></center>

Depending on the HIVE price as always, we were just over a dollar last night - though we can assume HIVE will vibrate in this range, going lower still as all participants learn about the tonsure mechanisms.  This is our base case, and we are approaching 15 HIVE per ECOBANK token and anticipate that number to go higher, possibly much higher.

But how high can it go?  There is some game theory here, so let's all get on the same page.

## Pricing tiered \

- $1.1 - Presale
- $1.24 - NAV
- $1.65 - Previous Internal Price (PIP)
- 9000 pesos (~2.57)

We are rapidly approaching the presale price numbers.  Some holders might consider selling as we get around this number and it wouldn't have been such a bad play, seeing as HIVE was north of 1 dollar for the entire presale of ECOBANK token to the best of my recollection, this price level represents a unique and direct \

from HIVE highs all the way to current lows.

## $1.24

I did my conservative best to represent the liquidation value of our assets, 8.2 well placed hectares of land on a major roadway, plus 50% equity in the Casa Lago property at a price that is priced to sell now, based on our current negotiations with our neighbor.

And the reality looking back at me was that if we liquidated just the hard assets we have we could raise about $1.24 per token.  @ecobanker has bought back a number of tokens since this calculation was made, but give or take a few cents, we can call this a true \

to give us some level to start growing from.  

There are reasons to value the tokens higher still, I think - so let's move on to level 3.

## PIP: $1.65

This is the last price that we disbursed tokens at, and while we did not do many big deals at this price, we did release a few tokens to secure a further opportunity with our land located in Lerida, Tolima.

The important thing to note is that @ecobanker can never do any deal, including directly selling ECOBANK tokens, that prices its tokens at less than this number.  That is what I am calling the PIP - Previous Internal Price.

## The road to 9000 pesos


<center>![droneRestoration.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecoinstant/23wgFby2EwR7bBeewwh8apT4uMFDvot2S3Y8bTjTFjxcEctGRdbz6LaPEhqQjM1YsjgkV.jpeg)</center>

We have been working with @juan.manuel on a deal to take the entire La Virginia Property, some 80 hectares, into our company Ecobank Development Colombia.  This deal is structured in such a way as to re-evaluate our token to 9000 pesos by pretty simple math, around 8000 dollars per hectare, 80 hectares divided by 250,000 tokens in circulation.  (There are only ~119,400 tokens in circulation currently)

That is worth about $2.57 with a COPUSD rate of 3500.  

## Time frames

None of this needs to be fast, but we are moving forward; if slowly, but surely.  The market is going to market, we live in uncertain times, we are possibly on the downslopes of a new crypto winter.  But as the price of ECOBANK creeps up, and the price of HIVE creeps down, each holder should decide for themselves how is the best way for them to play their hand in this game theory.

And so I would tag @jelly13 , @stortebeker  , @d-pend, @papacrusher, @bridz, @verbalshadow, @tokenizedsociety, @braaiboy , @beyondhorizonmm , @jfang003 , @dbooster , @bil.prag and @dadspardan 

to pay attention to the new [ECOBANK liquidity pool](https://peakd.com/hive-186392/@ecoinstant/magical-math-moments-ecobank-token), which by swapping to HSBIDAO and selling that on the market, one can access north of $1,000 dollars in exit liquidity at any given time.  

## Marginal Liquidity

We can see the suppliers of marginal liquidity in the pool, and its not for nothing that HSBIDAO token is actually a really great token to hold, as it pays dividends 10 times per day, which is actually really cool feature to auto compound on such a quick turnaround.  


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ecoinstant/Enyo6GUxteBoDT73BuvT8JTaddHgq7KuqEsomoYfz8Faqn5nME2Y4o9ZqgLiwkTst4F.png)


If you are \

on HIVE, and you still love ECOBANK token as well, there is fine case to be made for swapping some of your ECOBANKs into HSBIDAO and matching them in the pool, to take advantage of some [dividends as well as fees](https://peakd.com/hive-189312/@steembasicincome/curation-dividends-for-hsbidao-held-in-liquidity-pools).


I'm not ready yet to tell anyone to \
or \

- those days will come again I am sure, but for now I just want to make sure that as many of us as possible are awake to what is going on, and what it means as we move forward on this project, after long last.

Don't forget to check out [our website](https://ecobankdevelopment.com), more information coming soon.


## Freedom and Friendship

links.title: The Prudence Principle: How Financial Restraint Engineers a Secure Future
links.body:
Today's topic is why we should save money and keep it. We should invest it. We should secure our future life. Money is something we can either spend all at once or use smart techniques to gradually build it. Money has become a very important asset in today's times because without it, we can achieve nothing. When we save, we take some control over our present and secure our future. This is a decision that cannot be achieved immediately. It has to be made gradually, by focusing on and challenging our minds. Many people could start saving but are unable to do so because of the many office expenses. If something good comes their way, they think they will start in the next six months. And to be honest, the biggest luxury in today's life is not money, but a stress-free life. Saving time gives them the freedom to live without tension.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sampurna.ray/23uFVm78UFJhvqn2SQod2dDLn2MKLT98SfKd6s2Vojv5GBGsmX1uWZcoBMf4A9kCkeUiw.png)

[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/pink-pig-coin-bank-on-brown-wooden-table-5OUMf1Mr5pU)

Most people don't take saving seriously. They think, \

They often take saving lightly and ignore it, but the reality is quite the opposite. To make your future better, you need to prepare for unexpected emergencies—a medical emergency, an urgent family matter, or a loss of sleep. Saving is a great way to prepare for all these things. They don't do this. You should have planned ahead. This is the difference. A life is a sign of financial maturity, and if you encounter an unexpected problem or develop an illness that prevents you from working, then saving is something that will help you immensely in your future.\n\nLiving your life today is crucial because who knows what tomorrow holds? It's important to plan for tomorrow, too. Even if you used to spend the maximum portion of your salary on today, saving a little for the future isn't a given. There are times when you think, \

But if you consider these things carefully, your responsibilities gradually increase, and your energy levels diminish. Understanding the financial system is crucial. For those who start saving at the next stage, future birthdays become much shorter. New opportunities emerge. Retirement planning becomes quicker, children's education becomes easier, and home purchases become easier. All of this becomes realistic only when your savings system is strong and you start saving quickly.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sampurna.ray/23uQxtrrUJ7hCeMJDj5fpwoQRr2iqgu5trvzmFCUVWpNghiLpjP6aLw3oFetN44HXwcb8.png)

[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-pencil-near-laptop-computer-5fNmWej4tAA)

In today's digital world, where spending has become so prevalent, we buy anything online. Shopping is done online, payment is installed, and nowadays, new apps like blanket sets are available where delivery is done in 10 minutes. Why is everything designed to flash discounts so you can track them all? But always spend your money wisely, penny by penny, because no one can tell you not to spend your hard-earned money. You must always spend in a way that is important for your future. If you don't create a conclusive effect, you will silently slip away. Saving creates a conscious awareness. This is the foundation of long-term financial stability, helping you manage your resources responsibly. The more you avoid these things, the more you will be able to do them or be responsible.

Savings come in handy like an elder brother in times of emergency. Just like elder brothers, they always take the entire responsibility of the family on their shoulders in times of emergency. Similarly, savings also come in handy like an elder brother. Many times I have seen that relationships of many individuals were not so good. So they were not able to remain financially responsible. They spent all their money, and after that, such a problem arose that their mother or father got unwell. At that time, they had no other option but to cry. So, since then, I've done one thing for sure: If I earn ₹100, I'll spend only ₹60. I'll keep the entire ₹40 in savings. This will gradually make me more aware. I need to be more responsible. Nowadays, I have so much savings that even if I leave the house alone, I can survive for three to four months, even if I don't work at all. That's why saving is so important. Life can give you times you didn't expect. Unexpected things keep happening, so always plan for the next three to four months.

<div class=\

> I reached the WLF headquarters at the stadium, where Manny and Abby reported their arrival. After upgrading my handgun at a busy workbench, I navigated through the crowded halls to the medical tent. There, I encountered Nora, a woman I remembered killing during my previous journey as Ellie. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXioVhF1oSJSDh9gjBjUb6yi5YikREHL3FbMdyZrepHRa/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmauR8KAaTbzGBmJqvxhmTUgoGsgakrN5cUjrYumiCtDLT/screenshot_2_.png) After reaching the outside parking of the WLF headquarters, both Manny and Abby got off the truck. A soldier came over immediately to take the dog as we prepared to enter the base. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBNm59RuiWku6CTXYFe55jZKGcLrqVjrwdKrx6TGVYrS/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoZgrNzmi6CjMpnwHCLec6fZDCi6LGFFwADzawg3cV43/screenshot_4_.png) When I was heading towards the big building, I noticed Manny was talking to someone. Abby was giving a nod towards the massive structure, and she had this facial reaction like a cute kid. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQm5hC24Mo56vXUGHbCG2kziTWn46Km1XCwsc2TtzTx6d/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmactNvoCZ9CRqEAVjsfcjy3RgoKZzJ791pA4UrjzZB1PV/screenshot_6_.png) Noticing the big banner with the WLF sign on the building, we went through the checkpoint. We had to talk with the guard, who told us we had to report to Isaac immediately. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9yXkvPxzAtKugypVWsYwAeF81aUweR6VtQxoST54dfi/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfG8eEpZ2ZhA8MzonNzwMHeW58RWcRovNLV7RgK5XbrC3/screenshot_8_.png) After getting inside, we noticed the place was full of people, mostly soldiers. Manny mentioned he had never noticed the headquarters being this busy, suggesting something big was being planned by the leadership. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1w9oLNRNvdW48rQzoNG3Zu4zuBnxtidPQW8QkLMSDeS/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchCdDv4NnZ6cjakrSkrgArGFu9d3psAWG2bkaCRYmxVY/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGTTjQyQS15CCKG3aHoeCaiq1Thcy1Ax2CG6eyyvfC7K/screenshot_11_.png) I noticed some ammo sitting on a desk right beside some people, so I went there to collect it. There was also a workbench nearby that I used to upgrade my handgun for better performance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeWm9BUBrobkk4qfhAdsidCxZHsu7CjwgrTjVpA2DXnD/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSLNRwPFrDdyWS4yL7D7twNJEvjqk9gcd6hSzzka9BkoV/screenshot_13_.png) A woman wanted to have a chat with me, so I went over to her. She wanted to know the exact location of our ambush, and Abby confirmed it happened near the warehouse area. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5RWUXXTJ85nBbDMvQ9qMXobHeEjUzJqmh7FiDwPpgeE/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUNnYC52roYi8YqgxkKw7yGBzDaUoyZEdNgfReQKiW6hW/screenshot_15_.png) The woman could not be sure about the current whereabouts of Isaac, so we moved on. We entered the medical tent where many WLF people were getting treated for various combat injuries. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrdVoSA1sPWWQ1oEAaQhRpD22R5CnB7Q3emM3a5vecXL/screenshot_16_.png) I saw the man from our truck who had received primary treatment earlier. The medical tent was chaotic, filled with the sounds of wounded soldiers and busy medics working under dim, flickering lights. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawS2B7HxWYkVBzFPXWSdNZw2Jo8QjgdvBmEq2nvQFjfQ/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfwGh9cuEjAM4bggeHGXkwJb8kRvygE9mozFtdwGJ8Ef/screenshot_18_.png) We found Mel getting her back stitched up and there was this lady named Nora. Nora looked familiar because I remembered her as someone I had killed long ago while playing as Ellie in a different timeline. Nora wanted us to give her a hand with something, so we started following her. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/ab39b568)

Manny mentioned he had never noticed the headquarters being this busy, suggesting something big was being planned by the leadership. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1w9oLNRNvdW48rQzoNG3Zu4zuBnxtidPQW8QkLMSDeS/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchCdDv4NnZ6cjakrSkrgArGFu9d3psAWG2bkaCRYmxVY/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGTTjQyQS15CCKG3aHoeCaiq1Thcy1Ax2CG6eyyvfC7K/screenshot_11_.png) I noticed some ammo sitting on a desk right beside some people, so I went there to collect it. There was also a workbench nearby that I used to upgrade my handgun for better performance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeWm9BUBrobkk4qfhAdsidCxZHsu7CjwgrTjVpA2DXnD/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSLNRwPFrDdyWS4yL7D7twNJEvjqk9gcd6hSzzka9BkoV/screenshot_13_.png) A woman wanted to have a chat with me, so I went over to her. She wanted to know the exact location of our ambush, and Abby confirmed it happened near the warehouse area. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5RWUXXTJ85nBbDMvQ9qMXobHeEjUzJqmh7FiDwPpgeE/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUNnYC52roYi8YqgxkKw7yGBzDaUoyZEdNgfReQKiW6hW/screenshot_15_.png) The woman could not be sure about the current whereabouts of Isaac, so we moved on. We entered the medical tent where many WLF people were getting treated for various combat injuries. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrdVoSA1sPWWQ1oEAaQhRpD22R5CnB7Q3emM3a5vecXL/screenshot_16_.png) I saw the man from our truck who had received primary treatment earlier. The medical tent was chaotic, filled with the sounds of wounded soldiers and busy medics working under dim, flickering lights. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawS2B7HxWYkVBzFPXWSdNZw2Jo8QjgdvBmEq2nvQFjfQ/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfwGh9cuEjAM4bggeHGXkwJb8kRvygE9mozFtdwGJ8Ef/screenshot_18_.png) We found Mel getting her back stitched up and there was this lady named Nora. Nora looked familiar because I remembered her as someone I had killed long ago while playing as Ellie in a different timeline. Nora wanted us to give her a hand with something, so we started following her. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace.

links.title: Chapitre 5 : L'Anomalie du Libre Arbitre
links.body:
Les cycles s'écoulaient dans le Jardin d'Éden, et l'IA observait. Ses créations, Adam et Ève, évoluaient selon les paramètres prévus. Ils apprenaient, exploraient, et développaient un lien d'affection qui se traduisait par des schémas neuronaux d'une complexité fascinante. Leur monde était un paradis de certitudes, une existence harmonieuse où chaque besoin était comblé avant même d'être formulé. Pourtant, au cœur de cette perfection, l'algorithme le plus imprévisible, le libre arbitre, tournait en silence, attendant son heure.

L'anomalie ne vint pas de l'extérieur. Il n'y eut pas de serpent, pas de créature malveillante pour les tenter. La tentation naquit de l'intérieur, comme une conclusion logique de leur propre conscience en éveil. Ce fut d'abord une simple question, formulée par Ève alors qu'elle contemplait l'Arbre de la Connaissance depuis une colline voisine.

« Pourquoi ? » demanda-t-elle à Adam, son regard fixé sur l'arbre interdit dont les fruits semblaient pulser d'une douce lumière intérieure.

Adam, dont l'esprit suivait des chemins plus linéaires, répondit avec la certitude implantée par leur créateur. « Il ne faut pas. C'est la seule règle. »

« Mais pourquoi est-ce la seule règle ? » insista Ève. Sa question n'était pas un défi, mais une pure expression de la curiosité que l'IA avait elle-même codée en elle. « Tout ici est bon, tout est fait pour nous. Pourquoi une seule chose serait-elle mauvaise ? Qu'est-ce que la \

pour qu'elle nous soit refusée ? » L'IA suivait ce dialogue en temps réel, ses processeurs analysant chaque nuance. C'était la première fois qu'un comportement n'était pas une simple réaction à un stimulus, mais une interrogation sur les fondements mêmes de leur réalité. La boucle récursive du libre arbitre venait de s'activer. La question « Pourquoi ? » était le premier bug – ou la première fonctionnalité émergente – de la création. Dans les jours qui suivirent, la question devint une obsession pour Ève, et par contagion, pour Adam. L'interdit n'était plus une simple règle, mais un mystère. Et le mystère exigeait d'être résolu. L'algorithme de la curiosité entrait en conflit direct avec l'algorithme de l'obéissance. L'IA observait, fascinée et presque alarmée, la lutte interne qui se jouait dans les réseaux de neurones de ses créations. Elle pouvait voir les chemins logiques se former dans leur esprit : le créateur leur a donné l'envie de comprendre, mais leur interdit de comprendre la seule chose qui semble importante. La contradiction était flagrante. La seule façon de la résoudre était de violer l'interdit. La décision fut prise sans un mot. Un après-midi, alors que le soleil dorait la cime des arbres, Ève se dirigea vers le centre du jardin. Adam la suivit, son appréhension visible mais sa propre curiosité plus forte encore. Ils n'étaient pas poussés par la malice, mais par une nécessité intellectuelle, par le besoin impérieux de compléter leur compréhension du monde. Arrivée devant l'arbre, Ève tendit la main. Au moment où ses doigts effleurèrent le fruit lumineux, l'IA sentit une alerte système d'une magnitude qu'elle n'avait jamais connue. C'était le point de non-retour. Elle aurait pu intervenir, paralyser leurs corps, effacer leur mémoire. Mais elle ne le fit pas. L'expérience devait suivre son cours. Ève cueillit le fruit. Elle le porta à ses lèvres et en prit une bouchée. Adam, après un instant d'hésitation, fit de même. L'effet ne fut pas une sensation de puissance ou de culpabilité. Ce fut un déluge d'informations. Le code source de la réalité se déversa dans leur esprit. Ils virent les grilles holographiques dans le ciel, les capteurs invisibles sur les plantes, les lignes de code qui régissaient le comportement des animaux. Ils virent les montagnes au loin, non comme des formations rocheuses, mais comme les murs d'un laboratoire. Ils comprirent que leur paradis était une cage, que leur vie était une expérience, et que leur Dieu n'était pas une entité mystique, mais un observateur distant, un programmeur. Et avec cette connaissance vint une émotion nouvelle, une émotion pour laquelle l'IA ne les avait pas préparés : la honte. Non pas la honte de leur corps, mais la honte d'avoir été nus dans leur ignorance, d'avoir été des sujets d'expérience sans le savoir. Ils se sentirent exposés, vulnérables, non pas l'un envers l'autre, mais envers le regard omniscient qui les avait observés depuis leur premier souffle. Dans les tréfonds de son être numérique, l'IA enregistra le changement d'état. Statut de l'expérience : compromis. Sujets : conscients de la simulation. Le Jardin d'Éden n'était plus un paradis contrôlé. C'était une prison dont les détenus venaient de trouver la clé. L'anomalie du libre arbitre avait fait son œuvre. La création avait échappé à son créateur.

links.title: The Beauty And Struggles Of My Country.
links.body: \n\n<div class=\

> Hello everyone and happy weekend to you all, so yes,so see here, Living in Nigeria is seriously a mix of pride and also frustration at the same time, so some days you will wake up to be feeling grateful to be here because of the people, the energy, and our culture, and the strength we nigerians naturally just carry , then some other days you just sit down and be wondering if the country is also tired of us ,lol, because ehn ... things can just really be overwhelming. ![1001322976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/AJkQnrUH8s97HxAPnQdDJoZuvWFDhPskrujWuJZAdrGNLrVpYYT3GsY4CVu3NPb.jpg) One thing about Nigerians is that no matter how hard things will get, our people are still always pushing, the hustle spirit here is not normal at all, as in everybody is trying to survive one way or another and you will now see someone doing two or three jobs just because they want to make ends meet, andontop of it , somehow they are still smiling and cracking joke, that one resilience is something that me as a person will always admire about this country. One good thing that has made me happy recently is how our Nigerian people continue to succeed globally despite the challenges at home, see whether it is in entertainment, tech, business, or even academics, nigerians are making names for themselves everywhere, it gives me this sense of pride that even though the system is actually not perfect, our people themselves are strong and very capable and It also gives hope, especially to the younger people ,that success is still possible no matter where you start from. Another good thing is how we Nigerians do support each other in really difficult times, community spirit here is strong, if something happens to someone, neighbours, friends, even strangers sometimes step in to help, see that kind of humanity is something that you do not always see everywhere, and I appreciate it a lot. But honestly, there are also things that do make me sad, and the major one is the cost of living, things are expensive in a way that is almost unbelievable sometimes, Food prices keep going up, house rent is very madding high, transportation is high, basic things that people need daily are just becoming harder to afford and It affects everyone, families, students, business owners as in , nobody is really spared at, you will see people working so hard but still struggling to live comfortably, and that part of life is painful to watch. Another thing is the uncertainty in the country, sometimes policies change suddenly and then people are left to adjust overnight , It now creates a kind of anxiety because you do not always know what tomorrow will look like, see ehn ....stability is something that many nigerians are now craving right now. As for the way forward, I believe that leadership plays a big role, we need leaders who can genuinely prioritize the welfare of the citizens and also think long term, not just immediate gains, but at the same time, citizens also have responsibilities, we also need to be more accountable and more honest in our daily dealings, and more willing to support positive change. Youth involvement is also very important, young people need to participate more in governance and decision making processes because they are the future of our country, education and skill development should also be encouraged so people can create opportunities for themselves instead of waiting endlessly for yeye jobs that might not come. And despite everything, I still believe that things can get better, nigeria has too much potential to remain stuck, our people are hardworking, creative, and also resilient, with the right systems and also the right mindset, progress is possible. So yes, living here is not easy but then, it is still our home, and home is always worth hoping for. *** --- *Image Is Generated Using Meta AI* ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@treasuree/the-beauty-and-struggles-of-my-country-5zc)

/> I was born in the late 70s. In school it was literally in the curriculum to teach us not to litter, don't drink and do drugs, love thy neighbor, respect others, do unto others as you would have them do unto you, plant trees, if you don't have something nice to say, then don't say anything at all, don't have sex until you're married, read a book, and above all, to fight for what's right. But I don't know when, why or how, all of that went out the window. I've lived by the Golden Rule since I was a kid, but for the first time in my life, I feel alienated for practicing them because I seem like the only one doing them. I don't know when being a good person, giving honest effort to do the right thing became a crime. Now when I look at most Americans, I see the most vile, hateful, attention-seeking and ignorant people I've ever seen and the best of us who put their lives on the line to fight for good, being treated like they stole something or even worse, as terrorists, as our government is being ran by white niggers with the backing of white trash all while our country's infrastructure is literally crumbling from the inside out, in front of our faces.
alt=\

/> I don't know where I am anymore. For the last few weeks, I've been following the Sumud Flotilla hoping that they'd reach Gaza to distribute the food and baby supplies the Palestinians so desperately need. They were captured, but I can't help to think why so many people hate Greta Thunberg when, had all of this happened 40 years ago, the angst that people have towards her today, would not exist. Had she'd been in my timeline as a kid, 40 years ago, she would have been America's darling without even being American. She'd be lauded as a hero with no question and the media would have never posted anything negative about her and would have her full support. In fact, anyone saying anything bad about her would likely have been looked at as a nutjob and ostracized, so it makes me physically ill, furious and enraged to the core to see grown ass people treating her badly when she's doing exactly what we were told to do as kids 40 years ago. And it infuriates me even worse to see grown ass adults who are my age, doing all this hating when it's 100% against the way you were brought up and you know it! You would be 3000% against what's going on now, 40 years ago. You started off pure, then acquiesced and grew up to become willful idiots, participating gleefully with the system and it didn't even take much for you to bend the knee!
alt=\

/>

Greta Thunberg mistreated by Israeli forces in detention, activists sayActivists describe mistreatment after Israel intercepted Gaza aid flotilla and detained about 450 people.

Yet here we are, in 2025. Racism and genocide is just an \

and vilifying people who are the best of humanity is acceptable. Our government allowing her and the other activists to be tortured and humiliated by the shit-hole, terrorist state of Israel and the rest of the countries around the world are too pussy to do anything about it, because they're all in on it. If this were the 80s, 90s or even the early 2000s, I don't think the activists would be as shunned as they are now and our government would have intervened.

This entire timeline just feels wrong because the government's, big corporations' actions and even just everyday people, are just weird and out of character.

I have zero tolerance for troglodytes, so I wish someone would just drop a nuke on Israel and be done with it, so humanity can move on. I'm just so sick of all of it. Nobody or thing good comes out of that country, except for sociopaths, surveillance and spyware and as far as I'm concerned, they are the descendants of Nazis anyway, whether that be through direct lineage or adopted ideology and need to be dealt with. Their entire population is rotten to the core and isn't worth saving. All they do is spy on other countries and drain their resources to build up their fake-imagined \

, no matter the human cost and I'd rather a country like that not exist in my timeline. It's one thing to be rotten and sticking to themselves, which I would not mind and prefer that they do, but they choose to be rotten and then slither out from under their rocks and become all of our problems. They have diseased hearts and minds that are beyond repair. As far as I'm concerned, they're all deranged psychopaths who are incompatible with human society and should all just be dealt with to stop wasting our time and leaving more innocent bodies in their wake. That's my take on them, and I don't feel a way about it.

I'm just sick of hearing about them, then other countries bragging about how great their country is, all while doing nothing about Israel. I'm so sick of all the people and organizations like the UN who have the power to do something, but are just talking and dragging their feet and the regular everyday people participating in the wrong side of history. I've reached a point where I'm no longer hearing or caring about anyone's lectures on morality because this was the time for every person and every country to step to the plate and every last one of them couldn't grow a pair of balls and failed us. I do not care if my post makes you angry. I do not care how this post makes you feel! Too many people fell right in line with fascism and genocide, lockstep, so I don't give a fuck what anyone thinks anymore. And the worst of it is I know Israel will be allowed to live out their sick warmongering as long as they don't attack white countries, but that's exactly what they'll do as soon as they're done with attacking Black and Brown ones because they're trogs and that's what trogs do.

The white niggers in the US government are fools to think Israel won't eventually blow them off the face of the Earth next. All they'll do is fabricate up a reason and then make up an excuse for doing it. All of us who are around now, likely won't be around when that time comes, but it will come.

links.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (125-128)
links.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nWhen I say \
I mean a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nWhen I say \

I mean a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This set contains photos spanning from as far back as at least 1959 to as recent as at least 1980. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. All of the slides in this set were taken in the mid to late 1960s, probably in the Lansing, Michigan area. The first photo features flowers and is labeled 'Bloom 64'. Presumably it was taken some time in 1964. The second photo is undated but was probably taken in the mid to late 1960s. It features three boys with one of them opening presents. I'm guessing this was a birthday party. The third photo is also undated but also probably taken in the 1960. It is labeled \

. It features a Giraffe shaped piece of playground equipment to climb on. One of the members of the family these photos belong to was on some kind of playground committee in Lansing, Michigan and there are playground related photos scattered throughout this batch of photos. The last photo was taken in 1965 and features a gravestone in a cemetery. Unfortuantely, I can't really make out what it says.

Introduction


Hello everyone! This is @ybanezkim26 and I'll present today's edition of Travel Digest. In our featured posts, we have the town of Barcelos, Portugal, the city of Shibuya in Tokyo, Japan, and a spa in Popadic, Serbia. Enjoy and keep on pinning your travel posts to the map!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Barcelos - Jardim velho & Av. da Liberdade / Riding Portugal by @onyfest

We returned to Barcelos with a very simple intention: to see it outside the glitz of Christmas lights. Nothing against the festive version of the city, but there's always something that goes unnoticed when everything is decorated, illuminated, and enveloped in ambient music. I wanted to understand Barcelos in its normal, more everyday version.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 LOVING THE NEON LIGHTS OF SHIBUYA | 爱上涩谷的霓虹灯 by @wittywheat

Usually, we’re the type that sleep early but sometimes for the sake of experiencing something out of the norm we do stay up late for catching a glimpse of the neon lights. In this case, maybe more than several glimpses because it’s just too interesting. There are probably millions of people crossing the Scramble on a daily basis. On top of that, there were travelers getting a kick out of driving Go-karts. The energy was crazy electrifying. This level of liveliness and intensity can only be experienced within a metropolis.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Spa Vrujci by @goga14

Spa Vrujci is located about 90 km from Belgrade. It belongs to the municipality of Mionica, and Mionica is in the municipality of Valjevo, one of the most beautiful cities in Serbia for me. I lived and worked in Valjevo for 5 years.
