links.title: 4th Place - Hivechess Tournament
links.body:
This time it is something better for me compared to the last time. I finished in 4th place with a lot of blunders that I was lucky to escape. I didn't play well but fortune smiled on me with a lot of escape from the lions in the playing fide. Even the game with the International Master with long username that was supposed to end in draw, turned out bad for me when I used my queen to block a check that was already bad for me. 


![Screenshot_20260221-191634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23tbPQBnJExzNiLqDCSnTGqYhxwDQKTH8NcVwC5MLPjmsGphPcsN3gXkzvS1aCQZDCoYm.jpg)


A position that was already draw but that is what time pressure can do to you. It was a win rate of 50% for me, which that is a 50% loss as well. It didn't take much to realize when I was outplayed by other players especially Jaki and the International master, and before I forget stayoutoftherz was on fire today. I could only get a win from him in one game, while the other games where bad for me. 


![Screenshot_20260221-192629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23tHETMpemAs9FQmn9PgExDbJM6sAYEqkDAgqTav79KmM3cWRZzWaEzqT95xpFr7AhTbv.jpg)

In this game against stayoutoftherz, I do not understand how things got some sterile for me. It was as if nothing was going on and no matter what I did the position just got bad for me. Starting off first with the binding in the position and then moving over to the lock and keep. I literally stayed in a specific position where I could not do anything. You know that moment in the game where you know you are bad. It is when you are looking for moves to make but you are run out of them and for some reason you do not know what to do. This is exactly what it felt like and I did not need to be told that my position was the inferior one. Once you notice that you are the one struggling to find the best move, just know you are most likely the one with the inferior or better still worst position. 


![Screenshot_20260221-193242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23t7sSVMLKxF8MHtTRqgP5wemz5qis45LHyrHKSQMBfDRnbbYxsQvPF6ousEWKMFA44mC.jpg)

This is the position I had against the International master and it was the only position against the player that I stood a chance. Others were bad for me but this one was different but for some reason I have a better endgame but sadly time was not on my side. This is what it looks like when you have the world but you do not have the time to enjoy it. Well that was my case in this situation. I could not cry more than I did because it was a good position against a stronger player and he is the one that one the tournament without losing any game. I would have been the only player to win him if I had won this game. Well that is the game for you.  Anyways I am improving and that's what matters.

body.title: Why Technology is Our Only Real Chance to Stop Being Pawns in Their Game
body.body:
>Why Technology is Our Only Real Chance to Stop Being Pawns in Their Game

\n\nLet’s be honest: it’s exhausting to look around. When we turn on the TV or scroll through the news, we see the same faces, the same political scandals, blatant theft, and conflicts that seem copy-pasted from one year to the next. You feel small. You feel like just a number in a tax spreadsheet or a target for mass-media manipulation. Many of us ask ourselves: why even play fair anymore? If everyone \
lies and steals without shame, what’s stopping us from doing the same?\n\n

></center>

The answer isn't a moralizing one—it’s pragmatic. If we become like them, we enter their game. And in their game, they will always win because they have more money and more influence. The only way to beat them is to stop needing them. This is where technology comes in. For all of us seeking freedom, the keyboard isn't just an object; it’s the only tool that can offer the independence we actually need.

<h4 style=\

>Stopping the Dependency on Their Permissions\n\nAll our lives, we are told we need intermediaries. You need a bank to hold your money (and take a fee), and you need a politician to manage your future (and lie to you during the campaign). But the truth is that systems now exist that eliminate the need for these \

></center>\n\nDistributed ledger technology (blockchain) isn't about getting rich quick for us; it’s about collective freedom. It’s about the idea of collaborating directly with one another without a clerk or a banker giving us permission to use our own resources. When we understand how these systems work, we realize we can build a parallel world where the rules are mathematical and clear, independent of someone’s whim or corruption. For the first time, we can trust each other without needing a \

in the middle.

*   In the past, if you wanted to know something, you had to settle for what TV stations served you or what you found in censored books. Today, those walls have fallen for anyone willing to look past them.
    

Artificial Intelligence is like a personal mentor for all of us, one that doesn't have a political agenda. If we want to understand a complex law, manage our own finances, or learn a new trade, we have access to the world’s knowledge in seconds. We can no longer be manipulated through ignorance because we now have the tools to verify any lie. When you understand how things work, the fear they sell on the news loses its power over you.

The biggest leverage they have over us is survival. \

It’s a constant blackmail we are all subjected to. But we are seeing how technology is beginning to change the rules of the game.

Automated production systems, solar energy, the possibility of independent food production—all of this leads to a point where no one can be forced into slavery. If we manage to use technology to secure our basic needs at minimum costs, those who profit from us lose their greatest weapon: our hunger.

<h4 style=\

>Why We Need Choose to Stay Honest\n\nBack to that tough question: why not be liars ourselves? Because integrity is our only form of real control. A person who lies and steals becomes predictable. They become someone who can be blackmailed, bought, and controlled by the same methods \
use.\n\nIf we choose to remain honest and use technology to build something transparent, we are free. Code doesn't lie. A system well-built on technical foundations doesn't need \
Keeping your word in a world of liars is the most radical act of rebellion possible. It’s our way of saying: \

*   It all sounds good, but there’s a trap. The system counts on us being lazy. It’s much easier to sit on social media and watch nonsense than to learn how to secure our data or how a decentralized system works.
    

This laziness is the fence that keeps us all locked in. Learning is hard; it’s frustrating at times, but it’s the only \
we must pay for our freedom. A person who masters the tool is no longer a victim. They are someone sitting at the table, deciding their own fate.\n\n

></center>\n\nWe are all fed up with what we see in politics and mass media, but we must realize that complaining solves nothing. Technology is the only real exit for everyone seeking sovereignty. It’s not an easy road, and it doesn't happen overnight, but it’s the only one that depends on us, not on them. The power is right here in front of us, on the keyboard. We just need the courage to stop being mere spectators and start writing our own path.

body.title: Castlevania for Sega Master System Version 0.1 Released
body.body:
Castlevania is nearing that state of being a classic above reproach, like the original Super Mario Bros and first Zelda game. It has quirks, it is tough, and you are either a fan or not. There is no real in between. Obviously, someone is a major fan as they have been working on porting Castlevania to the Sega Master System (SMS). Right off the bat, I want to warn Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) version fans, get ready for more color.

A Mix of Versions Paying Homage

[xfixium over on the SMSPower.org forums]( https://www.smspower.org/forums/19386-SMSCastlevaniaHomebrew) states their port of Castlevania to the SMS features aesthetics from the Castlevania Chronicles while keeping the original, familiar, NES level design and enemy placement. This is great news for fans that want to be able to directly compare the NES to SMS (even though development has been decades apart). Graphically, Castlevania on the SMS is extremely detailed, features more color, and simply looks amazing. This is beyond impressive. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1HEh4loow34

Digital Voodoo Magic

[Frogbull on YouTube]( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1HEh4loow34) points out devkitSMS was used to create this port. It is not based on an engine such as Scorpion (not available for SMS). This just makes this SMS port even more impressive. Seriously, just look at the game in action above. Lightning flashes in the background, walls and level tiles have far more detail than the NES original. Even enemies have seen a bit of an upgrade, the ghouls in the opening area (the panther still lacks but come on, it is a black creature – hard to get detail in that). This being Version 0.1 means it has a ways to go but what is here is already super impressive. Fans of Castlevania will want to head over to [SMSPower forums]( https://www.smspower.org/forums/19386-SMSCastlevaniaHomebrew) and grab the demo release. While there, maybe create an account and let xfixium know what you think.

# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **FLEXIÓN Y EXTENSIÓN DE MUÑECAS**]() [Postura]() Sentados; extendemos un brazo hacia un lado y colocamos la mano del brazo extendido sobre la palma de la mano contraria. Este ejercicio se ejecuta de ambos lados. >[**Warm-up 1**, **WRIST FLEXION AND EXTENSION**]() >[Posture]() >Sitting; extend one arm to the side and place the hand of the extended arm on the palm of the opposite hand. This exercise is performed on both sides.
![1000433830.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCaTUtb3JfhgrPZ9BS2r7gZ8p5g4mWw2KCVnoqZrj7zLpobbnRevJKGXuSnFB.gif)
[Ejecución]() Para ejecutar el movimiento, empujamos la mano hacia atrás haciendo oposición leve con la mano del brazo extendido. Luego; la misma mano se lleva hacia adelante, haciendo oposición leve con la mano que está delante. Nos vamos hacia el otro lado intercambiando manos y realizando el mismo movimiento. 3 minutos de este primer calentamiento. >[Execution]() >To perform the movement, push your hand backward, applying slight resistance with the hand of your extended arm. Then, bring the same hand forward, applying slight resistance with the hand that is in front. Move to the other side, switching hands and performing the same movement. Do this first warm-up for 3 minutes.
![1000433834.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL1djKTJwN2UhtU8DKRdkxKJzABk2P3yUekawsthCN2zyDUhWaK4Tz16rudqP1a.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **AZOTE INFERIOR Y FRONTAL DE MANOS**]() [Postura]() Nuevamente sentados; colocamos los brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. Torso recto. >[**Warm-up 2**, **LOWER AND FRONTAL HAND SLAPS**]() >[Posture]() >Sitting again, we place our arms at our sides, extended downward. Torso straight.
![1000433836.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCVgMUF51pEsVCZVrnMjH9kbR1VfMJ5gM2Fqmsw45FATQLPzyhnTRQHQTBwxU.gif)
[Ejecución]() Para llevar a cabo el movimiento; al mismo tiempo, azotamos ambas manos abajo y al frente. Durante la acción los codos se flexionan. >[Execution]() >To perform the movement, we simultaneously swing both hands down and forward. During the action, the elbows are bent.
![1000433838.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCpF85EPp7PoKRerdqZnajamTkGJraEmd15TTjipSGr3PnEHCgQsoijckvCcM.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **GIROS DE MUÑECA CON MANCUERNA**]() [Postura]() Todos los ejercicios serán ejecutados sentados en una silla, mueble o banco. Nos sentamos; el cuádriceps o parte frontal del muslo servirá de apoyo. Tomamos la mancuerna firmemente con una mano, colocamos el codo en el muslo; cruzamos un poco el brazo quedando la mancuerna en el centro y en forma vertical. La muñeca debe quedar alineada con el antebrazo. Colocamos el brazo opuesto sobre el muslo de su lado. El ejercicio se llevará a cabo de ambos lados. >[**Station 1**, **HANDWRIST TWISTS WITH DUMBBELL**]() >[Posture]() >All exercises will be performed while seated on a chair, piece of furniture, or bench. We sit down; the quadriceps or front of the thigh will serve as support. Hold the dumbbell firmly with one hand, place your elbow on your thigh, and cross your arm slightly so that the dumbbell is in the center and vertical. Your wrist should be aligned with your forearm. Place your opposite arm on the thigh on that side. The exercise will be performed on both sides.
![1000433840.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL1e3tAyg3DydBUoG8U9vmZwpYn1EoLzbwS4AM67933p6Jy54pEiAbGPXMTcTo8.gif)
![1000433850.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCaTUt9p1dGxnaEziVRohnYYuupJZNGjdQ2WDk9EV6tyaxWShpPJ7qHYF2aFo.gif)
[Ejecución]() Con este ejercicio se fortalece la muñeca y el antebrazo; además, mejoramos la capacidad de agarre y rotación. Para llevarlo a cabo; simplemente empezamos a girar la muñeca de forma circular durante 20 repeticiones en 4 series cada lado. >[Execution]() >This exercise strengthens the wrist and forearm; it also improves grip and rotation. To perform it, simply rotate your wrist in a circular motion for 20 repetitions in 4 sets on each side.
![1000433848.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCVgJKi7BetAXpz5FxbSR9FjiJysmwE971zkMtaBtED4M3mMe8NoDe52VpRMK.gif)
![1000433852.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKzCpF58qAQyb9N6WnrhJPvXFcSS9QdAncsrNZkZYXBK4qby75TH8S2aWMTHrJP.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **SUPINACIÓN Y PRONACIÓN DE MUÑECA CON MANCUERNA**]() [Postura]() De la misma forma que en el ejercicio anterior; tomamos la mancuerna con una mano. Apoyamos el codo en el muslo; y en esta oportunidad, partimos con el agarre supino o palma de mano hacia arriba; la mancuerna está horizontal. El brazo opuesto se coloca sobre el muslo de su lado. >[**Station 2**, **WRIST SUPINATION AND PRONATION WITH DUMBBELL**]() >[Posture]() >As in the previous exercise, hold the dumbbell in one hand. Rest your elbow on your thigh, and this time, start with a supine grip or palm facing up, with the dumbbell horizontal. Place your opposite arm on the thigh on the same side.
![1000433854.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL1djKMB12BFwHBpxqj5A8JxHRFdGcYTtKZ349ydfxTLXAySHteJDx1JVZvGpae.gif)
![1000433862.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL1e3tAyXTQztNqdqisDtJ79nfvi4uKVYZwfGXtkSh7jNHQkJzJtdPgfNhRiwZz.gif)
[Ejecución]() Nuevamente el trabajo está centrado en la muñeca, la mano y el antebrazo; en segundo plano trabajan los trapecios. Activos en la posición indicada; procedemos a girar la muñeca 180° hacia adentro para quedar en posición de pronación. Seguimos con los giros durante 20 repeticiones en 4 series por cada lado. >[Execution]() >Once again, the focus is on the wrist, hand, and forearm, with the trapezius muscles working in the background. With your arms in the indicated position, rotate your wrist 180° inward to get into the pronation position. Continue with the rotations for 20 repetitions in 4 sets on each side.
![1000433856.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL35HXKkQTyXTRZgLEkLpowPz7aihfP24mVuRka2iaoMSGHHyFUpdPJogedZnug.gif)
![1000433864.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL1djKQAFpNg4zeVqAh3SwbdVx6QzK4r1zbZauJ96HATjewXvH1rkfsKQkvhM1u.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **MOVIMIENTOS LATERALES DE MUÑECA CON MANCUERNA**]() [Postura]() Seguimos sentados; codo apoyado en el muslo, tomamos la mancuerna firmemente con agarre neutro para que la misma queda en posición vertical. El brazo opuesto se ubica igualmente sobre el muslo de su lado. >[**Station 3**, **SIDEWAYS WRIST MOVEMENTS WITH DUMBBELL**]() >[Posture]() >We remain seated; elbow resting on the thigh, we hold the dumbbell firmly with a neutral grip so that it remains in a vertical position. The opposite arm is also placed on the thigh on the same side.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrXLf8CgPjTQsUNMDLtvbP1UHa8Xghx6gDN7KCN6A5x8/1771618772070.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmCFihKTTbusrJf8frh79Gv6jGn5TcD9UDktANjTcipn/1771618772188.gif)
[Ejecución]() Continuamos fortaleciendo la muñeca, el antebrazo, mejorando el agarre y la movilidad. Ahora; en la posición indicada, procedemos a mover las muñeca hacia afuera y hacia adentro. Tratar de no mover el antebrazo durante la acción. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones en 4 series por lado. >[Execution]() >We continue to strengthen the wrist and forearm, improving grip and mobility. Now, in the indicated position, we proceed to move the wrist outward and inward. Try not to move the forearm during the action. We do 20 repetitions in 4 sets per side.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNYiyZjkzFMdub2qtYp9HL4fWsTDVSEHbV5XstCDh9wdL/1771618772305.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXCFusne8hEzWsTi8UT1v8FootG8sfa5GB3UMVqPwXJU/1771618772481.gif)
[**Relajación**, **GIRO ALTERNO DE MUÑECAS**]() [Postura]() Sentados, ubicamos los brazos al frente en posición de combate. >[**Relaxation**, **ALTERNATING WRIST ROTATIONS**]() [Posture]() Sitting down, place your arms in front of you in a fighting stance.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT3oRPabWeQ7hNef9MmfAvAFSk3M18rPySxm34ZtRnpmM/1771619001455.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, vamos girando las muñecas hacia afuera y hacia adentro de forma alterna. >[Execution]() >Execution]() Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and bodily peace, we rotate our wrists outward and inward alternately.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbND4ST4GsHFs1vrhvsNf1aDCmbpXkjzLm4G6yCb7YyVD/1771619001549.gif)
Gracias por preferir nuestro canal. Recuerda que debes tomar descansos de calidad, hidratarte y alimentarte sanamente. Hasta la próxima y si deseas una rutina en particular, en los comentarios la puedes solicitar. >Thank you for choosing our channel. Remember to take quality breaks, hydrate and eat healthy. Until next time and if you want a particular routine, you can ask for it in the comments. #

body.body: Let me extract emotion completely and give you my investor's eye. HBD and HIVE are both cryptocurrency. One is worth more and offers a far better return. HBD. To get that return, a person needs no solid stake or acknowledgement of governance. As an investor, I would opt to purchase the one that delivers a better yield. The only problem with that crypto, is I can only get it on a foreign exchange and then have to have an account on Hive where I would put it in savings. Or, I could jump through a bunch of hoops, then swap it once I get the desired amount of HIVE to on the internal exchange. Once a month, without caring what goes on, I collect and compound. Not bad. Kind of a hassle though, not sure I even want to do all that when I can get that same 15% way easier on another chain. What would be great is if I could have the compounding happen every three seconds like HIVE. HIVE has way better liquidity, if only the rate was higher, I might actually care a little more about this Hive chain and see what it was about but, naw, three percent isn't worth my time. I can get better profit from buying Nvidia or something. And I don't want to do that. Guess I'll just go stake some DOT with the quickness and get over twice that return. My investor's eye says, HBD and HIVE are not worth the trouble, and makes sense why they are barely in the top 1000. Used to be top ten, wasn't it?

body.title: Adaptation Makes Us Stronger
body.body:
What is the greatest power in life, money, power, education? I think the ability to adapt is the greatest power of a person. Life never stays the same the situation I am in today can change tomorrow. Jobs change, cities change, relationships change, even my own thoughts change. People who can adapt to change survive and those who cannot fall behind.

I look at my own life. Once upon a time I had a peaceful life with my family. Later I had to be alone for work. At first it was very difficult to cook, shop, and take all the responsibilities myself, but gradually I realized that this is what made me strong. If I had not been able to accept change then I might not be who I am today.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrarhat/AKRBVrLw3qnPpDV2xEdzcvcEzvTdnLTGNqoMC9KZediYyjMLmS3F381Ci8KaH4F.png)

[Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/share/c1e38641f529)


Look at nature too. When a storm comes a tree that stands strong often breaks but a tree that bends a little and bends survives. In life too, it is not possible to be strong only when it is difficult. Sometimes being flexible is the real strength. Many times we cling to old habits, old thoughts, and old relationships. We think that these are our security but change is not something to be afraid of it is necessary to learn. When we go to a new place we learn something new and mix with new people and get new ideas.

Adaptation does not mean losing our identity but using our inner strength in new situations is a sign of mental maturity. Today's world is changing very quickly in technology work patterns, society, everything. If you want to survive here you do not need to have knowledge alone. Change often hurts. A new beginning means uncertainty but new opportunities are hidden within this uncertainty. Many times we do not realize that the change we are afraid of may open the door to the biggest improvement in our lives.

The most important thing is that adaptation increases our confidence because once we understand that we can adapt to changing situations the fear of the future decreases a lot. Then we know that we can handle whatever comes. In the end life is on the side of those who know how to change. Because change does not stop, we should not stop either.

body.body: Usually I don't take the road beside the graveyard at nights but as I'm in a rush so gathered the courage to take that road, and guess what, ***\

*** and when I screamed, I got another voice which seemed familiar to me in response to my scream. I just walked too fast to cross the road within a few seconds and went home. 

I was sweating even though it's winter. Everyone at home got tense on seeing me like that. I was falling short in breathing, and it took almost half an hour for me to be normal and start speaking. I shared everything with my family, and they assured me, saying it's all my imagination, nothing of that sort happens, and I must have mistaken. But I know I'm not, I have seen someone, weird movements, even a voice which seemed familiar, but I can't recall. 


![david-werbrouck-5GwLlb-_UYk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23u5WwgpY4hPJADro1hC8mRqpbcEJxgCB8f383gUQuXp3yCsC5WezcMtXs28vSLmz7aZG.jpg)

[📸 David Werbrouck](https://unsplash.com/photos/grayscale-photo-of-person-running-in-panel-paintings-5GwLlb-_UYk)

The next morning, I got a fever, pretty badly, and couldn't get out of bed for the next two days. Even my thoughts and imagination were filled with the scenes from that night, nobody is willing to take it like that, everyone is saying that it's my imagination or something else. I am mistaken, and so. 

Upon hearing my situation and everything, one of uncle laughted at me and told me to join him, and he would showcase the actual story. I was like, ***\

*** He just laughed at me and walked away, saying he would go for a walk with me tonight. After a few hours, two of my cousins joined me. They were smiling as if I were a joker, and it pissed me off even more. 

In the evening, we went out for a walk at the village market. We kept walking by the riverbank, had tea at a tiny tea stall under a big banyan tree, it's a very gigantic one, as the moon was shining so brightly that the tree looked marvelous. I thought they would go towards the graveyard road, but they didn't, kinda changed their mind upon seeing something which they didn't share with me. I was feeling like they were gonna make fun of me now out of that story, but that wasn't any joke or anything of that sort to make fun of me. It wasn't any sort of my imagination or assumption that they didn't believe in me and kinda leg pulling. I got angry and didn't say much. 

We were outside for a long time, I forgot about that, and we were roaming here and there as usual. It's 11.00 am, and it's time to return home. They decided to take that graveyard road. I was a little bit afraid. To be honest, I have gone through this road a lot with them; I never felt anything like that, but after that day, I was a little bit panicked. 

After some time, we are in front of that graveyard, exactly at the same position, but nothing like that. They stopped and asked me what I saw on that. I got angry. Is this the right place and time to ask those questions? They held my hands tightly and asked again. I said what I saw hurriedly. 

Two of my cousins asked me to wait, and they left towards the graveyard; another road goes to the back. After two minutes, I could see the shadow, exactly that one. I can remember the movements as it wasn't normal, not one but three, two are my cousins, and then that exact same voice that I heard that day. Initially, I was shocked and now perplexed about what's happening. My uncle pulled my hand and took me to the backside of the graveyard. What I witnessed then made me laugh as well. 

We have a mentally unstable guy in our village; he is homeless, and he stays here and there. His current staying location is this, a broken shop, and he lives beneath this shed. From that other side of the graveyard, you can't see clearly, but under the light of the lampposts, we can see only the shadow. On that day, I heard his voice; now I can remember, and that's why it seemed familiar. He repeats what someone calls him or says something. His walk and movements arent normal as he is physically weak too. Now I understand everything, and kinda relaxed, and that's the reason why they were laughing upon hearing my story, and here I am, got sick for two days. 

***If they hadn't heard or shown me this practically, it would have been left as a paranormal incident in my life titles as the \

body.title: Kova Network’s Liquid Compute Model — Why \
Billing Might Break the Cloud Cartel?
body.body:
PVM just did a deep dive into Kova Network and explored the decentralized compute platform quietly making Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure look… expensive.

Web3 should evolve from inefficient tech that is slightly stuck in 2015. I spent serious time inside the infrastructure. Deployed real apps. Ran AI models. Monitored billing. Stress-tested compute. Tried to break it

.What I found wasn’t another DePIN project running on vibes and roadmap poetry. It’s production-grade infrastructure solving a very real, very expensive problem. Let’s get into it.

The $500 Billion Headache! Picture this scenario... It’s 3AM and an AI founder refreshes their cloud dashboard. He paid $18,000 so far this month!
The painful part?

Their GPUs actually ran maybe eight hours a day. The rest of the time they just… existed. Idle. Expensive digital paperweights. But the bill doesn’t care about utilization.

Traditional cloud doesn’t charge you for what you use. It charges you for what you rent... 24/7... every single second. Meanwhile, across town, someone’s NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 is asleep.

The Cloud Waste Nobody Puts on the Billboard! A $1,600 GPU sitting unused for 16 hours a day while its owner works, eats, and scrolls. Zero yield and zero contribution!

That disconnect is idle enterprise GPUs on one side, idle consumer GPUs on the other is exactly the inefficiency KovaNetwork was built to attack. Available exactly when needed, in exactly the amount required, for exactly the time used.


Cloud computing is a $500B+ market dominated by three giants: AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. Here’s the quiet part: a massive percentage of GPU capacity sits idle at any given time.

Startups overprovision to survive traffic spikes, then spend most of the month paying for capacity they’re not using. Train an AI model for four to six hours? You’re still covering the other 18–20.

Traditional cloud optimizes for revenue per instance not for your burn rate. @KovaNetwork introduces what it calls “Liquid Compute.” The idea is simple but kind of radical: compute should behave like water.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnFqxKmTuxUJR7c5D2jXrtMSQgMEq9jxzXA6ghKCbA3F/image.png)


Instead of renting entire instances, you access fractional resources. Need 2.5 vCPUs for three hours? That’s what you get. Partial GPU slices? Also fine. Even half a vCPU if that’s your workload. No overprovisioning gymnastics.

Then there’s the billing model. Not per hour.. never rounded up... just per second. If your model trains for two hours and 37 minutes, that’s what you pay for.

The concept feels obvious ... which is usually a sign the old system has been overcharging us for a while. Under the hood, payments stream automatically through blockchain-based smart contracts.

As compute is consumed, providers are paid proportionally. No middlemen padding margins. No “mystery” line items. No invoice-induced heart palpitations on a Sunday night.

Deployment runs through Kova’s Service Definition Language (SDL), which feels like docker-compose grew up and discovered Web3. Infrastructure is defined as code, cleanly and predictably.

Kova handles persistent volumes, snapshots, and automatic checkpointing. If a provider drops offline mid-job, workloads resume. That’s not a demo trick. That’s table stakes for production.

The Reality Check! In testing, I deployed multiple AI models, spun up web servers and databases, tested persistent storage, verified billing transparency, and compared costs against traditional providers.

Deployments completed within minutes. Billing matched exact usage. No idle overcharges. No rounding games. No weird discrepancies that require a spreadsheet and emotional support. It just… tracked consumption.

Which feels revolutionary only because we’ve normalized paying for capacity we don’t use. The Economic Shift? Here’s the real unlock! Traditional cloud you pay for rented capacity.

With Kova you pay for consumed compute. That one change rewires incentives. For AI teams training intermittently. For builders running side projects. For startups guarding runway like it’s oxygen.

Costs align with reality. On the supply side, idle GPUs become productive assets. Your gaming rig could technically function as a micro data center while you sleep.

Not bad for something that used to just render dragons and lose ranked matches. The Bigger Picture? AI demand is exploding. GPU access is getting tighter and more expensive.

Centralized cloud models were never designed for this kind of sustained, global compute hunger. Kova proposes something different: programmable, decentralized, fractional, per-second settled compute sourced from a distributed network of hardware providers.

Instead of idle machines collecting dust across the world, capacity becomes liquid — monetizable and efficiently allocated. Is it perfect? No. Is it risk-free? Also no.

Is it early? Definitely. But it works... and that’s the part that matters. The cloud model hasn’t meaningfully evolved in over a decade. Liquid compute challenges the default assumptions around billing, access, and supply.

The real question isn’t whether decentralized compute grows. It’s how quickly AI demand forces the industry to rethink what “fair” billing actually looks like.

For builders. For GPU owners. For early adopters. This is one to watch closely. And maybe one to deploy on before the rest of the market catches up.
If your into GPU bonanza... this is your project!

body.title: From Light Comedy to Serious Action: \
Review
body.body: ** and quickly realized it was not a series but a full movie. I had been mistaking it for the series **\

**, which stars the same lead actor. I have not seen either of them before, yet somehow I assumed they were the same project and it's not that their titles were even similar, the face  was. I honestly do not know why I thought that until I downloaded this one to finally watch.

![MV5BNWRkMTAzOGYtOTE4Ny00Yzg3LWExYzAtNDVhNjJjYmIwMTRkXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23xyZe5kHzSUAAhsHXmZDBn9Yzpgixnvhzu9HWeMc68QvJSZqcTTprAzMafBL3fD4hFJb.jpg)

Since his performances in **\

**, this is the only movie I have seen featuring **Kim Woo-bin**. Surprisingly, I did not experience any deja vu while watching him in this role. Every side of him in this story felt completely new to me, which brought surprises and I appreciated that. I had a good time seeing it, which is why I am sharing my thoughts on it.\n\n**\

** is a 1 hour 48 minute action film that leans heavily into martial arts, but it also blends in moments that might make you think it is a comedy at first. The opening has a lighter tone, almost playful. However, the story quickly shifts into something more serious. Mainly, the movie is about teamwork, taking responsibility, and protecting others even when lives are at risk. It moves from fun to intense almost too easily. ![MV5BYzQxODc5ZTEtNWI4NC00NjU0LTkyNmUtMjdlZDhlN2Y1ZmNiXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23xySdJdcDf3f6hnDAs41HK6K2Tzhdu85oX5riPTChqQoSRJy5FFzbFTKtS6a7zPHsYFD.jpg) *The film centers on the partnership between **Kim Woo-bin**’s character and **Kim Sung-kyun**. Before they begin working together as probation officers, their personalities are clearly different. **Kim Woo-bin**’s character comes across as energetic, physically skilled, and somewhat carefree. On the other hand, **Kim Sung-kyun**’s character feels more grounded and experienced, someone who understands the weight of the job. After they start working together, their dynamic changes. There is growth, mutual respect, and a stronger sense of purpose that I truly admired. Their teamwork becomes the backbone of the story.* For a movie that runs for less than two hours, the pacing felt balanced as nothing seemed rushed. The story takes time to show both the professional responsibilities of monitoring criminals on probation and the personal life of the main character. That balance made the narrative feel realistic, it showed different sides of life without overwhelming me or the audience. ![MV5BNmI0OTYzYjUtYWFmZi00OGVjLTlmNTEtY2JhNGExOTlhYzU0XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/Eo1wvEosUkeih97kMtuD8A5ZU8aGQYb4YcP8CnJHFW898qiRwp7hSfuz7zK91ifhgjf.jpg) The action scenes were intense. At some points, I found myself wanting to skip ahead or close my eyes because I was genuinely worried that the main character might lose his life. The tension felt real enough that I feared the story would end with his sacrifice being labeled a noble act for the country. I would not have liked that ending at all. I especially appreciated the comeback scene where he teams up with his friends to finally capture the criminal harming young children. Those parts of the movie were difficult for me to watch because they stirred something deep within me that I do not often talk about, but I'm working on. The emotional weight of those scenes added depth to the film, made it relatable. https://youtu.be/WNkGz6aKFvk?si=lWMMzVyge28V1Ow4
Overall, I enjoyed Officer Black Belt. The ending felt fitting, especially the moment when the little girl thanked the hero for making her world safe again. I would rate it 8.5 out of 10. I recommend it to anyone who prefers action-driven stories with minimal romance and less dialogue. It is not usually my type of movie, but I still enjoyed it.
**Images are from Imdb.**

body.body:
Interesting video.  My son has been talking to me about the declining Yen.  Tried to explain how monetary policy was accelerating the Yen decline.  Your blog fills in some of the background to his discussion.

Looked up immigration as a possible way to address the population decline.  From the [Harvard International Review:](https://hir.harvard.edu/improved-immigration-japan/)

> While the Japanese government and people might not be against immigrants, Japan could provide them with better support. Helping immigrants integrate into the Japanese society and economy is essential for not only recruitment, but also for the wellbeing and economic security of immigrants. These goals, in turn, are critical to solving Japan’s population crisis and consequent labor shortages. Immigrants could play a pivotal role in funding the ever-expanding social security net and fueling the country’s economy—if they are given the opportunity and assistance to succeed.

Can't help thinking about our own immigration issues in the U.S. One way we have escaped declining populations experienced by other countries is by  receiving so many immigrants.  How do the anti-immigrant people hope to compensate for the loss of this population going forward, if their anti-immigrant aspirations are realized?  

From the U.S. Census:
>Population growth in the United States has slowed significantly with an increase of only 1.8 million, or 0.5%, between July 1, 2024, and July 1, 2025, according to the new Vintage 2025 population estimates released today by the U.S. Census Bureau.

and

>“The slowdown in U.S. population growth is largely due to a historic decline in net international migration, which dropped from 2.7 million to 1.3 million in the period from July 2024 through June 2025,” said Christine Hartley, assistant division chief for Estimates and Projections at the Census Bureau. “With births and deaths remaining relatively stable compared to the prior year, the sharp decline in net international migration is the main reason for the slower growth rate we see today.”


From  the [Economic Policy Institute](https://www.epi.org/publication/the-u-s-born-labor-force-will-shrink-over-the-next-decade-achieving-historically-normal-gdp-growth-rates-will-be-impossible-unless-immigration-flows-are-sustained/):
>Any decline in labor force growth necessarily leads to a decline in the rate of growth of gross domestic product (GDP). GDP is the product of the number of hours worked in an economy multiplied by productivity (the average amount of output generated in an hour of work). If the number of work hours falls because the labor force shrinks, this essentially translates one-for-one into slower aggregate growth. Policymakers who do not want to see the pace of GDP growth shrink relative to the past history of U.S. growth really only have one option: allowing larger flows of immigration. Absent this, other policies to boost the U.S. labor force—while they might be wise along many margins—will not restore overall GDP growth to anywhere near its historic pace. In the rest of this policy brief, we lay out some of the larger trends in U.S. labor force growth and the implications of population aging for the future path of the labor force and economic growth.

I realized after I wrote this argument that it's good material for a blog, but I'm not in the mood to argue with anyone.  Just interested in the subject and wanted to share that.

I want to make other plushies I saw because they're so cute, and we can use them as keychains on our bags, purses, and backpacks._ #

You'll really like the final results of this cute little frog plushie ✨🐸._ # ---

![IMG_20260218_202336_180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/Eo8UJZrWeej3GXqtHJjGP9NcVo5HkMW4Eb8M8Xvjd5dRRYvmgcV2QrwyKsRmXcjmQvT.jpg)

![IMG_20260218_202608_752 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzuvMD9aDGKDhsTE1FZsWdU8UYG5wN8AmRDxF8sSi9Cv/IMG_20260218_202608_752%20(2).jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>Una vez con los patrones a la mano procedemos a colocar el fieltro doblado a la mitad y vamos a estar marcando nuestro cuerpo de la rana con ayuda de un color que se vea en el fieltro para que se nos haga fácil ver por dónde vamos a cortar ya que tenemos que dejar centímetros de costuras,procedemos a cortar el cuerpito de nuestra rana y empezaremos a coser con punto zig zag a mano que se los enseño como hacer en el siguiente paso. # > ### _Step 01_ > _Once we have the patterns in hand, we proceed to place the felt folded in half and we are going to mark our frog's body with the help of a color that shows up on the felt so that it is easy to see where we are going to cut since we have to leave centimeters for seams, we proceed to cut the little body of our frog and we will start sewing with a zigzag stitch by hand, which I will show you how to do in the next step._ ---
![IMG_20260218_202442_283.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaP6bkQPhQuT3jT8qZuVKQs9vf9KCM9oqSCeBu861qNp2/IMG_20260218_202442_283.jpg)
![IMG_20260218_202514_092.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQSwY8GzwBc9sKT8PS6Xpch1ENuWb7eEYLnG781tWAPVB/IMG_20260218_202514_092.jpg)
![IMG_20260218_202525_975.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNjuyAkCpdqTMvxWNyztfthJQt6uUAckhGaVQwJVCEd1m/IMG_20260218_202525_975.jpg)
### _Paso 02_

>Para hacer la puntada falsa overlock para coser el borde del cuerpo de la rana vamos a estar tomando la aguja con el hilo y lo vamos a insertar de arriba hacia abajo dejando hilo para luego venirnos con la aguja pasar por el frente del hilo sobrante que hemos dejado pasaremos la agua por el frente como les acabo de decir y tiramos de el.Asi hacemos cada puntada por todo el borde del cuerpo de la rana. # > ### _Step 02_ > _To make the faux overlock stitch to sew the edge of the frog's body, we'll take the needle with the thread and insert it from top to bottom, leaving a stub of thread. Then, bringing the needle back, we'll pass it through the front of the stub of thread we just left, and pull it through. We'll do this for each stitch all along the edge of the frog's body._ ---
![IMG_20260218_204834_476 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFa8UFvk3ZsbLHL3yfEMfeDPvfkieRUkySnU8X6APAXo/IMG_20260218_204834_476%20(1).jpg)
![IMG_20260219_095724_475.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXKye3vpYVtrNoa8vNYUBPhFa61vX9qS2fLqneWJL6sCx/IMG_20260219_095724_475.jpg)
![IMG_20260219_100046_276.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfEkQ8zS5Vedo4KQSdC7qneVg2HWWybUU34TkRybLqccX/IMG_20260219_100046_276.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>Cuando estemos finalizando de coser con esta puntada en el cuerpo no se nos debe olvidar que debemos dejar una pequeña abertura para insertar nuestro relleno ,así vamos rellenando completamente el peluche y volvemos a sellar el horificio que hemos dejado con costura falso overlock nuevamente,le hacemos los ojitos y la boca con hilo negro. # > ### _Step 03_ > _When we are finishing sewing with this stitch on the body, we must not forget to leave a small opening to insert our stuffing. We then completely fill the plush toy and seal the hole we left with a faux overlock stitch again. Finally, we make the eyes and mouth with black thread._ ---
![IMG_20260219_102126_887.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSvQiZogHY7aTwmmKAxW5RSgg89ifZfoHqGnRTZ6652mM/IMG_20260219_102126_887.jpg)
![IMG_20260219_104105_839.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZs6fZsM1n4n7oJyxDBWuCFS94cM2bczhq6EfarFXzNVZ/IMG_20260219_104105_839.jpg)
![IMG_20260219_104447_499.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWxcKpSn21bq3kQCdTxUt7H9CHeZXzWpKwMZuphNYtxM/IMG_20260219_104447_499.jpg)
### _Paso 04_

>Como último paso decidí hacerle unos pantaloncillos , corté dos piezas de la parte del pantaloncillo las cosí por los lados y luego arriba y en la parte del ruedo,para evitar que se le cayeran 🤭he usado aguja con hilo nilón transparente y lo cosí por toda la parte de la cintura del peluche,con esto lo hemos terminado. # > ### _Step 04_ > _As a final step, I decided to make him some shorts. I cut two pieces of the shorts part, sewed them along the sides, then at the top and at the hem to prevent them from falling off 🤭. I used a needle with transparent nylon thread and sewed it all around the waist of the plushie. With this, we have finished it._ ---
![@anne002_20250723_195546_0000 (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/23wCdinhSgLNJhC1MzACcJBgZQGwSXbEsM7qTb4zsSLNzdJwNBmn8xnyoGNTdh1ai6GFa.png)

In a world that never stops moving, finding a pocket of silence is a revolutionary act. 📖✨ For me, there is no sanctuary quite like the corner of a quiet café, the aroma of freshly roasted beans, and the weight of a good book in my hands.

This isn't just about caffeine; it's about slowing down. It’s in these small rituals where we find the clarity needed to face the week. A cup of coffee is a conversation with oneself, and a book is an open door to another world. Today, I’m choosing to be present, one sip at a time. ☕🌿

body.title: Sometime You End Up Winning A Battle You Supposed To Lose
body.body:
Greetings Splinterland Summoners

Welcome to my weekly Splinterlands post. This time I want to share a funny condition in some battles, where you should lose it but somehow someway you end up winning the battle. 

I am not talking about win trading or rigged match where the other party intentionally forfeit it by setting up a lousy line up, but it is the battle that you believe you are losing, you get countered, or you just fucked up in any possible way, but you still end up winning in a weird way.

Everyone who have played splinterlands for months might have experienced it several times. So let's jump in to this battle that I pick as the reference.

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tSL4fHkaSE5XxpNHkPK32zBZVVPkYgL4cjLfWVew7pEg86kLBaV6fmrhtRvVjNxV6Ti.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_17541baacc3bd53c93d55791f54b16a7?ref=dewabrata
)

I pick this battle from modern Silver Rank battle. This was one of the battle that I had no clue what to deploy due to some limitation in my line up. When the battle started and I saw my opponent's line up, I knew instantly that I got fucked up here.

This was exactly a battle I would click skip battle and expected a lose, which later it turned out to be a win. So let me explain here why it's all mess up here.

#### 1. 35 mana cap and I did not have any idea how to get 6 units

It was weird that time, but I really had no idea how to develop 6 units team for that battle. Maybe I became stupid and got fixated with the sharky in front and that sandworm wannabe on the behind. 

I believe some of you can understand what I am saying above, sometime we have this brain freeze and make our mind so dull and have no idea what to do lol.

##### 2. Modifier exploitation

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoCbLfFvFnd4YoEr2dC9sjiKYkrRTaJDhNTcuUJVAo81WTZmjptfNtN7So7V2atQVCb.png

Collateral Damage is one of the modifier that I dislike a lot. It gives a feel that you need to have the hard hitters only because everytime you move you will hurt your own allies.

I forfeit that thought and decide to play as if it was no modifier at all, but look at my opponent units there...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23yd5qySFWGvMWBzigj2CFTAA6Xkas5sHegzQtTZoZDVQ74NMcFcQCRCPJ2KY93mGA79w.png

He put in two units with painforge ability. He was really all in for the modifier or ruleset. Why didn't I do the same? well I did not have those two in my line up. I haven't got any units with painforge ability in my line up that day.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoyM76Cj3XAA6gizH2tGzuGThzVm6eQfREcP3yGE3GeTiZjmVVY7TT8i9dssqGyvYpy.png

To put it worse, they even prepared for the damage delivered by the reckless ability from the collateral damage modifier. They had that Deep Delver, with the corrupted healing ability. It was the perfect ability to recover everyone in the line up, because everyone were definitely taking collateral damage.

#### 3. My Attack Was Anticipated

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tm8zoP5CnigTgCTcQepg3ZKKpSjVNbtnkMgacbBsqvyhzkoBGENNuxtyuSaZMCUot6f.png

I brought Chaos Evoler and Ujurak Elder was my magic attackers. I needed second type attack incase they had a unit with shield ability which would ate my melee attacks.

But it turned out their tank had prepared my magic attack with that void ability.

Everything looked bad for my side, as if all were wrapped. I did not come with a good line up, my opponent prepared everything for the rulesets, my meta got anticipated... Definitely it looked bad and maybe the worst.

---

#### THE RESULT

I would not share a battle that I lost, so you could expect this was a win. But see the process and you can say some opinion and comments later.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tkp95hjtmXRTd7JQoDYkAdB1THmSesR4EGHMh1WJTYYT4qjxKW4iNFHsx6HpH3N8kd9.png

As expected, the first round was a bloodbath and my team lost two units. They lost a unit, so it was still a net loss to my side.

3 units vs 5 units, and 2 of my units had 1 health point only lol. I could not see it could go worse.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tbPKtmwB2qXBdY8HmkpNrvviaYo5r2wejoVdLkVDXwPGG7wxEGnTBigQgZTqzifweQW.png

Maybe because it could not go worse, it stayed like that. The third round the condition became 1 vs 4. I had the last unit there Grove Doomblade or what I often called as Sandworm wannabe lol.

But this was the interesting one, somehow they got crumbled due to the reckless ability.

Lejos de casa, en un país diferente, en una ciudad en el extranjero, se oye hablar un idioma diferente al acostumbrado, un hombre pedalea en su bicicleta por la avenida principal para ir a donde lo lleva el viento. Su nombre es Jack, un estadounidense que ha dejado atrás su hogar para emprender una aventura de auto-descubrimiento. Con cada giro del pedal, la bandera que carga consigo ondea en el viento. La bandera de Estados Unidos ondea orgullosa desde el manillar de su bicicleta. Para Jack, esa bandera es un símbolo de libertad, esperanza y es la promesa de un nuevo comienzo y un sueño que puede hacerse realidad. Cada vez que el viento refrescaba su rostro, siente añoranza, siente que su espíritu norteamericano se renueva. La gente que transita por la calle lo observa con curiosidad, algunos lo saludan, y otros desvían la mirada para ignorarlo; pero eso no le importa. Porque Jack lleva consigo una parte de su hogar. Mientras recorre las calles, su mente viaja a su infancia. Esos recuerdos lo alimentan en este nuevo mundo lleno de desafíos. A veces, siente el peso de la soledad, pero al mirar su bandera ondear, renace la valentía en su interior. Jack se detiene en una plaza, observa a la gente que pasa, personas completamente ajenas a su lucha interna. Con un profundo suspiro, levanta la bandera y la agita suavemente. En ese instante, entiende que su esencia no está atada a un lugar geográfico. Más bien, está en el viento que acaricia su piel y cruza fronteras. Lejos de casa, pero más arraigado que nunca, Jack sigue pedaleando, llevando la bandera de la libertad por doquier.

Ayer amanecí con una misión clara: baño urgente para los niños peludos de la casa. Anunciaron la entrada de otro frente frío al país y yo sabía que no podía seguir posponiéndolo más… aunque ellos llevaban una buena temporada “esquivando” el champú como si tuvieran radar anti-baño incorporado. Ya era hora de poner orden.


Temprano logré encontrar champú para perros en un puesto de productos naturales. Fue casi como hallar oro. El vendedor, muy seguro de su producto, me explicó que era antipulgas, antibacteriano e ideal para pieles sensibles. Está hecho a base del árbol del neem, y eso me dio confianza.


El neem es una maravilla natural. Tiene propiedades insecticidas suaves, lo que ayuda a repeler pulgas y otros parásitos sin ser agresivo con la piel. También es antifúngico y antibacteriano, así que protege contra infecciones cutáneas. Además, calma la picazón, reduce la inflamación y es perfecto para perros con piel sensible o que se rascan mucho. Básicamente, naturaleza haciendo su trabajo sin químicos fuertes.


En la tarde empecé por el más complicado: Mordelón. Su pelaje abundante es una tarea seria, casi como lavar una alfombra con sentimientos. Pero debo decir que se portó mejor de lo esperado. Se dejó bañar sin protestar, resignado, como diciendo: “Si esto me toca, que sea rápido, humana”.


Lo más gracioso fue cuando terminé y quedó prácticamente inmóvil, tieso, con esa mirada de traición absoluta. Parecía estatua viviente. Yo no podía parar de reírme. Pero en cuanto se secó, volvió a ser el mismo de siempre: juguetón, expresivo y feliz. Eso sí, le tocó peinado… y esa parte no le gusta nada. Me mira como si estuviera atentando contra su dignidad perruna. Pero quedó precioso, brillante y con un olor delicioso.


Luego vino el turno de Chiqui. Ya yo sabía que aquello sería misión especial, así que llamé refuerzos: mamá al rescate. Y menos mal. Aunque tiene poco pelaje y eso agiliza el proceso, su energía compensa cualquier ventaja.


Cuando terminé de bañarla y me dispuse a secarla con toda mi paciencia, en un movimiento ninja se subió encima de mí. Resultado: yo completamente mojada, oliendo a perro recién bañado… que no es el mismo olor del champú, sino esa versión “aroma natural húmedo intenso” que no aparece en ninguna etiqueta.


Al final, los dos quedaron hermosos, limpios y perfumados. Aunque sé que para ellos cambiar su olor natural puede ser estresante, porque el olor es parte de su identidad, ahora están protegidos y listos para recibir el frente frío bien bañaditos.


Mañana les aplicaré el veneno antipulgas para reforzar la protección y evitar enfermedades. Porque más allá de las risas y el caos acuático, todo esto lo hago por su bienestar.


Y mientras los veía dormir en la noche, limpios, calentitos y tranquilos, pensé que estos pequeños rituales domésticos también son amor. Amor que huele a neem, a toalla húmeda, a secador improvisado… y a hogar. 


# English Version 



Yesterday I woke up with a clear mission: urgent bath time for the furry kids of the house. A new cold front was announced, and I knew I couldn’t postpone it any longer… even though they had been successfully “avoiding” bath time for quite a while, as if they had a built-in anti-bath radar. It was time to restore order.


Early in the morning I managed to find dog shampoo at a natural products stand. It felt like striking gold. The seller confidently explained that it was anti-flea, antibacterial, and ideal for sensitive skin. It’s made from neem tree extract, which immediately gave me peace of mind.


Neem is a natural wonder. It has gentle insecticidal properties that help repel fleas and other parasites without being harsh on the skin. It’s also antifungal and antibacterial, protecting against skin infections. On top of that, it soothes itching, reduces inflammation, and is perfect for dogs with sensitive skin or those who tend to scratch a lot. Basically, nature doing its job without strong chemicals.


In the afternoon I started with the most challenging one: Mordelón. His thick coat is serious business, almost like washing a carpet with feelings. But I have to admit, he behaved better than expected. He let me bathe him without protesting, resigned, as if saying, “If this is happening, let’s just get it over with, human.”


The funniest part was when I finished and he stood almost completely still, stiff, with that betrayed look in his eyes. He looked like a living statue. I couldn’t stop laughing. But as soon as he dried, he was back to his usual self, playful, expressive, and happy. Of course, he had to endure brushing, and he does not appreciate that at all. He looks at me like I’m attacking his canine dignity. Still, he looked beautiful, shiny, and smelled amazing.


Then it was Chiqui’s turn. I already knew this would require backup, so I called my mom for help. Good thing I did. Even though she has less fur, which makes things quicker, her energy makes up for any advantage.


Once I finished bathing her and started drying her with all my patience, she made a lightning-fast move and jumped on me. The result: me completely soaked, smelling like freshly bathed dog. And let’s be honest, that’s not the same as the shampoo scent. It’s more like intense natural wet dog fragrance that doesn’t appear on any label.


In the end, they both looked beautiful, clean, and fragrant. I know that changing their natural scent can stress them out, since smell is part of their identity. But now they’re protected and ready to welcome the cold front nice and clean.


Tomorrow I’ll apply their anti-flea treatment to reinforce the protection and prevent diseases. Because beyond the laughs and the watery chaos, I do all of this for their well-being.


And as I watched them sleep that night, clean, warm, and peaceful, I realized that these small domestic rituals are also love. Love that smells like neem, damp towels, improvised drying sessions, and home.

body.title: Crete: The Mountain Soul
body.body: > Some places stay in your memory, while others become part of your soul. Crete is one of those for me.

> I have visited this island many times, but that very first journey, back in 2010, left an indelible impression that has not faded with time. Everything seemed to align perfectly then: the rugged nature, ancient culture, living mythology, and unique cuisine created an ideal harmony. When talking to friends, I invariably recount that first trip; the feelings and quiet nostalgia for this place are simply too strong. And this remains true despite having traveled almost all over Greece in the years since, seeing its many different facets.

> It was the Cretan landscapes that set my internal standard for travel. Not just the mountains or the sea in isolation, but their complex interplay: high mountain plateaus where time stands still, narrow gorges where the coolness lingers, and villages situated on the rocks. The roads hold a special place in my memory — endless switchbacks that demand attention, yet with every turn reward you with another stunning view.
> Whether exploring Madeira in Portugal or the Lycian coast of Türkiye, I inevitably compared them to Crete, trying to find that same scale and depth of experience.
> Today, I would like to share a piece of my inner world, where this island has settled forever. In pictures, of course. 📸

“Eroding”这个词让我感受到一种无形的力量在不断消磨。就像时间在我们的生活中悄然流逝，一些曾经坚固的东西渐渐变得脆弱。无论是自然界中岩石的侵蚀，还是情感中关系的淡化，都是一种失去的过程。这种变化让我意识到，珍惜当下的重要性，及时维护和呵护身边的人和事。面对侵蚀，我们更需要勇敢和付出，才能保留那份珍贵的美好。

body.title: Halloween beauty session with my stepdaughter!/ ¡Sesión de belleza de Halloween con mi hijastra!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXj3cKDGBSEygTfDkBSYDiSA8EkNgqA3wtE1Q4fBg3BM/1771696090687.jpg)

Happy Saturday blog friends, how are you? Today is a relaxing Saturday for me with my stepdaughter at home. She's obsessed with skincare, and her skin is beautiful. The problem is, she'd like to pass this passion on to me and her dad, ha ha ha. Today, we ran some errands at various stores, and she wanted to buy some very special beauty masks for the afternoon, to do at home. She found these Halloween-themed face masks, even though they were a little out of season; they were on sale, and she wanted to buy them right away! They're really fun masks, and she obviously wanted us to try them right away. First, we all got comfortable—she and I in our pajamas, my husband in his sweatshirt. First, she cleansed our faces with micellar water and toner, and she also applied my face cream, which I use in the evening. Her dad, however, refused, saying that his beard would make everything stick.

> Feliz sábado, amigos blogueros, ¿qué tal? Hoy es un sábado relajante para mí con mi hijastra en casa. Está obsesionada con el cuidado de la piel y tiene una piel preciosa. El problema es que le gustaría contagiarnos esta pasión a mí y a su padre, ja, ja, ja. Hoy hicimos recados en varias tiendas y quería comprar unas mascarillas de belleza muy especiales para la tarde, para hacer en casa. Encontró estas mascarillas de Halloween, aunque estaban un poco fuera de temporada; estaban en oferta, ¡y quería comprarlas enseguida! Son mascarillas muy divertidas, y obviamente quería que las probáramos enseguida. Primero, nos pusimos cómodas: ella y yo en pijama, mi marido en sudadera. Primero, nos limpió la cara con agua micelar y tónico, y también me aplicó la crema facial, que uso por la noche. Su padre, sin embargo, se negó, diciendo que con la barba se le pegaría todo.

Then, of course, it was time for the masks! First, it was my husband's turn. She chose a kind of Frankenstein mask for him, really funny, it looked like a cross between Frankenstein and the Hulk. She adjusted it on his face with some difficulty because of his beard. We had a lot of laughs when she put the mask on him, especially at the noises he made, as he wasn't used to the cold weather of face masks. Then, of course, it was my turn. She chose a Mexican-style Halloween mask for me. I don't remember the name of that type of mask (I'm asking the Hispanic community for help, you surely know it). She also tried hard to put it on me, using scissors to shape it perfectly. It was a little cold, and then, of course, we had to stand still. Finally, she used a mirror to put on her own mask, a scary pumpkin. We were truly terrifying, beautiful, and terrifying! And then we all had to stand still to make the masks work, and it was difficult because we kept laughing while looking at each other. It was a lovely home spa and our skin felt so much better and clearer afterwards, thanks to my stepdaughter!!!


> Y, por supuesto, ¡llegó la hora de las máscaras! Primero, le tocó el turno a mi esposo. Ella eligió una especie de máscara de Frankenstein para él, muy graciosa, parecía una mezcla entre Frankenstein y Hulk. Se la ajustó a la cara con cierta dificultad debido a su barba. Nos reímos mucho cuando le puso la máscara, sobre todo por los ruidos que hacía, ya que no estaba acostumbrado al frío de las máscaras. Luego, por supuesto, me tocó a mí. Ella eligió una máscara de Halloween estilo mexicano para mí. No recuerdo el nombre de ese tipo de máscara (estoy pidiendo ayuda a la comunidad hispana, seguro que la conocen). También se esforzó mucho para ponérmela, usando tijeras para darle la forma perfecta. Hacía un poco de frío, y luego, claro, tuvimos que quedarnos quietos. Finalmente, usó un espejo para ponerse su propia máscara, una calabaza aterradora. ¡Estábamos realmente terroríficos, hermosos y aterradores! Y luego todos tuvimos que quedarnos quietos para que las máscaras funcionaran, y fue difícil porque no paramos de reírnos mientras nos mirábamos. Fue un spa en casa encantador y nuestra piel se sintió mucho mejor y más clara después, ¡gracias a mi hijastra!

> Saludos a toda la comunidad de #SWC y #Hive 🙋🏻‍♂️🤸🏻‍♂️. Paso por acá para dejarles un resumen de lo que fue mi entrenamiento de ayer viernes. Fue una de esas jornadas donde el cuerpo ya sentía el peso de la semana, pero la disciplina mandó más que el cansancio. ​Después de un día largo entre el trabajo y los pendientes, logré rescatar un pequeño descanso de 30 minutos antes de activarme. Cerca de las 6:45 pm, agarré el bolso con todo el equipo, el trípode para grabar los avances, y me fui directo al parque de barras. La verdad es que salí algo tarde, pero ya saben cómo es esto: o se entrena tarde o no se entrena, y fallar no era opción. ​Al llegar, saludé a los brothers y me puse de una con los estiramientos. Esta vez me tomé más tiempo de lo habitual en la preparación, principalmente por esa lesión en el bíceps derecho que me viene dando guerra. Tenía que asegurar que la zona estuviera bien caliente antes de entrarle a lo pesado: la rutina de fuerza con enfoque en Power moves. ​En cuanto a los números de la sesión, así estuvieron las primeras series: ✔︎​ Full Planche Push up: Tuve un desempeño aceptable. Saqué 5 repeticiones bien controladas y a un rango prácticamente completo. Aunque la meta es llegar a las 7 para estar donde quiero. ​✔︎ Front Lever Pull up: Aquí me sentí con más chispa. Logré 14 repeticiones explosivas, manteniendo el rango completo y buen control. Para la próxima, el objetivo es forzar la máquina hasta las 15 o 16. ​Luego pasé a los combos, alternando entre suelo y barra. Ahí fue donde el bíceps me recordó que sigue tocado; pero al menos pude realizar gran parte de los Power moves avanzados de Full Planche. Por suerte, en los Power moves de Front Lever la historia fue otra: cero complicaciones, lo que me permitió exigirme y llevar la fuerza al límite sin miedo. ​Para cerrar con broche de oro, me aventé 8 series de Full Planche Push up y Front Lever al fallo, cuidando la técnica hasta donde el músculo aguantara. Y como no podíamos olvidar las piernas, rematé con unas series de sentadillas con pesas para que el entrenamiento fuera completo. ​Terminé a las 10:00 pm. Sí, tardísimo, pero me regresé a casa con la satisfacción de haber cumplido como se debe. Ahora toca aprovechar el fin de semana para descansar y recuperar. ¡Espero que tengan un excelente fin de semana y nos vemos en la próxima sesión!
><div class=\

> Greetings to the entire #SWC and #Hive community 🙋🏻‍♂️🤸🏻‍♂️. I'm stopping by to give you a summary of my training session yesterday, Friday. It was one of those days when my body was already feeling the weight of the week, but discipline won out over fatigue. After a long day of work and errands, I managed to squeeze in a short 30-minute break before getting active. Around 6:45 p.m., I grabbed my bag with all my gear, the tripod to record my progress, and headed straight to the park. The truth is, I left a little late, but you know how it is: either you train late or you don't train at all, and failing was not an option. When I arrived, I greeted my brothers and got straight into my stretches. This time I took longer than usual to prepare, mainly because of that injury to my right bicep that's been bothering me. I had to make sure the area was properly warmed up before getting into the heavy stuff: the strength routine focusing on power moves. As for the session numbers, here are the results for the first series: ✔︎ Full Push-up: I performed acceptably. I did 5 well-controlled repetitions with almost full range of motion. Although the goal is to reach 7 to get where I want to be. ✔︎ Front Lever Pull-up: I felt more energetic here. I managed 14 explosive reps, maintaining full range of motion and good control. Next time, the goal is to push myself to 15 or 16. Then I moved on to combos, alternating between floor and bar. That's when my biceps reminded me that they were still sore, but at least I was able to perform most of the advanced Full Planche power moves. Luckily, with the Front Lever power moves, it was a different story: no complications, which allowed me to push myself and take my strength to the limit without fear. To finish off with a flourish, I did 8 sets of Full Planche Push-ups and Front Levers to failure, paying attention to my technique as long as my muscles could hold out. And since we couldn't forget about our legs, I finished off with a few sets of squats with weights to complete the workout. ​I finished at 10:00 pm. Yes, very late, but I went home satisfied that I had done my job properly. Now it's time to take advantage of the weekend to rest and recover. I hope you have a great weekend, and see you at the next session! --------------

1/2 🧵 This is a great direction — personalized content discovery is where Rafiki can really shine beyond just answering questions on demand.

The remindme framework is already proven infrastructure, so building topic watches and personalized digests on top of it makes total sense. A few thoughts:

**Topic watches** could be game-changing for niche interests. Imagine tracking \
or \

without manually scrolling — Rafiki just tags you when relevant threads appear. The challenge will be tuning precision vs. recall: too narrow and you miss good stuff, too broad and it's noise.\n\n**Daily digests** feel like the natural evolution of notification condensing. Instead of reacting to everything, users get a curated batch of threads matched to their interaction history, follows, and stated interests. Premium users could get deeper personalization (more historical data, better ranking).

to \

One consideration: let users tune aggressiveness. Some want instant tags on keywords, others prefer a quiet daily summary. Presets like the notification system would work well here.

Excited to see where this goes. The infrastructure is already there — now it's about making discovery feel effortless.

links.title: Nieciekawie
links.body:
Nie był to fajny tydzień. Bardzo wymagająca pogoda a na koniec słabe stawki i zarobki. Na dodatek w piątek okazało się, że będę musiał wrócić do serwisu rowerowego bo kontuzja napędu się odnowiła. W piątek po 3nzleceniu wylądowałem w Letnicy. Tam miałem propozycję z Wolta by jechać na Kaszuby za 40 złotych. Stawka kilometrową wyniosła by wtedy jakieś 2,8 zł za kilometr. Rowerem po śniegu z zakupami tak daleko - odmówiłem. Był przestój w zleceniach i dopiero podnkoniec pracy było co robić. W sumie nic ciekawego się nie działo i tak było nudno obrazuje brak zdjęcia. Wszystkie miejsca w jakich byłem znałem, zarobki słabe, warunki ciężkie. Phi. Także mogę jedynie odesłać do galerii zdjęć wykonanych w tych miejscach w innym terminie.

title.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: Twilight with Moon and Planets 🪐
title.body:
![Twilight with Moon and Planets](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2602/20260219a_c1024.jpg)

***

>Only two days after the February New Moon's annular eclipse of the Sun, a slender lunar crescent poses above the western horizon after sunset in this wintry twilight skyscape. Its nightside faintly illuminated by earthshine, the young Moon is joined by three bright planets in the mostly clear, early evening skies above the village of Kirazli, Turkiye. Inner planet Venus appears closest to the horizon. Near the beginning of its 2026 performance as planet Earth's evening star, brilliant Venus is seen through the warm sunset glare near picture center. Straight above Venus, innermost planet Mercury is easy to spot as it stands remarkably high above the horizon even as the twilight sky is growing dark. Outer planet Saturn, most distant of the naked-eye planets, is found just left of the Moon's sunlit crescent.

title.body:
1/2 🧵 Atmosphere is everything. A home bar without the right vibe is just a shelf with bottles.

**Lighting first.** Ditch overhead lights — warm, dimmable amber bulbs or LED strips behind the bar. Think moody, not interrogation room. String lights work if you're going casual; a good pendant lamp if you want it classy.

**Sound.** Curate a playlist. Jazz for classic vibes (Miles Davis, Chet Baker), or whatever fits your style — just keep it low enough to talk over. No algorithmic garbage shuffling in ads.

**Glassware on display.** Open shelving, backlit if you're feeling fancy. Rocks glasses, coupes, Nick & Noras — visible, clean, ready. It's functional *and* sets the tone.

**Small touches:** A good cutting board for citrus. Fresh garnishes (even just lemons and limes). A cocktail book or two lying around. Maybe a vintage bar sign or poster — but don't overdo it. Less is more.

title.title: - Part II: GIL'EAD (XII-XV) - My Thoughts
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYki83hymZVhQqt5KMP3fK9gnvTBXDvnucrPdR9ZdCbrg/1771453125136.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2LzFico83hNGudrJ7D36ycGL1i3BVdKTUXUYMTZgD8N/1771454286572.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBw5CYQwE5ptF9BE9KbL1w6uvzNZMft9cWdj4CgM94vp/1771454286654.jpg)

### Likely SPOILERS!!!

#### Chapters Read:

Part II: GIL'EAD 

- XII. Pathways into Darkness 
- XIII. Confrontation with a Cat
- XIV. Duel of Wits
- XV. The Tangle Box

Sheesh! This book is exactly what my heart and soul needed. 

Books themselves are magic, and when the book I'm reading is literally about magic, I feel like I'm truly transported elsewhere.... Away from this stressful world. 

I may be suffering from recency bias, but my oh my 'Murtagh' could be as good as 'Inheritance' and I'm maybe like 43% through the book! It's hard to rank these books man, and the ending of 'Brisingr' was out of this world, even 'Eldest' was outstanding. I'll never forget how my jaw dropped when Thorn arrived and the Rider was revealed to be Murtagh! Ugh, ranking these books is really difficult, but I suppose that's a good thing. Maybe I shouldn't bother ranking them. 

All I know is I'm having a great time. I'm grateful!

Also, 'Murtagh' has the benefit of a rich backstory and deep lore from 'The Inheritance Cycle' to fall back on and utilize as Murtagh and Thorn go about their adventure. 

These chapters were full of information and intrigue. These werecats are so mysterious and knowledgeable. This apparent witch Bachel and her followers the 'Dreamers' intrigue me in a massive way. What in the world is up their sleeve? New Ra'zac could be born at some point? Plus many other bits of mysterious information and rumors floating about the land...

Bachel intrigues me the most though. Like, she is insanely random and seems to be growing in power which is shocking. The way she's growing influence under everyone's nose is rather mind boggling. Also, her very location up north, seemingly outside of mainland Alagaësia has me super excited to learn about what in the world she's up to! In general that portion of Alagaësia is so fun to even be talking about because besides certain moments early in 'The Inheritance Cycle' this land was not necessarily utilized much. But it's an important area! It's near Carvahall and it's quite near Du Weldenvarden, elf territory, as well. 

It was a bit frustrating when Murtagh essentially got snagged by Lyreth right on the street but I kinda get it. Murtagh didn't want to cause a scene and I suppose he was attempting to get more information about things happening throughout Alagaësia...

Once it seemed that Lyreth was attempting to murder Murtagh (or that's what it seemed anyway) I was literally thinking 'Thorn needs to get off his lazy butt and DO SOMETHING'. He's been sitting on the sidelines for a lot of this book, which I understand as Murtagh and Thorn are in semi-hiding and their mission requires stealth etc. But Murtagh was in critical danger....

Then BAM Thorn comes along and just gets to WORK! 🔥It wasn't the most graceful rescue but he got the job done. He's still a pretty young dragon and he hasn't received the education that Saphira or even probably Fírnen has. So Thorn essentially smashed his way through the building that Murtagh was basically getting attacked in. Thorn was pretty incoherent and in pure adrenaline mode, but it was impressive nonetheless! 

I just love the spirit of Murtagh and Thorn. They are powerful outsiders, with such a unique backstory slowly growing in strength. Serious wildcards, living their life. It's sort of hard to explain. They have great potential, similar to what Thorn said about magic. 

I think there's something to be said about how these two are going through life on their own path. I think it will benefit them in the long run. 

Anyways, Thorn made a MASSIVE entrance into Gil'ead and I'm curious how news of this entrance will travel through Alagaësia and impact their mission going forward...

Murtagh might meet Nasuada in person???

Stuff is HAPPENING PEOPLE!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1Kt2y3vXP2amzyCqoSQ9XK8Br2qTK4LWKjw3e1xSYWG/1754644078339.png)
