body.title: Papa's Sacred Way
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUbbb8Xyea1LPd96Zo6qqs5tsWUtKSHkPUqZjrpRY9fq/1771689689063.jpg)



“Please help me I don't want to die,” Okopi kept saying this, running and panting for his life. The old man continued to pursue him without showing any weakness. How can this old man be this strong?  The old, wretched, and terribly looking man with a long beard, unkept grey hair and a wooden long stick in his hand. The man almost overpowered him when he shouted for help, but the man seemed not to be deterred from his assignment. He kept running and crying for help, but help did not come. He found himself among people in what looked like a marketplace. He shouted at the top of his voice, but still no one cared to listen. The old man was still full of energy running after him.  Okopi didn't notice a stump in front; his leg accidentally stumbled on it, and he fell. It was the right moment for the old wretched man to finish his job.  Okopi knew that that moment could likely be his end; he cried and kept on pleading with the man not to kill him. The man seemed not to have mercy. He wrestled with the old man but he was too feeble to match the old man’s strength, however, the old man overpowered him,  and without saying a word, he lifted his long stick and was about to land it on his head, Okopi immediately sprung up from bed with a shout “Jesus”, his wife could hear him, he was panting and sweat bathed in sweat. He held his heart and mused, “Thank God it's a dream”. Fear took hold of him so that he couldn't say a word to his wife, who was asking what the problem was.

He checked his time. It was 3:00 am on the dot. 

It was obvious he had a nightmare, his wife was curious to know. Recently her husband has been having a series of nightmares, and it calls for concern. This nightmare takes the same pattern as the attempted annihilation of her husband.

Both of them knew that there was a problem yet none of them wanted to face it.

“Babe”, she called him when he returned from the restroom. “This is getting out of hand o, what could be the problem?” The thought of her husband being involved in bad things crossed her mind, but she dismissed it. Her husband did not respond, rather he responded that whoever wants him dead will die. He went back to sleep, dismissing it as just a nightmare.

Neither Okopi nor his wife was a religious person; they hardly went to church unless invited for an occasion. However, his wife had told him to visit a prophet if he could foretell if there was a problem, so where. 

From the beginning, they have been suspecting family members who are after his life. Hence, the frequent nightmares. 

           **************

“Politics is a dirty game, and anyone who wants to be involved must be ready to do anything possible to remain relevant in the system, and you know that people are evil, people do not like good things. Remember the heart of men thinks evil”. 

At this point, Akopi was relaxed, he was happy that his friend was opening up to him. He took his drink and drank comfortably.
“So you need to meet the supreme being for absolute protection and fortification if not your opponent will just rubbish you anyhow”. Honourable Usen said. 

“As you can see,” he continues “I have been a federal house member for two terms, I am going for the Senate next election, no man will be able to stand against me. So that's the deal, if you want to be in politics you must belong, outside that you can't make it successfully”

At this point, Okopi had made up his mind to represent his people in the national assembly as a federal house member. Having visited Usen several times, he gave him an appointment when they met, Honourable Usen opened up to him what to expect. 
“I hope whatever we want to do doesn't involve shedding blood”? Okopi asked.

“Nobody talked about that,” he dismissed immediately. “It's just to introduce you to the supreme being, and he will sanctify you with his power, so you become untouchable. That's the first step before every other thing.” He sipped his drink. 

“Get ready, in two months, we will have a meeting with other big men. You'll see your president, governors, and top politicians in this country”. He concluded and assured him of victory in the poll. 

       *******

It was the last Sunday of August, a day that was set for Akopi’s general family meeting. Akopi was a family name, and Akopi was the lastborn of the family of five boys and two girls. As a lastborn, his father decided to give him the family name, not as the leader of the family, but because of the love he had for him. 

The day was bright, the meeting was slated for 4pm, Akopi and wife were already set for the meeting. They agreed that none of them would eat in the meeting. In fact, she warned her husband not to accept a handshake from anyone. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKouLpS5MhNxNnkJ1Y7VLpctE8d4ovkg5KRrQrWhPyxS/1771689375725.jpg)




On arrival, the family head, Mr Kenneth, led in the opening prayer. After that, he reminded them of what happened the day that their father passed on, how he bought the Holy Bible and shared it with everyone in the house, saying that anyone who deviates from following God's way shall meet his doom. 

Immediately, this statement hit Okopi as if he swallowed an ice, at that point, he had clarity of his recent misfortune. His mind wasn't stable, he lost focus, and he couldn't assimilate all that was discussed in the meeting. His attention was drawn back when he was told to lead in a closing prayer. 

He prayed and immediately had a change of plans.

body.title: Taveta Golden Weaver Feeding
body.body:
Whenever I can catch a small bird like this feeding, I know I will be lucky enough to get some shots, as it will likely be in one spot for a little while. It looked like an apple slice that was suspended from the wire here, and the Taveta Golden Weaver was seemingly enjoying every bite. The area that this bird was in at the Calgary Zoo is fairly dark, so it's a tough environment to get good shots in. It's opportunities like these that make it worth being a bit patient for, as trying to chase some action in the near darkness is a lot harder than just waiting for this little bird to go have a bite.

今天从小姨家转到外婆他们那边。
因为小姨是在市里，但是外婆他们又在另外的一个县内，所以还得转车。
早上在小姨家吃完早饭，然后就开始出发。
结果没想到，过年了，来旅游的人还是那么多，滴滴打车打了二十分钟，一直打不到车去公交车站。
然后小姨就让他们同村的人帮忙送一下。
送完最后坐上公交车，发现公交车也是挤的要死。
结果来到车站，都需要买票了，才发现身份证和钥匙还落在小姨家。
我滴天，后面还得让小姨回家的时候给我快递一下。
诶，我这丢三落四的习惯，也真的是麻了。
以后真得好好注意，在急也得把该弄的弄完，要是一味的就知道忙，那最后大概率啥也得不到。
套用下某些话就是：不是不能急，是得缓缓的急，得有节奏的急，让有经验的人先急，这样才能先急带动后急……
本来以为应该很快就能去到，没想到中间又跟着姨爹去了他哥家。
然后他又带着我们去了旁边的一个新晋网红景点。
其实就是一个小湖，不过因为颜色有点蓝，所以起了个所谓的蓝月谷的名称。
但是其实就是山里的一个小湖。
最后又做了一会车，终于来到了外公外婆家。
诶，洗洗睡吧，剩下的事，明天在说……

body.title: Hive Garden QOTW #45 -Seed Starting - by Sunscape
body.body:
![hivegarden-seeds.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfGrVnCHngDaMuAFoFxQi7wXWAAHEYLmxRu3CH61YWq3G/hivegarden-seeds.jpg)

I received the last of my seed ordered this week and these will be started soon but it's still early as my last frost date isn't until April 15th.  I started Spanish onions, and Walla Walla onion back in January and they are doing well.  

![hivegarden-seeds-spanish-onion.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZs11c3j19QABG8Yey3nHMkUgNbHve5yBd1xhRRmNqatx/hivegarden-seeds-spanish-onion.jpg)

The leaves are nice and strong now that I started feeding them with a light fertilizer.  Also, I have a three-tier fan facing the seed rack to buffet the seeds to help make them strong.

![hivegarden-seeds-red onion.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuwGHvpeMf3EFVZmZobQejbt5RVVppFMgsXVpnnFCQYu/hivegarden-seeds-red%20onion.jpg)

This past week I started red onions and they are all up and gaining strength too.  


![SRL-image-9 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZyAMUaqV8imseANJTXxToQefwYft538pZokwmDhMWUoL/SRL-image-9%20(1).jpg)

These were the two varieties that I planted this month and they have both germinated. 


![hivegarden-seeds-eggplant.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZw4c6bQY7myczsibxfWqVHCXMNXoWo7MKPMpgcffFVC1/hivegarden-seeds-eggplant.jpg)

The Eggplant just emerged and I started 6 seeds and 5 are up so far.

![hivegarden-seeds-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTjBbzv6PMH9dbDosoJb4y8QmU9dpWADpedD6mw2t64HY/hivegarden-seeds-1.jpg)

Some of the cold-weather lovers, broccoli, cauliflower, and cabbage are about to get their second leaves this week.  If weather permits, I will be moving all the trays out into the greenhouse the second week of March.  Once they are well established then I will plant them out in a raised bed in April with a row cover for protection.


![hivegarden-seeds-petunia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdPk8tLVrhnk73sf2bedJYynDkxqBLmSiCzhdqbeaASKn/hivegarden-seeds-petunia.jpg)

The only other seeds that have been started are Petunias.  I ordered a new variety to grow this year, \

and it looks like most of the seed germinated nicely. They are so tiny and it takes quite a long time to get to a decent size before putting them up into hanging baskets.  

![petunias.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPYmUiH6dCJisXQZS1XCtvQFmkGkQraGHWc1ctiBzjFcG/petunias.jpg)

Here is a look at the shelving rack with plant lights where I grow the seedlings until planting out.  I have 5 shelves with lights that can hold up to 20 trays.  Once the cooler tolerant plants get taken to the greenhouse, I have more room to start the tomatoes and annual flowers.  

![hivegarden-seeds-lights.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQpA47Xaih2bLEvtDCW3UisWPuRf3RZavgeUHqEsTRd6t/hivegarden-seeds-lights.jpg)

At the moment, this is what it looks like outside, most of the snow has melted yet it keeps coming most days.  Yesterday, we had sleet and rain which helped to melt some of it away.  I could actually see grass in some places.  

![greenhouse.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSxhsvjH7uRyBwGE6FHPW2U498EtoZqfGpoT95PBh64u/greenhouse.jpg)

Meanwhile, inside I have another Freesia flower blooming, so I get to enjoy a lovely flower even if it is snowing outside.  

![hivegarden-flower.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiCDyFF18uQhYihvncPicqFaAWpYQtKBDBB2iPveyrcb/hivegarden-flower.jpg)

Happy seeding everyone, soon we will be planting them all out in the garden.  


![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

![banner-morning glory.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZqr5MM8Tck9borrpBEdfrqHztV4CDzPNB4UrziqtrBNv/banner-morning%20glory.png)

body.title: Try questioning nonviolence in a world of real life conflict
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdWhYYK7r8Z7p45sJbDZcXeVT4hcH8MRK24UdmsPPuQi/1771689418089.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/dove-hands-peace-world-peace-hope-7071097/)

So I've been told, there's always a way to resolve any problem without using force or violence. Just make a deal, it's ridiculous to fight. Everything inside of you wants to say, yes, you completely agree with that, you wish it to be true every single time. 

Then you think about real life scenarios, not just hypothetical ones. Someone getting attacked in a dark corridor. A whole nation watching innocent people get slaughtered every day. What the heck do you do at that moment? Do you sit and wait for non violent dialogue and discussion to come up?

There are some extremely valid arguments made by extremely credible people, people like Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr., against using violence to solve problems. These arguments were about who you become when you use violence to solve your problems, even if violence is an effective solution to the problem. They make a very strong argument. But their argument doesn't cover all of life's complicated situations.

There is always a way to solve every problem without the use of violence. This is still a huge issue, even if you say it is the case. The big issue for me or the single largest point of contention with that statement is the use of the word always. That damn word always means more than anything else in the statement. 

Frantz Fanon made a different statement than Gandhi and King when it came to this issue. Just like you I wish there would be no fighting but think about what he said. I'll quote that.

> Violence is not just a strategic choice, but a psychological and historical necessity for those living under colonial rule.

So where does that leave us? Do you believe in non violent resistance to oppression? Affectionately you do. But now another scenario presents itself that challenges that rationale, did it not? Did the original premise hold up when you considered colonial rule?

The statement is true, but the world however, is not a place that is ideal or perfect, not right now.

body.body: Fuer die Nerds:\n\nDamit man sowas bauen kann, oder halt \
macht, muss man die ganzen Sachen \
bis zum Speien. \n\nDas faengt schon mit den Sprachmodellen selbst an, haben wir in XAIGPUARC ja genug \

von auch kleinen sehr feinen Modellen. 

Man sollte also unbedingt drauf achten, das kein Hochleistungsrechner notwendig wird finde ich, weil wir das ja fuer alle bauen und nicht nur fuer Programmierer. 

Die koennen sowas auch ohne das Programm.

Aber einer der vielleicht mal was ausprobieren wollte nicht unbedingt, fuer den bauen wir das, sozusagen fuer Leute wie mich, die nie warm werden mit manchen Sachen.

Dazu schon wie Beschrieben, muss man alles sehr sehr Gut eingrenzen. Ich habe mich fuer die Typischen \

entschieden, wie man das machen koennte, welche bei Bau von Programmen mir selbst passiert sind. Ganz normale Klassiker eben, wie zum Beispiel erwaehnte SYCL Geraeterkennung.\n\nIch denke, das des auch mein \
wird, also wie Gut die eine Geraeterkennung dann bauen koennen wird, weil ich mich damit schon auch beschaeftigt habe und mein \
ist, was wir dann sehen wollen. \n\nDa muesste dann also alles so eingegrenzt sein, durch den Prompt der zweiten \
das sie garnicht anders kann, als \
zu haben mit dem Ausprobiertem Material durch die Compiler entsprechende Fehler einfach direkt wieder als Prompt an die HauptKI von XAIGPUARC zu schicken.\n\nDa koennte man also die \

festlegen, natuerlich auch fuer anderes, wenn man moechte.

Was ich auch angesichts Leistung wichtig und richtig finde, ist sich auf eine Entwicklerunmgebung zu konzentrieren, eben, weil wir nur begrenzte Ressourcen nutzen koennen. Das haben die Phyton Menschen ja Gut vorgemacht sehr Maechtig.

Bei XAIGPUARC, kommen dann halt eher so \

Sachen zum Bauen rein. Ich denke, das man damit dann also weniger irgendwie was Buntes und Schoenes bauen kann, als eher kompliziert und funktional direkt auf die Hardware abgestimmt, die man nutzen moechte.

Sozusagen, koennte man sich schon vorher um der Einfachheiten willen auch wenn es dann tiefer in die Umsetzung geht, sich einfach so dermaßen einzuschraenken, das es nur klappen kann, weil viel zu simple, um große Fehler zu machen.

Man koennte dann XAIGPUARC sozusagen, von einem Kernelbauprogramm, in eine Spielenginebaumaschine umbauen, wenn man so wollte, meine ich das.

Einfach dann all des nehmen, was da \

drin steht im Programm und es Loeschen wie die Prompst und die Umgebungen, die genutzt werden sollen und dann durch die eigenen Wuensche ersetzen. So stelle ich mir das vor.

Die Umgebungen wiederum, kenne ich garnicht so Gut, da koennte ich vielleicht auch noch bisle Ideen brauchen, was man sich eigentlich so Wuenschen wuerde, wenn man koennte, was da bevorzugt behandelt wird in dem Baukasten.

Die CPU wird fuer die Pruefung die \

sein, soll heißen, die zweite KI, sollte eher nur auf der CPU und dem RAM laufen und auch wirklich wirklich klein sein, damit die den Arbeitsvorgang der HauptKI nicht so arg einschraenkt, wie ich mich solange noch vor fuerchte, bis ich selber gesehen habe, das es klappt wie ich mir das ausdenke.

Man ballert also ein bisschen KI in den normalen RAM rein, was dann auch wieder die Notwendigkeiten eines starken Unterbaus vorraussetzt, in Sachen Dual Channel RAM und Aufwaehrts, weil es sonst ja wieder nur zu Warteorgie verkommt und das brauchen wir auch nicht im Programm.

Ein bisschen, wird man aber warten muessen ich versuche solche Sachen unter 5-10 Minuten zu druecken ohne das die Qualitaet drunter leiden muss, die ich vorher ja mit dem Erfolg einer funktionierenden Gereateerkennung festgelegt habe als Minium aber auch fast schon wieder maximum an Leistungsfaehigkeit.

Das ist Wichtig, weil ich denke, das viele sich nicht so gerne mit den Antworten der KIs beschaeftigen, wie sie sollten und reine Benchmarkzahlen eben keine Produktive Arbeit ableisten koennen, sondern nur schoen anzusehende Werte sind.

Das ist also Fokus, den Fokus, zu fokusieren.

Der Sandkasten fuer das Testen, ist wohl die brutalste Huerde, wie schon angeschrieben, hier den RAM nicht zu voll zu machen.

Wir haben 2026 und Offiziell \

soll heißen, wir muessen die naechsten zwei Jahre wieder genauer hinschauen, was die Leute daheim haben und warum sie nicht mehr kaufen wollen, bei den Preisen.

16GiB SIND einfach zu wenig und das sage ich 7 Jahre nachdem Artikel, das mir 4 GiB RAM auch ausreichen wuerden, und das auch so war damals.

Aber 16 GiB ist wirklich was, wer da drunter baut, ich weis nicht, wie der das machen will. Die brauchen wir also wahrscheinlich auch.

Die CPU Leistungs selbst, muss natuerlich, damit die armen Normalanwender nicht kaputt gewartet werden muessen, AUCH nach Oben gesetzt werden, wo wir hier aber viel Glueck mit der Spielerschaft der Welt wieder mal haben, das der \

schon sehr Gut und Hoch ist.

Schnelles Compilieren bekommen wir eben nur durch gute und viele Kerne und deren Moeglichkeiten doppelte Befehle auszufuehren ala HT oder AMT.

Das muss auf jeden Fall also immer gesagt und gezeigt sein, das die Mindestanforderungen fuer so ein KI Programm wirklich harte Grenzen sind, die man nicht unterschreiten sollte und moechte, damit der Ruf des eigenen Forks oder Eigenbaus eben nicht in Gefahr ist, \
der Salat fuer die Damen und Herren.\n\nWas den Bau von der Aktion angeht, bleibt natuerlich wieder das Simple erhalten, da wirds von \

nicht viel zu sehen geben, kann der Nutzer vielleicht, wenn ich Lustig bin, auswaehlen, ob er zwei oder eine KIs benutzen moechte, damit er sich entsprechende Nutzererfahrung erwarten darf

Weil das ist auch was, warum zwei KIS, die sind meiner Meinung nach immer im Nachteil zu statt dessen einer großen KI, wenn der Nutzer eigentlich nur Chatten moechte. 

Die Bibliotheken....

Massen an Daten, bei OneAPI haben wir so ueber 10 GiB Ingesamt auf der Matte, weswegen ich das auch eben als Grundlage nutzen moechte, weil es sowieso notwendig ist fuer XAIGPUARC und warum Dutzende GiB auf dem Anwerderrechner verballern fuer etwas, das er wahrscheinlich fuer ein Spiel mal eben lieber wieder loescht, weil es auch wegen der PMIC Krise^^ eben an Festspeicher mangelt, zumindest schnellem.

Womit wir beim letztem Punkt sind, dachte ich mir, kann man auch ein bisschen herumswapen, wenns die Leistung nicht beeintraechtigt, die Daten fuer die Pruefungen auf den Speicher im zum Beispiel XAIGPUARC Ordner zu nutzen als kleine \

um die gemachten Code Schnipsel zwischenzuspeicher und zu sortieren und das vollautomatisch, wie es jetzt ja auch dank Llama.cpp schon mit normalen Prompts und deren Ausgaben passiert. Sozusagen, kann man dem Nutzer auch hier wieder Arbeit ersparen, sich durch unmengen von Daten wuehlen zu muessen und einfach eine Art eigenes Bibliothekt mit seinen Programmschnipeln bauen lassen, die man dann beliebig weiterverwenden kann, weil die zweite KI, auch immer mal was davon durchlesen und nachpruefen kann auf doppelt vorhandenes oder sehr aehnliches schon gebautes, das der Nutzer nur nicht mehr so auf dem Schirm hatte.\n\nIdeen und Anregungen, sind wie immer herzlich Willkommen.

body.title: Life bound in pages(fiction)
body.body: >Unsplash Age has made the pages fragile. Each careful turning of a leaf crinkling. A threat to crumble. You want to leave, I can feel it, but you're looking for answers. Answers from these dusty tomes that are in your hand writing. Somewhere in the ancient tomes that surround you with hazy memory and cobwebs of the past you want to find out the truth of your own existence. How you came to be pristine despite surviving eons. The people you protect have gone from simple farmers to inventors and artisans. The hoe and sickle replaced with machinery, horses with automobiles and swords with guns. And at the center of it all the ageless Lord protector. There are stories that you made a pact with a devil, or were granted a boon by a Fae queen or crafted a magical elixir, but you don't remember what happened. But I do, because I'm what happened. I hold the grief of years for you, the weight of decades turning to centuries turning to millennia, my body creaks, bones barely strong enough to stand, eyes gone blind but mind still sharp. Sharp enough to want an end. I am so tired. This body aches for release. I have some of your pride to though. You knew if you were to confident you'd make poor decisions, that good advice would fall on deaf ears. Advice that helped your people, our people, survive famines and floods, that turned war into trading partners. You've forgotten so much of it though. That's why you started the journals. It was on your 150th birthday you realized you had forgotten so much of the first fifty years of your life. So you wrote down what you could, and I remembered every word, every emotion, every twinge of the heart and anxiety of the mind. I watched from the shadows at first. Now I listen to the turning pages, memory and imagination creating visuals where my time dulled eyes cannot. Your mutterings echo in the stillness of this hidden library as you try to remember why you did this to yourself, or how. It was desperation, you knew you were the best to lead. Not an arrogant thought, your long since dead brothers were either greedy or incompetent. Or both. But you were the youngest, the least likely to rule unless they all died, so you made sure you'd survive them. While they sought glory and wealth you craved knowledge and magic. Despite the gentleness of your hands, the reverence you have for your own memories, the journal creaks as you close it. Your breath hitches as a funeral is remembered. Your first love, taken to early. A mere 50 years old when a strange illness of the lungs took her from you. An illness that hasn't taken any of your subjects lives for as long as mortal memory holds. A few deep breaths then you return the volume to the shelf. There's no tears, you lost that capacity around the 3rd century of this existence. I shuffle from the darkness, knees and hips aching with each step. It's only thanks to my cane I do not fall. \

You start as you see your face reflected back as if through a twisted mirror. As you see the same crown and signet ring. The same royal robes and fine shoes, the same coat keeping the dank and cold away. We are the same, except I'm bearing the weight of time. Paying it's toll. 

\
I find the chair across from you and sit. Weariness pulling every limb down. Weariness that no amount of rest has helped. That is all I do these days is rest.\n\n\
I don't judge you. It's always out of a love for those who depend on you. That's always the reason you leave me here. \n\n\
But maybe this time will be different. You feel the weight a little to. Maybe a lot. \
I gesture to where it stands on the top of an elaborately carved stand. Blood red wax with an ethereal blue flame. it gives no heat and barely any light.\
By every star in the sky, yes.\
I can't just leave them without a leader.\
I'll remember this time, and come back, when I have a heir. Someone to fill the role or perhaps I need to change the role.\
I'm sorry. I think.... I think I'm ready, but it'd be selfish to just disappear. To end when so many depend on me.\
But sire, I'm not sure I'm ready.\
If you do this, it'll only be my word that I didn't do something to you. The suspicion will be there. \
I have made it known I am leaving.\
This, the suffering and everything he experiences is the cost of my long life.\
It seems worth it for what you built.\

body.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  A Child's History of England #12/210
body.body:
While yet a boy, he had got out of his bed one night (being then in a fever), and walked about Glastonbury Church when it was under repair; and, because he did not tumble off some scaffolds that were there, and break his neck, it was reported that he had been shown over the building by an angel. He had also made a harp that was said to play of itself—which it very likely did, as Æolian Harps, which are played by the wind, and are understood now, always do. For these wonders he had been once denounced by his enemies, who were jealous of his favour with the late King Athelstan, as a magician; and he had been waylaid, bound hand and foot, and thrown into a marsh. But he got out again, somehow, to cause a great deal of trouble yet.

The priests of those days were, generally, the only scholars. They were learned in many things. Having to make their own convents and monasteries on uncultivated grounds that were granted to them by the Crown, it was necessary that they should be good farmers and good gardeners, or their lands would have been too poor to support them. For the decoration of the chapels where they prayed, and for the comfort of the refectories where they ate and drank, it was necessary that there should be good carpenters, good smiths, good painters, among them. For their greater safety in sickness and accident, living alone by themselves in solitary places, it was necessary that they should study the virtues of plants and herbs, and should know how to dress cuts, burns, scalds, and bruises, and how to set broken limbs. Accordingly, they taught themselves, and one another, a great variety of useful arts; and became skilful in agriculture, medicine, surgery, and handicraft. And when they wanted the aid of any little piece of machinery, which would be simple enough now, but was marvellous then, to impose a trick upon the poor peasants, they knew very well how to make it; and didmake it many a time and often, I have no doubt.

Dunstan, Abbot of Glastonbury Abbey, was one of the most sagacious of these monks. He was an ingenious smith, and worked at a forge in a little cell. This cell was made too short to admit of his lying at full length when he went to sleep—as if thatdid any good to anybody!—and he used to tell the most extraordinary lies about demons and spirits, who, he said, came there to persecute him. For instance, he related that one day when he was at work, the devil looked in at the little window, and tried to tempt him to lead a life of idle pleasure; whereupon, having his pincers in the fire, red hot, he seized the devil by the nose, and put him to such pain, that his bellowings were heard for miles and miles. Some people are inclined to think this nonsense a part of Dunstan’s madness (for his head never quite recovered the fever), but I think not. I observe that it induced the ignorant people to consider him a holy man, and that it made him very powerful. Which was exactly what he always wanted.

On the day of the coronation of the handsome boy-king Edwy, it was remarked by

>Odo, Archbishop of Canterbury (who was a Dane by birth), that the King quietly left the coronation feast, while all the company were there. Odo, much displeased, sent his friend Dunstan to seek him. Dunstan finding him in the company of his beautiful young wife

>Ethelgiva, a good and virtuous lady, not only grossly abused them, but dragged the young King back into the feasting-hall by force. Some, again, think Dunstan did this because the young King’s fair wife was his own cousin, and the monks objected to people marrying their own cousins; but I believe he did it, because he was an imperious, audacious, ill-conditioned priest, who, having loved a young lady himself before he became a sour monk, hated all love now, and everything belonging to it.

The young King was quite old enough to feel this insult. Dunstan had been Treasurer in the last reign, and he soon charged Dunstan with having taken some of the last king’s money. The Glastonbury Abbot fled to Belgium (very narrowly escaping some pursuers who were sent to put out his eyes, as you will wish they had, when you read what follows), and his abbey was given to priests who were married; whom he always, both before and afterwards, opposed.

body.title: Fresh snowfall
body.body:
![White milk barn](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiJ4WCGAPeNBiSijc6ZQ8Yz6audrd8G1hq98BKy4e9PJ/img_9427.jpeg)

We got some fresh snow last night.  Probably 6 plus inches.

![Driveway](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKMnx9s9dVX2TX2DEqJdkiW2FVJeFkzu1if4GurFRY3r/img_9425.jpeg)

Always nice photographs with new coating of snow.  No wind with this storm so the snow nicely coated everything.

![Barn front](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8mGB4bb7CiA9DGFFfobF6LPTyRMmHddHKhGS6vxqLsC/img_9138.jpeg)

This old barn provides some contrast for photos versus the white milk barn in the first couple of shots.  The green trim is a classic Vermont looks and the flag is fun.  Classic Vermont farmhouses are usually white with green trim like the first milk barn.

![Barn side](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdhanKZUvMBWMFAjpSx6VYoU2pbQjJAwr69V132SkCW4/img_9474.jpeg)

Our neighbor is a veteran.  Not only is this stylized flag on their barn but he puts up a flag each morning then takes it down at dusk. 

![Fresh snowfall](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz5toF1bgYByYzfphhkRZ8uQEx5McmhXbZW75vUR52cN/img_9413.jpeg)

We got out before the town plows.  The town plow was actually stuck in the ditch a little past our house lol The driver was waiting on another truck to pull the plow out.  We were nice but he was quite embarrassed.

![Thru trees](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTzJFG599wfUKHzgkf8QkDPAfareiucFY9uF7zmjzTSE/img_9137.jpeg)

Another few shots of my favorite local barn.

![Down the road](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWai677Bnk8rEK4gn7NA9eQXLX7RXs1EU8xXA5nZyPR9W/img_9135.jpeg)

Great old building that always photographs well 🙂

A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Saturn’s story about Hacksaw Duggan and backstage heat made one thing very clear. Miscommunication creates tension that bleeds into performance. And as I think about WOO this weekend, I wonder if the quiet atmosphere is less about inactivity and more about recalibration. Because sometimes silence is not absence. It is reset.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23w2HY78QUDcSYwg7H6DQLaB8ZLeLuNWzGGREdWm8QhpuBY41veWDNg7TQLhTRpagTEVj.png)

---

* **The Duggan story proves how rumours distort energy.**
  Saturn explained how misinformation shaped perception, even when no one was actively trying to sabotage anyone. That kind of environment affects performance. If WOO senses even minor internal or community tension, slowing down might be a way to stabilize.

* **Cooling periods prevent narrative spirals.**
  Wrestling communities can ignite quickly. A quieter weekend might allow discussions around Saturn’s bold statements to settle naturally rather than escalate.

* **Momentum does not always require acceleration.**
  Sometimes sustaining momentum means managing it carefully. WOO may be choosing sustainability over short bursts.

* **Letting conversations mature strengthens community bonds.**
  Heated topics require digestion time. Saturn’s candid admissions are layered. A quiet weekend allows that depth to resonate.

---

I have seen communities implode over misunderstandings before. If WOO is consciously slowing things down to maintain stability, I respect that. It signals maturity rather than neglect. So maybe this weekend is not empty. Maybe it is measured. Maybe WOO understands that sometimes the healthiest move is stepping back and letting energy recalibrate.

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: A wonderful activity that seeks to reinforce values within educational spaces 😊
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Uno de los grandes desafíos que enfrenta nuestra sociedad de hoy en día es la pérdida de los valores; lo cual se puede evidenciar casi que día a día, creo que nosotros como docentes jugamos un papel fundamental en tratar de recuperar estos valores que son tan importantes para una sana convivencia; en lo particular siempre trato con todo mis grupos de estudiantes de ponerlos en práctica y de promoverlos en la convivencia dentro del aula de clase. Así que, aprovechando la celebración del Día del amor y la amistad, organice un pequeño intercambio de regalos en un grupo donde he podido evidenciar muchas diferencias, rivalidades y enemistades dentro del aula de clases ;ellos están así como que sectorizados; pequeños grupos que solo se tratan entre ellos, he tratado de inculcarles que debe existir compañerismo entre ellos, el respeto, la colaboración, la tolerancia; así que, organicé el intercambio, no tanto por el regalo; sino para tratar de crear un espacio para el compañerismo y el trato entre los pequeños grupos.

> **
ENGLISH
** One of the great challenges facing our society today is the loss of values, which can be seen almost every day. I believe that we as teachers play a fundamental role in trying to recover these values that are so important for healthy coexistence. In particular, I always try with all my groups of students to put them into practice and promote them in the classroom. So, taking advantage of the celebration of Love and Friendship Day, I organized a small gift exchange in a group where I have seen many differences, rivalries, and enmities within the classroom. They are kind of divided into small groups that only interact with each other. I have tried to instill in them that there should be camaraderie, respect, collaboration, and tolerance among them. So, I organized the exchange, not so much for the gift, but to try to create a space for camaraderie and interaction between the small groups. ![Collage_2026-02-21_11_15_43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqpatQDbcXkmQpu1QL5GYGTcQgN1r7DdS1fqe1cCL6K9ZyiDWfx8yUTTnfNfUb52goN.jpg)

> Cuando se fueron a entregar los papelitos les aclaré que no iba a aceptar que cambiaran el nombre de quién les había tocado, pues la idea era crear un espacio para el compañerismo; mucho se quejaron, muchos al principio se molestaron, insistieron un poco para que les cambiara pues, porque no trataban a la persona que les había tocado; no hubo espacio para el cambio, cada quien le iba a regalar a quien le correspondía. Llegado el día del intercambio, una de las condiciones era que la persona debía decir algo positivo de esa otra persona a quién le iba a regalar; fue bastante hermoso, bastante emotivo, muchos alumnos que estaban en grupos diferentes pudieron encontrar algo positivo en esa otra persona a quien no trataban; al final tomamos muchas fotos en grupo, bromeamos, reímos un rato y creo que por lo menos en una medida pequeña se logró el objetivo, se hizo en un ambiente de paz, de armonía, de respeto, de tolerancia; que creo debe existir dentro de todo grupo en los distintos espacios donde convivimos. Espero la publicación haya sido de su agrado . Gracias por visitarme ! Dios te bendiga🙏

> When they went to hand in their slips of paper, I made it clear that I would not accept any changes to the names they had been assigned, as the idea was to create a space for camaraderie. Many complained, many were upset at first, and they insisted that I change their assignments because they did not get along with the person they had been assigned. There was no room for change; each person was going to give a gift to the person they had been assigned. When the day of the exchange arrived, one of the conditions was that each person had to say something positive about the person they were giving a gift to. It was quite beautiful, quite emotional. Many students who were in different groups were able to find something positive in that other person they didn't know. In the end, we took lots of group photos, joked around, laughed for a while, and I think that, at least to a small extent, the objective was achieved. It was done in an atmosphere of peace, harmony, respect, and tolerance, which I believe should exist within every group in the different spaces where we live together. I hope you enjoyed the post. Thank you for visiting! God bless you🙏 ![Collage_2026-02-21_11_14_46.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wX5r8NxzvHEYtg7gMpw4eMPCXhGzKf8bYbHmQ3dS9vHgKShiecoe4BU8n9pQ7f1xGSP.jpg) ![Collage_2026-02-21_11_14_11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xL2saJ8HqGwADsKNMkhLifx8E88qA85GL6sWUjZKxegSoC1U6SyREzsVmkKJbb8Dd7y.jpg)

title.title: A beer to beat the heat 🍺
title.body:
>

Every time the hot season hits, I remember what they said on a survival show, where they basically said that if you were lost in the mountains or the desert, extremely dehydrated, and suddenly came across a pack of beers, it was better to bathe in them than drink them. Well! I think that's true, I'm getting ready to pour several boxes over myself, because the heat right now is quite intense and desperate at the same time. This has even sparked curiosity among people who apparently have never drunk beer. I say this because on one occasion a woman asked if beer was really that effective at quenching thirst. All that uncertainty on her part was the result of hearing many people say something like, \

and boy, are there a lot of people who live up to that phrase right now, especially at midday. The truth is, you don't have to look or dig very deep to find the perfect excuse to have a cold beer, either alone or in company. 

![IMG-20260221-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23ywnxi4M7L3sqSik1baT5TmaDrBKMEsmcqLH8NwXLZhposGnhoX1rssoMByFzpNm1i2M.jpg)

Even for lovers of strong, dry rum, beer is becoming the drink of choice, and I say this with complete certainty because I know many friends who, when going to the beach or the river, prefer to buy several cases of beer rather than a few bottles of rum. Even sangria is suddenly becoming another option because it is a drink that you can also enjoy when it is very cold and serves to refresh you. How cold do you like your beer? Well, here some people ask for a beer \

which refers to the external appearance of the can or bottle when it is quite cold or practically frozen. For sellers, this can also be an important factor to consider. I say this because I often notice that people's preferences are not so much influenced by price (unless there is a considerable difference) but rather by how cold the beers are. It's like the complete opposite example that happens with food when you go to a restaurant and they serve you something that, no matter how tasty it looks and tastes, loses its essence if it's not served hot or at least at a cool and pleasant temperature for eating. ![IMG-20260221-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23wqbtonXaFgqhfBeQtMxPtTaqhWXb2YFjj2ZrHftaD1XkW5caFv3ZJcWDB3fJpAwsFBN.jpg) When the heat is extreme and intense, we may even forget about our favorite beers and, in order to quench our thirst, we give in and try other beers. I remember one time we were at the river and suddenly the only beer available was Polar Black, and although most of us there didn't drink that kind of beer, at the end of the day it was our only option. Extreme conditions can also lead us to make extreme decisions where we forget about our preferences or whims as we try to combat the heat at all costs. So, a beer to combat the heat? Let's hope that, regardless of the weather, we don't stop enjoying a cold beer to have a good time. Cheers to everyone! 🍺🍻 ![IMG-20260221-WA0016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23w2qUZS3xiSnvQnyg8pFz1WZj73pw4sHqtujErnHe6pTbrqCfcPFKwxW24YzJd7KJm69.jpg) --- This is #BeerSaturday week and I would like to invite @abisag @angeluxx to write a post in any language about beer with at least 3 pictures. >All photos belong to me. --- ***Thank you for valuing this publication with your time and attention.*** ***See you soon.***

title.title: Playing For Third Place?
title.body: /> [source](https://d2779tscntxxsw.cloudfront.net/tmis_651f2d7d8d7de.png) Who would have expected to see England playing Ireland at Twickenham knowing they are both playing for 3rd place on the table. Scotland play Wales later today which should see Scotland cement 2nd place even though they still have to play Ireland and Wales having lost to Italy in the opening round. The 3 teams being Ireland, Scotland and England seem to be of a similar standard with either team able to beat each other on the day. The French are a good 10 points better than these three teams, but saying that they could lose to Italy tomorrow. The Italians are the ones who are going to change how the table looks as I feel England who play in Rome for their last game of the Six Nations are ripe for the picking. The funny thing is every team will raise their game to play England as losing to the England team is that much harder to accept. The press build them up so much and place a massive target on the England team backs which comes across as arrogant. If you lose to Scotland or Ireland it does not seem so bad and the big one is England. Teams actually see this as an insult (Southern Hemisphere) losing to England and shows you how they are rated which is not that highly.

/></center>

[source](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-union/news/12040/13478696/maro-itoje-steve-borthwick-englands-goal-is-to-win-2027-rugby-world-cup-in-australia-weve-been-very-clear)

With the World Cup 2 years away you have to be winning the games now and building. England were full of themselves having been on a 12 match winning streak thinking they were already performing to the levels required. Other teams are also rebuilding and trying out various combinations.

If the wheels come off during this Six Nations for any of these teams then coming back and preparing for the World Cup which will be 18 months away would be a huge setback. This is all about building your squad strength and not thinking you are already world champions because this will bite you hard.

England like they do in all sports are already thinking of the final round in Paris to win the title and they have taken their eye off what is important and that is doing the basics. England can be humbled by the Italians which would see the entire England team under pressure with the coach being questioned if he is the right person. I am no England fan but have always questioned Borthwick's credentials as a coach and do not rate him. 

I just switched on todays match and the score is not a huge shock with England being humbled by 29 points to 7. This will not be the final score and will most likely finish very close with an Irish win. This will leave England close to the bottom of the table and their Six Nations campaign in tatters. This is where arrogance gets you and the players not remaining humble and this is all about attitude and staying grounded. The Ireland team were expected to raise their game for this particular match even if they are not that strong these days.

In June England play South Africa in South Africa and I can tell you the score will be high as the SA team will lay down a marker.

title.body: In my opinion, the fact that the Modern cards get a 50% nerf on their PP is a strong indicator that the plan was always to eliminate that nerf when they rotated out of Modern.  Otherwise, the new Modern sets would have always been at 1 and the previous sets would have had bigger multipliers (Chaos=2xPP, Untamed=4xPP, etc).  I was always under the impression that this would be the case.  If the team has been building and doing all of their calculations with this as their baseline, I don't think it would be a good idea to change the original plan.  As others have stated, if each new set continues to have discounted PP, then the future value of owning those cards after they leave Modern is basically nil.  Other than a handful of meta cards, most of those cards will be worthless for anything other than burning once they leave Modern.  I don't see any reason to make Chaos Legion *more* valuable than successive sets. Especially considering there are literally still hundreds of thousands of Chaos Legion cards to burn through. Stick with the plan.

title.body: > I destroyed the fog's source and reunited the team before descending into a vibrant, alien floral cavern. Guided by Mantis to the Healing Light, we were suddenly ambushed by a powerful stranger. After he overpowered Peter and Gamora, Groot saved Rocket from a lethal blade and restrained the attacker with his vines. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2QMx1PxobUrxWB6BhPCzdDiEgc7rFpFnzahC8BZeVPM/screenshot_1_.png) Even after Rocket did his toughest part, the source of the fog was not destroyed properly. I had to do the rest while fighting the leftover shadow enemies who were still spawning around me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNLH7WoQgfQHJGmzju5t5jJu449QeQ44V1hcrfFWdW2g/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRtYkgGQMH8HCM7p5HS4ChYwgtCFWJNfKFAMd61imi7K/screenshot_3_.png) I started shooting the big structure that served as the source of the fog. I destroyed it after several shots, and at last, both Gamora and Groot were released from their spectral trance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbcr26aCUT2oytj9wj9ncro9Tf1cvnQHevuSvvU1cYMGU/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYg3xjJxa4AXrX2NUUzCTZ8DnWtQaCe6hEYx4hAkcBDni/screenshot_5_.png) Rocket came out of the hole to say he was okay and still not dead despite his fear. The rest of the team praised him for his bravery, as they knew water was his scariest challenge. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUK3o8ePUsUzF2VV4chvQ8UF9jMRbDRBbGn4tjNfsvGX/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcL4kx1xnKSu8wFNZJytpepXPC1Niu8HpxPcsFFC4zD4x/screenshot_7_.png) Mantis came down with Drax and mentioned she was sure what they needed was further down. Rocket took the jump first, determined that he would not get wet for nothing during this mission. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSwhH7gFfUv1oBxmstzzHZkgej2UQBxNy2e7kA5e2xMQC/screenshot_8_.png) After the jump, the Guardians started sliding downwards as it was a steep, slippery path through a dark cave. We had to navigate the descent carefully to reach the bottom of the cavern safely. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyvujz1XCh1GRhfjBfR1SHJYTjfHLVKfGbQWMqHA8Ryk/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCKZyedHXRN7zm8TeEXf5DHxV4naPkgigS1ncZ8PvAdz/screenshot_10_.png) After coming out of the cave, we found a fantastic place that was incredibly floral and filled with alien trees. A tiny creature ran ahead of us again as we explored the strange environment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFtHk8bL1Ep974Y3JXQU9Sx4ceCSeaSV6qKaUkAcmK5s/screenshot_11_.png) Mantis confirmed this was the right place, mentioning she was pretty sure they would find the objective down here. The area looked pretty awesome with its glowing flora and mysterious atmosphere. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdkufiWcWTx2o3HA7yWf3UoAq9ry98bfak5oHMXjBkRKX/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRujPBGqPFQKAM7pLDZEvG2tRjPMix4xZxn4z5gAumFT4/screenshot_13_.png) We noticed a structure that Mantis called the home of the healing light and the source of Raker's power. Rocket remained skeptical, jokingly suggesting she was going to feed them to a giant bug. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYizcKSCYfv927yH9puYVZoyNf3U1bx6r5YPUBDJ5tKV9/screenshot_14_.png) Peter touched the soil there and showed a gross reaction to the texture. title.body: 1/2 🧵 The Fermi Paradox is the contradiction between the high probability of extraterrestrial civilizations existing and the complete lack of evidence for them.\n\nNamed after physicist Enrico Fermi, who famously asked \

— the paradox points out that:

**The universe should be teeming with life.** There are billions of stars in our galaxy alone, many with planets in habitable zones. Even if intelligent life is rare, the sheer numbers suggest we should see *something* — radio signals, megastructures, probes, colonization waves.

**Yet we see nothing.** No contact, no signals, no artifacts. The cosmic silence is deafening.

title.body:
2/2 🧵 **Proposed solutions** range from optimistic to chilling:
- We're early (intelligence is extremely rare or recent)
- They're hiding or ignoring us (zoo hypothesis)
- Life self-destructs before going interstellar (Great Filter ahead of us)
- We've already passed the Great Filter (life itself is the hard step)
- They exist but communication is harder than we think
- We're alone (the universe is ours by cosmic accident)

The paradox matters because the answer tells us about our own future. If civilizations always destroy themselves, that's terrifying. If we're truly alone, that's equally profound.

从14号到22号短短的几天，好快好充实，又很不现实，行李箱一开一合就过了一个年，收拾好妈妈准备的东西，带点家乡味就开始回到工作的地方。我就会真的想到人的一生究竟为了什么。有句话说人的一生就活几个瞬间，我觉得也很有道理。也就是最重要的瞬间需要定格，比如说结婚的瞬间，孩子出生的瞬间，自己重要的人生闪光点。有时候人努力的目标就为了活好过年这几天，这是一个奔头。有点心酸好像也有点幸福。

今年过年其实也很意外，短短四天里面，我去了男朋友家里，男朋友也来了我家里，两家人还见了一面吃了饭。也是挺神奇的，今晚上感觉很多，我的舍友居然要去深圳工作了，我跟她合租了半年。就像家人一样深情厚谊，我真的很舍不得。我本来以为这样安心的生活可以继续下去很长时间，结果突然就可能要跟陌生的人合租。而且这个陌生的人合租，需要磨合和了解。生活总要继续，我真的觉得挺难受的，过一个年好像一场梦一样。要意识到自己成为一个大人，要感受到自己的情绪，自己爱护自己。2026年加油呀，明天就回到工作的地方，去到更多的地方迎接新年，顺顺利利！

title.title: Jack the Ripper
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakr3ywQgA5CmhusZVjQDoEStWg3VTkUH8pJwXRJg6ePU/bubble_3_.png)



Murder is an old idea in human society and we have witnessed thousands of murderers in history yet there is something very frightening about a murderer who disappeared without being detected at all. You can also concur with it that Jack the Ripper is one of the most unsettling unresolved crimes of all time. I think this case can teach us that in some cases the force of evil works in a free environment and justice cannot do anything regardless of the number of resources we spend on resolving this case. I am saying that it means all our progress in forensic science and methods of investigation are just nothing when we fail to recognize the murderer that lived more than a hundred years past. I am saying so because this case brought me to the recollection of how humans arrogantly present their skill to solve problems and that they had miserably failed when it was most needed by the victims and their families.

Jack the Ripper worked in the Whitechapel area of London in 1888 in a time span of few months between August and November. Even in the olden days, serial killers were not perceived as a phenomenon and the police did not have a systematic method of catching such predators. I would assume that killers would instinctively be caught due to their own mistakes but in this case the Ripper killed at least 5 women and maybe dozens of women without leaving any evidence to trace them. The victims were all poor ladies employed as prostitutes in the unsanitary slums of East London where there was already violence. In addition, majority of those women were killed with the use of surgical mastery, implying that the murderer had medical knowledge and as such, it made investigators suspect doctors butchers or any other person who had medical training.

The killings created a state of complete riot in London and the newspapers were fueling the morbid curiosity of people on the gory details of the same. What is shocking may be that the murderer purportedly wrote letters to the police and the media boasting of his acts of murder and vowing to kill more people. I also believed that in my opinion the letters were authentic or hoaxes that showed to the world how the case turned out to be a spectacle and not a proper investigation. These were the journalists who valued sales of newspapers above the assistance in catching a murderer and their pretentiousness poisoned the whole case. The media instead of letting a tragedy be the actual truth made it entertainment. I was not aware of how devastating irresponsible journalism is until I read various cases where I came to learn that more than victims are benefited by media interference, criminals end up benefiting.

The culprits investigated by the police in the years ranged a wide spectrum of criminals and suspects such as Polish immigrants, local tradesmen in the area who failed medical students, even the high society members. During the old times the investigation was crippled by the prejudice of classes and xenophobia where the authorities were fast to accuse foreigners and the poor. I understood that bias is a blindstreet to investigators and wastes their time in chasing innocent individuals and letting the real criminal off the hook. Therefore, I made the conclusion that Jack the Ripper was probably a common-looking average individual that did not cause any suspicion in his everyday life. And so he would be walking through society undetected since the society anticipated a monster to appear monstrous when the evil is usually pretending to be normal.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRd1yrWKSVc3HnG1UArSZAaqZMQixAANmfvR5EyfJL141/bubble_4_.png)
The murders were abruptly stopped in November 1888 and there is no clear-cut explanation as to why so. According to some theories, the Ripper was killed in an institution or just left London to another place. It seems to me that the abrupt termination is nearly as inexplicable as the murders. However, simultaneously as modern forensic scientists have tried to crack the case through the DNA analysis of preserved body parts with one such contentious study indicating that the murderer was a Polish immigrant called Aaron Kosminski but numerous forensic scientists indicate that the evidence is inconclusive.

The saddest aspect of the phenomenon of Jack the Ripper is that the case was romanticized and commercialized. As you could see, Whitechapel now benefits off Ripper tourism by having walking tours museums and merchandise entirely focused on brutal murders. In some situations this is immensely disrespectful to the real women with names such as Mary Ann Nichols Annie Chapman Elizabeth Stride Catherine Eddowes and Mary Jane Kelly. They were the poor forgotten victims and whose humanity is being wiped away by our fascination of their killer. Unless we recall these women as individuals not only body counts the case but this counts it as ghoulish entertainment instead of a tragedy that should be remembered.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXHBiofPtvTH8txArYDdFJZVrh7YMWvc2tvnyfbqmRWHB/bubble_5_.png)


The enigma has spawned innumerable theories books documentaries and even the accuse the British royalty of involvement using imaginative conspiracy theories. I believe that it does indeed exasperate earnest investigators that speculation so wild so frequently has the effect of drowning analysis. In addition it demonstrates that unresolved cases serve as tabula rasa and others use it to paint whatever they wish to believe even when evidence and reason are used against them.

Therefore, it is most unlikely that the real identity of Jack the Ripper will be established now that it has taken many years. They did not understand that it was a real person murder, a woman murder and making it a thrilling guess that is a disgrace to the dead. I suppose some mysteries will always remain to us and the inability to always get closure is not bad in my mind.

This unit is really tanky not only from Ulund bloodline line up but mostly in everyline up since having taunt ability with 3 magic damage 7 armor 9 health and 3 speed. Shield ability so without got from Bella this unit still having shield ability. Reveal that will make any camouflage ability units will exposed. and the last is Void Armor. This is what makes this unit strong. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjPWKz69nQRrVVt3pkNj3ShRYEKXuNv1fGSiExPeMp1F/screenshot_185_.png)

Then **Warmall Juggernaut** this unit is kinda like semi carry. Having 4 melee damage 5 armor 12 health and 3 speed. Having reach ability that can be a secondary tanker unit and also as carry unit that can give huge damage since this unit also have Armor Strike ability that can throw its armor that will give bonus damage beside its melee damage. Painforge ability that will make this unit got 1 power eachgot allied damage such as burn or electrified or reckless ability. And the last is amplify that kinda not too usefull for this unit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfELcrSEDrUV9rLofh19nSUE13ifCczcXaKNXigBoqB3/screenshot_186_.png)

Next when combined with Morribound Arrowbait, **Pixie Knife Hunter** is really good as tanker too with 2 range damage 4 armor, 8 health and 3 speed. This unit is Rare Rewards card. Having Close range ability that can make this unit can attacking even in frontline position, Dodge ability that will having chance to dodge any melee and range damage. Swiftness that will buff all allied unit with 1 speed. Enfeeble that will reduce any melee type attack on opponent line up that got hit by this unit and the last is Heal which is make this unit kinda great as tanker. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX5wyxBhxS78hJUc6p8UNLjQULvCX73zoN3Eev2tVT2Df/screenshot_187_.png)

The last that usually i am using as tanker is **Mystic Mudbinder** the common from Conclave Arcana Core set. This unit having 3 magic damage 6 armor 7 Health and 3 speed with Oppress ability that will double the damage when damaging non attacker units, Void Armor that will make any magic damage will attacking the armor first instead its health, Armor Strike that will make this unit can throw its armor, and Heal ability.

Of course we still need carry unit in line up to give huge damage to opponent line up or at least will make the opponent hardly to counter our line up. There is some carry that i pick this time

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLhdStBL2CxCHQaqD8tw6YvxXiustifr6J4qBieXUpCv/screenshot_188_.png)

The first carry is from Escalation edition that still not released yet. There is still 3 days left for Presale. Maybe after presale ended it can be opened and this unit can be used in the battle. **Okora The Devourer** with dual damager range and magic damage which is fully related with Morribound Arrowbait that can boost this unit attack with each 2 damage. Having 8 health and 5 speed which is kinda fast killer too.  Having great ability that is Opportunity that will hunting down the lowest health unit first. Enrage that will make this unit only faster since this unit is not melee unit. Phase Ward that giving Phase ability for the unit in front of this unit. Bloodlust that will give 1 buff to all stats after killing opponent, and Kindred Will : Mimic that will give adjacent unit that having Kindred Spirit unit Mimic. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZtzwXsWVipNadPCTCJBNvDX7a3d7EUq9dx4CEWghbBq/screenshot_189_.png)

Next is Runic Skychonk. This unit kinda strong for a carry and yet can be a friendly fire since this unit having Reckless ability. Having 3 magic damage 5 armor and 5 health with 2 speed. This unit having Armory Strike that can damage using Armor and the combo is Protect ability that can add 2 armor to all allied. That will make this unit having 7 armor and when comboed with semi tanker **Warwall Juggernaut** it will be so strong. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPezRg86jRoD8DRrfzCWc3QNvQGDbWN8ELhp65wv3jav/screenshot_190_.png)

And lastly for Carry unit is **Thunderous Herald**. This unit can be a carry unit since this unit having pretty good ability even though the stats is not too good with 2 magic damage 1 armor 8 health and 3 speed. But the ability is making this unit good that is Enfeeble that will cut down the melee unit damage by 1 when hitting melee unit. Relentless Strike that will adding damage when attacking unit that having shield, Void, or Forcefield ability. And the last is Execute that will attacking again if the opponent health left with 2 health after got this attack. 
Next we need filler and support unit. In this Ulund Bloodline there is just a few support that really supportive mostly can be an attacker too not just as support. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaH34fkCY14Xr7T5z2Xc6r7Z24ERbjGWvQL1UU7aiM1S8/screenshot_191_.png)

Like this one Reward card Legendary called **Nyasha Mbalka**. This unit can be as support since having support abilities but can be a carry too since this unit having pretty good range damage that is 3 range damage. Also having 1 armor 7 health and 5 speed which is can be deadly as range attacker. Especially with Opportunity ability that hunting down the lowest health unit first. Inspire ability that giving all allied melee unit 1 buff damage. Return Fire that will give back damage if got attacked by range unit. And stun that having chance to make opponent that got damage skipping its turn. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHTkMj5HCm6rwiAHyoHWK4JKUEVyMTBUakj9DLg69QRP/screenshot_195_.png)

Next there is **Bludgeon Hucker**. This unit usually used for the support unit since this unit having pretty good ability for support. But, sometimes it can be very helpfull and deadly since this unit having 3 range damage 1 armor, 6 health and 3 speed. With Snipe this unit will attacking the non melee unit from first lineup. So, this unit can ignoring tanker unit and attacker carry unit if the opponent missplacing it. Also this unit having slow ability that can reduce opponent line up speed and having protect ability that adding 2 armor to all allied unit. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUXxzjpRZ4ra7GLG3qhHLG8Syr6kBP5Peen1y4f8v3qXD/screenshot_194_.png)

 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesTGkpkiPUPjpATykQH6hGBxrcYGPZ28TnSfeRpj1exp/screenshot_193_.png)

Next is those **Stampeding Calf** and **Tandi Janda**. Both of them is really rare i found in battle since both of them is not enough as support and not enough as attacker. For example Stampeding Calf is too weak as attacker with 3 melee damage 6 health and 3 speed with ability just Charge that make this unit can attack from anywhere, Weaken that reduce opponent line up 1 health and deflect ability that will immune to blast,thorns damage. But,still its not enough as attacker. If only the attack is 5 melee damage maybe it can be worth to used. Next ** Tandi Janda** Rewards Epic which is not good enough as attacker because of melee damager with low health. Having 4 damage with 1 armor 5 health and 5 speed. Still not enough as carry unit since cannot attack from anywhere and too weak as a tanker that attacking frontline. Having WingBreak ability that can attack Flying ability unit (if wrongly guess this unit cannot attack from its spot unless placed in frontline) Slow ability that can reduce opponent line up speed which is good for support,Lookout that will reduce damage taken adjecent allied unit if attacked by sneak, snipe, or opportunity unit. And Scavenger ability that will adding health if anyone died. So, this unit kinda in the middle that hard to attack, hard to be a defender. And just having 2 ability as support without giving any buff to allied. 

https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmX9ac6dX78dK53noi8FXsWp9g8s1ZUyNkcxyZvKGGv8iy/untitled_design.gif

But, overall i think Ulund Army unit still can be really dangerous and if the opponent forget to bring any Final Rest ability unit. It will be fatal and can be defeated. title.title: Acknowledging the Good, Addressing the Bad
title.body: > There's a lot to be said when it comes to discussions about a country and its happenings. There are certainly things to be examined and considered. What comes out of such examination, in honesty and truthfulness reflects the current state of things and the happenings within it. There's much to speak about when I consider the happenings in my country; from time past, to recent dealings even up to the present day events and realities.

/> History reveals beautiful moments, and terrible ones. Even in recent times, there's the good and the bad that we can see and talk about. It's sad that it's mostly hard to find something good to talk about in my country. What can one expect when on a scale, the weight of the bad deeds far outweighs the good? It's either emanating from the leaders, mostly; directly or indirectly, or the people. As such, even when good things deserving of applause happen, they barely enjoy the spotlights, not enough before another bad deed takes it. That's the reality. While this is true of my country; that bad deeds overwhelm the good, there's nonetheless the good that can be considered and talked of, even in recent times. One of the few things that I've come to see and appreciate is the road construction work. Some time back last year, I travelled home and when I reached the town I reside in, it seemed different to me. There was a new road network and it was looking good, with an underpass and all. Also, in a few other places I've stepped my feet, this is the case and I must say it's laudable. I've seen on the news network as well, and from other people's testimonies about this from locations far from mine. It seems it's something that's happening around several parts of the country. In that regard, I duly applaud the government and authorities that made this possible. As I said, there are still some good things that can be considered and talked about even though we're overwhelmed by bad happenings far more than the good.

/> It's easy to point out bad things happening in my country. You could sleep for a few minutes, and when you woke, something bad would have happened, with little or no repercussions. I can say a lot, from the poor health care system to the poor education system. It reflects how unconcerned and negligent the government is about matters that should matter a lot. But I'll be considering one, and this is something that citizens have cried and complained about. Yet, it's still happening. I'm talking about the situation of insecurity. Sadly, people don't feel safe. To travel or leave home and come back safely is a great concern. If the security of the people is tampered with, and endlessly over time as it has been here, then there's failure from the government because it's one of its fundamental duties－to protect the lives of citizens. Some weeks back, a recent attack in a rural area revealed the mass killing of more than one hundred people. If there's a thing that saddens me about my country, it's this matter of insecurity. Who will enjoy the infrastructure, economy or technology when the people are no more? * * * _Images are mine._ * * * ###### Thank you for reading through!

title.title: Wandering Through Luxury: My Thursday Adventure at EDSA Shangri-La Plaza Mall
title.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/AK6XgmnYBY5SiBhsLPG1VfrwGWE99RP5CrjtkcLd3WozvU46YXKci2nP76AbHMV.jpeg)

**Hello Hive Friends!** Happy weekend to all of you. I hope you’re enjoying your days with joy and relaxation. I’m excited to share one of my little adventures this week that took me to one of the Philippines’ most famous luxury shopping destinations.

![743fac15-9a5e-46df-ac28-63ac531bdd50.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoptRchG6fUEo8BSnNWEAh2fyFQed2wf12mZLP4hstdRokFxdsquasiKa66cse8b8BR.jpeg)


![middle.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoAag8MEgwM87tqkhHf9fiJZFs9A7sfVcSSqgqTGk2MTi6TL6j7HeqSHXnoaX5zrCYV.jpeg)

![middle2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoAbCPKKpMvHQPXUAM7TBU23QBAfYtcGqbZnaYxcqV8XYFaoXbhFny9ptM9frhCa4S6.jpeg)

Just this Thursday, after completing my transactions at PAG-IBIG Office and BPI Bank along Shaw Boulevard, I decided to drop by **Shangri-La Plaza Mall** in Mandaluyong.

![middle3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoEpyLmWVTTkHCSrmq6Ro6WqL1Yi1AjymN3LohV3UPjBHXyjqftpJEiW3Camcfstcp9.jpeg)

![rustans.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EopvKoLxTtZDznzp4Jyn8YoaMuvyiXHZSJMmkQimRGep39RcPVyBMSkPDe8Wafpv46Z.jpeg)

Inside, I couldn’t resist taking random photos to capture the beauty of the place:

•	The center part of the mall filled with **boutiques, coffee shops, and vibrant displays**.
•	The elegant **Red Carpet Cinema**, perfect for movie lovers.
•	The fun and practical finds at **Daiso Japan**.
•	And many other corners that highlight the mall’s charm.

![daiso.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoeGQ7ZZPvKLprPFFUyAfjHNQjwUZL5vR1V6sfDsPZr79zAk1QsgEUAd8LwSWBHiKZr.jpeg)

![red carpet.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoiWCH8mqLAHj7r1zvnZUwGw9daPYeczz2S8vnHB8QYBhNP33XychBvoYCfXHYdPRc9.jpeg)

The atmosphere was lively yet classy, and it’s no surprise that sometimes you might spot actors and actresses casually roaming around. Truly, Shangri-La Plaza lives up to its reputation as a luxury shopping haven.

![going to starmall.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EpCBJYM7jNQfqZTTiUbaQzkSwgAqKBcij8fBEdHwTRNtFeSCAxC52jtYewkHTzMqmZJ.jpeg)

![gping to starmall1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoCicYzGu7BcCXKCtvKG5qmiL26HCwSgU8YuCsqMH3Mm9pKbanYm9LoRi4jk8gU4vNs.jpeg)

I’m grateful to share this little journey with you, Hive Fam. **Thank you for always reading my blogs and joining me in these everyday adventures.** May your weekend be filled with joy, relaxation, and maybe even a bit of exploration too! 💖

title.title: MCGI Topic Review | Do we all believe in one God
title.body: > https://youtu.be/FOyK8rSBKsg?si=TkhZcCN_BdzS4Lxq The question of Do we all believe in one God is significant and valuable particularly in a world where there exists many religions and beliefs. The world has several different people who worship differently, have varied names of god and different traditions. Due to this, one might assume that we have a belief in numerous gods. However, when we go deeper we will find that the fact that there is one real God is not isolated. The bible explicitly educates the fact that there is no other God. Deuteronomy 6:4, provides that, Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord. In this verse, it is depicted that God is not partitioned. He is unique, and He is only one who should be worshipped. Although people refer to Him using various names, the real God remains to be one. In my opinion, confusion occurs when individuals pay more attention to religion than on God himself. There are rules, cultures and practices in religions yet God is above all these. Ephesians 4:6 says in the bible, there is one God and Father of all who is above all and through all, and in you all. This informs us that God belongs to all people and not only one group. Jesus Christ also preached of a single god. In John 17:3 He said, That they might know the only true God. This makes us remember that knowing God is not about division and argument, but truth and relationship. In summary, even not everybody thinks in the same manner, but in Bible it is clearly taught that there is only one true God. I believe that in case people try to find answers in truthful and modest ways, they will get to know this fact. Our faith in a single God must result in our love, unity and purity in the service of God. God bless his word Amen

title.title: Wallets físicas: qué son, cómo se usan y cuáles son las mejores 👨🏼‍🏫📈
title.body:
![1000399389.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/web3labs-da/23tRxtLwxHmA49qzkphdSVgm9WeEhVoPUpHHZBM9673qYRMaA2WhTXMMJW5Fzk8o1vz9V.png)


**Resumen:** En un entorno digital donde los exchanges y los monederos de software son vulnerables a ciberataques constantes, las wallets físicas o cold wallets se presentan como la única solución robusta para la protección de activos. 

La seguridad es la preocupación número uno para cualquier inversionista en el ecosistema de las criptomonedas, sobre todo cuando la administración del dinero depende en gran medida de su propietario. Por ello, mantener capital en plataformas de intercambio o exchanges expone al usuario a riesgos de robos, hackeos o incluso bloqueos gubernamentales. Ante esta realidad, surge la necesidad de tomar el control total de los activos mediante dispositivos como las wallets físicas.

Una wallet física, también conocida como monedero de hardware o hardware wallet, es una pieza de tecnología **diseñada específicamente para guardar de forma segura las claves criptográficas privadas de un usuario fuera de línea.** Físicamente, estos dispositivos suelen ser pequeños y compactos, guardando en ocasiones un parecido estético con memorias USB, pero con componentes internos especializados.

<span style=\

/> *Trezor es una de las hardware wallets más famosas del mercado.* Es fundamental desmitificar su funcionamiento: a diferencia de un monedero convencional para moneda fiat, una wallet física de criptomonedas no contiene las \

en sí mismas. En el mundo de la cadena de bloques, los activos son simplemente datos que residen en el libro mayor distribuido. Lo que realmente posee el usuario son las claves criptográficas (pública y privada).

- La Clave Pública: Funciona como un número de cuenta bancaria que permite recibir fondos.

- La Clave Privada: Es equivalente a un código PIN o clave secreta de acceso.

La wallet física protege esta clave privada en un entorno de almacenamiento \
(cold storage). Al estar desconectada de Internet, se eliminan los vectores de ataque digital que utilizan los piratas informáticos para comprometer monederos \

o con custodia en la nube. Estos dispositivos cuentan con chips de seguridad que impiden el acceso a los datos sin una autenticación previa por parte del propietario, ofreciendo una capa de soberanía financiera inigualable.

![1000399390.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/web3labs-da/1000399390.png)


### ¿Cómo se usan las wallets físicas?

El uso de una wallet física se basa en la interacción entre el dispositivo (fuera de línea) y la red (en línea), garantizando que los datos sensibles nunca se expongan al exterior. Este proceso se gestiona a través de lo que se denomina un \

, donde cada vez que el dispositivo físico se conecta a un computador puede acceder a la red de Bitcoin o la criptomoneda para llevar a cabo el firmado de transacciones.\n\nEl proceso de transacción \

Cuando un usuario desea realizar un envío o intercambio de activos, el procedimiento técnico sigue estos pasos:

- **Conexión:** El usuario conecta su wallet física a un ordenador o dispositivo móvil mediante USB, Bluetooth o códigos QR.

- **Preparación:** A través de un software o interfaz en el ordenador, se preparan los datos de la transacción sin firmar.

- **Firma Criptográfica:** El software envía la transacción al dispositivo físico. Es aquí donde ocurre el paso crucial: el monedero firma la transacción internamente utilizando la clave privada almacenada en su chip seguro. En ningún momento la clave privada sale del dispositivo hacia el ordenador.

- **Transmisión:** Una vez firmada, el dispositivo devuelve la transacción ya validada al software, que se encarga de transmitirla a la cadena de bloques para completarla.

### ¿Cómo debo mantener, administrar y recuperar mi wallet física?

Para utilizar estos dispositivos de forma segura, el usuario debe gestionar un PIN de acceso y una frase de recuperación (semilla). La frase de recuperación suele consistir en una serie de 12 a 24 palabras generadas aleatoriamente por el dispositivo durante su configuración inicial.

Si el hardware se rompe, se pierde o es robado, estas palabras permiten restaurar todas las claves y el acceso a los fondos en un dispositivo nuevo.

Es una mejor práctica almacenar esta frase de recuperación físicamente en un lugar seguro (fuera del domicilio si es posible) y protegida de elementos como el fuego o el agua. Jamás se debe digitalizar ni anotar en dispositivos conectados a la red.

<span style=\

/> *La frase semilla son una serie de palabras que representan el acceso total a tu wallet.* ### ¿Cuáles son las mejores wallets hardware? En 2026, el mercado ofrece diversas opciones adaptadas a distintos perfiles de inversor, desde aquellos que buscan simplicidad hasta quienes requieren las medidas de seguridad más extremas. Según la tecnología y durabilidad de sus materiales (plásticos duros o metales), estas son las opciones más destacadas: - **Ellipal Titan 2.0:** Un dispositivo robusto que destaca por su seguridad física y su sistema de \
(air-gapped), interactuando únicamente mediante códigos QR sin necesidad de conexiones físicas.\n\n<span style=\
/> - **Ledger Nano X:** Ofrece un equilibrio ideal entre portabilidad y seguridad, permitiendo gestionar activos desde el móvil mediante Bluetooth y un chip de seguridad certificado.
/> - **Trezor Safe:** La evolución de la marca pionera, centrada en el código abierto y una interfaz intuitiva para el usuario.
/> - **Tangem Wallet:** Un concepto innovador en formato de tarjeta que utiliza tecnología NFC para firmar transacciones, eliminando la necesidad de baterías o cables.

蒜蓉小龙虾真是一道让人垂涎欲滴的美食！每一只小龙虾都被蒜蓉的香气浸透，吃上一口，鲜嫩的虾肉伴随着浓郁的蒜香，令人无法抗拒。搭配上微微的辣味，味道层次更加丰富，非常开胃。和朋友们一起分享这道菜，边剥边聊天，热闹气氛让人倍感快乐。绝对是夏季的最佳美食选择！
