title.title: One day, which should be done every day / Un día, que se debe hacer todos los días (ENG /ESP)
title.body:
**Greetings, dear community,**

Although Valentine's Day has historical roots, Western culture has adopted it as a celebration of love and friendship, marked by displays of affection and the exchange of gifts and flowers. In my opinion, Love and Friendship Day is a day to remember that every day is a good day to show affection. It is common to see lots of text messages, gift exchanges, and celebrations. I like to remind my friends and family of the importance of maintaining bonds through continuous and genuine presence.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23w2q4MYc9LWN2fNh4k4wCfpKetcodDb7FSyz9eAjCEngwqov8iGhwgeXgMRJS4BTW6mF.png) ***

The first gift I give is to myself, out of respect and love. I ask myself: What do I want today? And I indulge my desire. A meal, a purse, or simply enjoying moments in nature. I accept and value myself, from the pleasure of being who I am, and from there, I look at my best friend, the one who is with me at all times, whom I care for and recognize.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23x1FLHfhPuxJ8sJPuxED32fomz79qCJxpP62ybQRTb7T8RHMMSiV6kezGhPq3Y9THw8k.png) ***

I remember when she was just 4 years old, holding out her little finger to intertwine it with mine, she told me that we would always be best friends. With tears in my eyes, I hugged her, and to this day, I hope it stays that way, we have had a beautiful relationship. This year, I will be doing a live Instagram session with my friend Marietta where we will talk about connections and self-love. How can we love others if we don't love ourselves? This is a topic we have been working on in Biodanza sessions with participants to continue discovering how wonderful we are.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/EoEq4vjMtve7FquG3hbj4XneUqF337qrwq8Eaxo2ByhE9q8MFKWNSw5rpidb39f8TWr.png) *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23yJX4z8GA66bzhRwriG43ahMuz2tj6CSZ3r6NBvBwCyE3pG7r5DinU8dnVmgfh9mrRtG.png) *** I am grateful to the @ladiesofhive community for [week's proposal](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-276) @cautiva-30 Thank you for reading my post, and I appreciate your comments. *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23tvoDdvScX4U9ydTBaPZEMruu9H79zdqfdMx6a1aiH8TWaEKCqRdZK2XzrYJPe94G2Z8.png) ***

**Saludos querida comunidad**, Aunque el día de San Valentín tiene raíces históricas, la cultura occidental la ha tomado como una celebración del amor y la amistad en la cual se realiza por medio de demostraciones afectivas e intercambio de regales y flores. En mi criterio el Día del Amor y la Amistad, es un día para recordar que todos los días, son propicios para ser afectivos. Gran cantidad de mensajes por celular, intercambios de regalos y celebraciones es el común. A mí me gusta recordar a mis amigos y familiares la importancia de mantener los vínculos, desde la presencia continua y verdadera.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23w2q4MYc9LWN2fNh4k4wCfpKetcodDb7FSyz9eAjCEngwqov8iGhwgeXgMRJS4BTW6mF.png) ***

El primer regalo que doy es para mí desde el respeto y el amor. Me pregunto: ¿Qué quiero hoy? Y desde mi deseo me complazco. Una comida, una cartera o simplemente el disfrutar de momentos en la naturaleza. Me acepto y me valoro, desde el placer de ser quien soy y de allí, miro a mi mejor amiga, la que está conmigo en todo momento, a la que cuido y reconozco.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23x1FLHfhPuxJ8sJPuxED32fomz79qCJxpP62ybQRTb7T8RHMMSiV6kezGhPq3Y9THw8k.png) ***

Recuerdo, cuando apenas tenía 4 años, mostrando su dedo meñique, para entrelazarlo con el mío, me dijo que siempre seriamos mejores amigas. Con lágrimas en los ojos, la abrace y hasta el día de hoy, y deseando que siga así, hemos tenido una hermosa relación. Este año estaré haciendo un Live por Instagram con mi amiga Marietta donde conversaremos sobre el los vínculos y el amor propio, ¿Cómo amar a otros sino nos amamos a nosotras mismas?, un tema que hemos estado trabajando en las sesiones de Biodanza con las participantes para seguir descubriendo lo maravillosa que somos.

*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/EoEq4vjMtve7FquG3hbj4XneUqF337qrwq8Eaxo2ByhE9q8MFKWNSw5rpidb39f8TWr.png) *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23yJX4z8GA66bzhRwriG43ahMuz2tj6CSZ3r6NBvBwCyE3pG7r5DinU8dnVmgfh9mrRtG.png) *** Agradecida a la comunidad @ladiesofhive por la propuesta de [esta semana](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-276) de @cautiva-30 **Gracias por llegar hasta aquí y tomarte el tiempo para leer mi publicación, aprecio también sus comentarios.** *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marielarc07/23tbRcuQpwrCLbG65diN2sh7PooqpwfzfX6ydwwMzrqfkdqHVexfH9HdWnfj3nX2p4h3Q.png) ***

title.body:
Common juniper. 
I love conifers: bushes, trees. I like their smell. The smell of a Christmas tree is the smell of the New Year, because it is customary for us to put a Christmas tree in our homes for the New Year. Its smell spreads throughout the house. It is a pleasant aroma. And then there is the smell of mandarins. We buy a lot of mandarins in winter. Mandarins are delicious with champagne. We drink champagne on New Year's Eve, when the clock strikes midnight. 
I also like coniferous trees because they are always green, no matter what time of year it is. When other trees have shed their leaves, the needles remain green. They have green needles. I have a thuja and two pine trees growing at home. I like them. They decorate the yard in winter.

title.title: Rubby Pérez (es/en)
title.body:
Hello, street art enthusiasts! As always, it is a pleasure to share a new discovery, and this time it is a posthumous mural that the artist *** Jost_Painter*** created in honour of Dominican singer Rubby Pérez, who died while performing at a show in his country, in which many people, including himself, died when the roof of the nightclub where he was performing collapsed on all those attending, leaving many dead and injured. 

![IMG_20251130_151915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/EouA7fZ6HScjH8j9icEzmbcfQWHbCtsUYxJaKFXaQxocjERk3iyaBJj7pVJTbQbUmX1.jpg)

![IMG_20251130_151906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/EoeGpgoBeg2gs7aD6fHxDBxXbZ3KkqDiPpFApLrNJVJPzkZzss2nDtLfvk44mtxVCMa.jpg)

![IMG_20251130_151742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/Eqb45L7LEDkuAJnVk3djcH4EzSjDLdXMszyStFmCjNXEiqaifPqz8cBmbWwJVrEzFsJ.jpg)


This mural is located in my hometown, Barquisimeto, Venezuela, on a busy street.

On the mural, we can see the names of the Venezuelans who died in this event. Ultimately, it is a moving and honourable mural dedicated to this merengue singer who was very famous in Latin America and the Caribbean.

![IMG_20251130_151844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/Eonm2RPu6rj1QGs97ipJ34BFFwDoND2LWuJhWN3fF381iX3HxNS8x88AMgoa3KDKHEr.jpg)

![IMG_20251130_151731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/EpQxkCgmhJdGELrseEuiHMpwcKA2RfjJiK18EMxyD3TYK3tqwnyaya6Drw2sJ3nc9nT.jpg)

Without further ado, I hope you liked it.

Photos taken with my ZTE mobile phone. 
In Barquisimeto, Venezuela. 
Author of the mural: *Jost_Painter*.

### spanish ###


Hola amigos de streetart, como siempre es un gusto poder publicar un nuevo hallazgo, y está vez se trata de muy mural post mortem que el artista ***Jost_Painter*** realizó en honor al cantante Dominicano Rubby Pérez quien murió cantando en medio de un show en su país el cual murieron muchas personas incluyendolo a el debido a que el techo de la discoteca donde el se presentaba de cayó encima de todos los asistentes y hubo muchos muertos y heridos 




![IMG_20251130_151915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frankblack/EouA7fZ6HScjH8j9icEzmbcfQWHbCtsUYxJaKFXaQxocjERk3iyaBJj7pVJTbQbUmX1.jpg)

title.title: Romantic Relationship insight
title.body:
>

Valentine period is popular known to be a special time to express love, kindness, gratitude between couples, and within those in relationships especially romantic relationship. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmanH3YHEzVpQm6TH9WhpVWpcVLLonELD5BUkYkuo4K6Kt/valentines-day-background-437968_1280.jpg 
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/valentines-day-background-couple-437968/)

One of the reason why I believe that any relationship especially \

should be 50/50, is because the both partners are very important, and I see no positive sign why one should be regarded as more important and the other less important. If every relationship runs In that way, partners will then live peacefully and respectfully if they are seeing each other equally. I think, romantic relationship should full in the same wey as partnership. Just like the way different companies do partner with each other, if romantic relationship is practised like that, then most relationship is going to be very nice. No partner will find it easy to look down nor try to become Dependent financially. With my personal experience on how I discovered most reason why some relationship Do have issues at times, and most especially in My country. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTb5iGNt8P1AqWyh3UncGbGu15gtPwVdcXbaHAdNo4W7j/valentines-day-background-2561053_1280.jpg [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/valentines-day-background-people-2561053/) In most cases, you can easily find some relationships partners being dependent to their fellow partner, to fully take care of their needs, provide free money, pay their bills and many more. This habit is mostly practised by some ladies, and some men does that as well, but... It's never goes high like that of some ladies. For a partner to be dependent to the other is never a good thing and I don't see it as a positive direction that can promote peace and love in any type of relationship. I believe being dependent is one of the main reason why some relationship do have issues, and before they might take a step to give it a stop, it might had already escalated to Great miss understanding. And if care is not taken, it might result in making the relationship unhealthy. so, for me. As any relationship concern, most especially romantic relationship. It should be seen as a partnership with each other, which should be 50/50 because the two partners are very important and and they have to work together so that things will work out perfectly well. If not, many things will go upside down. **Thanks for visiting my blog** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@youngezeblinzz/romantic-relationship-insight--bys)

title.title: From Morning in Manali to Sunset in Batal A Day of Adventure Across Harsh Roads and Hidden Himalayan Valleys
title.body:
![IMG_1617.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjjiQQoYZ4RwQu2WxtN8SDKMo6MxnWPg56fKwzrsn5dC/IMG_1617.jpeg)

Julley Everyone,


A beautiful morning out here today in the Himalayas as today, the day went something kind of different from it used to be every single day as today was the day when we decided to go on the expedition, the expedition that was kind of heavy. I would say the expedition at high altitude place and also at the remote locations in the Himalayas. So was this adventure my friends all the way exploring the remote locations around the northern Himalayas beyond kullu Valley, and so was this campsite called Batal. 

![IMG_1618.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJnjrn8JTfV6PT8hq9TxV2TVQTV9e3wmVyv3d9Q2eKqQ/IMG_1618.jpeg)

In this post, I’m gonna take you guys along with me to this journey where we went all the way from Manali and reached this beautiful location over here in the Himalayas and will take you guys along with me to this journey and share these beautiful moments with you guys through this post.

# the beginning of the adventure. 
![IMG_1619.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYY3nhrfxCVAq39fFdQ452rm7UaZA7Li6HBYUZeGYdbHQ/IMG_1619.jpeg)

So the journey begins something just like this. It was near about 7 AM when we started a journey all the way from Manali. It took us near about five hours in order to reach this place as the condition of the road it was so harsh. It was literally a narrow Trail that we came all the way through and literally my friends the views around the place. They were so beautiful and so magical followed by the views of hidden Hima Mountain peaks around the place we have been driving continuously, and it was literally so much of adventure that I would say in just a single day as it was the beginning of the adventure into the places, unknown and places isolated over here around the hidden valleys of Himalayas.

![IMG_1620.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBmXBuHXCeRLE7ZMsiyJvLN9o9QwuR8RcQgadchNmaYu/IMG_1620.jpeg)

Currently, when we reached at this campsite, the whole landscape kind of looked something just like this. There were these dry Mount peaks, followed by the place being at beyond the altitude of near about more than 4000 m above the sea level where literally we were above the non-tropical zone above the tree line, we hardly any sort of vegetation around the place.


![IMG_1621.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVMj9w7RvThHWVR2NWdDNAne5tjaFcu9UGUgG37LCrbZ9/IMG_1621.jpeg)

Moreover, we have been riding all the way through Manali in our motorcycles, and it was literally a dream come true moment that for a person who loves to ride motorcycles and that too in the Himalayas in these high altitude, himalayan mountain bike from Royal Enfield. 


![IMG_1622.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTAWpLx5jdRvLrfRNiQ4XjUxgB44QffqAsfbqR1W45MHd/IMG_1622.jpeg)

![IMG_1623.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma3CSmoBPAnS6GWMutGr2guzBEkHKaP4XECkb7LArbGEK/IMG_1623.jpeg)

It was truly a beautiful experience that I had on my friends that even the words can’t express, but more than the words the photos can express. It was literally beautiful moment that I spend here reached at this place, the whole landscape it was somewhere midday and due to high altitude place the sun it set early. It was about 3 PM later in the afternoon when the whole landscape, it was something like this now we were to think about where to stay and luckily, it was the campsite that we got followed by the old kind of Cafe called. dhaba that was also at the place that offered us fresh hot tea with some food. Also, usually the person is at the place for near about 3 to 4 months when the place is also accessible. Usually when the whole place is getting covered under a thick sheet of snow that the Snow last for quite a lot of time throughout the year. 


![IMG_1624.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZfKT3um7BKBiHJ6m5QsbfWasikqDprXtWLPJr3YXMwLs/IMG_1624.jpeg)

title.title: You are being assembled by what you consume every day
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJ9pD4QXq5zbLBftcxxjwVb4UuGHsUyiF54tLYAFqD4g/1771686738409.png)


> Thumbnail made using OpenAi

Do you know that right now as you're reading this blog, you have another version of yourself? 

Yesz there's a chance you don't even know about the other you, and you're not consciously working on developing this version, it's coming together because of the food you ate today and the longer you allow for conversations to go, podcasts, TV shows and the people you want to be around when everything seems boring for you.

One of the smart people I know said something to me about how your habits become your character and that's where I have been focusing a lot on the assembly process. The everyday assembly.

When it comes to food, it's usually thought of as an everyday thing, until you realize there is a connection to what you consume that is much more than that. The books you read are going to influence how high your thought ceiling is. Who you hang out with has an impact on how normal or desired you think the world is. You will become more normal through your experience or understanding.

Let's say for example, I have a park bench I sit at, a cup I drink from and a few go to people I talk to regularly. All of these things are typical structures of my days. I didn't create these intentionally, I created them without thinking about them. Therefore when I look at my life from within, that's what appears to me.

The new version of me that gets created through this process of aggregate input is not something I know before it is created out of habit, it comes into being fully developed with established opinions and consistent levels of tolerance for frustration or impatience.

You have the ability to audit your inputs. You can observe the inputs that are contributing to your assembly process. Regardless if you choose to observe them, the assembly process continues. The chair, the cup and the conversation are examples of this process.

To make it more detailed for you, this picture I'll share with you has list of some of the things you should be mindful of in your life because whether you see it or not, they shape your entire life.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaPD4JuPPhKZBNNv3PAM6AvfZGXwbgUtuGC79JRTy7Dn/1771686811193.jpg)

title.title: Renovating the garden
title.body:
>
![20260220_094613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23xpAVNZyB3BfR7deMVGxaUbWzLpvFnBwvX6pGh9Gpx8oHrQZYLZPsi2egZucnDHEatof.jpg)
The sacks of soil I bought have arrived. They brought me 20 sacks of river soil, 4 sacks of dry sticks, 3 sacks of wood ash, and a sack of coconut fiber. I have enough material to mix soils and make delicious substrates for my plants.
![20260221_094245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/EoK6kQL7yowfK5Wb5sj33bd21xjW3M1KhfdQ55kxcXHXUVKoFecjegxTjD2VcBH7jBR.jpg)
I am going to renew the soil in the recycled rubber planters, adding prepared soil so that, in addition to the elements I mentioned earlier, they also have organic worm compost. While turning the soil, I found this bunch of ginger and some small turmeric shoots. If they are not harvested in time, they will rot in the substrate.
![20260220_100025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23w2sW5uqTdAjEAfTtACKGNts5SoxMd2K3fsNAqenMuaihfvLtdtUGvb799napVWHMnYP.jpg)
![20260220_100032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23uFXkJJ5FAeY9LAsWNWgVa1ypr3ba7iG2XxWXxwW1dMibaMxVKWfCy8zwQFU5YBzPqxp.jpg)
After placing the new substrate in the rubber, I will replant the ginger and turmeric sprouts I removed. This time, I will keep an eye on the plants and harvest them on time.
![20260220_101049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23vsNbfVjX1ssh3C83h5fx7G5h77ax2WFnhM5NkZkWv1WWFq4rioETJaJYhnE6xyyvRSX.jpg)
The substrate for the lilies was also removed. Now I must wait for all these bulbs to sprout again and bring back my beautiful white lilies.
![20260220_101059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23x1BTBj8LkmTwU5adWjuAXAjUykusjmeWhNcpmEpueRgUPcAUpSfEUTgidxAdjTt8NQp.jpg)
I have moved the lemon plants to larger black bags. There are about 10 lemon plants of different sizes. They are in small bags and can no longer withstand the heat and lack of water.
![20260220_085406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/EoeFx6WhWKSctpMGYjFHVhrfFmwfdK5FC6Qh9upNqDUPB2EjEVhLbFUNTfJRVKwhAQ8.jpg)
![20260220_094554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23wX1BhWNpZhQvZrYroQa6ab5o1RyA5cZKoKvVNXis2FrDpW1fDtwew5faBrksg6BaTzh.jpg)
I also transplanted the cucumber seedlings into black bags; these three will grow very nicely. In time, I will put stakes in for them to climb on. I see that two of them had their roots touched during the transplant, and their stems have fallen. I hope it is only temporary and they will recover. That is what happened, yesterday they were sad, but today they are very happy.
![20260220_104613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23vsNmq7e5WZvoVhxaKU9ZnXLgRQ4hQ4M2JC2CxA573ELqBvxMNFEbXUvvYL32Ng5EZsi.jpg)
![20260220_104609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23uFXzr3rBZtscSGNAKfw8P1A5C1zrhAxYu6hNdeAPK3h9Uvkt4u3RBh34yR1waKGDRjq.jpg)
![20260221_094027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23wC9MEbVQ9ad8pjUstZn7gGqPmCCotA7rKewcB4XimVMqoz59qgnvgfsuPF3Upi91exk.jpg)
We have run out of prepared substrate, so planting and transplanting are suspended until Monday, when we will prepare substrate to transplant the peppers and tomato plants.
![20260220_084732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23vsNmnjQLmqdAQaCsLsXo88bN9hHqu75AwaQWrU92wrLPeGXNNjTeh63ECxtRXiMfojT.jpg)
I plan to plant potatoes to make the most of the land. I'll buy the potatoes and let them sprout. As soon as I have the sprouts, I'll start planting. Until the next update from my garden. The banners are made with Canva. The photographs are taken with the Samsung Galaxy S26. ![separador1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23tRzsAvAC4DmbQLVD6ZkH5k67gPJupDg1mvrCJf5Zb3g3ffym7iowCx4s6GdyTV5wb8f.png)

These magical triangular structures are the Gombos-hegyi wine cellars in Hercegkút. Far from being homes for small creatures, they are historic cellars carved into the ground, some reaching up to 40 meters deep!

This site is so unique and culturally significant that it was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walking through these grassy hills feels like stepping directly into a Tolkien novel, but with the added bonus of centuries of winemaking tradition.

Truly a dream location for any photographer! 📸

Credits: 📸 @peter.rajkai

Location: Hercegkút, Hungary 🇭🇺

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope that by the grace of Allah, everyone is well and healthy. I wish you all the best. I am also well with all my family by the grace of Allah, so friends, first of all, let me inform you that from today, the month of fasting, that is, the month of Ramadan, has begun in our country. Today, I am presenting a video of myself to you, wishing everyone a happy Ramadan.

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you tonight. The month of Ramadan is going on in our country, which we call the month of fasting. May we be blessed in this month of Ramadan, hoping to get closer to Allah. From dawn to dusk, we do not eat or drink anything and we are usually busy with prayers and recitation. This month is very important for us and is known as the month of self-purification. In this month, it is very easy to gain Allah's light because in this month, Allah's mercy starts to descend on a large scale. Getting close to Allah on the phone and gaining it becomes very easy. Friends, today I was fasting. Today is the third fast of this month of Ramadan. We do not know whether we will get this fast next year. Maybe Allah calls us to leave this world. So, by getting closer to Allah through more worship and devotion, we can choose the path of salvation in the afterlife. That is why we fast in this month. Friends, today I made a new video to show you during Iftar after fasting. It is a video of a tamarind juice. So friends, let's steal today's video.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQUhYS4LN1a6Azs9X4xacoA6b1WLe4XceMqbHGaVD3pG/1771684905900.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBeSfCBLXjK2H3yninW7hKW8FmdaESPRE5kwh3GkxLuQ/1771684906098.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZXoSpzVcaitU6gQFqSXAuQPJr6xDceDwKnme1ur6iRq/1771684906306.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9u6j2Prf4SdWw9CAGNU1eAyFq7tvZvGqXzs1LPc6MTr/1771684771696.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2S1TteF4dV613rwEyNc42pGZWwKgUPqP7VRKUmyGB9w/1771684771924.jpg)

So friends, to make this, we will need a lot of tamarind. We will soak the tamarinds for a while and then remove the seeds from them and mix them well with water and add some salt to it. However, if beet salt is used instead of salt, this syrup will become more delicious. We will use a lot of sugar so that our mouths will have a taste. And in this case, it is a very tasty and nutritious food. Its popularity increases a lot during the month of Ramadan. So friends, I took some tamarind sugar and salt for this syrup and stirred them very nicely and finally I chopped a green chili and added it to enhance its taste.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd876QDzDtG7YWv8ASGFKzFSDK74nbumVWMSW3sQHK39N/1771684794897.jpg)

That's why we always make some kind of sherbet, but today, making an exception, we have made a tamarind sherbet. It is a very popular food, especially for those who are fasting. But to be honest, I can't eat it much because I find it sour. However, today I had a lot of fun. Goodbye, I ate some of it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXyzsMeVJbBXwHgadBhyRUVYtk7yiLxmHaQ5kbqwEizT/1771684746933.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVPBKss4LpYoccRfhnT4mFUPMrH73YaN2AwH8w3htbnt/1771684747198.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZvZu2sVrA9Rk8MMvFYNcn9JUxqGgtPugWgFHY36RwtT/1771684747408.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you tonight. The month of Ramadan is going on in our country, which we call the month of fasting. May we be blessed in this month of Ramadan, hoping to get closer to Allah. From dawn to dusk, we do not eat or drink anything and we are usually busy with prayers and recitation. This month is very important for us and is known as the month of self-purification. In this month, it is very easy to gain Allah's light because in this month, Allah's mercy starts to descend on a large scale. Getting close to Allah on the phone and gaining it becomes very easy. Friends, today I was fasting. Today is the third fast of this month of Ramadan. We do not know whether we will get this fast next year. Maybe Allah calls us to leave this world. So, by getting closer to Allah through more worship and devotion, we can choose the path of salvation in the afterlife. That is why we fast in this month. Friends, today I made a new video to show you during Iftar after fasting. It is a video of a tamarind juice. So friends, let's steal today's video.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQUhYS4LN1a6Azs9X4xacoA6b1WLe4XceMqbHGaVD3pG/1771684905900.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBeSfCBLXjK2H3yninW7hKW8FmdaESPRE5kwh3GkxLuQ/1771684906098.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZXoSpzVcaitU6gQFqSXAuQPJr6xDceDwKnme1ur6iRq/1771684906306.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRPbor7kUJnpX8HuFtqV88yQ8JaL2BNYoUU1f3XCU3pR6/1771684771286.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVYEbHEnXaNVenrrz8gkYPPCEPHqXJnx9QoB13j5gb4P9/1771684771508.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9u6j2Prf4SdWw9CAGNU1eAyFq7tvZvGqXzs1LPc6MTr/1771684771696.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2S1TteF4dV613rwEyNc42pGZWwKgUPqP7VRKUmyGB9w/1771684771924.jpg)

So friends, to make this, we will need a lot of tamarind. We will soak the tamarinds for a while and then remove the seeds from them and mix them well with water and add some salt to it. However, if beet salt is used instead of salt, this syrup will become more delicious. We will use a lot of sugar so that our mouths will have a taste. And in this case, it is a very tasty and nutritious food. Its popularity increases a lot during the month of Ramadan. So friends, I took some tamarind sugar and salt for this syrup and stirred them very nicely and finally I chopped a green chili and added it to enhance its taste.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd876QDzDtG7YWv8ASGFKzFSDK74nbumVWMSW3sQHK39N/1771684794897.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQUhYS4LN1a6Azs9X4xacoA6b1WLe4XceMqbHGaVD3pG/1771684795127.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJmD22BBDqM5t6kxMfaLwyCZDHUCCPygYUrMWCmdRe7d/1771684795305.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX462DHNndF2xeLP7zs1JQQauAqRYoGZxxLaupTRMMUqL/1771684795531.jpg)

So friends, to be honest, this sherbet is very delicious and nutritious because during the month of Ramadan, fasting all day, drinking this sherbet is very delicious. That's why we always make some kind of sherbet, but today, making an exception, we have made a tamarind sherbet. It is a very popular food, especially for those who are fasting. But to be honest, I can't eat it much because I find it sour. However, today I had a lot of fun. Goodbye, I ate some of it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZXoSpzVcaitU6gQFqSXAuQPJr6xDceDwKnme1ur6iRq/1771684813909.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBeSfCBLXjK2H3yninW7hKW8FmdaESPRE5kwh3GkxLuQ/1771684814127.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTtqYr7zAUUpPEhPiZ3YnZgRMmPEpHrJ3JBbeq1ACHRy7/1771684814343.jpg)

Friends, how did you like today's tamarind juice? You must let me know through your comments. Later, I will present you videos on various topics related to Iftar. I am saying goodbye to you today with the hope and expectation that everyone will be well and healthy. May Allah Hafez bless you all.

>One week has already passed after Valentine's Day, but I still couldn't get rid of how that day gave butterflies in my stomach in a different way. Love, for most of history, is the final act of sharing one's self with someone as well as sharing their life that firmly binds and makes sense together as days go by. Valentine's Day put emphasis on this kind of love everyone deserves to experience, and for me, this year's heart's day is a special one. ![IMG_6746.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vekam/23uQy5xrrPPyFbyBEfyS6CytL9BQFjaLU9uzL7URoZPrdnr6e5FiqC4VbJ3ESatmAsaCb.jpeg)


This beautiful plant is an upright growing, herbaceous perennial that has almost symmetrical succulent pale green to pale reddish brown leaves that are ovate, Begonia cucullata, also known as clubbed begonia, is a species of the Begoniaceae that is native to South American countries of Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay & Uruguay.

It’s a native medicinal species from Paraguay popularly used to combat stomatitis, pharyngitis, respiratory ailments in children & inflammatory conditions among others.

Wax Begonias are widely used in landscaping, container gardening & as houseplants. Their ability to flourish in both sun & shade makes them versatile additions to various garden designs.

title.title: O Teatro do Esquecimento. SER ou NÃO SER? Eis... O post de hoje.
title.body:
/>

Olá Colméia, z z z Z Z Z Z Z

Não PROCURE o Criador nos mapas das galáxias ou no frio do vácuo sideral.

O maior segredo do universo não está escondido atrás de uma estrela distante; ele está olhando através de suas pupilas agora. Você nunca foi um corpo tentando encontrar Deus. Você é a própria Consciência que, em um ato de ousadia infinita, inventou um corpo para poder sentir o gosto da maçã e o peso da saudade.

A Ilusão da Matéria O mundo nos treinou para acreditar na \

do materialismo. Ensinaram-nos que fomos um acidente químico, poeira perdida em um espaço indiferente. Mas Max Planck, o pai da física quântica, já soprava o alerta em 1931: a matéria é desenvolvida; a consciência é fundamental.\n\nA matéria não é sólida; ela é um campo de possibilidades que só \
quando você observa. O que você chama de \

nada mais é do que o cenário que sua Consciência montou para poder representar um papel.

O Teatro do Esquecimento Por que escolhemos a dor, o medo e a dúvida? Porque o Infinito, em sua plenitude estática, não conhece o contraste. Para que a Luz seja percebida, ela precisou projetar a sombra. Para a Consciência experimentar a superação, ela precisa aceitar o limite.

Nós sofremos de uma amnésia sagrada . Esquecemos quem somos para que a história tenha graça. Se o ator entra em cena lembrando o tempo todo que é apenas um ator, não há drama, não há entrega, não há vida. O esquecimento é o preço que pagamos para viver a intensidade da jornada humana.

A Onda e o Oceano Imagine que você é uma onda. Você nasce, cresce, atinge o ápice e morre ao bater na areia. Se você se identificar apenas com a \

da onda, viverá com medo do fim. Mas, se você perceber que é a Água , entende que a quebra na areia é apenas uma mudança de estado. O oceano não diminui quando a onda se desfaz. Outra imagem mental que facilita o entendimento desse algo aparentemente tão complexo é: Um cubo de gelo flutuando numa piscina. Parece que ele adquiriu uma forma distinta e uma identidade separada da sua própria essência. Quando o gelo derrete, nada se perde. Não houve uma \
da substância, apenas o fim da fronteira que separava o cubo do resto da água. O gelo não \

na água; ele descobre que sempre foi água.

Sua identidade pessoal — seu nome, seus traumas, seu CPF — é uma onda ou um cubo de gelo. Mas o campo que percebe tudo isso é o oceano. Esse campo não tem idade, não tem cor e não pode ser ferido por uma crítica ou um fracasso.

Perder as Desculpas, Ganhar o Leme Acordar para essa verdade não lhe dá superpoderes, mas retira as desculpas. Quando você entende que o universo não acontece com você, mas através de você, a vitimização morre. Você deixa de implorar validação externa, pois percebe que já é o fundamento de tudo o que existe.

O materialismo nos oferece um vazio existencial perfumado de tecnologia. A consciência nos oferece uma responsabilidade cósmica. Não somos um cérebro que produz consciência como se fosse uma ligação química; somos a Consciência que usa o cérebro como um instrumento temporário de navegação.

Olhe para o intervalo entre um pensamento e outro. Ali, naquele silêncio sem nome, reside o que você é de verdade. O personagem que você defende com tanto afinco é transitório; a Consciência de que a sustentação é eterna.

A pergunta não é se isso é real. A pergunta é: você está pronto para viver como se fosse? O palco está montado, o capítulo está sendo escrito e o autor é você.

\

title.title: Andermatt, Switzerland | Captured Above the Clouds  | Landscape Photography
title.body:
- “Heaven is under our feet as well as over our heads.” — Henry David Thoreau ![IMG_3675.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYraF8tpmnQDZ5j6GHexBybo5AaqhoTdZ6DAH73MGbcmg/IMG_3675.jpeg) ![IMG_3674.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQbM8QGkGHftRW2iNNzwQcYdjo2KzFPzSSukm6AimFiF3/IMG_3674.jpeg) Greetings fellow Photography Lovers, Worldmappers, Travellers and Discoverers! Today i will share with you the rest of the hike i had in Andermatt - Switzerland! Last time i share with you basically a Landscape Photography and this time i will share with you the dam and its interesting concept and it’s glory
Moments Frozen in Alpine Air
This beautiful Dam and more accurately called the Grimsel Dam located over the Grimsel pass. It’s a Dam with such and interesting concept, cuz it’s a high-altitude hydroelectric dam which’s purpose is to store glacier and snowmelt water and then to turn it into electricity. It’s basically located in the central Alps and yeah that’s where the Evian water comes from. ![IMG_3683.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQivDRC4LCv7VuwB9gAbLc6cxM9Jq6AUYkVW6MB5iFEKQ/IMG_3683.jpeg) ![IMG_3663.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMjohdcA9Pvk1aH8MmjW7cAnFrkCYTPHvx6ZiSS5pX1W/IMG_3663.jpeg) ![IMG_3672.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXjZofehvQTe33SNA6vj6WQHdGsD4cW6HAMuAEJcEj7mZ/IMG_3672.jpeg) ![IMG_3655.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQQzHymkwCAaiir2Kq1wsMYSihZF2ZKERoZf2ydFooxo/IMG_3655.jpeg) ![IMG_3669.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUGQ3Ed9vZJQJAhFURAm5gRmpiiuY5ARutMd9jPMFp2uk/IMG_3669.jpeg) ![IMG_3684.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSdSNmHLRhuAvNDpvqcveKe5Dk8DTcAMhcj7T5UjQowF/IMG_3684.jpeg) It’s so breathtaking and calm up there it’s quiet and you just hear the water going through the Dam quietly it’s probably better than “white noise”. ![IMG_3678.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSTsSmEANNLaRVjhjDM8qogZSvgHmGHdRWaMJ7EsSfQZM/IMG_3678.jpeg) ![IMG_3679.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYPNVmnaYdgw8QCvA6KsxAkdi5XhKLf54Nrhrcg3n1osW/IMG_3679.jpeg) ![IMG_3685.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPBLfN7rpjJ8jbmUeRdXzqsxgQwZVBXHad6CfvdRqHHy/IMG_3685.jpeg) ![IMG_3680.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb4vcvJHxDAK83edjywK7LQfGtUoRQyxAqgECGRenAJYE/IMG_3680.jpeg) ![IMG_3676.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqHoGq2LvTXa8bG9YQUptBFZFxsrJmYT4CBywAYqc6X6/IMG_3676.jpeg) ![IMG_3677.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUHZzSfkxxJSZBdkGTbR6LrmjckAToKmiLWK392DkRA39/IMG_3677.jpeg) Everywhere you turn it’s beautiful the whole region is so well crafted by god the mountains, the greenery, the vibes are as calm as they can be. The engineers and the architects knew exactly what they were doing it must be so peaceful working there. Anyway next time im gonna share with you one last part and it’s the Glacier one. I so wanted to share it all in one post, but the photos are so large it crashes the site and i even had to crop some of the just to load. Anyway that’s for today see ya! 😄 [//]:# (!worldmappin 46.63754 lat 8.59769 long Breathtaking place! d3scr)

title.body:
**Dutch version (see below for the English translation).**

---

<div class=\

>Voor het eerst doe ik mee aan de **ZAPFIC50 Friday Challenge**. Onlangs ontdekte ik deze en een aantal andere korte, maar erg leuke schrijfuitdagingen. \n\nDeze schrijfuitdaging heeft als prompt het woord **\

**. Wat het extra uitdagend maakt, is dat je precies vijftig woorden moet gebruiken: niet meer en niet minder. Het woord van deze week bezorgde me flashbacks naar de geweldige vakanties uit mijn jeugd. Daar gaat dit korte verhaaltje over, of eigenlijk: over een van de vele dierbare herinneringen.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSKmY75avRSyGcVE5W5rYN7kmA5qoikAL6fZ91QTBWyEj/Gemini_Generated_Image_qgq3ztqgq3ztqgq3.png
## **Mijn verhaal / mijn jeugdherinnering:** ---

>Een map is voor mij meer dan papier met lijnen & namen. Tijdens familievakanties zat ik voorin naast mijn vader als zijn navigator. De gele lijn was onze leidraad. Als hij het vroeg, fluisterde ik onze huidige koers en onze nieuwe richting, en voelde ik hoe onze reis ons dichter bijeenbracht. ---
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbKQc1r1HTwEd5FwTvqc6sNJq1d14FLQLP4sQbGmteJEg/Schermafbeelding%202026-02-21%20152001.png
Screenshot, bewijs dat mijn verhaal precies 50 woorden is. --- ---

>Wishing you all the best in life and much health.     **@meraki7578** 💚 --- 📷 Photos: Created with [Gemini](gemini.com) and screenshot from [Wordcounter](wordcounter.net) 📝 Original Dutch translated to English : Using [DeepL](DeepL.com) ---

>This is my first time participating in the **ZAPFIC50 Friday Challenge.** I recently discovered this and a number of other short but very enjoyable writing challenges. This writing challenge has the word **“Map”** as its prompt. What makes it extra challenging is that you have to use exactly fifty words: no more, no less. This week's word gave me flashbacks to the wonderful vacations of my childhood. That's what this short story is about, or rather, one of my many cherished memories.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSKmY75avRSyGcVE5W5rYN7kmA5qoikAL6fZ91QTBWyEj/Gemini_Generated_Image_qgq3ztqgq3ztqgq3.png
## **My story / my childhood memory:** ---

>To me, a map is more than just paper with lines and names. During family vacations, I sat in the front seat next to my father as his navigator. The yellow line was our guide. When he asked, I whispered our current course and our new direction, and I felt how our journey brought us closer together. ---
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbKQc1r1HTwEd5FwTvqc6sNJq1d14FLQLP4sQbGmteJEg/Schermafbeelding%202026-02-21%20152001.png

title.title: Iris: The Goddess of the Garden and Her Unruly Rainbow
title.body:
Few flowers possess the sheer architectural drama and historical gravitas of the Iris. With its majestic, tripartite structure—the velvety ‘falls’ that cascade downward, and the upright, proud ‘standards’ that reach toward the sun—the Iris commands attention.

It is not merely a garden plant; it is a spring show-stopper, a living piece of history, and the perennial queen of cool-weather color.

If you’re looking to inject a dose of reliable elegance and extraordinary variety into your landscape, it’s time to truly appreciate this resilient beauty.

Seriously? You would leave if rotating cards received the same PP as Chaos Legion? It should have a negligible effect on land since there are tons more supply of Chaos Legion than any of the rotating modern sets.

I'm truly sittng here trying to understand why this is such a big, dramatic change that would push someone out of the game. From my point of view, this is an essential update to maintain a shred of value for non-meta cards as they rotate from modern.

If rotated modern cards continue to provide PP that is only half of CL cards, then it will crater the value of those cards when they rotate. It creates a HUGE DISADVANTAGE for modern card ownership as prices will tank after rotation.

It should stand to reason that Chaos Legion cards will remain the cheaper option compared to the rotating modern sets since there are multiples more CL cards than any of the rotated modern sets. Without the ability for rotating modern cards to be used on land, then I fear there will be even less demand for new modern cards and more potential losses for long-term collectors and competitive modern players.

Please make it make sense. You would leave because you think it doesn't make sense? You would leave because you don't want modern cards to maintain their value? I'm truly confused.

title.title: 悼念最後的艦長：致 Eric Dane 與那段《末日孤艦》的熱血歲月
title.body:
​當螢幕上的硬漢剪影成為永恆，我們才驚覺，那些曾經陪伴我們度過無數夜晚的英雄，已悄然駛向了星辰大海的彼端。驚聞 Eric Dane 離世的消息，拉叔心中那份沉重難以言喻。對於許多影迷來說，他是《實習醫生》裡充滿魅力的「白馬醫生」Mark Sloan，但對拉叔而言，他永遠是那個在末日餘生中，帶領我們尋找人類最後希望的 Tom Chandler 艦長。

​回想起拉叔追逐《末日孤艦》（The Last Ship）的那段日子，那不僅僅是一部關於病毒災難與軍事對抗的連續劇，它更像是一座精神堡壘。在劇中，全球人口因紅色流感幾近滅絕，Eric Dane 飾演的 Chandler 艦長帶領著驅逐艦「內森·詹姆斯號」（USS Nathan James），在孤立無援的海面上，成為了文明最後的火種。

那時的拉叔常被劇中展現的使命感所深深打動。Eric Dane 將這個角色詮釋得極具厚度：他不僅僅是一個下達指令的指揮官，更是一個在責任、家庭與人性抉擇中掙扎的普通人。他那雙深邃且堅毅的眼神，總能在最絕望的時刻給予隊員（以及螢幕前的拉叔）一種安定人心的力量。

在《末日孤艦》中，有幾個片段至今仍刻在拉叔腦海裡。當艦長為了保護研發疫苗的團隊，不得不做出艱難的軍事犧牲時，Eric Dane 臉上那種強忍悲慟卻必須保持冷靜的張力，簡直是演技的教科書。他賦予了 Tom Chandler 一種「士為知己者死」的英雄氣質，這種氣質在現代影劇中已不多見，卻讓拉叔看得如痴如醉，還不時在夢裡把自己代入了Eric的角色去泡妞（呸呸呸……我又說去哪兒了）。

​拉叔還記得當時在看劇時，常常會思考：如果世界真的崩塌，我們是否能像他一樣，守住內心的底線？Eric Dane 的表演給出了答案：英雄並非無所畏懼，而是即便恐懼，依然選擇前行。

Eric Dane 的離去，象徵著一個硬漢時代的某種落幕。他用他那充滿磁性的嗓音和魁梧的身軀，構築了一個讓拉叔在現實疲憊之餘，可以寄託熱血與正義感的虛構世界。

> 「We’re the last hope. We don’t have the luxury of quitting.」

這是劇中經典的台詞，如今讀來，更像是他留給影迷們的最後贈言。生活即便充滿變數，我們依然要像內森·詹姆斯號一樣，在驚濤浪湧中堅守航向。

Eric，謝謝你。 謝謝你帶給拉叔那個無所畏懼的夏天，謝謝你讓我們看到了一位艦長應有的脊梁。願你在另一個世界，能在平靜的海面上悠然遠航。


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrbEs2A7cDZkgqdxHeFHNHcQmiy6gnaQb7ALCpXkTS5u/1771685262620.png)
由於Eric所有照片均受版權所有，不得已只好借谷歌Gemini的想像力幫我一把，整一下這個了。是有點不像話，將就一哈吧。

title.title: I give you a smile / Te regalo una sonrisa (ENG / ESP )
title.body:
Sometimes that simple phrase brings us back to life. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZW8A5WrB5zFUQZYCmo74E7SjGgSRJqHh4esXngb4CzRe/img_20260221_092244.jpg)

Some time ago, a friend insisted that I prepare a small workshop as training for the people who work as volunteers at the house of the Servants of San José, who teach crafts to the children who are part of the institution. I couldn't decide and I asked myself: \

My daughters, when they were little, were part of them and the minor one also helped as a support teacher. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMJsWyV1STxbkJkDTSQr9qtAoUkXugXSTQGsSzVfLDGg/fb_img_1771606550607.jpg)

​But after so much insistence, I finally agreed and prepared four meetings. We would work on the art of making decorations with paper and, what a surprise! Not only have they learned new techniques; I have also discovered myself inventing dynamics of participation and sharing this wonderful gift of giving life and beauty to a simple sheet of paper. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTghzdSU4sVf2ki3xzQo2JmbZ7dL1mUF6Yt9WuRpF4Rm1/img_20260221_091743.jpg)

On the other hand, I also bring joy to the children who share a \

with my son Dylan. This little house works by and for children with special needs; My son is autistic, but he shares various pathologies with others. They wait for me every Friday morning and together we create puppets and stage children's stories and songs. The truth is that I don't know who has more fun, them or me. Feeling their hugs and seeing their faces full of light is like feeling the universe between my fingers. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDiLCTeQTVhyGEErrdg2PSyC3XmcooZybWsw4zA2zV1q/img_20260221_091615.jpg)

​This week I began the meeting in the house of the Servants with this dynamic: \

It turned out to be more rewarding than I expected; Time passed so quickly that we barely noticed. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDjhhYTqx8BtiCYrpazQofohWchNo5t9o486hjLeo4E3/img_20260206_wa0014.jpg)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVfYDN4DjS22h3LdrEEVvrYQ2tCQRxm4PFowBgTq3UDsJ/img_20260210_wa0025.jpg)

​Very soon, when this first workshop concludes, I will begin another one aimed at literary appreciation and creation, something that I hope to enjoy much more because it is what I am truly passionate about. Yes, sometimes life surprises you and gives you a smile. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMNJr7xMyQmAZDrM9DxdsGnjCHAVSGizBmjfE4zVGVbb/img_20260218_wa0038.jpg)

I leave you mine and I also give you this hug. Thank you for reading me and giving me your time. We will be meeting. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmakXP7KpSYiFhT8kE4nTDarAozzoLhC8BwuMrJR1Dekzd/azul_20y_20rosa_20moderno_20tecnolog_c3_ada_20electr_c3_b3nica_20y_20tecnolog_c3_ada_20retractable_20exhibic_20251026_022842_0000.png)

​\

. A veces, esa simple frase nos devuelve a la vida.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeae2ZkCrVfc95T5pjR2SVghR51c9ASa4w3tu23iTQthu/img_20260221_093035.jpg)

​Hace algún tiempo, una amiga insistía en que preparara un pequeño taller como capacitación para las personas que trabajan como voluntarias en la casa de las Siervas de San José, quienes enseñan manualidades a los niños que forman parte de la institución. Yo no me decidía y me preguntaba: \

. Mis hijas, de pequeñas, formaron parte de ellos y la menor ayuda también como maestra de apoyo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUzesYVo2f7Tp77VsLyb3XbT6NPTZnctKDTfmKTwAGQ5h/img_20260221_093054.jpg)

​Pero tras tanta insistencia, al fin accedí y preparé cuatro encuentros. Trabajaríamos el arte de hacer adornos con papel y, ¡qué sorpresa!, no solo ellas han aprendido nuevas técnicas; yo también me he descubierto inventando dinámicas de participación y compartiendo este don maravilloso de darle vida y belleza a una simple hoja de papel.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWQybdozfUJSdmoHu1M8qZkpkZTP7wGENQUG4uCTsuGi/img_20260221_093013.jpg)

​Por otra parte, también llevo alegría a los niños que comparten una \

con mi hijo Dylan. Esta casita funciona por y para niños con necesidades especiales; mi hijo es autista, pero comparte con otros de diversas patologías. Ellos me esperan cada viernes en la mañana y juntos creamos títeres y escenificamos cuentos y canciones infantiles. Lo cierto es que no sé quién se divierte más, si ellos o yo. Sentir sus abrazos y ver sus rostros llenos de luz es como sentir el universo entre mis dedos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3wRJN2qr53hYRoZj8dnFZBNfsAKoW4ZvoRjpUWhPW85/img_20260221_095131.jpg)

​Esta semana comencé el encuentro en la casa de las Siervas con esta dinámica: \

. Resultó más gratificante de lo que esperaba; el tiempo se escurrió tan deprisa que apenas nos dimos cuenta.
​Muy pronto, cuando concluya este primer taller, comenzaré otro encaminado hacia la apreciación y creación literaria, algo que espero disfrutar mucho más porque es lo que realmente me apasiona. Sí, a veces la vida te sorprende y te regala una sonrisa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV4vqxeSg9xxmWE4GgfZptZriBCHPX7sUVMbg5VU2k3eC/img_20260221_093127.jpg)

​Yo te dejo la mía y también te regalo este abrazo. Gracias por leerme y dedicarme tu tiempo. Nos estaremos encontrando.

title.title: Iran's Detailed Plan to Confront the US in Case of War
title.body: by Robert Stanberry on Robert Stanberry View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/robert.stanberry [![Iran's Detailed Plan to Confront the US in Case of War](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/390a83cb-9de1-472f-b23b-e042085c1e34.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/rMKzkpAuPQwBJcPzqgDZhy) The Tasnim News Agency affiliated with Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has outlined a detailed plan for a potential confrontation with the United States The plan details how Iran believes it could overcome the world's most powerful military in the event of an actual war between the two countries This strategy emerges against a backdrop of heightened tensions and stalled diplomatic efforts. Escalating Tensions and Strategic Preparations Tensions between Iran and the United States have escalated sharply since Washington's withdrawal from the nuclear agreement in 2018 The crisis has intensified in recent years marked by military posturing and proxy conflicts Indirect negotiations are ongoing in Geneva However these talks have yet to yield a comprehensive agreement that addresses core disputes particularly concerning Iran's nuclear program and ballistic missiles.

> The United States maintains a significant military presence in the Middle East the largest since the 2003 invasion of Iraq This includes deploying aircraft carriers and missile platforms signaling potential military strikes if diplomacy fails to achieve a meaningful agreement. Iran's War Plan and Perceived Path to Victory According to the plan published by Tasnim, any escalation would likely begin with a preemptive American attack This would involve air and missile strikes targeting key nuclear and military sites within Iran The Iranian strategy emphasizes defensive preparations designed to mitigate the impact of such strikes. A key component of Iran's defense strategy is the fortification and dispersion of vital facilities This aims to ensure the survival of critical military infrastructure even after initial attacks The strategy also involves embedding defensive infrastructure within civilian areas and underground facilities further complicating targeting efforts Multiple alternative command systems are in place to ensure the continuity of military operations even if primary command centers are disabled.

> Following a hypothetical US strike the Iranian response would unfold in several phases The first phase would involve a direct military response using ballistic missiles and drones to strike American bases and facilities throughout the region Potential targets include the US Central Command headquarters in Qatar and bases in Gulf countries such as Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates. Expanding the Battlefield and Asymmetric Warfare The confrontation would not be confined to Iranian territory Instead Iran would seek to involve its allies and proxies in the conflict Hezbollah in Lebanon could open a front against Israel drawing Israel into a multi-front war Houthi rebels in Yemen could intensify attacks on ships in the Red Sea disrupting maritime traffic Pro-Tehran Iraqi militias could target American forces or diplomatic missions within Iraq. This multi-front strategy faces several challenges Israel may have degraded the capabilities of some of these groups during previous conflicts Some countries hosting American bases may try to avoid their territories being used for operations that could provoke retaliatory military responses. Cyber warfare forms another critical aspect of the Iranian plan. Iranian leaders aim to penetrate sensitive networks belonging to the United States and its allies The goal is to disrupt communications military systems and logistical operations Such cyberattacks are intended to sow chaos and delay the US and its allies from responding in a coordinated manner.

> Strategic Control and Economic Leverage A central element of Iran's strategy involves leveraging its geographic position to influence global oil markets Iran could attempt to close or restrict passage through the Strait of Hormuz Approximately one-third of the world's seaborne oil passes through this critical chokepoint Any disruption could sharply increase oil prices and negatively impact the global economy Iran hopes that such economic pressure would compel international powers to push for de-escalation. Counterbalancing US Preparations and Diplomatic Overtures While Iran's plans highlight how it intends to counter a US attack American actions indicate preparations for more escalated scenarios The US has deployed multiple aircraft carriers, such as the USS Gerald R. Ford and USS Abraham Lincoln to the region Significant air and defense reinforcements have also been sent. The previous US administration set a deadline for Iran to reach a new nuclear agreement. Failure to do so could result in limited or broader US strikes Reports have also suggested that US plans might include targeting specific leaders or even regime change in Iran. Despite the military tensions Iranian officials reiterate that Tehran remains open to peace and diplomacy They emphasize that resolving the nuclear issue is possible if mutual respect is shown in negotiations The United Nations and international agencies are calling for a de-escalation of tensions and a negotiated solution They warn that an open military conflict could destabilize the entire Middle East. ____

title.title: It Is The Speed Stupid
title.body:
We still have some debate about the eventual impact of AI.  

On one side are those who believe that AI is simply going to usurp anything.  This tends to come from those involved in the industry, either using the tools to a large degree or creating them.  Then we have those who believe a near status-quo will be achieve.  Under this scenario, we will see improvement over time but nowhere to the level people are forecasting.

It is where the AI bubble and the believe we are in a hype cycle is coming from.

Personally, I believe this stems from the fact that people are not properly framing what we are dealing with.  The comparison to the Internet doesnt really hold.  That was networking, something that we know is slow to develop as evidenced by blockchain.

AI is a new form of compute.  That puts it on a different level.  It is resident in the digital world, at least to start.  It is something that is going to follow the trends of the 1960s-1990s.  There is a key difference.

In this article I will dive into some of what I foresee as emerging.

# It Is The Speed Stupid

We see a lot of comparisons to the Industrial Revolution. 

People are making the case that we are going to see a similar transformation of society.  On this, I agree.

One thing that gets overlooked is the fact that the shift during that period was not absent issues.  We saw many problems arising including labor conflicts that turned deadly.  It would be great to say it happened only a few times but history shows this is not the case.

Society, or at least segments of it, had a tough time adjusting.  

Here is the major differentiator: that occurred in spite of the transition occurring over a century.  There were many decades to prepare.  Generations were spurned during this time period.  And yet, there were massive issued that were difficult to resolve.

What happens when there is a contraction?

This time, we are not looking at a century.  Instead, it is only a decade or two.  During this period, society will change completely.

How do things look?  That is the multi-trillion dollar question.

## Recursive Training

The industry can get caught up in terms or metrics.  

One of the things we see hotly debated is whether we have achieved AGI or not.  Meeting some definition is not really important.  What is vital is the capabilities of these systems.

A key component is the recursive training capability.  This is what makes the acceleration a central part of any thesis.

Recursive training is the ability for AI to keep learning on its own, with no input from humans.  It equates to 24/7 progress at a rate that only increases over time.  Humans are limited by time.  We also see these systems do things in seconds which can take humans hours.

The net result is a massive increase in output.  This can be applied to whatever you desire.  For the sake of our conversation, this basically breaks down to code.

Of course, the expansion continues.  

Tesla, according to many, has a lead in autonomous driving that cannot be surmounted.  The pace of data collection far exceeds that of its competitors.  While this conclusion is certainly subject to debate, it does align with one of the key principles we are seeing in the AI world.

The more data that is amassed and processed, the better the system produced.

In other words, the goal is to get as much data as possible in a short period of time.  The companies that are doing that tend to be gaining a large advantage.

Over the next few months, we are likely to see a major step forward again.  The pace of Ai innovation means that it all comes down to one thing: speed.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@taskmaster4450/it-is-the-speed-stupid-b6m)

title.title: When Three Healers Guard a Single Fortress
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpAxgZCyztoYs8QKVbqQzCusi5dPgq9tTncczdF2uuQ7/thumbnail_battle_of_the_day.png)

Greetings **splinterfam**, loyal warriors in the **Splinterlands** arena.
Today I want to share a small story from my **battle of the day** that I found quite thought-provoking. The theme is simple: **“three sturdy healers.”** But as the elders in my village say, something that looks solid can sometimes collapse because of small, unnoticed cracks.

This battle took place in **Survival mode**, specifically in **Bracket III Active**. So you can imagine, the player I faced was no amateur. Their card collection was impressive, and their strategy looked well-prepared from the start.

<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/beta/Lyanna%20Natura_lv1.png</center>

My opponent used the archon **Lyanna Natura** from the Earth element. A classic choice that grants extra health to the entire team. But what really made me sigh a little was their monster formation.

On the front line stood **Mycelic Slipspawn** level 4 with the **Taunt** ability. That means all attacks had to be directed at it. It was like placing a giant shield right in the middle of the battlefield.

Behind it stood three diligent “doctors”:

* **Khmer Princess**
* **Wood Nymph**
* **Goblin Psychic**

Just imagine it. Every time Slipspawn was attacked, these three healers immediately patched up its wounds like tire repairmen working overtime.

And that wasn’t all. There was also **Mushroom Seer** reducing my team’s magic power, as well as **Creeping Ooze** slowing my team’s speed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVrvoatpVQPGLoX2iUWv7XrbGoYaB11wLyT2mTkvRyLyy/round_1.png)


In short: all attacks were funneled into one point, and that point kept getting repaired every time it was damaged.

Seeing a formation like that, I knew one thing: if I relied only on normal damage, this battle could last until the chickens came home to roost.

I used the archon **Thaddius Brood** to reduce the opponent’s magic attack. Then I placed **Gargoya Lion** with the **Void** ability at the front.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSPqvJEsbNVzxKD5WGvGR7Nr3UKQYa4VGBaDk4VeDhaNn/round_2.png)


The result was rather amusing.
The enemy’s magic attacks, which should have been dangerous, instead felt like a light drizzle in the dry season. Not painful—just slightly wet.

But then another problem appeared: my team also struggled to break through Slipspawn. Every time its HP dropped, the three healers worked like emergency room staff on duty.

At that point I even thought, “This might turn into a marathon match.”

Fortunately, I brought two cards that became the turning point.

The first was **Chaos Jailer**. Its poison does not always trigger, but once it lands, the effect starts to build.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTZmNn4b4GcE17WJxrtQwzRyDxWeXd3X1QVLWRnkVJh7/cripple.png)


The second was **Broken Earth Thug** with the **Cripple** ability.

This is what slowly cracked that fortress.

Each time Broken Earth Thug attacked, **Mycelic Slipspawn’s maximum HP decreased**. So even though the three healers kept working, they could no longer restore Slipspawn’s HP to its former state.

Combined with the poison effect from Chaos Jailer, the Slipspawn that once stood like a mountain… eventually crumbled, little by little.

Once Slipspawn fell, the three healers behind it were like losing their umbrella in the rain. They no longer had a place to hide.

And from that moment, victory began to take shape.

If you’re curious about the full drama in the arena, you can watch the complete battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_ee262d61607def93d2397e30e78ec3c5?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>


---

## Closing

What makes this battle interesting is one simple truth: **even strong healing has limits**.

Without **Cripple**, this match might have lasted a very long time. It could even have ended in **fatigue**, where the monster with the largest HP would be the one to survive.

But with Cripple, the game changed. Healing was no longer limitless.

For new players in the Splinterlands community, this is an important lesson. Sometimes we focus too much on big damage, when in fact **small abilities like Cripple can be the key to victory**.

In the end, I won the battle after the great fortress called Mycelic Slipspawn was finally breached.

My advice: when facing a team stacked with healers, don’t just hit harder. **Find ways to wear them down slowly.**

Because in Splinterlands, sometimes victory doesn’t come from the strongest blow…
but from small wounds that are left open long enough.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

text-justify\
pull-left\
text-justify\
pull-left\
text-justify\
pull-left\
, una historia conmovedora de lucha de clase frente a la época donde regia \

, donde años pocos años antes se había abolido la esclavitud, seguía rigiendo un racismo inundado de odio y rencor frente a gente llena de odio, y que es antes de los 1900 me entristece que hoy 2026 siga habiendo pensamientos de esta envergadura\n\n
><div class=\
>Welcome to a new post for film and series lovers. Today I bring you \

a moving story of class struggle set during the era of the Ku Klux Klan, a time when slavery had been abolished just a few years prior, yet racism, steeped in hatred and resentment, still reigned. It's saddening that even in 2026, thoughts of this magnitude still exist. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPej4TceFhCUrLKPAy5jqoCLLtuqePSCXgpPeXmtNK7L/stremio_txt_logo_small.png)
https://www.stremio.com/
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsPw2oPXc55N6sA86Ys2K7wu3bN6ugCuoLLMVVhCkSVG/image.png)
[Source](https://www.infobae.com/que-puedo-ver/2023/08/15/la-vision-de-jessica-chastain-para-una-secuela-de-historias-cruzadas/)
><div class=\
>Esta historia me hizo sentir muchas emociones (mas por los momentos que hoy pasa la Argentina) pero la bronca y el odio de ver como fue naturalizado el odio hacia \

, hacia las minorias que permanecieron por muchos años bajo el silencio y la vida completamente agobiante y que pudieron sobrevivir me resulta admirable, pero que sirva como total recuerdo de lo absurdamente grotesco que es el humano. Yendo al tema de la pelicula, relata la historia de los negros en esa epoca tan oscura, donde fue posible un cambio gracias a que una mujer acomodada blanca dio espacio a la voz de las \
, quienes representaban un valor real frente a la ausencia de los blancos con sus hijos, y sus abusos cotidianos recibidos por ellos
><div class=\
>This story stirred many emotions in me (especially given the current situation in Argentina), but the anger and hatred I feel at seeing how hatred towards \

towards the minorities who endured years of silence and oppressive hardship, and who managed to survive, has become normalized is admirable. But it serves as a stark reminder of the absurdly grotesque nature of humanity. Turning to the film itself, it tells the story of Black people during that dark period, where change was made possible thanks to a wealthy white woman who gave voice to the \

who represented real value in the face of the absence of white men and their children, and the daily abuse they suffered. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXDVU2v5KFQwRfA74ZwrkH9W52t2ksQcGU3KjBXi3h2YD/image.png)
[Source](https://spoiler.bolavip.com/cine/historias-cruzadas-esta-en-netflix-donde-ver-la-pelicula-con-emma-stone-y-viola-davis)
><div class=\

>El amor y el compañerismo entre ellas dieron lugar a la salvacion constante frente al sufrimiento cotidiano, dando lugar a la supervivencia y a la risa mientras convivían en el infierno constante, estas mujeres dieron una voz en alto aunque asumiendo las consecuencias, con miedo, para afrontar asi un paso hacia un mejor futuro para su futura generación
><div class=\

>The love and camaraderie between them provided constant salvation from daily suffering, leading to survival and laughter as they lived through constant hell. These women raised their voices, even while accepting the consequences, with fear, to take a step towards a better future for their next generation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMXCv6yiJ3ajv8THYLNmS4mPxAitf3n56qRDnZRBhBSk/image.png)
[Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1454029/mediaviewer/rm79464192/)
><div class=\

>Esta mujer dio una pequeña lucha a comparación de lo que hacían las negras para darles la voz, el lugar de la escucha, donde justamente por lo político se dio un lugar en el momento y trabajo adecuado para poder compartir sus historias y así dar voz a las atrocidades que se cometían en esas casas de la clase burgesa de aquella época
><div class=\

>This woman waged a small struggle compared to what Black women did to give them a voice, a place to be heard, where, precisely because of the political situation, she found a place at the right time and with the right work to share her stories and thus give voice to the atrocities that were committed in those bourgeois homes of that era. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMXHUSnbjSvdW912rwnxPQhdBbwpg7xZBY4KTUw4Bj4p/image.png)
[Source](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/Historias-Cruzadas/0GZ901IXIAHX94L0KW67C7QM6C)
><div class=\
>Una de las pocas personas \

que representaron lo bueno dentro de este cruel mundo dio lugar también a la fuerza necesaria para portar la voz del sufrimiento que vivió antes y el que ahora siguen constantemente sus compañeras. Pero para que suceda esto, fue necesario que sea excluyente el grupo frente a ella, para dar lugar a un espacio de mejor comprensión, y de un amor necesario que repara cualquier herida\n
><div class=\
>One of the few \

people who represented good in this cruel world also gave rise to the strength needed to voice the suffering she had endured and that her peers continue to suffer. But for this to happen, the group had to be exclusionary towards her, to create a space of greater understanding and the necessary love that heals any wound.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyP3RZgfBkuBQghCbAYAuyZbcpuZqoUPf3eyT71DYwaH/image.png)
[Source](https://poluxweb.com/Polux3/index.php/cine/en-la-mirada-de-un-espectador/943-historias-cruzadas)
><div class=\

>Ellas eran las encargadas de los hijos de los blancos burgueses, y sin escaparse de lo humano terminaban amando a aquellas que luego de grandes cometerían las mismas atrocidades que sus padres, fueron criadas con una mirada distorsionada, pero acompañada de sus mucamas, quienes les daban el amor que sus madres nunca le podrían brindar\n
><div class=\

>They were in charge of the children of the white bourgeoisie, and without escaping the human condition, they ended up loving those who, when they grew up, would commit the same atrocities as their parents. They were raised with a distorted view, but accompanied by their maids, who gave them the love that their mothers could never give them. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8QFFvBix696HbKs1NqiTMHhSDVLRXBAH61dBSmjqxht/image.png)
><div class=\

>Espero que disfruten de esta hermosa pelicula que vale totalmente la pena mas allá de su duración, en todo momento pasa algo interesante y que te termina conmoviendo. Sin mas, espero que disfruten de mi publicación amantes del cine y de las series, nos vemos en la próxima 💫\n
><div class=\

>I hope you enjoy this beautiful film, which is totally worth watching despite its length. Something interesting is happening throughout, and it will definitely move you. Anyway, I hope you enjoy my post, film and series lovers. See you next time! 💫\n\n
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZroPv27rYb8TWm4MQnRPpQ1NBtz3z9HrGAVhWjpTdYny/image.png)

Estos días han estado lloviendo muy fuerte y mis gatos actúan extraño, Alejandro apenas empieza llover se esconde debajo de la cama o debajo de los muebles, siempre ha sido un glotón pero cuando llueve, aunque ponga la comida el no sale, le da mucho miedo, a veces lo saco para abrazarlo y que no tenga miedo pero el se vuelve a meter, hoy me levante y no lo encontré, al llamarlo salió de debajo de la cama.

Maxinne por el contrario se vuelve muy cariñoso y me sigue, le gusta estar cerca y siento que le gusta la lluvia porque anda todo tranquilito y me pide comida a cada rato, creo que asume la personalidad de Alejandro cuando el esta escondido jeje

A mi por el contrario me gusta la lluvia aunque sabe entrar agua por la puerta de lo tan fuerte que llueve, aunque si salgo a caminar no me gusta cuando llueve, ayer salí a comprar y regrese mojado jaja

Estas fotos son de esta mañana de mis gatos, están hermosos e incluso Alejandro se pone a descansar en el lavamanos.

Feliz Caturday a Todos!!



>It's been raining really hard these past few days, and my cats are acting strange. As soon as it starts to rain, Alejandro hides under the bed or the furniture. He's always been a big eater, but when it rains, even if I put his food out, he won't come out. He's terrified. Sometimes I take him out to cuddle him and reassure him, but he just goes right back in. Today I woke up and couldn't find him. When I called him, he came out from under the bed.
>
>Maxinne, on the other hand, becomes very affectionate and follows me around. She likes being close, and I think she likes the rain because she's so calm and keeps asking for food. I think she takes on Alejandro's personality when he's hiding, haha.
>
>I, on the other hand, like the rain, even though water sometimes comes in through the door because it's so heavy. I don't like going for walks when it's raining, though. Yesterday I went shopping and came back soaked, haha.
>
>These photos are from this morning of my cats. They look beautiful, and Alejandro even rested on the sink.
>
>Happy Caturday to all!!

---

description.body:
A veces hablamos de resiliencia como si fuera un trofeo… pero en realidad es un proceso silencioso. No siempre se ve fuerte por fuera. A veces se parece más a respirar hondo cuando todo pesa, a levantarse sin aplausos, a reconstruirse sin anunciarlo.

Mientras escribía este post me di cuenta de algo: muchas de las batallas más importantes no las peleamos contra el mundo, sino contra nuestra propia narrativa interna. La forma en que nos hablamos en los días difíciles define más nuestro futuro que cualquier circunstancia externa.

Hoy quiero preguntarte algo con honestidad:

**¿Estás siendo duro contigo o estás aprendiendo contigo?**

La resiliencia no es resistir por orgullo. Es adaptarse con conciencia.
Te leo.

description.title: Week‑45‑Hive‑Garden‑Question by themyscira
description.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/24248TnGeXZFsumq4xabNzscwFvNG3C8XGcRCrtoGp69QYkZRojwX5HyqAHnX3ab5yt3R.png)
Hello, wonderful gardening enthusiasts! Once again, I am delighted to be participating in Hive Garden Question this week. After some deliberation – and having mentally gone through my entire seed box – I finally decided on two plants that I am particularly excited about this year: blue alfalfa and red clover.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EpCANohjfiHTFms4xJDEskkvqrz9ktTr3Nd3VFPwFs7hauRNGbhqTaff781zqmeBpqB.png)
Over the past few weeks, I have read a lot about both of them and am really impressed by what they can do. It is not without reason that alfalfa is considered the ‘queen of fodder plants’. It is incredibly nutritious, grows quickly and can be cut several times a year. Red clover, on the other hand, is a little soil magician: it binds nitrogen, improves the soil and ensures that the soil becomes more fertile in the long term. For my future chickens, I imagine it as a small all-you-can-eat buffet that grows back every year. I think they'll celebrate me for it – or at least lay a particularly proud egg.
Honestly, I'm really looking forward to seeing how the area develops and how the chickens will strut around in it later. There's something incredibly calming about planting plants that you know not only look beautiful but also have a real purpose.

This year, however, I also had a few setbacks. Some seeds simply refused to germinate. I suspect this was because I bought them in a sale – their germination capacity can sometimes be reduced. Some packets were as if they were jinxed: not a single seedling emerged. Others, on the other hand, sprouted without any problems. So I can't say for sure whether it was my fault, the seeds' fault, or whether the seeds simply decided to take a collective holiday. It was probably a mixture of everything. The three candidates that didn't sprout at all were aubergines and two different varieties of peppers. At least one plant did sprout from the chilli pepper seeds – and I think that's enough for this year.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/242DLjdW68967FV7RqWa3yvBQStWBvJpc5KfDedSviKAe1GHjTHvChS5PKC2bCTsZQBva.png)
😕

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xKtdUfRNvxKCp7zKi1Scm9VdgajzrERUb4QnTMwedcefkcV7y11DBVGz2pn3HzhNfoz.png)
😍

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/242Y9hpiXUKXwy9XQQBGXKn8hqXM7ciYFt5cf6fPEgTxQ1Zd6K38wxb3qxeS3YrycA7cN.png)

Nevertheless, I'm not letting it get me down. After all, gardening is always a bit of an adventure, and sometimes a little chaos is just part of the fun. This year, I'm especially looking forward to seeing how the alfalfa and red clover take root – and how my chickens will happily peck around in it later on.

Perhaps you have a few tips for me on how to get my seeds to sprout better, because my trick with ancient grain flour didn't work here. I always use that for difficult seeds like corn, and it works wonderfully.

On that note, I wish you all a wonderful weekend and lots of joy. See you next time. 💚

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EoJy7Ettno6AL13bqisbFaBuq8vK6F4yEwb6ka1JcVeZkLJhxP7XDnD4GRyW5AA1JYW.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23w38FjhQXtSPnUNognheH5EsLo8GjENm8HWmJhyD4EtVtzQye1pGWStEysj4eagGFAtc.png)
Thank you for reading my post. 😘


![Strich Farbe blau.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23wM2RyBGZtThmVa1jU2KbCx9NRMKwwvBQv78bqajonnE6KKuR8Maaba8mfg963Ym6XZ5.png)

DE


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/24248TnGeXZFsumq4xabNzscwFvNG3C8XGcRCrtoGp69QYkZRojwX5HyqAHnX3ab5yt3R.png)
Hallo zusammen, ihr wundervollen Gartenfreunde! Auch in dieser Woche bin ich wieder mit Freude bei der Hive Garden Question dabei. Nach einigem Überlegen – und nachdem ich gedanklich schon durch meinen ganzen Saatkasten gewandert bin – habe ich mich schließlich für zwei Pflanzen entschieden, die mich dieses Jahr besonders begeistern: blaue Luzerne und Rotklee.

In den letzten Wochen habe ich viel über beide gelesen und bin wirklich beeindruckt, was sie alles können. Luzerne gilt nicht umsonst als die „Königin der Futterpflanzen“. Sie ist unglaublich nährstoffreich, wächst schnell und lässt sich mehrmals im Jahr schneiden. Rotklee wiederum ist ein kleiner Bodenmagier: Er bindet Stickstoff, verbessert die Erde und sorgt dafür, dass der Boden langfristig fruchtbarer wird. Für meine zukünftigen Hühner stelle ich mir das wie ein kleines All you can eat Buffet vor, das jedes Jahr aufs Neue nachwächst. Ich glaube, die werden mich dafür feiern – oder zumindest ein besonders stolzes Ei legen.

Ganz ehrlich: Ich freue mich richtig darauf zu sehen, wie sich die Fläche entwickelt und wie die Hühner später darin herumstolzieren. Es hat etwas unglaublich Beruhigendes, Pflanzen zu setzen, von denen man weiß, dass sie nicht nur schön aussehen, sondern auch einen echten Nutzen haben.

Dieses Jahr hatte ich allerdings auch ein paar Rückschläge. Einige Samen wollten einfach nicht keimen. Ich vermute, dass es daran lag, dass ich sie im Ausverkauf gekauft habe – da kann die Keimfähigkeit schon mal nachlassen. Manche Tütchen waren wie verhext: kein einziger Keimling. Andere wiederum sind problemlos aufgegangen. Deshalb kann ich nicht mit Sicherheit sagen, ob es an mir lag, am Saatgut oder daran, dass die Samen einfach beschlossen haben, kollektiv Urlaub zu machen. Wahrscheinlich war es eine Mischung aus allem. Die drei Kandidaten, die gar nicht aufgingen, waren Aubergine und zwei verschiedene Paprikasorten. Von der Peperoni Saat ist immerhin eine einzige Pflanze entstanden – und ich denke, für dieses Jahr reicht sie erst einmal.

Trotzdem lasse ich mich davon nicht entmutigen. Gartenarbeit ist schließlich immer ein kleines Abenteuer, und manchmal gehört ein bisschen Chaos einfach dazu. Dieses Jahr freue ich mich besonders darauf, zu sehen, wie Luzerne und Rotklee ihren Platz einnehmen – und wie meine Hühner später darin glücklich herumpicken.

Vielleicht habt ihr ein paar Tipps für mich, wie ich meine Samen besser zum Keimen bringen kann, denn mein Trick mit Urgetreidemehl hat hier nicht funktioniert. Ich verwende das immer für schwierige Samen wie Mais, und es funktioniert wunderbar.

In diesem Sinne wünsche ich euch allen ein schönes Wochenende und viel Freude. Bis zum nächsten Mal. 💚


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EoJy7Ettno6AL13bqisbFaBuq8vK6F4yEwb6ka1JcVeZkLJhxP7XDnD4GRyW5AA1JYW.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23w38FjhQXtSPnUNognheH5EsLo8GjENm8HWmJhyD4EtVtzQye1pGWStEysj4eagGFAtc.png)
Vielen Dank, dass ihr meinen Beitrag gelesen habt. 😘
