description.title: Українська традиційна інструментальна музика на семпл-пак від СМИК
description.body: Ідея записати семпл-пак виникла під час першого потоку освітньої програми для саундпродюсерок і саундпродюсерів CMYK Education. Задум цієї освітньої локації - показати будову традиційної музики, її жанрові та регіональні особливості й отримати досвід поєднання автентики з електронікою.\nІ ось результат: спільнотою музикантів та митців \

створено семпл-пак із записами української традиційної інструментальної музики. Зібрано мелодії Галичини, Полісся і Наддніпрянщини. Вони виконані різними складами та записані в різних техніках. \nУ запису взяли участь три гурти:\n- музику з Полісся виконав київський гурт \
(дві скрипки та бубон);\n- Наддніпрянщину зіграла капела \

(скрипка, басоля, бубон);\n- Галичина прозвучала у виконанні гурту сільських музикантів зі Стратина Івано-Франківської області (скрипка, акордеон, барабан).\nДо запису підійшли дуже відповідально і професійно. Його проводили у Badminton Music Studio на Подолі трьома різними способами, щоб зробити семпл-пак зручним для продюсерів різного рівня. Стратинські музиканти грали всі разом, капела \
— почергово, гурт \

— почергово під метроном.
В подальшому географію планують розширювати. 
Послухати інструментал України можна [за посиланням](https://cmykyiv.bandcamp.com/album/cmyk-sample-pack).

description.title: Sinnvolle KI Antworten??? Geprueft? Kein Problem, das wird eher da sein, als die Kerne selbst! :-)
description.body: Ich stelle die Kerne immer dann zurueck, also den \
fuer XAIGPUARC und natuerlich auch XBTGPUARC, wenn ich denke, das ich gerade nicht mehr viel \

Lernen kann, ohne eine Pause zu machen.

Dann, schaue und denke ich eben anderes und Gestern dachte ich mir, oder Vorgestern weis ich nemmer, das es ja witzig waehre, so wie die Pyhton Leute eine SYCL Welt zu bauen, die den Code selbst prueft.

Das ist realtiv einfach so Einzubauen in XAIGPUARC, und kann deshalb viel viel Frueher erwartet werden, als mein erster \

Kernel fuer eines meiner Rechenprogramme wie auch XAIGPUARC dazu zaehlt in meinem Verstaendnis, weil da nunmal viel Herumgerechnet werden muss.

Naja ich habe das ganze Konzept jetzt auch solches im Gehirn. 

Das ist ein bisschen mehr, als das was die Pyhton Leute machen glaube ich. Aber es ist mir auch Egal weil Vergleichen koennen andere, oder auch nicht.

Ich baue auf jeden Fall auch fuer Laien folgendes recht Bald auch zusammen:

Die Code Pruefungseinheit fuer XAIGPUARC. Das kann dann ziemlich Lustigen Scheiß.

Des soll so Funktionieren:

Du sagst, bitte bitte lieber MathTutor, baue mir eine funktionierende SYCL Geraeterkennung fuer Grafikkarten oder sonstigem Zeug. 

DANN:

Manch die KI Folgendes:

Die rechnet im Hintergrund die Wahrscheinlich richtige Antwort auf Basis ihrer \

Datenlage zusammen. Soweit, so Gut kennen wir das alle bis hier hin schon.

ABER... dann Spuckt die die Antwort nicht einfach aus, kotzt sie Aus, wie wir es alle Hassen, wenn die KI Muell ausspuckt den wir nicht haben wollen, weil er nicht funktioniert.

Nein Besser, die KI, hat dann, sobald sie Code Generiert der den Parametern entspricht, wo ich hier ein dickes Grinsen hinsetzen werde, statt zu sagen, welche das sind, den Befehl, diesen Code in einen Sandkasten zu ballern und dann solange rumzubauen daran, bis da ein funktionierender Code rauskommt.

Das macht dann natuerlich am besten noch eine zweite KI dazu, das die sich gegenseitig bisle unter die Arme greifen, weil ich schon hohe Parameter gewaehlt habe und das \

darum noch nicht sooooo Gut in Datenlage da ist.

Die baut und baut dann solange an dem Code in dem Fall ja unsere SYCL Geraeteerkennung herum, bis er Baubar ist, also kompilierbar.

Dann erst, bekomme ich die Antwort von der KI zu sehen und vorher, einfach nicht. 

Ich weis jetzt noch nicht, wie ich das fuer was anderes als mein Mathezeug bauen soll, das kann ich schonmal sagen, sehe ich kaum ein Land das ist fuer Spaeter geiler Scheiß.

Aber ich weis, das des realitv Einfach wird fuer mich das umzusetzen, weil es eigentlich schon wieder nur \

sind, die ich da ordentlich zusammenbasteln muss und damit ja im Kopf komplett anfange und aufhoere, sonst wird man kein Stueck Code sehen.

Das wird schoen Schnuckelig, stell dir mal Vor, Du kannst der kleine Aufgaben zum Programmieren geben und weist, das die Antworten eine so hohe Qualitat haben MUESSEN, weil ja sonst die Logik im Programm nicht greift und dir schon zeigt das es nicht geklappt hat.

Ich finde das ist eine Super Idee. Da kriegt mich keiner mehr weg von, ist das auf jeden Fall auch eine, die ich recht schnell gebaut haben werden koennte ich denke zwei Monate werden viel sein. Neben den anderen Sachen.

Die hoeren ja nicht auf da zu sein. 

Die groeßten Probleme werde ich mit der \

des Speichers haben, weis ich auch schon wieder inzwischen, bei dem Vorbau im XAIGPUARC fuer das Code Pruefungseinheitsprogramm. 

Da muss man ja aufpassen, das der Sandkasten, nicht zu Groß wird und man wirklich auch nur Sand drin hat. 

So wie ich im Kopf manchmal, aber der gefaellt mir auch zum Bauen. Ich hoffe dir gefaellt die Idee, weil ich dir hier gerade sage, wenn Du willst, kannst Du, ein Programmierer werden, weil dann keine Ausrede mehr da ist, einfach Einzelteile zusammensetzen zu wollen.

Das soll dann so funktionieren wie ein Puzzle, nur das ich die Arbeit gemacht habe, das die Puzzleteile, auch wirklich wirklich perfekt ineinander passen, weil es ansonsten garnicht erst im Karton landet.

Das schaut fuer mich auf jeden Fall nach einem sehr erstrebenswertem Zwischenstopp aus. :-D

Salve

Alucian

</center>
</liketuimages>

这个春节是安静的，我喜欢这样的宁静。

过了这么多年的喧闹，这样静下来，感觉好像一下回归了自己，可以让生活暂时缓下来调节一下。

和孩子们除了在家学习干活，就是回娘家干活，我的那个老娘什么都指望我和我老公干，以前是这样，现在更是如此。她总会说，这些让小妮儿干一会儿都干完了，她早已习惯了我这么多年的付出，却没有想过这是她自己的女儿。

提起老娘，除了小时候拾姑姑家的旧衣服她没给我买过新衣服，毕业后我们俩在一个单位工作，她也未曾补贴过我。我这个人挣的多了给自己添些女孩子用的物品，挣的少了也不怎么去花销，所以也未曾向别人伸手过，即使我们俩住在一起，也是如此。

往事一件件一幕幕会在自己忧郁的某个瞬间涌上心头，泪流满面，我是谁家的女儿?不能让自己沉浸在过去，过往不再提……

看着傻傻的母亲，她也是一个受过苦的女人，但她一直都是她自己。偶尔翻看一下朋友圈，看到朋友们都热热闹闹喜气洋洋的全家出去旅游，也是很过眼瘾的，但我受不了那种人挤人的感觉了，那样我的身体也会处于疲倦中，热闹过后，一切还要归于平静，然后调整。

对外界没了欲望，一切都迎刃而解。孩子们见我也很安静，她们也安静的看书学习，然后我也会在某个阳光明媚的的中午，拉着他们到老娘的新院子晒晒太阳，我也会问他们有想去的地方么?老大说他不想出去，老二说他暑假上岸后，想去哈尔滨，唯一亏欠的是老三，她其实哪都想去，在老大老二这个年纪时，我和他爸爸经常带着他们出去玩，到老三的时候，却没怎么出去过。

向内求吧，谁的脸都不要再看，莫要参与别人的因果，一切都是最好的安排。

晚安💤

大年初五，有什么特别的新鲜事吗？😜

答:大年初五吃饺子，🥟寓意团圆❤️，团团圆圆，财源滚滚。
大年初五，喜迎五路财神进家门🎉。祝大家财源广进(੭˙ᗜ˙)੭🧧发发发财(❁´◡`❁)*✲ﾟ*。

朋友圈里，铺天盖地都是接财神的文案(つ≧▽≦)つ💰都讨个好彩头吧！(´▽｀)ﾉ♪

起个早，吃完早午餐，就闲着，本想今天去庙会转转，看看热闹，搁置了。午间过后，起风了，天空不作美，遭遇到新一轮的大风未降温，刮起久违的沙尘暴。

下午四点，风很大，出门去健身房锻炼💪。这城市仿佛披上了一层灰黄的薄纱。远处的高楼在朦胧中若隐若现，阳光被过滤成柔和的暖色，连空气都变得沉甸甸的。这样的天气，连呼吸都带着颗粒感，戴上避风的口罩😷，迎风而上。

健身房人还是依旧，看来大家都是寂寞人，只有健身锻炼来排挤这无聊的假期吧💪(≧ω≦)。离开健身房，天已黑，风依旧大，沙尘未褪，路边是谁丢下的的大红灯笼🏮，路边的吉祥扣，依旧挺立在那里，任风吹拂。

晚餐，母亲给我做的西兰花🥦炒虾仁🍤，健康美味，补充纤维素和蛋白质✌️。

就到这里吧😁谢谢大家的阅读❤️大年初六见🎉祝大家天天开心万事如意心想事成阖家欢乐(˶╹ꇴ╹˶)🧨

description.body: Today I'll take you on a tour of places where thrill and wonder await you everywhere. First let's talk about a town in Spain known as Queenka. This place is famous not only for its beauty but also for its dangerous location. The most unique feature of this city is its houses known as hanging houses which seem to be floating in the air when viewed from the valley below as if they could fall at any moment. These houses are built on the edge of a cliff with wooden beams extending out from the rock face with a drop of hundreds of feet below. What's astonishing is that these buildings have stood in this manner for centuries withstanding the harsh weather conditions. Nowadays these houses have been converted into a museum and restaurant for visitors. Now let's leave Spain and head to Greece where Matura is a unique blend of nature and human worship. This place is famous for its tall towering mountains that rise straight up from the ground towards the sky. On the peaks of these mountains places of worship have been built. These buildings are so high that clouds often appear to be floating below them. It's difficult to imagine the time and effort that went into constructing these places of worship. Nowadays stairs have been built for visitors but as you climb them you get a sense of how challenging life must have been hundreds of years ago. A similar example can be found in Italy where the church of Madonna della Corona is built into the side of a mountain. This church isn't located at the peak but rather in a natural niche halfway up the vertical face of the mountain. From a distance it appears as if the building is a part of the mountain itself emerging from the rocks. The church is situated at a height of approximately 2000 feet above the ground. The purpose behind its construction was to create a peaceful place for worship isolated from worldly concerns. Initially the path to reach it was extremely difficult and could only be accessed on foot but now a tunnel has been dug to make the journey easier. If we head towards Asia in Bhutan there's a monastery called Tiger's Nest or Paro Taktsang that appears to be suspended on the edge of a cliff. It's considered Bhutan's most sacred site. Legend has it that a guru flew here on the back of a tiger and meditated here hence the name Tiger's Nest. The building is perched 3,000 feet above the ground attached to the cliff face. In 1998. This beautiful structure made of wood and stone is proof that humans can achieve what seems impossible. In China there are several such places where humans have settled despite the risks. One famous example is a village known as the Rock Village situated at the top of a mountain. Until recently the only connection to the outside world was via bamboo ladders suspended thousands of feet in the air. Children used these perilous ladders daily to attend school and adults for daily necessities one wrong step meant certain death. Yet people have lived here for centuries as the location provided security and refuge during wars. When the world discovered this village everyone was shocked that in the 21st century people were living under such conditions. In China there's another place known as the world's narrowest city. This city is situated on the banks of a river flowing between two large mountains. The space is so limited that the city's width is just 30 meters in some areas. With virtually no land available buildings have been constructed tall and stand right on the river's edge.

description.title: EXPLORING THE OIL PALM PLANTATION IN THE AFTERNOON  // Discovery of turtle dove chicks and bee photography
description.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPLKntYB2bmKmJGnzyaFS5nrreGJMtEjqDv9RGJbyy6Sn/1771678945307.jpg) In this post I will share an exciting experience of mine while exploring a palm oil plantation to look for moments and objects to photograph, I did this exploration in the afternoon because the afternoon is the peak time of activity for many insects. In accordance with my expectations, in this exploration I managed to find many interesting objects such as the discovery of baby turtle doves, land leech, and a flower bee. It's been a long time since I explored a palm oil plantation like this, but this time I missed something I used to do like going on an adventure into the forest or exploring an abandoned plantation. It's about finding something amazing because I believe that the further we explore nature, the more interesting things we will find. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfL8mi955cgPkPN5S2d95QsS7Cqa1pPV5Es2nNrRMpMvd/1771678945367.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYopBaX6gpmmd4VKAxEodV43WekUgbbbC9HzpwnKHCi93/1771678945473.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVHjL5Vd4suGzvW8eKtXtBexit7PkWcJA5wZeY6ZJoEg/1771678945558.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPuPBqS5LtQ3uvgGmqpKqu7UpEKdpDDK9ShJ5Rx68AYwS/1771678945628.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFrUPXfVmA5WVYAjdYZsN2AoG5UzK52oJDr2eH17JFin/1771678945705.jpg) It was already evening and the atmosphere under the oil palm trees was already very dark, fortunately in this plantation there was an area that was still filled with young oil palm trees, so the atmosphere was still quite bright. Above the leaves we could also see the orange rays of the setting sun which indicated that night would soon come. Oh yes, in this exploration I was accompanied by my pet cat, so I had a friend at that time even though I couldn't chat Lol. I continued walking around this plantation, looking around and hoping to find something amazing, not long after I was surprised by the sound of the flapping wings of a bird flying from inside the oil palm tree, with curiosity I began to approach the tree. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNuvFEGa8JuncwajKXsh6yf7LqewnbRcFLmv517tJKQXh/1771679441054.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2wFtGYsnDNZSi8K61iR1ucMFYV2nTkym58LrVsgvqLx/1771678945874.jpg) After I looked at it, it turned out that on top of this palm oil tree there was a nest of turtle doves, the nest still looked quite new, it would have been impossible if I had only seen this bird's nest from a distance, after I got closer it turned out that there were two turtle dove chicks which were very cute. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqHh44ywBxxH49KJ7cDHDeNGs14d2zZjxwQvwRqxTSWt/1771678945924.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxqBUFnSo7esicnLHeQVi5FjgoVD3rhRxtzSzq29iPMf/1771678945996.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVmyC3kBCpQUhZiizWRuVnBVgj6EqBWxWShYVyDigwqpa/1771678946056.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4en7f1PYbF22FHw7Whuy7k6PSkomQTPiidFVSMDaDuS/1771678946115.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbFAq5Uzz4pAvtfFjqrG7qohSX48rwXV7yccJtGVGhvh/1771678946173.jpg) However,he is still very much a baby, in my estimation this baby bird is only one week old, starting from its soft feathers which are still brownish yellow and its eyes are not yet open. I know the mother bird is definitely watching me so I didn't linger here, but before that I decided to take a photo of these baby turtle doves first, to be honest they are very cute, maybe in about two weeks the main feathers will start to grow. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP2j56Zbz1XbpNHgwVjGdCH3w1cxZ7JWvxHpkjLHyzFW4/1771678946233.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9LZ4gaZVZS2bVrhHh4EuqoTkyLX9qG84Ya2xEQPJyy8/1771678946274.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfXuVuph6jst4Tskk1T5LQurS2YtY9JpRcyMovPhKMLM6/1771678946315.jpg) The atmosphere in this oil palm plantation is quite humid and one thing I really don't like is the large number of mosquitoes. I felt an itch on my leg, at first I thought it was a mosquito bite, but after I looked at it, it turned out there was a land leech on my leg that was sucking my blood. Land leeches often live on damp grass or leaves, they are generally harmless but their bites can cause itching, swelling and bleeding, but because of their strange shape, many people are afraid and don't like this ectoparasitic animal, I myself used to be very afraid, but because I often encounter them so I'm used to it. It was getting dark, and there wasn't much else I could do here so I quickly decided to make my way home. However, on my way home I managed to find a bee perched on a wildflower. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqtTjEezJw5pshJTUyV33zzHxbarScfYHxQSau5UpjFv/1771678946432.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbciNpyHuxrpo9fJiMdubnKA2JMpU2HrZTjxX4DDx9GF/1771678946485.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvtCijXbRKQZgJKiX3XQLBeNqsBU6Bm58oTD8Lm7mFmx/1771678946530.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWab74tHasueXHq8xyFRXgG9bmMKjNEJnKZgKw1THSnMH/1771678946573.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2DLuWYSdU7toa9RdYXehA6HzpCguXwtWoKT6oRx5m8J/1771678946614.jpg) I don't know what this bee is doing, but this bee has a relatively smaller size than bees in general,i managed to photograph this bee using a macro lens so that every detail can be seen clearly and beautifully. However, because it was getting dark, I didn't have enough light to photograph this bee, but the results still looked beautiful ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

description.title: Snow Much Fun For The First Timer Like Me ❄️
description.body:
***Hi lovely people in this community! I hope everyone is doing well today. I’m glad to share with you my first experience of winter weather here in Germany.***


![7C276882-5F7E-4035-B7D9-16616142E6EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/23w2uafPUm4QK2pQLpsxT8i9nEHt8EaSJEVSSs6pmCxnE2jbA5cs91fAPxSDLMgoqwUx2.jpeg)


Early in the morning when I woke up, it was a gloomy and cold day. When I looked outside, I saw white surroundings everywhere. I was happy to see this in person; however, it was too cold for me to go outside. Even though I wanted to play with the snow and felt like I was in the movie Let It Go, it was freezing cold for sure. I tried opening the window and let the snow fall onto my hands.


![9CC4E420-6DF6-414E-984D-F099E50579BE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/23xyZ9kFDr8ReFpiY9BSEyFATia3RzR8eagvSQhv2fFWQ33C6PXGBQsXXZ4HvF1z3LB6b.jpeg)

![D24B4EE2-40A0-4C4A-A46E-4630E52A8030.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/23w2gcD4bh9L19BbTRyqnNpQc67cWKweonemW1ijxDaCJavFjwbe159RmeXmNSwXwqy9L.jpeg)


I felt like a child at that moment. There was a smile on my face for a long time as I watched the snow fall from the window. Then I captured some pictures, which were very beautiful to me. My surroundings, covered in white, felt magical. Although it was not a heavy snowfall, it was still a wonderful experience for me.


![6FE974F5-FF44-415D-82EB-3734F542F2A5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/EqFsSiXDjD96CYDxKmYWNbPckRZEWjpPNfyzDGfFcuTdbSm7HfGq5Amyh2KZcPRf3ur.jpeg)

During this moment, I also took videos and pictures and sent it to the family group chat and show them how beautiful it was. They also loved it and my auntie even said that she will lay down on this snow when she also see it. How funny yeah?😊


I was also talking to my friend via video call during this time by the way. I know it was a lot happening here at this time but you know the feeling of excitement when you were able to see and experience it first hand and you just wanted to share it to your family and friends as well - it was so nice!


![FA392F16-32F6-4AC5-B749-1B6BD4D211FD.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/23wgS9brQcXy5rA1cd5rSgncYsvKBh3CnsDaPH7f5VTKHhJBH1FFDG8fyLedrGDBf6YDw.jpeg)

![875F9CC6-00E0-4D5F-A26E-32DAEF780109.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ceszianne/23wMcg51Ebry4aLSjveGFCfX2KdPaMEcz3tuAY6E4raATNyueFR6mr8pkDMJ4BtDBt1LL.jpeg)


I posted some of pictures and videos on Instagram and I got many reactions too. This was definitely a fun day experience however there is also a disadvantage of this weather. Some people cannot go outside more often because there’s not much to do outside. It’s very cold and when you are out for long you would want to go back home . I think this weather will be longer for months so say good luck to me. 😅 

**That is all for today and I will catch you on my next blog. Happy day everyone!**

************************
*All pictures taken are mine.
Edited using Canva.
Camera used is IPhone.*

Today we enjoyed a very special traditional meal that truly made the moment memorable. In front of us was a big and beautiful platter filled with soft basmati rice, tasty BBQ pieces, and perfectly cooked quail (bater) that added a unique flavour to the whole dish.

The grilled chicken, kebabs, and the colorful shredded carrots on top made the platter look even more tempting. Every bite was full of taste, and the combination of BBQ with rice was simply perfect. Along with this, we also had a bowl of fresh raita which increased the enjoyment of the meal.

Sharing such food with family or friends always brings happiness. Meals like this are not only delicious but also remind us of our traditions and our culture of hospitality.

It was truly a wonderful experience, and I’m happy to share this moment with you all.

description.title: La mentalidad que transforma fracasos en fortaleza: Resiliencia
description.body:
<center>
![Adriangge.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23xp8Yyg5BykSQfAwBwc7otmZStAdwVfZTRyqoQUy6x5KMwE3VfkZSQKeMr4ybXGfhjgg.png)

<sub>**Imagen propia editada con Gemini y Canva**</sub>

### **La resiliencia no elimina las tormentas sino que te enseña a caminar bajo la lluvia sin olvidar hacia dónde vas.** 
— *Oneray*

---

</center>

<div class=\

> Hay frases que repetimos casi en automático cuando el camino parece ponerse duro:
“Lo que no te mata, te hace más fuerte.” “Si caes siete veces, levántate ocho.” “Después de la tormenta, siempre sale el sol.”
Las hemos escuchado tanto que a veces pierden peso. Se vuelven decoración motivacional o afirmaciones que no nos llevan a ningún lado. A pesar de esto, hay días en los que dejan de ser frases bonitas y se convierten en una tabla de salvación en un mar tormentoso. Si en algo estaremos de acuerdo es que la resiliencia no suena épica cuando estás en medio del problema, por el contrario, suena injusta, pesada, suena a “¿por qué a mí?”, y sin embargo, es ahí donde realmente empieza el crecimiento personal. Déjame contarte algo sencillo: Imagina a un niño en la playa construyendo un castillo de arena. Él se toma su tiempo, lo diseña con cuidado y está emocionado. Cuando termina, viene una ola (o peor aún, otro niño travieso) y lo destruye por completo. Ocurre un silencio... Él tiene dos opciones: llorar y abandonar o empezar otra vez. La primera reacción suele ser la frustración, y en la vida adulta no lloramos en la arena, pero nos quejamos, nos cerramos y hasta nos rendimos por dentro. Sin embargo, cuando ese mismo niño decide reconstruir el castillo, esta vez más lejos del agua con una base más firme, o más cerca de sus padres buscando protección, algo cambia. Ya no está jugando solamente. Ahora está aprendiendo. Eso es resiliencia. No es negar el golpe o fingir que no dolió. **Es elegir volver a intentarlo con una mentalidad más fuerte y más consciente.** La vida nunca sigue el guion que imaginamos. Planes que se caen, proyectos que no funcionan, ingresos que no llegan como esperábamos y hasta relaciones que no prosperan. Y en esos momentos es fácil creer que el fracaso define nuestro valor. Pero te diré algo: el fracaso no define tu valor. Define tu entrenamiento. Hace un tiempo un proyecto importante no salió como lo había planeado. Había invertido tiempo, energía, ilusión. Cuando no funcionó, sentí esa mezcla de frustración y silencio incómodo a causa de las miradas y señalamientos que nunca faltan. La tentación fue pensar: “Tal vez no soy tan capaz como creía”. Ahí entendí algo clave sobre la mentalidad. La resiliencia no nace de repetir frases bonitas. Nace de lo que decides creer y hacer cuando todo parece derrumbarse. En lugar de preguntarme “¿por qué fallé?”, cambié la pregunta a “¿qué me está enseñando esto? ¿Cómo puedo mejorar para lograr lo que quiero”. No fue mágico, naturalmente ni mucho menos instantáneo. Pero cambió por completo mi postura. Pensé en esas plantas que crecen entre las grietas del cemento. El entorno no es ideal, no tienen tierra fértil ni tienen condiciones perfectas. Y aun así, buscan la luz. Se adaptan, se aferran y crecen. Ahora, nosotros podemos hacer lo mismo si así lo elegimos. El éxito, incluso el éxito financiero, no está reservado para quienes nunca caen; está reservado para quienes desarrollan la humildad de aprender cuando caen. Para quienes entienden que cada obstáculo fortalece un músculo interno que nadie ve, pero que sostiene todo lo demás. **La resiliencia es ese músculo invisible.** Cada vez que eliges intentarlo otra vez, se fortalece; cada vez que cambias queja por aprendizaje, crece. Cada vez que decides no rendirte, ese músculo madura. Y aquí quiero dejarte algunas preguntas, no como discurso, sino como espejo: * Cuando algo no sale como esperabas, ¿te hablas con dureza o lo haces con comprensión? * ¿Estás construyendo tu mentalidad para el crecimiento o para la excusa? * Si hoy tuvieras que empezar de nuevo, ¿lo harías con miedo… o con experiencia? La resiliencia no promete que no habrá tormentas. Promete que no te quedarás sin rumbo en medio de ellas. Porque al final, el verdadero crecimiento no se mide por cuántas veces todo salió bien, sino por cuántas veces decidiste levantarte cuando no como esperabas. **Y cuando aprendes eso, ya no temes caer... Aprendes a reconstruir.** *— Oneray* ---
![Oneray.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23uR563rkQ6mSLnpTcsMnDNtjQMyJ2bUBGHDhkpCubk1xP8AWnqYSLvyMiYQ71zBQ8Tsn.png) --- ![Esta publicación está libre de plagio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23tvZzFTr8MnU2mPbsneuM7pLGHvx2bZmU7AQ4ymL7b8Q7tD8y4G4iCRPLCcBFv9zHuSR.png) ---

</center>

<h6><div class=\

>
***Todas las imágenes que utilizo en mis publicaciones son de mi autoría, propias o creadas con herramientas de inteligencia artificial, a menos que indique lo contrario al pie de las mismas, y pueden haber sido editadas con [Canva](https://www.canva.com)***
Click here for English version
![Adriangge.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneray/23xp8Yyg5BykSQfAwBwc7otmZStAdwVfZTRyqoQUy6x5KMwE3VfkZSQKeMr4ybXGfhjgg.png) **Image edited with Gemini and Canva** ### **Resilience doesn't eliminate storms, but it teaches you to walk in the rain without forgetting where you're going.** — *Oneray* ---

>

There are phrases we repeat almost automatically when things get tough:

“What doesn’t kill you makes you stronger.”

“If you fall seven times, get up eight.”

“After the storm, the sun always comes out.”

We’ve heard them so often that they sometimes lose their meaning. They become motivational platitudes or affirmations that don’t get us anywhere. Despite this, there are days when they stop being pretty phrases and become a lifeline in a stormy sea.

If there’s one thing we can all agree on, it’s that resilience doesn’t sound epic when you’re in the middle of a problem; on the contrary, it sounds unfair, burdensome, it sounds like “Why me?” And yet, that’s where personal growth truly begins.

Let me tell you something simple:

Imagine a child on the beach building a sandcastle. He takes his time, designs it carefully, and is excited. When it's over, a wave comes (or worse, another mischievous child) and completely destroys it.

A silence falls...

He has two options: cry and give up, or start again.

The first reaction is usually frustration, and in adulthood, we don't cry on the sand, but we complain, shut down, and even give up inwardly. However, when that same child decides to rebuild the castle, this time farther from the water with a firmer foundation, or closer to his parents seeking protection, something changes. He's no longer just playing. Now he's learning.

That's resilience.

It's not denying the blow or pretending it didn't hurt.

**It's choosing to try again with a stronger and more conscious mindset.**

Life never follows the script we imagine. Plans fall apart, projects don't work out, income doesn't arrive as expected, and even relationships don't flourish. And in those moments, it's easy to believe that failure defines our worth.

But let me tell you something: failure doesn't define your worth. It defines your training.

A while ago, an important project didn't go as planned. I had invested time, energy, and enthusiasm. When it didn't work out, I felt that mix of frustration and awkward silence because of the stares and judgmental comments that are always present. The temptation was to think, \

That's when I understood something key about mindset.

Resilience isn't born from repeating pretty phrases. It's born from what you decide to believe and do when everything seems to be falling apart. Instead of asking myself, \
, I changed the question to, \

It wasn't magic, naturally, or instantaneous. But it completely changed my perspective. I thought about those plants that grow in the cracks of the cement. The environment isn't ideal; they don't have fertile soil or perfect conditions. And yet, they reach for the light. They adapt, they cling, and they grow. Now, we can do the same if we choose to. Success, even financial success, isn't reserved for those who never fall; it's reserved for those who develop the humility to learn when they fall. For those who understand that every obstacle strengthens an inner muscle that no one sees, but that sustains everything else. **Resilience is that invisible muscle.** Every time you choose to try again, it gets stronger; every time you replace complaining with learning, it grows. Every time you decide not to give up, that muscle matures. And here I want to leave you with some questions, not as a lecture, but as a mirror: * When something doesn't go as planned, do you speak to yourself harshly or with understanding? * Are you building your mindset for growth or for making excuses? * If you had to start over today, would you do it with fear… or with experience? Resilience doesn't promise there won't be storms. It promises you won't be left adrift in the midst of them. Because in the end, true growth isn't measured by how many times everything went right, but by how many times you decided to get back up when things didn't go as planned. **And when you learn that, you're no longer afraid to fall... You learn to rebuild.***— Oneray* ---

description.title: Plave Eunho Handmade Clay Phone Hipper
description.body:
![eunhophonehipper.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eonjcic4fCmV21X8v2ktHSaUoSoZUqa9uNz83hxkQUu9YD4E8BzNKuBXWm8okD9wdNr.gif)
Hello, how are you? Last time I made Bamby Phone Hipper, I fell inlove with it. I am using it now on my phone, so I decided to make one again, but this time his soulmate Eunho which his friend for almost a decade already, which is so cool. -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • Polymer Clay
  • Weighing Scale
  • Glass Sheet
  • Dotting Tool
  • Acrylic Stamping Block
  • X-Acto Knife
  • Paper
  • Heat Gun
  • Needle Tool

>
  • Soft Pastel
  • Brush
  • Oven
  • UV Resin
  • Disposable Gloves
  • Mask
  • UV Lamp
  • Doublesided Tape
  • Toothpick Container
-----
Craft Time!
> ![0.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWhf9rew896ivedpRdGLpKFuuvC2VC1eZ1nj6cxLb4pYE97RVK46Wr46kWiw7YUHM.JPG)

> ![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK4rDkrs146chKHwUnePQkkTn4rxWnSAREBU5rpkK1tTuTRPkQGLnVzyRPTCrJxsKJ.JPG) I sketch the reference first, and then I condition all the clay colors I am going to use. -----
> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyPbUikEyuwd9PR5Vqms1xiFYWEzQoEHjenvrRNwJmFJGJAfkMxFam9ZoikHk92iRg.JPG)

> ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoAZgMPknJ7jQ9VjN962b5BJV3quuW52ELuK459HB7Nj3TFXWQCUzxx8wKwb14gNV3u.JPG) So I like to start with a lighter color first because if I started with darker clay, it would stain my hands, and it would stain the lighter clay. -----
> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1WPGzxgKNFVM2Upsq9sY1ULKgqKsFJimVg1tV2LmogEi7BjD1MBHw4nHqPZqpsmZu.JPG)

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEjFTVwWSV2q6xxAMCCnxaDhNU3Gs9r2jNgcYKPPuUG1fML6rqnNRC1uCkNYNtoaP2.JPG) I will start with the skin first, all the part that all skin color I am going to group them so that when I start assembling them all, it is much easier to do it. -----
> ![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK6JxrupdAZYfmSZU5XQPDtJHAqDNkNPNi1Mdzch8sPnm78ZU7wamLyXivWuVkEuwY.JPG)

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoprXjGUQPNVA3LWJ2A6GEF7yeC77xxiZPvtVnSZ4gX1cSNXoVtDvvmRg72cDdjjbUW.JPG) Next part is his clothing with contains a lot of black, so I needed to wear gloves so that I would not stain my hands LOL. -----
Sculpting the Face:
> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowEfWkwjitXdPcDgyRZFanjhHVQRmDWkpWyXeqib3ygBbmVDSHwH51kjzpDZrwct3Z.JPG)

> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3doUvsHzDz6gy8791S9QCPxs6ZnqoqZFLcsWEFtzjFA7Euwhxd8bfuLW24oV4pCSe.JPG) First is I put the head on an acrylic stamping block just to make the sculpting easier. After that, using the dotting tool to map where I am going to put the eyes. -----
> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou7oKEurMAvEZCS5K5EeHFaBqZqPNFec7HHv9CkP5jseHk1mGTw7Eni8aEWWZiCiiZ.JPG)

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5kjUeRHdkDQTvVexnpGVvfV3iHy9Fa9FhebA7CgPkvdNcm5bhE6PEiwtJHjdvnYau.JPG) Then I carefully added the eyes using the dotting tool. -----
> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep7tdvMaLSTTdRYSwtSLrYJQQrYThmRK3DU45uAVPe4w6dVkpSpvuPnJN3hWgWToji3.JPG)
> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3eKqdryieb4HNapyUpEgkuiMbvyuyvW85YWNcq4jnaN3LEB1vUQVgbNeMvEnysDix.JPG) And then eyebrows. -----
> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpXJbPu8op79iWwPLnhpD35K7uycAoJELpFDxxdEfLXSR757Lcuu68hkShvS15sEPNu.JPG)

> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3fCwot8cPkf4HMxuFgumG2JHz3eR2rAmkapvgKSeXLW9HRXV6wDfWKhRn4AM5wpp2.JPG) For the nose, I shape it into a triangle shape, and then I cut it in the middle to form it as a heart shape. -----
> ![22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowFBX2BR9pqtzUtzT8DkWmpkpY6S6dH4VSJuuJswBL85nWD3bUp2m2Gd1C8YSU6dfs.JPG)

> ![23.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowFAkXnkFS6HnDHkPjDAkHnf4LcY72HZbrArQKpnmX3Udy2NAKeYSD41uoJNeYyuiE.JPG) This is what it looks like, and then I put it in the middle of the face. -----
> ![25.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EqDmZ2ezE43dsUAGdhVBfdoKg8hNZFPbdWSN6i2GMKnyZC2F9sKhqtSQzBRkEY9Viaf.JPG)

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCkVf1kjzb3jzBdQKx6WCDYYhXWizcyhu6gm7hkWMoFMoTNNHRm4y8oEaCjTSDjbzL.JPG) For the lips, this is the hardest part, but I am still in the process of perfecting it. I roll a dark brown clay until it is thin enough. -----
> ![27.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eops1uav4bJbnUYJM7g5e1r7MBWEfLBtsg3K7mWHcBjvZoeAPYRCgdJso6fZXJftNu3.JPG)

> ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou8Jb1JG9mVuBwKejXrmUd5QzaJwTKeWJJBryLF5hEen5degF52kSNRafoJyANuWCP.JPG) Then I cut it using the X- Acto Knife, and then one by one, adding it. -----
> ![30.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos1HnNgDQeMqddDQz8Zp71a1cZ8GRmP55kHwyzvnGDvTgBKuqxoRNH5VC625vbqdgB.JPG)
> ![31.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokc5SVmNWWvYxR5tBTY2EmA9jwe6z7drgVtjHkwEwWaz7u68trBenJPRvVeWQxi2AK.JPG) And then ears. -----
> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyPvGtSpjcoghYLhbggPx3WeYe7HXptTe3yf7Qzh4cJYiGceFviHxapYFuhVUTasC9.JPG)

> ![33.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3dnUJuYEdkEKAPqtojGjVPCTkzY5opwP9VQ8nX6ysUSrGNYoAaijsKTJvebvZZ9ky.JPG) Made a hole to imitate the ears. -----

description.title: Something good, something bad: reflections on Brazil.
description.body:
Hello everyone! Today here at @dreloop07 I'm going to talk a little about Brazil, a country of many contrasts. As many know, we have reasons to celebrate, but at the same time, we face challenges that sadden us.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXreeFE34y34ZaGmtCq9WyR5WanQS8QEBj5K8p1KLRtVo/copilot_20260221_113201.png)

| <a href=\

>*This publication was also writen in ENGLISH and PORTUGUESE .* | |---| ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSZfRy775sFxadZdcLJHRFxrpiSzQYkAiV9aiP5yysB5/captura_de_tela_2024_07_31_094609_removebg_preview.png) Hello this post is a onboard introduction project from BR audience,

>PORTUGUESE VERSION AT THE END. This dilemma is part of our history and reality. In recent times, Brazil has shown progress in science and technology. Recently, news that made me happy was the prominence of Brazilian researchers in international innovation projects, especially in the areas of renewable energy and health. Universities and research centers have achieved global recognition, showing that Brazilian talent is capable of competing anywhere in the world. An inspiring example is the progress in research on vaccines and medicines developed here. During the pandemic, we saw how institutions like Fiocruz and the Butantan Institute were fundamental in ensuring that millions of Brazilians had rapid access to immunization. This scientific leadership not only saved lives but also reinforced the importance of investing in national science. The Brazilian researcher who recently gained prominence is Tatiana Coelho de Sampaio, a professor at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ). After almost three decades of studies, she developed \

a molecule capable of stimulating the reconnection of damaged neurons in the spinal cord.

Another positive point is the growth of technology startups. Many of them are creating innovative solutions for local problems, such as urban mobility, digital education, and sustainability. Seeing young Brazilian entrepreneurs gaining space on the international stage is a source of pride and hope. This type of achievement makes me happy because it shows that, despite the difficulties, Brazil has the capacity to reinvent itself and contribute to the world with creative ideas and solutions.

## Something bad: inequality and violence

On the other hand, we cannot ignore the problems that still afflict us. One of the things that saddens me most is the persistence of social inequality and violence. Unfortunately, Brazil is still one of the most unequal countries in the world. While some have access to opportunities and quality of life, many live in precarious conditions, without adequate access to health, education, and security.

Urban violence is another painful aspect. News of robberies, homicides, and armed conflicts in communities is frequent. This generates fear and insecurity, directly affecting people's lives. It is sad to realize that many Brazilians do not feel safe even in their own neighborhoods. Furthermore, inequality is reflected in other problems, such as the lack of basic sanitation in several regions, unemployment, and precarious work. These factors create a difficult cycle to break, where poverty fuels violence and violence hinders development. This reality saddens me because it shows that we still have a long way to go to guarantee dignity and social justice for all.

## Considerations:

Brazil is a country of contrasts: while we celebrate advances in science, culture, and innovation, we also face serious problems of inequality and violence. This mixture of joy and sadness is part of our identity, but it should not paralyze us. On the contrary, it should motivate us to seek solutions.

---
# PORTUGUESE VERSION
<a id=\

> https://images.ecency.com/DQmQSZfRy775sFxadZdcLJHRFxrpiSzQYkAiV9aiP5yysB5/captura_de_tela_2024_07_31_094609_removebg_preview.png ## Algo bom, algo ruim: reflexões sobre o Brasil. Olá pessoa! Hoje aqui no @dreloop07 vou falar um pouco sobre Brasil um pais de muitos contrastes. Como muitos sabem temos motivos para celebrar mais ao mesmo tempo desafios que nos entristecem. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdugoxSAQzG4Qywi8d1T8rPmrBjhX7Vcff7HBJgfQEPwv/copilot_20260221_112846.png) Esse dilema faz parte da nossa história e realidade. Nos últimos tempos, o Brasil tem mostrado avanços em ciência e tecnologia. Recentemente, uma notícia que me deixou feliz foi o destaque de pesquisadores brasileiros em projetos internacionais de inovação, especialmente na área de energia renovável e saúde. Universidades e centros de pesquisa têm conseguido reconhecimento global, mostrando que o talento brasileiro é capaz de competir em qualquer lugar do mundo. Um exemplo inspirador é o avanço em pesquisas sobre vacinas e medicamentos desenvolvidos aqui. Durante a pandemia, vimos como instituições como a Fiocruz e o Instituto Butantan foram fundamentais para garantir que milhões de brasileiros tivessem acesso rápido à imunização. Esse protagonismo científico não apenas salvou vidas, mas também reforçou a importância de investir em ciência nacional. A pesquisadora brasileira que ganhou destaque recentemente é Tatiana Coelho de Sampaio, professora da Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ). Após quase três décadas de estudos, ela desenvolveu a \

, uma molécula capaz de estimular a reconexão de neurônios lesionados na medula espinhal.

Outro ponto positivo é o crescimento das startups de tecnologia. Muitas delas estão criando soluções inovadoras para problemas locais, como mobilidade urbana, educação digital e sustentabilidade. Ver jovens empreendedores brasileiros ganhando espaço no cenário internacional é motivo de orgulho e esperança. Esse tipo de conquista me deixa feliz porque mostra que, apesar das dificuldades, o Brasil tem capacidade de se reinventar e de contribuir para o mundo com ideias e soluções criativas.

## Algo ruim: desigualdade e violência

Por outro lado, não dá para ignorar os problemas que ainda nos afligem. Uma das coisas que mais me entristece é a persistência da desigualdade social e da violência. Infelizmente, o Brasil ainda é um dos países mais desiguais do mundo. Enquanto alguns têm acesso a oportunidades e qualidade de vida, muitos vivem em condições precárias, sem acesso adequado a saúde, educação e segurança.

A violência urbana é outro aspecto doloroso. Notícias de assaltos, homicídios e conflitos armados em comunidades são frequentes. Isso gera medo e insegurança, afetando diretamente a vida das pessoas. É triste perceber que muitos brasileiros não se sentem seguros nem mesmo em seus próprios bairros. Além disso, a desigualdade se reflete em outros problemas, como a falta de saneamento básico em várias regiões, o desemprego e a precarização do trabalho. Esses fatores criam um ciclo difícil de quebrar, onde a pobreza alimenta a violência e a violência dificulta o desenvolvimento. Essa realidade me entristece porque mostra que ainda temos um longo caminho a percorrer para garantir dignidade e justiça social para todos.

## Considerações:

O Brasil é um país de contrastes: ao mesmo tempo em que celebramos avanços na ciência, na cultura e na inovação, também enfrentamos problemas graves de desigualdade e violência. Essa mistura de alegria e tristeza faz parte da nossa identidade, mas não deve nos paralisar. Pelo contrário, deve nos motivar a buscar soluções.

description.body:
### **ONLY ONE** - Only one photo, a moment, a history, a perspective.

*****

![#0271 Schweiz Zürich Hauptbahnhof PHOTO_20200824_055535-01 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukasbachofner/23vi1t7Upu9tZCZd96qE8m88P9rBZL1WTdQQkGNho3NfzgVNrq3rSrPsbDDmzvFKTGMd1.jpeg)

<center> Zurich Mainstation (SWITZERLAND) </center>

*****
*****

#deutsch Dieses Bild habe ich eines Morgens auf dem Arbeitsweg gemacht. Der Schnappschuss entstand während der Wartezeit beim Umsteigen im Zürcher Hauptbahnhof (Schweiz), als ich noch kurz eine Zigarette rauchen ging.

*****

#english I took this photo one morning on my way to work. The snapshot was taken while waiting to change trains at Zurich Central Station (Switzerland), when I went out for a quick cigarette.

*****

#espanol Tomé esta foto una mañana de camino al trabajo. La instantánea fue tomada mientras esperaba para hacer transbordo en la estación central de Zúrich (Suiza), cuando salí un momento a fumar un cigarrillo.

****
****

#work
#visualshots
#travel

<center> The image and the text in German were created **without AI**. The text in Spanish and English I translated with deepl.com. </center>

description.title: A Fragrance That Follows You: The Enchanting Beauty of the Rangoon Creeper Flower
description.body:
There are flowers you notice with your eyes, and then there are flowers you feel—the Rangoon creeper belongs beautifully to the second kind. Also known as Madhobilata in many parts of South Asia, this vine is a storyteller. From the moment its delicate blooms begin to open, the air fills with a gentle, sweet fragrance that lingers like a memory you don’t want to let go.

What makes the Rangoon creeper truly magical is the way its flowers change color with time. They begin as soft white blooms, then slowly blush into pink, and finally deepen into a rich, romantic red. Watching the transformation feels like witnessing a painting in motion. It’s as if the vine celebrates every stage of its bloom, teaching us that beauty doesn’t stay still—it evolves, grows, and matures just like we do.

description.title: I Never Told You
description.body:
![Banners. PeakD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/natalialove/23u6MsH2XF4GnU6dduf8bW7wYUEaPBBn39Rs5oTFnPvzHKU5WBBf8DMqNX9GZRd8qNjjW.png)

---

# <center> I never told you that I rehearse goodbyes before love even begins... </center>

---

I never told you that I rehearse goodbyes before love even begins.

Because it always ends. That is how it is.

I rehearse them because I know it’s going to hurt,
and I want to be prepared.

I recognized my pattern,
the red flags I was chasing.
Of course I knew it was going to end.

Even with friends.

Because I felt that amazing old soul
entering my life,
like a reunion after thousands of years apart,
was going to keep traveling
and never come back in this lifetime.

I rehearse them over and over again,
every time I’m going to meet him later that day,

when he is lying half-asleep next to me in his bed.

I rehearse the goodbyes
so I don’t fall apart crying,
so I can act cool,
uninterested.

I never told you that I rehearse goodbyes before love even begins.

Perhaps because I didn’t want to love.
Or maybe I was already drunk on it.

I never told you that I loved you when you left,
because a goodbye was all I needed.

---

description.title: The Million Dollar Question
description.body:
Apparently, I have a problem, and if I'm being really honest, it's not exactly something that I'm new to. It's something I've always known, but this was definitely the first time someone was squarely pointing it out to me.

Earlier today, one of my neighbors approached me and told me that she had something she wanted to say to me. She had made a joke about me having a spiritual wife who helps me to dictate on what days I should or shouldn't smile.

![photo-1552096789-4e613d2c6e33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23vhunQ9VSzSp7psdR57XoNDFzXvFEJwy8vEgFSXkQKGdJWj51jKxb7Q8jY6WQBd4hobU.jpeg)
<sub> [photo by Ángel López](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-standing-under-pink-petaled-flowers-YwnF1Sfsagw) </sub>

According to her, there are days when I act all friendly, and I get to talk to everyone and just make them laugh, while there are also days when I act all moody and don't say much. Now this isn't your usual mood swing scenario, as it happens too often. I could be all smiley today and moody for the next two days, then I'm back to being friendly all over again.

When she said this, I laughed a bit because, like I said, this isn't something new to me. As a matter of fact, I've had to lie to someone that I had met them not too long ago, just in case they find me moody the next day; it was because my social battery was dead and all that. 

I had to tell them that in advance because we had just met, and she had met the happy version of myself, and I didn't want a situation where the next day comes and she's expecting the happy me, only to meet something different.

The sad thing about this whole thing right now is that I don't do these things on purpose. I just react based on how I'm feeling at the moment, and it's bad. I know it's bad, and I really hope to stop it, but how do you manually lift your mood when you're naturally feeling sad or just moody?

That is the million-dollar question that I believe holds the answer or solution to my problem.

### English

Hello, my dear friends from the **Black and White community**.

I had set aside my **Takanakuy** project for a while to focus on my photos from Cusco, but today I wanted to get back on track. I am still in the middle of an overwhelming photo selection process. I picked up right where I left off, after the last fight I posted, and here I present the most impactful moments of this new round.

As the fights progressed, they became faster, and the visual burst made documenting everything quite a challenge. I didn't get all the details about the specific characters, but I can certainly tell you what I felt: a rush of adrenaline and deep emotion in this almost ritualistic celebration. Upon reviewing my shots, I’ve found incredible details that I hope you can appreciate as well. I leave you with this series and look forward to your comments.

> **\

**

**¡Kachkaniraqmi!** *(Quechua: Until we meet again)*

---

Hola mis queridos amigos de la comunidad **Blanco y Negro**.

Había dejado un poco de lado mi proyecto de **Takanakuy** por ver las fotos de mi último viaje a Cusco, pero hoy quise ponerme al día. Todavía estoy en un proceso abrumador de selección de fotos. Busqué la última pelea que subí para continuar desde ahí, y acá les dejo las partes más impactantes de la siguiente contienda.

Al pasar de las peleas, estas se daban cada vez más rápido y el estallido visual me hacía más difícil documentarlo todo. No supe muy bien los detalles de los personajes, pero solo puedo decir lo que sentí: un sentimiento de adrenalina y mucha emoción en esta fiesta casi ritual. Al revisar mis fotos, encuentro detalles increíbles que espero que ustedes también puedan apreciar. Les dejo esta serie de fotografías y espero les guste; los leo en los comentarios.

description.title: Fashion meets festival with these mask.
description.body: Ever since a horror movie started popular among the audience, the \

of the character becomes a hot selling product in the open market. As soon as the movies release, the character mask can be easily found in the market / shops. I remember buying one during a fair in my childhood. There wont be much option available to chose during my days, but over the time we have so many new character came into foray which results in multi kind of masks option. Scary masks are used to evoke fear, conceal identity, and create a sense of the uncanny, making them popular for horror. But these masks are now part of holi celebration and the market is gearing for some hot stuffs as the festival is nearing.


![20260221_171429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tbnP1RBCaHNgThai5h3oAYjekXm1jpPKXp4GWuUFzVhXSLRdDZYcc7R1VKUVoCTD2wc.jpg)

Although holi is a festival of colors, but these masks are now getting popular too. These masks create iconic, intimidating, or thrilling, characters in, and haunted attractions. And at the time Holi festival they are selling like a hot cake. I happen to visit with my relative to buy holi product for his shop and ultimately ended up with so many haunted character at one shop. While we were looking for water colors and gulal, but finding these masks we too had few in our sack.


![20260221_171404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tbo37v9vYcNB9GWyKhGj9S4X6kuvYXFvTya7Aa2yNxYDj2kGnQGoaxU6MHqz9ZtXHMD.jpg)

![20260221_171445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tSKwm9h4kfJKUMMSKTL7VdLEDPMgDx9non1tZTE9bhLBGuGE3sezTuNZVcjKXbuuLFz.jpg)

![20260221_171348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tbpaHLHRoAEZEvVYjZT81UbYp9MZiKJoAjvG3QKUoxPgvzyaZ7JpyQz1bhZ94W5hPpT.jpg)



![20260221_171424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eou7BVEWmGx8RoeL823b3NKERVpGgEcY2DBL2N94fvaoTWg42t1vMQ5dxgVcbVucoy6.jpg)

![20260221_171440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8RPx6aYXrhwkzsWEY4GkBMuremDy7675s4qJk4MxGkayUGF6BuPexMi1gC4fYdo1j.jpg)



![20260221_171420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23xoz2NvZNa6MmZ2PqXJqTUhyz2yEbYmSQd5VTh1s2dWAzmYqWw4p5UboRZ91Db1RA474.jpg)

![20260221_171434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23u5ztFcz7Gf8XeCcAYyTs1hPGp1mtKGYk3uUKEFbBi4B196tvJAadYvoGjuD75TSo4SZ.jpg)


There might be question, as why these were sold during the festival of colors. We'll these adds a different theme to the festival but these have their own meaning. Masks help protect the face from strong, hard-to-remove dyes. Usually there are all kind of color available and some are hard to wipe of. Wearing a mask prevent from getting it close to the face. There are all kinds of masks but these scary figures remain kids attraction. So keeping them on shop would be a nicer idea. On bulk purchases these are available at a reduced rate, but in open market they are sold at a much higher price. 

Which one you like to put on to avoid the color. I liked the first one, more because it is actually appearing more scarier than others.




**In good faith - Peace!!**

description.title: Of No Literary or Artistic Value?
description.body:
![racing_sirens_12x9_ink_on_paper_w.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/artgrafiken/23wMo8uoTC5HZtBczfDxo49PvdXoLx687ENcdTyaVFcskAx4Pj4QrERRT6UcGmRmHUCE4.png)
**Of No Literary or Artistic Value?**

The title is the definition of pornography.
A comedian once said that's every commercial on television.
Sexual titillation is used to get the viewer to buy the product.
But that's not sex.
It's sexual teasing.
It's not sexual satisfaction.
Which most people are incapable of experiencing.
They hold against the pleasure with their guilt.
So never fully experience an unbridled orgasm.
Since we were young many were taught sex is dirty.
The neurosis began.
The problem we faced?
You get married and want to have sex with your partner.
But why would you want to do something dirty with someone you loved?
The market for Viagra just got bigger.
We live in a society that says violence can be shown to the young,
but not the sexual act.
Killing is okay—fucking is not.
What kind of a world is it when natural human behavior is stopped?
The kind we live in—twisted, depraved, perverse.
Natural life becomes the hunted enemy.
The promoters of this perversion?
Religion—authoritarian government—psychologically ill people.
This problem is held in place by the masses, the infected.
Their neurotic irrational behavior is accepted as sanity.
The truth is a healthy individual is self regulating.
He or she is not a sex maniac.
If you are capable of a full orgasm.
Without guilt, without remorse.
You lay exhausted next to your partner in a state of mutual grateful bliss.
You have satisfied your needs.
You have released the excess energy your body had stored up.
You are balanced again.
Next comes—work! That's right.
The desire to do some creative or useful work.
This is what is meant by self-regulation.
Which most people on this planet are incapable of.
And in there lies the rub.
And why those same people cannot understand what I am saying.
They've been taught, conditioned, to go against the natural way of life.
To actually fear it.
So here we are at this point in our history.
Just look at the headlines.
You may be able to see what I mean.

description.title: SPS Price Supported By Great Support Line
description.body:
SPS price went down from 0,01 USD to 0,006 USD in a few days. Even it is great price correction on this chart, SPS price is still solid when crypto market is in danger.

I shared lots of analysis about SPS price chart and I drew this draft a few months ago. It worked as well. SPS price touched the first target to 0,01 USD. After completing this target, SPS price entered correction and supported by great support line coming from all time low.


There was great downtrend line on SPS price chart. You can see what happened after breaking up this downtrend line. SPS price also completed retest of downtrendline. I worked as support.



![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/Eo6S6U3zkT6hRCLbAaBi11vyrhUGVAFMp3KRbJQm8DYZ3QzoSh8pfatXLqCHSWzA3SQ.PNG)

Here you can see the indicators on daily chart of SPS price. There was great downtrend line on RSI Indicator. It is broken down. MACD Indicator is trying to reverse up after price correction. These indicator show us possible uptrend on SPS price chart.

Even lots of altcoins are at all time low level, SPS price has uptrend line and It is going up slowly.

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/Eo2BRcNR3TdkLn5VGEJ1u8F4JNe7dozkSVFYnckiCEPjsMbzQqc3uJtjfG6xGgW6Dx7.PNG)

So, Even SPS price went down 40% from the top, It is still in bullish trend. We should see the new pattern on SPS price chart.

We will see..

description.title: Un hogar, no una jaula
description.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Un hogar, no una jaula](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/60cd3241-63a0-4646-bbbf-6d5672a95c60.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/ryEhxAZV7w8LKuPXVLX9LV) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Sábado 21 de febrero, 2026.

Al observar a un perro descansando a los pies de su dueño o a un gato que busca caricias en el sofá, es difícil imaginar que esa cercanía no siempre fue la norma. Hace miles de años, la relación entre humanos y animales era puramente utilitaria; los lobos se acercaban a las hogueras buscando sobras y, con el tiempo, aquellos menos temerosos comenzaron a compartir el espacio, dando origen a una alianza basada en la protección mutua y la caza cooperativa. 

No hubo un contrato firmado ni una decisión repentina, sino un lento proceso de domesticación donde la confianza se construyó generación tras generación, transformando al depredador salvaje en el compañero leal que hoy duerme en nuestras camas.

Con el paso de los siglos, especialmente a medida que las sociedades se volvieron más sedentarias y urbanas, el rol de estos animales cambió drásticamente. Dejaron de ser vistos únicamente como herramientas de trabajo o guardianes del ganado para convertirse en miembros emocionales de la familia. En las antiguas civilizaciones ya se veían indicios de este vínculo afectivo, pero fue en la era moderna cuando la mascota adquirió su estatus actual de ser querido por sí mismo, sin necesidad de realizar una tarea específica más que ofrecer compañía. 

Hoy en día, la historia de las mascotas es un reflejo de la propia evolución humana y de su necesidad de conexión. Se ha pasado de alimentar restos a diseñar dietas equilibradas, de dejar que sanen solos a realizar cirugías complejas y tratamientos oncológicos, todo impulsado por el deseo de prolongar esos años juntos. 

Cada especie ha encontrado su nicho; mientras los perros han mantenido esa capacidad única de leer las emociones humanas, los gatos han navegado desde ser venerados como deidades hasta ser compañeros independientes pero afectuosos en apartamentos pequeños. 

Esta trayectoria no es solo sobre cómo hemos cambiado a los animales, sino sobre cómo ellos han moldeado nuestra sociedad, enseñándonos sobre empatía, responsabilidad y el valor silencioso de tener a alguien esperándonos al llegar a casa.

Cuidar de una mascota va mucho más allá de llenar el plato de comida o sacar al perro a hacer sus necesidades; se trata de entender que cada animal es un individuo con necesidades físicas y emocionales únicas que cambian según su edad, raza y personalidad. 

La alimentación es la base, pero no basta con darles cualquier cosa, sino ofrecer una dieta equilibrada que cubra sus requerimientos nutricionales específicos, evitando los excesos que suelen derivar en obesidad, uno de los problemas más comunes que se ven en la consulta diaria. 

La salud preventiva juega un papel crucial en esta ecuación, pues las visitas regulares al veterinario permiten detectar enfermedades silenciosas antes de que se manifiesten con síntomas graves. Las vacunas y los desparasitantes, tanto internos como externos, no son opcionales, ya que protegen no solo a la mascota sino también a toda la familia humana de zoonosis y parásitos peligrosos. 

Sin embargo, el cuidado físico debe ir de la mano con la estimulación mental y el ejercicio adecuado; un animal aburrido o con energía acumulada puede desarrollar conductas destructivas o sufrir de ansiedad por separación. Sacar a pasear a un perro no es solo para que orine, es su momento de explorar el mundo, oler y socializar, mientras que para un gato es fundamental contar con enriquecimiento ambiental, como rascadores y juegos interactivos que imiten la caza, para mantener su mente ágil y su espíritu tranquilo.

La higiene y el aseo también forman parte integral del bienestar, desde el cepillado regular que ayuda a controlar la caída de pelo y fortalece el vínculo afectivo, hasta el cuidado de las uñas, los dientes y los oídos, zonas donde suelen acumularse infecciones si se descuidan. 

Todo esto se sostiene sobre una base de paciencia, amor y respeto, entendiendo que ellos dependen completamente de nosotros y que nuestro compromiso es garantizarles una vida digna, feliz y llena de seguridad hasta el último de sus días.

Tener un animal de compañía en casa transforma el entorno de maneras que a veces pasan desapercibidas hasta que se vive en carne propia. Desde el punto de vista de la salud física, los dueños de perros, por ejemplo, tienden a mantenerse más activos porque sus mascotas exigen paseos diarios, lo que se traduce en mejoras cardiovasculares, reducción del estrés y un sistema inmunológico más fortalecido. 

Pero los beneficios no se quedan solo en lo físico; la presencia de un gato que ronronea en el regazo o un perro que recibe con entusiasmo al llegar a casa activa la liberación de oxitocina y serotonina, hormonas relacionadas con el bienestar y la calma, ayudando a disminuir la ansiedad y los niveles de cortisol en momentos de tensión.

Para las personas que atraviesan soledad o procesos de duelo, una mascota puede convertirse en un pilar emocional silencioso pero poderoso. Ofrecen una compañía incondicional, sin juicios ni expectativas, lo que genera un espacio seguro para quienes luchan contra la depresión o el aislamiento social. En niños, crecer junto a un animal fomenta la empatía, la responsabilidad y el respeto por otras formas de vida, mientras que en adultos mayores, el cuidado de una mascota brinda propósito y rutina, dos elementos fundamentales para mantener la salud cognitiva y emocional. 

Incluso en entornos terapéuticos, la presencia de animales ha demostrado reducir la presión arterial y acelerar la recuperación en pacientes hospitalizados, algo que la ciencia respalda pero que cualquiera que haya sentido el calor de su mascota al lado ya sabía intuitivamente.

Más allá de lo individual, las mascotas también actúan como puentes sociales; sacar a pasear a un perro suele derivar en conversaciones con vecinos o nuevos amigos, rompiendo barreras que a veces parecen insuperables en la vida urbana. 

En el hogar, establecen dinámicas de cooperación y cuidado que fortalecen los lazos familiares. Y aunque implican responsabilidad y esfuerzo, el retorno emocional es desproporcionadamente positivo: una mirada cómplice, una cola que se mueve al escuchar la voz conocida o un ronroneo suave en la noche son pequeños regalos que, sumados día tras día, construyen una calidad de vida más plena. 

Pero existe una línea muy fina, a menudo borrosa por el deseo humano de conectar con lo exótico, entre tener una mascota y mantener cautivo a un animal salvaje, y cruzar esa frontera trae consigo consecuencias que rara vez se dimensionan hasta que es demasiado tarde. 

Cuando alguien decide llevar a casa un felino grande, un primate o un reptil venenoso, suele hacerlo fascinado por su belleza o singularidad, olvidando que esos instintos no se domestican con cariño ni con jaulas lujosas. El riesgo para las personas es inmediato y tangible; un juego que comienza como una muestra de afecto puede terminar en tragedias irreparables cuando el animal alcanza la madurez sexual o simplemente reacciona ante un estímulo natural que su cerebro interpreta como una amenaza o una presa. 

No hay maldad en el animal al atacar, solo está siendo fiel a su naturaleza, pero el daño físico y psicológico para las familias involucradas puede ser devastador, sumado a la enorme dificultad de encontrar soluciones éticas cuando la convivencia se vuelve imposible.

Más allá del peligro directo para el dueño, el impacto en el medio ambiente es quizás aún más silencioso pero igual de destructivo. El comercio ilegal de fauna silvestre es uno de los motores principales de la pérdida de biodiversidad, vaciando bosques y selvas de especies clave para el equilibrio ecológico. 

Cuando estas mascotas son abandonadas o se escapan, a menudo se convierten en especies invasoras que compiten agresivamente con la fauna nativa, depredan poblaciones locales o introducen enfermedades para las cuales los animales autóctonos no tienen defensas. Históricamente, hemos visto cómo la liberación de una sola especie exótica puede colapsar ecosistemas enteros, alterando cadenas alimenticias que tardaron milenios en formarse.

La intención de quien libera al animal suele ser buena, pensando que lo devuelve a la libertad, pero la realidad es que lo condena a una muerte lenta o lo convierte en un agente de destrucción ambiental.

En el fondo, tener un animal salvaje como mascota refleja una desconexión profunda con la verdadera esencia de la conservación. Amar a la naturaleza no significa poseerla ni encerrarla en una sala de estar, sino respetar su lugar y permitir que cumpla su rol en el mundo libre. 

Cada vez que se normaliza la tenencia de fauna silvestre, se envía un mensaje peligroso que prioriza el capricho humano sobre el bienestar animal y la salud del planeta, ignorando que la mejor manera de cuidar de ellos es, precisamente, dejar que sigan siendo salvajes donde pertenecen.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción y reflexión de sábado.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

description.title: [Eng./Esp.]   The Gentle Tyranny of Red.   ||   La Suave Tiranía del Rojo.
description.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

> What a fitting phrase for today because in the English-speaking world, the “velvet curtain” is not just a decorative object, but a powerful metaphor that plays on the duality between what is shown and what is hidden. If the “Iron Curtain” represented a rigid, cold, and political division, the “Velvet Curtain” represents a soft, seductive, and often elitist one.
# ***
The Gentle Tyranny of Red
*** The city breathes beneath a grey drizzle that turns the asphalt into a distorted mirror, but in front of the old theatre's threshold, the world seems to stand still. There are no concrete walls or armed guards to block the way, only a silk rope and that dense, almost organic, crimson velvet curtain guarding the entrance. It is a subtle barrier, a reminder that true exclusivity does not need brute force; the softness of a texture is enough to separate the chosen ones from the yearning ones. Upon crossing it, the noise of traffic magically disappears, and the air thickens with a scent of cedar, ancient dust and vanity, marking the beginning of a realm where reality is suspended and status is measured by proximity to the folds of the fabric.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23tv8exCs5HPgZXaR6p8Bb7JcRhwXT1UV1KSQSbhGPxWpiF5uTMZT7qhEfzEyYUvFBZuV.jpg) [Thanks to the Banana Geminis 3 app for bringing my idea to life in this image.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Once inside, the grand curtain presides over the space with an almost religious elegance. On stage, the lighting creates a perfect setting, a fiction that we all accept as absolute truth for the duration of the performance. However, the real mystery lies not in what is illuminated under the spotlights, but in what lurks just behind that curtain of heavy fabric. On the other side of the velvet, the magic crumbles into chaos of cables, sweat and hurried whispers. It is there, behind the scenes, that the chronicle of everyday life becomes disturbing, almost Lynchian; a dimension where the subconscious seeps through the seams of order and the faces of the actors, stripped of their public masks, reveal a raw vulnerability that the audience must never witness. That curtain, however, does not end at the theatre. It extends invisibly outward, like a cultural heritage that divides civilisations and strata, a border of customs and languages so dense that no political treaty can completely tear it apart. It is the skin of a society that prefers the caress of luxury to the harshness of naked truth. In the end, we are all eternal spectators before our own velvet curtain, the one that separates us from our deepest desires or the shadows we prefer not to name. Its softness seduces us and invites us to touch it, but its weight warns us that what is hidden has a price that only the initiated are willing to pay. When the final applause erupts and the lights go out, the curtain falls, heavy and silent, reminding us that mystery always prefers to sleep among the folds of the exquisite, leaving the rest of the world outside, in the rain, waiting for an invitation that may never come. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:
# **
[PROMPT: «velvet curtain»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/21-february-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3021-velvet-curtain)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/23uRBYxntNDghgQBBSPkJxf47zTS12QnXYpihh1e9rmsu7JqCYG3LHjhcPGYMXrjBKd76.jpg Cover of the initiative.
*** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***
>

> Qué buena frase para el día de hoy, pues, en el mundo angloparlante, la “velvet curtain” no es solo un objeto decorativo, sino una poderosa metáfora que juega con la dualidad entre lo que se muestra y lo que se oculta. Si la “Cortina de Hierro” (Iron Curtain) representaba una división rígida, fría y política, la “Cortina de Terciopelo” representa una división suave, seductora y, a menudo, elitista.
# ***
La Suave Tiranía del Rojo
*** La ciudad respira bajo una llovizna gris que convierte el asfalto en un espejo deforme, pero frente al umbral del viejo teatro, el mundo parece detenerse. No hay muros de hormigón ni guardias armados que impidan el paso, solo una soga de seda y esa densa, casi orgánica, cortina de terciopelo carmesí que custodia la entrada. Es una barrera sutil, un recordatorio de que la verdadera exclusividad no necesita de la fuerza bruta; le basta con la suavidad de una textura para separar a los elegidos de los anhelantes. Al cruzarla, el ruido del tráfico se extingue como por arte de magia y el aire se espesa con un perfume de cedro, polvo antiguo y vanidad, marcando el inicio de un reino donde la realidad se suspende y el estatus se mide por la proximidad a los pliegues de la tela.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wg8o6n4V6eAowSTdftwubvuz9PRvzDzZsrxQ3cjGJbkuTHEEFvapcPtQ2eP4yA89rMi.jpg) [Gracias a la app Banana Geminis 3, por plasmar mi idea en esta imagen.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
Una vez dentro, el gran telón preside el espacio con una elegancia casi religiosa. Sobre el escenario, la luz dibuja una puesta en escena perfecta, una ficción que todos aceptamos como verdad absoluta mientras dure la función. Sin embargo, el verdadero misterio no reside en lo que se ilumina bajo los focos, sino en lo que acecha justo detrás de esa frontera de fibras pesadas. En el envés del terciopelo, la magia se desmorona en un caos de cables, sudor y susurros apresurados. Es allí, en las bambalinas, donde la cronica de lo cotidiano se vuelve inquietante, casi lynchiana; una dimensión donde el subconsciente se filtra por las costuras del orden y los rostros de los actores, despojados de su máscara pública, revelan una vulnerabilidad cruda que el espectador jamás debe presenciar. Esa cortina, sin embargo, no termina en el teatro. Se extiende invisible hacia afuera, como una herencia cultural que divide civilizaciones y estratos, una frontera de costumbres y lenguajes tan densa que ningún tratado político logra rasgar del todo. Es la piel de una sociedad que prefiere la caricia del lujo a la aspereza de la verdad desnuda. Al final, todos somos eternos espectadores ante nuestra propia cortina de terciopelo, esa que nos separa de nuestros deseos más profundos o de las sombras que preferimos no nombrar. La suavidad nos seduce y nos invita a tocarla, pero su peso nos advierte que lo que está oculto tiene un precio que solo los iniciados están dispuestos a pagar. Cuando el aplauso final estalla y las luces se apagan, la cortina cae, pesada y silenciosa, recordándonos que el misterio siempre prefiere dormir entre los pliegues de lo exquisito, dejando al resto del mundo fuera, bajo la lluvia, esperando una invitación que quizá nunca llegue.
*** ***

> Ven y participa; aún estás a tiempo. Toda la información la podrás encontrar cada día en la Comunidad [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created). Específicamente, el día de hoy, aquí la publicación del prompt:

*** ***

Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, con su arte, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/AK3dh9o6Y7gX8bHX31JkbGQRrjvqVsRLqpAELN5YuAWeKo71zo5YipMbw9wt3zm.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif

Hello everyone, my name is @tehilah . Am happy to be here and express myself and build my vocabulary through writing. I hope I get to meet loads of awesome people here. Thank you for having me.



She was hiv positive (Human immunodeficiency virus) before she meet her husband, but never told him even when they got married. 

![1000329199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tehilah/AJpiV71xyM5y8R48R5fgJWgGLWWdjzh33NsXs7HiYuCirEcU5z9bZ7v12SJUn4x.jpg)

She usually goes to the hospital to refill her anti retroviral medication, very faithful to each dose which has made the virus suppressed (not transmittable) to her husband or her child, with certain precautions of course. 

He found out she was positive through her jealous friend, him scared for himself and their unborn baby made him build up with rage.

Tears filled his eyes as he wished it was just a dream, she came in excited to tell him about her day.. but the gaze from him upon her was a death scare.

He confronted her with the thought of divorce running through his mind. she cried, pleading for forgiveness screaming at the top of her lungs \

.

description.title: Let's Cook Efere Abak
description.body:
![7b9179d257e0f0005ca5c71ab7070b1f9e30c7ce.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/torisha/Eou9c9PvjQwhP6ze3dMtQYK1rh7TiSuHosZnkxmFFn3gsxcf98sLqWVkJtjKB4zSCpp.jpg)



Efere Abak is one of the meals loved by the people of Akwa Ibom. It is prepared using palm fruit with other protein ingredients.

The meal is simple, nutritious and delicious to enjoy.

     Ingredients 
Palm fruit

Beef

Periwinkle

Dry fish

Cowskin

Pepper

Maggie

Salt

Uyayak

Onion

Atama leaf

    Preparation method 
Wash the palm fruit and boil. When it is soft, drain out the water. Using a mortar and pestle, pound it to have a smooth mixture.

Take it out and put it in a bowl, and use warm water to squeeze out the oil.

Take out a little squeeze of water, used and cooked stock with sliced onions, pepper, salt and Maggie.

Turn in the stock inside the squeeze water and start cooking the meal properly. Cook the meal until it becomes thick.

Check the meal if the ingredients have taken their respective places and then add crayfish and Uyayak to cook.

Add the Atama leaf, stir and bring down the pot. The Efere Abak is ready to be consumed.

Depending on individual choice, this meal can be enjoyed with boiled white rice or swallow such as fufu, amala, garri, semovita, or wheat.
