description.title: 🇲🇽𝙴𝚕 𝙻𝚊𝚋𝚎𝚛𝚒𝚗𝚝𝚘 𝚍𝚎 𝚕𝚊 𝚂𝚘𝚕𝚎𝚍𝚊𝚍|𝚁𝙴𝚂𝙴Ñ𝙰 (𝙴𝚂𝙿-𝙴𝙽𝙶)
description.body: <div class\
>\n\n><sub>\

. > >El laberinto de la soledad, Octavio Paz. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYznbuHMVyDKq3mNk7dfRo5U9ZrucCMD6sYBUD5u228nA/1771638622158.jpg)
***

habla de la caída de un hombre en el abismo de su propio ser y su difícil, su casi imposible, retorno a la luz del mundo. ¿Qué es un mexicano?, se pregunta el poeta que esto escribió, y que responde al nombre de Octavio Paz. Mas para responder a tal pregunta, Paz no convoca a las musas, sino que desciende por sí mismo a la morada de los muertos, la morada de la Historia. Ve, en su descender, las antiguas pirámides de piedra volcánica, donde aún parece latir el corazón de los sacrificados al Sol. Ve la majestad de los dioses antiguos, Quetzalcóatl, la serpiente de plumas, y Tezcatlipoca, el espejo humeante. Ve luego, como una ola que todo lo inunda, la llegada de otros hombres desde el mar, hombres de hierro y cruz, hombres de otra palabra y otro dios, que rompieron aquel mundo de obsidiana y maíz como Aquiles rompió con su lanza las apretadas filas troyanas. De aquel encuentro violento, de aquella herida que no cierra con el paso de los siglos, nació un pueblo nuevo y desgarrado. Nació, como dice el poeta, el hijo de la Malinche, el huérfano de padre, el que lleva en su sangre la espada del vencedor y el llanto silencioso del vencido. Y de aquella herida, oh mortales, nació su máscara. Pues este hombre del que canta Paz es un ser de apariencias y silencios. Es un hombre que se cubre el rostro con una sonrisa cuando debiera mostrar la ira, que guarda silencio cuando las palabras le quemarían la lengua. Habla poco y cuando habla, dice menos. Anda entre los suyos como un extranjero, y solo en la soledad deja caer las vestiduras que lo cubren. Solo en la fiesta, en ese estallido de colores y pólvora que nada tiene que envidiar a las dionisíacas, se desnuda su alma y muestra por un instante su verdadero ser. Solo ante la muerte, que en esta tierra no es el final oscuro y temible sino una vieja amiga con la que se juega y se baila, el mexicano se ríe de su propia sombra. Porque la muerte, en este libro, es un motivo donde la vida se mira y descubre su vacío o su plenitud. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSd7XXxWNRUCYroeFAXB9NxJYazYokVb2FpxuGdCu16a/1771638622268.jpg)
***
>\n\nCanta también Octavio Paz el poder del \
y el enigma profundo de la \

, palabras que encierran en su vulgaridad todo el misterio de un pueblo que se sabe nacido de la violencia y la entrega, de la violación y el abandono. 

Nos lleva por calles de nombres extraños y polvorientos, por plazas donde el tiempo palidece, por altares donde el maíz se vuelve ofrenda y la calavera de azúcar se come con dulzura entre los vivos. 

Y en todo ello descubre al hombre solo, al hombre que, entre las olas embravecidas, navega entre la multitud sin ser visto, oculto tras la máscara que él mismo se ha tejido para protegerse de la mirada ajena.

Mas no es este un canto de tristeza y lamento, en \

Octavio Paz canta la soledad del mexicano para que, conociéndola en toda su hondura, pueda romper los muros de su propio laberinto. Porque el laberinto, oh amigos y lectores de mi post no fue construido para que en él se viva eternamente, sino para que, tras el esfuerzo y la búsqueda, se encuentre la salida hacia la luz. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVq38Zdj17fenaJ3z2uFfCaNXmY3MGctUFvSm2GrsKyYk/1771638622348.jpg)
***

> Así termino mi reseña sobre este extraño y profundo libro, que sin hablar de dioses ni de héroes, sin narrar batallas ni naufragios, habla de lo divino y lo heroico que anida en el corazón de los hombres cuando estos tienen el valor de mirarse a sí mismos sin las máscaras que los cubren. El viaje más largo, el más peligroso, no es el que se hace sobre las olas del ponto desde Troya hasta Ítaca, sino el que se emprende desde los ojos hacia adentro, hacia ese reino oscuro y silencioso donde habita, desnuda y temblorosa, nuestra verdad. ![separator](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/1752848220077.png)

> Ⓜ️ Contenido Original en español y traducción al inglés en Google Translation. ![marabuzal](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCBMLrCe1r8x98QE2vRuUp6seGUjji2vAArciyFkjC8N/1768407559541.jpg) ![ingles](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg) 🇲🇽𝚃𝚑𝚎 𝙻𝚊𝚋𝚢𝚛𝚒𝚗𝚝𝚑 𝚘𝚏 𝚂𝚘𝚕𝚒𝚝𝚞𝚍𝚎|𝚁𝙴𝚅𝙸𝙴𝚆 (𝙴𝚂𝙿-𝙴𝙽𝙶)
>\n\n><sub>\

>The Labyrinth of Solitude, Octavio Paz. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYznbuHMVyDKq3mNk7dfRo5U9ZrucCMD6sYBUD5u228nA/1771638622158.jpg)
***
speaks of a man's fall into the abyss of his own being and his difficult, almost impossible, return to the light of the world.\n\n\

asks the poet who wrote this, whose name is Octavio Paz. But to answer this question, Paz does not summon the muses, but rather descends himself into the abode of the dead, the abode of History. In his descent, he sees the ancient pyramids of volcanic stone, where the hearts of those sacrificed to the Sun still seem to beat. He sees the majesty of the ancient gods, Quetzalcoatl, the feathered serpent, and Tezcatlipoca, the smoking mirror. Then, like an all-encompassing wave, came other men from the sea, men of iron and cross, men of a different word and a different god, who shattered that world of obsidian and corn as Achilles broke through the tight Trojan ranks with his spear. From that violent encounter, from that wound that does not heal with the passage of centuries, a new and torn people was born. Born, as the poet says, was the son of La Malinche, the fatherless one, the one who carries in his blood the sword of the victor and the silent weeping of the vanquished. And from that wound, oh mortals, his mask was born. For this man of whom Paz sings is a being of appearances and silences. He is a man who covers his face with a smile when he should show anger, who remains silent when words would burn his tongue. He speaks little, and when he does, he says even less. He walks among his own people like a stranger, and only in solitude does he shed the garments that cover him. Only at the festival, in that explosion of colors and gunpowder that rivals the Dionysian revels, does his soul bare and reveal, for an instant, his true self. Only before death, which in this land is not a dark and fearsome end but an old friend with whom one plays and dances, does the Mexican laugh at his own shadow. Because death, in this book, is a motif upon which life reflects and discovers its emptiness or its fullness. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSd7XXxWNRUCYroeFAXB9NxJYazYokVb2FpxuGdCu16a/1771638622268.jpg)
***
>\n\nOctavio Paz also sings of the power of the \
and the profound enigma of \

words that, in their vulgarity, encapsulate all the mystery of a people who know themselves to be born of violence and surrender, of rape and abandonment.

He takes us through streets with strange, dusty names, through plazas where time pales, past altars where corn becomes an offering and sugar skulls are eaten sweetly among the living.


 And in all of this, he discovers the solitary man, the man who, amidst the raging waves, navigates the crowd unseen, hidden behind the mask he himself has woven to protect himself from the gaze of others.

But this is not a song of sadness and lament. In \

Octavio Paz sings of the Mexican's solitude so that, by understanding it in all its depth, he may break down the walls of his own labyrinth. For the labyrinth, oh friends and readers of my post, was not built for one to live in eternally, but so that, after effort and searching, one may find the way out to the light. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVq38Zdj17fenaJ3z2uFfCaNXmY3MGctUFvSm2GrsKyYk/1771638622348.jpg)
***

> Thus ends my review of this strange and profound book, which, without speaking of gods or heroes, without narrating battles or shipwrecks, speaks of the divine and the heroic that dwells in the hearts of men when they have the courage to look at themselves without the masks that cover them. The longest, most dangerous journey is not the one made across the waves of the sea from Troy to Ithaca, but the one undertaken from the eyes inward, toward that dark and silent realm where our truth dwells, naked and trembling. The longest, most dangerous journey is not the one made across the waves of the sea from Troy to Ithaca, but the one undertaken from the eyes inward, toward that dark and silent realm where our truth resides, naked and trembling. ![separator](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/1752848220077.png)

description.title: Clean ears free of parasites 👂
description.body:
Hello friends, happy Caturday. Last week I told you about my first bubble bath, but before that, my mom cleaned my ears thoroughly, a few days after I arrived at her house. She was very surprised to see how dirty my ears were inside. She researched and read about it on the internet on her cell phone, which I sometimes bite because she won't let go of it. 

* * *

<center>![1001477123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/243qTtnjYgxdjwhb4sJEbLtR1zL9vdaUugwU1oDpotVoVofSzKWeoDeZFmXYhNi7GdoJ1.jpg)</center>

* * *

She discovered that it was dangerous to clean them at home and that it was better to take the cat to the vet. However, since she had everything she needed and couldn't wait any longer, she decided to do it herself, using cotton swabs and special drops for cats and dogs that she had from my canine brother, because he sometimes has ear problems. 

* * *

<center>![20260128_164931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AKLtSMcQudnwhDCmWzFiFye96GnzAE3qfBPE6YSrVHagoZGNo2jBV6nQE7Ns4dr.jpg)</center>

<center>![20260128_164952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AKcfK9qLdg2ano8KWnc1VMtewJrDyiPHVN4gDkEM4einXGAg14Jx3Sfyow72vTH.jpg)</center>

* * *

So she moistened the swabs and carefully passed them to me, without letting any dirt or liquid fall into the ear canal. Anyway, that liquid is supposed to be antibiotics and anti-inflammatories, but with all that dirt in there, it's not good to have it inside. My mom read that they were parasites. I definitely arrived at her house very small and full of nasty little creatures. 

* * *

<div class=\

> ![InShot_20260211_101741090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AK576cmiKU85mv5XdjoiUzzp2qYg7HRS5FwHNGYPt6rrNQwqZVVCo2j7Xrqa9NE.jpg) ![InShot_20260211_101543976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AK56ryjtGWP3nYJZLgerW1To7gKyGxPZGMc9fNLW3XiUrLh4XWvoniMwqG4nnwH.jpg)

> ![InShot_20260211_101448848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AJpkWajVK7mM2Pn2DjSrL5QDqT8sjeJuKhWTtTRvY6EWUBhzaxMpMW6BJzdLELh.jpg) ![20260128_165009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AJkS7jqAP8gLjsmaC5p7NoFgDu8NqRginpSZw4LRjbXFk6LmjjcTkw6sup1Km16.jpg) * * * Even though I bit her a lot, my mom is strong and says I bite like a girl 🤨 After that, I can hear the birds singing better, and in the future, I know I'll eat them 😂. My mom doesn't want to see that, but she knows that's the way nature is. One thing I heard was that she said I'm a male, and since I have three colors, I'm probably sterile and won't be leaving children scattered everywhere. A friend of hers recommended that she leave my balls (testicles) alone, but she says I'll abandon her when I grow up and she doesn't want to suffer like she did with her other children. I swore to her that I would never leave her, but well, you never know when love will come along, desires come together. 🤣. Mommy, I love you right now, so enjoy me while I'm a baby. * * *
![20260128_164925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AKSdfRVJuMN6dxosWj5JMAJAYuVPKGDPpRb8rTk2kcgoxNoUTfJj6Wigzc9HT9a.jpg)
![20260128_164940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/AKe6bstgsXdTx2ox8E5nUhBjKLS1QyLQgNXGygMyirQDFnVPu7xCpt2sErArbVn.jpg)

links.body: <div class=\

> 

Hello guys, welcome to this wonderful and awesome week, and welcome to hive reachout weekly activities. I have been absent for a while now because of some school troubles, but I am back now and I am very happy and pleased to be here with you all. This is another great week and I hope you all are happy to have me here today.

For this week, ee have been asked to talk about, the Absence of fear. This topic is really amazing and it has a lot in it, but will just be showing and telling you guys what I think and what I have experienced, starting from the fact that the word \
has a lot of meanings, it also being being afraid, so I am going to be using the phrase \
instead of \

because it goes will with the sentence more than Fear. ![17716833515207317524566867818776.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesseash/AKSdzR1ZYiDHKiKJtBpked2hMJLC2qxcRNiBCrcjB1TzRLBPGzmKDAKEhKyXUBv.png) [Src](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/man-silhouette-thoughtful-fear-8287181/) Being afraid is something that can help you and can also make you loose opportunities, respect, and many other things, it can get you into trouble and save you from trouble, it is just based on the way you use it. As of today, I will be telling you guys about my own experience on this weeks topic, so I would love you all to follow me. Let me tell you all how I lost an opportunity because I was scared and afraid. I am a type of person that is shy most of the time, so when I have the opportunity to do something or say something, I find it difficult and hard to do. It was on school here, on a faithful day I went to attend lectures and that day during the lecture I was feeling a bit tired so I went out to get something to eat so I can regain myself well, when I came back, I saw that they were writing a quiz already, and that quiz was 10 marks, I wanted to enter back into the class but they lecturer sent me out thinking I was just coming to class. As I shy and reserved person that I was, I found it hard to explain to him that I just went out not long ago to get something to eat because of the way I was feeling, and he ended up chasing me out of the class and I lost that 10 marks because of I was afraid and shy. It is actually the way I am till date, but I try my best to speak up a bit now, and I can also say that it saves you from many things too, being afraid or being shy can also save, I am a testimony of it, but I will not be sharing it with you guys today, this is all what I will be sharing with you guys today. Thanks for stopping by my blog, I hope you are happy to see me here again, and I would love to see you all again next week. Bye.

links.title: Pokemon Japan's Ninja Spinner Set Reveal
links.body: Pokemon Japan's next set is named Ninja Spinner. The featured Pokemon in this set is Mega Greninja ex. The release date is on March 13, 2026. There were leaks about Mega Greninja ex that appeared on Reddit. I could've made an earlier post on it but I was not sure if it was real (even though it looked real.)
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source   ## Chespin & Quilladin --- | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/02/005-m4rg68y.png | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/02/006-m4h4gza.png | ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEXVeY8t85m5Qb4YqxkGWgDjLUjXyKHbGCSnJpTv6La7/chespinquilladin.png) Chespin and Quilladin as attackers are not great. You do need them for Chestnaught.   ## Chesnuaght ---
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeK8hGcmHoQLEY1HaP8nbxLe1nf5YrXvP5V5z9BYarzDB/chestnaught.png) Here is Chesnaught. The Impound attack requires too much energy for the cost. You deal 160 damage and the Defending Pokemon cannot retreat. In theory, you can trap a non attacking Pokemon and then eventually knock it out. The Needle Armor ability is a counterattack type of ability. If Chesnaught is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from the opponent's Pokemon then you place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokemon for each Grass Energy attached to this Chesnaught. One combo idea is this and Meganium. Meganium doubles the amount of Grass Energy in play. A lot of combo pieces needed to get this setup going though. As Chestnaught is a Grass type, you can use Forest of Vitality for fast evolution provided you have the evolution line. | | | |---|---| | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a5/MeganiumMegaEvolution10.jpg/180px-MeganiumMegaEvolution10.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/21/ForestofVitalityMegaEvolution117.jpg/180px-ForestofVitalityMegaEvolution117.jpg |   ## Fennekin & Braixen --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7GjrKvwaZQ67q9hqiQ875DHxmo3NhB59ygGU3rwjJu6/fennekinbraixen.png) Fennekin and Braixen as attackers are not great. The Fennekin's Call for Family attack is really good in the early game. For any 1 Energy, you can search your deck for 2 Basic Pokemon and put them onto your Bench (then shuffle afterwards). It is rare to have a Call For Family attack and it is also rare for the Call for Family attack to place 2 Basic Pokemon from deck to Bench.   ## Delphox --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNp7pJwCQqqbiNKJx2d87maMHBfwWUeinxZpVtabsRTHz/delphox.png) Delphox is the final evolution of Fennekin. The Energy Storm attack requires 2 Fire Energy to deal 30 damage for each Energy attached to all Pokemon in play. The minimum damage you do from this is 60 from the Delphox attack alone. Opponent decks that use a lot of Energy boost the firepower of Delphox. Yeah you can deal something like 300 damage but that would require 10 energy in play. Is it realistic/common? Not likely. The Flare Magic ability on Delphox is a draw power ability. Once during your turn, you may discard a Fire Energy from your hand in order to draw cards until 7 in hand. You can go from a low hand size into 7 cards. One combination I had in mind when I saw this was this Delphox and Blaziken ex. Would this be good? Maybe. There are a lot of combo pieces in order to get this setup going.
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source   ## Froakie, Frogadier --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCm757Mgy3TPx4BXYPsrZQox19EeBZSuZExU1A9ADoW7/froakiefrogadier.png) Froakie and Frogadier are not great attackers but the Collect attack can be useful in the early game where you draw 1 card. Frogadier's Calling Jutsu is good for searching Pokemon from the deck and into your hand. Watch out for hand disruption like Judge. | | | |---|---| | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/8/8b/JudgeDestinedRivals167.jpg/200px-JudgeDestinedRivals167.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/6/67/XerosicMachinationsShroudedFable64.jpg/180px-XerosicMachinationsShroudedFable64.jpg |   ## Mega Greninja ex ---
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbR16WRegka4MAJABNR751LvLy1yXpeejxy8MuPSrqvq/megagreninja_ex.png) Here is Mega Greninja ex, the final evolution of Froakie. The Ninja Spinner attack requires 2 Water Energy to deal 120 base damage. You may put 1 Water Energy attached to this Mega Greninja ex into your hand yo deal 80 more damage (total of 200 damage). In terms of pure firepower, this attack is not awful but not crazy amazing. The Mortal Shuriken ability is interesting. You can use this ability once during your turn if Mega Greninja ex is in the Active Spot. You may discard 1 Basic Water Energy card from your hand in order to place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. It is possible to knockout weak Pokemon like Budew or Pokemon with 60 HP or less with this ability. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/b/bf/BudewPrismaticEvolutions4.jpg/180px-BudewPrismaticEvolutions4.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/4/4f/DuskullShroudedFable18.jpg/200px-DuskullShroudedFable18.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a5/BattleColosseumInfernoX79.jpg/180px-BattleColosseumInfernoX79.jpg |   If there is a Battle Cage stadium in play, then you would have to place damage counters on the Active Pokemon instead of a Benched Pokemon from the ability. Battle Cage prevents damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokemon by the effects of attacks or abilities from the opponent's Pokemon.   ## Big Catch Net --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsG8CjqppquscFR3FcD1kZAxUejhZnfaFFSzDYYQYxF3/bigcatchnet.png) Big Catch Net is a powerful recovery Item card for Water Pokemon. With Super Rod out of the standard play around April 2026, the only recovery cards are Night Stretcher, Sacred Ash and Energy Recylcer. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a2/NightStretcherShroudedFable61.jpg/180px-NightStretcherShroudedFable61.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a8/SacredAshDestinedRivals168.jpg/200px-SacredAshDestinedRivals168.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/2f/EnergyRecyclerDestinedRivals164.jpg/200px-EnergyRecyclerDestinedRivals164.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/0/08/SuperRodPaldeaEvolved188.jpg/200px-SuperRodPaldeaEvolved188.jpg |   With Big Catch Net, you shuffle up to 3 Water Pokemon and up to 3 Basic Water Energy from your discard pile into your deck. It is like a better Super Rod and a mixture of Sacred Ash and Energy Recycler. This item card alone provides a good boost for Water decks.   ## AZ's Tranquility --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPoznser6hFudkQ3YgboEdGRfjGAZTUWaYfpDkg5rXPEY/aztranqulility.png) AZ's Tranquility combines a Switch and healing in a Supporter card. The Pokemon that is moved to the Bench gets 80 damage healed in this way. I can see a few decks trying out 1 copy of this card. In theory, you use this card to switch out a damaged Mega Pokemon to the bench and heal 80 damage from it. There are other better and more useful Supporters like Boss's Orders and the new staple card Lillie's Determination than this though. | | | |---|---| | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/4/42/BossOrdersAscendedHeroes183.jpg/200px-BossOrdersAscendedHeroes183.jpg | https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/f/fd/LillieDeterminationMegaEvolution119.jpg/180px-LillieDeterminationMegaEvolution119.jpg |   ## Bubble Water Energy --- Bubble Water Energy is a special Energy card for Water Pokemon. You can attach this to any Pokemon and this card provides 1 Water Energy. If this Bubble Water Energy is attached to a Water Pokemon then that Water Pokemon recovers from Special Conditions such as Poison, Asleep, Paralysis and Confusion. In addition, the Water Pokemon with this card cannot be affected by Special Conditions. Special Conditions don't appear too much in the TCG but some of them are annoying to deal with. Having the option to heal Special Conditions on your Water Pokemon is helpful so you can keep attacking.   ## Closing Notes --- From the reveals so far, we have the Kalos starter Pokemon and their evolutions. Mega Greninja ex as a stand alone card looks decent. It is uncertain what decks around Mega Greninja ex look like. Maybe a secondary attacker is Mega Froslass ex. Not sure.
/></center>\n<center><a href=\

>Image Source I do think there are more surprises coming from the set such as new Mega Pokemon ex and new Trainer cards. Let's see.  
Thank you for reading.

links.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTsjan7eHDFQa9DwJRBHmYpQvtxscLYkFMXJSKharfryy/0thumbnailtemp_collage_hive.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjCanf7Boyn3dVnCYew1wJWKQ2JGy9eQd3WMDPZiaWLk/img20251011062556.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTKD8vFwPsxZaqMBWT3Gi4FvS1PiakescXpSm8EmnC6bu/img20251009085651.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyqQWAJ7vDaiiUGBfhVwqLFFMQbiSnNSu8qzoFibGhnK/img20251009092112.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJokNtzC6Dumbr1rZArGrS6AzRCh88AVeYDE85b4YLyW/img20251009102330.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvVqvBfMTVLuxayjavYzgR64cjVwSTuvixhvPAPGh2G3/img20251009105757.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaoCRQ5eeY2eHLXkvGSsRBbXpRFp9CAuXctx7AyGxysAg/img20251009130522.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRkfGrGEEbwJyvFap5UT8tguzjiGtj1TrYXBJWV2ns2r/img20251009152440.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ6qrf1RWeiWpSu5TStGbbJd3fcCDeWRE9a3U2EkzTUDS/img20251010083517.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanivpxj5RLL4MPZryoYhAiApB5wymAvTC3YsFkfZcaGH/img20251010210049.jpg) I've brought you some black and white photos from my heart, which I call Solang Valley. I lived here for a few years, and there's hardly a place I haven't seen. I explore every corner of this valley, and that too on foot. Situated at an altitude of 2450 meters, this valley is considered an adventure valley. Tourists come here every year to participate in a variety of activities, including hiking, mountaineering, ziplining, river crossing, zorbing, paragliding, and skiing. My only interest lies in trekking, so today's photos are from my trek from Kothi Village to Kothi Top. During the trek, I saw spectacular views of Hanuman Tibba, Shitidhar, Mukhar Bah, Ladakhi Peak, Friendship Peak, and Patalsu Peak. On this trek, we completed our task by walking through the snow that had fallen two days earlier. Walking on the snow was extremely difficult, as the snow had already wet our boots and pants, making it extremely cold. The coldness only got worse when dark clouds gathered in the sky and a strong, cold wind began to blow. Anyway, it was a lot of fun. **Hindi Version** कुछ ब्लैक एंड वाइट फ़ोटोज़ आपके लिए लेकर आया हूँ अपने दिल से जिसे मैं सोलंग घाटी कहता हूं. मैं यहाँ रहता भी था कुछ साल, यहाँ मुश्किल ही कोई जगह होगी जो मैंने नही देखी. इस घाटी के कौने-कौने में घूमकर देखता है वो भी पैदल. २४५० मीटर पर मौजूद इस घाटी को एडवेंचर घाटी होने का दर्ज़ा प्राप्त है. यहाँ हर साल सैलानी बहुत सारी एक्टिविटीज में भाग लेने आते हैं. यहाँ हिकिंग, mountaineering, ज़िपलाइन, रिवर क्रासिंग, ज़ोब्रिंग, पैराग्लाइडिंग और स्की होती है. मेरा इंटरेस्ट सिर्फ ट्रैकिंग में होता है, आज के फ़ोटोज़ कोठी गाँव से कोठी टॉप ट्रैकिंग करते हुए समय के हैं. ट्रेक के दौरान मैंने हनुमान टिब्बा, शितिधार, मुखर बह, लदाखी पीक, फ्रेंडशिप पीक और पतालसू पीक के शानदार नजारे देखे. इस ट्रेक पर हमने २ दिन पहले गिरी बर्फ पर चलकर अपने टास्क को पूरा किया, बहुत मुश्किल था बर्फ पर चलना क्योंकि बर्फ ने हमारे जूते और पेंट पहले ही गीली कर दी थी जिसकी वजह से ज्यादा ठण्ड लग रही थी, हमें और ठण्ड तब लगने लगी जब आकाश में काले बादल आ गए और तेज़ ठंडी हवा चलने लगी. खैर मजा तो बहुत आया. links.title: How I made this bubu Kimono
links.body: Hello everyone, I welcome you to my blog again, I hope you find this resourceful. The fabrics I worked with was African Print (Ankara) 2 yards and crepe plain material, black to be precise of 1 trouser (45 inches per 60 inches), you can work with Aso -Oke or denim material depending on what the customer wants. This crepe will be at the tip of the ankara fabric, the sleeve, the neck, and the down part, I folded into 4 inches in a way that I wouldn't need to join the shoulder again. The front and the back I cut it together.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> I deducted the 5 inches I will be using from the actual length, that is the person's top length is 36 I will minus 5 inches making 32 and the sleeve is 18, I will minus 5 making 13, but I added extra allowance because it is a bubu and I have to use the same measurements down and the biggest circumference is the hip, her hip is 4, I divided by 4 which is 10.25, so I made it 10 and 1/2 inch,I added extra 5 inches for the freeness now making 16 inches.
alt=\
>\n\n
alt=\

> After cutting the sides, I chalked out the neck, the neck depth I used for the front was 8 inches while the back 1 inch because I am not joining the shoulder, then I used the wideness as 3 inches for both, I made the front to be in a form of V shape, then I cut it, and I slit it open. I cut all the crepe I will be needing which is 10 inches when folded into 2 becomes 5 inches. I pinned it down to secure this material and prevent it from sliding I sew it by half of an inch, this was how I did it for all the down, sides and neck region, the width of the neck is 5 inches when folded becomes 2 and 1/2 inches, it won't be wide like the others and really long,I used iron to press it , then I fixed it.
alt=\
>\n\n

> I made sure I was done with fixing the crepe, before I cut the pocket, the pocket is 11 inches in length and 9 inches in width, I measured from shoulder to 17 inches which is waist and where I will be placing the pocket, I made sure it is in the middle of the Ankara fabric, 4 inches apart. To join the sides like the bubu I measured from shoulder to 11 inches that was where I stitched it down. Note that I didn't stitch to the 5 inches. When I put it on the mannequin

links.title: Exploring the Hidden Mushroom World of Trodena Natural Park, Italy
links.body:
Nature often hides its most fascinating details right under our feet, and the forests of Trodena Natural Park in northern Italy are a perfect example. While many travelers visit for the alpine views, few truly explore the quiet, shadowed corners where mushrooms and fungi thrive in a world of color, texture, and silent complexity.

During my photographic exploration of Trodena, I captured a wide range of fungi—from rare alpine species to vibrant forest mushrooms.Each photography has its own theme, style, and emotional tone, making the collection diverse, rich, and ready for organic discovery.

Below is a structured breakdown of each photography, along with a brief description of its purpose and aesthetic direction.

Unique Nature Photography from Trodena

A foundational set capturing rare mushrooms in their natural forest environment. Natural tones, crisp details, and a balanced composition style perfect for nature enthusiasts....

body.title: Spa Vrujci
body.body:
Today I will take you to visit another beautiful place in Serbia. It is Banja Vrujci.
I have already told you that my job allows me nice trips and teaching in nature. So I was with my students in this beautiful spa.
Spa Vrujci is located about 90 km from Belgrade. It belongs to the municipality of Mionica, and Mionica is in the municipality of Valjevo, one of the most beautiful cities in Serbia for me. I lived and worked in Valjevo for 5 years.
Let's go back to the Vrujci spa. We were accommodated in the \

hotel, which is located in the center of the spa. Next to the hotel flows the river Gornja Toplica. The spa is very famous for its healing mud and natural hot water pools, and mostly cures bone and joint diseases.

![13221713_1210730228975708_1911039551745704618_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goga14/243zffHUEs5DNDGkMhpfWZzK2VRjc2avd4WCce5bKUEJeKV1BNAS7mSL3Kh1362p71hAB.jpg)

Teaching in nature is designed so that children are active all day. After breakfast, different activities are organized, swimming, tennis, football or playing in the park. In the afternoon we have classes lasting 2 school hours and in the afternoon again different activities. In the evening, there are themed evenings: quizzes, masquerade ball, schiz-frieze, show what you know...

One day a trip to Brankovina was organized. It is a famous village near Valjevo where the famous: Mateja, Ljuba, Aleksa and Jakov, who are known heroes of the 1st Serbian Uprising, were born. Besides them, the most famous Serbian poetess was born in Brankovina, and she was buried there. This is Desanka Maksimović. The whole complex around the \

school, where I worked for almost 2 years, is literally a big park. There is also a Russian church built by Desanka Maksimović's husband, who was originally from Russia. The characteristic of that church is that its walls and ceiling are not painted like in Serbian churches, i.e. they don't have a single fresco on the wall.

body.title: Flawed       …Part 6        …Impulsive Decision
body.body:
*Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself. ―Leo Tolstoy*


![Brown Dog.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd2nqPYxTZPMMJTZnub1Mw7Gi4EjgPTJBb2rYr2Vsd1q9/Brown%20Dog.png)
*Rainy Night Cafe*


I'm beginning to have doubts about the use of recalling my past. It's over and will always be over―there's nothing I can do about it other than regret it. This whole business about gaining insight from it is probably just a dead end. Maybe instead of trying to correct my memories of the past my time might be better spent changing my behaviour in the present. Sure, I blue-pencilled out a lot of bad memories, but it didn't make it better―just eased my conscience until they percolated up to the surface and confronted me as night terrors. It's always bugged me when people talk about spooky houses, but places aren't haunted, people are and even the dead still oppress us through our memories.

I suppose I'm obsessing about Sofia and the way someone from the past can come back to haunt me. tonight is a perfect setting―sitting by the fire while outside it's dark and raining. It's just the right mood and atmosphere to conjure up her memory. Just saying her name inside my head turns on a movie reel of images. I picture her quaint Art Deco apartment building on a tree-lined street near the university. I knew cheating on Emma was wrong but it all seemed so damn romantic and it blurred all the warning signs the same way this rain tonight hides me from the rest of the world.

But those warning signs were all there, right down to the street number of her building. I mean, 1313 Odd Place―hell, the universe was sending me a cosmic SOS, if I even cared to look, which I didn't. Sofia knew about Emma and I didn't hide the truth from her. She didn't care―even suggested I could marry Em and she'd be content to be my mistress. When I balked she blackmailed me into submission―threatened to tell Em if I didn't stay with her until the end of semester. What was her game plan―that I'd fall in love and not want to leave her? But whatever it was, it didn't work. My guilty conscience made me reveal the truth to Em. I didn't hate Sofia―I actually felt sorry for her. I felt bad I caused her pain although in truth, we both were to blame for continuing.

So now here I am, in my mid-thirties and still unmarried. As for these mind journeys I've been on, all they've done is show how much baggage I'm carting around in my subconscious. And Nat has to get drunk and and tell Sofia enough information about me that it won't be hard for her to find me. Ordinarily, that wouldn't worry me, but the truth is, seeing her again showed me I'm still not strong enough to resist her. That's why sitting by the fire on a rainy evening can be like a film noir playing inside me.

My cell vibrates in my pocket and I pick up to Zach's familiar voice on the other end. \

he yipped on the other end.

As I drove to the coffee shop I wondered what Zach had in mind. We used to meet for coffee once or twice a week but that tapered off when he got married. I hoped there were no problems between him and Mitzy. We got a window seat and ordered apple fritters to go with our coffee. It was pleasant chatting with Zach in the cozy coffee shop with black rain trails marring the windows making me appreciate how good it was to be inside. \
Zach informed me, between bites of his warm apple fritter. \
I was taken completely off-guard. I hadn't expected Zach to present me with a job offer. \
I hedged.\n\nZach's mouth was full of fritter, but he waved off my doubt and held up his hand so I'd wait while he took a gulp of his coffee. \
I was shocked again. Zach was serious. This was all happening so fast. \

I laughed, figuring he was being facetious, but saw the sober look on his face and realized he was dead serious.

\
I smiled, munching on my apple fritter. \

Within an hour I was back before the fire in my living room wondering what the hell I just signed up for on the spur of the moment. It was unlike me to be impetuous, but my life needed a change and this position would serve the purpose. Besides, it would bring me closer to Emma and that was a bonus.

To be continued…

body.title: Weeding Between the Cracks and My Continual Battle With Blooming Nature
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmWhicaNQhmztNGD2wp7osVH1u3iQCB6NTZPHBuQxhxvtj/20260221_092441.jpg

This morning, I went down to our communal garden to do a bit of tidying up.  I spent some time pulling up the weeds from between the cracks in the concrete. I bought a little gadget from a shop that's actually meant for getting mud out of a horse riders' boots. The last time I looked, I didn’t have a horse, but I found that it was perfect for pulling up weeds.  It was as cheap as chips, too. It's backbreaking work, but it feels good to get some fresh air. I know in a couple of weeks' time, the frigging weeds will be poking through again, but for now it looks a lot better.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjXanijqqJ7peD9qyjLRPcWGBY1xfvJocZp3fubPqR1C/1000092206.jpg

I came across a few surprises in the garden while I was weeding and clearing things out.  The first was a pot meerkat peering at me. I felt as though I was being judged on my work.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcowTi257yQC1DiM6iq3mjEffRaXdPEidpno7qRn5p3Ut/1000093102.jpg

The second was a sign, which I thoroughly agree with. \

Gardening is bad enough, without touching my toes.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPNBK2iKYs3Egc2ySKbWAzRzH9C42voamboS87XyhA1L/Messenger_creation_390971596853527.jpeg

For several months, a little robin has taken up residence in one corner of the garden.  Every time, I pop down it  makes an appearance.  I usually have some birdseed in my pocket, so it always gets fed.  Robins like sunflower hearts, so I might plant some sunflower seeds when the frost has past. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3K5qcPG8GN36dJYj9L2t3VMvJwPGWxoDCPgokDaNUmf/1000093239.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcA5HfAFqB8yn9xPcGhLzicQ8Zt15kMZSb1f1PKBJk1dk/1000093238.jpg

Sweeping up the leaves, I came across the usual suspects of worms and caterpillars. I think everything has its place, so I rescued them and put them somewhere safe. I don't like picking up worms. I think it goes back to my childhood when my grandad used to throw them at me. Anyway, I had my thick gardening gloves on, so it wasn't a problem.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcLtS4sp8SzTBYmnngmfY9WXiYAnGKemShPaUbpJUHVmi/Messenger_creation_20BEF70E-805A-4E9F-B5FF-5E6FADFB29BA.jpeg

The toads also got taken over the road to the village pond. After all that, it was time for me to have a shower!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTK1Hf3fujiGbzPk2wTrHry9fhSgJiTGRxkkEaRBPoR1c/InCollage_20260221_130851059~.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

body.body:
Greetings, friends of #queercoin. This week's topic really sparked my imagination. Can you imagine how many things we would do and dreams we would fulfill if we were millionaires? What I can assure you is that I would never stop working.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJhZiNDRmD5w19RPgkBowNwPMHi2EiuzDonmczEAGLBa/img_0794.png)


I consider myself a very enterprising woman. I like to feel useful in society and strive to improve myself every day. That's why I chose my profession, which is teaching. Because of it, I must be in constant preparation and study. I would never give it up for a better salary. Besides, I can't imagine myself spending all day at home doing nothing. I would take advantage of my vacations if I were a millionaire, but when the new school year started, I would gladly return to the classroom.

Among my favorite hobbies, I can assure you that my favorite is traveling, so I would take advantage of my free time, use my personal means of transport, because well, I'm supposed to be a millionaire, haha, and go for a walk. I love to discover new places, historical sites, cultural sites, rural areas, in short, any kind of place. I'm sure I wouldn't miss a single corner of the world.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7ZMp9JZaCc3nJ3E7A16YxUVd8AJk7aFaK9MHAqWeRZF/img_0795.png)

Besides helping people in financial need, especially children who have been abandoned or are ill, I believe that when life rewards you, especially in this way, you should show your gratitude by sharing with those in need, helping the vulnerable, and bringing smiles to faces that have lost their joy and strength to keep fighting.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZnNPF2tmzoii2j6bPpWPHy9JxX34tVWjrn6oPe8VYeT/img_0796.png)

Thank you #queercoin for making me dream while awake and imagine a life of such magnitude. Hugs and have a wonderful day, everyone.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJhZiNDRmD5w19RPgkBowNwPMHi2EiuzDonmczEAGLBa/img_0794.png)



Me considero una mujer muy emprendedora, me gusta sentirme útil en la sociedad y superarme todos los días , por ello escogí mi profesión, que es el magisterio, debido a ella debo estar en una constante preparación y estudio. Jamás la dejaría por una mejora económica, además no me visualizo todo un día en una casa sin hacer nada, si cogeria y aprovecharía mis vacaciones en la vida de millonaria pero al empezar el nuevo curso con gusto volvería a las aulas. 

Entre mis hobbies favoritos, te puedo asegurar que el preferido es viajar, así que aprovecharía el tiempo libre tomaría mis medios de transporte personales, porque bueno se supone que soy millonaria jj y a pasear , adoro conocer lugares nuevos,  sitios históricos , culturales, campestres, en fin de cualquier índole, segura estoy no me perdería de ni un solo rinconcito del mundo. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7ZMp9JZaCc3nJ3E7A16YxUVd8AJk7aFaK9MHAqWeRZF/img_0795.png)


Además de ayudar personas necesitadas económicamente, principalmente a niños que sufren de abandono o que padecen alguna enfermedad, considero que cuando la vida te premia y más de esta forma , debes agradecer compartiendo con los necesitados, ayudar al desvalido y regalar sonrisas en los rostros que han perdido la alegría y la fuerza para seguir luchando. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZnNPF2tmzoii2j6bPpWPHy9JxX34tVWjrn6oPe8VYeT/img_0796.png)



Gracias #queercoin por hacerme soñar despierta e imaginarme una vida a tal altura. Abrazos y linda jornada a todos.

body.title: One Good News, Many Concerns
body.body: Talking about my country of residence, a lot is happening every now and then. If I should start writing it all, then, I might end up writing a term paper on this post. Good enough, we were asked to write just one, and that makes it better. To start with, my country is blessed with great people, amazing culture across different tribes, mineral resources, great tourist centers, and lots more. A lot of times, I used to really pay attention to the good sides of my country despite the weaknesses here and there. ![20260221_145805_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/243M7SjfbXgfkHmK3F7JAE3DPsFshjTuneRtdeWU98Wp3t8eUNppiZvfyCdHPaUR9geFo.png) One vital thing we are yet to grab is great leaders that can help see that our light shines out. Until then, you will keep hearing one negativity or the other, but that wouldn't stop me from recognizing that we are naturally endowed. I also don't think I have seen or heard of a country devoid of downsides, just that the level of challenges is different from one country to another. For this prompt, we are to discuss one good thing that has happened in recent time in my country that I am happy with. And then, one bad thing I am sad about. Two months ago, I went to buy fuel in a filling station close to my home, and I noticed the long queue in there. I began to ask questions, and I discovered that this particular filling station sells cheaper than others. Upon further inquiry, I heard that our very own Dangote refinery started operation, and a few filling stations are getting petrol from there, so they sell it cheaper. It was an interesting discovery, and I went deeper into reading the news. My country has been exporting raw petrol to outside countries to refine for us while we buy it back, making the natural resources we have very expensive. It's been years since the construction of the said Dangote refinery, but it has never been operating until recently. This development brought a little crash in the price of petrol recently, although not all filling stations buy from the refinery. We have wanted and protested that the price of petrol should be reduced, as it contributes to the high cost of living in the state, but the more we complain, the more they increase the price. So with this recent development of the new refinery in the system, I am optimistic that soon, the price may drop generally for the good of our country. On the other side, the bad things happening recently have been terrible, but I am not losing hope yet. The killings recently were giving me goosebumps after watching some videos, or was it the kidnapping activities happening in rural areas nowadays? Overall, I am not happy about the insecurity system of my country. ![20260221_150053_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23uFH1k3PyqTb57SkrVYuLWvLaRgQBVALz9sYqSUcsMExnJR6mcrmuzeFJVEsuC9Q98pg.png) People are being killed like rats; it's a big concern, to the extent that the US president came down for our rescue to some extent.It's high time our governor woke up to their full responsibility and pay a close attention to lives. If the citizens die, I wonder whom they will lead. ***Images were taken from canva***

body.title: SENDANG WANASUKA (Part of Baturraden park #2)
body.body:
>Hello, travellers... welcome back with me, and this is chapter 2 of my journey through Baturraden. After wandering around for a while and then taking a break because I was feeling a bit tired, while my friend sat where we had been drinking coffee and resting, he encouraged me to go exploring on my own. He would wait there while enjoying his drink. Since I saw that it was almost raining or foggy, I finally made an agreement with him; I would explore while he waited. 

After finishing my drink, I went back down the stairs and headed to the next fountain.

--- 

<center>SENDANG WANASUKA</center>


---
Actually, there are many fountains here, but I won't look for them all because some are located quite far into the forest. Since I was alone, I didn't dare to go too far. Hahaha.

To get to Sendang Wanasuka, visitors have to climb more steps than at the first fountain, Sendang Mulya. You can see how many steps there are. I continued walking with enjoyment. As long as the air is fresh, I can face any steep road. I carefully walked down the stairs until I found the Wanasuka fountain after walking a little further.

---


![IMG20250817134123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23zGVyqFdz3iD3aCQNuCzyKgpa4dgVrV2od5AubYBmp1U3V2HH7ftY7VF7gVnhtG9yyui.jpg)

![IMG20250817132653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23x1BAkYVnJgtQFHRRDLjGo4tUJTk2ecMs41428rQnGFBhK94VdRteeuzbUfVhi1ngGEp.jpg)

![IMG20250817134132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23ynSejsfVZWjK5dwWuUGUa1fpH5Y85tGWh5Bkt28vUnZz4pW2TyEaba5RHpZNrdCAeCm.jpg)



---



 It is only a small fountain located on the side of the path. Right in front of it is a seating area equipped with a wide umbrella to block the heat and rain. Visitors can relax and sit here. Meanwhile, I continued my journey.

---


![IMG20250817134758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/244xwqDA2HM5Le4QhBaUuEjrTTSghRjZsZ4KVCRcLDjgTanjZsn3DJKVBCAxG4gPbHhky.jpg)

![IMG20250817134748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/243zbKeyJyVHuEdhSw5NGcgVydNu9fcesVcmLiwCw95TMXYTcbk6MXFYwsnoWjsoHt9Y4.jpg)

![IMG20250817134646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23y8otDoFq4zng8pv9YXYoW56zLFEq7ozksCVtdDJDpqtKiQP4qUpB8Q2V5fXMJAJSpN2.jpg)

![IMG20250817134743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23y8me2aUwKNaZaRF1xvBYbnJSpHA74fdvw2mehWRSyUKM9e5y4JUNtWVXfVNaV7Xfcvs.jpg)



---

 Walking along the path with pine trees on my right and left, several times I found photo spots as well as places to sit, and there were climbing leaves that formed a canopy, so I posed a little here. 


---

![IMG20250817140119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23s9TBX8axPTapHDCJx3MBvLkpsNQcSanydGjTq35uJh5JAzpjSyUhPHZSHr9mPmdm4tX.jpg)

![IMG20250817135937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xVCTEYjsKgHHDwUxCCAkejmntVKixLvaRnngYUL18QoiQvNGYggzayCeJGjA3z1oBXr.jpg)

![IMG20250817134957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/244A4TiozAVoUgJ6kPQNSGLhLfJ3cauHYS5q9q8fG3WKLvxF5LzWAdRRTsRgMxX8WYFe1.jpg)

![IMG20250817135000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xAZuSedqcEGxnoyVPZM8jpcG3CxDaX28U8LfyToHgF8TVjLpRs795tK9ueQYdPhQ8yn.jpg)



![IMG20250817135056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23w2sMPUCrYzE86WbCSdDTo4h9CipvV6bNwwajUVX5rEABNQBWuabRNp7iEeaBVn6yyL4.jpg)




---


And do you know what I found afterwards? Yes, another fountain, this one smaller, but that's not the point. Here it is... a pond for paddle boating. What is the proper name for this game, anyway? 


----

![IMG20250817135656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/244obEjRfJ32MtDULaEHBCbUqcM2G6R8CqUrLmjyrtZckPUBuErZFWjYdXyPzcnEepj8o.jpg)

![IMG20250817135600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/2449zXJx3ra86bsRUnRkAw1dZQctLWVbkwsfdr15PEC1SUpVM4W9HhK9ZqUmdofCWB6fh.jpg)

![IMG20250817135624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EpJY8BsEFWN5zmJKqAWMjZR6FxVn9ghytccjCas3yXn2SJfcuaR6HYpHxJqxGLTffmz.jpg)

---



I think it's exciting. At a high point, with a green landscape, paddle boating with your loved ones. Some people even played alone, wow... they were very brave. 

Far away, you can see the word ‘Baturraden’ written in a distinctive faded red colour. I stood there for a moment and watched the people who looked happy and enjoyed their boats until time passed and the boat controller told them that their time was up. Wow... this must be a fun experience for the family.

---



---

If you visit Baturaden, will you try this paddle boat? Or will you skip it?

Please share your opinions with me.

Thank you for reading and following my adventures. See you in my next post.

body.title: The Myth of Equal Priority
body.body:
>

Trying to please everyone and give equal weight to every responsibility leads to a life where everything feels important, yet nothing truly matters.

>Tratar de complacer a todo el mundo y darle el mismo peso a cada responsabilidad te lleva a una vida donde todo se siente importante pero nada trasciende realmente.

When all priorities are treated the same, energy is scattered, decisions become exhausting, and progress feels elusive.

>Cuando todas las prioridades se tratan por igual la energía se dispersa las decisiones se vuelven agotadoras und el progreso se siente inalcanzable.

This pattern can be avoided when values are clearly defined and intentionally prioritized. Life is full of competing demands, and conflict is unavoidable. A predetermined hierarchy of values provides a steady internal compass, allowing difficult decisions to be made with clarity, confidence, and peace rather than guilt or second-guessing.

>Este patrón se puede evitar cuando los valores están claramente definidos y se priorizan con intención. La vida está llena de exigencias opuestas y el conflicto es inevitable. Tener una jerarquía de valores ya establecida funciona como una brújula interna constante que permite tomar decisiones difíciles con claridad confianza y paz en lugar de sentir culpa o dudar de uno mismo.

When values are properly prioritized, productivity increases naturally. Time and attention are no longer divided among distractions but focused on what genuinely serves their leadership, their business, and their family. The result is not just more output, but more meaningful progress and sustainable balance.

>Cuando los valores se priorizan de forma adecuada la productividad aumenta de forma natural. El tiempo y la atención ya no se dividen entre distracciones sino que se enfocan en lo que genuinamente sirve a su liderazgo a su negocio y a su familia. El resultado no es solo producir más sino lograr un progreso más significativo y un equilibrio sostenible.

body.title: Camping at Hinaguan Nature Park with Family United and Reconciled
body.body:
Staying in nature is my most favorite spot to sit and relax.Specially together with my whole family from my mom,children to my sibling and nephews.Nothing compares the enjoyment we all had gathering and relaxing together forget the worries in life for a few days.


![Brown Collage Quote Instagram Post (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/AJpkTMbNRauC2Aoc3kqFJQJe8h5o5uemoXzKtCcngm9uaKSRJHgvLUby2QLuMov.png)


Last month was my daughter 10th birthday and it was our long plan to travel and celebrate her birthday at Hinaguan Nature Park.


![635049383_1318784586948278_8347480225937312204_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/EoEqx2QsCZCYWxtN2nMkxgsoGe98aHusmePPCccFDci1wWnJGWDiDFErkjFTte8bAGS.jpg)

![636106602_908346215284694_6729223305922376052_n - Copy.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/EoAafGPvQJsGwEB5ucsELfCdgu4a3YGJiYauMBfh8w39L4pJBT3321ByPABs2JdmXcF.jpg)


I posted yesterday about Sagpulon Waterfalls and the distance is just nearby so its a one destination visit with a different tourist spots.So if you visit Jasaan I advice you to visit the different spots to save your travel expencess.




![638527108_1428453375353648_4391668225514197442_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23tmFiFbpaCvs1pYGMAczX4M9PjD3kDcMGABE8E8pc9Yx5FEUAs4fRhNHzmkCm9EeuBAx.jpg)

![634369683_1441364194304230_121779386152527935_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23y8oRdrHbr5Q5VEcA4i3XoUSyvCVYomP3gfiarHozXMvFwxQiyHCYdTdoXpQRjADTVC8.jpg)


Actually this is our second time to visit Hinaguan it was last year our first visit but it has no pool last time and just the river.So I am interisted to get back here to see and experience the newly comeback opening of Hinaguan Nature Park.




![637778214_26546379958318775_1602308937938675502_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23vhwREx1jvVpLsDM9nDbfZMDKJ6cNGhqLWyTzM2TVNhTYtzZQWEjv1UPCGiaeiRUMRAw.jpg)

![628547702_891564760436490_1214167474230915547_n (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23z7Dz16ZwRXrvgrMU9iXPpiCVTEPJveDbEspa7AYGRvNi1a73XbVmY3LXPK69Va8Lw3X.jpg)

What I like here is the entrance fee is very affordable and accessible.I do not need to walk for a long distance its just a 1 minute walk from Solana road.



![634716422_1273519271321532_2613218240685043911_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23wWtxjBCHKx18nQrNnd8eTpMDZCLuYMyGuiigCVB34WZc6NeBEhzGFirs2nXZrs551kU.jpg)

You need to pass the mini river going to Hinaguan Farm then voila the nature will welcome you.Hinaguan is always will groomed every by its owner himself Brenda Mage a celebrity social media influencer with 6 Million followers the reason why it is famous and its most visited.




![624071134_1633525620991783_6381586850716375412_n (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23wWrVUARKB7egtQ9piAAdhUhzr9KECbyvc43SBXEf9YyjLoNs5emh3sBhum9Y5MXiVzJ.jpg)

We had 2 days camping here and we brought some foods to cook and stove.Its also a birthday celebration and we all enjoyed swimming in the pool and swimming in the river and enjoy viewing the environment such as plants,mountain,garden and rice field.


I thought that we could book a nipa house but due to they had so many guest and it was fully booked good thing that we bring a tent so we could sleep over and it was really fun.


![625666733_1559839365131873_1287721120284653299_n (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/Ep5mj3DP6h6J6e2cLy4EpcCJSq8UkEFf8JUEGbUGA28U81NX7uNm7uFDq5gCxPFfuh5.jpg)

body.title: The Anikulapo Franchise
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMT33B7jc76sV54U5cjnMYwtwazUzXbyu5aZqPUZzHEx/1771682371913.jpg) [source](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/tobiloba-ayo-ajayi-057b38119_anikulapo-social-commentary-in-disguise-activity-6984141205404069888-Ll1y) Anikulapo is a Nigerian Netflix franchise. A Nigerian movie made by Netflix, all Nigerian cast and crew, and it is one of the best things from Nigerian cinema. The first installation was released in 2022 and it was quite great, it was just one movie of 1hour 50+ minutes, the people loved it and soon in 2024 they made what seemed like a limited series to continue what happened in the first installation. And just this year they've made another sequel called Anikulapo: The Ghoul Awakens. # The Upsides I love this franchise, irrespective of what criticisms I have of it. It's genre is epic fantasy and it is set in the pre colonial days of Western Nigeria. The story style is the old folk tale style African stories are known for amongst those who know about folk tales 😉. It's so great watching a movie of this sort. Nigerian Cinema has already done a good job in the past with these kind of stories in it's B-movies, but that was pre 2010. Nigeria had great B-movies back then that can't really be called B-movies but something between B and A. They were just good and budget did not come to play. So it was good to see more justice done to this genre in this modern era, and not only that the story was great, especially the first installation, the action was great and it was a lovely way to show Western Nigerian culture before British conquest. So, watch it if you need to see a setting like that and get a taste of Nigerian cinema, the sort of taste that a picky Nigerian like me is saying is worth a try, and is worth showing the rest of the world. # The Downsides ### The Environment It is funny how the environment usually looks like it was freshly cleared and built just for the movie. They weren't just able to stick this part. Most of the houses and environments just look like some days back a group of people went into a forest, cleared up the bushes and built the houses just for the movie. Lol. The houses are definitely the same type Africans lived in in the past, made with clay soil and roofed with raffia. But they all just look new in the ### The Costumes The costumes give off a similar vibe too, although only a little, like they were made just for the movie. Hardly anyone wears clothes that looks like they've been wearing them for a long time, almost all of them just look new and fresh. But the clothes are beautiful Nigerian clothing that are still worn even to this day because that's how beautiful Nigerian tailoring is. ### The Facial Tribal Marks Many Nigerian tribes used to tear their faces with blades to create patterns on their skin just like tattoos. This was just the practice of many tribes back then. These facial markings were permanent. But in these movies they all look like drawings done on their faces rather than skin deep markings and that's a bummer. We still have some Nigerians to this day who have these markings and we know the ones in the movies are just so clearly fake. This is what these markings look like in real life: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkZ3rFkFW6SJ99XoeArcnpBGSpgpH5r67Wtj35hcJk6H/1771681941973.jpg) [Source](https://guardian.ng/life/the-symbolism-of-tribal-marks-in-nigeria/) And this is what they look like in the movies: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf34bxAPu1vnP7SsFNc8NH3VJdRLH9ontX8x1Ff8oxyEf/1771682001255.jpg) The patterns are not the issue, but the fact that one looks like something done with a painting while the others are real cuts. # Conclusion Watch it, though, it's one of the most authentic things out there, it is authentically Nigerian without any influences. And the story is a great folklorish stuff, the acting is also great too. It's just mainly a good African experience. --- The End ---

body.body:

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. Since I've already bought all my epic and rare draws from batch 1 of this season, now it's time to buy some common draws, 200 to be exact. I didn't use any alchemy potions, because unfortunately I spent a lot in my epic draws. I will try to buy more when I have more glint.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23swgMxfajUfMkWXrYVAsNZDbVGt1R8bDeUoaMxskpJQyPPZqMtjsY9bLCaczveLPU11k.png)

---

Unfortunately, I didn't get any gold cards in my first 100 common draws :(
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23vsBzhUnvYzM2NSBY2DDWP4fJJtB9YxbNMjZQxGK3FFKb5qSPEGpHzG77dpwgxMm3vvX.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=49d83235ab0e9bc4b09e478a1891ade34dc766dd&ref=langice)</center>

---

And in my other 100 common draws that I opened, once again, I didn't find a single gold card. Well, at least I have a lot of common cards, so it's time to level up.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/EoeCa4NcLSJ4aYSTvK8rdYYo674fop7MX5abgTq95A1NYqwaH3CLTtzstFiKTT3ABSA.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=062696ccedf150d55af1f847fbaf76c2c906096a&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my canisan Stonebind Matron is at level 6, where it gained 1 speed point. This unit currently only has 2 magic attack power, but when it reaches the level 8, it will gain +1 magic attack power, so it will be pretty good, and I will use it more since I like units with hight attack power.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo8KbusbxixF15m5UGV2HMS3MaqvwAaudmfJquNsC7WuDPVVeDTjbMvuf117qB1wXa3.png)

---

Currently, the closest common unit to reach level 8 is my djinn, Oshannus Unmade, who only needs three more copies, so he can get +1 ranged attack power. It will definitely be more useful, especially in battles where only units with ranged attacks are allowed.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRvNFRgVbJy9rB8U432jXqVaBv8VJTGQpVnUojQGAU9LDb1MjtUFrVYUYYpZURghS2w.png)

---

Now, all my common conclave arcana reward cards are at level 7, except for three cards that have the upgrade option underneath; this is because I already have them at the max level in gold foil. I'm really excited that my cards are little by little increasing their level and I can't wait to see them all at the max level. I wish you the best of luck with your rarity draws and have fun playing Splinterlands.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wMQ8dmuLkFrqBX8U6foBKxP89b6F5Sbz8NsJLoccJGMDacD8uwCUyjmMb2RKJo5wGG1.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

body.body: /> [Moonkarts](https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com/play) Game ,This is a racing game of [Arcade Colony](https://arcadecolony.com/). If you are fond of racing games, then you can play Arcade Colony's Moon karts Game on the hive blockchain. To play this game, you must have fuel. I will tell you today how fuel is generated in the MoonkartsGame. You can generate fuel very easily. In this, when you stake the Moonkarts Assets, which are called cards, NFT Card , fuel will be generated from this staking. I have staked some Moonkarts NFT Assets and I am getting fuel from this staking. When you participate in the game for racing, you will need fuel to run your kart. So, understand that you will need fuel for racing and to keep your car on the track. You will need fuel. You can generate this fuel through staking. Today, I will show you. How much fuel am I currently generating daily in the Moonkarts Game? Apart from this, if you do not play racing in the Moonkarts Game and you keep generating fuel, then you can also sell your fuel because fuel is very important for the vehicle and when you race with multiplayer in the Moonkarts Game, you have to use fuel in this race because your vehicle, which is called a kart, will not move forward until there is no fuel inside your vehicle. So even if you do not participate in racing, you can also sell the fuel that you are generating in the market. In this way, you will generate fuel by staking in the Game. With the fuel, you will take your vehicle to racing with multiplayer and then if you do not want to participate in racing, you can also sell the fuel. So, in this way, I am showing you the fuel that I am generating in the Moon Card Game. * * *

/> * * * I have currently staked 10 cards in Auto Vault. You can see in the screenshot that I have staked 10 cards at the moment and from these 10 cards I am getting 133 fuel generated daily and I have also staked 24 script tokens to stak the 10 cards. Here I want to tell you that when you stak any card in Arcade Colony game, you will have to stak two script tokens along with it to get production from it. Then for produce fuel for that card or produce hotSauce because there are many games in Arcade Colony that are currently being played. One of them is the game Moonkarts and the other game is the Stakehouseden game. If you stak the assets of these two games in both these games, then along with staking, you will also have to stak two script tokens in exchange for each card. Then go and generate production from your staking. Similarly, in the Moonkart game, I have staked 10 cards and to produce fuel from these 10 cards, I have also staked 24 script tokens. Thus, the fuel I am getting is 133 fuel, which I get daily. Today, I am showing you in the screenshot that I have not claimed fuel for a few days and you can see above that 6966 fuel has been generated by staking at this time and today I will claim it and you can see above in the screenshot that it is written here as claim fuel, so now I am going to claim 6966 fuel which I can use in racing.

/> * * * Now you must have understood how fuel is generated in the Moonkarts game. When your fuel is generated, then use it to play the race in the game. Now you are seeing in the screenshot above that you are seeing different buttons. First of all, you are seeing the **My Packs** button on the left side below the My Name button. When you click on the My Pack button, you will see the packs that you have purchased or that you have not opened yet. Similarly, there is the **My Cards** button below the My Pack. When you click on the My Cards button, all the Moonkarts assets or cards that you have obtained after opening the pack or that you have purchased from the Moon karts Shop will be displayed in front of you. All the cards that you have collected in the Moon karts game will be displayed in front of you. **Preset** is written below it. When you click on the Preset, you can select the packs that you have purchased. There is a kart, you set up which kart you want to use and how to upgrade it so that you can upgrade your karts by going to the preset and then you have to click on the save button. Similarly, there is a red color auto-Vault button below. When you click on this auto-vault button, you can go to the new screen that will open in front of you and stak your cards or if you have already staked cards, if you want to stak them, you can unstack them. Similarly, you have to click on the same button and go here and claim daily fuel. Now I will tell you how to transfer fuel. If you want to transfer fuel or sell it or transfer it to another Moon karts player, how will you do that? * * *

/>

* * *

To transfer fuel, you have to click on the **fuel transfer** button on the left side. As soon as you click on the fuel transfer button, an interface will open in front of you. On the right side, it will be written that you have to transfer 25 percent, 50 percent, or 100 percent fuel. If you select any of them, 25 percent, 50 percent, or 100 percent, then that percentage of your fuel will be included in the amount of fuel. Then, under Transfer to, you have to write the ID of the hive player to which you are transferring fuel. You will see that on the left side of the same page, as much fuel as you have available will be written and below it, the amount that will be left after transferring fuel will be written. In this way, when you write the specified amount of fuel and also write the hive ID to which you are transferring, you have completed the transfer. If you click on the button, this fuel will be given to the relevant player, so in this way you will transfer fuel. Moon karts Game is a racing game. You can earn your money from here by playing racing. Whenever you win in this game or during the victory, you can collect colony tokens. In this way, you can get a very good reward from this game. If you get colony tokens as rewards at the end of the season, you can stake these colony tokens and you will continue to get colony token rewards from staking. In this way, out of all the games in arcade colony, I am playing the game most often. One of them is splinterlands, Stakehouseden Game and Moonkarts Game. I am playing these three games regularly. And if you also want to play these games, then join the games in arcadecolony now and start earning your passive money. Thank you very much to all of you.

body.title: Rebuilding Trust// La reconstrucción de la confianza (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
**English**

Hello to all the members of this community. This is my first post in Personal Development, and after reading some of your stories, I decided to share an anecdote about growth and personal motivation.

​Two years ago, I accepted the challenge of leading the finances for the workers' union in my department at the Institute of Geology and Paleontology in Cuba, where I work. I took on the role because everyone asked me to. At that time, trust in the union was broken; transforming that perception among the other workers and motivating them to participate in activities has been one of the most challenging personal development lessons I’ve experienced.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczG5ZvcpPSjy5Sddp8ux5pTmo75M9WiZE9YJHyv8wcBJ/img_20260218_144806.png)</center>
***

**​The Initial Challenge**

​At my workplace, the union was viewed with skepticism—a sector many perceived as something that only asked for money without offering solutions or activities to unite the team. When I was elected as the financial officer to manage funds and drive initiatives, I knew my task wasn’t just about organizing numbers, but about rebuilding trust. Initially, I saw it as a tedious task, but I told myself that changes would come with time.

​A year ago, the situation was critical: debts with the Ministry and total disorganization. I was handed the management with zero funds, and no one could explain what had happened to the previous money. It took me a year of strategy to stop the union from stumbling and get it back on its feet. Today, after settling debts and streamlining processes, we finally have basic tools, like a WhatsApp group, to stay up to date.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTW7BMVyg4rBes3XrjwAGdFa6mwgiRZCSZ53hmmPnC2W/img_20260221_083933.png)</center>
***

**​Results**

​After a year and four months of inactivity, we held our first meeting this month to discuss real issues in our area and the center in general, seeking joint solutions amidst the severe economic, political, and social crisis the country is going through.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjgAPKKo59H9x4A4yRyKh1TmsM1h2a6wgCoaqCGcdTBT/img_20260218_150218.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoLDV96zCqhsemzoC7U2MbGgdbXoWfK8AN9wbPijRgT8/img_20260218_150231.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1wAkyq4fuoP8Y86hbowQpRd3YbCoaD6S6XCnuwdWoo3/img_20260218_145649.png)</center>

​To make sure February 14th didn't go unnoticed and to celebrate this new beginning, I prepared a simple but meaningful gift for each unionized worker: small jars of Nutella decorated with handmade hearts. In an environment that felt \

this gesture brought joy to everyone.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfSuwuv6vXTqRCgxDEbAewU6WwHoZgjw7MF69rLF8dXs/img_20260218_144539.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbowjz9emp7jo6Brhke8PBX1HN24hWqLRCNXbi4RnqvZZ/img_20260218_145043.png)</center>

​Seeing the reaction of my colleagues—even those asking for \

for their partners—confirmed that empathy is the foundation of any leadership. Managing money well is fundamental, but using it to remind people that their commitment is worth it is what truly drives change.

***
***

**Español**
Hola a todos los miembros de la comunidad. Este es mi primer post en Personal Development y, luego de leer a algunos de ustedes, decidí compartir una anécdota sobre crecimiento y motivación personal.

​Hace dos años acepté el reto de liderar las finanzas del sindicato de trabajadores de mi área en el Instituto de Geología y Paleontología (Cuba), centro para el cual trabajo. Asumí el cargo porque todos me lo pidieron. En aquel momento, la confianza en el sindicato estaba rota; transformar esa percepción en los demás trabajadores y motivarlos a participar en las actividades ha sido una de las lecciones de desarrollo personal más desafiantes que he tenido.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmczG5ZvcpPSjy5Sddp8ux5pTmo75M9WiZE9YJHyv8wcBJ/img_20260218_144806.png)</center>
***
**​El reto inicial**

​En mi centro de trabajo, el sindicato era visto con escepticismo: un sector que muchos percibían como algo que solo pedía dinero sin ofrecer soluciones ni actividades que unieran al colectivo. Cuando me eligieron como financista para administrar los fondos e impulsar iniciativas, sabía que mi tarea no era solo organizar números, sino reconstruir la confianza. Al principio lo vi como algo tedioso, pero me propuse lograr cambios con el tiempo.
​Hace un año la situación era crítica: deudas con el ministerio y una desorganización total. Me entregaron la gestión sin fondos y nadie supo explicar el destino del dinero anterior. Me tomó un año de estrategias lograr que el sindicato dejara de tambalearse. Hoy, tras saldar deudas y organizar los procesos, finalmente contamos con herramientas básicas, como un grupo de WhatsApp, para mantenernos al día.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTW7BMVyg4rBes3XrjwAGdFa6mwgiRZCSZ53hmmPnC2W/img_20260221_083933.png)</center>
***

**​Resultados**

​Tras un año y cuatro meses de inactividad, este mes realizamos nuestra primera reunión para debatir problemas reales del área y del centro, buscando soluciones conjuntas en medio de la fuerte crisis económica, política y social que atraviesa el país.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjgAPKKo59H9x4A4yRyKh1TmsM1h2a6wgCoaqCGcdTBT/img_20260218_150218.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoLDV96zCqhsemzoC7U2MbGgdbXoWfK8AN9wbPijRgT8/img_20260218_150231.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1wAkyq4fuoP8Y86hbowQpRd3YbCoaD6S6XCnuwdWoo3/img_20260218_145649.png)</center>

​Para no dejar pasar por alto el 14 de febrero y celebrar este nuevo comienzo, preparé un detalle sencillo pero cargado de intención para cada trabajador sindicalizado: frasquitos de Nutella decorados con corazones hechos a mano. En un entorno que se sentía infértil, este gesto trajo alegría a todos.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfSuwuv6vXTqRCgxDEbAewU6WwHoZgjw7MF69rLF8dXs/img_20260218_144539.png)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbowjz9emp7jo6Brhke8PBX1HN24hWqLRCNXbi4RnqvZZ/img_20260218_145043.png)</center>

​Ver la reacción de mis compañeros —incluso de aquellos que pedían \

para sus parejas— me confirmó que la empatía es la base de cualquier liderazgo. Administrar bien el dinero es fundamental, pero usarlo para recordarle a las personas que su compromiso vale la pena es lo que realmente impulsa los cambios.

***
***
<center>Translation by deepl</center>  
<center>Pictures are mine</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdue2Y7dz9uNBykmosZjNqqeaAYKkBeJq6sq6WfBQzgi7/oficial.jpg)  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYojG5djdFc8X6LFvSYDkQbhLR5pNa8VBquhBsr5FBMH7/tarjeta_de_presentaci_n_amarilla.jpg)
