In short, the first relevant reward was SplinterVibes, a reward that, as I said, I had never received and had no idea could come in chests. Next, lots of potions, merits, and common and rare cards, without much luck with the cards themselves. It seems the chance of getting epic and legendary cards has been greatly reduced in some of the past updates, and that's exactly why I try to get an epic draw whenever possible since I have almost no epics, so the chance of getting a duplicate is very low, and this time I was lucky enough to get the goblin card Kila Fen.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/Enyo3Yzhv1CL8YTJphx1DadYQFmmbxKwY6oEpsKDFgNvHjZPaVpK1kiqAye6WpuiHFr.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Going into more detail about the main reward of EOS, SplinterVibes. For those who don't know, it's now possible to get some songs in chests, which can be heard in the upper right corner in a sound icon next to the gear. Those who obtain a SplinterVibes will be able to play it there. In my case, the version I received was from the artist DJ PLADO, called SplinterVibes: Virid Venomancer. This is a calm song at times, but it gets more upbeat later on. I can say that I really liked the vibe of the song and I already leave it playing as soon as I enter Splinterlands.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23tRqzFSHYtsqTtK4WxNH1xVXyBB6UGWEJExFWQpR77kytAKKwsY7zUNn49poJmiX7Z8o.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
It's great to have these customization options and make better use of the game's resources, since you can only obtain them from chests or from other players, if I'm not mistaken. SplinterVibes is still a very rare reward, because there aren't many available yet and the marketplace is almost full of music for sale. Don't miss the chance to get one of these Music NFTs. Looking at the market, some examples of music I found for sale were Arcane Skywalker being sold for $5.90 and Venomancer itself having options for $2.99. Over time, as players find more of these songs, the prices may decrease, but for now they are more expensive than some cards.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/Ep1UXvhC1kEf6eRr9fVUYeDJwKKWRhKZRavaP8dvd37qjerYFt9FiLftgG8UE88E8bX.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Finally, within the strategy of obtaining an epic draw whenever possible, since the chances of getting it from a chest are extremely low, I managed to obtain the Kila Fen card. This is a high mana card (8), but with very good stats, having 2 magic damage, 7 HP and 2 shield which helps to withstand a good amount of damage and 3 speed which is reasonable. In addition, it has the divine shield ability, which protects from one hit. A card that appears to be quite versatile, able to play in the second position or in the backline to protect against attacks. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![SPLINTERVIBES from a Minor Chest! (EOS).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23uQi7NfdTKNhQzg1BsN1asWoZKe8kmmXSZSvLYXkRhaPXRsCd6FGfju1wbXatwA6B1pG.jpg) Acabei esquecendo de comentar em conteúdo sobre as recompensas de End of Season da última temporada do Splinterlands, em que recebi uma reward bem diferente de tudo que já vi de recompensas no Splinterlands. Assim, além de comentar sobre essa reward do SLINTERVIBES que recebi de um dos Minor Chest abertos com o glint de EOS, vou também aproveitar e mencionar sobre algumas das melhorias feitas no deck com o upgrade nas cartas Reward da coleção conclave arcana recentemente. É curioso como mais uma vez o Glint se mostra um recurso muito interessante dentro do ecossistema do Splinterlands e que acaba incentivando os jogadores à buscarem a ter mais SPS em Stake ou alugar mais SPS - que atualmente não está tão fácil - para conseguir aumentar o boost de glint e claro melhorar o Deck para subir as suas chances de vitória e o seu ranking para ganhar mais glint por partida. Venha descobrir um pouco mais sobre o que é SPLINTERVIBES e alguns dos upgrades feitos com glint no Deck. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## SPLINTERVIBES from a Minor Chest! (EOS Rewards)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23tSKnEdDG3TiFXRhGL7NFNPQKWD8UdM4LqWcwZ2rdP3jngUqgWhn2wEfvCUpSCCRaMph.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Começando com as recompensas de EOS, nada melhor que um compilado, mostrando um panorama geral das recompensas e a estratégia por trás de cada escolha e depois entrar em detalhes nas recompensas principais. De forma resumida, a primeira recompensa relevante foi o SplinterVibes, uma recompensa que como já disse nunca tinha recebido e nem tinha ideia que podia vir nos baús. Em seguida, muitas potions, merits e cartas comuns e raras, sem grandes sortes com as cartas, parece que a chance de conseguir cartas épicas e lendárias foi altamente reduzida em alguma das atulizações passadas, e é exatamente por isso que eu tendo pegar um epic draw quando possível já que não tenho quase nenhuma épica, então a chance de vir repetida é bem baixa e dessa vez tive a sorte de conseguir a carta goblin Kila Fen.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/Enyo3Yzhv1CL8YTJphx1DadYQFmmbxKwY6oEpsKDFgNvHjZPaVpK1kiqAye6WpuiHFr.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Abordando com mais detalhes a principal recompensa do EOS, o SplinterVibes. Para quem ainda não conhece, agora é possível conseguir algumas músicas nos baús, que podem ser ouvidas no lado direito superior em um ícone de som ao lado da engrenagem. Para quem obter um splintervibes vai poder colocar para tocar lá. No meu caso, a versão que eu recebi foi do artista DJ PLADO, chamada Splintervibes: Virid Venomancer. Essa é uma música calma em alguns momentos, mas que depois vai dando uma animada, posso dizer que gostei muito da vibe da música e já deixo ela tocando assindo que entre no Splinterlands.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23tRqzFSHYtsqTtK4WxNH1xVXyBB6UGWEJExFWQpR77kytAKKwsY7zUNn49poJmiX7Z8o.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
É muito bom ter essas opções de customização e dar mais utilidade para os recursos do jogo, já que você só pode obter dos baús ou de outros jogadores se não me engano. O SplinterVibes ainda é uma recompensa bem rara, porque não há muitos obtidos ainda e no marketplace quase não encontra músicas à venda, não perca a chance de obter um desses Music NFTs. Dando uma olhada no market, alguns exemplos de músicas que encontrei à venda foi a Arcane Skywalker sendo vendida por $5,9 e a própria Venomancer tendo opções por $2,99. Com o tempo, conforme os jogadores vão encontrando mais dessas músicas a tendência pode ser que os preços vão diminuindo, mas por enquanto estão mais caras do que algumas cartas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/Ep1UXvhC1kEf6eRr9fVUYeDJwKKWRhKZRavaP8dvd37qjerYFt9FiLftgG8UE88E8bX.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Por fim, dentro da estratégia de obter um epic draw quando possível já que as chances de conseguir no baú são extremamente baixas, consegui obter a carta Kila Fen. Essa é uma carta de mana alta (8), mas com status muito bons, tendo 2 de dano mágico, 7 de HP e 2 de escudo que ajuda a aguentar uma boa quantidade de dano e 3 de velocidade o que é razoável. Além disso, possui a habilidade divine shield, que protege de um hit. Uma carta que parece ser bem versátil podendo ficar na segunda posição ou na backline para proteger de ataques. ---

body.title: Chicken roll recipe 🌯🫔😋✨
body.body:
Hi guys! How are you all? I hope you’re all doing very well. Alhamdulillah, I’m also doing great. Today, I’m here with a special Ramadan recipe that’s even more delicious and exciting. It’s crispy, yummy, and spicy and it tastes absolutely amazing! So, let’s get started and I’ll share the recipe with you all.🌯🫔


- 
![505830E8-AFCB-49BF-9C21-5D3B5D2E67BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23uR5TevrWiPayTCj9FXnqdG3rAU6X1umF8QVWY6umGfwJxhNano4V6kg4EWP4snYk6uX.jpeg)


## Ingredients:🌯🫔😋

1.Chicken breast pieces,
2.Potato,
3.Tomato,
4.Capsicums, 
5.Ginger paste,
6.Garlic paste,
7.Onion paste,
8.Salt,
9.Turmeric powder,
10.Red chili powder,
11.Cumin powder,
12.Coriander powder,
13.Fresh coriander leaves,
14.Flour,
15.Soy sauce,
16.Tomato sauce,
17.Oregano. 


![EFCF9F2D-C471-4DCC-A11D-29E214B2C777.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23wgfBrmEEtGsRBHfm6QhXoPF3Et7qGLa1CJGMarUfdjtUNpynySo6VJTQBNpbR7RaJnv.jpeg)


## Process : 😋🌯🫔

First, to prepare the filling for the roll, I neatly cut the chicken breast into small pieces. I also chopped the tomato, capsicum, and potato into small pieces.
Then I turned on the stove and heated a frying pan. Once it was hot, I added a suitable amount of oil. 


After that, I added the chopped chicken, potato, tomato, and capsicum one by one. Then I added ginger paste, garlic paste, onion paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, red chili powder, turmeric powder, and fresh coriander leaves. Fry everything well over medium heat.


When all the ingredients are nicely cooked and well fried, add a little soy sauce and tomato sauce. Mix everything well, and the filling will be ready.



![IMG_5009.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23u6UPJEkWR8z99c2ziLtRdj2SEKAGoBddFfWuU2U1yrkU3fyeMVaEvbVUAJyBN2QHitN.jpeg)


Now boil the flour dough and knead it well. Then, just like making roti, prepare the flatbread in the usual way. After that, place the prepared filling in the center in an appropriate amount. Shape it as you like. Since this is a chicken roll, I shaped it like a roll. 💛🌯



![IMG_5013.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23viK8ndrvX96j4zeHZsGDi2JQzn9BsLpXL2oPetQPYQoBaXnnNvYS7D4YSU3xLZLZ5e1.jpeg)

![IMG_5012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23uRBLWwNnhRSxvmvrC4TyP4jm16Mc8fo9JWko1nPHqPp77yKisjmpEW7dvRTt4wTemyV.jpeg)



If you store them in an airtight box in the deep freezer, they will stay good for many months.



Here, I have fried a few rolls. Just fry them lightly in a little oil, and your yummy, crispy chicken rolls will be ready. 😋🌯🫔



![505830E8-AFCB-49BF-9C21-5D3B5D2E67BA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tathoy/23uR5TevrWiPayTCj9FXnqdG3rAU6X1umF8QVWY6umGfwJxhNano4V6kg4EWP4snYk6uX.jpeg)

🌿☕ A hectic morning... but filled with the warmth of love 🌿♥️🤍

## Hello, my lovely friends!

I might be a little late in greeting you today because I had an important task to attend the final farewell to my sister-in-law's mother. But before leaving the house, my most important duty was to take care of \

which is my own mother-in-law. ♥️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQvWNYmRWy15VDeLP7JqPLSBTTYjtFU8qBJt2rdui5N3/1771677984767.jpg)


Every morning begins with purpose. I carefully bathe, dress, and lovingly feed my mother-in-law, wanting her to feel comfortable and satisfied before I attend to other matters.

After taking care of the \

After taking care of everyone around me, it's time for a short treat: a warm cup of coffee and a soft cake to recharge before starting my gardening work.
⏰ 9:30 AM — The clock strikes, signaling the start of my green mission.
I head to the backyard garden with the vegetables I bought yesterday. Today, I'll focus on planting mint and betel leaves on the prepared wooden platform. I meticulously tilled the soil and watered the plants on the patio, feeling incredibly refreshed by the lush greenery. Unfortunately, time flew by faster than I expected, so today's gardening work will have to wait. There are still a few chili plants that haven't been planted yet, which will have to be postponed until tomorrow.

body.title: Onerchain: Every Kilowatt Has Its Own Passport
body.body:
Brothers, let’s talk about something real— The electricity you use at home: is it wind or coal? Did it come sweeping down from the North Sea, or was it just burned up at the lignite plant next door?

https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgJjc1IWKnD96ahnNchDQWxgZB1UUTQCV0eQ_4JxE_Tw6L_25GpM8EW9C2URBmbkOhxbOCn6jyS8c_9VtUFFS_Sm7A7NMR7KKLFrZgs6MAdcufHL2J9WXC9oSGWUBdAsHpXWSTAzkz6JWl64VtaFCW7V5SwUwHvMezxMbfslKyzAOZljr9cSCmOf2QFfZg/w640-h360/Onerchain%20Every%20Kilowatt%20Has%20Its%20Own%20Passport.png

As of today, nobody can give you a definite answer. Energy companies can’t, the grid can’t, customs can’t.

But starting in 2025, there’s no hiding anymore：The EU’s DPP (Digital Product Passport) is rolling out, CBAM carbon taxes take effect, and every imported product must declare: how much green power was used in production, how much carbon was emitted. Calculated hour by hour, down to the finest detail.

Germany, as a major exporter, is already feeling anxious: suppliers claim green power, but how do we verify? When goods arrive in Rotterdam, why should customs believe us? Annual audits mean endless Excel reconciliations, weeks of labor wasted, and the data still doesn’t match.


Is this the digital age or the abacus age?  Recently, I came across a project called Onerchain. Finished reading the whitepaper at 3am Berlin time, messaged my peers: “Someone finally nailed energy traceability.”

 

It’s not about installing monitors on the grid, but about giving every kilowatt an ID card.  Onerchain’s logic is simple and very “German”—rigorous, verifiable, no nonsense.  Every kilowatt, every kilo of green hydrogen, from production, storage, transport, to delivery, carries a “blockchain passport” throughout its journey.

 

What does this passport look like?  Smart meters generate readings every 15 minutes, hardware key signatures, factory-bound DID, anti-counterfeit from the source;  

Data is packaged using the GS1 EPCIS 2.0 international standard, mapped directly to EU DPP fields—customs, auditors, trade partners can use it straight away, no need for translation;

 

Production, loading, transit, delivery—every event is logged in real time, unchangeable, undeniable.  This isn’t some Frankenstein “IoT + blockchain” mashup, but a global energy ledger, born for EU compliance.

 

German companies are famously sensitive about data privacy. Onerchain’s solution is clever: you don’t have to put all your secrets on-chain, just prove what needs proving.

 

It uses zero-knowledge proofs to wrap carbon calculations and green power origin checks into circuits. Only proofs and hashes stay on-chain; raw data is encrypted and kept private as needed.

 

Auditors want to check? No problem. Companies can generate a plaintext report, verifiable in 3 seconds, tracing the entire supply chain end-to-end, no more Excel, no more reconciliation.

 

Compliance and privacy—no compromise, they want both.

Costs Slashed, Performance at National Scale  .Why haven’t previous blockchain+energy projects taken off? Three words: slow, expensive, hard to use.  

Onerchain takes a pragmatic route: zk-Rollup + modular DA.  

Batch transactions are compressed and submitted to Ethereum mainnet, data availability moved to Celestia or EigenDA, per-transaction cost down to $0.01, enough to handle all Germany’s new energy installations with ease.  

 

On the enterprise side? REST/GraphQL for SAP, ERP integration, or direct Solidity contracts for Web3 ops. Old world and new world bridged, no need to blow everything up and rebuild.

 

ONCA: No Hype, Just Data : Total supply of ONCA tokens: 5 billion. Distribution is sincere: 35% for node incentives, 20% for ecosystem fund, 15% for the team locked for 12 months—nobody’s dumping at launch.  

 

The value capture path is refreshingly clear:  Data providers (power plants, edge gateways) upload events, earn ONCA;  Data consumers (banks, auditors, traders) query data, mint certificates, spend ONCA;  Validators stake ONCA to batch and generate ZK proofs, earn block rewards;  Daily buyback and burn for ONCA, deflation built in.

 

This isn’t vaporware, but turning enterprise compliance costs into real network revenue.

 

My Straight Talk: Onerchain isn’t the kind of project you want to ape into instantly.  No flashy AI Agents, no fancy game theory, not even a sexy story.  It’s doing something simple, big, and absolutely necessary:  Building a trustworthy, neutral, globally verifiable digital foundation for Europe’s energy transition.  Compliance needs it, customs need it, trade needs it, finance needs it.

 

If the energy traceability and carbon data market really hits the $120 billion scale IEA predicts for 2030, every Rollup, every ZK circuit, every signed smart meter Onerchain lays down today is laying the tracks for that future.

 

It’s not a pig riding the wind. It’s carrying the sleepers before the wind even arrives.

 

#Onerchain #DePIN #RWA #GreenEnergy #DPP #CBAM #ZeroKnowledgeProof #EUCompliance #EnergyBlockchain #RealWorldAssetsOnChain

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1819
Saturday 21, February 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1884
Noxsoma Life Camp: https://noxsoma.substack.com/

Sabado Grande, Mi Gente. 

Welcome to one more day above ground.

We have made it through another week without WW3 kicking off. The puzzled pundits are losing patience. Typical behavior. They’d rather be “right” than “left,” (in confusion, that is.).

After a year, or so, in this “community” we are finally taking advantage of some of the features. Maybe these features weren’t even here a year ago. I honestly don’t know. Anyway, we started pushing buttons, ticking boxes and opening drop down menus and, “Whoa,” we have a podcast.

We also learned how to add voice-over, which I call “vox,” just to differentiate human voices from artificial vox. One weird trick, that I find tricky and challenging, is to get Vox to pronounce the words they way I want it to. Dramatic pauses. Emphasizing some words and syllables, while not emphasizing others. It can be fun at times. But sometimes it’s just “fuggetaboutit!”

FYI: The audio included has very little to do with the show. The text provided is a truncated portion of the audio, as it’s a little thicker than some of the video platforms can handle. We think that most explorers to this channel will opt for the audio first. If you want to watch the show without being lured into some casino or talked into buying a used boat, click the link. It will take you to Odysee.com. A quasi-obscure free-speech channel that is somehow hanging in there. You can watch without registering. 

Thanks for all the positive feedback for the “Echoes” series. We will have more snippets from around the world and back in time. 

We should have an audio montage of this week’s “video notes” before the sun goes down on your California town. 

Stay safe, stay sane, stay strong, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed. 

PEACE.   

The Substack Experience

![1884.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRrePB59Pt4qDqJs3dxeTSSA7VDq4TtjfWGd3E69J14n/1884.png)

![1884.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRrePB59Pt4qDqJs3dxeTSSA7VDq4TtjfWGd3E69J14n/1884.png)

Replacing an entrenched mindset with a better one.    

Today's Episode:	https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1819_full_2-21-26_1884_substack:2?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 

The Trap of Reaction (Preview Segment, full audio on Substack in English.)

This is where the transition gets dangerous. The human mind abhors a vacuum. When you leave a rigid mindset, the temptation is not to find truth, but to find the opposite of what you left.

If the Church told you that the world began six thousand years ago, the reactive mind rushes to worship Richard Dawkins with the same fervor it once reserved for the Pope. If the military told you to trust the government blindly, the reactive mind assumes every single headline is a lie. If your parents watched Fox News, you start getting all your information from a TikTok influencer with a ring light and a grudge.

This is not freedom. This is just wearing the enemy's clothes inside out. You are still letting the old structure dictate your terms. They said \

But you are still playing their game of chess; you just switched sides.

 The Architecture of the New World

So how do you build a better mindset without simply building the old one in reverse? How do you replace the fortress with a home?

The first step is accepting intellectual humility. In your old system, you had all the answers (or the institution did). In the new space, you have to become comfortable with the phrase, \

Leaving mainstream media doesn't mean you suddenly know the truth; it means you admit that the truth is harder to find than a thirty-second segment. It means reading three sources, including the ones that bore you.

The second step is curating your loneliness. When you leave a tribe, you are statistically likely to join another one quickly to stop the pain. The better mindset resists this. It understands that the period of wandering in the desert is necessary. It is in the desert that you discover what you actually believe, not just what you were told to believe. It means finding friends who don't need you to agree with them on everything to break bread with you.

The third step is building a practice, not a doctrine. A veteran might replace the structure of the barracks with the discipline of a morning run or a woodworking shop. The former evangelical might replace Sunday service with a Sunday hike—a ritual of awe without the liturgy. The media skeptic might replace the nightly news with deep-dive history books, gaining context instead of clicks. A doctrine tells you what to think. A practice gives you something to do while you figure out what to think.

*En esta segunda parte de las fotografías de flores en mi celular, quisiera resaltar la belleza e importancia que tiene un ser vivo tan pequeño y tan delicado que merece mucha más admiración de la que realmente recibe. Priorizando siempre su estado natural, es decir conectado a la planta. Cada vez que pasamos por una planta con flores y arrancamos una estamos interrumpiendo un ciclo que va más alla de nuestro entendimiento básico; ¿Sabias que al arrancar una flor estás dejando sin alimento a animales polinizadores como abejas y mariposas? Además de contribuir con la sobreproducción de dióxido de carbono, el cual puede llegar a ser emitido hasta 3 kilogramos por flor arrancada. Eso sin contar la reducción de la vida de la planta por falta de nutrición o reproducción. 
Así que ya sabes, si ves una flor que te gusta mucho fotografiala y compártela con nosotros pero no la arranques, déjala justo dónde está, siempre junto a su madre, siempre viva.*

*Te agradezco mucho por haberte tomado el tiempo de leerme y espero que hayas disfrutado mi publicación. Feliz día*:)

***In this second part of the flower photos on my phone, I would like to highlight the beauty and importance of such a small and delicate living being that deserves much more admiration than it actually receives. Always prioritizing its natural state, that is, connected to the plant. Every time we pass by a flowering plant and pick a flower, we are interrupting a cycle that goes beyond our basic understanding; Did you know that when you pick a flower, you are depriving pollinating animals such as bees and butterflies of food? In addition to contributing to the overproduction of carbon dioxide, which can reach up to 3 kilograms per flower picked. Not to mention the reduction in the plant's life span due to lack of nutrition or reproduction. 
So now you know, if you see a flower you really like, take a picture of it and share it with us, but don't pick it. Leave it right where it is, always next to its mother, always alive.***

***Thank you very much for taking the time to read this, and I hope you enjoyed my post. Have a great day*** :)

body.body:

These are previews from matches involving Belgian Teams with all the latest on team news, player form, and injuries along with my personal betting angles, ...

/> The match yesterday kind of played out as I anticipated bit with a 0-1 score at the end and a red card for AA Gent it screwed up a couple bets in the end making me lose a minimum which I gladly settle for. It also goes to show how difficult it is to actually get in with size and confidence. So on Saturday with 3 matches, the cautious grind continues...

Dender vs Sint-Truiden

>https://images.hive.blog/DQma5MeLU84buMv7ZLMjp5xrLUvpH4Ef7w6yeyx6PmpoCzz/image.pngDender is still last and got themselves in a losing streak again after they had a period where things didn't look hopeless. They still try to make the gap workable but now at 8 points and some of the other teams picking up form, it again just looks really bad. The thing is that at times they show good things but never 90 minutes and they aren't good enough when falling behind. In their last home match they started weak and got quickly 0-2 behind which was followed by an away match where they were really focused at the start which created and under match. Last week away against OHL they started out again willing to go forward and quickly made the 0-1. I do expect them starting with high energy and a drive forward today. Stvv were helped by the ref last week on pitch conditions that didn't suit them because of the snow. The week howevern they took a deserved 0-4 win against a poor Westerlo showing that the 0-2 loss at home against Charleroi was an anomaly in an otherwise solid season. They are 2-in 2nd place and sure of playoff 1 and as long as their A-Squad stays fit there is no reason that they would have a collapse in the remaining matches during the regular season. I expect Dender to come out with high energy and stvv who try to control this situation knowing that it will only last that long. Stvv has been underrated all season and it feels like this continues to be the case. Dender is starting to get in a spot of desperation which more than often turns in a continued downtrend with lower and lower confidence. I took 0.3 units on Sint-Truiden -0.25 @ 1.837 along with 0.1 unit on Sint-Truiden Team total Over 1.5 @ 2.00 boh with an eye to possibly increase the stake in-game as I can see a scenario where odds go up or Dender even scores first. I'm also keeping an eye out for Dender 1st half corners but I need to get some confirmation first for that one.

Club Brugge vs OH Leuven

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmQktHDVXA36MmbXxV4ybqGPVybC8SiuMP2wzoYBUjMex1/image.pngClub Brugge this season showed that their focus is in the Champions League while they tend to 'get the job done' in the league without this ever being convinvingly. they are inbetween Champions League matches putting up a good performance against Atletico and in a position where they can pull a stunt potentially. So I do expect a combination of players their mind aleady on Tuesday and also likely some rotation from the coach. Their ideal scenario would be to make the difference early with a couple of goals and control afterward saving energy. However, it's rarely as easy as this and much more likely is a scenario where they don't really convince again and if they win it will be a case of 'getting the job done'. OHL since schrijvers got back from injury have been a bit more solid and have shown better things. They were a bit lucky last week to get away with a 3-2 score even though it was deserved. The week before, they won with a 1-3 score agains AA Gent in a match where they were efficient and didn't give too much away. I fully expect them to focus on defense and the counters today and I'm not so sure that Club Brugge will have an easy time to break that. I see some possible edge on the under and the underdog with a narrow home win as the most likely outcome where Brugge really feels the influence of being inbetween champions League matches. I took 0.14 units on Under 3 @ 2.045, 0.11 units on 1st Half Under 1.25 @ 2.00, & 0.13 units on OH Leuven +1.5 @ 1.909 leaving me some room to add more in-game.

Union SG vs Antwerp

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmV51GdMkoekUQzPCuU3akSBSubzEjCabHePuUPE1h1P6p/image.pngUnion is still 1st in the league, but they have show some signs of slight decline especially away as the many matches added up. this time around though, they had a full week off and I expect them to be ready and motivated to get in a good performance. They have some injury worreis with Scherpen, Leysen, Floricz, Niang but those are mostly reducing their options on the bench while the starting A-Squad is still solid. They have gotten quite heaving handicaps at home but these are starting to come down as in recent matches they only won by a 1-goal margin failing to cover them. Overall though at home, they are 9W-2L against their handicaps. Antwerp after a temporary streak with better results is back to being a pretty bad team and also last week they lost deserved to Westerlo, while the match before they got trashed by Anderlecht in the cup standing no chance. They now dropped back to 11th place in the league and need to start looking down which will bring about more stress. They also picked up some injuries with Somers, Van Helden, Benitze and Adekami leaving thel with limited options off the bench. I would not be surprised to see a superior Union today, and Antwerp as no match to them after 90 minutes. The numbers show that Antwerp is an under Away team at 1W-10L-1P on the over closing total, both also have rather low xg against at 0.87 & 1.19 in the last 4 matches. I am willing to back Union today and would not be surprised at all if this one turned out in a rare blowout home win. body.title: Transformers In Real Life
body.body:
A couple of months ago, when there was still sun outside rather than the grumpy cold weather we all can't wait to get rid of, I had a unique experience in a pretty basic day.

I was literally on a walk to the shopping center near my home to get some snacks for the evening where I was planning to get cozy at home whether to read for a couple of hours, play video games, watch a movie, or even a bit of everything, when my attention was quckly captured by some tall and imposing pieces of art that could be seen from the distance.

This was not one of the most common views one can have because when you look towards the parking lot, you don't really expect to see anything other than just cars, obviously, but somehow things were different back then.

As a kid who grew up with these movies and always dreamed of owning a Bumblebee in miniature, there is no need to say that I was gone in a blink of an eye from my boyfriend's side, who was still trying to figure out why I got so excited, lol.

![Photo_1771312859004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23u5tbFRdxVyk9E6yrkWYQkaxjQXfZhTRB66fqFi9THxf9diuPExoVwcUQzVNRjuBV8hn.jpg)

![Photo_1771312829697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xKp7gQHuM79gCwA7ZNFw6TEtfTg2UFGGESx2ag6UEnzAmkJWTzk6Y7fzhXjuKCr7jAK.jpg)

![Photo_1771312860000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wgKyqbNC52JD7RS84SrPy9AUPdFUbabgafArUWHqfC5Mjh1b4wRY9bthDX8rpodoRCN.jpg)

![Photo_1771312828352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/243BZtDwoB6wM71NdawA5EaHtW9YsoT4yJ1DP8decaTnqT5YieS55gYjUYo2APZ9mmeFu.jpg)

The open air exhibition was called **Transform Robots** and it took place between 7th November and 5th December in 2025, and it was supposed to be open daily between 10 AM and 8 PM.

Sadly, that proved to be a bit wrong because during the time when this exhibition took place, I had more walks towards that direction and I never found it open, which seemed at least weird. 

But as a person who couldn't miss the chance to see the robots even from a distance, I managed to take a couple of shots over the fence that was supposed to block visitors from seeing these unless they paid for a ticket.

By the way, the price of a ticket was around 4 EUR for a kid and 5 EUR for an adult, which still seems a bit too expensive, but there are always parents who would pay a little fortune for a ticket just for the happiness of their kids. The problem was, that, as I said, in none of the days I tried to visit this, there was never anyone on the ticket office.

![Photo_1771312858399.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23ywiwwWxfGzZ8qw65e1ZeLqiYqbkFL7Mfg8ZvL9AVG3KifqCwtc25FLMT7cUiTz8bejR.jpg)

![Photo_1771312832653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23wgFkyVWTBpoppt2p7CtZ1kdjVjgvVAcDRynUXE7YQp1M1Cgtam9Cfdxkuh7Hueyh6f8.jpg)

<center>![Photo_1771312826781.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23ycyhGUwQK59Gc9d8egD9KrTUdSvAyL6pGTUVq5iSVGSvzy732DcWnvmTLUpFuWuJ11j.jpg)</center>

<center>![Photo_1771312831121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uFMh3tqo1igqzjyFGzdo7K2gRYzLFPNUADpYbnFv9a2v2JN3NHNFfhqow3umvyYycZQ.jpg)</center>

![Photo_1771312861448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Ep5kmXosRQJhMxa3dTEo4ajjC2PQ4u8MasshMd2uMSxVC1hSq5ovTzy97xkANZoeDhF.jpg)

Some of the robots they mentioned on the informative panel as being part of the exhibition were Bronkerson R-264, Waxanarus R-238, Pexiwald R-294, Brewster R-217 and Drambot R-534, that I am sure some of you might remember about, but sadly I couldn't take a picture of all of them because of not having them placed near the fence as these I already took a picture of.

Anyway, even with an experience half enjoyed at the end of the day, I was still happy to change my routine even for just a couple of minutes, and even today, when I relived everything by writing this article, I still find it a unique experience.

body.title: Splinterlands Social Media Challenge: Survival Mode Redefined, Incentives, Psychology and Player Behaviour
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tkhdBEocyTLshVZWEzejUnktVZEXkcDC5Lp9dcFXU2EGUs5ej5jBaRGCG9kNcvPyNXa.png)

HELLO to all Splinterlands readers of my humble Hive blog. 👋👋👋 

When I first logged into Splinterlands and saw the announcement that Survival Mode was coming back with a brand new design, I felt a mix of excitement and caution. That original mode had so much potential yet struggled under its own mechanics. The old version often felt punitive rather than rewarding, and players frequently avoided it for fear of losing cards to cooldowns that bled into the rest of their gameplay. Now, with a complete structural redesign, Survival Mode is reinventing not just how we play, but why we choose to engage. This is less an update and more a psychological and economic experiment in competitive game design with implications for engagement, retention, and community health.




<center>![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)</center>




No matter! I present to you — **Survival Mode Redefined: Incentives, Psychology and Player Behaviour**.

So without further ado, let's dive into this week's themed topic for the Splinterlands Social Media Challenge! 🎉




<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/AJhU8UC2vVbt4yuQSVsA2mahwQxkMG9xb5RJLrTtyZBpNSRCEwdYiLAzn45mwTe.png)
</center>

<center>![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)</center>

# <center> ⚔️🛡️ Survival Mode Redefined: Incentives, Psychology and Player Behaviour 🛡️⚔️ </center>

<center>![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)</center>




---

## **Psychological Cost of Participation: From Fear to Opportunity**

• **Removing fear of punishment boosts player engagement**
Compared to its earlier versions, Survival Mode now operates without cross-mode cooldown penalties. In the past, if your card lost and went on cooldown, that could hurt not just your Survival progress but your performance in Ranked, Brawls, or Tournaments. That did more than constrain gameplay; it created a psychological barrier to participation, one that made risk seem irresponsible. Now, card cooldowns apply only within Survival Mode itself, meaning a defeat there no longer handicaps your broader Splinterlands journey. This alone can increase willingness to play and experiment because players no longer fear losing access to their strongest decks elsewhere. For many, this change transforms Survival Mode from a risky gamble into a sandbox for strategic exploration, and that shift in risk perception can drive participation.

• **Free-to-play structure removes entry cost anxieties**
Survival Mode now runs completely free to play, provided you have the cards needed for your chosen bracket. This isn’t just a convenience, it’s a deliberate lowering of economic friction. When participation no longer requires spending or staking upfront, players feel freer to experiment and grow without fear of wasted investment. That can boost both short-term activity and long-term retention, as players learn systems and mechanics at their own pace.

• **Bracket locking creates identity and commitment**
At the start of each season, players must choose one bracket and stay in it for its duration. While that may sound limiting, it leverages a subtle psychological principle: commitment leads to identity formation. Once players align with a bracket’s culture, whether manual PvP or automation, they are more likely to stick around, build strategies, and emotionally invest in their performance. This decision point also prevents casual hopping between brackets to chase perceived rewards, making participation feel more meaningful and intentional. 

---

## **Participation-Based Rewards: A Shift from Fixed Outputs to Dynamic Incentives**

• **Reward pools scale with actual activity**
The traditional model in many competitive games is to pre-assign rewards to specific tiers or finishes. Things like “X SPS for Bronze, Y SPS for Gold” appear logical but can inadvertently create stagnant play, especially when rewards feel unattainable. The new Survival Mode abandons this in favour of a participation weighted reward pool, where the size of each bracket’s share of SPS depends on how much Collection Power (CP) was played within it over the season. The total pool is finite (initially 850,000 SPS), but how it gets divided is fluid and driven by player behaviour. That means the bracket with real activity earns real share of the rewards, a direct feedback loop between participation and payout.

• **Incentives reflect both effort and engagement**
The system calculates individual rewards based on a player’s share of total bracket reward shares (rshares), weighted further by how much SPS they have staked relative to others in that bracket. Purposeful staking deepens engagement, as players feel a stronger connection between their long-term decisions and their returns. Instead of being paid out based solely on arbitrary finish positions, players are rewarded for actual contribution to their bracket’s competitive ecosystem. This subtle shift in reward architecture can change the way players value wins and losses, treating each engagement as a measurable contribution to a larger economic game.

• **Brackets incentivize balanced population distribution**
Player behaviour naturally gravitates toward rewards, but if one bracket becomes overloaded while others languish, the reward system inherently corrects for this. A bracket with more CP means more SPS share, but individual earnings are diluted if too many players contribute. This self-balancing incentive can draw players to join underpopulated brackets where their individual rshare contribution is more meaningful, a clever psychological incentive that spreads activity more evenly across the ecosystem.

---

## **Automation vs Manual Play: A Behavioural Divergence**

• **Formalized automation legitimizes strategic diversity**
Survival Mode now explicitly differentiates between Active brackets (manual play) and Automated brackets (allowed third-party bots). While some players rail against automation on philosophical grounds, making it a clear and sanctioned choice respects player variety. A player who enjoys optimizing builds and adapting in real time can choose Active brackets, while another who seeks efficiency and volume may prefer Automated play. Rather than forcing a homogenized experience, this choice acknowledges diversity in how players derive satisfaction from competition.

• **Mental models differ between playstyles**
Active players often derive psychological reward from mastering mechanics and reading opponents. Automated players may feel gratification from maximizing throughput and efficiency. By giving both groups a legitimate lane, Survival Mode reduces tension between purists and efficiency-minded players, offering two equally viable psychological experiences within the same competitive framework.

---

## **Scaling Cooldowns: Balancing Pace and Risk**

• **Bracket-scaled cooldown percentages reshape risk**
Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all cooldown timer, Survival Mode now scales cooldown percentages based on bracket cap. Novice players face only 10 percent of standard cooldowns, while players in Silver and Gold tiers see 25 and 50 percent reductions, respectively. Higher brackets adhere to full cooldowns. This means that in lower tiers, losses sting less, encouraging experimentation, while in top tiers, loss avoidance remains a significant strategic consideration.

• **Cooldown mechanics as behavioural throttle**
Cooldowns function as behavioural regulators. Shorter cooldowns lower the penalty for risk-taking, prompting players to play more aggressively and learn faster. Longer cooldowns make each loss more consequential, elevating tension and deliberate decision-making. By tying cooldown severity to bracket level, Survival Mode nudges player behaviour in ways that align with skill and collection investment.

• **Transparency in formulas fosters trust**
Cooldown times are now calculated using a clear formula that factors in card rarity, level, and foil, and Gold foil cards receive half the cooldown of regular cards. Transparent cooldown math builds trust because players know the “rules of the treadmill.” They can optimize expectations, plan around cooldown windows, and make informed participation decisions.

---

## **Behavioural Game Theory and Community Impact**

• **Players are weighted toward activity, not idle participation**
Reward systems that prioritize active engagement, and then reward actual activity, typically outperform fixed ones in long-term retention. A shared reward pool where effort directly increases payout potential encourages consistent participation rather than sporadic bursts.

• **Bracket commitment creates social identity**
When players pick a bracket for an entire season, they are more likely to form social patterns around it. They begin comparing stats, strategies, and outcomes with peers within that bracket rather than against the entire player base. This fosters small-group identities, which are stronger engagement drivers than larger, diffuse communities.

• **Participation incentives have ripple economic effects**
As players chase easier rshare contributions in underpopulated brackets, the marketplace may see ripples in card demand for certain power levels or summoner combinations. Efficiently balancing bracket participation thus becomes an economic heartbeat, not just a gameplay outcome.

---

The return of Survival Mode is more than nostalgia. It is an experiment in player behaviour, incentive engineering and economic design. By dismantling cross-mode penalties, introducing dynamic brackets, and aligning rewards with actual engagement metrics, Splinterlands has created a mode that rewards activity and strategic choice rather than luck and status. This overhaul reflects a deep understanding of player psychology and competitive reward loops, and it will be fascinating to see how the meta evolves as players adapt.

Survival Mode now rewards participation over fear, choice over restriction, and strategy over randomness. Whether you thrive on manual PvP, enjoy automated optimization, or simply seek fair competition, the new structure offers layers of motivation few game modes attempt to balance. Only time will tell how deep these incentives run, but from where I stand, this redesign could be one of the most psychologically sound competitive systems Splinterlands has ever launched.

body.body:
Rogue Quest is a simple point-and-click adventure game that follows and explorer in her quest to retrieve the treasures of a former tyrant. She gets trapped because of her rivals mistakes, and the three of them have to find a way to the top. The game has a sense of humor, and as far as point-and-click games go, it was short and to-the-point.


The game is short, you could complete **Rogue Quest: The Vault of the Lost Tyrant** in less than an hour. 

While this game has generic mechanics and the story can be summarized in just two lines, the strong points is its characters. The tyrant is there as an AI after his death, and it's a funny story how he became an AI. I really liked the idiot pair of enemies and I think this game utilized its few characters quite well.

All in all, I'm glad I played this game.

Below you'll see my 1 hour and half playthrough, but be warned, I spent a long time backtracking (unnecessarily) with some puzzles as I didn't use a guide playing this game.

body.title: Staatsaufbau, Grundgesetz und Grundrechte XXXIII
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

nachdem wir uns jetzt einmal angeschaut haben wie die Meinungsfreiheit, die Kunstfreiheit und die Wissenschaftsfreiheit aussieht, haben wir heute und in den nächsten Posts die Versammlungsfreiheit vor uns. Heute schauen wir uns den Versammlungsbegriff einmal an und wie weit man einen Versammlungsbegriff fassen kann. 

#### Versammlungsbegriff
Wenn wir uns anschauen was eine Versammlung ist, dann treffen wir auf verschiedene Versammlungsbegriffe. Die erste Frage ist schon wie viele Teilnehmer eigentlich eine Versammlung braucht. Es gibt hier einige Definitionen, also haben wir wieder ein strittiges Thema. Manche sagen 2 Leute reichen aus, andere sind der Meinung das man 7 Personen braucht, da dies analog zum Vereinsrecht genommen ist. Die herrschende Meinung ist aber, dass 2 Leute ausreichen. Dazu kommt das der Zweck einer Versammlung umstritten ist. Wir kennen drei verschiedene Versammlungsbegriffe, den engen Versammlungsbegriff, den erweiterten Versammlungsbegriff und den weiten Versammlungsbegriff. Diese schauen wir uns jetzt aber noch einmal genauer an. Diese Einteilung unterscheidet den Zweck einer Versammlung.
#### Verschiedene Versammlungsbegriffe
Zuerst haben wir den engen und den erweiterten Versammlungsbegriff, wobei man sagen muss, diese beiden sind schwierig voneinander Abzugrenzen, weshalb im Zweifel eigentlich immer pro Versammlung entschieden wird. Beim engen Versammlungsbegriff haben wir einen Zweck zur kollektiven Meinungsbildung und Meinungsäußerung zu politischen oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten. Hier geht es um die Erörterung dieser öffentlichen Angelegenheiten. Dagegen umfasst der erweiterte Versammlungsbegriff auch die kollektive Meinungsbildung und Meinungsäußerung die auch private Angelegenheiten umfasst. In der herrschenden Meinung ist man der Ansicht, dass primär der enge Versammlungsbegriff gültig ist. Beim weiten Versammlungsbegriff geht es darum, dass der Zweck unerheblich ist. Es ist nur gefordert, dass es eine innere Verbundenheit zwischen den Teilnehmern gibt. Also das diese ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgen, wie zum Beispiel eine Fangruppe vom lokalen Fußballverein. Es ist eine Form der Persönlichkeitsentfaltung in Gruppenform. Was nicht betroffen ist, sind reine Zuschauerveranstaltungen. Also wenn 20 Fans in der Bar sich das Fußballspiel anschauen ist es keine Versammlung nach dem weiten Versammlungsbegriff. 20 Fans die sich am Stammtisch treffen um über Fußball zu diskutieren, aber schon. Sollte man eine gemischte Versammlung haben, zum Beispiel hat bei uns die Gewerkschaft einmal ein Konzert nach einer 1 Mai Kundgebung organisiert, dann gilt der Zweck als primär gültig, der im Vordergrund steht. Und zwar aus dem Betrachtungswinkel eines externen Beobachters. Deshalb ist zum Beispiel die Loveparade keine Versammlung, sondern eine Veranstaltung. 

So nachdem wir uns jetzt den Versammlungsbegriff näher angeschaut haben, schauen wir uns im nächsten Post einmal an was eigentlich alles keine Versammlungen sind, was es mit friedlich und ohne Waffen auf sich hat und welche Aktivitäten rund um eine Versammlung geschützt sind.

body.title: Jessie Ware, with a western twist.
body.body: <center>[uDiscoverMusic](https://www.udiscovermusic.com/news/jessie-ware-superbloom-new-album/)</center>\nWhile her next studio album (titled ***Superbloom***) is still a ways off (something that will only happen on **April 10th**, at least that's the confirmed official release date at this moment), **Jessie Ware** releases another single: *”Ride”*. Although the British artist stays within the essence of the already known - *and appreciated* - dance-pop and electro-pop rhythm, this time she delivered something a little \

to listeners... Another assertive point in her new phase.\nBy making a very efficient mix of 80s atmosphere (which is always used as a reference to create new musical tones in the modern music industry, which only proves the efficiency of this decade in the music scene) with some powerful synthesizers, Ware does an excellent job of harmonic interpolation, and bringing something that can be imagined as a fusion of the Wild West (inspired by **Ennio Morricone**'s classic soundtrack), the song is assertive.\nSupporting her new work based on the eurodance scene, one of the things I appreciate most about her work (of undeniable quality, by the way) is how well she manages to structure (and outline) the projects she is completely immersed in. This time she delved into the more \

pop (and I would have preferred to hear less of that in the music), but that doesn't make the work any less interesting... On the contrary, it's attractive and quite fun.\nTechnically, this is one of those songs that from the first moment you listen to it... You get the clear impression that it is a carefully thought-out, strategically well-executed and quite expensive work (due to the musical refinement that the technical part requires to polish this product). Ware's captivating voice is the \

where the important thing is just to have fun.
---
<center>**Jessie Ware, con un toque western.**</center.
Aunque su próximo álbum de estudio (titulado ***Superbloom***) aún está lejos (algo que ocurrirá el **10 de abril**, al menos esa es la fecha oficial confirmada por el momento), **Jessie Ware** lanza otro sencillo: *”Ride”*. Si bien la artista británica se mantiene dentro de la esencia del ya conocido - *y apreciado* - ritmo dance-pop y electro-pop, esta vez ofreció algo un poco fuera de lo común... Otro punto fuerte en su nueva etapa.
Al crear una mezcla muy eficiente de atmósfera ochentera (que siempre se usa como referencia para crear nuevos tonos musicales en la industria musical moderna, lo que demuestra la eficacia de esta década en la escena musical) con potentes sintetizadores, Ware realiza un excelente trabajo de interpolación armónica, aportando algo que podría considerarse una fusión del Salvaje Oeste (inspirada en la banda sonora clásica de **Ennio Morricone**), la canción es contundente.
Al apoyar su nuevo trabajo, basado en la escena eurodance, una de las cosas que más valoro de su obra (de innegable calidad, por cierto) es lo bien que logra estructurar (y esquematizar) los proyectos en los que está completamente inmersa. Esta vez se adentró en el pop más “chicle” (y hubiera preferido escuchar menos de eso en la música), pero eso no le resta interés... Al contrario, es atractiva y bastante divertida.
Técnicamente, esta es una de esas canciones que, desde el primer momento en que la escuchas... tienes la clara impresión de que se trata de una obra cuidadosamente pensada, estratégicamente bien ejecutada y bastante costosa (debido al refinamiento musical que requiere la parte técnica para pulir este producto). La cautivadora voz de Ware es la “guinda” del pastel, adentrándonos en una \

donde lo importante es simplemente divertirse. ---
**Jessie Ware, com um toque western.**
Enquanto o seu próximo álbum em estúdio (intitulado ***Superbloom***) não chega (algo que só vai acontecer no dia **10 de abril**, ao menos até este momento essa é a data confirmada do lançamento oficial), **Jessie Ware** lança mais um single: *”Ride”*. Apesar da britânica se manter dentro da essência do já conhecido - *e apreciado* - ritmo do dance-pop e electro-pop, dessa vez, ela entregou aos ouvintes algo um pouco “fora da caixa”... Um outro ponto assertivo em sua nova fase. Fazendo uma mistura muito eficiente de atmosfera dos anos 80 (que sempre é usada como referência para criar novos tons musicais na indústria da música moderna, o que só prova a eficiência dessa década no cenário musical) com alguns sintetizadores potentes, Ware faz um trabalho de interpolação harmônica de excelente qualidade, e trazendo algo que pode ser imaginado como uma fusão do faroeste (inspirado na trilha clássica de **Ennio Morricone**), a música é assertiva. Apoiando o seu novo trabalho na base do cenário eurodance, uma das coisas que eu mais aprecio no trabalho dela (de qualidade incontestável, aliás) é o modo como ela consegue estruturar (e delinear) tão bem os projetos nos quais ela está completamente imersa. Dessa vez ela mergulhou no pop mais “chiclete” (e eu preferia ter ouvido menos disso na música), mas isso não torna o trabalho em algo menos desinteressante... Pelo contrário, é algo atrativo e bem divertido. Tecnicamente, essa é uma daquelas músicas que desde o primeiro momento em que você a escuta... Você tem a nítida impressão de que se trata de um trabalho cautelosamente bem pensado, estrategicamente bem executado e bastante caro (devido ao refinamento musical que a parte técnica exige para lapidar esse produto). A voz envolvente da Ware é a “cereja” do bolo, nos fazendo mergulhar numa “realidade alternativa” onde o importante é apenas procurar diversão. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/jessie-ware-with-a-western-twist-brt)

body.title: Greed should be curbed.
body.body: is a common natural characteristic found in everyone in the world. There is no human being, animal or even insect in this world who does not have greed. Greed can be observed in every animal and most of all in humans. Although there is greed in animals for eating food, there is no greed in anything else, but in humans, just as there is greed for eating good food and chess, there is greed for various other things. This greed is a natural characteristic of us and although it is in everyone, it has a certain limit. If a person goes beyond our certain limit, that thing can cause us a lot of harm. Although the greed that we have for some things in our life is good, some greed is not good at all. If we pay a little attention, we can see that some people have a lot of greed for different foods, which means that some people are very fond of food. These people do not understand anything else except food. Some people's greed works for various other hobbies and hobbies. These greeds are not very bad and do not cause harm to others, but there are some greeds in humans that cause harm to others. There are some people who become very greedy for other people's things, such as being greedy for good clothes if someone else is wearing them, being greedy for other people's good things, and being greedy for other people's property. We are human beings, so it is natural for us to be greedy, but being greedy for these other people's things never suits us. We should own our own favorite things and the things we covet through hard work and earning money, that is, in the way that it can be made our own. If we like something, we can make that thing our own in the right way, but we should never take something from someone out of greed or hurt someone or even harm someone's life. We see many people around us who are greedy for money in various relationships, such as brothers, sisters, brothers, sisters, and others, and destroy the relationship by dividing or arguing over property. Money never brings us peace, so if we are greedy for money and cannot control it, then a lot of damage will come to our lives, and our loved ones may also suffer. And because of this greed, we can lose our close people and our beloved ones. So we have to start controlling greed from small things. If we can learn to control greed from small things and do not insist on making anything our own, then we will gradually be able to remove greed from big things or not be greedy. And as a result, we will be protected from many big losses in the future. Actually, greed for any thing never gives us anything good. Greed always works like a curse in our life. If we do not have greed, our life will be very beautiful, we will not lack anything and we will be able to fulfill every dream and we will get the necessary things. Greed does not help us in any way to get anything or achieve success in our life. Greed only brings harm and causes harm in our lives. So if we completely eliminate the thing called greed from our lives, it will not harm us in any way. But if we expose greed, we will be able to notice various problems in our lives. So we have to constantly try to control greed. Excessive greed always causes unrest in our lives. So if we can control greed, then only then will we find a beautiful path in our life and follow that path beautifully and get success. The weekend went well up here in the mountains, thankfully. It was colder, so we got out of bed a little late. body.title: Welcome Back to Haircut 100
body.body:
At first my teenage brother was a punk but about 1980 he transformed into a romantic. This was the beginning of the British New Romantic period and summed up no better than by the band called Haircut 100. Overnight he lost his blond spiky hair and pink pajamas with safety pins attached to looking like a preppy college boy. Thank goodness his relatives said!

Haircut 100 may be unknown to an American because they didn't make it big over there, but they were the poster boys over here. Formed in London they were led by the charismatic and boyish Nick Heyward. Along with his friend Les Nemes, they formed several punk bands before experimenting and forming Haircut 100 - a rather silly name - they would agree!

Known for their chunky knitwear, preppy style and infectious jazz-infused pop.

Between 1981 and 1982 they had no fewer than four Top 10 singles: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CAy-RxquZPk&list=RDCAy-RxquZPk&start_radio=1


Favourite Shirts {Boy Meets Girl)


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_msHpEa3_Y&list=RD5_msHpEa3_Y&start_radio=1
Love Plus One - my favourite.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BsF4suwvpsY&list=RDBsF4suwvpsY&start_radio=1



https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3he9CJCWmJA&list=RD3he9CJCWmJA&start_radio=1

Their debut albumn is a certified classic of the era.

![Haircut-100-Pelican-West-40-cover-967546388.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfVBV6kV3D49HMxLUNKfLnTNcfbD8NE77dQ5dxRC1z7Ze/Haircut-100-Pelican-West-40-cover-967546388.jpg)

Following a gruelling world tour and under pressure from the record company to release a second album Nick Heyward's mental health began to crack. he distanced himself from bandmates and was devastated as they proceeded to turn out an album without him, Paint and Paint, which failed to gain any traction. 

However I learnt recently they have reformed with the original line up, Heyward, Nemes, Graham Jones and Blair Cunningham. On March 20 they are releasing their first new album in 44 years titled Boxing the Compass. This will include new single The Unloving Plum.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=isLlvY_YGuI&list=RDisLlvY_YGuI&start_radio=1

To top off they are following this up with a UK tour this May. 

So in my opinion this is not just another 80s band reforming to cash in. They represent a specific kind of optimistic 80s feel that feels fresh again.

Te miré pasar con él
 algo loca lo diré
 y aunque no pude entender,
 ya mejor ni pregunté.

 En tus ojos ojos no miré
 la dulzura que extrañé,
 pasó el tiempo en un amén 
 tu belleza y tu desdén.

 Ahora veo, lo diré
 ya no hay nada y como ayer
 no te quiero ni querré 
 ya contigo amanecer.

 Aún así mueves tus caderas
 buscando la atención de los paseantes
 bailando muy lejos de la hoguera
 donde tu altar se dirigía como fiera.

 Y pasas las noches buscando cariño
 pero no encuentras consuelo
en la sonrisa de un niño,
 hoy que tu maternidad está dormida
 por la edad y la mentira.

Te miré pasar con él
 algo loca lo diré
 y aunque no pude entender,
 ya mejor ni pregunté.

 En tus ojos ojos no miré
 la dulzura que extrañé,
 pasó el tiempo en un amén 
 tu belleza y tu desdén.

 Ahora veo, lo diré
 ya no hay nada y como ayer
 no te quiero ni querré 
 ya contigo amanecer.

Poesía/ Rola y fotografía 
@ saulos

</center>

body.title: Un ave haciendo vida en el universo. Por @ramaco54.1
body.body:
>Buenos días amigos de Hive, les saluda su gran amigo el pintor Ramaco, quien les trae una nueva publicación artística, en esta oportunidad trabaje el arte digitalmente unida a mi creatividad, que es tanto para ustedes como para el universo entero, por lo tanto espero que disfruten esta artística y loca presentación.
Bienvenidos a ver mis ocurrencia artística o un hermoso paisaje, en el blog digital de Hive.

@ramaco54

La ilustración de hoy se titula.

Un ave haciendo vida en el universo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLAXG2iDYZm252UXRVa9eHM6cEeZbcvy7Q8QJuguji46/diapositiva8.bmp)

>Los materiales utilizados en esta ilustración artística son digitales, entre los que se pueden enumerar los siguientes: programa de digitalización Adobe Photoshop, para modificaciones, metamorfosis, creación de imágenes brillo y colorido digitales y Power Point, para pasar las imágenes a formato jpg.
PROCESO PASO A PASO.

>Amigo espectador, curador y fiel seguidor de mi trabajo en la plataforma de hive, el arte siempre ha tenido un lenguaje universal, y la creatividad de cada artista ha ido creciendo conjuntamente con los avances tecnológicos de la vida, por esta razón hoy doy a conocer mi trabajo artístico, por medio de las interesantes técnicas digitales, que explico de la siguiente manera.
EL INICIO.

>Interesantes manchas de color metalizados, se presentan en la diapositiva, con la intensión de transformarse, ya que visualmente genera un movimiento o la existencia de algo más...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRg3KZXkcY22Fa8Vz9uhRXSgWczMSxNZ6P2QjRM3Fa5FJ/diapositiva1.jpg)

>Observen amigos, la transformación visual se está haciendo realidad, ya está presente ante nuestra vista una hermosa ave de colores metalizados, y punto de luz y vida en su mirar.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzk6HsouCY3pRkohAcwFtqxzoNyhcRz4HtZ3L9Es4DwS/diapositiva3.jpg)

>Color y locura figurativa se pueden visualizar en el cuerpo del ave, mientras ella mira en el vacío oscuro, un aro prometiendo el universo entero.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJbJmXAEfuNJfqkJUtDjihJcEYDBy3Um1yW6nftJNHtc/diapositiva4.jpg)

>Mientras el ave abre las alas, el aro se empieza a transformar en algo más...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmew37Tc94cWgimxqm2j9XCa7vb3GiUZFdncuBmSCYXbWW/diapositiva5.jpg)

>Miren la luz del poder del universo a través de los ojos de un ave misteriosa.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRn7fDjAoKMuEHGYcZRzxVyJRnZ8gp6LpAXsH775MPkch/diapositiva6.jpg)

>La hermosura del universo se hace ilustración, reflejada en la añoranza de esta misteriosa ave, quien muestra en su ojos el brillo de emoción...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxy9F551cQYHNMHdK2eqFoM5FDs2No4H5RLszQgLc2hE/diapositiva7.jpg)

>Observen la armonía del color en la ilustración que llevo al ave a experimentar la belleza del universo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAW4oJY5w8vGQRZY9rttKiYpWQDENWAB3fpa3Fm5mjQA/diapositiva8.jpg)

>Interesante obra ilustrada que muestra la dedicación en cada color, detalle, desde el fondo hasta la figura del ave conforman una obra, una historia, que nace de la creatividad y convirtiéndose en:

Un ave haciendo vida en el universo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLAXG2iDYZm252UXRVa9eHM6cEeZbcvy7Q8QJuguji46/diapositiva8.bmp)

>Bien amigos espectadores, curadores y fieles seguidores de mi trabajo artístico, la creatividad es parte del ser humano, y fluye cuando uno la estimula a diario, por esta razón hoy les traigo esta sencilla pero muy creativa obra realizada con arte digital, que me inspiro desde el primer momento, porque si yo tuviera la oportunidad de volar por el universo, lo haria con la misma ilusión reflejada el ave en la ilustración y llevaría conmigo a mis fieles mascotas, que en esta oportunidad forma parte de esta nueva publicación.\n\n

>Espero de todo corazón que les haya gustado esta sencilla nacida del surrealismo y mundo de los sueños, porque quien ha visto un ave volar por la inmensidad del universo.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Un abrazo, los quiero mucho.

@ramaco54

________________________________________________________ >

>Good morning, Hive friends! This is your great friend, the painter Ramaco, bringing you a new artistic post. This time, I've combined digital art with my creativity, which is for you and the entire universe. I hope you enjoy this artistic and whimsical presentation. >
Welcome to see my artistic musings or beautiful landscapes on the Hive digital blog.
>

@ramaco54

>
Today's illustration is titled:
>

A bird making life in the universe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLAXG2iDYZm252UXRVa9eHM6cEeZbcvy7Q8QJuguji46/diapositiva8.bmp)

><div class=\

>Dear viewer, curator, and loyal follower of my work on the Hive platform, art has always had a universal language, and the creativity of each artist has grown alongside technological advancements. For this reason, today I present my artistic work through interesting digital techniques, which I explain as follows. >
THE BEGINNING.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRg3KZXkcY22Fa8Vz9uhRXSgWczMSxNZ6P2QjRM3Fa5FJ/diapositiva1.jpg)

>Look, friends, the visual transformation is becoming a reality. A beautiful bird with metallic colors is already before our eyes, a point of light and life in its gaze.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzk6HsouCY3pRkohAcwFtqxzoNyhcRz4HtZ3L9Es4DwS/diapositiva3.jpg)
>

>Color and figurative madness can be seen in the bird's body, as it gazes into the dark void, a ring promising the universe. whole.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJbJmXAEfuNJfqkJUtDjihJcEYDBy3Um1yW6nftJNHtc/diapositiva4.jpg)

>As ​​the bird opens its wings, the hoop begins to transform into something more...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmew37Tc94cWgimxqm2j9XCa7vb3GiUZFdncuBmSCYXbWW/diapositiva5.jpg)
>

>See the light of the universe's power through the eyes of a bird mysterious.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRn7fDjAoKMuEHGYcZRzxVyJRnZ8gp6LpAXsH775MPkch/diapositiva6.jpg)
>

>The beauty of the universe becomes an illustration, reflected in the longing of this mysterious bird, whose eyes show the sparkle of emotion...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxy9F551cQYHNMHdK2eqFoM5FDs2No4H5RLszQgLc2hE/diapositiva7.jpg)
>

>Observe the harmony of color in the illustration that led the bird to experience the beauty of universe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAW4oJY5w8vGQRZY9rttKiYpWQDENWAB3fpa3Fm5mjQA/diapositiva8.jpg) >

>An interesting illustrated work that shows dedication in every color and detail. From the background to the figure of the bird, they form a work, a story, born from creativity and becoming: >

A bird making life in the universe.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRLAXG2iDYZm252UXRVa9eHM6cEeZbcvy7Q8QJuguji46/diapositiva8.bmp) >

>Well, friends, viewers, curators, and loyal followers of my work In art, creativity is part of being human, and it flows when we stimulate it daily. For this reason, today I bring you this simple yet very creative piece created with digital art, which inspired me from the very first moment. If I had the opportunity to fly through the universe, I would do so with the same enthusiasm reflected in the bird in the illustration, and I would take my faithful pets with me, who are also part of this new post.


><div class=\

>I sincerely hope you enjoyed this simple piece born from surrealism and the world of dreams, because who has ever seen a bird fly through the vastness of the universe? >
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
>

body.title: My Country: Achievements, Problems and Prospects
body.body:
Hello to all hive users 🤗❤️🙏
Hope you all are healthy and doing great in your life🙂


Friends, whatever country you live in, events occur daily. Some are good, some are bad. Some people are happy with a government decision, while others are unhappy. Similarly, every country has its own unique perspectives, and it's best to ask the people themselves. If we look closely, very few people are happy with the government, saying that it has done a good job and that they are very satisfied with its work. Many people point out various flaws in the government's work. This is logically correct, but this isn't the case everywhere. In some countries, the government does good work and is also concerned about the public. Now, let me tell you about my country. I live in India, a country of diversity. A variety of dialects and languages are spoken here. Our country is the largest democracy. If we were to discuss what's good in India today, I would first talk about this.  The best thing happening in India is the expansion of technology. Because of this expansion, developments are taking place in the educational, medical, and other fields, providing convenience to the public. Thanks to technological advancements, internet access is now available in every village, at affordable prices. UPI transactions are proving extremely helpful, eliminating the hassle of carrying cash, allowing for easy and secure transactions. As villages are developing and people are gaining access to connectivity, rural residents will no longer lack access to education. They can study online, and they don't necessarily have to travel to other cities for their education. They can access various online courses from the comfort of their homes, which is a significant time-saver. Children who can't afford to live in cities can study comfortably at home, making this a valuable option.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3y1EZX3okv4iLNbHVStfVv2ouLyZVz7uWLf6cGQR4Do/1771660257198.png)

Image Generated By Chatgpt 




Digital India has brought a lot of digitization to many people, providing them with better services, and reducing corruption and other scams. In the past, even small tasks required frequent visits to government offices, and sometimes, some officials wouldn't even work without bribes. However, with digitization, many services have become online, eliminating the need to leave their homes. All work is done from the comfort of their homes.

This was about the good things in our country. Now, if we discuss the things that we're sad about, the one thing that I find most concerning is the growing unemployment in our country. Our country's population is quite large, and compared to that population, jobs are very few. Nowadays, even getting a small job requires a lot of hard work. If we talk about government jobs, there are far fewer vacancies than before, and the competition for the ones that do come up is so intense that even those who have been preparing for years find it difficult to get selected. The government is reducing vacancies and has started outsourcing much of its work to contractors, so the government doesn't need to hire employees or anything else. They simply need to convince the contractor, who then hires employees at a lower salary, according to their own calculations.  If we talk about a data entry operator, a government data entry operator is paid a salary of approximately 25,000 to 30,000 Indian Rupees. Furthermore, the government also provides for a provident fund. There is a compulsory employment rule until the employee reaches 60 years of age. However, since the introduction of the contract system, contractors have been able to hire data entry operators at will, paying them 10,000 to 12,000 Indian Rupees, and then getting them to do more. This is deeply wrong. The government should publish vacancies so that the youth here will have confidence in the government. Secondly, finding a job in the private sector is extremely difficult, as they are often required to pay very low wages, and in many companies, there is a form of exploitation, and no one speaks out against this. If anyone speaks out, they will be the first to lose their job. The biggest compulsion for people here is to work.  The government should at least ensure that one person in every family has a government job so that every family has at least enough money to support itself and does not have to worry about jobs. The problem of unemployment is increasing because jobs are decreasing. Many companies are using automated systems, which are done by machines and do not require many people. The government should focus on increasing employment. Everyone should have a job when money is available and attention should be paid to how employment can be increased without corruption.
Many Changes are required.




Thanks for reading my post till the end. 
If you have any suggestions or feedback then please comment down.

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1819
Saturday 21, February 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1884
Noxsoma Life Camp: https://noxsoma.substack.com/
The Substack Experience

![1884.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRrePB59Pt4qDqJs3dxeTSSA7VDq4TtjfWGd3E69J14n/1884.png)

Victory 
Hubcap Nostalgia  
Replacing an entrenched mindset with a better one.    

Today's Episode:	https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1819_full_2-21-26_1884_substack:2?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 

The Trap of Reaction (Preview Segment)

This is where the transition gets dangerous. The human mind abhors a vacuum. When you leave a rigid mindset, the temptation is not to find truth, but to find the opposite of what you left.

If the Church told you that the world began six thousand years ago, the reactive mind rushes to worship Richard Dawkins with the same fervor it once reserved for the Pope. If the military told you to trust the government blindly, the reactive mind assumes every single headline is a lie. If your parents watched Fox News, you start getting all your information from a TikTok influencer with a ring light and a grudge.

This is not freedom. This is just wearing the enemy's clothes inside out. You are still letting the old structure dictate your terms. They said \

But you are still playing their game of chess; you just switched sides.

 The Architecture of the New World

So how do you build a better mindset without simply building the old one in reverse? How do you replace the fortress with a home?

The first step is accepting intellectual humility. In your old system, you had all the answers (or the institution did). In the new space, you have to become comfortable with the phrase, \

Leaving mainstream media doesn't mean you suddenly know the truth; it means you admit that the truth is harder to find than a thirty-second segment. It means reading three sources, including the ones that bore you.

The second step is curating your loneliness. When you leave a tribe, you are statistically likely to join another one quickly to stop the pain. The better mindset resists this. It understands that the period of wandering in the desert is necessary. It is in the desert that you discover what you actually believe, not just what you were told to believe. It means finding friends who don't need you to agree with them on everything to break bread with you.

The third step is building a practice, not a doctrine. A veteran might replace the structure of the barracks with the discipline of a morning run or a woodworking shop. The former evangelical might replace Sunday service with a Sunday hike—a ritual of awe without the liturgy. The media skeptic might replace the nightly news with deep-dive history books, gaining context instead of clicks. A doctrine tells you what to think. A practice gives you something to do while you figure out what to think.
