body.title: RECICLANDO Y CREANDO PARA MI HOGAR ♻️ // RECYCLING AND CREATING FOR MY HOME ♻️
body.body:
![Polish_20260219_194259395.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/48TomF1TnLJtr7rgi876cv8aVps9oC8y4MeuPAGuCksQ7nurHqZpvFLYcfjMTUjWph.jpg)

Hola queridos amigos de esta linda, dinámica y prestigiosa comunidad, es un placer para mí estar de nuevo con ustedes. Luego de unos días de ausencia motivado a las ocupaciones de ama de casa, madre y cuidadora, he vuelto. 
En esta ocasión vengo a presentarles una manualidad realizada con material descartable, he reciclado ♻️ una franela de mi hijo y con ella pude hacer dos limpiadores para mí baño (esponjitas) y estos dos hermosos y muy prácticos agarra ollas. Todo el proceso lo disfruté muchísimo ya que hacer estas labores en mi tiempo libre me permite relajarme y liberar un poco la mente de mortificaciones. Espero que disfruten del proceso y se animen a recoger esas franelas que ya no quieren usar y las transformen. ¡Bienvenidos! 

>Hello dear friends of this beautiful, dynamic, and prestigious community, it is a pleasure for me to be with you again. After a few days of absence due to my duties as a housewife, mother, and caregiver, I am back. 
This time, I'm here to show you a craft made from disposable materials. I recycled ♻️ one of my son's flannel shirts and used it to make two bathroom cleaners (sponges) and these two beautiful and very practical pot holders. I really enjoyed the whole process, as doing these crafts in my free time allows me to relax and free my mind from worries. I hope you enjoy the process and are inspired to collect those flannel shirts you no longer want to wear and transform them. Welcome! 

### RECICLANDO Y CREANDO PARA MI HOGAR ♻️
### RECYCLING AND CREATING FOR MY HOME ♻️

Para realizar está manualidad de reciclaje ♻️ utilicé los siguientes **materiales**:

👕 Tela de franela reciclada. 
👕 Tijeras. 
👕 Aguja para 🧶 tejer, crochet número 7mm. 
👕 Aguja e hilo 🧵 de coser. 

>To make this recycled craft ♻️, I used the following **materials**:

>👕 Recycled flannel fabric.
>👕 Scissors.
>👕 Knitting needle, 7 mm crochet hook.
>👕 Sewing needle and thread. 


![Polish_20260219_194418650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/48XeuRSx89BVWt5bJa4JFKLq6Pd16s3os6fPasDpPyugEoZv1pFB3t4snEFS3BB3n8.jpg)

Mi hijo compró esta franela y él mismo la estampó. Por un lado dibujó la imagen relacionada con un emprendimiento que tenía para el momento y por el otro dibujó y pintó el logo de HIVE. Le dió mucho uso. Es una franela larga de tela de algodón, delgada. La elegí para reciclar ♻️ porque aún tiene mucha tela en buenas condiciones. Me dió dolor tener que cortar los dibujos, pero no me quedaba otra opción. 

>My son bought this T-shirt and printed it himself. On one side, he drew an image related to a business venture he had at the time, and on the other, he drew and painted the HIVE logo. He wore it a lot. It's a long, thin cotton T-shirt. I chose to recycle it ♻️ because it still has a lot of fabric in good condition. It pained me to have to cut up the drawings, but I had no other choice. 


![Polish_20260220_221650926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/EpEKC1U9gzdxjcW6gZkf2asS8Zp8XoYXhrkzbxo4nmKScWw2xGiFVb6fDqV9yZQgVbz.jpg)

♻️ Entonces lo que hice fue tomar las tijeras ✂️ y empezar a cortar toda la franela, la intención era hacer con ella material para tejer, es un material que llamamos **trapillo** artesanal. Mi mamá me ha servido de motivación porque desde que le enseñé a reutilizar y a tejer en redondo ella no desperdicia nada, incluso pide que le lleven ropa vieja para convertirla en alfombras o tapetes. De esta franela saqué dos agarra ollas y dos esponjas para lavar los lavamanos. La verdad es que me parece que rindió. 

>♻️ So what I did was take the scissors ✂️ and start cutting up all the flannel. The idea was to use it to make knitting material, which we call **handmade yarn**. My mom has been a source of motivation for me because ever since I taught her how to reuse and knit in the round, she doesn't waste anything. She even asks people to bring her old clothes so she can turn them into rugs or mats. From this flannel, I made two pot holders and two sponges for washing sinks. I think it was worth it. 



![GIF_20260220_225954_434.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/23xVKE26puFy69tAwptLTYZFBNuNrK3QLfDugVTkj53dx67UPohGGWVQB2L8YW9Jc1Gm1.gif)

♻️ El proceso para 🧶 tejer fue sencillo, pero no rápido. La tela es un poco flexible y debí ser muy cuidadosa para ir tejiendo sin que se fuera estirando. Primero intenté tejer con puntos altos, luego decidí tejer con puntos bajos. Una vez que terminé de tejer me di cuenta que con puntos bajos el agarra ollas con este trapillo quedó muy firme, ideal para tapetes de cocina, sin embargo siempre tejí los agarra ollas porque es lo que necesito. 
Cómo todo tejido circular empecé tejiendo un anillo mágico y dentro seis u ocho puntos bajos. A partir de allí fui haciendo aumentos en cada vuelta hasta lograr el tamaño que necesito para los agarra ollas. 

>♻️ The knitting process was simple, but not quick. The fabric is a little flexible, and I had to be very careful to knit without stretching it. First, I tried knitting with double crochet stitches, then I decided to knit with single crochet stitches. Once I finished knitting, I realized that with single crochet stitches, the pot holders made with this fabric were very firm, ideal for kitchen mats, but I always knit pot holders because that's what I need. 
Like all circular knitting, I started by knitting a magic ring and then six or eight single crochet stitches inside it. From there, I increased on each row until I achieved the size I needed for the pot holders. 



![Polish_20260220_221932845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AKSdzWQYzHEKU3g4v3GZfDwY3TuGDEtZc4dWqLive5fFfF277i82DjT6ytpX3ue.jpg)

Me encantaría tener el poder adquisitivo para comprar trapillo comercial y hacer bolsos y carteras. Es uno de mis sueños. Dios permita que la economía en el país mejore para lograr hacerlo. Como ven, estos agarra ollas tejidos con puntos bajos quedan bien cerrados, no muy flexibles, pero si cumplen con la función de agarrar el mango del sartén y las asas de las ollas. Para agarrar las tapas necesitaré unos más delgados y flexibles. 

>I would love to have the purchasing power to buy commercial fabric yarn and make bags and purses. It's one of my dreams. God willing, the country's economy will improve so that I can do it. As you can see, these pot holders knitted with single crochet stitches are tightly closed, not very flexible, but they do the job of gripping the handle of the pan and the handles of the pots. To grip the lids, I will need thinner and more flexible ones. 



![GIF_20260219_210413_725.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/23wWvxNCnoxZxoZWQW3hvfXdCj67zpz7dyrjKEL8kLoQwfNWwJfyEt95ojozu8cZmEUQh.gif)

Antes de finalizar la labor, tomé hilo 🧵 y aguja de coser para hacer algunos remates en el inicio del tejido ya que como la tela es ♻️ reciclada podría desatarse al momento del lavado. 

>Something else I really enjoy is knitting with this size seven crochet hook. Although I love knitting small things 😊, I have learned to enjoy knitting with thicker materials. 
Before finishing the project, I took some thread and a sewing needle to make some finishing touches at the beginning of the crochet, since the fabric is recycled and could come undone when washed.
 

![Polish_20260219_194610154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AK9QUAmh2A2pv5DS27x5NyNE9xzdZmHMB6qQyadriK8hM46DmGhzDKE7LR71MZA.jpg)

### Digital paintings... (3D art #1536) #### Hello friends,

I hope you are all having a beautiful day. Today I want to share another artwork I created in Cinema4D and the creative journey behind it. This piece started as an abstract 3D composition. I designed a circular geometric structure with white marble-like forms and subtle red glowing accents. In the center, I placed a sculpted face, keeping the overall look symmetrical and dramatic. At first, it was just an artistic experiment with form, balance, and lighting. After finishing the render, I imagined what would happen if this sculpture could come to life. So I reworked the idea in Grok and transformed the central face into a joyful mythical girl. I kept the circular structure as a magical halo and used the red glow as part of her energy and aura. The final result became a bright, fairy-like character with long flowing hair and unique makeup, inspired directly by the original shapes and colors of my 3D design. It was exciting to see how a cold, sculptural form could turn into something warm and alive. I’m sharing both the process and the final transformation with you, and I would love to know which version you prefer — the abstract sculpture or the living fantasy character? ✨

>Good evening how are you guys, hope you have a nice day. And as usual, On this occasion, I am not like usual who always wanders in the forest, and today I returned to hunting in a large field but it has been overgrown with weeds and other wild plants because this field is no longer maintained, and this field is not far from where I live because it is in the next village, and at that time I immediately explored this field and hoped to get some species of small animals for my post this time.

body.title: How I was selected in the job interview.
body.body: Greetings friends! ================== I was jobless till yesterday. Today, I got a dream job. For this I had to appear in the job interview. Let's see what happened there:

>I was jobless for many days. I tried in various companies but they already had hired employees. So, I had no choice but to wait. One day I saw a job advertisement in the local newspaper. A big company was hiring skilled workers. Everyone knows that I am a skillful person. So, I applied for the job. There dozens of aspirants had come. Competition was very tough. But I was full of confidence. I had to face the interview there.

>They asked the candidates that who knows Python. I raised my hands while half others denied. So, half of the candidates were ordered to left. Then they asked about anaconda. Remaining half of the candidates had no knowledge of it. So, they were ordered to left. Finally, they asked who is familiar with Java. Only I left my hand. So, I was selected.

>I have to work with python and anaconda. I had a pet python at my home. So, anaconda won't be a challenge for me. I can visit Java and Sumatra if they like. I know I am not going to have a tough time there. But I have no idea why are they obsessed with animals like python and place like Java? Do you have any idea?

body.title: A leizure stroll across St.Petersburg streets for #streetphoto back in May 2024 (11 photos)
body.body:
>

\nAll of a sudden, I had a rush for tinking with my photos and spent a few happy hours digging my folders, watching captures and polishing nails captures in photoshop. My photoshop meditations is one of the best ways to spend time. I invite you on a stroll through the streets of St. Petersburg. No dreary autumn or deathly frozen city – only warm, gentle summer and clear well-washed spring! No more words, just enjoy the visuals.\n

>

Сегодняшним утром меня охватило внезапное желание покопаться в фотоархиве, и я провел несколько счастливых часов копаясь в папках и фотошопя снимки (медитации в фотошопе — один из моих любимых способов провести время). Приглашаю вас на прогулку по улицам Петербурга; никакой унылой осени или мерзлой зимы - только теплое ласковое лето и прозрачная, хорошо умытая весна!

--------- ![2024-jun-7616w-h2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23yJNm3FmHZYQva2LqxwrZQwbKF2rJY9vUwJPcq2dupDGmX4ysKjxwuCiZ1b3HMCUVFoG.jpg) Flower seller girls. (Photo was taken at a fencing festival). I was deeply impressed by the image (characteer) created by the old man in the white shirt on the left. Perfecto! ![2024-may-3529w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wMeapkccFPTkvCxGDyzTB8FA4oiDNnKNSoTDaTJWB7zvJczL87mw82ViswJvXJ3LeoA.jpg) Old boys are still in love with toy cars... ![2024-may-4773w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23u6BZYNx1WFe89fqvaY4KVWyHC9m4Fyo1ujPnVNPHApYRQXCUmuQsByqiJFmdb4NiNdn.jpg) This old-style street musicial isnt a busker - old man actually is promoting performances of the City Circus. ![2024-may-4813w-h1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23zGeiTXoAuLLcDkFpZnQgxgU1G31oUo8cMjAJx2qwNWrRkpof6JvKuNHycVjDYUhVZPx.jpg) Break dancers at Nevsky avenue - the main street of the city. ![2024-may-4978w-h1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23uQr54SLhadZpwoCiDRpdTXqPLDn4CbgDtZsjYhAmCZtdSuGctppTsAHbRindiriMzDN.jpg) An avid fan of reading. ![2024-may-5058w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23x1AzgcFEk5JatEAyu4ExAn46JSTyjxsmhfXhmdqwANKPUvXVjQWkwaQMiwK7kmkXxbZ.jpg) Baloon seller - hunter for the tourists and their money. ![2024-may-5095w-h1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23w2mSD8mEgfp73V2EAffzfL9tJ4YB4F83rw7BQG4NWKjkZybuLmbhUw8Wb7SLx1bCvjh.jpg) Everybody likes baloons... body.title: How I made this bubu Kimono Jacket
body.body: Hello everyone I welcome you to my blog, happy weekend, I hope you find this resourceful on how I made this bubu for my customer. She came with African Print (Ankara) 2 yards and crepe plain material, black to be precise of 1 trouser (45 inches per 60 inches), you can work with Aso -Oke or denim material depending on what the customer wants. This crepe will be at the tip of the ankara fabric, the sleeve, the neck, and the down part, I folded into 4 inches in a way that I wouldn't need to join the shoulder again. The front and the back I cut it together.

> I deducted the 5 inches I will be using from the actual length, that is the person's top length is 36 I will minus 5 inches making 32 and the sleeve is 18, I will minus 5 making 13, but I added extra allowance because it is a bubu and I have to use the same measurements through it down and the biggest circumference is the hip, her hip is 41, I divided by 4 which is 10.25, so i made it 10 and 1/2 inch,I added extra 5 inches for the freeness now making 16 inches.

> After cutting the sides, I chalked out the neck, the neck depth I used for the front was 8 inches while the back 1 inch because I am not joining the shoulder, then I used the wideness as 3 inches for both,I made the front to be in a form of V shape, then I cut it, I slit it open. I cut all the crepe I will be needing which is 10 inches when folded into 2 becomes 5 inches. I pinned it down to secure this material and prevent it from sliding, I sew it by half of an inch, this was how I did it for all the down, sides and neck region, the width of the crepe for the neck is 5 inches, when folded it becomes 2 and 1/2 inches, it won't be wide like the others and really long, I used iron to press it, then i fixed it.

> I made sure I was done with fixing the crepe, before I cut the pocket, the pocket is 11 inches in length and 9 inches in width, I measured from shoulder to 17 inches which is waist and where I will be placing the pocket, I made sure it is in the middle of the Ankara fabric, 4 inches apart. To join the sides like the bubu I measured from shoulder to 11 inches that was where I stitched it down. Note that I didn't stitch to the 5 inches, I stopped stitching where the ankara fabric ends. Trying it on the mannequin.

body.title: One Of the Most Important  Things For Your Future
body.body: ![FindFamily.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbwA71jYpHH7chDViDZ7ZPAZNU674hLHHRgUbWJ9DjXcg/FindFamily.png)\n\nOne of the biggest, and most important things to you personally, is finding your tribe/your \

.

Bigger than the coming banking system collapse.
Bigger than the unCivil wars.
Bigger than the stock market collapse and the later multi-national-corporation collapses.

Although those are big things, finding your tribe is the beginning of a new paradigm.  It is the giving up of the everyone for themselves paradigm.  And it the rejection of the everyone as a collective paradigm.  It is the start of interdependence.  And that changes everything.

So many of the children born today lived traumatic childhoods.  And, these children, who became adults, were told to just stuff it, and so, never heal, passing it to the next generation.  A larger \

than just the nuclear family, solves so much of this. Welfare will be handled by your peers. People who have a direct connection with you. People who know what you need. Not some bureaucrats behind soulless computers. Basically, so much of what you actually need is provided living in a intentional community. Made of people that you choose to live with. So much that you didn't know you were missing.

> ## Ending childhood trauma Childhood trauma that ends in CPTSD doesn't really happen because of the trauma, it happens because no one is there, that believes them, and offers a way to resolve it. The actual trauma is from not having a way out. Being/feeling trapped. With more that just a mother and a father, so much of the trauma doesn't get a chance to form into CPTSD. There are other adults to go to. Children are not trapped in bad relationships, with no one to help, and without a different view of how things can be. More parental figures gives more viewpoints, more people to ask, and most importantly, someone to runaway to. (The child does not feel as trapped) Maybe we will really break the childhood trauma cycle. Hurt people, hurt, people. A child traumatized will traumatize their children, unless they do serious healing work on themselves.

> ## Fear, seriously mitigated. So much fear, especially for women, comes from not having anyone who actually cares for them. It is them against the world, and the world can be very scary. When you are in the big city, you need a job, so you can buy food. Your eating relies on you keeping a job. You are trusting in a boss/company, that doesn't really care about you. And trusting in a grocery store, that doesn't really care about you. So many moving pieces. The floor could fall out from beneath you at any moment. Starvation is around every corner. In a small community, with your tribe, everyone is working on maintaining food production. Some people milking cows, some people collecting eggs, some people growing vegetable, others growing livestock. It is all by a group of people who want everyone to be fed; no one to go hungry. Where excess is good. Not like crony-capitalism where excess means someone doesn't get paid for growing. In the city, when you are walking down the street (at night, of course) there are just strangers. You don't know what they will do. The next one you meet could be a criminal out to rob you, if you are lucky. That would be a much better outcome then the things you are having run through your mind. Being in a small community of less then 100 people means you can know each person. In a big city, your brain cannot hold that much information, that many connections, so you end up with many meaningless connections, and those connections have a limit. Your brain can't hold any more. And when you know everyone, meetings, even on the street at night is usually good. Someone you know. Someone you may have been looking forward to talking to. The fear/stress levels are much lower.

></center>
## Not for money

In an intentional community the work is not for money.  Everyone helps with the farming.  Everyone is a part time farmer.  The electricity is made by systems that the community owns, maintains and runs.  The community is almost self sufficient.

And so, things that people need, that are made inside the community, aren't sold for money.  It might be traded, or bartered, or just made out of the goodness of their heart.

Of course there will be a \

business. What the community makes to trade/exchange/sell to other communities. Something that allows the tribe to get things it can't make/grown themselves. This really changes peoples views about money. No one can really get rich; make people jealous, without improving the quality of living for everyone.
></center>\n\nI call it the Great Migration. (and some others call it that too) We are, as a planet, going to seek out our tribes/\

.\n\nGovernments are going to become something completely different.  As you can see, from what i have written, so much of what the govern-cement today does will be useless, unneeded, unwanted by the \

in the future.  Welfare will be handled locally. Criminal acts will be handled locally. Laws will be handled locally.  Food will be handled locally.  No police, no taxes, no electric grid.

The things government may do is to actually offer help, when asked, to solve a problem a community runs into and cannot find a solution for.  A wise council, that is actually wise.

To the people in the community, life will be so much better.  So much less stress, fear.  And a feeling of connection, safety.

However, you, me, we, will have to work out interpersonal communication and problem solving in a way we haven't done for a while.  Instead of running away, or closing ourselves off, we must work things out.

Things will get a LOT better.  And the world will get a LOT better.

So, keep an eye out for your \

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

Ingredients such as daikon radish, konjac, eggs, and various fish cakes are slowly simmered in a light dashi broth, bringing out the natural umami of each ingredient. Protein is provided by items made from fish paste—such as chikuwa, satsuma-age, and ganmodoki—while daikon and konjac are low in calories and contain dietary fiber. Enjoyed together with the warm broth, this meal gently warms the body and is easy to digest, making it a comforting, home-style dish. Overall, oden is relatively low in fat and features a wide variety of ingredients, making it a representative Japanese seasonal dish. --- 🇸🇪 Svenska 🍽 ① Måltidens innehåll Oden (japansk vintergryta) Daikonrättika Kokt ägg Konnyaku (konjakrot) Chikuwa (rörformad fiskkaka) Satsuma-age (friterad fiskkaka) Ganmodoki (friterad tofubiff med grönsaker) Atsuage (tjock friterad tofu) Olika sorters friterade fiskpastejprodukter Varmt te 📝 ② Beskrivning av måltiden Dagens måltid kretsar kring oden, en klassisk japansk vinterrätt. body.title: Captain Fellblade — Opportunity Ability Destroyed the Enemy Backline
body.body:
![night reaper.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tbijTdxowWYuBx1CW8oRJmCNbSTGJ93Ytc8tHfjUk5VopQVG1rbW5ogqq5UsrmasTq9.png)


Today in a 38 mana battle a wonderful match was seen. Before the battle even started I saw the opponents lineup and it was completely filled with 7 monsters. That means he used every slot and selected as many monsters as possible. 

But I selected only 5 monsters. Obviously it was looking that he had more advantage but I focused on quality and strategy instead of quantity. This battle was totally focused on the strategy and that worked perfectly.

In 38 mana it is easy to make a strong lineup but wrong selection can also become the reason of defeat. Proper selection and positioning plays important role in winning the battle.

The opponent selected more support type monsters. I thought that I will select more tank type monsters so that their damage can be absorbed. If they have more support then their main tank will be weaker and if the tank falls early then the whole lineup gets disturbed.

![Screenshot 2026-02-21 114853.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/48Gg8MBNhZHitUFXh4Cairi7MwPyhCjNskBWeuuLrSiNw44a8uw3RL912sS1XV1ZgC.png)

That is why I kept a strong frontline tank which kept absorbing damage. Along with it I also selected ranged attack monsters so that direct pressure can be put on the backline. My plan was to first eliminate their weak support monsters so that in the end only their tank remains which is not getting any support.

When the battle started everything went exactly according to plan. My tank kept taking damage and from behind the ranged monsters kept doing their job. One by one the opponents backline monsters kept getting eliminated. When the support finished then their main tank was left alone. At that time it had neither healing nor extra damage support.

When monster selection is correct, positioning is correct and strategy is clear then victory is not difficult. In the same way in this 38 mana battle I got a wonderful win. Everything happened according to planning and I got a lot of satisfaction.

My favorite monster in this battle was Captain Fellblade. This is my favorite card and in this match it showed amazing performance. Its best ability is Opportunity which targets the monster with the lowest health. Because of this the opponents weak monsters were eliminated quickly.

![Screenshot 2026-02-21 114551.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/Eo4C6w9cfwRGYQApdU53S6BqfGeHRuEf9mQjowg2i2gwnPMdNQzDQa49Ak816sgLsUb.png)

Besides this its speed is also good which gives it the chance to attack first. The combination of high damage and good speed makes it very dangerous. But it also has a weakness. If it comes in the first position it cannot attack because it is a ranged monster. Its health is also not very high so protection is necessary.

What do you people think about this monster, have you played before? Tell about its any ability. Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Escalation, Land And Frontier What Is Next For Me
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23tm9YBb49GojUZ5R7NidcJBBa4SXQkYj5eLG5jvYrnpjGAaRLth5B5ksDbowCLLdMwr3.png Hallo splinter fam, Its weekend, coffee next to me, frontier battles done and my head is full of Splinterlands thoughts again 😄 So what better to do than start a small Hive blog and just ramble a bit about all the changes in the game, what is coming up and where my mind is going lately. There is honestly a lot going on and I keep jumping between topics in my head. Things that keep me busy right now * Escalation * Upcoming land buildings * Frontier almost 3 accounts maxed so what next * Frontier wheel spin * Extra glint Let’s dive in. #
Escalation From Zero To 100 Packs Real Quick
So yeah… about that. I went from “I will skip this one and save my SPS” to buying 100 packs so I can grab that 1 legendary promo. Classic me 😂 ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tkk11XcvzFjy8QhAKrurNoRecBVW3oAJ1QbGFj5vC6sFZphEnAbJMxTF6tNeyb5hdXQ.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t77B9uJiTZcS91AJKrKzpuzvZ3Tc97MRnVNwDBaVfKkkB2MC7RC2zSRRUe9cPMrVo4X.png) I still have not fully decided what to do with the packs. * Open directly? * Wait for better Black Foil chances? If I am honest, even if I open everything, I will not have enough to compete on a high level in Modern. I would probably end up in Silver which actually fits my spending level. Do I like that? Of course not. Meanwhile my bot is chilling in Wild in Diamond I or Champion earning way more than I ever could manually. So for now the bot stays active there. It just makes sense. Still funny how fast the mind can change when new shiny cards drop. #
Land Buildings Excited But Also Question Marks
You all know I love land. Can I already plan everything? No. Not really. Nothing is set in stone and everything shared can still change pretty easily. What we know * Buildings are coming * You can level them up * Worksites stay as they are now I really like this extra dimension. It adds complexity and decision making. That is what makes land interesting to me. Will it be beneficial for small players? That is still the big question. There will be choices to make and probably trade offs. What I really love is the idea that you can create buildings and other players can place orders to craft something (this benefits smaller players). That gives a real economy vibe. One big question in my head is about the building in a box. Is that meant also for land with a worksite? It feels a bit strange if building rarity does not really matter beyond common plots. Right now there is no clear reason to place a building on a higher rarity plot other than common. So I am watching this closely. Land is still my long term play. #
Frontier Still Loving It
I am still playing Frontier manually every single day on 3 accounts. Why? 1. Because it is fun. Even if at higher level it sometimes feels like paper rock scissors. 2. I am still trying to complete all cards on 3 accounts. About 95% earned, not bought. 3. The special jackpot cards are still very far away. Not even close on one account. That grind is real. ![Beaker007](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23wC16d9RbdCCjXRfJxKYWgh6NZ4hM6ekeBbkRKX5sKDyJ5BKYv6uK3N5aNfqQLiSoLbv.png) ![Shinoumonk](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23uEzCcJrbyJT6QmCFeJx1ukBpSbojPTSnfPegMJeLXUszmuvaDeJCKSSaHKRbBNPMj72.png) ![Beakerr](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23vhTqqM972azHrzSxJi5kokrK58Gc3fw36NgejCgRK8mzcnkWY7kJU17qCCGD9WJiac7.png) In the last Town Hall they mentioned a daily login bonus and a wheel spin. Not official yet but it is coming. My take As someone who plays daily anyway, I think it is fine. It will 100% help to bring players back every day. That is good for the game. But I am also a bit critical. There are more and more gambling style mechanics in the game. Ranked rewards, Frontier draws, All foil chances, now daily spin. I know almost every game does this. I will participate as well. Still, it is getting harder to keep track of all mechanics. Especially for new players. They also mentioned a new token Spark as Frontier glint. No real opinion yet. Just another thing to farm, track and optimize. They are clearly hitting the goal where you simply cannot do everything anymore. You need to specialize in what you enjoy and what fits your style and capital. #
Extra Glint The Temptation Is Real
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23t7936UpW9Q7GSDh75jkSWB6A6k7idJ9ta4kTBg3hZqk3dTzwpYoQWKJd9rJSA5nSDjz.png Man I want this. If I look at my latest season report I would lose around 1.5K SPS per season. In return I would gain around 235K extra glint. I think I would actually do that trade. Now the problem My bot plays way better than me and earns way more. So I bot my main account in Wild. Xbot currently has no option to enable the glint boost because they would lose the shared SPS. I looked at the Splinterhub bot as well. For my level and earnings it is too expensive. I think the price is fair because of the system they run. I expected it to be higher. I do not mind slightly lower earnings. But losing money is a no go. So for now I keep it as it is. I really hope Xbot finds a workaround. Maybe some kind of invoice system for the SPS that would have been earned when glint boost is enabled. That would be perfect. #
Wrapping Up Morning Thoughts
So there you have it. Just my weekend rambling. * Escalation hype * Land dreams * Frontier grind * Glint temptation I just finished my Frontier matches as well. Happy days. No extra card. No song. Sad times 😅 Will be back tomorrow. Beaker signing off, see you on the battlefield 👋 https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/splinterlands_logo.png Do you also want to be part of this amazing play to earn game consider using my [refferal](https://splinterlands.com?ref=beaker007) link.

body.title: Let Today Be Just Enough
body.body:
![17716011424448253035954491256212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/48PTNtfzTADky45zmd1JmrKTxiU6dxFHDPGFe7xLiKiRKUMTDTnTERPsVwmdgr6KGK.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)





<center>I catch the yearning, I notice how my mind keeps reaching for something bigger, as if this moment isn’t enough to hold me,
I catch the yearning, I see how I postponed peace as if it were something earned after achievement, and then questioned why relief never stayed,
I catch the yearning, I confess I’ve fed myself fantasies like sugar, sweet in the moment and hollow after, quietly training my heart to crave more than it can hold,
I catch the yearning, is this craving helping me live or quietly stealing the life I’m already in,
I catch the yearning, I return my focus to what is real and remain with it without rushing ahead…



<center>I envy the imagined, I feel how comparison drains the color from the present when I hold it up to a dream still unearned,
I envy the imagined, I admit I chase the feeling of “soon,” like the promise of later is more comforting than the honesty of the “now”,
I envy the imagined, I confess that longing can feel refined and almost noble, yet it quietly steals appreciation from the life already in my hands,
I envy the imagined, am I willing to release the version of life I keep polishing in my head and engage with the one in front of me,
I envy the imagined, I soften my grip and let just today be enough…



<center>I choose what quietly sustains me, I notice happiness isn’t loud for me, it’s quiet and steady, and my restless side keeps mistaking quiet for lack,
I choose what quietly sustains me, I admit I’ve treated contentment like complacency, as if constant wanting were proof of ambition, even when that wanting made me sharp and impatient,
I choose what quietly sustains me, I see how I’ve traded steadiness for significance, and the tension settles into my shoulders long after the moment passes,
I choose what quietly sustains me, is my drive building my life or just feeding a hunger that never ends,
I choose what quietly sustains me, I let contentment breathe through me and call that quiet steadiness my strength…



<center>I’ve stopped bargaining with myself, I recognize how I made peace conditional, as though it had to be purchased with progress,
I’ve stopped bargaining with myself, I confess I delayed tenderness in the name of responsibility, and then wondered why life felt dry,
I’ve stopped bargaining with myself, I confess the hardest part is accepting that nothing is missing in this moment except my willingness to be here,
I’ve stopped bargaining with myself, can I quit negotiating with life and simply live it today,
I’ve stopped bargaining with myself, I settle into the present and stay, and let that decision anchor everything else…





<center>Watchwords:
Tomorrow feels like where life begins,
I fed myself fantasies like sugar,
Longing makes me ungrateful in secret,
My drive feeds a hunger that ends,
I settle into the present and stay,







![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>



![tikatarot sign.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/cUPh7Abd-tikatarot20sign.png)

body.title: La máscara perfecta… hasta que alguien miró más de cerca
body.body:
<div class='text-justify'>


A veces la vida confabula y permite que uno vea más cosas de otra manera, hace una semana, más o menos, alguien me comentó de un caso de una persona que *-lamentablemente*- tiene años en la lucha de un cáncer que le ha limitado mucho en su vida, pero aún así, se mantiene activa, el detalle es que se ha valido de esto para obtener ciertos beneficios económicos de mala manera, y ya entenderán el porqué les digo esto.


Les dije que uno puede cambiar la manera de ver las cosas a partir de lo que vive, ve, lee , o le comentan, y es que recientemente leí el [post](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cuando-las-mascaras-se-quedan-tres-ejemplos-de-mascaras-que-danan-esen) del amigo @emiliorios, donde habla de las Máscaras que muchas personas suelen utilizar, y en este caso particular, de la persona que les comento, ha usado una gran máscara de victimismo que ha generado muchísimo daño.


<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbJQ5MiSYsq4ZuRFnid3DrM4raH4pHFgJ7N4mZv43M1a/image.png)
</center>
<center>[Imagen de Francesco Ungaro | Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/foto-en-escala-de-grises-de-mascaras-en-un-palo-669319/)</center>

La enfermedad que padece es real, si, ha sido sometida a múltiples cirugías y ha recibido quimio y radio en varias oportunidades, para ello ha recibido apoyo monetario de todos sus familiares, por suerte está en una familia unida y que tiene cierta solvencia económica como para poder colaborarle *\

*, ya entenderán las comillas en eso del tratamiento.


No solo eso, sino que cuando organizan paseos y reuniones familiares, no le piden absolutamente nada, porque consideran que su situación es muy compleja, hasta así parece todo normal, pero falta un detalle, para tener una mejor visión del asunto, está mujer es casada, tiene una niña, por suerte su esposo tiene un muy buen trabajo, y es un tipo responsable.

*¿No parece haber nada anormal en la situación?* Más que una difícil realidad de una persona con una de la peores enfermedades que alguien puede tener, pero hay un gran problema, yo lo así, eso fue lo que ella quiso mostrar, la MÁSCARA que quiso usar para aprovecharse de todos.


<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4H4o54YZvMazg1FYZxVvse63U3eDaktanzWgtvxF6DU/image.png)
</center>
<center>[Imagen de Anna Shvets | Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-entrenar-tren-de-viaje-3962213/)</center>

Aquí hay una realidad, y es que ella tiene un seguro médico que le cubre todos sus tratamientos, el esposo trabaja en un buen lugar, y goza de un beneficio medico que le cubre absolutamente todo, incluso los millones de pesos que cuestan sus tratamientos y cirugías que ha recibido, pero era esto algo que nadie en la familia sabía, hasta que el papá de esta mujer se dió cuenta de algunas cosas y no pudo soportar la gran máscara que tenía su hija.

En un mes, recibió más 5000 dólares en \

para su tratamiento, y cuando le preguntaron en qué lo había gastado, ella no sabía, simplemente saliendo, comiendo en la calle, comprándose ropa y demás cosas sin sentido, pero nunca necesitó dinero para cubrir gastos de enfermedad, sólo cogió el dinero y se lo gastó en lo que me jor le parecía.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPtGzrgfr4uaXSuX7ZKCNLXzCxgAAGPvrUdmuoRGrnvo/image.png)
[Imagen de Maksim Goncharenok | Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/resfriado-frio-mujer-efecto-desenfocado-4662960/)
Uso una máscara de víctima, durante mucho tiempo, aprovechándose de su enfermedad para, literalmente, estafar a familias y amistades. Ha generado una gran indignación en sus allegados, porque lo que hizo nunca debió pasar. Es una historia que tiene muchos más detalles, pero creo que va muy bien en la temática que nos trae @emiliorios, dónde hay quienes usan máscaras para distintos fines, y este es uno de los malos usos. Mucho cuidado con gente así, a veces los tenemos muy cerca, bonito fin de semana para todos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXJ83kY9BN2p9LYSbwXSBXReBLDTGBc5YnFKLLf4e4ke/image.png)

body.title: Maintaining mental and physical health
body.body:
/>

The other day I talked about how positive thinking skill has helped my life very well and this does not only make me keep focused on the task ahead, it keeps my mind cool and undisturbed, hence helping me to maintain good mental health. Mental health is something a lot of us overlook because the negative effects don't appear physically most times except it has become worst and with this, people tend to push it aside and concentrate more on the physical health. Although as a human, I can't live without having problems and these problems trouble the mind very well, whenever they come I try as much as possible to maintain a positive thought throughout. I know the problem isn't going to last long and I always try to see the good end of that situation from the point I am. With this, my mental health is always in a steady and undisturbed manner.

As for my physical health, I take care of it just like I take care of my mental health. I'm among those who don't like to be disturbed by any sort of pain or sickness, so anytime I get symptoms of a sickness, I rush to tame it with medicine quickly to avoid escalating the situation. Maybe this isn't the right way to fight sickness but I do it a lot. As we all know, when we go to work, our body gets worn out and once in a while, it accumulates and emerges as sickness. Also, I try as much as possible to prevent my body from having sickness is this us by taking in Water regularly to keep my system hydrated, rest whenever I'm tired, eat food when hungry and do not wait when my stomach is hurting already before eating. Also, I give in to sleep regularly too.

body.title: Conditions that influence choices [EN/PT]
body.body:
## Hello Splinters, welcome back!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzMGTdDp3acNq1NBXjgduhsSGj2HEtQufypFuzZaxdkR/convenience_6_.gif)

Lately, I've been starting my posts with philosophical, or quasi-philosophical, quotes, and most of the time it's intentional, but today I wouldn't have done so until I looked at the title I chose. You see, I usually formulate my content based on a battle I found interesting, and from that premise, I choose my title, of course, based on what I'm thinking about it. Today really wasn't going to be something philosophical, but it will be... Conditions influence our choices. Is there anything more concrete than that?

Let's put Splinterlands aside for just a second, but in the end, you'll understand how it's related. Imagine, in your right mind, you wouldn't do anything wrong, assuming you're a normal person with no inclination toward crime. But you, an ordinary person, wouldn't steal something from a bakery, of course, because why would you do something like that? But that's under normal conditions, where you work and have your own money. But then let's change the conditions and here you are a guy in despair, without a job, who has tried everything, all alternatives have failed to get money and buy bread, but this bread is not for you, it's for your child. In this condition, would you steal?

Some would say yes, others no, but we would only really know what we would do if we were living in that situation. Until then, it's just speculation, and of course, we should never steal or do wrong, okay? And nothing justifies a wrong act, because we know the consequences. But anyway, what does this have to do with Splinterlands after all? A lot! From condition to condition, we change our way of thinking, our way of seeing what is the best option, what are the best directions for efficient choices. And what are the conditions within our beloved Splinterlands? Battle rules, amount of mana, available elements, and even what types of card options you have, and each choice is only an important choice when we experience those specific conditions. Do you understand what I mean when I make this correlation?

So, what we can take from this is that each condition is a way to guide our choices, and in the battle I brought today, this is very visible. Just one simple rule has the power to make us build a strategy. You see, the rule was simply that all monsters would gain shields, and immediately we thought about filling our team with magical monsters, but then we remembered that our opponent could do the same, so we built our defense and then we were at the mercy of what was advantageous and disadvantageous within that framework, and for a moment we were forced to think outside the box, because without that we would not win. In fact, the winner is the one who thinks about it best and finds the best pieces for the game. So how did it go? Keep following!


https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070730101290979349/66.gif

## [To watch this battle, click here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_c4602726157baa9f1974ab27303a7a51)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQodN5gr2JBuYBjaEnHQJfbQV2b4AbjJTDCsHE3dzsaiv/image.png)</center>


### Some points to mention:

As I mentioned earlier, the rule of this battle involves only adding shields to the team, but one important detail is to note the amount of mana we have available. With this resource, you can create any team, as long as you have several options. We only have three elements available here, and I choose the death element, while my opponent chooses the water element.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEeJnrRKa5AAdkCjCs9yWDTm5StsbacWF8nMjgnJF4Qk/image.png)</center>

For the tank, my opponent makes a good choice, a magnificent tank, good against other magic attack monsters, and in addition, it has good speed, which makes it a good monster for dealing with physical attacks as well. My choice is very similar for the same purposes, but if I make a quick comparison, perhaps my opponent has done better here.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPUpK1nEh55DSYDhFHAyJ4HX1FGCmgobJVzcjfSsdyatt/image.png)</center>


In my back line, I tried to gather everything that could help me in this battle and focused very little on the offensive side, which, due to carelessness, almost ruined me.

Basically, with three magic attack monsters, due to the influence of the battle rule, these monsters had their attacks neutralized, leaving the offensive burden to the ranged and melee attack monsters.


My choice was interesting in that sense, but my most promising ranged attack monster suffered some almost irreversible damage, and if it weren't for the resurrection, I would have lost one of my team's strengths.


<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxuNTrUGhfgM1tyRuP9j3FsrBz4Td6vGW19nTfpQqbvE/image.png)</center>


At first, I thought it would be an easy battle because I was dealing with an opponent with lower-level cards, but I was surprised by the strategy he used. I don't know if I was really playing against a human player or a bot, but either way, it was a very interesting battle to play, and he used a very good strategy.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaokTtDGUk1AVggvZwMfZQL6BKsD6GKCfbvMqNyV6YmWL/image.png)</center>

Well, that was today's battle. I hope you enjoyed it. Thank you for reading this far and spending some of your time with my words and thoughts. See you next time!


https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1026615110300602368/rdgf2gh.gif



## Olá Splinters, bem vindos de volta!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzMGTdDp3acNq1NBXjgduhsSGj2HEtQufypFuzZaxdkR/convenience_6_.gif)

Ultimamente eu tenho começado meus posts com citações filosóficas, ou quase filosóficas, e na maioria das vezes é intencional, mas hoje não teria isso até que olhei para o título que escolhi. Veja bem, normalmente eu formulo meu conteúdo baseado em uma batalha que achei legal e, através dessa premissa, escolho meu título, claro, baseado no que estou pensando para isso. Realmente hoje não seria algo filosófico, mas será... Condições influenciam nossas escolhas. Existe algo mais concreto do que isso?

Vamos deixar Splinterlands de lado só por um segundo, mas no final você vai entender como isso tem relação. Imagine, você em sã consciência não faria algo de errado, supondo que você seja uma pessoa normal, sem inclinação ao delito. Mas você, uma pessoa comum, não roubaria algo de uma padaria, claro, por que você faria algo desse tipo? Mas isso são em condições normais, onde você trabalha e tem seu próprio dinheiro. Mas então vamos mudar as condições e aqui você é um cara em desespero, sem trabalho e que já tentou de tudo, todas as alternativas falharam para conseguir dinheiro e comprar um pão, mas esse pão não é para você, é para seu filho. Nessa condição, você roubaria?

Alguns diriam que sim, outros que não, mas só saberíamos de fato o que iríamos fazer se estivéssemos vivendo essa situação, até lá é apenas suposição e claro, de forma alguma devemos roubar ou fazer coisas erradas ok? E nada justifica um ato errado, pois sabemos das consequências. Mas enfim, o que isso tem a ver com Splinterlands afinal? Muito! De condição em condição, mudamos nossa forma de pensar, nosso modo de ver qual é a melhor opção, quais são os melhores direcionamentos para escolhas eficientes. E quais são as condições dentro do nosso querido Splinterlands? Regras de batalha, quantidade de mana, elementos disponíveis e até quais tipos de opções em cartas vocês possuem e cada escolha só é uma escolha importante quando vivemos aquelas condições especificas. Entende o que quero dizer quando fiz essa correlação?

Então, o que podemos tirar disso é que cada condição é uma forma de direcionar nossas escolhas e na batalha que eu trouxe hoje isso fica muito visível. Apenas uma regra simples tem o poder de nos fazer construir uma estratégia. Veja bem, a regra era apenas que todos os monstros iriam ganhar escudos e de imediato já pensamos em encher nosso time de monstros mágicos e então nos lembramos que nosso adversário também poderá fazer isso e construímos nossa defesa e então ficamos à mercê do que é vantagem e desvantagem dentro desse direcionamento e por um lapso somos obrigados a pensar fora da caixa, pois sem isso não venceremos. Na verdade, vence aquele que pensar melhor sobre isso e encontrar as melhores peças para o jogo. Então como foi isso? Continue acompanhando!


https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070730101290979349/66.gif?ex=699a7a5d&is=699928dd&hm=77b2b80900cd01f597fc8e3158b89478acac00494a9cb0b5ca43f2548d45fb5a&

## [Para assistir essa batalha, clique aqui](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_c4602726157baa9f1974ab27303a7a51)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQodN5gr2JBuYBjaEnHQJfbQV2b4AbjJTDCsHE3dzsaiv/image.png)</center>


### Alguns pontos a serem mencionados:

Como mencionei anteriormente, a regra dessa batalha envolve apenas a adição de escudos ao time mas um detalhes importante, note a quantidade de mana que temos disponível, com esse recurso, pode- se criar qualquer time, desde que você tenha vários opções. Temos aqui apenas 3 elementos disponíveis e eu escolho o elemento morte, meu adversário, o elemento água.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEeJnrRKa5AAdkCjCs9yWDTm5StsbacWF8nMjgnJF4Qk/image.png)</center>

Para o tank, meu adversário faz um a boa escolha, um tank magnífico, bom contra outros monstros de ataque mágicos e além disso ele possui uma boa velocidade que o transforma em um monstro bom também para lidar com ataques físicos. Minha escolha é bem semelhantes par os mesmo fins mas se fizer uma comparação rápida, talvez meu adversário tenha se saído melhor aqui.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPUpK1nEh55DSYDhFHAyJ4HX1FGCmgobJVzcjfSsdyatt/image.png)</center>


Na minha linha de trás eu tentei reunir tudo que poderia me ajudar nessa batalha e foquei bem pouco na parte ofensiva o que por descuido, quase foi minha ruína.

Basicamente com 3 monstros de ataque mágico, devido a influencia da regra de batalha, esse monstros tiveram seus ataques neutralizados e ficando então o encargo ofensivo aos monstros de ataque ranged e melee.


Minha escolha foi interessante nesse sentido, mas meu monstro mais promissor de ataque ranged sofreu alguns danos quase que irreversíveis e se não fosse por conta da ressuscitação, eu teria perdido um  dos pontos fortes do meu time.


<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxuNTrUGhfgM1tyRuP9j3FsrBz4Td6vGW19nTfpQqbvE/image.png)</center>


Inicialmente eu achei que seria uma batalha fácil por estar lidando com um adversário de level de cartas mais baixa, mas me surpreendeu a estratégia que ele usou. Eu não sei se eu estava jogando realmente contra um jogador humano contra um bot, mas de qualquer forma, foi uma batalha bem interessante de realizar e contra uma estratégia muito boa usada por ele.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaokTtDGUk1AVggvZwMfZQL6BKsD6GKCfbvMqNyV6YmWL/image.png)</center>

Bem, e essa foi a batalha de hoje, espero que tenha gostado. Obrigado por ler até aqui e passar um pouco do seu tempo com minhas palavras e pensamentos, até a próxima!

body.body:
____________________
#
Hello! Hello!
_______________________
Happy to participate in this week #288 of the CCC's Street Art Contest, where I bring you a small sample of how art can be found anywhere; you just have to recognize it and admire the artists who work on it. In the town of Chuspa, La Guaira state, Venezuela, there is this graffiti made by #Criollohappystylss #Ufutu #Paad and #Capsu of this girl with a pufferfish: >![Spanish version]Feliz de participar en esta semana #288 del CCC's Street Art Contest, donde les traigo una pequeña muestra de cómo el arte se encuentra en cualquier parte; solo basta reconocerlo y admirar a los artistas que trabajan en ello. En la población de Chuspa, estado La Guaira, Venezuela, se encuentra este grafiti que hicieron #Criollohappystylss #Ufutu #Paad y #Capsu sobre esta niña con un pez globo: https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tmFvRfQXe6UmKCZoAZZSTPBDroYjhwARPw5qERZr9xS9Vi2J9Vv1dekvFBPJkFxyKWT.jpeg I liked it because it is an art that welcomes you in a purely beachy setting. It's about a girl wearing a sweater, which seemed suffocating to me because, assuming you're AT THE BEACH, how are you going to dress like that? 🤣, so covered up; in half an hour, she would already be sweating 😥. >![Spanish version]Me gustó porque es un arte que da la bienvenida en un paisaje meramente playero. Se trata de una niña con un suéter, que me pareció sofocante porque, asumiendo que estás EN LA PLAYA, ¿cómo vas a ir vestida de esa manera? 🤣, tan tapada; en media hora ya estaría sudando 😥. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tbiC8vHLW9F5KS8nu6L7G8FrMmj5GbB55nnRfreNf8VKfLfeaTcvf6bTxYGg4e1QGr7.jpeg Detailing the art, if you notice the tied-up hair, for those who don't know, it's a detail that goes unnoticed, but for those of us familiar with the sea, we know that this 'red strand' is like a piece of octopus, characteristic of seafood 😊: >![Spanish version]Detallando el arte, si se fijan en el cabello recogido, para los que no saben es un detalle que pasa desapercibido, pero para los que conocemos el mar, sabemos que ese \

es como un pedazo de pulpo, característico de los frutos del mar 😊:


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23u5te9jgWJDWdBZpLFg4boD6Du9sfmbSdVeLRpv68uEFaUQP8tv834RWzKS1aGbH6Qy1.jpeg

The pufferfish in his hand is a satire to say something like 'everyone carries their balloon however they want,' or that the only balloon he knows is the one he has there near the sea... Another observation is that, in that area, because of the wind, kites fly a lot, and activities like paragliding are done; in this case, pufferfish 'fly' 😉:

>![Spanish version]El pez globo en su mano es una sátira para decir algo como \
, o como que el único globo que conoce es ese que tiene allí cercano al mar... Otra apreciación es que, en esa zona, por la acción de los vientos, se \
, se hacen actividades como parapentes; en este caso, \

pez globo 😉:


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tmDLxLztm9zhxmSYe6m5eaVES3sobTT4KrnwkaPGF8M1Bv1L3e98nQGsVdyaabRTWoi.jpeg

The image looks a bit worn, and that is the result of sun-wind-sand exposure. In these areas, it is very difficult to maintain structures because the environmental conditions quickly deteriorate anything; however, it is a piece of art that draws attention, it does not go unnoticed because it is the only one there and it serves as a topic of discussion due to its unique features.

You, who know more than I do about art, did you notice any other details? I’d love to read them 😎:

>![Spanish version]La imagen luce algo desgastada, y eso es producto de la acción sol-viento-arena. En estas zonas es muy complicado mantener estructuras porque las condiciones ambientales deterioran muy rápido cualquier cosa; sin embargo, es un arte que llama la atención, no pasa desapercibido porque es el único que está allí y sirve para comentarlo por las particularidades que tiene.
Ustedes, que saben más que yo sobre el arte, ¿consiguieron otro detalle? Los quiero leer 😎:


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tmB3LFH62CidMmfyT1isC9rbfREG9cWtnKVi8UwDKfSgAPAKo4NtENfNgo3JJCp5cmW.jpeg

The translator I used was Google Translate.  

# Until next time 😊

El traductor que usé fue Google Traductor.
Hasta una próxima oportunidad 😊.

body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



En mi país, a los dibujos animados les decimos \
, aunque también se les conoce como \

. Todas las tardes, los pequeños se reunían en casa de alguien del barrio que tuviera una televisión, para disfrutar de su tanda infantil. Momento donde se rodaban en la televisión todas estas caricaturas animadas, que marcaron generaciones. Una de las más populares, entre los niños cubanos, eran las aventuras del Pidio Valdés.\n\nPero los \

, como les llamen en tu lugar de origen, han cambiado mucho. No sé si estás de acuerdo conmigo, pero de los muñequitos que se hacían antes a los de ahora por computadora, va un largo trecho. Los caricaturistas de nuestro tiempo hacían arte en forma de dibujos animados, mientras que los de ahora, a mi entender, no tienen nada del otro mundo y algunos hasta mal dibujados.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnjD6ctKiHEiWNThZmHcTGH6PzreCt8USra2QB2TLAsQ/1771623752243.jpg)
[Fuentes:](https://m.filmaffinity.com/es/movieposters.php?movie_id=169730#&gid=1&pid=1)
Recuerdo que en su momento se tenía la opinión de que los muñequitos eran solo para los niños. Sin embargo, está más que demostrado que los dibujos animados nos encantan a todos. Lo que cambia es el contenido, que en muchas ocasiones no está acorde a estas edades tempranas. Como, por ejemplo, esta serie de animación que estaba viendo hace poco. Que no es que consuma este tipo de contenidos con frecuencia, pero me llamó la atención y terminé viendo esta serie que se hace llamar Primal. **La serie** También conocida como Genndy Tartakovsky's Primal, y sin temor a exagerar, diría que es una de las series de animación más espectaculares que he visto. El genio detrás de esta serie de animación es Genndy Tartakovsky, quien ha venido trabajando en este mundo con otras obras icónicas como Samurai Jack, Dexter's Laboratory y la versión del año 2003 de Star Wars: Clone Wars. Primal se estrenó en el año 2019 y se convirtió en un referente del medio audiovisual adulto animado.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpxm5nAfoE7Kt6WZQedvFvq6mFBAiK4TBzQ2fMCA5cah/1771623836831.jpg)
[Fuentes:](https://m.filmaffinity.com/es/movieposters.php?movie_id=169730#&gid=1&pid=2)
Solo he podido ver dos temporadas de esta serie, pero la misma cuenta con tres ediciones y la más reciente, estrenada este propio año 2026. Desde el primer capítulo te das cuenta de que estás ante algo que marca la diferencia, por lo que la serie acumula elogios de todo público que la ha disfrutado. Haciendo uso de una narrativa visual pura, su brutalidad feroz y su capacidad para transmitir emociones humanas profundas, sin usar siquiera una sola palabra de diálogo. **¿De qué trata la serie?** Pues aparentemente es una sencillez, solo que no lo es; aquí se nos muestra un mundo prehistórico, anacrónico y fantástico. En este último se hace identificar por ese, vamos a llamarle recurso literario, de querer mostrar una posible convivencia entre dinosaurios, mamíferos de la era glacial, hombres primitivos y hasta humanos con metalurgia.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXqabXbL4btLg5zQxmh2ZBEVXshW2zW26WGn9Kd8Mf7w5/1771623931890.jpg)
[Fuentes:](https://m.filmaffinity.com/es/movieposters.php?movie_id=169730#&gid=1&pid=3)
Pero lo más llamativo, sin lugar a dudas, en este audiovisual animado, es esta interacción especial y familiar que logran un neandertal llamado Spear, el cual pierde trágicamente a su familia a manos de una manada de depredadores, con una hembra de Tyrannosaurus rex llamada Fang, que igualito que el neandertal sufre la pérdida de sus crías. El dolor de ambos es tan conmovedor que los une en una alianza poco improbable, la que les permite en su conjunto luchar por su supervivencia. Estos dos seres, tan diferentes entre sí, se convierten en compañeros inseparables, recorriendo todo este mundo salvaje, hostil y hermoso a la vez, donde experimentan aventuras épicas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhC21TWyipMW3GezHHU4RzKvSUiem1SQDoPYsaDWdv6p/1771624049342.jpg)
[Fuentes:](https://m.filmaffinity.com/es/movieposters.php?movie_id=169730#&gid=1&pid=4)
**¿Qué hace a Primal tan especial?** En esta serie de animación, lo que menos importa es el diálogo hablado, así que la historia se cuenta mediante animación, expresiones faciales, lenguaje corporal, rugidos, gruñidos, la violencia y una banda sonora que no necesita decir nada más. Con un estilo de animación fluido, líneas gruesas, colores saturados y movimientos exagerados de una coreografía de alguna pelea visceral, lo convierten en una poesía visual. Tartakovsky en Primal ha dejado claro por qué es considerado uno de los grandes maestros de la animación. La serie no es para todo tipo de públicos, mucho menos para los niños, ya que contiene mucha violencia. Las batallas son sangrientas, crudas y realistas, con una brutalidad a gran escala donde las cabezas salen arrancadas de sus cuerpos destrozados. Muchísima sangre que sale salpicando por todos lados de la pantalla, pero esto no es simple violencia; se hace uso de ella para mostrarle al espectador la crudeza de un mundo en el que se vive al extremo y donde la supervivencia es lo único que importa.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPVJCV1YiukbCHuzxjxs1fHnMVcTWrRhAaHKGBX1rPiH/1771624169444.jpg)
[Fuentes:](https://m.filmaffinity.com/es/movieposters.php?movie_id=169730#&gid=1&pid=5)
**Comentario final** Esta serie no solo es entretenimiento; es un viaje a los inicios de la evolución del planeta, pero a modo de declaración artística. Es una historia épica, emotiva, incluso filosófica, contada con el recurso de la animación, y sin decir una sola palabra. Quizás sea brutal, demasiado, para el criterio de muchos que prefieren un contenido más pausado, pero en igual medida también es hermosa, triste y esperanzadora. Si aún no la has visto, te recomiendo prepararte para uno de los viajes animados más intensos que verás en tu vida. https://youtu.be/co28PDKv2VY?si=ruEmkdRrMliu2kw0
Las imágenes utilizadas en el post fueron dadas las fuentes. Textos llevados al inglés por [Deepl Traslate](https://www.deepl.com/mobile-apps/?utm_source=android&utm_medium=app&utm_campaign=share-with-friends). Corrector ortográfico [LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/es).

In my country, we call cartoons \
, although they are also known as \

. Every afternoon, the little ones would gather at the house of someone in the neighbourhood who had a television to enjoy their children's programme. This was the time when all these animated cartoons, which marked generations, were shown on television. One of the most popular among Cuban children was the adventures of Pidio Valdés.\n\nBut \

, whatever you call them where you come from, have changed a lot. I don't know if you agree with me, but there's a big difference between the cartoons that were made in the past and the ones made on computers today. The cartoonists of our time made art in the form of cartoons, while those of today, in my opinion, are nothing special and some are even poorly drawn. I remember that at the time, the opinion was that cartoons were only for children. However, it has been proven beyond doubt that we all love cartoons. What has changed is the content, which in many cases is not suitable for young children. Take, for example, this animated series I was watching recently. It's not that I consume this type of content often, but it caught my attention and I ended up watching this series called Primal. The series Also known as Genndy Tartakovsky's Primal, and without fear of exaggeration, I would say that it is one of the most spectacular animated series I have ever seen. The genius behind this animated series is Genndy Tartakovsky, who has been working in this world with other iconic works such as Samurai Jack, Dexter's Laboratory and the 2003 version of Star Wars: Clone Wars. Primal premiered in 2019 and became a benchmark in adult animated audiovisual media. I have only been able to watch two seasons of this series, but it has three editions, the most recent of which premiered this year, 2026. From the very first episode, you realise that you are watching something that stands out, which is why the series has garnered praise from everyone who has enjoyed it. It makes use of pure visual storytelling, fierce brutality and its ability to convey deep human emotions without using a single word of dialogue. What is the series about? Well, it seems simple, but it's not; it shows us a prehistoric, anachronistic and fantastical world. The latter is identified by what we might call a literary device, which seeks to show a possible coexistence between dinosaurs, Ice Age mammals, primitive men and even humans with metallurgy. But the most striking thing, without a doubt, in this animated audiovisual work is the special and familiar interaction between a Neanderthal named Spear, who tragically loses his family at the hands of a pack of predators, and a female Tyrannosaurus rex named Fang, who, just like the Neanderthal, suffers the loss of her young. The pain of both is so moving that it unites them in an unlikely alliance, which allows them to fight for their survival together. These two beings, so different from each other, become inseparable companions, travelling throughout this wild, hostile and beautiful world, where they experience epic adventures. What makes Primal so special? In this animated series, spoken dialogue is of little importance, so the story is told through animation, facial expressions, body language, roars, growls, violence and a soundtrack that needs no further explanation. With a fluid animation style, thick lines, saturated colours and exaggerated movements reminiscent of visceral fight choreography, it becomes visual poetry. Tartakovsky has made it clear in Primal why he is considered one of the great masters of animation. The series is not for all audiences, much less children, as it contains a lot of violence. The battles are bloody, raw, and realistic, with large-scale brutality where heads are torn from their mangled bodies. There is a lot of blood splattering all over the screen, but this is not simple violence; it is used to show the viewer the harshness of a world where life is lived to the extreme and survival is all that matters. Final comment This series is not just entertainment; it is a journey to the beginnings of the planet's evolution, but in the form of an artistic statement. It is an epic, emotional, even philosophical story, told through animation, without a single word. It may be brutal, too much so for the tastes of many who prefer more leisurely content, but it is equally beautiful, sad and hopeful. If you haven't seen it yet, I recommend you prepare yourself for one of the most intense animated journeys you will ever see. The images used in the post were sourced. # Learn Python Series (#44) - Context Managers & Decorators Deep Dive

You've been using `with` statements since episode #12 to open files. And if you've ever touched Flask or Click, you've seen `@decorators` sprinkled everywhere. But here's the thing — most Python programmers use these features without truly understanding the mechanism underneath. And once you do understand it, you start seeing opportunities to use them *everywhere*.

Both context managers and decorators solve the same fundamental problem: separating \

Resource cleanup, timing, retries, authentication checks — all the repetitive scaffolding that clutters your actual logic.\n\n**Nota bene:** This isn't syntax trivia. Context managers and decorators are how experienced Python developers eliminate entire categories of bugs (resource leaks) and boilerplate (cross-cutting concerns). If you want to write code that other Python developers look at and think \

— this episode is essential.

## Why resource management is hard

Consider opening a file, reading it, and closing it:

```python
file = open(\

)
data = file.read()
file.close()
```

Simple enough. But what if `read()` raises an exception? The file never closes. You're leaking a file descriptor.

So you add error handling:

```python
file = open(\

)
try:
    data = file.read()
finally:
    file.close()
```

This works. But now every file operation requires this try/finally boilerplate. And files aren't the only resource that needs cleanup - database connections, network sockets, locks, temporary files all follow this pattern.

The mental model: **resources need paired setup and teardown**. You acquire a resource, use it, then release it. The challenge is guaranteeing the release happens, even when errors occur.

## Context managers: the protocol

Python's `with` statement solves this through the context manager protocol. A context manager is any object with `__enter__` and `__exit__` methods:

```python
class FileManager:
    def __init__(self, filename, mode):
        self.filename = filename
        self.mode = mode
        self.file = None
    
    def __enter__(self):
        self.file = open(self.filename, self.mode)
        return self.file
    
    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        if self.file:
            self.file.close()
        return False  # Don't suppress exceptions
```

Now you can write:

```python
with FileManager(\

) as f:
    data = f.read()
```

When Python encounters `with`, it calls `__enter__`, runs your code block, then **always** calls `__exit__` - even if an exception occurred.

The `__exit__` method receives exception information (type, value, traceback) if an error occurred, or `None` for all three if the block succeeded. Returning `True` suppresses the exception, returning `False` lets it propagate.

Why this matters: you've separated **what** to do with the resource from **how** to manage its lifecycle. File operations are now safe by default.

## The contextlib shortcut

Writing `__enter__` and `__exit__` is verbose for simple cases. The `contextlib` module provides a decorator to turn generator functions into context managers:

```python
from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def file_manager(filename, mode):
    f = open(filename, mode)
    try:
        yield f
    finally:
        f.close()
```

Everything before `yield` is `__enter__`, the yielded value is what `as` binds to, and everything after (in the finally block) is `__exit__`.

This is cleaner for one-off context managers. For reusable ones, the class form is clearer.

## Real-world context manager: database transactions

```python
@contextmanager
def transaction(db_connection):
    \

cursor = db_connection.cursor()
    try:
        yield cursor
        db_connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        db_connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        cursor.close()
```

Usage:

```python
with transaction(db) as cursor:
    cursor.execute(\

)
```

Either both updates succeed and commit, or an error occurs and both roll back. The transaction logic is separate from the business logic.

## Decorators: the mental model

Decorators solve a different problem - modifying or enhancing function behavior without changing the function's code.

The core idea: functions are objects. You can pass them around, return them from other functions, and wrap them in new behavior.

```python

```

`@timing_decorator` is syntactic sugar for:

```python
slow_operation = timing_decorator(slow_operation)
```

The original function gets replaced with the wrapped version. Calling `slow_operation()` now includes timing logic automatically.

## Preserving function metadata

Wrapping functions creates a problem - the wrapper function has different metadata:

```python

)

# Use as context manager
with timer_context():
    slow_code()

# Or as decorator
@timer_context()
def slow_function():
    slow_code()
```

The decorator form wraps the entire function execution in the context.

## Practical example: temporary file cleanup

```python
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

    try:
        yield temp_dir
    finally:
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)

# Usage
with temp_directory() as tmp:
    file = tmp / \

)
    process_file(file)
# Directory and contents are deleted here
```

This guarantees cleanup even if `process_file()` raises an exception.

## When to use what

**Context managers** for:
- Resource acquisition and release (files, connections, locks)
- Setup and teardown that must happen in pairs
- Temporary state changes (changing directories, patching during tests)

**Decorators** for:
- Adding behavior to multiple functions (logging, timing, caching)
- Modifying function behavior based on configuration
- Enforcing preconditions or postconditions

**Both** when:
- You want the same functionality as both context and decorator
- Use `contextlib.ContextDecorator` as a base class

        connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        cursor.close()
        connection.set_isolation_level(old_isolation)

The key insight: without the context manager, every caller would need to remember `try/finally` to return the connection. One forgotten `finally` block, and the pool leaks. Under load, the pool empties, and the entire system grinds to a halt. The context manager makes the *safe* path the *easy* path.

Here's where decorators really shine — when you stack them to build composable behavior. Rather than cramming retry logic, caching, logging, and authentication into every function, you separate each concern into its own decorator. Each one does one thing.

1. `@timed` starts a timer

This pattern is powerful because it makes misuse difficult. The context manager ensures resources are cleaned up, and the decorator ensures methods can't be called in an invalid state. They work together — two different mechanisms reinforcing the same invariant.

You'll find this exact pattern in production Python libraries. SQLAlchemy's `Session`, Redis clients, gRPC channels — they all combine lifecycle management (context managers) with operation guards (often implemented as decorators or internal state checks).

## Did it click? Let's check

In this episode, we went deep on context managers and decorators:

- Context managers guarantee setup/teardown pairing through the `__enter__`/`__exit__` protocol
- The `with` statement ensures cleanup code runs even when exceptions occur
- `contextlib.contextmanager` simplifies creating context managers from generator functions
- Decorators modify function behavior by wrapping the original function
- `functools.wraps` preserves function metadata when decorating
- Parameterized decorators require an extra nesting level to receive configuration
- Class-based decorators maintain state across calls (rate limiters, counters, caches)
- Connection pools use context managers to make safe resource borrowing the default
- Decorator stacking composes independent concerns (timing, retry, caching, validation) into resilient API clients
- The managed service pattern combines both: context managers for lifecycle, decorators for operation guards
- Production libraries like SQLAlchemy, Redis, and gRPC all use these exact patterns

Once you internalize these patterns, you'll find yourself reaching for them constantly — and your code will be better for it. Fewer resource leaks, less boilerplate, cleaner separation of concerns.

Oto edukacyjny post o dziennych kursach walut wg NBP z komentarzem i kursami z tabeli średnich NBP z dnia 20.02.2026 (ostatnia opublikowana tabela dla dnia 21.02.2026 jeszcze oficjalnie nie jest jeszcze w archiwum) – wykorzystano dane tabela 035/A/NBP/2026 z dnia 20.02.2026:

📅 Kursy walut wg NBP – piątek, 20.02.2026
Oficjalne średnie kursy walut obcych publikowane przez Narodowy Bank Polski stanowią punkt odniesienia dla rozliczeń księgowych, podatkowych i analiz finansowych. Kursy średnie nie są kursami kupna/sprzedaży w kantorach – tam mogą być różne.

💱 Najważniejsze kursy dzisiejsze (średnie wg NBP):
• EUR (euro) – ~ 4,2241 PLN
• USD (dolar USA) – ~ 3,5898 PLN
• CHF (frank szwajcarski) – ~ 4,6297 PLN
• GBP (funt brytyjski) – ~ 4,8347 PLN
• Hrywna (UAH) – ~ 0,0829 PLN
• Jen (100 JPY) – ~ 2,31 PLN


🔎 Co to oznacza w praktyce?
✅ Gdy np. przeliczasz faktury zagraniczne lub planujesz budżet w walucie – to te kursy stanowią oficjalne wartości referencyjne.
✅ Kursy średnie publikowane są codziennie (dni robocze) ok. godz. 12:00 i bazują na notowaniach rynkowych.
✅ Kursy w kantorach lub bankach zwykle różnią się – zawierają marże i spready netto.

📌 Krótki komentarz dnia:
Euro stabilne powyżej 4,22 PLN, dolar kontynuuje notowania w okolicach 3,59 PLN, a frank szwajcarski wykazuje niewielką tendencję wzrostową – co może być sygnałem do obserwowania dalszych ruchów na rynkach finansowych w nadchodzącym tygodniu.
