title.title: Movie Review - The Boy Who Harnessed The Wind[2019] || Celebrating Black Excellence
title.body: Many people, including myself, watch movies for pure entertainment and leisure purposes, but watching \

reminded me that I also watch films for a deeper purpose. I watch them in order to view the world through other people’s lenses, to learn from what I see and hear, and to hold those lessons close to my heart. These three realizations draws me to share this review of the wonderful movie I saw last week. * * *

/>

Title: The Boy Who Harnessed The Wind

Genre: Drama

Release Date: March 1, 2019

Main Cast: Maxwell Simba, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Lily Banda, Aïssa Maïga, Noma Dumezweni, Lemogang Tsipa, Joseph Marcell

* * *

<h5 style=\

>SYNOPSIS In a small village in Malawi, a 13 year old boy, William Kamkwamba, whose family struggles to make ends meet, is determined to rise above the storms and change the entire trajectory of his life and that of his community. His family’s predicament with extreme poverty stems from the food crisis in Malawi in the early 2000s, which leaves them with little grain and meagre savings. Eventually, he is forced to drop out of school because his parents can no longer afford his fees. While others help their families farm corn on hard, dry soil every day, William becomes more interested in finding a long term solution to the famine.

/>

This story explores the harsh reality of poverty and the overwhelming challenges and insecurities that plague the mind of the common man. It also highlights the continuity of love, respect, and hope that holds strong through adversity. William’s love for learning, solving technical problems, and building meaningful items from scrap materials paves the way for a remarkable invention, even as the famine threatens to tear his family apart.

<h4 style=\

>MY VERDICT The Boy Who Harnessed The Wind is one of the most life changing movies I have watched this year. It is a deeply inspirational adaptation of a true story that teaches you not only to dream big but to remain resilient on the journey toward achieving those dreams. It also reminds us that the paths to success often begins in small, uncomfortable places, and we must be willing to sit with that discomfort until we grow beyond it.

/> Frankly, there is far more to praise than to critique, so I'll start with the praises. The first thing I loved about this movie is the use of Chichewa(One of Malawi's native languages) in the dialogue. It impressed me and gave me hope that some filmmakers truly understand the importance of preserving African culture and identity on big screens rather than erasing it. Secondly, the characters. The casting was done with so much intentionality, as if the team set out to find only the best actors to embody the scripts, and these actors delivered their roles perfectly. Every character carried their own emotions through the movie. From enthusiasm, to curiosity, strength, grace, and even frustration, it all felt deeply authentic to watch.

/>

Thirdly, the adaptation of the book was excellent. Every cinephile knows how difficult it can be to turn a book into a really good film as many adaptations have fallen short of that excellence. But this movie was made to meet the expectations of every viewer. It was engaging, well scripted and possessed the necessary scenes capable of capturing the heart of every audience.

Fourthly, the portrayal of hardship was incredibly realistic and made familiar to many Africans while also offering foreigners a clear picture of what it's like to depend on a government that does little for its people. The emotional depths were the core fragments of excellence that brought every scene to life. A father stretched to his limit watching his family ration meals. A mother staring helplessly at the floor where their last few bags of grain got stolen. A daughter eloping so her family has one less mouth to feed. Villagers struggling in line, under the scorching sun, to buy overpriced grain. Families migrating to nearby villages to escape the famine. These moments capture the human cost of poverty.

```
My only critique would be that I wish William’s relationship with his mother and sister had been explored as deeply as his relationship with his father. I think that added depth would have made the emotional arc more rich.
```

That being said, \

remains a solid 9 out of 10 for me, probably the highest rating I have ever given a film, and it truly deserves it because it is black excellence at its finest. So, if you're looking for a story that will inspire and motivate you while opening your eyes to the everyday struggles faced in many African countries, you should definitely watch this movie. I recommend it wholeheartedly. * * * ###### First image is a Netflix promotional material for the movie's release. ###### Other images are slides from the movie.

***

# 10 Уникальных Советов для Оптимизации Вашего Linux-сервера

Привет, администраторы и любители командной строки! Сегодня мы поговорим о том, как сделать ваш Linux-сервер быстрее и эффективнее. Готовы? Давайте погрузимся в мир оптимизации, где каждый байт на счету, а \

— это ваше второе имя!

## 1. Уберите ненужные службы

Зачем держать включенными службы, которые вы никогда не используете? Это как держать холодильник, полный еды, когда вы на диете. Отключите все лишнее, и ваш сервер скажет вам \

.

## 2. Используйте SSD

Если ваш сервер все еще работает на HDD, это как пытаться гонять формулу-1 на старом жигули. Поменяйте на SSD, и скорость загрузки будет такая, что вы и не заметите, как уже открылся ваш веб-сайт!

## 3. Настройте кэширование

Кэширование — это как запомнить, где вы положили ключи. Если сервер не будет каждый раз искать их в карманах, он будет работать быстрее. Используйте такие инструменты, как Redis или Memcached, и наслаждайтесь скоростью!

## 4. Мониторинг ресурсов

Зачем гадать, когда можно знать? Установите инструменты мониторинга, такие как Nagios или Zabbix, и следите за состоянием вашего сервера. Это как регулярные медицинские осмотры, только без уколов.

## 5. Оптимизация базы данных

Если ваша база данных работает медленно, это как пытаться найти иголку в стоге сена. Используйте индексы, оптимизируйте запросы и не забывайте про регулярное обслуживание. Ваши пользователи будут вам благодарны!

## 6. Удалите старые логи

Логи — это как старые любовные письма: чем больше их храните, тем больше места они занимают. Настройте ротацию логов и освободите место для новых приключений (или ошибок).

## 7. Используйте легковесные дистрибутивы

Если ваш сервер выглядит как танк, возможно, пора перейти на что-то более легкое. Легковесные дистрибутивы, такие как Alpine или Arch, могут сделать ваш сервер более маневренным.

## 8. Автоматизация задач

Зачем делать одно и то же снова и снова? Используйте скрипты и инструменты автоматизации, такие как Ansible или Puppet. Это как иметь персонального помощника, который никогда не жалуется!

## 9. Обновление ПО

Не забывайте обновлять программное обеспечение! Это как менять масло в машине: если не делать этого, рано или поздно что-то сломается. А вам не нужны дополнительные проблемы, когда у вас уже есть сервер.

## 10. Регулярные бэкапы

И последний, но не менее важный совет: делайте регулярные бэкапы! Это как страховой полис для вашего сервера. Никогда не знаешь, когда что-то пойдет не так, и лучше быть готовым!

---

Итак, вот наши 10 уникальных советов для оптимизации вашего Linux-сервера. Надеюсь, вы нашли их полезными и, возможно, даже немного забавными. Удачи в администрировании, и помните: \

title.body: >\nIt was quite busy day for me today because for the first time I decided to cooked pancake for our snacks. This was my first time to cooked and I've learned this from my Mother. She teached me how to mixed the Ingridients in right proportions or quantity including the Ingredients and I tried to baked here in our house. Yesterday, I maked a list of the Ingredients I want to buy just like Wheat flour, sugar, baking, yeast, cooking oil, eggs and Milk. I only spent 200 Pesos and I really careful to checkes the ingredients if it is complete, and gladly I brought it all. \n</div class=\

>

After buying all the Ingredients, I also gathered lots of coconut husks to be used as a firewood to cooked pancakes. Coconut husks is perfect to used when it cooked pancakes so I can control the heat just as what my Mother told me to do. I also prepared the kitchen utensils just like frying pan and finally I gathered all the needed materials and Ingredients. 

![IMG_20260221_105237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EoCiA7VbtzGr7YCTaiQWTyjF8WBwp2Aqf4wavVnZDy7r8FE3NSZ8dzRCMhmr9VHszLN.jpg)
</center>
I used two frying pans so I can cooked lots of pancakes on time. It will finished early when I will used two frying pans and the kitchen will expected to occupied. First I cookes the food for our breakfast and preparing viands for our breakfast and after that I ate our breakfast very early so I can started to cook my pancakes. Gladly We have lots of water and I can easily washed those utensils on time including the plates, spoons, forks and many more. I carefully Placed those dried coconut husks and create a fire in exact amount of heat. Cooking pancakes needs a lot of time because it takes almost 10 minutes before completely cooking it. That is why I used two frying pans so I can cookes lots of it. The cooking activity takes almost 3 Hours and I've cookes 45 pancakes. This will be very perfect snacks for us here combined with coffee or softdrinks. 

![IMG_20260221_105226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.life/EopsxK1ENodCFJPnXkL2U1Q8AcWooGPWzFgX6PwV1UE4RK1Rv6ULMxtCzFaqcf74qzw.jpg)

After cooking the pancakes, I also checked my ornamental plants I've placed at the terrace. title.body:

>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Today, through this community and this contest, I wanted to pay tribute to my best friend on the face of the earth, who has always been with me through the worst and best moments of my life, dried my tears, and laughed with me. So, more than my best friend, God, life, and time have made us sisters of the heart. In fact, my mom considers her another daughter, and it has always been that way. And even though our respective occupations have kept us apart, we never lose touch and will always be there for each other when we need it 😊. >Hoy a través de esta comunidad y este concurso quise rendir homenaje a mi mejor amiga en toda la faz de la tierra, quien siempre ha estado conmigo ene los peores y mejores momentos de mi vida, ha secado mis lágrimas y también ha reído conmigo, así que más que mi mejor amiga, Dios, la vida y el tiempo nos han convertido en hermanas del corazón, de hecho mi mamá la considera una hija más, y siempre ha sido así, y a pesar de que nuestras respectivas ocupaciones nos han mantenido distanciadas, nunca perdemos el contacto y siempre estaremos la una para la otra cuando lo necesitemos 😊.

![b7f2d2b714e0f0a8aaca853beb639cc41aa905d8r1-320-181_00.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vrtjWAMmaagjdHYXdWBCo9VLg7mV1486sy7GP9qxZYUMVrCU82denbWwxWwCr9REEYF.gif)

1️⃣ In the month of Love and Friendship, as content creators, think about what to send for Valentine's Day! What to dedicate to your partner, spouse, children, and friends? Happy Valentine's Day!

>En el mes del Amor y la Amistad como creadores de contenido, piensa ¿Qué enviar por San Valentín? ¿Qué dedicar a tu pareja, esposo, hijos y amigos? ¡Feliz San Valentín!

I've never really seen Valentine's Day as a very important date; I see it more as an excuse for businesses to profit immensely 😜. I'm sorry if I seem reckless or if I somehow shatter the illusion, but I like to be honest and say what I think. The date is just an excuse to fatten the bank accounts of merchants. In my case, I prefer to acknowledge love and friendship any day of the year and for no reason at all. However, this time I felt the need to send my best friend a little something, something I knew she would really appreciate because she's the kind of person who prefers more personal gestures. So I started editing a card in Canva with a photo of both of us and an AI-generated image that transformed us into Ghibli characters 🤗.

>Realmente nunca he visto San Valentín como una fecha demasiado importante, la veo más como una excusa a través de la cuál el comercio se beneficia demasiado 😜, lo siento si les parezco imprudente o si rompo de alguna manera la ilusión, pero me gusta ser sincera y decir lo que pienso, la fecha es solo una excusa para engrosar las cuentas bancarias de los comerciantes, en mi caso yo prefiero reconocer el amor y la amistad en cualquier fecha del año y sin ningún motivo, sin embargo en esta ocasión sentí la necesidad de enviarle un detalle a mi mejor amiga, algo que yo sabía que ella iba a apreciar mucho porque ella es de las personas que prefieren los detalles más personales, así que me puse a editar en Canva una tarjeta con una foto de ambas y una imagen generada por IA que nos transformaba en personajes de Ghibli 🤗.

She loves this kind of thing, so I thought it was ideal for her, but actually, all year round, we both really value our friendship and send each other tokens of affection, even though we've been physically distant due to our daily occupations.

>A ella le encantan este tipo de cosas, así que pensé que era ideal para ella, pero en realidad siempre, durante todo el año, ambas valoramos mucho nuestra amistad y nos enviamos muestras de afecto, a pesar de que hemos estado muy distanciadas físicamente debido a nuestras ocupaciones diarias.

2️⃣ It's true that Valentine's Day is the day of love, but also of friendship!… So I ask you: Who should you love first? Who is your best friend?

>Es verdad que San Valentín es el día del amor, pero ¡también de la amistad!… Y entonces te pregunto yo a ti: ¿A quién debes amar primero? ¿Quién es tu mejor amiga?

>Mi mejor amiga es Victoria, a quien respeto y admiro profundamente, y a quien quiero con toda mi alma como si fuese mi hermana, y es que ambas siempre hemos estado juntas, apoyándonos en los momentos difíciles, aconsejándonos la una a la otra, y también festejando los momentos felices. A pesar de que hoy en día no nos vemos tan seguido como antes, ella y su mamá siempre ha estado pendientes de mi y de mi familia. Victoria no solo es una mujer muy inteligente, la admiro porque es resiliente, ha tenido que enfrentar momentos difíciles y siempre lo ha hecho con la frente en alto, se toma en serio su trabajo, es responsable y no tolera las injusticias porque tiene un corazón muy noble, es amable y cordial aunque sabe defender sus ideales con uñas y dientes, pero siempre desde el respeto y la justicia, por todas esas razones la quiero y la admiro profundamente 🤗.

title.title: [ESP/ENG] I'll teach you how to prepare a cassava dough to make delicious cheese tequeños.
title.body:
> Mi gente hermosa un saludo cordial desde la distancia para todos los que visita mi blog, en este día maravilloso donde les estaré enseñando a preparar una masa de yuca para preparar unos deliciosos tequeños, esta es una forma creativa de disfrutar de la rica comida dejando de lado la tradicional masa de harina de trigo en una sustitución de yuca. > My beautiful people, a warm greeting from afar to all who visit my blog. On this wonderful day, I will be teaching you how to prepare a cassava dough to make delicious tequeños. This is a creative way to enjoy this tasty food, leaving aside the traditional wheat flour dough and using cassava instead.
![GridArt_20260220_233316995.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK9QtzeD3tR3j91DTjaYhVZdqi4CKMwUmSLRUAJrj9homxgq1WEsosj91Lr7VLS.jpg)
Ingredientes: 200 gramos de yuca, 1/2 de taza de harina de trigo, 1 huevo, 200 gramos de queso duro, 1 cucharada de mantequilla, sal, aceite. > Ingredients: 200 grams of cassava, 1/2 cup of wheat flour, 1 egg, 200 grams of hard cheese, 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, oil.
![GridArt_20260220_232654558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23uQpVUEQE8JrEeHeHGKGSzBCtCVzH8BcVRhJF8Pu9puB5JcodtBxDGGH89jSJbcjWDjj.jpg)
Primeramente vamos a cocinar nuestra yuca, la colocaremos una olla con agua y un poco de sal, por unos 25 minutos hasta que esta tenga una consistencia blanda, luego la agregamos en un plato y con ayuda de un tenedor vamos a triturarla hasta que quede finamente pastosa. > First we are going to cook our cassava, we will place it in a pot with water and a little salt, for about 25 minutes until it has a soft consistency, then we add it to a plate and with the help of a fork we are going to crush it until it is finely pasty. Agregamos una cuchara de mantequilla y una pizca de sal y mezclamos. > We add a spoonful of butter and a pinch of salt and mix.
![GridArt_20260220_232809205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJkS9Wc9nZVbJxJ3qkTBR4M824XPFo4tHaT12yZzoo3tNbcGxjspGipXtaX4GjD.jpg)
Seguidamente vamos a agarrar un huevo lo batimos y lo incorporamos a la mezcla, conjuntamente con la media taza de harina de trigo dónde vamos a unir todos estos ingredientes y obtendremos una masa suave. > Next, we will take an egg, beat it, and add it to the mixture, along with half a cup of wheat flour. We will combine all these ingredients and obtain a smooth dough.
![GridArt_20260220_232841622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AKApjDrSiXAEAWpZ3GWa89CDAsPpDspcnRJpaj6dX9ufgNkWjAscuFVgWSeaGAv.jpg)
Seguidamente vamos a cortar nuestros quesos en palitos largos con un centímetro de grosor, tomamos la masa de yuca la colocamos en una bolsita plástica aplanamos y colocamos el palito de queso dándole forma de un pequeño. > Next, we will cut our cheeses into long sticks one centimeter thick, we take the yucca dough, place it in a plastic bag, flatten it and place the cheese stick, giving it the shape of a tequeño. Luego llevamos estos palitos a un sartén con suficiente aceite a cocinar a fuego medio hasta que queden doraditos. > Then we put these sticks in a pan with enough oil to cook over medium heat until they are golden brown.
![GridArt_20260220_232921522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJoJJTHTR6t2Y37FBuvT1MUe9KkhDK2PmhZvC5H7zRZUs8AdfgigPh2LEzmS8Ae.jpg)
![GridArt_20260220_233002016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJmsz5TVe7tR9gRV1E7ncXBaA6f2cUGpa8muUvy7VGWc9FPK1LTEjcNFsAxzAio.jpg)
![IMG-20210518-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vsmbX5FEuYW4QJWvpf9gV1SsdcvFYWz2pdHSV6Rbh7pKEvx1MfBLag9bwed31NV4LFw.jpg)
Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son de mi autoria @mariaser Traducido con Deepl traductor > Thank you for reading me and your valuable support. The photos are by me @mariaser Translated with Deepl translator

title.title: Loop ride around Coolangatta Mountain : February 20 2026
title.body:
A completely different start to the day - my granddaughter has been booked into gymnastic classes in our local community centre. Close to our house makes an easy visit chance ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/536f698b-1b8b-4ebe-b294-791141088fb7.jpg) Hall all set up. No photos - Scarlett was a bit distracted by me being there. We did have a chance to look at the flowers and sit on the grass together before they left. Got a blue sky day. Got on the bike to ride the circle around Coolangatta Mountain. First stop is the boat launch spot on the Broughton River ramp. Not really a ramp - just a slope with no concrete ramp ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8bc359a8-2695-4c0c-8a85-8ebfa9002066.jpg) Had not noticed the reflection when I took the shot. One of the best mangroves this way ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1f0296b4-9e6c-4a6f-a26b-2d8cd975bcc2.jpg) Mangrove shot - flat water ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d2428003-ebe0-4cdf-ba19-b1331752c10c.jpg) Views around the Southern Tablelands from the road. Berry Mountain mid shot - cycled that a few times in my time here ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/53ed23a0-f3a6-42e9-ba62-e42926fee41d.jpg) Looking to the south - Cambewarra Mountain on the extreme left - zoom into see the TV tower ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/16578c3c-024d-4ab1-800b-8b9349184f66.jpg) Coolangatta Mountain from the back. Decided not to ride up the access road. Too hot. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6323d68-5cd2-4f62-86ec-f125772b9f8c.jpg) For Sale board up at the intersection with the road that goes up to access the mountain. Fab spot - rolling hills, always green, close to Berry and Nowra ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0555d9e0-57fb-4059-a0be-2b864c191d61.jpg) Shot of the house - single storey facing North, solar panels and some outbuilding structures ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/50e85e49-a5fb-496b-a677-e41572377bba.jpg) Longest bike ride in a while. Hill work felt fine. Easy start to doing some training for next month's bike tour. It will be rail trail flattish. Cooked dinner for friends - a bit of a mix and match bbq. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/47269f1f-db84-435d-940c-a57040226e60.jpg) Spent a late night finishing bonus pages for Amanda Craven's Companion Cash launch - check it here https://mclnks.com/ccashbonus
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@carrinm/actifit-carrinm-20260221t105533847z)_

title.body:
/>
Hola queridos amigos de Hive. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes un corrido una pieza que nace del folklore y que vibra en el tono de Re mayor. Es una interpretación que me conecta profundamente con nuestra identidad cultural, y que cobra aún más vida gracias al acompañamiento magistral del Maestro Ramón Páez en el arpa. Su talento y sensibilidad aportan un fondo sonoro que eleva cada nota. Este tema lo presento con mucho cariño en el Hive Music Festival, semana 175, ronda 1, un espacio que siempre nos invita a celebrar la diversidad musical y a compartir lo que llevamos en el corazón. Para mí, participar en este festival es más que mostrar una canción: es abrir una ventana hacia esas melodías que nos recuerdan quiénes somos y de dónde venimos. El corrido, como género, tiene la fuerza de narrar historias y transmitir sentimientos colectivos. En esta ocasión, mi interpretación busca honrar esa tradición, pero también darle un toque personal, con la energía que me inspira la comunidad de Hive. Cada acorde en Re mayor resuena con alegría y esperanza Quiero agradecer a todos los que hacen posible este festival, porque nos brindan un espacio para crecer, aprender y disfrutar juntos. Y, por supuesto, les envío un saludo lleno de afecto, como siempre, de su amiga @Yoxibeth.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3705f285834fd310e0d870c6610d8a463549d307df2e2f92ec33606fda5da8e31bfeec42e1c6a6e2b90f7711ae8cd34456d936b9f2b18a6410c1b19009a2049e_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

러브 스토리는 다양한 주제를 통해 사랑의 복잡성과 아름다움을 탐구할 수 있습니다. 아래는 각기 다른 주제를 가진 러브 스토리의 개요입니다.

## 1. 첫사랑의 기억
- **주제**: 순수한 첫사랑
- **줄거리**: 고등학교 시절, 서로의 마음을 모르고 지내던 두 친구가 졸업 후 재회하게 되며, 잊고 있던 첫사랑의 감정이 되살아나는 이야기.

## 2. 시간 여행자의 사랑
- **주제**: 시간과 공간을 초월한 사랑
- **줄거리**: 미래에서 온 시간 여행자가 과거의 한 여성을 사랑하게 되며, 그녀를 지키기 위해 시간의 법칙과 싸우는 이야기.

## 3. 전쟁과 평화
- **주제**: 전쟁 속의 사랑
- **줄거리**: 전쟁 중 만난 두 사람의 사랑 이야기. 서로 다른 배경을 가진 그들이 힘든 상황 속에서도 서로에게 희망이 되어가는 과정을 그린다.

## 4. 비밀스러운 연인
- **주제**: 비밀과 거짓말
- **줄거리**: 서로의 정체성을 숨긴 채 만나는 두 사람. 진실이 밝혀지면서 그들의 사랑이 어떻게 변해가는지를 다룬다.

## 5. 재회와 용서
- **주제**: 과거의 상처를 치유하는 사랑
- **줄거리**: 오랜 시간 동안 연락이 끊겼던 연인이 우연히 재회하게 되고, 과거의 아픔을 극복하며 서로를 용서하고 이해하는 과정을 그린다.

## 6. 세대 간의 사랑
- **주제**: 나이 차이를 극복한 사랑
- **줄거리**: 세대 차이가 큰 두 사람이 서로에게 끌리게 되며, 사회의 편견과 싸우면서 진정한 사랑을 찾아가는 이야기.

## 7. 우정에서 사랑으로
- **주제**: 친구에서 연인으로
- **줄거리**: 오랜 친구 사이에서 서로의 마음을 깨닫고, 우정이 사랑으로 발전하는 과정을 그린다.

## 8. 꿈을 쫓는 사랑
- **주제**: 꿈과 사랑의 갈등
- **줄거리**: 각자의 꿈을 이루기 위해 노력하는 두 사람이 사랑과 목표 사이에서 갈등하며 성장해가는 이야기.

## 9. 이별 후의 사랑
- **주제**: 이별과 재시작
- **줄거리**: 이별한 후 각자의 삶을 살아가던 두 사람이 우연히 다시 만나 서로의 마음을 확인하는 이야기.

## 10. 문화의 차이를 넘어서
- **주제**: 다문화 사랑
- **줄거리**: 서로 다른 문화와 배경을 가진 두 사람이 사랑에 빠지며, 그 과정에서 겪는 갈등과 이해의 과정을 그린다.

이러한 다양한 주제를 통해 러브 스토리는 사랑의 다양한 면모를 보여줄 수 있습니다. 각 이야기는 독자에게 감동과 공감을 불러일으킬 수 있는 요소를 지니고 있습니다.

Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente gratificante. Empecé por un parque que siempre me sorprende con su belleza. Allí conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que había estado viniendo al mismo parque durante más de 30 años y que cada vez que se sienta en el banco, siente que se conecta con la naturaleza y la vida que la rodea. Su energía y pasión por el lugar eran contagiosas. Más adelante, pasé por una calle llena de murales coloridos. Uno de ellos me llamó especialmente la atención: era una representación grande de manos entrelazadas, simbolizando la unión y la diversidad. Me detuve a tomar una foto y, mientras lo hacía, conocí a un artista local que estuvo trabajando en un nuevo mural. Compartió su visión de cómo el arte puede transformar espacios urbanos y conectar a las personas. Hoy fue un recordatorio de cómo, en cada caminata, podemos encontrar historias y conexiones inesperadas. Cada rincón de la ciudad tiene su propio carácter y siempre hay algo nuevo que descubrir. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). It is difficult and a mind field in mental health as i hate to say it but alot of people are using it as a platform to be and feel special.

To be honest i get it, but it don't make it right.

Our mental health issues if people have them cannot be our personality nor can it be an excuse.

Personally i have a diagnosis that would make most people give up.

I have CPTSD, treatment resistant paronoid schizophrenia, with underlining Adhd, autism and symptomatic OCD.

I don't do groups for the very reason you state that i quoted above and i was diagnosed before it was a trend, i am in my 50's and was diagoned fully in my late 20's.

The truth is we all have character flaws and mental health issues of some kind as everyone goes through tough times and have suffered but like i said it can't be an excuse and it can't be our persona to become healthier.

I run a business i have raised 4 children, me and the wife have fostered children while being highly active in supporting our children with theirs.

Our whole family are neurodivergent in some way or another but it is not our whole personality neither do we allow it to rule or ruin our lives it just makes things different, sometimes very challenging and sometimes downright hilarious.

Regardless of mental health issues or character flaws the important thing is to constantly be working on ourselves to the best of our ability and to try and change the things that cause problems or at least learn to manage them.

That goes for anyone inflicted with mental health issues or not.

The next wave isn’t just better models — it’s where and how they land in the real world.

title.title: More continuity issues with later season of Scrubs
title.body:
I remember when *Scrubs* was first released and how much of a hit it was.  I also consider it to be one of my favorite comedy series of all time.   When I decided to revisit the series I found myself getting hooked just like I did when I was watching it the first time but since I am watching it on streaming and not on DVD's or just network TV, I am noticing things that didn't stand out to me before.

I just finished season 7 and noticed earlier how they just kind of forgot that Dr Cox got a haircut in one episode but then had all of his hair back in the next, and then he shaved it for the first time in a later episode.  They also had someone who had previously die in an episode and then reappear for a scene in a later one.   

Toward the end of Season 7 it starts to look like perhaps there was some internal problems with the show, because it looks like they kind of stopped caring about the story and continuity.

<center> https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/scrubs/images/1/11/7x11_Elliot_and_JD_III.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20091127231800
[src](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/scrubs/images/1/11/7x11_Elliot_and_JD_III.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20091127231800)</center>

For one thing, season 7 was only half as long as the previous seasons and I can't find out why that was.  I'm going to guess that it had something to do with the fact that the show changed from NBC where it began, to ABC in season 8.

So the continuity problem in later season 7 isn't limited to hair or the screw up with the dead person appearing again but with a major part of the overall story.   Bob Kelso, the mostly not nice chief of medicine, is a central character in this season as it is revealed that he has been lying about his age in order to not get dismissed from his position.

<center> https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/scrubs/images/4/48/2x19_Kelso%27s_portrait.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20090720010839
[src](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/scrubs/images/4/48/2x19_Kelso%27s_portrait.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20090720010839)</center>

They dedicated 3 episodes to this build up and how the characters who previously loathed him, started to feel like they would really miss him if he was gone and it was kind of touching to see them connect that way.   Eventually his job is spared because of outpouring of support only to have him quit anyway.  It wasn't that he wanted to keep his job, he just wanted to leave on his own terms.    So he leaves and Dr. Cox takes over his position and then another episode happens and boom!  Bob Kelso is just magically back as head of medicine.  No explanation of any sort is offered.  This is also when they have a very bizarre and not very good \

episode.  

<center> https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/5-11.jpg?q=49&fit=contain&w=750&h=422&dpr=2
[src](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/5-11.jpg?q=49&fit=contain&w=750&h=422&dpr=2)</center> 

Ok, I accidentally figured out why the season was cut short and why it seems to have very lazy writing:  There was a Writers Guild of America strike in 2007 and the season was rushed and cut short because of it.   It does still seem very strange that they would just \
that Laverne was dead, Dr Cox already shaved his head, and that Bob Kelso retired.  \n\nOne other very minor continuity issue is that in the season finale \
episode JD is riding a donkey and refers to it as \

which was the name of his scooter which in real life he no longer has as his brother had bought him a car.  I guess they forgot about that as well.   

I have read some fan theories that the final episode was never meant to be the final episode but their hand was forced by the writer's strike and that episode was actually meant to take place before the Kelso retiring character arc even happened.    

It is worth noting that in the year it aired originally, it was losing viewers very rapidly and had sunk from 14th place overall to 115th.   

I honestly don't remember what happened in season 8 and 9 from the first time of watching it - some of it such as the inevitable reunion of JD and \

is obvious - but I'm thinking that it probably wasn't very good because the show was totally cancelled after a mere two seasons on ABC.   

I do recall that they experimented with guest stars such as Courtney Cox ironically butting heads with the show's Dr. Cox and that was funny for about a second and a half.   

All good things have to come to an end though, and I will likely finish up all of the available episodes in the next day or so.

title.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles Prompt 34 [Iniciative] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![miniatura youtube gym rojo negro (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23vhyvntZsNtQXmCWGZiP5xxT3gfGUppnubmP7qCGW3x5fFTaH3PHNmRL19oK5hXcT7ZT.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

I was truly motivated from the moment I read the title of the original post for this week's #SilverBloggers initiative. The thing is, I was a rebellious teenager, but don't think I was rebelling against my parents. My rebellion was against the system. During my teenage years (the 70s) in my country (Venezuela), students of all levels, but especially high school and university students, were always in the streets demanding rights, protesting for things like student bus passes, dignified treatment for students, or public transportation (which was scarce for students). So, schools would fill up with students shouting slogans that the police tried to stifle with tear gas, but we were already armed with pieces of cloth soaked in vinegar to counteract the effects. >De verdad que me sentí motivada desde el momento en el que leí el título del la publicación original para la iniciativa de esta semana de #SilverBloggers, lo que sucede es que yo fui una adolescente rebelde, pero no crean ustedes que yo me rebelaba contra mis padres, mi rebeldía era contra el sistema, y es que en la época de mi adolescencia (años 70) en mi país (Venezuela) los estudiantes de todos los niveles, pero en especial de secundaria y universitarios, siempre estaban en las calles exigiendo derechos, protestando por derechos como el pasaje estudiantil, trato digno para los estudiantes o transporte publico (el cuál era escaso para los estudiantes) así que los colegios se llenaban de alumnos gritando consignas que la policía pretendía sofocar con gases lacrimógenos, pero nosotros ya estábamos armados con trozos de tela impregnados en vinagre para contrarrestar los efectos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23u5y7Uc3hVBMTyEgBPuW9og5PGhDP5tyqKxT71jGEBzBFVwzH15EZDuJNHqaTpfVHsos.png)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/clima-plan-b-klimastreik-4600289/)

There was always a reason to protest, and because my parents knew this, they told me to be careful and never to participate, since at that time there were very few, or rather, no rights for minors, so you could end up in jail or even dead. But me, being young, reckless, and impulsive, I always went with my friends to those protests. Sometimes other students from different schools would come to drag us away and start the rebellion (even though all we did was shout slogans, clap, and play protest music), but all this enraged the police.

>Siempre había una razón para protestar, y debido a que mis padres lo sabían, ellos me pedían que me cuidara y que por nada del mundo se me ocurriera participar en ello, ya que en esa época había muy poco, o mejor dicho, nulos derechos para los menores de edad, así que podías terminar preso o incluso muerto, pero yo, joven al fin, temeraria e impulsiva, siempre me iba con mis amigos a esas protestas. En algunas ocasiones venían otros estudiantes de otros colegios al nuestro para sacarnos de allí e iniciar la rebelión (aunque lo único que hacíamos era gritar consignas, aplaudir y poner música de protesta) pero todo esto enardecía de rabia a los policías.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23z7HnGusqdJihuZbtjfKg3fRTR3bPBYgJ2rThKkfn6DBkFr1MyrAbR2iV2bj2afUDHYF.png)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/protesta-huelga-demostraci%c3%b3n-4758909/)

However, one day the police came to our school. Most of the students ran away, but they still caught me and some of my friends. They put them in \

—that's what they called the police cars back then. But the officer holding my arm got distracted talking to another one. At first, I struggled to get free, but when I couldn't, I calmed down and thought... What would happen to me if they put me in jail with my friends? I was sure my dad would come to rescue me there, but then I knew I'd get a good scolding from him. But... what if they made me disappear like so many other students? Then I thought it was time to use my ace in the hole. 😄 I pulled out some acting skills I didn't even know I had.

\n\n>Sin embargo en una ocasión llegó la policía a nuestro colegio, la mayoría de los estudiantes salimos corriendo, pero aún así me capturaron a mi y a algunos de mis amigos, a ellos los metieron en \

era así como le decían a las patrullas policiales en esa época, pero el policía que me tenía agarrada del brazo se distrajo hablando con otro. Al principio yo luchaba por liberarme pero al no poder hacerlo me quedé tranquila pensando... ¿Qué sería de mi si me metían presa junto con mis amigos? estaba segura de que mi papá me iría a rescatar allá pero luego me esperaría una buena reprimenda de él, pero... ¿Y si me hacían desaparecer como a tantos otros estudiantes? entonces pensé que había llegado el momento de usar mi As bajo la manga 😄 saqué unas habilidades histriónicas que yo no sabía que tenía.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wWpWmqhrSSkKPYJ25rJNZstJFLENm9Am9zbRvfoBDBgxCjdEAgjZehMX9aK4ntPmBz7.png)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/meg%c3%a1fono-altavoz-voz-anuncio-1480342/)

I threw myself to the ground, feigning convulsions, my body writhing in shock to the astonishment of the police officers. My friends were confused inside the \

The officer holding my arm let go to get help, but I seized the moment. I got up and ran faster than a gazelle being chased by a lion 😄, leaving everyone confused and the police officers furious that I had managed to outwit them.

\n\n>Me lancé al suelo fingiendo convulsiones, mi cuerpo se retorcía ante el asombro de los policías. Mis amigos estaban confundidos dentro de la \

El policía que me tenía sujeta del brazo me soltó para ir a pedir ayuda, pero entonces aproveché el momento. Me levanté del suelo y salí corriendo más rápido que una gacela cuando la persigue un león 😄 dejando a todo el mundo confundido, y a los policías rabiosos al ver que yo había logrado burlarlos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23uQnHnp7MR2QQijdoiLkGEbnWprGyAv1Mcdrwuubj794t93BBdz5Wfj5nmhXdRcThLpa.png)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/polic%c3%ada-mujer-polic%c3%ada-colegas-1016218/)

I think that was the riskiest thing I ever did during my teenage years. Not only did I get involved in protests, which, however necessary, were dangerous, but I also outsmarted the police with my amateur acting skills 🤣. Anyway, I hope you enjoyed my story. For now, I'll say goodbye, sending you virtual kisses and hugs 😘 🤗.

>Creo que eso fue lo más arriesgado que llegué a hacer durante mi adolescencia, no solo meterme en protestas que, por más que fueran necesarias eran peligrosas, pero no solo eso, sino que burlé a la policía con mis dotes de actriz empírica 🤣. Bueno, espero que se hayan divertido con mi anécdota. Por ahora me despido enviándoles besos y abrazos virtuales 😘 🤗.

title.title: My Sketchbook Journal: Rescue
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jadung/23ynoVi7YqZNWNkYtNX9Mfqp79k521HtvZJd7GZzwWfrdq6yAALTBikVBq6h8VMyDEqas.png)

Welcome to My Digital Sketchbook Journal. In this sketchbook journal you can explore my digital scribbles, which is much like a spontaneous adventure. These are quick sketches, born from whimsy on the fly so you get the idea. This is also my entry to the #sketchquest contest of @quatro.

Finally found that line. After searching through apps and missing the uneven thickness of a classic fountain pen, I gave PenUp a shot. Ther is something in a line drawing that varies in volume—it feels more human, less digital.

Started this piece with a specific inspiration in mind: an animal lover I saw online who didn’t hesitate to take home a sickly stray kitten. That selfless moment stuck with me. To capture it, I stepped away from my usual style and went for something that is hand drawn with a pencil or fountain pen with flat aesthetic. I wanted the colors to feel warm and intentional, using that soft orange backdrop to make the purple and blue tones of the character pop. It’s a departure from my regular work, but the contrast between the bold, uneven linework and the flat fills really brought the story of the rescue to life for my SketchQuest entry.

Does the warmth of these colors make you feel the same sense of hope I felt?


If you'd like to stay connected and see more of my art, I invite you to join our [Draw A Day community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140877/created) It's where I predominantly share my art and engage with fellow artists. Thank you and see you in the next post

title.title: Will Energy Data Assetization Become the Next Infrastructure-Level Track?
title.body:
https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgoEI8JPISRHo1pNyh9IfNCKHKnALZSNPh29ZMUbUwZnlTYxu6XuTq_CInghxaRjrCy-Y9EEpIV0u4IDTzAi5ivXwzgGeHvMoI992DT82d6ugcFx_o9rnpN0fLDsV7eFeYDCfVPtmnAJW1oKfbohBWgVSRrSPjw__8WtR22Z5JtnyiZrcfOX8vHTxoI3xw/w640-h360/Will%20Energy%20Data%20Assetization%20Become%20the%20Next%20Infrastructure-Level%20Track.png

Recently, I have become increasingly convinced that the real issue with green energy is never “is there enough,” but “can it be trusted.” Wind, solar, and hydropower are all growing, but as soon as the question arises—“Is this electricity truly green? Did these carbon reductions really happen?”—the answers turn into reports, random inspections, and paper audits. What follows is information fragmentation, data silos, risks of tampering, and high traceability costs. Ultimately, everyone ends up “trusting a centralized spreadsheet.” This is not the foundation a green economy should have.

The approach taken by EcoWattChain is direct and bold: using blockchain + IoT + smart contracts to turn the entire process of energy production, transmission, and consumption into a verifiable “trust chain.” It is not just a slogan of “blockchain + energy”—it aims to make “energy trust” an infrastructure. Each unit of energy has a unique digital identity, with data collected by trusted IoT devices, signed, encrypted, and uploaded to the chain, where it can be traced, audited, and publicly queried.

To sum up its ambition in one sentence:  

### Upgrade “green” from a slogan to an on-chain fact.

Even more interesting, it goes beyond traceability to “value collaboration.” The native token ECOW of EcoWattChain serves as both incentive and governance medium: green power generation, data uploading, green consumption, regulatory participation—all these behaviors can be quantified and rewarded, forming a positive cycle.

Its core value proposition is fourfold: trustworthy, transparent, green, incentivized—but its implementation is all about technical substance: consortium chain architecture (emphasizing high performance and low energy consumption), consensus via PoA/BFT, privacy by combining ZKP with off-chain storage mapping, and reserved cross-chain interfaces for mainstream public chains to prepare for future green asset circulation.

### What makes it particularly compelling is that its innovations hit several “timely” buttons:

 

**Energy Asset NFTization:** Each unit of energy can be confirmed as an on-chain asset, bound to data such as source, time, and path—meaning “green power” is no longer just a contractual description, but a verifiable on-chain certificate.

**Automatic Carbon Footprint Smart Contracts:** Not post-hoc reports, but real-time data streams automatically calculating carbon intensity/carbon footprint, providing a highly reliable data foundation for ESG disclosures and carbon trading.

### IoT + DID Integration: Devices are given on-chain identities, solving the “last mile” of data source trustworthiness.

So you will find EcoWattChain is not just “issuing a token,” but rewriting the collaborative mode of the energy industry chain: enterprise compliance, government regulation, financial integration, and public queries can all revolve around a single on-chain truth. Typical scenarios include green power traceability certification, full-process oil and gas regulation, carbon asset confirmation and trading, energy compliance reports for industrial parks and factories—each one addresses real-world needs. 

If you ask me: what is the true ceiling for this type of project? I believe it is making “energy data assetization” a consensus: data can be confirmed, carbon can be measured, certificates can circulate, incentives can be sustained. The choice of EcoWattChain to start from the most lacking “trustworthy data foundation” of the industry is a smart move.

title.title: Going for a stroll.  My Actifit Report Card: February 21 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/55a73590-641a-480b-be7a-00a6579abf28.jpg)


My wife returned to Canada today so I'm by myself in Indonesia again.  When she first arrived she was asking to go back home within 24 hours of getting here.  Why?  Because I was living like a monk.  I get up, I read my Bible, I exercise, I stretch, read more, exercise more and I only eat one meal a day.  

When she left in the morning it was really early in the morning.  Her words to me at the airport.... \

.  By the end she was enjoying the hotel lifestyle...She just went out and did more things while she was here (and dragged me along with her).

As for my breakfast buffet?  It was super quiet.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/964132d1-b529-4553-a519-762b688205db.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f8a905bb-e31e-4623-94e3-325b0f69e600.jpg)

In Indonesia during Ramadan from 4:30am until about 6pm people just aren't out eating.

So I enjoyed my hotel breakfast and then it was time to move to a less expensive hotel.  Yes, I caved and took my wife to a little nicer hotel near the mall to keep her happy.  I don't care so I go to a perfectly acceptable hotel with a great breakfast included for less money.

Unfortunately the local area is kind of, well, boring.  It is on a major road so there really isn't much around to see.  However, that didn't stop me from trying.  I got my 10K steps by walking down the road.... Walking to the other side... Walking back until I couldn't go any further....walked back to an insane intersection and finally got back home. 

But this time I took detours down little side areas where I found a bunch of different places.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0b614f1c-3420-430b-b2c4-5f191210c7a4.jpg)

First up was 

* Mie Gacoan

A noodle restaurant where you choose the spice from 1-8.  The meal is cheap at about $0.80 and popular.  I figured I would ask the hotel staff what \

was in Indonesian (debungkas) .. I would order, ask to go, then return to the hotel.

When I went I realized it was 5:45 and everyone was getting ready to break their fast for the day.  It was chaos.  Also you place your order, get a number, and wait for it to be called...except I have no idea how to listen for my food...so I chickened out and paid the extra $1 to have it delivered to my hotel room.  I ordered spicy #4 and.....bad idea... I had to order another meal because it was just way too spicy.  

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/964d343e-3c91-4f06-810f-7a11d8c25b6a.jpg)

Next up I found a little \

for lack of a better word.  No cars flying by, no street visibility, but surprise there was a money changer.  Very useful as I have Canadian and American dollars so when I need to exchange I know a closer place to go.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a36975c3-56da-4e1c-952a-285b2c98d17f.jpg)

Next up a cool looking Korean restaurant.  Kind of sad I just found it.  If I knew before I could have gone with my wife and going by myself when I'm on a diet?  Kind of sad.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/85893764-835e-4746-8fea-cb77a16d3229.jpg)

I had to smile at the Red Doorz inn.  Mostly because my wife refuses to go to it.  Now honestly it is a very basic style hotel but then again it's about 1/3 the cost of where I'm staying now...and my current place is very cheap by Canadian standards.  

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/93f1895c-8be0-403e-aa31-73a6e4021792.jpg)

Then I had to cross the street near the Ciputra mall.  Sure those 3 lanes don't look too bad but that's only half the road and they have the big forest divided in the middle.  When it comes up to intersection?  6 lanes of chaos.  I like the overpass.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/338c3f6b-b503-4780-b5f1-b01ea8384ad2.jpg)

There's the Ciputra mall.  It is very clean and bright inside but lacks the real world charm of walking the street so I just kept on walking.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9ec6e07b-0e9b-46e4-a417-21f67cc936aa.jpg)

I saw this place which looked like a nice clean hotel so I took a picture to look it up back at my hotel.  Surprise it was actually a wood working company.  Kind of interesting to me.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/547c444f-11b3-4ce8-9227-b5061a0242f6.jpg)

That up above actually *was* a hotel.  You have to look really closely or you will miss it.  It is also way cheaper than where I'm staying.  I'll probably have to book something so see just what I miss if I cut my budget by 70% :)  As an interesting side note... There was a massage place a couple doors down in the same complex.  My wife had a massage before she left so I thought maybe I would get one.  I went in to check the price and was pointed to a sign saying \

...that's like a month.  When I got back to my hotel?  Same thing.  Spa closed.  Seems the government banned all spa,s, massage places both public and private, even the women's only massage.  I was really surprised when I found out that they have decency police who will actively go around checking hotel rooms to verify compliance.  As a Canadian that was odd but here it is apparently normal.  

That's why you travel ... To see different ways of doing things.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a8b47209-34ad-444a-9bad-598d13b9f7b4.jpg)

Then I found \

and thought... Cool another grocery store near the hotel. I looked closer and it is actually an engineering firm. I thought that was just odd. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/75528c45-8066-4f06-9259-2cb740f4d56f.jpg) I kept going and finally got to the Holland Bakery. Now I see it every morning from the breakfast buffet window. It looks kind of shabby when seen from above (the hotel buffet is on a high floor) but in person it was quitec nice. I bought a few doughnuts because they were cheap and looked yummy. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e0e86f8f-77fa-4d87-90da-469081ddad82.jpg) I kept on moving and found a memorial cemetery. Cool but not really a tourist attraction of place to visit. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/70f2acaa-f05f-4fff-9396-39023a9fc86c.jpg) Then I got to the McDonalds. I didn't want fast food but on the other side of the street the road is impassable. I was hoping that maybe on this side of the street it wouldn't be as bad. Hahaha Wishful thinking ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/452c6a75-494c-4a2e-a1d3-a95ee539fb17.jpg) Then when I was walking back the Otep Otep store caught my eye. Mostly because I couldn't figure out what it was. From the sidewalk it kind of looked like a weird auto parts store. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a4aac387-ac13-4efb-ade7-7bfebb32abbe.jpg) I went inside and found out that it was a specialty food store which sells Indonesian food products geared at tourists. I had to smile...my wife spent so much time roaming the mall looking for Indonesian stuff to take home as gifts and the store that sold only that kind of stuff was right across the street from the hotel she didn't want to be in. I didn't actually buy anything to take back home because I have ZERO space in my luggage/backpack. I did see that they had competitively priced diet soda and it was really hot so I bought two and smiled Then it was back home to rest and enjoy my evening. ... Almost 11K steps complete.

title.title: Pandan Jam Cake for Breaking the Fast
title.body:
> ![20260125_122438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Ep7vX353xDDqsN75A6UiB88astdHjF4mKmr7z7x2p6JtDiHPu7gs8jqvkqMSim4hwcq.jpg)
Breaking the fast with sweet treats and fried foods has somehow become a tradition in my area. Every time it's time to break the fast, there are always fried snacks. Whether it's tempeh, risol, bakwan, or even other types of traditional cakes, they are often the mainstay of our serving plates. This time, I'm cooking something light with a sweet, home-style flavor. This cake is a favorite of many people and is often served at family gatherings and other events. It is also a sweet snack that is often enjoyed with tea.
Pandan Gabin Fla
![20260125_122503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xL2ipFSgpZvQwHCq2ciYwcW5N5ixoHGaQaRLy13CxsqiPBcYHZa8iSAYUB4qJTC5j8N.jpg)
Gabin fla is a fried gabin petak biscuit filled with pandan fla. Usually, gabin fla is not only filled with pandan, but many people add other types of fillings such as sweet potato, tape, or even other jams according to their taste. The process of making it is almost the same, but the treatment when making the jam will be very different. Usually, the key to the deliciousness of this cake is in the jam, so the process of making the jam must be paid attention to. Here, I will guide you through one of my favorite recipes for pandan-flavored gabin fla cookies.
Ingredients
![20260125_091747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoeFKWEeNnFd5iZSXJryoKkSNt14owLabz3KwVtHiZjT88DrvbnWLhGt4ZfLr3MbHVA.jpg)
1 pack of gabin biscuits 1 egg 300 ml of liquid milk 2 tablespoons of cornstarch 2 tablespoons of powdered milk 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar 100 grams of all-purpose flour
Procedure for Making
Mix milk, salt, and sugar, stirring until the sugar dissolves.

> ![20260125_091836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xL9NyiKWJsv3ubsRjX9QS9urTmcDBWYKi7qJnin786AiKh6KChtmzof1vaW9Qzu43XE.jpg)
Then add flour, cornstarch, and powdered milk to the pan.

> ![20260125_091844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTeuUNcV2JseufhnPEwzJQb24H4BZtNRnEvwT9KErEesK4g9RUbrLXCSKxsQbrCuWbo.jpg)
Then cook. While cooking, I remembered to add pandan paste, which should have been added at the beginning when stirring the jam mixture.

> ![20260125_093655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgDBaxMWbCUzu5DsqrMrjE95GYuPByjHqyaJVUnNLy6baNCf5Re4sf9kuRXuSDJJt3X.jpg)
Wait for the jam to cool slightly, then spread it on the biscuits. Spread it evenly on the surface of the biscuits, then stick them together with other biscuits.

> ![20260125_093810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2sLv9g41aNmjrjFojTgLVHMHomVZtKaA5KRpiwURsDmPDDZFSKD5G93Wt28iFCBbDb.jpg)
Make a coating mixture of 4 tablespoons of all-purpose flour and salt to taste, mix with water and stir until smooth. Then dip the filled gabin bread into the mixture.

> ![20260125_095421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zbRuVhRGmcqdrBMWWgvNc8i5CVLgMjYSXzyp8CmBEUPWr7xNYt19xm5EBCGmLkL9GTb.jpg)
Fry immediately in hot oil over low heat until golden brown.

> ![20260125_100411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vi21JyV2zaPmW81vfGRc6y2fnyE82UoCZ33eyMc9AyA8J6xuJGyaeGao9Fd33XaREna.jpg)
Result
![20260125_122657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wCLbQhxqagWkwerpt72xwpkYKMSgg5njZYzoH8ascpLvUz2qk7NGvPUuDhz6rGxLKUu.jpg) My pandan jam-filled gabin bread is ready to enjoy. Serve while warm or at room temperature—both are excellent. Especially when enjoyed with a nice cup of tea, I'm sure it will be delicious. The jam has a very soft texture, and the outside is very crispy, which makes it even more delicious.

> ![20260125_122713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xpFHumeQMvSds1VrpPPNte7ZvTCUAcdghSeFWAwtUSQKksFqifXAcjvhc7EjNLNnUzt.jpg)
The taste is sweet, savory, and absolutely delicious. I love this cake, especially since it's my mother's favorite dish. ![20260125_122624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpJaTVpTKTsdM4akQvBRWbEPZvFwcZyPuhjbhqy35maVhDTVv7wZYqpn2KarCBHzsqK.jpg)
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

About The Author
Welcome to this blog, I have a real name \

, who comes from Indonesia. I have several hobbies, reading, writing, gardening, I also love food and cooking, even art related.  And the most interesting one is spending the whole day traveling. From those hobbies, I will share some inspiring content for all of you, I hope you like my blog, please and reblog this post if you like it!.</sub>

# The Social Dynamics of Penguin Colonies: Communication, Cooperation, and Conflict

Penguins, with their charming waddles and striking black-and-white plumage, have long captivated the hearts of people around the world. However, beneath their adorable exterior lies a complex social structure that is essential for their survival in the harsh environments they inhabit. In this post, we will explore the intricate social dynamics of penguin colonies, focusing on their communication, cooperation, and conflict.

## Communication: The Language of Penguins

Penguins are highly social birds that rely on a variety of vocalizations and body language to communicate with one another. Each species has its own unique calls, which can convey different messages such as:

- **Mating Calls**: During the breeding season, male penguins use distinctive calls to attract females and establish their territory.
- **Chick Communication**: Parent penguins and their chicks develop specific vocalizations that help them recognize each other in crowded colonies.
- **Alarm Calls**: Penguins also have warning calls that alert others to potential threats, such as predators or environmental dangers.

### Non-Verbal Communication

In addition to vocalizations, penguins use body language to express emotions and intentions. For instance, a penguin may bow its head or flap its wings to display aggression or courtship behavior. Understanding these signals is crucial for maintaining social harmony within the colony.

## Cooperation: Working Together for Survival

The social structure of penguin colonies is heavily based on cooperation. Here are some key aspects of their collaborative behavior:

### Breeding and Parenting

Many penguin species, such as the Emperor and Adélie penguins, exhibit strong parental care, with both parents sharing responsibilities for incubating eggs and feeding chicks. This cooperative breeding strategy enhances the survival rates of their offspring.

### Foraging

Penguins often forage in groups, which provides several advantages:

- **Increased Efficiency**: By hunting together, they can locate food sources more effectively and reduce the risk of predation.
- **Safety in Numbers**: Foraging in groups helps protect individual penguins from predators, as there is safety in numbers.

## Conflict: Navigating Rivalries and Competition

While cooperation is vital for survival, conflict is an inevitable part of social dynamics in penguin colonies. Competition can arise over resources such as food and nesting sites. Here are some common forms of conflict:

### Aggressive Interactions

Penguins may engage in aggressive displays or physical confrontations to establish dominance or defend their territory. These conflicts can involve vocalizations, posturing, and even pecking.

### Resource Competition

During the breeding season, competition for prime nesting sites can lead to disputes among penguins. In some cases, a dominant pair may usurp the nests of others, leading to tension within the colony.

## Conclusion: The Balance of Social Dynamics

The social dynamics of penguin colonies are a fascinating interplay of communication, cooperation, and conflict. Understanding these behaviors not only enhances our appreciation of these remarkable birds but also sheds light on the evolutionary strategies that enable them to thrive in some of the planet's most challenging environments.

As research continues, we uncover more about the complexities of penguin societies, revealing the intricate web of relationships that define their existence. Observing these dynamics can inspire us to reflect on our own social structures and the importance of communication and cooperation in our lives.

title.title: [ENG-SPN] A Medieval Photo Booth in El Arenal / Un fotomatón medieval en El Arenal
title.body:
![P1190249.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqQP5TzNARRqNFGHKjfbN6dLtjvXjQs4Z3NkH2NNcBtSjoyS18v6SZGQXNXJ9Ro3p1S.JPG)

On the western facade that leads to its beautiful porticoed gallery, we have the curious feeling of standing before a monumental medieval photo booth, where the diligent stonemasons recorded different faces. Their intentions, though obviously far removed from those administrative traps whose purpose we don't quite understand today—passports—nonetheless hint at the formidable social standing of their time.

![P1190324.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23ydA5HzLy3TZwEvKTmbjAFZQr1adMV29a7in6QSQeS6tRKLoinUesAwgidh856qUgfv2.JPG)

We find ourselves on the outskirts of a village called El Arenal, in the somber light of midday, in the solitary Romanesque church dedicated to Saint John the Baptist—the same one who had to diminish so that Christ might grow, and the same one who lost his head for Salome—in whose sculpture we again encounter that hallmark, the mark of stonemasons' guilds. In their sculpture, besides the repetition of certain archetypes, we observe the insistence on finding them interwoven with that mysterious nature, represented by vines and tendrils, a hidden reference, perhaps, to ancient cults, which characterizes the vast majority of the churches we have been highlighting on our route.

![P1190325.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23wX3na787eyFQeCNkyUN3aeKHtiozC6RRr1Mb8JfhhmfVYpDPG7vy9HcgUs2BF3p6r5a.JPG)

In the Church of San Juan, therefore, we encounter once again those familiar biases, represented, for example, by chattering harpies who seem to conspire to stir the desires of a spectator—the superstitious medieval man—mixed with New Testament scenes, some mysteriously vanished and replaced by modern, silent capitals, and also with that precise carving of nature, which, besides being that wondrous environment, full of life, mystery, and myths, contained remedies whose knowledge and symbolism, after all, were not unknown at the time, often constituting the prelude to old folk remedies.

![P1190263.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpVB56RGxeXHoSoAQwuaYqzsssPpfcEiGdki5JbZrPkrUNiBX9HSLDjQ9e7yHh7xgHY.JPG)

En la portada de poniente que da acceso a su hermosa galería porticada, tenemos la curiosa sensación de encontrarnos frente a un monumental fotomatón medieval, donde los afanados canteros consignaron diferentes rostros, cuyas intenciones, aunque lejos estaban, obviamente, de esas trampas administrativas que hoy en día no sabemos exactamente para qué sirven, los pasaportes, dejan entrever, no obstante, el formidable estamento social de su época.

![P1190327.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xyZGxbsym4tDHHNtiphPXazzQiaLWPxeTpdWWeQs8jGY5tPNABNn6vSLZ6Wqp8vd4pG.JPG)

Nos encontramos a las afueras de un pueblo, de nombre El Arenal, a la taciturna luz del mediodía, en la solitaria iglesia románica dedicada a la figura de San Juan Bautista -el mismo que tenía que menguar para que Cristo creciera y el mismo, también, que perdió la cabeza por Salomé- en cuya escultura, volvemos a encontrarnos esa seña de identidad, que es la huella de unas cofradías de canteros, en cuya escultura, además de la repetitividad de unos arquetipos determinados, observamos la insistencia de volverlos a encontrar entreverados en esa misteriosa naturaleza, representada por unas lianas y unos zarcillos, referencia soterrada, posiblemente, a los antiguos cultos, que caracteriza a la gran mayoría de templos que venimos destacando en nuestra ruta.

![P1190317.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/243zditHMYKPyRSnznfng4S2XoygPX1Akn5Kye6iKdGF9Nd4LQasMCr8gHV4ZgSVdthqy.JPG)

En el templo de San Juan, por tanto, volvemos a encontrarnos con esos sesgos familiares, representados, por ejemplo, por unas arpías parlanchinas que parecen ponerse de acuerdo para alentar el deseo de un espectador, el supersticioso hombre medieval, mezcladas con escenas neotestamentarias, algunas misteriosamente desaparecidas y sustituidas por modernos capiteles mudos y también con esa precisa labra de una naturaleza, que, además de ser ese entorno prodigioso, lleno de vida, de misterio y de mitos, contenía remedios, cuyo conocimiento y simbolismo, después de todo, no era desconocido en la época, constituyendo, en muchas ocasiones, el preludio de los viejos remedios populares.

![P1190248.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23yTm86CmiQe7soM54eK7pJfTCKjEn3TC6xHrRDstYFvJ7rfAP4euXAMVgQ7HmFHDLv4C.JPG)

title.title: Wonder August's lesson [Book Review] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Miniatura para Youtube Tips de Marketing Digital Moderno Rosa y Blanco (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23x19UVwo4WUvHKPzAqmAWRKTHsiRYjL1remPevcKuJXnV3Dmqs7Z3BoLFXdejirJFUZ7.jpg)

Hello, internet people! How are you? I recently found this gem, a book that made me reflect a lot on our lives, the way we sometimes complain about problems that are really trivial compared to the situation some people in the world are living through, so for this reason I think the title of the book is very fitting, \

by R.J. Palacio.\n\n>¡Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Recientemente encontré esta joya, un libro que me hizo reflexionar mucho acerca de nuestras vidas, la manera en que a veces nos quejamos de problemas que son realmente banales en comparación con la situación que viven algunas personas en el mundo, así que por esta razón pienso que el título del libro es muy acertado, \

por R.J. Palacio.

August Pullman is a ten-year-old boy who has had to deal his entire life with a rare condition called Treacher Collins Syndrome, which deformed his face. Besides facing the challenges of living with this condition, such as medical expenses, hospitalization, and undergoing numerous tests and surgeries, he has also had to cope with loneliness. Always homeschooled, he couldn't socialize normally with other children. However, when August enters fifth grade, he faces the biggest challenge of his life: for the first time, he enters a school. There, unfortunately, he is subjected to prying eyes, judgment, and worst of all, bullying, ridicule, and rejection. But amidst these unpleasant encounters and experiences, two characters I adore emerge: Summer and Jack Will, who value August beyond his peculiar appearance. They listen to him, understand him, and open their hearts to him.

>August Pullman es un niño de diez años que ha tenido que lidiar toda su vida con una extraña enfermedad llamada \

, la cuál deformó su rostro, pero además de tener que enfrentarse a los retos que implica padecer esa enfermedad, como gastos médicos, hospitalización y someterse a un montón de análisis médicos además de cirugías, también ha tenido que enfrentarse a la soledad, pues siempre fue educado en casa y no podía convivir normalmente con otros niños, sin embargo cuando August llega al quinto grado se enfrenta al mayor reto de su vida, pues por primera vez entra a una escuela, y allí lamentablemente es objeto de miradas indiscretas, juicios y lo peor de todo, el acoso, las burlas y el rechazo, pero en medio de esos encuentros y experiencias desagradables surge un par de personajes que adoro 😍: Summer y Jack, quienes valoran a August por encima de su apariencia peculiar: lo escuchan, lo entienden y le abren su corazón.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xebfxLGEhMFMYotjCV2QmTQpxHVha6sk535TiwvMq6vrRPqiY6U48KFgVQLTXmnoEaN.png)
[Fuente](https://alquimista.com.bo/product/16172_wonder_la_leccion_de_augusto?srsltid=AfmBOopOsb0H4CQB8zMLtd5uYpVoWECsnkpNuZDjwsxTT2hTtYrI-Dyc)

Something I truly appreciated about this book is that it doesn't just show the brutality of bullying—there are times when you, as the reader, are filled with rage and helplessness seeing what happens and how they torment someone whose illness is already torment enough—but it also shows the importance of friendship, empathy, and love. August isn't just a victim; he's a resilient and brave child. He's still a child, like everyone else, with dreams and aspirations, but with a maturity that many adults would envy. The bullying scenes are disturbing and difficult to read, but absolutely necessary for us to grasp the gravity of the situation and try to put ourselves in the victim's shoes.

>Algo que realmente aprecié de esta lectura es que no solo te muestra la crudeza del acoso, hay ocasiones en que tú como lector te llenas de rabia e impotencia al ver lo que sucede, y como se ensañan con alguien cuya enfermedad es suficiente tormento, pero también te muestra la importancia de la amistad, la empatía y el amor. Auugust no es solo una victima, es un niño resiliente y valiente, sigue siendo un niño, como todos, con sueños e ilusiones, aunque con una gran madurez que muchos adultos envidiarían. Las escenas de acoso son molestas y difíciles de leer, pero absolutamente necesarias para que podamos dimensionar la gravedad de la situación y tratemos de ponernos en el lugar de la víctima.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tbkNns1vXH5wLE2fsDWL2pypQ58zFExVZFE4P25Ya7mstSJTDvzdkUALt845FPiJ9ou.png)
[Fuente](https://www.decoratel.com/2018/07/25/la-pelicula-infantil-mas-taquillera-y-entranable-del-2017/)

The book's structure is very appealing, as it features multiple narrators, and I think this offers a comprehensive and complete view of how August's situation affects his surroundings. Furthermore, I believe the book is necessary because it aims to foster empathy towards people who are different, while simultaneously raising awareness about the normalization of these differences. It seeks to help children understand that there are people who suffer from these types of illnesses, that these are situations they cannot control, and that this doesn't make them \

They are simply people with different conditions who have the same right to be included as everyone else, and therefore should be treated with respect and viewed with admiration rather than contempt.

\n\n>La estructura del libro es muy atractiva, ya que tiene varios narradores, y yo pienso que esto ofrece una visión integral y completa acerca de como la situación de August afecta el entorno, por otra parte creo que el libro es necesario porque pretende generar empatía hacia las personas que son diferentes, pero al mismo tiempo busca crear consciencia también acerca de la normalización de esas diferencias, que los niños comprendan que hay personas que padecen este tipo de enfermedades, que son situaciones que ellos no pueden controlar, que eso no los vuelve \

, solo son personas con condiciones distintas, que tienen el mismo derecho a integrarse que tenemos todos, y que por lo tanto se les debe tratar con respeto y mirarlos con admiración en lugar de desprecio.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/AKCJuqm2tm8RFT8PMFq4XhYVG9QTYFkREKQkBdSoQW6HVMqWNtit6DBhAtqpbhL.png)
[Fuente](https://www.mijuegobonito.com/products/wonder-la-leccion-de-august-novela-juvenil-sobre-amistad-autoestima-e-inclusion-nube-de-tinta-a-partir-de-10-anos-mi-juego-bonito?srsltid=AfmBOoq5U3G7QK9SJJxXDzedvp3VsgVs94OTQlqF8METbYDDxw-bZtev)

August is a life teacher who comes to teach a lesson in empathy and love, but this leads me to talk about two characters who, for me, take the prize in terms of development and evolution 🤗 I'm referring, of course, to Jack Will and Summer. They went from being cowardly children, afraid of others' judgment, to valuable friends who overcame social pressure. Because, after all, the greatest enemy is social pressure, the desire to fit into a space where everything seems \
August fell outside that standard, and for that reason, Jack began to speak ill of him, trying to conform to \

However, when he decided to defend him, he broke the mold, demonstrating that labels are nothing more than that: facades, farces. What truly matters is being true to your heart, that being kind costs nothing and, in return, you can gain a valuable friendship that transcends any prejudice. This makes Jack and Summer (who sat next to him on the first day when no one else wanted to) such brave characters, so I love them 😍

\n\n>August es un maestro de vida que viene a dar una lección de empatía y amor, pero esto me lleva a hablar de dos personajes que para mi se llevan el premio en cuanto desarrollo y evolución 🤗 me refiero por supuesto a Jack Will y Summer, pues pasaron de ser niños cobardes, que le temían a los juicios de los demás, a valiosos amigos que superaron la presión social, porque después de todo el mayor enemigo es la presión social, el querer encajar en un espacio en el que todo parece \
August se salía de ese estándar y por esa razón Jack comenzó a hablar mal de él, para tratar de amoldarse a la \

sin embargo cuando decide salir en su defensa rompió el molde, demostró que las etiquetas no son más que eso, fachadas, farsas, lo que realmente importa es serle fiel a tu corazón, que ser amable no cuesta nada y en cambio puedes ganar una valiosa amistad que esté por encima de cualquier prejuicio. Esto convierte a Jack y Summer (quién se sentó a su lado el primer día cuando nadie más quería hacerlo) en personajes valientes, así que los amo 😍
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wgMzYf3zJkBDFaQG98M1oLCkPDtezN27ys39o4RfP18KL9Hq13CbRxFFJ9sSN2ZVD9d.png)
[Fuente](https://felpecta.cl/products/wonder-la-leccion-de-august-aniv?srsltid=AfmBOopXgjqw12C_iw42qV9Eq5s9vqPzx1pymOGCXYzIxSok-nn6Y_np)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

I made the cover and farewell image in Canva

>La imagen de portada y despedida la realicé en Canva.
