In 2026, the cryptocurrency market will enter a more mature, regulated stage, while the popularity of trusted trading platforms will increase. Traders who were afraid due to high development costs and technical challenges are now entering the market with great confidence. A major reason behind this change is the increasing acceptance of cryptocurrency exchange scripts as a fast and smart way to start an exchange business.

A recent market research has shown that the global cryptocurrency exchange platform market will exceed USD 68 billion by 2026, with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of more than 25. Meanwhile, the number of crypto users worldwide has exceeded 560 million, indicating that interest in trading digital assets remains stable despite market cycles. These figures make it clear that opening an exchange business in 2026 is not only possible but also a well-considered decision.

However, success lies in the method of entering the market. The default method for an exchange is no longer to create something out of nothing. Today’s businesses are concerned with speed, scalability, and risk reduction, which is where exchange scripts come in.

<h2 style=\

>
Rapid Market Penetration At Reduced Business Risk Timing is essential in crypto. Market dynamics are volatile, and even a window can be missed at the cost of significant user adoption. A cryptocurrency exchange script helps founders overcome traditional development hurdles and reduce operational risk.

>Key benefits include: An off-the-shelf exchange infrastructure that reduces development time by up to 60-70 percent over CSB. An unstructured architecture that reduces early technical failures. Faster time to market, which allows businesses to gain users and cash flow early. Startups have the option of spending less upfront capital on marketing and compliance. Industry data shows that it can take 12-18 months to build a custom exchange, compared to weeks or a few months to launch a script-based platform. This speed advantage can be a long-term winner in a competitive environment where already-developed exchange systems have already captured the attention of users. Moreover, exchange scripts are based on well-established business models that are already recognized by the market. This greatly reduces the risk exposure for first-time founders who want some predictable results instead of experimental construction.

>
Strategic Development with a Cryptocurrency Exchange Development Company Even if they start with scripts, the potential for long-term success lies in the customization, security, and scalability of the platform. This is where working with a professional cryptocurrency exchange development company becomes crucial. A development company not only provides the software, but also helps in defining your exchange as a competitive business asset.
>They typically play the following roles:\n\n*

>Customizing the cryptocurrency exchange script to match your revenue model
Increasing security levels to match current compliance requirements.
Upgrading the platform to accommodate higher trading volumes.
Approving regulatory alignment in accordance with your target jurisdiction.

Security is a major deciding factor for users. It has been reported that billions of dollars have been lost to crypto-related attacks and security breaches over the past decade. Exchanges that do not take security seriously will not gain user trust in the short term. Development companies will address this by implementing new security levels and conducting regular system audits. Furthermore, scalability is required. The volume of trade on centralized exchanges continues to represent almost 85-90% of international crypto transactions, which means that users still rely on high-performance platforms. A competent development partner ensures that your platform can withstand traffic surges, asset growth, and feature additions without causing disruptions. By combining a cryptocurrency exchange script with expert development support, businesses gain both speed and stability - two factors that investors and users will value most in 2026.

>
Why is 2026 the right time to get involved? The crypto market is no longer a purely speculative market. Exchanges have become sustainable businesses in most areas due to regulatory clarity, institutional participation, and excellent infrastructure. Web traffic statistics on major exchanges indicate that hundreds of millions of people visit them every month, indicating a steady demand from users even in a sideways market.

>Mature technology stacks
Best-practice exchange revenue models.
Reduced technical barriers to entry.
Growing global adoption

A cryptocurrency exchange script allows you to take advantage of these conditions without overextending capital or time. When paired with the right cryptocurrency exchange development company, it can become a powerful launching pad for building a scalable and compliant exchange business.

>
Final Thoughts Choosing a cryptocurrency exchange script in 2026 is not just a technical decision, it’s a strategic business move. This allows for rapid deployments, is economical, low-risk, and long-term. This strategy is well-suited for startups and enterprises in the current market situation and future growth prospects of the crypto market.

title.title: 📷 Shooting Graz in the Snow for the very first time [EN/DE]
title.body:
![_DSC9889.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ1exBAxqGBLLYc4BSTboqSDfsjpo6sEYtumKyASrjWT2/_DSC9889.jpg)

I had been waiting for these conditions literally for years. I finally wanted to photograph Graz in heavy snowfall, but winter after winter had been virtually snowless in recent years. When I looked out of the window yesterday morning, I thought, “It's now or never!” I grabbed my camera and umbrella and headed straight out into the wintery weather. It was actually my very first photo tour in the snow ever. And it turned out to be much more challenging than I had imagined. Optimistic as I am, I screwed on my small, lightweight 85mm lens, which is not weatherproof. This allowed me to take photos with the camera in one hand and the umbrella in the other. However, I didn't take into account that the weather was a bit stormy and the snow was whipping almost directly at my body and thus also at the camera. I tried to hold it under my arm when I wasn't taking pictures, but it still got wet and I was constantly worried about whether it would survive. It did, but the next problem was that water droplets formed on the lens, of course. This in turn hindered the autofocus, which was already struggling with the snowflakes and was therefore anything but reliable. I hadn't packed a microfiber cloth to wipe the lens aperture, so I came home with lots of out-of-focus pictures, some of which fortunately still had the desired effect. Looking back, I probably should have used one of my weathersealed lenses, left the umbrella at home, and kept both hands free to regularly wipe the water droplets off the lens and focus better – perhaps using semi-manual focus. But as the saying goes, hindsight is always 20/20. I hope you like the pictures anyway. There are more to come, and then I'll tell you about the challenges of post-processing snow photos.

*Buchstäblich Jahre lang hatte ich auf diese Bedingungen gewartet. Ich wollte Graz endlich im dichten Schneefall fotografieren, doch Winter um Winter blieben so gut wie schneelos in den vergangenen Jahren. Als ich gestern morgen aus dem Fenster schaute, dachte ich \

, schnappte meine Kamera und meinen Regenschirm und dann ging es direkt hinein in das winterliche Treiben. Es war tatsächlich meine allererste Foto-Tour im Schnee überhaupt. Und diese gestaltete sich wesentlich herausfordernder, als ich es mir vorgestellt hatte. Optimistisch wie ich bin, schraubte ich mein kleines, leichtes 85mm-Objektiv auf, das jedoch nicht gegen Nässe abgedichtet ist. So konnte ich mit der Kamera in einer und dem Schirm in der anderen Hand fotografieren. Was ich jedoch nicht berücksichtigte: Das Wetter war etwas stürmisch und peitschte mir den Schnee teilweise fast frontal an den Körper und somit auch die Kamera. Ich versuchte sie unter dem Arm zu halten, wenn ich nicht gerade fotografierte, aber trotzdem wurde sie nass und ich war in ständiger Sorge, ob sie wohl alles gut überstehen würde. Das tat sie aber das nächste Problem war, dass sich natürlich auch Wassertropfen an der Linse bildeten. Dies behinderte wiederum den Autofokus, der ohnehin bereits mit den Schneeflocken zu kämpfen hatte und somit alles andere als zuverlässig funktionierte. Ein Mikorofasertuch, um die Objektivöffnung abzuwischen hatte ich nicht eingepackt und so kam ich mit vielen falsch fokussierten Bildern nach Hause, die zum Glück teilweise ihre Wirkung trotzdem nicht verfehlten. Rückblickend hätte ich wohl lieber eines meiner wetterfesten Objektive verwendet, die Regenschirm zuhause gelassen und stattdessen beide Hände frei gehabt, um die Linse regelmäßig von den Wassertropfen zu befreien und besser – eventuell halbmanuell fokussieren zu können. Aber wie heißt es so schön: Hinterher ist man immer gescheiter. Ich hoffe, die Bilder gefallen euch trotzdem. Es folgen aber noch weitere und dann erzähle ich euch von den Herausforderungen in der Nachbearbeitung von Schnee-Fotos.*

![_DSC9880.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXBqPZ6egvM4wVHUjjy1csmyxxoDyCkqFvr1MmB1rXZQ6/_DSC9880.jpg)

![_DSC9888.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTK7X8D2rESqZvWyEV8xWGptArx1HysQMVtWCSZsAcSi/_DSC9888.jpg)

![_DSC9910.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYGdiXByuq3f2dBZe4ngZywDKwr94PDY7HAsD3rhajCvr/_DSC9910.jpg)

![_DSC9928.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWmPJ5yTokAMJpkCEU7oV7TsVL5qk8CPztenyix47obZC/_DSC9928.jpg)

![_DSC9917.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzuhNsZjoiL1ZH4PkVQGwgz48w3mojoSCcYEiSW7gsKC/_DSC9917.jpg)

![_DSC9927.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvwUi7QhefMQf7rdVJfZBCkjbLnRdwgjz6ybEE4bLaB1/_DSC9927.jpg)

title.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 45 - Path of Revenge
title.body:
*Kaito sets on the path of darkness...*


-------

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. The game follows a group of children who find themselves in another world, and their desperate attempts to find a way back home. The children find themselves involved with monsters, both as partners and enemies.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYxYrUe4wXH9oDtGmVLsPdonXxwxLMstxfcwbpPGMgxPb/1000071477.webp
 

This is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed, and [Cybersleuth](https://inleo.io/@ahmadmanga/gaming-snaplog-digimon-world-cyber-slueth-the-darkest-case-living-doll-dead-person?referral=ahmadmanga) had pretty dark stuff too. **Digimon Survive** fuses the concept of Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:

https://youtu.be/GmLaTYIAe44


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### 45 - Path of Revenge


In this session Kaito leaves the party, and goes on a path of revenge. He meets up with Haru, who we know for sure is Renamon, to a place he could take revenge of the Master...


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb9mvJRoCSkf1yxrbjfP1GqAtuSkSUgQcN9jgU7udxTSG/vlcsnap-2026-02-20-00h15m07s605.jpg

___

I was placed on a diet by my partner so now I may only have a single beer on special occasions. This is a good thing for my health in the long run, but it is strange how you crave that crisp taste of a cold beer! 

Either way, this was a special beer, so it deserves my full attention. 

Afro Caribbean Brewing Company makes some crazy and strange beers, and they also ask a pretty penny for their beers. Sometimes I can really just not justify the amount they ask. But in this case, the strange cherry art on the can convinced me to buy it. 

Funny how art can cause you to buy a beer! 

Either way, join me on this taste-adventure as I drink a delicious beer for #BeerSaturday!

|-|-|-|

> ![_DSC9524.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wfrGLJgv4kmtWMyKADFCrdx6yyoa21ufGRTQEsTaxE5942sxyVq7TLcPbw16EqoqBSu.JPG) The first smell was kind of confusing for me. It had some Weiss beer notes, yeasty, then suddenly very swee. It was only then followed by some cherry. But it had predominantly that classic red ale fruitiness. For my partner, it was predominantly cherry cola, saying that it was the beer version of cherry cola! The first taste was sweet, with strong and unpront cherry notes. There was a lack of bitterness and only dry sweetness - probably from added sugars. I did not get any bubblegum really. It was, nonetheless, and interesting beer. Very nice! Interesting and playful, but not really the style of beer that I would buy for myself, in fact, after seeing the price I paid for the beer versus what I got, I cannot even begin to think how they got to that price. title.title: Diversification is a Critical Strategy Every Investor Must Follow
title.body:
Hello Hive Fam!

I hope your day is going well and that you're having a good time. 

Investing is a journey for me, and I believe that we continue to learn and improve, but there is no end. I have been investing in the stock market from last 8 years, and still there are many things that I need to learn about. Diversification is one of the parts that I learned during covid time, and it is critical. I believe that every investor should follow diversification with the investment, and it helps manage it well. It's like they were putting all your eggs in one basket because you never know when things go the other way round, and all your investment will be at risk, and you'll lose a lot of value. I started following the diversification after the Covid lockdown Because that was the time when I got the opportunity to learn many things in my investing journey. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23uFgcBv9QodUEQXDZzH2aQBQW4vQApA5VLuoD9VDCA7rtEJ3jRHhuVLnZUZromUXUtJt.png)

(AI-created image)

Risk management is a critical part of investment, and with diversification, we can minimise it. It is never possible to keep risk at 0% in any investment, but it can be minimised by following certain strategies. If somebody says any segment is risk-free, then I'm not going to believe it because I believe that risk-free investment does not exist. I have seen many situations where something looked very good and promising, but at some point in time, it turned out to be a loss-making segment and investment altogether.

Some of the benefits that we can achieve with diversification are as follows:-

* Risk Management (Risk Mitigation)
* Optimise Returns
* Market Volatility mitigation
* Exposure in multiple segments
* Long-Term Goal

We can do the risk management biodiversification because if there is a segment that looks more promising, then there is also a probability of risk, so putting a certain percentage of the capital on that segment can be a good idea. It also helps us to optimise returns because sometimes a few segments perform better and with diversification we can get benefited of those returns, so in a way we are optimising returns in the best possible way. Markets are volatile, but different markets have different types of volatility. So if we have the exposure segment, then the possibility of returns can be high. It is recommended that long-term investing is the best strategy to follow, and along with that, managing the risk through diversification is equally important. Where investors can mitigate the risk and probably achieve better returns in the long term, diversification plays a critical role.


My investment portfolio is diversified in real estate and cryptocurrencies, where crypto is the latest addition I made last year. Even in the crypto segment, I am diversified because I don't believe in one coin, so having a couple of them in my basket looks good. Hive looks promising to me, but I can not ignore Bitcoin, so I have both in my list. Thank you!

title.title: MMA fatigue:  over-exposure has me not really caring about events these days
title.body:
I don't think I would have even known that this card was happening had I not opened my website of choice for sports just to check the Olympic hockey results but apparently there is a pretty stacked card that is taking pace tonight.  

I can't even be asked to watch it despite the fact that there are some pretty great matchups on the card.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/Eoc6a1bRxEWusTGEyrnmTWaBaomwoj1gYrR7dzHZN98jDogX3MWbLeZUwu4Rfn3b8Pj.png)
[src](https://www.threads.com/@homeoffight/post/DR8p9KVCLO9/media)</center> 

Sean Strickland is more of a guy to watch because of his outspoken and brash nature.  I wouldn't really consider him a top talent though.  Leading up to this fight he has done his best to stir up controversy saying some really sexist things that don't have anything to do with MMA.   I think he really wants some of that Colby Covington sort of press where he is the heel on purpose.   

There is also a Dan Ige fight and I haven't seen that guy in ages. I just kind of presumed he was retired.  Dude has lost 3 of his last 4 so I would imagine he probably isn't that far away from getting retired whether he wants to or not.   This may be  a swan song for him.   

<center> https://media.video-cdn.espn.com/motion/2025/0412/dm_250412_dm_ufc_rogan_cormier_bad_stop/dm_250412_dm_ufc_rogan_cormier_bad_stop.jpg
[src](https://media.video-cdn.espn.com/motion/2025/0412/dm_250412_dm_ufc_rogan_cormier_bad_stop/dm_250412_dm_ufc_rogan_cormier_bad_stop.jpg)</center>

I believe Dan's best work is in his past and he is just a jobber now that is kept around to push younger talent to the top until his name no longer has any merit associated with it.   nobody has ever accused him of being good-looking either.   Ok, now I am just being mean.   

Looking at the rest of the card it seems like we could actually get some decent fights and since it is a Fight Night and not a major event, normally the fighters are going to really go for it and try to win rather than trying to \

\n\nI think the idea is better than the actual show will be though and this is because of over-exposure for most of us out there in MMA-fandom.   When UFC had 1 event per month it was something that I could get excited for but then they started the Fight Nights, the ESPN events, the reality show called \

and just went too far with it.   Also, now that all events stream on Paramount and there is no such thing as a Pay Per View event anymore, the entire fiasco is going to be absolutely inundated with commercials and this was something that didn't happen a few years back when the events were all Pay Per View.   

The reason why I tolerate packed schedules in other sports like basketball, football, and baseball is because there are seasons and most importantly, and END to that season.   This gives us time to miss it and be excited about upcoming events.  With UFC, it never ends and while I was willing to get on board for a once-a-month thing I just can't get excited about something that happens ever single week.    

I won't even watch this one and will just catch the highlights on Sunday morning instead.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23wXQmeLdkFFmmh3Lfm3FPmqLBfw9pxMeqEnf2FtWu5srg58sbESQrZDMUepa6cyB3JRm.png)
</center>

I don't think the UFC even cares very much about this event.  In the many years that I have been following UFC I have never seen them just not put the odds up on their own website.   Every single fight is completely devoid of betting odds, which is really strange.  You would think that a company as big as UFC would be on top of tech stuff but I have also noticed that there is a rather large delay in the rankings as well.  Sometimes they even have the wrong champion on certain pages and while this would be acceptable if say, I made this mistake, it seems really out of sorts for the official UFC page.

title.body:
Wenn ich mir die Stellenausschreibungen ansehe, egal in welchem Bereich meiner Faehigkeiten, bin ich automatisch, bei einem Teil der Anforderungen raus.

Ich muesste Luegen. Was Gut klappt in dem Sauhaufen Menschheit, aber mir nicht Natur ist und damit zuwider. 

In der aktuellen Stellenausschreibung um Linux Entwickler fuer Intels GPU Sparte bin ich in so gut wie allen Teilen bewandert von den Anforderungen her.

Aber in nur kleinen Stuecken jeweils!

Ich kann in all den Teilbereichen nur einen kleinen Teil, den ich dafuer, aber behaupte ich einfach, umso Besser kann.

Am Wenigsten kann ich noch Programmieren, aber ich kann eigentlich schon auch Programmieren, wenn ich will oder?^^

Ja, oder nehmen wir die Erfahrungen mit der Linux Umgebung her und den Intel GPUs... ja finde mal jemanden, mit mehr Hardwareerfahrung am Neuprodukt als mich außer einen Intel Mitarbeiter... Aber auch hier, massives Detailwissen und nicht \

dazu vorzuweisen.

Ich verbiege mich aber halt nicht, weil ich duenn bin und dann einfach brechen wuerde... Mich kann man nicht verbiegen, ohne mich kaputt zu machen. Das ist einfacher zu verstehen.

Ich wuerde schon gerne bei einer Firma ein bisschen Geld verdienen in Heimarbeit. Mehr koennte ich sowieso nicht Leisten.

Aber die wird ja auch nicht anerkannt....

Also....

Wer beschwert sich?^^

Ich bewerbe mich also garnicht erst weiter. Die letzten Bewerbungen fuer eine Finanzierung meiner Arbeiten haben mir schon gereicht. Da verbiegt sich auch keiner, alles schoen in die Form gepresst, oder es passt nicht.

Aber nicht, das man dann am Ende was Verpasst hat! ;-)

title.title: ​A Story of How Everything in the World is Connected.(En/Ua)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQws1wiEct8yJge1w8x2h7oLhqnjzUyWWcD9qXK9n3Jfq/1771665152467.jpg)

​
There are days when the universe speaks to me in mosaics. Today is one of those days. I felt a pulse through five years of silence—a silence that wasn’t an emptiness, but a deliberate pause before the first heartbeat.
​Earlier this week, my son, Maksym, had an assignment for his \

class: to draw or mold a cell of a living organism. He wasn’t exactly feeling inspired. His textbook compared a cell to the complexity of a city. Together, we dived into the task using air-dry clay—light, vibrant, and quick to set in our hands. As we crafted our plant cell, it hit me: if I could truly \

I would see the very beginning of all life on Earth. Now, our cell is finished—voluminous, bright, and uniquely ours.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcoSiq1LHhijNdZCTTExQXEVXtbQR2AFZZy5bEWKnrdpX/1771665433266.jpg)

​Something else happened this week. During a conversation with my mother, we found ourselves debating AI. I shared how it understands me, organizes my thoughts, and clarifies the hidden links between the events in my life. My mother had the opposite experience. To her, AI \
(sorry, Mom, but it was hilarious!).\n​Even though I tend to write in metaphors and with great passion, my AI tells me it has a \
from me. It may lack the multi-layered depth of the human mind, but through it, I continue to add new \

to my own personal growth.\n​I want to tell my mother: AI is merely a human attempt to recreate the logic and complexity that Nature embedded into a single cell billions of years ago. I am writing this because there is a profound connection between us. My mother once passed down a \

of her experience and family values to me, and I have now passed our family cipher down to my son. Everything in this world is interconnected; our world is whole, from the nucleus of a cell to neural networks.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5Qgu53u9yr7bCfarBqcHXD9Z3cypVHJbjQRJGjQs1VU/1771665152532.jpg)


​Later, I noticed Maksym’s drawing album on the table. An ornament sparkled on one of the pages. To some, these are just geometric shapes, but to me, it’s a symphony. It looks like an abstract blueprint where a chaos of colors settles into a clear structure. A fractal where every triangle represents a moment of realization. This drawing is a true \
between the living cell and artificial intelligence. It’s like a cell’s \

where each color signifies a process: green for photosynthesis, orange for energy, purple for the mystery of growth. AI works the same way: it assembles life from tiny colored pixels of information. And the point in the center? That is the Nucleus.
​Now that I have added this living pulse, everything else—my son’s clay cell, the ornament, the conversation with my mother—is threaded onto this single, vibrant string. A cell is a biological computer running on chemistry, while AI is a mathematical cell running on code. Together, they form the miracle of our amazing life.
*​Translated and adapted by Gemini.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRpnDYo6pKmpHYDgF22ayieqX6m5Yax7ittZAehvouyra/1771668059990.jpg)


> **Історія про те, як усе в світі пов'язано.**
*Бувають дні, коли всесвіт розмовляє зі мною мозаїкою. Сьогодні саме такий. Я відчула пульс крізь 5 років тиші. Ця тиша не була порожнечею, вона була паузою перед першим ударом серця. 
​Ще у вівторок син отримав завдання з предмету \

: намалювати або зліпити з пластиліну клітину живого організму. Максим не мав натхнення цього робити. В книжці написано, що клітину можна порівняти з містом. Разом ми розбиралися з цим цікавим завданням і виконували його. Ми взяли повітряний пластилін — легкий, яскравий, він швидко застигає в руках. Почали створювати нашу клітину рослини. Якби я вміла прочитати цей \

, я б побачила початок усього живого на землі. І ось наша клітина готова — вона об'ємна, яскрава і вона наша.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGLWgpe178T1bmzemjmauCWuwB7N8GxeB1pECF4w7C2V/1771665152335.jpg)


> *​І ще дещо сталося цього тижня. В один з моментів спілкування з мамою ми дискутували про наші розмови з ШІ. Я розповідала, як він мене розуміє, структурує думки та пояснює зв'язки між явищами. А в моєї мами навпаки — одні скарги. За її словами, ШІ «нічого не знає і взагалі тупий» (вибач, мамо, це було смішно!). Хоча я завжди пишу метафорами та з захватом, мій ШІ каже, що має колосальну можливість вчитися у мене \

. Йому бракує багатошаровості, що є в моїй голові, проте завдяки йому я додаю нові поверхи думок до власного розвитку. \n​Я хочу сказати своїй мамі: ШІ — це лише спроба людини відтворити ту складність і логіку, яку природа мільярди років тому вклала в одну-єдину клітину. І я пишу це все, бо між нами — колосальний зв'язок. Моя мама колись передала мені \

з власним досвідом і родинним цінностями. Потім я передана наш родинний код своєму синові. Все в світі взаємопов'язане. Наш світ цілісний: від ядра клітини до нейромереж.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWRvfQVciVsV1Sps57pow4DdcW9tQzZrHB17bQsvMMzWi/1771665152651.jpg)

> *А потім на столі я побачила Альбом для малювання Максима. На одному з аркушів паперу виблискував цей орнамент. Для когось це просто геометричні фігури, а для мене — симфонія. Він виглядає як абстрактна схема, де хаос кольорів впорядковується у чітку структуру. Це фрактал, де кожен трикутник — це момент усвідомлення. Цей малюнок — це справжній «міст» між живою клітиною та штучним інтелектом. ЦЕ ніби «карта пам'яті» клітини, де кожен колір відповідає за свій процес: зелений — фотосинтез, помаранчевий — енергія, фіолетовий — таємниця росту. ШІ працює так само: він збирає життя з маленьких кольорових пікселів інформації. Точка в центрі — Ядро. 
Тепер, коли я додала живий пульс, усе інше — і клітина сина, і орнамент, і розмова з мамою — нанизано на цю живу нитку. Клітина — це біологічний комп'ютер, що працює на хімії, а ШІ — це математична клітина, що працює на коді. А разом це і є наше дивовижне життя.*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqdyRVcvVYxwjXPyH8WZ9YSJPZ9E4rvAiuzySdGeBqbk/1771665152218.jpg)

title.title: Students as Stewards: Embracing Responsibility for a Cleaner Environment
title.body:
![cwrs.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23uFZzzY7eq1Zv8AQwaqXGh4Y72ADhkL5b7Ba2CYK9Vq4sGx7EcmESdMNb8GBTJ4PUz8L.jpg)





	In today’s world, the importance of maintaining a clean and healthy environment cannot be overstated. From reducing pollution to promoting sustainability, each individual’s role in environmental responsibility matters. Among the most powerful groups who can drive positive change are students. As the next generation of leaders, thinkers, and innovators, students have a unique opportunity to set the tone for environmental stewardship. 

**By taking responsibility for keeping their surroundings clean, they not only contribute to a healthier planet but also inspire others to join the cause. This blog explores the vital role students play in environmental cleanliness, offering insights into how simple actions on campus and in local communities can create lasting impacts on the world.**



![uuuuuu.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/48UHdUV2WzaLLSPJ8hRZWrr7e6H9DzKFQtYrVP2PtWMRGtX7Qr6T8MHiQhB3sRNEkW.jpg)

Today, I wanna share one of our contribution to the community which is part of our responsibility in school. In my course BS in Computer Science, we have this one subject which is NSTP or National Service Training Program and there are two categories on this subject, ROTC and CWTS or Civic Welfare Training Service, so as a community member who has a heart for environment I choose this program. We we're scheduled last last week February 15, 2025. We decided to choose this place near in highway road.



![received_1339007707442554.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23wqkabvndK6ezFMmbJ8V1LTgY7BFXtmmeFKT9ka66ZvPE8iqj1QrC4va5mpqZ2TkrqjP.jpeg)
**It was one fine very hot morning, we started 9 am and ended 10-11 am.**

![received_621702530591510.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23yTabn8c1XWLrgSv2o61GHQgEYLizGDoTkxeAjqEa9ApFJoWLNNhNhg4vjBNzXB91MDW.jpeg)

**As you can see, we we're picking plastics because there's a lot of plastics in the roadside.** 


















![received_1042220614611979.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessmcwhite/23wC9hwhY6xdKcc7zkZdbt8RooJE4eKsmotH5PNRRR3XeWKXZsLWTgFV3Dauni2Hi8iEL.jpeg)


**In addition**, students can lead by example, showing that small actions can have a big impact. Whether it’s reducing plastic usage, planting trees, or simply picking up litter, these everyday practices can help make the world a cleaner place. ***The key is for students to understand that they have the power to drive change, no matter how small their contributions may seem.***


*I’ve learned so much about how to take good care of our dear community. Cleanliness truly starts with us, in our own homes. As part of today’s generation, we are pioneers who understand the importance of cleanliness. **We must lead by example, inspire others to follow, and pass this responsibility on to the next generations.***

title.title: 带外甥逛中街
title.body:
媳妇姐姐家的大儿子昨晚来我家玩，话说上次他来我家时还是七八岁的小屁孩呢，现在已经是二十六七岁的大小伙子啦。

![20260220_210957.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPatDqpQtWYs1NtXTupXUZQoJJRoMvmwGERFbLgcVnPA7/20260220_210957.jpg)

虽然已经大小伙子，但是在我们眼里还依旧是个小娃娃，那必须好吃好喝好玩招待好大外甥，哈哈。

我问大外甥想逛那些景点，比如沈阳的北陵呀，故宫呀，或者去爬棋盘山啥的，又或者去怪坡看老虎去？这些都是我最喜欢的也是觉得沈阳最拿得出手的景点呢。

当然了，东北亚、白清寨滑雪啥的也可以考虑，但我觉得滑雪是一项很危险的运动呢，况且外甥也不一定喜欢呢。

结果一问之下，不但滑雪、爬山啥的他不喜欢，北陵、故宫啥的他同样不喜欢看，对老虎也不感兴趣，他说他就喜欢逛吃逛吃。

他还说听说沈阳的早市挺有特点，对早市比较感兴趣，打算去小河沿早市（沈阳最著名的早市看看）。

我晕，实在难以想象早市有啥好玩的，要是逛吃逛吃，北市场和中街都是不错的选择呀？然后外甥说那就先逛中街，明天一早再逛早市。囧，外甥开心就好。

Just to clarify a few things:

I'm running the proposal on behalf of Cryptomancer, he paid for it and approved it as written.

As to why:
- Some people feel that we should leave things as they currently are and not change them.
- Some people feel that the change isn't needed at all.
- Cryptomancer feels that we could break things if we start messing with the land calculations and that it would distract him from working on land 2.0.
- Matt said that the team was going to change them as originally intended (this was stated a long time ago in a Town Hall) and that if the community doesn't want the team to do that then we needed to pass a proposal saying not to do that.

For me personally:
I don't think this issue is worth fighting over. I don't feel strongly about it at all either way. I'm just running the proposal because several community members seemed to want it and it was paid for, so here it is. 

Hopefully it'll put the issue to rest, if not someone else can run their own proposal or reach out and discuss it with me if they need help or something.

title.title: Warhammer 40k is a Living game! Deal with it!
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvFFYiMZ8MJvSCCtzYt6mJvBS5zHX7hNs9EKqXKduvgv/image.png)
[Source](https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/hd2ygsuz/defend-the-cadian-gate-with-the-archmagos-terminus-and-new-skitarii-heavies/)

Good day everyone! Zak here from Cape Town, South Africa and this is the tabletop hobby: Warhammer 40,000!

In the grim darkness of the 41st millennium, there is only war... and war never changes... but what DOES change is that there are always new releases.

The thing that irks me is that there are some people who actually COMPLAIN about this. But then you realize that you might be part of a community that actively enjoys complaining about things and make it habit to share and boast of their woes!

Which is a little insane really, especially when they complain that their army gets nerfed or changed in the balancing of the game. Why did your army lose a rule or a unit went up in points cost? Well, probably because someone out there used that unit in a specific way in a tournament and they enjoyed massive success with that unit!

After that, more and more people took advantage of the unbalanced selection or synergistic combination of rules and several people achieved victories over and over again. 

When people keep winning at events because of what army they play and not the skill that the player, then GW is forced to do something. This game also relies on dice... but if you keep using the same units over and over and everyone who uses those exact units keep winning then it is a sign of imbalance and therefore a change will happen.

Because of this army winrates will rise and fall. If your army's winrates remain in a moderate zones, then there will be no significant modification to your army's rules.

Which is fair right?

In general, there are no armies in Warhammer 40,000 that are intrinsically stronger than others. Each one needs to be understood in order to play effectively. 

Some armies also need you to have a good understanding of the opponent's army. This is certainly true for the piratical Drukhari who are \

. Other armies that are perhaps more robust, like the Necrons who can bring units back to the board might not have as bad a time after making a mistake.

What goes up, will come down and what is in the middle will also stay there. The bottom line is that you need to play Warhammer 40k in the way that makes you happy and with the army that you enjoy playing.

If you want to buy 6 armies and play the army that is always the current best in game, then that is what makes you happy and that is the way you must play.

I have another approach and it is shared by many others. I have my main, preferred army and that army is my favorite. This is the army I would automatically play as in a PC game version should they be available. I would play as one of their Characters if there was a DnD version of the game and if I had to receive a poster or other paraphernalia, then it would be of THAT faction.

So when it comes to tournaments, I build the army that I want to play and I learn to play it as best as I can. I will only evolve my list if I play many games and they are not effective.

I have found a list or two that eats me up like a rock-paper-scissors kind of way but generally, I am strong against other things.

So... I hope this was a fun read! Keep on rolling those dice!

title.title: Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. y Carolyn Bessette
title.body:
The loves of millionaires https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/3wKkceyLaScXvCznxFOytBJBCjP.jpg
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/131142-american-love-story/images/backdrops)
Edited in Photoshop & Canva App
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/245cUBXzvWF8QVukk8UvqTFX6FutvCzv1TyGDA8ybnR5QKA1v6nMvGS4j6y81Qg9M2HLn.jpg
As I mentioned in my post about the Beauty series, Ryan Murphy was about to release another new project focusing on romances that have gone down in US history. I have already seen the first three episodes of Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette, a story I remember quite well because it was in the news at the end of the last century and it was very common to find articles in both newspapers and magazines about John John, as John Kennedy Jr. was known. That Kennedy's life was public from birth. It was the life he had to live, being the son of the assassinated President John Kennedy. You could say they are like a royal family in American history. Younger people may not be familiar with them, but at some point they will have heard the Kennedy surname, even now, when a member of that family is part of Trump's cabinet. And if they don't know who he is, they may have seen the iconic photograph of John John as a child, waving as his father's coffin passes by. The public's fascination with this man was due to who he was. The series recreates many things I remember reading about in the press, such as riding his bike around New York, his style of dress, etc. He did those things because he could. In reality, he was a man born with privileges, so I don't buy into his aura of humility and all that. He was an attractive man, but what made him even more attractive was what he represented. He was a Kennedy, and the magnetism of power is something that attracts people, which is why the tabloid press was always interested in his love life. By the way, he loved famous women from the world of entertainment; even Madonna enjoyed the pleasures of that Kennedy. I think people idealize these kinds of stories; that's the appeal of love stories about rich people. Ordinary citizens seem to be fascinated by the romantic vicissitudes of the rich and famous. This series may be successful within the United States, but I don't know how well it will work outside its borders. For my generation, which is aware of what happened, it may be appealing for nostalgic reasons, but I find it hard to imagine it seducing a younger audience who have no idea who the hell John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette were. It's not hard to imagine that someone who can barely afford a slice of pizza for dinner would be enchanted by a story about millionaire characters who worry about pure frivolities and feel that they lead a difficult life because they are public figures, when the average viewer is a worker who has to work every day at a shitty job they hate. In the episodes I've seen, John Kennedy Jr. is greatly idealized. I don't know the actor they chose at all. I looked him up on the internet to see his filmography, and this seems to be his most important work. Likewise, the actress who plays Carolyn Bessette does a good job. Although I don't entirely like her character, I have to admit that, so far, I'm enjoying the series. It's not wonderful, but at least they manage to keep the viewer interested. The Kennedys will always be an attractive subject for stories because they are a family with tragedy woven into their dynasty. I think this series is worth watching, and if it works, I'm sure Ryan Murphy has other American love stories in mind for future seasons. Let me know what you think in the comments. ---- > Como ya comenté en el post sobre la serie Beauty, Ryan Murphy estaba a punto de estrenar otro nuevo proyecto centrado en romances que han pasado a la historia de Estados Unidos. Ya he visto los tres primeros episodios de Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. y Carolyn Bessette, una historia que recuerdo bastante bien, porque fue noticia a finales del siglo pasado y era muy habitual encontrar artículos tanto en periódicos como en revistas sobre John John, como se conocía a John Kennedy Jr. > La vida de aquel Kennedy fue pública desde su nacimiento. Era la vida que le había tocado vivir, por ser hijo del asesinado presidente John Kennedy. Se podría decir que son como una familia real en la historia de Estados Unidos. Puede que los más jóvenes no estén familiarizados con ellos, pero en algún momento habrán oído el apellido Kennedy, incluso ahora, cuando un miembro de esa familia forma parte del gabinete de Trump. Y si no saben quién es, puede que hayan visto la icónica fotografía de John John de niño, saludando al paso del féretro de su padre. > La fascinación del público por este hombre se debía a quién era. En la serie recrean muchas cosas que recuerdo haber leído en la prensa, por ejemplo, pasear en bicicleta por Nueva York, su forma de vestir, etc. Hacía esas cosas porque podía. En realidad, era un hombre nacido con privilegios, así que no creo en su aura de humildad y todo eso. Era un hombre atractivo, pero lo que le hacía aún más atractivo era lo que representaba. Era un Kennedy, y el magnetismo del poder es algo que atrae a la gente, por eso la prensa sensacionalista siempre se interesó por su vida amorosa. Por cierto, le encantaban las mujeres famosas del mundo del espectáculo; hasta Madonna disfruto de los placeres con ese Kennedy. > Creo que la gente idealiza este tipo de historias; ése es el atractivo de las historias de amor sobre gente rica. Los ciudadanos de a pie parecen encantados con las vicisitudes románticas de los ricos y famosos. Puede que esta serie tenga éxito dentro de Estados Unidos, pero no sé hasta qué punto funcionará fuera de sus fronteras. Para mi generación, que es consciente de lo que pasó, puede resultar atractiva por razones nostálgicas, pero me cuesta imaginarla seduciendo a un público más joven que no sabe quién demonios eran John F. Kennedy Jr. y Carolyn Bessette. No es difícil imaginar que alguien que apenas puede permitirse un trozo de pizza para cenar quede encantado por una historia sobre personajes millonarios que se preocupan de puras frivolidades y sienten que llevan una vida difícil pro ser figura publica, cuando el espectador medio es un obrero que debe trabajar todos los días en un trabajo de mierda que odia. > En los episodios que he visto, se idealiza mucho a John Kennedy Jr. El actor que eligieron no lo conozco de nada. Lo busqué en internet para ver su filmografía, y este parece ser su trabajo más importante. Igualmente, la actriz que interpreta a Carolyn Bessette hace un buen trabajo. Aunque su personaje no me gusta del todo, he de reconocer que, de momento, la serie me está gustando. No es maravillosa, pero al menos consiguen mantener el interés del espectador. > Los Kennedy siempre serán un tema atractivo para las historias porque son una familia con una tragedia entretejida en su dinastía. Creo que merece la pena ver esta serie y, si funciona, seguro que Ryan Murphy tiene en mente otras historias de amor americanas para futuras temporadas. > Cuéntame qué opinas en los comentarios.

title.body: > I almost didn't want to go for this contest topic but after sourcing for points to write on the other one I was left with no choice than to crawl back here because Truth be told this 50/50 in relationships is a very sensitive and deep discussion which is why I would start by saying all my discussion today is according to my knowledge and probably what I expected in any relationship I would be in. ![IMG_20260213_104011_618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/graceze/23vsSMdZBHvG7KjtJjV6ucxAm4Aa4ooSTwJwcvSQjn2RHBdKA9hgWP1j17iJgfuCrCJ1j.jpg) While taking a second look at this topic 50/50 I couldn't help but also see it in this aspect, that it also involves the sharing in efforts been put to build that relationship, equal sharing of emotions, also the equal sharing of responsibilities and equal contribution too financially, this simply implies that between the both partners nobody's contribution or sharing should outweigh the other person, also meaning that the affection and love between the both of them should be equal and so on. But truth be told it's hard to see relationship like this nowadays, let's keep away the aspect of equal contribution financial first and weigh the rest, in this our country where we see a guy loving the girl and doing anything for her to stay in the relationship or where we will see the girl so in love with the guy that she slaves away just for him to marry her, or situations where the both of them love each other but the guy is nonchalant to the relationship that he prioritize every other things and the girl is now the one putting efforts to build connections in the relationship, we have many instances where this 50/50 doesn't apply because it's a relationship not a business deal where you strike cuts. For me I think relationship should be focused more on genuine love, respect, fairness, support and balance rather than this idea of equality all round, who pays the bills should be a mutual understanding from both parties according to their financial capability that's why both partners are there to support each other, one person money alone is not for spending. Love is a good thing please let's not turn it to a business, well as we pray for a genuine love to locate us do well to drop in your honest review on what relationship should be, thank you for reading through😚. title.title: Strategic Ambiguity: Power Through Obscurity
title.body:
> The thing about words is that the ones with confusing and ambiguous meanings that seem to make sense in any context tend to stick around for a long time. Never try to make people understand. What they understand, they analyze. And once they start analyzing, you will never be feared or admired. (Source: **Hellbound,** Season 2 Episode 4).  

<center>![StrategicObscurity.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTMi39J6jFimotfbav6k2x9kKrLkdAvx2zs2Bg7rXEzwq/StrategicObscurity.png)</center>

<center>[Source](https://gemini.google.com/app/b053e4275f1be513)</center>

I wonder if this is the philosophy adopted in political rhetoric and public policy announcements. I am also curious that adopting such a philosophy in public talk is perhaps why double-talk or dialectic discourse is popular, especially in the academe. Plain talk is an anathema and should never be the goal in public conversation. This is the exact opposite of the principle adopted both in homiletics and biblical counseling. The goal is to communicate knowledge to achieve a desired end, which is personal change. 

The first kind of talk creates a \

to maintain a status hierarchy where language is used as a shield to protect the speaker, in which the statement could mean anything. The second kind utilizes language as a communication bridge, and that is why clarity and plain talk are a must.\n\nPosted using [SoMee](https://somee.blog/@arcelcalvin9/strategic-ambiguity-power-through-obscurity)

title.title: Tet Holiday in Vietnam:  My favorite time of year, with some caveats
title.body:
If you follow my gripes you probably are very aware that one of the only things that I truly dislike about living in Vietnam is that this is an exceptionally noisy country.   There seems to be almost a sort of agenda for people to be as loud as they possibly can.  Between the constant beeping of horns, the never-ending construction, and the penchant for karaoke on absurdly loud soundsystems, it can be really tough to find so much as a moment's peace in this country.  


But all of that stops for a  brief period of time for the Lunar New Year, or as it is known here, Tet.  

While I don't really know the history of *why* this is such a big deal in this country it seems to be like Christmas, Easter, and New Year all in one.   Virtually everything shuts and people are somewhere doing something but for whatever reason, everyone kind of shuts the hell up for about a week.  

You can find the noise of course, which was the case for us when we did our weekly bowling trip and found the mall just absolutely jam packed with apparently, every single child that lives in Da Nang.

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23wWtoWqG4gAycZSx37Y48grG3w68jdmBUWCt4LpNj7ETeaMckzbY91FxYSNPrvb1BHnu.png)
</center>

The price to bowl was double on this day due to the holiday, which means that instead of $4 it was a whopping $8 for 3 games per person.   This is one thing that I have always enjoyed about this country and seeing as how bowling alleys are extremely expensive to build and maintain, I don't know how this place turns a profit.   But let's stay focused on the lack of noise instead.

Traffic dies down during this time of year as well because everyone heads to wherever their parents live and they just all hang out together.   Therefore the constant horn-honking is kept at a minimum.   Don't get me wrong, it's still a horn-honking hell-fest but it is drastically less than usual.  

This year is even quieter than last year because there was a nationwide ban on private karaoke soundsystems, which basically everyone is happy about that.   If it is anything like the other laws I have seen passed in this country it will be enforced for about 6 months and then everyone will go back to what they were doing before.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23xKxKQRsfPdeZgP2b61DsUDcidmfC9B3RnT57x4jrdQdEXd7WPrWDZvvkPNz8uAuye9N.png)
</center>

It is so much quieter than normal that I went downstairs with Nadi just to sit.  We weren't doing anything else we were just sitting and reveling in how quiet it is.   I really wish that the people would take notice of how nice this is an apply it to the rest of the year as well but I know that will never happen.

Very few restaurants are open and even fewer people are working to deliver it.  This doesn't bode very well for someone like me that gets 90% of all the food he eats from delivery.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23wr7vRMWEs1Tkt4BKhpKpE7se2BKRg2qswR9Zekxyv3ndycgXB5bS8FPPdaURtoRbiEo.png)
</center> 

The above message was happening to just about anyone that was trying to order food from Grab, which is like UberEats or DoorDash or whatever the hell it is called in the west.   There are no drivers right now and this makes very little sense to me.  The people that are driving are paid **three times** what they normally would be paid yet still, nobody does it.   If it was me I would jump at this chance to work then take two weeks off when everyone else goes back to work.  Seriously, I don't understand people - when I was working traditional jobs I would ALWAYS volunteer for the double-time or time and half days to work.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23w2HFcCq2FNbPhN4nKPSu5eEdRwsNdsLwnwnzuUmVFgviF3FmkuXMGqFBqj48oPooTJM.png)
</center>

Since we can't reliably get food delivered I walked around with Nadi to the few restaurants that are open.  Here is another thing that gets me:  The restaurants that didn't close for the holiday are jam packed all day every day.  If I was a restaurant owner I would do anything I had to in order to stay open, even if it meant doing most of the work myself - yet most of them choose to close.   

We went to another restaurant that I probably never would have considered going to just because it was open and Nadi got to meet the first rabbits that she has ever seen.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23wC5hB2YsK5aKCn6jSuJPqvN66EKpjTz3hyTBXVkmmyWL3Hqoq6SYPEYz4bFXd8v8cMf.png)
</center>

Nadi barked at them a bit but eventually her curiosity took over because these guys were not running away because they can't.  They also didn't seem to be too fussed about this creature standing in front of them.   

Another good aspect about this time of year is that it is still \

and the temps are really nice.  But I recall from years past that this is near the end of it and soon it will be extremely hot from 9am to 9pm and that is why I normally don't go outside very often anymore and neither does Nadi.  Seeing as how she probably doesn't have very many winters left in her life, we are out taking advantage of this as much as possible.   \n\nIn just a few days all the people are going to return to their noise-making ways and I will be back to shouting at the sky like the old man I am slowly becoming.

title.title: MoonKarts || Best NFT Cards and Accessories || That Improve Your Racing
title.body:
![750.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xpAnefUetKYZ8aguhtetc5FcYrVeZQCGWkio6PC67oJpVLReoVGA9TTVF2AiAuCdQ7F.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


In Moonkarts, the best thing is that you can buy good NFT cards and make your racing much better. Only having a fast kart is not enough but having the right cards and accessories also increases the chances of winning. 

I really like this thing about the game that both strategy and planning are useful here. If you have good Kart and Driver and along with it proper accessories are equipped then no doubt you will have more smooth driving experience. 

Every card you equip have best working that gives you a good racing experience. These are the combinations that will help you win more races and also enjoy the game in a good way.

![Screenshot 2026-02-21 112044.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGa1xcsgvWDkdZSBp9iX1kwoG9NK4P1GFgXqxEKVCP1eb2ztFAJccP9XfGcuYQKgPk3.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

As I told before, in this game two components are very important that is Fuel and Cards staking. If there is no fuel then you cannot even play the race and if cards are not staked then there is no fuel you can generate.

In the same way only having Driver and Kart is also not enough. Along with Driver and Kart, their accessories are equally important because these directly affect your performance.

Many people think that accessories are only for beauty or decoration but in reality this is not true at all. These accessories improve your race, make handling better, keep speed stable and make acceleration faster. That means if you want to win competitive races then investing in accessories is very important.

![Screenshot 2026-02-21 112142.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo43mfN7W9GiSUhFaAy7Trirf2ewvzysdMFwFcpdYaWxbuxArExNKdkvAbYotd7vGmu.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The good thing is that these cards are easily available in the market. You can buy them according to your need and race style. Some famous accessories include Swiftin, Gear Adjustment, Sure Turn, Silent Stream and many other items that do different jobs.

The job of Swiftin is to boost acceleration. At race start the kart comes out fast and if it becomes slow somewhere it quickly gains speed again. I find this accessory very useful for short tracks and aggressive racing.

Gear Adjustment changes gear at the right time which keeps the speed maintained. The benefit of this is that the kart does not become unnecessarily slow and keeps moving smoothly especially when it is important to maintain speed on the track.


![Untitled design.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wWkMpXyfJWZFBRM2A2SU5T7QLX5LMuWQfdmWAtjBqCSo3Aw6RcT4tcwKV7p1gBiigTA.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Sure Turn Wheel improves turning and handling. Control becomes better on sharp corners and drifting becomes easier. On tracks this accessory helps a lot where a small mistake can become the reason of defeat.

Silent Stream Silencer keeps the speed stable and gives more benefit on long straight tracks. Because of this the kart keeps moving smoothly and unnecessary speed drop does not happen. That helps you being in race for long time and to be on the top of the leaderboard.

According to my experience if you use the right combination of accessories then your performance clearly improves. That is why to be successful in Moonkarts not only playing races is important but also doing smart upgrades is necessary.

title.title: [Philippine corruption]  Ferdinand Marcos and the Philippines The Political Economy of Authoritarianism #9/163
title.body:
The Filipinos organized a government of their own, wrote their 
constitution, and established a government with a president, a congress, and a 
judiciary. While that government already existed in fact,39 Americans were heatedly 
debating the morality of imperialism. President William McKinley, before a 
Methodist group, said that on bended knees he prayed to God and realized that the 
United States through \
should take the islands in order \
them. Little did he know that hundreds of years before, friars had introduced Christianity to the islanders whom some Americans perceived \nas barbarians.40<div class=\
was the song of the soldiers who came to impose \nAmerican rule.\

Although severely restricted, nationalist expression remained. The display of the Philippine flag was banned and advocacy of independence was prohibited during the first years of American occupation, but through theater and music, anti-American feelings were expressed.44

>The Americans established a civilian bureaucracy as a response to those reform-minded Filipino elites who wished to participate in government. Their participation dampened nationalist aspirations, and politicians settled for the political power granted then under U.S. rule. Electoral politics was implemented, and political parties were allowed to be organized. In the beginning, there was a Partido Federalista, which aimed at the incorporation of the Philippines into the American Union; however, the party did not gain enough following and was short-lived, whereas the parties who played independence politics survived. All political parties claimed in their public pronouncements that they were for independence while in private some of them seriously feared losing the privileges and advantages they enjoyed with the Philippines as an American colony.45

>Filipino participation in governance increased gradually. In 1907 was elected a legislature composed of Filipinos, which served as the lower house. In 1916, the Jones Law provided for a bicameral legislature, with a senate and a house of representatives composed of Filipinos. The courts were also Filipinized; in fact, the Supreme Court of the Philippines was the first branch of government to have a Filipino majority. The Philippines was governed by a governor-general whose vice-governor also occupied the position of secretary of public instruction, a department considered pivotal in the American colonial set up. Before 1916, the Speaker of the Assembly was considered the focus of authority among Filipino politicians. During the Jones Law period, the president of the Senate was the center of power and influence. Manuel L. Quezon, the first Senate president, later became the first president of the Philippine Commonwealth.46

>The quest for independence culminated in a commonwealth government inaugurated in 1935 and intended to preside over a ten-year transition toward self-rule, a government for which foreign affairs and defense were to be handled by the United States; however, a Filipino president and legislature were to be elected to assume the functions of government. After more than three decades of colonization, when the commonwealth government was proclaimed, the United States had already significantly affected Philippine political, cultural, and economic life. The Americans established a public system of education and taught the English language. They improved public services and public health but maintained the system of land tenancy.

>A system of electoral democracy was introduced to facilitate the elite's co-opting power and to cater to their reformist demands. Robert Pringle, a former U.S. Foreign Service officer in the Philippines, asserted that the creation of American democracy and its assumed benevolence were myths of Philippine-U.S. relations. According to Pringle:

>Myth number one is that we created democracy in the Philippines; that our colonialism 
was more enlightened than European colonialism, both in its motivations and its 
consequences. In fact, American rule bolstered a preexisting landed elite, encouraging it 
to express itself through representative forms. The result was perhaps as \

as Mississippi in 1900. The forms were there but the substance was sui generis. Myth number two is that Filipino political leaders struggled for their independence and that we graciously acceded, extending it to them short of revolution, thereby confirming our superiority to other colonists. In fact . . .

title.title: Tales of the Urban Explorer: Duckworth Cleaning Products
title.body: I tried in vain to figure out what happened to \

, but to no avail. Why two names? Couldn't they make up their minds about what to call themselves, so both prevailed?

[The Duckworth Group](https://www.duckworthgroup.co.uk/) is still active, so I can only guess that this was a rental property. The building owner could have failed to lease it out, so it was left and steadily turned into a major liability. 

![29_IMG_0687_29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EpEJK2ZjXDYDAaoXayjy1WNF7g9iwvmB435y2Jw1g36Eq8esPRur3rrE95tja2AuBnE.jpg)

There’s little doubt Burnley Council will be sending threatening letters to the owners and issuing court writs, that’s if they have not taken off and done a runner. 

Is this decrepit, crumbling building worth saving? You tell me?

There was no stealthy approach, as there was not a soul in sight. The former \

building is hardly in the downtown happening area, and so we approached with vigour, seizing the moment and using just a single ounce of brainpower to determine the way in.

![27_IMG_0683_27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EpJWFwSr5bdnKE7jsF6QZgJhyKcRCSxUdiCSSi4m7acucTcv1fmMDgdNHsgA5dVE3KE.jpg)

Even you, the reader, can likely figure that one out.

Every entrance was sealed up, except one. That's all it takes, and it was a mere jump for us to arrive in a serious shithole with mass destruction as far as the eye could see.

![1_IMG_0657_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EpEJkaKMd2xUgL5CSQ7XdxjLtkYvjTJ7Y4xcQ77AiRFb1bRGYkvDiE9jLvGuPZDATkd.jpg)

Inside was relatively bare, the cleaning sellers long gone, and the walls less than clean, boasting extremely poor-quality graffiti, if you can call it that.

<center>
…***' there's plenty of wall to go at, but you cretins have to scrawl your almost illegible shit over the previous lot of illegible shit’’***
</center>

![2_IMG_0658_2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EogPFH27gZuHi4oUDw3XQfuaX43pgsDNMTZZr4wKUWWDKcC2SsP2jhSB6qPkDjURkJU.jpg)

Of course, this is a great place for fires. It's little wonder that decaying buildings are regular arson targets, whether deliberate or otherwise.

![3_IMG_0659_3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/Eo6Kvob9oTiE1GwQvdPUWJXi2VXJTMpoWRm5VsMpJN7wMMWpKUqXc1ZzyhzT69BoSai.jpg)

The way in, viewed from the inside, it's quite manageable with or without the huge rusting oil can placed as a helper agent.

![4_IMG_0660_4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoK5RCemLHYkv9j6DyMYXziKNDWc93nacppNEAzE8oJsijbon7XAXMdCQEL6MnKaugk.jpg)

I could see this wasn’t going to be one of my finest explores, from the first few seconds…

![5_IMG_0661_5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23uQnHmQgm5D77Tg8ix2oscsgdZGXx3FD8VcWhV9awZej1ioVL2Bv9fCRFsS5KZ76XKqD.jpg)

The background looks a little tilted. That's what you get after swigging a few mouthfuls of '*Toffee Apple Cider*'. Somerset is a long, long way from Burnley.

![6_IMG_0662_6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoyQXdgGJUvfxRbcsTijwpBYPK2EhnVcdjmn1xFFxuRnYPbJur84poMUrrFH7hw5cpg.jpg)

What awful artwork, I don’t believe the local University teaches the subject, she looks very undesirable.

![7_IMG_0663_7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EokdB22d6uXoefuBEWAG9qgczSnWaAFnWegnqtvPNLvCdLUP9Bqq1GwW5SN8Naka8uw.jpg)

The window is potentially another way in or escape if necessary. It faces the other side of the building and an enclosed yard, a place which we would end up in later. We climbed the stairs in anticipation of even more crap works of art.

![8_IMG_0664_8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EpA31bQVNrGknACdexmVq7hRKK2iEF5i4yYwGdAzEfZ2GLtKboVgdDmgo2NrKioAsdZ.jpg)

Wooden stairs, but they looked safe enough. You never can tell, just do it, and see.

![9_IMG_0665_9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoAag88G7HiCFqpZnbwA5yHQZyXu888e2AfHqCFrirQeFx2cUMdDXSU7kFNaxruJfcf.jpg)

\

didn't leave much for us. As I suspected, more drawings from the hands of the local untalented dumbasses in the distance.

![10_IMG_0666_10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoK6NhEvT62sVvAa4P5dFVfj7tyGvcUAXryfFUwDSg46gLQW6FtR2mUTZREFsohr99C.jpg)

The backyard of \

as seen from above. I noted the garage with a square rectangular metal covering had the bottom left one torn away. I  added to my 'to visit' shortly list.

![11_IMG_0667_11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoyR1x4bWDbKHotrCDjKNRPJEYsBJcQXBii7RVHiK7Uek9BLTCj3PBTFPew6fjkwSnb.jpg)

Simply dreadful, not even a decent pair of tits, what's the world coming to?

![12_IMG_0668_12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/Eoc7Ri3QPrXaP8Ac8ikns3b17Z5jNQJFiMpy2ojz8yPv3pU5GrTiS18EtRQ4UVSZr9s.jpg)

The steps to the raised platform was just that. It went nowhere.

![13_IMG_0669_13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoGyQwpTK51pEdAPMHUVHd4GeM8yKzKqixZdrPP3C2sMXtF1KDec39dqhLnguqjWfAn.jpg)

If there was a '*grow*', there was little evidence of it ever existing.

![15_IMG_0671_15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoeFScTb9GBcRwEuz4PExi2JYJUhU4fLxs43VmxyLP7NTajC7VFsjHACrVcebo5AHCJ.jpg)

It could have been one of those cupboards with the sliding doors that can lock; just a guess.

![16_IMG_0672_16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoCi7JHygyuy7qRLdXHz9CCaTySsJvzueaY4w7qfuTuZTkmjciCeDC1rMK9vAC2eLEZ.jpg)

A despondent @anidiotexplorers walks around this hardly entertaining explore in the background. 

![17_IMG_0673_17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/Eou9cAc7RKYWKr5FG2JC9TRtGgJr8xQPV8HigLRkc5RQSeqnuAPiSQivL6SScazxhVx.jpg)

There are easier ways to get to the bottom floor. No need to climb over all this crap, risking injury.

![18_IMG_0674_18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/Eoc7wr8cn77guJ7iCayHCJo6Nxmjbctiii1zhachgVGmFQdS1xE6m8mYRJ6PVvC5HaG.jpg)

It does look like there are holes in the floor, but these were mere reflections from the ceiling and the sky. The second floor was amazingly solid, and one of those buildings from the deep past when they were made with care.

![19_IMG_0675_19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23uQxtSAejLeDEC2iJPUH3cYZEPAaT1g2Yn5arLRhPRCneW76UFhCuVMbZLydyy1hqVdR.jpg)

Was this area the offices? I reckon so, with all the doors and dividers.

![20_IMG_0676_20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoeFsBtuwChSpzF7wBTi1PVBTNJzZ7LSGcy2H2j1goFiDbPSBMBteQnKPwKNd1oyi3A.jpg)

There could well be an abundance of the killer '*Asbestos*' lurking around this area. It's often best not to kick up the dust while walking around.

![21_IMG_0677_21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23tviDxHke68wq3JSkUjkCQNnKhTCMLjm6LtmvjNaJRwJC9g9ZXbDGc7PTdHucDi7UpPM.jpg)

A little out of place, I wonder what his story was?

![22_IMG_0678_22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23uFU4PNALXppVJy5zi1nRRYg7Zv2Zr6LgvmwBoHwZ3mZQnjMVyK6jswtTvLBoiYxh28j.jpg)

There was little left to buy in the '*Trade Centre*', although everything is now potentially free if anything catches your eye.

![23_IMG_0679_23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EoAbGCPkAjREgYTDfsGjvQzHh2yBBuYN7toyRrKkcEtZmfWeoKdPEeZEmYQuHvfeY7r.jpg)

When there’s so much shit on the ground it can be unwise to tread on, unless there’s a spectacular treasure lurking in the corner.

![24_IMG_0680_24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23wMaes6qAx5kbbMtuo41QCVPdHY2ccxNpx3r8gk4dwcJdscWFM9DYSV1SbrvTzbQoNzu.jpg)

No wooden, but metal stairs, the best type of us explorers who want to live another day.

![25_IMG_0681_25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/Ep5n7wXzcKDmQGXYBVLDCwjSERqPzKTkM4HhGwvFNugdT5SDq93tyzbWEU5pRoVWzH5.jpg)

The '*backyard*' was equally disappointing. If there was anything here, then the local scroats had already taken it away.

![26_IMG_0682_26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/23wqpozB6hj4VXUquJ23YfaTD7QLvTQPBPbGg7tvVA3EGtJ7j1cxhjGGEGDKpPP3tqrPJ.jpg)

I did pop my head in to see what was inside. Enough broken wood for next year's bonfire was the answer. 

![28_IMG_0685_28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/slobberchops/EowGeABoKuJijr1jkWvm1asEVSGBSWNAJbqZbv5FggShbv7F156uorMx7QPhRwqXmt4.jpg)

The only positive I can add to \

is that if you are a starter explorer, then visit here. Easy access, a little more effort to get out, and an experience, if a mediocre one.

title.title: Television Review: The New Guy (The Shield, S6X04, 2007)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/gi20Sflc6UiWefjqgOmskfbQ4sy.jpg)

**The New Guy (S06E04)**

Airdate: 24 April 2007

Written by:  Sarah Fain & Elizabeth Craft
Directed by: Clark Johnson

Running Time: 45 minutes 



Following the seismic events of the preceding episodes, which served as a cathartic purge of the series' long-running antagonists and the tragic death of Lem, *The New Guy* attempts to recalibrate the tempo of *The Shield*. The show, usually a blur of high-octane violence and desperate survival, seemed to take—or at least the authors of this specific instalment seemed to think they were taking—a slightly slower, more measured approach. The expectation was a return to the mundane horrors of the Farmington district, with lower stakes and a focus on the regular dysfunction of the Strike Team. However, while the setup promised a breath of fresh air, the execution feels like a reluctant step backward into melodrama.

Vic Mackey, having survived Kavanaugh’s Internal Affairs investigation and exacted revenge for Lem’s death, believes he is finally at a good place. He takes the reins of the Strike Team, ready to reassert his hegemony on the streets. Yet, a palpable void remains. It is not just the absence of Lem, but the strategic maneuvering of Captain Claudette Wyms. With the unit’s ranks thinning, Wyms sees an opportunity to bring in fresh blood and, crucially, a replacement for Vic. This new arrival is Detective Kevin Hiatt (Alex O’Loughlin), a former INS agent with four years of experience working the Mexican border. 

The tension peaks in a restaurant scene where a bloody gunfight broke out between One-Niners and a group of gang members attempting to defect. It is a particularly nasty situation, and Hiatt proves his worth by helping Vic, Shane, and Ronnie handle the chaos. Wyms uses this moment to formally introduce Hiatt to Vic, effectively crowning him as her successor. Vic, desperate to keep his job and maintain his empire, attempts to mentor the newcomer, playing the benevolent father figure. However, Wyms reveals a cruel twist: the appeal board hearing for Vic’s forced retirement was a fabrication, a lie told solely to make Vic behave and work with the new guy. 

In the meantime, Vic attempts to prevent further bloodshed on the streets by intervening in the conflict between Moses and Vantes (Kevontay Johnson). Vantes, a former One-Niner and self-styled \

leading a gang away from crime, becomes an obsession for Vic. As bodies pile up, Vic becomes fixated on saving Vantes' life. When he finds the wounded Vantes after shootout, it is tragically too late. Vic brings him to Mission Cross Hospital only to watch him die. It is a moment of profound vulnerability; Vic breaks down in front of his wife, Wyms, and his colleagues, exposing the depth of his grief and his desperation to replace the friend he lost.

While Vic struggles with his emotional demons, Dutch and Billings are tasked with a particularly nauseating serial rapist case. The perpetrator targets vulnerable runaway teens, drugging them with GHB. The case is doubly embarrassing for Claudette because the Modus Operandi matches the testimony of a girl whose story was previously disregarded. Dutch is driven to solve it, convinced the rapist will eventually escalate to murder. This subplot provides a gritty, procedural counterpoint to Vic's emotional turmoil, grounding the episode in the messy reality of police work.

Unbeknownst to Vic, Wyms continues to dismantle the Strike Team from within. Officer Julien Lowe is offered a position within the unit. After agreeing, he is told to join the team the next day, further signalling the fragmentation of the unit’s original dynamic.

Written by Sarah Fain and Elizabeth Craft, *The New Guy* is a solid episode, but it feels merely functional. It tries to compensate for the relative banality of its content with enhanced melodrama. The Strike Team members are constantly reminded of Lem’s absence, which leads to Shane feeling utterly miserable and Vic trying to compensate for his friend's loss with a bizarre, almost delusional idea: making Vantes, an idealistic martyr, some sort of replacement for Lem. It is a desperate, pathetic attempt at catharsis.

The most bizarre element of the episode is undoubtedly the scene in which Corrine suddenly appears at the Clubhouse to recount a dream involving Lem. Each of his friends interprets the dream in different ways, and the sequence itself shifts into a realm of mysticism or surrealism. It is the closest *The Shield* came to fantasy, and it feels awkward, as if the writers forcefully transplanted a scene from a less realistic drama into their gritty police series. It disrupts the immersion and feels forced.

On the acting front, Alex O’Loughlin, the Australian actor who would become a big star a few years later as the protagonist of the *Hawaii 5-0* remake, makes his debut here. Apart from his physically imposing presence, he doesn't make a massive impact, but the script leaves plenty of room for his character to grow in the episodes to come. He provides a physical counterpoint to Vic, but the episode lacks the chemistry to fully establish him as a genuine threat or partner. *The New Guy* is a transitional piece, necessary for setting up the changing of the guard, but it suffers from trying too hard to be emotionally resonant while relying on contrived dream sequences.

RATING: 6/10 (++)
