title.title: For every thing that angers me, there are many that make me laugh. (Week 297)
title.body:
> --- >Laughter is one of the most positive vibrations that exist, like love, peace, calm and, above all, gratitude. In contrast, there is fury, anger, hatred, rage and sadness, with negative vibrations and negative thoughts. I try to always be in the first group, although sometimes there are things that make me stray from it. --- ![20260221_005145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zks2ud9UwMNokMhujmqQKrFLkEA29ozrWCUTtgSYjhwo9PCnjAyRWxPGKJfGNM9ao4e.jpg) --- I think it's always better to talk about the negative first so you can end on a positive note and attract more of that. I don't usually get angry or upset, I always say so, but rather I get sad, both of which are negative. But that's how I am. Someone once told me that anger is better because you let it out and that's it. But sadness is more profound. I don't really know, but that's how I am. But there are things that infuriate me, and when I see them too often or they are extremely noticeable, they drive me crazy, such as lack of respect and consideration, injustice, exaggerated human idiocy or stupidity, and laziness that wants to get things for nothing. There are surely more things, but those come to mind. --- ![20180823_150446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkvec3jTTJLAaH1qqcbEZEtB4sxy9x4dznRk2t1nXzmcJt2EwzdP7ZeAtAss63iRiak.jpg) --- There are so many examples in real life, and I see them every day, like the woman who reluctantly attended to my mother this morning at the ophthalmologist's office, not wanting to look up her file to find out why she was there without a letter from the health centre, or the young people who don't give up their seats to older people on the bus, tourists who litter the streets or beaches, which I see with my own eyes and it infuriates me, mothers who have a sick child and yet go on holiday with their new boyfriend and don't care about their little boy. The latter is a direct case that my friend told me about someone in her family. And in all these cases there are many things going on together: disrespect, stupidity and injustice. But there are also people who want money without working. Like a 22-year-old guy who got a great job in Switzerland, but because he earned less than his boss, he quit to go to Germany and receive unemployment benefits from the state. And I think: Get a job, you lazy bum! Because on top of that, he complains, but he'd rather sit around doing nothing. --- ![20180823_151424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244oZ5t87cw67exxFzbVMeuaqaWQzY4V6k5zjNMPjApjhyFj1UFVvsa6H2BzLKXYaF4tQ.jpg) --- These are things we see every day, and there are worse things, but these are the ones that come to mind right now. But for every one of these, there are many other things that make me laugh. And laughing is the best thing in life; it's a very high and positive vibration, like gratitude. Many things make me laugh; in fact, my own family says I laugh at anything. I think laughter is good; it's good for the soul and even for the body. You feel better when you laugh, stress is released, worries are lessened, and there is good energy in the atmosphere. It's also contagious, and what could be better than that, bringing joy to others? --- ![20180823_152238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WVpF8Hm8iY38pqMsj1WmMH36XDWBtvSgU2pgjegXmeUjVsZ9eYyoF2BcG6o1HXSK9H.jpg) --- Silly jokes make me laugh, but above all, it's how the joke is told, especially in the case of jokes that probably aren't jokes, but the face of the person telling it seriously or making a gesture is funnier than the joke itself. Some people are naturally funny, my brother is one of them. Sometimes he looks at me and says, 'I don't know what you're laughing at. What did I say? And it's even worse, it makes me laugh even more. I laugh at my own things, often simple things that happen in life, like bumping into something, not realising that what I'm looking for is right in front of me, or silly mistakes I might make, but also and above all I laugh when someone makes me laugh, I'm very susceptible to that. And laughing together with another person is the best thing there is, it's as if something good were multiplied a thousandfold. An endless contagion of laughter is fabulous. --- ![20180823_151830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGo3LFbUKRYR7tT1Pn4dspef1gmk645ENcT9HSBM2FLFrc9DPhVHcaCXawJCeFZZTqo.jpg) --- And when I think about motivation, that's really great. Of course, it depends on the moment and the object of motivation. Rain motivates me to write, as does certain music. Depending on the music, I can write horror stories, poems or even thoughts and develop them extensively. I am motivated by a walk in nature, among the trees, or walking along the beach with the water touching my feet. Water is always motivating for me. The small, big things in life. My cats motivate me; they are always a source of joy for me. I am motivated by recognition for a job well done, for the perseverance and dedication I put into things, and words of recognition and gratitude motivate me to continue doing what I do and much more. --- ![20180823_151447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243qGrCGLbzzygjBLxkqdQAswtGUxfdri8jqtPHwWiWKRCCHDqB3SjLTCfC2NcmCoYpjn.jpg) --- A kind word, a caress, being there in difficult times and laughing in good times motivate me. I am always motivated to do the things I love, the things I enjoy. I am motivated by the morning sun and the night moon. It is the simplest things, but I believe the most important ones, that always motivate me, and above all, the beautiful signs from the universe, as I call them. I am motivated by people like me, people with the strength to move forward, who show commitment, quality and perseverance. I am motivated by seeing my reflection in those people, and so we motivate each other. |||| |-|-|-| |||| |||| That's why for every thing that might upset you, there are many others that make you laugh and motivate you. That's what being positive is all about. This is one of the great [weekend topics](https://peakd.com/hive-168869/@galenkp/weekend-engagement-topics-week-297) raised by @galenkp. Thank you for that. Thank you all very much for joining me today. I wish you a very good weekend. See you soon. Amonet. |||| |-|-|-| |||| ||||
All the photographs are mine. Used translator [Deepl.com](https://www.deepl.com/translator) free version.

title.title: The Silent Waves of Kapıkırı  -  Kapıkırı'nın Sessiz Dalgaları  ( EN-TR)
title.body:
Kapıkırı Village, one of the most beautiful villages of the Aegean, awakens in the mornings with a thin mist of fog settling over the lake. The town's streets are lined with single-story stone houses whose walls are stained with earth. The wind from distant lands brings with it seagulls. The sounds of the seagulls flying over the lake can be heard along the shoreline. Herakleia Ancient City, one of the most beautiful structures in the village, stands as a silent history defying time. And Lake Bafa, as it does every evening in summer, manages to paint the sky orange. Melek opened her eyes to the world on the shores of this lake in the first week of July.


>Ege'nin en güzel köylerinden biri olan Kapıkırı Köyü, sabahları gölün üstüne çöken ince sis dumanıyla birlikte uyanır. Kasabanın sokaklarında duvarları toprağa bulanmış tek katlı taş evleri vardır. Uzak diyarlardan gelen rüzgar yanında martıları da getirirdi. Gölün üstünde uçuşan martıların sesleri kıyı şeridi boyunda duyulurdu. Köyün en güzel yapılarından olan Herakleia Antik Kent, zamana direnen suskun bir tarih olarak durur. Bafa Gölü ise, yazın her akşam olduğunu gibi, gökyüzünü turuncuya boyamayı başarırdı. Melek, Temmuz ayının ilk haftası bu gölün kıyısında dünyaya gözlerini açtı. 


![IMG20240808125823.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekr6UX1Y37z5rMbJkmmsQJhk1Dfro9BFYdCiEYLnw51W/IMG20240808125823.jpg)


![IMG20240808125838.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRbhurkYKo7v6Sbf1LnTnf2jK5xWBWRZMcLgjsmYLQ5sj/IMG20240808125838.jpg)


![IMG20240808125801.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme8EFhY2bqgBsqKNNVRmU4f1KB8geCekhsdZYZQLy7B43/IMG20240808125801.jpg)
Melek's father was a fisherman. He took very good care of his long, white hair. He had piercing eyes beneath his dark eyes. He rarely trimmed his bushy mustache and thick beard. He was one of those men who took the sea very seriously. Her mother, Zeynep, sold eggs in her small shop in the village square. She would chat with the people who came to her shop. Melek completed her primary, secondary, and high school education in Muğla city center. Every morning, as she left for the school bus, she would wave to her father, who was waiting by the lake to set sail.

>Melek'in babası balıkçıydı. Uzamış beyaz saçlarına çok iyi bakardı. Siyah gözlerinin altında, kesken bakışları vardı. Pala bıyıklarını ve gür sakallarını çok sık kesmezdi. Denizi fazla ciddiye alan adamlardan biriydi. Annesi Zeynep ise, köy meydanındaki küçük dükkanında yumurta satardı. Dükkanına gelen kişilerle hal hatır sohbeti ederdi. Melek ilk, orta ve lise eğitimini Muğla merkezde tamamlamıştı. Her sabah servisle yola çıkarken gölün kıyısında denize açılmayı bekleyen babasına el sallardı. 


![IMG20240808125026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXUQz6DJvBrbBG7kde5KGMjYqEmMSzJjUkFSe6bTXuYo2/IMG20240808125026.jpg)


![IMG20240808125212.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTJjtLXLRUoi9wt8wSjKrFjcqRv7DHno8KaPFBJoEnxE/IMG20240808125212.jpg)

His father, Hasan, had named his boat Hope. But he knew very well that some hopes couldn't even stop the storms hidden within a person. It was winter. In the freezing January air, Hasan had once again set sail. The weather reports were normal. The lake was calm and still. But when evening came, Hasan didn't return. His phone was unreachable. The next day, everyone in the village started spreading rumors about Hasan's whereabouts. The next day, the gendarmerie arrived. On the third day, everyone was talking amongst themselves, wondering if he had simply given in to the waves. Zeynep had closed her shop. She was waiting for Hasan on the shore with teary eyes. Melek had witnessed how the lines on her mother's face had deepened in a single day. Every evening, Zeynep would go to the lake's edge, searching for a sign on the surface of the water.

>Babası Hasan teknesine Umut adını vermişti. Ama bazı umutların insanın içinde sakladığı fırtınaları bile durduramayacağını çok iyi biliyordu. Mevsimden kıştı. O soğuk Ocak ayının ayazında Hasan yine denize açılmıştı. Hava raporları normaldi. Göl sakin ve durgundu. Fakat akşam olduğunda Hasan geri dönmedi. Telefonuna da ulaşılamıyordu. Ertesi gün köyde herkes Hasan'ın nerde olduğu hakkında çeşitli söylentilere başladı. İkinci gün Jandarma geldi. Üçüncü günde herkes dalgalara teslim olmuş olabilir de kendi aralarında konuşuyorlardı. Zeynep dükkanını kapatmıştı. Kıyıda yaşlı gözlerle Hasan'ı bekliyordu. Melek annesinin yüzündeki çizgilerin bir günde nasıl derinleştiğine şahit olmuştu. Zeynep, her akşam gölün kıyısında giderek, suyun yüzeyinde bir işaret arıyordu. 


![IMG20240808124117.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYHRaLdCduEcukc3MSVtQLxnChjBXaMtpFecdN3887QEs/IMG20240808124117.jpg)



![IMG20240808113245.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtC21vST9pe3hC8GydckmaVxnYrrKv9aJ11axnPmSyQi/IMG20240808113245.jpg)


![IMG20240808113241.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSEeXFVtnbijn9tR3StLLhLSb6zhPQijGZsvRGUq64875/IMG20240808113241.jpg)

But Hasan wasn't dead. He had planned his disappearance long before. The tragedies of his childhood haunted him. When he was only ten years old, he had lost his father in a boating accident, and his mother, struggling with poverty, had passed away after contracting a serious illness. Since then, it had been very difficult for Hasan to form attachments. There was a constant pain deep in his heart. It was as if he felt that everything he loved would be taken from him.


>Ama Hasan ölmemişti. Çok önceden kayboluşunu planlamıştı. Küçüklüğünde yaşamış olduğu trajediler bir türlü aklından çıkmıyordu. Henüz on yaşındayken babasını bir tekne kazasında kaybetmişti, annesi yoksullukla mücadele ederken ağır bir hastalığa yakalanarak hayata veda etmişti. O günden sonra Hasan için bağlanmak çok zor olmuştu. Yüreğinin derinliklerinde sürekli bir acı vardı. Sanki sevdiği her şeyin elinden alınacağını hissediyordu. 



![IMG20240806172137.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKgsjeD2FTfPP9zDiXt6hb7EdTKBWkT3uX9dACS8SZu9/IMG20240806172137.jpg)


![IMG20240713154227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVWTFRfv6hvACvimcLsV5579FegKUwVvnR253hVpkU91/IMG20240713154227.jpg)

![IMG20240713154157.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWstnv8r94kxcxxErzTcpqbRPrXrxnPonrenvahyALBSs/IMG20240713154157.jpg)

Melek had grown up and was dreaming of going to university. Her father's old fears had resurfaced. He constantly thought that one day he would leave them. One Sunday morning, Hasan, with the help of a fisherman friend, left his boat in a deserted cove and disappeared without a trace. He intended to work in another port under a new identity. He thought he was protecting his family from himself in this way. But the void he left behind was deeper than the wounds inflicted by the waves of the sea. Melek couldn't accept her father's disappearance. She knew him very well. He knew the sea. He wouldn't go out to sea regardless of the weather conditions.


>Melek büyümüş, üniversiteye gitmenin hayallerini kuruyordu. Babasının içindeki eski korkular uyanmıştı. Sürekli aklından bir gün bizi bırakacak düşüncesini geçiriyordu. Bir pazar sabahı Hasan başka bir kıyıya geçmek için bir balıkçı arkadaşının yardımıyla teknesini ıssız bir koyda bırakarak, kimseye görünmeden oradan uzaklaşmıştı. Yeni bir kimlikle başka bir limanda çalışmayı amaçlıyordu. Böylelikle ailesini kendinden koruduğunu düşünüyordu. Oysa geride bıraktığı boşluk, denizdeki dalgalarının açtığı yaradan daha derindi. Melek bir türlü babasının kayboluşunu kabul etmek istemiyordu. Babasını çok iyi tanıyordu. O denizi biliyordu. Hava koşullarına bakmadan denizde açılmazdı. 



![IMG20240407105352.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeQkueZjMpjdLcNkDsco3kX4cp4HfUa9WF8epYmAnMQWG/IMG20240407105352.jpg)



![IMG20240407104240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEqv5RzsQg6S95u9WavfeZ8emvr6wZj1pPbN1wbCjHLG/IMG20240407104240.jpg)



![IMG20240406185613.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTc2Rbp4HRNMwL575jeX5LLT5seiijcpWfgnhr7tHML3z/IMG20240406185613.jpg)
Melek sat sadly on the old boat her father had made for her. As she sat there, her eyes fell upon a dusty, black wooden box. Opening it, she saw old, darkened envelopes and photographs of her father from his youth. Inside was also a notebook. It contained some drawings and a single sentence that filled an entire page, along with some unfinished sentences.

>Melek, üzgün gözlerle babasının kendine yaptığı eski sandalın üstünde öylece oturuyordu. Sandal da otururken bir ara gözü sandal da yer alan  tozlanmış siyah ahşaptan yapılmış kapalı bir kutu ilişti. Kutunun içini açtığında, eskimiş ve kararmış olan zarflarla babasının gençlik yıllarında çektirdiği fotoğrafları gördü. Kutunun içinde bir de defter vardı. İçinde bazı çizimler ve yarım kalmış cümlelerle sayfayı komple doldurulmuş tek bir cümle yazıyordu. 


![IMG20240406184526.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmckoqDDDsEpfeE1kqAVfjrMAR9YEK65srVwmD5p4yPDGd/IMG20240406184526.jpg)

\

\n\nMelek read that sentence over and over again. Her father had run away. At that moment, she thought of him as strong but wounded. Melek told her beloved guidance counselor about it in high school. That's when she decided to study psychology. She wanted to understand the deep wounds people carry inside, wounds they can't tell anyone about. She especially wanted to understand the situation of those who, like her father, run away from their loved ones. Melek was determined to find her father. Before leaving the house, she hugged her mother tightly and said to her, \
Herkesin iyi olması için ben gitmeliyim\

dedi. 


![IMG20240406184529.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc3MWYV2i3U7ntHtABAUJywNdjsZVbPivQXfjtAiFHJM8/IMG20240406184529.jpg)

Her mother Zeynep's eyes filled with tears. But this time, there was more hope than fear in her eyes. Melek had memorized the routes her father had written in a notebook in the past, starting her journey from Muğla city center. One of those envelopes had a slightly faded but legible postmark pointing to an Aegean island. It was a deserted harbor near Söke. Melek had arrived in Söke. On the Söke shore, she met an old fisherman. She described her father. The old man said he had seen someone matching Hasan's description in this harbor. But he had specified that his name wasn't Hasan. \

he said. Melek's heart raced, and she was filled with excitement.


>Annesi Zeynep'in gözleri doldu. Ama bu sefer gözlerinde korkudan çok, bir umut bakışı vardı. Melek Muğla merkezden başlayan yolculuğunda babasının geçmişte deftere  yazdığı rotaları zihnine kazımıştı. O zarflardan birinde posta damgası biraz silinmiş ama okunabilir bir Ege adasını işaret ediyordu. Söke yakınlarında kimsenin uğramadığı bir limandı. Melek Söke'ye gelmişti. Söke kıyısında yaşlı bir balıkçıyla karşılaştı. Babasını tarif etti. Yaşlı adam Hasan'ın tarifine uyan birini bu limanda gördüğünü söyledi. Ama adının Hasan olmadığını belirtmişti. Kızı  adını değiştirmiş dedi. Melek'in kalbi hızlandı ve heyecanlanmıştı.  


![IMG20240401170754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbJFbFcq5mRsumUd1tL7pzEQi8nbzpJKUJbopat1kWiqC/IMG20240401170754.jpg)

Melek started walking towards a small cove that seemed to be nestled between two mountains in Söke. When she reached the shore, she saw an old boat. The boat had no name. But on the deck, she saw a knot technique her father had used when he was young. He had taught her that knot when she was a child. She saw her father approaching the boat. For a moment, her hands trembled, her breath caught in her throat. Hasan froze when he saw his daughter. Melek ran off the deck to her father's side. They made eye contact. Melek whispered, \
Hasan's eyes filled with tears. The childhood fears he had carried within him for years flashed before his eyes like a film scene. Then, with a trembling voice, he said to his daughter, \

Upon hearing his daughter's words, Hasan cried for the first time.


>Melek Söke'nin iki dağ arasında sıkışmış gibi görünen küçük bir koya doğru yürümeye başladı. Kıyıya vardığında burada eski bir tekne gördü. Teknenin adı yoktu. Ama güvertede babasının gençken kullandığı bir düğüm tekniğini gördü. O düğümü çocukken kızına öğretmişti. Karşıdan tekneye doğru gelen babasını gördü. Bir an için  elleri titredi, nefesi kesildi. Hasan kızını görünce oracıkta donup kaldı. Melek güverteden dışarı çıkıp koşarak babasının yanına geldi. Göz göze geldiler. Melek kısık bir sesle: \
Hasan'ın gözleri dolmuştu. Yıllardır içinde taşımış olduğu çocukluk korkuları o an bir film karesi gözlerinin önünden geçti. Sonra titreten sesiyle kızına: \
Sonra da sizi kaybedeceğim sandım.  Melek babasına sıkı sıkı sarıldı. \

dedi. Benimle birlikte gel baba, annem seni bekliyor. Kızının bu sözleri üzerine Hasan ilk kez ağlamıştı. 


![IMG20240324172242.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZpryQLrXxjL4sQnteyNHFDzpNrd7N7UKV5ifSNYSgc7/IMG20240324172242.jpg)

Melek returned to Kapıkırı Village with her father. Hasan hugged his daughter and wife tightly and said, \
>Melek babasını da yanına alarak Kapıkırı Köyüne geri döndü. Hasan kızını ve karısı sımsıkı sarılarak:  \

Life had started flowing again in Kapıkırı. Zeynep continued selling eggs in her shop. Melek was preparing for university entrance exams to study psychology. Hasan, on the other hand, had forgotten his old wounds and was learning to live without running away.


>Kapıkırı'da hayat yeniden akmaya başlamıştı. Zeynep dükkanında yumurta satmaya devam etti. Melek psikoloji okumak için üniversite sınavlarına hazırlanıyordu. Hasan ise eski yaralarını unutmuş, kaçmadan yaşamayı öğreniyordu.

body.title: I Wasn’t Sure, But I Answered
body.body:
I sat there staring at the paper in front of me, my pen resting between my fingers.

One question was left.

I had been doing well so far. The test wasn’t easy, but it wasn’t impossible either. Still, that last question made me pause. I had seen something like it before, but I wasn’t completely sure. My mind started playing games with me.

What if I get it wrong?
What if it ruins everything?

I told myself to skip it and come back later. But later never feels safer. It only brings more pressure.

I looked around the room. Others were still writing. Some looked confident. Some looked lost. The clock on the wall kept ticking, louder than before. I knew time was slipping away.

I thought about leaving it blank.
That felt safer. No mistake. No risk.

But then I remembered how many times I had held back because I wasn’t “sure enough.” How often I chose comfort over effort. I realized that leaving it blank was also a decision—just a quieter one.

So I tried.
I wrote what I knew. Not perfectly. Not confidently. But honestly. I worked through it step by step, trusting what I had learned instead of waiting for certainty.

When time was up, I put my pen down and exhaled.
Days later, the results came out. I didn’t get everything right. But that question I almost skipped? I got most of it correct. Enough to make a difference. Enough to remind me of something important.

That day taught me a clear lesson. Waiting until you feel completely sure can cost you more than trying and getting it partly wrong. Progress doesn’t come from certainty. It comes from effort.

Now, when I face moments like that—when doubt tells me to stop—I remember that question. And I choose to try anyway.


This story is fictional and written to share a life lesson.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8vUhR7aw2tDCBeDBa9ai7JaDRgKA4K8CfJUb7pQXLA4/file_00000000840471f4bd0d9bead160f5ac.png)

The Rajasthan Motorcycle Tour officially starts in Delhi, which serves as both the arrival and departure point of the journey. Delhi is well connected by international and domestic flights, making it convenient for riders joining the motorbike tour in Rajasthan from across the world. After arrival, riders are briefed and prepared before heading into the royal landscapes of Rajasthan.

**What Is the Complete Route of the Tour?**

The full riding route is designed in a circular format to ensure smooth logistics and diverse experiences

*Delhi – Mandawa – Bikaner – Jaisalmer – Jodhpur – Udaipur – Pushkar – Jaipur – Agra – Delhi*

This route allows riders to experience desert highways, historic forts, rural villages, and vibrant city culture within one structured itinerary.

**Why Is Delhi the Ideal Starting Point?**

Beginning in Delhi ensures better road connectivity, professional support services, and easy transfers. The carefully crafted [Rajasthan Motorcycle Travel](https://www.indiamotorbiketour.com/Destination/rajasthan) plan balances long riding stretches with cultural exploration, making the Rajasthan Motorcycle Tour both practical and memorable for every rider.

body.title: Ich trolle einfach alle, die sich im Internet ueber Politiker beschweren. Wahlvolk halt, hat nix zu sagen, aber viel zu klagen. :-)
body.body:
Ab und An, bekommt man immer noch sein Brettchen, von mir, damit man jahrnicht vergisst!

Ich muss mir ja selber Treu bleiben. Also bin ich von Mauler, zum Polittroll geworden.

Ich mach mich Lustig ueber die Leute, die sich Beschweren. So einfach ist das, gehe ich mit Doppelwahlvolk um, wie verdient.

Zweitstimmen sind ein No-Go. 

Ich moechte ein Verbot von poltischen Aeußerungen in der Oeffentlichkeit, wennm na gewaehlt hat.

Als Nichtwahler, bin ich wenigstens so Konsequent, und halte mich raus aus dem Spiel, das mir nicht gefaellt, mit meiner Stimme auf einem Zettel fuer VIER Jahre abdelegiert.

Alleine wie oft ich selber meine Meinung in vier Jahren aendere, macht die Waehlerschaft fuer mich zur Lachnummer, niemals Erwachsen zu werden.

Ja, genau. Delegieren ist nicht.

Macht auf dem Hive auch keiner gerne, oder gar Vollstaendig, wenn es Ernst ist mit dem Eigenavatar... warum wohl...

Scheinheilig ist es fuer mich wie die Gottesanbeter, mit ihrem gutem Glauben, sich zur Wahlurne zu bewegen und dannach im Internet nur zu Blaeken und zu Bloeken wie Doof die Poltiker doch alle sind.


Manch ein Waehler widerum, wuenscht sich, das nicht jeder Waehlen gehen darf. Ich zum Beispiel nicht, weil ich ein Nutznießer dieser Gesellschaft bin, fuer Solche Heiligenscheine.

Die Poltiker sind Gut so wie sie sind! Besser, als sie muessten wuerde ich sogar sagen...

Vielleicht werde ich auch Politiker am Ende doch noch... Dann trolle ich Total sozusagen.

Gute Entscheidungen fuer schlechte Waehler zu treffen ist eben nicht moeglich.

Also mehr Demokratie oder? Mehr Eigenverantwortung, nicht nur beim Geldbeutel, sondern auch, wenns um den Dreck auf der Straße geht!

Salve

Alucian aka Sascha Pürner

body.title: A Little Sneak Peek of Baybay City, Leyte
body.body: > Happy Saturday Hivers! ## Baybay City, Leyte is one of the most progressive cities in the province. Over the years, many establishments have grown and developed here. It is also the nearest city to our home, which makes it a convenient and important place for us. Transportation here is not difficult since there are many buses and vans available for those who do not have their own vehicle. Baybay City is approximately a 45-minute bus ride from our home, although this can take as little as 30 minutes depending on the speed. A few weeks ago, I went to Baybay City with my mother. We visited one of their tourist spots, Aya Hills, which I already posted about here. After our visit to Aya Hills, we headed straight to the heart of Baybay City because we simply wanted to see what it was like at night. I haven't visited Baybay City at night so we took that opportunity to witness Baybay City at night. ## ![IMG_2937.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23zGgWTJKgECLA3j9MmCZcpJe2sxmrUig5GqNby8sjWLvNKupryeiydfCpuy2r9vTYffm.jpeg) ## When you reach the very heart of Baybay City, the first thing that greets you is their large and historic church, the Immaculate Conception Church. Its bell tower easily captures people’s attention because of its height and striking presence. ## ![IMG_3381.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23yTb7E5vzvSzjcRtj8k92d2tnJb4x1RfjQMm8qACe2hpXogBgvZZbactB5pPWzU7wUU9.jpeg) ## ![IMG_2938.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23wqpNUGHormQ5u3EFT2DjB9NWwmjFL1nLXNvKRB2wJNzSHLf5FYcRVG3MVRaBcJdeW4B.jpeg) ## Although the exterior looks old and preserves its historic charm, the interior has been renovated and now has a more modern feel. They intentionally kept the outer structure of the church to maintain its original and classic appearance. ## ![IMG_2932.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/242DJfEWEJeZFqn1ofLBkBY8sxdpUHvHiSPq2BUQu498tUB6kshgyfeDhiFKBLmZHhJTn.jpeg) ## Their plaza is very close to the church, actually, it is right beside it. You can easily see the plaza as soon as you are at the church. In the afternoon, the plaza becomes lively with many people hanging out, and most of them are students. They usually stay there because the place is spacious, breezy, and comfortable. ## ![IMG_2941.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23yJLbaMKgFBMrb1x5nHVNnbWJcZtEVjvNUk7ASYPS3KBrBLkSwufXkunfxqDsbnCvWtg.jpeg) ## You can really tell that the plaza is well-maintained and thoughtfully designed. It gives the impression that the people managing the city truly value providing citizens with a pleasant public space where they can relax. In today’s stressful times, we all need a place where we can escape for a while, unwind, and recharge. That is exactly the kind of atmosphere you can feel when you spend time in the plaza of Baybay City. ## ![IMG_2944.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/2423q9pJkGBxtHC4WyBH24cQxY8bkJSAjBGDtTQoaSjPJmt2DC5wVnNH9wtWEi5ReatdN.jpeg) ## Did you know that their plaza is also near the sea and has a baywalk? If you want to witness the sunset, you can simply sit along their very clean baywalk and enjoy the view. From there, you can see Camotes Island, the large island that is part of Cebu, making the scenery even more relaxing and beautiful, especially during sunset. ## ![IMG_2951.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23vhsM4Pje8H8pdMNL9ZaepauichxVrxMCMKX3GLmETyVVSPEHP37deBRwmYFhBEoA5tn.jpeg) ## After strolling around the plaza and baywalk, we started to feel hungry. You do not have to worry, though, because there are many food stalls and restaurants along the baywalk, and most of them offer Filipino cuisine. At that time, my mother and I were craving barbecue, so we looked for a place that served barbecue. ## ![IMG_2956.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/Eoc82SPhv88PeF3L7LTWSXdp3D4xmJfSDtDv9wUDQxkvAVE1qBfCeNZA61XuheaeggT.jpeg) ## ![IMG_2957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23uQr55rjQB6jGCkgB36Ef4CY8JiB7PPdLUihLP5TbogisJbScSWTuT9wERSZ3oJysXyA.jpeg) ## What I liked about the food place was that it did not feel stuffy because it was an open space. While eating, you could relax and enjoy the view since it was located along the baywalk. ## ![IMG_2958.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23ywsYQwNint8bByz6mRsnzsfCkG6XNmG6g4yUFEKeTzMKM1MaAFXmQAfYQ6po3vR2y22.jpeg) ## It was a great experience strolling around Baybay City as the evening approached. The day ended on a very relaxing note, and my mother and I truly felt refreshed and at ease. ## ![IMG_2959.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/Eoc7zhdfm9AwyWQTQt8CN3tXL5h8C9WHC31rg5WHnEMJBZEMEXuQz6HLyG4TR3uypV5.jpeg) ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

OK,今天先分享到这儿哈，再次祝福大家初五快乐，财源广进。

body.title: Two Stories, One Masterpiece, And A Sequel That Somehow Surpassed The Original Why The Godfather Part II Still Sets The Standard For Every Film That Came After It
body.body:
The Godfather Part II is one of those rare sequels that does not just live up to the original. It expands it, deepens it, and in many ways surpasses it. Released in 1974, the film proved that a continuation of a great story could also become one of the greatest films ever made.

![IMG_7791.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNQ7ZRq6zhqc3XwmbQTYAchDNUtQAKHNe1acguAEr1wpk/IMG_7791.jpeg)

Francis Ford Coppola returned as director and brought the same patience and precision that made the first film legendary. Instead of repeating himself, Coppola chose to tell two stories at once. One follows Michael Corleone in the present as he tightens his grip on power, while the other shows the early life of Vito Corleone and how the family empire began.

Al Pacino’s performance as Michael is colder and more controlled this time. In the first film we watched him reluctantly enter the family business. Here we see a man fully consumed by it. Pacino plays Michael with quiet intensity, showing how power isolates him from everyone around him, including his own family.

Robert De Niro steps into the role of young Vito Corleone, originally played by Marlon Brando, and somehow makes the character completely his own. De Niro’s portrayal is subtle and deliberate, showing Vito’s intelligence, patience, and sense of loyalty as he rises from an immigrant struggling in New York to a respected figure building his legacy.

The contrast between father and son is what makes the film so compelling. Vito’s story is about building something through relationships and trust. Michael’s story is about maintaining control through fear and calculation. Watching those two journeys unfold side by side gives the film an emotional depth that few movies ever achieve.

The supporting cast is just as strong. Diane Keaton brings vulnerability and heartbreak to Kay as she realizes what Michael has become. Robert Duvall returns as Tom Hagen, steady as ever but increasingly sidelined. John Cazale’s Fredo provides one of the film’s most tragic arcs, a character caught between loyalty and weakness.

Coppola’s direction allows every scene to breathe. The film moves at a deliberate pace, letting the audience absorb the weight of each decision and consequence. Nothing feels rushed, and that restraint adds to the sense of inevitability as Michael’s world grows darker.

Visually, the movie is stunning. The warm tones of Vito’s early years contrast with the colder, more shadowed look of Michael’s timeline. That visual difference reinforces the emotional divide between the hopeful rise of a father and the moral decline of a son.

Nino Rota’s score once again gives the film its haunting identity. The music ties both timelines together, reminding us that these two stories are part of the same legacy, even as they move in opposite emotional directions.

What makes The Godfather Part II stand apart from other sequels is its ambition. It is not just continuing a story. It is reflecting on it, questioning it, and showing the cost of everything that was built in the first place.

The film explores themes of family, power, loyalty, and corruption without ever feeling heavy handed. It trusts the audience to see the parallels and understand the tragedy unfolding across generations.

By the time the film reaches its quiet final moments, the contrast is complete. We have seen Vito surrounded by people as he builds his future, and Michael alone as he protects what he inherited. That emotional shift is what lingers long after the movie ends.

![IMG_7790.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzHcguBJhs3PtCFpFspbGy2jn6WWbPAWURuPtPejZ4SX/IMG_7790.jpeg)

Decades later, The Godfather Part II remains the gold standard for what a sequel can be. It is bold, layered, and unforgettable, proving that sometimes the continuation of a story can become just as legendary as the beginning.

body.title: A nice story for my ECL
body.body:
![IMG_4280.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYxVArBxbrVUgo7TZWcgm7h7iVCq7vK3qCAp34xPodWF8/IMG_4280.png)

I continue to work hard on my ECL test preparation. As I said before I’ve cchoosen podcast listening as one of the methods to improve my listening skills. Unexpectedly it became also the way to broaden my knowledge of classic English literature. 

Each time when I find the story I like, I save it into my watching list. Usually I return to it several times and each time I find something new for me not only in English language constructions but also in the plot of the story. 

I like short classic stories best. Maybe someday I’ll be able to follow plots of novels or romans. But not today. 

**The short story I want to introduce to you today is  “The Umbrella Man” by Roald Dahl”**

It was published in 1980 so some moments may probably seem old-fashioned for the young generation. But not for me who was born in 1970. 

At the same time the main idea  (as I see it) is relevant at any time: don’t judge people for their appearance  or social status. 

But please don’t be  jumping to conclusion that this story is a moralistic pamphlet. Not at all! I would say it is a little detective with the absolutely unexpected end. 

You can find the story PDF here if you prefer to read ⤵️

https://dn720005.ca.archive.org/0/items/the-umbrella-man-by-roald-dahl-a-4/The%20Umbrella%20Man%20by%20Roald%20Dahl%20a4.pdf

The podcast where I've found the story first is here ⤵️

https://youtu.be/Fxm1vTW5jdg?si=cjycp8M_Xwh4oG_-

And here is the short movie which is based on the story. I don’t know how about you, but I like it: to read a story and then to see a movie and vice verse ⤵️

https://youtu.be/vy7cuOjEUqc?si=PS1QE3MvNaVG82GO

**So listen, watch, read, have fun and in prove your English together with me and English classic literature**

body.title: Не буває маленьких донатів
body.body: ![IMG_20260220_174858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23vsUbnPir3iJoK7JcfqfyqZ74gHLQi5rZNZKuAHYDmuH7SXMaYC2ngeLWxVLEjxniDcn.jpg)\n\nВчора ходили з друзями — з подругами та їхніми чоловіками — до театру на балет «Лісова пісня» за мотивами твору Лісова пісня Леся Українка. Постановка — від творців балету \

— і, як і попередня їхня робота, вона мені дуже сподобалася.

Дуже красива хореографія. Через мінімалістичні, дещо нереалістичні декорації настрій і тон сцени передавалися світлом і, власне, танцем — і це було справді сильно. Щоправда, без знання сюжету не все легко вгадати, про що не забув сказати мені мій чоловік … але це ж чоловіки, ви їх знаєте 😉

Та зараз трохи не про це.

Перед виставою ми не встигли повечеряти, тож мали лише пів години й вирішили зайти швидко перекусити в \

. Там дуже смачно — і це не реклама (хоча я була б не проти 😉). Ей, рекламодавці, звертайте увагу! Жартую… хоча, як відомо, у кожному жарті є лише частка жарту.

Поки чекали на замовлення, читали побажання від клієнтів з різних міст. І мене дуже вразили слова військових. Вони писали, що завжди забігають у «Львівські круасани» перед виходом на позиції. І навряд чи йдеться про сам Львів — ця мережа є в багатьох містах України, навіть близько до сходу.

Вони пишуть, що вірять: ще повернуться й знову їстимуть свої улюблені круасани повним складом. Тобто всі повернуться живими. 🥲

Це так вдарило в саме серце! Ми часто не розуміємо й не цінуємо того, що маємо. Не замислюємося, якою ціною нам це дається. Іноді — ціною чиїхось життів. Життів тих захисників, які не повернулися з позицій.

А ще в кінці вони написали: «Кожен донат має значення».
І справді — навіть якщо це вартість однієї кави, для когось це вже допомога. Якщо таких донатів багато — це сила.

Наші донати потрібні хлопцям. Тож підтримуймо їх завжди, коли маємо можливість.

А ви донатите?

body.title: Small steps
body.body:
Hi, guys!

I have two days off left, and now I need to get some good rest before returning to work. I've actually been able to relax quite a bit during this time, and now I'm hoping that after returning to work, I'll be able to ease back into my routine and continue working normally, without putting too much pressure on myself.

I hope this will be true, because my vacation lasted a whole week, but it's been two months since I've been able to get back into a normal routine, and naturally, it's irritating me terribly. So I need to make sure everything I've planned starts working again quickly. I've started trying a system of small steps, starting with exercise. I've started adding one minute to my exercise routine every day, and now my workout is fifteen minutes a day. In a week, it will be 22 minutes, in two weeks, half an hour, and in a month, an hour, and then I'll reach my normal workout duration without pain or fear.

I plan to do the same with other elephantine tasks. For example, tomorrow I plan to add flute playing in exactly the same way. I'll start with ten minutes a day and gradually increase that time to thirty minutes. I probably won't do more than that; half an hour a day will be enough for me to grow in this direction. I'll probably just add another thirty minutes of vocals later. And that's how music will reenter my life.

Then, in the same way, I'll add drawing and other areas I want to be present in my life. And so, little by little, I'll develop a set of activities that I've been too afraid to tackle before. Little by little, in small steps. There's nothing scary about it; I'm just gradually starting to add them into my day.

So far, this seems like a great idea, and I plan to continue in the same spirit.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.title: Mental Health and Understanding: For Better or For Worse?
body.body:
These days it feels like *everyone* is involved in some aspect of mental health and *understanding themselves* better.

![0402-LipTree.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23yTfLXCZxgGdkXsCMaiMk9kjk95r4cQvkHVdU6364482TJURKRt1aPzrgoJy1jPUhoxK.jpg)

The whole *\

* thing notwithstanding, it seems like such a radical swing from my own childhood, where emotions were pretty much *ignored,* or at least something you kept to yourself and *never* shared in public.

Now, I'll be the first to admit that years of self-inquiry and striving to understand what my underlying motivations are has been helpful. But I have also learned that it's something best not taken to extremes. At best, what you end up with is a sort of road map that makes life a little *easier,* no more.

Far be it for me to deny someone a process that allegedly helps them cope with life, but I think being unable to tie your shoelaces without your *\

* present steps over a line from the merely *therapeutic* to the *self-indulgent.*

And just *how much* do you need to discover about yourself before you're ready to *do* something with your life?

![0936-CrescentLake.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23tvAWVVVKqqq3Th6qzhyfvJN3DoPVSGmBnXxNEAMGjbcXAUkckQnmETfkgs8qKuhF3Uc.JPG)

## *How Much is \

*

I'm vaguely reminded of some of the assertions I heard during my University days where people often pointed out that those staying in college to work on their 7th degree are not actually into *educating themselves,* but instead into *avoiding life.*

I think the pursuit of mental health and self-improvement walks a similar fine line where you can get so stuck in the process of trying to *understand* life that you completely forget to actually *live* it.

For example, I am afflicted with so-called ADHD, and I belong to several online communities where people share tips and helpful ideas on how to manage life. This is, of course, fine and good... but what's *not* so good are those who take over the *\
* as their entire self-identity, and it's not long before they attribute everything that happens in their lives to *\

*

Which would mostly just be a way to *dis-*empower yourself...

![0810-SunLeaves.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23tSNDs7HS3ejZvEpe4GtAjCicCyWaybd1fGRzWcQTbzin9yWNjDwnG7JUoT1Sg3NHWXr.JPG)

After all, this stuff is supposed to make life *easier,* not get in the way of your progress through it! I suppose it's just tempting to attribute every difficulty you encounter to some *\

* rather than take ownership of your own laziness and/or ineptitude. 

And those support groups? Some people do get mired down in their eternal *suffering* rather than applying the psychological tools they've learned... and end up feeling like they are perpetual victims. 

Thanks for stopping by and have a great weekend!

title.title: Splinterlands: Synergy of Resurgence and Scavenger!🔥
title.body:
>This is the first season I'm testing this legendary archon, Elowen Sylphie, from the Arcana set, and the first battle with her surprised me so much that I thought maybe there's no need to test her further, and now I'll just have to save up and prepare to purchase her. But in the ever-changing weather of Splinterlands, you can't tell how perfect you are based on a few battles. However, one of this Archon's great powers seems to outperform in every battle, like this battle, in which I lost two cards from my team of four in the first round, but the battle was still on because the two remaining cards were the same two cards that I had provided the Resurgence and Trample abilities under my Archon's special powers.

\n\n

>I've omitted some of the middle ground and focused solely on one synergy: the mind-blowing partnership between Scavenger and the Resurgence ability. With the Resurgence ability, my remaining two cards were equal to four, not two, because as soon as a card was knocked out, its identical avatar reappeared with all 100% stats, dealing a -1 health blow to all Battlefield cards upon its arrival. All cards on the enemy team, except for the Tank, were weak in health, which I took full advantage of. Although a card with a 5 Magic Attack power dealt the most damage to my team, its own Electrified ability also dealt a -1 health blow to its partner cards every round. So, firstly, relatively low health cards were continuously weakening with 1 Electrified blow per round + Resurgence blow when my two cards equipped with special powers were knocked out and reappeared, due to which 3 enemy cards were killed in these blows without any direct attack.

>But still the enemy's Tank and Magic Shock Trooper cards thrashed my team and my Endless Ape also got killed while 3 enemy cards were still on the battlefield but this was the first life of this Endless Ape, which means immediately after this the Endless Ape reappeared with its 100% stats but this time its health was more than twice that of 100%, guess how?

>Firstly, on reappearing with Resurgence, all the cards on the Battlefield suffered a damage of -1 health, as a result of which two more cards out of the 3 enemy cards were knocked out. Then the health of the newly born Endless Ape was 18, which is 8+ from the initial health of this card, 10. And this happened because Endless Ape had the Scavenger Ability, due to which the health of this card was increasing by +1 when every card on the Battlefield was knocked out. And in this way, taking the maximum level to which the health had increased as the base, Resurgence put this card in its new birth. Now see, by taking -1 damage with Resurgence, it first knocked out 2 cards of the enemy without attacking and then reappeared in front of the only remaining card of the enemy with massive health and 100% stats. In the battle that I would have lost under normal circumstances without this Archan, the winds have changed so much that now there seems to be no possibility of the enemy winning.

>Watch this battle now to fully enjoy every move of it because only then will you know the impact that happens when two amazing powers work in perfect synergy with each other.

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

# Markdown 簡介

Markdown 是一種輕量級的標記語言，旨在使文檔的格式化變得簡單易懂。它通常用於撰寫網頁內容、文檔和 README 文件等。

## 基本語法

### 標題

使用 `#` 符號來創建標題，`#` 的數量對應標題的層級：

```markdown
# 這是 H1 標題
## 這是 H2 標題
### 這是 H3 標題
```

### 粗體和斜體

- 粗體：使用 `**` 或 `__` 包裹文本
- 斜體：使用 `*` 或 `_` 包裹文本

```markdown
**這是粗體文本**
*這是斜體文本*
```

### 列表

無序列表使用 `*`、`-` 或 `+` 開頭：

```markdown
- 項目一
- 項目二
  - 子項目
```

有序列表使用數字加點：

```markdown
1. 第一項
2. 第二項
   1. 子項
```

### 連結和圖片

連結的語法為 `[顯示文字](網址)`，圖片則在前面加上 `!`：

```markdown
[訪問 Google](https://www.google.com)

![圖片描述](https://example.com/image.jpg)
```

### 程式碼

行內程式碼使用反引號 `` ` `` 包裹，區塊程式碼使用三個反引號：

```markdown
這是 `行內程式碼`

```
這是區塊程式碼
```
```

## 結論

Markdown 是一種方便的工具，適合用於快速編寫格式化文檔。透過簡單的語法，使用者可以輕鬆創建結構化的內容。
```

title.title: Roblox da colorare: creatività e divertimento per giovani artisti
title.body:
Roblox è una piattaforma di gioco incredibilmente popolare tra bambini e ragazzi, che permette di esplorare mondi virtuali, creare giochi personalizzati e vivere avventure insieme ad amici. Oltre all’esperienza digitale, molti giovani amanti di Roblox cercano modi alternativi per avvicinarsi ai loro personaggi e ambientazioni preferiti — e una delle attività più divertenti è sicuramente la colorazione.

Colorare immagini ispirate a Roblox permette ai bambini di interpretare i personaggi e gli scenari secondo la propria fantasia. Grazie allo stile grafico semplice e riconoscibile dei blocchi e degli avatar, i disegni da colorare offrono un ottimo punto di partenza per sperimentare con i colori, inventare storie e dare vita a nuove idee artistiche.

Se cerchi una raccolta di disegni pronta da stampare, puoi esplorare la sezione dedicata a [Roblox da colorare](https://paginacolorare.com/roblox/). Qui troverai varie immagini che rappresentano personaggi, oggetti e scene ispirate alla piattaforma di gioco. I disegni sono perfetti per attività creative a casa, come laboratorio artistico o momento di relax lontano dagli schermi digitali.

Colorare offre anche un valore educativo: migliorare la coordinazione, concentrarsi su un compito e scegliere combinazioni di colori sono abilità che si trasferiscono facilmente in altre attività. Per molti bambini, trasformare un foglio bianco in una scena di Roblox colorata è anche un modo per raccontare le proprie avventure o creare nuove narrative legate al mondo del gioco.

Questa attività è adatta a tutte le età e può essere condivisa in famiglia o con gli amici, creando un momento di creatività collettiva. Inoltre, i disegni completati possono essere appesi alle pareti, regalati o usati come biglietti personalizzati, aggiungendo un tocco personale a ogni progetto artistico.

Per trovare tante immagini dedicate a Roblox da stampare e colorare, visita la sezione Roblox da colorare: troverai disegni gratuiti e organizzati per aiutarti a portare l’universo digitale su carta… con un arcobaleno di colori!

I dinosauri sono creature che affascinano grandi e piccoli da decenni. Questi giganti della preistoria, comparsi milioni di anni fa sulla Terra, continuano a ispirare curiosità, libri, film e giochi educativi. Per molti bambini, i dinosauri rappresentano un mondo misterioso e stimolante, ideale per attività creative come la colorazione.

Colorare immagini di dinosauri è un’attività perfetta per stimolare la fantasia e l’apprendimento. Attraverso i colori, i bambini possono immaginare se T-rex fosse verde brillante, se lo pterodattilo fosse azzurro e come potevano apparire gli scenari della preistoria. L’attività aiuta anche a sviluppare la coordinazione mano-occhio, la concentrazione e la capacità di esprimere idee artistiche.

Se vuoi trovare materiale pronto da stampare, esiste una raccolta dedicata ai [Dinosauri da colorare](https://paginacolorare.com/dinosauri/) che offre molte illustrazioni diverse: dinosauri feroci, erbivori gentili, uova di dinosauro e paesaggi preistorici. I disegni sono ideali per attività scolastiche, laboratori creativi o semplicemente per trascorrere un pomeriggio divertente con i bambini.

Queste immagini possono essere usate come spunto per raccontare storie, parlare di scienza e stimolare la curiosità sui periodi come il Triassico, il Giurassico e il Cretaceo. Molti insegnanti utilizzano disegni da colorare in abbinamento alle lezioni per rendere l’apprendimento ancora più coinvolgente e personale.

Se sei alla ricerca di una risorsa semplice e gratuita per attività artistiche, puoi visitare la sezione dedicata ai dinosauri da colorare, dove troverai tantissime immagini pronte per essere stampate e colorate. Con un po’ di colori e tanta fantasia, ogni foglio può trasformarsi in una finestra aperta su un mondo antico e pieno di avventure.

title.title: R555 Green V7, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body:
![1771602904369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23vrnbK1zBz6ARmS8ph4Put7Q3mnUfuAcebHjK1nT2BRg36mf9kAwpUcGHcYN2AxRvdhq.jpg)


Blessings, everyone! Today I'll show you my most recent drawing, created from one of the elegant cards in the game. It's of the R555 Green V7. I'm struck by the number 5 on it, lol. This electric guitar is quite different from the others we've seen in various drawings, like yesterday's drawing of another electric guitar I did. I say it's different because of its shape—it's V-shaped. They're not something you see every day; in fact, I'd say they're quite rare in today's music.

It was more common back then, especially when it was created a long time ago. You know, the '60s-'90s. This guitar had its heyday back then, not referring to the exact model in the game, but to V-shaped guitars in general. Guitarists really liked them in those years because they were futuristic, and bands that used them were seen as being on a higher level. That's why almost everyone wanted one, and they were super common to see.

Today, some still see it as a futuristic guitar, and it's still used, though less frequently. Others like it for its comfort, because its V-shape makes it easier to flex the arm to play the lower strings. Before we continue, I'll show you an example of a song played on this type of guitar so you can see what they look like and how they sound. Then we'll move on to the drawing.

https://youtube.com/shorts/YNmCqYGJVWk?si=6-RKNPEYTNJ_Tluf

Now that you've seen the video of the guitar, let's get to the drawing. This guitar has some lovely green colors that I added both to the background, since it's the predominant color, and to the guitar itself. I started the drawing by creating the inner frame of the guitar. It turned out like this.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZT9ykVFygft28CPL7yZhza9TL3BQkTy1bHruacDSNYju5gBVsne5RsyMKZ.jpg) After creating the frame, I drew the guitar's neck and then its V-shaped body. I did both in Adobe Illustrator. See how they turned out. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxZSAgPVVap5KCQ85n2RRaWbKr9NhdFYLgdBbaDA8iJPTp42nCnrB8D7pLmbk.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWhq8meW6CssTi4V8fXp28kvUuHcQVRg3FjC59WXeeUuP1DYpTSEgUwyd3Lm6.jpg) In the next step, I added the tuning pegs, which in this case are six. And with that, the sketch was ready for the next step. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1QoiHGhHSYk3TnRQG36XkSqXr1xmuHBLbhq6ATcUWP59vusKF15mZmXg.jpg) What comes next is the painting. As you can see, this is how I painted everything. I started with the background, then the frame, the interior background, and finally the guitar. See how I applied each color in the following screenshots. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoEtqgCZsKdq9Sh4b7C2RyUxQFb5CfvUGMVsRTkEemt9CLaPStRWLjr315T9BsP4fZ3.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Ep3XA43mXMzqR1XepfQtkd5XqPmUuTCYEs8XULJQTfPBTs7NmbpgCQBfv3b8YMTEKhr.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpJPxrXz4yeWjBKtxUjFz6CHbeAiuHJQtSbEPHZpmdEqBtLoDzhG81k2KF4SfEvg5B9.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpLWv5GwxaAmvbjuaDawaUJkFzzRBa1Bn7S4CGtB2snyFozBjyBqTbsqgCg3cUXV91r.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpLXJFBebf3Q1aaTuP77TmSK6v32NTm2dVwKG7rh85xfoyNQrSzXAKyBWB6DdckwwW7.jpg) And to finish, here's the final result. See you in the next drawing. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23xUciBawZvegdreuimniiY9LMikNAaqEMSG4fiycV15fVyN2w8szThhCBCEi1Y7cLx5Q.jpg)

title.title: sweet and spicy crispy tofu
title.body:
> ![1000567644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x1DgQvqWYqDXWvH6U8tvUarn7ku68anSivA3axC33WXVXF2FyT9zv9uphLXKNWQ5xUS.jpg) *** *** *** Tofu is a very good food for our body, the price is also very cheap in our place, tofu itself is also very popular and can also be processed into various kinds of favorite foods, both snacks and also as good as side dishes at home, today I will make a dish from this white tofu, the white tofu that is very popular in Indonesia, various delicious foods that can be produced from it ![1000567650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xVPksVfMVUKMy8vtJD72gjdBKXoMkzuTZ8offZp3hep6hyK2XetDZ782Wb19TUBemny.jpg) as a snack or as a side dish, both are very delicious, you can make it yourself at home, based on the recipe that I will give later, as usual, I got this super spicy sweet crispy tofu recipe from my mother, my mother often makes it herself at home but this is the first time I tried making it, but the process of making it is quite easy, anyone can make it ![1000567651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyQQZ2XCj5Vn2XLXo78Hxts5AXDrbKJx66ZRzLoBA2NUnXdbukrcLGfL7uKtRL845A.jpg) Tofu that is fried as usual, then seasoned with selected spices and coated with all-purpose flour so that it tastes crispy, crunchy, savory and delicious. I'm curious about how I make this snack. Well, just follow the steps that I will share in my post today. *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000565539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMYfBZzseQUuyfKjDokmVPLrsd8WxWCtFU91KpMUqviuumgcP6Jq9CZfiTereEkovd6.jpg) ***
2 blocks of tofu 1 packet of all-purpose flour 4 red chilies 2 shallots 2 cloves of garlic 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp granulated sugar 1/2 tsp mushroom stock
*** ###
Manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First I cut the tofu into small squares then I prepared the oil for frying it. |![1000565542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xyZ14gWhJxt8og79NhwQZoAYVQqqEWRcShVLazvyfdonnhEkTPowMWwtgScwxyZ7CXj.jpg)|![1000565544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyP5uKJwFwL7crZoJKAGHNGuFSKLko71R6w3oNTdrs4xJzpC7F7cLpj3rARBwE5nAc.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eonk4wD1pXnmu9H87kh2Q1yy7g4r546sCZzaEp8UdetJn48xKJsb74nRaCqmGq61Jk2.jpg)|![1000565545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23uQtf5yKbjJ8rkeAgwi8ewQBYDEdpsvBHssTk5VtC2EuV4unNbLRD5fPHfoXJwfpQM5q.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** Next, I poured all-purpose flour into the wet tofu and then fried it until it was half dry. |![1000565547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeERR9adqLeg237UTbjVBrLoCtavNiZkbb8MZDHELAHVv8sQzMpvZwo4obKGcDvTqs.jpg)|![1000565548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23vsE4dHkvoenGj7gEEnWKGNxptb6zMWxfE2tRwCzPZDdWWgq2yifpTsCW7VYpzM1FTFW.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopsRPjUMW3Qf86bBKwXjcskZxGUPVBof9N1RR39wL71U5QXz8ra3xz2nFkZRYnDkAH.jpg)|![1000565550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKvR35UdpQZGWuXvrWQC1SAqFcDd5ofqXUVUXQTP8roPpf6t6PzA7twN37pnRanTuNZ.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next, I also prepared wet flour to sprinkle again on top of the tofu. |![1000565552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeCVFhYBjAaCEYAGWnRZNKmP4Qurbg8yjZRstVCyCw7oLdvumoEWMPtK26cekzTE5x.jpg)|![1000565556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wCEHwUasPEaa4qvpMumfzHX1dJAYd3JJezGLgam91uEzLD8qCftviRMohDkx8vSbF1j.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK6ikybs6NHTYSgGsbjCKaUZHtVUnRNsGedoGt47L1v8JR7jYAFEMaQpLmmmQFJTf6.jpg)|![1000565560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiVHYC6pJ1xWV5PTB5aHtoC7baxE5SZPJ1UXpUa6GciEEL6KKZssbmJcKFQkWDtZGs.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Four**
*** then I sprinkled wet flour onto the tofu and fried it again until the tofu was dry,while I prepare the ground spices |![1000565561.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou7HHfJtSib7kSZmFkumYuTqzcP2MGqP3Vmrn6JfkHnQxUymym5sh5FbWLWeobDBeQ.jpg)|![1000565562.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eonj5i3SJMdknzAGieKgSWtJEXXDNC7TNJuieS2TJw7E4q5VgUf5buJp6fV5hHSPqeP.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565563.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc1DEFmYq2kjmpPjbZVo1Dq32oXy32ae7xokez9HHTkDiJEVPHu2es9qDV11G3y44A.jpg)|![1000565553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopuNLbSc6AMSBVCJtXNMyAjYFWu7Wc4oTZA11BUYpRnhKQWWNzQXxTbmtVXh9rC9wF.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Five**
*** I grind the ground spices until they are really smooth, then I sauté them in hot oil until they are really cooked and fragrant, don't forget to add the spices |![1000565555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowG6A9aHBGBXFpr3K49HFsKYJrRJoCSM1ZeiPdd3uZJ1qyQjParY7RHXqQRp8WkBcu.jpg)|![1000565569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpA1yB5x3sKGgbD3sPBujrqoM2vYnTfJpTombi8DtRDgeLoruX2hQdx7Gb33jsnujxk.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoprQs8PhbjVyuYeBemoJByUuSv7A4QDtJZrzQ7nLyz5ijx1faYCWMNV3XUvYbPiEr1.jpg)|![1000565568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowG79cBWodtUfPBbTmo3aSMhEuVG7ty3p4jTMw7F3DcDwZu4wuQ4DtR23ZSREHmMNe.jpg)|![1000565591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogMsEXe6ucn9h5t5oG5w6t7Lz46rpRaQNuvWVzV2QHnxKriSuCTUwkMhgVDrwHURaf.jpg) |-|-|-| ***
**six**
*** After the ground spices are cooked, I often stir the spices so that the oil doesn't get absorbed. Then I sprinkle it on top of the tofu. |![1000565592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eonj1noG7Jw8xAM8FXsBxg55AX5eZ1sLtWUciwGZpF1AUPJkpK3iFMe8HaT27WnR9nu.jpg)|![1000565593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eopsvg6CtyFnY2ewjJ8jMzAJC1KZpduxUefZ1rTCyGhKuVAfqJqqAPbLYDQ9R95qyGq.jpg) |-|-| |![1000565594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1WzfL68acvH1ycykv4bQY1bYThp9G55sCq8PhsFgkTk6hEYJjg7KrehrDifjGrbjJ.jpg)|![1000565595.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23xKxeGH2wszX1jWU9rBuzq5PkwhQxAaNu9tjW9VjUMF5NjwXccft2N4MxWGawkY7NGix.jpg) |-|-| *** *** ###
RESULTS
### *** ![1000567648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/242DSyjEgewqv1XnD9eazZ2G5mv9cQJPz1Yj9QacCYe2BemTYkqMStteUPJivgnsd7rvT.jpg) Here's the tofu, ready to enjoy with your family at home. Crispy tofu with a delicious aroma of spices makes this snack incredibly delicious. It's perfect served with rice or if you want to have a snack like that, it's also very delicious. |![1000567647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMgpWHGBN6qUyQ4Nhd4LT1iEkF13bXEyyAcm2kzQ484S63nj2iF2rriyAC2ZxhvrktJ.jpg)|![1000567646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMcLmHTyB8ANZwnD7FkwA7QBm4kCY8Y1HkMhsB5Lt6rvLHVtqiwJ5wVLZgP3ztfwSk1.jpg) |-|-| when enjoyed, it tastes very crunchy, creamy and very tasty, making us enjoy it very voraciously. I enjoy it as a snack while my mother enjoys it as a side dish to break the fast this afternoon, because the spicy, savory and sweet taste makes us very happy with this snack. ![1000567645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wqro9MsazrVD2PDKahEMKdm4Q5tjdcEr2tWxGo8oTe1PtE2SabntrQEdv2bYdsaMZDE.jpg) *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗
### *** *** ***

I am usually called Ryana, I come from Indonesia, my daily activities are working, cooking, taking care of the household, and also traveling, I really enjoy traveling with my husband and children. I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, and see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here we can make it happen</sub>

title.title: The Simplest Things
title.body:
You're not given options in prison. You are subject to whatever it is that is – you know, the circumstances you're in. And I find myself having a hard time making certain choices. 


<center>https://media.istockphoto.com/id/1263852434/photo/freshly-baked-bread-one-of-lifes-simplest-pleasures.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=osYQb-D5rVKD0LLD2C-xudUB1XFXrhzIdZiMcTSiKvQ=[Source](https://media.istockphoto.com/id/1263852434/photo/freshly-baked-bread-one-of-lifes-simplest-pleasures.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=osYQb-D5rVKD0LLD2C-xudUB1XFXrhzIdZiMcTSiKvQ=)</center>


Like, I mean, the simplest things – what are we going to have for lunch? And I'm defaulting to, like, whatever anyone else wants. I was like, oh, that sounds great. You know, like, I've lost the opinionated mindset of, oh, I want this or I want – no, it's really just – I'm defaulting because I've almost, in a weird way, forgotten how to make those choices.

And I'm speaking this as somebody who was in prison for 84 days. Now, imagine people who served prison for extended amounts of times. And I used to hear all those stories of people saying, you know, oh, it's hard to adjust. 

I believe them now. It is very difficult to adjust. It is very challenging to reintegrate yourself because of the conditions in which you're kept.

So mentally, I'm – you know, I was abruptly taken off Adderall. I've been taking Vyvanse for my ADD since I'm 15 years old. I'm 37. 

And I was – it was like a cold turkey, like, nope, you're done. And on that front, it's really bad. And then to replace the fact of me having Adderall, they substituted it with an antidepressant and an anti-anxiety pill, which then doesn't really help because they're creating other issues psychologically.

So I'm trying to get back with my mental health in order, you know, because I've always been very outspoken of my own journey in that case. And I just wanted to make sure that, you know, I can be in the right spot, right mindset. So it's an adjustment.

title.title: 正月初五 Po Wu 【中文/English】
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![BRJP9VVXATdOhESS_liketu.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/fayezhen/images/BRJP9VVXATdOhESS_liketu/BRJP9VVXATdOhESS_liketu.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

正月初五，俗称“破五”，清晨被一阵爆竹声惊醒，竟比除夕还要热闹几分。这份意外，藏着今年“鞭炮禁放令”的严格——往年远郊还会宽松些，今年却难寻半串鞭炮的踪影。这密集响亮的声响，哪里是爆竹，分明是每个人心底藏不住的期许，在迎财神的日子里，盼着新一年能顺顺利利、财源安稳。

年俗“破五”破的是旧年禁忌，更是过往的不顺，过了这一天，生活归位，人心也跟着舒展。而最让人期盼的，便是迎财神、送穷神，扫去一身晦气。北方人家的初五，离不开一碗热气腾腾的饺子。形似元宝的饺子，剁馅时的叮咚声是“捏小人嘴”的祈愿。儿时记忆中，这一天露天集市上摊贩陆续增多，爆竹一响，便是新一年生意的开端；街头巷尾的庄稼人也凑在一起，念叨着开春的庄稼，盘算着种子化肥，那时就隐隐知道，彻底的休憩结束了，新一年的奔头，从这天正式启程。

往年的初五，我也只是跟着凑热闹，看爆竹、吃饺子，从没想过，生意人燃放爆竹时，藏着多少对生计的期许、对顺利的渴求。这份懂得，来得猝不及防，全因今年第一次试着追题材——年前一时冲动买了两只春节档相关的股票，尽管持仓不多，却成了整个春节的牵挂，从节前就开始关注春节档预售票房数据，心里总在忐忑，既怕票房不及预期影响股价，又怕错过风口错失机会。这份纠结，唯有亲身经历过，才懂其中滋味。

On the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, called “Po Wu,” I was woken up early by the loud sound of firecrackers. It was even noisier than New Year’s Eve. This surprise also showed how strict the firecracker ban was this year. In past years, people in the suburbs could still set off some firecrackers, but this year it was almost impossible to find any. The loud sounds were not just firecrackers — they were people’s hopes. On the day of welcoming the God of Wealth, everyone wishes for a smooth year and stable income.
“Po Wu” means breaking old taboos and leaving bad luck behind. After this day, life returns to normal, and people feel more relaxed. The most important traditions are welcoming the God of Wealth, sending away the God of Poverty, and cleaning away bad luck. In northern China, families always eat hot dumplings on this day. Dumplings look like gold ingots, which symbolize wealth. The chopping sound when making dumpling filling also represents the wish to drive away bad luck.
In my childhood memories, more sellers would appear in the outdoor markets on this day. Once the firecrackers started, it meant business for the new year had begun. Farmers would gather together, talking about crops, seeds, and fertilizer. Even back then, I knew the holiday was truly over, and the new year’s hard work had officially begun.
In past years, I only joined the fun — watching firecrackers and eating dumplings. I never realized how much hope business owners placed on those firecrackers. This year, I finally understood. Before the holiday, I impulsively bought two stocks related to Spring Festival movies. Even though I didn’t invest much, I kept thinking about them throughout the holiday. I followed the presale box office numbers closely and felt nervous. I was afraid the box office would be lower than expected and hurt the stock price, but I was also afraid of missing a good opportunity. This mixed feeling is something you only truly understand after experiencing it yourself.

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@fayezhen/po-wu-english)

title.title: Evergreen video |  No One Like You 🎶
title.body:
/>

It has been 14 years since the video of **_No One Like You_** by PSquare was released. The video now appears blurry when viewed on our modern-day high-resolution devices, but that does not take away the beauty of both the song and the video. Till today, the views are still increasing, and comments filled with good memories are still dropping.

https://youtu.be/ty2advRiWJM?si=8EyIQC43yADEFvRE

Each time I come across the video, I always shower praises on the director of the music video. The video matches the song so perfectly that nothing more could have been done. It is one of those videos that, as you watch it, your mind travels far into space, either imagining how your love life will look, especially on your wedding day, or drifting back to reminisce on the good old days spent with a lover. I must say, this song and the video can make someone shed tears, maybe tears of joy… I do not know.

I will not lie; each time I watch this video, I always imagine myself on my wedding day, possibly with the one I am dedicating this song to. The imagination is always worth imagining. Lol.

Non-Nigerians or Africans may not really understand the weight of this song or the video. Way back in 2012 and beyond, this was a big song used at wedding events, and anytime it came on, it captured the entire environment and got everyone singing and dancing to the cool dancing vibes portrayed in the video.

The song was done by PSquare, twins who are now defunct. These guys gave us evergreen songs when they were still together, and their videos, lyrics, and overall creativity matched so well. This video was done effortlessly, and the other extras who joined in the groove did excellently well. Gosh! I wish we could have this time back.

The song is all about love, unlike many trendy songs these days that talk more about nudity. This one speaks about love emotionally, the beauty of a woman, and above all, the video is clean with no nakedness. It is so decent!

This is my response to the theme of this month prompted by @advesing, and I am dedicating it to one of my troublesome friends, @jeclyn60

Great article and thanks for sharing your views. (For those who don't know the **[Joey](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sZqbSNRa8Fk)** mentioned in the previous post, isn't a baby kangaroo). Regarding the BBC's decline, there are a lot of factors at play here, some involving some conspiracy facts and theories. Whether mainstream media is a ***[propaganda or 'programming' machine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Propaganda_model)*** almost becomes irrelevant when we consider the fact that we now have much more choice, because of the availability of things we actually want to watch. When TV channels have consistently displayed their bias towards certain topics or individuals, eventually people see that bias, and if it doesn't align with their own personal views, they will look elsewhere. Additionally, channels such as 3Speak and YouTube offer a more personal interaction where you can often communicate directly and instantaneously (live chats) with the person or team live 'on air'. Having said that channels such as the BBC have modernised their content delivery mechanismsand I guess eventually that will lead to more views and viewers.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5oCpCee7Dd1pey7DUQ439FiPATGU3M91ASF8bYyLSGf/image.png) Image from [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=bbc)

title.title: The Reason Behind Crop Production During The Dry Season And The Raining Season For Individual Farmers. Pepper Production 🫑🫑🌶️🌶️ Climbs Better Performance At The Moment.
title.body:
![Screenshot_20260220-115133.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23vsUdgaTsZgC1nCs6Qs4X31SuLFHan9uVwBiX5FiZzQ5GpbNPqSeosbyxW2jSKViWZ1V.png)








Hello Hivers 💕💘,






---
---
---








Agricultural mindset they ability to always follow the procedures is highly a mandatory because no matter how active you are at the farmer you must always have what is called a proactive mindset. This is also achievable true so many factors as well as through a lot of active work on the farm. That is why agriculture is always a constant routine for everyone who has the good activeness to produce food and also to produce animals. It goes in line with each other for crop production and animal production. 

There is no how you will impute any type of farming routine to your crop production that will not be applicable the same method to animal production as well. Take for instance when you are into crop production and your visiting to the farm is constant and regular. Which also show more of crop differences where it will come in between the leaves differences, as well as the plant differences. This is when you attend a lot of knowledge when it comes to production of crops. This knowledge as well will also bring you to more constant check up of animals at regular interval so that you will absolutely know when there are differences to come in production of animals or in time of breeding. So this knowledge work hand in hand together. and that is why agriculture is always a safe place to bring out your knowledge and also to relate more better with different people's mindset. 

When the production is more then you have a larger responsibilities to take as long as you want better production and more. Seeing more of pepper farming, the needful must be done which is the constant check and regular cultivation of unwanted plants. Not just the pepper Farm alone but all farm must be kept clean always so that even when there are differences in your crop production it will be easily seen even from distance. So I took some pictures of what we have to get done on the farm as work progresses gradually.  



* That is why planting of crops should be done always, so that it will help to improve a lot of knowledge slowly and gradually. So many people believe in just a minute farming. Whereby all what you plant will grow in a particular day and also reach its full maturity state just a day. It is never done that way. I have met a lot of questions on discord channel and it was addressed with full explanations even with pictures. 

![Screenshot_20260220-115345.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xVPmo1LbtHzL3vEdVPGUC6UtoVUoTP6p1xvahDxvkeW8U5a9rdWYibtkUcrd12qQXff.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115144.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EouBZXFDyiijpZCh61frecKv9y2b2DHL1PdYcWbsxXDGdpKCS5tUA4TLhQGyWXfj7VP.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115123.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Ep3fGSshgJWpfA6sUnTkzM4HDASpPV5ArYhJEcRfNG2zV6FGXcUiu883kJAdiCjHgMa.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115458.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23u6BHFaX8YnQC8ZxVXBSHbwWshVbDhAXdk65gZ8mVmxrktEXpLyeVVsUozpTEfyh1uVH.png)


The visitation was done late in the evening and I was also privileged to capture some areas on the farm which also showed a little bit more of pepper cultivation likewise with other crops. The more reason why I prefer to use this method of planting and cultivation mixed cropping system. It will give you as a farmer the constant privilege to secure other crops even with a small range of agricultural Farmland with confidence. 


![Screenshot_20260220-115407.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xVRPMEQxHELEbL9SG86GsiFGpcfipS1D8BfFXiWQn59jycrq6YGWAYhZdrFW6HfAVMt.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115539.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoiXcChBJmgL1dfhh6g58dqGR9hKaVXdtaSExxaS9qGXpHvL21ZxSFwvwTXwLaBkZvi.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115357.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EogQHp1mfwRPnqwEy1tc2FwkPd11mw9GCLCu5pHyDu7uMYArrtkU8bZsvyCqRze94pb.png)


The kind of Farm cleaning that is being practiced during the rain season is much more different from the kind of weed remover that is been practiced during the dry season. The reason being that even when you try as much as possible to uproot weed during the rainy season it will always grow back within two weeks Max. But during the dry season even when you have the privilege to uproot so many unwanted plants it can be used as mulching. Which will also guide the cultivated crop for so many weeks from excessive sunlight. 



![Screenshot_20260220-115255.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23uFcJVL3ZaXcRv1hf2UooY4RajuqR1KTB6q75AUBdpcgMirVqcbD9FFuZHzBuMtSPmhN.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115045.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23tvigoHCtpc1vNNb7Vo9QW5Lt3BZrehz2NA8HsTXaY587gdvUWSUraBnKujWf2LtGpYQ.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115222.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23vsYuzLwpU4B3SADDGre5WLSRZMXonFPQfq7to5Ja5roRdpTVfZrZUFtWa2o1UGGQcu9.png)


Where you also used your tools to uproot the unwanted plants will also stay even more than 4 weeks before it starts to sprout out new weed. That is the differences between farming during the rainy season and also farming during the dry season. There are a lot of differences. 



![Screenshot_20260220-115418.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EogQj7h1JS9AHqQFhZdR7mxGLsWLv9g91JQeNZSWXH27aj598gRoepxkgnahuGzczST.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115200.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23wX5MevmBRbKntN9JsUK9vrTo1jdaQVPFFa6AQ9ukP4D6ZuEAaTRQfG9agfWo6fnZcZz.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115244.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23wMgpwAcfvkLhaGwbkRWN9ueJHt7aUbAuxyAHHNyfvBhGxKnPTqE4rb3NSUf2NMwuEoy.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115057.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23x1B3AsEn9SdC4rE8zaK3aGVYZVKegYxcpn3SsRjbYjVD9oTp4fFm8RgGvFsVmfrMFrp.png)


Sometimes we as individual farmers we also need to use our intellectual ability. Take for instance, intentionally we left the unwanted plants to grow alongside with the cultivated crops. Why? the reason being that, it's also reduces the amount of it that goes into the soil. When there is a lot of heat supply into the soil it will reduce a lot of production slowly. But when you leave some amount of unwanted plants with the cultivated crops it will serve as a guide and protection as long as you want it to stay. 


![Screenshot_20260220-115515.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23wX5aG69VKTkhFx8A4HKv8QuRJ3zmjDNLSKLRqSJtQatAVtweFb2cXuB8dwBFNgv2APA.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115318.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EoGzLfrCU9ACuG5NjVGKdm7PYSHV1n535b3nKrCbyXWMDdnpavhPpafEsiZmUQ8yP9i.png)

![Screenshot_20260220-115029.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xen3sWkkdmDHMx2NRCsPFDNGFYknfNX4Mm1zNASj7Fwg1mjWXdoeUi6QnwpXpQEKNoP.png)

You can see that there are water hose pipes all over the farm. This equally means that there are more operational and continuity work going on on the farm. So twice in a day we always apply water to support the crops growing. So sometimes as well it is been administered just once. So that they water can reach all sections of the farm. Agriculture is not for lazy fellow. You think twice, you work twice.

![q7YMogWUPEiFpq7C_1000534117.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/auleo/images/q7YMogWUPEiFpq7C_1000534117/q7YMogWUPEiFpq7C_1000534117.webp)

跟大家分享一下新年期间，在马来西亚外食的情况。

大多数华人摊贩当然就休业了，一部分没休或提早开业的，总会自行加价，幅度总是吓人。而且还大排长龙。

当然有些人就不计较，他们是中华胃，非吃中餐不可；而我对于这样的涨幅觉得不可接受，所以通常新年期间我们都选马来、印度或西餐，回避莫名其妙的砍菜头。

不过今年初三就碰上了穆斯林的斋戒月，日间他们不可进食或饮水，所以很多马来穆斯林开的餐馆就选择日间闭馆-午餐就有点难度，但也有些餐馆是马来、华人市场通吃的，他们就会继续经营。

所以就互惠互利-餐馆缺了食客，而我们缺没有新年溢价的食物，一拍即合。

晚餐则完全没问题了，开斋夜市全都是美食，任君选择。
```
