title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  The Mystery of Edwin Drood #12/166
title.body: Is she stupid in everything?”
>After a pause, in which the whimsically wicked face has not been unobservant of him, Rosa says:
>“And this most sensible of creatures likes the idea of being carried off to Egypt; does she, Eddy?”
>“Yes. She takes a sensible interest in triumphs of engineering skill: especially when they are to change the whole condition of an undeveloped country.”
>“Lor!” says Rosa, shrugging her shoulders, with a little laugh of wonder.
>“Do you object,” Edwin inquires, with a majestic turn of his eyes downward upon the fairy figure: “do you object, Rosa, to her feeling that interest?”
>“Object? My dear Eddy! But really. Doesn’t she hate boilers and things?”
>“I can answer for her not being so idiotic as to hate Boilers,” he returns with angry emphasis; “though I cannot answer for her views about Things; really not understanding what Things are meant.”
>“But don’t she hate Arabs, and Turks, and Fellahs, and people?”
>“At least, she musthate the Pyramids? Come, Eddy?”
>“Why should she be such a little—tall, I mean—Goose, as to hate the Pyramids, Rosa?”

>“Ah! you should hear Miss Twinkleton,” often nodding her head, and much enjoying the Lumps, “bore about them, and then you wouldn’t ask. Tiresome old burying-grounds! Isises, and Ibises, and Cheopses, and Pharaohses; who cares about them? And then there was Belzoni or somebody, dragged out by the legs, half choked with bats and dust. All the girls say serve him right, and hope it hurt him, and wish he had been quite choked.”
>The two youthful figures, side by side, but not now arm-in-arm, wander discontentedly about the old Close; and each sometimes stops and slowly imprints a deeper footstep in the fallen leaves.
>“Well!” says Edwin, after a lengthy silence. “According to custom. We can’t get on, Rosa.”
>Rosa tosses her head, and says she don’t want to get on.
>“That’s a pretty sentiment, Rosa, considering.”
>“If I say what, you’ll go wrong again.”
>“You’ll go wrong, you mean, Eddy. Don’t be ungenerous.”
>“Then I don’tlike that, and so I tell you plainly,” Rosa pouts.
>“Now, Rosa, I put it to you. Who disparaged my profession, my destination—”

>“You are not going to be buried in the Pyramids, I hope?” she interrupts, arching her delicate eyebrows. “You never said you were. If you are, why haven’t you mentioned it to me? I can’t find out your plans by instinct.”
>“Now, Rosa; you know very well what I mean, my dear.”
>“Well then, why did you begin with your detestable red-nosed Giantesses? And she would, she would, she would, she would, she W<span class=\
>OULDpowder it!” cries Rosa, in a little burst of comical contradictory spleen.
>“Somehow or other, I never can come right in these discussions,” says Edwin, sighing and becoming resigned.
>“How is it possible, sir, that you ever can come right when you’re always wrong? And as to Belzoni, I suppose he’s dead;—I’m sure I hope he is—and how can his legs, or his chokes concern you?”
>“It is nearly time for your return, Rosa. We have not had a very happy walk, have we?”
>“A happy walk? A detestably unhappy walk, sir. If I go up stairs the moment I get in and cry till I can’t take my dancing-lesson, you are responsible, mind!”

>“Ah!” cries Rosa, shaking her head and bursting into real tears. “I wish we couldbe friends! It’s because we can’t be friends, that we try one another so. I am a young little thing, Eddy, to have an old heartache; but I really, really have, sometimes. Don’t be angry. I know you have one yourself, too often. We should both of us have done better, if What is to be had been left, What might have been. I am quite a serious little thing now, and not teasing you. Let each of us forbear, this one time, on our own account, and on the other’s!”

>Disarmed by this glimpse of a woman’s nature in the spoilt child, though for an instant disposed to resent it as seeming to involve the enforced infliction of himself upon her, Edwin Drood stands watching her as she childishly cries and sobs, with both hands to the handkerchief at her eyes, and then—she becoming more composed, and indeed beginning in her young inconstancy to laugh at herself for having been so moved—leads her to a seat hard by, under the elm trees.

>“One clear word of understanding, Pussy dear. I am not clever out of my own line—now I come to think of it I don’t know that I am particularly clever in it—but I want to do right. There is not—there may be—I really don’t see my way to what I want to say, but I must say it before we part—there is not any other young—?”
>“Oh no, Eddy! It’s generous of you to ask me; but no, no, no!”

>They have come very near to the Cathedral windows, and at this moment the organ and the choir sound out sublimely. As they sit listening to the solemn swell, the confidence of last night rises in young Edwin Drood’s mind, and he thinks how unlike this music is, to that discordance.
>“I fancy I can distinguish Jack’s voice,” is his remark in a low tone in connexion with the train of thought.

>“Take me back at once, please,” urges his Affianced, quickly laying her light hand upon his wrist. “They will all be coming out directly; let us get away. Oh, what a resounding chord! But don’t let us stop to listen to it; let us get away!”

>Her hurry is over, as soon as they have passed out of the Close. They go, arm-in-arm now, gravely and deliberately enough, along the old High Street, to the Nuns’ House. At the gate, the street being within sight empty, Edwin bends down his face to Rosebud’s.
>She remonstrates, laughing, and is a childish schoolgirl again.
>“Eddy, no! I’m too stickey to be kissed. But give me your hand, and I’ll blow a kiss into that.”
>He does so. She breathes a light breath into it, and asks, retaining it and looking into it:
>“Now say, what do you see?”
>“Why, I thought you Egyptian boys could look into a hand and see all sorts of phantoms? Can’t you see a happy Future?”
>For certain, neither of them sees a happy Present, as the gate opens and closes, and one goes in and the other goes away.

正月初四给舅舅、姨妈们拜完年，我们四姐妹就带着孩子们一起去了万象城，就在南昌摩天轮旁边。

其实在姨妈家都没怎么吃饱，人实在太多，整整开了五桌，特别挤。加上最近大鱼大肉吃多了，酒店里全是荤菜，还没家里炒的好吃，我们就随便吃了两口，到了商场孩子们都喊饿，商场除了饭店只剩肯德基了，给她们安排肯德基填饱肚子后，我们又转场去坐摩天轮。

一到现场才发现，排队的人真的超级多，不过也挺快，排了不到一个小时就轮到我们了。
 
摩天轮票价：不满一米二免费，一米二到一米四半价25元，成人和一米四以上都是50元一张。坐一圈25分钟左右。

我就让大姐带着外甥、我两个女儿还有外甥女上去坐了，我自己以前坐过，对摩天轮也没太大兴趣。白天也能望得很远很高，毕竟这可是亚洲第二高的摩天轮，晚上夜景更好看。
 
旁边就是赣江，夏天这里是免费玩水游泳的好地方，冬天沙滩上全是玩沙的人，摆摊的也特别多，卖挖沙工具、套圈圈的都有。

三个孩子吵着要工具，一下子花了30块。我们还开玩笑说，下次直接在拼多多批发点来这摆摊，又能玩又能挣钱，多好啊。
 
这边旅游的人也是真多，人山人海，年味十足。

我们就在旁边吃点小吃，吹吹江边的风，假装在海边度假～
现在南昌也被叫做“芝加昌”，虽然跟维多利亚港不能比，但在我们心里也超美。
 
不过天气好，风景也属实不错，孩子们玩得特别开心，总算不用窝在家里看电子产品了！

摩天轮最佳打卡机位一站，再配上那个独有的BGM，这一趟“芝加昌”就算没白来！排队的人好多我就不凑热闹了，随便一拍都很好看呀！
 
走进商场大厅，门口立着一个特别大的塑像，是BKT杨幂代言的护腰椅。最近这个护腰椅特别火，我们也上去试坐了一下，确实蛮舒服的。
 
来玩的人实在太多，车子停地下车库，找车位都找了半天。好不容易才找到一个靠边的位置，二姐也停靠边，三姐直接停在路面上。
还好现在大点的商场地下车库都有找车位导航，还是挺便捷的。

三姐最先找到车，先回家做饭了。看看我姐的手艺，桌上这几个菜是真合胃口。

---

title.title: Chasing perfect will drain you. Chasing progress will grow you
title.body:
![swastikarora-india-7069656_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAEQtco2GTaHWSvpGtcosFBccVjm67Yx3oVSYWcyWV8N/swastikarora-india-7069656_1920.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/india-women-work-working-village-7069656/)
Perfection is a desired state for anyone, but is it a necessity From my own personal behavior I feel sometimes I waste too much energy on being perfect, which may not be necessary. A little flaw here and there is ok. Social media keeps bombarding us with images of perfection and these days you do not even know what is AI generated and what is real and when we look at it, it makes us feel like we are not good enough. When we see perfect images on social media it makes us feel inferior. A person on social media with a perfect figure, a perfect house, sometimes their families may also look perfect to us. But behind the scenes what's happening we never know. Last month while I was in India, at a social gathering I met one lady, she has been into extreme fitness regime since the last 2 years and her body looks perfect, and at that time I had a little belly coming out. She passed a comment on me saying, oh look you are having a bloated belly. At first I felt very bad and felt very conscious also. It's not that I am not in to fitness, but right now I am going through my menopause phase and no matter how much ever I am trying little belly is still there.
![vM1pGHgNcyCXUWJECrZbvn1NMPj1oFGUo3gYfF3NNPRD9Zsxuw8Zu5zRL2wfuXNtzFrkgw9p48tyB6QvqGtHZ4hLVCR9PQVB5xzyLxkiScn3ss11wmW1fxbyM9pL41TspbhN5vE.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmenkCBE71iXZvjzoUHqSdp3D4xxMoqWxBaTgJvmMta84s/vM1pGHgNcyCXUWJECrZbvn1NMPj1oFGUo3gYfF3NNPRD9Zsxuw8Zu5zRL2wfuXNtzFrkgw9p48tyB6QvqGtHZ4hLVCR9PQVB5xzyLxkiScn3ss11wmW1fxbyM9pL41TspbhN5vE.jpeg)
For few days I kept worrying about it, but then I thought. Why am I getting so paranoid about it. That girl is in her 30s and I am in my 50s we both have different environments and conditions. In my 30s I was also that way, so it's ok for me to accept my current environment and myself in whatever I am. I am not unhealthy, nor am I overweight, so why am I stressing out myself so much. This was just on one front of life. As such there are so many other things in life where perfection is not important. Perfection can also be boring sometimes. As humans we are vulnerable and have our own weaknesses. We learn and grow. No one knows everything from birth, we keep pushing ourselves to keep opening to new experiences and learning and learning never stops. The moment we start believing that we are perfect then possibly the learning will also stop. In work or in self or in general life, the most successful people have also failed but they did not let their imperfection define them. Their failure was used as a stepping stone to grow, learn and become who they are. So it's ok to be out of shape, messy, and a little quirky. Most important is to be yourself. With all of that again it is not like perfection is never required. There are somethings in which perfection is important and one must not let that pass.

title.title: Visited Wat Tha Ton in Chiang Mai, Thailand with my family.
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdX2CnAb1KHYKcWsuA6GZ5BMVP1VhzeYByZ2NMSBrks2e/1771662125203.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. My wife's mother rarely gets to travel. But it was a trip several months ago, Me and my wife took her mother to a temple in Mae Ai district. Besides my wife's mother, we also took our granddaughter to the temple on this trip. This temple is called Wat Tha Ton. A large and famous temple with many beautiful architectural and sculptures. This temple is not only a place for religious ceremonies but also a popular tourist attraction, especially local people. Wat Tha Ton is located on a mountain. Wat Tha Ton area on this mountain have 9 floor in total. But this time we only went to the 8th floor of the temple. The highlight of Wat Tha Ton is on the 8th floor. On the 8th floor of the temple is a large building used for religious ceremonies. And there is also a large pagoda and other sculptures. This pagoda is called the Chedi Kaew.

The atmosphere on the 8th floor of the temple and pagoda.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQRu32HLQeDd45trP1syZHzVeY5qxwfUhp2nfHr9VsTr/1771659973012.jpg)

The inside of this pagoda has 3 floors in total. This pagoda has many sculptures on each floor, both in Thai buddhist and Chinese buddhist styles. But on the 3th floor of the pagoda, there are relics of the Buddha.

title.title: Foundation pack opening.
title.body:
Just 15 foundation packs but I still need to max out the deck and at 6c each it's hard no to keep picking them up. 

The cards are going to keep going down in value as people are maxing them out so fast and get a chest every day but it's all the fun of a real opening session with none of the cost.

I'm just hoping for some gold or legendary cards to sell and buy a few more packs.

I'm sure that they will add some more cards to the set down the line but it's a very limited batch to start with. If we had more options it would be more fun to play especially a few low mana cards as it's hard to maximize your lineup when all of the cards are 5 mana plus.

## Pack results.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYtsWjb9ezBfKYTJkvpdJu2mnQoHoZ9uFkk5N7KJkAJmg/image.png

I need all of the summoners as mine are still on level 3. I know that I could just buy the extra cards but that's just not as much fun as opening packs.

Now to sort out what I need, what's extra and what I can sell to go again.

I might even pick up a few of the new escalation packs while I'm at it since they would be even more fun to start opening. I can see that card values are dropping fast since the last time that i tried to sell some so the market is getting fairly saturated. Should be easy to pick up those last few cards soon enough.

title.title: Stop the thief =/= Haltet den Dieb - Berlin Impressions   🇩🇪🍻🥨  ENG-GER
title.body: ![IMG_8298-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeVdM9rYuK9GPUcVQQADsvNvTto9g6EH8EWSAgbSN2nJW/IMG_8298-1.jpg) Some claim that you should always have a cucumber in your pocket. Others swear by chickens. To each its own, although an (almost) empty pants pocket also has its advantages. At least you can't lose anything, especially if the holes in your pocket get bigger and bigger. The pants may also be a jacket, in which on each side comfortably fits a chicken. At least in earlier times, this made the work of some citizens quite easier, at least it was convenient for the easy retrieval of the captured booty. And the holes probably were only big enough for an egg to slip out. If one could now still avoid that the fresh loot drew too much attention with some weird screaming, one could perhaps manage to sneak away undetected. And if not, it was not the chicken whose neck was turned, but the vicious sneaker, which had actually only fought for his own survival. But as the times were in the past, maybe they will be again some day. What connects everyone and everything is the wisdom to immediately point at someone else when caught and then to shout: \

This has worked more than once and seems to work again and again. But fortunately, there is no guarantee for that either... ![IMG_8298.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSXddq3ezSXgfuJah45WWw1eFGMfDrg9mSRywcDdjM3NT/IMG_8298.JPG) DEUTSCH Manche behaupten, dass man immer eine Gurke in der Hosentasche haben sollte. Anderen schwören dagegen auf Hühner. Jeder wie es ihm behagt, wobei eine (fast) leere Hosentasche auch so ihre Vorteile hat. Zumindest kann man nichts verlieren, vor allem, wenn die Löcher in der Tasche wieder einmal größer werden. Nun mag die Hose auch mal eine Jacke sein, in welche auf jeder Seite bequem ein Huhn hineinpasst. Das hat zumindest in früheren Zeiten die Arbeit einiger Bürger ziemlich erleichtert, zumindest dem leichten Abtransport der errungenen Beute war es zuträglich. Und die Löcher mögen wahrscheinlich auch nur so groß gewesen sein, dass maximal ein Ei hinausrutschen konnte. Wenn man nun noch vermeiden konnte, dass die frische Beute mit all zu schrägen Geschrei auf sich aufmerksam machte, konnte man es vielleicht schaffen, sich unentdeckt von dannen zu schleichen. Und wenn nicht, wurde halt nicht den Hühnern der Hals umgedreht, sondern dem fiesen Schleicher, welcher doch eigentlich nur um sein eigenes Überleben gekämpft hatte. Aber so wie die Zeiten mal waren, sind sie vielleicht dereinst wieder. Was alle und alles eint ist die Weisheit, beim Ertapptwerden umgehend auf jemand anders zu zeigen und zu rufen: \
. Das hat schon mehr als einmals geklappt und scheint immer wieder zu funktionieren. Aber glücklicherweise gibt es auch darauf keine Garantie...\n

title.body:
Viscri a small village in the heart of Trnsylvania is today a Unesco World Heritage Site with breathtaking landscapes, history and tradition. The well-known colorfully painted houses of Viscri, the Saxon fortified church, the charming architectureand the handmade textiles and ceramics are on show in an exhibition. For many centuries, the Saxon fortified church, dating back to the 13th century, has been a meeting place where locals come together for celebrations, church and cultural events. Even today, it's still going well and the efforts to promote tourism are helping the village to keep growing and preserve its heritage. As some of you know, I love traveling to Romania, so I still have many unpublished photos in my archive. Here are a few from last summer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSuxs8gdw8dkwpyYtrfACnf3PGpwqGDM7xdibvJ4W9bi3/1771656004672.jpg)

В такий погожий день захотілося прогулятися до нашого місцевого озера. Тут все без змін, відколи два місяці тому воно вкрилось льодом. Численні сліди на снігу свідчать про кількість бажаючих походити по льоду.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKYzvZEXczBGkCA1LZLRTEwvrhdSFi1ki5TBFNqnyZPN/1771656005442.jpg)

Якщо весна принесе стабільне тепло, то вся ця сніжна маса почне швидко танути і вода може вийти з берегів озера, бо шлюзи розмерзнуться в останню чергу і спуск зайвої води буде неможливий. Єдине, що може врятувати від паводку, це поступове танення.

title.title: Chase Less, do More
title.body:
Hello friends, take a look at this.

Essentialism 

In the Modern world now people are faced with endless and bulk issues of life thereby throwing so many off balance as they try to pay attention to all vicissitude of life, prioritising every single one of these problems forgetting that carrying out plenty task within a limited time gives stress to the mind and giving an output that is not always pleasing to the eyes.

Essentialism the act of pursuit of less but earning bountifully. Learning to carry out small tasks and making sure it's being accomplished with greater result should be what everyone as individual should prioritise, it gives ease to work and reduces stress as you don't think of so many things your mind is focused on the one thing you are working on and with little time and little effort this task is brought to an end and never to be visited again simply because quality time and good work was invested into it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfjVYBi7ic3Z8WAYp57dV6bxJCYUwVvmCcVDbN48GUdM/1771661772863.png)

Image source *Ai Gemini*

Essentialist thinking gives you an edge over your life giving you full control and a more appropriate way to take on your day to day activities without having to go through much in order to fulfil a task.

Are you faced with so many choices? Essentialism teaches that only choices that align with what matters to them as individuals we all have got that which is more essential in our lives, the ability to make smart moves by deciding how best to tackle such a problem resides with us alone.

Activities would be carried out but then again you must learn and master those activities that furthers the goal and work more efficiently on them disregarding any activity that is a nuisance. Sometimes we fail to dictate because of too many activities carried out and we end up wasting much of our time with little or no result.

Success no longer comes from hard work in this new dispensation, as we categorise successful people from hard work with stories of how they get minimal sleep working even at night just to attain a height. 

Essentialism teaches good rest. A good and a healthy sleep schedule gives less time to work but then a quality and a powerful result will be produced within these short hours of work. While others think an extra hour of sleep leads to an extra loss of work hours, an essentialist sees an extra hour of sleep as more energy gathered to achieve more profitable hours of work.

The key is to start small, encourage progress and celebrate small wins . With this growth is assured and little wins sum up to become big ones.

Pay close attention to what is essential.

Przekładane bez mała z pięć razy, od października. Myślałam, że idziemy na grypę 2 i ospę 1, ale okazało się, że do drugiego roku życia trzeba podać pentaxim, a tu czasu niewiele. Stanęło więc na pentaxim i ospie, grypa może kiedyś. Za to ogarnięcie tego szczepienia też było fascynującym doświadczeniem, bo po przebadaniu Dzindzi i ustaleniu planu działania trzeba było wystawić receptę, ubrać siebie i Dzidzię, pognać do sąsiedniej apteki, zaś się rozebrać, zaszczepić, ubrać i wyjść. Wspominałam już, że nienawidzę zimy? Aspekt ubierania tylu warstw co chwilę jest najpoważniejszym powodem mojej szczerej nienawiści. > Friday was a day off for Dzindzia, as we finally managed to get vaccinated. It had been postponed almost five times since October. I thought we were going for influenza 2 and chickenpox 1, but it turned out that Pentaxim is required until the child is two years old, and there's not much time. So we settled on Pentaxim and chickenpox; maybe the flu someday. However, managing this vaccination was also a fascinating experience, because after examining Dzindzia and establishing a plan of action, we had to get a prescription, get dressed for Dzindzia, rush to the neighboring pharmacy, undress, get vaccinated, get dressed, and leave. Have I mentioned that I hate winter? The aspect of putting on so many layers over and over again is the biggest reason for my sincere hatred.

title.title: Sabado de pizzas caserasºººººHomemade Pizza Saturday
title.body:
Hola  a todos, la verdad amigos cuando se habla de pizza, las cosas se ponen mucho mejor como lo es en esta ocacion, lo digo por el solo hecho de que esta es una pizza casera, lo primero es preparar la masa la cual se hace de la siguiente manera,utilizamos harina, agua, levadura, sal, huevo, entonces colocamos en un volts, la harina, la abrimos un poco y le agregamos huevo, agua tibia , despues agregamos un poco de levadura y mesclamos todo muy bien, le vamos vertiendo de a poco el agua antes mencionada , previo le agregamos un poco de sal y comenzamos a mesclar todo, hasta que vaya tomando consistencia la misma, cuando esta dicha masa, la tapamos y dejamos que descanse un poco, para despues comenzar a armar lo que seria esta pizza casera.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wMYNMoDES6MtPW2FV1wxVyvkHYco9fWexxjofEZVLVKCjph4GWcwRWLtehrhaNUo4CD.png)

Como lo comente amigos, una ves que ya tenemos la masa y su descanso, en un molde agregamos la masa que seria para una pizza, le damos la forma y la llevamos al horno, hasta que este a medio cocinar, seria la prepizza.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbyGXoqmiLGt79348CC88iDfVcgifKJauvo4SJ3mi4h9R9Ts1NRSS34TS2pDkj32BpC.png)

Una ves que esta la misma armada, la llevamos al horno con la salsa de tomate la cual la agregamos en la parte de arriba, luego cuando la misma esta casi cocinada, le agregamos, el queso, bueno a toda la pizza le agregamos el queso, asi que tambien tomate cortado en julianas, cuando el queso esta derretido como lo vemos en la foto al comienzo del post, es cuando dicha pizza esta lista.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uFVvEUs6NeAzxV9N2zxcogB73CkQJjgVQint3SoAncn27XeBHrBwZUnw7AaLpbtDjNk.png)

Tambien por supuesto que no debe de faltar a la pizza, que seria lo escencial, LAS ACEITUNAS,  que son las que le dan un sabor especial, bueno es a gusto de cada uno, no a todos les agrada dichas aceitunas.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23vsQpshyCW8Fki7WQrmf3hpF1g3wrnVwjqZsATCfzvWBRFjUCwwYbtNehSHTezWBZa29.png)

De esta manera es como disfrutamos el dia sabado de una unas sabrosas pizzas casera, que la verdad salieron muy sabrosas.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN BUEN COMIENZO DE FIN DE SEMANA.

ENGLISH

Hello everyone, honestly friends, when it comes to pizza, things get much better as it is on this occasion. I say this simply because this is a homemade pizza. The first step is to prepare the dough, which is done as follows: we use flour, water, yeast, salt, and egg. Then we place the flour in a bowl, make a little well in it, and add the egg, warm water. After that, we add a bit of yeast and mix everything very well. We gradually pour in the previously mentioned water, add a bit of salt, and start mixing everything until it reaches the right consistency. Once the dough is ready, we cover it and let it rest a bit before we start assembling what would be this homemade pizza.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wMYNMoDES6MtPW2FV1wxVyvkHYco9fWexxjofEZVLVKCjph4GWcwRWLtehrhaNUo4CD.png)

As I mentioned, friends, once we have the dough and it has rested, we place the dough that would be for a pizza in a mold, shape it, and put it in the oven until it is halfway cooked, which would be the pre-pizza.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbyGXoqmiLGt79348CC88iDfVcgifKJauvo4SJ3mi4h9R9Ts1NRSS34TS2pDkj32BpC.png)

Once it is assembled, we put it in the oven with the tomato sauce, which we add on top. Then, when it is almost cooked, we add the cheese. Well, we add cheese to the entire pizza, and also julienned tomatoes. When the cheese is melted, as we see in the photo at the beginning of the post, that's when the pizza is ready.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uFVvEUs6NeAzxV9N2zxcogB73CkQJjgVQint3SoAncn27XeBHrBwZUnw7AaLpbtDjNk.png)

Also, of course, it should not be missing from the pizza, which would be essential, OLIVES, which give it a special flavor. Well, it's up to each person's taste; not everyone likes those olives.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23vsQpshyCW8Fki7WQrmf3hpF1g3wrnVwjqZsATCfzvWBRFjUCwwYbtNehSHTezWBZa29.png)

This is how we enjoyed a delicious homemade pizza on Saturday, which turned out to be really tasty.

Thank you very much for following and reading me, have a great start to the weekend.

sezonowo również wypożyczalnią autek dla dzieci – Cars for Kids Wrocław 🚗

Własny biznes daje mi dużo satysfakcji, ale też… więcej elastycznego czasu. A skoro pojawiła się przestrzeń, postanowiłem wykorzystać ją na coś, co od dawna mnie ciekawiło – naukę programowania.

Co ciekawe, moja przygoda z komputerami zaczęła się wiele lat temu – od Atari 130XE i pierwszych linijek kodu w BASIC-u. To były czasy wpisywania programów z gazet i ogromnej satysfakcji, gdy w końcu coś zadziałało 🙂

Dziś wracam do tej pasji na nowo. Obecnie zgłębiam głównie Pythona 🐍 i traktuję to trochę jako zabawę, trochę jako rozwój, a trochę jako inwestycję w przyszłość. Fascynuje mnie to, jak wiele można zautomatyzować i jak technologia może wspierać codzienny biznes.

Na Hive chciałbym dzielić się:

swoją drogą od etatu do własnej firmy,

doświadczeniami z prowadzenia lokalnego biznesu,

postępami w nauce programowania,

przemyśleniami o zmianie zawodowej po latach w jednej branży.

Mam nadzieję, że znajdę tu inspirujących ludzi i wartościowe dyskusje.

Dzięki za przeczytanie i do zobaczenia w kolejnych postach! 🚀

title.title: I love little moments of joy like that.
title.body:
/>

I’d been at the gym that last Saturday morning. When I was done with my workout, I drove to grocery store to buy a few things. As I walked back to my car, a woman parking her own car wished me good morning. I smiled and good morning'd her.

She was so kind. We made small talk while she was exiting her vehicle and I was putting my bag in the car and she said “Hold on, I have something for you” she walked over to me with a big box and it was a brand new vibration plate in the box, never opened.

I was so shocked, because I had been thinking about getting a vibration plate because there are some health benefits associated with using them. I was so grateful.

She told me she offered it to me because I smiled at her and she needed that smile.

The moment had me in awe of her kindness to a stranger, but also, it was a reminder to be kind to others and that sometimes all it takes is a smile and hello.” Also, my mind was blown because, I REALLY wanted a vibration plate and all of a sudden, I had one.

I love little moments of joy like that.

title.title: Promises, Promises...
title.body: Hive — or rather, Hive-Engine — is home to a number of different *\

* many of which promise various dividends and rates of return.

But how well - and for how long - do they actually keep their promises?

![CCP-023-Stairs.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/23xp4hkHjnhVCAHWxvBvaqwExNhwFu5wcG74G1zZgWs6Ypk48wdvZxwRNXqjCJT9SG6ML.jpg)

Do these promises of *\
* actually hold up under scrutiny?\n\nI'm not really interested in singling out any particular asset/token, but I have to admit that *most* of these fall victim to the same *\

* thinking pattern.

I'll kick in the footnote that I am excluding the outright rugpull/scams from the equation, here... just referring to those with *sincere intentions.*

Starting pretty much *anything* in a pervasive down market/economy is extremely challenging. And that doesn't matter whether you're hawking a crypto token or a new kind of shoe. 

![CCP-000-Considers.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/Eqb2xeGPahB99LSEN4vYthJ55yRRgTqxbmVvwfrGeB6Kn4SismXtN4hLmJUUdjTn3xK.JPG)

I remember in the *\
* of Hive, Layer 2 tokens were often pitched as a way to tokenize *(monetize)* a community or a particular *\

* personal brand. While that might sound marvelous — *on paper* — it usually ends up being an invitation to discover that *far fewer* people actually care about you/your community than you could ever have imagined!

Typically, it's relatively easy to sell *hype,* but very difficult to follow through on those promises.

But mostly, those with creative ideas have a tough row to hoe. After all, getting attention is all about who can shout the loudest with the most promises... which is why more people gravitate towards *get rich quick* than *get rich slowly.*

![CCP-000-SalmonFalls.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/EoyMytwKTWip7g7syTtoFigjgSXdyt3N4oAkcpGXntooVXBhGUReWXM2d2hqQJc6NT7.jpg)
*Treacherous falls...*

Stated a little differently, it's much easier to pitch a *\
* that will take off all that excess weight, than to pitch a rigorous regimen of diet and exercise for the next 12 months. People invariably want to push the *\
*\n\nAnd here in the Cryptosphere, we've been *trained* to *\
* our opportunities to be able to magically *\

* rather than gradually appreciate over time. 

And so, promises are made that are perhaps only *keep-able* in the most perfect of conditions, but not when you're actually operating in an environment where 80% of the time we're in a long slow slide into oblivion, and only 20% of the time we're rocketing to the Moon, in the most ridiculous way.

For now, I'm just going to take my few drips and drabs and cautiously put them in something that *hopefully* will live up to their *lesser* promises of getting rich *slowly.*

*Feel free to leave a comment — this IS \

media, after all!*

***As always, a 10% @commentrewarder bonus is active on this post!***

title.title: MILANESA CON ARROZ, LENTEJA Y ZANAHORIA-----BREADED MEAT WITH RICE, LENTILS, AND CARROT
title.body:
Buenos dias a todos, hoya fin de semana prepare para el almuerzo milanesa de pechuga de pollo con lenteja, zanahoria rallada y arroz, dicha comida es muy facil de prepararla y por supuesto sale muy rica, para preparar la milanesa la cual es de la siguiente manera, en un volts agregamos huevo, sal, pimienta, cebolla de verdeo, batimos bien todo, luego agregamos la carne cortada en fetas, para luego quitarla de ahi y pasarla por el pan rallado, donde se la apelmasa bien, despues la agregamos en la sarten donde la freimos de ambos lados para que quede bien cocinada, la vamos quitando de la sarten y agregandola en una fuente con papel de servilleta, para que se termine de salir el aceite que queda.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/EorzsJomxNdmXbr9x4d9zHJb4ZkKVTX44tLbUYJjP3kbp1TDgsdELEnPq9GhA8zkba8.png)

De esta manera, rallamos la zanahoria, luego para preparar el arroz, lo hacemos de la siguiente ,manera, agregamos una olla en la hornalla de la cocina con agua caliente, luego dicho arroz y cuando el mismo esta blando es porque esta cocinado, le quitamos el agua y listo, por supuesto que salio todo muy sabroso, lo mismo hacemos con la lenteja, una ves cocinada la colamos y ya esta, todo muy rico.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, this weekend I prepared chicken breast milanesa with lentils, grated carrot, and rice for lunch. This dish is very easy to prepare and, of course, it turns out delicious. To prepare the milanesa, we do the following: in a bowl, we add egg, salt, pepper, green onion, and beat everything well. Then we add the meat cut into slices, take it out, and coat it with breadcrumbs, pressing it well. After that, we add it to the pan where we fry it on both sides until it's well cooked. We then remove it from the pan and place it on a plate with a napkin to absorb any remaining oil.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/EorzsJomxNdmXbr9x4d9zHJb4ZkKVTX44tLbUYJjP3kbp1TDgsdELEnPq9GhA8zkba8.png)

In this way, we grate the carrot, then to prepare the rice, we do it as follows: we put a pot on the stove with hot water, then add the rice, and when it is soft, it means it is cooked. We drain the water and that's it. Of course, everything turned out very tasty. We do the same with the lentils; once cooked, we strain them and that's it. Everything is very delicious.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

title.title: Standard H.K. Roast at Geylang Bahru Hawker Centre... A Trio Plate for My Hong Kong Roast Cravings
title.body:
For today’s lunch, I dropped by **Geylang Bahru Hawker Food Centre** with one mission: find something satisfying enough to match my cravings (and my mood). I was strolling past the usual suspects when a newly opened stall caught my eye, **“Standard H.K. Roast.”** The name alone already feels like a challenge, right? If you brand yourself as *standard*, I’m immediately going to test you against my personal benchmark: **Wong Chiew Hong Kong Restaurant at Springleaf**, the one that consistently makes me happy with every roasted meat bite.


![1000105698.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eos2pMNkFTVGkTUBrRzcs3dqBRHmrXuSyy1Uh77JUzEt6vYwRQz4WpEAay2MarXpEB3.jpg)


And honestly… I still felt like I was in “holiday mode.” Plus, I got a little extra Ang Bao from my boss, so it became my official excuse to treat myself again. LOL.


![1000105693.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoeEN3uNYLLaiXyHuHcSgvJ24kjfKtVkB9QPM6fZRgCgjGTTqyzgnP4zBbSzvfcGn18.jpg)


What pulled me in first wasn’t even the meat (yet), it was the **signage**. The stall looks modern and bold: a black background, super lit-up display, and menu photos that are trying very hard to hypnotize you while you’re queueing. It worked on me. Behind the glass, you can see the **glossy roasted meats hanging**, looking shiny and dramatic under the lights, like they know they’re the main character of someone’s lunch story.


![1000105694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep1XRUbjb5bVTQ1Le4LL9cqHhPi76yQuQFX4x4UHRa6zxoAPsX9beguKXNLzsgvhH9v.jpg)

![1000105695.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoGxWJ3zNvpZcBqQufgGqypzoznY1NuvXkHtSUG7SYtVxmfPUavekci7pJEqBPhh16Q.jpg)


The menu item that immediately grabbed my attention was the **Roasted Duck Trio Combination Rice**. I mean… a trio in one plate? That’s actually smart marketing. Instead of choosing one meat and regretting it later, you get to try everything at once. For **SGD 6.50**, I’d say it’s pretty reasonable, especially since this kind of “mixed tasting” usually means paying extra elsewhere.


![1000105697.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopuqdcqeaEw8uZaoSCG64gAJJt7t3ZcyYN1MczbSNaERLd5cme4yrVpqXqY6tBrLot.jpg)

![1000105696.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep3gBvpYn2UB8khkPQgHbGqJwkfpK2ErLvz69QAtaDdf5czN8Ma4QVapf1BR5uYCUZp.jpg)


I requested them to add the **savory duck sauce** (must-have), and I also scooped some **chili sauce** on the side. You already know I’m not really into spicy food, but I still like a little heat, just enough to wake the taste buds up without ruining my day.


![1000105700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EopuJbT4BDZKAPSJ8hEJbAeCb22C8wmudthGaXic6naChZet7KD6kLWcdW3T9T7G4Xv.jpg)


## Now, let’s talk about the meats.


![1000105703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23zbTuAuaMRVJyvFdfEngnQtTzhDLmLcRe3ERM8S7bNRCFdCffyFyYqe9WGhnLfK541Ke.jpg)


The **roasted pork** was my favorite on the plate. The skin had that satisfying crunch, and underneath it, the meat stayed tender and juicy. That texture contrast, crispy top, soft inside, always gets me. It’s the kind of bite that makes you pause for a second like, “Okay… this is the good stuff.”


![1000105702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23xyZ9GWrytZjsUVeeKkgcuib7yjzPL4iaWqbX3HzkayWNmo1D2AH7zkMm6YbyRUJZ72p.jpg)


The **char siew**, though, was a bit on the dry side. It felt quite lean, and maybe slightly overcooked, so it didn’t have that classic juicy sweetness I usually look for. The flavor was still there, but the texture didn’t hit as nicely. That said, I’m also the kind of person who prefers char siew with a little more fat balance, so this might be a preference thing.


![1000105704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23xyXNWEyYk6cg7wK5vB2ieBHafDYm1oVt9cG4TCjDK5oVLHjbmCx3yYNX7cnbzfV3LZx.jpg)


The **roasted duck** was pleasant, especially when paired with the duck sauce. The sauce helped bring everything together and gave that deeper, savory richness that makes duck feel extra comforting. If you’re the type who loves sauce-soaked rice (same), you’ll enjoy mixing it into the grains.


![1000105701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA3xBZ4kkARHfA3TDACEH8HJaD8VN22hgD5deUFffZHuEC1JveSkiS4GZLFr2P8JeT.jpg)


And of course, to cut through all that roasted meat heaviness, I had to get my usual partner-in-crime: **Iced Lemon Tea**. The citrusy acidity is such a perfect reset button between bites, refreshing, simple, and it keeps the meal from feeling too “gelat” halfway through.

***Overall, this meal was **okay**, with a few strong moments (hello crispy pork) and a couple of areas that can improve (char siew, I’m looking at you). But since this stall is newly opened, I genuinely believe they’ll get better as they settle into their rhythm. And yes, I will come back in the near future to order the trio mix again, because the concept is fun, the price is fair, and I like supporting stalls that are still building their journey.***

[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmY4myEVoSKCCR7EUMRCyGBgtwCQcVHpyFM97N7WuV7zVp/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/ab8b3bca)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/ab8b3bca)


---

Hello Chess community, today is the first time I've posted a chess game here.

It was very interesting because Steve had resigned.I used to be very addicted to playing chess, but now I don't play it regularly because when I lived in the village, there was a lot of talk about chess.Many people thought it was bad for the brain, but I think it's an intellectual game.Today I played chess online with a guy from Paris.I played chess online for the first time in my life and it was very interesting.I won the first game.

The most interesting thing was that while I was still playing, Steve, who came from Paris, saw my game and resigned.I won the first game and he lost.This victory is very interesting and very happy.I invite you to watch my first moment of victory.

You can enjoy today's chess playing.
Until next time, stay healthy everyone.

Thank you 🙏

---

Hello, creative friends

Welcome to the **Doodle Magic Drawing Challenge**. Here’s your chance to take a simple doodle and turn it into something amazing. We’ve got a reference photo below to get you started. Use it as inspiration, and let your creativity do the rest.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theithei/242DkGHrspNAiMJgDD7E2AL5PFUe53CCssKvkGmBpx6z3nPzZUQty2aVPD3PEy62mSWbK.png)

**How It Works:**
- Make it your own: Add your personal touch to the doodle—whether it’s enhancing the details, adding new elements, or just putting your unique spin on it.
- Level it up: Take that basic doodle and turn it into something extraordinary. Let your artistic skills shine.
- Keep the heart of it: While you’re adding your flair, keep the essence of the original intact. Let it grow into something new while honoring where it started.
- Have fun with it: This challenge is all about exploring ideas, experimenting, and enjoying the process.
- There’s no wrong way to approach this. Whether you draw, paint, or just describe your vision, the goal is to express yourself. Share your work and show us how you see the world through your art.

We’re so excited to see what you come up with. Your creativity always inspires us! Let’s make some magic happen.

title.title: I Got That Math Wrong
title.body:
I just wanted to say thank you, everybody, for joining. Understand this. There is something called withdrawals, and the withdrawals of being off spaces and talking to you guys was really challenging, and I know that that sounds like I'm a junkie, but not being able to talk to people was exceedingly difficult for me, especially people that I've gotten and grown accustomed to talking to regularly.



<center>https://media.istockphoto.com/id/471285739/photo/rebel-student.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=FBiHdZ0YvxBEz6V8byOUh7TT0ZaLzvR5s_zdbIXNOP8=[Source](https://media.istockphoto.com/id/471285739/photo/rebel-student.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=FBiHdZ0YvxBEz6V8byOUh7TT0ZaLzvR5s_zdbIXNOP8=)</center>

A lot of you are really part of my day-to-day, and you do not understand how much, psychologically speaking, I have missed you guys, and I am sorry it's taken a few days, but I've been really busy, and I needed to also take some time to decompress. There's something to be said about the transition that I just experienced, and I really want to get into it and talk about it, but David, the floor is yours, and let's get to it, my friend. Well, yeah, let's get right out the gate. 

I mean, obviously, the question that everybody wants to know – well, first, everybody's going to want to know, because they love you, is how are you doing now that you've emerged from what was probably one of the most difficult things you've ever encountered in life? I know all of us heard from your goodbye face, and in the months leading up to serving your sentence, we all knew how concerned you were with everything, and look, Trump blessed you with a commutation, which I hoped would happen, and I'm excited that you're back. So the question is, obviously, how are you doing? You've been out like a week or two now at this point, so how are you? So it's been nine days – 10 days today. It's been – sorry, nine days today. 

I got that math wrong. So last Friday, today's Sunday, so it's been nine days. There's adjustments that I've been going through that – first of all, I haven't slept through a night yet.

title.title: AMA Recap Feb 18 2026 {Part 2}
title.body: ### Transition Toward USDC Rewards USDC is expected to function as a reward treasury. When conversions occur, reward pools will shift to stable value distribution. This reduces fluctuation tied to PIXEL price volatility and creates a more predictable reward environment. Long term, PIXEL may transition into a stake only token. The goal is to reduce sell pressure while creating meaningful staking incentives. Competitive staking yields will be critical to maintaining demand. The broader strategy is to remove immediate sell dynamics while aligning long term holders with ecosystem growth.

/> * * * ### New Player Experience and Retention Reputation requirements and early grind friction were acknowledged as key barriers for new players, particularly in the first seven days. Planned improvements include: • Transitioning economics toward stable rewards • Creating smoother new user flows • Leveraging Stacked and paid acquisition channels • Expanding endgame features to make Pixels feel more complete The first phase focused on economic stability. The next phase focuses on product depth and growth. * * * ### Web2 Integration Without Abandoning Web3 Concerns were raised about moving toward Web2. The response was clear: the foundation remains on chain. Stacked enables a hybrid model. A traditional player can enjoy the game without interacting directly with Web3 components. Players who care about rewarded play can access it through Stacked. This structure also opens doors to platforms like Steam, where direct Web3 integration may not be permitted inside the game client itself. The vision is not abandoning Web3. It is abstracting complexity while keeping ownership and staking mechanisms intact. * * * ### NFTs, Marketplaces, and Play to Earn The team expressed strong belief in sustainable play to earn. If executed properly, it remains a powerful growth engine. A sustainable model allows players who believe in play to earn to hold and stake PIXEL while enabling games to function competitively in broader markets. Most of the circulating supply has already been distributed to Pixels players, reinforcing the player first foundation. * * * ### Advertising and Stacked’s Role Traditional ad revenue has proven difficult in Web3 gaming. Many brands avoid placing ads directly in Web3 environments. Stacked addresses this by separating rewarded infrastructure from the core gameplay experience. Core Pixels can maintain a Web2 friendly front end while the underlying system remains on chain. This separation allows for more traditional user acquisition funnels.

/>

* * *

### Founder Outlook: AI, Moats, and the Future

Luke shared excitement about internal AI tooling that has significantly increased team productivity. The belief is that software development will fundamentally change over the next two to three years.

Simply building a game or SaaS product may no longer be enough. The future belongs to projects with defensible moats, strong data advantages, and network effects.

The conviction is that Stacked, combined with the broader PIXEL ecosystem, has the potential to create that long term moat.

The team continues to operate with the same intensity as during the token generation phase, driven by belief in building sustainable systems that offer real participation and upside when executed responsibly.

* * *

The message from this AMA was clear:

First build sustainability. Then refine product depth. Then scale growth.

Pixels is positioning itself not for short term hype, but for long term durability.

title.title: Kapsuła czasu Hive
title.body:
> Słuchajcie, jest akcja. Nie wiem na ile się uda, ale myślę, że warto skorzystać z nowych wynalazków na Hive.

Wykuć internet w bloku łańcuchów

Niedawno uruchomiono usługę ArcHive, która ma na celu zapisywanie zawartości internetu zapisywać na naszym blockchainie. Niedawno ujawniono dokumenty Epsteina, momentalnie powstały serwisy je przechowujące i ułatwiające ich przeglądanie. Szybko jednak okazało się, że ilość danych i ruch sieciowy generują ogromne koszty. Przechowywanie danych na Hive kosztuje użytkownika niewiele (kosztuje, ale to temat na inny post, bo koszt ten ponoszą wszyscy). Pomyślałem, że wiele razy spotkałem się z blogiem, stroną, do której chciałbym wrócić po latach a webarchive (i alternatywy) tych stron nie zapisał. Są też takie dokumenty jak Wikileaks czy właśnie Epsteina, których zniknięcie jest w interesie wielu grup. Nie ukrywam, że czasami miałbym ochotę zrobić na złość i utrwalić je. W takim przypadku można zmusić front-end (hive.blog, peakd etc.) do ukrycia, ale już zmusić do usunięcia z łańcucha bloków się nie da. W związku z tym, powstało konto @polish.arch, które będzie wkuwać zawartość internetu w łańcuch. Nagrody z tych postów automatycznie są spalanie. Wyposażę konto w 25 SOL, żeby coś tokenów Hive się spaliło. Jeśli chcecie, by coś utrwalić to podsyłajcie linki, będę się starać na tym koncie publikować jak najczęściej. Zachęcam was do tego również. Nie wiem czy będę korzystać z ArcHive, bo jednak te narzędzie narzuca zbyt wiele ograniczeń i nie wiem czy jednak nie wolę wykorzystać samemu dobrych wzorców a te złe odrzucić. Jak wygląda takie coś? Przykład możecie znaleźć poniżej. Może to nie jest majstersztyk, ale jest podstawą do tego żeby Hive mógł robić swoją robotę. Kwestia wyszukiwania contentu na Hive będzie łatwiejsza dowiezienia jeśli ten content tu już będzie. https://hive.blog/archivedcontenthaf/@polish.hive/archive-1771617956600-h1edhq ![1000014217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/polish.hive/23tbLvcqgyp9vF175Gxbc3rSqGedxVkEbXgTmPKwbL9FEq7nNZ7mroDfTHZdBtApf7ZUk.jpg) ![1000014214.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/polish.hive/AJoE1dGe9fuTofrv7k9qr9tXUoggDZGQxJ8DhBgXPoJZNko3P4aWxCsL67Ywyxm.png)

title.title: 21 February 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3021: velvet curtain
title.body:
/>[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/search/velvet%20curtain/)

It hangs there like a secret story just waiting to be told. Perhaps royal blue, deep crimson, hefty enough to soak up sound. It protects what is not yet ready to be seen rather than just conceals a stage.

A velvet curtain knows timing.

lights warm the air. For it, nevertheless, the crowd only sees collected, impeccable, motionless calm cloth. The curtain holds the fear so the rest of the world does not have to.

Though soft to the touch, velvet is still not weak. It blocks light. It controls focus. It sets the beginning of the story. Everything changes when it splits. Needing a few more seconds before exposure.

The velvety curtain reminds us that not everything has to be disclosed all at once. Some occasions call for ready. Some objectives call for defense before publication.

It then opens gradually, purposefully when the time is perfect, and what was hidden finally breathes in front of the world.

title.title: A walk through history: half-term family fun...
title.body:
<center>![20260219_095240.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUMyjJkRPXa5ZvnjokC3BGFmqe8tfZz12KfKnyhzQzsZ8/20260219_095240.jpg)</center>

Yesterday was definitely one of those days that leaves you tired in the legs, hoarse in the voice, and oddly full in the heart... Half term has a habit of creeping up quickly, so with an early start and packed bags, I took my two children along with two of their friends(1 each) to [St Fagans National Museum of History](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://museum.wales/stfagans/&ved=2ahUKEwj-yNmG8OiSAxX6UkEAHaWcGiYQFnoECBsQAQ&sqi=2&usg=AOvVaw3Cjqzxp0Buku4XlTYlQsfx) for a full day of learning, playing, and proper exploration.

From the moment we arrived, the excitement was infectious. There is something about St Fagans that feels different from a typical museum. It is not about standing still, being quiet and reading plaques, it is about walking through history, touching it, smell8ng it and imagining what life once looked like. The children bounced between old cottages, farm buildings, and workshops, asking questions that only seem to appear when curiosity is truly sparked.

<center>![20260219_103608.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWdMK6M8EKzB3FnsgkLECMs8B39ngyu5cBphC67pYbJS1/20260219_103608.jpg)</center>

<center>![20260219_103225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHnA5BSnz1eLntWLvAqXxW5gacospsZiF25zf5Nohb8M/20260219_103225.jpg)</center>

What I loved most was how naturally learning slipped into the day. One minute they were playing games on the grass, the next they were asking how people cooked their food hundreds of years ago or why houses were built the way they were. There was no pressure, no forced education, just stories, spaces, and experiences doing the teaching quietly in the background. With \

staff in every building, dispensing their knowledge to anyone brave enough to ask, even I picked up things i didnt know, and ive been there countless times already.

<center>![20260219_124028.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJCs64gjGLr65JkVJk63M8WZKYneWQUvR1TcoZ3dxcdB/20260219_124028.jpg)</center>

By lunchtime, energy levels were still high, helped along by fresh air and freedom to roam. I found a spot to sit, eat, and laugh, watching the kids retell what they had already seen as if they were the guides themselves. It was one of those moments where you realise that days like this do more than entertain, they build memories and confidence without anyone noticing at the time.

![20260219_104634.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTW6ctPy56Sm3NSDMCPYgv14MgAYgXpmsGdQHZGiyXa1V/20260219_104634.jpg)

![20260219_142112.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW3VTJDPbN28uuTjRELhrzgoCnhqJrUPoF2MaVfKY6GaD/20260219_142112.jpg)

![20260219_132939.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNft2FtMsfiEdzfJiBdBeb7F7NBQfaJh96zAnHp6X5nV9/20260219_132939.jpg)

![20260219_102621.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNkT9D4Gtq3aDTmjDuUXNpfz5AGmYZU36vCXUUsFYdpn/20260219_102621.jpg)

![20260219_101220.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKY2zywy1RZ5JPnm5w3RovZJDBYoDA7ePn8kFxjGgAMv/20260219_101220.jpg)

![20260219_102448.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb3Ax5SxCrKQwFTWMXVoDeMhrpxdnXq2yJ2nu38CWGWF2/20260219_102448.jpg)

![20260219_102719.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXqN6wB5JDM2PwM8TpZYhcuxkVkhE22T7otxwJVBR5mfc/20260219_102719.jpg)

As the afternoon rolled on, legs grew heavier but spirits stayed strong. There was still time for more wandering, more questions, and more imaginative play. Even towards the end of the day, when tiredness finally started to show, no one wanted to rush away. That, to me, says everything about how special thisplace is...

Driving home, the car was much quieter than it had been that morning. Four children worn out from a day well spent, and me feeling grateful for the chance to share something meaningful with them. Half term can be hectic, but days like this remind me that learning does not always come from books or screens. Sometimes it comes from old buildings, muddy shoes, and a long day spent together discovering the past while making memories in the present.

title.title: U.S. Supreme Court strikes down reciprocal tariffs; Trump hits back with new 10% global tariff.
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRqSQh5DEhCRCVbjRmzYN9USofLfTguMzfUt4Du5JFFn3/image.png)

>[Seoul = Newsis] Reporter Moon Jae-sung = When the U.S. Supreme Court ruled against the Donald Trump administration's mutual tariffs on the 20th (local time), President Trump immediately responded by imposing new tariffs of 10% on imports from countries around the world.

>President Trump said on his social media Truth Social that he signed a new executive order on customs duties. He expressed his strong will to maintain the effectiveness of the tariff policy despite the Supreme Court ruling.
According to the White House, the new tariffs will take effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern time on the 24th.
The 10% tariff invoked this time is based on Article 122 of the Trade Act. The relevant provision stipulates that the President can impose an emergency tariff of up to 15% for 150 days in response to serious balance of payments deficit or a drop in the value of the dollar. It is the first time that the tariff was actually invoked since its enactment in 1974. As legal grounds exist, additional tariffs are valid for 150 days before parliament approves the extension.
However, some agricultural products such as beef, tomatoes, and oranges, as well as important minerals, metals, fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, some electronics and passenger cars that are difficult to produce in the United States, are not subject to tariffs.
Earlier on the same day, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that President Trump's mutual tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) and the imposition of fentanyl tariffs on Mexico, Canada and China were illegal. This is the same as the first and second trials.
Since then, President Trump has signed an executive order to officially end tariffs imposed based on IEEPA, including mutual tariffs.

>Meanwhile, the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) immediately launched an investigation into Article 301 of the Trade Act, which was announced immediately after the Supreme Court ruling. The so-called \

clause allows for widespread retaliatory measures in the event of U.S. trade restrictions due to unfair trade practices by counterparts. The review includes most of the countries that trade with the U.S.

>The Supreme Court's ruling is expected to increase confusion inside and outside the United States.
First of all, the variable \

is drawing attention. This is because the Supreme Court did not clearly mention the issue of the refund of tariffs collected so far in the ruling.
U.S. companies in various industries and subsidiaries in the U.S. of foreign companies have already filed a lawsuit to return tariffs in preparation for a mutual tariff violation, and the number of refund lawsuits is likely to increase further after the ruling.
The amount of refunds these companies demand is expected to reach hundreds of billions of dollars. The U.S. mutual tariff revenue under IEEPA, compiled by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), totaled 133.5 billion dollars (about 193 trillion won) by mid-December last year.

>Political repercussions are also significant. Entering the second year of his second term in office, President Trump faced a significant political blow as he put the brakes on his representative policies. The New York Times reported that the Supreme Court's ruling dealt a severe blow to President Trump's economic policies and brought new uncertainties to the global market, which is struggling to adapt to the rapidly changing U.S. trade policies.
In particular, some countries, including South Korea, where President Trump signed a new trade agreement with the promise of astronomical investment in the U.S. on the condition of tariff cuts, are also expected to face considerable confusion.
There is also a possibility that the negotiating power with China will weaken. The White House officially announced that President Trump will visit China from March 31 to April 2. It is the first visit by the U.S. president to China since Trump's first visit to China in 2017, and a change in the key means of pressure called tariffs is expected to be a new variable in the U.S.-China summit negotiations.
Reporter Moon Jae-sung (sophis731@newsis.com )

It was a matter of principle, not ideology.

Even in a Supreme Court overwhelmingly conservative in orientation, the conclusion was reached that the tariffs were illegal.

Now it seems some brakes will be put on arbitrary administrative actions.

We need to watch how things will normalize from here.

title.title: Let Down by 'Woman Down' – My Thoughts on Colleen Hoover’s Latest
title.body: > [](https://booktrib.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Woman-Down-1.webp) Okay. Deep breath. I have… feelings about this one 😂 Going into this, I truly assumed that this will be another thrilling book like Verity. I was preparing for mind-blowing chaos, characters without any moral compass, and that familiar ‘what did I just read?’ frenzy. Classic Colleen Hoover. Instead, it is definitely a romantic suspense. I really wish they had marketed this as such because I think my confusion came from expecting the other things and getting something else entirely. Worst part is, I pretty much forced Ramesh (@bighungrypanda) to read this book as well and he hated it even more than me 😭 The premise is strong. Petra Rose is a bestselling author whose life is turned upside down after a film adaption of one of her books flops. As the internet condemns her as a scam and tarnishes her reputation, she retreats in writer's block and a bruised ego from the world. That part honestly seemed intimate and real. While the writer insists we should not read too much into it, I can’t help but think about the parallels to fame, criticism, and social media. Learning what I really ‘think’ was cathartic like a writer working through her own complicated feelings about readers and public opinion. That didn’t bother me in the least. What I really minded was how long it took for the action to begin. The chapters are quite lengthy. And comprehensive. Occasionally extremely detailed. In this book, there is a literal scene that takes ages for a character to get out of the car and walk to the door. Petra, the author, also has this habit of taking one idea and repeating it, but use slightly different wordings for pages. It honestly was reminded of school essays that I wrote to increase the word count. I understand that this scene signifies her ascent into madness but this may have been a little over the top.

> Let’s discuss Petra now. I had a hard time with her. This was a challenge. There were many times when I felt like tossing my phone against the wall (and not in a light-hearted, theatrical manner). She makes annoying decisions, is narcissistic. For a huge chunk of the book, I found her to be actively dislikeable. Sadly, I did not love most of the other characters either. The husband especially didn’t feel fully real to me. I felt an odd sense of pity for him. Consequently, the chemistry between Petra and Detective Nathaniel Saint? I wasn't into it either. It was messy and not in a good way. I found it more vulgar than I had imagined (those window and midnight scenes??😳). If you dislike cheating tropes, you will strongly dislike this. That was my least favorite part (out of a long list of least favourite ones) and it definitely influenced my score. Just when I was about to lose interest, there is a twist around 70-80% in. I'll give credit where it's due - this part worked for me! I believed we were moving toward a great explosion. But then… that sort of died down. The conclusion is not bad. It actually does something neat for Petra’s character development, which I really liked. It didn't get the impact I had envisioned though. I even predicted parts of it early on, although I also thought up way better theories in my head that never happened 😂.

> But Mari, though? Loved her. She was hilarious and a much-needed relief in an otherwise boring and gloomy story. Overall, this was a strange reading experience. I almost hated it while reading it. I was annoyed. Underwhelmed. Sometimes bored. But it’s bingeable in that classic CoHo style – easy to follow, dramatic, and emotionally charged. The audiobook actually helped a lot. I think if I’d had to physically read all the repetitive paragraphs, I might’ve rated it even lower. Is this her best book? No way (are you even kidding me). Is it her worst? Nope (though, it comes very close). It just feels... lower-middle of the pack. A 3-star read. Not something you need to sprint to the bookstore for, but not a total waste of time either. I think my biggest problem was going in thinking it was going to be another Verity. That’s on me. If you go into this thinking it’s romantic suspense with complicated characters and morally ambiguous decisions, you’ll probably like it better. Yeah. So. I didn’t love it. I didn’t hate it. My brain is still trying to figure out what the actual plot was 😂 But I’m going to go with 3 stars – with the reminder that even when she misses for me, I respect the ambition.

title.title: AMA Recap Feb 18 2026
title.body: 🚀 **AMA Recap: Sustainability, Strategy, and What’s Next for Pixels** We’re entering a pivotal phase for Pixels. Several internal developments are ready, but the team is intentionally pacing announcements to ensure the user experience meets a high standard. In a bear market environment, timing and execution matter. The core belief remains unchanged: if you build something of real value, crypto becomes a powerful mechanism to distribute that value across the protocol and its participants. Pixels has already proven it can build games players love. The current focus is on refining sustainable economic models that support long term growth.

/>

* * *

🎭 **Community Moments from the AMA**

During the session, Heidi spent time in the theater with the community, distributing Quicksilver and UGC items. She also showcased standout UGC creations, including Silverwing’s new fences and the Cursed Lemon Cow.

Heidi later worked through taskboard and animal care activities on lands such as 1470, 178, 179, 1845, 1034, and 1699 while Luke answered questions live.

* * *

Key Strategic Discussions
-------------------------

### RORS and User Growth

Return on Reward Spend was described as the critical first milestone toward sustainability. With that foundation in place, the focus can now shift toward new user acquisition and onboarding improvements.

Some decline in daily grinder retention is expected. Early phases attracted players focused primarily on extracting as much PIXEL as possible. With the introduction of Stacked, reward distribution can be capped and optimized to prevent a small percentage of users from capturing a disproportionate share of rewards.

Sustainability requires balance. It is not healthy for 1 percent of users to take 50 percent of rewards.

title.title: Tofu Soup With Mixed Veggies
title.body:
>
Whoa, it's been a while since I've shared my recipe here. You see, that's because I've been focusing on healthy home cooking. So I don't have a lot of variety, and most of my dishes have already been shared here.

![IMG_3574.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23uFUA4wkEjykgr9wYSg8b5cf1Mq8FgfAYpqv9An24y4CFRTY5qZLXa8dKjmsMCLNLqHW.jpeg)


This time, it's tofu soup again. But I'm using the soft, creamy \

variety.

![IMG_3552.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK3fF2zGNdYKMCfoQ2jMZJQEYYP8AReUqxDdsfcQvtJM1capSJZ3k69htKVBcrF.jpeg)

Well, egg tofu is widely available in markets. However, because it tends to be more expensive than the usual tofu, I rarely buy it.


![IMG_3576.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK55nje7gfLvwgZhAmAkVdmnmQqxH9RXmNT4KzjwZppuAW8Y1t3TuCwmY7iyZh7.jpeg)
However, I was craving the egg tofu I once ate at a favorite restaurant in my hometown. So, I decided to make this egg tofu dish at home!

With simple ingredients, of course. I made this dish for breaking the fast, as it's the Muslim fasting month of Ramadan 2026.

---


![IMG_3551.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKWw3FThFgnbXj175x216ai5V49k3reHp4Bo6HEmdfUjPu6kqhVut8Z8UXgf5Kp.jpeg)
Well, I'm happy to have a new photo spot with a direct view of the mini garden in front of my house. I'm super excited for more!

---
---
---

## THE INGREDIENTS

![IMG_3550.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK7xewiv2WbqGodNizD4jrEqKDSmJFXPivF18bqgimDacRL334m3KP67CFQYoJY.jpeg)
- 2 packages of egg tofu, 125 grams each
- 50 grams of Chinese cabbage
- 100 grams of bok choy
- 100 grams of carrots
- 400 ml of water

*spices and herbs*
![IMG_3553.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJmsMxtvTqbL5HamUwZeSVwnyTuG1ZBJTEDTjtyW92oWkjn7Y2BNp5LvKTab4dp.jpeg)
- a thumb-size amount of ginger
- green onion, to taste
- celery, to taste
- 1 stalk of lemongrass
- (optional) chili oil

*seasoning*

- 2 tablespoons of sweet soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons of cornstarch
- 1/2 teaspoon of salt
- 100 ml of water

---
---
---

## COOKING STEPS

![IMG_3555.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKJ2JqPx67tD7SPDd7E9WVhaBMESAHpPxSXwygqKKopN3d3C8eMvvfaZGy3bwe9.jpeg)

I chopped all the vegetables first. But don't chop the egg tofu first so it retains its soft yet chewy texture.

![IMG_3556.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK9Pu6Q7288yyAbvDgUajnVLLDPsKuUNT7hRTjbvMvPDEnYfWp8qFk48uSwrR8R.jpeg)
I also sliced ​​the green onions and lemongrass. I also thinly sliced ​​the ginger.

---
---


![IMG_3554.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK6ZNsyresak4RjQb3rvEy6zSuBHkiR31VKG2uvrBHPTdzM9wBFoNrJtfMeddMr.jpeg)
Then, I moved on to preparing the seasoning. First, I dissolved the cornstarch in 100 ml of water.

---

---

<div class=\

> ![IMG_3558.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKCGimjepTYMcrnRsfHvFXeV64dBczxY45dhkTn7DUgUxPqtKd6pvAriXSKbvgA.jpeg) --- Once the cornstarch dissolved, I added this solution to the bowl containing the soy sauce. Stir well. --- --- --- Then, as an option, I added chili oil. Well, I have a lot of chili oil on hand since I have a large harvest of organic chilies in my garden. The chili oil I stocked up on made it really easy to cook, so I didn't have to sauté the onions anymore. Because I added the shallots and garlic to the chili oil during the cooking process. --- Well, I almost forgot to mention. If you're not using chili oil or pre-made stock, you can sauté the onions first before making the vegetable and tofu soup. --- ![IMG_3559.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK9QqkXmYfASf3nNfZaQx5US9qDQJBLyBYCvQcXSoTekbfo3UNz8DzjoUHUihWk.jpeg) Don't forget to prepare the egg-tofu when you're ready to cook the soup. Carefully remove the egg tofu and cut it into thick slices so it doesn't fall apart during cooking. --- --- ![IMG_3560.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKJ1vVvQbaoMsUTHK7Ach8MtcD4WZmX1DTtfvoHQ64ugEuEsHSAFRV2uudvhYTM.jpeg) I used a Korean-style clay pot that retains heat longer. I brought 400 ml of water to a boil. --- ![IMG_3561.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK55rf3pA4XgubEo3w4xT1wVaKzMZKkwFjUaXnd4rpw9f5jcduFrHb8EjrPV8pv.jpeg) Once the water boiled, I added all the vegetables to the clay pot and cooked for about 3 minutes. ---

> ![IMG_3566.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKAq8jEbJhGvftGtparySS3F85Vsv9puxB1ZrpZcdig9piy4hKaBjKw3ZuM4ebJ.jpeg) --- After 3 minutes, I added the egg tofu pieces and the seasoning I made earlier. ![IMG_3562.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKKT8y4mY3YxTo3ZCk6XRkWPwofVJhLYeftbwVT9cBworMpkNciefA1bXMz3fhT.jpeg) Cooked them for another 3 minutes. I covered the clay pot so they cooked faster. --- --- # SERVE! ![IMG_3573.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23vi1oKY5AYWLKz1CxBrdVwvYas6sEd65nMxK5KMiqgG4MaRobeFyRNsmtRQzHEQkGtxS.jpeg) ---

> ![IMG_3577.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJoJZ3sjEDJw4iwuo6LJMGQ5ozekCewKaLat9JDxuA3EgmgbWTkWLBcnTTDa2Nb.jpeg) --- Whoaaaaaaaaaa, thick broth! This is just what I wanted! In fact, I didn't even have to bother changing the serving dish. This clay pot can be used directly on the table. It stays clean while cooking. Great! ![IMG_3579.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKF99ZDiQzvoHYjXQc1bhLDoX37ikAkvLKUymt3S3vrLsLbYZ2cJLzENtQ127Ri.jpeg) The egg tofu is so soft. I'm addicted. Well, after dinner, there's still plenty of soup left over. I reheated it to make egg soup drops! Nothing was wasted. ---

> ![IMG_3570.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23xAZuWoAE79xtBsywW69XT62xmtHLspSMqxvxT1qf4g5EY3nwqCDsxvR3umT34fEFuFv.jpeg) ![IMG_3571.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AKDhJLVzHCHgsCYGvVxoD8L5cTRB62awiLZgufT1gnW9nDQX4DEjLmKm8LS2z4g.jpeg) --- Remember, the warmth from the sliced ​​ginger and lemongrass is like the warmth of home with a welcoming hug from a loved one. Pssst, I miss my late mother. :) --- --- --- >Best Regards, Anggrek Lestari ---

> Who is Anggrek Lestari? Anggrek Lestari is an Indonesian fiction writer who has published two major books. Now She is a full-time content creator. She has a goal to share life, poem, and food content that makes others happy and can get inspiration. --- Contact Person: authoranggreklestari@gmail.com Discord: anggreklestari#3009 --- Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@anggreklestari/tofu-soup-with-mixed-veggies-8i9)

title.title: AMA Recap Feb 11 2026
title.body: 🎙️ **AMA Recap: Birthday Energy, Big Questions, and What’s Next for Pixels** Today’s AMA was packed with celebration and serious discussion. Heidi hosted a massive energy party on her birthday map, complete with her own signature pink energy. She also participated live in Heidi’s Birthday Bake quest, which remains active until Friday, and spent time hanging out with the community. During the session, Heidi visited several community lands including 1171, 3752, 850, and 951, while Luke answered in depth questions about the future of Pixels and Stacked.

/>

* * *

### **Key Questions from the AMA**

**What is the role of the PIXEL token in Stacked? Why is it needed?**

PIXEL will continue as a reward currency in Stacked for a limited time. Over time, it will transition into a stake only token. Long term staking rewards are expected to shift toward USDC or USDT and will be tied directly to game performance.

* * *

**With Lootrush shutting down, could land rental be integrated into Pixels?**

While possible, the current focus is on exploring a more open source code base, allowing broader community contribution and flexibility.

* * *

**How should AI be used in Pixels?**

Luke emphasized that a game is a work of art and an act of love. Pixels does not use AI generated art because it already works with talented artists.

However, AI could be useful in development, particularly if the front end becomes open source. AI tools can help contributors build apps and software more efficiently.

UGC submissions are not rejected for being AI generated specifically. They are only rejected if they fail to meet quality standards.

* * *

**How will Stacked combat bots?**

Stacked will rely on large scale data science and historical data from Pixels to identify suspicious behavior. Offers will be highly personalized and precisely targeted, making bot exploitation significantly harder.

* * *

**How will Pixels onboard Web2 users more easily?**

Improving onboarding is now a top priority. The team first focused on building a sustainable economic model. Now that the foundation is stronger, attention can shift toward growth and simplifying the experience for mainstream users.

* * *

### **Community Feedback and Honest Discussion**

Some players expressed that the core product feels incomplete or lacks direction compared to Web2 crafting games.

Luke acknowledged that improvements are needed. Sustainability came first because building a fun game without a viable model is not enough. With the economic model performing well, the team can now dedicate more focus to features, progression, and overall game feel.

There were also discussions about long term progression, feature depth, and comparisons to traditional Web2 games. The key differentiator highlighted was earnings and ownership.

Pixels and Stacked combine gameplay with earning potential, which fundamentally changes player psychology and engagement. Not every player is motivated by earnings, but for many it adds an additional layer of value that Web2 games do not offer.

* * *

### **The State of Web3**

The broader Web3 and crypto space is currently facing challenges. Luke acknowledged that it is not the easiest environment to operate in. However, he reaffirmed strong belief in the Pixels ecosystem, its technology, and its long term potential.

* * *

Today’s AMA blended celebration with transparency. From birthday energy parties to deep economic discussions, the message was clear: the model is stabilizing, growth is the next focus, and the ecosystem is continuing to evolve.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: February 21 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g895e07d138a27775a76c47f29571623bcacc04694c8fe60abaf8f87349daee7207d36d38c82e7acc2e4579c25cb2011bead32e8897b70e4243c795c4676873f1_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día perfecto para caminar por la ciudad. El clima estaba fresco y soleado, ideal para disfrutar de las calles. Al salir, me crucé con un grupo de jóvenes artistas que estaban pintando un mural en una pared. Era impresionante ver cómo transformaban un espacio gris en una explosión de colores. Me detuve un momento a observar y conversar con ellos; me contaron que el mural representaba la diversidad de la comunidad y cómo el arte puede unir a las personas. Más adelante, conocí a una señora que vendía flores en un pequeño puesto. Tenía una gran sonrisa y me explicó la historia detrás de cada tipo de flor que ofrecía. Me gustó especialmente una orquídea morada que decía que simbolizaba la belleza y la fuerza. También disfruté de un café en una terraza cercana, donde pude ver a varias personas paseando a sus perros y a niños jugando en el parque. Sin duda, cada caminata es una nueva oportunidad para descubrir la vida vibrante de la ciudad y conectar con las historias de quienes la habitan. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_
