title.title: A GREAT NATION
title.body:
/>

[image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/nigeria-peace-hand-nation-2131332/)

My country is blessed with intelligent minds who make an impact all over the world in every industry, from finance and medicine to sports and beyond. Aside from being blessed with intelligent minds, my country is also blessed with abundant natural resources; it has rich deposits of many minerals, which contribute to the country's wealth. The country has a beautiful cultural heritage, hosting over 250 ethnic groups with beautiful cultural practices like their foods, style of dressing, dance and festivals.

One of the things I love about my country, Nigeria, is the unity we show when we are called to be united. I can remember many occasions when it might seem as if we are a divided people, but as soon as a world competition comes up, we all come together to support and cheer our country’s representative. We are always good at standing as a nation. Even on social media banters, where you will find a united Nigerian stand the most, we are ever ready to defend the country’s pride any day and at any time.

The people of Nigeria are a bunch of happy people; even in the midst of chaos, they always find humour in everything. Because of how religious we are, we are a hopeful people, always believing that there is a better tomorrow, despite the everyday hardship, an average Nigerian will always show up to work or the religious place with a heart filled with gratitude, believing that their tomorrow will be greater than their today. Hope is what keeps us as a country, and hope is what unites us even more.

The thing I don’t fancy about my country is the corrupt state of the nation, corruption started gradually at the grass root but has corrupted the hearts of most people in the nation, if you meet a young person today and ask about corruption some will tell you that it is only corruption when you are not in the benefiting side, but for as long as you get your own slice of it, it is no longer corruption. People who have longed to be in power to fight corruption tend to get corrupted so easily, as if to say it was all a propaganda to be allowed to serve, and instead of serving the majority, they tend to serve their beliefs when they get there, its like the seat of power is the problem correcting every individual or all along, it was what they have had in mind.

A major road leading to the capital city of my country is usually congested due to having a large population of workers who work in the capital city (Abuja) residing in that area. People have lamented and have gotten tired of complaining to the government to increase the width of the road or to just do something that will reduce the traffic congestion. This is serious because the traffic congestion created an avenue for thieves to rob others on the traffic. Just recently, the government has decided to build a better road in order to solve the traffic situation, making the journey to and from the city less exhausting and safer for the commuters. This is the current happening in my country that has my attention. Here in my country, it takes the grace of God for the ruling class to affect the lives of the poor. Most times, they put effort only because elections are coming, and once they are elected, it is back to normal business.

As much as we are united, we are sometimes divided by religion or ethnicity, which is the enemy of the progress of my country. My country is a great place, no doubt, but the greed of a few individuals is reflecting on the many; people go for my religion or my ethnicity even when it comes to politics, rather than going for the best candidate.

Thank you for reading. My name is@rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive Learners weekly Featured Content Week 205 Episode 03: “SOMETHING GOOD, SOMETHING BAD”.

body.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmdU1V8Eefmv5E77Ct6hNG8A3f9b75dZmVS6ZVvw5ynnrn/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=djbravo/c855d10e)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=djbravo/c855d10e)


---

Hi Wednesdaywalk and Threespeak Community. 

Whenever there is such beautiful weather, neither too cold nor too hot, all the beautiful parks in our city are arranged in this way. Different types of flowers are brought there so that people can come there and enjoy seeing them. Therefore, what I want to say here is that the time that is coming is special for all of us and we should enjoy it in the same way. 

Hola Comunidad de Wednesdaywalk y Threespeak.

Cuando hace un tiempo tan bonito, ni demasiado frío ni demasiado calor, todos los hermosos parques de nuestra ciudad se arreglan así. Se llevan diferentes tipos de flores para que la gente pueda venir y disfrutarlas. Por lo tanto, lo que quiero decir es que esta época que se avecina es especial para todos nosotros y debemos disfrutarla de la misma manera.

![PhotoCollage_1771624458131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbsddLv3XL5yUt7uET3VdD1b4HWhJ4vQpKQmozYSCCAz7/PhotoCollage_1771624458131.jpg)

The rush was quite high and here you all know that Ramadan has started. Some people may not know what Ramadan is called. So here I will tell you that this is a month in which all Muslims all over the world eat bread in the morning and then after that they eat in the evening after the Maghrib call to prayer. What is the purpose of this and why is this done? So here I want to say that there are many poor people in this world who eat less bread and do not have much money. 

Había mucha gente y ya saben que Ramadán ha comenzado. Algunos quizá no sepan cómo se llama Ramadán. Les cuento que este es un mes en el que todos los musulmanes del mundo comen pan por la mañana y luego por la tarde, después de la llamada a la oración del Maghrib. ¿Cuál es el propósito y por qué se hace? Quiero decir que hay mucha gente pobre en este mundo que come menos pan y no tiene mucho dinero.

So this month has been made so that we can also realize how difficult it is for these people. So this month has been made so that we can help them and learn their feelings. So here we also see that Zakat has also been mentioned here. This means that those who are rich give money to the poor and give them grocery. As long as we do not have feelings, there is no point in living in this world. 

Este mes se ha creado para que también nos demos cuenta de lo difícil que es para estas personas. Para que podamos ayudarlas y comprender sus sentimientos. Aquí también se menciona el Zakat. Esto significa que los ricos dan dinero a los pobres y les dan comida. Mientras no tengamos sentimientos, no tiene sentido vivir en este mundo.

It is through feelings that we love each other and respect each other. So what I am saying here is that after helping each other with feelings, we know how to live with each other. We must help each other in difficult times. That is why we are given one month in a year so that we can help each other all year long, feel each other, understand each other's problems, not to say that this person is lying, but we should know everything. 

Es a través de los sentimientos que nos amamos y respetamos. Lo que quiero decir es que, después de ayudarnos mutuamente con los sentimientos, sabemos cómo convivir.  Debemos ayudarnos mutuamente en tiempos difíciles. Por eso se nos da un mes al año para que podamos ayudarnos mutuamente durante todo el año, comprendernos, comprender los problemas del otro. No quiero decir que alguien mienta, sino que debemos saberlo todo.

![IMG_20260220_171752.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYrSt2qR1dtzrPkNbX3G8Txb7DVY8WfRy62XsDWoakFx/IMG_20260220_171752.jpg)

![IMG_20260220_171825.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQam43C7g49nkPYMbyoXzYjP2RcZLDhBaefEFZoa8nTL/IMG_20260220_171825.jpg)

There are definitely some people who take money by lying. Such people should not be given money at all. So, first of all, if we are helping anyone, then the first thing we should know is that that person is in need. Our religion here is much simpler and many things were told to us 100 years ago that we are now seeing happening in this world. This is the reality of this world that we all have to leave this world one day. 

Sin duda, hay gente que se aprovecha del dinero mintiendo. A estas personas no se les debería dar dinero en absoluto. Así que, ante todo, si ayudamos a alguien, lo primero que debemos saber es que esa persona está necesitada. Nuestra religión aquí es mucho más sencilla y hace 100 años se nos enseñaron muchas cosas que ahora vemos suceder en este mundo. Esta es la realidad de este mundo: todos tendremos que partir algún día.

Therefore, it is better that we all spend our time helping each other because some people cannot earn much money and some people are earning more. Helping each other brings blessings to our business and when we help each other, happiness is also greatly increased. It is better to help each other succeed than to envy each other. Time in this world is passing quickly and much more modern technology has emerged. 

Por lo tanto, es mejor que dediquemos nuestro tiempo a ayudarnos mutuamente, ya que algunas personas no pueden ganar mucho dinero y otras ganan más. Ayudarnos mutuamente trae bendiciones a nuestro negocio y, al ayudarnos mutuamente, la felicidad también aumenta considerablemente. Es mejor ayudarnos mutuamente a tener éxito que envidiarnos. El tiempo en este mundo pasa rápido y ha surgido una tecnología mucho más moderna.

People were enjoying this place a lot more now and they were also getting a lot more knowledge about different types of flowers. Everything was written about each and every flower here. 

La gente disfrutaba mucho más de este lugar ahora y también adquiría mucho más conocimiento sobre los diferentes tipos de flores. Aquí se escribía mucho sobre cada flor.

Here we will talk a little about the crypto market, as we do in every post. Here I want to say that are we in a bear market right now? Will the market remain down for another year? Here I want to say that when history does not repeat itself, no one can make predictions. Even now, most of the people who are telling things are lying so that they can keep getting views on YouTube and getting money. 

Aquí hablaremos un poco sobre el mercado de criptomonedas, como hacemos en cada publicación. Quiero preguntar: ¿estamos en un mercado bajista? ¿Seguirá el mercado a la baja un año más? Quiero decir que cuando la historia no se repite, nadie puede hacer predicciones. Incluso ahora, la mayoría de quienes dicen cosas mienten para seguir ganando visitas en YouTube y dinero.

That is why we should not watch them and we should watch and learn from a person with whom our heart is satisfied. Not every person is made a teacher. When there is a teacher, he teaches us many things in life. When we learn many things, then we gain a lot of knowledge about things. What I want to say here is that no one can predict the market correctly at this time because history is not repeating itself. 

Por eso no deberíamos dejarnos llevar por ellos, sino observar y aprender de alguien con quien estamos satisfechos. No todos son maestros. Cuando hay un maestro, nos enseña muchas cosas en la vida. Cuando aprendemos muchas cosas, adquirimos mucho conocimiento. Lo que quiero decir es que nadie puede predecir el mercado correctamente en este momento porque la historia no se repite.

Whenever history is not repeating itself in the market, whatever everyone is saying, most people's predictions are proving to be correct. What I want to say here is that if we start giving candles above 70,000, the market will look a little green to us and then we may see green for a few more weeks to come. If we do not get daily and weekly candles above 70,000, then the market will remain the same, it will come down, it will go up a little. 

Cuando la historia no se repite en el mercado, digan lo que digan, la mayoría de las predicciones resultan correctas.  Lo que quiero decir es que si empezamos a ver velas por encima de 70.000, el mercado se verá algo verde y podría seguir así durante algunas semanas más. Si no vemos velas diarias y semanales por encima de 70.000, el mercado se mantendrá igual, bajará y subirá ligeramente.

So what I am saying here is that there is still an opportunity for those people who do not know anything about this market. 

Todo esto continuará así durante un año y luego se confirmará que, una vez más, hemos entrado en un mercado bajista sin una temporada de altcoins. Esta vez, las personas han tenido más pérdidas que ganancias en este mercado porque la mayoría tenía altcoins y no tenía suficiente dinero para comprar Bitcoin o Ethereum. Por lo tanto, lo que digo es que aún hay una oportunidad para quienes no conocen nada sobre este mercado.

Otherwise, the altcoin season is completely over now and we should not invest in this way anymore. Otherwise, there will be losses. info.author: djbravo

content.description:
Hi Wednesdaywalk and Threespeak Community. 

Whenever there is such beautiful weather, neither too cold nor too hot, all the beautiful parks in our city are arranged in this way. Different types of flowers are brought there so that people can come there and enjoy seeing them. Therefore, what I want to say here is that the time that is coming is special for all of us and we should enjoy it in the same way. 

Hola Comunidad de Wednesdaywalk y Threespeak.

Cuando hace un tiempo tan bonito, ni demasiado frío ni demasiado calor, todos los hermosos parques de nuestra ciudad se arreglan así. Se llevan diferentes tipos de flores para que la gente pueda venir y disfrutarlas. Por lo tanto, lo que quiero decir es que esta época que se avecina es especial para todos nosotros y debemos disfrutarla de la misma manera.

![PhotoCollage_1771624458131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbsddLv3XL5yUt7uET3VdD1b4HWhJ4vQpKQmozYSCCAz7/PhotoCollage_1771624458131.jpg)

The rush was quite high and here you all know that Ramadan has started. Some people may not know what Ramadan is called. So here I will tell you that this is a month in which all Muslims all over the world eat bread in the morning and then after that they eat in the evening after the Maghrib call to prayer. What is the purpose of this and why is this done? So here I want to say that there are many poor people in this world who eat less bread and do not have much money. 

Había mucha gente y ya saben que Ramadán ha comenzado. Algunos quizá no sepan cómo se llama Ramadán. Les cuento que este es un mes en el que todos los musulmanes del mundo comen pan por la mañana y luego por la tarde, después de la llamada a la oración del Maghrib. ¿Cuál es el propósito y por qué se hace? Quiero decir que hay mucha gente pobre en este mundo que come menos pan y no tiene mucho dinero.

So this month has been made so that we can also realize how difficult it is for these people. So this month has been made so that we can help them and learn their feelings. So here we also see that Zakat has also been mentioned here. This means that those who are rich give money to the poor and give them grocery. As long as we do not have feelings, there is no point in living in this world. 

Este mes se ha creado para que también nos demos cuenta de lo difícil que es para estas personas. Para que podamos ayudarlas y comprender sus sentimientos. Aquí también se menciona el Zakat. Esto significa que los ricos dan dinero a los pobres y les dan comida. Mientras no tengamos sentimientos, no tiene sentido vivir en este mundo.

It is through feelings that we love each other and respect each other. So what I am saying here is that after helping each other with feelings, we know how to live with each other. We must help each other in difficult times. That is why we are given one month in a year so that we can help each other all year long, feel each other, understand each other's problems, not to say that this person is lying, but we should know everything. 

Es a través de los sentimientos que nos amamos y respetamos. Lo que quiero decir es que, después de ayudarnos mutuamente con los sentimientos, sabemos cómo convivir.  Debemos ayudarnos mutuamente en tiempos difíciles. Por eso se nos da un mes al año para que podamos ayudarnos mutuamente durante todo el año, comprendernos, comprender los problemas del otro. No quiero decir que alguien mienta, sino que debemos saberlo todo.

There are definitely some people who take money by lying. Such people should not be given money at all. So, first of all, if we are helping anyone, then the first thing we should know is that that person is in need. Our religion here is much simpler and many things were told to us 100 years ago that we are now seeing happening in this world. This is the reality of this world that we all have to leave this world one day. 

Sin duda, hay gente que se aprovecha del dinero mintiendo. A estas personas no se les debería dar dinero en absoluto. Así que, ante todo, si ayudamos a alguien, lo primero que debemos saber es que esa persona está necesitada. Nuestra religión aquí es mucho más sencilla y hace 100 años se nos enseñaron muchas cosas que ahora vemos suceder en este mundo. Esta es la realidad de este mundo: todos tendremos que partir algún día.

Therefore, it is better that we all spend our time helping each other because some people cannot earn much money and some people are earning more. Helping each other brings blessings to our business and when we help each other, happiness is also greatly increased. It is better to help each other succeed than to envy each other. Time in this world is passing quickly and much more modern technology has emerged. 

Por lo tanto, es mejor que dediquemos nuestro tiempo a ayudarnos mutuamente, ya que algunas personas no pueden ganar mucho dinero y otras ganan más. Ayudarnos mutuamente trae bendiciones a nuestro negocio y, al ayudarnos mutuamente, la felicidad también aumenta considerablemente. Es mejor ayudarnos mutuamente a tener éxito que envidiarnos. El tiempo en este mundo pasa rápido y ha surgido una tecnología mucho más moderna.

People were enjoying this place a lot more now and they were also getting a lot more knowledge about different types of flowers. Everything was written about each and every flower here. 

La gente disfrutaba mucho más de este lugar ahora y también adquiría mucho más conocimiento sobre los diferentes tipos de flores. Aquí se escribía mucho sobre cada flor.

Hoy la mirada se detiene en un parque que, para muchos, es simplemente un punto de paso. Pero para otros, para los que crecimos cerca, es memoria viva.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhNo7s9FYYcpe7SUsAEptsFoGbN5j5w2Q95SkigkkAwf/screenshot_20260220_075701_01.jpg)

El parque que muchos llaman todavía “Los Pinitos” está situado donde hace décadas estuvo la playa Los Pinos. Quien no lo vivió quizá no lo imagine, pero allí hubo arena, brisa directa, agua más cercana. El mar formaba parte inmediata del paisaje, no como fondo lejano, sino como presencia casi tangible.

Cuando era muchacho y estudiaba la secundaria, frecuentaba mucho ese parque. Estaba cerca de la escuela, y se convirtió en punto habitual de encuentro. En aquellos años en que existía la llamada “escuela al campo”, con jornadas de 45 días, ese era el lugar donde nos reuníamos para salir en las guaguas. Mochilas, despedidas breves, risas adolescentes, el bullicio previo al viaje. El parque era más que árboles y bancos, era expectativa.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJp1V2RBq57mZzMmjJtmPkBdbc1xSU4e6ktLcP42nA9J/screenshot_20260220_075651_01.jpg)

También allí estaba la parada de ómnibus que usaba para ir y regresar de la escuela. Ese detalle cotidiano termina marcando una relación profunda con un lugar. Uno no se da cuenta en el momento, pero los sitios donde esperamos también forman parte de nuestra historia.

A finales de los años 80 y principios de los 90 se construyó el viaducto, una obra que buscaba aliviar el tránsito por la vieja calzada y facilitar la conexión hacia la salida de La Habana. Fue una transformación importante para la ciudad. Sin embargo, el último tramo no llegó a completarse como se proyectó inicialmente.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTC9rNTz4HwTWGNFbwhEXdE2qDHqvzpHFCBh5pjKDPt9X/screenshot_20260220_075645_01.jpg)

Con el viaducto, el mar se alejó un poco del parque. No fue mucho, pero sí en sensación. Parte de aquella playa hermosa desapareció bajo la intervención urbana. Aún se conserva un tramo que sigue siendo bello, aunque más alejado y el paso del tiempo y la falta de cuidados lo muestran más vulnerable, más expuesto.

Quienes recordamos la playa Los Pinos recordamos también el olor salino mezclado con la sombra de los árboles, el sonido constante del agua, la luz reflejada en la superficie del mar. Realmente todo cambio, recuerdo cuando podías resultar bañado con una ola mientras viajabas en un ómnibus por la calzada. Hoy el parque tiene otro ritmo. Más tránsito. Más concreto. Menos horizonte abierto.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVH4HdP28US5ZoQBx5MXEZEMkXku6T7aC4FT7b1ZQfxb6/screenshot_20260220_075639_01.jpg)

En uno de sus espacios se levanta un monumento dedicado a Felipe Espínola y Travieso, mártir cubano vinculado a las luchas por la independencia. Su presencia allí recuerda que la ciudad no solo cambia por decisiones urbanas, sino que también se sostiene sobre la memoria de quienes entregaron su vida por ideales mayores. El monumento no es grandilocuente, pero sí firme. Está ahí como ancla histórica en medio del movimiento diario.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafSif9LFcHvem6cHpYvaDmQs3GokhUj6pd7VNGVjhnpR/screenshot_20260220_075632_01.jpg)

Este parque es una superposición de tiempos:

>la playa que fue,
la adolescencia que pasó,
la ciudad que creció,
la memoria que permanece.

Caminar hoy por Los Pinitos no es solo atravesar un espacio verde. Es caminar sobre capas de historia personal y colectiva. Es entender que las ciudades no pierden del todo lo que fueron; lo transforman.

El mar sigue ahí.
Un poco más lejos.
Pero todavía respirando cerca.

Esta serie seguirá siendo eso,
>miradas a lo cotidiano,
>a lo que pasa desapercibido,
>a lo que sigue ahí incluso cuando no lo nombramos.


Esta fue la septima mirada.
#### Nos vemos el próximo fin de semana  en otra mirada de Matanzas.

# English Version

## Matanzas in 100 Views #07
### Where the Sea Moved a Little Farther Away

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7y8r3KZ3rmgxybG1ayBQLjAQfDhCSaJWSMt5yti14Yz/screenshot_20260110_181801_01.jpg)

Hello #worldmappin community, once again I return to this community.
Today I continue with the series that is born from walking without hurry and looking with intention. 

This series is born from walking without haste and looking with intention.
Today the view stops at a park that, for many, is simply a passing point. But for others, for those of us who grew up nearby, it is living memory.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhNo7s9FYYcpe7SUsAEptsFoGbN5j5w2Q95SkigkkAwf/screenshot_20260220_075701_01.jpg)

The park that many still call “Los Pinitos” is located where Los Pinos beach stood decades ago. Those who did not live it might not imagine it, but there was sand there, direct sea breeze, closer water. The sea was an immediate part of the landscape, not a distant backdrop, but an almost tangible presence.

When I was a teenager in secondary school, I used to frequent that park a lot. It was close to the school, and it became a regular meeting point. In those years when the so-called “escuela al campo” existed, with 45-day work-study periods, that was the place where we gathered to leave on the buses. Backpacks, brief goodbyes, teenage laughter, the bustle before departure. The park was more than trees and benches; it was expectation.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJp1V2RBq57mZzMmjJtmPkBdbc1xSU4e6ktLcP42nA9J/screenshot_20260220_075651_01.jpg)

The bus stop I used to travel to and from school was also there. That everyday detail ends up marking a deep relationship with a place. You don’t realize it at the time, but the places where we wait also become part of our history.

In the late 1980s and early 1990s, the viaduct was built, a project intended to ease traffic along the old roadway and facilitate a faster connection toward the exit to Havana. It was an important transformation for the city. However, the final stretch was never completed as originally planned.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTC9rNTz4HwTWGNFbwhEXdE2qDHqvzpHFCBh5pjKDPt9X/screenshot_20260220_075645_01.jpg)

With the viaduct, the sea moved a little farther from the park. Not by much in actual distance, but in feeling. Part of that beautiful beach disappeared under urban intervention. A section still remains that is beautiful, though farther away, and the passage of time and lack of care show it as more vulnerable, more exposed.

Those of us who remember Los Pinos beach also remember the salty smell mixed with the shade of the trees, the constant sound of the water, the light reflected on the surface of the sea. Everything truly changed. I remember when you could end up splashed by a wave while riding a bus along the roadway. Today the park has a different rhythm. More traffic. More concrete. Less open horizon.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVH4HdP28US5ZoQBx5MXEZEMkXku6T7aC4FT7b1ZQfxb6/screenshot_20260220_075639_01.jpg)

In one of its areas stands a monument dedicated to Felipe Espínola y Travieso, a Cuban martyr linked to the struggles for independence. His presence there reminds us that the city does not change only through urban decisions, but is also sustained by the memory of those who gave their lives for greater ideals. The monument is not grandiose, but it is firm. It stands there as a historical anchor amid daily movement.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafSif9LFcHvem6cHpYvaDmQs3GokhUj6pd7VNGVjhnpR/screenshot_20260220_075632_01.jpg)

This park is a layering of times:

>the beach that once was,
the adolescence that passed,
the city that grew,
the memory that remains.

Walking today through Los Pinitos is not just crossing a green space. It is walking over layers of personal and collective history. It is understanding that cities do not entirely lose what they once were; they transform it.

The sea is still there.
A little farther away.
But still breathing nearby.


This series will continue to be that,
>looks at the everyday,
>at what goes unnoticed,
>at what is still there even when we don’t name it.

This was the seventh look..
#### See you next weekend in another view of Matanzas.

The images are my own, taken with my mobile phone, and the series cover was edited by me using Canvas and will accompany the whole series. For the English version I used the Google translator.

body.title: The Pride of Walking Through My Camagüey: A Reunion with My Roots [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEvuvR5ymViDDiQKbV7t8Qv4YWkAbxVaw6CmyZmgrxTd/1771640697240.jpg)




***
***
Sometimes, life accelerates so much that we forget to look around us, and it happens that amid the daily hustle, the worries, and the noise of the city, one forgets what is essential. Today, bored on an ordinary afternoon, I started looking at the photos in my phone's gallery, and suddenly, it was as if I had been hit by a gust of fresh air. Photo after photo, I saw myself on a bench in Agramonte Park, with the Cathedral in the background, others with my tired but happy feet on the cobblestones of República Street...
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSQUP2Rtop88fj7qb1hvTR54R2htq5vgzWd3zS1Ndt8w/1771640904950.jpg)


***
Then I realized, I am fascinated by walking through the streets of my Camagüey. It is not just the exercise or the destination I am heading to, but the act itself, that feeling under my feet of the cobblestones, worn and shiny from the passage of centuries and the generations that have made this city their home. It is a unique sound, that of shoes against the cobblestone, which immediately connects me to history, to the essence of being from Camagüey.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNc3i34Keib73c3jmomw3HSXtyB5cVfXAo8ncKZnZiZM/1771640905105.jpg)


***
I love sitting in its squares and parks. It could be the little plaza of La Caridad, with its more popular and bustling atmosphere, or the majesty of Agramonte Park, which is the heart that never stops beating. Sitting on a bench is not just about resting; it is about observing, watching the children play, the elderly converse, lovers gaze at each other, and vendors offer their gum or peanuts.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1oQXkUPrpBJzrgRzZ5kGLWLq6NXroYvY6Aj7YGhdKaw/1771640905187.jpg)


***
It is there, in those moments of stillness in the middle of walking, that I am overcome by an immense, deep feeling: the pride of being from here, from this city of tinajones and churches, of legends and people with character. It fills me with pride to know that I am part of this labyrinth of streets that find me and return me to who I am. Camagüey is not just the place where I live; it is also an extension of myself.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJt7QcSrkhWJgZvgZ1Urypu2iB1mapwc8sJ6zRQpWnR6/1771640905329.jpg)

***
Every corner has a story that the elders have told me, every old lamppost seems like a sentinel from other times. The columns of the arcades, the grilles on the windows, the bustle of the Avenida de los Mártires... all of it composes a symphony that reconciles me with my roots.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZKHntqebFA45dEBvVv9FAUqZQH6St1K4a24pbBkbbDg/1771641262224.jpg)

***
Reviewing those photos, I promised myself not to stop getting lost and finding myself in my walks, because when I walk through these streets, I am not just going from one place to another; I am honoring my history while feeling the pride of being Cuban, of being from Camagüey.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWsE1szZLAFb4Le56LpHEnyvMKamyaJUzurVzh1bUmHL/1771641262298.jpg)

***
At the end of the day, there is no greater luxury than sitting in a square in your city, taking a deep breath, and saying: \

<center>⛲</center>
<center>⛲</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1771641262345.jpg)

<sub>✨ **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** ✨  
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.  
𝑨𝒍𝒍 **𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒎𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏-𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒆 (𝒏𝒐 𝑨𝑰).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒊𝒈𝒏𝒆𝒅 𝒃𝒚 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
𝑳𝒐𝒗𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒕? **𝑼𝒑𝒗𝒐𝒕𝒆, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕, 𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈** 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔 𝒐𝒇 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒕𝒚! 💛</sub>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>El orgullo de caminar por mi Camagüey: Un reencuentro con mis raíces </center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTPZREjRrofrh8op1AdqMh5Wzox1V83Tu3ocnLyVaF5D/1771640697326.jpg)

***
***



A veces, la vida se acelera tanto que olvidamos mirar a nuestro alrededor, y sucede que entre el trajín diario, las preocupaciones y el ruido de la ciudad, uno se olvida de lo esencial. Hoy, aburrida como una tarde cualquiera, me puse a revisar las fotos de la galería de mi teléfono, y de repente, fue como si me hubiera llevado un golpe de aire fresco. Foto tras foto, me vi a mí misma en una banca del Parque Agramonte, con la Catedral al fondo, otras con mis pies cansados pero felices sobre los adoquines de la calle República.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSQUP2Rtop88fj7qb1hvTR54R2htq5vgzWd3zS1Ndt8w/1771640904950.jpg)


***
Entonces caí en cuenta, me fascina caminar por las calles de mi Camagüey. No es solo el ejercicio o el destino al que voy, sino el acto en sí, ese sentir bajo mis pies los adoquines, gastados y brillantes por el paso de los siglos y de las generaciones que han hecho de esta ciudad su hogar. Es un sonido único, el de los zapatos contra el adoquín, que me conecta de inmediato con la historia, con la esencia de ser camagüeyana.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNc3i34Keib73c3jmomw3HSXtyB5cVfXAo8ncKZnZiZM/1771640905105.jpg)


***
Me encanta sentarme en sus plazas y parques. Puede ser la placita de La Caridad, con su ambiente más popular y bullicioso, o la majestuosidad del Parque Agramonte, que es el corazón que nunca deja de latir. Sentarme en una banca no es solo descansar, es observar, ver a los niños jugar, a los ancianos conversar, a los enamorados mirarse y a los vendedores ofrecer sus chicles o sus maníes.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1oQXkUPrpBJzrgRzZ5kGLWLq6NXroYvY6Aj7YGhdKaw/1771640905187.jpg)


***
Es ahí, en esos momentos de quietud en medio del caminar, donde me embarga un sentimiento inmenso, profundo: el orgullo de ser de aquí, de esta ciudad de tinajones y de iglesias, de leyendas y de gente de carácter. Me llena de orgullo saber que soy parte de este laberinto de calles que me encuentran y me devuelven a lo que soy. Camagüey no es solo el lugar donde vivo, es además una extensión de mí misma.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJt7QcSrkhWJgZvgZ1Urypu2iB1mapwc8sJ6zRQpWnR6/1771640905329.jpg)


***
Cada esquina tiene una historia que me han contado los mayores, cada farol antiguo parece un vigía de otros tiempos. Las columnas de los portales, las rejas de las ventanas, el bullicio de la Avenida de los Mártires, todo ello compone una sinfonía que me reconcilia con mis raíces.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZKHntqebFA45dEBvVv9FAUqZQH6St1K4a24pbBkbbDg/1771641262224.jpg)


***
Revisando esas fotos, me prometí a mí misma no dejar de perderme y encontrarme en mis caminatas, porque cuando ando por estas calles, no solo estoy yendo de un lugar a otro, estoy honrando mi historia mientras siento el orgullo de ser cubana, de ser camagüeyana.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWsE1szZLAFb4Le56LpHEnyvMKamyaJUzurVzh1bUmHL/1771641262298.jpg)


***
Al final del día, no hay mayor lujo que sentarse en una plaza de tu ciudad, respirar hondo y decir: \

<center>⛲</center>
<center>⛲</center>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQA2nwFQo3sZ1vuEqgLphQMjgqrarqB5nhtG2BYMxCbV/1771641262377.jpg)

<sub>✨ **¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** ✨  
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒆ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
¿𝑻𝒆 𝒈𝒖𝒔𝒕ó 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂 𝒑𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒂𝒄𝒊ó𝒏? **𝑽𝒐𝒕𝒂, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒖𝒆𝒂** 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒂𝒚𝒖𝒅𝒂𝒓 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒓 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒂𝒔. 💛</sub>

body.body: >Unsplash 這兩天看到人家推薦太平年這部劇，在吃東西的時候點來看，想不到是我有興趣的歷史主題，而且還是比較少當題材的五代十國，之前只有在文字介紹中了解這段歷史，雖然知道大概，卻模模糊糊的。 像是主角所在的吳越，便是在看文字歷史時不曾注意的地方，其實維基百科裡面有寫，只是不曾想過這國如此特殊，若不是以戲劇的方式呈現，我也不會特別去深入了解。 目前看了前幾集，講一下我對此劇喜歡跟厭惡的劇情部分，有一段劇情是柴榮殺了一位領粥時不守規矩的流民，以達到殺雞儆猴之效，夜晚卻在祭拜這位流民，被主角錢弘俶冷嘲熱諷，他白天的時候就對柴榮處死這名流民感到不快。 劇中的柴榮說道，亂世之中人人有不得不為錯的時候，但心中需仍有是非對錯，不能因為幾次不得做錯後，就當作是對的，這段話我非常贊同，之前心裡也想過類似的東西，只是配合劇中的亂世場景，會有更深的感覺。 反過來看錢弘俶，在劇中表現的過於天真，不斷說著\

，坦白說是編劇的鍋，類似的劇情重複了太多次，讓我有對主角都產生反感了，兩三次也罷，被編劇搞得幾乎每集一兩次，讓人好不耐煩。

---

body.title: The 5 Unique Gifts You Have. Learn To Maximise Them
body.body:
>

A lot of people move through life believing that they are not specially gifted, maybe because they cannot sing or dance, or code, or play football like Ronaldo. But what they fail to understand is that everyone has unique gifts, which may be quiet, subtle, and often overlooked. Some of these gifts may not attract public applause, but they are very powerful, potent, and valuable. In order to achieve bigger success, you need to discover these gifts and then try to maximise them in the way that is required. Here, we shall be taking a look at these 5 unique gifts.

<center>![pexels-samsilitongajr-789555.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUiQCfjEDRaqbfD2NpTv45uf969JFxMiUhNntyyfsueAM/pexels-samsilitongajr-789555.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-in-black-hijab-headscarf-walking-on-field-789555)</sub></center>

The first gift on the list is the gift of influence. You may not stand on a stage to be an activist, or lead an organisation, but the fact remains that your words, actions, and attitude have ways of affecting people on a daily basis. The way you respond to situations, or the way you treat people, will send a strong message to others about who you really are. You will be surprised how your positive lifestyle can naturally influence people towards hope, discipline, and determination, without even you realising it. This is why you have to learn to act out the best side of you; speak calmly, act well, take responsibilities. All these count. Someone may be watching you, and your actions can be what will also determine the way they will act.

The second one is the gift of encouragement. Your ability to encourage and uplift others is a rare, yet very valuable gift. There are some people who naturally know how to say the right words at the right time to make someone feel better. Your gift of encouragement is what allows you to inspire hope, help to restore someone's confidence, and provide strength to people in difficult times. This is why you have to be intentional about how you speak and act towards people. Your words or your actions can actually make someone feel better, but they can also break someone if used wrongly. Learn to give people genuine compliment, offer constructive feedbacks kindly, speak positively. The truth is that encouragement can change the course of someone's life forever.

The third one is the gift of observation. There are some people who have quiet but very powerful ability to notice even the tiniest details. They can sense changes in mood, they can quickly identify problems even at the onset, they also recognise opportunities early. This kind of gift can be instrumental to prevent mistakes, create solutions, and improve one's decisions. To maximise this gift, you need to sharpen your awareness. Learn to listen more than you speak. Listen to understand, watch to see, and look beyond the surface. When you develop your gift of observation, you will discover that the solutions to problems are often lying side-by-side the problems.

<center>![pexels-olly-3769697.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTsX31X3VMddsdf5W1nTzvFQcQ85Wouwx1HFQwBSSuQ1V/pexels-olly-3769697.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-using-binoculars-in-between-stack-of-books-3769697)</sub></center>

The fourth one is the gift of adaptability. You will be surprised at what humankind can adapt to. Life can be unpredictable, so the ability to adapt and adjust without losing focus is a very powerful gift. Some have the ability to remain calm during changes, quickly learn new systems, and even adjust quickly to new environment. In this era where everything changes so quickly, this kind of gift is needed. In order to fully maximise this gift, you should be committed to learning. Also learn to see changes as tool for growth, not as a threat. You should also be flexible in your approach to life.

The final gift that we will look at here is the gift of resilience. You have the gift to recover even from a massive setback. But the question is, have you activated the gift? Resilience is the ability and inner strength that allows you to rise up from failure, disappointment, or rejection. It is your mindset of determination that will make you to convince yourself that \

even if the result you expect did not come. All these gifts may not be be loud, but they are significant, real, and valuable. When you discover them, develop them, and then use them consistently, they will improve the quality of your life. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.body:
I'm watching your video, and with the help of a translator, I think I've understood some of what you're saying, and I identify with your feelings.

I find it incredible that a platform like Hive still isn't valued as it truly deserves. If most people could understand how great this ecosystem is, they would realize that, unlike traditional social media, our time and effort are actually valued here. I understand what you're trying to express, and I've often wondered the same thing. 

I know we can't sell Hive as a gold mine because we tend to mislead people and make them believe they can come here and make money. I always try to tell those I bring to Hive, or those who ask me about it, that to be a content creator on Hive, you have to enjoy interacting, be consistent, and have the patience to grow and take things slowly. **But if they give it a try, it would be a wonderful experience.**

Regarding your point about inflation: offering a 50% reward to users is something you don't see anywhere else, and I personally think it's fantastic on Hive and has helped me a lot as a user to cover many of my daily expenses.

I also completely agree with you that attracting external advertising would be wonderful; it would be a great help, a good option, and I think it would attract investors and make Hive much more profitable for everyone active here.

I'm convinced that we need a strong community and to understand the harm done to many Hive users who aren't valued properly, while we see users being valued with automated votes who don't even interact with their own posts. This should be reviewed; we need to support those who are on Hive and contribute to its growth and consolidation.

Ultimately, that's the way forward: truly rewarding those who contribute real value and constant improvements to the community.

to become stronger as a community and try by all means to attract more users.

### This is my humble opinion and what I truly feel in my heart.

body.title: Glutes Focusing training
body.body: > Today my gym workout was pretty chaotic because it was so crowded and I couldn't use the machines I needed. I felt really frustrated about that today. I also woke up a little late, which put me in a bad mood. I tried to focus my workout on my glutes and did some hamstring exercises too. Lately, I've been feeling so disoriented and out of control, like everything's been shifting around. I'm going to work on improving so I can start next month off on the right foot. By the way, I did complete my 10k steps, but my watch didn't sync with my phone. ![IMG_8160.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZP1Jt2LdZjbueuM5zBMCjaP6Y7qftcE9NLLMMDbC3Uh/IMG_8160.jpeg) Versión español Hoy mi entrenamiento del gym fue bastante desordenado porqué había bastante gente y no podía utilizar las máquinas que necesitaba, realmente me sentí un poco frustrada de ese hecho hoy, también desperté un poco tarde y eso me tuvo también de mal humor. Traté de enfocar el entrenamiento en los glúteos e hice un poco de isquiotibiales también, últimamente me siento como tan desorientada y fuera de control, siento que todo se me movió de un lugar a otro, voy a trabajar en mejorarlo para iniciar mejor el próximo mes. ### ***Prezydent podpisuje ustawę o KSC i… odsyła ją do Trybunału***

Prezydent RP podpisał długo wyczekiwaną nowelizację ustawy o Krajowym Systemie Cyberbezpieczeństwa, dostosowującą ostatecznie polskie prawo do potężnej unijnej dyrektywy NIS2. Nowe przepisy drastycznie rozszerzają listę podmiotów uznawanych formalnie za kluczowe i ważne dla funkcjonowania gospodarki, nakładając na nie niezwykle rygorystyczne obowiązki w zakresie zabezpieczeń oraz błyskawicznego raportowania incydentów. Niespodziewanie jednak prezydent zdecydował się skierować ustawę do Trybunału Konstytucyjnego w trybie następczym, mając duże wątpliwości co do konstytucyjności trybu jej procedowania w parlamencie. Mimo to ustawa standardowo wchodzi w życie, co oznacza dla tysięcy firm konieczność błyskawicznego, pełnego audytu swoich polityk wewnętrznych oraz struktury IT. body.title: La peligrosa quietud de la indiferencia [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
_Saludos comunidad @holos.lotus_ 
 _Vivimos saturados, la vida cotidiana nos somete a un goteo constante de presiones, lo que falta, lo que urge, lo que no sale bien; las tensiones se van acumulando, por lo que algunas veces reaccionamos con exceso, con estallidos que luego podemos lamentar, otras veces la respuesta es más silenciosa y quizá por eso también más peligrosa._

 _Hay personas que de repente dejan de estar, no explotan no se enfadan, sino que sencillamente se convierten en alguien anestesiado, como una imagen proyecta una forma de la indiferencia, ese estado de neutralidad absoluta en el que nada provoca atracción ni rechazo, las cosas pasan la gente va y viene, los problemas se suceden y ahí está la persona inmóvil, como si la vida no le importara._

 _Esta especie de anestesia a veces proviene del desgaste, seres que llevan mucho tiempo luchando, sometidas a un oleaje constante de pequeños avances y grandes retrocesos, se esfuerzan, pelean pero cada vez que creen tocar tierra firme, algo las vuelve a hundir, llegando a un punto en que el cuerpo y la mente pueden decir: \

; entonces la indiferencia aparece como un escudo, un mecanismo de defensa para que la situación deje de doler, viene siendo como una especie de armadura del que ha sido herido muchas veces._\n\n _Ah! Pero no siempre es solo eso, la indiferencia también puede ser una decisión, aunque no lo parezca, es cuando la persona en lugar de seguir luchando, dice: \

y que pase lo que tenga que pasar yo no me involucro, una forma de concluir con un no me importa, no me duele porque no espero nada, por tanto no me decepcionare._

 >Greetings community @holos.lotus

 >We live saturated; daily life subjects us to a constant drip of pressures—what's missing, what's urgent, what's not going right. Tensions accumulate, so sometimes we overreact with outbursts we might later regret. Other times, the response is more silent and, perhaps for that reason, more dangerous.

 >There are people who suddenly just… stop being there. They don't explode, they don't get angry; they simply become someone numbed. Like an image projected, it's a form of indifference. That state of absolute neutrality where nothing provokes attraction or rejection. Things happen, people come and go, problems occur one after another, and there the person stands, motionless, as if life didn't matter to them.

 >This kind of numbness sometimes comes from burnout. Beings who have been fighting for a long time, subjected to a constant ebb and flow of small advances and major setbacks. They strive, they fight, but every time they think they've touched solid ground, something pulls them under again. Reaching a point where the body and mind can say: \

Then indifference appears as a shield, a defense mechanism so the situation stops hurting. It becomes like a kind of armor for one who has been wounded many times.\n\n >Ah! But it's not always just that. Indifference can also be a decision, even if it doesn't seem like it. It's when the person, instead of continuing to fight, says: \

Let whatever happens, happen; I won't get involved. A way of concluding with: I don't care, it doesn't hurt me because I e

 <center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2025/01/26/14/21/ai-generated-9360949_1280.jpg</center>

<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-mujer-resignaci%c3%b3n-9360949/)</center>


 _Ahora bien por malo que sea el estrés y dañinas resulten esas tensiones que nos desbordan, optar por la indiferencia puede ser peor, cuando una persona está estresada, al menos está peleando, está incómoda sufre se agota pero está en movimiento, de alguna forma esta tratando de superar la situación, de salir adelante y de cambiar las cosas,  está en el ring aunque le estén dando golpes, la indiferencia en cambio es sinonimo de resignación, mirar desde fuera y decir: \

, dejando de ser un sujeto activo de su propia vida para convertirte en espectador, apartando la movilización, y esto podría derivar en entregarse al problema, rindiendose ante él mismo._\n\n _Esta proyeccion en ocasiones nace del cansancio o decepción acumulada, cuando se ha intentado en varias oportunidades, hemos remontado determinadas situaciones para volver a caer, entonces humanamente es posible en algún punto decir \

, si esta acompañado de la ya mencionada  indiferencia, no es capaz de resolución alguna, al contrario puede perpetuar la cuestión. El estrés con todo lo molesto que resulta al menos nos llama a lidiar y resistir, en cambio la indiferencia nos invita a la resignación, a aceptar que las cosas son así y no pueden cambiar._\n\n _Y esa es una conclusión peligrosa, pues podemos alejarnos de la vida, inundados por la desesperanza, la desilusión, el \

; el camino para convertir algo en imposible empieza siempre con la indiferencia, cuando nos da igual que algo suceda o no, dejamos de empujar para que suceda, cuando nos da igual que una relación funcione, dejamos de cuidarla, si nos da lo mismo que determinadas cosas mejoren, estamos dejando de luchar por mejorarlas, obstaculizando posibles cambios o caminos, que contribuyan al crecimiento y avance._

 _En la vida sería prudente optar por una mejor decisión, por difícil que sea el momento, o dura que sea la contienda, aun si pesa mucho el cansancio, la opción tiene que ser de lucha, no una ingenua y ciega; hablo de negarnos a ser anestesiados, mantenernos activos, no entregar nuestra capacidad de acción, de seguir siendo aunque duela o cueste, ser  sujetos de nuestra propia vida, porque ella es movimiento y no parálisis; el estrés al menos, nos recuerda que aún sentimos, la indiferencia nos convierte en fantasmas, y entre sentir demasiado y no sentir nada, creo que podriamos preferir lo primero._

 >Now, as bad as stress is, and as harmful as those overwhelming tensions can be, choosing indifference can be worse. When a person is stressed, at least they are fighting. They are uncomfortable, they suffer, they get exhausted, but they are in motion. Somehow, they are trying to overcome the situation, to get ahead, to change things. They are in the ring, even if they're taking punches. Indifference, on the other hand, is synonymous with resignation. Watching from the sidelines and saying: \

Ceasing to be an active subject of your own life to become a spectator. Setting aside mobilization, and this could lead to surrendering to the problem, yielding to it.\n\n >This projection sometimes stems from accumulated tiredness or disappointment. When you've tried multiple times, you've overcome certain situations only to fall again. Then, humanly, it's possible to reach a point and say \

if accompanied by the aforementioned indifference, is incapable of any resolution. On the contrary, it can perpetuate the issue. Stress, as annoying as it is, at least calls us to cope and resist. Indifference, however, invites us to resignation, to accept that things are the way they are and cannot change.\n\n >And that is a dangerous conclusion. Because we can drift away from life, flooded by hopelessness, disillusionment, the \

The path to making something impossible always begins with indifference. When we don't care whether something happens or not, we stop pushing for it to happen. When we don't care if a relationship works, we stop nurturing it. If we don't care whether certain things improve, we stop fighting to improve them, hindering possible changes or paths that could contribute to growth and progress.

 >In life, it would be prudent to choose a better decision. No matter how difficult the moment, or how hard the struggle, even if the tiredness weighs heavily, the choice must be for struggle. Not a naive or blind one; I'm talking about refusing to be numbed. To stay active, not to surrender
our capacity for action. To continue being, even if it hurts or costs us. To be subjects of our o
wn lives, because life is movement, not paralysis. Stress, at least, reminds us that we still feel. Indifference turns us into ghosts. And between feeling too much and feeling nothing at all, I believe we could prefer the former.

body.title: [Español-English]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcune4x8pq3U1sFYZTGhUn9Vyy5y9jDnyEG5eGzSWSVw/1771651779716.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-portrait-pose-style-4605248/)

Un saludo muy cordial para todos los amigos de nuestra Comunidad @holos-lotus. Hoy quiero conversar con ustedes sobre un tema que se mete en la vida de muchas parejas y que, si no se atiende, termina por arruinar lo que pudo haber sido una historia bonita. Me refiero a la celotipia, esa mezcla de inseguridad y baja autoestima que se disfraza de amor pero que en realidad es miedo, miedo a perder, miedo a no ser suficiente.

Hace un tiempo atendí a una paciente que llegó con el corazón hecho pedazos. Me dijo: “Doctor, soy un fracaso en mis relaciones, siempre termino perdiendo y sé que la culpa es mía”. Yo lograba visualizar lo que me contaba, lograba imaginarla, pletórica de inseguridad, revisando teléfonos, sospechando de cualquier demora, imaginando historias de infidelidad inexistentes. Ella misma reconocía lo irracional de su conducta, pero ya era tarde: las relaciones se habían desgastado hasta romperse. Y lo más duro era el duelo posterior, lleno de reproches contra sí misma, como si no mereciera amar ni ser amada.

Este caso me hizo pensar en Otelo, aquel personaje de Shakespeare que se dejó arrastrar por los celos hasta la tragedia. Y de ahí el título de este escrito: “Oh Otelo sal de mi senda”. Porque si dejamos que los celos gobiernen, terminamos repitiendo esa historia de dolor, aunque en escenarios más cotidianos y menos teatrales. La raíz del problema no estaba en la pareja de mi paciente, sino en su propia percepción: una autoestima baja que la hacía sentir insuficiente, reemplazable, siempre en riesgo de ser abandonada.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbvMVPyXL77bfzkFyvmuFrE8NJAQWWBmRfBWhYpeXbAv2/1771651884153.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/william-shakespeare-othello-poster-67765/)

La inseguridad es un enemigo silencioso. Se mete en la relación disfrazada de cuidado, de preocupación, pero en realidad es una herida que no ha sanado. Cuando alguien no se siente valioso por sí mismo, busca constantemente pruebas de que el otro lo quiere, y en ese afán de comprobarlo termina ahogando la relación. Es como querer agarrar el agua con las manos: mientras más aprietas, más se escapa.

Lo que ocurre es que la persona insegura no logra disfrutar del amor en paz. Vive anticipando traiciones, imaginando problemas, creando fantasmas que terminan siendo más reales que la propia relación. Y lo más triste es que, en su intento de evitar perder a la pareja, termina provocando justo lo contrario: distancia, desgaste y ruptura. Es un círculo vicioso que se repite una y otra vez.

En el caso de mi paciente, cada intento de control generaba más rechazo. Él buscaba espacios de libertad, ella lo interpretaba como señales de engaño, y así se alimentaba la rueda del sufrimiento. Romper ese patrón no depende de que la pareja dé más pruebas de fidelidad, porque el problema no está en el otro, está en uno mismo. Es un trabajo de autoconocimiento, de aprender a mirarse con otros ojos, de sanar las heridas que hacen sentir que no valemos lo suficiente.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU1SP9f4Ngf4yuiakCV1JqNbkTQeuK1KMBiz3JBBtkZ1/1771652288251.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-face-wall-view-eyes-228178/)

Siempre digo que para tener una relación sana primero hay que tener una relación sana con uno mismo. La seguridad, la confianza y la autoestima no se construyen desde afuera, sino desde adentro. No es la pareja la que debe convencernos de que valemos, somos nosotros quienes debemos reconocerlo. Y cuando eso ocurre, el amor deja de ser un campo de batalla y se convierte en un espacio de crecimiento compartido.

La historia de esta paciente es la historia de muchos. No es un fracaso que una relación termine, el fracaso es no aprender de ella. Cada vínculo nos deja huellas, nos muestra rincones de nuestra propia vida interior que quizás no habíamos mirado, y nos da la oportunidad de transformarnos. El amor, cuando se vive con conciencia, es como un maestro que nos enseña a reconocer nuestras heridas y a trabajar en ellas. No es un espejo repetido, es más bien una ventana que se abre hacia lo que todavía podemos mejorar de nosotros mismos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDHk9g5disnyNdXqxqG5HRRQbgNdB4s9MpJQseCMJKrj/1771652098933.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-model-beard-pose-expensive-8030463/)

El amor no es refugio para nuestras inseguridades, es un espacio para compartir desde la libertad y la confianza. Cuando entendemos eso, podemos construir relaciones más sólidas, más plenas, más humanas. Así que, amigos, si alguna vez sienten que los celos los están gobernando, recuerden a Otelo y díganle: “Sal de mi senda”. Porque el amor sano no se basa en el control ni en el miedo, sino en la capacidad de acompañar al otro mientras cada uno sigue creciendo en su propio camino. Y ese camino, aunque a veces sea difícil, siempre vale la pena recorrerlo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGi5itFjQsMumBqfmH2LZCXonYxQbCo6bCAySuB9qFyj/1771652173924.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-pose-style-curly-hair-3116587/)

***
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKgYj7Dr19acMrFU1Psbe6LNDZZnf6sa6eqynSXj2NUf/1771652441707.jpg)

***

English Version 

\

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcune4x8pq3U1sFYZTGhUn9Vyy5y9jDnyEG5eGzSWSVw/1771651779716.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-portrait-pose-style-4605248/)

A very warm greeting to all the friends in our @holos-lotus Community. Today I want to talk with you about a subject that often sneaks into the lives of many couples and, if left unattended, ends up ruining what could have been a beautiful story. I’m referring to jealousy—this mix of insecurity and low self-esteem that disguises itself as love but is, in reality, fear. Fear of losing, fear of not being enough.

Some time ago, I attended to a patient who arrived with her heart in pieces. She told me: “Doctor, I’m a failure in relationships. I always end up losing, and I know it’s my fault.” I could visualize what she described, imagine her, overflowing with insecurity, checking phones, suspecting every delay, inventing stories of infidelity that didn’t exist. She herself admitted the irrationality of her behavior, but by then it was too late: her relationships had worn down until they broke. And the hardest part was the grief afterward, filled with self-reproach, as if she didn’t deserve to love or be loved.

This case made me think of Othello, that Shakespearean character who let jealousy drag him into tragedy. And that’s where the title of this piece comes from: “Oh Othello, step out of my path.” Because if we allow jealousy to rule, we end up repeating that story of pain, though in more everyday and less theatrical settings. The root of the problem wasn’t in my patient’s partner, but in her own perception: a fragile self-esteem that made her feel insufficient, replaceable, always at risk of being abandoned.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbvMVPyXL77bfzkFyvmuFrE8NJAQWWBmRfBWhYpeXbAv2/1771651884153.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/william-shakespeare-othello-poster-67765/)

Insecurity is a silent enemy. It sneaks into the relationship disguised as care, as concern, but in reality it’s an unhealed wound. When someone doesn’t feel valuable on their own, they constantly seek proof that the other loves them, and in that desperate attempt to confirm it, they end up suffocating the relationship. It’s like trying to hold water in your hands: the tighter you squeeze, the faster it slips away.

What happens is that the insecure person cannot enjoy love peacefully. They live anticipating betrayals, imagining problems, creating ghosts that become more real than the relationship itself. And the saddest part is that, in their attempt to avoid losing their partner, they end up provoking exactly the opposite: distance, wear, and rupture. It’s a vicious cycle that repeats itself over and over.

In my patient’s case, every attempt at control generated more rejection. He sought spaces of freedom, she interpreted them as signs of deceit, and thus the wheel of suffering kept turning. Breaking that pattern doesn’t depend on the partner offering more proof of fidelity, because the problem isn’t in the other—it’s within oneself. It’s a process of self-knowledge, of learning to see oneself differently, of healing the wounds that make us feel unworthy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU1SP9f4Ngf4yuiakCV1JqNbkTQeuK1KMBiz3JBBtkZ1/1771652288251.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-face-wall-view-eyes-228178/)

I always say that to have a healthy relationship, you first need a healthy relationship with yourself. Security, trust, and self-esteem aren’t built from the outside, but from within. It’s not the partner’s job to convince us of our worth; it’s ours to recognize it. And when that happens, love stops being a battlefield and becomes a space for shared growth.

My patient’s story is the story of many. It’s not a failure when a relationship ends; the failure is not learning from it. Each bond leaves traces, reveals corners of our inner life we may not have looked at, and gives us the chance to transform ourselves. Love, when lived consciously, is like a teacher that helps us recognize our wounds and work on them. It’s not a repeated mirror, but rather a window opening toward what we can still improve in ourselves.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDHk9g5disnyNdXqxqG5HRRQbgNdB4s9MpJQseCMJKrj/1771652098933.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-model-beard-pose-expensive-8030463/)

Love is not a refuge for our insecurities; it’s a space to share from freedom and trust. When we understand that, we can build stronger, fuller, more human relationships. So, friends, if you ever feel jealousy taking over, remember Othello and tell him: “Step out of my path.” Because healthy love is not based on control or fear, but on the ability to walk alongside another while each continues growing on their own journey. And that journey, though sometimes difficult, is always worth taking.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGi5itFjQsMumBqfmH2LZCXonYxQbCo6bCAySuB9qFyj/1771652173924.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-pose-style-curly-hair-3116587/)

***
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWHJ9gyJbuUxJ63Y7jv5yAqvrnbtr4bXfgvDD3U1z8jZD/1771652801882.jpg)

***

body.title: From Facing Life’s Toughest Moments to Embracing New Beginnings – My Story of Family, Filipino Flavors, and Growing Alongside All of You (My Introductory Post)
body.body:
![1_20260221_131121_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23vsbWFJM29kGQDjj4Dubwg7AP6D1Li4CU3ZMHKQejm47fK8oiCVD7YjHfrbDRVtrEpjR.png)


 
Hey everyone here on Hive! A big warm hello to each and every one of you so glad i’m finally getting around to introducing myself properly here.
 

![3_20260221_131122_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23vsYzEvNjyRT7g7wbsn82UJ1jZEhoXmCd2gWUXooYjY8uopKJFLAzpQFpPer24J4KaWb.png)

 
My name’s Marlyn Abella, and o just turned 58 last month. You know how life goes one minute you are chasing after little ones and trying to keep up with their crazy schedules and the next thing you know you are counting gray hairs and reminiscing about the old days. I have got four kids total and let me tell you being a mom has been the biggest blessing and the hardest job i have ever taken on. Each of them is so different from the other one’s a nurse another runs a small sari-sari store near our place the youngest is still in college studying education. They keep me busy, that’s for sure!
 
![7_20260221_131122_0006.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23uR7YZeoHd1DFJrExe1n8Y3C5FEySQYEGAXQYG8fXPiJwv5yrMpy9BvyVE7eBXgYKCA4.png)

 
But i had be lying if i said everything’s been sunshine and rainbows. A few years back, we lost my eldest child to kidney disease. It was… well there’s really no easy way to say it  it broke our whole family apart for a while. We tried everything we could  countless doctor visits medications even looking into transplant options but sometimes life just does not go the way we plan. Some days are still really tough, especially when i walk past their old room or catch a whiff of their favorite dish being cooked somewhere. But i have learned that grief does not ever really go away  you just learn how to carry it with you like a heavy bag you have gotten used to slinging over your shoulder.
 
![2_20260221_131121_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23wMabX9DxXZVju1FxCz8m9vi2k9HBen7wJSBSvDAtreGYAx8Hjsja2VjUcyBLe3ZBEX4.png)

 
I want to give a huge thank you to @jocabanero4 she is the one who really pushed to get me on here. I found out about Hive from her and my youngest daughter she’s always telling me i need to find ways to connect with people and share my stories instead of just sitting at home watching TV all day. At first i thought “Me? On the internet? I can barely figure out how to use my smartphone without their help!” But they sat down with me showed me how things work and here i am now.
 

![6_20260221_131122_0005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23xevMUm2ivGhqVXLLpY9rWUxsK6wNNJ5fps2dusVYkZnk35TCf12u9N3iM6jYPg3jDBn.png)

 
I have always loved cooking Filipino food you name it i can probably make it. Adobo, sinigang, kare-kare my kids say my lechon kawali is the best they have ever tasted. I’m also really into gardening i have got a little plot in our backyard where i grow tomatoes eggplants and some herbs. There’s something so peaceful about getting your hands dirty and watching things grow from tiny seeds. Maybe  i will share some of my recipes or gardening tips here if you guys are interested?
 

![4_20260221_131122_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/23wqtjwv3wEJB2giCPfqnkvB1NprVV8KTErgLKmHzyFjDzzSxwfrUKxdFmp1RRo7mZxoA.png)

 
I’m not exactly sure what im doing here yet still figuring out how to navigate everything  but i know i want to meet new people hear about your lives and maybe even help someone out if i can. Life’s taught me that we all need each other especially when times get tough. So if you have got a story to tell or just want someone to talk to feel free to drop me a message. I promise i will do my best to write back  even if it takes me a little while to type everything out properly!
 
![5_20260221_131122_0004.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/serram007/243zfi2Gd7i39iUyhjhtmtLDVBamr6nrPrsxKAid691W9TRqhMHubmz1SqPAFPbTWXwQk.png)

 
Looking forward to getting to know all of you better. Here’s to making new friends and sharing good times and even the not so good ones together..

Hope you like my story, till my next journey God bless 🙏

body.title: Resumen de mis últimos días || Summary of my last few days
body.body:
![1000784239.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23x1FYS5egmYKySkMKcUkDtQFnJow1UYGkxc32MYLu65XJEBspvnGYznQjGjmxVWwSQPL.png) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Les cuento que hemos estado del timbo al tambo y han pasado muchas cosas en mi vida los últimos días. No se imaginan cuanto. Hay un proyecto enorme que se nos está dando que luego cuando estemos viviéndolo se los contaré, y también han pasado cosas bastante particulares. ¿Se acuerdan de lo que les conté hace días, que logré resguardar los conejos de unos vecinos? Pues haberle rescatado esos conejos marcó un antes y un después. Desde que tuve el primer contacto via telefónica sabía que todo iba a cambiar y dos días después de haberle entregado los conejitos recibí un mensaje. Era esa vecina ofreciéndome un plato de comida, supongo que en agradecimiento por haberles cuidado a los conejitos. La verdad fue súper sorpresivo todo pero le recibí con gusto el gesto y pues la verdad es que estaba bien sabrosa la comida. Dividí el plato en 3 y lo acompañe con otra cosa. Ese fue nuestro almuerzo de ese día.

Hi everyone!

I wanted to tell you that we've been incredibly busy lately, and so much has happened in my life these past few days. You can't imagine how much. There's a huge project coming up that I'll tell you about when we're really getting into it, and some other unusual things have happened too. Remember what I told you a few days ago, about how I managed to rescue some neighbors' rabbits? Well, rescuing those rabbits was a game-changer. From the first phone call, I knew everything was going to change, and two days after I handed the bunnies over, I received a message. It was that neighbor offering me a plate of food, I suppose as a thank you for taking care of the bunnies. It was all a total surprise, but I gladly accepted the gesture, and the food was really delicious. I divided the plate into three and had something else with it. That was our lunch that day.
![1000784238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wgQ19pgknJwaYfLSuMBHWJVzXXvcvRvB1JHhA51bFrFNHDC3jX7ce23WZVVhDExmoL4.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png) ![1000784236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23y8t1FZezAnbtwNir2gaQNspidS7Fo773SNvKAoCjTj9FYwukncFXaku4anVPTQrT6eT.jpg)
Hemos seguido con las clases como de costumbre y en la última recibí un regalo de San Valentín por parte de una de mis alumnas. Como no nos vimos ese día ella tuvo el detalle de guardarlo hasta que nos vimos. Esta clase de detalles los aprecio muchísimo. También estuve haciendo las compras de unas franelas para unos encargos que tengo. Espero poder comenzar pronto con ellos.
We continued with classes as usual, and in the last one, I received a Valentine's Day gift from one of my students. Since we didn't see each other that day, she thoughtfully kept it until we could meet. I really appreciate these kinds of thoughtful gestures. I was also shopping for some t-shirts for a few orders I have.
![1000784235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsQptotPQuw85HdAQ7SWvy6YGBK42vjDddzV57BPjH3MEcUKg9sXXFDM19GGe48NUw5.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png) ![1000784234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/242YCN4L7ZYKwDRstoPVg8dhzwHXbUuTvN1thprCCLHKSBfLrfzt9Vw7UbHuPJH4chg9N.jpg)
He trabajado fuertemente en el negocio y actualmente estamos trabajando en nuestros uniformes. Se me ocurrió que una buenísima opción sería que los alumnos pinten ellos mismos sus franelas y esto los ha tenido súper emocionados. El miércoles fue la primera clase y mañana será la próxima con el otro grupo, ya pronto les contaré que tal nos fue en ese primer día de trabajo. Y lo que siento que más cambio nuestras vidas en los últimos días es que adoptamos una perrita. Desde que cuidamos los conejitos quede con muchas ganas de traer una mascota a casa y justo a mitad de semana revisando unos estados en WhatsApp vi que estaban dando en adopción la perrita. No me pude resistir y dije que la quería y pues después de una aventura la traje a casa. Luego les daré más detalles de esto. Por ahora me despido porque debo despertar dentro de 4 horas para ir a trabajar. 🤭🥹
I've been working hard on the business, and we're currently working on our uniforms. I thought it would be a great idea for the students to paint their own shirts, and they've been super excited about it. Wednesday was the first class, and tomorrow is the next one with the other group. I'll tell you soon how that first day of work went. And what I feel has changed our lives the most in the last few days is that we adopted a puppy. Ever since we took care of the bunnies, I've really wanted to bring a pet home, and right in the middle of the week, while checking some WhatsApp statuses, I saw that they were giving the puppy up for adoption. I couldn't resist and said I wanted her, and after a bit of an adventure, I brought her home. I'll give you more details about that later. For now, I'm signing off because I have to wake up in 4 hours for work. 🤭🥹
![1000784233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23ynWTX6JVWRmkHh7wFBuiRhTfDJQUQD2QuGh6ekETVUsLA8zTTRvgLPa1hdWb3V4k6W6.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
