body.title: First choir rehearsal with Canticum Merú 💖🎹[ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the Lifestyle community. Today I'm joining you to share another day in my life. This time, I want to tell you about my first day with the Canticum Merú choir, the most beautiful women's choir in Guayana, which I was fortunate enough to join just a few days ago. Our rehearsal was on Thursday, and I was super excited, thinking about a lot of things, including how everything would go and what I needed to do. Before leaving, I got things sorted at home and work so I could arrive on time. Again, it was a beautiful day, full of sunshine and blue skies.

\n\n>

>Saludos a todos en la comunidad de Lifestyle. El día de hoy me uno por aquí para compartir con ustedes un día más en mi vida. En esta oportunidad quiero enseñarles cómo me fue hoy en mi primer día en el coro de Canticum Merú, el coro femenino más bonito de Guayana y del cual tuve la dicha de poder entrar hace apenas unos días. El día jueves fue nuestro ensayo y estaba super entusiasmada por ello, pensando en un montón de cosas sobre cómo iría todo y que debía hacer, pero antes de irme arregle las cosas en mi casa y trabajo, para poder llegar puntual a la hora del ensayo. Nuevamente, fue un día muy bonito, lleno de sol y cielo azul.

![IMG_20260219_181026641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23y92TSff9iaHAZ83uvNya5uaat45wsPiFTkqGEVgdWCj8H5pP6pFkevA3z4MfdanL85T.jpg) ![IMG_20260219_195318241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23tRv7PzM1n8DRjYE5uS83AjtVrALYCStohDda27nwqrtKxzsF3MThADRneBCJ53DStRv.jpg) ![IMG_20260219_194927542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23uQkLv6c7bx3k4HpK3s6Tat83GYvETXnqZCcbRRGLhpZe6BJgdq4VghKXZp5D88rfqC7.jpg) ![IMG_20260219_205031587_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/23w2yasqxnLXgacqZSh3KcfqzSs9eNZBdLrKeX8L7dKeBu7DQbgEcFLPvcxhkmXAft8N3.jpg)

>I was happy and a little nervous about how it would all go, but to be honest, from the moment I walked into the academy for my audition, I felt comfortable and at ease. I don't know if it's because the teacher is so kind or because everything made me feel so welcome. So I got to know all my fellow choir members, who were all so kind and lovely. Some of them have been with the choir since its founding, which will celebrate its 31st anniversary on March 29th. We started with physical warm-up exercises (a little stretching here and there), then vocal exercises (they were great and I was able to warm up my voice a bit), and then we began with the repertoire they're working on. The teacher surprised everyone with the score for Lacrimosa from Amadeus, so everyone was happy.

\n\n

>Since I was new, I had to listen to several of the pieces first and I recorded some parts, so that later at home I could listen carefully and see what my lead singer pointed out. I'm with the sopranos, and she's very patient, by the way, and she showed me how to use the score and pay attention to everything. She even gave me her score for Lacrimosa. I have it here with me and I'll make an effort to learn everything, because they all really work very hard to make the choir something beautiful, high-quality, and professional. We finished late, and luckily, I received a payment with which I could eat some hot dogs, which I hadn't had in weeks. So enjoy your meal! Lots of things are coming, and I'll be sharing them with you here. That's all for now, thank you so much for stopping by.

\n\n>

>Yo iba contenta y un poco nerviosa por cómo sería todo pero para ser sincera, desde el primer momento en que entré en la academia, cuando me tocó hacer la audición, me sentí cómoda cómo confortable y no se si es porque la profesora es muy gentil o porque todo el conjunto de cosas me hicieron sentir bienvenida. Así que fui conociendo a todas mis compañeras del coro, quiénes fueron muy amables y lindas. Algunas están desde la fundación del coro, el cual el 29 de marzo cumplirá 31 años. Empezamos con ejercicios de calentamiento físico (estirar un poco aquí y allá), luego vocalizar (estuvieron muy buenos y pude despertar un poco mi voz) y comenzamos con el repertorio que ellas están trabajando. La profesora me dió una sorpresa a todos con la partitura de Lacrimosa de Amadeus, así que todas estaban contentas.

\n\n>

>Cómo yo era nueva, varias de las piezas las tuve que escuchar primero y grabé algunas cosas, para ya luego en casa escuchar con atención y ver lo que mi jefa de cuerdas me hacía notar. Estoy con las sopranos y ella por cierto es muy paciente y me enseñaba cómo guiarme con la partitura y estar pendiente de todo. Incluso me regaló su partitura del Lacrimosa. Aquí lo tengo conmigo y haré un esfuerzo por aprender todo, pues realmente todas trabajan muy duro para hacer del coro algo bello, de calidad y profesionalidad. Terminamos tarde y por suerte, recibí un pago con el que me pude comer unos perritos calientes que tenía semanas sin comer. Así que bien provecho. Se vienen muchas cosas y por aquí se las estaré mostrando. Sin más que decir, muchísimas gracias por pasar por aquí.

![Thank You for stopping by_20251222_235935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carminasalazarte/EqQRuBXhDFu9VJKoUi9KYBHi1fizexq9zibK9463CkCj7BCiSq9HsujVhAP8Vem6kgg.png)

body.title: Trading Aluminum for Silver (kind of)
body.body:
![Aluminum 4 silver cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/23u6DR8dv4qSRZEajcMS5AQemcaKAjA7tHLbrLNT4Urkx2CyBDf72ybrAtdBjWNzFSk5M.jpg)

For this weeks [Show Us Your California](https://peakd.com/mycalifornia/@thesocalhive/show-us-your-california-contest-week-295) contest by @thesocalhive I headed to the recycle center and ended up...

#
Trading Aluminum for Silver (kind of)!
![socalhive divider.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXrocoFcozQcGBtDzy5HDP8qN1xbDaFLyF3Wugedqre1h/socalhive%20divider.png)
I had been saving up my aluminum cans for awhile and I had a couple big trash bags full so I decided to make a trip down to the recycle center. I went to San Bernardino Recycling which is connected to the Jimmy's food store (which is really just a liquor store) because they usually seem to pay pretty well. But on this day what I didn't yet know was that they were going to pay even better than usual. I dragged over my bags of cans and emptied them into the baskets and then waited in line. There was an old man in front of me who was trying to recycle all kinds of non-recyclable plastic and they were making him go through his baskets and pull it all out. So I had to wait for a bit, but before long it was my turn. They threw my baskets up on the scale and then gave me my voucher to take into the store to get my money. I took it in and gave it to the cashier. He came back with my payment and when he put it in my hand I immediately noticed a silver dime in the change. Being a person who is very much into precious metals it was obvious to me, but as I looked back up at the cashier I could tell he had no clue and I wasn't going to say anything. So I just put the money in my pocket and smiled and thanked the cashier and then headed out to my truck. Once in my truck I immediately pulled the dime out of my pocket to check it out and it turned out to be a 1945 Mercury Silver Dime which is also commonly referred to as the Winged Liberty Head Dime and is composed of 90 percent silver which is just over .072 troy ounces of silver which at todays current silver prices is worth about $6! It's got quite a bit of tarnish, but it's still a beautiful piece and I was beyond stoked to have been lucky enough to get it. Needless to say I felt like I really got an extra great return on my aluminum cans this time!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/EnqR62JX6WiziR6SKxWxFS4WeqEtk4m8eMSsorwGHsG78WL4wR9BB8XCkRaUWzwQzDX.jpg) Jimmy's Food Store
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/Epta21dQYiUP1XMHdSc96WewbTke29G9kgzk8YUaQEqwZzV7Kg3m6uhAhuAEaj9V739.jpg) San Bernardino Recycling
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/Eo8SMQMWZnhjBL1LKDx5n1zz4j14zhMUoi9HkXwdPtJ8q7EVjkx3mB24GHYyMeY3vQi.jpg) Getting paid
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/Eo8SMQvCmYJC3Lxc9dzS3UrbdADbDXJ1wSxRS6yjBj3V8aqzhLgFCsFCB6BhDBoqfvz.jpg) 1945 Mercury Silver Dime (front)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/derekrichardson/Eo6JxDWdUtY5fCkJh6dp4GRStXPrHuZF7mE8ejcN6iN9YqmYSr3rfGifkE6uxVpgxF1.jpg) 1945 Mercury Silver Dime (back)

And so until next time...

title.title: Unbelievable moments.
title.body:
It's over 10 years this particular incident happened but it still sends shivers to my spine whenever i remembers it.
   One day i ajd my friends were coming from a rehearsal from church we were laughing chatting whilst trekking on the long dusty narrow road.
    A lady was ahead of us, just a stone throw. All of a sudden the lady disappeared into the thin air was nowhere to be found.
For a moment it seemed like a movie we couldn't believe it, we intended to run but it seemed our leg go struck.
We walked closely to each other, we intially wanted to run but on the second we decided to walk close to each other past the long lonely road.
 Immediately we cut off to the next road,we ran as fast as our legs could carry us.

When we reached home we started narrating the ordeal, people didn't believe us. Some said it was ghost, some said it was juju, someone even said that it was our mind that was playing tricks on us.
  
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUn2U38FTyKAt2ZtmWRxv3GVHmm3bxYF1h28c4Z56wfdK/1771648633308.png)

Truly that event that took place was one of this kind,scary and terrific. I'll share another with you
   
When we're much younger, we were washing plates under a shade and that day it was raining cats and dogs. My elder sister suddenly started saying \

But I couldn't see anything. she pointed the palm tree directly opposite us, i saw a animal that has glowing skin as light with pure black eyes, the moment my elder sister pointed at the direction of this strange creature, a loud thunder stroke towards our shade.
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBNycgLF3MWq3u7BwutrNGkD1WYXhTmQ7GS2Kny1bxUg/1771648633397.jpg)

As children we shouted and ran into our house shouting and crying.
  That particular scene gave me nightmare for weeks. Indeed it wasn't just scary but a horrible one. Most times i still remember them because even as they really happen it's just too real to believable.

title.title: Coffee Anyone? ☕️…….My Actifit Report Card: February 20 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71771639674.5525599) Coffee anyone? I had noticed in my Starbucks app, that this week through tomorrow, they were offering zero delivery fees on drinks and food orders. Yesterday, I mentioned this to Lisa, my coworker and she said let’s do it. So today, around noon, she customer ordered our coffees and a sweet treat for us both through the app and took advantage of the free delivery. Neither she nor I had ever done delivery through the app. Given the busyness of the day, this was an especially nice treat when it arrived. What we learned from the experience-despite free delivery, you are still charged tax on that delivery fee. Prices overall are just a bit higher than ordering in person. Also, there has to be another tax of some variety levied due to the total of sales tax in the order. Despite the extra cost, it was a nice break for there is not a Starbucks in Everson. title.title: The chaotic days that followed/その後の雑多な日々
title.body:
It feels relatively warm today, even though February isn't over yet. There's barely any snow. This worries me in itself. I'm not Greta Thunberg, but I'm sensitive to the climate crisis. What if there's a water shortage in the summer?

The Japan Independent Exhibition is being held in Roppongi, Tokyo, next month. My oil painting this year is an abstract, done with oil paints I received as a keepsake from the late chairman of the Sakujitsu-kai. It's small, too. Since I developed osteoarthritis in my knees, it's become difficult for me to paint, which is why I've shifted to abstract painting. I forgot to take a photo before sending the work, so there are no images.

I had piroshki at a nearby bakery again today. It's become a ritual. If money weren't a problem, I'd like to have lunch at the Italian restaurant on the Hachiman Co-op campus every day.

The other day, I was talking about the constant errands I have to run: with my helper, visiting my father, and meeting with the visiting nurse. I somehow managed to get through it safely.

 This was the second time the helpers came, and they continued cleaning my room and did a little cleaning of the toilet.

This was the first time I went alone to visit my father. We weren't a very close family, but those memories are now gently in the past, and my father's expression has mellowed. He has given the go-ahead for the demolition of his family home, a place he so longed to return to. That's right, our family home will be demolished at the end of March. We will no longer have a home to return to.

The visiting nurse also came. My temperature, oxygen level, pulse rate, and blood pressure were all fine. I take a lot of medication, so she helped me adjust them.

The only other thing I'm concerned about for the time being is attending the Miyagi Anti-Nuclear Demonstration Rally at Nishikicho Park on March 1st. My knees are feeling relatively well today, probably because it's warm, and I hope it stays that way on the day of the rally.

今日は比較的暖かいような気がします。まだ2月終わっていないんですが。積雪がほとんどない。これはこれで心配です。スウェーデンの環境活動家グレタ・トゥーンベリさんではないが気候危機に敏感なものですから。夏に水不足になったらどうしましょう。

東京は六本木での日本アンデパンダン展が来月にありますが、今年は朔日会の故会長の形見分けでもらった油絵の具を使って描いた抽象画なんです。サイズも小さい。変形性膝関節症になってから絵を描くのもつらくなって、それもあっての抽象画へのシフトです。作品を送る前に写真を撮るのを忘れてしまい、画像はなしです。

今日も近所のパン屋さんでピロシキを食べました。もう儀式と化していますね。金銭的に問題なければ、毎日八幡生協敷地内のイタリアンのお店でランチしたいと思ったりします。

さて、先日はヘルパーさん、父の面会、訪問看護師さんと用事が続く話をしました。なんとか無事に乗り切りました。

ヘルパーさんが来るのは2度目でしたが、部屋の掃除の続きとトイレを少し掃除してもらいました。

父の面会は初めて1人で行きました。私たちはあまり仲の良い家族ではなかったけど、その記憶も優しく過去のものとして去り、今は父の表情は角がとれて丸くなりました。あんなに帰りたがっていた実家の解体にゴーサインを出したわけですから。そうです、3月末に実家は解体されます。もう帰るおうちはなくなります。

訪問看護師さんも来ました。体温、酸素濃度、脈拍、血圧と問題ありませんでした。私はたくさん薬を飲んでいるので薬のセッティングを手伝ってもらいました。

あとは3月1日の錦町公園での脱原発みやぎデモの集会のみ参加が当面、気になる用事です。今日は暖かいせいか比較的膝の調子がいいですが、集会当日もそうだといいなと思います。

![20260220_091630.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyb6y9fwzMjR7A4LVTJyNDw6Yy1qXGnFwpP8u95TSBqK/20260220_091630.jpg)

title.title: A moment of the day spending time with my friend. 💖
title.body:
![IMG_8860.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EpA3YcPXvsrB7oN3DbW2KsoQLSsa11DVYr5v2fBuGz3RkKbfbLjCTnkNzXaDEWm3cps.jpeg)

***
Hi everyone! Today I'm sharing another small activity I've had in the past few days. As I said, I haven't been going out much lately, so I've been feeling bored and down. One day, I received a message from a friend asking me to come along to a birthday party for her child's friend, which was being held in town. She wanted me to sit and chat while the kids finished their activities.
***

![IMG_8854.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EowG8EFaZXfoFtRoSd7NRXQjUa1eJXnu9RKjAUL2nLhxneNmLUCeAPpV5XyjzQ5xveN.jpeg)

![IMG_8873.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EoCi7JC42BdjTkddDDdZUNXBweCV8X9ByHLHkXa5v3mUjqtFJ3PjRMzN1JVGsWWMZHs.jpeg)


***
Honestly, I wasn't really keen on going; I felt a bit awkward since it was a child's birthday party and I didn't know them personally. But my friend insisted, and besides, it was just a kids' activity, and we could do other things while we waited, like chatting. So I decided to go, agreeing to be her companion.
***

![IMG_8862.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EopqtwDTapityyKgeRomHMvQ9QchYzPS8Nhbr3w66HrrNs36x6qhrPS2F59TL2fobGP.jpeg)

***
At the appointed time, my friend drove to pick me up at my house, and we went. The kids started their activities, which included bowling, divided into teams. We adults just watched from a distance. They had the activities set up in steps; first, they handed out snacks to the kids, and then they went bowling.
***

![IMG_8872.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/Eou9cbboXwHCF5vq1fBk4oPkCb7q1B6cmn49DDZ69xcD6ZittfY2SEtKBbpYLVhM9D2.jpeg)

***
While waiting for the kids, my friend and I bought some beer. There was nothing to worry about; the kids were having fun playing, and we just sat and chatted while watching them from afar.
***

![IMG_8858.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EoChi8TTHQJkNLRwKwXbKneJtHKNp8fx26HrVC6UC6iERtyMv2iEhjaDRAoGuDJ5mC7.jpeg)

***
We spent about two hours, which wasn't long at all. It was an evening activity after the children played games, then they blew out the birthday candles and opened presents. It was a fun activity for the children, and for us, seeing them play made us happy too.
***

![IMG_8859.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23wgRrEuyRq9UFTQ8odxsanRerSohqmyDHS16YVtZm5FxwaVftx3612n5pVDxfUkZi3Jx.jpeg)

***
And this is another moment for me, an activity I got to participate in. I'd never seen anything like it before, not because I have children, but because I could only watch and smile happily. I hope everyone enjoys my photos and story. Thank you for following and have a great day!

title.title: SPS Governance Proposal - Don't Change PP Values
title.body:
SPS Governance Proposal - Don't Change PP Values


Purpose

The purpose of this proposal is to address a recent announcement made by @yabapmatt that the team was planning to adjust the PP (land production points) of cards to match Chaos Legion once the sets rotate out of modern. There has been occasional speculation about this for quite some time, since the Rebellion PP numbers were initially announced, but some community members feel that this adjustment is not needed, and there hasn't been clarity on the point until now. This proposal will determine if we'd like to stop the team from making that change and essentially maintain the baseline PP at 0.5x Chaos Legion card's PP value going forward.

Proposal

If this proposal passes, the community would formally request that the PP values of cards do not change when rotating out of the Modern format. All future sets should operate with a base PP (production points) multiplier of 0.5x the baseline value established with the Chaos Legion set. It will be assumed no changes need to be made in regards to PP values going forward unless another proposal is passed to change these guidelines.

title.title: Judit Polgar - The Queen of Chess
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToccd9tWrHYYxwE3VPbBZ6VRo7FXVrbFFj9k121uDPkW/image.png)
source: chessbase.com

The Queen of Chess currently on Netflix. It's a documentary film that tells the story of Judit Polgar, a Hungarian chess grandmaster who is the strongest female chess player in history. She was a child prodigy trained along with her older sisters under a unique educational experiment by her dad. She broke into the world’s elite at an early age. In 1991, at just 15 years old, she became the youngest ~~female~~ grandmaster in history at the time, surpassing Bobby Fischer's record. Unlike most top female players, she competed primarily in open tournaments rather than women tournaments. She faced and beat the world’s best male players. She defeated multiple world champions, including Gary Kasparov and Magnus Carlsen and reached a peak ranking of World No. 8.

In 1999, she beat future World Champion Vishwanathan Anand in a beautiful game. At the time, Anand was one of the top players in the world and a candidate of becoming World Champion. Beating him in a sharp Najdorf Sicilian was a major achievement.

The game started with 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 a6

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKk6L45Vhqw9Dro8PddSiBV6EEvu93WcUU5fJ9CsK27c/image.png)

The Najdorf Sicilian, one of the most combative responses to White's e4 6. Be3 e6 7. g4 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSiHNNMA49uczHGohmDbe57vJvVdnmpvhxoM83KzEhcUz/image.png)



Judit is known as an aggressive player and she shows it even against an elite like Anand. g4 is the Keres Attack, intending to storm Black's King side early. 7. ...e5 8. Nf5 g6 9. g5 gxf5 10. exf5 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJf5WpqUMbEG9PRLJA2awaPFtrJUByRGjEQNoVTjaNF5/image.png)



Sacrificing a piece in the opening in exchange for a direct attack on Anand's King. 10. ...d5 11. Qf3 d4 12. O-O-O Nbd7 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLK6ZGDysRfZLu1A5k4cJmr8zXv2cZEFr4FGsR84fgqU/image.png)

Judit didn't recapture the Knight on f6 but focused on development. Meanwhile, Anand's King is still stuck in the center. 13. Bd2 dxc3 14. Bxc3

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQR8ux6vy8JNTSgNMCmAGnXD5WCJXJ1n3qEKEjbE5vGpj/image.png)

Giving up another piece! 14. ...Bg7 15. Rg1 O-O 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQoCEwJH4ToHij3D2PgKrk7P2brvDT4YmnaNhd6wtyXBd/image.png)

Anand opted to castle rather than save his Knight via the g8 square. But Judit's attack is still on fire. 16. gxf6 Qxf6 17. Qe3 Kh8 18. f4 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHN45AWu49RVFSUyEjjtLbpC7p7QLobzJRy9a3PmoYQk/image.png)

Pressure on the a1-h8 diagonal along with the g file. Although Anand is up a piece, Judit has the initiative. 18. ...Qb6 19. Qg3 Qh6 20. Rd6 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbaQCEQnJKdbVoFUU7SSTEtRtmRbGm8RU7FbuaViDk3NZ/image.png)

Judit's pieces are active and coordinating in the attack. Anand's are still in the back rank. 20. ...f6 21. Bd2 e4 22. Bc4 b5 23. Be6 Ra7 24. Rc6 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNgjD2mSkYjFkr2BzwhumaEXMBfC5oc8yYu6RS6Wxgiun/image.png)

Not easy for Black to untangle himself from this position. In spite of the piece deficit, White is already winning. 24. ...a5 25. Be3 Rb7 26. Bd5 Rb8 27. Rc7 b4 28. b3 Rb5 29. Bc6 Rxf5 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoeo27ThcuXsm5YepaCT3HLsjpWTqbRL1pdHRQqp3dsq/image.png)

Now White can recover her material while keeping the advantages in her position. Black will be left with an exposed King. 30. Rxc8 Rxc8 31. Bxd7 Rcc5 32. Bxf5 Rxf5 33. Rd1 Kg8 34. Qg2 1-0

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaD5K1rGePycbo5x465GHbHva1pEqDTxWKHYvg1GGc72Y/image.png)

Judit was threatening to attack Black's exposed King. At this point Anand has had enough and threw the towel.

Game link: https://lichess.org/d9l464mF#0

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHVSP1DND7kdWvBkmY3VZQqhFM4pLyhqEJRoYJTuxnjg/image.png)


Playing chess is great for the mind but let's not forget about physical activities. I recently committed to exercise and to keep me motivated, I joined actifit.io

title.body:
i have always viewed any vehicle as a wealth dump and so many people I know buy well out of their price range in some sort of poor effort of flexing wealth that they don't actually have.   I have always found car payments, large car payments, to be one of the biggest drains on the working class and it is very effective.  There are these places here in the states that intentionally target people with horrible credit ratings and rope them into really terrible long-term payments plans that they are definitely going to default on.  There is a huge industry that revolves around repossessing these cars with a drive by tow truck operation and there are video channels that make a circus out of this for internet points.   

One side of me feels bad for these people who are being targeted, but another side shrugs its shoulders at how they are the victims of their own stupidity.   

For me, I have always had a rather crap looking car that is functional.  I have only ever owned a brand new car once, and that was a very basic sedan and the only reason I bought it was because the US car industry was in the toilet and every company was offering 0% financing.   It was nice owning a brand new car sure, but there wasn't really any benefit beyond the initial glee of that wonderful new car smell.   

I disagree about property not being an asset though.   But this is only if you aren't a slave to the payments.   Now that I am in the clear with my property I am just angry that we as a society have accepted that the government is allowed to tax you to have property.  There is some talks about abolishing land/property taxes and that would be wonderful.

title.title: Why People Take Less Love Than They Deserve
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVD4GSf68tgaM4VzTdooQcje3G4Ze6435z9AYq4BkdfRX/img_7761.jpg)


[source](https://pin.it/10L1sKGoS)










*I know that some of us may have been wondering or even asked ourselves this question so many times but just cant find an answer. Love is very hard to explain or understand as it is a thing of mystery, i have been in love before and i recommend being in love with someone that loves and respect you.*


*Most people do not accept less because they are unsure of their value thats also how fear sets in. Now they are afraid so they accept less, they now love being alone and at the same time  they are afraid to start over. 
In many relationships people are already fed up but for some reason they still stay, sometimes the reason they stay is because they are afraid this might be the best they will ever get. They leave when it feels like it is more than they can handle not because they're really happy.*

*We ignore warning signs. Think they are just phases. We remember the times so we make excuses for bad behavior and then we start hold ing on to the hope that things will get better of which it never happens in most cases because those signs are behaviours that are already part of the other person. At some point in time we start to get used to it and we become more patient or  try to understand more, until we realize we have been settling for less. It takes time to get used to less, It happens very slowly. Then suddenly you get used to things not being right.*




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbvMpZfLbGTd4fahAfG7DjQEQdqyzas39MVCCExvJVRH/img_7762.jpg)

[source](https://pin.it/6S03vIb0G)


*Love should not be something that confuses you all the time. 
When you are only asking for things it should not feel like you are asking for too much. True love is safe. It is not perfect. It is not dramatic. It is just safe. You can talk safely. You can tell the truth safely. You can be yourself without having to prove it all the time. A lot of us prefer to know what we are getting even if it is not good than taking a chance, on something unknown.*

*To walk away is to trust yourself.. After spending  a lot of time feelings and memories that can be scary.. Eventually you get tired. Tired of expressing your feelings? Tired of lowering your standards? I am tired of being thought of too much. Then it hits you. Love was never supposed to make you feel like you are too much. You were never too much.*




***Thank you for reading***

title.title: A Helpful Guide To Choosing A Reliable Dispensary Near You That Is Open Late
title.body:
Finding a trustworthy dispensary that meets your needs can sometimes feel overwhelming, especially when you’re searching for “[dispensaries open now near me](https://nectar.store/).” Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned consumer, knowing where to go and what to look for can make all the difference. Dispensaries open late or even 24/7 are a blessing for those who have busy schedules or need access during unconventional hours, but reliability is just as important as convenience. A good dispensary should not only be accessible but also licensed, reputable, and stocked with quality products. Checking reviews online and asking for recommendations from friends or local communities can provide valuable insights into which dispensaries maintain high standards in both product selection and customer service.



![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/2037ecedf4a91a98b4adbccb0deb70b217632c63cd4206f289eaa8df2a804543)



Location is a crucial factor when choosing a dispensary, as proximity can save you time and make frequent visits more manageable. Many dispensaries now offer online menus, curbside pickup, and delivery services, which adds a layer of convenience. However, being close to a dispensary that is licensed and regulated ensures that you are getting products that meet safety standards and quality controls. In addition, reputable dispensaries employ knowledgeable staff who can guide you in selecting products that suit your preferences, medical needs, or recreational intentions. Asking questions about strains, potency, and consumption methods can help you make informed choices while avoiding products that may not be suitable for you.

Product variety is another essential consideration. A reliable dispensary typically carries a wide range of products including flower, edibles, concentrates, tinctures, and topicals. This allows customers to explore different consumption methods and find what works best for them. Checking for lab-tested products and transparent labeling is important, as it ensures the potency, ingredients, and safety of what you’re purchasing. Many dispensaries also offer promotions or loyalty programs, which can make regular visits more rewarding. Understanding return policies and customer support practices is also key; a dispensary that stands behind its products demonstrates accountability and builds trust with its clientele.

Ambiance and environment should not be overlooked, as they contribute to the overall experience. A clean, well-organized space with friendly staff creates a comfortable atmosphere where customers feel welcome and respected. Dispensaries that prioritize customer experience often provide educational resources, from product guides to workshops, ensuring that even new users feel confident in their choices. Safety is another crucial factor; reliable dispensaries maintain secure payment methods, comply with local regulations, and store products responsibly to prevent mishaps.

Lastly, staying informed about local laws and regulations surrounding cannabis use is essential. Each state or city may have different rules regarding hours of operation, delivery restrictions, and legal consumption limits. A knowledgeable dispensary keeps customers up to date and ensures that all transactions are legal and compliant. By considering location, product quality, staff expertise, safety, and legal compliance, you can confidently choose a reliable dispensary near you that is open late and meets your needs, making your cannabis experience both safe and enjoyable.

---

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g1989520c711d54311284abdaddfc5380419417f1bb4a7d122508b256b4dce45cabf34544415906c70a8ed308c149c8da4cd16f760c36437a19989af0589e9ce4_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 探索城市中的自然

在现代城市生活中，钢筋水泥的建筑和繁忙的街道常常让我们忽视了自然的存在。然而，城市中其实隐藏着许多自然的美丽，等待着我们去探索和发现。本文将带你走进城市中的自然，寻找那些被遗忘的角落。

## 1. 城市公园的魅力

城市公园是人们接触自然的最佳场所。无论是晨跑、遛狗还是家庭聚会，公园都提供了一个放松身心的环境。你可以在公园里：

- **观察鸟类**：带上望远镜，寻找栖息在树上的各种鸟类，聆听它们的歌唱。
- **享受花卉**：春天的花朵竞相开放，夏天的绿树成荫，秋天的落叶缤纷，冬天的雪景如画。
- **参与社区活动**：很多公园会定期举行自然教育活动、生态讲座和志愿者清理活动。

## 2. 城市绿化的创新

随着可持续发展的理念深入人心，越来越多的城市开始重视绿化。以下是一些城市绿化的创新举措：

- **屋顶花园**：在高楼大厦的屋顶上种植花草，不仅美化环境，还能降低城市热岛效应。
- **垂直绿化**：在建筑外墙上种植植物，形成“绿色墙面”，提升空气质量。
- **社区花园**：鼓励居民共同参与，利用闲置土地种植蔬菜和花卉，促进邻里关系。

## 3. 自然步道的探索

许多城市都开辟了自然步道，供人们在城市中徒步或骑行。你可以：

- **发现隐秘的自然景观**：沿着步道行走，可能会发现小溪、湖泊或隐藏的花园。
- **进行健康活动**：步行或骑行不仅能锻炼身体，还能让你更好地与自然亲密接触。
- **拍摄自然美景**：带上相机，记录下城市中那些美丽的自然瞬间。

## 4. 自然与城市生活的结合

在城市中，我们可以通过一些简单的方法将自然融入日常生活：

- **室内植物**：在家中或办公室摆放一些绿植，净化空气，提升心情。
- **自然教育**：参加城市中的自然课程，学习关于植物、动物和生态系统的知识。
- **支持本地农产品**：购买当地农民的有机产品，支持可持续农业，享受新鲜的自然味道。

## 结语

城市中的自然并不是遥不可及的梦想，只要我们用心去发现，就能找到那些美丽的角落。让我们一起走出家门，探索城市中的自然，重新连接与大自然的关系。你最喜欢城市中的哪个自然景观呢？欢迎在评论区分享你的故事和体验！

title.title: Our habit is to disturb the natural beauty with the boisterousness of small families gathering together side by side
title.body:
On that calm morning, nature seemed to open its arms wide. Rows of tents stood neatly on the still damp ground, surrounded by shady green trees. The air feels fresh, carrying the aroma of leaves and earth combined in simple harmony.

In front of a simple blue tent, we sat side by side. Smiles and laughter flow warmly, becoming their own color among the green nature. The togetherness that exists is not just about sitting close to each other, but about the feeling of comfort that grows from the simple habit of telling stories, sharing and enjoying time without rushing.

In the distance, the soft boisterous sounds of families gathered together could be heard, adding to the liveliness of the atmosphere without disturbing the peace. Nature is a witness that happiness doesn't always have to be luxurious, just a simple tent, cool air, and a sincere smile that strengthens each other.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5vNWUYZ3i9Psso3UeU5XrUVCdjoqU6NeuDy4TVzwjCo/1771647026288.jpg)

title.title: The Unthinkable: Surviving Multiple Operations.
title.body:
This is something people find hard to believe when I tell them about it. And believe me, it's not as if I talk about it that much, reason being that it's not something words can fully comprehend, and also because I hate being pitied or seen in a different light. So, I kind of don't feel that comfortable sharing it.



![1000718616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xyZHpezaXQyqtSmrvcdP28iyZDCvZnBkDqsuTHzoq48xUMRXTZEAcV3t8cmZWjurh1m.jpg)



Even still, I can't deny that it's something I had to undergo, just that it happens to be something that makes the few I tell say, *\

* And a whole lot more.


So, I was sick for sometime and the sickness forced me to let go of my education. I had to undergo several operations, yes. And when I say several, I'm not talking about one, two, not even five or six.....don't let me scare you by counting. Though, not all were major surgeries, some were minor surgeries, but the major ones outnumber the minor ones. But then, each and every one of them took a toll on me.



![1000089710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/EpLeXqH8kVcTvEYyrAg91rb5zzDjK2aUpqpg4Du2vqzM6w5dj1iZJLEAGju2vKa6fgn.jpg)



One of the reasons why it's unbelievable is because, mine was the first in my country and in the whole of West Africa(as said by my doctors). Back then, I was told they've never done it before and that it's done mostly when the patient is still a child, not an adult like me. But as an adult, I had to undergo it.


![1000058251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8yoouSGv9uGZWTamndiq37KhLRm8qTnvV9hCjQ2bJjmJSffhn1wW6xwzW1wY4BjwJY.jpg)


During the course of all of this, I as well had to undergo an operation without getting anesthesia. Yes, there was one of the operations that needs to be done urgently, and because of how tight things were in the hospital then and considering my situation, they had to go ahead with it. Not as if they didn't try giving me something to ease or not feel the pain, but none of it was working. And I couldn't be put to sleep because the operation requires that I would be changing positions and do certain things.



It's hard to believe that I had to undergo those things, but it's real. I get different reactions from people, some even say maybe I'm exaggerating things, they never knew I haven't/didn't even gone/go deep into things. But then, it is understandable, I know of about three people who had few operations as well and aren't balance till now.



![1000718716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1000718716.jpg)


But  here I am, if I don't tell you, you won't know. It's not something you can notice by just looking at me. After I healed, I continued my life and went back to school, I never see it has something to brag about, life came at me, yes, it's unbelievable, yes. But I survived, and here I am.


🌹

Images are mine.

Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.

title.title: Holding Zone 3 - My Actifit Report Card: February 20 2026
title.body:
End of the week finally arrived and it was another busy day as I was set at my desk early this morning as I caught up on things given the busy day yesterday. I did not get a chance to go for an early walk but knew I would have a challenge in the afternoon at my weekly gym GTX class. First, I did have to prepare for it with good energy by way of some meals. I kept the protein up and had a banana for some carbs half hour before the gym visit. The GTX class was one of the most challenging I have done in a while. I was suspicious when I first saw the workout blocks as the incline while in Zone 2 was a recipe to be in Zone 3. After the first interval, I was consistently in Zone 3 for workout. It lasted through the floor routine with weight lifting as it was also a challenge. I think this will serve as a good routine for my weight routine as well. title.title: Crispy Snow Cireng/Snow Tapioca Fritters
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8s9kK2zny5us5hvAckEFaL4erEXuCCG57x9pAHHSABR/1771642352165.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, happy weekend everyone. Today I'm going to share our traditional food that looks like snow, has a crispy and chewy texture, and is dipped in spicy soy sauce sambal, making it a perfect flavor combination. Okay, let's get started. 

**Ingredients:**

- 200 grams of tapioca flour 
- 1 spring onion
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder 
- 1/2 teaspoon ground pepper
- a pinch of salt 
- 100 ml water


**Steps:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWQij8kCGhTVCxV8rhZEFGw2aXkUVPXjEx6Zhh6GBkZr/1771642437816.jpg)

- Put 3 tablespoons of tapioca flour and chopped spring onion into a pan 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVbE3x14kK87JRqT6rM3Hb2uSAB9SBP62Cip75cGQqwcf/1771642564996.jpg)

- Add garlic powder, salt, and ground pepper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXzzES8Aj4CkV8rjeEyYyUJcUDR8gzAPUrdeCynFeupQT/1771642600975.jpg)

- Add water to the pan

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQpzwJbJaXKdtuSa6WbpDcqm1Gbd7Vn6sQqP9v2GgeBV/1771642648105.jpg)

- Stir until the mixture is blended 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXzRAFiPjazHUkoprmUWAX3EhQvCCBZSqnhfaERkP2AHv/1771642701784.jpg)

- Turn on the heat and cook over low heat

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2nzLCvqZPvVkPSV1WdNKByHrq66iFVSz1wnevQ9cD83/1771642725285.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWK9jqJz5fN2SMLuhaoakPTXgvMPiYp468Fg4pv9PLXiU/1771642725455.jpg)

- Stir until the mixture thickens and becomes clear like this 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSYMeEREPZvNMFnwwK4pMVscexfavhWMSchKRH9cnixo/1771644329500.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZyujjkC9aEHFdrDdSucCDmPeaBDvYd5dCdgVKxdC7c8/1771644329699.jpg)

- Put the hot dough into the remaining tapioca flour in another container

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2DZMGxxBTPzjWFmcnJKWjprePig2vtwP5RVkNmPdHDa/1771644500650.jpg)

- Knead the dough in the tapioca until it is blended and can be shaped into balls (this is an important part of making successful cireng)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhfnWs3zRzTW72QfV5HZwSy7M5PosHmex2veSC3yZiK5/1771644661809.jpg)

- Take the dough and flatten it

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzP5VcM64ezvqVg372RCBhwymxyTH6FM7AEKGrf6cfnU/1771644713533.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbhUsVck1qK3bvUzZz1wQnZ5j14ZERDQnXXq9BASNBKF/1771644713676.jpg)

- Fry in hot oil over low heat

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGHx7dGMh8ouV2j6wTvCGKE2r6DAFsjHkSevEKt3nKCL/1771644713773.jpg)

- Cook until puffed and firm

- Remove and drain

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUc5AbAK6ym3RRRfmpwu2XsGbmmQXov4SbzmmYio5SNjV/1771644793790.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtvgy8944KUHq4onnusztQNx7fawdsN47jrFc7bowVb8/1771644793966.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULi8oDeeWcNrc5rVx7WgjzaUgivPUGvdEDbn5zUgYN2C/1771644984278.jpg)

- For the dipping sauce, chop the chili peppers and add soy sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU3TgyRZVXCe6P3KiNb2Uoa2aTPVEV1mMM8UGynXZ3BVy/1771645353521.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNZCueiotk2H7EU9F6ZY5wEskvTyyHa512J82Nrh1hVW/1771645353732.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKMTsbfS3ZUHpBGtMQ9vnRpfStLBnWQvy2RufNnFPgiZ/1771645353976.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXhLJHoLE4E6NVeBw9AntRPeS9dzfSc9L5PcPSNJDQ75t/1771645354146.jpg)

- Crispy Snow Cireng is ready to eat

title.title: Notes from This Week (Poem)
title.body:
# <u>The Thinker, the Pursuer</u>

woke up wanting more.
Desires pushed
as I veiled
not to end.. but

a continuation for the defaulter,
who slipped and watched.

![pawel-czerwinski-XaiP_NLrtoM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corpsekaizen/23tGKKdyy4YK1iNgWokA55UeLKeUSUziSvapfGrdqJacnTHcxjEyG3KFSCS9kQsFP3pU7.jpg)

Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash The hand forgets. The timer counts down. A disconnect, uncoupled. The thinker, the pursuer. nothing waits ahead, nothing follows, only the body, continuing out of refusal, to end, the same. ## HUNGER ![patrick-hendry-LL9wzvCI2gw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corpsekaizen/23wgDcEyP41bADyPwv3VrdLKhrTSjrYxr9S51kR1jbGAVLSUPYuY3JisnTuF8RsVSobtV.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash I stay hungry where passion leaves me. Every time I go through it, I come back different. When I get to the edge, the numbness sets in. The headaches. The cage around my head. Then the cravings kick in. I eat whatever I see. No matter how hard I try, how much I show, I cave in. The mind plays, and I stand at its order. What would it do to me if there were nothing? Nothing to consume. Nothing to chase. Nothing to fill. If hunger is all I am, what happens when there is nothing left to eat? ### Waiting for Their Turn hollow psyche, pulse that aches existence a memory waiting for their turn ![self-portrait_2014.136.14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corpsekaizen/23w2gbkYBYqiSEZUho2aGpSygofox216Ty7pXz7ZsGXNguiHABxvYMx5AJgFagk3hADwF.jpg) [1919 Abbott Handerson Thayer](https://www.nga.gov/artworks/176558-self-portrait) 🔗 the ones, given up why wait — surrender, just rest a bit smolder, layer by layer stranger to the sorrow, the misery graves scatter, marrow ripens humble me or take me a soul, no more ashes These are some of the poems I wrote this week. I had to post more than 1 to not trigger the word limit. I like to write poems but have not found any community to post it in. Follow me @corpsekaizen

title.title: The Unforgettable Bloom Discovering the Plush, Layered Splendor of a Double-Petal Hibiscus in My Friend's Backyard
title.body:
![1000029598.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xepGEcMmjaGo2BZg698Fo7SkAdtdJybHRMAXKKhAmN1Jr1g4pBzHJfBFHPxc65P3TSY.png)


 
So i went to my friend's house the other day. Her garden was really nice. I have seen many gardens but something there really surprised me.
 

![1000029599.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/242hf6dfa9PeodSWSDBdkcdKRhSi1pgBsfwUSZx7WrjXXQSk47uijxHf3oKvdbzwP4yxB.png)

 
It was a hibiscus flower. I thought i knew what hibiscus looked like  usually pretty, with a few petals. But this one was different.. 
 

![1000029602.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23ywsYnzrrXbiFyS4jzg3nHArgd8gQfzzR4rTRdUNGpxvkNPfMTK1m727RmJfJ3yNME9X.png)

 
It had double petals. I had never really noticed them before. It wasn't just a few petals it was like a big ball of them! Lots of layers all ruffled up almost like a fancy rose, but still a hibiscus.
 

![1000029600.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xKvhW3LLzcp1KYc3sQsmQXaZ8vZMMgz9yJxiByV54jaAzLtiGKViDy5WJML9wVJmfbz.png)

 
The color was amazing! It was a bright orange or maybe a deep red orange. It really shined. But the best part was how thick the petals were. Most flower petals are thin, like paper. Not these. They felt strong and soft almost like velvet. It looked very fancy like it belonged in a special garden, not just a backyard.
 

![1000029603.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23xAnZc6V64E4yWFZ2DEQsxprK5bE5onx8rVHsG3aXdsCTXfBzsPpGkWV1Q8AAQawqso1.png)

 
I just stood there, looking at it for a long time. My friend probably thought I was being silly, just staring at a flower. But i was so amazed you have no idea. It was like nature did something extra special and i got to see it.
 

![1000029601.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocabanero4/23ywqKdBBogu8tfDCfh39r6AUDFW4rghXzPPfFtRzVU8d5wL1JgcYajGYBYhe4W1riwZh.png)

 
That flower made her garden feel very unique. It was like finding a secret treasure. I kept thinking about it all day. It showed me that even common flowers like a hibiscus can be super surprising if you see the right kind. It really made my visit even better!

> **The materials used were:** Ribbed fabric (wine and gray) Elastic bias tape (2 cm wide) Pins Pattern Measuring tape Scissors Sewing machine Chalk

> **Los materiales usados fueron:** Tela Rib( vino y gris) Sesgo elástico (2 cm de ancho Alfileres Molde Cinta métrica Tijera Máquina de coser Tiza ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> **Elaboration** The first step in making the top was cutting the pieces. Since I'm going to use the joinery technique, I cut two pieces for the front and two pieces for the back. I cut both pieces in wine and gray. I really like this sewing technique because of the neat result, with the seams hidden.

> **Elaboración** El primer paso para la elaboración del top, fue cortar las piezas, como voy a usar la técnica del embonado se cortan dos piezas del delantero y dos piezas del posterior, corté ambas piezas en color vino y gris, esta técnica de costura me gusta mucho por el resultado prolijo, con las costuras ocultas. ![top deportivo (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep7v4ic7V999HayurdWfGH34Pgcz6TbuuvGSdXivAKBiQhmQs56Upm6vcVgbCRw5xCy.jpeg)

> The second step was to place the back pieces right sides together and attach the elastic (27 centimeters) at the top, securing it with a pin for easier sewing. Then, I placed the front pieces right sides together, pinned them, and sewed the armholes and neckline with a straight stitch. On the back piece, I sewed the armholes, neckline, and shoulders, leaving the sides and hem open.

> El segundo paso, fue enfrentar derecho con derecho las piezas del posterior y colocar el elástico (27 centímetros) en la parte superior, sujeté con alfiler para más comodidad al momento de coser, luego enfrenté las piezas delanteras por el derecho, fijé con alfileres y cosí con puntada recta las sisas y cuello, en la pieza trasera cosí sisa, cuello y hombros, dejando abiertos los costados y bajo. ![top deportivo (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eoke7WiB5PadGijGToU53eF4dEP2548rFGZS5Vkc8kUxeexqbEB6NN68pYG6XxfEdnj.jpeg) ![top deportivo (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpXL1qqcPwuTaw7TRasS14riKnMoaQuPxh3JAeBpzX9e57xLvoM6xzrrMiQdqwvAv2K.jpeg) ![top deportivo (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpNppXbQDLuA5ZQ6T6SNnPBSPMRR6Q2zdu3Qefx2Ge5uYZEPQ5vVGghvjCVSZrpx7ju.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> To join the front and back pieces, I placed them right sides together and, through the opening at the shoulders of the front piece, I passed the bias tape through the hole, pinned it, and sewed a double stitch with a straight stitch to reinforce the first one.

> Para unir la pieza delantera y posterior enfrenté derecho con derecho y por la abertura que quedó en los hombros del delantero, por el orificio pasé el sesgo,sujeté con alfileres y pasé doble costura con puntada recta, para asegurar la anterior. ![top deportivo (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpnEk2XKan5wTqo6ewdsBqbum1of715nxPEPYxGf5C2JUxAX9rLBDt4hueSBKd5iXL7.jpeg) ![top deportivo (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep1XTfS37NWY99gQP4exMDVqn7NGuontCiAJUj6ZiFAU6UyBH93nF7ZtbhU1AgqcqiP.jpeg) ![top deportivo (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpQxBz3piAy2BtpWW4MGQZg1G79L27yyMXvk7nNcdX4datZwDJZxEgDaQ9phdoiiwgF.jpeg) ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> Then I turned the piece right side out and aligned the side seams, pinning them in place and sewing with a straight stitch. This top doesn't have bias binding at the hem; instead, I reduced it by three centimeters so it fits snugly.

> Luego volteé la pieza por el derecho y enfrenté los costados, de tal forma que coincidan las costuras de la sisa, fijé con alfileres y también cosí con puntada recta. Este top no lleva sesgo en el bajo, para ello se le hizo una reducción de tres centímetros y así se ajusta muy bien al bajo. ![CINTILLO B.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23ydV5FZaqNcDMKtbipQ1N5NLm3e5QMkn955u9dcp41hg2uR4SL2MQnzytKVN11aTGikQ.jpg)

> **Bendiciones!**
**
See you later! Hasta luego!
** ![costura desp.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wr85YNHNfzjNDefHmANoY86XwtaJHgAruYyWjAZa8wsKTHtGTcp5sM9BBCsKEi14D1r.jpg)

title.title: Sublimation: Bolsito playero / Beach Bag (Esp/Eng)
title.body:
> [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Espero todos se encuentren muy bien. No he podido integrarme a mis actividades normales como creadora de contenido debido a los cortes eléctricos prolongados a veces durante casi todo el día. Como parte de las impresiones que hice para aprovechar material de mi publicación anterior acerca de sublimación, hoy traigo otra propuesta con otro modelo muy diferente de bolsito, me pareció tan fresco y bello que no veía la hora de poder compartirlo. Hubiera querido grabar el proceso en vídeo sin embargo por ahora os traigo el paso a paso para lograrlo, que sirva de inspiración a futuros proyectos. Espero les guste. >! [English version] Greetings, community! I hope you are all doing well. I have not been able to resume my normal activities as a content creator due to prolonged power cuts, sometimes lasting almost the entire day. As part of the impressions I made to take advantage of material from my previous post about sublimation, today I bring you another proposal with a very different bag model. I found it so fresh and beautiful that I couldn't wait to share it. I would have liked to record the process on video, but for now, I bring you the step-by-step instructions to achieve it, which will serve as inspiration for future projects. I hope you like it.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg # Materiales / Materials https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
|||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_170757_919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eos2L5PfUScX5iQu9hTzJHkK9Gv35HB9c4Vm3eoKhgah7fwuCcKTaazRNMZ9sLZhUHn.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_170809_112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpEJkaAiV9ffkXfAEmbm3L3LPpaNmtpBCipNb74aaRu7Mj6UrrJFRR7GTdMDDx6xxPz.jpg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EokdXCbP3jeNcUQ5wEUXKyY2C8m7hXPKkXPwPKnGLoEpCFMHDdzEp9QS8dHfxAFZvoR.png)
|||| |-|-|-| |**Spanish**|**English**| | Cinta térmica | Heat tape | | Tijera, hilo | Scissors, thread | Maquina de coser | Sewing machine | Equipo para sublimar | Sublimation equipment | Imágenes e impresiones | Images and prints | Tela de seda | Silk screen | Lámina de teflón | Teflon sheet | Cinta gross | Grosgrain ribbon

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg # Paso a paso / Step by Step https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
# Step 1️⃣/ Paso 1️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_171545_055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpQwM4gSUx4CCZy937YJWak3chECfPqTQe2TG7noqbJZBgvnkyq9tVsvypNa7DqcM7N.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_170858_602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoc8QdPo8tzxaDPcREAmz84KbGwvRBAn1UkePUpmTyuDCvATF4KXGBW2pKs1ZZsMVEM.jpg)| ![IMG_20260220_171312_421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoErW8dsQCwY9fjkoReHoa3KeE4LQw35J5Yx3emWrwCUJCQ2FNHbDF6HBMYnJiJX6wZ.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_172411_345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpT56tQCwMhRv8wUaGgRTbf8sVd4V9sTB6VquVHKjWdj8fowLtV2gkgYJFwaa8oDNGg.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_172402_026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpT5DTUMFibMMmagrNjuyLMxPjjkCRPouzMa5m5n4ubVkjmh5NfxPb5MqRaAwQkGMJd.jpg)

> [Esp] Hoy usé la plancha grande pues la mini plancha para sublimar, no cubre todo el diseño, es para piezas más pequeñas. Precalienta la plancha hasta 180°C. Mientras tanto es bueno con una plancha casera, planchar la tela, deja enfriar. Coloca el diseño con la pintura frente a la tela al derecho y usa la cinta térmica para fijar el diseño que no se mueva. Con la plancha ya caliente, coloca la pieza a sublimar sobre ella y sobre la tela coloca la lámina de teflón. Baja la plancha y deja por 40 segundos. Abre la plancha y si no la usarás más apaga. >! [English version] Today I used the large iron because the mini iron for sublimation does not cover the entire design; it is for smaller pieces. Preheat the iron to 180°C. In the meantime, it is a good idea to iron the fabric with a household iron and let it cool. Place the design with the paint facing the fabric and use thermal tape to secure the design so that it does not move. With the iron already hot, place the piece to be sublimated on it and place the Teflon sheet on top of the fabric. Lower the iron and leave for 40 seconds. Open the iron and if you are not going to use it anymore, turn it off.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
### Step 2️⃣/ paso 2️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_172537_102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eo6LToTHce4hamdCwyGrCXCaDr2gN8KqtptQHpQRnCWwxQLUDgQsFbuQtcKUz2JE1Xa.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_175511_815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eo8ToAKtDPyo8VUKJyaj7Kjobu6bGXrChKVSUK4MAJj4S2GHG7wpTbHqAj5nht8PANY.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_175605_215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eo8TKyqBYqDr7hnygxcQDL3o9ApxhoTz9YDzL9Rss4yAwApBomXYwMdB6ewR3gfJnUD.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_180249_476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EonkbX2H35h45rDueWcboSJ9PUe9mSipoPERvMWoZX1FsW5DpF1snu8fNhBLqgW4asN.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_180426_855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoEr4bNnLWyU7kcSnrGwo8iXGazL9tN2vKNJuvvW9qGZcqXwbB5zaVWX3iSZQHUWRA3.jpg)

> [Esp] Deja enfriar la pieza. Retira el papel con la cinta térmica con mucho cuidado. Corta el largo de las asas de la bolsita, he usado cinta gross. Voltea dejando el diseño hacia adentro y cierra los laterales del bolso con una recta. Quema los bordes con un yesquero. Evitará deshilache. --- >! [English version] Allow the piece to cool. Carefully remove the paper with the heat-activated tape. Cut the length of the bag handles; I used grosgrain ribbon. Turn the bag inside out and close the sides with a straight stitch. Seal the edges with a lighter to prevent fraying.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
### Step 3️⃣/ paso 3️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_180449_091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Eoke8bDCsRPhT2EPCV6vaeywJNhLHuQavwHQAhwojeRErkLMQQ9JR5SQNr7HgihR2jU.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_180713_635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoK6Gsy6mc7tYRD6KjRvvEFrReTi5v5minyr71guaqhS6ihAFXdkR5nmL3MVweQSXJj.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_180802_571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EogNNdwSVXwy7xrGAZUy1fuFosR9nTjGecHMVZG5rW19eMcNqgvokzmkrDYqS2P76nV.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_180901_629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EowFZcHMSdyXgSPuzPApdd8jR1DJukprmwSkPW4Sui4e1rqr7htRgXp3ccayFzaJnmF.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_181037_719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoeFQtYUs7m5Q9fVo6BnFVuHMaAZUxJ6pFMFZpNoz3kbbvvZpUKVJpJUFkokRsBTMcu.jpg)

> [Esp] Cose zig zag por los laterales. Usa un cuadrito de 2cm por 2cm. y marca ambas esquinas, luego recorta. Dobla la pieza por la mitad y cierra con una recta. Cose un dobladillo con la cinta gross para dar un buen acabado en la costura anterior. >! [English version] Sew a zigzag stitch along the sides. Use a 2 cm by 2 cm square and mark both corners, then cut out. Fold the piece in half and close with a straight stitch. Sew a hem with the grosgrain ribbon to give a nice finish to the previous seam.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23x1YN1cVfkFGFUApsNEqcy14kxB39rxwAvrfhHpVnSeH2hL1EmizukyCqHNz4teH41nn.jpg
### Step 4️⃣/ paso 4️⃣
|||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_181307_388.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Ep7uCFidyRMEhwgvwwKhERr2TmNf3ypHWrukKD8EKQykbWu79hSXngQRvj4AgtMHdim.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_181644_910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoiWBHu9ZjFGwrZzAf6cRBV8kkFe1jXXhSMJoGgps9vU28jSzv98uhU28GUSo3U74kj.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_181833_766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoEr1kz9mifMqckCte6beNt3hkYiXCjMDfCZEtsaNHWY3GUTq9pPU8CMkQLVULEf946.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260220_182217_920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoK6qyoENi1yfKB1oY9KJZmTh5hCYaTm3oqjTqN8qxBNvWYPkaViNuED44MPnDMAShy.jpg)|![IMG_20260220_182322_068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoErSyX5ZBwGutCmTdBWZerqueK3XPupgZHvMQfrjGiNWKXQEWwPcWYoDaV5aMtAmp8.jpg)| ![IMG_20260220_182410_993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoeEzjdPZeFwJMkJiqDeq7cbxiQ6efC9cRrieVmkzUCi1uNL7juNYVPhzb15BShVStX.jpg) ![IMG_20260220_182554_871.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23yJGXzka33phTygvddoSatZvFF9aoLa7pKWBWQ6CBQ245PJoM4S1oProUFHhZGcKv8d6.jpg)

> [Esp] Voltea la pieza. Plancha un dobladillo en la parte superior de la abertura para facilitar la costura. Coloca y fija las asas con ayuda de unas pinzas. Cierra con una recta de doble costura en la parte superior de la pieza fijando las asas del bolsito. Me ha encantado este proyecto, aunque lo hice pensando en un día de playa, un útil bolsito para guardar tus cremas hidratantes, bronceadores, aceites y cosméticos que normalmente llevamos a esos lugares para consentirnos.... Su tamaño es perfecto para guardar tres mazos de mi colección de cartas de tarot XD! Espero les guste. >! [English version] Turn the piece over. Iron a hem at the top of the opening to make sewing easier. Position and secure the handles with the help of some clips. Close with a double straight stitch at the top of the piece, securing the bag handles. **¿Have you ever longed for or fallen in love with something you see and want.?**

It costs **1,899 reais**, which is about **$366**. I know I couldn't afford to pay that much and neglect other personal or much more important things to pay for it, but I think it's a good price and an excellent opportunity to buy one. body.title: The Skill i Grew into; Rabbit Farming
body.body:
; When it comes to skills, people have different interests, mindsets, and understandings. Some may not even count certain things as a skill, but for me, I have an agricultural skill, a skill that has been a part of my life for as long as I can remember. 
Agriculture has always been a cornerstone of my life. It’s what I grew up seeing, learning about, and exploring. It has shaped my interests, my growth, and my awareness. Simply put, it has always been everything to me.

In this week’s #contest, I will  love to share my journey with one specific agricultural skill: Rabbit farming.
After I was posted to a new unit in the agricultural sector where i work, I found myself in a part of the farm I had never explored before; raising rabbits. At first, I didn’t know anything about them, their care, feeding, or breeding. But it was a job I had to do, and I had to deliver. So, I decided to learn.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsRtbKgjtoEZy1r57sgTCXERLeHGVWciPHAxTANov9kx/1771644418135.jpg)
Over time, I picked up the essential rabbitry skills: how to feed them with both fresh and formulated feed, how to care for the mothers and kittens, how to observe their health, vaccinate them when needed, and even understand their mating cycles. I have  learnt to provide the right grasses to ensure mothers could produce enough milk for their young. I observed, studied, and practised every day, making sure I could handle all aspects of rabbit farming responsibly.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPtsBnDPt7KKVYQ95ySxjrr5sf5o7bSQ3PUGtF4JWJihV/1771644514810.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3FFtXZk5ytifA4EVFLLk35Mj6dGF8jUy2sohteSzY7z/1771644984157.jpg)
Have learnt that rabbit farming is not just about feeding and cleaning. It’s about observing subtle behaviours, noticing when a rabbit is uncomfortable or stressed, knowing when a doe is ready to mate, and even learning which kind of nesting material keeps her calm. I have spent mornings carefully checking their hutches, making sure the kits are safe and warm, and evenings preparing the right mix of feed to help them grow healthy and strong. I have learnt  the joy of watching tiny, wobbly kits slowly grow into lively, curious rabbits, hopping around their enclosures with energy and life. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNxxnGzUDL2apDoWBHAE3hnK95YWeeB1tPwb4vcfVw31/1771645061135.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcTw8vSKafFwZLLri6KVPpbrxdKWCuXz4mW6NswDGgX5w/1771645061269.jpg)

Not only the joy that comes with rabbits, sometimes there are challenges too, illnesses, loss, or times when a doe rejected her kits, but each challenge taught me patience, resilience, and the importance of careful observation. Every small success, like a litter growing healthy under my care, felt like a personal victory, a reminder that dedication can turn the unknown into mastery.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhjHyKrcThAxdEmuMwNyi2FhtKRHDeRvcJfr1ibSX8WV/1771645245737.jpg)
Today, looking at the rabbits have raised over the years, I feel a deep sense of accomplishment. This skill didn’t come from mere curiosity, it came from responsibility, dedication, and the willingness to grow into a role I had never imagined. Rabbit farming is my skill, my passion, and my story, and I am grateful to share this experience with this wonderful community that keeps inspiring me week after week.

Thanks to the organisers of this weekly #uicontest. 
I remain @pascalukandy.

body.title: Sobres en el Oso
body.body:
> Mi maravillosa amiga Alicia (@purrix) me invitó a participar. Y como yo me quedo en las nubes cada vez que ella me menciona, casi no llego por andar de Torombolo. En estos días, todo el mundo del marketing se revolucionó con el regreso de la batalla entre Pepsi y Coca-Cola. Y el protagonista fue, nada más y nada menos, que un oso polar. En Venezuela, el oso polar tiene peso simbólico: lo asocias con una malta o con una bien fría. ¿Y ustedes se preguntarán por qué vengo con eso? Pues porque lo que para muchos parece una alfombra, para mí es el pelaje del oso que perdió la pelea… o al que le arrancaron la piel. Y, para colmo, el osado que hizo semejante cosa dejó pistas, cual Acertijo de BATMAN. Los enigmas están en cada uno de los sobres que, según mi apreciación, llevan sellos de corazones de colores. Tal vez la razón de haber dejado el pelaje del oso esté en el sobre que tiene el corazón más grande. Pero el cuento no se queda ahí. Tampoco es que yo sea un detestable. Al ver que los sobres de la imagen tienen corazones, no queda otra que pensar que por allí andaba el amor. Y como estamos en febrero, inevitablemente pienso que el amor dejó esas cartas para quienes andamos en modo solitario… y que solo hay que tomar el sobre que nos corresponde. Como se me ocurrió que quien le quitó la piel al oso tiene mucho que decir en el sobre del corazón grande, ese debe ser el que me toca. Y como no puedo abrirlo —porque está en la imagen—, especularé qué dice para mí… si es que hay algo adentro. Y sí, hay algo. Pero nada amoroso. Más bien, algo oscuro. Algo que no podía creer. Algo que no quería recibir. El remitente me hace saber que ha pensado en mí… No, no es Alicia. Ella no tiene nada de oscuridad. Ella es luz. Resulta que el banco me está cobrando la deuda de las tarjetas de crédito, y yo, como andaba disfrazado de maula, pues no me pelaron. Ustedes dirán: “Este sí que está loco con esta participación”. Pero es que, a esta hora y apurado porque se va a vencer el plazo, saqué lo que tenía en el sombrero. Quería que fuera más espeluznante. O con más amor. O tal vez más humor. Pero esto es lo que hay. Creo que ya no hay tiempo de invitar…

body.title: ESA's new proposal to eliminate space debris.
body.body:
>

ESA's new proposal to eliminate space debris.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmc1bPi2nz3f1LLMrsMXjRhAGPgzEe2Ti1LqCH1s1rmy5g/image.png

> In previous publications I have touched on the topic of Elon Musk's program or project to create a million space satellites that serve as artificial intelligence servers, launching them from the Moon to avoid the issue of pollution, but even so they are still a million space satellites that are also going to multiply because other companies and other countries will also want to have their constellation of space satellites similar to the one that Musk wants to put up.


The question is what to do then with space debris, because there is a lot of space, but not so much in low Earth orbit, which is where most space satellites are currently, so how is it done? How is space debris removed? Or how satellites that are out of use and that can be a problem for other space satellites are eliminated, at the European Space Agency ESA they are developing the OMLET program.


It would be using a laser to push space debris, although it sounds very spectacular to use a laser, do not think that it is going to destroy the satellite or the debris. space, but what they are going to do is push them and not by much, they could push it up or down, but a matter of meters, enough to group the space debris, which would be the intention rather than knocking it down, which would be more complicated.


The problem of space debris is Kessler syndrome, a syndrome developed in the 1970s by Donald J. Kessler, a NASA astrophysicist, in which it was basically a cascade effect. If too many disused satellites accumulated, too much space debris, in the end we could find that a fragment of space debris ends up impacting a satellite, destroying it, and that destroyed satellite becomes a cloud of space debris fragments that end up impacting other satellites. destroying them, creating more space debris and thus cascading until the entire low Earth orbit was full of debris, destroying all satellites, all ships and all space stations and making it impossible to have a satellite in orbit.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Fvrg6H6byo

> It would be the apocalypse of the satellite era and it would also be a tremendous complication for space exploration because we would have to go through that area of ​​“garbage minefield bullets”. This method being developed by the European Space Agency aims to group rather than demolish, using laser strikes.


It is not to destroy the disused satellite or space debris with the laser, but to push them little by little to place them in orbits or in safe areas, you can push up or down, but trying to shoot down, some could be used as a weapon to shoot down an enemy satellite, it would be a fairly useless weapon because the pushes are quite subtle, it would take months hitting them with the laser to be able to shoot down one satellite at a time, so it would not be a very good tactic in terms of destroying satellites, in fact, the tendency current military is not to destroy satellites in orbit, because it would be catastrophic, it would start Kessler syndrome.


The current trend in terms of military defense against enemy satellites is to capture them, to create ships that can trap the enemy satellite in orbit and throw it into the Earth's atmosphere so that it disintegrates or if it is possible to capture the enemy satellite and bring it whole to Earth, with which you would have the technology of the enemy power, that is what the military is currently doing.


The problem is complicated because the issue of space debris is who pays, who pays for the removal of space debris, large disused satellites have an owner and that owner should eliminate that space debris, but the authorities or the UN or whoever at an international level, if one day an authority is created, can demand from governments or companies that you have to pay for the removal of that satellite, when the satellites have an owner, but what happens to the fragments or the waste or the little pieces that are left floating around and there are hundreds of them? of thousands? Who do you demand to pay it? The topic is very complicated and that is a problem that is going to increase.

Set in 1944, it tells the story of a lone man who must defend a large cache of gold from a group of Nazis, a confrontation that sparks an unprecedented wave of violence. It was precisely this type of action and the story itself, which was not original but very direct, that generated widespread acceptance and undoubtedly prompted the development of a sequel. After all, who didn't want to see more of the now famous \

(The Immortal) destroy any enemy that stood in his way.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260220_234302_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Eo6DgDLt4Qd1DesEQhMNkph3s4inphTzkBhN8jvbhnSkjJd6SUBHXhKYurtPxMomd64.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://www.thewrap.com/where-to-watch-sisu-2-road-to-revenge/)

En **\
** tenemos una secuela directa de su predecesora; es el claro ejemplo de las consecuencias generadas por los actos que realizó \
en anteriores combates, lo cual motiva a antiguos enemigos a querer obtener venganza de quien recibió un seudónimo y hasta el nombramiento de leyenda después de acabar con muchos integrantes del \

; esa necesidad de venganza hará que haga apariencia un enemigo que seguramente Aatami no esperaba encontrar y cuando sepa quién en realidad es, será el momento en dónde nuevamente El Inmortal surja; como pueden observar el desarrollo de esta historia o el relato en sí, no es lo más profundo o, como dije anteriormente, algo original y, para ser sincero, eso no importa porque lo que sí realmente debe tener relevancia son las escenas filmadas por _**Helander**_ quien hace un gran trabajo haciendo lucir a su gran protagonista.
> In **\
**, we have a direct sequel to its predecessor; it is a clear example of the consequences generated by the actions of \
in previous battles, which motivates old enemies to seek revenge against the man who received a pseudonym and even the title of legend after killing many members of the \

This need for revenge will bring forth an enemy that Aatami surely did not expect to encounter, and when he finds out who this enemy really is, it will be the moment when The Immortal emerges once again. As you can see, the development of this story or the narrative itself is not the most profound or, as I said before, original, but to be honest, that doesn't matter because what really matters are the scenes filmed by _**Helander**_, who does a great job of making his main character shine.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260220_234302_0001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EoprSbbGFvhQG4Cofsi7iCv4SnxWsAj443gwurBmnBWzxcECurb1u8JwZrwmdvmbG4z.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://variety.com/2025/film/features/sisu-road-to-revenge-director-killing-nazis-sequels-1236526704/)

A pesar de que la duración es de una hora y media, así como fue el primer film, en esta oportunidad _**Helander**_ usa un esquema diferente en el momento de relatar la historia, esto al no usar una pausa de la acción a mitad del film, sino en el principio; esa fue una acertada decisión porque el protagonista necesita un nuevo motivo para seguir adelante y en esta oportunidad es correcto que se exploren sus sentimientos con respecto a su traumático y triste pasado, lo cual le impulsa a su actuación en esta historia; cabe destacar que en el momento en que finaliza la breve pausa, existe un ritmo trepidante, lo cual es formidable y es un aspecto que me ha gustado en esta secuela porque es como si existiera un extenso acto final, uno que no es aburrido y que está lleno de escenas satisfactorias, con acción y hasta momentos de muy buen uso del humor.
> Although the film lasts an hour and a half, just like the first one, this time Helander uses a different approach to telling the story, with a break in the action at the beginning rather than in the middle. This was a wise decision because the protagonist needs a new reason to move forward, and this time it is appropriate to explore his feelings about his traumatic and sad past, which drives his actions in this story. It should be noted that when the brief pause ends, there is a fast-paced rhythm, which is formidable and an aspect that I liked in this sequel because it is as if there were an extended final act, one that is not boring and is full of satisfying scenes, with action and even moments of very good use of humor.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260220_234302_0002.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/EpNoTTcz1Ebrt4wTNhwDuUzcb62dafXMWYYurnoragXXt1gGmuSmnF4KobuTgiGRa3E.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://butwhytho.net/2025/09/sisu-road-to-revenge-review-sisu-2/)

Para quien haya visto el primer film y para quien no, debe saber que los diálogos en esta película son muy pocos, más que nada con el personaje de \

interpretado por _**Jorma Tommila**_; en el primer film, su personaje está lleno completamente de odio y se nota, al momento de ir en contra de los nazis, su rostro lleno de rabia y la necesidad de drenar todo lo que siente de una manera violenta; es algo que me pareció excelente; ahora en la secuela, tiene que interpretar de una manera diferente a este personaje que después de pensar que su guerra personal llega a su fin, ahora debe primeramente huir para sobrevivir y después recobrar ese instinto de venganza para dar fin a una parte de su atormentado pasado; posiblemente creerán que al ser un film de acción, con una historia simple y directa, no existe un desarrollo correcto del personaje, pero _**Tommila**_ en mi opinión, hace un mejor trabajo del que hizo en la anterior película. Anexo al renglón de actuación el excelente trabajo de _**Stephen Lang**_ como \

, el principal antagonista, un gran villano que en muchas escenas se adueña del film y que fue una gran adquisición para esta secuela.
> For those who have seen the first film and those who haven't, you should know that there is very little dialogue in this film, mostly with the character \

played by _**Jorma Tommila**_; In the first film, his character is completely filled with hatred, and you can see it when he goes up against the Nazis, his face full of rage and the need to vent everything he feels in a violent way; I thought that was excellent. Now, in the sequel, he has to play this character differently. After thinking that his personal war is coming to an end, he must first flee to survive and then regain that instinct for revenge to put an end to a part of his tormented past. You may think that, being an action film with a simple and straightforward story, there is no proper character development, but in my opinion, _**Tommila**_ does a better job than he did in the previous film. I would also like to mention the excellent performance of _**Stephen Lang**_ as \

the main antagonist, a great villain who steals the show in many scenes and was a great addition to this sequel.
![BEE FUTBOL_20260220_234302_0003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nameless16/Enyo7MnCfyeCrdwbUyb2ccKgHMRm6Lke7wrMXhhuiU7WNBWbjJTJEjKb8zcACZuvxDj.png)
[Fuente / Source](https://geektyrant.com/news/badass-trailer-for-sisu-2-road-to-revenge-unleashes-brutal-action)

**Sisu: Road to Revenge** cumplió con todas mis expectativas; es una película que, cuando la acción comienza, no se detiene y eso es lo genial de esta secuela, junto a la suma de un buen antagonista, necesario para el relato vengativo que se anuncia en su título y que, de una manera muy bien desarrollada, impulsa el motivo vengativo del protagonista. Creo que estéticamente es más pulcra y con un mejor uso del CGI, y hay que nombrar que este film contó con un presupuesto nada extenso, pero a la vez se nota el cuidado para el desarrollo de muy buenas escenas de acción y, repito, esta película sabe cómo usar la pausa, el drama y el humor; justamente esto es algo que no esperaba que estuviera tan marcado, pero fue una grata sorpresa que no se tomara en serio ciertas cosas. En realidad, la pasé genial viendo (por fin) esta película y más aún pensando en mi padre, que lamentablemente no la pudo ver, pero estoy completamente seguro de que le hubiera encantado.
> **Sisu: Road to Revenge** met all my expectations; it's a film that, once the action starts, doesn't let up, and that's what's great about this sequel, along with the addition of a good antagonist, necessary for the revenge story promised in the title, which, in a very well-developed way, drives the protagonist's desire for vengeance. I think it's more polished aesthetically and makes better use of CGI, and it's worth mentioning that this film had a very limited budget, but at the same time, you can see the care taken in developing very good action scenes and, I repeat, this film knows how to use pause, drama, and humor; this is something I didn't expect to be so prominent, but it was a pleasant surprise that it didn't take certain things too seriously. Actually, I had a great time watching this film (at last) and even more so thinking about my father, who unfortunately couldn't see it, but I'm completely sure he would have loved it.
-----

这几天闲来无事翻了翻手机相册，发现之前拍了好多好吃的还没来分享，这几天就集中写这些啦。好利来家的半熟芝士味道尊嘟很好，非常浓郁的芝士味儿，不可复制。

盒马生牛乳香蕉奶，味道同进口超市的香蕉奶一般无二，价格确实便宜又大碗的。喜欢这个味道的姐妹们，推荐大家无脑冲！分享完好吃的，也想来说件很糟心的事儿。

我在群里发买了春节限定一整套皮肤，有个辅助主播联系我要直播打我的号。我看他主玩的就是我打分的英雄，寻思着打着也没事，第一天给上了800多分我也发了红包。


结果第二天打我的两个打分英雄，前一天打的掉了200多分，另一个国50的主角掉了接近700！来回相比较之下，不仅没给我上分，还掉了接近100分且没有任何道歉。

他不道歉我也不会说什么，但下个月我不会续费也不会找他打单子。我觉得这种就是不会为人处事的，哪怕只是口头道歉下都好啊。我也不是不舍得花钱的人，很烦这种。

懒得去想这些糟心事，打开游戏做任务啦。做完以后收获新英雄诺拉和初生庆典队旗，你别说这个旗帜尊嘟很好看！最后来个战利品钥匙10连抽，只收到了48个原石😭

除此以外，还出来了风执事·加里奥、魅惑女巫·厄运小姐、至尊之拳·李青、黑暗骑士·阿利斯塔和游侠法师·拉克丝碎片。没事我喜欢的，聊胜于无吧~


（本篇完）
