body.title: Reseña de Cine Clásico con \
de Jackie Chan (2002)/Classic Film Review featuring \
by Jackie Chan (2002)
body.body:
>
Jackie Chan's career is a fascinating case study in how raw talent, forged in adversity, can completely redefine a film genre.

From his earliest childhood, he was no ordinary boy; his parents, so poor they almost sold him, enrolled him in the rigorous Peking Opera Academy. For a decade, young Chan underwent daily training sessions of over 18 hours, combining martial arts, acrobatics, singing, and acting. This crucible of disciplines forged an exceptional martial artist and an unparalleled physical communicator. Far from simply being a successor to Bruce Lee, Jackie found his own voice, replacing his predecessor's lethal fury with a charisma and acrobatic humor that would make him a global icon.
La trayectoria de Jackie Chan es un caso de estudio fascinante sobre cómo el talento bruto, forjado en la adversidad, puede redefinir un género cinematográfico por completo.

Desde su infancia no un niño corriente; sus padres, de recursos tan limitados estuvieron a punto de venderlo, lo inscribieron en la estricta Academia de la Ópera de Pekín. Durante una década, el pequeño Chan se sometió a entrenamientos diarios de más de 18 horas combinando artes marciales, acrobacia, canto y actuación. Este crisol de disciplinas forjó a un artista marcial excepcional y a un comunicador físico sin igual. Lejos de limitarse a ser un simple sucesor de Bruce Lee, Jackie supo encontrar su propia voz, reemplazando la furia letal de su predecesor con un carisma y un humor acrobático que lo convertirían en un ícono global

>\n\n
His rise to international fame in the 1990s, with films like \
proved that his formula worked in any language. However, it was in his foray into family-friendly science fiction that his physical prowess reached an almost surreal dimension. In \

(2002), Chan plays a humble taxi driver who becomes embroiled in a spy mission after donning a high-tech tuxedo that grants him superhuman abilities. The fascinating aspect of the film is that, while the suit justifies the plot, the real spectacle is Jackie's physique. The film presents a playful and engaging game where the artifice of science fiction becomes unnecessary in the face of the reality of his human talent.

And indeed, Jackie Chan's body has always been his best and most reliable special effect. While the tuxedo endows his character with robotic precision for dancing or driving, the viewer can't help but smile knowingly, aware that the actor is capable of such feats without a single chip. His fighting style, which he performs, is a torrent of creativity where any everyday object becomes an extension of his limbs. There is a perfect mechanics in his movements, a supernatural synchronization that, paradoxically, makes the audience believe he is an automaton programmed for combat, humanizing robotic perfection through the playful spirit of its protagonist. The film also benefits from the acting counterpoint provided by his co-stars.
Su salto a la fama internacional en los años 90, con películas como \
, demostró que su fórmula funcionaba en cualquier idioma. Sin embargo, fue en su incursión en la ciencia ficción familiar donde su destreza física alcanzó una dimensión casi surrealista. En \

(The Tuxedo), del año 2002, Chan interpreta a un humilde taxista que se ve envuelto en una misión de espionaje al ponerse un esmoquin de alta tecnología que le otorga habilidades sobrehumanas. Lo fascinante de la propuesta es que, aunque el traje justifica la trama, el verdadero espectáculo es el cuerpo de Jackie. La película plantea un divertido juego comprensivo donde el artificio de la ciencia ficción se vuelve innecesario ante la realidad de su talento humano.

Y es que el cuerpo de Jackie Chan siempre ha sido su mejor y más fiable efecto especial. Mientras que el esmoquin dota a su personaje de una precisión robótica para bailar o conducir, el espectador no puede evitar sonreír con complicidad, sabiendo que el actor es capaz de esas proezas sin necesidad de un solo chip. Su estilo de lucha, que él realiza, es un torrente de creatividad donde cualquier objeto cotidiano se convierte en una extensión de sus extremidades. Hay una mecánica perfecta en sus movimientos, una sincronización sobrenatural y que, paradójicamente, hace creer al público que es un autómata programado para el combate, humanizando la perfección robótica a través del espíritu lúdico de su protagonista El filme también se beneficia del contrapunto actoral que le proporcionan sus compañeros de reparto.

>\n\n
In contrast to Chan's boundless, physical energy, the talented Jennifer Love Hewitt brings a layer of nervous comedy and empathy, embodying a novice apprentice whose clumsiness only highlights her mentor's mastery. On the other hand, the presence of an actor of Jason Isaacs' caliber, in the villain role, adds the necessary gravitas to elevate the film. Isaacs, with his classic bearing and his ability to portray a charismatic and ruthless antagonist, offers the seriousness and refinement that the genre needs for the viewer to accept the game of technological fantasy. His performance adds nuance to the film, creating a perfect contrast between the malevolent elegance and the ordered chaos that Chan unleashes.

As for its technical aspects, \

is a very representative product of early 2000s action cinema, with clean production design and cinematography that prioritizes visual clarity to ensure the action scenes are easily understood. Sound, a fundamental pillar in any martial arts film, more than delivers, emphasizing every punch, every kick, and every acrobatic feat, giving them a weight and realism that anchors even the most outlandish elements of the plot to a powerful sensory experience. The direction knows how to frame Jackie Chan so that his talent shines in all its glory, using shots that show his entire body in motion—a mark of respect for a choreographer who never needs frenetic editing to hide limitations, but rather to showcase his strengths.\n\n
Frente a la energía desbordante y física de Chan, la talentosa Jennifer Love Hewitt aporta una capa de comedia nerviosa y empatía, encarnando a una novata aprendiz que, con sus torpezas, resalta aún más la maestría de su mentor. Por otro lado, la presencia de un actor de la talla de Jason Isaacs, en el papel de villano, añade el empaque necesario para elevar la función. Isaacs, con su porte clásico y su habilidad para interpretar a un antagonista carismático y despiadado, ofrece la seriedad y el refinamiento que el género necesita para que el espectador acepte jugar el juego de la fantasía tecnológica. Su actuación matiza la obra, creando un contraste perfecto entre la elegancia malévola y el caos ordenado que provoca Chan

En cuanto a sus aspectos técnicos, \

es un producto muy representativo del cine de acción de principios de los 2000, con un diseño de producción limpio y una fotografía que privilegia la claridad visual para que las escenas de acción sean legibles. El sonido, un pilar fundamental en cualquier película de artes marciales, cumple con creces al enfatizar cada golpe, cada patada y cada acrobacia, dándoles un peso y una realidad que anclan lo más estrambótico de la trama a una experiencia sensorial contundente. La dirección sabe cómo encuadrar a Jackie para que su talento luzca en todo su esplendor, utilizando planos que muestran la totalidad de su cuerpo en movimiento, un sello de respeto hacia un coreógrafo que nunca necesita del montaje frenético para ocultar limitaciones, sino para exhibir virtudes.
##
Trailer Youtube
https://youtu.be/nc-NIveaM3U?si=j0dYLg5n_lFWJu9q
Ultimately, \

is a time capsule that encapsulates Jackie Chan's most commercially successful period in Hollywood, but it's also a testament to his unparalleled skill.

Watching him move is like watching a Swiss watch in action: an infinite complexity of parts working in perfect harmony to deliver a simple yet wonderful result. The film reminds us that, long before technology promised us perfect bodies and instant abilities, Jackie Chan had already spent decades training his flesh and bones to become the closest thing to a superhero that ever graced the screen. It is, without a doubt, an eccentric and vibrant tribute to a talent that remains as human as it is extraordinary.

This film is worth watching with the family to marvel at and laugh at this blend of fighting and comedy that makes this classic an essential reference point for great cinema. Until next time, God bless you…\n\n
En definitiva, \

es una botella del tiempo que encapsula la etapa más comercial de Jackie Chan en Hollywood, pero también es un testimonio de su inigualable habilidad.

Verle moverse es como ver a un reloj suizo en acción: Una complejidad infinita de piezas que trabajan en perfecta armonía para ofrecer un resultado sencillo y maravilloso. La película nos recuerda que, mucho antes de que la tecnología nos prometiera cuerpos perfectos y habilidades instantáneas, Jackie Chan ya había pasado décadas entrenando su carne y sus huesos para convertirse en el ser humano más cercano a un superhéroe que jamás haya pisado la pantalla. Es, sin duda, un excéntrico y vibrante homenaje a un talento que sigue siendo tan humano como extraordinario.

Vale la pena ver esta obra en familia para maravillarnos y reírnos de esta mezcla de pelea y comedia que hace de este clásico, una referencia obligada de buen cine. Hasta la próxima, Dios les bendiga…

昨天玩累到忘记写文了，话说我们抵达长沙的时候已经是傍晚6点多，打算把行李全部放到酒店，再出门觅食。虽然每次都有些折腾，但是放下行李后会觉得一身轻松。

所幸住的酒店距离我们下车的地铁站非常近，大约只需要5分钟的步行时间，所以没有浪费太多时间。
 
出门已是晚上7点，准备前往五一广场。之所以去那边，只因为它是整个长沙市区最热闹的地方，美食自然是很多。
 
在地铁上，我们便开始研究吃什么，我们对来到长沙的第一顿饭非常期待，看了各式各样的美食推荐，有传统的湘菜，有龙虾大餐，还有各种小吃，最后我们选择了一家名叫登隆街大饭铺的饭馆。
 
这家店位于登隆街，这个名字乍一听以为是打灯笼的“灯笼”，其实是登山的登，轰隆隆的隆，也是从灯笼二字谐音而来，有着步步登高、生意兴隆的好寓意。
 
这家店就开在长沙IFS国金中心附近，与十分出名的聚味瞿记龙虾馆对街而立。
 
来到饭店，我们才开始排队取号，因为线上根本无法提前取号，只能到店取。此时前面还有大约20桌，店员说至少要等一个小时，这个时间我们还算能接受，因为可以趁这个空档去附近吃一些街头小吃。
 
吃了一圈之后，再回到登隆街大饭铺一楼等候的区域坐着休息，刚才吃小吃也没有吃得太饱，正是怕待会正餐吃不下去。
 
等了一个多小时，总算等到我们了，门口的店员让我们上二楼，以为就能直接找到桌位扫码点餐了，结果又让我们继续等，看着那些服务员手忙脚乱，一个个疲惫不堪，估计也是超负荷运转了。

等他们把桌子收拾干净，入座已经是9点过了，合着这顿饭直接变夜宵了……


---

body.title: Spectral Shadow: Ghost Edition
body.body: Concepto y Ejecución\nPara esta pieza, busqué reinterpretar la estética icónica de Simon \

Riley mediante un estilo visual agresivo y de alto contraste. El objetivo fue alejarme del renderizado realista convencional para crear algo que se sienta como un híbrido entre arte pop moderno y glitch digital. Detalles Técnicos en Photoshop: Tratamiento de Color: Utilicé una paleta de duotono extrema, enfrentando un rojo saturado en el fondo contra tonos cian y sombras profundas en el personaje para generar un impacto visual inmediato. Efecto de Tramado (Halftone): Apliqué texturas de líneas y patrones de interferencia en las sombras del personaje para darle una estética de cómic retro o impresión de baja fidelidad. Composición y Branding: El logo de Warzone y el emblema de MW están posicionados estratégicamente para equilibrar el peso visual, manteniendo el enfoque principal en el detalle de la máscara y el parche de la SAS.
\nConcept and Execution\nFor this piece, I sought to reinterpret the iconic aesthetic of Simon \

Riley through an aggressive, high-contrast visual style. The goal was to move away from conventional realistic rendering to create something that feels like a hybrid of modern pop art and digital glitch. Technical Details in Photoshop: Color Treatment: I used an extreme duotone palette, contrasting a saturated red in the background against cyan tones and deep shadows on the character to generate an immediate visual impact. Halftone Effect: I applied line textures and interference patterns to the character's shadows to give it a retro comic book or lo-fi print aesthetic. Composition and Branding: The Warzone logo and MW emblem are strategically positioned to balance the visual weight, keeping the main focus on the detail of the mask and SAS patch.

body.title: The most realistic humanoid robot to date.
body.body:
The most realistic humanoid robot to date.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeSy52Q41StgodGBQU638GTdapmpjiRTZDNrnjN9RiD59/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

>\nFor years, the idea of ​​companion robberies appeared in fiction as something distant, highly functional, almost human machines, capable of helping with household tasks and living next to us, but <a href=\

>AheadForm's proposal with the Origin M1 follows a different path, it was not created to lift boxes or perform household tasks.


The Origin M1 was designed for something much more unusual, a level of facial realism that reaches the point of being uncomfortable, the highlight of the demonstration being in the mouth, teeth and micro-expressions. The movement of the facial muscles, the texture of the skin and the very oriental, almost human smile show how the company is focused on crossing the famous valley of strangeness, that point where a machine is so similar to a human that it ends up causing discomfort instead of connection.


Visually, the progress is evident compared to the company's previous model, the M1 Original, the face seems more alive, with subtle details that recall real expressions, bringing the robot closer to a hyper-realistic mannequin and movement. But there is a curious contrast, despite the highly sophisticated appearance, the rest of the body remains practically static.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YE9OSgdnSS0
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Origin M1 was not designed to perform practical tasks, it does not perform domestic services, but demonstrates functional capabilities beyond visual and emotional interaction, in other words, it is a robot made for company, not for work. This type of approach raises an interesting discussion within current robotics.


While companies like Figure, Tesla and Unitree focus on physical dexterity and industrial applications, AheadForm seems to explore a different frontier, the social presence of machines. Origin M1 shows that the evolution of humanoids does not occur only in engines and algorithms, but also in the attempt to replicate something much more difficult, the social naturalness of our species.


In the end, the Origin M1 seems less like an assistant from the future and more like a reminder that copying human appearance can be easy compared to the real challenge, making a machine that actually behaves as a useful presence in the real world, because the truth is that copying human appearance is only part of the problem, the real challenge is always in the hands and while some projects focus on visually impressing, others are trying to master what makes the human body truly functional, dexterity.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

links.title: When Disunity Overshadows a Final Goodbye
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBAuVhaCvm2py1J54FGAkhQvw9j3cEMBKoeVTM4P3foc/1771600979317.jpg)


The burial of my great-aunt was meant to be a solemn and respectful event. Instead, it became a painful display of disunity among siblings.



There was clear tension between my uncle Solomon and his elder sisters. His sisters were financially stronger, and unfortunately, they refused to carry him along in the burial planning. This lack of communication and unity led to chaos on the burial day.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPz8uGFJChsEQp6aToL2DvyTMtK622As2tPQ5Svo4ym7E/1771600979523.jpg)

The corpse was brought from the mortuary in a coffin, accompanied by drummers who paraded it to the main road. However, when they reached the road, the ambulance that was supposed to be waiting had been canceled by my uncle. Shockingly, the coffin was dropped on the road—something that should never happen in our culture.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPDn8tFBhz3sFANAG6y27RFnokV9B9bVEY8Cp73mS8sqt/1771600996928.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRw3KCkAYoZjCwf6mi24ZBbGk49QiLNavJkbbCAsXmZQ/1771600979619.jpg)


Panic set in. The driver’s phone was initially unreachable, 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBdHz8dEMNKGj8YWuFYX8TmSmMRCpnD5a9npD6jTmDxs/1771600979420.jpg)

and when contact was finally made, he revealed he had taken another client but promised to arrive within an hour. It was embarrassing and heartbreaking.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4kpxGiF2AxwrdEMS1jBKHDXSDZkVQokzMFbedZouep5/1771600997062.jpg)


When we arrived at my great-aunt’s house, we discovered there was no canopy to shield guests from the weather. There were no chairs for exhausted attendees and, most importantly, no coffin podium prepared. Basic arrangements had not been made. All of this could have been avoided with proper planning and unity.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmchrciFxqZspih3ZQCTdJswP73DZGKCR4yR8wsYjs5Vxs/1771600997186.jpg)

The elders of the community quickly sensed that there was conflict among the siblings. They paused the burial proceedings to address the matter. Palm trees and bamboo were arranged to create temporary shade while discussions took place.
My uncle and his sisters were brought before the elders. Each claimed they had no issue with one another, though the tension was obvious. My uncle openly said that all he wanted was to successfully bury his mother and afterward cut ties with his sisters.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRH9Sc1GMprE54S7LPyEr1jHeGbEwc3tpp4uQHqNf5QRQ/1771600061241.jpg)


The elders advised them wisely. They reminded them that their late mother would not want division among her children. She would want love, unity, and peace. After much counsel, the siblings forgave one another, and some of the tension eased.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPDswEsn5ENCEhpsrnUQpwiC26rUfhbisogr2zMrDBEWy/1771600061106.jpg)


They then officially presented themselves before the community to declare that they were burying their mother. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdbhUCSh2g9ADCebmSwHdcfP5xYZvFqmD7kuFnJjXRzA9/1771599918810.jpg)

A simple stone podium was prepared, church choruses were sung, prayers were offered, and finally, my great-aunt was laid to rest.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdbhUCSh2g9ADCebmSwHdcfP5xYZvFqmD7kuFnJjXRzA9/1771599918810.jpg)

ust when we thought the challenges were over, we arrived at the event field and discovered


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4UTp35RJiZm5v52hTNdbWZtp7L8QJgHxBpeFKf2CNQf/1771599918698.jpg)


 refreshments had not been properly arranged. For a Nigerian burial—where hospitality is highly valued—the snacks provided did not reflect the importance of the occasion.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQJDXC9RmbsgoUdiLd3BJ8MMbz3T38RFtmgUV27pgiT3/1771599918548.jpg)

Despite everything, the burial was completed. My uncle later returned to Lagos.

https://ecency.com/hive-165757/@amaborri/a-journey-home-to-say


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMqH2YC9MUbuzmASQtpCks6jmJHxZBxH1Rxgnnr3zjUB/1771599918351.png)

> ¡Un saludo a todos los usuarios de Hive y a los atletas de SWC! Espero que se encuentren muy bien y sigan con ánimo y disciplina para llevar a cabo sus entrenamientos. En esta oportunidad, quiero compartir una sesión de entrenamiento enfocada en uno de los elementos de fuerza más desafiantes y estéticos de la calistenia: el hefesto. # Apreciados lectores, la evolución en nuestro deporte implica enfrentar constantemente nuestras debilidades para convertirlas en fortalezas. **Aunque tengo un nivel muy bajo en hefesto, estoy muy ansioso y motivado por dominar esa skill, así que hoy decidí ponerme manos a la obra y llevar a cabo una rutina para ir acostumbrando a mi cuerpo**. Este ejercicio requiere una movilidad de hombros excepcional y una fuerza de bíceps inmensa, por lo que el acondicionamiento progresivo es vital para evitar cualquier tipo de lesión. # Para iniciar con la máxima energía, **comencé con los ejercicios más difíciles para mí, que son las negativas de hefesto; básicamente se trata de empezar desde arriba del todo en la barra y bajar lo más lento posible realizando la fase negativa**. Controlar el descenso permite que los tejidos conectivos se adapten a la tensión extrema que genera la extensión del hombro tras la espalda. Cada centímetro ganado en la lentitud de la caída es un paso más hacia el dominio del movimiento completo. # Para complementar el trabajo de fuerza específica, **posteriormente realicé curl de hefesto en barra baja; este ejercicio es similar al curl de bíceps invertido, se realiza con los pies en el suelo y en una barra baja para posteriormente imitar el movimiento del hefesto**. Al tener el apoyo de las piernas, pude concentrarme en la técnica y en el rango de movimiento sin que el peso total del cuerpo me impidiera realizar las repeticiones necesarias. En todo momento, **estuve concentrado en realizar la mejor técnica posible en cada ejercicio**, buscando la máxima contracción. Me retiro del parque con los brazos fatigados pero con la satisfacción de haber iniciado formalmente el camino hacia este gran objetivo. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post ¡Hasta la Próxima!
><div class=\

> Greetings to all Hive users and SWC athletes! I hope you are doing very well and continue with the spirit and discipline to carry out your training. On this occasion, I want to share a training session focused on one of the most challenging and aesthetic strength elements in calisthenics: the hefesto. # Dear readers, evolution in our sport involves constantly facing our weaknesses to turn them into strengths. **Although I have a very low level in hefesto, I am very anxious and motivated to master that skill, so today I decided to get to work and carry out a routine to get my body used to it**. This exercise requires exceptional shoulder mobility and immense bicep strength, so progressive conditioning is vital to avoid any type of injury. # To start with maximum energy, **I began with the most difficult exercises for me, which are the hefesto negatives; basically it's about starting from the very top of the bar and going down as slowly as possible performing the negative phase**. Controlling the descent allows the connective tissues to adapt to the extreme tension generated by shoulder extension behind the back. Every centimeter gained in the slowness of the drop is one more step toward mastering the full movement. # To complement the specific strength work, **I later performed hefesto curls on a low bar; this exercise is similar to an inverted bicep curl, it is done with feet on the ground and on a low bar to later imitate the hefesto movement**. Having leg support allowed me to focus on technique and range of motion without the total body weight preventing me from doing the necessary repetitions. At all times, **I was focused on performing the best possible technique in each exercise**, seeking maximum contraction. I leave the park with fatigued arms but with the satisfaction of having formally started the path toward this great goal. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time! ------

大年初五迎财神，祝大家财源广进，马年发大财,2026年一路发发发。其实在国外111气氛都没有的，那就只能自己找点过节的气氛。

说起过年，现在老外有的人也会知道我们中国过年，他们会祝贺我们新年好。店里员工也会讨喜，过年那天，他们学会说两句中国话:老板新年好，恭喜发财，红包拿来，跟小领导们讨红包，一般每年公司都会给他们包个小红包。

员工yoryi脸皮最厚了，跟我们要红包，我们就怼他，他们过圣诞节，公司送礼物🎁给他们，又有年终双良，到了我们过年，不应该他们要给我们礼物吗？被我们说了，他无言以对，不过最后下班，我们都有给他们包了红包🧧。

links.title: Golden Naan Snack || Spicy Naan Squares
links.body:
## <center> Hello all Bloggers </center>

Hi guys...! How are you all, I hope you all are well.
Today my in this blog I will share with you guys a new recipe. 
Last time I shared the recipe of Mini Dumplings, I am happy you all liked my recipe and gave me great feedback. 😍
Today I am going to share with you guys the recipe of Spicy Naan Squares.

Let's see how I made it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzqePB2Kz7ZaSQnqSMK82sroKbPaZRgFDMjwxmuNheWr/1771644771415.png)

***

## <center> Ingredients </center>

-  Potatoes  ( 200 grams )
-  Gram Flour ( 3 sp )
-  Bread  ( 2 )
-  Oil       ( for Fry )
-  Onion  ( 50 grams )
-  Water ( for mixing )
-  Spices Powder 
-  Green Chillies 

***

## <center> Process </center>

Guys, so far I have shared most of the recipes with you, so today I am going to share a new dish with you guys. 
So, without wasting time, I will tell you how to make it.

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVo52AEdJ642b5NwPuyf2X4UKXEB5kize4Y4pJFRVEZp/1771641685173.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhTL2T6hE8KFMWk4dM8Ag7smUajXkSXCnjUvMfdHggE1/1771641685332.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrKu2iEFphSTkpvobYDpv3FmSzwgZHzZacsKzCms4Mwm/1771641685477.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcSWjhYKcttciePJuQEhm9SZ5tYz6P2ZDHUWVMFGKyyDm/1771641685624.jpg)|
|-|-|

So first I grated half the potatoes very finely and chopped the onion very finely.
Then I cut the remaining potatoes into thin slices and also finely chopped the green chillies and added them.

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafYMCsfwDgENif6N5o9oZGhuppDHR5B7YzP3TEtfnEZg/1771641685775.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdQcFoRB57NKtLDsFnpUetA74h65Doxr2wR6C7CJDNfUQ/1771641759402.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfP8MLFfQExRdHeR9qu6ZcdRorWUNZZFG4fZN89oqC4zN/1771641759573.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnitBGTWtjobC6Z44JzLXwirPZmUvTMNYfNuXtVL25BB/1771641759731.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I added the gram flour and then the ground spices which include salt, ground red chillies, turmeric and garam masala.
Then I added little water and made a paste of all this mixture.

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5ATiPHbzHW2DU9zsheovsNZir2UrsV1xiGM7hMaQSaQ/1771641759893.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4GqbomRboBApKf5JGSEFpwzxUbVwsS3yKDH9whUk9BQ/1771641760067.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKSBwnGPD5AePQBQG5vRWQVp5ZFXz9rSzxXXSq98SCUR/1771641879996.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtND6h948dLnjXQuwJTVFkR8n8R25Bck2gq76TzJmC32/1771641880159.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I cut the naan (bread) into four pieces and spread this mixture on them one by one. 
At the same time, I poured cooking oil into a frying pan and put it on the fl to heat it.

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXX7pDfxJE6Rmb5aKD8VSY834dS2mecCWegC4pQAMayPU/1771641880323.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevzN7qdrDkSJtihakdqqALEU6LUAX1ntx9qoZbhDqbeL/1771641880470.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWcZp6Giv4pQLkH3NJsHpnPEswbYGG2F6pYtqszH6stFz/1771641880629.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWk9LwyY8XCz3uCMj19HkovFg5zPMnReRcWenNibSFU4f/1771641993869.jpg)|
|-|-|

When the oil was hot, I started putting each piece in it, the side on which the mixture was applied, I put it down. 
When the mixture was cooked, I changed its side and when its color turned brown and they became crispy, I took them out on a plate with the help of a sieve.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemrt9DBdGWeA3fAaEafx1gD5FWAzswUNHdUWBAFGAc4y/1771641994045.jpg)

Golden, crispy naan topped with a flavorful potato and onion filling, creating the perfect balance of crunch and softness in every bite.   
This homemade snack is not only tempting to look at but also delivers pure comfort and deliciousness in every bite.

***

## *Final Look:*

Served with ginger-garlic tomato sauce, it becomes even more rich, tangy, and irresistible.
The bold flavors of the sauce perfectly complement the crispy texture, making it a true street-style delight.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoqveEp25SpKc12t46qWjta2LQ3wUC7h71hQnSZYEds4/1771641994226.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP86Qn1ACmEc5Lr4RnQK1wWN3roqMHmmhMc8HwHm1pYwD/1771641994387.jpg)

***
***

I hope you all like my recipe. I will wait for your comments. Now we will meet in the next post with a new recipe. Until then, Good Bye...🤗

links.body:
![IMG_2896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23uQLvcn6uri6qqkL7bU22oaoGAFdwAnbmaFpw2Gv5Mr13WcNUgcgV2VeuQadoyKiN2ut.jpg)

Today, on a whim, I went with some old friends to a spot in the city of San Diego, Venezuela, that I never imagined I'd ever see. It's what looks like the remains of the railway line and station that was supposed to run through practically all of Venezuela. It was a project from decades ago, but in the end, it was never finished, leaving only structures, stations, and vast stretches of railway tracks.

![IMG_2937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23ywgsT4Zod1YidffRBNUAAnrCBTchcnKvGw3x3NRvFV9cLyKRLXLySVwSPStcJ8iEo9z.jpg)

![IMG_2935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23wqZpskNwDP4GEAZ66PMZie51wS15Bj9frDDih2ggXxF5v75MvPWi9wCaShHAonXKwfm.jpg)

I used to see these tracks when I passed by on the bus during my travels, and I always thought that it was probably too far away or impossible to walk to. But it was actually closer than I thought, and quite accessible. You just had to walk a long way; of course, it's a bit isolated from the city, but at the same time, very close.

![IMG_2926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23tmB3rPcWshWft6tWFNuGaFzjSHdZkR36ahi2TTrcLjvnVLnxGcKNwQgFChgYEQniu3T.jpg)

![IMG_2914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/241tSkLhFkiutMc9z5EzZTxT52Cw6mFXnxSy3JzfA7o4icEJwk4xBzPsQ8639dCGEtxt5.jpg)

During this journey, we passed through two tunnels and a train station. I took the opportunity to capture some silhouettes, especially of my friends, but also a bit of the landscape, which blends what appears to be abandonment with a glimpse of nature in this area, characterized by dry lands nestled among a series of low mountains. It was quite an adventure, without a doubt.

![IMG_2948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/242YG5fMPwmEWKPtmYbeaUWiLgs6oEZh2xVmYo4FFT7Vefq7uzoWFpeQyHqa1ksuSNjXk.jpg)

![IMG_2923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23xyhXeubmJTpPkZBnPeQbsEe4BikZYXt51YF4XAELkhTmDu9f7GRRkPnjN8892cDxZUZ.jpg)

All photographs are my own.

links.title: There's Different Types Of Evidence.
links.body:
I have heard that said as well, Walter, but have I seen any documentation, any pictures? Like, has there been any sworn investigator that said, yes, Jeffrey Epstein had cameras in every room, including the bathroom? No, a witness said that. People that were there said that. Doesn't mean that it's not true, but you know what I mean? Like, the fact that… I don't know.

It's just it's not the same as, like, hard evidence. That's when I know opinions and me kind of touched on this. Like, there's different types of evidence.




If you have solid evidence, it's very easy to get convictions. When you don't, that's when you run into these problems, like I think we're seeing right now. You can't just have, like, a flight log that says, you know, Bob went to the island, and then the jury is going to throw him under the bus, and he's going to jail forever because he went to an island where somebody had actually, you know, done a crime with somebody else that we weren't able to prove either.

Because on the videos, like you were saying, there's no identifiers that identify the people. First of all, you need probable cause just to make an arrest. And even if you have that, doesn't mean it's going to be enough for a prosecutor to say, yeah, we're going to prosecute this crime.

They could be like, yeah, you have probable cause, but I don't have enough to even think I could prove this. Bye. You know, and just because they bring somebody in, even with evidence rock solid, they're not going to, I did it, you got me, you know, it's over.


<center>https://media.istockphoto.com/id/1344877131/photo/flipping-fake-to-fact-word-on-wooden-cube-block-on-blue-background-market-trend-positive.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=27CxF-AxVKjeDXPOiJEBi2WlJ_iSYLcHVDwOGQ32cGI=[Source](https://media.istockphoto.com/id/1344877131/photo/flipping-fake-to-fact-word-on-wooden-cube-block-on-blue-background-market-trend-positive.webp?b=1&s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=27CxF-AxVKjeDXPOiJEBi2WlJ_iSYLcHVDwOGQ32cGI=)</center>

Well, there's discovery laws too that come into it that are a bitch, right? Opinions of the cops. Discovery laws are usually what makes it very hard to even make a case. Well, and when you talk about the criminal enterprise side of it is when you get into the RICO stuff, which is very hard to prove and very complicated for jurors to understand.

links.title: Tom, the neighbor's cat [Eng/Esp]
links.body: <div class=\

>

Many people think I'm lucky with cats because of the number of photos I take of them and because they often cooperate quite a bit, but there are also times when it's a bit tricky. Today I'm sharing some photos I took of Tom, a neighbor's cat who, even though he looks so calm in the photos, still doesn't trust me and I have to take the photos from a distance because the slightest movement makes him run away. I hope you enjoy these photos.

Muchas personas consideran que tengo suerte con los gatos, por la cantidad de fotos que les hago y que en muchas ocasiones colaboran bastante, pero también tengo momentos donde es un poco complicado y el día de hoy les comparto unas fotografías que le hice a Tom, un gato vecino el cual, aunque lo vean tan tranquilo para las fotografías, todavía no confía en mí y tengo que hacer las fotos desde lejos, porque al cualquier mínimo movimiento se va corriendo, espero que disfruten de estas fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wX3hLBH2ooNFMbbAKu92LNrX4r5AWkmeFBikRu8MGbZQVJEwrVszZG9d6HTNyTjYrhC.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xVKHTpnzo8MbguFUNK2cqGJkxe72M56W6MpJ3ERhezgHakoNmmTHTdwBkahmrroK6JK.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23zS7FUrFDaVWCSL36egGPrZemFboGgAMtAXTL1ydRQuuvKRC6RcwJ8zCGTRXBr2wLRfq.jpg

>

There is a type of cat that is very shy around people, while others like to be petted, but Tom is definitely one of the former. It's not that he let me take pictures of him with me nearby, it's that he was inside his house and I was standing behind the fence that clearly separated us. I knew I couldn't get any closer, so I had to use the zoom on my camera to take these pictures. That's why the photos look like they were taken up close, but it was definitely a lot of work to take them.

Hay un tipo de gatos que son muy sigilosos con respecto a las personas, mientras otros les gusta que las personas les hagan cariño, pero Tom sin duda es de los primeros y no es que se dejó hacer las fotos teniéndome cerca, es que, él está dentro de su casa y yo estaba desde el enrejillado que claramente nos separaba, sabía que no podía avanzar más de ahí, por lo que tuve que apoyarme del Zoom de mi cámara para estas fotografías, de ahí que las fotos parezcan estar cerca, pero sin duda fue un trabajo completo el hacerle estas fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23ydAHquKio3nJrwRknRhz7ghbZTMLCJ4hcD4UYJak234VvDMQzB9ovVLvjmJiNxZsPUH.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uFKEwFm5U4jfXYqWtKPJTs6TVYLJTs8LRVq8PPwzzgsLaGfEs3FPeaSp6UkBn4jBP4W.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23yTYq4AZ98nhGP1x9GYTTcSnQtsqrGW5ic8MYrJW5RbWSSzJUa7RUQsGFw1DZJFqEWEk.jpg

>

What I do consider an advantage in a way is that Tom, knowing that I couldn't get past him, ignored me and did whatever he wanted: he cleaned himself up, lay down, looked around to see where the noise was coming from, and just stayed there. It was good for me, obviously, because it gave me the opportunity to take pictures, but he also moved his face around a lot, so I had to take several shots to get a good focus.

Lo que sí considero una ventaja de alguna manera es que Tom, al saber que no podía pasar yo, hasta me ignoraba e hizo lo que quiso: se limpió, se acostó, miró a todos los lados de donde provenía ruido y simplemente estuvo allí. Fue algo bueno para mí, claramente porque me daba la oportunidad de hacer fotografías, pero también movía mucho la cara, por lo que tuve que hacer varias fotos para enfocar de una buena manera.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wMVzz2qGktf6hvJ8acdz8yFa2KxHHSfHvV918tZY3dDoRuQnz8DceLTG3wMsZhBVt1C.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xei729P3AV91yGmeihRX36JS8kEZJZb8YybufxDaNLa5eF2TAabNdr8Xzmy7pHWGYqD.jpg

>

That's all for now. I hope you enjoyed these photos of such an unloving cat (I hope to win his trust at some point). Thank you for taking the time to look at my photos; I really appreciate it. I hope you're all doing great. Have a wonderful day!

Hasta aquí la publicación; espero que disfrutaran de estas fotografías de un gato tan poco cariñoso (espero en algún momento ganarme su confianza). Gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías; lo aprecio mucho. Deseo que todos se encuentren genial. ¡Feliz día!

links.title: The Exploration Continues...
links.body: I've been quite busy with work and gardening recently... and in addition, it was rainy for weeks. However, it hardly rained this week, and I felt that my body needed to move more than the everyday gardening work. I asked my father last night if he wanted to go for a jog the next morning. I only had one class today since the usual 2-hour class was rescheduled for tomorrow instead. He agreed!\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> It was blue hour when we left the house. It was around a quarter to six, and my class is at eight. :) We initially planned to go to the previous route (going beyond the Elementary school) because it was a nice place to jog compared to the other routes.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/> On our way to the main road, we saw this cute baby cow. Recently, there have been baby cows in our neighborhood because a couple of mommy cows gave birth. They're so cute and fun to watch.
alt=\
/> As I've mentioned earlier, we initially planned to go the usual route _(the left side)_, but when we arrived in the area, we decided to go the opposite side and explore what's there.
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> The road on the right also splits in two, and we chose to go to the left. There was a small stream, and many trees. However, when we walked around 300 meters, there were quite a lot of houses and so many dogs on the road, so we did a 180. _hahaha_
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/> Finally, we chose this road, hoping not to encounter many dogs along the way. _hahaha_
alt=\
/> There's this huge house near the corner of the road. It's a compound, and when we passed by, they had a huge caged iguana near the gate! I didn't take a photo of it, though. _hahaha_
alt=\

/> As we continued walking, we heard flowing water. I wonder what it was, so I tried finding it. I think it's connected to the stream from the other side earlier. In this place, you could only hear the flowing water, the trees swaying because of the wind, and the bird sounds. It's so amazing!
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> After quite a long stretch of just trees that makes the place like a small forest, there's an open area! There were some houses here and there, but most of them are away from the road. The trees are huge, and some are quite old, but I love the vibes. Anyway, here's the open area below!
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\
/>\n\n
alt=\

/> It had a completely different vibe from the area we just passed by earlier. We decided to just stop in this area, and went back to the place we passed by. We just walked to this place, but going back to the intersection, we jogged most of the way. I was out of breath since I couldn't go for walks and jogs for weeks, but it felt really good! We arrived home a few minutes before seven, so I had enough time to have breakfast and prepare for my class. My mom wants to go for a walk tomorrow, and I plan to accompany her. We'll probably take the same route as today. She'll definitely enjoy the scenery! I'll end this post here for now. See you around! (^^,)/

links.body:
![Blue Minimalist Travel Summer Scrapbook Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48XB9EAfg88R6tfe1FQoZrUmKUffmBjYahqd1GNo7LG3NNBn6iwjeX6TbdzUU6jBDL.jpg)

Hello everyone! 🍅
Early in the morning, before the sun rises high, we already start harvesting my parents’ tomatoes plant. I can still feel the cold air while we walk toward the farm. Since our farm is far from the main road, we cannot easily bring everything to the vehicle. That is why we use a horse to carry our harvest. 

![IMG_20260213_111106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQiHxrXEDRZmduSYCuqzxfa5TfYT2f2xdoEt6Qdgc95kfRejtrPUoRE2pE94EzZus8P.jpg)

After picking the ripe red tomatoes, we carefully load them into sacks and place them on the horse. Watching the horse slowly walk while carrying our hard work feels humbling. Step by step, we bring the tomatoes to the area along the rocky road where the elf vehicle can reach. From there, we transfer everything again, this time into the elf truck. The tomatoes are placed in sacks to keep them secure during transport. 

![IMG_20260213_111151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zRxodxLuNmgzn83LGcEwkqKLaGuyn9T6g92xe95owptZMAr41tVeUb1869HHuaVg4C5.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_113405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xedS6DsZeE1xCALsTXeTP9oLKsEyS3yQNbRjA6fRXUzAXUAKxncffp8tzAXq6Th9kJK.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_113401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zbKXo9vR4Z4KBEXkYrgTNtgfBZ7MjuWqhy3tsQUz97gQyzeKCNCFLbMSZG66QynHuRN.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_113409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQr56Wdz8P4TuRie3JeK1sej92JF9JDsNUACe34nxPWUxtqLLZMPbhAp6KQX6rCq5W1.jpg)

When we arrive home, my work continues. We wash the tomatoes thoroughly. This is very important for me because we want them clean, shining and free from dirt and sprayed Pesticides. 

**Please, when you buy tomatoes in the market, make sure to wash the, very well before cooking or eating**. 

After washing, we do nut rush the packing. We lay the tomatoes in our traditional bamboo drying and let them air dry. We arrange them properly and leave the, there until they are completely dry. This prevents moisture from causing early spoilage. 

![IMG_20260213_121501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFPdTD1HCqKLnPnv4ycUNq55WL6Ys5ubn2BT53LrwbRGT5gBYYXmeUvrtgWMaNfDF84.jpg)

When the tomatoes are no longer wet, we start weighing them. Each pack contains 20 kilos. We carefully place the tomatoes into thick cellophane bags. Seal the, properly and prepare the, for delivery in the market. We wholesale each 20 kilos pack for 800 pesos. 

![IMG_20260213_130857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xei2c9FjJQfcByBCSWyWkKTr4j1zMgsVZ5BnyuRiALQpiSYv2MuomnFr72GeveRXezy.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_121425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u697NnMQJCJS5Jj8mWkpy6JWMPK68VjrRg3FrFiKrNKeC8rvPFzbk76hHx1wMerN7PN.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_113704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQpMjurP5jh37qQApM6x8Vd5Z2FgEK4nBHB39ZD5wEX6wcRSbbCNhBfXtXTUsmWXDpF.jpg)

From early morning harvesting, horse transport, truck transfer, washing, drying, weighing and packing, every step requires effort, teamwork and hard work. It is not just about selling tomatoes. It is about proper handling and making sure quality produce reaches the market fresh and clean. Also, we make sure to classify it base on the sizes and prices. 

![IMG_20260213_130907.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbwMBaNCvGrZUupo2YMZ5HWtJRwykQbqgDmSiVgZ2mhvGLSdGp7veMbcwPyf1En4dHU.jpg)

![IMG_20260213_141342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xebX9ty77yDS1d3XVqsi7Z5kargLhGgR7ASmZswSTfD72PNE7VAEnGQdZisiDDJrryS.jpg)

Thank you for reading and supporting my story! This is my own picture, edited in Canva. Have a nice day everyone.

links.title: In the Carwash, cuz we just a bit too dirty.
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcfBQU2w8N72AKEWYBrfLEcQwaAVV8QF81oSHLxuzGQSb/1771642973076.jpg)

...and we are in the ups and downs like a roller coaster.  Im just a train on the tracks apparently.  The weather is lighter, my car is so dirty and i had to head to the Emissions place, close to my house.  Its like mandatory testing by the state, Emissions regulation type stuff.  Im due to buy the yearly sticker too, so here we go.

> I hate..... having to do the testing, and pay the now $150 for a new sticker this year.

But I respect the system, and i must keep things in order.  

The DMV was quick actually.  When i pulled up, there was hardly just 1 car in front of me and in was just about done anyways by time i pulled into the lane.  Im not even really 100% just suddenly but i dragged myself out to complete this mission.  The Emissions check is quick, hardly even a moment to prepare and take any pictures there....i said.....screw it.  My car is working well so no problems, and i move forward with clearance to now purchase the sticker online.  

I could have stopped inside since i was there, but im in no rush for the sticker and id rather ignore the people today haha 😆 

## Am I even Awake ##

Phew, i take a deep breath, im back on the road, the traffic is easy...and i pull up to the CarWash place.....

> gotta keep the ride lookin fresh.. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeujqzJC3ibb6KArFNwa8UfoPhW57VxFNQ8C5LqHPqDFh/1771643734342.jpg)

I gotta adjust ever so carefully....while i pull into the track...my car is precious...

> piece of crap cost enough lolol

GET IT IN NUETRAL

DONT PANIC....

But for some reason, my fancy electronic park/neutral/drive select tweaks a little.  So in in the track, car in neutral, this is costing $15 usd.   Of course its a good wash, the undercarriage, a basic wax.  My wheels are fine, and i dont want more extras.  But thats where today's prices are at.  A mid service essentially, for 15 bucks.  Used to cost an easy 10, 10 years ago though.  Time has been moving for sure.

But anyways, speaking of time moving.

May the wash..  start moving.....


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwR36dby7iZEH9pa5EGYtAWWebZnayw8gMyxPXv47hDo/1771644133021.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpC1mYMKLfDfa3977YQ39CY3d8a67oMJQtoyUuC4fs5A/1771644133093.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTfW1yB9rDYzZbjqrjpsGQ6YCqxyBtsPv4eHhFwmv24io/1771644133165.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnKUVNchS499qdJXAMs5kg5qEigNNaTWYNEukPEnV9E4/1771644133244.jpg)

And by time these big beautiful blue things get done smackin me around.....its time to dry up...

And ride away....into the afternoon #chicago sunset.

Ranting about my time and place.....in this current space.

And this current Car Wash....up in yo Face....

---
---

links.title: Cats are not only adorable, they are actually the best predators.
links.body: ‎<div class=\

>I hope you have a good time. Today's beautiful expedition with two cats is a great experience for cats. And cats are one of the best predators. However, cats' inquisitive eyes and experience in understanding the scent of fish are really difficult achievements that they are able to understand very easily.

However, cats are really very resourceful, beautiful, sweet, and cunning. However, it is true that I cannot help them properly. Still, I do not hesitate to run away when I see a hungry animal. But some cats have a very challenging life outside.

Owner cats are partners in human activities through various training. But the animals that grow up on the street, the behavior is very different from the owner animals. However, it is really true that outdoor cats are twice as good at protecting themselves than indoor cats. Because their life is challenging.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS95xRt7DU1VZAfBHCrv4MN8tMxuWnvjgzhiSFFBPMaUF/1771436594606.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqFv9Q3tHmYYRBX9JejMbMZ2puixepq6Fr96HE2XmtY9/1771436594637.jpg)

The cat is sitting in a warehouse with a very angry attitude. He is trying to find something next to this door and is sitting silently without making any sound. But the cat's eyes show a very angry attitude.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYCTpUcT7cwmZ2fgRs2q61RRP6NPX2QUaCWMCjYnsPwsK/1771436594668.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSscYN489pWwJ8W13dhfpJUT22BQVd5acxHEDwsfkayPt/1771436594700.jpg)

But as far as I know, this cat has taken a strong stance to confront a rat. He is standing guard at this door and looks very angry. I thought I had hurt the cat with a rat.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDo7eggefBw5hw6GHuvnN2PhSq8hCQUBM76iE6b131p1/1771436689317.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRCTF74Xz6MXskyLLpyBXfay2uiw2gfzxsRodj3Y4ebU8/1771436689353.jpg)

The stray cats on this street are very hardworking. This cat has a problem with one eye. Only through a difficult life can he see the light of this world with one eye. But the other eye is damaged.



 You pay a little attention. He sometimes comes to our house to eat. He comes to eat fish with fish bones and juicy rice. But I don't chase this creature away, I just try to understand his desires. But it's really hard to see the world with one eye. The older he gets, the more responsible he has to be to protect himself.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeT13gWq5DSGqJckzgU9gHenyQARV1TFomN3YyBQhuLfg/1771436689438.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTacTwEt6gLCgSgutjRnBpmh2NXk5cYkVgwbsERw1s1Xv/1771436689386.jpg)

But the animal's experience is really great, it has the experience of climbing trees. Also, every day from my yard I see the cat walking on the wall. But I don't understand one thing. Why is it walking on the wall every day? In search of some food or again in search of some mouse. Do you understand the reason for walking on the wall? Don't hesitate to tell me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPfMdbUbsoD9uTft6LYbMitJRRMHm2CzihCnXS8ZpJDs8/1771436689412.jpg)

Today I have highlighted the lifestyle of two beautiful cats and their daily lives. I hope animals are always a part of compassion. We as humans love animals.

links.title: 春节放烟花炮竹
links.body: 每到春节的时候，感觉很多都开始\

。

首当其冲的，就是只知道初几，不知道日期，更不知道星期几，有种陶渊明《桃花源》里那种“不知有汉 无论魏晋”的感觉。

其次呢，就是饮食习惯“乱套”。春节期间的饮食都比平日里丰富了多出不少，加上走亲戚，到处都是美食，这里吃一些，哪里多一点，每次量虽不多，但一天下来，总体下肚的量还是非常客观。

这不，这才到初五，我称了下自己体重，俨然比年前已经多出5斤多。。。囧

不过春节也有很多欢乐，对于孩子们来说，最大的乐趣，应就是放烟花和炮竹了。

男孩子天性都爱放炮竹，尤其是孩子。还未到春节，孩子们就早早出去买了炮竹，但是我提醒他们，要放炮竹和烟花，要等到回到乡下，找块空旷地方才可以。


![IMG20260219200626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/23wgMdN9YJTNh6Rizk5j8QrZDpx72rk4poZ35iZ5XxN8snsLVEZNrB1C5TFKPdU57Bzgn.jpg)


等到了乡下，傍晚的时候，几个小孩子聚在一起，吵嚷着要去放炮竹，老大提议，要找个有水地方，理由是他要把炮竹扔到水里炸鱼。

我带着小朋友们来到河边，找了块空旷地方，确认安全后，便开启了烟花炮竹模式。


![IMG20260219201105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/23x18qQDB247ckam73oHLCQ89qK6uUzteKGq5JrTtRjFv7aeZMWfAmrqrmDaCQ3umY3NQ.jpg)


老大节前的时候，让孩子妈妈在网上给他买了个“放炮神器”，其实就是个类似炮架子，把炮竹塞进去，点燃后炮竹会自己打出去，这样虽然很安全，但感觉不够刺激。于是在尝试了几次后，很快就被“抛弃”了。

男孩子放炮竹，总是能想出新的花样。先是炮竹变换着花样放，等到最后，放那个最大的加特林烟花时，老大提议说想拿到手上。起初我是不同意那样做，但在仔细查看了之后，确认如果操作得当，还是比较安全，于是最后同意了。

老大拿着“加特林”，学着电影《终结者》里施瓦辛格扮演的T100机器人样子，对着河边的上空，来回不断地“发射”，兴奋的大叫，旁边的孩子们也跟着一起喊，很是开心的样子。

我想起来我小时候，那时候虽没有这么丰富的烟花，但炮竹还是不少。鞭炮太小，不够威力不够刺激，于是便把许多鞭炮剥开，倒出里边的火药，攒到一起，然后重新自己制作个更大的炮仗，跑到田野里，放到牛粪上，干啥？自然是炸牛粪啊！跑到水库边上，炸鱼。。。有时候自制的炮竹威力和响声实在太大，惹来水库看门的老头“凶神恶煞”般跑过来。。。于是大伙便一哄而散。。。

玩炮竹虽然刺激，但是安全绝对是第一位的。我小时候就有过多次教训，手被火药灼烧过都是小事，被炮竹炸过也有几次，好在最后都没造成大的影响。

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/EQK_I3h1TCY

但是，有时候玩大了，就会出事。我自己跟我同学和他弟弟一起玩，那次就是想更刺激下，将一堆火药倒进木桩里，嗯，里边有个孔，然后封起来，点燃。。。结果呢，一声巨响之后，我同学的弟弟被送进医院，当晚就死了。。。

那次亲眼目睹的教训，给了我很大的震撼。

春节放烟花和炮竹虽然很美，很带劲，但安全绝对是首要的。

links.title: Wise men should be followed to ensure moral education of children
links.body:
Hello students and gentlemen. Today I am here to share a special topic with you. Basically, we all give moral education to our children and also provide them with formal education. Formal education and moral education play a very important role in our children. As children grow older, they become more educated and formal education plays an important role in their lives. We all want our children to excel in moral education along with formal education. But if we really want to make our children aware of moral education, then we must make them follow various wise people.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdKkFzWf9sWEqc9NpBzEb1CvBn1dnZrPPKJJdFz8xdQ4Q/pexels-akelaphotography-448877.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/shallow-focus-photography-of-girl-448877/)

The Creator has sent various sages and sages to this world. Allah has sent saints and good people to this world. There are various real-life stories and experiences about how good a person can be, if he is good, he can give away all the wealth of his house to the poor. 

There are many saints of Allah in our world who have worshipped the Creator without eating only to find the Creator. There are some stories that teach good behavior towards animals and birds. 

Hazrat Omar (RA) was a ruler of a country who used to go to every house without eating at night and would keep an eye on which family had food. 

Various saints of Allah and sages of different religions have come to this world. Each of them has some wonderful stories in their lives and they are real-life stories. Stories can educate us in a lot of good lessons and those stories play a very good and important role in our real-life experiences. 

Sometimes we want our children to listen to stories of various wise and talented people.  Newton discovered that the earth is held together by gravity by falling from an apple tree. That is, if we want to raise our children to be wise, kind and humane, then it is our moral responsibility to tell them the stories of the lives of various sages. All those stories have a huge impact on the lives of children and they will be able to do something good in their lives.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR3dwDTotBj2Rpw83NmoZVgnHKqMZSvs48HatAaRvLcMR/pexels-hai-nguyen-825252-1699414.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-and-women-wearing-red-and-black-academic-gowns-and-black-mortar-boards-1699414/)


We educate children only for certificates. But in real life, the value of certificates is zero for me. Because certificates alone cannot make a person's life beautiful. To make a person's life beautiful, it is very important to have moral education in all aspects. 

A person who does not have moral education within him can never be educated. Formal education alone cannot change a person's life. 

A person is called educated and religious only when he has morality within him and has respect and love for people. So if we really want our children to lead the society as educated and religious, then they should definitely know the real-life events of wise people. So we and all of you will tell the children the real-life stories of Oli and various wise people. Then they will become like people and will be able to make a huge change in their lives. Because every success story helps children reach the peak of further progress.


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@bestrakibul2/wise-men-should-be-followed-to-ensure-moral-education-of-children-leh)

title.title: Deliciosa pasta con salsa cremosa de queso/Delicious pasta with creamy cheese sauce 🧀🍽
title.body:
> La pasta es de los alimentos más versátiles que hay, y es que la puedes acompañar con prácticamente todo, desde pollo, carnes, pescado, mariscos, vegetales, verduras, y un sin fin de salsas y cremas, y como saben, en casa amamos la pasta, y como solemos comerla practicamente todas las semanas, trato de variar siempre la forma en que la preparo, y hace unos días decidí acompañarla con una salsa cremosa de queso y perejil que quedó súper deli.
Pasta is one of the most versatile foods there is, because you can pair it with practically anything, from chicken, meat, fish, seafood, vegetables, and an endless variety of sauces and creams. As you know, we love pasta at home, and since we eat it practically every week, I always try to vary the way I prepare it. A few days ago, I decided to pair it with a creamy cheese and parsley sauce that turned out to be super delicious.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5pyTPJBd4J4gPPWK2uiDNSnerzCiE4oYJSk5nkTd1kr/1771644017111.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Esta es una receta como las que me gusta preparar, bastante sencilla de hacer, rápida y deliciosa, es de esas recetas que necesitas para cuando quieres comer rico y sin mucho trabajo, así que la quise compartir con ustedes el día de hoy. >This is the kind of recipe I like to make—quite simple, quick, and delicious. It's one of those recipes you need for when you want to eat well without a lot of work, so I wanted to share it with you today. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW86nVkDtdvVAzrdRjhvVy64a62v1KCyJrDuvXTgjWFh4/1771643430557.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de pasta corta Crema de leche 1 taza y 1/2 de queso rallado 3 dientes de ajo 2 cucharadas de perejil 1 cucharada de aceite 1 taza del agua de la cocción de la pasta Sal Pimienta
## Ingredients 500 grams of short pasta Heavy cream 1 1/2 cups of grated cheese 3 cloves of garlic 2 tablespoons of parsley 1 tablespoon of oil 1 cup of pasta cooking water Salt Pepper
## Procedimiento/Procedure Para comenzar con nuestra preparación lo primero que haremos es ocuparnos de la pasta, la que cocinaremos como de costumbre, y una vez lista reservamos una taza de la cocción de la misma.
To begin our preparation, the first thing we will do is take care of the pasta, which we will cook as usual, and once it is ready, we will reserve a cup of the cooking water.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcGU8xMzemJKJ63nrDETMvB2RSXrmg4iDQVbzkxxrJvAH/1771642833867.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Cuando agreguemos la pasta al agua comenzaremos con la preparación de la salsa, que como les comenté es bastante sencilla, y lo primero que haremos será triturar los dientes de ajo y sofreirlos en la cucharada de aceite por unos segundos.
To begin our preparation, the first thing we will do is take care of the pasta, which we will cook as usual, and once it is ready, we will reserve a cup of the cooking water.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeqmA7Hr2rsfB4PsMP1gTYnTxMkMkDqkfLVLHiMttosc/1771642610683.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgFpBKjhnyLFAk82keQpnJbvGB6szTgKjoJT87PZc1se/1771642831664.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente incorporamos la crema de leche y cocinamos por 2 minutos sin dejar de remover.
Next, add the heavy cream and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmec9ZB74rXYrTGgTDGpPj7viR6iN6YmFqPJhB5vFiH1vT/1771642612431.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El siguiente paso es agregar la taza de agua de la cocción de la pasta y seguidamente el queso, una pizca de sal y pimienta. Dejamos cocinar por 4 minutos sin dejar de remover.
The next step is to add the cup of water used to cook the pasta, followed by the cheese, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring constantly.

title.title: Entrada al Concurso \
| Seres sin rostro
title.body:
>

Salió del baño, aún con el cabello mojado y la toalla enrollada en su cintura; se arodillo junto al catre donde había estado durmiendo los últimos meses, tomó una bocanada de aire como quien va a sumergirse bajo el agua, y posó sus ojos sobre la mochila de viejero.

> Hay momentos en la vida de un hombre, cuando tiene que decidir entre continuar viviendo una vida de mentiras o tirar todo a la mierda y largarse.

Lentamente se quitó el rostro y lo doblo con cuidado, guardándolo en su mochila entre los pocos trapos que le quedaba, asegurandose de arrugarlo, pues seguramente podría necesitarlo más adelante, en algún lugar distante y desconocido.

Era inevitable, pues la mascara de hombre amoroso, tierno y comprensivo hacía rato que había dejado de funcionar con la ultima incauta que había caído en sus garras.

Se vistió en silencio y sin rostro, y salió cerrando la puerta con un golpe seco tras de sí.

Juliana permaneció sentada impávida en la barra del comedor, mirando profundamente su taza, quizá con la esperanza de ver su futuro en el asieto del café.

Se cuestionaba el no haberse dado cuenta a tiempo de las multiples falsas caras del hombre con quien había compartido los últimos años; el mismo que la había sacado de su lugar de origen y llevado a una tierra extraña y ajena, donde su soledad la había hecho aferrarse a él a pesar de la mentira y la manipulación en que se había convertido la relación.

Y no es que no hubiesen habido señales desde el principio, pero cuando el corazón y los sueños se imponen a la razón, es muy difícil poder ver la realidad que se oculta detrás de las mascaras.

Recordó las palabras de su mejor amigo, que siempre le decía que necesitaba lentes para ver mejor a los hombres con los que congeniaba; casi todos escorpianos y definitivamente cada uno más psicópata que el otro.

Quizá las cosas no eran tan así, como decía su exagerado amigo, pero definitivamente sus elecciones en la vida no habían sido las más acertadas.

*-Será verdad eso que dicen sobre la Ley de la atracción-* se preguntaba sin voltear a ver lo que sucedía en su entorno, ¿acaso ella también tenía sus propias máscaras que había ido construyendo como medida de autoprotección?

Los chinos suelen decir que en toda relación de pareja interactuan cuatro personalidades: lo que somos, lo que mostramos, lo que vemos y lo que hay detrás de lo que vemos.

Cómo saber lo que es real y lo que es una apariencia, si vivimos cegados por lo que deseamos ver; deslumbrados por el brillo de lo que nos quieren mostrar, y aturdidos por creer, o querer creer, que los lúdicos sueños se están haciendo realidad.

Ese hombre por un tiempo le había mostrado lo que ella quería ver; le habia inculcado la idea de que junto a él podría hacer realidad su sueño de independencia y crecimiento; pero día a día fue construyendo una relación de dependencia, restricciones, manipulación y control, haciéndola sentir insegura,  temerosa y culpable. Y no puede haber amor donde no hay libertad y respeto.

En varias oportunidades había querido separarse, pero el miedo a la soledad y a la incapacidad de valerse por sí misma la terminaba manteniendo en ese vínculo dañino y pernicioso.

Este tipo de relaciones no terminan hasta que se tiene el valor de anteponer el autorespeto y la dignidad, a la falsa sensación de seguridad y compañía. Y ese día por fin había llegado.

Tan solo bastó un: \

Al percatarse que estaba sola, que su torturador por fin se había marchado, sintió un gran alivio, al tiempo que un gran vacío se apoderó de ella, experimentando por un momento, lo que Kundera llama la insoportable levedad del ser. Juliana se levantó de su silla, se dirigió al guardaropa y abrió la maleta con la que había llegado al pueblo. Del fondo sacó una mascara, la colocó sobre su rostro y salió sin rumbo fijo, sin planes y sin expectativas. Afuera, el desfile de carnaval ya había comenzado.
**--Texto de mi autoría *E.Rivera*--**

title.title: REQUETOLANDIA CITY (ES.EN)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmShQqRgvgvX4jLbKXpgJqDgpaRhy1c7NZTFopcWY4EVem/img_20260220_215244.jpg)


En enero de 2059 cayó el último bastión del proletariado. Las naciones del sistema colapsaron; la más crítica: Reguetolandia, epicentro del conflicto unipolar. 
Un sobreviviente —rescatado en estado fantasmal, con fonética deformada y sin dominio de otros idiomas— murmuró: “Mister, nadie se preocupa por nadie”. Su testimonio, casi ininteligible, complicó la investigación. Protegido por una corte marcial de derechos humanos, mostraba temblores severos: síntoma típico de desintoxicación del caos al ingresar al nuevo orden mundial.  

Se analizan dos hipótesis sobre su fuga:  
1) Rechazo psicológico involuntario ante el éxtasis y la irresponsabilidad generalizada.
2) Intención subversiva: formar mercenarios y alianzas externas.  
Se descarta su pertenencia a los grupos intelectuales clandestinos que aún se esconden en suburbios antisociales, perseguidos por el régimen.  

Diagnóstico internacional:  
1) Requetolandia es una tiranía de facto sin estatutos legítimos, con una “constitución” autoproclamada y leyes cambiantes según conveniencia.  
2) Su Consejo de Estado incluye un presidente transgénero de turno y un parlamento liderado por ex presidiarios indultados —acusados previamente de violación y asesinato.  
3) Zona franca de decibeles: uso indiscriminado de sonido, violando leyes globales de contaminación acústica.  
4) Nudismo y sexo libre sin restricciones en espacios públicos.  
5) Educación prohibida. El lenguaje está deformado oficialmente; el uso de uniformes escolares y vocabulario estándar es ilegal. El docente es considerado culturalmente inferior.  
6) Las redes sociales, en “requetolandés”, son el único medio legal de información.  
7) Tatuaje obligatorio del 50 % de la piel en ancianos y niños, como identificación social.  
8) Policía y ejército integrados por bandas armadas de barrios marginales. No existen prisiones ni tribunales; se aprueba la purga colectiva.  

En Requetolandia City, se ejecuta inmediatamente a quienes rechazan las “libertades impuestas”. Leer, aprender o pensar críticamente está prohibido. Un letrado fue descubierto y linchado públicamente. Los fines de semana, en la Plaza “Orgia”, el Estado distribuye armas, drogas, alcohol y espectáculos pornográficos en vivo.  

La comunidad internacional ha declarado alerta global: Requetolandia representa un flagelo expansivo. El Consejo de Seguridad evalúa sanciones severas y, de ser necesario, intervención militar. El tiempo se agota.

Imagen de copilot editada por @yepez72
Texto de mi autoría 

ENGLISH VERSION

In January 2059 the last bastion of the proletariat fell. The nations of the system collapsed; the most critical: Reggaetoland, epicenter of the unipolar conflict. A survivor—rescued in a ghostly state, with deformed phonetics and no command of other languages—murmured: “Mister, no one cares about anyone.” His testimony, almost unintelligible, complicated the investigation. Protected by a human rights court-martial, he showed severe tremors: a typical symptom of detoxification from chaos upon entering the new world order. 

Two hypotheses about his escape are analyzed:
1) Involuntary psychological rejection of ecstasy and generalized irresponsibility.
2) Subversive intention: form mercenaries and external alliances. 
Their membership in clandestine intellectual groups that still hide in antisocial suburbs, persecuted by the regime, is ruled out. 

International diagnosis:
1) Requetolandia is a de facto tyranny without legitimate statutes, with a self-proclaimed “constitution” and changing laws according to convenience. 
2) Its Council of State includes a sitting transgender president and a parliament led by pardoned ex-convicts—previously accused of rape and murder. 
3) Decibel free zone: indiscriminate use of sound, violating global noise pollution laws. 
4) Nudism and free sex without restrictions in public spaces. 
5) Prohibited education. The language is officially deformed; the use of school uniforms and standard vocabulary is illegal. The teacher is considered culturally inferior. 
6) Social networks, in “Requetolandés”, are the only legal means of information. 
7) Mandatory tattooing of 50% of the skin in the elderly and children, as social identification. 
8) Police and army made up of armed gangs from marginal neighborhoods. There are no prisons or courts; The collective purge is approved. 

In Requetolandia City, those who reject the “imposed freedoms” are immediately executed. Reading, learning or thinking critically is prohibited. A lawyer was discovered and publicly lynched. On weekends, in the Plaza “Orgia”, the State distributes weapons, drugs, alcohol and live pornographic shows. 

The international community has declared a global alert: Requetolandia represents an expansive scourge. The Security Council evaluates severe sanctions and, if necessary, military intervention. Time is running out.

title.title: 💛 Abejitas en pulsera: La manualidad perfecta para regalar a los niños-Little bees on a bracelet: The perfect craft to give to children
title.body:
¡Hola, corazones creativos! 🐝✨

>Hello, creative hearts! 🐝✨

Hoy les traigo una idea super divertida y sencilla para hacer para los peques de la casa. Vamos a realizar unas lindas abejitas tipo pulsera, ideales para jugar, regalar o simplemente pasar una tarde entretenida creando con nuestras manos.

>Today I'm bringing you a super fun and easy idea for a craft project for the little ones at home. We're going to make some cute little bee bracelets, perfect for playing with, giving as gifts, or simply spending a fun afternoon creating with our hands.

Son tan tiernas que estoy segura que los niños (y no tan niños) van a querer tener una. 

>They're so cute, I'm sure kids (and adults too) will want one. Ready to get started?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmehPqeHoXwnVVJgv5Txi6W3jbAJapoKgTA8yXDmUgpJ93/1771643402945.jpg)

Los materiales qué utilicé 

>The materials I used

| **Material (Español)** | **Material (English)** |
|------------------------|------------------------|
| Foami amarillo | Yellow foam sheet |
| Foami blanco | White foam sheet |
| Foami negro | Black foam sheet |
| Marcador negro | Black marker |
| Marcador rosa | Pink marker |
| Marcador amarillo | Yellow marker |
| Marcador naranja | Orange marker |
| Cierre mágico (velcro) | Magic tape (velcro) |
Cierre mágico (velcro) Magic tape (velcro)

Paso a paso para crear nuestras abejitas pulsera:

>Step by step to create our little bee bracelets:

1. Cortamos la base de la pulsera
Para comenzar, vamos a recortar una tira de foami amarillo con las medidas de 15 cm de largo x 5 cm de ancho. Tal como lo pueden ver en la imagen. Esta será la base de nuestra pulsera y el cuerpecito de la abejita.

>We cut the base of the bracelet
To begin, we'll cut a strip of yellow foam measuring 15 cm long x 5 cm wide, as you can see in the image. This will be the base of our bracelet and the body of the little bee.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCKkHuDQMLJXGsayvxrTaQMs27YwMFsMpGR9nNxjAMCQ/1771642928921.jpg)

2. Colocamos los cierres mágicos
En las orillas de la tira amarilla, vamos a pegar los cierres mágicos (velcro): uno de cada lado. Así podremos abrir y cerrar la pulsera fácilmente cuando la usemos.

>Attach the Velcro fasteners
On the edges of the yellow strip, attach the Velcro fasteners: one on each side. This will allow you to easily open and close the bracelet when you wear it.

3. Dibujamos y recortamos la figura de la abejita
Ahora viene la parte más divertida. En la imagen pueden ver cómo dibuje la silueta de la abejita sobre el foami. Una vez lista, la recortamos con cuidado para darle forma a nuestro personaje.

>We drew and cut out the little bee shape.
Now comes the fun part. In the image, you can see how I drew the bee's silhouette on the foam sheet. Once it was ready, we carefully cut it out to give shape to our character.

4. Le colocamos las alitas
Con foami blanco recortamos dos alitas y las pegamos detrás del cuerpecito. Aquí la abejita ya empieza a tomar forma.

>We added the wings.
We cut out two wings from white foam and glued them behind the little body. The little bee is starting to take shape.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdazHpaKod4wHB9BdBgwtY9vVq5VdBtZLn5Dj9tnGxtCP/1771642987153.jpg)

5. Pintamos la carita
Llega el momento de darle vida. Con marcador negro le hacemos los ojitos y la boquita. Con marcador rosa le pintamos unos lindos cachetes para que se vea aún más tierna.

>Let's paint the face!
Now it's time to bring it to life. With a black marker, we draw the eyes and mouth. With a pink marker, we paint cute cheeks to make her look even more adorable.

6. Hacemos las antenitas
Utilizando foami negro, recortamos dos tiritas delgadas para las antenas y las pegamos en la parte de arriba de la cabecita. ¡Ya parece una abejita de verdad!

>We make the antennae
Using black foam, we cut out two thin strips for the antennae and glue them to the top of the head. Now it looks like a real little bee!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeArUXHrqND4WJNCCB6qe15T7htLFprWaimFrNtx222Yq/1771642987475.jpg)

7. Le colocamos las rayitas negras
Para las rayitas características de las abejas, seguimos usando foami negro. Recortamos tiras delgadas y las pegamos sobre el cuerpecito amarillo. Así le damos ese look clásico de abejita.

>We added the black stripes.
For the characteristic stripes of bees, we continued using black foam. We cut thin strips and glued them onto the little yellow body. This gives it that classic bee look.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdn5cJYZVBRFstgaeUNzv3UWibRVJD4yn28AkSwBDn1i/1771642987632.jpg)

8. Últimos toques con color
Y para finalizar los detalles, con marcador amarillo y naranja le damos esos pequeños toques extras que hacen que nuestra abejita luzca aún más especial y llena de vida.

>Final touches with color
And to finish the details, with yellow and orange markers we give it those extra little touches that make our little bee look even more special and full of life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZgPLy3hJq1KzkVGzE82Q7QcesZa2JTUz8uKbWDK7ko7/1771643117288.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSPyDDpV26aKHVFYKFakjUAnbVDPUgdPhgKPHt6FVPTG/1771643117643.jpg)

9. ¡Lista para usar!
Y así queda este lindo diseño: una pulsera de abejita suavecita, colorida y divertida. Perfecta para los peques de la casa, para jugar, para regalar o simplemente para tener un detalle bonito hecho por nosotros mismos.

>Ready to use!

title.title: Wilderness of Inspiration: a Line of Poetry about the Movies
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR99akscwSpUcDRAiyjjhMfXUgHZH5JmykwjWuBwQUu5M/image.png)
[](
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR99akscwSpUcDRAiyjjhMfXUgHZH5JmykwjWuBwQUu5M/image.png))

***
By @ayijufridar

From the wilderness
inspiration blooms like a flower
greeting the sun even on cloudy days
before withering and falling to the earth
rotting in the soil
devoting oneself to becoming a root again
never to be picked
and cooked into a restless tale of ropes
becoming a mirror and shield for oneself
from the screen navigating life

intertwining roots
nailing the earth
like pillars of self
waving green leaves
perhaps transforming into a city garden
emerging from the screen
or exploding in a global celebration
dancing before millions of eyes
on a fully carved menu
ingredients picked daily from nature's gardens
fresh every strand
with fragrant smoke rising from an old basket.
_Lorong Asa, March 2025_

***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfToZbntk9dT9HFkDyy3C85AMmV4CTKkqtzqXjVU3Dye9/image.png)
https://pixabay.com/images/download/quangpraha-women-3051614_1920.jpg
https://pixabay.com/images/download/sitoruiz-women-7341444_1920.jpg
***

# Belantara Ilham
@ayijufridar

dari gugusan belantara 
ilham mekar serupa kembang
menyapa matahari bahkan di kala mendung
sebelum layu luruh ke bumi
membusuk dierami tanah
mengabdi diri
menjelma akar kembali 
tanpa sempat dipetik
dan dimasak menjadi kisah resah tali-temali
menjadi cermin dan perisai diri
dari layar menapaki kehidupan

akar-akar berkelindan memaku bumi
serupa pilar-pilar diri
dedaunan hijau melambai
mungkin menjelma taman kota
menyeruak dari layar kaca
atau meledak dalam perayaan dunia
menari di depan jutaan pasang mata

dalam daftar menu terpahat lengkap
bahan yang dipetik sepenuh hari dari kebun alam
segar setiap helainya
dengan asap wangi mengepul dari bakul tua
_Lorong Asa, Maret 2025_
***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTagEM1H847sJpkAJscBe8PjkAq7Dmo6fhk527VvsxS4E/image.png)
[](
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTagEM1H847sJpkAJscBe8PjkAq7Dmo6fhk527VvsxS4E/image.png))


***


The poem above is included in the poetry anthology _Kebangkitan_ which is set in the world of film.
