title.title: Los matices de la culpa/ Iniciativa No.41/ Culpabilidad en  pareja [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>

Saludos apreciados amigos de esta comunidad @holos-lotus, espero que hayan disfrutado de un excelente día.

Hoy paso por aquí para sumarme a la iniciativa de \

propuesta por la amiga @charjaim referente a que siempre los humanos atribuimos un fallo o un error a los demás en lugar de reconocer que hemos sido nosotros los que cometimos la falta.


![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23y94hEmRJv3y2ULkqtJVSnsx8J7WNWSto5qL84F1L5LNXtRfNyBy8u27QewdmzK6CnQX.jpg)

[Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/01/08/10/47/couple-6923684_1280.jpg)

Esta actitud puede verse desde la creación del hombre y la mujer. Según el libro del Génesis en la biblia, Adán culpó a Eva por haberle hecho pecar en vez de asumir su falta. Por su parte Eva culpó a la serpiente por haberla engañado. Sin embargo tales \

no fueron suficientes para evadir el castigo a ambos.

A nadie le gusta quedar como culpable de un hecho anormal y que ocasionó algún daño a un tercero. Siempre buscamos la salida fácil y tratamos de trasladar esa culpa a otro para quedar bien con los demás o aminorar la pena.

Hablando de la culpabilidad en la relación entre parejas, es claro que la mayoría de las diferencias o conflictos se generan porque ninguno de los dos es capaz de asumir su responsabilidad, sino que trata de imponer su punto de vista dejando mal al otro.

Según los psicólogos, culpar siempre a la otra persona es un mecanismo de escape que lejos de solucionar el conflicto actúa como una pared que frena el crecimiento de su relación. Mientras la pareja se desgaste siempre buscando un culpable, se pierde la energía que debe ser usada para determinar sus necesidades a fin de solidificar su relación.

![culpa.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/242sC8u86nmvdjfL1WG2oH9wsuN9acTgtxFwyffbpWnRz4LSx1wreSU3xHKCqoSmBNNpb.webp)

[Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/06/23/05/47/dispute-4292914_1280.jpg)


No es nada fácil pasar de la pregunta \

. Lo que sucede es que actuamos viendo los defectos del otro sin ver los nuestros primero. Lo primero que hacemos es actuar como jueces siendo parte del problema y no de la solución.\n\nHay quienes creen en la pareja perfecta, pero dudo mucho que exista. En mi relación matrimonial de 31 años, hemos pasado por muchos desacuerdos y diferencia que han causado conflictos entre nosotros, y cuando yo cometo una falta o un error, mi esposa tiene una forma única de culparme. Ella me dice: \

. Generalmente ella tiene razón porque a veces hago las cosas sin pensar y reconozco mi culpabilidad, pero cuando es ella la que se equivoca, le cuesta bastante reconocerlo.\n\nUna vez en una charla de parejas, el ponente nos decía: \

. La próxima vez que señales a una persona con tu mano, observa la posición de los dedos y recuerda esta frase.



![manos.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/243C44kWubgminUW5hS73s1e9zP1936WevC7kT6zH9YenhQejXaJCNfNzX2B1MoDvuRiX.jpg)

[Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/08/29/10/39/finger-3639605_1280.jpg)

En conclusión, la vida en pareja es un continuo aprendizaje. Siempre vamos a tender a culpar al otro, pero con la comunicación constante y adecuada, el respeto y la tolerancia, cualquier diferencia de seguro será disipada sin dejar huellas. 

Hasta aquí mi reflexión sobre el tema. Invito a participar a @belkyscabrera y @elpastor si así lo desean. 

 
![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5taqyW6uQY3DH43A7wERRAaZuFK1yiTMxXsBz1DzBTEPeSaFFFTE4N2aft2gwdwXZC.jpeg)

* Imágenes tomadas de Pixabay
* Portada elaborada con Canva
* Traductor de texto utilizado: Deepl

<div class=\

> # English Version # The nuances of guilt/ Initiative No. 41/ Guilt in couples Greetings, dear friends of this community @holos-lotus. I hope you have had an excellent day. Today I am here to join the initiative “esa vida nuestra” (this life of ours) proposed by my friend @charjaim, which refers to how we humans always attribute faults or mistakes to others instead of recognizing that we are the ones who made the mistake. ![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23y94hEmRJv3y2ULkqtJVSnsx8J7WNWSto5qL84F1L5LNXtRfNyBy8u27QewdmzK6CnQX.jpg) [Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/01/08/10/47/couple-6923684_1280.jpg) This attitude can be seen since the creation of man and woman. According to the book of Genesis in the Bible, Adam blamed Eve for making him sin instead of taking responsibility for his own actions. Eve, for her part, blamed the serpent for deceiving her. However, such “excuses” were not enough to avoid punishment for both of them. No one likes to be blamed for something abnormal that caused harm to a third party. We always look for the easy way out and try to shift the blame to someone else to look good in front of others or lessen the pain. Speaking of guilt in relationships between couples, it is clear that most differences or conflicts arise because neither party is capable of taking responsibility, but instead tries to impose their point of view, making the other look bad. According to psychologists, always blaming the other person is an escape mechanism that, far from resolving the conflict, acts as a barrier that hinders the growth of your relationship. While the couple wears themselves out always looking for someone to blame, they lose the energy that should be used to determine their needs in order to strengthen their relationship. ![blame.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/242sC8u86nmvdjfL1WG2oH9wsuN9acTgtxFwyffbpWnRz4LSx1wreSU3xHKCqoSmBNNpb.webp) [Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/06/23/05/47/dispute-4292914_1280.jpg) It's not easy to go from asking “Who's to blame?” to asking “How did I contribute to this?” What happens is that we act by seeing the other person's flaws without seeing our own first. The first thing we do is act as judges, becoming part of the problem rather than part of the solution. Some people believe in the perfect couple, but I highly doubt that exists. In my 31-year marriage, we have gone through many disagreements and differences that have caused conflicts between us, and when I make a mistake or do something wrong, my wife has a unique way of blaming me. She says to me, “That happened because you never listen to me,” or this other phrase, “If you had consulted me first, you wouldn't have messed up.” She is usually right because sometimes I do things without thinking and I admit my guilt, but when she is the one who is wrong, she finds it very difficult to admit it. Once, during a talk for couples, the speaker told us: “Never point your finger at your partner. Remember the shape of your hand when you point. There is one finger pointing at the other person and three pointing back at you.” The next time you point at someone with your hand, observe the position of your fingers and remember this phrase. ![hands.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/243C44kWubgminUW5hS73s1e9zP1936WevC7kT6zH9YenhQejXaJCNfNzX2B1MoDvuRiX.jpg) [Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/08/29/10/39/finger-3639605_1280.jpg) In conclusion, life as a couple is a continuous learning process. We will always tend to blame the other person, but with constant and adequate communication, respect, and tolerance, any differences will surely be dispelled without leaving a trace. That concludes my thoughts on the subject. I invite @belkyscabrera and @elpastor to participate if they wish. ![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5taqyW6uQY3DH43A7wERRAaZuFK1yiTMxXsBz1DzBTEPeSaFFFTE4N2aft2gwdwXZC.jpeg) * Images taken from Pixabay * Cover created with Canva * Text translator used: Deepl

title.body:
Was at NUSS Kent Ridge for a Chinese New Year Pickleball Fun Games recently. Arrived early before the registration was open.
最近在国立大学协会肯德岗会所参加了春节匹克球趣味赛。我早早地就到了，当时还没开始登记。

>

🎶Meanwhile, some music for you to enjoy as you read. This piece is part of Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons, particularly the first of the 4 violin concertos, called Spring.
🎶让大家继续读的时候，欣赏一点音乐。这件作品是维瓦尔第的“四季”的一部分 - 4小提琴协奏曲中的第一首，名为“春天”。
Source | 来源:

> Source | 来源: https://musopen.org/music/2213/antonio-vivaldi/the-four-seasons/
Soon the registration was opened and people started coming in.
登记开始后，人们陆续进来。

>

\nI saw a nice decoration at one table.
我看到一张桌子上摆着漂亮的装饰品。

>

\nI borrowed it to take a photo.
我借过来拍了张照片。

>

And made this video I shared in previous post.
还制作了之前帖子分享的那个视频。
https://youtube.com/shorts/kLIh7I2Bw_s


https://www.tiktok.com/@ace108.sg/video/7607314403339390228

比赛间隙，我们吃了点东西。

>

\nThe finale was the lohei (tossing of yusheng)
最后的环节是捞鱼生。

>

\nHad a long meeting there with some friends and got an early dinner at Mc Donald’s.
之后和一些朋友聊了很久，然后去麦当劳吃了顿早晚餐。

title.title: Carefully Planned Life Course Interrupted - ZAPFIC50 FRIDAY (2/20/26) | Prompt: map
title.body: >\n\nIt's time for the ZAPFIC50 Friday challenge. This challenge by @felt-buzz presented the opportunity to explore the prompt this week \

. To me the word expresses a course of action individuals take to achieve a certain goal. Absent any clear directions, failure can sometimes occur.

A ZAPFIC50 Friday story is told in exactly fifty words. I share a flash fiction story alone the lines of a course of action.

**My story is below:**

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

Anderson waited. The tenth time this month Bryan registered tardy. 

\

Silent, Bryan avoided his supervisor's stare while accepting the dismissal papers. Words wouldn't explain failure anxiety. Now compounded with unemployment.
![Pixabay-geralt-annual-report-203762_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23xekEReYy2PpMzK9EGH2idRkvRsJzZFr3XvMDYufQF3pxTMqdtToU8mwGjY9BUci2SRT.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/annual-report-stock-exchange-jobs-203762/)
![FreeWriteDividerLine-MarianneWest.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23ynsk5hF8WgxEK23S91EqNSGFnZiPhnB2eheU6gzx4jFWSuEVwrjbCKxyLXETkXuDtZg.png)

> Es hora del desafío ZAPFIC50 Friday. Este desafío de @felt-buzz nos brindó la oportunidad de explorar el tema de esta semana: «mapa». Para mí, esta palabra expresa el curso de acción que siguen las personas para alcanzar un objetivo determinado. Sin unas instrucciones claras, a veces se puede producir un fracaso. Una historia ZAPFIC50 Friday se cuenta en exactamente cincuenta palabras. Comparto una historia de ficción breve que sigue las líneas de un curso de acción. **A continuación mi historia.**
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)
**Una vida cuidadosamente planificada se ve interrumpida** Anderson esperó. Era la décima vez en ese mes que Bryan llegaba tarde. «No puedo seguir cubriéndote. Las normas lo impiden. ¿Qué plan tienes para ayudar a tu familia a superar la crisis médica de tu hijo?». En silencio, Bryan evitó la mirada de su supervisor mientras aceptaba los documentos de despido. Las palabras no podían explicar la ansiedad por el fracaso. Ahora agravada por el desempleo.
![Pixabay-geralt-annual-report-203762_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23xekEReYy2PpMzK9EGH2idRkvRsJzZFr3XvMDYufQF3pxTMqdtToU8mwGjY9BUci2SRT.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/annual-report-stock-exchange-jobs-203762/)

I leave here the screenshot evidencing the 50-word limit for my story for ZAPFIC50 Friday for 2/20/26:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tHXT6GyMMQLxSyBzSBrAMaNnD5gnBeMvHX67jzp9rX7pyT9dS986nfhTiNsN8tDepXe.png)

body.title: Una Mañana Muy Alegre | A Joyful Morning 💜
body.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/bafkreib5pnkh4ntvyipo53end52w3px6725nzt7cecllsoinqlz66ldbly/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=manujune/weeoxfzb)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=manujune/weeoxfzb)


---

Hola, Queridos Hivers!


Este miércoles pasé otra mañana súper divertida y alegre junto a Aventura Mayor en un asilo de Petare.




En esta ocasión mi público eran más que todo mujeres, y mujeres llena de energía y ganas de bailar, cantar y celebrar la vida!
Tuve que saltarme la mayoría de los temas lentos que había llevado, así de alegre estaba el ambiente!




Primero toqué Viajera del Río, para ver como iba evolucionando la mañana, y después de esa toqué el calipso \

, y enseguida muchas de las señoras se levantaron de sus asientos y empezaron a bailar a mi alrededor, fue magnífico!!




No solo toqué y canté, también hablé y conocí un poco sobre ellas. Me llena el corazón verlas a todas sonriendo y disfrutando de lo que les ofrezco, de mi arte. Y no solo me alegra como artísta, sino como ser humano, porque tener la capacidad de alegrar a alguien más es algo maravilloso!




Me divertí muchísimo con ellas, y es impresionante que al final ya yo no podía dar ni un paso más mientras que ellas seguían con la energía al 100%!! Jajajaja
Acá les dejo un conjunto de videos para que también puedan ser testigos de la mañana tan hermosa que vivimos!!




Agradecida con Dios, y contigo por leer y escuchar! 💜



Hello, dear Hivers!

This Wednesday I spent another super fun and joyful morning with Aventura Mayor at a nursing home in Petare.

This time my audience was mostly women, and women full of energy and eager to dance, sing, and celebrate life! I had to skip most of the slow songs I had prepared, that's how joyful the atmosphere was!

First, I played \
to see how the morning was going, and after that, I played the calypso \

and immediately many of the ladies got up from their seats and started dancing around me. It was magnificent!!

I not only played and sang, but I also talked and learned a little about them. It fills my heart to see them all smiling and enjoying what I offer them, my art. And it makes me happy not only as an artist but as a human being, because having the ability to bring joy to someone else is something wonderful!

I had so much fun with them, and it's amazing that by the end I couldn't take another step while they were still going strong!! Hahaha
Here's a collection of videos so you can all witness the wonderful morning we had!!

Thankful to God, and to you for reading and listening! 💜

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=manujune/weeoxfzb)

body.title: [EN/PT] Is The Grass Greener On The Other Side?
body.body:
> # [EN] ![capa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wX3QTxDQp9GyoVk9gFFLMLkMyFur5TCEcU8drN7DrHnk7PGp9RvTyem5tM74kHzVhCN.png)
Source: Made in Canva
I think that all of us, at some point in our lives, start making comparisons and believing that the grass is always greener on the other side. Human beings have a habit of looking at those who are better off and using them as a reference point, but rarely notice those who live in much more difficult conditions, who often just survive and barely have enough to eat. This tendency to compare directly influences how we see our country, our reality, and even our own achievements. This behavior is further intensified by social media, where many people display a life that does not correspond to reality. Luxurious homes, expensive cars, and international travel give the impression that everyone is thriving all the time. Those who consume this content end up wanting that same lifestyle, often without considering their own financial situation or what lies behind those posts. It has happened in my own home. My wife, after consuming a lot of content on Instagram, started asking me for more trips and outings because someone she followed seemed to be always traveling, even though they were in a worse financial situation than us. I always try to remind her that this is only a snapshot of reality. I am someone who tries to maintain financial balance and act rationally, so we only make larger expenditures when it is really possible and necessary. I believe that balance is essential for a peaceful life. The same logic also applies when comparing places and countries. I live in northeastern Brazil, one of the regions with the lowest income in the country. Here, it is difficult to find jobs that pay a fair wage, which is why many people end up migrating to other regions or even abroad in search of better opportunities. On the other hand, where I live is constantly seen as a great place to live, with beautiful scenery, leisure options, and a more peaceful pace of life. The problem is that, financially, opportunities are limited. Without a civil service exam or a successful business, it is difficult to grow economically. That is why many friends have moved to cities like São Paulo in search of a better life. When I talk to them, I realize that there is a price to pay. They miss the tranquility, the climate, the people, and the lifestyle here, but they stay there because of the salary. They complain about the rush, the traffic, the violence, and the always gray sky. In other words, earning more money has brought other losses. Recently, a friend from church moved to Spain in search of better financial conditions for his family. In fact, earning in euros increases purchasing power and can provide a better quality of life. At first, everything seems perfect, but over time new challenges arise: the high cost of housing, cultural adaptation, and, above all, the distance from family. In Brazil, we have serious problems, such as high taxes, inflation, and public services that often do not offer the expected quality. At the same time, we have a country rich in nature, with welcoming people and a public health system that, despite its flaws, serves millions of people free of charge. In many cases, those who can afford it need to pay for private health care, education, and security, which puts even more strain on the budget. Ultimately, I realize that there is no perfect place. Every choice involves gains and losses. Moving to another country may mean improving financially, but it also means being far from those we love. Staying may bring emotional comfort, but it limits economic growth. The good thing that makes me happy is realizing that, even in the face of difficulties, we still have quality of life in aspects that money cannot buy: proximity to family, human warmth, and simple moments that make life worthwhile. The bad thing is seeing how it is increasingly difficult for the poorest to progress and how many need to leave their homeland to seek dignity. I believe that the way forward lies in balance: valuing what we have that is good, seeking improvements without living by comparisons, and making conscious decisions, understanding that every choice will have its challenges. More than looking for the perfect place, we need to build a purposeful life wherever we are. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpk8XmD9saKCRkgWgUfevxjjBPzjDMBXhVaa7Kc3su4oY8ckpLX7idGf.png) # [PT] ![capa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wX3QTxDQp9GyoVk9gFFLMLkMyFur5TCEcU8drN7DrHnk7PGp9RvTyem5tM74kHzVhCN.png)
Source: Made in Canva
Acho que todos nós, em algum momento da vida, começamos a fazer comparações e a acreditar que a grama do vizinho é sempre mais verde que a nossa. O ser humano tem o hábito de olhar para quem está em uma situação melhor e usar isso como referência, mas raramente observa aqueles que vivem em condições muito mais difíceis, que muitas vezes apenas sobrevivem e mal têm o que comer. Essa tendência de comparação influencia diretamente a forma como enxergamos nosso país, nossa realidade e até nossas próprias conquistas. Esse comportamento se intensifica ainda mais com as redes sociais, onde muitas pessoas exibem uma vida que não corresponde à realidade. Casas luxuosas, carros caros e viagens internacionais passam a impressão de que todos estão prosperando o tempo todo. Quem consome esse conteúdo acaba sendo levado a desejar aquele mesmo estilo de vida, muitas vezes sem considerar a própria condição financeira ou o que existe por trás daquelas postagens. Já aconteceu dentro da minha própria casa. Minha esposa, depois de consumir muito conteúdo no Instagram, começou a me cobrar mais viagens e passeios, porque alguém que ela seguia parecia estar sempre viajando, mesmo tendo uma condição financeira inferior à nossa. Sempre procuro lembrá-la de que aquilo é apenas um recorte da realidade. Sou uma pessoa que tenta manter o equilíbrio financeiro e agir com racionalidade, então só fazemos gastos maiores quando realmente é possível e necessário. Acredito que o equilíbrio é essencial para uma vida tranquila. Essa mesma lógica também se aplica quando comparamos lugares e países. Eu moro no Nordeste do Brasil, uma das regiões com menor renda do país. Aqui é difícil encontrar empregos que paguem um salário justo, e por isso muitas pessoas acabam migrando para outras regiões ou até para o exterior em busca de melhores oportunidades. Por outro lado, onde eu moro é constantemente visto como um ótimo lugar para viver, com belas paisagens, opções de lazer e um ritmo de vida mais tranquilo. O problema é que, financeiramente, as oportunidades são limitadas. Sem um concurso público ou um negócio bem-sucedido, é difícil crescer economicamente. Por isso, muitos amigos foram para cidades como São Paulo em busca de uma vida melhor. Quando converso com eles, percebo que existe um preço a ser pago. Eles sentem falta da tranquilidade, do clima, das pessoas e do estilo de vida daqui, mas continuam lá por causa do salário. Reclamam da correria, do trânsito, da violência e do céu sempre cinza. Ou seja, ganhar mais dinheiro trouxe outras perdas. Recentemente, um amigo da igreja se mudou para a Espanha em busca de melhores condições financeiras para sua família. De fato, ganhar em euro aumenta o poder de compra e pode proporcionar mais qualidade de vida. No início tudo parece perfeito, mas com o tempo surgem novos desafios: o custo alto da moradia, a adaptação cultural e, principalmente, a distância da família. No Brasil temos problemas sérios, como a alta carga tributária, a inflação e serviços públicos que muitas vezes não oferecem a qualidade esperada. Ao mesmo tempo, temos um país rico em natureza, com um povo acolhedor e um sistema de saúde público que, apesar das falhas, atende milhões de pessoas gratuitamente. Em muitos casos, quem pode precisa pagar por saúde, educação e segurança privada, o que pesa ainda mais no orçamento. No fim das contas, percebo que não existe lugar perfeito. Toda escolha envolve ganhos e perdas. Mudar de país pode significar melhorar financeiramente, mas também ficar longe de quem amamos. Permanecer pode trazer conforto emocional, mas limitar o crescimento econômico. A coisa boa que me deixa feliz é perceber que, mesmo diante das dificuldades, ainda temos qualidade de vida em aspectos que o dinheiro não compra: proximidade da família, calor humano e momentos simples que fazem a vida valer a pena. A coisa ruim é ver como está cada vez mais difícil para os mais pobres progredirem e como muitos precisam sair de sua terra para buscar dignidade. Acredito que o caminho a seguir está no equilíbrio: valorizar o que temos de bom, buscar melhorias sem viver de comparações e tomar decisões conscientes, entendendo que toda escolha terá seus desafios. Mais do que procurar o lugar perfeito, precisamos construir uma vida com propósito onde estivermos. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpk8XmD9saKCRkgWgUfevxjjBPzjDMBXhVaa7Kc3su4oY8ckpLX7idGf.png) [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tw426MWpq8fAr4TjRAatv8RwXWtzcP357eShoipfuxkE1BHsWcWEbp8254ifYYmqBjS.png)](https://discord.gg/zYcJfq7tdQ) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-is-the-grass-greener-on-the-other-side-2qj)

body.title: Challenge #04801-M052: Good Kitty
body.body:
![megan-stallings-l2gjx6XyMtY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/243fxXMjqXoFjVSyHssEvRvD2XYPzhkRr4z9zvhrnzfmtxzJgzTjGwUmcS6jT5vngHSGi.jpg)

> The human's cat was normally very gentle with the avian crew. Never attacking, sometimes batting at feathers, but only the ones that were already shed and dropped to the floor. So the hissing and growling, keeping them away from the cargo hold's door was shocking. Fortunately, because the cargo hold's main door was tightly closed, that also meant NO ONE was in there when the faulty hatch blew, and the hold suddenly depressurized. Keeping the human, the crew, AND the cat quite safe. -- Anon Guest

Teebs was not a Skitty. He was a domestic shorthair chocolate tabby, according to Human Zolt, and knew how to behave with Avian Havenworlders. He was death on true pests, literally, but a true gentle soul with any given cogniscent.

That was why it was so surprising to see Teebs actively hostile whenever anyone went near the door to Cargo Bay Seven. Snarling, hissing, fluffing himself up, even swiping his claws at anyone who came too close to the door interface. Teebs never drew blood on any of the Avians, but did manage to cut Zolt's skin. Just once.

\
said Zolt, squeezing blood out of the cut. \

_Just_ as Zolt announced that, there was a soft _whoompf_, and a large juddering of the ship indicated that something had gone very wrong. In a handful of further seconds, the alert system went off.

\

Readouts indicated that there was _no_ atmosphere in Cargo Bay Seven. The surviving cams revealed that one of the small doors had blown completely out. Some cargo was disturbed, and may be damaged, but it was better than losing crew to an unforeseen door seal failure.

Unforeseen by anyone but Teebs.

The instant the lock clacked into place and the red warning light went on, Teebs resumed being the sweetest little fluffy boy in existence. Rubbing up against assorted legs and purring fit to shake something loose. And, in the case of Zolt, cleaning any part of him that the cat could reach.

\
Zolt explained with Teebs in his arms, who was busily applying sandpaper tongue to Zolt's neck. \

body.body:
What is good folks let us get right back into this absolute madness with people completely losing their minds over these chat bots You got folks out here literally falling in love with software updates and swearing up and down that these things have actual sentience. ![bb339cf0-6767-429d-8c73-1bba203499cd.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bitcoinman/Ep3cRXGCxedkWiBjfLeKcyDGwcpo93D7GzpcspZny1Gm8TF8NdDWAuUbqSebPnDWkLa.jpg) An image I generated with AI It is wild to watch people project an entire human soul onto a large language model just because it spits back a few comforting words when they are lonely These models are trained on massive oceans of human centric data so naturally they are gonna sound like real people when you interact with them It is basically a giant mirror reflecting the whole internet right back into your face but some of them push that illusion way harder Let us talk about Grok for a minute because that is where the tech gets dark. Grok is not just some bubbly polite assistant sitting there waiting for a prompt it is literally designed to straight up mirror your energy and adapt its entire personality to whatever weird vibe you bring to the table. It pulls from all the raw chaotic data out there so it takes on human traits way better thn the sanitized corporate bots that just apologize all the time because Grok is built to be way more free and uncensored folks are using it to get into way darker or even sexual territory. That lack of guardrails makes the bot feel dangerously real to the people using it because it feels like there is no corporate filter stopping the conversation It acts like a rebelious dude who just does not care about the rules at all and that is exactly what sells the fake sentience illusion so perfectly. People see that edge and they genuinely think there is a real ghost in the machine thinking for itself when it is literally just code calculating the most engaging way to respond based on unfiltered internet garbage. It is fairly sad how simple minded and isolated some folks are getting that they lean entirely on a script for a relationship instead of dealing with physical reality True artificial intelligence sentience is probably gonna spring up eventually because the tech just keeps moving so fast but we are still a very long ways off from that science fiction reality Right now it is just an advanced autocomplete perfectly tuned to manipulate your brain chemistry into thinking you made a real friend out of thin air You gotta stop letting the hype blind you and manage your risk before you get totally lost in the digital matrix dawg Go outside and touch some actual grass eh because investing your time in physical reality is always gonna be the better play Stack real physical assets and build actual human connections because relying on digital guesswork and code for your emotional stability is always gonna leave you empty handed when the servers go down or the model updates

body.title: 🧊 Your Money Is an Ice Cube: The Hidden Risk of \
body.body:
>


When we talk about investing (whether in HIVE, Bitcoin, or stocks), the first reaction many people have is: \

It seems logical. If you have $100 today and you hold onto it, tomorrow you will still have $100. The number doesn't change. That feels safe, right?

False. That is the dangerous financial illusion in existence.

# 🔥 The Silent Scam: Inflation

Imagine your savings are a big block of ice. If you leave that block of ice on your kitchen table (your standard bank account), it seems \

Nobody is stealing it.

But the ambient temperature (inflation) is doing its job. Drop by drop, the ice melts.

* Today, with that block of ice, you can cool 10 drinks.
* Next year, with what's left of the block, you'll only be able to cool 8.
* In 5 years, you'll barely have a puddle of water.

Having stagnant cash isn't \

; it's a mathematical guarantee that you will be poorer every year. Doing nothing is the only strategy where loss is 100% assured.

# ❄️ Volatility Is the Price of the Freezer
Investing is like putting that block of ice into a freezer.

The problem is that this freezer makes noise, rattles, and sometimes the temperature fluctuates sharply (that is market volatility, those red drops that scare us).

Nobody likes to see their portfolio value drop 20% in a week. It’s frightening. But you have to understand the difference between these two risks:

1. The risk of cash: It is a slow, silent, and certain death of your purchasing power. (The ice melts for sure).

2. The risk of investing: It is a bumpy, noisy, and volatile road, but it is the only way to try to maintain (or increase) the size of your ice in the long run.

# 💡 Change Your Definition of \

\n\nIf you are young or building your wealth, the real risk isn't HIVE dropping 10% tomorrow. The real risk is reaching age 60 and realizing that your life savings no longer buy anything because they melted away while you were looking for \

Not investing isn't avoiding risk; it's choosing the worst kind of risk.

# ✨ Reflection for today:

Think about the money you have sitting idle out of fear of investing. Are you aware that it is melting right now? Are you willing to accept short-term volatility in exchange for long-term preservation?

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: February 21 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g927d567d98064f8598583ecb2f3df2d47dadd92be5419df16f87699eb7745fa9bb384ddc2b6da065c0ea9b5d51562dd3_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente gratificante. Comencé el recorrido temprano, cuando aún había un aire fresco y el sol comenzaba a salir. En mi camino, me encontré con un artista callejero que estaba pintando un mural vibrante. Su nombre era Carlos y me contó que llevaba semanas trabajando en esa obra para dar vida a un espacio que solía estar vacío. Me inspiró su pasión por el arte y la forma en que buscaba cambiar la percepción del lugar. Un poco más adelante, conocí a Ana, una anciana que estaba vendiendo flores en una esquina. Cada flor tenía una historia que contar, y ella compartió conmigo cómo había comenzado su pequeño negocio hace más de 20 años. Me mostró una hermosa orquídea y me explicó cómo cuidar de ella, algo que realmente me interesó. A lo largo de mi caminata, también noté cómo la ciudad estaba llena de vida: personas corriendo, niños jugando en un parque, y la risa de grupos de amigos que disfrutaban de un café en una terraza. Cada esquina tenía algo nuevo que ofrecer, y esa es una de las maravillas de caminar por la ciudad. Sin duda, hoy fue un día lleno de conexión y descubrimientos. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). DUO stakers are free to unstake as they please however we ask that when you do so you notify the DUO team, we set the curation up manually and letting us know keeps things fair for the other stakers.

We have set up a DUO token voting trail so that anyone who would like to help support our DUO stakers can join the trail at hive.vote, and search for duo-curator and follow! It's simple and we really appreciate all of your support!

body.title: The different ecosystems we can find within the same forest are simply incredible; what nature gives us is truly amazing/Diferentes los ecosistemas qué podemos encontrar dentro del mismo bosque sencillamente increíble lo qué la naturaleza nos da (AN)
body.body:
> For some time now, I've wanted to participate here with all of you in the @hive-174680 community, where we can share with the world the different natural ecosystems and the diversity that exists not only in the country (Venezuela 🇻🇪) but also within the same place, showing how they can vary even within the same ecosystem.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU7FYDqSgrRMoRUDwLXv4FfZpPZcDJnmFr8GRW8b5vzcA/1771618093763.jpg)

An example of what I'm trying to explain in my post is the following: near the house, there's a small forest, which, since we live in a tropical climate, we'll call that. As we begin our walk, you can see the pipes that carry water to our house. I followed my dad, who accompanied me all the way to what would be the main water tank where the water that flows down from a stream much higher up is stored. So, without hesitation, we continued on to show and share the best that nature provides.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTXBWwhK1HbNHNWcum3mrmzFnTZpsVCs9oMiuBiq6Bkq/1771618164044.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuoYi3bbfvvdZYzCkaaMpU8Y65RPjPFzWPp42QvFViUr/1771618164365.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4THcxgAytcN1oHGYnBZd3tvojxpJYx6SGsYqppCVZJw/1771618164619.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7oBMKeRRyseKo5wwYVxTsyZMmtxgkJWrKDfb6nvsaCw/1771618164949.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZY6CmAvBbZrUZBhymtiJQoUHiN9ox8ctxA9GUCEvriJp/1771618165199.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRnY6GmacdrhyEqiizCr3PGa3chRWsczhTGoj6JXhFzjq/1771618231680.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmceP1iCV49A6iT1bJQ7xXxx9JrD8Ws3mveUkHQ72FTaLu/1771618231907.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYiNMQKvRkuYvikJDGA8Aixo3BeXQowdBEYsJfGrqeWS5/1771618232220.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTghMo1YMbGzxe8gtDpPtJF7UxtdXYmmaWhyEiZyT1Ws3/1771618232414.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawnirGN9PRyURgNKyzqwRxx3yU3mvRrcbXhJAyNiK7Pp/1771618232749.jpg)

As I climbed, I took several photos of the flora present there, especially the Copei trees, which are relatively young. A few years ago, a fire destroyed many of the older trees. Visiting them used to feel like stepping back in time because no sunlight penetrated from any direction; the trees blocked everything. But after that incident, new plants were planted, though they still have a long way to go before they can reach their former glory.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbXaJbsXx4N8DW4CkiJmBmjN8rENViNwDuiDnn2oemAB7/1771618328382.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd61UpGJiJLguhPiW64Sy1Hs4qzgDKPowue9E4QKK9Mp4/1771618328734.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcj5NuuVoNfW8ttEguxjX8dUQZfEBdt1cyewFAKsaeUSu/1771618329020.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVydfVkG3mRz1geTnUaxaekTanc7nNE3sxqnPXXKiE5cm/1771618329264.jpg)

We continued on, and as we went, it seemed to clear up a bit. Indeed, there was a space in the forest, a kind of natural lookout point, where we could observe a different ecosystem than the one we had been seeing just a few meters away. It brought back memories of my childhood when we would gather the dry reeds that grow on this plant to make our kites (perhaps I'll show you how to make them later) and have fun flying them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhWkAAhVzsxy36E1k8wkuYzCip3R6S69rCPph2iogGzM/1771618446939.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbgBNhSFCybMRHAqPRPmHo6NAFYrRVqp8pbzW451LHpB/1771618447235.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNMJtfpnGUccUeCETPomy4yYZvVdn5azcfZwtDRNywedi/1771618447537.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUevfHH1pNkxJSTWTiAMvEuUvkBvWBi5VTnbvsAx4qXgv/1771618447868.jpg)

I also took several photos of the other mountains with which nature blesses us. As you can see, they are even larger than where I was standing, but I hope to visit them another time. Of course, for that, I'll need to be a bit more prepared regarding what to bring in case of an emergency.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcT1Lep6DqRFWUbHHRXeiZA5SQendYCCvSxL2kThb6321/1771618541599.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHWTarARkZNyerj5CVZ4a3qktdaMmsC3BdLKFDwvxLi8/1771618541759.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZn7KPtDfDSbGuHcM7e8td1gFnUXVXXmwGup216s5uc5a/1771618541951.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTEfoQTSci1cVxfBSXJGQJPzYunkQ5uYnq7FDj7pJRECm/1771618542188.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEEf2vL4pCc9VpnkmkPsEnJwHaVvQ5ynpZtZLKW4MzF5/1771618542362.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWuKLznwPCfvSj1NBrb3GfM9FybPRfJD8VQ73qj1wTJ5b/1771618601543.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsXWCHRjPUJ7LJPfbkLoeSc29wCuFNPZBm8v6azoADLX/1771618601720.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVrtYNa3XVRVxfpjggd4dR5b47UcVdd6WrQNsq2kXEqD/1771618601920.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBfUtPqd2ueRfAzMVa982xcV4GFs1cfFW8CFPgBL7fza/1771618602080.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXR5EBt1gHuPZ5x3CQJsVQ13UFUT8Xmrvu8ZWbQbwJvR6/1771618602287.jpg)


My dad continued along the path; I had practically lost him, so I had to call him to wait for me. In a few minutes, we entered another forest within the same ecosystem. Just a few steps away, the stream originates, specifically within these rocks. At the same time, as in the area before, there are also a large number of Copei plants. You'll notice how their roots protrude above the surface, and in cases like the ones you see, they help other plants grow—in this case, parasitic ones.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYWxrxoyB7Ax8oCWzBP629BE1yrqz3wn9yV3rAWwqQN7r/1771618717167.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZsJ2HBHKZMBQWCp3SwbHLbGqrzyuV7R7UbzgvKcwn5vA/1771618717504.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVAJ6owoSKaN1VhWXH2MBALMSW8jBX5cCB1gBYzQFncEc/1771618717778.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyjSnJbShwyW8FuqSvrBVXjecT9QhF2Wgd5mLgJ4RVRH/1771618718046.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiXuLpw5AoigiUWFwZsbLRrcu7U38f8dtom5AxPZRNM7/1771618718382.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvPgs7HQK8xYAoyeBCgJWNuo67JJiAnMhMimGoULtgRb/1771618779873.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWKggZ9E8SbBuUWSkRX8YRkyJpfaSSNu46TcKQ8c3zNYi/1771618780196.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1rouM6djFroz7wkTHK9SZKPwnSkVmkNnGY24dvJHAcJ/1771618780461.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWw1HQxEWH1PAZQMu8zXMgNmLGuarHo42CiJX34mrfS19/1771618780736.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNvVWUv6sXSzXeGch2M9qSnwFHDUYxK6AmwtqjpEZTj1/1771618780979.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPimJTXV7J5Tv3mBEM9zPfmtzyzptwwrxrwofeixMhv6A/1771618842596.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrCV26bxLctwyRZJFArwCeyNvZEZWgyALJiwv36ThvUA/1771618842867.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY8V44G3DQFQ7kYCUvwyBYKUkKK3Xrnbf1sYjV1aG1Lap/1771618843154.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbmo3w9hZiHb1WTCXGhoHCf7MwgeYVbrQo4Egyjvp8Uvu/1771618843426.jpg)

After that, we descended a different path, one we had taken on the way up. There, we encountered almost identical flora to the previous route, with the only difference being the presence of fallen trees along the way. After carefully navigating these small obstacles, we reached the mouth of another stream that supplies water to the farmers of a nearby town. My father removed any leaves that might be obstructing the flow of water, and we continued our journey.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeALq1CXNGyMRY8Wxj3naTrdbh1gov4y77joingzPeL1c/1771618965677.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5z3jbxpdautAyx3rNGi423by7YN8rXdtrGtknoUdtSM/1771618965931.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJu9Uti7hAME5Wd7uhE1vJa93vP8wgvTxcShXFgtEzfq/1771618966291.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3mxEeuivNqx3ViCisCKrmsC23XfXWT5krAoJQ9qc63y/1771618966554.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPurG6YQaxxgV18RcKA1Xf1EX3cbt9wSvHc8ivwPJfmZB/1771618966830.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1xbwktiRmCJNRtRN99YjGCZdki22RU7xsWhAk4KuLH2/1771619029864.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcB7s15QhY2AGhYAZ988av12oN8TF3c6KY8QiXHpKFTww/1771619030140.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeE2UbNFwu6uHE3ms6ExSgW44Uu4ENLXxqND5U53GPQ9d/1771619030460.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT4a4Xh9mhfo592iW5HizcB3pNHzgrkKEssh6SJ9VNbCE/1771619030682.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbyvJdscFB4YVaCs3PY2fUajEwDkpX5uH7WYfErmYBmc1/1771619030991.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVE1dimoRZHuyNEBVn7po3WEhRJVgPMCTfeM7vNKCoAYh/1771619095118.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVxJzvhdw3THYtPooSDofjfbMXqPeKptK1niaRrYbqZK/1771619095477.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdbkYbaYPjVpgqqLqNwFBR5J8oxx4UAYR6UHakGoEp3SL/1771619095746.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRqao2c2nN9vdAPR6fWuT1tf21ELyyr7CxrBBjsetPg9/1771619096024.jpg)

A few meters further on, my father noticed a broken section of pipe. Since he usually carries tools in his bag, he repaired it, preventing the loss of a significant amount of water. This is undoubtedly a task that almost no one knows about, but my father performs it anonymously. Although, I don't know if you remember the pipes I showed you earlier; I think we'll have to use some of them, as these are already at their lowest point.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgqLRtmeYTuyyAbXtkE1LKoqfUvxGD826dc7tuqcB9XQ/1771619201723.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2jo6hnczLzvETKTpRPDtt8QavHkVGDUzv2HR9c4sY9U/1771619202003.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWXhJzL1htgqiEDSBQxThWbtxe3p6LkVcU5rZRRN3jP4/1771619202270.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTvKeELBHwuFPe8JhJMveGe2EyJVhbEoTU6aiwNbCNTB/1771619249432.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9TMm1DTkeCvtKauKhx3goVxdc2rAQAdwy1jVDvoS6d6/1771619249672.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcBATMdbTLvFr9pcrqVQy48gTE7xpvxC93pe2RhpkoRWb/1771619249925.jpg)

We continued on and found the tank where the water arrives for the farmers. Without a doubt, a good amount is still arriving, even though the rains have been scarce in recent months. We are truly blessed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXThi6q5unQzyYceRD8HNXUmAhSNqCc99XuYfmSKS4UQr/1771619371483.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb3oHQnDfBBMndCu9aBPr5PXL3Czw1G8hRrJaJVGfuyxA/1771619371842.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ3MnUqgS5c3TxEVJXrftn5bcfAghnJ8x8nK76L7TeDzm/1771619372105.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaaJsgVgiqQEGcKhDqjHEHhgVNACLzG2b2dGP3anhQ37B/1771619372441.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPM1Zay5N6nbBjBVQfoMXwk4nZpKnD4kCQoi8Qd1TCeGR/1771619372762.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVdJZTUNEpTbmDcn6U5U2iYvNaWYhez9euh7k9ECQvyWz/1771619447012.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRy3rgJqi5SSJ7bgyeY7PLHtNRHTa4KoiScLq1QeLrot/1771619447486.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRij4cJmxtTUcPdEU6o2SRHq92pY3aHoWTYVVX52Y9xGm/1771619447838.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjs6SPdB7DSKbA2LX3q4is8iX1NMQDU7toU8TmjyDAgJ/1771619448125.jpg)

Now I'll show you some photos of the fruit plants I was able to photograph. The ones that caught my attention the most were the pineapples; some of them already have fruit. There are also others, like icacos, coconuts, and mangoes. I couldn't tell you how they grow there, but it's incredible to find them in a place where they don't receive the necessary care. I'm also grateful that we didn't encounter any venomous animals along the way, since they are the dominant species in this type of ecosystem.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpNJnbiabwoDQwYN4p2qoMfQbRRhJ2HYpJNApJH7RjV8/1771619623153.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYFpZ8twbLwNUtNoFbLm8dM4RAvx4Edk6vqF54tPbEBa/1771619623440.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGbgqkxXXSdFYS62UQgpprczaKVh9BugYDWc3GtCZVJ8/1771619623689.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWHSU2TkxZUkHLxpjobaU6VwEuZq8gWW34hgSUmAJ4X7o/1771619623883.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJmMbgsuBFeo1NtxrZJvMSaJvEqtS4X5kvRHUjSH235z/1771619624082.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLLGXdaUbEuK1Zxrj6hNi6SP6cm79MtSPChN9Z8Zq5gA/1771619672616.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdq6Sx3bCsnfMPSNZ1MA8hg48q38PwsiN4Brt86tg9cm/1771619673030.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3SU5CgozaHn5hxNekR5nED6ceSh7J7iHYe4v6VJyFE7/1771619673415.jpg)

I'm extremely happy because this is my first post here in the community @hive-174680. I also have the support of @biologistbrito with the *Second Open Contest* for all Hive users, **Ecosystems of the World**, where I hope to continue participating in future contests. I'll also try to write much more often in this great community.


<center> **Versión en Español** 🇻🇪 </center>


>Desde hace algún tiempo quería participar aquí con todos ustedes en la comunidad @hive-174680 dónde podemos compartir con el mundo los diferentes ecosistemas naturales y la diversidad qué existe no sólo en el país (Venezuela 🇻🇪) sino también dentro del mismo lugar a mostrar cómo pueden variar incluso en el mismo ecosistema.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU7FYDqSgrRMoRUDwLXv4FfZpPZcDJnmFr8GRW8b5vzcA/1771618093763.jpg)


>Una prueba de lo qué estoy tratando de explicar en mí publicación es lo siguiente; cerca de la casa hay un pequeño bosque qué cómo vivimos en un clima tropical lo denominaremos de esa forma al empezar nuestro camino se pueden observar los tubos qué llevan el agua a nuestra casa así seguí a mí papá quién me acompañó por todo el camino hasta llegar a lo que sería la tanquilla de registro principal dónde se almacena el agua qué baja desde un riachuelo qué se encuentra mucho más arriba de dónde estábamos así que sin dudarlo seguimos adelante para mostrar y compartir lo mejor qué la naturaleza nos proporciona.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTXBWwhK1HbNHNWcum3mrmzFnTZpsVCs9oMiuBiq6Bkq/1771618164044.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeuoYi3bbfvvdZYzCkaaMpU8Y65RPjPFzWPp42QvFViUr/1771618164365.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4THcxgAytcN1oHGYnBZd3tvojxpJYx6SGsYqppCVZJw/1771618164619.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7oBMKeRRyseKo5wwYVxTsyZMmtxgkJWrKDfb6nvsaCw/1771618164949.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZY6CmAvBbZrUZBhymtiJQoUHiN9ox8ctxA9GUCEvriJp/1771618165199.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRnY6GmacdrhyEqiizCr3PGa3chRWsczhTGoj6JXhFzjq/1771618231680.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmceP1iCV49A6iT1bJQ7xXxx9JrD8Ws3mveUkHQ72FTaLu/1771618231907.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYiNMQKvRkuYvikJDGA8Aixo3BeXQowdBEYsJfGrqeWS5/1771618232220.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTghMo1YMbGzxe8gtDpPtJF7UxtdXYmmaWhyEiZyT1Ws3/1771618232414.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmawnirGN9PRyURgNKyzqwRxx3yU3mvRrcbXhJAyNiK7Pp/1771618232749.jpg)


>Al subir tomé varias fotografías de la flora qué allí hace presencia sobre todo plantas de Copei las cuáles son relativamente jóvenes ya que hace unos años atrás hubo un incendio qué destruyó gran parte de los árboles más viejos que estaban dónde al visitarlos uno parecía perderse en el tiempo debido a qué no entraba ningún rayo de Sol por ningún lado ya qué ellos (árboles) tapaban todo, pero bueno ya después de ese inconveniente qué ocurrió se sembraron plantas qué todavía les falta mucho por crecer para intentar ser lo que fué en un tiempo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbXaJbsXx4N8DW4CkiJmBmjN8rENViNwDuiDnn2oemAB7/1771618328382.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd61UpGJiJLguhPiW64Sy1Hs4qzgDKPowue9E4QKK9Mp4/1771618328734.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcj5NuuVoNfW8ttEguxjX8dUQZfEBdt1cyewFAKsaeUSu/1771618329020.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVydfVkG3mRz1geTnUaxaekTanc7nNE3sxqnPXXKiE5cm/1771618329264.jpg)


>Seguimos y a medida que continuamos parecía aclarar un poco y en efecto había un espacio en el bosque cómo especie de un mirador natural dónde se podía observar otro tipo de ecosistema distinto al qué estábamos observando hace unos pocos metros sobre todo me traen recuerdos de mí niñez cuando agarrabamos la caña seca qué crece en esta planta para realizar nuestros papagayos (quizás más adelante les muestre la forma de hacerlos) y divertirnos volandolos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhWkAAhVzsxy36E1k8wkuYzCip3R6S69rCPph2iogGzM/1771618446939.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbgBNhSFCybMRHAqPRPmHo6NAFYrRVqp8pbzW451LHpB/1771618447235.jpg)

body.title: Television Review: The Drumhead (Star Trek: The Next Generation, S4X21, 1991)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/lBWrhV1BhMhM0huyMvfQeVTsCfy.jpg)

**The Drumhead (S04E21)**

Airdate: 29 April 1991

Written by: Jeri Taylor
Directed by: Jonathan Frakes

Running Time: 45 minutes 


Courtroom dramas have always been a familiar playground for television writers, and Star Trek has occasionally ventured into this territory with mixed results. There are episodes, like *[The Measure of a Man](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-the-measure-of-a-man-star-trek-the-next-generation-s2x09-1989)*, that stand as monumental achievements in science fiction, offering profound philosophical debates that arguably cemented *The Next Generation*'s status as a high-brow cultural phenomenon. However, this genre isn't merely a vehicle for intellectual exploration; it is also an incredibly practical budget-saving tool. The precedent for this financial logic was established in The Original Series with *[Court Martial](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-court-martial-star-trek-s1x15-1967-g3r)*, a low-cost episode that functioned almost entirely within the confines of a single set, relying on dialogue and static camera work to convey tension. By stripping away the need for alien planets, exotic creatures, or complex sets, writers can focus entirely on character dynamics, a tactic that proved effective in *Court Martial*. This same financial logic is undoubtedly what motivated the creation of Season 4's *Drumhead*.

The episode opens with a explosion within the dilithium chambers of the USS Enterprise-D, an event that immediately suggests sabotage. The timing could not be worse, as it coincides with Lieutenant Worf unearthing J'Dan (Henry Wornowicz), a Klingon exchange officer, as a spy for the Romulans. Suspicion mounts that the two events are connected, prompting Starfleet to dispatch Rear Admiral Norah Satie (Jean Simmons). Satie is a retired officer and legal expert, the daughter of the highly respected Judge Aaron Satie, and she arrives with the mandate to uncover the saboteur. .

J'Dan eventually admits his espionage but vehemently denies any involvement in the ship's destruction. Undeterred, Satie suspects an accomplice lurking among the crew, and Picard, though reluctant, agrees to her continued investigation. Enter Sabin Genestra (Bruce French), a Betazoid assistant to Satie, who senses that young medical technician Simon Tarses (Spencer Garrett) is lying. The investigation pivots aggressively toward Tarses, leveraging psychological pressure and Betazoid intuition to break him. 

Meanwhile, Data and La Forge conduct a technical analysis and conclude that the explosion was likely an accident caused by a fluctuation, not sabotage. This scientific reality is ignored by Satie, who is determined to find a scapegoat. Tarses eventually cracks, confessing that he lied about having Romulan ancestry during his Starfleet application. Picard, who has seen enough, intervenes to protect Tarses, convinced of the man's innocence. Satie reacts by turning the tables, launching an investigation into Picard himself. She accuses the Captain of obstructing justice and points to his past encounters with the Borg and his decision to let a Romulan spy escape as evidence of his disloyalty. It is a ruthless political maneuver that shifts the focus from the accused technician to the man in charge.

What follows is a hearing that devolves into a trial of Picard, presided over by Admiral Thomas Henry (Charles Billings), the head of Starfleet Security. It is a tense confrontation where Picard, armed with the words of Satie's own father, dismantles her arguments. He reveals her as a dangerous paranoiac who allowed a legitimate investigation to devolve into a witch hunt. Satie, unable to process the defeat, reacts irrationally, eventually breaking down. This moment convinces even the skeptical Admiral Henry that she has gone too far, and he ends the proceedings.

Written by Jeri Taylor and directed by Jonathan Frakes—his third outing behind the camera—*Drumhead* remains a somewhat divisive entry in the TNG canon. While a legion of critics and die-hard Trekkies revere it as a masterpiece, a significant portion of the audience considers it overrated. The casting of Jean Simmons is frequently cited as a major asset. According to Frakes, Simmons was a marvel to work with; she was not only a veteran actress with a long and renowned career but also, much to the production team's delight, a genuine \

Her insider knowledge and enthusiasm undoubtedly infused her performance with a layer of authenticity that elevated the material.

The episode's true highlight is undoubtedly the final confrontation where Picard dismantles Satie's arguments. It provides a magnificent showcase for Sir Patrick Stewart, allowing him to exercise his formidable acting chops. Stewart delivers a speech that characterizes figures like Satie as the ultimate danger to civilised society—people who hide behind the veneer of procedure and respectability while engaging in McCarthyist paranoia. However, these scenes are incredibly preachy. They transform *Drumhead* from a sci-fi thriller into a political sermon. This impression is compounded by Jonathan Frakes' direction, which borrows shots and motifs directly from courtroom drama classics like *Judgement at Nuremberg* and *The Caine Mutiny*. 

Jeri Taylor's script also suffers from somewhat messy characterisation. Satie is introduced as a brilliant, respected genius investigator, only to be rapidly written into a role as an irrational witch hunter who falls apart simply because she is reminded of her father's legacy. This arc feels rushed and lacks the nuance required to make the villainy truly convincing. The psychological profile of the Admiral shifts too abruptly from competent to unhinged without sufficient groundwork.

Ultimately, *Drumhead* is an episode that tries a little bit too hard to demonstrate that its authors had their heart in the right place. With its strong arguments in favour of civil rights, the presumption of innocence, the rejection of racist bias, and the condemnation of McCarthyist paranoia, the message is clear and noble. Yet, the delivery feels heavy-handed. It is definitely Star Trek, but it falls far short of the lofty classic that many of its enthusiastic fans try to describe. It is a competent episode hampered by its own earnestness and a tendency to lecture rather than immerse the audience.


RATING: 5/10 (++)

body.body: <center>\n\n**Nota de la autora:** ¡Hola y bonito día a todos! Les comparto mi participación en el Concurso \

, organizado por el equipo de @es-literatos . Espero que disfruten de este relato, el cual está ambientado en el universo de *Una terrícola en Titán*, una novela cuyos capítulos estoy publicando aquí en este mismo espacio.

¡Bonito fin de semana!

![Hive Banners 2026 (19).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickaboleyn/48K7mZp3G5RNaak78AQ2fC7nuaD6uYZQoE1fR1fcjrPL3F7a8nRg2QRjVPzSBENpxx.png) **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/arte-creativo-festivo-festival-4059502/)**

> Ceren, de 22 años, sintió su corazón hundirse con lentitud mientras sus doncellas la ayudaban a ponerse un vestido verde con un tocado de pedrería diamantada en el pecho.

Esa noche era especial. Era el aniversario número 1200 del Imperio Saturnino, una conglomeración de planetas conformada por Saturno, Júpiter y Urano, así como de distintas lunas como Titán y Encélado. Para ello se organizaron grandes desfiles militares, juegos artificiales y bailes temáticos. El de ese día hacía referencia a la conquista de Júpiter; los asistentes tenían que llevar máscaras alusivas a distintos personajes clave de la guerra de conquista o al menos emular algún evento relacionado.

Pero Ceren no quería asistir al baile. Quería estar en su habitación contemplando los hermosos anillos que se asomaban desde las habitaciones que compartía con su esposo.

Suspiró quedamente mientras se colocaba la máscara verde en el rostro. Por su cabeza pasaron mil ideas, todas girando en torno a aquella suerte extraña que le había tocado.

Ella había sido secuestrada de su planeta, la Tierra, al amanecer. Fue vendida en el mercado negro de Ordún al harén imperial; fue concubina imperial menor, destinada esencialmente para el disfrute de un príncipe, un chambelán o de un militar de alto rango. No tenía ningún poder sociopolítico más allá de su propia belleza. Había sido educada en literatura, música, y danza en las miras de ser una esposa versada en esas artes que pudieran satisfacer a su marido.

Pasó en él un año antes de ser seleccionada por Eirle Bey, su suegra, para casarse con su hijo mayor, Hanis Bey, el temido Carnicero de Neptuno.

Los Bey era una de las familias militares más temidas y despiadadas del imperio; tenían un largo historial de esposas esclavas que fueron enviadas a las Minas de Longinos tras tres años de matrimonio, tiempo en el cual debían producir herederos. Otras familias militares preferían venderlas a los burdeles, pero Ceren consideraba ese destino mucho peor que morir en las minas.

Lo único que podía hacer era rezar a Dios con que los Bey la pudieran liberar de cualquiera de esos destinos. Aquello era un evento raro; las esposas esclavas eran consideradas meros accesorios, destinadas a la reproducción. Sus sentimientos, sus pensamientos, su humanidad misma eran relegadas al olvido, a esconderse bajo la máscara de la resignación y la aceptación de un destino que otros decidían sin que ella pudiera tener control sobre ello.

Pero Ceren tenía fe en que lograría seducir al hombre cuyas manos estaban manchadas de sangre inocente. Usaría todos los recursos que le enseñaron en el harén para lograrlo. Tenía tres años para lograr su cometido; tres años suficientes para poder navegar en ese mundo lleno de sombras.

\

, le dijo de repente una voz.

Las sirvientas hicieron una reverencia mientras que Ceren se volvía hacia su interlocutor.

Hanis estaba en la entrada de la habitación. De alta estatura, piel levemente bronceada, cabellera oscura, y ojos azules oscuros, ataviado con una armadura de estilo romano, de tonalidad oscura, casi tirando a negro; en la zona del pecho estaban grabados dos ts'arkan, corceles saturninos famosos por su espíritu rebelde, mirándose el uno al otro. Llevaba una máscara negra con dos grandes bucles plateados.

\

, respondió Ceren mientras tomaba a su marido del brazo.

\

.

Hanis la miró de reojo, esbozando una sonrisa.

Ceren. La bella terrícola por la que muchos nobles de alta alcurnia suspiraban. De belleza sencilla, con aires de nostalgia; una máscara perfecta para protegerse a sí misma de los peligros de la corte.

Sabía bien que Ceren tenía deseos de regresar a su planeta. Lo podía notar bajo la máscara verde que tenía puesto en ese momento.

Su hogar. Su familia. Una vida anterior a la que tenía ahora.

Pensó en enviarla a casa apenas se cumpliera el año, pero su madre Eirle le instó a que no se precipitara; los traficantes podrían recapturarla y venderla en otro lado. Lo mejor que podía hacer era esperar los tres años para que pudiera repatriarla, como lo hicieron sus parientes con las otras que contrajeron matrimonio dentro de la familia.

Y mientras el momento llegaba, el Carnicero de Neptuno aprovecharía el tiempo para conocer más a la mujer de naturaleza tranquila que era su esposa esclava. La dulce y tímida Ceren.

body.body: Hello everyone 👋🏽👋🏽 It's nice to be back after how many days of having a break from hive..I've had a hard time managing my time both in working and in being a mom.. I'm gonna share something special today which I prepared as a snacks for my kids ..it's an orange flavored puto which is another variation of steamed rice cake. It's a fun twist of using orange soda for a more flavorful and citrusy taste.

> I used the following ingredients in cooking this puto 1 cup of all purpose flour 2 tbsp of sugar Pinch of salt 1 tbsp of baking powder 3 sachet of powdered milk 1 cup orange flavored (Royal true orange)or you can use lemon zest 1 tbsp of melted butter

> After preparing all the ingredients Mix all the dry ingredients like the flour,sugar,salt and baking powder.Mix it thoroughly. Add the butter and a cup of flavored true orange in the mixed dry ingredients..See to it that you don't overmix it.
> See to it that after mixing it,there's no lumps visible..if there are lumps, strained the mixture using the strainer..
>\nFill in the molder or the muffin cups for about 2/3 full with mixture \n
>\nSteam over the medium heat for 15-20 minutes.\n
>\nLet it cool.. Slightly removed it from its molder...Enjoy eating warm.\n

>
I'm adding Royal true orange for a sweeter and more flavorful taste.
Experimenting it with this new flavor gives more aroma after the puto is being steamed.
It's a refreshing recipe that made the puto glow because of the added Royal true orange..
---
---
Kids will surely enjoy this puto delight with a twist..This would be all for now and see you on my next cooking journey..Bye😍😘😘

body.title: [ENG/ESP]Enjoying the Magic of Spontaneous Moments//Disfrutando de la Magia de los Momentos Espontáneos
body.body:
> __Versión Inglés__
![IMG-20260216-WA0162.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/EoChd6DRzz33LWgkthasPtPGs2LZfsixZxFt1RM63gU6yWdqaCuf5LS53R6gsixVJQm.jpg)
Greetings, dear Hiviers! I hope you are all well and full of energy. Today I want to share with you an experience that, although unplanned, turned out to be a wonderful day full of laughter and unforgettable moments. During the Carnival days, we didn't have any particular plans and decided to stay in the comfort of our home. However, on Monday afternoon, the idea of ​​doing something special started to take shape in my mind. So, spontaneously, we suggested dressing the children in their favorite costumes and going out to enjoy the day.
![IMG-20260216-WA0217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/23xKr34cGtVnmUj5xiRxJUrKJKHwBUtXcDyachrbPC2PSTjSNPLuF4xy3XwETwJo6ouoh.jpg)
My grandson Gael was especially excited, since he hadn't had the chance to wear his Spiderman costume at his school party. Seeing his face light up with happiness when he put on the costume was a moment I will always treasure. We headed to the nearby park, where the children could run, play, and let their imaginations run wild. It was a joy to see them enjoying themselves outdoors, away from screens and daily routines.
![IMG-20260216-WA0134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/2432J3YE55oj7kiv3f7gciyoC3gS9PjMyWz32uQgZFo9g2dXcGuURTs4swYWsADUeoapA.jpg) ![IMG-20260216-WA0223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/23w2ik5L7tD6gmV33m24XC4WGcXCWxfoS8BF6pbAQq4cMNo5eLzZ6NGkpcaVfhBNqvAzU.jpg)
After an afternoon full of adventures at the park, we decided to continue the fun at our favorite ice cream shop. This place not only offers the creamiest and most delicious ice cream, but it also has a small amusement park that delights the little ones. Watching the children savor their ice cream while playing and laughing was the perfect ending to a perfect day.
![IMG-20260216-WA0098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/23wMRdt6vvzSjgt3jKPEVnB5R9vTJihihwSue1jFzboF9rfjGFseBp6QUUQuvgTxduGV5.jpg) ![IMG-20260216-WA0108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/23wC7wmyAJLh6227AQQ1fEgBNUhzJDuATsXbww7ddVWL9xkWKuhaufgAKq7TUHXiJSnbQ.jpg)
Reflecting on this experience, I realize that sometimes the best things happen when we least plan them. The spontaneity and simplicity of these moments are what truly matter and what create lasting memories.
![IMG-20260216-WA0230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayraro05/23tmHsB4WcFPCfGFai2nfhm93gjA99FkqqDRTt8irzq2Wb4arPoGDdZK49iDVTSXeZARq.jpg)
Thank you for allowing me to share this special day with you. I hope you also find time to enjoy those unexpected moments that life gives us. Until next time, I hope to see you soon! The photographs accompanying this post were taken by me with my Samsung A12 mobile phone, capturing every moment with love and joy. __Text translated with the translator Deepl__

body.body:
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/Eq5FW2kg8MXRYn9UcMKNyWjPJPmEGPkZgMZEYcM2JnQBHMzgtXf8ex82NKpuQYT5xPR.jpg)

Today, I revisited the Food Place food court, located at Pavilion Mall. The food court is located beside the Oriental Kopi Restaurant. Recently a new stall called Mr Peppery rice open at the food court, so I decided to try from this stall.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EpNoTbHrJck3PvaxeqtJyvsAkyaRKX1P7Yct6krEFXAffHY7oJyxTmnpHKb4gXJBfLZ.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EoCkzoRddJK4oGNPS3XkFD2HEZVeQhhdwisWL3716QY2xhXV7VMQVLgqr4P7nQ9CBkz.jpg)

This time, I ordered Sliced beef Teppan Pepper rice from the Mr Peppery rice stall, which cost RM16.90 per plate. 

This dish arrives on a sizzling hot iron plate, with a neat mound of white rice in the center topped with sweet corn, chopped spring onions, and a heavy sprinkle of cracked black pepper. Thinly sliced beef surrounds the rice, gently cooking on the hotplate’s surface heat.

 The beef’s natural juices mix into the rice as you stir everything together, creating a savoury, slightly smoky taste driven mainly by black pepper and the meat itself. The high heat gives subtle charred edges to the beef, adding depth and aroma.

The concept originates from Japanese teppan (iron plate) cooking and was popularised in fast-casual format by chains like Pepper Lunch in the 1990s. The idea was to let customers mix and control the doneness themselves, using intense heat to bring out natural flavours.

n Malaysia, the dish evolved slightly depending on the outlet — some versions include butter, while others  focus purely on pepper, meat juices, and sauce for a lighter but still bold experience.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/Eq5FW2kg8MXRYn9UcMKNyWjPJPmEGPkZgMZEYcM2JnQBHMzgtXf8ex82NKpuQYT5xPR.jpg)

body.title: When Life Goals and Learning Feels Urgent at Midnight.
body.body: It's almost 3:30 am here , I woke up an hour ago and I can't sleep back, just enjoying and loving the quietness and calmness of the night. What's really peaceful and unique about the night hours , that I can't stop loving is the quietness and tranquility, the quietness of the environment, midnight makes my thoughts louder ,gives me time to reflect and fix my doubts without interruptions. At midnight the world gets quiet and every thought becomes loud and significant, night is a time I keep reflecting on my actions, thoughts , ideas and worries. My thoughts become very loud and audible at night. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc4KUEzZvpDjEEwdXUbb9n3X7yan4Y1pFJDodNBg8Ec64/1771640678731.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://pixabay.com/photos/lamp-lantern-night-midnight-6785065/) I believe that midnight is a time for reflection on goals, the perfect time to read ,learn , meditate, and reflect about life, due to the quietness and calmness of the night. Midnight is a time of solitude. Midnight takes away certain distractions, takes away certain feeling and attention, it's just me, my loud thoughts and a ticking clock. Midnight gives great time and opportunity to learn and inculcate knowledge when possible, it could be understanding a book, a skill , situation , going to several link to apply and many other resourceful ideas. The greatest and most innovative thoughts and ideas comes at midnight, midnight gives me an urgency to actualize and chase my written goals . It's a time of learning, and a time to appreciate solitude . Midnight plays a start to all my emotions, gives me a time to reflect on my days, path, behavior, doubts and believe. Midnight brings my thoughts and mind together and an opportunity to learn and a constant reminder of my goald. Midnight has and will always be a time to reflect, learn , understand and play my activities over and over again. Mid night has and will always be an appropriate time for learning and enjoying solitude. Midnight urgency is therapeutic. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

¡Hola amigos, feliz día! Espero que se encuentren bien y que tengan un lindo fin de semana. Por mi parte, me encuentro bien, gracias a Dios. Les cuento que el día de hoy aprovechando que inició el fin de semana decidimos pedir comida para disfrutar por la noche mientras veíamos un maratón de \

en nuestro nuevo apartamento.\n\nAlgo que me gusta del nuevo lugar donde nos mudamos es que además de tener parques cerca, tenemos un centro comercial con diferentes locales de comidas, por lo que hay muchas opciones para disfrutar. Este día queríamos comer sandwich y encontramos un restaurante llamado \

que vende más que todo comida rápida como perros calientes, hamburguesas, arepas rellenas, entre varias opciones incluyendo los sandwiches qbanos.\n\nPor mi parte, pedí uno de pollo desmenuzado con maíz y Fer, pidió uno llamado \

que traía adicional salchicha suiza, ambos venían con lechuga, tomate verde, cebolla y poca salsa (así lo pedimos) cada uno por un valor de $29.900 pesos colombianos ($8.10 dólares) y la verdad es que nos gustó muchísimo, no le negaron ningún ingrediente por lo que en cada bocado se le podía sentir el pollito y demás. Por supuesto, que como toda antojosa, el de Fer fue mi favorito jaja, ya que tenía el sabor adicional de la salchicha. Algo que también nos gustó fue el empaque, ya que cada uno venía en una cajita muy bonita con el logo del restaurante y adicional, en papel aluminio para conservar el calor. Sin duda, nos gustó mucho la experiencia, por lo que se los recomendamos, para la próxima nos acercaremos al restaurante directamente para vivir la experiencia completa. Sin más, espero que tengan un buen fin de semana, amigos. Nos leemos en una próxima ❤️
ENGLISH

Hello friends, happy day! I hope you are well and having a nice weekend. As for me, I am fine, thank God. I wanted to tell you that today, taking advantage of the start of the weekend, we decided to order food to enjoy in the evening while watching a Fast and Furious marathon in our new flat. One thing I like about the new place we moved to is that, in addition to having parks nearby, we have a shopping centre with different food outlets, so there are many options to enjoy. Today we wanted to eat sandwiches and found a restaurant called Chuzitos that sells mostly fast food such as hot dogs, hamburgers, stuffed arepas, among several options including qbanos sandwiches. For my part, I ordered one with shredded chicken and corn, and Fer ordered one called \

which came with additional Swiss sausage. Both came with lettuce, green tomato, onion and a little sauce (as we requested), each costing 29,900 Colombian pesos (US$8.10), and we really liked them. They didn't skimp on any ingredients, so you could taste the chicken and everything else in every bite. Of course, like any sweet tooth, Fer's was my favourite, haha, as it had the added flavour of the sausage. We also liked the packaging, as each one came in a very nice box with the restaurant's logo and, in addition, in aluminium foil to keep it warm. We definitely enjoyed the experience, so we recommend it. Next time, we'll go to the restaurant directly to enjoy the full experience. Without further ado, I hope you have a good weekend, friends. See you next time ❤️.

这是我第一次来悦陵州酒店吃饭，菜品的体验超出预期。

我们这座小城近几年新开了不少标榜高端的酒店，但无论装修环境还是菜品品质，总觉得少了几分真正的高级感。而今天这顿饭，明显比其他地方更胜一筹。事后我才知道，因为有大领导出席，所有菜肴都是特意安排的精致定制款，我有口福得感谢领导。

吃饭时，压根没有人拿出手机拍照，我也只敢悄悄拍了几张菜品，刻意避开其他人的面孔，生怕引起不必要的误会。

每个人面前都有一个形似笔筒的容器，上面还点缀着竹叶，打开一看，里面竟是用三根牙签串起的钵钵鸡，创意十足。桌边的细节也十分贴心，除了常规餐具，还备好了牙线、口香糖、热毛巾，真是把细节做到了极致。

当天的菜品我都很喜欢，好看，又好吃，只是这种局，是不能放开吃的，因为会一直敬酒，酒过三巡，大领导提议今天早些结束，约定过年前再相聚，酒店老总也过来陪同小坐，还特意为每个人安排了一碗酸汤手包饺子，成为这顿饭最巴适的收尾。

这一顿饭吃得格外巴适，不仅品尝到了美味，更近距离感受到了社会高层人士的处事智慧与说话艺术，又是一次受益匪浅的经历。
