body.title: Playing Predecessor with Friends is Way More Fun
body.body:
![GIF1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xAMZA2hqk1JkWdzdffnHEYHMXJfZA1BVBJN34FSj7My9FjYaLnrs63ULbv8HMB5VLMb.gif)


Hey gamers, how are you doing? Hope you're all doing great! So, as you know, one of the toughest things as we grow older is the reduction of gaming buddies. Usually when we're kids, there are always plenty of people to play with, but this is something that gets lost over time, and the most common thing is to play with randoms. However, when we can play with friends, everything changes and becomes way more fun.

But here's the thing—like any MOBA, Predecessor can be brutal when you're playing solo with randoms. You know how it goes: nobody communicates, people spam ping when things go wrong, and teamwork becomes more of a fantasy than a reality. That's why playing with friends transforms the entire experience from frustrating to absolutely amazing.

## The Agreement to Fight Together

![GIF2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vhsM3cpmxJAhyJS1R4qUgYSYQJuTxDwV8CDVb7yikasgniMhhNKBQXtQdtdPyqhJ4X3.gif)

When you can actually communicate with your team, everything becomes easier. Attacking as a unit, protecting your lane, defending towers, or destroying enemies in coordination—it's all better. In Predecessor, this becomes even more critical because the game isn't just about clicking on a map from above. You're right there in third-person view, dodging abilities, aiming skillshots, and using the game's incredible verticality to your advantage.

I've had matches where my friend and I planned out ganks in advance. We'd coordinate exactly when to strike, what abilities to chain together, and how to escape if things went south. That level of planning just doesn't exist when you're playing with randoms who might not even have a microphone or speak your language. Being able to say \

and having your teammate ready to follow up is an absolute game-changer.

The communication extends beyond just fights too. Knowing when to rotate, when to contest objectives like the Fangtooth or the Orb Prime, when to push for towers, or when to back off and farm—all of this becomes so much smoother when you're on voice chat with people you trust. You develop strategies together, you learn each other's playstyles, and you start to anticipate moves before they even happen. That's the kind of synergy that wins games.

In a game like Predecessor where split-second decisions matter, where you need to vault over terrain to escape or position yourself perfectly to land that game-winning ultimate, having teammates who know exactly what you're thinking is invaluable. We've pulled off plays that felt straight out of a professional esports match just because we could communicate clearly and execute together.

## Playing Jungle with a Friend in Mid Lane

![GIF3.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23w2cue2dF38P8WX879CYPJscSceeHoX5jEcT4TEcVv6EtcLS4tHXYT2VGVG923mY8XeQ.gif)

This is one of my favorite combinations, and it's absolutely deadly in Predecessor. When you're jungling and you have a friend in the mid lane, you create this powerful duo that can eliminate enemies by surprise and completely dominate the map.

The mid lane in Predecessor is crucial—it's the shortest lane, it provides access to both sides of the jungle, and it's often where the most skilled players go. Having a friend there who you can coordinate with as a jungler is like having a secret weapon. I can't tell you how many times we've caught enemy mid laners completely off guard because we timed our ganks perfectly.

Here's how it works: I'm farming my jungle camps, keeping an eye on the mid lane. My friend is playing it cool, maybe even letting the enemy push up a bit. Then I ping that I'm coming, and he sets it up perfectly. Maybe he baits out an escape ability, or positions the enemy exactly where I need them. Then I come in from the jungle with my gap closer, we chain our crowd control, and boom—another kill on the board.

What makes this even better in Predecessor is the mobility options. Some junglers can literally fly over walls or vault through terrain. The enemy mid laner thinks they're safe under their tower, but suddenly I'm dropping in from above while my friend cuts off the escape route. These kinds of coordinated plays just hit different when you're playing with someone you know.

The synergy extends throughout the match too. We can coordinate invades into the enemy jungle, stealing their camps and buffs. We can collapse on objectives together. If my mid lane friend gets into trouble, I'm already rotating to help because he told me what's happening. And if I need help securing a tough jungle camp or contesting an objective, he can rotate faster than anyone else on the map.

## A Five-Player Team - The Dream

![0126 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tS37BXPHmyLknDfJ9mbF66Ehryyt9udCMbPrDvJ57uNyP2iChV4dwhGadEZurzxHqxs.jpg)

Now this would be incredible—being able to play with five friends in the same match and coordinate everything that happens in the game. The strategies, attacks, blocks, tower destruction, roles, and more. This would be truly amazing. Getting a full MOBA team where competition becomes another level entirely. I hope someday I can play Predecessor this way.

Imagine it: you've got your top laner who specializes in those tanky bruiser heroes, your mid laner who's a mechanical god with the mage characters, your support player who's always looking out for the team, your ADC who can farm like crazy and carry teamfights, and your jungler orchestrating plays across the entire map. Everyone knows their role, everyone trusts each other, and everyone is working toward the same goal.

In a five-stack, you could practice specific team compositions. Maybe you want to run a dive-heavy comp where everyone has mobility and crowd control to hunt down high-priority targets. Or maybe you want a poke composition where you wear down the enemy before engaging. With randoms, you're stuck with whatever people feel like playing. With a full team of friends, you can actually strategize and build synergies.

The shot-calling becomes so much cleaner too. Instead of five different people pinging different objectives and nobody knowing what the plan is, you have one person making the calls and everyone executing. \

Everyone shows up on time, everyone knows the plan, and you secure the objective cleanly.

Team fights would be so much more coordinated. You could practice combos together—like having your support set up a perfect crowd control chain that leads into your mid laner's area-of-effect ultimate, followed by your ADC cleaning up. These kinds of plays require timing and coordination that you just can't get with random players.

![0126 (2)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vhuR3hYV2Y6G4d3jJ19XtgpzVvHjJqgX5pqkaA4mFiR158h26BpW9ZP6jjLJPMB9ARW.jpg)

And let's be honest, even when you lose, it's more fun with friends. You can laugh about the mistakes, discuss what went wrong, and queue up for another match without the toxicity that often comes with solo queue. No more dealing with randoms flaming each other in chat or giving up after first blood. Just five people working together, learning together, and improving together.

The competitive scene in Predecessor is growing, with both community tournaments and official esports events. Having a dedicated five-player team would let you actually compete in these tournaments, test your skills against other coordinated teams, and maybe even make a name for yourselves in the community. That's the kind of MOBA experience that creates lasting memories and friendships.

Right now, I usually play with one or two friends, and even that makes such a massive difference. But the dream is definitely to get a full squad together. We'd practice specific strategies, learn the ins and outs of every hero matchup, master the timings on jungle camps and objectives, and really push ourselves to see how good we could become.


![0126 (2)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5y7b3mDrUPvKS9yT2D59NLCiixiAxoxEWh2aGDds7JkYQfAgWQXbCNE5cKsjYV61m3.jpg)


If you haven't tried Predecessor yet, definitely give it a shot. And if you have friends who are into MOBAs or even just competitive games in general, convince them to download it. Trust me, coordinating plays with friends, pulling off sick combos, and celebrating victories together makes every moment better.

The game has over 45 heroes now, multiple game modes including the new Labs features, regular updates with new content, and a development team that actually listens to the community. It's in a great place right now, and it's only getting better.

So hey, if any of you play Predecessor and want to squad up sometime, let me know! Maybe we can work toward that dream of a full five-player team. Until then, I'll keep grinding, improving my jungle game, and hoping to find more friends to dominate the battlefield with.

See you in the arena, gamers!

body.title: Un paseo rápido por la zona de Palermo📍🇦🇷 | Hay un Farmatodo?🤔 y probando el McFlurry Dubai!🍦 | A quick stroll through the Palermo neighborhood📍🇦🇷: Is there a Farmatodo?🤔 And trying McFlurry Dubai!🍦
body.body:
#### **¡Bienvenidos a mi blog! ♡**

Holi gente de esta linda comunidad, espero que todos estén muy bien hoy✨.

Tenía por acá estos bonitos recuerdos de una zona a la que he ido poco, pero me encanta de la ciudad de Buenos Aires y me había olvidado de mostrarles por acá.

> #### **Welcome to my blog! ♡**
>
>Hi people in this lovely community., I hope y'all very well today✨.
>
>I had these beautiful souvenirs from an area I haven't visited much, but I love in Buenos Aires, and I had forgotten to show them to you here.

-------

![1000290985.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23u67UTB21gFtpemU6L8WYcYsjPBwEKtiyDCNT4LxYAkLjD79YLmRAL66FwnD99WB5VgB.png)

-----

El contexto es el siguiente, a mi novio Marcos le dieron unos cupones en su trabajo para poder utilizarlos en una tienda especifica por la llegada del verano acá. 

La tienda se llama Calipsian Palermo y se encuentra en el Alto Palermo Shopping, cuando me enteré de esto estuve muy feliz porque me gusta mucho pasear por esta zona.

Nos costó un poco conseguir el lugar porque creo que nunca habíamos pasado por acá, pero al final conseguimos y fue genial, compramos algunos trajes de baño para este verano y algunas otras cositas para esas reuniones en la pileta que tanto nos gustan, aunque el calor a veces es insoportable, así es más llevadero.

>The context is as follows: my boyfriend Marcos was given some coupons at work to use at a specific store for the arrival of summer here. 
>
>The store is called Calipsian Palermo and is located in Alto Palermo Shopping. When I found out about this, I was very happy because I really like walking around this area.
>
>It took us a while to find the place because I don't think we had ever been there before, but we finally found it and it was great. We bought some swimsuits for this summer and a few other things for those pool parties we love so much, even though the heat is sometimes unbearable. This way, it's more bearable.

-------

<center> ![1000278554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23vYWyiQPnE3z4jwRqqZaAzLWigCaiU1Md1BGXzMFfpd1KF5JL5axs5ijMA5nih8kTGoE.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23sU6ZtKYiwFaGPPieh97EnzVPYMLbWBtJmuinEYcLkUEheUjidtuNDFq35YquFV8PqVz.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/243BaFSY2SisDvfW2MZQbUY3zSuzee1t9Xvm9Nw5QybhYVecWsydJX52EW4qeHTXVb4Zw.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23yJGbLuYHwyzsfYsbA24j3pGp24PLDVZYWqow8Lnnwr1wyoNS6XxvBpKshzsRNiCoXZ1.jpg) </center>

------ 
 
Después de buscar las cosas, nos quedamos paseando un rato y tomando algunas fotos en los alrededores, recuerdo que aún había algunas decoraciones navideñas que quedaron de diciembre así que si, tengo una foto en un árbolito navideño cuando estamos en febrero, la vida se nos descarriló un poco jaja.

Ya para finalizar nuestro paseo, decidimos ir al Mc Donald's para probar un rico helado de chocolate Dubai, que estaba bueno y todo el mundo hablaba de él así que no podíamos quedar por fuera.

>After shopping, we stayed for a while and took some photos in the surrounding area. I remember that there were still some Christmas decorations left over from December, so yes, I have a photo of myself on a Christmas tree in February. Life got a little out of control for us, haha.
>
>To end our outing, we decided to go to McDonald's to try a delicious Dubai chocolate ice cream, which was good and everyone was talking about it, so we couldn't miss out.

-------

<center> ![1000278551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23xen3WtXwGGqXg2FkwX6NnWZ9Zyx1X99uaGuJ3XxgzoygnUV8quxesDCGQz6YkLvT7NY.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23xKrV7eUPuQGN7dP6UmQ3Fk5VkuAB6WhtyeUNtcWdj9ioGb3hi3RL2c48smHrGGWdV6J.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23yd1dzZsReyw7q9phJrnH1TYFDjVeSBMC1WZyo7iQVkrcDrp7EtF7W9mwuBf482FDneF.jpg) </center>

<center> ![1000278565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23ynX4G1zU68sSGSLrD9ZFf9KSBon7NT9wzwuTAw482WCfLGjNT7svRfmWKPVuH4TrNmd.jpg) </center>

------

Algo que me emocionó mucho fue que vimos un Farmatodo, si, un Farmatodo, esto es muy famoso en mi país, Venezuela, así que tuvimos que entrar, aunque ya nos íbamos y esto fue un pequeño chequeo rápido y no pude observar con detalles, así que tengo una nueva tarea la próxima vez que venga ahora que sé que está acá.

Me gusta mucho Palermo, espero volver pronto.

>Something that really excited me was that we saw a Farmatodo, yes, a Farmatodo, which is very famous in my country, Venezuela, so we had to go in, even though we were already leaving, and this was just a quick look around and I couldn't see everything in detail, so I have a new task for the next time I come, now that I know it's here.
>
>I really like Palermo, I hope to come back soon.

------

<center> ![1000278568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esgabita/23zbMgVVGqJBtUUEt1zinK4xRAQtgBEQpdChXcbCmcYPgm9QMVLMH2oEG66Vh7hJAn25W.jpg) </center>

---

A new week in which I update rewards for my delegation in this beautiful community and the ZING tokens I have accumulated in stake. As usual, I bring you a new work of art. body.title: Photo contest  round 258/Chasing the Black Ibis (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> #### Hello, fellow bird lovers! # The black heron, as I call it, is not actually a heron but an ibis, Phimodus infuscatum. I was curious to know how to tell them apart, and it is the type of beak that determines this. The ibis is characterized by a long, curved beak that helps it search for food under mud or leaves, which differentiates it from herons, which generally have yellow, pointed beaks for quickly catching their prey. >Their diet determines the characteristics of their beaks. The ibis generally feeds on insects, small crustaceans, worms, and also grains and leaves. This dark-plumaged ibis is called coquito, red-faced ibis, and shaved ibis in different regions of South America. It is a bird that has adapted to living in urban areas in search of food. Where I live, it is very common to see them in groups near the garbage dump. I have photographed it on several occasions. This time I observed it accompanied by common pigeons and rock pigeons. I approached to photograph the group, but they all flew away except for her or him—it is not very easy to differentiate between males and females. It just walked away a little, and I started to follow it and photograph it. ![20260220_094656(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb38h5eZTNjivsKwzrjkU58exebCgYbn6KSNPsrxzvmL3/20260220_094656(1).jpg) At times, it took flight, but not very high, and returned to the ground to continue searching for food among the dry leaves. That allowed me to take more pictures without getting too close. This photo is my favorite, with its wings spread. Its colors are bright. Its plumage is not completely black; its beak and legs are light red, and its wings have brown and greenish feathers. ![20260220_094818.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSPLQjvQY3Gy1UnWkNH1RA9PTMyvrHLEWYt14VGkZEkT/20260220_094818.jpg) These birds are accustomed to the presence of people because the place they frequent is a sports field and a parking lot, but this one in particular was not afraid of me. I think it did not consider me a danger from which it had to flee. This allowed me to take several photographs. ![20260220_191812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfXXK6uVgoLBBxjfxGwXBb8fuc6N8VG1KrrowgM9sHSL/20260220_191812.jpg) This is the sequence of photos I took while it was walking. ![20260220_094819.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc5ayeDeUio7akVW2q4qx7qt5pSx3iK8mdPWYYbS4Sy8Q/20260220_094819.jpg) Finally, she had moved away a little, trying to continue her search for food, and I decided I should leave her alone. She had already allowed me to take several photographs of her.
![20260220_094830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6rznzZ4kCoDRfzUECR4HSzpJuyyrgp21VvgraHupukD/20260220_094830.jpg)
![Ingredientes_20251229_113202_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc76aDc2U35fsey8A1gfe3CjysjsjgxQX7aF2JFvXDP4h/Ingredientes_20251229_113202_0000.jpg) *** Thank you very much for reading, and I hope you enjoy them. *** ![Ingredientes_20250428_210521_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxoAedsAyYcSSs6PCbFL2YcoZfw25QPi9H1gJRjuRsmz/Ingredientes_20250428_210521_0000.jpg) La garcita negra como yo la llamo,  realmente no es una garza sino un ibis,  Phimodus infuscatum. Me dio curiosidad saber que diferenciaba una de la otra y el tipo de pico es lo que lo determina. El ibis se caracteriza por un pico largo y curvo que le ayuda a buscar su alimento bajo el lodo o las hojas y esto la diferencia de las garzas que tienen el pico generalmente amarillo y  puntiagudo,  para atrapar rápidamente a sus presas.   La alimentación determina las características de sus picos. El Ibis se alimenta generalmente de insectos, pequeños crustáceos, lombrices y también granos y hojas. A este ibis de plumaje oscuro lo llaman coquito, ibis de cara roja e ibis afeitado en diferente  regiones de Suramérica. Es un ave que se ha adaptado a vivir en espacios urbanos en la búsqueda de alimento. En el lugar donde vivo es muy común verla en grupos cerca del depósito de la basura. La he fotografiado en varias oportunidades. Esta vez la observe  acompañada de las palomas comunes y las palomas tocases.  Me acerque a fotografiar al grupo, pero todas volaron excepto ella o el, no es muy fácil diferenciar  el macho de la hembra. Solo caminó intentando alejarse un poco y allí empecé a seguirla y a fotografiarla.
![20260220_094656(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb38h5eZTNjivsKwzrjkU58exebCgYbn6KSNPsrxzvmL3/20260220_094656(1).jpg)
En algunas momentos levanto vuelo pero no muy alto y volvía al suelo para continuar buscando comida entre las hojas secas. Eso me permitió tomar otras fotografías sin acercarme mucho. ***
![20260220_094818.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSPLQjvQY3Gy1UnWkNH1RA9PTMyvrHLEWYt14VGkZEkT/20260220_094818.jpg)
Estas aves, están acostumbradas a la presencia de las  personas,  porque el lugar donde frecuentan, es una cancha deportiva y un estacionamiento, pero esta en especial no tuvo miedo de mi presencia, creo que no me consideró un peligro, del cual tuviera que huir.  Esto me permitió tomar varias fotografías. Esta foto es mi favorita, abriendo sus alas. Sus colores son brillantes. Su plumaje no es completamente negro, su pico y patas son de color rojo claro  y sus alas tienen plumas  marrones y verdosas.   Esta es la secuencia de fotos que tomé mientras ella caminaba. ![20260220_191812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfXXK6uVgoLBBxjfxGwXBb8fuc6N8VG1KrrowgM9sHSL/20260220_191812.jpg) Ya por último se había alejado un poco, tratando de continuar con su búsqueda de alimentos y decidí que debía dejarla tranquila. Ya me había permitido tomarle varias fotografías. ![20260220_094830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6rznzZ4kCoDRfzUECR4HSzpJuyyrgp21VvgraHupukD/20260220_094830.jpg) ![Ingredientes_20251229_113202_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc76aDc2U35fsey8A1gfe3CjysjsjgxQX7aF2JFvXDP4h/Ingredientes_20251229_113202_0000.jpg) Muchas gracias por leer y espero que las disfruten. ![17716396568705211884511633804623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTUK7pxngycsLLWNrKWvyCicXLfNaGhoTR43mQ9UAU6G3/17716396568705211884511633804623.jpg) Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

Z tej okazji spotykamy się w Królestwie, aby porozmawiać o tym jak trwająca wciąż wojna zmieniła świat oraz o relacjach polsko-ukraińskich. Pretekstem do rozmowy będzie film \

, w którym Maciej Hamela udokumentował nie tylko wojenne zniszczenia i tysiące kilometrów trasy ewakuacyjnej z terenów przyfrontowych, ale przede wszystkim dramat tych, którzy musieli opuścić swoje domy. 

Rozpoczęcie o godzinie 19.00. Wstęp wolny, ale jak zwykle można się dobrowolnie opodatkować na rzecz otwartej enklawy.

<center>* * *</center>

Tuesday, February 24, marks the 4th anniversary of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. To commemorate this day, we are meeting at Królestwo to discuss how the ongoing war has changed the world and to reflect on Polish-Ukrainian relations. The starting point for our conversation will be the film 'In the Rearview' (Skąd dokąd), in which Maciej Hamela documented not only the destruction of war and the thousands of miles of evacuation routes from the front lines but, above all, the personal tragedies of those forced to flee their homes.

Start: 7:00 PM. Admission is free, but as usual, you can voluntarily contribute to the open enclave.

body.title: Dry Mix Veg Recipe - Healthy  and Delicious Recipe...
body.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.



Today I would like to share the recipe of *Dry Mix Veg Recipe* it is unique and interesting dry sabji or vegetable-based recipe made with a choice of vegetables coated with aromatic and flavors of indian spices. This dry mix veg is served as side dish to your meal or can be serve with a paratha or Roti(indian Breads), can be served during lunch or Dinner. It is healthy and delicious in taste and Common in indian household. Even you can add more vegetables of your choice and availability. It is quick and easy to prepared, even one pot recipe. Try this recipe, 'm sure you gonna love it.




![1000609693.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/Eos3jCuD59AW1Wy71Bpu8LQZNQ8EQiMTsMpMqk9VXp9U6kmCkLfkDCegX2BfDx5kRtY.jpg)



____________________________________
# <center> Timing 🕑</center>
____________________________________




|Preparation Time|5-7 Min| 
|-|-|
|Cooking Time|10 Min|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course| Side Dish|
|Serving|3-4 Person|


____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients📃</center>
____________________________________


• 2 tsp oil.
• ½ tsp cumin.
• Pinch of asafoetida
• ½ tsp kasuri Methi.
• 1 chopped onion.
• ½ chopped capsicum.
• 1 diced Potato.
• 1 chopped Carrot.
• 4-5 Florets of cauliflower.
• 3-4 cloves of garlic.
• ½ tsp chilli powder.
• ½ tsp coriander powder.
• ¼ tsp garam masala.
• Salt to taste.
• Green Coriander leaves for Garnish.

____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________

#### Preparation 



![1000588968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xVKMiSMNE1Bms6djeRgcAa7Ac3jnPDFguEHNtTwtW7UxybMG1xrd3xAsmymgkAmCDd7.jpg)

Chopped the onion and Garlic.

![1000588972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23u67BZnhhBDkGVftp66fr37SyStMTsUFspHaHPbTRe4B3TxDJUJ6ZdPVN2UdnwjGCFQb.jpg)


Wash the vegetables thoroughly and cut them as I have shown in the photo to make delicious mix veg recipe.
____________________________________


#### Let's Start 👨🏻‍🍳


![1000609438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vi4AFkADyrZ8nt2tsF1TtoWCSNjbk4JWXKcHE4zxpKL1RR8wuqHxcngsVwGS13TfEcb.jpg)

Heat the oil in the kadai, add the cumin seeds and asafoetida then wait untill it starts sputtering, then add chopped onions and garlic, then saute the onion untill it get translucent.

![1000588970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wC7vmrxFn23LnfJDob7HLZoonN86pNvc44iT3FbHt9yLga41YuH3wW5G7QaUqFRNwDC.jpg)

once your onion is done, then add chopped capsicum.saute it for a minute.

![1000588980.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/243BeQvHtPUUVeWcfeXiMefbigD4u1RAQwuVo7oQEgNSRXB5iqFqG2r4fL9NC9ewa7cnM.jpg)

Lower the flame, add the kasthuri methi.

Tip: Rub Kasuri Methi between your palms before adding it to enhance its flavor and aroma.


![1000588969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242DNET9jfYyJkAQvo6E6Xe2JmyXmgiXXam9gRdWf9dVVEYzJD6TmJAZPKCKALefi6Uoe.jpg)


Further add the chopped potatoes, carrot and cauliflower.

![1000588966.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/244KTGtxJ9B5ZYAwnC9R4AmfxDSAdmvuuiCdcZTd39KvTEgnCUiP4SbSzMYcUZEowfMEb.jpg)

keeping the flame on low, add ½ chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt to taste. 


![1000588979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/2432L7Ywt52ZKdNHkn5RSMdrC9ZXavCXgw8PKJax3TA2pZZJvwGK19Sn8zLdgE5Aq2MnQ.jpg)




![1000588971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/244eGT6HyQgSmyEDWeuSFYGwhJpTUQHkWa7s2Dkpzxa98xQFrMeLozb571eFyxprYTpWk.jpg)



Mix well so that spices get well coated with veggies.

**In my opinion, the taste and aroma found in Indian spices are unmatched by any other spices in the world. All our dishes are made using common ingredients, yet every single one has its own unique flavor and taste.**




![1000588973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yJGfic8bdAiG3wJhBN94f6eucYHKhqLedZSeJs7Hv6qw6pBmMLZq82LyCxHKn7PSS7A.jpg)

Cover and cook veggies on medium heat for about 8-10 minutes.

Tip : If you feel veggies are sticking to the pan than add 1-2 tbsp water and cook again.

![1000588977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xp4FKQ18hopm7scKE9fA3GX3uUjnuDfWV2rGpirGf2Zjbz876YYmC3UviuWkKdUWZqZ.jpg)



Cook untill your veg get soft and cooked well.



![1000588976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23u62xJQc9gWCtFK6Aodrxh1SYjYNEyQg97M4LeAVveiRpmHCpq2KkCTuX55RSpLY4cyK.jpg)


Add coriander leaves and mix well. Mix veg dry is all ready. Serve the hot mix veg with Paratha or roti(indian bread) or can be served as side dish in your meal.

**It's Delicious and easy to cook recipe, try it. 'm sure you are gonna love it. Try this recipe and let me know how it is. For more indian cuisine stay connected to my blogs.**

body.body:
![Post de Instagram Moderno Senc_20260220_180348_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uQrikHbQupwtp4hsjU7bxFxqgYqvL32pAjS21zJaKFeWNdjZCbvH9TusQvodEDvTAgk.png)




#### Greetings, friends, welcome to my blog 🌟

 

</center>

<div class=\
>\n\nAs soon as I saw the theme of the month, I said, \

For about 10 years now, I've always liked to write everything down, keep my diaries to plan better, write my own reflections, quotes from books, in short, being able to write everything down is something I've always liked. But here I'm going to show you my current collection for this year. These notebooks are only from 2026.

The theme is thanks to @mipiano. What is written in your notebooks? The thing is, we write so many things, well, those of us who like to write, because there are people who don't like it, and that's fine too.  Everyone plans as they want.

![20260220_163549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tbwM7CEQXFkQ9CvTuPBJ1MBkW8GWorG4Ge5EG1KJDLeXDKQ4V7X73GY2X6b2S2B3yuz.jpg)

I liked this notebook because it's cute 😀. I really like its design, but it's a normal notebook, just with lines and dividers. I use it to write down my plans for the week and the day.  It's also one of the ones I carry in my bag to take notes when I go to church or any other activity. I take notes here,  and since it has a planner, I cross off what I've done and what I still have to do. It's like my daily notebook or my personal agenda.

![20260220_163553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tviSr8zkm9H23uQdp4yhNWbBycz1Tbi9T6BjG3SoWUx9gRz18dgym52Fai9mAJDubjd.jpg)

This other one is a slightly worn notebook that I've been carrying around for years and still use, as it contains passwords that help me with various app stores, emails, and other things. It's a small notebook, but it contains a lot of important information, so I keep it in a special place.


 ![20260220_163614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uQpS6s4XVgvM9fiVhWvvR3KcrjM9axYrfKYCCbWzBXzJAoEoZJZBmPR4GbVxCDvEz1V.jpg)

I keep this little notebook on my nightstand, and it's for jotting down phrases and ideas that pop into my head when I'm lying in bed. Good ideas always come suddenly, and we have to be ready for them, so that's what this little notebook and pencil next to it are for.

![20260220_163559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsSmFPchBzrb5vii3DWnYrGDFuKReJWH16PiBjyQucmDmdkUVVicaGEzJkzKuSsvByL.jpg)

 This beautiful notebook from Hive is a medium-sized planner. I use it to write down my projects and their progress. I am currently working on a new project and I love writing in it. ✍️ I can see the progress and measure how to continue planning for this year and 2027.

![20260220_163604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsLXC8gRy5LatZxtmSFv8Jw3txLe2K1j2B862WkDasTySm72aXFnyftLEL5nyrMgHeV.jpg)

This little notebook also goes everywhere with me. I keep it in my bag and use it to make shopping lists or checklists of things I need to buy. It's great for quick notes. This notebook is very cute and practical, as it doesn't take up much space.

![20260220_163609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vi25iKQ738DmP9LtwFConbQoxmgvQ8C72B3ybT31g5BtjtKY6uMAybLqxHuSHYRrFhd.jpg)

This notebook I have is also a memento of my mother, as it belonged to her, but it only had a few notes written in it and was mostly blank, so I took it to keep track of the vehicle's maintenance and keep an eye on it.

![20260220_163619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uQnHnpdPCF8CnoxjuFnPviEadzopPZr4KFBWeU5vCj1fjLD2mrow39enPgXA7KSo6fP.jpg)

 Finally, I'll show you a large notebook or notepad. This is one of my most important notebooks because I use it to write down everything related to my finances, my monthly expenses, income, and outgoings. So, I write down everything I receive and my budgets here.

These are my notebooks for the year 2026, where I can write down everything in detail and be better organized and have my ideas in order. What do you think?

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Valley

## Once Upon a Time

In a lush valley surrounded by towering mountains, there lived a community known as the Harmonious Valley. The people of this valley prided themselves on their ability to live in perfect harmony with one another and with nature. They shared their resources, celebrated their differences, and resolved conflicts through dialogue and understanding. 

## The Gift of Harmony

The valley was blessed with abundant crops, clear rivers, and vibrant wildlife. The villagers believed that their harmony was the reason for their prosperity. They would often gather in the central square to sing songs and share stories, reinforcing their bonds and nurturing their peaceful existence.

## The Arrival of the Stranger

One day, a weary traveler stumbled upon the valley. He was drawn to the joyful sounds and the vibrant colors of the community. However, as he observed the villagers, he noticed something peculiar: everyone seemed to agree with one another, and no one dared to voice dissent or express differing opinions.

Curious, the traveler approached the villagers and asked, \
\n\nThe villagers smiled and replied, \

## The Seeds of Discontent

Intrigued, the traveler decided to stay a while. He shared stories from distant lands where differing opinions led to innovation and growth. The villagers listened, but some began to feel uneasy. They had always valued their peaceful existence and feared that introducing dissent might disrupt their harmony.

As days turned into weeks, the traveler’s presence sparked quiet discussions among the villagers. Some felt inspired to express their thoughts and ideas, while others clung to the belief that silence was the key to their unity. Tensions began to simmer beneath the surface.

## The Storm of Conflict

One fateful day, a disagreement erupted over the allocation of resources. The villagers, who had long suppressed their differing opinions, found themselves in a heated argument. The once-harmonious valley became a battleground of voices, each vying to be heard. The traveler watched in despair as the community he admired began to fracture.

In the chaos, the villagers realized that their harmony had been built on a fragile foundation of silence. They had neglected the importance of honest communication, and now, the very fabric of their community was unraveling.

## The Path to True Harmony

After the storm had passed, the villagers gathered to reflect on what had happened. They understood that true harmony does not mean the absence of conflict, but rather the ability to embrace differences and engage in constructive dialogue. 

With the traveler's guidance, they began to create a new way of living—one that celebrated both unity and individuality. They established forums for open discussion, where every voice could be heard without fear of retribution. 

## The Wisdom of the Valley

The Harmonious Valley learned a vital lesson: 

> **True harmony arises not from silence, but from the courage to express differences and the wisdom to listen.**

From that day forward, the valley flourished not only in abundance but also in understanding and respect. The villagers discovered that embracing their differences brought them closer together, enriching their lives and their community.

## Conclusion

The tale of the Harmonious Valley reminds us that while harmony is a beautiful ideal, it must be nurtured through open communication, acceptance of differing opinions, and the willingness to engage in difficult conversations. Only then can we create a truly harmonious existence, both within ourselves and with those around us.

<div class=\
>  \n \n<div class=\

> 

Desde muy joven he escuchado esa vocecita interior que me guía, aun cuando lo que percibo no parece tener sentido para mí.

Pero es que no sólo me susurra, sino que me impulsa a obececerle y, aunque al inicio luchaba por ignorarla, con el paso del tiempo me di cuenta de que esa voz, sabe lo que dice.

Me advierte cuando algo no está bien, es una inquietud, una sensación difícil de explicar.

En alguna publicación anterior conté una pequeña parte de lo que voy a compartir ahora, pero es mi más gráfico ejemplo en este tema.

Bienvenidos a [\

](https://ecency.com/hive-139925/@syllem/una-nueva-columna-ha-llegado), este cálido espacio en el que podemos compartir nuestras experiencias, nuestra perspectiva o visión, en formato iniciativa, como una manera de encender la chispa a un diálogo que nos enriquece de alguna manera. Busquen su bebida favorita y pónganse cómodas(dos), que esta historia es buena.

>  
 
From a very young age, I have heard that little inner voice guiding me, even when what I perceive does not seem to make sense to me.

But it doesn't just whisper to me, it urges me to obey it, and although at first I struggled to ignore it, over time I realized that that voice knows what it's saying.

It warns me when something is wrong, it's a feeling of unease, a feeling that's hard to explain.

In a previous post, I shared a small part of what I am about to share now, but it is my most graphic example on this topic.

Welcome to [\

](https://ecency.com/hive-139925/@syllem/una-nueva-columna-ha-llegado), this welcoming space where we can share our experiences, perspectives, and visions in the form of initiatives, as a way to spark a dialogue that enriches us in some way. Find your favorite drink and get comfortable, because this story is a good one.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJ3FyLdXyeLVbWb6LA3SmeVN7L18rBiXDCVNAjNAsJEN/imagen.png
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNV8QQAkMWAmKKDyAAHmtWrVmCNkRg42nDbZganUwz5ok/image.png
>  \n \n<div class=\

> Al poco tiempo de comenzar en mi empleo (hace ya 22 años), fui a una tasca en compañía de mi mamá, donde conocimos a un joven con el que conversamos y nos pareció agradable. Fue algo muy loco, porque eso fue un sábado y el lunes, yo tenía una reunión en mi trabajo, mi jefe me explicó la sala a la que debía ir, en el piso 1. Subí al ascensor, pero me equivoqué y me quedé en el nivel plaza, un piso más abajo. Cuando abrí la puerta del supuesto lugar de la reunión, ¡era la oficina del joven de esa tasca! Aún ahora que lo escribo me parece insólito. Creo que eso sólo me pasa a mí y al pato Lucas. Ustedes no pueden imaginar mi sorpresa, casi salgo corriendo.

> Shortly after starting my job (22 years ago now), I went to a bar with my mother, where we met a young man with whom we talked and found him pleasant. It was crazy because it was a Saturday, and on Monday I had a meeting at work. My boss told me which room to go to, on the first floor. I got in the elevator, but I made a mistake and stayed on the plaza level, one floor below. When I opened the door to the supposed meeting place, it was the office of the young man from that bar! Even now as I write this, it seems unusual to me. I think that only happens to me and Daffy Duck. You can't imagine my surprise; I almost ran away. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQvFWTw3DKQGDAHJpg6KddH1MGTBHN4BJwbtAJZyGBkh/image.png
***
>  \n \n<div class=\

> Me escurrí rápidamente, en realidad tenía prisa por llegar a la reunión, un piso más arriba. Allí descubrimos que trabajábamos para la misma empresa. Poco después me invitó a salir, en plan de panas, sin tono romántico y para ser honesta la pasamos muy bien, así que por un tiempo ideábamos sitios a los que ir. Ya me estaba gustando el muchacho, cuando sucedió otro evento increíble... Una tarde, él me acompañó a la parada de buses, como ya era costumbre, se suponía que luego él se iría a su casa. Mientras esperaba el bus, algo dentro de mí me dijo: “camina”, y yo me respondía; pero ¿a dónde? Intenté quedarme quieta, pero como suele pasarme en este tipo de situaciones, mi corazón se aceleró, y comencé a caminar, sin saber dónde iba. Poco después, yo estaba frente a una fuente de soda donde había ido unos días atrás con el personaje en cuestión y es como si esa fuerza que me llevó hasta allí me empujara a entrar.

>  

I slipped away quickly, I was actually in a hurry to get to the meeting one floor above.

There we discovered that we worked for the same company.

Shortly after, he asked me out, just as friends, without any romantic undertones, and to be honest, we had a great time, so for a while we came up with places to go.

I was already starting to like the boy when another incredible event occurred... 

One afternoon, he accompanied me to the bus stop, as was his custom, and was supposed to go home afterwards.

While waiting for the bus, something inside me said, \
and I replied, \

I tried to stay still, but as often happens to me in these situations, my heart started racing, and I began walking, not knowing where I was going. Shortly after, I was standing in front of a soda fountain where I had gone a few days earlier with the person in question, and it was as if the force that had brought me there was pushing me to go inside. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPGRyDZoWoQvQ5rMEc6SFZv4mvRCutE25u7LjTP3vFVA/image.png Why?
***
>  \n \n<div class=\

> Entonces, me encontré parada frente al susodicho que estaba muy acaramelado con otra chica. Sí, lo sé, no parece algo real. Yo todavía no me lo creo. Fue épico ver su cara en ese momento. Él sólo alcanzó a decir ¿Qué haces aquí? Yo sólo sonreí y salí de allí. Me sentí tan feliz, porque me había librado de él sin que lograra lastimarme. Se lo agradecí enormemente a Dios. Al día siguiente él intentó hablarme y sus palabras se fueron al vacío. Muy sonriente le dije que él no tenía nada que explicarme, que él era libre y podía hacer lo que quisiera, pero no conmigo. Esa experiencia nunca la olvidaré. Pero la historia no termina ahí, no no no.

>  
 
Then, I found myself standing in front of the aforementioned guy, who was getting very cozy with another girl.

Yes, I know, it doesn't seem real. I still can't believe it.

It was epic to see his face at that moment. He only managed to say, \

I just smiled and left. I felt so happy because I had gotten rid of him without him hurting me. I thanked God enormously. The next day he tried to talk to me, but his words fell on deaf ears. With a big smile, I told him he didn't have to explain anything to me, that he was free and could do whatever he wanted, but not with me. I will never forget that experience. But the story doesn't end there, no, no, no. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmVczFD53JYcyWqdw9hG2HfeNCBc37StbSb1M6sqqAKdVz/20260219_183333.gif
***
>  \n \n<div class=\

> Un tiempo después, una amiga, que ya sabía esa historia, se arriesgó y sí tuvo una relación con él y no tan sólo eso… ¡Se casó con ese hombre! Le deseé lo mejor, porque si soy objetiva, lo que pasó no fue grave, aunque para mí fue suficiente, pero digamos que, con los años las personas cambian, maduran. Para resumir el cuento, los años que mi amiga vivió con él, fueron una pesadilla. Él fue totalmente irresponsable, llegaba borracho todo el tiempo (algo que yo no tolero), la trataba mal, no colaboraba en el hogar... En fin, todo fue un desastre. Al final se divorciaron. Si antes estaba agradecida por haberme alejado de él, imagínense después de saber todo esto.

> Some time later, a friend of mine, who already knew this story, took a chance and did have a relationship with him, and not only that... she married him! I wished him well, because if I'm objective, what happened wasn't serious, although for me it was enough, but let's say that, over the years, people change and mature. To cut a long story short, the years my friend lived with him were a nightmare. He was totally irresponsible, always came home drunk (something I can't tolerate), treated her badly, didn't help out around the house... In short, it was a complete disaster. In the end, they got divorced. If I was grateful before for having gotten away from him, imagine how I feel now that I know all this. ***
https://images.hive.blog/300x300/https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSjtCXM2m3wXBZa6aGAEbPNq9BhtrjroTxjEVLbMpevx/image.png
***
>  \n \n<div class=\

> Escucharme no ha sido fácil, a veces me da miedo aceptar lo que ya sé, porque escuchar mi intuición implica tomar decisiones, implica dejar ir. Pero tengo como recompensa, paz. También intento ser muy cuidadosa antes de tomar cualquier decisión. Me pregunto: ¿Esto me da tranquilidad o me la quita? ¿Estoy actuando desde el miedo o desde la sensatez? Porque les cuento, cuando no le he hecho caso a mi intuición, me he arrepentido. Creo firmemente que Dios nos habla de muchas maneras, y una de ellas es esa sensación profunda que nos guía hacia lo que nos conviene, aunque no siempre sea lo más cómodo, ni lo más lógico. Cuando escucho esa voz interior, incluso si la decisión es difícil, sé que es lo mejor para mí y que sólo es cuestión de tiempo para conocer el capítulo completo, así que confío. Por eso es tan importante apagar el ruido externo y conectar con nuestro ser, porque dentro de cada uno de nosotros, están las respuestas que buscamos.

> Listening to myself has not been easy. Sometimes I am afraid to accept what I already know, because listening to my intuition means making decisions, it means letting go. But my reward is peace. I also try to be very careful before making any decisions. I ask myself: Does this give me peace of mind or take it away? Am I acting out of fear or common sense? Because, let me tell you, when I haven't listened to my intuition, I've regretted it. I firmly believe that God speaks to us in many ways, and one of them is that deep feeling that guides us toward what is best for us, even if it is not always the most comfortable or logical choice. When I listen to that inner voice, even if the decision is difficult, I know it's the best thing for me and that it's only a matter of time before I see the whole picture, so I trust it. That is why it is so important to tune out external noise and connect with our inner selves, because within each of us lie the answers we seek. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ4bhPfTGvwbPdBnYQg9y83gHZZYnStWB2iCDqeU1M5oV/20260220_214419.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNV8QQAkMWAmKKDyAAHmtWrVmCNkRg42nDbZganUwz5ok/image.png

> ## ¿Qué tal tu instinto? ¿Está bien despierto alertándote sobre posibles riesgos o está silenciado ante tanto ruido externo? Puedes contar alguna anécdota en la que tu instinto te puso sobre aviso y te salvó de alguna situación riesgosa o incomoda. No tiene que ser algo magistral, a veces simplemente nuestro cuerpo se rehúsa a ir a un sitio y luego te enteras de que sucedió algo no grato y dices, menos mal que no fui. Tienes libertad de escribir lo que sea que te haya inspirado esta publicación. Si es de tu agrado, invita a dos personas a participar y recuerda seguir las reglas de la comunidad.

> ## How is your intuition? Is it alert, warning you of potential risks, or is it silenced by all the external noise? Can you share a story in which your intuition warned you and saved you from a risky or uncomfortable situation? It doesn't have to be anything spectacular; sometimes our body simply refuses to go somewhere, and then we find out that something unpleasant happened and say, “Thank goodness I didn't go.” You are free to write whatever this post has inspired you to write. If you like, invite two people to participate and remember to follow the community rules.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNV8QQAkMWAmKKDyAAHmtWrVmCNkRg42nDbZganUwz5ok/image.png

links.title: - Part II: GIL'EAD (VIII-XI) - My Thoughts
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYki83hymZVhQqt5KMP3fK9gnvTBXDvnucrPdR9ZdCbrg/1771453125136.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2LzFico83hNGudrJ7D36ycGL1i3BVdKTUXUYMTZgD8N/1771454286572.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBw5CYQwE5ptF9BE9KbL1w6uvzNZMft9cWdj4CgM94vp/1771454286654.jpg)

### Likely SPOILERS!!!

#### Chapters Read:

Part II: GIL'EAD 

- VIII. Masks
- IX. Uniforms
- X. Softly Creeping...
- XI. The Door of Stone 

I think these have been my favorite chapters so far! 

The new characters discovered have been extremely interesting! Gert was an intriguing dude but two characters in Captain Wren and Esvar were quite memorable. 

Captain Wren seemed to demand attention and respect but not in a very overbearing way. I'm suspicious of him for sure and if he ends up being a bad guy, he seems like he'll be a tricky opponent. 

Esvar on the other hand is a breath of optimistic fresh air, he was a nice change of pace to this story. 

Another reason this was one of my favorite sections is because I feel like I'm learning more about Murtagh and a bit about Thorn as well. 

Murtagh seems to enjoy the taste of camaraderie he felt as he was performing drills with the other soldiers. A part of him wishes he could stay longer and not have to betray them for his personal mission. This tells me a lot about Murtagh in a good way, he respects the common man a lot it seems and even feels for the Empire's soldiers, many of whom were forced to fight the Varden. He didn't want to necessarily defeat the Varden, but he wishes he could have protected the men more during the war which I really respect. 

All in all Murtagh has a lot of semi-conflicting and complex emotions about everything he's gone through. I get so upset when people think it was just Eragon and Saphira who defeated Galbatorix I swear. It's such an injustice that nobody really understands what Murtagh and Thorn went through. 

One of my favorite lines in this chunk of book was said by Thorn in the chapter 'Uniforms' when he said to Murtagh:

***'You are as close to a dragon in human form as I have ever met.***

Murtagh jokes about if only he could breathe fire and Thorn says that's what magic is for. This passing comment makes me wonder if Murtagh will breathe fire at some point through some wild magic LOL. 

That scene was just super nice and confirms my idea that Murtagh and Thorn have a very similar personality which is cool, they really care for and need each other. 

Finally, these final two chapters in this recent chunk I read really made me like this section a lot in 'Softly Creeping...' and 'The Door of Stone'.

These chapters were pure fun fantasy! Murtagh has to sneak through various highly mysterious chambers filled with deep mystery and I was loving it! Maps, potions, bones, odd plants and other strange items. I was so happy when Murtagh discovered a dictionary of the ancient language! He seriously needs that and I imagine it will help him progress well in his magic abilities.

The last chapter I read ended on a real cliffhanger.... Can't wait to keep going!

I am becoming very suspicious that things are going a bit too smoothly for Murtagh but it's hard to say. Him randomly showing up having defeated Muckmaw when many people claimed only a Rider or elf could have done so is quite interesting. Murtagh's story as to how he killed it seemed strangely simple if I were hearing Murtagh tell it. 

But yeah, these chapters offered new characters, and serious mysteries. This is unlike any 'The World of Eragon' book I've read previously!

links.title: GEMS for Betterlife - Activity of Delivering Flower Boards for Employee Inauguration Events
links.body:
![IMG_3344.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnaamB2zi6fFfBZ1DsxrjgXx4N8pN2wiFd5LdwzXt871hBpJrHUvkL6RpEEogq6W6XV.jpeg)

### ENGLISH

Hello Gems friends, may God always bless us all. Greetings to all members and respected stakeholders.

In this post, I want to share my activities as a florist. Some time ago, I received an order for flower arrangements for the inauguration of government employees with work contracts (PPPK). The inauguration took place on Thursday, February 5, 2026, and lasted one day, from morning to noon.

![IMG_3343.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EqUeNG72fexgYn8nPqmyKJSpg1N3nckw44LgPks9fcK82jb2wsJwTKzmqQKMqz4z1RH.jpeg)

This inauguration ceremony took place publicly at Musara Alun field in Takengon, where many of their families were present to witness the inauguration procession. For this event, I received an order for 19 flower boards from relatives of those being inaugurated that day.

The order came in two days before the inauguration ceremony, and with the help of my wife and sister, I prepared everything needed to arrange the flower boards. The flower boards ordered included digitally printed greeting boards, rustic flower boards, and acrylic flower boards, with the acrylic ones being the most popular.

![IMG_3319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23xKrUdNYWQhYZUve2Hue3WaH7DNuNUh8DVe6wC14kwQCRtqo8U74Gkj8dRuBcxHUyo1G.jpeg)

Acrylic flower boards are currently one of the most frequently ordered flower boards, with many people sending greetings through them. Since I first opened my florist business in 2022, this type of flower board has immediately attracted a lot of interest, especially among students in the Bener Meriah and Central Aceh areas.

Perhaps because in addition to its contemporary, aesthetic, and minimalist appearance, and luxurious style, this type of flower board is also very economical. I implement a rental system for ordering flower boards, where orders for sending greetings are listed as rental.

![IMG_3342.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23sJxBaGRNXUTJhv9dRR3rESrsqQLXFtNCM1acWwxYj8RxwQPntBvRfQw3FwsxCLxTDgK.jpeg)

I set the rental price for this flower board at around IDR 100,000 to IDR 200,000. This includes delivery to the event location, making it very economical. This flower board consists of a flower arrangement, an acrylic board, a sticker message, and a tripod; everything is prepared the night before.

After the order comes in via WhatsApp, we immediately prepare the cut-out sticker text to be affixed to the acrylic board. The text is a greeting for the inauguration of their relatives. To enhance the message, we also add icon stickers and arrange plastic flowers.

![IMG_3367.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/2458GGaRk12vKNCuuodkQoPMQVp1snYDwhfGNa6GHhCcrctdRmakzq6WTcq1VTAjqS1Sd.jpeg)

This project took about two days, and we worked slowly to ensure the quality and aesthetic value of the flower boards we provided. We delivered the acrylic flower boards in the morning and displayed them in a location close to the inauguration ceremony field. Since we had assembled all the boards at home, we simply set them up and tidied them up upon arrival.

![IMG_3372.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/244xkjdt1G1WY3ZBBCYSuhrKNnhNjAUFBYXwLEsEJfMZ32LhCEqYagRiAnEby5oozHsTe.jpeg)

![IMG_3371.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23sJjUaG2xfkVbeCNYHxQtm6Q1tEUnaHL9tZS4tw45o9NR2dakb2x97UGTVPuum1y5uzD.jpeg)

![IMG_3374.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EpJXe1USxmCBK853DKSmbQwet7sGVNH8q9rKJx5hFUkve2LrspNv86VL7CE4FoEKvsH.jpeg)

These flower boards are used by customers after the ceremony, taking selfies as souvenirs and as documents to share on social media. These modern-style flower boards have had a positive impact on our income, as this type of flower board is currently in high demand.

For more information about our florist activities, you can follow @ranis.florist

-----------

### INDONESIA

![IMG_3344.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnaamB2zi6fFfBZ1DsxrjgXx4N8pN2wiFd5LdwzXt871hBpJrHUvkL6RpEEogq6W6XV.jpeg)

Halo sahabat Gems, semoga tuhan selalu memberkati kita semuanya. Salam untuk seluruh anggota dan para pemangku kepentingan yang terhormat.

Pada postingan ini saya ingin berbagi aktivitas saya sebagai penyedia jasa florist, beberapa waktu yang lalu saya mendapatkan orderan papan bunga untuk acara pelantikan pegawai pemerintah dengan perjanjian kerja (PPPK). Acara pelantikan tersebut berlangsung pada hari kamis tanggal 5 Februari 2026 selama satu hari yang dimulai sejak pagi hingga siang hari.

![IMG_3343.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EqUeNG72fexgYn8nPqmyKJSpg1N3nckw44LgPks9fcK82jb2wsJwTKzmqQKMqz4z1RH.jpeg)

Acara pelantikan kali ini berlangsung secara terbuka di lapangan musara alun, takengon, dimana banyak dari seluruh keluarga mereka juga yang hadir untuk menyaksikan prosesi pelantikan. Dalam acara ini saya mendapatkan orderan sebanyak 19 papan bunga yang dipesan oleh kerabat-kerabat mereka yang dilantik pada hari tersebut.

Pesanan telah masuk sejak dua hari sebelum acara pelantikan berlangsung, saya dibantu oleh istri dan adik saya telah menyiapkan segala kebutuhan untuk merangkai papan bunga. Papan bunga yang dipesan diantaranya adalah papan ucapan digital printing, papan bunga rustik dan papan bunga akrilik, yang paling banyak dipesan adalah jenis papan bunga akrilik. 

![IMG_3319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23xKrUdNYWQhYZUve2Hue3WaH7DNuNUh8DVe6wC14kwQCRtqo8U74Gkj8dRuBcxHUyo1G.jpeg)

Papan bunga akrilik saat ini menjadi salah satu papan bunga yang paling sering saya terima pesanan, banyak orang yang mengirimkan ucapan melalui papan bunga akrilik. Dari tahun 2022 sejak pertama kali saya membuka usaha florist, papan bunga jenis ini langsung diminati oleh banyak orang, terutama di kalangan mahasiswa yang ada diwilayah Bener Meriah dan Aceh Tengah.

Mungkin karena selain tampilan papan bunga ini yang terlihat kekinian, estetik dan minimalis, serta tampil dengan gaya yang mewah, papan bunga jenis ini juga sangat ekonomis. Adapun sistem pesanan papan bunga ini saya menerapkan sistem sewa, dimana status pesanan papan bunga untuk mengirimkan ucapan adalah dalam status sewa.

![IMG_3342.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23sJxBaGRNXUTJhv9dRR3rESrsqQLXFtNCM1acWwxYj8RxwQPntBvRfQw3FwsxCLxTDgK.jpeg)

Biaya sewa papan bunga ini saya terapkan di kisaran harga IDR 100 K hingga IDR 200 K, ini sudah termasuk biaya pengantaran ke lokasi acara, jadi termasuk sangat ekonomis. Papan bunga ini terdiri dari rangkaian bunga, papan akrilik, ucapan/tulisan dari stiker dan juga tripod, semuanya telah kami siapkan sejak malam hari.

Setelah orderan masuk melalui kontak WhatsApp, kami langsung menyiapkan tulisan stiker yang di cutting untuk ditempelkan di papan akrilik. Tulisan tersebut adalah tulisan berbentuk ucapan atas pelantikan kerabat mereka, untuk memperindah ucapan, kami juga menambahkan stiker ikon dan juga merangkai bunga plastik.


![IMG_3367.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/2458GGaRk12vKNCuuodkQoPMQVp1snYDwhfGNa6GHhCcrctdRmakzq6WTcq1VTAjqS1Sd.jpeg)

Pekerjaan ini telah menghabiskan waktu sekitar 2 hari, dimana semua kami kerjakan secara perlahan-lahan untuk memastikan kualitas dan nilai estetika dari papan bunga yang kami sediakan. Kami mengantarkan papan bunga akrilik ini pada pagi hari dan memajang di lokasi yang dekat dengan lapangan upacara acara pelantikan tersebut, karena seluruh papan telah kami rangkai dirumah, jadi sesampai dilokasi lapangan kami hanya meletakkan saja dan merapikannya. 

![IMG_3372.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/244xkjdt1G1WY3ZBBCYSuhrKNnhNjAUFBYXwLEsEJfMZ32LhCEqYagRiAnEby5oozHsTe.jpeg)

![IMG_3371.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/23sJjUaG2xfkVbeCNYHxQtm6Q1tEUnaHL9tZS4tw45o9NR2dakb2x97UGTVPuum1y5uzD.jpeg)

![IMG_3374.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EpJXe1USxmCBK853DKSmbQwet7sGVNH8q9rKJx5hFUkve2LrspNv86VL7CE4FoEKvsH.jpeg)

Papan bunga ini digunakan oleh pemesan setelah upacara selesai, mereka menggunakan papan bunga ini untuk berswafoto sebagai kenangan dan menjadi dokumen untuk di unggah ke sosial media. Papan bunga dengan gaya modern ini telah memberikan dampak yang baik untuk pendapatan ekonomi kami, karena papan bunga jenis ini sangat banyak diminati saat ini. 

Untuk hal lainnya tentang aktivitas kami di bidang florist, anda dapat mengikuti @ranis.florist

links.title: Hígado de res encebollado para mi almuerzo [ESP/ENG]
links.body: # Hígado de res encebollado para mi almuerzo [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y que me leen en esta comunidad de @hivefood, gusto en saludarlos, espero que hayan pasado un excelente día,  les deseo a todos  bendiciones en abundancia. Los invito a que sean bienvenidos a mi blog.

![57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vi42RCkdUWg7F1YtQDPr9CskqBSY3bC1ZWueXTozyKNcVSiiBw3A6YPGeqkE5cNt74A.jpg)

Hoy me encuentro una vez mas pasando por esta comunidad, con el fin de competirles otra de mis recetas de esta semana y es un rico, deliciosos y nutritivo hígado de res encebollado, que prepare el día de hoy cuando regrese a casa después de regresar de viaje de casa de mi mama, venia cansada, quería preparar algo sencillo y rápido, por lo que le pedí a mi esposo que me comprara hígado de res.

![52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo6LPzZF94tMsWzJqLvgFP4iL5NZVPnUpScBKomDuMQ8EBCJKH3vmpfaKos8inaFEw6.jpg)

Les comento que me encanta comer hígado pero poco lo preparo en casa por el aspecto que es medio gelatinoso, sin embargo cuando voy a un restaurante me encanta ordenar este plato, pero hoy quise prepararlo yo. este es un plato que debemos tratar de comer de vez en cuando por todo los nutrientes y vitaminas que contiene.

![49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo8SpUjRAk9P5BTM8QeNA3NV6aVVuHPMEZ17w2zFbDj4Sd65nXF6E8LZqxctiCoR4HS.jpg)

Los medico ordenan en la dieta de los pacientes que tienen la hemoglobina baja a comer hígado para subírsela y realmente es un potente elevador de la hemoglobina. A la mayoría de las personas no le gusta, pero si pudieran leer algunas reseñas de todo lo que contiene el hígado creo que no dejarían de degustarlo. Es una fuente de proteínas, vitaminas  B12, A, hierro, zinc y minerales.
, 
![53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAYqk1ez4UQteiDCt7awZUDFEGeWy9R2Fe8KwVgMy1BpXsUda8qjzodw6a95L7vNT4.jpg)

Es una receta muy sencilla de preparar, económica, solo lleva pocos ingrediente, cebolla y aliño, el que desee, 

Sin más preámbulos vamos a iniciar la receta y preparacion del mismo.

# Ingedientes
* 2 hígados grandes de res (400 gramos) 
* ¼ de cebolla blanca 
* 4 dientes de ajo
* Aceite para freír
* salsa de soya y salsa inglesa algusto
* Orégano molido al gusto
* Sal y pimienta al gusto

![47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tYuZVZ1TYzjYmCyHGXWJ8xP9pi6CmpPBZ2rojdqLywqnhcABLzUiZTc7y1RmMqZTJq.jpg)

# Preparación
Lavar bien el hígado hasta votar la sangre que contiene, luego triturar los ajos y agregárselos, colocarle orégano molido, salsa inglesa y de soya, sal y pimienta, masajearlos y dejarlos macerar durante 15 minutos.

![48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqFsYdsk7878qoLvPE8ipKf7ALcSxPRn8HBfu8LkXwdAD1oinxN9WgPPwi7jBSDgegr.jpg)

![49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo8SpUjRAk9P5BTM8QeNA3NV6aVVuHPMEZ17w2zFbDj4Sd65nXF6E8LZqxctiCoR4HS.jpg)

Posteriormente colocarlo en un sarten, llevarlo a la estufa a fuego medio con algo de agua como para sancocharlo; una vez que ya haya votado la sangre y que el agua haya mermado o se haya consumido, colocarle aceite, voltear por ambos lados y por ultimo agregarle la cebolla cortada en juliana, dejar cocinar por 10 minutos o hasta que dore bien la cebolla.

![51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tS32McZceBFKsYTTna4LuJwpdcP3d3ghG9qZd7ng2sx9QyGm9rmpZQpLEPwKAoAiabL.jpg)
![53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAYqk1ez4UQteiDCt7awZUDFEGeWy9R2Fe8KwVgMy1BpXsUda8qjzodw6a95L7vNT4.jpg)
![54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/244odBgp5Ac23qbUeUAaQGJMxZVuHJWGnUD3ob4a3RhSzyUsXPbJaCGToDvCL3vV4w2at.jpg)
![56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wX3LatYokRakvqTzu37vEqYMiaer76PqEaQsELG86UUNgxxspsy65AZGHa3wpJ268cL.jpg)

La receta rinde de 2 a  3  comensales, mi mama fue quien me enseño a preparar el hígado encebollado.

Hasta aquí mi contenido, espero haya sido de su agrado, les dejo algunas fotos, nos vemos en un próximo post.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version Beef liver with onions for my lunch

> Hello, fellow food lovers who read my posts in this @hivefood community. It's a pleasure to greet you. I hope you've had an excellent day, and I wish you all abundant blessings. Welcome to my blog. ![57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vi42RCkdUWg7F1YtQDPr9CskqBSY3bC1ZWueXTozyKNcVSiiBw3A6YPGeqkE5cNt74A.jpg) Today I find myself once again visiting this community to share another one of my recipes from this week, a rich, delicious, and nutritious beef liver with onions that I prepared today when I returned home from visiting my mother. I was tired and wanted to make something simple and quick, so I asked my husband to buy me some beef liver. ![52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo6LPzZF94tMsWzJqLvgFP4iL5NZVPnUpScBKomDuMQ8EBCJKH3vmpfaKos8inaFEw6.jpg) I should mention that I love eating liver, but I rarely prepare it at home because of its gelatinous appearance. However, when I go to a restaurant, I love to order this dish, but today I wanted to prepare it myself. This is a dish that we should try to eat from time to time because of all the nutrients and vitamins it contains. ![49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo8SpUjRAk9P5BTM8QeNA3NV6aVVuHPMEZ17w2zFbDj4Sd65nXF6E8LZqxctiCoR4HS.jpg) Doctors prescribe liver in the diet of patients with low hemoglobin to raise it, and it really is a powerful hemoglobin booster. Most people don't like it, but if they could read some reviews of everything liver contains, I think they wouldn't stop eating it. It is a source of protein, vitamins B12 and A, iron, zinc, and minerals. , ![53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAYqk1ez4UQteiDCt7awZUDFEGeWy9R2Fe8KwVgMy1BpXsUda8qjzodw6a95L7vNT4.jpg) This recipe is very easy to prepare and inexpensive, requiring only a few ingredients: onion and your choice of seasoning. Without further ado, let's get started with the recipe and preparation. # Ingredients * 2 large beef livers (400 grams) * ¼ white onion * 4 cloves of garlic * Oil for frying * Soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce to taste * Ground oregano to taste * Salt and pepper to taste ![47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tYuZVZ1TYzjYmCyHGXWJ8xP9pi6CmpPBZ2rojdqLywqnhcABLzUiZTc7y1RmMqZTJq.jpg) # Preparation Wash the liver thoroughly to remove any blood, then crush the garlic and add it to the liver. Add ground oregano, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Massage the mixture into the liver and let it marinate for 15 minutes. ![48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqFsYdsk7878qoLvPE8ipKf7ALcSxPRn8HBfu8LkXwdAD1oinxN9WgPPwi7jBSDgegr.jpg) ![49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eo8SpUjRAk9P5BTM8QeNA3NV6aVVuHPMEZ17w2zFbDj4Sd65nXF6E8LZqxctiCoR4HS.jpg) Then place it in a frying pan, put it on the stove over medium heat with enough water to boil it; once the blood has drained and the water has reduced or evaporated, add oil, turn it over on both sides and finally add the julienned onion, cook for 10 minutes or until the onion is golden brown. ![51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tS32McZceBFKsYTTna4LuJwpdcP3d3ghG9qZd7ng2sx9QyGm9rmpZQpLEPwKAoAiabL.jpg) ![53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAYqk1ez4UQteiDCt7awZUDFEGeWy9R2Fe8KwVgMy1BpXsUda8qjzodw6a95L7vNT4.jpg) ![54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/244odBgp5Ac23qbUeUAaQGJMxZVuHJWGnUD3ob4a3RhSzyUsXPbJaCGToDvCL3vV4w2at.jpg) ![56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wX3LatYokRakvqTzu37vEqYMiaer76PqEaQsELG86UUNgxxspsy65AZGHa3wpJ268cL.jpg) The recipe serves 2 to 3 people. My mother taught me how to prepare liver with onions. That's all for now. I hope you enjoyed it. Here are some photos. See you in my next post. * Photos taken with iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl

links.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXWY9vzFqtRyBvh6XxaRCVRHzchqJ7wGLQGwA6sMYa4K/image.png)
[fuente](https://www.ciudadccs.info/publicacion/9175-ministro-de-la-defensa-conmemora-el-dia-de-la-bandera)

#


ERES MI BANDERA

Como hondea mi bandera
vestida de tres colores
ese sol sus esplendores
y un azul que pareciera
vestirse de primavera
de amarantos encarnados
ocho de ellos enfilados
como el arco de un portal
representan la moral
por la historia fue creado.

Ese rojo que en las guerras
se convirtió en sacrificio
derrotando al maleficio
que sucumbió en nuestra tierra
y que nuestra historia entierra
derrotando al Español
desde entonces un nuevo sol
nos dio un nuevo amanecer
para nunca más volver
al yugo del opresor.

Araguaney de mi tierra
diminuto sol de oro
doy gracias por tu decoro
que tu belleza encierra
y que entre el cielo y la tierra
vuele aquél pájaro azul
que con su pluma de tul
vuela con el cardenal
y un horizonte pintar
ocho estrellas en el azul.

Eres mi bandera
mi bandera tricolor
amarillo, azul y rojo
que me robas el amor
Eres mi bandera
mi bandera tricolor
amarillo, azul y rojo
que me robas el amor

#

![Polish_20240328_214658962.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSrWkMAfaADxCqj93uEzj4AhWaDKLEjKo4LBaSutDPksu/Polish_20240328_214658962.jpg)


#


YOU ARE MY FLAG

As my flag waves,
dressed in three colors,
that sun in its splendor,
and a blue that seems
to dress in spring,
of crimson amaranths,
eight of them lined up
like the arch of a portal,
representing the morality
for which history it was created.

That red that in wars
became a sacrifice,
defeating the evil
that succumbed in our land,
and that our history buries,
defeating the Spaniard. Since then, a new sun
gave us a new dawn,
so we may never again return
to the yoke of the oppressor.

Araguaney of my land,
tiny golden sun,
I give thanks for your dignity,
that your beauty holds,
and that between heaven and earth
that blue bird may fly,
that with its tulle feather
flies with the cardinal,
and paint a horizon
eight stars in the blue.

You are my flag
my tricolor flag
yellow, blue, and red
that steals my love
You are my flag
my tricolor flag
yellow, blue, and red
that steals my love

links.body: En un mundo acelerado, a menudo olvidamos pausar y valorar a quienes nos rodean. Cada momento compartido es un tesoro que enriquece nuestras vidas.
